 1044: fn main() {
 1045:     let args = std::env::args().skip(1).collect::<Vec<_>>();
 1046:     let command = parse_command(&args);
 1047:     match execute(command) {
 1048:         Ok(output) => println!("{output}"),
 1049:         Err(err) => {
 1050:             println!("error: {err}");
 1051:             std::process::exit(1);
 1052:         }
 1053:     }
 1054: }

 1056: fn parse_command(args: &[String]) -> CliCommand {
 1057:     match args {
 1058:         [cmd] if cmd == "status" => CliCommand::Status,

 1060:         [cmd] if cmd == "netcheck" => CliCommand::Netcheck,
 1061:         [cmd] if cmd == "version" || cmd == "which" => CliCommand::Version,

 1164:         }

 1166:         [cmd] if cmd == "disk-errors" => CliCommand::BlockDeviceErrorCounters,
 1167:         [cmd, path] if cmd == "dir-size" => CliCommand::DirectorySizeSnapshot(path.clone()),
 1168:         [cmd] if cmd == "cache-efficiency" => CliCommand::FilesystemCacheEfficiency,
 1169:         [cmd, path] if cmd == "file-integrity" => CliCommand::FileIntegrityCheck(path.clone()),
 1170:         [cmd] if cmd == "syslog-config" => CliCommand::SyslogConfigurationAudit,
 1171:         [cmd, path] if cmd == "acl-audit" => CliCommand::AccessControlListAudit(path.clone()),
 1172:         [cmd] if cmd == "boot-integrity" => CliCommand::BootIntegrityCheck,
 1173:         [cmd] if cmd == "system-snapshot" => CliCommand::SystemStateSnapshot,
 1174:         [cmd] if cmd == "compare-baseline" => CliCommand::CompareToBaseline,
 1175:         [cmd] if cmd == "perf-regression" => CliCommand::PerformanceRegressionDetection,
 1176:         [cmd, subcmd] if cmd == "config" && subcmd == "show" => CliCommand::ConfigShow,
 1177:         [cmd, rest @ ..] if cmd == "logs" => {
 1178:             let mut follow = false;
 1179:             let mut level = None;
 1180:             let mut lines = None;
 1181:             let mut i = 0;
 1182:             while i < rest.len() {
 1183:                 match rest[i].as_str() {
 1184:                     "--follow" => follow = true,
 1185:                     "--level" if i + 1 < rest.len() => {
 1186:                         level = Some(rest[i + 1].clone());
 1187:                         i += 1;
 1188:                     }
 1189:                     "--lines" if i + 1 < rest.len() => {
 1190:                         lines = rest[i + 1].parse::<usize>().ok();
 1191:                         i += 1;
 1192:                     }
 1193:                     _ => {}
 1194:                 }
 1195:                 i += 1;
 1196:             }
 1197:             CliCommand::Logs(LogsCommand {
 1198:                 follow,
 1199:                 level,
 1200:                 lines,
 1201:             })
 1202:         }
 1203:         [cmd, subcmd] if cmd == "state" && subcmd == "refresh" => CliCommand::StateRefresh,
 1204:         [cmd, subcmd] if cmd == "operator" && subcmd == "menu" => CliCommand::OperatorMenu,
 1205:         [cmd, subcmd, node] if cmd == "exit-node" && subcmd == "select" => {
 1206:             CliCommand::ExitNodeSelect(node.clone())
 1207:         }
 1208:         [cmd, subcmd] if cmd == "exit-node" && subcmd == "off" => CliCommand::ExitNodeOff,
 1209:         [cmd, subcmd] if cmd == "lan-access" && subcmd == "on" => CliCommand::LanAccessOn,
 1210:         [cmd, subcmd] if cmd == "lan-access" && subcmd == "off" => CliCommand::LanAccessOff,
 1211:         [cmd, subcmd] if cmd == "dns" && subcmd == "inspect" => CliCommand::DnsInspect,
 1212:         [cmd, subcmd, action, rest @ ..] if cmd == "dns" && subcmd == "zone" => {
 1213:             match parse_dns_zone_command(action, rest) {
 1214:                 Ok(command) => command,
 1215:                 Err(_) => CliCommand::Help,
 1216:             }
 1217:         }
 1218:         [cmd, rest @ ..] if cmd == "traversal" => match parse_traversal_command(rest) {
 1219:             Ok(command) => CliCommand::Traversal(Box::new(command)),
 1220:             Err(_) => CliCommand::Help,
 1221:         },
 1222:         [cmd, subcmd, cidr] if cmd == "route" && subcmd == "advertise" => {
 1223:             CliCommand::RouteAdvertise(cidr.clone())
 1224:         }
 1225:         [cmd, subcmd] if cmd == "key" && subcmd == "rotate" => CliCommand::KeyRotate,
 1226:         [cmd, subcmd] if cmd == "key" && subcmd == "revoke" => CliCommand::KeyRevoke,
 1227:         [cmd, rest @ ..] if cmd == "assignment" => match parse_assignment_command(rest) {
 1228:             Ok(command) => CliCommand::Assignment(Box::new(command)),
 1229:             Err(_) => CliCommand::Help,
 1230:         },
 1231:         [cmd, rest @ ..] if cmd == "membership" => match parse_membership_command(rest) {
 1232:             Ok(command) => CliCommand::Membership(Box::new(command)),
 1233:             Err(_) => CliCommand::Help,
 1234:         },
 1235:         [cmd, rest @ ..] if cmd == "trust" => match parse_trust_command(rest) {
 1236:             Ok(command) => CliCommand::Trust(Box::new(command)),
 1237:             Err(_) => CliCommand::Help,
 1238:         },
 1239:         [cmd, rest @ ..] if cmd == "ops" => match parse_ops_command(rest) {
 1240:             Ok(command) => CliCommand::Ops(Box::new(command)),
 1241:             Err(_) => CliCommand::Help,
 1242:         },
 1243:         [cmd, rest @ ..] if cmd == "node" => match parse_node_command(rest) {
 1244:             Ok(command) => CliCommand::Node(command),
 1245:             Err(_) => CliCommand::Help,
 1246:         },
 1247:         [cmd, rest @ ..] if cmd == "policy" => match parse_policy_command(rest) {
 1248:             Ok(command) => CliCommand::Policy(command),
 1249:             Err(_) => CliCommand::Help,
 1250:         },
 1251:         [cmd, rest @ ..] if cmd == "relay" => match parse_relay_command(rest) {
 1252:             Ok(command) => CliCommand::Relay(command),
 1253:             Err(_) => CliCommand::Help,
 1254:         },
 1255:         [cmd, rest @ ..] if cmd == "cert" => match parse_cert_command(rest) {
 1256:             Ok(command) => CliCommand::Cert(command),
 1257:             Err(_) => CliCommand::Help,
 1258:         },
 1259:         [cmd, rest @ ..] if cmd == "trust-state" => match parse_trust_state_command(rest) {
 1260:             Ok(command) => CliCommand::TrustState(command),
 1261:             Err(_) => CliCommand::Help,
 1262:         },
 1263:         [cmd, rest @ ..] if cmd == "analytics" => match parse_analytics_command(rest) {
 1264:             Ok(command) => CliCommand::Analytics(command),
 1265:             Err(_) => CliCommand::Help,
 1266:         },
 1267:         [cmd, rest @ ..] if cmd == "backup" => match parse_backup_command(rest) {
 1268:             Ok(command) => CliCommand::Backup(command),
 1269:             Err(_) => CliCommand::Help,
 1270:         },
 1271:         [cmd, rest @ ..] if cmd == "restore" => match parse_restore_command(rest) {
 1272:             Ok(command) => CliCommand::RestoreState(command),
 1273:             Err(_) => CliCommand::Help,
 1274:         },
 1275:         [cmd, rest @ ..] if cmd == "export-keys" => match parse_export_keys_command(rest) {
 1276:             Ok(command) => CliCommand::ExportKeys(command),
 1277:             Err(_) => CliCommand::Help,
 1278:         },
 1279:         [cmd, rest @ ..] if cmd == "config" => match parse_config_subcommand(rest) {
 1280:             Ok(command) => CliCommand::Config(command),
 1281:             Err(_) => CliCommand::Help,
 1282:         },
 1283:         _ => CliCommand::Help,
 1284:     }
 1285: }
 1286: 
 1287: fn parse_ops_command(args: &[String]) -> Result<OpsCommand, String> {

 3608:             config: ops_e2e::E2eIssueDnsZoneBundlesFromEnvConfig {

 3610:                 issue_dir: parser

 3619: fn parse_membership_command(args: &[String]) -> Result<MembershipCommand, String> {
 3620:     if args.is_empty() {
 3621:         return Err("membership subcommand is required".to_string());
 3622:     }
 3623:     let subcommand = args[0].as_str();
 3624:     let parser = OptionParser::parse(&args[1..])?;
 3625:     let paths = parser.membership_paths();
 3626:     let now_unix = parser.parse_u64_or_default("--now", unix_now())?;
 3627: 
 3628:     match subcommand {
 3629:         "status" => Ok(MembershipCommand::Status { paths }),
 3630:         "verify-log" => {
 3631:             let audit_output_path = parser.path_or_default(
 3632:                 "--audit-output",
 3633:                 PathBuf::from("artifacts/membership/membership_audit_integrity.log"),
 3634:             );
 3635:             Ok(MembershipCommand::VerifyLog {
 3636:                 paths,
 3637:                 now_unix,
 3638:                 audit_output_path,
 3639:             })
 3640:         }
 3641:         "generate-evidence" => Ok(MembershipCommand::GenerateEvidence {
 3642:             paths,
 3643:             now_unix,
 3644:             output_dir: parser
 3645:                 .path_or_default("--output-dir", PathBuf::from("artifacts/membership")),
 3646:             environment: parser
 3647:                 .value("--environment")
 3648:                 .unwrap_or_else(|| "unknown".to_string()),
 3649:         }),
 3650:         "propose-add" => {
 3651:             let node_id = parser.required("--node-id")?;
 3652:             let node_pubkey_hex = parser.required("--node-pubkey")?;
 3653:             let owner = parser.required("--owner")?;
 3654:             let roles = parser
 3655:                 .value("--roles")
 3656:                 .map(split_csv)
 3657:                 .unwrap_or_else(|| vec!["tag:members".to_string()]);
 3658:             let operation = MembershipOperation::AddNode(MembershipNode {
 3659:                 node_id: node_id.clone(),
 3660:                 node_pubkey_hex,
 3661:                 owner,
 3662:                 status: MembershipNodeStatus::Active,
 3663:                 roles,
 3664:                 joined_at_unix: now_unix,
 3665:                 updated_at_unix: now_unix,
 3666:             });
 3667:             Ok(MembershipCommand::Propose {
 3668:                 config: proposal_config(&parser, paths, operation, node_id)?,
 3669:             })
 3670:         }
 3671:         "propose-remove" => {
 3672:             let node_id = parser.required("--node-id")?;
 3673:             Ok(MembershipCommand::Propose {
 3674:                 config: proposal_config(
 3675:                     &parser,
 3676:                     paths,
 3677:                     MembershipOperation::RemoveNode {
 3678:                         node_id: node_id.clone(),
 3679:                     },
 3680:                     node_id,
 3681:                 )?,
 3682:             })
 3683:         }
 3684:         "propose-revoke" => {
 3685:             let node_id = parser.required("--node-id")?;
 3686:             Ok(MembershipCommand::Propose {
 3687:                 config: proposal_config(
 3688:                     &parser,
 3689:                     paths,
 3690:                     MembershipOperation::RevokeNode {
 3691:                         node_id: node_id.clone(),
 3692:                     },
 3693:                     node_id,
 3694:                 )?,
 3695:             })
 3696:         }
 3697:         "propose-restore" => {
 3698:             let node_id = parser.required("--node-id")?;
 3699:             Ok(MembershipCommand::Propose {
 3700:                 config: proposal_config(
 3701:                     &parser,
 3702:                     paths,
 3703:                     MembershipOperation::RestoreNode {
 3704:                         node_id: node_id.clone(),
 3705:                     },
 3706:                     node_id,
 3707:                 )?,
 3708:             })
 3709:         }
 3710:         "propose-rotate-key" => {
 3711:             let node_id = parser.required("--node-id")?;
 3712:             let new_pubkey_hex = parser.required("--new-pubkey")?;
 3713:             Ok(MembershipCommand::Propose {
 3714:                 config: proposal_config(
 3715:                     &parser,
 3716:                     paths,
 3717:                     MembershipOperation::RotateNodeKey {
 3718:                         node_id: node_id.clone(),
 3719:                         new_pubkey_hex,
 3720:                     },
 3721:                     node_id,
 3722:                 )?,
 3723:             })
 3724:         }
 3725:         "propose-set-quorum" => {
 3726:             let threshold = parser.parse_u8_required("--threshold")?;
 3727:             Ok(MembershipCommand::Propose {
 3728:                 config: proposal_config(
 3729:                     &parser,
 3730:                     paths,
 3731:                     MembershipOperation::SetQuorum { threshold },
 3732:                     "quorum".to_string(),
 3733:                 )?,
 3734:             })
 3735:         }
 3736:         "propose-rotate-approver" => {
 3737:             let approver_id = parser.required("--approver-id")?;
 3738:             let approver_pubkey_hex = parser.required("--approver-pubkey")?;
 3739:             let role = match parser.required("--role")?.as_str() {
 3740:                 "owner" => MembershipApproverRole::Owner,
 3741:                 "guardian" => MembershipApproverRole::Guardian,
 3742:                 _ => return Err("invalid --role: expected owner|guardian".to_string()),
 3743:             };
 3744:             let status = match parser.value("--status").as_deref().unwrap_or("active") {
 3745:                 "active" => MembershipApproverStatus::Active,
 3746:                 "revoked" => MembershipApproverStatus::Revoked,
 3747:                 _ => return Err("invalid --status: expected active|revoked".to_string()),
 3748:             };
 3749:             let operation = MembershipOperation::RotateApprover(MembershipApprover {
 3750:                 approver_id: approver_id.clone(),
 3751:                 approver_pubkey_hex,
 3752:                 role,
 3753:                 status,
 3754:                 created_at_unix: now_unix,
 3755:             });
 3756:             Ok(MembershipCommand::Propose {
 3757:                 config: proposal_config(&parser, paths, operation, approver_id)?,
 3758:             })
 3759:         }
 3760:         "sign-update" => Ok(MembershipCommand::SignUpdate {
 3761:             record_path: parser.required_path("--record")?,
 3762:             approver_id: parser.required("--approver-id")?,
 3763:             signing_key_path: parser.required_path("--signing-key")?,
 3764:             signing_key_passphrase_path: parser.required_path("--signing-key-passphrase-file")?,
 3765:             output_path: parser.required_path("--output")?,
 3766:             merge_from: parser.optional_path("--merge-from"),
 3767:         }),
 3768:         "verify-update" => Ok(MembershipCommand::VerifyUpdate {
 3769:             signed_update_path: parser.required_path("--signed-update")?,
 3770:             paths,
 3771:             now_unix,
 3772:             dry_run: parser.has_flag("--dry-run"),
 3773:         }),
 3774:         "apply-update" => Ok(MembershipCommand::ApplyUpdate {
 3775:             signed_update_path: parser.required_path("--signed-update")?,
 3776:             paths,
 3777:             now_unix,
 3778:             dry_run: parser.has_flag("--dry-run"),
 3779:         }),
 3780:         _ => Err(format!("unknown membership subcommand: {subcommand}")),
 3781:     }
 3782: }

 3784: fn parse_assignment_command(args: &[String]) -> Result<AssignmentCommand, String> {
 3785:     if args.is_empty() {
 3786:         return Err("assignment subcommand is required".to_string());
 3787:     }
 3788:     let subcommand = args[0].as_str();
 3789:     let parser = OptionParser::parse(&args[1..])?;
 3790:     match subcommand {
 3791:         "issue" => {
 3792:             let target_node_id = parser.required("--target-node-id")?;
 3793:             let output_path = parser.required_path("--output")?;
 3794:             let signing_secret_path = parser.required_path("--signing-secret")?;
 3795:             let signing_secret_passphrase_path =
 3796:                 parser.required_path("--signing-secret-passphrase-file")?;
 3797:             let verifier_key_output_path = parser.optional_path("--verifier-key-output");
 3798:             let nodes = parse_assignment_nodes(parser.required("--nodes")?.as_str())?;
 3799:             let allow_pairs = parse_assignment_allow_pairs(parser.required("--allow")?.as_str())?;
 3800:             let mesh_cidr = parser
 3801:                 .value("--mesh-cidr")
 3802:                 .unwrap_or_else(|| "100.64.0.0/10".to_string());
 3803:             let exit_node_id = parser.value("--exit-node-id");
 3804:             let lan_routes = parser
 3805:                 .value("--lan-routes")
 3806:                 .map(split_csv)
 3807:                 .unwrap_or_default();
 3808:             let generated_at_unix = parser.parse_u64_or_default("--generated-at", unix_now())?;
 3809:             let ttl_secs = parser.parse_u64_or_default("--ttl-secs", 300)?;
 3810:             let nonce = parser.parse_u64_or_default("--nonce", generate_assignment_nonce())?;
 3811: 
 3812:             validate_assignment_issue_config(
 3813:                 nodes.as_slice(),
 3814:                 allow_pairs.as_slice(),
 3815:                 target_node_id.as_str(),
 3816:                 exit_node_id.as_deref(),
 3817:             )?;
 3818: 
 3819:             Ok(AssignmentCommand::Issue(Box::new(AssignmentIssueCommand {
 3820:                 signing_secret_path,
 3821:                 signing_secret_passphrase_path,
 3822:                 target_node_id,
 3823:                 output_path,
 3824:                 verifier_key_output_path,
 3825:                 nodes,
 3826:                 allow_pairs,
 3827:                 mesh_cidr,
 3828:                 exit_node_id,
 3829:                 lan_routes,
 3830:                 generated_at_unix,
 3831:                 ttl_secs,
 3832:                 nonce,
 3833:             })))
 3834:         }
 3835:         "verify" => Ok(AssignmentCommand::Verify(AssignmentVerifyCommand {
 3836:             bundle_path: parser.required_path("--bundle")?,
 3837:             verifier_key_path: parser.required_path("--verifier-key")?,
 3838:             watermark_path: parser.required_path("--watermark")?,
 3839:             expected_node_id: parser.value("--expected-node-id"),
 3840:             max_age_secs: parser
 3841:                 .parse_u64_or_default("--max-age-secs", DEFAULT_AUTO_TUNNEL_MAX_AGE_SECS)?,
 3842:             max_clock_skew_secs: parser.parse_u64_or_default(
 3843:                 "--max-clock-skew-secs",
 3844:                 DEFAULT_SIGNED_STATE_MAX_CLOCK_SKEW_SECS,
 3845:             )?,
 3846:         })),
 3847:         "init-signing-secret" => {
 3848:             let output_path = parser.required_path("--output")?;
 3849:             let signing_secret_passphrase_path =
 3850:                 parser.required_path("--signing-secret-passphrase-file")?;
 3851:             let length_bytes = parser.parse_u64_or_default("--length-bytes", 32)?;
 3852:             if length_bytes < 32 {
 3853:                 return Err("signing secret length must be >= 32 bytes".to_string());
 3854:             }
 3855:             if length_bytes > 4096 {
 3856:                 return Err("signing secret length must be <= 4096 bytes".to_string());
 3857:             }
 3858:             Ok(AssignmentCommand::InitSigningSecret {
 3859:                 output_path,
 3860:                 signing_secret_passphrase_path,
 3861:                 length_bytes: length_bytes as usize,
 3862:                 force: parser.has_flag("--force"),
 3863:             })
 3864:         }
 3865:         _ => Err(format!("unknown assignment subcommand: {subcommand}")),
 3866:     }
 3867: }

 4097:         CliCommand::AccessControlListAudit(path) => execute_acl_audit(&path),
 4098:         CliCommand::BootIntegrityCheck => execute_boot_integrity(),
 4099:         CliCommand::SystemStateSnapshot => execute_system_snapshot(),
 4100:         CliCommand::CompareToBaseline => execute_compare_baseline(),

 4102:         CliCommand::Login => Ok("login: open auth URL and complete device enrollment".to_string()),
 4103:         CliCommand::OperatorMenu => execute_operator_menu(),

 4116:         ),

 4119:         CliCommand::Membership(command) => execute_membership(*command),
 4120:         CliCommand::Trust(command) => execute_trust(*command),

 4129:         CliCommand::RestoreState(command) => execute_restore_state(command),
 4130:         CliCommand::ExportKeys(command) => execute_export_keys(command),
 4131:         CliCommand::Config(command) => execute_config_subcommand(command),
 4132:         other => {
 4133:             let ipc_command = to_ipc_command(other);
 4134:             match send_command(ipc_command) {
 4135:                 Ok(response) => {
 4136:                     if response.ok {
 4137:                         Ok(response.message)
 4138:                     } else {
 4139:                         Err(response.message)
 4140:                     }
 4141:                 }
 4142:                 Err(err) => Err(format!("daemon unreachable: {err}")),
 4143:             }
 4144:         }
 4145:     }

 4153:     reconcile_persisted_lan_blackhole_routes_after_refresh()?;
 4154:     Ok(response.message)

 4164: fn execute_assignment(command: AssignmentCommand) -> Result<String, String> {
 4165:     match command {
 4166:         AssignmentCommand::Issue(issue) => {
 4167:             let AssignmentIssueCommand {
 4168:                 signing_secret_path,
 4169:                 signing_secret_passphrase_path,
 4170:                 target_node_id,
 4171:                 output_path,
 4172:                 verifier_key_output_path,
 4173:                 nodes,
 4174:                 allow_pairs,
 4175:                 mesh_cidr,
 4176:                 exit_node_id,
 4177:                 lan_routes,
 4178:                 generated_at_unix,
 4179:                 ttl_secs,
 4180:                 nonce,
 4181:             } = *issue;
 4182:             let signing_secret = load_assignment_signing_secret(
 4183:                 &signing_secret_path,
 4184:                 &signing_secret_passphrase_path,
 4185:             )?;
 4186: 
 4187:             let policy = PolicySet {
 4188:                 rules: allow_pairs
 4189:                     .iter()
 4190:                     .map(|pair| PolicyRule {
 4191:                         src: format!("node:{}", pair.source_node_id),
 4192:                         dst: format!("node:{}", pair.destination_node_id),
 4193:                         protocol: Protocol::Any,
 4194:                         action: RuleAction::Allow,
 4195:                     })
 4196:                     .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
 4197:             };
 4198: 
 4199:             let core = ControlPlaneCore::new(signing_secret, policy);
 4200:             for node in nodes {
 4201:                 core.nodes
 4202:                     .upsert(NodeMetadata {
 4203:                         node_id: node.node_id,
 4204:                         hostname: node.hostname,
 4205:                         os: node.os,
 4206:                         tags: node.tags,
 4207:                         owner: node.owner,
 4208:                         endpoint: node.endpoint,
 4209:                         last_seen_unix: generated_at_unix,
 4210:                         public_key: node.public_key,
 4211:                     })
 4212:                     .map_err(|err| format!("register node failed: {err}"))?;
 4213:             }
 4214: 
 4215:             let bundle = core
 4216:                 .signed_auto_tunnel_bundle(AutoTunnelBundleRequest {
 4217:                     node_id: target_node_id.clone(),
 4218:                     generated_at_unix,
 4219:                     ttl_secs,
 4220:                     nonce,
 4221:                     mesh_cidr,
 4222:                     exit_node_id: exit_node_id.clone(),
 4223:                     lan_routes,
 4224:                 })
 4225:                 .map_err(|err| format!("issue assignment bundle failed: {err}"))?;
 4226: 
 4227:             let wire = ControlPlaneCore::signed_auto_tunnel_bundle_to_wire(&bundle);
 4228:             write_text_file(&output_path, &wire)?;
 4229: 
 4230:             let verifier_key_hex = core.assignment_verifier_key_hex();
 4231:             if let Some(verifier_path) = verifier_key_output_path.as_ref() {
 4232:                 write_text_file(verifier_path, &format!("{verifier_key_hex}\n"))?;
 4233:             }
 4234: 
 4235:             Ok(format!(
 4236:                 "assignment bundle issued: target={} output={} generated_at_unix={} expires_at_unix={} verifier_key_output={}",
 4237:                 target_node_id,
 4238:                 output_path.display(),
 4239:                 bundle.generated_at_unix,
 4240:                 bundle.expires_at_unix,
 4241:                 verifier_key_output_path
 4242:                     .as_ref()
 4243:                     .map(|path| path.display().to_string())
 4244:                     .unwrap_or_else(|| "<not_written>".to_string())
 4245:             ))
 4246:         }
 4247:         AssignmentCommand::Verify(command) => execute_assignment_verify(command),
 4248:         AssignmentCommand::InitSigningSecret {
 4249:             output_path,
 4250:             signing_secret_passphrase_path,
 4251:             length_bytes,
 4252:             force,
 4253:         } => {
 4254:             let mut secret = vec![0u8; length_bytes];
 4255:             fill_os_random_bytes(secret.as_mut_slice(), "assignment signing secret")?;
 4256:             persist_encrypted_secret_material(
 4257:                 &output_path,
 4258:                 secret.as_slice(),
 4259:                 &signing_secret_passphrase_path,
 4260:                 "assignment signing secret",
 4261:                 force,
 4262:             )?;
 4263:             secret.zeroize();
 4264:             Ok(format!(
 4265:                 "assignment signing secret initialized: output={} length_bytes={}",
 4266:                 output_path.display(),
 4267:                 length_bytes
 4268:             ))
 4269:         }
 4270:     }
 4271: }

 4273: fn execute_dns_zone_issue(command: DnsZoneIssueCommand) -> Result<String, String> {
 4274:     let DnsZoneIssueCommand {
 4275:         signing_secret_path,
 4276:         signing_secret_passphrase_path,
 4277:         subject_node_id,
 4278:         output_path,
 4279:         verifier_key_output_path,

 4284:         generated_at_unix,
 4285:         ttl_secs,
 4286:         nonce,
 4287:     } = command;
 4288:     ensure_regular_file_no_symlink(&records_path, "dns zone records manifest")?;
 4289:     let records = load_dns_zone_records_manifest(&records_path)?;
 4290:     let signing_secret =
 4291:         load_assignment_signing_secret(&signing_secret_path, &signing_secret_passphrase_path)?;
 4292: 
 4293:     let policy = PolicySet {
 4294:         rules: allow_pairs
 4295:             .iter()
 4296:             .map(|pair| PolicyRule {
 4297:                 src: format!("node:{}", pair.source_node_id),
 4298:                 dst: format!("node:{}", pair.destination_node_id),
 4299:                 protocol: Protocol::Any,
 4300:                 action: RuleAction::Allow,
 4301:             })
 4302:             .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
 4303:     };
 4304: 
 4305:     let core = ControlPlaneCore::new(signing_secret, policy);
 4306:     for node in nodes {
 4307:         core.nodes
 4308:             .upsert(NodeMetadata {
 4309:                 node_id: node.node_id,
 4310:                 hostname: node.hostname,
 4311:                 os: node.os,
 4312:                 tags: node.tags,
 4313:                 owner: node.owner,
 4314:                 endpoint: node.endpoint,
 4315:                 last_seen_unix: generated_at_unix,
 4316:                 public_key: node.public_key,
 4317:             })
 4318:             .map_err(|err| format!("register node failed: {err}"))?;
 4319:     }
 4320: 
 4321:     let bundle = core
 4322:         .signed_dns_zone_bundle(rustynet_control::SignedDnsZoneBundleRequest {
 4323:             zone_name,
 4324:             subject_node_id: subject_node_id.clone(),
 4325:             generated_at_unix,
 4326:             ttl_secs,
 4327:             nonce,
 4328:             records: records
 4329:                 .into_iter()
 4330:                 .map(|record| rustynet_control::DnsRecordRequest {
 4331:                     label: record.label,
 4332:                     target_node_id: record.target_node_id,
 4333:                     ttl_secs: record.ttl_secs,
 4334:                     rr_type: rustynet_control::DnsRecordType::A,
 4335:                     target_addr_kind: rustynet_control::DnsTargetAddrKind::MeshIpv4,
 4336:                     aliases: record.aliases,
 4337:                 })
 4338:                 .collect(),
 4339:         })
 4340:         .map_err(|err| format!("issue dns zone bundle failed: {err}"))?;
 4341: 
 4342:     let wire = ControlPlaneCore::signed_dns_zone_bundle_to_wire(&bundle);
 4343:     write_text_file(&output_path, &wire)?;
 4344: 
 4345:     let verifier_key_hex = core.dns_zone_verifier_key_hex();
 4346:     if let Some(verifier_path) = verifier_key_output_path.as_ref() {
 4347:         write_text_file(verifier_path, &format!("{verifier_key_hex}\n"))?;
 4348:     }
 4349: 
 4350:     Ok(format!(
 4351:         "dns zone bundle issued: zone_name={} subject_node_id={} output={} generated_at_unix={} expires_at_unix={} record_count={} verifier_key_output={}",
 4352:         bundle.zone_name,
 4353:         bundle.subject_node_id,
 4354:         output_path.display(),
 4355:         bundle.generated_at_unix,
 4356:         bundle.expires_at_unix,
 4357:         bundle.records.len(),
 4358:         verifier_key_output_path
 4359:             .as_ref()
 4360:             .map(|path| path.display().to_string())
 4361:             .unwrap_or_else(|| "<not_written>".to_string())
 4362:     ))
 4363: }

 4518: fn execute_dns_zone_verify(
 4519:     bundle_path: PathBuf,
 4520:     verifier_key_path: PathBuf,
 4521:     expected_zone_name: Option<String>,
 4522:     expected_subject_node_id: Option<String>,
 4523: ) -> Result<String, String> {
 4524:     ensure_regular_file_no_symlink(&bundle_path, "dns zone bundle")?;
 4525:     ensure_regular_file_no_symlink(&verifier_key_path, "dns zone verifier key")?;
 4526: 
 4527:     let bundle_wire = fs::read_to_string(&bundle_path)
 4528:         .map_err(|err| format!("read dns zone bundle failed: {err}"))?;
 4529:     let bundle = parse_signed_dns_zone_bundle_wire(&bundle_wire)
 4530:         .map_err(|err| format!("dns zone bundle parse failed: {err}"))?;
 4531: 
 4532:     let verifier_contents = fs::read_to_string(&verifier_key_path)
 4533:         .map_err(|err| format!("read dns zone verifier key failed: {err}"))?;
 4534:     let verifying_key = parse_dns_zone_verifying_key(&verifier_contents)
 4535:         .map_err(|err| format!("dns zone verifier key parse failed: {err}"))?;
 4536:     verify_dns_zone_bundle(&bundle, &verifying_key)
 4537:         .map_err(|err| format!("dns zone verification failed: {err}"))?;
 4538: 
 4539:     if let Some(expected_zone_name) = expected_zone_name {
 4540:         let normalized = canonicalize_dns_zone_name(&expected_zone_name)
 4541:             .map_err(|err| format!("expected zone name is invalid: {err}"))?;
 4542:         if bundle.zone_name != normalized {
 4543:             return Err(format!(
 4544:                 "dns zone bundle zone_name mismatch: expected {}, got {}",
 4545:                 normalized, bundle.zone_name
 4546:             ));
 4547:         }
 4548:     }
 4549:     if let Some(expected_subject_node_id) = expected_subject_node_id
 4550:         && bundle.subject_node_id != expected_subject_node_id
 4551:     {
 4552:         return Err(format!(
 4553:             "dns zone bundle subject_node_id mismatch: expected {}, got {}",
 4554:             expected_subject_node_id, bundle.subject_node_id
 4555:         ));
 4556:     }
 4557: 
 4558:     Ok(format!(
 4559:         "dns zone verification passed: zone_name={} subject_node_id={} generated_at_unix={} expires_at_unix={} record_count={}",
 4560:         bundle.zone_name,
 4561:         bundle.subject_node_id,
 4562:         bundle.generated_at_unix,
 4563:         bundle.expires_at_unix,
 4564:         bundle.records.len()
 4565:     ))
 4566: }

 4568: fn execute_operator_menu() -> Result<String, String> {
 4569:     let stdin = io::stdin();
 4570:     loop {
 4571:         println!();
 4572:         println!("Rustynet Operator Menu");
 4573:         println!("  1) Status");
 4574:         println!("  2) Netcheck");
 4575:         println!("  3) Exit node off");
 4576:         println!("  4) Advertise default exit route (0.0.0.0/0)");
 4577:         println!("  5) LAN access on");
 4578:         println!("  6) LAN access off");
 4579:         println!("  0) Exit");
 4580:         print!("Choose an option: ");
 4581:         io::stdout()
 4582:             .flush()
 4583:             .map_err(|err| format!("flush stdout failed: {err}"))?;
 4584: 
 4585:         let mut choice = String::new();
 4586:         stdin
 4587:             .read_line(&mut choice)
 4588:             .map_err(|err| format!("read menu input failed: {err}"))?;
 4589:         if choice.is_empty() {
 4590:             return Ok("operator menu exited (stdin closed)".to_string());
 4591:         }
 4592: 
 4593:         match choice.trim() {
 4594:             "1" => render_operator_action("status", send_command(IpcCommand::Status)),
 4595:             "2" => render_operator_action("netcheck", send_command(IpcCommand::Netcheck)),
 4596:             "3" => render_operator_action("exit-node off", send_command(IpcCommand::ExitNodeOff)),
 4597:             "4" => render_operator_action(
 4598:                 "route advertise 0.0.0.0/0",
 4599:                 send_command(IpcCommand::RouteAdvertise("0.0.0.0/0".to_string())),
 4600:             ),
 4601:             "5" => render_operator_action("lan-access on", send_command(IpcCommand::LanAccessOn)),
 4602:             "6" => render_operator_action("lan-access off", send_command(IpcCommand::LanAccessOff)),
 4603:             "0" => return Ok("operator menu exited".to_string()),
 4604:             _ => println!("unknown option"),
 4605:         }
 4606:     }
 4607: }
 4608: 
 4609: fn render_operator_action(action: &str, result: Result<IpcResponse, String>) {
 4610:     match result {
 4611:         Ok(response) if response.ok => println!("{action}: {}", response.message),
 4612:         Ok(response) => println!("{action}: failed: {}", response.message),
 4613:         Err(err) => println!("{action}: daemon unreachable: {err}"),
 4614:     }
 4615: }
 4616: 
 4617: fn execute_membership(command: MembershipCommand) -> Result<String, String> {
 4618:     match command {
 4619:         MembershipCommand::Status { paths } => {
 4620:             let (_, _, state) = load_current_membership_state(&paths, unix_now())?;
 4621:             let active_nodes = state.active_nodes().into_iter().collect::<Vec<_>>();
 4622:             let root = state.state_root_hex().map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
 4623:             Ok(format!(
 4624:                 "membership status: network_id={} epoch={} quorum_threshold={} active_nodes={} state_root={}",
 4625:                 state.network_id,
 4626:                 state.epoch,
 4627:                 state.quorum_threshold,
 4628:                 active_nodes.join(","),
 4629:                 root
 4630:             ))
 4631:         }
 4632:         MembershipCommand::Propose { config } => {
 4633:             let (_, _, state) = load_current_membership_state(&config.paths, unix_now())?;
 4634:             let prev_root = state.state_root_hex().map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
 4635:             let mut candidate = state.clone();
 4636:             // Reducer legality is checked using state transition during apply later.
 4637:             // For propose, compute candidate root using deterministic transition helper.
 4638:             candidate =
 4639:                 rustynet_control::membership::preview_next_state(&candidate, &config.operation)
 4640:                     .map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
 4641:             let new_root = candidate.state_root_hex().map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
 4642:             let created_at_unix = unix_now();
 4643:             let expires_at_unix = created_at_unix.saturating_add(config.expires_in_secs);
 4644:             if expires_at_unix <= created_at_unix {
 4645:                 return Err("invalid expiry window: --expires-in must be > 0".to_string());
 4646:             }
 4647:             let record = MembershipUpdateRecord {
 4648:                 network_id: state.network_id,
 4649:                 update_id: config.update_id,
 4650:                 operation: config.operation,
 4651:                 target: config.target,
 4652:                 prev_state_root: prev_root,
 4653:                 new_state_root: new_root,
 4654:                 epoch_prev: state.epoch,
 4655:                 epoch_new: state.epoch.saturating_add(1),
 4656:                 created_at_unix,
 4657:                 expires_at_unix,
 4658:                 reason_code: config.reason_code,
 4659:                 policy_context: config.policy_context,
 4660:             };
 4661:             let payload = encode_update_record(&record).map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
 4662:             write_text_file(&config.output_path, &payload)?;
 4663:             Ok(format!(
 4664:                 "membership proposal written: {} operation={} target={} epoch_new={}",
 4665:                 config.output_path.display(),
 4666:                 record.operation.operation_name_for_cli(),
 4667:                 record.target,
 4668:                 record.epoch_new
 4669:             ))
 4670:         }
 4671:         MembershipCommand::SignUpdate {
 4672:             record_path,
 4673:             approver_id,
 4674:             signing_key_path,
 4675:             signing_key_passphrase_path,
 4676:             output_path,
 4677:             merge_from,
 4678:         } => {
 4679:             let record_payload = fs::read_to_string(&record_path)
 4680:                 .map_err(|err| format!("read record failed: {err}"))?;
 4681:             let record = decode_update_record(&record_payload).map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
 4682:             let signing_key = load_signing_key(&signing_key_path, &signing_key_passphrase_path)?;
 4683:             let signature = sign_update_record(&record, approver_id.as_str(), &signing_key)
 4684:                 .map_err(|err| format!("sign update failed: {err}"))?;
 4685: 
 4686:             let mut signatures = if let Some(path) = merge_from {
 4687:                 let signed_payload = fs::read_to_string(&path)
 4688:                     .map_err(|err| format!("read merge-from update failed: {err}"))?;
 4689:                 let existing =
 4690:                     decode_signed_update(&signed_payload).map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
 4691:                 if existing.record != record {
 4692:                     return Err(
 4693:                         "merge-from update record mismatch: payloads must be identical".to_string(),
 4694:                     );
 4695:                 }
 4696:                 existing.approver_signatures
 4697:             } else {
 4698:                 Vec::new()
 4699:             };
 4700: 
 4701:             if signatures
 4702:                 .iter()
 4703:                 .any(|entry| entry.approver_id == approver_id)
 4704:             {
 4705:                 return Err("duplicate approver signature is not allowed".to_string());
 4706:             }
 4707:             signatures.push(signature);
 4708: 
 4709:             let signed = SignedMembershipUpdate {
 4710:                 record,
 4711:                 approver_signatures: signatures,
 4712:             };
 4713:             let envelope = encode_signed_update(&signed).map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
 4714:             write_text_file(&output_path, &envelope)?;
 4715:             Ok(format!(
 4716:                 "membership signed update written: {} signatures={}",
 4717:                 output_path.display(),
 4718:                 signed.approver_signatures.len()
 4719:             ))
 4720:         }
 4721:         MembershipCommand::VerifyUpdate {
 4722:             signed_update_path,
 4723:             paths,
 4724:             now_unix,
 4725:             dry_run,
 4726:         } => {
 4727:             let (_, entries, state) = load_current_membership_state(&paths, now_unix)?;
 4728:             let signed_payload = fs::read_to_string(&signed_update_path)
 4729:                 .map_err(|err| format!("read signed update failed: {err}"))?;
 4730:             let signed = decode_signed_update(&signed_payload).map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
 4731:             let mut replay_cache = replay_cache_from_entries(&entries)?;
 4732:             let next = apply_signed_update(&state, &signed, now_unix, &mut replay_cache)
 4733:                 .map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
 4734:             let next_root = next.state_root_hex().map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
 4735:             let mode = if dry_run { "dry-run" } else { "verify" };
 4736:             Ok(format!(
 4737:                 "membership update {mode} passed: epoch_new={} state_root={next_root}",
 4738:                 next.epoch
 4739:             ))
 4740:         }
 4741:         MembershipCommand::ApplyUpdate {
 4742:             signed_update_path,
 4743:             paths,
 4744:             now_unix,
 4745:             dry_run,
 4746:         } => {
 4747:             let (_, entries, state) = load_current_membership_state(&paths, now_unix)?;
 4748:             let signed_payload = fs::read_to_string(&signed_update_path)
 4749:                 .map_err(|err| format!("read signed update failed: {err}"))?;
 4750:             let signed = decode_signed_update(&signed_payload).map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
 4751:             let mut replay_cache = replay_cache_from_entries(&entries)?;
 4752:             let next = apply_signed_update(&state, &signed, now_unix, &mut replay_cache)
 4753:                 .map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
 4754:             if dry_run {
 4755:                 return Ok(format!(
 4756:                     "membership apply dry-run passed: epoch_new={}",
 4757:                     next.epoch
 4758:                 ));
 4759:             }
 4760:             append_membership_log_entry(&paths.log_path, &signed).map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
 4761:             persist_membership_snapshot(&paths.snapshot_path, &next)
 4762:                 .map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
 4763:             Ok(format!(
 4764:                 "membership update applied: snapshot={} log={} epoch_new={}",
 4765:                 paths.snapshot_path.display(),
 4766:                 paths.log_path.display(),
 4767:                 next.epoch
 4768:             ))
 4769:         }
 4770:         MembershipCommand::VerifyLog {
 4771:             paths,
 4772:             now_unix,
 4773:             audit_output_path,
 4774:         } => {
 4775:             let (_, entries, state) = load_current_membership_state(&paths, now_unix)?;
 4776:             write_membership_audit_log(&audit_output_path, &entries)
 4777:                 .map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
 4778:             Ok(format!(
 4779:                 "membership log verification passed: entries={} epoch={} audit={}",
 4780:                 entries.len(),
 4781:                 state.epoch,
 4782:                 audit_output_path.display()
 4783:             ))
 4784:         }
 4785:         MembershipCommand::GenerateEvidence {
 4786:             paths,
 4787:             now_unix,
 4788:             output_dir,
 4789:             environment,
 4790:         } => emit_membership_evidence(paths, now_unix, output_dir, environment),
 4791:     }
 4792: }
 4793: 
 4794: fn execute_trust(command: TrustCommand) -> Result<String, String> {
 4795:     match command {
 4796:         TrustCommand::Keygen {
 4797:             signing_key_path,
 4798:             signing_key_passphrase_path,
 4799:             verifier_key_output_path,
 4800:             force,
 4801:         } => {
 4802:             let mut seed = [0u8; 32];
 4803:             fill_os_random_bytes(&mut seed, "trust signing key")?;
 4804:             persist_encrypted_secret_material(
 4805:                 &signing_key_path,
 4806:                 &seed,
 4807:                 &signing_key_passphrase_path,
 4808:                 "trust signing key",
 4809:                 force,
 4810:             )?;
 4811:             let signing_key = SigningKey::from_bytes(&seed);
 4812:             seed.zeroize();
 4813:             let verifier_key_hex = hex_bytes(signing_key.verifying_key().as_bytes());
 4814:             write_text_file(&verifier_key_output_path, &format!("{verifier_key_hex}\n"))?;
 4815:             Ok(format!(
 4816:                 "trust signing key initialized: signing_key={} verifier_key_output={}",
 4817:                 signing_key_path.display(),
 4818:                 verifier_key_output_path.display()
 4819:             ))
 4820:         }
 4821:         TrustCommand::ExportVerifierKey {
 4822:             signing_key_path,
 4823:             signing_key_passphrase_path,
 4824:             output_path,
 4825:         } => {
 4826:             let signing_key = load_signing_key(&signing_key_path, &signing_key_passphrase_path)?;
 4827:             let verifier_key_hex = hex_bytes(signing_key.verifying_key().as_bytes());
 4828:             write_text_file(&output_path, &format!("{verifier_key_hex}\n"))?;
 4829:             Ok(format!(
 4830:                 "trust verifier key exported: signing_key={} output={}",
 4831:                 signing_key_path.display(),
 4832:                 output_path.display()
 4833:             ))
 4834:         }
 4835:         TrustCommand::Issue {
 4836:             signing_key_path,
 4837:             signing_key_passphrase_path,
 4838:             output_path,
 4839:             updated_at_unix,
 4840:             nonce,
 4841:         } => {
 4842:             let signing_key = load_signing_key(&signing_key_path, &signing_key_passphrase_path)?;
 4843:             let payload = format!(
 4844:                 "version=2\ntls13_valid=true\nsigned_control_valid=true\nsigned_data_age_secs=0\nclock_skew_secs=0\nupdated_at_unix={updated_at_unix}\nnonce={nonce}\n"
 4845:             );
 4846:             let signature = signing_key.sign(payload.as_bytes());
 4847:             let body = format!("{payload}signature={}\n", hex_bytes(&signature.to_bytes()));
 4848:             write_text_file(&output_path, &body)?;
 4849:             Ok(format!(
 4850:                 "trust evidence issued: output={} updated_at_unix={} nonce={}",
 4851:                 output_path.display(),
 4852:                 updated_at_unix,
 4853:                 nonce
 4854:             ))
 4855:         }
 4856:         TrustCommand::Verify {
 4857:             evidence_path,
 4858:             verifier_key_path,
 4859:             watermark_path,
 4860:             max_age_secs,
 4861:             max_clock_skew_secs,
 4862:         } => execute_trust_verify(
 4863:             evidence_path,
 4864:             verifier_key_path,
 4865:             watermark_path,
 4866:             max_age_secs,
 4867:             max_clock_skew_secs,
 4868:         ),
 4869:     }
 4870: }
 4871: 
 4872: fn execute_trust_verify(
 4873:     evidence_path: PathBuf,
 4874:     verifier_key_path: PathBuf,
 4875:     watermark_path: PathBuf,
 4876:     max_age_secs: u64,
 4877:     max_clock_skew_secs: u64,
 4878: ) -> Result<String, String> {
 4879:     ensure_regular_file_no_symlink(&evidence_path, "trust evidence")?;
 4880:     ensure_regular_file_no_symlink(&verifier_key_path, "trust verifier key")?;
 4881:     ensure_regular_file_no_symlink(&watermark_path, "trust watermark")?;
 4882: 
 4883:     let report = verify_signed_trust_state_artifact(
 4884:         &evidence_path,
 4885:         &verifier_key_path,
 4886:         &watermark_path,
 4887:         max_age_secs,
 4888:         max_clock_skew_secs,
 4889:     )?;
 4890:     Ok(format!(
 4891:         "trust verification passed: updated_at_unix={} nonce={} tls13_valid={} signed_control_valid={} signed_data_age_secs={} clock_skew_secs={} payload_digest_sha256={}",
 4892:         report.updated_at_unix,
 4893:         report.nonce,
 4894:         report.tls13_valid,
 4895:         report.signed_control_valid,
 4896:         report.signed_data_age_secs,
 4897:         report.clock_skew_secs,
 4898:         report.payload_digest_sha256
 4899:     ))
 4900: }

 5388: fn execute_ops_refresh_trust() -> Result<String, String> {
 5389:     require_root_execution()?;
 5390:     enforce_pinned_runtime_binary_custody("trust-refresh")?;
 5391: 
 5392:     if !parse_env_bool_with_default("RUSTYNET_TRUST_AUTO_REFRESH", "true")? {
 5393:         return Ok("[trust-refresh] auto-refresh disabled; skipping.".to_string());
 5394:     }
 5395: 
 5396:     let trust_evidence_path = env_path_or_default(
 5397:         "RUSTYNET_TRUST_EVIDENCE",
 5398:         "/var/lib/rustynet/rustynetd.trust",
 5399:     )?;
 5400:     let trust_signer_key_path = env_path_or_default(
 5401:         "RUSTYNET_TRUST_SIGNER_KEY",
 5402:         "/etc/rustynet/trust-evidence.key",
 5403:     )?;
 5404:     let trust_signing_key_passphrase_path =
 5405:         env_required_path("RUSTYNET_TRUST_SIGNING_KEY_PASSPHRASE_FILE")?;
 5406:     let daemon_group = env_string_or_default("RUSTYNET_DAEMON_GROUP", "rustynetd")?;
 5407:     refresh_trust_record_with_inputs(
 5408:         SigningPassphraseHostProfile::Linux,
 5409:         trust_evidence_path.as_path(),
 5410:         trust_signer_key_path.as_path(),
 5411:         trust_signing_key_passphrase_path.as_path(),
 5412:         daemon_group.as_str(),
 5413:     )
 5414: }
 5415: 
 5416: fn execute_ops_refresh_signed_trust() -> Result<String, String> {
 5417:     let config = signing_passphrase_ops_config_from_env()?;
 5418:     if matches!(config.host_profile, SigningPassphraseHostProfile::Linux) {
 5419:         require_root_execution()?;
 5420:     }
 5421: 
 5422:     let node_role = env_optional_string("RUSTYNET_NODE_ROLE")?
 5423:         .unwrap_or_else(|| "admin".to_string())
 5424:         .to_ascii_lowercase();
 5425:     if node_role != "admin" && node_role != "blind_exit" {
 5426:         return Err(format!(
 5427:             "refresh-signed-trust requires node role admin or blind_exit; got {node_role}"
 5428:         ));
 5429:     }
 5430: 
 5431:     let trust_evidence_path = env_path_or_default(
 5432:         "RUSTYNET_TRUST_EVIDENCE",
 5433:         "/var/lib/rustynet/rustynetd.trust",
 5434:     )?;
 5435:     let trust_signer_key_path =
 5436:         env_path_or_default("RUSTYNET_TRUST_SIGNER_KEY", DEFAULT_TRUST_SIGNER_KEY_PATH)?;
 5437:     if !trust_signer_key_path.exists() {
 5438:         return Err(format!(
 5439:             "signer key not found at {}",
 5440:             trust_signer_key_path.display()
 5441:         ));
 5442:     }
 5443:     let daemon_group = env_string_or_default("RUSTYNET_DAEMON_GROUP", "rustynetd")?;
 5444: 
 5445:     ensure_signing_passphrase_material_ops(&config)?;
 5446:     let passphrase_tmp =
 5447:         create_secure_temp_file(std::env::temp_dir().as_path(), "trust-passphrase.")?;
 5448:     if let Err(err) = materialize_signing_passphrase_ops(&config, passphrase_tmp.as_path()) {
 5449:         let _ = secure_remove_file(passphrase_tmp.as_path());
 5450:         return Err(err);
 5451:     }
 5452: 
 5453:     let refresh_result = refresh_trust_record_with_inputs(
 5454:         config.host_profile,
 5455:         trust_evidence_path.as_path(),
 5456:         trust_signer_key_path.as_path(),
 5457:         passphrase_tmp.as_path(),
 5458:         daemon_group.as_str(),
 5459:     );
 5460:     let cleanup_result = secure_remove_file(passphrase_tmp.as_path());
 5461:     match (refresh_result, cleanup_result) {
 5462:         (Ok(message), Ok(())) => Ok(message),
 5463:         (Err(err), Ok(())) => Err(err),
 5464:         (Ok(_), Err(cleanup_err)) => Err(cleanup_err),
 5465:         (Err(err), Err(cleanup_err)) => Err(format!("{err}; cleanup failed: {cleanup_err}")),
 5466:     }
 5467: }
 5468: 
 5469: fn refresh_trust_record_with_inputs(
 5470:     host_profile: SigningPassphraseHostProfile,
 5471:     trust_evidence_path: &Path,
 5472:     trust_signer_key_path: &Path,
 5473:     trust_signing_key_passphrase_path: &Path,
 5474:     daemon_group: &str,
 5475: ) -> Result<String, String> {
 5476:     let target_dir = trust_evidence_path.parent().ok_or_else(|| {
 5477:         format!(
 5478:             "trust evidence path has no parent: {}",
 5479:             trust_evidence_path.display()
 5480:         )
 5481:     })?;
 5482: 
 5483:     let (owner_uid, owner_gid, trust_mode) = match host_profile {
 5484:         SigningPassphraseHostProfile::Linux => {
 5485:             validate_root_owned_encrypted_signing_file(trust_signer_key_path, "trust signer key")?;
 5486:             validate_root_owned_passphrase_file(
 5487:                 trust_signing_key_passphrase_path,
 5488:                 "trust signer key passphrase file",
 5489:             )?;
 5490:             let trust_group_gid = group_gid_required(daemon_group)?;
 5491:             let trust_mode = 0o640;
 5492:             ensure_directory_exists(target_dir, 0o750, Uid::from_raw(0), trust_group_gid)?;
 5493:             (Uid::from_raw(0), trust_group_gid, trust_mode)
 5494:         }
 5495:         SigningPassphraseHostProfile::Macos => {
 5496:             validate_encrypted_secret_file_security(trust_signer_key_path, "trust signer key")?;
 5497:             validate_encrypted_secret_file_security(
 5498:                 trust_signing_key_passphrase_path,
 5499:                 "trust signer key passphrase file",
 5500:             )?;
 5501:             ensure_directory_with_mode_owner(target_dir, 0o700, None, None)?;
 5502:             (Uid::effective(), Gid::effective(), 0o600)
 5503:         }
 5504:     };
 5505: 
 5506:     let record_tmp = create_secure_temp_file(target_dir, "rustynetd-trust-record.")?;
 5507:     let issue_result = execute_trust(TrustCommand::Issue {
 5508:         signing_key_path: trust_signer_key_path.to_path_buf(),
 5509:         signing_key_passphrase_path: trust_signing_key_passphrase_path.to_path_buf(),
 5510:         output_path: record_tmp.clone(),
 5511:         updated_at_unix: unix_now(),
 5512:         nonce: generate_assignment_nonce(),
 5513:     });
 5514:     if let Err(err) = issue_result {
 5515:         let _ = remove_file_if_present(&record_tmp);
 5516:         return Err(err);
 5517:     }
 5518: 
 5519:     if let Err(err) = publish_file_with_owner_mode(
 5520:         &record_tmp,
 5521:         trust_evidence_path,
 5522:         owner_uid,
 5523:         owner_gid,
 5524:         trust_mode,
 5525:         "trust evidence",
 5526:     ) {
 5527:         let _ = remove_file_if_present(&record_tmp);
 5528:         return Err(err);
 5529:     }
 5530: 
 5531:     Ok(format!(
 5532:         "[trust-refresh] refreshed signed trust evidence at {}",
 5533:         trust_evidence_path.display()
 5534:     ))
 5535: }
 5536: 
 5537: fn execute_ops_refresh_assignment() -> Result<String, String> {
 5538:     require_root_execution()?;
 5539:     enforce_pinned_runtime_binary_custody("assignment-refresh")?;
 5540: 
 5541:     if !parse_env_bool_with_default("RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_AUTO_REFRESH", "false")? {
 5542:         return Ok("[assignment-refresh] auto-refresh disabled; skipping.".to_string());
 5543:     }
 5544: 
 5545:     let target_node_id = env_optional_string("RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_TARGET_NODE_ID")?
 5546:         .or_else(|| std::env::var("RUSTYNET_NODE_ID").ok())
 5547:         .ok_or_else(|| {
 5548:             "assignment target node id is required (RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_TARGET_NODE_ID or RUSTYNET_NODE_ID)".to_string()
 5549:         })?;
 5550:     if !is_valid_node_id(target_node_id.as_str()) {
 5551:         return Err(format!(
 5552:             "target node id contains unsupported characters: {target_node_id}",
 5553:         ));
 5554:     }
 5555: 
 5556:     let nodes_spec = env_required_nonempty("RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_NODES", "assignment node map")?;
 5557:     let allow_spec = env_required_nonempty("RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_ALLOW", "assignment allow rules")?;
 5558:     let exit_node_id = env_optional_string("RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_EXIT_NODE_ID")?;
 5559:     if let Some(exit_node_id_value) = exit_node_id.as_deref()
 5560:         && !is_valid_node_id(exit_node_id_value)
 5561:     {
 5562:         return Err(format!(
 5563:             "exit node id contains unsupported characters: {exit_node_id_value}",
 5564:         ));
 5565:     }
 5566:     let lan_routes = env_optional_string("RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_LAN_ROUTES")?
 5567:         .map(split_csv)
 5568:         .unwrap_or_default();
 5569:     if !lan_routes.is_empty() {
 5570:         validate_assignment_refresh_lan_routes(lan_routes.as_slice())?;
 5571:         if exit_node_id.is_none() {
 5572:             return Err(
 5573:                 "RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_LAN_ROUTES requires RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_EXIT_NODE_ID"
 5574:                     .to_string(),
 5575:             );
 5576:         }
 5577:     }
 5578: 
 5579:     let signing_secret_path = env_path_or_default(
 5580:         "RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_SIGNING_SECRET",
 5581:         "/etc/rustynet/assignment.signing.secret",
 5582:     )?;
 5583:     let signing_secret_passphrase_path =
 5584:         env_required_path("RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_SIGNING_SECRET_PASSPHRASE_FILE")?;
 5585:     let bundle_path = env_path_or_default(
 5586:         "RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_OUTPUT",
 5587:         "/var/lib/rustynet/rustynetd.assignment",
 5588:     )?;
 5589:     let verifier_key_path = env_path_or_default(
 5590:         "RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_VERIFIER_KEY_OUTPUT",
 5591:         "/etc/rustynet/assignment.pub",
 5592:     )?;
 5593:     let ttl_secs = parse_env_u64_with_default("RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_TTL_SECS", 300)?;
 5594:     if !(60..=86_400).contains(&ttl_secs) {
 5595:         return Err(format!(
 5596:             "assignment ttl must be an integer in range 60-86400 seconds: {ttl_secs}",
 5597:         ));
 5598:     }
 5599:     let min_remaining_secs =
 5600:         parse_env_u64_with_default("RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_MIN_REMAINING_SECS", 180)?;
 5601:     let daemon_group = env_string_or_default("RUSTYNET_DAEMON_GROUP", "rustynetd")?;
 5602: 
 5603:     validate_root_owned_encrypted_signing_file(&signing_secret_path, "assignment signing secret")?;
 5604:     validate_root_owned_passphrase_file(
 5605:         &signing_secret_passphrase_path,
 5606:         "assignment signing secret passphrase file",
 5607:     )?;
 5608:     refresh_local_traversal_bundle_from_specs(
 5609:         target_node_id.as_str(),
 5610:         nodes_spec.as_str(),
 5611:         allow_spec.as_str(),
 5612:         daemon_group.as_str(),
 5613:     )?;
 5614: 
 5615:     let now_unix = unix_now();
 5616:     if bundle_path.exists()
 5617:         && let Some(current_expires_at) =
 5618:             read_bundle_u64_field_optional(&bundle_path, "expires_at_unix")?
 5619:         && current_expires_at > now_unix.saturating_add(min_remaining_secs)
 5620:     {
 5621:         let remaining_secs = current_expires_at.saturating_sub(now_unix);
 5622:         return Ok(format!(
 5623:             "[assignment-refresh] current assignment expires in {remaining_secs}s; skip refresh.",
 5624:         ));
 5625:     }
 5626: 
 5627:     let bundle_group_gid = group_gid_required(daemon_group.as_str())?;
 5628: 
 5629:     let bundle_dir = bundle_path.parent().ok_or_else(|| {
 5630:         format!(
 5631:             "assignment bundle output path has no parent: {}",
 5632:             bundle_path.display()
 5633:         )
 5634:     })?;
 5635:     let verifier_dir = verifier_key_path.parent().ok_or_else(|| {
 5636:         format!(
 5637:             "assignment verifier key output path has no parent: {}",
 5638:             verifier_key_path.display()
 5639:         )
 5640:     })?;
 5641:     ensure_directory_exists(bundle_dir, 0o750, Uid::from_raw(0), bundle_group_gid)?;
 5642:     ensure_directory_exists(verifier_dir, 0o750, Uid::from_raw(0), bundle_group_gid)?;
 5643: 
 5644:     let bundle_tmp = create_secure_temp_file(bundle_dir, "rustynetd.assignment.tmp.")?;
 5645:     let verifier_tmp = create_secure_temp_file(verifier_dir, "assignment.pub.tmp.")?;
 5646: 
 5647:     let nodes = parse_assignment_nodes(nodes_spec.as_str())?;
 5648:     let allow_pairs = parse_assignment_allow_pairs(allow_spec.as_str())?;
 5649:     validate_assignment_issue_config(
 5650:         nodes.as_slice(),
 5651:         allow_pairs.as_slice(),
 5652:         target_node_id.as_str(),
 5653:         exit_node_id.as_deref(),
 5654:     )?;
 5655: 
 5656:     let issue_result =
 5657:         execute_assignment(AssignmentCommand::Issue(Box::new(AssignmentIssueCommand {
 5658:             signing_secret_path,
 5659:             signing_secret_passphrase_path,
 5660:             target_node_id,
 5661:             output_path: bundle_tmp.clone(),
 5662:             verifier_key_output_path: Some(verifier_tmp.clone()),
 5663:             nodes,
 5664:             allow_pairs,
 5665:             mesh_cidr: "100.64.0.0/10".to_string(),
 5666:             exit_node_id,
 5667:             lan_routes,
 5668:             generated_at_unix: unix_now(),
 5669:             ttl_secs,
 5670:             nonce: generate_assignment_nonce(),
 5671:         })));
 5672:     if let Err(err) = issue_result {
 5673:         let _ = remove_file_if_present(&bundle_tmp);
 5674:         let _ = remove_file_if_present(&verifier_tmp);
 5675:         return Err(err);
 5676:     }
 5677: 
 5678:     let generated_at_unix = read_bundle_u64_field_required(&bundle_tmp, "generated_at_unix")?;
 5679:     let expires_at_unix = read_bundle_u64_field_required(&bundle_tmp, "expires_at_unix")?;
 5680:     if generated_at_unix >= expires_at_unix {
 5681:         let _ = remove_file_if_present(&bundle_tmp);
 5682:         let _ = remove_file_if_present(&verifier_tmp);
 5683:         return Err("issued assignment bundle has invalid expiry window".to_string());
 5684:     }
 5685: 
 5686:     if let Err(err) = publish_file_with_owner_mode(
 5687:         &bundle_tmp,
 5688:         &bundle_path,
 5689:         Uid::from_raw(0),
 5690:         bundle_group_gid,
 5691:         0o640,
 5692:         "assignment bundle",
 5693:     ) {
 5694:         let _ = remove_file_if_present(&bundle_tmp);
 5695:         let _ = remove_file_if_present(&verifier_tmp);
 5696:         return Err(err);
 5697:     }
 5698: 
 5699:     if let Err(err) = publish_file_with_owner_mode(
 5700:         &verifier_tmp,
 5701:         &verifier_key_path,
 5702:         Uid::from_raw(0),
 5703:         Gid::from_raw(0),
 5704:         0o644,
 5705:         "assignment verifier key",
 5706:     ) {
 5707:         let _ = remove_file_if_present(&verifier_tmp);
 5708:         return Err(err);
 5709:     }
 5710: 
 5711:     Ok(format!(
 5712:         "[assignment-refresh] refreshed signed assignment bundle at {} (generated_at_unix={} expires_at_unix={})",
 5713:         bundle_path.display(),
 5714:         generated_at_unix,
 5715:         expires_at_unix
 5716:     ))
 5717: }

 5719: fn execute_ops_state_refresh_if_socket_present() -> Result<String, String> {
 5720:     require_root_execution()?;
 5721: 
 5722:     let socket_path = env_path_or_default("RUSTYNET_SOCKET", DEFAULT_DAEMON_SOCKET_PATH)?;
 5723:     let socket_present = socket_exists_and_is_socket(socket_path.as_path(), "daemon socket")?;
 5724:     if !socket_present {
 5725:         return Ok(format!(
 5726:             "state refresh skipped: daemon socket is absent ({})",
 5727:             socket_path.display()
 5728:         ));
 5729:     }
 5730: 
 5731:     let response = send_command_with_socket(IpcCommand::StateRefresh, socket_path.clone())?;
 5732:     if response.ok {
 5733:         Ok(response.message)
 5734:     } else {
 5735:         Err(response.message)
 5736:     }
 5737: }

 5739: fn execute_ops_verify_runtime_binary_custody() -> Result<String, String> {
 5740:     enforce_pinned_runtime_binary_custody("runtime-binary-custody")?;
 5741:     Ok(format!(
 5742:         "runtime binary custody verification passed: {PINNED_RUNTIME_RUSTYNET_BIN}"
 5743:     ))
 5744: }
 5745: 
 5746: fn enforce_pinned_runtime_binary_custody(context: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
 5747:     let pinned_path = Path::new(PINNED_RUNTIME_RUSTYNET_BIN);
 5748:     let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(pinned_path).map_err(|err| {
 5749:         format!(
 5750:             "[{context}] required executable not found: {} ({err})",
 5751:             pinned_path.display()
 5752:         )
 5753:     })?;
 5754:     if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
 5755:         return Err(format!(
 5756:             "[{context}] pinned binary must not be a symlink: {}",
 5757:             pinned_path.display()
 5758:         ));
 5759:     }
 5760:     if !metadata.file_type().is_file() {
 5761:         return Err(format!(
 5762:             "[{context}] pinned binary must be a regular file: {}",
 5763:             pinned_path.display()
 5764:         ));
 5765:     }
 5766:     let mode = metadata.permissions().mode() & 0o777;
 5767:     if mode & 0o111 == 0 {
 5768:         return Err(format!(
 5769:             "[{context}] pinned binary is not executable: {}",
 5770:             pinned_path.display()
 5771:         ));
 5772:     }
 5773:     if metadata.uid() != 0 {
 5774:         return Err(format!(
 5775:             "[{context}] pinned binary must be root-owned: {}",
 5776:             pinned_path.display()
 5777:         ));
 5778:     }
 5779:     if mode & 0o022 != 0 {
 5780:         return Err(format!(
 5781:             "[{context}] pinned binary must not be group/world writable: {} ({:03o})",
 5782:             pinned_path.display(),
 5783:             mode
 5784:         ));
 5785:     }
 5786: 
 5787:     let current_exe = std::env::current_exe()
 5788:         .map_err(|err| format!("[{context}] resolve current executable failed: {err}"))?;
 5789:     let current_canonical = fs::canonicalize(current_exe.as_path()).unwrap_or(current_exe);
 5790:     let pinned_canonical = fs::canonicalize(pinned_path).map_err(|err| {
 5791:         format!(
 5792:             "[{context}] canonicalize pinned binary failed ({}): {err}",
 5793:             pinned_path.display()
 5794:         )
 5795:     })?;
 5796:     if current_canonical != pinned_canonical {
 5797:         return Err(format!(
 5798:             "[{context}] unexpected executable path: expected {} got {}",
 5799:             pinned_canonical.display(),
 5800:             current_canonical.display()
 5801:         ));
 5802:     }
 5803:     Ok(())
 5804: }

 5806: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
 5807: enum Phase6Platform {
 5808:     Linux,
 5809:     Macos,
 5810:     Windows,
 5811: }
 5812: 
 5813: impl Phase6Platform {
 5814:     fn as_str(self) -> &'static str {
 5815:         match self {
 5816:             Self::Linux => "linux",
 5817:             Self::Macos => "macos",
 5818:             Self::Windows => "windows",
 5819:         }
 5820:     }
 5821: 
 5822:     fn raw_filename(self) -> &'static str {
 5823:         match self {
 5824:             Self::Linux => "platform_parity_linux.json",
 5825:             Self::Macos => "platform_parity_macos.json",
 5826:             Self::Windows => "platform_parity_windows.json",
 5827:         }
 5828:     }
 5829: 
 5830:     fn probe_source_env_var(self) -> &'static str {
 5831:         match self {
 5832:             Self::Linux => "RUSTYNET_PHASE6_LINUX_PROBE_SOURCE",
 5833:             Self::Macos => "RUSTYNET_PHASE6_MACOS_PROBE_SOURCE",
 5834:             Self::Windows => "RUSTYNET_PHASE6_WINDOWS_PROBE_SOURCE",
 5835:         }
 5836:     }
 5837: 
 5838:     fn all() -> [Self; 3] {
 5839:         [Self::Linux, Self::Macos, Self::Windows]
 5840:     }
 5841: }
