 5843: fn execute_ops_collect_platform_probe() -> Result<String, String> {
 5844:     let out_path = collect_platform_probe_artifact()?;
 5845:     Ok(format!("wrote platform probe: {}", out_path.display()))
 5846: }
 5847: 
 5848: fn execute_ops_generate_platform_parity_report() -> Result<String, String> {
 5849:     let out_path = generate_platform_parity_report_artifact()?;
 5850:     phase6_validate_platform_parity_report(out_path.as_path())?;
 5851:     ops_phase9::write_phase6_parity_evidence_attestation(out_path.as_path())?;
 5852:     ops_phase9::execute_ops_verify_phase6_parity_evidence()?;
 5853:     Ok(format!(
 5854:         "wrote platform parity report: {}",
 5855:         out_path.display()
 5856:     ))
 5857: }
 5858: 
 5859: fn execute_ops_collect_platform_parity_bundle() -> Result<String, String> {
 5860:     let raw_dir = env_path_or_default(
 5861:         "RUSTYNET_PHASE6_PARITY_RAW_DIR",
 5862:         DEFAULT_PHASE6_PARITY_RAW_DIR,
 5863:     )?;
 5864:     let inbox_dir = env_path_or_default(
 5865:         "RUSTYNET_PHASE6_PARITY_INBOX_DIR",
 5866:         DEFAULT_PHASE6_PARITY_INBOX_DIR,
 5867:     )?;
 5868: 
 5869:     fs::create_dir_all(&raw_dir).map_err(|err| {
 5870:         format!(
 5871:             "create parity raw directory failed ({}): {err}",
 5872:             raw_dir.display()
 5873:         )
 5874:     })?;
 5875:     fs::create_dir_all(&inbox_dir).map_err(|err| {
 5876:         format!(
 5877:             "create parity inbox directory failed ({}): {err}",
 5878:             inbox_dir.display()
 5879:         )
 5880:     })?;
 5881: 
 5882:     let now_unix = unix_now();
 5883:     for platform in Phase6Platform::all() {
 5884:         let inbox_path = inbox_dir.join(platform.raw_filename());
 5885:         phase6_stage_probe_from_source_env(platform, inbox_path.as_path(), now_unix)?;
 5886:     }
 5887: 
 5888:     collect_platform_probe_artifact()?;
 5889: 
 5890:     for platform in Phase6Platform::all() {
 5891:         let raw_path = raw_dir.join(platform.raw_filename());
 5892:         let inbox_path = inbox_dir.join(platform.raw_filename());
 5893:         phase6_sync_platform_probe_from_inbox(
 5894:             platform,
 5895:             raw_path.as_path(),
 5896:             inbox_path.as_path(),
 5897:             now_unix,
 5898:         )?;
 5899:     }
 5900: 
 5901:     let report_path = generate_platform_parity_report_artifact()?;
 5902:     phase6_validate_platform_parity_report(report_path.as_path())?;
 5903:     ops_phase9::write_phase6_parity_evidence_attestation(report_path.as_path())?;
 5904:     ops_phase9::execute_ops_verify_phase6_parity_evidence()?;
 5905: 
 5906:     Ok("phase6 platform parity bundle generated from probes".to_string())
 5907: }
 5908: 
 5909: #[derive(Debug, Clone)]
 5910: struct Phase6ProbeMetadata {
 5911:     payload: Value,
 5912:     probe_time_unix: u64,
 5913:     is_fresh: bool,
 5914: }
 5915: 
 5916: fn phase6_load_probe_metadata(
 5917:     path: &Path,
 5918:     platform: Phase6Platform,
 5919:     now_unix: u64,
 5920: ) -> Result<Option<Phase6ProbeMetadata>, String> {
 5921:     if !path.exists() {
 5922:         return Ok(None);
 5923:     }
 5924: 
 5925:     let payload = read_json_value(path, "platform parity probe")?;
 5926:     let payload_obj = payload.as_object().ok_or_else(|| {
 5927:         format!(
 5928:             "platform parity probe must be JSON object: {}",
 5929:             path.display()
 5930:         )
 5931:     })?;
 5932:     if payload_obj
 5933:         .get("evidence_mode")
 5934:         .and_then(Value::as_str)
 5935:         .is_none_or(|mode| mode != "measured")
 5936:     {
 5937:         return Err(format!(
 5938:             "platform parity probe must set evidence_mode=measured: {}",
 5939:             path.display()
 5940:         ));
 5941:     }
 5942: 
 5943:     let payload_platform = payload_obj
 5944:         .get("platform")
 5945:         .and_then(Value::as_str)
 5946:         .map(str::trim)
 5947:         .unwrap_or_default()
 5948:         .to_ascii_lowercase();
 5949:     if payload_platform != platform.as_str() {
 5950:         return Err(format!(
 5951:             "platform parity probe platform mismatch: expected {} got {} ({})",
 5952:             platform.as_str(),
 5953:             if payload_platform.is_empty() {
 5954:                 "<missing>"
 5955:             } else {
 5956:                 payload_platform.as_str()
 5957:             },
 5958:             path.display()
 5959:         ));
 5960:     }
 5961: 
 5962:     let probe_time_unix = payload_obj
 5963:         .get("probe_time_unix")
 5964:         .and_then(Value::as_u64)
 5965:         .ok_or_else(|| {
 5966:             format!(
 5967:                 "platform parity probe requires positive integer probe_time_unix: {}",
 5968:                 path.display()
 5969:             )
 5970:         })?;
 5971:     if probe_time_unix == 0 {
 5972:         return Err(format!(
 5973:             "platform parity probe requires positive integer probe_time_unix: {}",
 5974:             path.display()
 5975:         ));
 5976:     }
 5977:     if probe_time_unix > now_unix.saturating_add(300) {
 5978:         return Err(format!(
 5979:             "platform parity probe probe_time_unix is too far in the future: {}",
 5980:             path.display()
 5981:         ));
 5982:     }
 5983: 
 5984:     Ok(Some(Phase6ProbeMetadata {
 5985:         payload,
 5986:         probe_time_unix,
 5987:         is_fresh: now_unix.saturating_sub(probe_time_unix) <= PHASE6_MAX_EVIDENCE_AGE_SECS,
 5988:     }))
 5989: }
 5990: 
 5991: fn phase6_stage_probe_from_source_env(
 5992:     platform: Phase6Platform,
 5993:     inbox_path: &Path,
 5994:     now_unix: u64,
 5995: ) -> Result<(), String> {
 5996:     let Some(source_path) =
 5997:         env_optional_string(platform.probe_source_env_var())?.map(PathBuf::from)
 5998:     else {
 5999:         return Ok(());
 6000:     };
 6001: 
 6002:     phase6_stage_probe_from_source(platform, source_path.as_path(), inbox_path, now_unix)
 6003: }
 6004: 
 6005: fn phase6_stage_probe_from_source(
 6006:     platform: Phase6Platform,
 6007:     source_path: &Path,
 6008:     inbox_path: &Path,
 6009:     now_unix: u64,
 6010: ) -> Result<(), String> {
 6011:     let metadata =
 6012:         phase6_load_probe_metadata(source_path, platform, now_unix)?.ok_or_else(|| {
 6013:             format!(
 6014:                 "phase6 external platform probe missing: {}",
 6015:                 source_path.display()
 6016:             )
 6017:         })?;
 6018:     if !metadata.is_fresh {
 6019:         return Err(format!(
 6020:             "phase6 external platform probe is stale; recollect probe evidence: {}",
 6021:             source_path.display()
 6022:         ));
 6023:     }
 6024: 
 6025:     write_json_pretty_file(inbox_path, &metadata.payload)?;
 6026:     Ok(())
 6027: }
 6028: 
 6029: fn phase6_sync_platform_probe_from_inbox(
 6030:     platform: Phase6Platform,
 6031:     raw_path: &Path,
 6032:     inbox_path: &Path,
 6033:     now_unix: u64,
 6034: ) -> Result<(), String> {
 6035:     let raw_metadata = phase6_load_probe_metadata(raw_path, platform, now_unix)?;
 6036:     let inbox_metadata = phase6_load_probe_metadata(inbox_path, platform, now_unix)?;
 6037: 
 6038:     let should_import_inbox = match (&raw_metadata, &inbox_metadata) {
 6039:         (None, Some(inbox)) => inbox.is_fresh,
 6040:         (Some(raw), Some(inbox)) => {
 6041:             inbox.is_fresh && (!raw.is_fresh || inbox.probe_time_unix > raw.probe_time_unix)
 6042:         }
 6043:         _ => false,
 6044:     };
 6045: 
 6046:     if should_import_inbox {
 6047:         let inbox_payload = inbox_metadata
 6048:             .as_ref()
 6049:             .expect("inbox metadata must exist when import is selected");
 6050:         write_json_pretty_file(raw_path, &inbox_payload.payload)?;
 6051:     }
 6052: 
 6053:     if raw_path.exists() {
 6054:         return Ok(());
 6055:     }
 6056: 
 6057:     Err(format!(
 6058:         "missing platform parity probe for {}: expected {} or {}",
 6059:         platform.as_str(),
 6060:         raw_path.display(),
 6061:         inbox_path.display()
 6062:     ))
 6063: }
 6064: 
 6065: fn collect_platform_probe_artifact() -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
 6066:     let raw_dir = env_path_or_default(
 6067:         "RUSTYNET_PHASE6_PARITY_RAW_DIR",
 6068:         DEFAULT_PHASE6_PARITY_RAW_DIR,
 6069:     )?;
 6070:     fs::create_dir_all(&raw_dir).map_err(|err| {
 6071:         format!(
 6072:             "create parity raw directory failed ({}): {err}",
 6073:             raw_dir.display()
 6074:         )
 6075:     })?;
 6076: 
 6077:     let platform = phase6_detect_probe_platform()?;
 6078: 
 6079:     let (
 6080:         route_hook_ready,
 6081:         dns_hook_ready,
 6082:         firewall_hook_ready,
 6083:         route_probe_cmd,
 6084:         dns_probe_cmd,
 6085:         firewall_probe_cmd,
 6086:     ) = match platform {
 6087:         Phase6Platform::Linux => {
 6088:             let route_probe_cmd = "ip -o route show default".to_string();
 6089:             let route_hook_ready =
 6090:                 phase6_command_succeeds("ip", &["-o", "route", "show", "default"]);
 6091: 
 6092:             let (dns_hook_ready, dns_probe_cmd) = if phase6_command_available("resolvectl") {
 6093:                 (
 6094:                     phase6_command_succeeds("resolvectl", &["status"]),
 6095:                     "resolvectl status".to_string(),
 6096:                 )
 6097:             } else {
 6098:                 (
 6099:                     phase6_nonempty_file(Path::new("/etc/resolv.conf")),
 6100:                     "test -s /etc/resolv.conf".to_string(),
 6101:                 )
 6102:             };
 6103: 
 6104:             let (firewall_hook_ready, firewall_probe_cmd) = if phase6_command_available("nft") {
 6105:                 (
 6106:                     phase6_command_succeeds("nft", &["list", "tables"]),
 6107:                     "nft list tables".to_string(),
 6108:                 )
 6109:             } else if phase6_command_available("iptables") {
 6110:                 (
 6111:                     phase6_command_succeeds("iptables", &["-S"]),
 6112:                     "iptables -S".to_string(),
 6113:                 )
 6114:             } else {
 6115:                 (false, "nft|iptables unavailable".to_string())
 6116:             };
 6117: 
 6118:             (
 6119:                 route_hook_ready,
 6120:                 dns_hook_ready,
 6121:                 firewall_hook_ready,
 6122:                 route_probe_cmd,
 6123:                 dns_probe_cmd,
 6124:                 firewall_probe_cmd,
 6125:             )
 6126:         }
 6127:         Phase6Platform::Macos => {
 6128:             let contract_ready = phase6_macos_start_contract_ready()?;
 6129:             let route_hook_ready = contract_ready
 6130:                 && phase6_root_owned_command_ready("route", "route")
 6131:                 && phase6_root_owned_command_ready("ifconfig", "ifconfig")
 6132:                 && phase6_root_owned_command_ready("launchctl", "launchctl");
 6133:             let dns_hook_ready = contract_ready
 6134:                 && phase6_root_owned_command_ready("scutil", "scutil")
 6135:                 && phase6_root_owned_command_ready("launchctl", "launchctl");
 6136:             let firewall_hook_ready = contract_ready
 6137:                 && phase6_root_owned_command_ready("pfctl", "pfctl")
 6138:                 && phase6_root_owned_command_ready("launchctl", "launchctl");
 6139:             (
 6140:                 route_hook_ready,
 6141:                 dns_hook_ready,
 6142:                 firewall_hook_ready,
 6143:                 "root-owned route/ifconfig/launchctl + hardened macOS start contract".to_string(),
 6144:                 "root-owned scutil/launchctl + hardened macOS start contract".to_string(),
 6145:                 "root-owned pfctl/launchctl + hardened macOS start contract".to_string(),
 6146:             )
 6147:         }
 6148:         Phase6Platform::Windows => (
 6149:             phase6_command_succeeds(
 6150:                 "powershell.exe",
 6151:                 &[
 6152:                     "-NoProfile",
 6153:                     "-NonInteractive",
 6154:                     "-Command",
 6155:                     "Get-NetRoute -DestinationPrefix '0.0.0.0/0' | Select-Object -First 1 | Out-Null",
 6156:                 ],
 6157:             ),
 6158:             phase6_command_succeeds(
 6159:                 "powershell.exe",
 6160:                 &[
 6161:                     "-NoProfile",
 6162:                     "-NonInteractive",
 6163:                     "-Command",
 6164:                     "Get-DnsClientServerAddress | Out-Null",
 6165:                 ],
 6166:             ),
 6167:             phase6_command_succeeds(
 6168:                 "powershell.exe",
 6169:                 &[
 6170:                     "-NoProfile",
 6171:                     "-NonInteractive",
 6172:                     "-Command",
 6173:                     "Get-NetFirewallProfile | Out-Null",
 6174:                 ],
 6175:             ),
 6176:             "powershell.exe Get-NetRoute".to_string(),
 6177:             "powershell.exe Get-DnsClientServerAddress".to_string(),
 6178:             "powershell.exe Get-NetFirewallProfile".to_string(),
 6179:         ),
 6180:     };
 6181: 
 6182:     let leak_source = phase6_leak_report_source(platform)?;
 6183:     let leak_matrix_passed = phase6_leak_report_passed(Path::new(leak_source.as_str()));
 6184: 
 6185:     let out_path = raw_dir.join(platform.raw_filename());
 6186:     let payload = json!({
 6187:         "evidence_mode": "measured",
 6188:         "platform": platform.as_str(),
 6189:         "route_hook_ready": route_hook_ready,
 6190:         "dns_hook_ready": dns_hook_ready,
 6191:         "firewall_hook_ready": firewall_hook_ready,
 6192:         "leak_matrix_passed": leak_matrix_passed,
 6193:         "probe_time_unix": unix_now(),
 6194:         "probe_host": phase6_probe_host(),
 6195:         "probe_sources": {
 6196:             "route": route_probe_cmd,
 6197:             "dns": dns_probe_cmd,
 6198:             "firewall": firewall_probe_cmd,
 6199:             "leak_report": leak_source,
 6200:         },
 6201:     });
 6202:     write_json_pretty_file(&out_path, &payload)?;
 6203: 
 6204:     let strict_mode = env_string_or_default("RUSTYNET_PHASE6_PARITY_STRICT", "1")?;
 6205:     if strict_mode == "1"
 6206:         && (!route_hook_ready || !dns_hook_ready || !firewall_hook_ready || !leak_matrix_passed)
 6207:     {
 6208:         return Err(format!(
 6209:             "platform parity probe recorded failing controls in {}",
 6210:             out_path.display()
 6211:         ));
 6212:     }
 6213: 
 6214:     Ok(out_path)
 6215: }
 6216: 
 6217: fn generate_platform_parity_report_artifact() -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
 6218:     let raw_dir = env_path_or_default(
 6219:         "RUSTYNET_PHASE6_PARITY_RAW_DIR",
 6220:         DEFAULT_PHASE6_PARITY_RAW_DIR,
 6221:     )?;
 6222:     let out_path = env_path_or_default(
 6223:         "RUSTYNET_PHASE6_PARITY_OUT",
 6224:         DEFAULT_PHASE6_PARITY_REPORT_PATH,
 6225:     )?;
 6226:     let environment = env_required_nonempty(
 6227:         "RUSTYNET_PHASE6_PARITY_ENVIRONMENT",
 6228:         "phase6 parity environment",
 6229:     )?;
 6230: 
 6231:     let mut results = Vec::new();
 6232:     let mut source_artifacts = Vec::new();
 6233:     for platform in Phase6Platform::all() {
 6234:         let source = raw_dir.join(platform.raw_filename());
 6235:         if !source.exists() {
 6236:             return Err(format!(
 6237:                 "missing raw platform parity input: {}",
 6238:                 source.display()
 6239:             ));
 6240:         }
 6241:         let payload = read_json_value(&source, "raw platform parity payload")?;
 6242:         if !payload.is_object() {
 6243:             return Err(format!(
 6244:                 "raw platform parity payload must be object: {}",
 6245:                 source.display()
 6246:             ));
 6247:         }
 6248: 
 6249:         let result = json!({
 6250:             "platform": platform.as_str(),
 6251:             "route_hook_ready": phase6_require_bool_field(&payload, "route_hook_ready", &source)?,
 6252:             "dns_hook_ready": phase6_require_bool_field(&payload, "dns_hook_ready", &source)?,
 6253:             "firewall_hook_ready": phase6_require_bool_field(&payload, "firewall_hook_ready", &source)?,
 6254:             "leak_matrix_passed": phase6_require_bool_field(&payload, "leak_matrix_passed", &source)?,
 6255:         });
 6256:         results.push(result);
 6257:         source_artifacts.push(source.display().to_string());
 6258:     }
 6259: 
 6260:     let report = json!({
 6261:         "evidence_mode": "measured",
 6262:         "captured_at_unix": unix_now(),
 6263:         "environment": environment,
 6264:         "source_artifacts": source_artifacts,
 6265:         "platform_results": results,
 6266:     });
 6267:     write_json_pretty_file(&out_path, &report)?;
 6268:     Ok(out_path)
 6269: }
 6270: 
 6271: fn phase6_detect_probe_platform() -> Result<Phase6Platform, String> {
 6272:     if let Some(override_platform) = env_optional_string("RUSTYNET_PHASE6_PLATFORM_OVERRIDE")? {
 6273:         return match override_platform.to_ascii_lowercase().as_str() {
 6274:             "linux" => Ok(Phase6Platform::Linux),
 6275:             "macos" => Ok(Phase6Platform::Macos),
 6276:             "windows" => Ok(Phase6Platform::Windows),
 6277:             _ => Err(format!(
 6278:                 "unsupported platform override: {override_platform}",
 6279:             )),
 6280:         };
 6281:     }
 6282: 
 6283:     match detect_host_profile() {
 6284:         "linux" => Ok(Phase6Platform::Linux),
 6285:         "macos" => Ok(Phase6Platform::Macos),
 6286:         other => Err(format!("unsupported platform for parity probe: {other}")),
 6287:     }
 6288: }
 6289: 
 6290: fn phase6_leak_report_source(platform: Phase6Platform) -> Result<String, String> {
 6291:     let default_source = env_optional_string("RUSTYNET_PHASE6_LEAK_REPORT")?
 6292:         .unwrap_or_else(|| DEFAULT_PHASE10_LEAK_REPORT_PATH.to_string());
 6293:     let platform_source = match platform {
 6294:         Phase6Platform::Linux => env_optional_string("RUSTYNET_PHASE6_LEAK_REPORT_LINUX")?,
 6295:         Phase6Platform::Macos => env_optional_string("RUSTYNET_PHASE6_LEAK_REPORT_MACOS")?,
 6296:         Phase6Platform::Windows => env_optional_string("RUSTYNET_PHASE6_LEAK_REPORT_WINDOWS")?,
 6297:     };
 6298:     Ok(platform_source.unwrap_or(default_source))
 6299: }
 6300: 
 6301: fn phase6_leak_report_passed(path: &Path) -> bool {
 6302:     if !path.exists() {
 6303:         return false;
 6304:     }
 6305:     let payload = match read_json_value(path, "phase6 leak report") {
 6306:         Ok(payload) => payload,
 6307:         Err(_) => return false,
 6308:     };
 6309:     payload
 6310:         .get("status")
 6311:         .and_then(Value::as_str)
 6312:         .is_some_and(|status| status == "pass")
 6313:         && payload
 6314:             .get("evidence_mode")
 6315:             .and_then(Value::as_str)
 6316:             .is_some_and(|mode| mode == "measured")
 6317: }
 6318: 
 6319: fn phase6_probe_host() -> String {
 6320:     if let Ok(hostname) = std::env::var("HOSTNAME")
 6321:         && !hostname.trim().is_empty()
 6322:     {
 6323:         return hostname;
 6324:     }
 6325:     let output = Command::new("hostname")
 6326:         .stdout(Stdio::piped())
 6327:         .stderr(Stdio::null())
 6328:         .output();
 6329:     if let Ok(output) = output {
 6330:         let hostname = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).trim().to_string();
 6331:         if !hostname.is_empty() {
 6332:             return hostname;
 6333:         }
 6334:     }
 6335:     "unknown".to_string()
 6336: }
 6337: 
 6338: const PHASE6_MACOS_REQUIRED_START_PATTERNS: &[(&str, &str)] = &[
 6339:     (
 6340:         "validate_macos_passphrase_source_contract",
 6341:         "missing macOS passphrase source contract enforcement in start.sh",
 6342:     ),
 6343:     (
 6344:         "configure_macos_binary_path_env",
 6345:         "missing macOS privileged binary custody enforcement in start.sh",
 6346:     ),
 6347:     (
 6348:         "rustynet ops bootstrap-wireguard-custody",
 6349:         "missing Rust-backed macOS WireGuard custody bootstrap in start.sh",
 6350:     ),
 6351:     (
 6352:         "rustynet ops restart-runtime-service",
 6353:         "missing Rust-backed macOS launchd restart path in start.sh",
 6354:     ),
 6355:     (
 6356:         "RUSTYNET_WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE=\"${WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_PATH}\"",
 6357:         "missing macOS passphrase placeholder path wiring in start.sh",
 6358:     ),
 6359:     (
 6360:         "RUSTYNET_WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_KEYCHAIN_ACCOUNT=\"${WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_KEYCHAIN_ACCOUNT}\"",
 6361:         "missing macOS keychain account wiring in start.sh",
 6362:     ),
 6363:     (
 6364:         "RUSTYNET_MACOS_WG_PASSPHRASE_KEYCHAIN_SERVICE=\"${MACOS_WG_PASSPHRASE_KEYCHAIN_SERVICE}\"",
 6365:         "missing macOS keychain service wiring in start.sh",
 6366:     ),
 6367: ];
 6368: 
 6369: const PHASE6_MACOS_FORBIDDEN_START_PATTERNS: &[(&str, &str)] = &[(
 6370:     "install_macos_unprivileged_wireguard_tools",
 6371:     "insecure macOS unprivileged WireGuard fallback is still present in start.sh",
 6372: )];
 6373: 
 6374: fn phase6_workspace_root() -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
 6375:     PathBuf::from(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"))
 6376:         .parent()
 6377:         .and_then(Path::parent)
 6378:         .map(Path::to_path_buf)
 6379:         .ok_or_else(|| "failed to resolve workspace root for phase6 parity probe".to_string())
 6380: }
 6381: 
 6382: fn phase6_macos_start_contract_ready() -> Result<bool, String> {
 6383:     let start_path = phase6_workspace_root()?.join("start.sh");
 6384:     let body = fs::read_to_string(&start_path).map_err(|err| {
 6385:         format!(
 6386:             "read macOS start contract failed ({}): {err}",
 6387:             start_path.display()
 6388:         )
 6389:     })?;
 6390:     phase6_validate_macos_start_contract_text(&body)?;
 6391:     Ok(true)
 6392: }
 6393: 
 6394: fn phase6_validate_macos_start_contract_text(body: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
 6395:     for (pattern, message) in PHASE6_MACOS_REQUIRED_START_PATTERNS {
 6396:         if !body.contains(pattern) {
 6397:             return Err((*message).to_string());
 6398:         }
 6399:     }
 6400:     for (pattern, message) in PHASE6_MACOS_FORBIDDEN_START_PATTERNS {
 6401:         if body.contains(pattern) {
 6402:             return Err((*message).to_string());
 6403:         }
 6404:     }
 6405:     Ok(())
 6406: }
 6407: 
 6408: fn phase6_root_owned_command_ready(command_name: &str, label: &str) -> bool {
 6409:     resolve_absolute_command_path(command_name)
 6410:         .and_then(|path| validate_root_owned_executable_path(path.as_path(), label))
 6411:         .is_ok()
 6412: }
 6413: 
 6414: fn phase6_command_available(command: &str) -> bool {
 6415:     if command.contains('/') {
 6416:         return Path::new(command).is_file();
 6417:     }
 6418: 
 6419:     let Some(path_env) = std::env::var_os("PATH") else {
 6420:         return false;
 6421:     };
 6422:     for directory in std::env::split_paths(&path_env) {
 6423:         let candidate = directory.join(command);
 6424:         if candidate.is_file() {
 6425:             return true;
 6426:         }
 6427:     }
 6428:     false
 6429: }
 6430: 
 6431: fn phase6_command_succeeds(command: &str, args: &[&str]) -> bool {
 6432:     if !phase6_command_available(command) {
 6433:         return false;
 6434:     }
 6435:     Command::new(command)
 6436:         .args(args)
 6437:         .stdout(Stdio::null())
 6438:         .stderr(Stdio::null())
 6439:         .status()
 6440:         .map(|status| status.success())
 6441:         .unwrap_or(false)
 6442: }
 6443: 
 6444: fn phase6_nonempty_file(path: &Path) -> bool {
 6445:     fs::metadata(path)
 6446:         .map(|metadata| metadata.is_file() && metadata.len() > 0)
 6447:         .unwrap_or(false)
 6448: }
 6449: 
 6450: fn write_json_pretty_file(path: &Path, payload: &Value) -> Result<(), String> {
 6451:     let mut body = serde_json::to_string_pretty(payload)
 6452:         .map_err(|err| format!("serialize json failed: {err}"))?;
 6453:     body.push('\n');
 6454:     write_text_file(path, &body)
 6455: }
 6456: 
 6457: fn read_json_value(path: &Path, label: &str) -> Result<Value, String> {
 6458:     let body = fs::read_to_string(path)
 6459:         .map_err(|err| format!("read {label} failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
 6460:     serde_json::from_str(body.as_str())
 6461:         .map_err(|err| format!("parse {label} failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))
 6462: }
 6463: 
 6464: #[allow(dead_code)]
 6465: fn print_json(v: &Value) {
 6466:     println!(
 6467:         "{}",
 6468:         serde_json::to_string_pretty(v).unwrap_or_else(|_| v.to_string())
 6469:     );
 6470: }
 6471: 
 6472: fn phase6_require_bool_field(payload: &Value, key: &str, source: &Path) -> Result<bool, String> {
 6473:     payload
 6474:         .get(key)
 6475:         .and_then(Value::as_bool)
 6476:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("{} requires boolean field: {key}", source.display()))
 6477: }
 6478: 
 6479: pub(crate) fn phase6_validate_platform_parity_report(report_path: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
 6480:     if !report_path.exists() {
 6481:         return Err(format!(
 6482:             "missing platform parity report: {}",
 6483:             report_path.display()
 6484:         ));
 6485:     }
 6486:     let report = read_json_value(report_path, "platform parity report")?;
 6487:     let report_obj = report
 6488:         .as_object()
 6489:         .ok_or_else(|| "platform parity report must be a JSON object".to_string())?;
 6490: 
 6491:     if report_obj
 6492:         .get("evidence_mode")
 6493:         .and_then(Value::as_str)
 6494:         .is_none_or(|value| value != "measured")
 6495:     {
 6496:         return Err("platform parity report must set evidence_mode=measured".to_string());
 6497:     }
 6498: 
 6499:     let captured_at_unix = report_obj
 6500:         .get("captured_at_unix")
 6501:         .and_then(Value::as_u64)
 6502:         .ok_or_else(|| {
 6503:             "platform parity report requires positive integer captured_at_unix".to_string()
 6504:         })?;
 6505:     if captured_at_unix == 0 {
 6506:         return Err(
 6507:             "platform parity report requires positive integer captured_at_unix".to_string(),
 6508:         );
 6509:     }
 6510: 
 6511:     let now_unix = unix_now();
 6512:     if captured_at_unix > now_unix.saturating_add(300) {
 6513:         return Err("platform parity report captured_at_unix is too far in the future".to_string());
 6514:     }
 6515:     if now_unix.saturating_sub(captured_at_unix) > PHASE6_MAX_EVIDENCE_AGE_SECS {
 6516:         return Err(
 6517:             "platform parity report is stale; regenerate with fresh measurements".to_string(),
 6518:         );
 6519:     }
 6520: 
 6521:     let environment = report_obj
 6522:         .get("environment")
 6523:         .and_then(Value::as_str)
 6524:         .ok_or_else(|| "platform parity report requires non-empty environment".to_string())?;
 6525:     if environment.trim().is_empty() {
 6526:         return Err("platform parity report requires non-empty environment".to_string());
 6527:     }
 6528: 
 6529:     if report_obj.contains_key("gate_passed") {
 6530:         return Err("platform parity report must not include gate_passed toggle".to_string());
 6531:     }
 6532: 
 6533:     let source_artifacts = report_obj
 6534:         .get("source_artifacts")
 6535:         .and_then(Value::as_array)
 6536:         .ok_or_else(|| {
 6537:             "platform parity report requires non-empty source_artifacts list".to_string()
 6538:         })?;
 6539:     if source_artifacts.is_empty() {
 6540:         return Err("platform parity report requires non-empty source_artifacts list".to_string());
 6541:     }
 6542: 
 6543:     let required_platforms = Phase6Platform::all()
 6544:         .iter()
 6545:         .map(|platform| platform.as_str().to_string())
 6546:         .collect::<HashSet<_>>();
 6547:     let mut source_by_platform = HashMap::new();
 6548: 
 6549:     for source in source_artifacts {
 6550:         let source_str = source.as_str().ok_or_else(|| {
 6551:             "platform parity report has invalid source_artifacts entry".to_string()
 6552:         })?;
 6553:         if source_str.trim().is_empty() {
 6554:             return Err("platform parity report has invalid source_artifacts entry".to_string());
 6555:         }
 6556:         let mut source_path = PathBuf::from(source_str);
 6557:         if !source_path.is_absolute() {
 6558:             source_path = PathBuf::from(".").join(source_path);
 6559:         }
 6560:         if !source_path.exists() {
 6561:             return Err(format!(
 6562:                 "platform parity source artifact missing: {source_str}"
 6563:             ));
 6564:         }
 6565: 
 6566:         let source_payload = read_json_value(&source_path, "platform parity source artifact")?;
 6567:         let source_obj = source_payload.as_object().ok_or_else(|| {
 6568:             format!("platform parity source artifact must be JSON object: {source_str}")
 6569:         })?;
 6570:         if source_obj
 6571:             .get("evidence_mode")
 6572:             .and_then(Value::as_str)
 6573:             .is_none_or(|mode| mode != "measured")
 6574:         {
 6575:             return Err(format!(
 6576:                 "platform parity source artifact must set evidence_mode=measured: {source_str}"
 6577:             ));
 6578:         }
 6579: 
 6580:         let source_platform = source_obj
 6581:             .get("platform")
 6582:             .and_then(Value::as_str)
 6583:             .ok_or_else(|| {
 6584:                 format!("platform parity source artifact missing platform field: {source_str}")
 6585:             })?
 6586:             .trim()
 6587:             .to_ascii_lowercase();
 6588:         if source_platform.is_empty() {
 6589:             return Err(format!(
 6590:                 "platform parity source artifact missing platform field: {source_str}"
 6591:             ));
 6592:         }
 6593:         if !required_platforms.contains(&source_platform) {
 6594:             return Err(format!(
 6595:                 "platform parity source artifact has unsupported platform: {source_str}"
 6596:             ));
 6597:         }
 6598:         if source_by_platform.contains_key(&source_platform) {
 6599:             return Err(format!(
 6600:                 "duplicate platform parity source artifact for platform: {source_platform}"
 6601:             ));
 6602:         }
 6603: 
 6604:         let probe_time_unix = source_obj
 6605:             .get("probe_time_unix")
 6606:             .and_then(Value::as_u64)
 6607:             .ok_or_else(|| {
 6608:                 format!(
 6609:                     "platform parity source artifact requires positive integer probe_time_unix: {source_str}"
 6610:                 )
 6611:             })?;
 6612:         if probe_time_unix == 0 {
 6613:             return Err(format!(
 6614:                 "platform parity source artifact requires positive integer probe_time_unix: {source_str}"
 6615:             ));
 6616:         }
 6617:         if probe_time_unix > now_unix.saturating_add(300) {
 6618:             return Err(format!(
 6619:                 "platform parity source artifact probe_time_unix is too far in the future: {source_str}"
 6620:             ));
 6621:         }
 6622:         if now_unix.saturating_sub(probe_time_unix) > PHASE6_MAX_EVIDENCE_AGE_SECS {
 6623:             return Err(format!(
 6624:                 "platform parity source artifact is stale; recollect probe evidence: {source_str}"
 6625:             ));
 6626:         }
 6627: 
 6628:         let probe_host = source_obj
 6629:             .get("probe_host")
 6630:             .and_then(Value::as_str)
 6631:             .ok_or_else(|| {
 6632:                 format!(
 6633:                     "platform parity source artifact requires non-empty probe_host: {source_str}"
 6634:                 )
 6635:             })?;
 6636:         if probe_host.trim().is_empty() {
 6637:             return Err(format!(
 6638:                 "platform parity source artifact requires non-empty probe_host: {source_str}"
 6639:             ));
 6640:         }
 6641: 
 6642:         let probe_sources = source_obj
 6643:             .get("probe_sources")
 6644:             .and_then(Value::as_object)
 6645:             .ok_or_else(|| {
 6646:                 format!(
 6647:                     "platform parity source artifact requires probe_sources object: {source_str}"
 6648:                 )
 6649:             })?;
 6650:         for key in ["route", "dns", "firewall", "leak_report"] {
 6651:             let value = probe_sources
 6652:                 .get(key)
 6653:                 .and_then(Value::as_str)
 6654:                 .ok_or_else(|| {
 6655:                     format!(
 6656:                         "platform parity source artifact missing probe source '{key}': {source_str}"
 6657:                     )
 6658:                 })?;
 6659:             if value.trim().is_empty() {
 6660:                 return Err(format!(
 6661:                     "platform parity source artifact missing probe source '{key}': {source_str}"
 6662:                 ));
 6663:             }
 6664:         }
 6665: 
 6666:         source_by_platform.insert(source_platform, source_payload);
 6667:     }
 6668: 
 6669:     let platform_results = report_obj
 6670:         .get("platform_results")
 6671:         .and_then(Value::as_array)
 6672:         .ok_or_else(|| {
 6673:             "platform parity report requires non-empty platform_results list".to_string()
 6674:         })?;
 6675:     if platform_results.is_empty() {
 6676:         return Err("platform parity report requires non-empty platform_results list".to_string());
 6677:     }
 6678: 
 6679:     let mut seen = HashSet::new();
 6680:     for result in platform_results {
 6681:         let result_obj = result.as_object().ok_or_else(|| {
 6682:             "platform parity report has invalid platform_results entry".to_string()
 6683:         })?;
 6684:         let platform = result_obj
 6685:             .get("platform")
 6686:             .and_then(Value::as_str)
 6687:             .ok_or_else(|| "platform parity report entry missing platform".to_string())?
 6688:             .trim()
 6689:             .to_ascii_lowercase();
 6690:         if !required_platforms.contains(&platform) {
 6691:             return Err(format!("unexpected platform in parity report: {platform}"));
 6692:         }
 6693:         seen.insert(platform.clone());
 6694:         let Some(source_payload) = source_by_platform.get(&platform) else {
 6695:             return Err(format!(
 6696:                 "platform parity report missing source artifact for platform: {platform}"
 6697:             ));
 6698:         };
 6699:         for key in [
 6700:             "route_hook_ready",
 6701:             "dns_hook_ready",
 6702:             "firewall_hook_ready",
 6703:             "leak_matrix_passed",
 6704:         ] {
 6705:             let value = result_obj
 6706:                 .get(key)
 6707:                 .and_then(Value::as_bool)
 6708:                 .ok_or_else(|| {
 6709:                     format!("platform parity requirement failed for {platform}: {key} must be true")
 6710:                 })?;
 6711:             if !value {
 6712:                 return Err(format!(
 6713:                     "platform parity requirement failed for {platform}: {key} must be true"
 6714:                 ));
 6715:             }
 6716:             let source_value = source_payload.get(key).and_then(Value::as_bool).ok_or_else(|| {
 6717:                 format!(
 6718:                     "platform parity source requirement failed for {platform}: {key} must be true"
 6719:                 )
 6720:             })?;
 6721:             if !source_value {
 6722:                 return Err(format!(
 6723:                     "platform parity source requirement failed for {platform}: {key} must be true"
 6724:                 ));
 6725:             }
 6726:         }
 6727:     }
 6728: 
 6729:     if seen != required_platforms {
 6730:         let mut missing = required_platforms
 6731:             .difference(&seen)
 6732:             .cloned()
 6733:             .collect::<Vec<_>>();
 6734:         missing.sort();
 6735:         return Err(format!(
 6736:             "platform parity report missing platforms: {}",
 6737:             missing.join(", ")
 6738:         ));
 6739:     }
 6740: 
 6741:     Ok(())
 6742: }

 6815: fn execute_ops_apply_managed_dns_routing() -> Result<String, String> {
 6816:     require_root_execution()?;
 6817:     if !cfg!(target_os = "linux") {
 6818:         return Err("apply-managed-dns-routing is supported on Linux only".to_string());
 6819:     }
 6820: 
 6821:     ensure_systemd_resolved_active()?;
 6822:     let interface = managed_dns_interface_name_from_env()?;
 6823:     wait_for_managed_dns_interface(
 6824:         interface.as_str(),
 6825:         Duration::from_secs(MANAGED_DNS_ROUTING_INTERFACE_WAIT_SECS),
 6826:     )?;
 6827:     let zone_name = managed_dns_zone_name_from_env()?;
 6828:     let resolver_bind_addr = managed_dns_resolver_bind_addr_from_env()?;
 6829:     let resolver_arg = managed_dns_resolver_server_arg(resolver_bind_addr)?;
 6830:     let routing_zone = format!("~{zone_name}");
 6831: 
 6832:     run_resolvectl_action(&["dns", interface.as_str(), resolver_arg.as_str()])?;
 6833:     run_resolvectl_action(&[
 6834:         "domain",
 6835:         interface.as_str(),
 6836:         routing_zone.as_str(),
 6837:         zone_name.as_str(),
 6838:     ])?;
 6839:     run_resolvectl_action(&["default-route", interface.as_str(), "no"])?;
 6840:     run_resolvectl_action(&["status", interface.as_str()])?;
 6841: 
 6842:     Ok(format!(
 6843:         "managed DNS routing applied: interface={interface} zone={zone_name} resolver={resolver_bind_addr}"
 6844:     ))
 6845: }
 6846: 
 6847: fn execute_ops_clear_managed_dns_routing() -> Result<String, String> {
 6848:     require_root_execution()?;
 6849:     if !cfg!(target_os = "linux") {
 6850:         return Err("clear-managed-dns-routing is supported on Linux only".to_string());
 6851:     }
 6852: 
 6853:     let interface = managed_dns_interface_name_from_env()?;
 6854:     if let Err(err) = ensure_systemd_resolved_active() {
 6855:         if managed_dns_routing_already_absent(err.as_str()) {
 6856:             return Ok(format!(
 6857:                 "managed DNS routing already cleared: interface={interface}"
 6858:             ));
 6859:         }
 6860:         return Err(err);
 6861:     }
 6862:     let revert_output = run_command_capture("resolvectl", &["revert", interface.as_str()])
 6863:         .map_err(|err| format!("execute resolvectl revert {interface} failed: {err}"))?;
 6864:     if !revert_output.status.success() {
 6865:         let detail = command_failure_detail(&revert_output);
 6866:         if managed_dns_routing_already_absent(detail.as_str()) {
 6867:             return Ok(format!(
 6868:                 "managed DNS routing already cleared: interface={interface}"
 6869:             ));
 6870:         }
 6871:         return Err(format!("resolvectl revert {interface} failed: {detail}"));
 6872:     }
 6873: 
 6874:     Ok(format!(
 6875:         "managed DNS routing cleared: interface={interface}"
 6876:     ))
 6877: }
 6878: 
 6879: fn managed_dns_routing_already_absent(detail: &str) -> bool {
 6880:     detail.contains("Failed to resolve interface") || detail.contains("No such device")
 6881: }

 6883: fn execute_ops_restart_runtime_service() -> Result<String, String> {
 6884:     require_root_execution()?;
 6885:     if cfg!(target_os = "linux") {
 6886:         let restart_output =
 6887:             run_command_capture("systemctl", &["restart", DEFAULT_RUNTIME_SYSTEMD_SERVICE])?;
 6888:         if !restart_output.status.success() {
 6889:             return Err(format!(
 6890:                 "restart {} failed: {}",
 6891:                 DEFAULT_RUNTIME_SYSTEMD_SERVICE,
 6892:                 command_failure_detail(&restart_output)
 6893:             ));
 6894:         }
 6895: 
 6896:         let active_output = run_command_capture(
 6897:             "systemctl",
 6898:             &["is-active", "--quiet", DEFAULT_RUNTIME_SYSTEMD_SERVICE],
 6899:         )?;
 6900:         if !active_output.status.success() {
 6901:             return Err(format!(
 6902:                 "runtime service is not active after restart: {DEFAULT_RUNTIME_SYSTEMD_SERVICE}"
 6903:             ));
 6904:         }
 6905: 
 6906:         return Ok(format!(
 6907:             "runtime service restarted: {DEFAULT_RUNTIME_SYSTEMD_SERVICE}"
 6908:         ));
 6909:     }
 6910: 
 6911:     if cfg!(target_os = "macos") {
 6912:         return execute_ops_restart_runtime_service_macos();
 6913:     }
 6914: 
 6915:     Err("restart-runtime-service is supported on Linux and macOS only".to_string())
 6916: }

 6953: fn execute_ops_show_runtime_service_status() -> Result<String, String> {
 6954:     require_root_execution()?;
 6955:     if cfg!(target_os = "linux") {
 6956:         let status_output = run_command_capture(
 6957:             "systemctl",
 6958:             &[
 6959:                 "--no-pager",
 6960:                 "--full",
 6961:                 "status",
 6962:                 DEFAULT_RUNTIME_SYSTEMD_SERVICE,
 6963:             ],
 6964:         )?;
 6965:         if !status_output.status.success() {
 6966:             return Err(format!(
 6967:                 "status {} failed: {}",
 6968:                 DEFAULT_RUNTIME_SYSTEMD_SERVICE,
 6969:                 command_failure_detail(&status_output)
 6970:             ));
 6971:         }
 6972: 
 6973:         let stdout = String::from_utf8_lossy(&status_output.stdout)
 6974:             .trim()
 6975:             .to_string();
 6976:         if !stdout.is_empty() {
 6977:             return Ok(stdout);
 6978:         }
 6979:         let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&status_output.stderr)
 6980:             .trim()
 6981:             .to_string();
 6982:         if !stderr.is_empty() {
 6983:             return Ok(stderr);
 6984:         }
 6985:         return Ok(format!(
 6986:             "runtime service status available: {DEFAULT_RUNTIME_SYSTEMD_SERVICE}"
 6987:         ));
 6988:     }
 6989: 
 6990:     if cfg!(target_os = "macos") {
 6991:         return execute_ops_show_runtime_service_status_macos();
 6992:     }
 6993: 
 6994:     Err("show-runtime-service-status is supported on Linux and macOS only".to_string())
 6995: }

 7060: fn execute_ops_install_trust_material(
 7061:     verifier_source: PathBuf,
 7062:     trust_source: PathBuf,
 7063:     verifier_dest: PathBuf,
 7064:     trust_dest: PathBuf,
 7065:     daemon_group: String,
 7066: ) -> Result<String, String> {
 7067:     for (path, label) in [
 7068:         (verifier_source.as_path(), "verifier source"),
 7069:         (trust_source.as_path(), "trust source"),
 7070:         (verifier_dest.as_path(), "verifier destination"),
 7071:         (trust_dest.as_path(), "trust destination"),
 7072:     ] {
 7073:         if !path.is_absolute() {
 7074:             return Err(format!("{label} path must be absolute: {}", path.display()));
 7075:         }
 7076:     }
 7077:     ensure_regular_file_no_symlink(&verifier_source, "trust verifier source")?;
 7078:     ensure_regular_file_no_symlink(&trust_source, "trust evidence source")?;
 7079: 
 7080:     let daemon_group = daemon_group.trim().to_string();
 7081:     if daemon_group.is_empty() {
 7082:         return Err("daemon group must not be empty".to_string());
 7083:     }
 7084: 
 7085:     let host_profile = match env_string_or_default("RUSTYNET_HOST_PROFILE", detect_host_profile())?
 7086:         .to_ascii_lowercase()
 7087:         .as_str()
 7088:     {
 7089:         "linux" => SigningPassphraseHostProfile::Linux,
 7090:         "macos" | "darwin" => SigningPassphraseHostProfile::Macos,
 7091:         other => {
 7092:             return Err(format!(
 7093:                 "unsupported host profile for trust material install: {other}"
 7094:             ));
 7095:         }
 7096:     };
 7097: 
 7098:     let (owner_uid, verifier_group_gid, verifier_mode, trust_group_gid, trust_mode, trust_group) =
 7099:         match host_profile {
 7100:             SigningPassphraseHostProfile::Linux => {
 7101:                 if !cfg!(target_os = "linux") {
 7102:                     return Err(
 7103:                         "linux host profile for install-trust-material is supported on Linux only"
 7104:                             .to_string(),
 7105:                     );
 7106:                 }
 7107:                 require_root_execution()?;
 7108:                 let owner_uid = Uid::from_raw(0);
 7109:                 let verifier_group_gid = Gid::from_raw(0);
 7110:                 let (trust_group_gid, trust_mode, trust_group) =
 7111:                     match Group::from_name(daemon_group.as_str()).map_err(|err| {
 7112:                         format!("resolve daemon group {daemon_group} failed: {err}")
 7113:                     })? {
 7114:                         Some(group) => (group.gid, 0o640, daemon_group.clone()),
 7115:                         None => (Gid::from_raw(0), 0o644, "root".to_string()),
 7116:                     };
 7117:                 (
 7118:                     owner_uid,
 7119:                     verifier_group_gid,
 7120:                     0o644,
 7121:                     trust_group_gid,
 7122:                     trust_mode,
 7123:                     trust_group,
 7124:                 )
 7125:             }
 7126:             SigningPassphraseHostProfile::Macos => {
 7127:                 if !cfg!(target_os = "macos") {
 7128:                     return Err(
 7129:                         "macos host profile for install-trust-material is supported on macOS only"
 7130:                             .to_string(),
 7131:                     );
 7132:                 }
 7133:                 (
 7134:                     Uid::effective(),
 7135:                     Gid::effective(),
 7136:                     0o644,
 7137:                     Gid::effective(),
 7138:                     0o600,
 7139:                     Gid::effective().as_raw().to_string(),
 7140:                 )
 7141:             }
 7142:         };
 7143: 
 7144:     install_trust_material_file(
 7145:         verifier_source.as_path(),
 7146:         verifier_dest.as_path(),
 7147:         owner_uid,
 7148:         verifier_group_gid,
 7149:         verifier_mode,
 7150:         "trust verifier key",
 7151:     )?;
 7152:     install_trust_material_file(
 7153:         trust_source.as_path(),
 7154:         trust_dest.as_path(),
 7155:         owner_uid,
 7156:         trust_group_gid,
 7157:         trust_mode,
 7158:         "trust evidence",
 7159:     )?;
 7160: 
 7161:     Ok(format!(
 7162:         "trust material installed: verifier={} trust={} trust_group={} trust_mode={:03o}",
 7163:         verifier_dest.display(),
 7164:         trust_dest.display(),
 7165:         trust_group,
 7166:         trust_mode
 7167:     ))
 7168: }
 7169: 
 7170: fn install_trust_material_file(
 7171:     source_path: &Path,
 7172:     destination_path: &Path,
 7173:     owner: Uid,
 7174:     group: Gid,
 7175:     mode: u32,
 7176:     label: &str,
 7177: ) -> Result<(), String> {
 7178:     if let Ok(destination_metadata) = fs::symlink_metadata(destination_path) {
 7179:         if destination_metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
 7180:             return Err(format!(
 7181:                 "{label} destination must not be a symlink: {}",
 7182:                 destination_path.display()
 7183:             ));
 7184:         }
 7185:         if !destination_metadata.file_type().is_file() {
 7186:             return Err(format!(
 7187:                 "{label} destination must be a regular file: {}",
 7188:                 destination_path.display()
 7189:             ));
 7190:         }
 7191:     }
 7192: 
 7193:     let destination_parent = destination_path.parent().ok_or_else(|| {
 7194:         format!(
 7195:             "{label} destination has no parent directory: {}",
 7196:             destination_path.display()
 7197:         )
 7198:     })?;
 7199:     let destination_parent_metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(destination_parent).map_err(|err| {
 7200:         format!(
 7201:             "inspect {label} destination parent failed ({}): {err}",
 7202:             destination_parent.display()
 7203:         )
 7204:     })?;
 7205:     if destination_parent_metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
 7206:         return Err(format!(
 7207:             "{label} destination parent must not be a symlink: {}",
 7208:             destination_parent.display()
 7209:         ));
 7210:     }
 7211:     if !destination_parent_metadata.file_type().is_dir() {
 7212:         return Err(format!(
 7213:             "{label} destination parent must be a directory: {}",
 7214:             destination_parent.display()
 7215:         ));
 7216:     }
 7217: 
 7218:     let temp_path = create_secure_temp_file(destination_parent, "rustynet.ops.trust-material.")?;
 7219:     if let Err(err) = fs::copy(source_path, temp_path.as_path()) {
 7220:         let _ = remove_file_if_present(temp_path.as_path());
 7221:         return Err(format!(
 7222:             "copy {label} source {} failed: {err}",
 7223:             source_path.display()
 7224:         ));
 7225:     }
 7226:     if let Err(err) = publish_file_with_owner_mode(
 7227:         temp_path.as_path(),
 7228:         destination_path,
 7229:         owner,
 7230:         group,
 7231:         mode,
 7232:         label,
 7233:     ) {
 7234:         let _ = remove_file_if_present(temp_path.as_path());
 7235:         return Err(err);
 7236:     }
 7237:     Ok(())
 7238: }
 7239: 
 7240: fn execute_ops_disconnect_cleanup() -> Result<String, String> {
 7241:     require_root_execution()?;
 7242:     if cfg!(target_os = "macos") {
 7243:         return execute_ops_disconnect_cleanup_macos();
 7244:     }
 7245:     if !cfg!(target_os = "linux") {
 7246:         return Err("disconnect-cleanup is supported on Linux and macOS only".to_string());
 7247:     }
 7248: 
 7249:     let interface = env_string_or_default("RUSTYNET_WG_INTERFACE", DEFAULT_WG_INTERFACE)?
 7250:         .trim()
 7251:         .to_string();
 7252:     validate_managed_dns_interface_name(interface.as_str())?;
 7253: 
 7254:     let mut errors = Vec::new();
 7255:     let mut service_was_active = false;
 7256:     let mut service_stopped = false;
 7257:     let mut interface_present = false;
 7258:     let mut interface_removed = false;
 7259:     let mut routes_flushed = false;
 7260:     let mut policy_rules_removed = 0usize;
 7261:     let mut nft_tables_removed = 0usize;
 7262:     let mut ipv6_restored = false;
 7263: 
 7264:     match run_command_capture(
 7265:         "systemctl",
 7266:         &["is-active", "--quiet", DEFAULT_RUNTIME_SYSTEMD_SERVICE],
 7267:     ) {
 7268:         Ok(output) => {
 7269:             if output.status.success() {
 7270:                 service_was_active = true;
 7271:                 match run_command_capture("systemctl", &["stop", DEFAULT_RUNTIME_SYSTEMD_SERVICE]) {
 7272:                     Ok(stop_output) => {
 7273:                         if stop_output.status.success() {
 7274:                             service_stopped = true;
 7275:                         } else {
 7276:                             errors.push(format!(
 7277:                                 "stop {} failed: {}",
 7278:                                 DEFAULT_RUNTIME_SYSTEMD_SERVICE,
 7279:                                 command_failure_detail(&stop_output)
 7280:                             ));
 7281:                         }
 7282:                     }
 7283:                     Err(err) => errors.push(err),
 7284:                 }
 7285:             }
 7286:         }
 7287:         Err(err) => errors.push(err),
 7288:     }
 7289: 
 7290:     match run_command_capture("ip", &["link", "show", "dev", interface.as_str()]) {
 7291:         Ok(show_output) => {
 7292:             if show_output.status.success() {
 7293:                 interface_present = true;
 7294:                 match run_command_capture("ip", &["link", "del", "dev", interface.as_str()]) {
 7295:                     Ok(delete_output) => {
 7296:                         if delete_output.status.success() {
 7297:                             interface_removed = true;
 7298:                         } else {
 7299:                             errors.push(format!(
 7300:                                 "remove interface {} failed: {}",
 7301:                                 interface,
 7302:                                 command_failure_detail(&delete_output)
 7303:                             ));
 7304:                         }
 7305:                     }
 7306:                     Err(err) => errors.push(err),
 7307:                 }
 7308:             } else {
 7309:                 let detail = command_failure_detail(&show_output);
 7310:                 if !is_interface_absent_detail(detail.as_str()) {
 7311:                     errors.push(format!("inspect interface {interface} failed: {detail}"));
 7312:                 }
 7313:             }
 7314:         }
 7315:         Err(err) => errors.push(err),
 7316:     }
 7317: 
 7318:     match run_command_capture(
 7319:         "ip",
 7320:         &["route", "show", "table", DEFAULT_DISCONNECT_ROUTE_TABLE],
 7321:     ) {
 7322:         Ok(routes_output) => {
 7323:             if !routes_output.status.success() {
 7324:                 errors.push(format!(
 7325:                     "inspect route table {} failed: {}",
 7326:                     DEFAULT_DISCONNECT_ROUTE_TABLE,
 7327:                     command_failure_detail(&routes_output)
 7328:                 ));
 7329:             } else {
 7330:                 let has_routes = !String::from_utf8_lossy(&routes_output.stdout)
 7331:                     .trim()
 7332:                     .is_empty();
 7333:                 if has_routes {
 7334:                     match run_command_capture(
 7335:                         "ip",
 7336:                         &["route", "flush", "table", DEFAULT_DISCONNECT_ROUTE_TABLE],
 7337:                     ) {
 7338:                         Ok(flush_output) => {
 7339:                             if flush_output.status.success() {
 7340:                                 routes_flushed = true;
 7341:                             } else {
 7342:                                 errors.push(format!(
 7343:                                     "flush route table {} failed: {}",
 7344:                                     DEFAULT_DISCONNECT_ROUTE_TABLE,
 7345:                                     command_failure_detail(&flush_output)
 7346:                                 ));
 7347:                             }
 7348:                         }
 7349:                         Err(err) => errors.push(err),
 7350:                     }
 7351:                 }
 7352:             }
 7353:         }
 7354:         Err(err) => errors.push(err),
 7355:     }
 7356: 
 7357:     loop {
 7358:         match run_command_capture("ip", &["rule", "list"]) {
 7359:             Ok(rule_output) => {
 7360:                 if !rule_output.status.success() {
 7361:                     errors.push(format!(
 7362:                         "list ip rules failed: {}",
 7363:                         command_failure_detail(&rule_output)
 7364:                     ));
 7365:                     break;
 7366:                 }
 7367:                 let rules = String::from_utf8_lossy(&rule_output.stdout);
 7368:                 if !contains_ip_rule_lookup_table(rules.as_ref(), DEFAULT_DISCONNECT_ROUTE_TABLE) {
 7369:                     break;
 7370:                 }
 7371:                 match run_command_capture(
 7372:                     "ip",
 7373:                     &["rule", "del", "table", DEFAULT_DISCONNECT_ROUTE_TABLE],
 7374:                 ) {
 7375:                     Ok(delete_output) => {
 7376:                         if delete_output.status.success() {
 7377:                             policy_rules_removed += 1;
 7378:                         } else {
 7379:                             errors.push(format!(
 7380:                                 "remove policy rule lookup {} failed: {}",
 7381:                                 DEFAULT_DISCONNECT_ROUTE_TABLE,
 7382:                                 command_failure_detail(&delete_output)
 7383:                             ));
 7384:                             break;
 7385:                         }
 7386:                     }
 7387:                     Err(err) => {
 7388:                         errors.push(err);
 7389:                         break;
 7390:                     }
 7391:                 }
 7392:             }
 7393:             Err(err) => {
 7394:                 errors.push(err);
 7395:                 break;
 7396:             }
 7397:         }
 7398:     }
 7399: 
 7400:     if command_available("nft") {
 7401:         match run_command_capture("nft", &["list", "tables"]) {
 7402:             Ok(tables_output) => {
 7403:                 if !tables_output.status.success() {
 7404:                     errors.push(format!(
 7405:                         "enumerate nft tables failed: {}",
 7406:                         command_failure_detail(&tables_output)
 7407:                     ));
 7408:                 } else {
 7409:                     let tables = String::from_utf8_lossy(&tables_output.stdout);
 7410:                     for line in tables.lines() {
 7411:                         let fields = line.split_whitespace().collect::<Vec<_>>();
 7412:                         if fields.len() != 3 || fields[0] != "table" {
 7413:                             continue;
 7414:                         }
 7415:                         let family = fields[1];
 7416:                         let table_name = fields[2];
 7417:                         let managed = (family == "inet" && table_name.starts_with("rustynet_g"))
 7418:                             || (family == "ip" && table_name.starts_with("rustynet_nat_g"));
 7419:                         if !managed {
 7420:                             continue;
 7421:                         }
 7422:                         match run_command_capture("nft", &["delete", "table", family, table_name]) {
 7423:                             Ok(delete_output) => {
 7424:                                 if delete_output.status.success() {
 7425:                                     nft_tables_removed += 1;
 7426:                                 } else {
 7427:                                     errors.push(format!(
 7428:                                         "delete nft table {} {} failed: {}",
 7429:                                         family,
 7430:                                         table_name,
 7431:                                         command_failure_detail(&delete_output)
 7432:                                     ));
 7433:                                 }
 7434:                             }
 7435:                             Err(err) => errors.push(err),
 7436:                         }
 7437:                     }
 7438:                 }
 7439:             }
 7440:             Err(err) => errors.push(err),
 7441:         }
 7442:     }
 7443: 
 7444:     match run_command_capture("sysctl", &["-w", "net.ipv6.conf.all.disable_ipv6=0"]) {
 7445:         Ok(sysctl_output) => {
 7446:             if sysctl_output.status.success() {
 7447:                 ipv6_restored = true;
 7448:             } else {
 7449:                 errors.push(format!(
 7450:                     "restore IPv6 sysctl failed: {}",
 7451:                     command_failure_detail(&sysctl_output)
 7452:                 ));
 7453:             }
 7454:         }
 7455:         Err(err) => errors.push(err),
 7456:     }
 7457: 
 7458:     if !errors.is_empty() {
 7459:         return Err(format!(
 7460:             "disconnect cleanup completed with residual-state errors: {}",
 7461:             errors.join(" | ")
 7462:         ));
 7463:     }
 7464: 
 7465:     Ok(format!(
 7466:         "disconnect cleanup complete: service_was_active={service_was_active} service_stopped={service_stopped} interface_present={interface_present} interface_removed={interface_removed} routes_flushed={routes_flushed} policy_rules_removed={policy_rules_removed} nft_tables_removed={nft_tables_removed} ipv6_restored={ipv6_restored}"
 7467:     ))
 7468: }

 7485: struct MacosLaunchdRestartConfig {

 7487:     daemon_gid: u32,

 7495:     daemon_environment: Vec<(String, String)>,
 7496: }

 7498: fn execute_ops_restart_runtime_service_macos() -> Result<String, String> {
 7499:     let config = macos_launchd_restart_config_from_env()?;
 7500:     let daemon_uid = Uid::from_raw(config.service.daemon_uid);
 7501:     let daemon_gid = Gid::from_raw(config.daemon_gid);
 7502: 
 7503:     ensure_directory_with_mode_owner(
 7504:         config.runtime_base.as_path(),
 7505:         0o700,
 7506:         Some(daemon_uid),
 7507:         Some(daemon_gid),
 7508:     )?;
 7509:     ensure_directory_with_mode_owner(
 7510:         config.log_base.as_path(),
 7511:         0o700,
 7512:         Some(daemon_uid),
 7513:         Some(daemon_gid),
 7514:     )?;
 7515: 
 7516:     let daemon_plist_parent = config
 7517:         .service
 7518:         .daemon_plist_path
 7519:         .parent()
 7520:         .ok_or_else(|| {
 7521:             format!(
 7522:                 "daemon launchd plist path has no parent: {}",
 7523:                 config.service.daemon_plist_path.display()
 7524:             )
 7525:         })?
 7526:         .to_path_buf();
 7527:     ensure_directory_with_mode_owner(
 7528:         daemon_plist_parent.as_path(),
 7529:         0o700,
 7530:         Some(daemon_uid),
 7531:         Some(daemon_gid),
 7532:     )?;
 7533: 
 7534:     ensure_directory_with_mode_owner(
 7535:         Path::new("/Library/LaunchDaemons"),
 7536:         0o755,
 7537:         Some(Uid::from_raw(0)),
 7538:         Some(Gid::from_raw(0)),
 7539:     )?;
 7540: 
 7541:     let helper_group = Group::from_name("wheel")
 7542:         .map_err(|err| format!("resolve group wheel failed: {err}"))?
 7543:         .map(|group| group.gid)
 7544:         .unwrap_or_else(|| Gid::from_raw(0));
 7545: 
 7546:     write_launchd_plist(
 7547:         config.service.helper_plist_path.as_path(),
 7548:         build_helper_launchd_plist(&config).as_str(),
 7549:         Uid::from_raw(0),
 7550:         helper_group,
 7551:         "macOS privileged helper launchd plist",
 7552:     )?;
 7553:     write_launchd_plist(
 7554:         config.service.daemon_plist_path.as_path(),
 7555:         build_daemon_launchd_plist(&config).as_str(),
 7556:         daemon_uid,
 7557:         daemon_gid,
 7558:         "macOS daemon launchd plist",
 7559:     )?;
 7560: 
 7561:     launchctl_bootout_unit(
 7562:         "system",
 7563:         config.service.helper_label.as_str(),
 7564:         config.service.helper_plist_path.as_path(),
 7565:     )?;
 7566:     launchctl_bootout_unit(
 7567:         config.service.daemon_domain.as_str(),
 7568:         config.service.daemon_label.as_str(),
 7569:         config.service.daemon_plist_path.as_path(),
 7570:     )?;
 7571: 
 7572:     run_launchctl_action(
 7573:         &[
 7574:             "bootstrap",
 7575:             "system",
 7576:             config.service.helper_plist_path.to_string_lossy().as_ref(),
 7577:         ],
 7578:         "launchd helper bootstrap",
 7579:     )?;
 7580:     run_launchctl_action(
 7581:         &["kickstart", "-k", config.service.helper_target.as_str()],
 7582:         "launchd helper kickstart",
 7583:     )?;
 7584:     run_launchctl_action(
 7585:         &[
 7586:             "bootstrap",
 7587:             config.service.daemon_domain.as_str(),
 7588:             config.service.daemon_plist_path.to_string_lossy().as_ref(),
 7589:         ],
 7590:         "launchd daemon bootstrap",
 7591:     )?;
 7592:     run_launchctl_action(
 7593:         &["kickstart", "-k", config.service.daemon_target.as_str()],
 7594:         "launchd daemon kickstart",
 7595:     )?;
 7596: 
 7597:     wait_for_unix_socket(
 7598:         config.service.helper_socket_path.as_path(),
 7599:         "privileged helper socket",
 7600:         Duration::from_secs(MACOS_RUNTIME_SOCKET_WAIT_SECS),
 7601:     )?;
 7602:     wait_for_unix_socket(
 7603:         config.service.daemon_socket_path.as_path(),
 7604:         "daemon socket",
 7605:         Duration::from_secs(MACOS_RUNTIME_SOCKET_WAIT_SECS),
 7606:     )
 7607:     .map_err(|err| {
 7608:         let tail =
 7609:             tail_utf8_lines(config.daemon_log_path.as_path(), 40).unwrap_or_else(|_| String::new());
 7610:         if tail.is_empty() {
 7611:             err
 7612:         } else {
 7613:             format!("{err}; recent daemon log:\n{tail}")
 7614:         }
 7615:     })?;
 7616: 
 7617:     Ok(format!(
 7618:         "runtime service restarted: host=macos daemon_target={} helper_target={} daemon_socket={} helper_socket={}",
 7619:         config.service.daemon_target,
 7620:         config.service.helper_target,
 7621:         config.service.daemon_socket_path.display(),
 7622:         config.service.helper_socket_path.display()
 7623:     ))
 7624: }

 7626: fn macos_launchd_restart_config_from_env() -> Result<MacosLaunchdRestartConfig, String> {
 7627:     let service = macos_runtime_service_context_from_env()?;
 7628:     let daemon_gid = macos_daemon_gid_from_env(service.daemon_uid)?;
 7629: 
 7630:     let runtime_base = env_required_path("RUSTYNET_MACOS_RUNTIME_BASE")?;
 7631:     let log_base = env_required_path("RUSTYNET_MACOS_LOG_BASE")?;
 7632:     let daemon_log_path = env_required_path("RUSTYNET_MACOS_DAEMON_LOG_PATH")?;
 7633:     let helper_log_path = env_required_path("RUSTYNET_MACOS_HELPER_LOG_PATH")?;
 7634:     if !daemon_log_path.starts_with(log_base.as_path()) {
 7635:         return Err(format!(
 7636:             "daemon log path must remain under log base: {}",
 7637:             daemon_log_path.display()
 7638:         ));
 7639:     }
 7640:     if !helper_log_path.starts_with(log_base.as_path()) {
 7641:         return Err(format!(
 7642:             "helper log path must remain under log base: {}",
 7643:             helper_log_path.display()
 7644:         ));
 7645:     }
 7646: 
 7647:     let daemon_binary_path =
 7648:         binary_path_from_env_or_command("RUSTYNET_DAEMON_BINARY_PATH", "rustynetd", "rustynetd")?;
 7649:     let wg_binary_path = binary_path_from_env_or_command("RUSTYNET_WG_BINARY_PATH", "wg", "wg")?;
 7650:     let wireguard_go_binary_path = binary_path_from_env_or_command(
 7651:         "RUSTYNET_WIREGUARD_GO_BINARY_PATH",
 7652:         "wireguard-go",
 7653:         "wireguard-go",
 7654:     )?;
 7655:     let ifconfig_binary_path =
 7656:         binary_path_from_env_or_command("RUSTYNET_IFCONFIG_BINARY_PATH", "ifconfig", "ifconfig")?;
 7657:     let route_binary_path =
 7658:         binary_path_from_env_or_command("RUSTYNET_ROUTE_BINARY_PATH", "route", "route")?;
 7659:     let pfctl_binary_path =
 7660:         binary_path_from_env_or_command("RUSTYNET_PFCTL_BINARY_PATH", "pfctl", "pfctl")?;
 7661:     let kill_binary_path =
 7662:         binary_path_from_env_or_command("RUSTYNET_KILL_BINARY_PATH", "kill", "kill")?;
 7663: 
 7664:     let keychain_account = required_macos_tunnel_keychain_account(
 7665:         env_string_or_default("RUSTYNET_WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_KEYCHAIN_ACCOUNT", "")?.as_str(),
 7666:     )?;
 7667:     let keychain_service = env_required_nonempty(
 7668:         "RUSTYNET_MACOS_WG_PASSPHRASE_KEYCHAIN_SERVICE",
 7669:         "macOS tunnel keychain service",
 7670:     )?;
 7671:     if keychain_service.trim().is_empty() {
 7672:         return Err("macOS tunnel keychain service must not be empty".to_string());
 7673:     }
 7674: 
 7675:     let wg_passphrase_path = env_required_path("RUSTYNET_WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE")?;
 7676:     validate_macos_wg_passphrase_placeholder_path(wg_passphrase_path.as_path())?;
 7677: 
 7678:     let helper_timeout_ms =
 7679:         parse_env_u64_with_default("RUSTYNET_PRIVILEGED_HELPER_TIMEOUT_MS", 2000)?;
 7680: 
 7681:     let auto_tunnel_enforce = parse_bool_value(
 7682:         "RUSTYNET_AUTO_TUNNEL_ENFORCE",
 7683:         env_string_or_default("RUSTYNET_AUTO_TUNNEL_ENFORCE", "false")?.as_str(),
 7684:     )?;
 7685:     let fail_closed_ssh_allow = parse_bool_value(
 7686:         "RUSTYNET_FAIL_CLOSED_SSH_ALLOW",
 7687:         env_string_or_default("RUSTYNET_FAIL_CLOSED_SSH_ALLOW", "false")?.as_str(),
 7688:     )?;
 7689:     let wg_interface = env_string_or_default("RUSTYNET_WG_INTERFACE", DEFAULT_WG_INTERFACE)?
 7690:         .trim()
 7691:         .to_string();
 7692:     validate_managed_dns_interface_name(wg_interface.as_str())?;
 7693:     let wg_listen_port = env_string_or_default("RUSTYNET_WG_LISTEN_PORT", "51820")?
 7694:         .parse::<u16>()
 7695:         .map_err(|err| format!("invalid wireguard listen port: {err}"))?;
 7696:     if wg_listen_port == 0 {
 7697:         return Err("wireguard listen port must be between 1 and 65535".to_string());
 7698:     }
 7699: 
 7700:     let helper_program_arguments = vec![
 7701:         daemon_binary_path.display().to_string(),
 7702:         "privileged-helper".to_string(),
 7703:         "--socket".to_string(),
 7704:         service.helper_socket_path.display().to_string(),
 7705:         "--allowed-uid".to_string(),
 7706:         service.daemon_uid.to_string(),
 7707:         "--allowed-gid".to_string(),
 7708:         daemon_gid.to_string(),
 7709:         "--timeout-ms".to_string(),
 7710:         helper_timeout_ms.to_string(),
 7711:     ];
 7712: 
 7713:     let daemon_program_arguments = vec![
 7714:         daemon_binary_path.display().to_string(),
 7715:         "daemon".to_string(),
 7716:         "--node-id".to_string(),
 7717:         env_required_nonempty("RUSTYNET_NODE_ID", "node id")?,
 7718:         "--node-role".to_string(),
 7719:         env_required_nonempty("RUSTYNET_NODE_ROLE", "node role")?,
 7720:         "--socket".to_string(),
 7721:         service.daemon_socket_path.display().to_string(),
 7722:         "--state".to_string(),
 7723:         env_required_path("RUSTYNET_STATE")?.display().to_string(),
 7724:         "--trust-evidence".to_string(),
 7725:         env_required_path("RUSTYNET_TRUST_EVIDENCE")?
 7726:             .display()

 7887: fn macos_daemon_gid_from_env(daemon_uid: u32) -> Result<u32, String> {
 7888:     if let Some(raw) = env_optional_string("RUSTYNET_MACOS_DAEMON_GID")? {
 7889:         return raw
 7890:             .parse::<u32>()
 7891:             .map_err(|err| format!("invalid daemon gid value '{raw}': {err}"));
 7892:     }
 7893:     if let Some(raw) = env_optional_string("SUDO_GID")? {
 7894:         return raw
 7895:             .parse::<u32>()
 7896:             .map_err(|err| format!("invalid sudo gid value '{raw}': {err}"));
 7897:     }
 7898:     let user = User::from_uid(Uid::from_raw(daemon_uid))
 7899:         .map_err(|err| format!("resolve daemon uid {daemon_uid} failed: {err}"))?
 7900:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("daemon uid {daemon_uid} does not exist"))?;
 7901:     Ok(user.gid.as_raw())
 7902: }

 7904: fn binary_path_from_env_or_command(
 7905:     env_key: &str,
 7906:     command_name: &str,
 7907:     label: &str,
 7908: ) -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
 7909:     let path = if let Some(raw) = env_optional_string(env_key)? {
 7910:         let candidate = PathBuf::from(raw);
 7911:         if !candidate.is_absolute() {
 7912:             return Err(format!(
 7913:                 "{label} binary path must be absolute: {}",
 7914:                 candidate.display()
 7915:             ));
 7916:         }
 7917:         candidate
 7918:     } else {
 7919:         resolve_absolute_command_path(command_name)?
 7920:     };
 7921:     validate_root_owned_executable_path(path.as_path(), label)?;
 7922:     Ok(path)
 7923: }
 7924: 
 7925: fn resolve_absolute_command_path(command_name: &str) -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
 7926:     if command_name.trim().is_empty() {
 7927:         return Err("command name must not be empty".to_string());
 7928:     }
 7929:     if command_name.contains('/') {
 7930:         let path = PathBuf::from(command_name);
 7931:         if !path.is_absolute() {
 7932:             return Err(format!("command path must be absolute: {}", path.display()));
 7933:         }
 7934:         return Ok(path);
 7935:     }
 7936:     let path_env = std::env::var_os("PATH").ok_or_else(|| "PATH is not set".to_string())?;
 7937:     for base in std::env::split_paths(path_env.as_os_str()) {
 7938:         let candidate = base.join(command_name);
 7939:         if let Ok(metadata) = fs::metadata(candidate.as_path())
 7940:             && metadata.is_file()
 7941:             && (metadata.mode() & 0o111) != 0
 7942:         {
 7943:             return Ok(candidate);
 7944:         }
 7945:     }
 7946:     Err(format!(
 7947:         "unable to resolve absolute path for command: {command_name}"
 7948:     ))
 7949: }
 7950: 
 7951: fn validate_root_owned_executable_path(path: &Path, label: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
 7952:     if !path.is_absolute() {
 7953:         return Err(format!(
 7954:             "{label} binary path must be absolute: {}",
 7955:             path.display()
 7956:         ));
 7957:     }
 7958:     let metadata = fs::metadata(path)
 7959:         .map_err(|err| format!("inspect {label} binary failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
 7960:     if !metadata.file_type().is_file() {
 7961:         return Err(format!(
 7962:             "{label} binary path must reference a regular file: {}",
 7963:             path.display()
 7964:         ));
 7965:     }
 7966:     if metadata.uid() != 0 {
 7967:         return Err(format!(
 7968:             "{label} binary must be root-owned for privileged runtime safety: {}",
 7969:             path.display()
 7970:         ));
 7971:     }
 7972:     let mode = metadata.mode() & 0o777;
 7973:     if (mode & 0o022) != 0 {
 7974:         return Err(format!(
 7975:             "{label} binary permissions too broad ({mode:03o}); group/other write is not allowed: {}",
 7976:             path.display()
 7977:         ));
 7978:     }
 7979:     if (mode & 0o111) == 0 {
 7980:         return Err(format!(
 7981:             "{label} binary must be executable: {}",
 7982:             path.display()
 7983:         ));
 7984:     }
 7985:     Ok(())
 7986: }
 7987: 
 7988: fn validate_macos_wg_passphrase_placeholder_path(path: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
 7989:     if !path.is_absolute() {
 7990:         return Err(format!(
 7991:             "macOS passphrase placeholder path must be absolute: {}",
 7992:             path.display()
 7993:         ));
 7994:     }
 7995:     match fs::symlink_metadata(path) {
 7996:         Ok(metadata) => {
 7997:             if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
 7998:                 return Err(format!(
 7999:                     "persistent passphrase placeholder path must not be a symlink: {}",
 8000:                     path.display()
 8001:                 ));
 8002:             }
 8003:             if metadata.file_type().is_file() {
 8004:                 return Err(format!(
 8005:                     "persistent plaintext passphrase file is not allowed on macOS: {}",
 8006:                     path.display()
 8007:                 ));
 8008:             }
 8009:             return Err(format!(
 8010:                 "passphrase placeholder path is occupied and cannot be used: {}",
 8011:                 path.display()
 8012:             ));
 8013:         }
 8014:         Err(err) if err.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound => {}
 8015:         Err(err) => {
 8016:             return Err(format!(
 8017:                 "inspect macOS passphrase placeholder path failed ({}): {err}",
 8018:                 path.display()
 8019:             ));
 8020:         }
 8021:     }
 8022:     Ok(())
 8023: }
