 8045: fn render_launchd_plist(
 8046:     label: &str,
 8047:     program_arguments: &[String],
 8048:     environment: &[(String, String)],
 8049:     stdout_path: &Path,
 8050:     stderr_path: &Path,
 8051: ) -> String {
 8052:     let program_args_xml = render_launchd_string_array(program_arguments, "    ");
 8053:     let environment_xml = render_launchd_environment_dict(environment, "  ");
 8054:     format!(
 8055:         "<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"UTF-8\"?>\n\
 8056: <!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC \"-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN\" \"http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd\">\n\
 8057: <plist version=\"1.0\">\n\
 8058: <dict>\n\
 8059:   <key>Label</key>\n\
 8060:   <string>{}</string>\n\
 8061:   <key>ProgramArguments</key>\n\
 8062:   <array>\n\
 8063: {}\n\
 8064:   </array>\n\
 8065: {}\n\
 8066:   <key>RunAtLoad</key>\n\
 8067:   <true/>\n\
 8068:   <key>KeepAlive</key>\n\
 8069:   <true/>\n\
 8070:   <key>StandardOutPath</key>\n\
 8071:   <string>{}</string>\n\
 8072:   <key>StandardErrorPath</key>\n\
 8073:   <string>{}</string>\n\
 8074: </dict>\n\
 8075: </plist>\n",
 8076:         launchd_xml_escape(label),
 8077:         program_args_xml,
 8078:         environment_xml,
 8079:         launchd_xml_escape(stdout_path.to_string_lossy().as_ref()),
 8080:         launchd_xml_escape(stderr_path.to_string_lossy().as_ref()),
 8081:     )
 8082: }
 8083: 
 8084: fn render_launchd_string_array(values: &[String], indent: &str) -> String {
 8085:     values
 8086:         .iter()
 8087:         .map(|value| {
 8088:             format!(
 8089:                 "{indent}<string>{}</string>",
 8090:                 launchd_xml_escape(value.as_str())
 8091:             )
 8092:         })
 8093:         .collect::<Vec<_>>()
 8094:         .join("\n")
 8095: }
 8096: 
 8097: fn render_launchd_environment_dict(values: &[(String, String)], indent: &str) -> String {
 8098:     if values.is_empty() {
 8099:         return String::new();
 8100:     }
 8101:     let child_indent = format!("{indent}  ");
 8102:     let mut rows = Vec::new();
 8103:     rows.push(format!("{indent}<key>EnvironmentVariables</key>"));
 8104:     rows.push(format!("{indent}<dict>"));
 8105:     for (key, value) in values {
 8106:         rows.push(format!(
 8107:             "{child_indent}<key>{}</key>",
 8108:             launchd_xml_escape(key.as_str())
 8109:         ));
 8110:         rows.push(format!(
 8111:             "{child_indent}<string>{}</string>",
 8112:             launchd_xml_escape(value.as_str())
 8113:         ));
 8114:     }
 8115:     rows.push(format!("{indent}</dict>"));
 8116:     rows.join("\n")
 8117: }
 8118: 
 8119: fn launchd_xml_escape(value: &str) -> String {
 8120:     value
 8121:         .replace('&', "&amp;")
 8122:         .replace('<', "&lt;")
 8123:         .replace('>', "&gt;")
 8124:         .replace('"', "&quot;")
 8125:         .replace('\'', "&apos;")
 8126: }
 8127: 
 8128: fn write_launchd_plist(
 8129:     destination_path: &Path,
 8130:     body: &str,
 8131:     owner: Uid,
 8132:     group: Gid,
 8133:     label: &str,
 8134: ) -> Result<(), String> {
 8135:     let parent = destination_path.parent().ok_or_else(|| {
 8136:         format!(
 8137:             "{label} destination path has no parent directory: {}",
 8138:             destination_path.display()
 8139:         )
 8140:     })?;
 8141:     if let Ok(parent_metadata) = fs::symlink_metadata(parent)
 8142:         && parent_metadata.file_type().is_symlink()
 8143:     {
 8144:         return Err(format!(
 8145:             "{label} destination parent must not be a symlink: {}",
 8146:             parent.display()
 8147:         ));
 8148:     }
 8149: 
 8150:     let temp_path = create_secure_temp_file(parent, "rustynet.ops.launchd.")?;
 8151:     if let Err(err) = write_private_bytes_to_file(temp_path.as_path(), body.as_bytes()) {
 8152:         let _ = remove_file_if_present(temp_path.as_path());
 8153:         return Err(err);
 8154:     }
 8155:     if let Err(err) = publish_file_with_owner_mode(
 8156:         temp_path.as_path(),
 8157:         destination_path,
 8158:         owner,
 8159:         group,
 8160:         0o644,
 8161:         label,
 8162:     ) {
 8163:         let _ = remove_file_if_present(temp_path.as_path());
 8164:         return Err(err);
 8165:     }
 8166:     Ok(())
 8167: }
 8168: 
 8169: fn run_launchctl_action(args: &[&str], label: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
 8170:     let output = run_command_capture("launchctl", args)?;
 8171:     if output.status.success() {
 8172:         return Ok(());
 8173:     }
 8174:     Err(format!(
 8175:         "{} failed: {}",
 8176:         label,
 8177:         command_failure_detail(&output)
 8178:     ))
 8179: }
 8180: 
 8181: fn wait_for_unix_socket(path: &Path, label: &str, timeout: Duration) -> Result<(), String> {
 8182:     if !path.is_absolute() {
 8183:         return Err(format!("{label} path must be absolute: {}", path.display()));
 8184:     }
 8185:     let deadline = Instant::now() + timeout;
 8186:     loop {
 8187:         match fs::symlink_metadata(path) {
 8188:             Ok(metadata) => {
 8189:                 if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
 8190:                     return Err(format!("{label} must not be a symlink: {}", path.display()));
 8191:                 }
 8192:                 if metadata.file_type().is_socket() {
 8193:                     return Ok(());
 8194:                 }
 8195:                 return Err(format!("{label} must be a unix socket: {}", path.display()));
 8196:             }
 8197:             Err(err) if err.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound => {}
 8198:             Err(err) => {
 8199:                 return Err(format!(
 8200:                     "inspect {label} failed ({}): {err}",
 8201:                     path.display()
 8202:                 ));
 8203:             }
 8204:         }
 8205:         if Instant::now() >= deadline {
 8206:             return Err(format!("timed out waiting for {label}: {}", path.display()));
 8207:         }
 8208:         std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(100));
 8209:     }
 8210: }
 8211: 
 8212: fn tail_utf8_lines(path: &Path, max_lines: usize) -> Result<String, String> {
 8213:     if max_lines == 0 {
 8214:         return Ok(String::new());
 8215:     }
 8216:     let body = fs::read_to_string(path)
 8217:         .map_err(|err| format!("read daemon log failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
 8218:     let lines = body.lines().collect::<Vec<_>>();
 8219:     let start = lines.len().saturating_sub(max_lines);
 8220:     Ok(lines[start..].join("\n"))
 8221: }

 8223: fn execute_ops_stop_runtime_service_macos() -> Result<String, String> {
 8224:     let context = macos_runtime_service_context_from_env()?;
 8225:     launchctl_bootout_unit(
 8226:         context.daemon_domain.as_str(),
 8227:         context.daemon_label.as_str(),
 8228:         context.daemon_plist_path.as_path(),
 8229:     )?;
 8230:     launchctl_bootout_unit(
 8231:         "system",
 8232:         context.helper_label.as_str(),
 8233:         context.helper_plist_path.as_path(),
 8234:     )?;
 8235:     remove_socket_if_present(context.daemon_socket_path.as_path(), "daemon socket")?;
 8236:     remove_socket_if_present(
 8237:         context.helper_socket_path.as_path(),
 8238:         "privileged helper socket",
 8239:     )?;
 8240:     Ok(format!(
 8241:         "runtime service stopped: daemon_target={} helper_target={} daemon_socket={} helper_socket={}",
 8242:         context.daemon_target,
 8243:         context.helper_target,
 8244:         context.daemon_socket_path.display(),
 8245:         context.helper_socket_path.display()
 8246:     ))
 8247: }

 8249: fn execute_ops_show_runtime_service_status_macos() -> Result<String, String> {

 8254:             .status

 8265:     )?;
 8266:

 8268:         "runtime service status (macos):\ndaemon_target={} loaded={}\nhelper_target={} loaded={}\ndaemon_socket={} present={}\nhelper_socket={} present={}",
 8269:         context.daemon_target,
 8270:         daemon_loaded,
 8271:         context.helper_target,
 8272:         helper_loaded,
 8273:         context.daemon_socket_path.display(),
 8274:         daemon_socket_present,
 8275:         context.helper_socket_path.display(),
 8276:         helper_socket_present,
 8277:     ))
 8278: }

 8280: fn execute_ops_disconnect_cleanup_macos() -> Result<String, String> {
 8281:     let context = macos_runtime_service_context_from_env()?;
 8282:     let interface = env_string_or_default("RUSTYNET_WG_INTERFACE", DEFAULT_WG_INTERFACE)?
 8283:         .trim()
 8284:         .to_string();
 8285:     validate_managed_dns_interface_name(interface.as_str())?;
 8286: 
 8287:     let mut errors = Vec::new();
 8288:     let mut service_stopped = false;
 8289:     let mut wireguard_go_killed = 0usize;
 8290:     let mut pf_anchors_flushed = 0usize;
 8291: 
 8292:     match execute_ops_stop_runtime_service_macos() {
 8293:         Ok(_) => {
 8294:             service_stopped = true;
 8295:         }
 8296:         Err(err) => errors.push(err),
 8297:     }
 8298: 
 8299:     match run_command_capture("ps", &["-ax", "-o", "pid=", "-o", "command="]) {
 8300:         Ok(ps_output) => {
 8301:             if !ps_output.status.success() {
 8302:                 errors.push(format!(
 8303:                     "enumerate process list failed: {}",
 8304:                     command_failure_detail(&ps_output)
 8305:                 ));
 8306:             } else {
 8307:                 let ps_body = String::from_utf8_lossy(&ps_output.stdout);
 8308:                 match parse_wireguard_go_pids_from_ps(ps_body.as_ref(), interface.as_str()) {
 8309:                     Ok(pids) => {
 8310:                         for pid in pids {
 8311:                             let pid_raw = pid.to_string();
 8312:                             match run_command_capture("kill", &["-TERM", pid_raw.as_str()]) {
 8313:                                 Ok(kill_output) => {
 8314:                                     if kill_output.status.success() {
 8315:                                         wireguard_go_killed += 1;
 8316:                                     } else {
 8317:                                         let detail = command_failure_detail(&kill_output);
 8318:                                         if !detail.contains("No such process") {
 8319:                                             errors.push(format!(
 8320:                                                 "terminate wireguard-go pid {pid} failed: {detail}"
 8321:                                             ));
 8322:                                         }
 8323:                                     }
 8324:                                 }
 8325:                                 Err(err) => errors.push(err),
 8326:                             }
 8327:                         }
 8328:                     }
 8329:                     Err(err) => errors.push(err),
 8330:                 }
 8331:             }
 8332:         }
 8333:         Err(err) => errors.push(err),
 8334:     }
 8335: 
 8336:     match run_command_capture("pfctl", &["-s", "Anchors"]) {
 8337:         Ok(anchor_output) => {
 8338:             if !anchor_output.status.success() {
 8339:                 errors.push(format!(
 8340:                     "enumerate PF anchors failed: {}",
 8341:                     command_failure_detail(&anchor_output)
 8342:                 ));
 8343:             } else {
 8344:                 let body = String::from_utf8_lossy(&anchor_output.stdout);
 8345:                 for anchor in parse_managed_pf_anchors(body.as_ref()) {
 8346:                     match run_command_capture("pfctl", &["-a", anchor.as_str(), "-F", "all"]) {
 8347:                         Ok(flush_output) => {
 8348:                             if flush_output.status.success() {
 8349:                                 pf_anchors_flushed += 1;
 8350:                             } else {
 8351:                                 errors.push(format!(
 8352:                                     "flush PF anchor {} failed: {}",
 8353:                                     anchor,
 8354:                                     command_failure_detail(&flush_output)
 8355:                                 ));
 8356:                             }
 8357:                         }
 8358:                         Err(err) => errors.push(err),
 8359:                     }
 8360:                 }
 8361:             }
 8362:         }
 8363:         Err(err) => errors.push(err),
 8364:     }
 8365: 
 8366:     if !errors.is_empty() {
 8367:         return Err(format!(
 8368:             "disconnect cleanup completed with residual-state errors: {}",
 8369:             errors.join(" | ")
 8370:         ));
 8371:     }
 8372: 
 8373:     Ok(format!(
 8374:         "disconnect cleanup complete: host=macos service_stopped={} daemon_target={} helper_target={} wireguard_go_killed={} pf_anchors_flushed={}",
 8375:         service_stopped,
 8376:         context.daemon_target,
 8377:         context.helper_target,
 8378:         wireguard_go_killed,
 8379:         pf_anchors_flushed
 8380:     ))
 8381: }
 8382: 
 8383: fn parse_managed_pf_anchors(body: &str) -> Vec<String> {
 8384:     let mut anchors = body
 8385:         .lines()
 8386:         .map(str::trim)
 8387:         .filter(|line| line.starts_with("com.apple/rustynet_g"))
 8388:         .map(ToString::to_string)
 8389:         .collect::<Vec<_>>();
 8390:     anchors.sort();
 8391:     anchors.dedup();
 8392:     anchors
 8393: }
 8394: 
 8395: fn parse_wireguard_go_pids_from_ps(ps_output: &str, interface: &str) -> Result<Vec<i32>, String> {
 8396:     let mut pids = Vec::new();
 8397:     for line in ps_output.lines() {
 8398:         let trimmed = line.trim();
 8399:         if trimmed.is_empty() {
 8400:             continue;
 8401:         }
 8402:         let mut fields = trimmed.split_whitespace();
 8403:         let Some(pid_token) = fields.next() else {
 8404:             continue;
 8405:         };
 8406:         let pid = pid_token
 8407:             .parse::<i32>()
 8408:             .map_err(|_| format!("invalid pid token in ps output: {pid_token}"))?;
 8409:         if pid <= 0 {
 8410:             return Err(format!("invalid pid value in ps output: {pid}"));
 8411:         }
 8412:         let command_tokens = fields.collect::<Vec<_>>();
 8413:         if command_tokens
 8414:             .windows(2)
 8415:             .any(|window| window[0].ends_with("wireguard-go") && window[1] == interface)
 8416:         {
 8417:             pids.push(pid);
 8418:         }
 8419:     }
 8420:     pids.sort_unstable();
 8421:     pids.dedup();
 8422:     Ok(pids)
 8423: }

 8425: fn macos_runtime_service_context_from_env() -> Result<MacosRuntimeServiceContext, String> {
 8426:     let daemon_uid = macos_daemon_uid_from_env()?;
 8427:     let daemon_domain = macos_launchd_domain_for_uid(daemon_uid);
 8428:     let daemon_label = env_string_or_default(
 8429:         "RUSTYNET_MACOS_LAUNCHD_DAEMON_LABEL",
 8430:         DEFAULT_MACOS_LAUNCHD_DAEMON_LABEL,
 8431:     )?;
 8432:     validate_launchd_label(daemon_label.as_str(), "daemon launchd label")?;
 8433:     let helper_label = env_string_or_default(
 8434:         "RUSTYNET_MACOS_LAUNCHD_HELPER_LABEL",
 8435:         DEFAULT_MACOS_LAUNCHD_HELPER_LABEL,
 8436:     )?;
 8437:     validate_launchd_label(helper_label.as_str(), "helper launchd label")?;
 8438: 
 8439:     let daemon_plist_path = resolve_macos_daemon_plist_path(daemon_uid, daemon_label.as_str())?;
 8440:     let helper_plist_path = env_path_or_default(
 8441:         "RUSTYNET_MACOS_LAUNCHD_HELPER_PLIST",
 8442:         DEFAULT_MACOS_LAUNCHD_HELPER_PLIST_PATH,
 8443:     )?;
 8444:     let daemon_socket_path = env_path_or_default("RUSTYNET_SOCKET", DEFAULT_DAEMON_SOCKET_PATH)?;
 8445:     let helper_socket_path = env_path_or_default(
 8446:         "RUSTYNET_PRIVILEGED_HELPER_SOCKET",
 8447:         DEFAULT_PRIVILEGED_HELPER_SOCKET_PATH,
 8448:     )?;
 8449: 
 8450:     Ok(MacosRuntimeServiceContext {
 8451:         daemon_uid,
 8452:         daemon_domain: daemon_domain.clone(),
 8453:         daemon_label: daemon_label.clone(),
 8454:         helper_label: helper_label.clone(),
 8455:         daemon_target: format!("{daemon_domain}/{daemon_label}"),
 8456:         helper_target: format!("system/{helper_label}"),
 8457:         daemon_plist_path,
 8458:         helper_plist_path,
 8459:         daemon_socket_path,
 8460:         helper_socket_path,
 8461:     })
 8462: }

 8464: fn macos_daemon_uid_from_env() -> Result<u32, String> {
 8465:     let raw_uid = match env_optional_string("RUSTYNET_MACOS_DAEMON_UID")? {
 8466:         Some(value) => value,
 8467:         None => env_optional_string("SUDO_UID")?
 8468:             .unwrap_or_else(|| Uid::effective().as_raw().to_string()),
 8469:     };
 8470:     let daemon_uid = raw_uid
 8471:         .parse::<u32>()
 8472:         .map_err(|err| format!("invalid daemon uid value '{raw_uid}': {err}"))?;
 8473:     if daemon_uid == 0 {
 8474:         return Err("daemon uid must be a non-root user on macOS".to_string());
 8475:     }
 8476:     Ok(daemon_uid)
 8477: }

 8479: fn macos_launchd_domain_for_uid(uid: u32) -> String {
 8480:     let gui_domain = format!("gui/{uid}");
 8481:     match run_command_capture("launchctl", &["print", gui_domain.as_str()]) {
 8482:         Ok(output) if output.status.success() => gui_domain,
 8483:         _ => format!("user/{uid}"),
 8484:     }
 8485: }

 8487: fn validate_launchd_label(label: &str, field_name: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
 8488:     if label.trim().is_empty() {
 8489:         return Err(format!("{field_name} must not be empty"));
 8490:     }
 8491:     if !label
 8492:         .chars()
 8493:         .all(|ch| ch.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(ch, '.' | '_' | '-'))
 8494:     {
 8495:         return Err(format!("{field_name} contains invalid characters"));
 8496:     }
 8497:     Ok(())
 8498: }

 8500: fn resolve_macos_daemon_plist_path(daemon_uid: u32, daemon_label: &str) -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
 8501:     if let Some(explicit_path) = env_optional_string("RUSTYNET_MACOS_LAUNCHD_DAEMON_PLIST")? {
 8502:         let path = PathBuf::from(explicit_path);
 8503:         if !path.is_absolute() {
 8504:             return Err(format!(
 8505:                 "daemon launchd plist path must be absolute: {}",
 8506:                 path.display()
 8507:             ));
 8508:         }
 8509:         return Ok(path);
 8510:     }
 8511: 
 8512:     let user = User::from_uid(Uid::from_raw(daemon_uid))
 8513:         .map_err(|err| format!("resolve daemon uid {daemon_uid} failed: {err}"))?
 8514:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("daemon uid {daemon_uid} does not exist"))?;
 8515:     Ok(user
 8516:         .dir
 8517:         .join("Library/LaunchAgents")
 8518:         .join(format!("{daemon_label}.plist")))
 8519: }

 8521: fn launchctl_bootout_unit(domain: &str, label: &str, plist_path: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
 8522:     if !plist_path.is_absolute() {
 8523:         return Err(format!(
 8524:             "launchd plist path must be absolute: {}",
 8525:             plist_path.display()
 8526:         ));
 8527:     }
 8528:     let target = format!("{domain}/{label}");
 8529:     let plist_arg = plist_path.to_string_lossy().to_string();
 8530: 
 8531:     let target_output = run_command_capture("launchctl", &["bootout", target.as_str()])?;
 8532:     if target_output.status.success() {
 8533:         return Ok(());
 8534:     }
 8535: 
 8536:     let domain_output = run_command_capture("launchctl", &["bootout", domain, plist_arg.as_str()])?;
 8537:     if domain_output.status.success() {
 8538:         return Ok(());
 8539:     }
 8540: 
 8541:     let print_output = run_command_capture("launchctl", &["print", target.as_str()])?;
 8542:     if !print_output.status.success() {
 8543:         return Ok(());
 8544:     }
 8545: 
 8546:     Err(format!(
 8547:         "failed to unload launchd unit {}: {}",
 8548:         target,
 8549:         command_failure_detail(&domain_output)
 8550:     ))
 8551: }

 8553: fn socket_exists_and_is_socket(path: &Path, label: &str) -> Result<bool, String> {
 8554:     match fs::symlink_metadata(path) {
 8555:         Ok(metadata) => {
 8556:             if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
 8557:                 return Err(format!("{label} must not be a symlink: {}", path.display()));
 8558:             }
 8559:             if !metadata.file_type().is_socket() {
 8560:                 return Err(format!("{label} must be a unix socket: {}", path.display()));
 8561:             }
 8562:             Ok(true)
 8563:         }
 8564:         Err(err) if err.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound => Ok(false),
 8565:         Err(err) => Err(format!(
 8566:             "inspect {label} failed ({}): {err}",
 8567:             path.display()
 8568:         )),
 8569:     }
 8570: }
 8571: 
 8572: fn remove_socket_if_present(path: &Path, label: &str) -> Result<bool, String> {
 8573:     if !path.is_absolute() {
 8574:         return Err(format!("{label} path must be absolute: {}", path.display()));
 8575:     }
 8576:     match fs::symlink_metadata(path) {
 8577:         Ok(metadata) => {
 8578:             if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
 8579:                 return Err(format!("{label} must not be a symlink: {}", path.display()));
 8580:             }
 8581:             if !metadata.file_type().is_socket() {
 8582:                 return Err(format!("{label} must be a unix socket: {}", path.display()));
 8583:             }
 8584:             fs::remove_file(path)
 8585:                 .map_err(|err| format!("remove {label} failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
 8586:             Ok(true)
 8587:         }
 8588:         Err(err) if err.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound => Ok(false),
 8589:         Err(err) => Err(format!(
 8590:             "inspect {label} failed ({}): {err}",
 8591:             path.display()
 8592:         )),
 8593:     }
 8594: }

 8596: fn run_command_capture(program: &str, args: &[&str]) -> Result<std::process::Output, String> {
 8597:     Command::new(program)
 8598:         .args(args)
 8599:         .output()
 8600:         .map_err(|err| format!("invoke {} {} failed: {err}", program, args.join(" ")))
 8601: }
 8602: 
 8603: fn command_failure_detail(output: &std::process::Output) -> String {
 8604:     let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).trim().to_string();
 8605:     if !stderr.is_empty() {
 8606:         return stderr;
 8607:     }
 8608:     let stdout = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).trim().to_string();
 8609:     if !stdout.is_empty() {
 8610:         return stdout;
 8611:     }
 8612:     format!("exit status {}", output.status)
 8613: }

 8615: fn is_interface_absent_detail(detail: &str) -> bool {
 8616:     let normalized = detail.to_ascii_lowercase();
 8617:     normalized.contains("cannot find device")
 8618:         || normalized.contains("does not exist")
 8619:         || normalized.contains("no such device")
 8620: }

 8648: 
 8649: fn execute_ops_ensure_local_trust_material(
 8650:     signing_key_passphrase_path: PathBuf,
 8651: ) -> Result<String, String> {
 8652:     if !signing_key_passphrase_path.is_absolute() {
 8653:         return Err(format!(
 8654:             "signing key passphrase file path must be absolute: {}",
 8655:             signing_key_passphrase_path.display()
 8656:         ));
 8657:     }
 8658:     ensure_regular_file_no_symlink(
 8659:         signing_key_passphrase_path.as_path(),
 8660:         "signing key passphrase file",
 8661:     )?;
 8662: 
 8663:     let config = signing_passphrase_ops_config_from_env()?;
 8664:     if matches!(config.host_profile, SigningPassphraseHostProfile::Linux) {
 8665:         require_root_execution()?;
 8666:     }
 8667: 
 8668:     let trust_signer_key_path = config.trust_signer_key_path;
 8669:     let trust_verifier_key_path = env_path_or_default(
 8670:         "RUSTYNET_TRUST_VERIFIER_KEY",
 8671:         DEFAULT_TRUST_VERIFIER_KEY_PATH,
 8672:     )?;
 8673: 
 8674:     let verifier_parent = trust_verifier_key_path.parent().ok_or_else(|| {
 8675:         format!(
 8676:             "trust verifier key path has no parent directory: {}",
 8677:             trust_verifier_key_path.display()
 8678:         )
 8679:     })?;
 8680:     let verifier_parent_metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(verifier_parent).map_err(|err| {
 8681:         format!(
 8682:             "inspect trust verifier parent directory failed ({}): {err}",
 8683:             verifier_parent.display()
 8684:         )
 8685:     })?;
 8686:     if verifier_parent_metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
 8687:         return Err(format!(
 8688:             "trust verifier parent directory must not be a symlink: {}",
 8689:             verifier_parent.display()
 8690:         ));
 8691:     }
 8692:     if !verifier_parent_metadata.file_type().is_dir() {
 8693:         return Err(format!(
 8694:             "trust verifier parent path must be a directory: {}",
 8695:             verifier_parent.display()
 8696:         ));
 8697:     }
 8698: 
 8699:     let (signing_key, initialized_signer) = if trust_signer_key_path.exists() {
 8700:         (
 8701:             load_signing_key(
 8702:                 trust_signer_key_path.as_path(),
 8703:                 signing_key_passphrase_path.as_path(),
 8704:             )?,
 8705:             false,
 8706:         )
 8707:     } else {
 8708:         let mut seed = [0u8; 32];
 8709:         fill_os_random_bytes(&mut seed, "trust signing key")?;
 8710:         let signing_key = SigningKey::from_bytes(&seed);
 8711:         let persist_result = persist_encrypted_secret_material(
 8712:             trust_signer_key_path.as_path(),
 8713:             &seed,
 8714:             signing_key_passphrase_path.as_path(),
 8715:             "trust signing key",
 8716:             false,
 8717:         );
 8718:         seed.zeroize();
 8719:         persist_result?;
 8720:         (signing_key, true)
 8721:     };
 8722:     let verifier_key_hex = hex_bytes(signing_key.verifying_key().as_bytes());
 8723:     let verifier_payload = format!("{verifier_key_hex}\n");
 8724: 
 8725:     let verifier_tmp = create_secure_temp_file(verifier_parent, "trust-verifier.tmp.")?;
 8726:     if let Err(err) =
 8727:         write_private_bytes_to_file(verifier_tmp.as_path(), verifier_payload.as_bytes())
 8728:     {
 8729:         let _ = remove_file_if_present(verifier_tmp.as_path());
 8730:         return Err(err);
 8731:     }
 8732: 
 8733:     let (owner, group) = match config.host_profile {
 8734:         SigningPassphraseHostProfile::Linux => (Uid::from_raw(0), Gid::from_raw(0)),
 8735:         SigningPassphraseHostProfile::Macos => (Uid::effective(), Gid::effective()),
 8736:     };
 8737:     if let Err(err) = publish_file_with_owner_mode(
 8738:         verifier_tmp.as_path(),
 8739:         trust_verifier_key_path.as_path(),
 8740:         owner,
 8741:         group,
 8742:         0o644,
 8743:         "trust verifier key",
 8744:     ) {
 8745:         let _ = remove_file_if_present(verifier_tmp.as_path());
 8746:         return Err(err);
 8747:     }
 8748: 
 8749:     Ok(format!(
 8750:         "local trust material ensured: signing_key={} verifier_key={} initialized_signer={}",
 8751:         trust_signer_key_path.display(),
 8752:         trust_verifier_key_path.display(),
 8753:         initialized_signer
 8754:     ))
 8755: }

 8785: fn execute_ops_bootstrap_wireguard_custody() -> Result<String, String> {
 8786:     let config = wireguard_custody_ops_config_from_env()?;
 8787:     if matches!(config.host_profile, SigningPassphraseHostProfile::Linux) {
 8788:         require_root_execution()?;
 8789:     }
 8790: 
 8791:     ensure_parent_directory_for_wireguard_path(
 8792:         config.runtime_private_key_path.as_path(),
 8793:         config.host_profile,
 8794:     )?;
 8795:     ensure_parent_directory_for_wireguard_path(
 8796:         config.encrypted_private_key_path.as_path(),
 8797:         config.host_profile,
 8798:     )?;
 8799:     ensure_parent_directory_for_wireguard_path(
 8800:         config.public_key_path.as_path(),
 8801:         config.host_profile,
 8802:     )?;
 8803:     if matches!(config.host_profile, SigningPassphraseHostProfile::Linux) {
 8804:         ensure_parent_directory_for_wireguard_path(
 8805:             config.passphrase_credential_blob_path.as_path(),
 8806:             config.host_profile,
 8807:         )?;
 8808:     }
 8809: 
 8810:     if config.encrypted_private_key_path.exists() {
 8811:         validate_encrypted_secret_file_security(
 8812:             config.encrypted_private_key_path.as_path(),
 8813:             "tunnel encrypted private key",
 8814:         )?;
 8815:     }
 8816:     if config.public_key_path.exists() {
 8817:         ensure_regular_file_no_symlink(config.public_key_path.as_path(), "tunnel public key")?;
 8818:     }
 8819:     if config.passphrase_credential_blob_path.exists() {
 8820:         ensure_regular_file_no_symlink(
 8821:             config.passphrase_credential_blob_path.as_path(),
 8822:             "tunnel passphrase credential blob",
 8823:         )?;
 8824:     }
 8825: 
 8826:     let encrypted_present = config.encrypted_private_key_path.exists();
 8827:     let public_present = config.public_key_path.exists();
 8828:     let credential_present = config.passphrase_credential_blob_path.exists();
 8829:     let legacy_plaintext_private_key_path = Path::new(DEFAULT_LEGACY_LINUX_WG_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH);
 8830:     let legacy_plaintext_passphrase_path = Path::new("/etc/rustynet/wireguard.passphrase");
 8831: 
 8832:     if matches!(config.host_profile, SigningPassphraseHostProfile::Linux)
 8833:         && !config.runtime_private_key_path.exists()
 8834:         && legacy_plaintext_private_key_path.exists()
 8835:     {
 8836:         return Err(format!(
 8837:             "legacy plaintext tunnel private key detected at {}; implicit migration is disabled. Move it to canonical runtime path {} and rerun, or rotate/reinitialize keys explicitly",
 8838:             legacy_plaintext_private_key_path.display(),
 8839:             config.runtime_private_key_path.display()
 8840:         ));
 8841:     }
 8842: 
 8843:     if matches!(config.host_profile, SigningPassphraseHostProfile::Linux)
 8844:         && encrypted_present
 8845:         && !credential_present
 8846:     {
 8847:         return Err(format!(
 8848:             "encrypted key exists but credential blob is missing ({}); restore the encrypted credential blob from backup or perform explicit key rotation",
 8849:             config.passphrase_credential_blob_path.display()
 8850:         ));
 8851:     }
 8852: 
 8853:     if encrypted_present && public_present {
 8854:         match config.host_profile {
 8855:             SigningPassphraseHostProfile::Linux => {
 8856:                 if credential_present {
 8857:                     validate_root_owned_private_file(
 8858:                         config.passphrase_credential_blob_path.as_path(),
 8859:                         "tunnel passphrase credential blob",
 8860:                     )?;
 8861:                     let removed_runtime_plaintext =
 8862:                         secure_remove_if_present(config.passphrase_path.as_path())?;
 8863:                     let removed_legacy_plaintext =
 8864:                         secure_remove_if_present(legacy_plaintext_passphrase_path)?;
 8865:                     let removed_legacy_plaintext_private_key =
 8866:                         secure_remove_if_present(legacy_plaintext_private_key_path)?;
 8867:                     return Ok(format!(
 8868:                         "tunnel custody already initialized: encrypted_private_key={} public_key={} credential_blob={} removed_runtime_plaintext_passphrase={} removed_legacy_plaintext_passphrase={} removed_legacy_plaintext_private_key={}",
 8869:                         config.encrypted_private_key_path.display(),
 8870:                         config.public_key_path.display(),
 8871:                         config.passphrase_credential_blob_path.display(),
 8872:                         removed_runtime_plaintext,
 8873:                         removed_legacy_plaintext,
 8874:                         removed_legacy_plaintext_private_key
 8875:                     ));
 8876:                 }
 8877:             }
 8878:             SigningPassphraseHostProfile::Macos => {
 8879:                 let account =
 8880:                     required_macos_tunnel_keychain_account(config.macos_keychain_account.as_str())?;
 8881:                 if macos_generic_password_exists(
 8882:                     config.macos_keychain_service.as_str(),
 8883:                     account.as_str(),
 8884:                 )? {
 8885:                     let removed_runtime_plaintext =
 8886:                         secure_remove_if_present(config.passphrase_path.as_path())?;
 8887:                     return Ok(format!(
 8888:                         "tunnel custody already initialized on macOS: encrypted_private_key={} public_key={} keychain_service={} keychain_account={} removed_runtime_plaintext_passphrase={}",
 8889:                         config.encrypted_private_key_path.display(),
 8890:                         config.public_key_path.display(),
 8891:                         config.macos_keychain_service,
 8892:                         account,
 8893:                         removed_runtime_plaintext
 8894:                     ));
 8895:                 }
 8896:                 if config.passphrase_path.exists() {
 8897:                     store_passphrase_in_os_secure_store(
 8898:                         config.passphrase_path.as_path(),
 8899:                         Some(account.as_str()),
 8900:                     )?;
 8901:                     secure_remove_if_present(config.passphrase_path.as_path())?;
 8902:                     return Ok(format!(
 8903:                         "tunnel passphrase migrated to macOS keychain custody: keychain_service={} keychain_account={} encrypted_private_key={} public_key={}",
 8904:                         config.macos_keychain_service,
 8905:                         account,
 8906:                         config.encrypted_private_key_path.display(),
 8907:                         config.public_key_path.display()
 8908:                     ));
 8909:                 }
 8910:                 return Err(format!(
 8911:                     "encrypted key exists but macOS keychain passphrase item is missing (service={}, account={}); restore keychain entry or rotate keys",
 8912:                     config.macos_keychain_service, account
 8913:                 ));
 8914:             }
 8915:         }
 8916:     }
 8917: 
 8918:     if !config.allow_init {
 8919:         return Err(
 8920:             "encrypted tunnel key material is missing and initialization is not approved; set RUSTYNET_WG_CUSTODY_ALLOW_INIT=true".to_string(),
 8921:         );
 8922:     }
 8923: 
 8924:     let passphrase_tmp =
 8925:         create_secure_temp_file(std::env::temp_dir().as_path(), "tunnel-passphrase.")?;
 8926:     let mut random_bytes = [0u8; 48];
 8927:     fill_os_random_bytes(&mut random_bytes, "tunnel passphrase")?;
 8928:     let mut passphrase_hex = Zeroizing::new(hex_bytes(&random_bytes));
 8929:     random_bytes.zeroize();
 8930:     passphrase_hex.push('\n');
 8931:     if let Err(err) =
 8932:         write_private_bytes_to_file(passphrase_tmp.as_path(), passphrase_hex.as_bytes())
 8933:     {
 8934:         let _ = secure_remove_file(passphrase_tmp.as_path());
 8935:         return Err(err);
 8936:     }
 8937: 
 8938:     let bootstrap_result = (|| -> Result<String, String> {
 8939:         let source_private_key_path = if config.runtime_private_key_path.exists() {
 8940:             Some(config.runtime_private_key_path.clone())
 8941:         } else {
 8942:             None
 8943:         };
 8944: 
 8945:         let operation = if let Some(source_private_key_path) = source_private_key_path {
 8946:             validate_private_key_source_file(
 8947:                 source_private_key_path.as_path(),
 8948:                 config.host_profile,
 8949:                 "tunnel plaintext private key source",
 8950:             )?;
 8951:             migrate_existing_private_key_material(
 8952:                 source_private_key_path.as_path(),
 8953:                 config.runtime_private_key_path.as_path(),
 8954:                 config.encrypted_private_key_path.as_path(),
 8955:                 config.public_key_path.as_path(),
 8956:                 passphrase_tmp.as_path(),
 8957:                 Some(passphrase_tmp.as_path()),
 8958:                 true,
 8959:             )?;
 8960:             "migrated"
 8961:         } else {
 8962:             initialize_encrypted_key_material(
 8963:                 config.runtime_private_key_path.as_path(),
 8964:                 config.encrypted_private_key_path.as_path(),
 8965:                 config.public_key_path.as_path(),
 8966:                 passphrase_tmp.as_path(),
 8967:                 Some(passphrase_tmp.as_path()),
 8968:                 true,
 8969:             )?;
 8970:             "initialized"
 8971:         };
 8972: 
 8973:         match config.host_profile {
 8974:             SigningPassphraseHostProfile::Linux => {
 8975:                 provision_linux_tunnel_passphrase_credential_blob(
 8976:                     passphrase_tmp.as_path(),
 8977:                     config.passphrase_credential_blob_path.as_path(),
 8978:                 )?;
 8979:                 let removed_runtime_plaintext =
 8980:                     secure_remove_if_present(config.passphrase_path.as_path())?;
 8981:                 let removed_legacy_plaintext =
 8982:                     secure_remove_if_present(legacy_plaintext_passphrase_path)?;
 8983:                 let removed_legacy_plaintext_private_key =
 8984:                     secure_remove_if_present(legacy_plaintext_private_key_path)?;
 8985:                 Ok(format!(
 8986:                     "tunnel custody {operation}: encrypted_private_key={} public_key={} credential_blob={} removed_runtime_plaintext_passphrase={} removed_legacy_plaintext_passphrase={} removed_legacy_plaintext_private_key={}",
 8987:                     config.encrypted_private_key_path.display(),
 8988:                     config.public_key_path.display(),
 8989:                     config.passphrase_credential_blob_path.display(),
 8990:                     removed_runtime_plaintext,
 8991:                     removed_legacy_plaintext,
 8992:                     removed_legacy_plaintext_private_key
 8993:                 ))
 8994:             }
 8995:             SigningPassphraseHostProfile::Macos => {
 8996:                 let account =
 8997:                     required_macos_tunnel_keychain_account(config.macos_keychain_account.as_str())?;
 8998:                 store_passphrase_in_os_secure_store(
 8999:                     passphrase_tmp.as_path(),
 9000:                     Some(account.as_str()),
 9001:                 )?;
 9002:                 let removed_runtime_plaintext =
 9003:                     secure_remove_if_present(config.passphrase_path.as_path())?;
 9004:                 Ok(format!(
 9005:                     "tunnel custody {operation} on macOS: encrypted_private_key={} public_key={} keychain_service={} keychain_account={} removed_runtime_plaintext_passphrase={}",
 9006:                     config.encrypted_private_key_path.display(),
 9007:                     config.public_key_path.display(),
 9008:                     config.macos_keychain_service,
 9009:                     account,
 9010:                     removed_runtime_plaintext
 9011:                 ))
 9012:             }
 9013:         }
 9014:     })();
 9015: 
 9016:     let cleanup_result = secure_remove_file(passphrase_tmp.as_path());
 9017:     match (bootstrap_result, cleanup_result) {
 9018:         (Ok(message), Ok(())) => Ok(message),
 9019:         (Err(err), Ok(())) => Err(err),
 9020:         (Ok(_), Err(cleanup_err)) => Err(cleanup_err),
 9021:         (Err(err), Err(cleanup_err)) => Err(format!("{err}; cleanup failed: {cleanup_err}")),
 9022:     }
 9023: }
 9024: 
 9025: fn execute_ops_set_assignment_refresh_exit_node(
 9026:     env_path: PathBuf,
 9027:     exit_node_id: Option<String>,
 9028: ) -> Result<String, String> {
 9029:     require_root_execution()?;
 9030:     if !env_path.is_absolute() {
 9031:         return Err(format!(
 9032:             "assignment refresh env path must be absolute: {}",
 9033:             env_path.display()
 9034:         ));
 9035:     }
 9036:     if cfg!(target_os = "linux") {
 9037:         // Expected runtime for assignment-refresh coupling mutation.
 9038:     } else {
 9039:         return Err("set-assignment-refresh-exit-node is supported on Linux only".to_string());
 9040:     }
 9041:     if let Some(exit_node_id_value) = exit_node_id.as_deref()
 9042:         && !is_valid_assignment_refresh_exit_node_id(exit_node_id_value)
 9043:     {
 9044:         return Err(format!(
 9045:             "invalid exit node id (allowed: letters, numbers, dot, underscore, hyphen): {exit_node_id_value}"
 9046:         ));
 9047:     }
 9048: 
 9049:     ensure_regular_file_no_symlink(&env_path, "assignment refresh env file")?;
 9050:     let existing = fs::read_to_string(&env_path)
 9051:         .map_err(|err| format!("read assignment refresh env failed: {err}"))?;
 9052:     let rewritten =
 9053:         rewrite_assignment_refresh_exit_node(existing.as_str(), exit_node_id.as_deref());
 9054: 
 9055:     let parent = env_path.parent().ok_or_else(|| {
 9056:         format!(
 9057:             "assignment refresh env path has no parent: {}",
 9058:             env_path.display()
 9059:         )
 9060:     })?;
 9061:     let tmp = create_secure_temp_file(parent, "assignment-refresh.env.tmp.")?;
 9062:     if let Err(err) = write_private_bytes_to_file(tmp.as_path(), rewritten.as_bytes()) {
 9063:         let _ = remove_file_if_present(&tmp);
 9064:         return Err(err);
 9065:     }
 9066:     if let Err(err) = publish_file_with_owner_mode(
 9067:         &tmp,
 9068:         &env_path,
 9069:         Uid::from_raw(0),
 9070:         Gid::from_raw(0),
 9071:         0o600,
 9072:         "assignment refresh env",
 9073:     ) {
 9074:         let _ = remove_file_if_present(&tmp);
 9075:         return Err(err);
 9076:     }
 9077: 
 9078:     Ok(match exit_node_id {
 9079:         Some(exit_node_id_value) => format!(
 9080:             "assignment refresh exit node set: {} ({exit_node_id_value})",
 9081:             env_path.display()
 9082:         ),
 9083:         None => format!(
 9084:             "assignment refresh exit node cleared: {}",
 9085:             env_path.display()
 9086:         ),
 9087:     })
 9088: }
 9089: 
 9090: fn execute_ops_apply_lan_access_coupling(
 9091:     enable: bool,
 9092:     lan_routes: Vec<String>,
 9093:     assignment_refresh_env_path: PathBuf,
 9094: ) -> Result<String, String> {
 9095:     require_root_execution()?;
 9096:     if !cfg!(target_os = "linux") {
 9097:         return Err("apply-lan-access-coupling is supported on Linux only".to_string());
 9098:     }
 9099:     if !assignment_refresh_env_path.is_absolute() {
 9100:         return Err(format!(
 9101:             "assignment refresh env path must be absolute: {}",
 9102:             assignment_refresh_env_path.display()
 9103:         ));
 9104:     }
 9105:     if enable || !lan_routes.is_empty() {
 9106:         validate_assignment_refresh_lan_routes(lan_routes.as_slice())?;
 9107:     }
 9108: 
 9109:     let assignment_refresh_available =
 9110:         assignment_refresh_available_ops(assignment_refresh_env_path.as_path())?;
 9111:     if !assignment_refresh_available {
 9112:         return Err(format!(
 9113:             "assignment refresh is unavailable ({}); LAN access coupling is fail-closed",
 9114:             assignment_refresh_env_path.display()
 9115:         ));
 9116:     }
 9117: 
 9118:     ensure_regular_file_no_symlink(&assignment_refresh_env_path, "assignment refresh env file")?;
 9119:     let existing = fs::read_to_string(&assignment_refresh_env_path)
 9120:         .map_err(|err| format!("read assignment refresh env failed: {err}"))?;
 9121:     let previous_lan_routes =
 9122:         assignment_refresh_env_value(existing.as_str(), "RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_LAN_ROUTES")?
 9123:             .map(split_csv)
 9124:             .unwrap_or_default();
 9125:     let previous_lan_block_routes =
 9126:         assignment_refresh_env_value(existing.as_str(), "RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_LAN_BLOCK_ROUTES")?
 9127:             .map(split_csv)
 9128:             .unwrap_or_default();
 9129:     let disable_blackhole_routes = disable_lan_blackhole_routes(
 9130:         lan_routes.as_slice(),
 9131:         previous_lan_block_routes.as_slice(),
 9132:         previous_lan_routes.as_slice(),
 9133:     );
 9134: 
 9135:     let socket_path = env_path_or_default("RUSTYNET_SOCKET", DEFAULT_DAEMON_SOCKET_PATH)?;
 9136:     let status = send_command_with_socket(IpcCommand::Status, socket_path.clone())?;
 9137:     if !status.ok {
 9138:         return Err(format!(
 9139:             "query daemon status failed before LAN access coupling: {}",
 9140:             status.message
 9141:         ));
 9142:     }
 9143:     let node_role = status_field(status.message.as_str(), "node_role")
 9144:         .ok_or_else(|| "daemon status missing node_role".to_string())?;
 9145:     if node_role == "blind_exit" {
 9146:         return Err("LAN access coupling is not permitted for blind_exit role".to_string());
 9147:     }
 9148:     let selected_exit_node = status_field(status.message.as_str(), "exit_node")
 9149:         .ok_or_else(|| "daemon status missing exit_node".to_string())?;
 9150:     if enable && (selected_exit_node.is_empty() || selected_exit_node == "none") {
 9151:         return Err("select an exit node before enabling LAN access".to_string());
 9152:     }
 9153: 
 9154:     let persisted_exit_node =
 9155:         assignment_refresh_env_value(existing.as_str(), "RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_EXIT_NODE_ID")?;
 9156:     if enable {
 9157:         match persisted_exit_node.as_deref() {
 9158:             Some(exit_node_id) if exit_node_id == selected_exit_node => {}
 9159:             Some(exit_node_id) => {
 9160:                 return Err(format!(
 9161:                     "assignment refresh exit node mismatch: daemon selected {selected_exit_node} but env persists {exit_node_id}"
 9162:                 ));
 9163:             }
 9164:             None => {
 9165:                 return Err(
 9166:                     "assignment refresh env is missing RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_EXIT_NODE_ID; re-select the exit node first"
 9167:                         .to_string(),
 9168:                 );
 9169:             }
 9170:         }
 9171:     }
 9172: 
 9173:     let rewritten = rewrite_assignment_refresh_lan_block_routes(
 9174:         rewrite_assignment_refresh_lan_routes(
 9175:             existing.as_str(),
 9176:             if enable { lan_routes.as_slice() } else { &[] },
 9177:         )
 9178:         .as_str(),
 9179:         if enable {
 9180:             lan_routes.as_slice()
 9181:         } else {
 9182:             disable_blackhole_routes.as_slice()
 9183:         },
 9184:     );
 9185:     let parent = assignment_refresh_env_path.parent().ok_or_else(|| {
 9186:         format!(
 9187:             "assignment refresh env path has no parent: {}",
 9188:             assignment_refresh_env_path.display()
 9189:         )
 9190:     })?;
 9191:     let tmp = create_secure_temp_file(parent, "assignment-refresh.env.tmp.")?;
 9192:     if let Err(err) = write_private_bytes_to_file(tmp.as_path(), rewritten.as_bytes()) {
 9193:         let _ = remove_file_if_present(&tmp);
 9194:         return Err(err);
 9195:     }
 9196:     if let Err(err) = publish_file_with_owner_mode(
 9197:         &tmp,
 9198:         &assignment_refresh_env_path,
 9199:         Uid::from_raw(0),
 9200:         Gid::from_raw(0),
 9201:         0o600,
 9202:         "assignment refresh env",
 9203:     ) {
 9204:         let _ = remove_file_if_present(&tmp);
 9205:         return Err(err);
 9206:     }
 9207: 
 9208:     if !enable {
 9209:         apply_lan_blackhole_routes(disable_blackhole_routes.as_slice(), true)?;
 9210:     }
 9211:     force_local_assignment_refresh_now_ops()?;
 9212:     wait_for_daemon_status_field(
 9213:         socket_path.as_path(),
 9214:         "lan_access",
 9215:         if enable { "on" } else { "off" },
 9216:         Duration::from_secs(20),
 9217:     )?;
 9218:     if enable {
 9219:         apply_lan_blackhole_routes(lan_routes.as_slice(), false)?;
 9220:     } else {
 9221:         // Reinstall the fail-closed blackhole after the refresh path, because
 9222:         // the dataplane generation rebuild can replace table 51820 contents.
 9223:         apply_lan_blackhole_routes(disable_blackhole_routes.as_slice(), true)?;
 9224:     }
 9225: 
 9226:     Ok(if enable {
 9227:         format!(
 9228:             "LAN access coupling enabled with {} via {}",
 9229:             lan_routes.join(","),
 9230:             assignment_refresh_env_path.display()
 9231:         )
 9232:     } else {
 9233:         format!(
 9234:             "LAN access coupling disabled via {}",
 9235:             assignment_refresh_env_path.display()
 9236:         )
 9237:     })
 9238: }
 9239: 
 9240: fn disable_lan_blackhole_routes(
 9241:     requested_lan_routes: &[String],
 9242:     previous_lan_block_routes: &[String],
 9243:     previous_lan_routes: &[String],
 9244: ) -> Vec<String> {
 9245:     if requested_lan_routes.is_empty() {
 9246:         if previous_lan_block_routes.is_empty() {
 9247:             previous_lan_routes.to_vec()
 9248:         } else {
 9249:             previous_lan_block_routes.to_vec()
 9250:         }
 9251:     } else {
 9252:         requested_lan_routes.to_vec()
 9253:     }
 9254: }
 9255: 
 9256: fn reconcile_persisted_lan_blackhole_routes_after_refresh() -> Result<(), String> {
 9257:     let assignment_refresh_env_path = env_path_or_default(
 9258:         "RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_REFRESH_ENV_PATH",
 9259:         DEFAULT_ASSIGNMENT_REFRESH_ENV_PATH,
 9260:     )?;
 9261:     if !assignment_refresh_env_path.exists() {
 9262:         return Ok(());
 9263:     }
 9264: 
 9265:     ensure_regular_file_no_symlink(
 9266:         assignment_refresh_env_path.as_path(),
 9267:         "assignment refresh env file",
 9268:     )?;
 9269:     let existing = fs::read_to_string(&assignment_refresh_env_path)
 9270:         .map_err(|err| format!("read assignment refresh env failed: {err}"))?;
 9271:     let lan_block_routes =
 9272:         assignment_refresh_env_value(existing.as_str(), "RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_LAN_BLOCK_ROUTES")?
 9273:             .map(split_csv)
 9274:             .unwrap_or_default();
 9275:     if lan_block_routes.is_empty() {
 9276:         return Ok(());
 9277:     }
 9278: 
 9279:     let status = send_command(IpcCommand::Status)?;
 9280:     if !status.ok {
 9281:         return Err(format!(
 9282:             "query daemon status failed after state refresh: {}",
 9283:             status.message
 9284:         ));
 9285:     }
 9286:     let lan_access = status_field(status.message.as_str(), "lan_access").unwrap_or_default();
 9287:     let exit_node = status_field(status.message.as_str(), "exit_node").unwrap_or_default();
 9288:     if lan_access == "off" && !exit_node.is_empty() && exit_node != "none" {
 9289:         apply_lan_blackhole_routes(lan_block_routes.as_slice(), true)?;
 9290:     } else {
 9291:         apply_lan_blackhole_routes(lan_block_routes.as_slice(), false)?;
 9292:     }
 9293:     Ok(())
 9294: }
 9295: 
 9296: fn execute_ops_apply_role_coupling(
 9297:     target_role: String,
 9298:     preferred_exit_node_id: Option<String>,
 9299:     enable_exit_advertise: bool,
 9300:     assignment_refresh_env_path: PathBuf,
 9301:     skip_client_exit_route_convergence_wait: bool,
 9302: ) -> Result<String, String> {
 9303:     require_root_execution()?;
 9304:     if !cfg!(target_os = "linux") {
 9305:         return Err("apply-role-coupling is supported on Linux only".to_string());
 9306:     }
 9307:     if !assignment_refresh_env_path.is_absolute() {
 9308:         return Err(format!(
 9309:             "assignment refresh env path must be absolute: {}",
 9310:             assignment_refresh_env_path.display()
 9311:         ));
 9312:     }
 9313:     if target_role != "admin" && target_role != "client" {
 9314:         return Err(format!(
 9315:             "unsupported target role for coupling: {target_role} (expected admin|client)"
 9316:         ));
 9317:     }
 9318:     if let Some(exit_node_id) = preferred_exit_node_id.as_deref()
 9319:         && !is_valid_assignment_refresh_exit_node_id(exit_node_id)
 9320:     {
 9321:         return Err(format!(
 9322:             "invalid preferred exit node id (allowed: letters, numbers, dot, underscore, hyphen): {exit_node_id}"
 9323:         ));
 9324:     }
 9325: 
 9326:     let mut warnings = Vec::new();
 9327:     let assignment_refresh_available =
 9328:         assignment_refresh_available_ops(assignment_refresh_env_path.as_path())?;
 9329:     if !assignment_refresh_available {
 9330:         return Err(format!(
 9331:             "assignment refresh is unavailable ({}); role coupling is fail-closed",
 9332:             assignment_refresh_env_path.display()
 9333:         ));
 9334:     }
 9335:     if target_role == "client" {
 9336:         if let Err(err) = execute_ops_set_assignment_refresh_exit_node(
 9337:             assignment_refresh_env_path.clone(),
 9338:             preferred_exit_node_id.clone(),
 9339:         ) {
 9340:             return Err(format!("set assignment refresh exit node failed: {err}"));
 9341:         }
 9342:     } else if let Err(err) =
 9343:         execute_ops_set_assignment_refresh_exit_node(assignment_refresh_env_path.clone(), None)
 9344:     {
 9345:         return Err(format!("clear assignment refresh exit node failed: {err}"));
 9346:     }
 9347: 
 9348:     if let Err(err) = force_local_assignment_refresh_now_ops() {
 9349:         return Err(format!("forced local assignment refresh failed: {err}"));
 9350:     }
 9351: 
 9352:     if target_role == "client"
 9353:         && let Some(expected_exit_node) = preferred_exit_node_id.as_deref()
 9354:     {
 9355:         if skip_client_exit_route_convergence_wait {
 9356:             warnings
 9357:                 .push("skipped client exit route convergence wait after role coupling".to_string());
 9358:         } else {
 9359:             let socket_path = env_path_or_default("RUSTYNET_SOCKET", DEFAULT_DAEMON_SOCKET_PATH)?;
 9360:             if let Err(err) = wait_for_client_exit_route_convergence(
 9361:                 socket_path.as_path(),
 9362:                 assignment_refresh_env_path.as_path(),
 9363:                 expected_exit_node,
 9364:                 Duration::from_secs(30),
 9365:             ) {
 9366:                 return Err(format!(
 9367:                     "client exit route convergence failed after role coupling: {err}"
 9368:                 ));
 9369:             }
 9370:         }
 9371:     }
 9372: 
 9373:     if target_role == "admin"
 9374:         && enable_exit_advertise
 9375:         && let Err(err) =
 9376:             send_role_coupling_ipc(IpcCommand::RouteAdvertise("0.0.0.0/0".to_string()))
 9377:     {
 9378:         warnings.push(format!("advertise default exit route failed: {err}"));
 9379:     }
 9380: 
 9381:     if warnings.is_empty() {
 9382:         Ok(format!(
 9383:             "role coupling applied for target role {target_role}"
 9384:         ))
 9385:     } else {
 9386:         Ok(format!(
 9387:             "role coupling applied for target role {target_role} with warnings: {}",
 9388:             warnings.join(" | ")
 9389:         ))
 9390:     }
 9391: }

 9393: fn execute_ops_prepare_system_dirs() -> Result<String, String> {
 9394:     let host_profile =
 9395:         env_string_or_default("RUSTYNET_HOST_PROFILE", detect_host_profile())?.to_ascii_lowercase();
 9396:     let is_linux = host_profile == "linux";
 9397:     let is_macos = host_profile == "macos" || host_profile == "darwin";
 9398:     if !is_linux && !is_macos {
 9399:         return Err(format!(
 9400:             "unsupported host profile for prepare-system-dirs: {host_profile}"
 9401:         ));
 9402:     }
 9403:     if is_linux {
 9404:         require_root_execution()?;
 9405:     }
 9406: 
 9407:     let mut directories = HashSet::new();
 9408:     if is_linux {
 9409:         directories.insert(PathBuf::from("/etc/rustynet"));
 9410:         directories.insert(PathBuf::from("/run/rustynet"));
 9411:         directories.insert(PathBuf::from("/var/lib/rustynet"));
 9412:     }
 9413:     if is_macos {
 9414:         insert_absolute_directory_from_env(
 9415:             "RUSTYNET_MACOS_STATE_BASE",
 9416:             &mut directories,
 9417:             "macOS state base",
 9418:         )?;
 9419:         insert_absolute_directory_from_env(
 9420:             "RUSTYNET_MACOS_RUNTIME_BASE",
 9421:             &mut directories,
 9422:             "macOS runtime base",
 9423:         )?;
 9424:         insert_absolute_directory_from_env(
 9425:             "RUSTYNET_MACOS_LOG_BASE",
 9426:             &mut directories,
 9427:             "macOS log base",
 9428:         )?;
 9429:     }
 9430: 
 9431:     for key in [
 9432:         "RUSTYNET_STATE",
 9433:         "RUSTYNET_TRUST_EVIDENCE",
 9434:         "RUSTYNET_TRUST_VERIFIER_KEY",
 9435:         "RUSTYNET_TRUST_WATERMARK",
 9436:         "RUSTYNET_AUTO_TUNNEL_BUNDLE",
 9437:         "RUSTYNET_AUTO_TUNNEL_VERIFIER_KEY",
 9438:         "RUSTYNET_AUTO_TUNNEL_WATERMARK",
 9439:         "RUSTYNET_DNS_ZONE_BUNDLE",
 9440:         "RUSTYNET_DNS_ZONE_VERIFIER_KEY",
 9441:         "RUSTYNET_DNS_ZONE_WATERMARK",
 9442:         "RUSTYNET_TRAVERSAL_BUNDLE",
 9443:         "RUSTYNET_TRAVERSAL_VERIFIER_KEY",
 9444:         "RUSTYNET_TRAVERSAL_WATERMARK",
 9445:         "RUSTYNET_WG_PRIVATE_KEY",
 9446:         "RUSTYNET_WG_ENCRYPTED_PRIVATE_KEY",
 9447:         "RUSTYNET_WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE",
 9448:         "RUSTYNET_WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_CREDENTIAL_BLOB",
 9449:         "RUSTYNET_SIGNING_KEY_PASSPHRASE_CREDENTIAL_BLOB",
 9450:         "RUSTYNET_WG_PUBLIC_KEY",
 9451:         "RUSTYNET_MEMBERSHIP_SNAPSHOT",
 9452:         "RUSTYNET_MEMBERSHIP_LOG",
 9453:         "RUSTYNET_MEMBERSHIP_WATERMARK",
 9454:         "RUSTYNET_MEMBERSHIP_OWNER_SIGNING_KEY",
 9455:         "RUSTYNET_PRIVILEGED_HELPER_SOCKET",
 9456:     ] {
 9457:         insert_parent_dir_from_env_path(key, &mut directories)?;
 9458:     }
 9459: 
 9460:     let mut ordered = directories.into_iter().collect::<Vec<_>>();
 9461:     ordered.sort();
 9462:     for directory in ordered.as_slice() {
 9463:         if is_linux {
 9464:             ensure_directory_with_mode_owner(
 9465:                 directory.as_path(),
 9466:                 0o700,
 9467:                 Some(Uid::from_raw(0)),
 9468:                 Some(Gid::from_raw(0)),
 9469:             )?;
 9470:         } else {
 9471:             ensure_directory_with_mode_owner(directory.as_path(), 0o700, None, None)?;
 9472:         }
 9473:     }
 9474: 
 9475:     Ok(format!(
 9476:         "prepared {} runtime directory path(s) for {}",
 9477:         ordered.len(),
 9478:         host_profile
 9479:     ))
 9480: }

 9482: fn managed_dns_interface_name_from_env() -> Result<String, String> {
 9483:     let interface = env_string_or_default("RUSTYNET_WG_INTERFACE", DEFAULT_WG_INTERFACE)?
 9484:         .trim()
 9485:         .to_string();
 9486:     validate_managed_dns_interface_name(interface.as_str())?;

 9490: fn validate_managed_dns_interface_name(interface: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
 9491:     if interface.is_empty() || interface.len() > 15 {
 9492:         return Err(
 9493:             "managed DNS routing interface name length must be between 1 and 15".to_string(),
 9494:         );
 9495:     }
 9496:     if !interface
 9497:         .chars()
 9498:         .all(|ch| ch.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(ch, '_' | '-' | '.'))
 9499:     {
 9500:         return Err("managed DNS routing interface contains invalid characters".to_string());
 9501:     }
 9502:     Ok(())
 9503: }

 9507:     canonicalize_dns_zone_name(zone_name.as_str())
 9508:         .map_err(|err| format!("invalid managed DNS zone name: {err}"))
 9509: }

 9511: fn managed_dns_resolver_bind_addr_from_env() -> Result<SocketAddr, String> {
 9512:     let raw = env_string_or_default(
 9513:         "RUSTYNET_DNS_RESOLVER_BIND_ADDR",
 9514:         DEFAULT_DNS_RESOLVER_BIND_ADDR,
 9515:     )?;
 9516:     let addr = raw
 9517:         .parse::<SocketAddr>()
 9518:         .map_err(|err| format!("invalid managed DNS resolver bind addr: {err}"))?;
 9519:     if !addr.ip().is_loopback() {
 9520:         return Err("managed DNS resolver bind addr must be loopback".to_string());
 9521:     }
 9522:     Ok(addr)
 9523: }

 9525: fn managed_dns_resolver_server_arg(addr: SocketAddr) -> Result<String, String> {
 9526:     match addr {
 9527:         SocketAddr::V4(v4) if v4.ip().is_loopback() => Ok(format!("{}:{}", v4.ip(), v4.port())),
 9528:         SocketAddr::V6(_) => Err(
 9529:             "managed DNS routing currently requires an IPv4 loopback resolver bind addr"
 9530:                 .to_string(),
 9531:         ),
 9532:         _ => Err("managed DNS resolver bind addr must be loopback".to_string()),
 9533:     }
 9534: }

 9536: fn ensure_systemd_resolved_active() -> Result<(), String> {
 9537:     let output = Command::new("systemctl")
 9538:         .arg("is-active")
 9539:         .arg("--quiet")
 9540:         .arg("systemd-resolved.service")
 9541:         .output()
 9542:         .map_err(|err| {
 9543:             format!("invoke systemctl is-active systemd-resolved.service failed: {err}")
 9544:         })?;
 9545:     if !output.status.success() {
 9546:         let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).trim().to_string();
 9547:         if stderr.is_empty() {
 9548:             return Err(
 9549:                 "systemd-resolved.service must be active for managed DNS routing".to_string(),
 9550:             );
 9551:         }
 9552:         return Err(format!(
 9553:             "systemd-resolved.service must be active for managed DNS routing: {stderr}"
 9554:         ));
 9555:     }
 9556:     Ok(())
 9557: }
 9558: 
 9559: fn wait_for_managed_dns_interface(interface: &str, timeout: Duration) -> Result<(), String> {
 9560:     let interface_path = Path::new("/sys/class/net").join(interface);
 9561:     let deadline = Instant::now() + timeout;
 9562:     loop {
 9563:         if interface_path.exists() {
 9564:             return Ok(());
 9565:         }
 9566:         if Instant::now() >= deadline {
 9567:             return Err(format!(
 9568:                 "managed DNS routing interface did not appear within {}s: {}",
 9569:                 timeout.as_secs(),
 9570:                 interface
 9571:             ));
 9572:         }
 9573:         std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(200));
 9574:     }
 9575: }
 9576: 
 9577: fn run_resolvectl_action(args: &[&str]) -> Result<(), String> {
 9578:     let output = Command::new("resolvectl")
 9579:         .args(args)
 9580:         .output()
 9581:         .map_err(|err| format!("invoke resolvectl {} failed: {err}", args.join(" ")))?;
 9582:     if !output.status.success() {
 9583:         let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).trim().to_string();
 9584:         let detail = if stderr.is_empty() {
 9585:             format!("status {}", output.status)
 9586:         } else {
 9587:             stderr
 9588:         };
 9589:         return Err(format!("resolvectl {} failed: {}", args.join(" "), detail));
 9590:     }
 9591:     Ok(())
 9592: }

 9594: fn execute_ops_apply_blind_exit_lockdown() -> Result<String, String> {
 9595:     require_root_execution()?;
 9596:     if !cfg!(target_os = "linux") {
 9597:         return Err("apply-blind-exit-lockdown is supported on Linux only".to_string());
 9598:     }
 9599: 
 9600:     let assignment_signing_secret_path = env_path_or_default(
 9601:         "RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_SIGNING_SECRET",
 9602:         DEFAULT_ASSIGNMENT_SIGNING_SECRET_PATH,
 9603:     )?;
 9604:     let assignment_refresh_env_path = env_path_or_default(
 9605:         "RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_REFRESH_ENV_PATH",
 9606:         DEFAULT_ASSIGNMENT_REFRESH_ENV_PATH,
 9607:     )?;
 9608:     let systemd_env_path =
 9609:         env_path_or_default("RUSTYNET_SYSTEMD_ENV_PATH", DEFAULT_SYSTEMD_ENV_PATH)?;
 9610: 
 9611:     let mut removed = Vec::new();
 9612:     if secure_remove_root_owned_file_if_present(
 9613:         assignment_signing_secret_path.as_path(),
 9614:         "assignment signing secret",
 9615:     )? {
 9616:         removed.push(assignment_signing_secret_path.display().to_string());
 9617:     }
 9618:     if secure_remove_root_owned_file_if_present(
 9619:         assignment_refresh_env_path.as_path(),
 9620:         "assignment refresh env file",
 9621:     )? {
 9622:         removed.push(assignment_refresh_env_path.display().to_string());
 9623:     }
 9624: 
 9625:     let mut warnings = Vec::new();
 9626:     if let Err(err) = set_assignment_auto_refresh_disabled(systemd_env_path.as_path()) {
 9627:         warnings.push(err);
 9628:     }
 9629:     if let Err(err) = disable_assignment_refresh_timer() {
 9630:         warnings.push(err);
 9631:     }
 9632: 
 9633:     let mut summary = format!(
 9634:         "blind-exit lockdown applied: removed_sensitive_files={}",
 9635:         removed.len()
 9636:     );
 9637:     if !removed.is_empty() {
 9638:         summary.push_str(" [");
 9639:         summary.push_str(removed.join(", ").as_str());
 9640:         summary.push(']');
 9641:     }
 9642:     if !warnings.is_empty() {
 9643:         summary.push_str(" warnings=");
 9644:         summary.push_str(warnings.join(" | ").as_str());
 9645:     }
 9646:     Ok(summary)
 9647: }
 9648: 
 9649: fn execute_ops_init_membership() -> Result<String, String> {
 9650:     let config = signing_passphrase_ops_config_from_env()?;
 9651:     if matches!(config.host_profile, SigningPassphraseHostProfile::Linux) {
 9652:         require_root_execution()?;
 9653:     }
 9654: 
 9655:     let node_role = env_string_or_default("RUSTYNET_NODE_ROLE", "client")?.to_ascii_lowercase();
 9656:     if node_role != "admin" && node_role != "client" && node_role != "blind_exit" {
 9657:         return Err(format!(
 9658:             "unsupported node role for membership init: {node_role} (expected admin|client|blind_exit)"
 9659:         ));
 9660:     }
 9661:     if node_role == "blind_exit"
 9662:         && !matches!(config.host_profile, SigningPassphraseHostProfile::Linux)
 9663:     {
 9664:         return Err("blind_exit role is supported on Linux only".to_string());
 9665:     }
 9666: 
 9667:     let snapshot_path = env_path_or_default(
 9668:         "RUSTYNET_MEMBERSHIP_SNAPSHOT",
 9669:         DEFAULT_MEMBERSHIP_SNAPSHOT_PATH,
 9670:     )?;
 9671:     let log_path = env_path_or_default("RUSTYNET_MEMBERSHIP_LOG", DEFAULT_MEMBERSHIP_LOG_PATH)?;
 9672:     let watermark_path = env_path_or_default(
 9673:         "RUSTYNET_MEMBERSHIP_WATERMARK",
 9674:         DEFAULT_MEMBERSHIP_WATERMARK_PATH,
 9675:     )?;
 9676:     let owner_signing_key_path = env_path_or_default(
 9677:         "RUSTYNET_MEMBERSHIP_OWNER_SIGNING_KEY",
 9678:         DEFAULT_MEMBERSHIP_OWNER_SIGNING_KEY_PATH,
 9679:     )?;
 9680:     let node_id = env_required_nonempty("RUSTYNET_NODE_ID", "membership node id")?;
 9681:     if !is_valid_assignment_refresh_exit_node_id(node_id.as_str()) {
 9682:         return Err(format!(
 9683:             "membership node id contains unsupported characters: {node_id}"
 9684:         ));
 9685:     }
 9686:     let network_id = env_string_or_default("RUSTYNET_NETWORK_ID", "local-net")?;
 9687:     if network_id.trim().is_empty() {
 9688:         return Err("membership network id must not be empty".to_string());
 9689:     }
 9690:     let rustynetd_bin = env_string_or_default("RUSTYNET_RUSTYNETD_BIN", "rustynetd")?;
 9691:     if rustynetd_bin.trim().is_empty() {
 9692:         return Err("RUSTYNET_RUSTYNETD_BIN must not be empty".to_string());
 9693:     }
 9694: 
 9695:     for path in [
 9696:         &snapshot_path,
 9697:         &log_path,
 9698:         &watermark_path,
 9699:         &owner_signing_key_path,
 9700:     ] {
 9701:         ensure_parent_directory_for_membership_path(path, config.host_profile)?;
 9702:     }
 9703: 
 9704:     if snapshot_path.exists() {
 9705:         ensure_regular_file_no_symlink(&snapshot_path, "membership snapshot")?;
 9706:     }
 9707:     if log_path.exists() {
 9708:         ensure_regular_file_no_symlink(&log_path, "membership log")?;
 9709:     }
 9710: 
 9711:     if snapshot_path.exists() && log_path.exists() {
 9712:         let removed_owner_key = maybe_remove_blind_exit_owner_signing_key(
 9713:             node_role.as_str(),
 9714:             config.host_profile,
 9715:             owner_signing_key_path.as_path(),
 9716:         )?;
 9717:         return Ok(format!(
 9718:             "membership files already present: snapshot={} log={} owner_signing_key_removed={removed_owner_key}",
 9719:             snapshot_path.display(),
 9720:             log_path.display(),
 9721:         ));
 9722:     }
 9723: 
 9724:     ensure_signing_passphrase_material_ops(&config)?;
 9725:     let passphrase_tmp =
 9726:         create_secure_temp_file(std::env::temp_dir().as_path(), "membership-passphrase.")?;
 9727:     if let Err(err) = materialize_signing_passphrase_ops(&config, passphrase_tmp.as_path()) {
 9728:         let _ = secure_remove_file(passphrase_tmp.as_path());
 9729:         return Err(err);
 9730:     }
 9731: 
 9732:     let output = Command::new(rustynetd_bin.as_str())
 9733:         .arg("membership")
 9734:         .arg("init")
 9735:         .arg("--snapshot")
 9736:         .arg(snapshot_path.as_os_str())
 9737:         .arg("--log")
 9738:         .arg(log_path.as_os_str())
 9739:         .arg("--watermark")
 9740:         .arg(watermark_path.as_os_str())
 9741:         .arg("--owner-signing-key")
 9742:         .arg(owner_signing_key_path.as_os_str())
 9743:         .arg("--owner-signing-key-passphrase-file")
 9744:         .arg(passphrase_tmp.as_os_str())
 9745:         .arg("--node-id")
 9746:         .arg(node_id.as_str())
 9747:         .arg("--network-id")
 9748:         .arg(network_id.as_str())
 9749:         .arg("--force")
 9750:         .output()
 9751:         .map_err(|err| format!("execute rustynetd membership init failed: {err}"))?;
 9752: 
 9753:     let cleanup_result = secure_remove_file(passphrase_tmp.as_path());
 9754:     if !output.status.success() {
 9755:         let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).trim().to_string();
 9756:         let stdout = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).trim().to_string();
 9757:         let detail = if !stderr.is_empty() { stderr } else { stdout };
 9758:         return Err(format!("rustynetd membership init failed: {detail}"));
 9759:     }
 9760:     cleanup_result?;
 9761: 
 9762:     let removed_owner_key = maybe_remove_blind_exit_owner_signing_key(
 9763:         node_role.as_str(),
 9764:         config.host_profile,
 9765:         owner_signing_key_path.as_path(),
 9766:     )?;
 9767: 
 9768:     Ok(format!(
 9769:         "membership initialized: node_id={} snapshot={} log={} owner_signing_key_removed={removed_owner_key}",
 9770:         node_id,
 9771:         snapshot_path.display(),
 9772:         log_path.display()
 9773:     ))
 9774: }
 9775: 
 9776: fn ensure_parent_directory_for_membership_path(
 9777:     path: &Path,
 9778:     host_profile: SigningPassphraseHostProfile,
 9779: ) -> Result<(), String> {
 9780:     let parent = path.parent().ok_or_else(|| {
 9781:         format!(
 9782:             "membership path has no parent directory: {}",
 9783:             path.display()
 9784:         )
 9785:     })?;
 9786:     match host_profile {
 9787:         SigningPassphraseHostProfile::Linux => ensure_directory_with_mode_owner(
 9788:             parent,
 9789:             0o700,
 9790:             Some(Uid::from_raw(0)),
 9791:             Some(Gid::from_raw(0)),
 9792:         ),
 9793:         SigningPassphraseHostProfile::Macos => {
 9794:             ensure_directory_with_mode_owner(parent, 0o700, None, None)
 9795:         }
 9796:     }
 9797: }
 9798: 
 9799: fn maybe_remove_blind_exit_owner_signing_key(
 9800:     node_role: &str,
 9801:     host_profile: SigningPassphraseHostProfile,
 9802:     owner_signing_key_path: &Path,
 9803: ) -> Result<bool, String> {
 9804:     if node_role != "blind_exit" {
 9805:         return Ok(false);
 9806:     }
 9807:     if !owner_signing_key_path.exists() {
 9808:         return Ok(false);
 9809:     }
 9810:     match host_profile {
 9811:         SigningPassphraseHostProfile::Linux => secure_remove_root_owned_file_if_present(
 9812:             owner_signing_key_path,
 9813:             "membership owner signing key",
 9814:         ),
 9815:         SigningPassphraseHostProfile::Macos => {
 9816:             secure_remove_file(owner_signing_key_path)?;
 9817:             Ok(true)
 9818:         }
 9819:     }
 9820: }
 9821: 
 9822: fn ensure_parent_directory_for_wireguard_path(
 9823:     path: &Path,
 9824:     host_profile: SigningPassphraseHostProfile,
 9825: ) -> Result<(), String> {
 9826:     let parent = path.parent().ok_or_else(|| {
 9827:         format!(
 9828:             "tunnel key path has no parent directory: {}",
 9829:             path.display()
 9830:         )
 9831:     })?;
 9832:     match host_profile {
 9833:         SigningPassphraseHostProfile::Linux => ensure_directory_with_mode_owner(
 9834:             parent,
 9835:             0o700,
 9836:             Some(Uid::from_raw(0)),
 9837:             Some(Gid::from_raw(0)),
 9838:         ),
 9839:         SigningPassphraseHostProfile::Macos => {
 9840:             ensure_directory_with_mode_owner(parent, 0o700, None, None)
 9841:         }
 9842:     }
 9843: }
 9844: 
 9845: fn secure_remove_if_present(path: &Path) -> Result<bool, String> {
 9846:     match fs::symlink_metadata(path) {
 9847:         Ok(_) => {
 9848:             secure_remove_file(path)?;
 9849:             Ok(true)
 9850:         }
 9851:         Err(err) if err.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound => Ok(false),
 9852:         Err(err) => Err(format!("inspect {} failed: {err}", path.display())),
 9853:     }
 9854: }
 9855: 
 9856: fn validate_root_owned_private_file(path: &Path, label: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
 9857:     let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(path)
 9858:         .map_err(|err| format!("inspect {label} failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
 9859:     if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
 9860:         return Err(format!("{label} must not be a symlink: {}", path.display()));
 9861:     }
 9862:     if !metadata.file_type().is_file() {
 9863:         return Err(format!(
 9864:             "{label} must be a regular file: {}",
 9865:             path.display()
 9866:         ));
 9867:     }
 9868:     if metadata.uid() != 0 {
 9869:         return Err(format!("{label} must be root-owned: {}", path.display()));
 9870:     }
 9871:     let mode = metadata.mode() & 0o777;
 9872:     if (mode & 0o077) != 0 {
 9873:         return Err(format!(
 9874:             "{label} permissions too broad ({mode:03o}); expected owner-only (0600): {}",
 9875:             path.display()
 9876:         ));
 9877:     }
 9878:     Ok(())
 9879: }
 9880: 
 9881: fn validate_private_key_source_file(
 9882:     path: &Path,
 9883:     host_profile: SigningPassphraseHostProfile,
 9884:     label: &str,
 9885: ) -> Result<(), String> {
 9886:     let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(path)
 9887:         .map_err(|err| format!("inspect {label} failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
 9888:     if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
 9889:         return Err(format!("{label} must not be a symlink: {}", path.display()));
 9890:     }
 9891:     if !metadata.file_type().is_file() {
 9892:         return Err(format!(
 9893:             "{label} must be a regular file: {}",
 9894:             path.display()
 9895:         ));
 9896:     }
 9897:     let mode = metadata.mode() & 0o777;
 9898:     if (mode & 0o077) != 0 {
 9899:         return Err(format!(
 9900:             "{label} permissions too broad ({mode:03o}); expected owner-only (0600): {}",
 9901:             path.display()
 9902:         ));
 9903:     }
 9904:     match host_profile {
 9905:         SigningPassphraseHostProfile::Linux => {
 9906:             if metadata.uid() != 0 {
 9907:                 return Err(format!("{label} must be root-owned: {}", path.display()));
 9908:             }
 9909:         }
 9910:         SigningPassphraseHostProfile::Macos => {
 9911:             let expected_uid = Uid::effective().as_raw();
 9912:             if metadata.uid() != expected_uid {
 9913:                 return Err(format!(
 9914:                     "{label} owner mismatch: expected uid {expected_uid}, found {} ({})",
 9915:                     metadata.uid(),
 9916:                     path.display()
 9917:                 ));
 9918:             }
 9919:         }
 9920:     }
 9921:     Ok(())
 9922: }
 9923: 
 9924: fn required_macos_tunnel_keychain_account(account: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
 9925:     let normalized = account.trim();
 9926:     if normalized.is_empty() {
 9927:         return Err(
 9928:             "macOS tunnel keychain account is required (RUSTYNET_WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_KEYCHAIN_ACCOUNT)"
 9929:                 .to_string(),
 9930:         );
 9931:     }
 9932:     if normalized.len() > 128 {
 9933:         return Err("macOS tunnel keychain account exceeds max length (128)".to_string());
 9934:     }
 9935:     if !normalized
 9936:         .chars()
 9937:         .all(|ch| ch.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(ch, '.' | '_' | '-'))
 9938:     {
 9939:         return Err(
 9940:             "macOS tunnel keychain account contains invalid characters; allowed: [A-Za-z0-9._-]"
 9941:                 .to_string(),
 9942:         );
 9943:     }
 9944:     Ok(normalized.to_string())
 9945: }
