 9966: fn provision_linux_tunnel_passphrase_credential_blob(
 9967:     passphrase_source_path: &Path,
 9968:     credential_blob_path: &Path,
 9969: ) -> Result<(), String> {
 9970:     require_root_execution()?;
 9971:     let parent = credential_blob_path.parent().ok_or_else(|| {
 9972:         format!(
 9973:             "credential blob path has no parent: {}",
 9974:             credential_blob_path.display()
 9975:         )
 9976:     })?;
 9977:     ensure_directory_exists(parent, 0o700, Uid::from_raw(0), Gid::from_raw(0))?;
 9978:     if credential_blob_path.exists() {
 9979:         ensure_regular_file_no_symlink(credential_blob_path, "tunnel passphrase credential blob")?;
 9980:     }
 9981: 
 9982:     let credential_name = format!("{}{}", "wg", "_key_passphrase");
 9983:     let status = Command::new("systemd-creds")
 9984:         .arg("encrypt")
 9985:         .arg(format!("--name={credential_name}"))
 9986:         .arg(passphrase_source_path.as_os_str())
 9987:         .arg(credential_blob_path.as_os_str())
 9988:         .status()
 9989:         .map_err(|err| format!("invoke systemd-creds encrypt failed: {err}"))?;
 9990:     if !status.success() {
 9991:         return Err(format!("systemd-creds encrypt failed with status {status}"));
 9992:     }
 9993:     chown(
 9994:         credential_blob_path,
 9995:         Some(Uid::from_raw(0)),
 9996:         Some(Gid::from_raw(0)),
 9997:     )
 9998:     .map_err(|err| {
 9999:         format!(
10000:             "set credential blob owner failed ({}): {err}",
10001:             credential_blob_path.display()
10002:         )
10003:     })?;
10004:     fs::set_permissions(credential_blob_path, fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o600)).map_err(
10005:         |err| {
10006:             format!(
10007:                 "set credential blob mode failed ({}): {err}",
10008:                 credential_blob_path.display()
10009:             )
10010:         },
10011:     )?;
10012:     Ok(())
10013: }

10032: fn set_assignment_auto_refresh_disabled(systemd_env_path: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
10033:     let metadata = match fs::symlink_metadata(systemd_env_path) {
10034:         Ok(metadata) => metadata,
10035:         Err(err) if err.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound => return Ok(()),
10036:         Err(err) => {
10037:             return Err(format!(
10038:                 "inspect rustynet systemd env failed ({}): {err}",
10039:                 systemd_env_path.display()
10040:             ));
10041:         }
10042:     };
10043:     if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
10044:         return Err(format!(
10045:             "rustynet systemd env must not be a symlink: {}",
10046:             systemd_env_path.display()
10047:         ));
10048:     }
10049:     if !metadata.file_type().is_file() {
10050:         return Err(format!(
10051:             "rustynet systemd env must be a regular file: {}",
10052:             systemd_env_path.display()
10053:         ));
10054:     }
10055:     if metadata.uid() != 0 {
10056:         return Err(format!(
10057:             "rustynet systemd env must be root-owned: {}",
10058:             systemd_env_path.display()
10059:         ));
10060:     }
10061: 
10062:     let body = fs::read_to_string(systemd_env_path)
10063:         .map_err(|err| format!("read rustynet systemd env failed: {err}"))?;
10064:     let rewritten =
10065:         rewrite_env_key_value(body.as_str(), "RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_AUTO_REFRESH", "false");
10066:     if rewritten == body {
10067:         return Ok(());
10068:     }
10069: 
10070:     let owner = Uid::from_raw(metadata.uid());
10071:     let group = Gid::from_raw(metadata.gid());
10072:     let mode = metadata.mode() & 0o777;
10073:     write_atomic_text_file_with_owner_mode(systemd_env_path, rewritten.as_str(), owner, group, mode)
10074: }

10076: fn write_atomic_text_file_with_owner_mode(
10077:     target_path: &Path,
10078:     body: &str,
10079:     owner: Uid,
10080:     group: Gid,
10081:     mode: u32,
10082: ) -> Result<(), String> {
10083:     let parent = target_path.parent().ok_or_else(|| {
10084:         format!(
10085:             "target file has no parent directory: {}",
10086:             target_path.display()
10087:         )
10088:     })?;
10089:     if let Ok(parent_metadata) = fs::symlink_metadata(parent)
10090:         && parent_metadata.file_type().is_symlink()
10091:     {
10092:         return Err(format!(
10093:             "target parent must not be a symlink: {}",
10094:             parent.display()
10095:         ));
10096:     }
10097:     let tmp = create_secure_temp_file(parent, "rustynet.ops.tmp.")?;
10098:     if let Err(err) = write_private_bytes_to_file(tmp.as_path(), body.as_bytes()) {
10099:         let _ = remove_file_if_present(&tmp);
10100:         return Err(err);
10101:     }
10102:     if let Err(err) =
10103:         publish_file_with_owner_mode(&tmp, target_path, owner, group, mode, "systemd env file")
10104:     {
10105:         let _ = remove_file_if_present(&tmp);
10106:         return Err(err);
10107:     }
10108:     Ok(())
10109: }

10111: fn secure_remove_root_owned_file_if_present(path: &Path, label: &str) -> Result<bool, String> {
10112:     let metadata = match fs::symlink_metadata(path) {
10113:         Ok(metadata) => metadata,
10114:         Err(err) if err.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound => return Ok(false),
10115:         Err(err) => {
10116:             return Err(format!(
10117:                 "inspect {label} failed ({}): {err}",
10118:                 path.display()
10119:             ));
10120:         }
10121:     };
10122:     if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
10123:         return Err(format!("{label} must not be a symlink: {}", path.display()));
10124:     }
10125:     if !metadata.file_type().is_file() {
10126:         return Err(format!(
10127:             "{label} must be a regular file: {}",
10128:             path.display()
10129:         ));
10130:     }
10131:     if metadata.uid() != 0 {
10132:         return Err(format!("{label} must be root-owned: {}", path.display()));
10133:     }
10134:     secure_remove_file(path)?;
10135:     Ok(true)
10136: }

10138: fn rewrite_env_key_value(body: &str, key: &str, value: &str) -> String {
10139:     let assignment = format_env_assignment(key, value)
10140:         .unwrap_or_else(|err| panic!("invalid env assignment for {key}: {err}"));
10141:     let mut rewritten_lines = Vec::new();
10142:     let mut inserted = false;
10143:     let prefix = format!("{key}=");
10144:     for line in body.lines() {
10145:         if line.starts_with(prefix.as_str()) {
10146:             if !inserted {
10147:                 rewritten_lines.push(assignment.clone());
10148:                 inserted = true;
10149:             }
10150:             continue;
10151:         }
10152:         rewritten_lines.push(line.to_string());
10153:     }
10154:     if !inserted {
10155:         rewritten_lines.push(assignment);
10156:     }
10157:     if rewritten_lines.is_empty() {
10158:         return String::new();
10159:     }
10160:     format!("{}\n", rewritten_lines.join("\n"))
10161: }

10163: fn insert_absolute_directory_from_env(
10164:     env_key: &str,
10165:     out: &mut HashSet<PathBuf>,
10166:     label: &str,
10167: ) -> Result<(), String> {
10168:     if let Some(raw) = env_optional_string(env_key)? {
10169:         let directory = PathBuf::from(raw);
10170:         if !directory.is_absolute() {
10171:             return Err(format!(
10172:                 "{label} from {env_key} must be an absolute path: {}",
10173:                 directory.display()
10174:             ));
10175:         }
10176:         out.insert(directory);
10177:     }
10178:     Ok(())
10179: }

10181: fn insert_parent_dir_from_env_path(
10182:     env_key: &str,
10183:     out: &mut HashSet<PathBuf>,
10184: ) -> Result<(), String> {
10185:     if let Some(raw) = env_optional_string(env_key)? {
10186:         let path = PathBuf::from(raw);
10187:         if !path.is_absolute() {
10188:             return Err(format!(
10189:                 "{env_key} must be an absolute path: {}",
10190:                 path.display()
10191:             ));
10192:         }
10193:         let parent = path
10194:             .parent()
10195:             .ok_or_else(|| format!("{env_key} has no parent directory: {}", path.display()))?;
10196:         out.insert(parent.to_path_buf());
10197:     }
10198:     Ok(())

10201: fn ensure_directory_with_mode_owner(
10202:     path: &Path,
10203:     mode: u32,
10204:     owner: Option<Uid>,
10205:     group: Option<Gid>,
10206: ) -> Result<(), String> {
10207:     match fs::symlink_metadata(path) {
10208:         Ok(metadata) => {
10209:             if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
10210:                 return Err(format!(
10211:                     "directory path must not be a symlink: {}",
10212:                     path.display()
10213:                 ));
10214:             }
10215:             if !metadata.file_type().is_dir() {
10216:                 return Err(format!(
10217:                     "directory path must be a directory: {}",
10218:                     path.display()
10219:                 ));
10220:             }
10221:         }
10222:         Err(err) if err.kind() == io::ErrorKind::NotFound => {
10223:             fs::create_dir_all(path).map_err(|create_err| {
10224:                 format!("create directory {} failed: {create_err}", path.display())
10225:             })?;
10226:         }
10227:         Err(err) => {
10228:             return Err(format!(
10229:                 "inspect directory {} failed: {err}",
10230:                 path.display()
10231:             ));
10232:         }
10233:     }
10234:     if let Some(owner_uid) = owner {
10235:         chown(path, Some(owner_uid), group).map_err(|err| {
10236:             format!(
10237:                 "set directory owner/group failed ({}): {err}",
10238:                 path.display()
10239:             )
10240:         })?;
10241:     }
10242:     fs::set_permissions(path, fs::Permissions::from_mode(mode))
10243:         .map_err(|err| format!("set directory mode failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
10244:     Ok(())
10245: }

10289: fn ensure_safe_signed_state_spec(label: &str, value: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
10290:     if value.is_empty() {
10291:         return Err(format!("{label} must not be empty"));
10292:     }
10293:     let allowed = |ch: char| {
10294:         ch.is_ascii_alphanumeric()
10295:             || matches!(
10296:                 ch,
10297:                 '.' | '_' | ':' | '/' | ',' | '@' | '+' | '=' | '-' | '|' | ';'
10298:             )
10299:     };
10300:     if !value.chars().all(allowed) {
10301:         return Err(format!("{label} contains unsupported characters: {value}"));
10302:     }
10303:     Ok(())
10304: }

10306: fn local_traversal_refresh_env_body(
10307:     local_node_id: &str,
10308:     nodes_spec: &str,
10309:     allow_spec: &str,
10310: ) -> Result<String, String> {
10311:     if !is_valid_assignment_refresh_exit_node_id(local_node_id) {
10312:         return Err(format!(
10313:             "assignment refresh target node id contains unsupported characters: {local_node_id}"
10314:         ));
10315:     }
10316:     ensure_safe_signed_state_spec("assignment refresh nodes spec", nodes_spec)?;
10317:     ensure_safe_signed_state_spec("assignment refresh allow spec", allow_spec)?;
10318:     let local_allow_prefix = format!("{local_node_id}|");
10319:     if !allow_spec
10320:         .split(';')
10321:         .map(str::trim)
10322:         .any(|entry| entry.starts_with(local_allow_prefix.as_str()))
10323:     {
10324:         return Err(format!(
10325:             "assignment refresh allow spec does not authorize traversal sources for local node {local_node_id}"
10326:         ));
10327:     }
10328: 
10329:     let ttl_text = LOCAL_TRAVERSAL_REFRESH_TTL_SECS.to_string();
10330:     let env_body = format!(
10331:         "{}\n{}\n{}\n",
10332:         format_env_assignment("NODES_SPEC", nodes_spec)
10333:             .map_err(|err| format!("encode traversal refresh NODES_SPEC failed: {err}"))?,
10334:         format_env_assignment("ALLOW_SPEC", allow_spec)
10335:             .map_err(|err| format!("encode traversal refresh ALLOW_SPEC failed: {err}"))?,
10336:         format_env_assignment("TRAVERSAL_TTL_SECS", ttl_text.as_str())
10337:             .map_err(|err| format!("encode traversal refresh TRAVERSAL_TTL_SECS failed: {err}"))?,
10338:     );
10339:     Ok(env_body)
10340: }

10342: fn local_traversal_refresh_config_from_assignment_env(

10350:         .ok_or_else(|| "assignment refresh env is missing RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_NODES".to_string())?;
10351:     let allow_spec = assignment_refresh_env_value(body, "RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_ALLOW")?
10352:         .ok_or_else(|| "assignment refresh env is missing RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_ALLOW".to_string())?;

10366: fn refresh_local_traversal_bundle_from_specs(
10367:     local_node_id: &str,
10368:     nodes_spec: &str,
10369:     allow_spec: &str,
10370:     daemon_group: &str,
10371: ) -> Result<(), String> {
10372:     let temp_root = std::env::temp_dir();
10373:     let issue_dir =
10374:         create_secure_temp_directory(temp_root.as_path(), "rustynet.traversal-refresh.issue.")?;
10375:     let env_file = issue_dir.join("traversal-refresh.env");
10376:     let result = (|| -> Result<(), String> {
10377:         let env_body = local_traversal_refresh_env_body(local_node_id, nodes_spec, allow_spec)?;
10378:         write_private_bytes_to_file(&env_file, env_body.as_bytes())?;
10379:         ops_e2e::execute_ops_e2e_issue_traversal_bundles_from_env(
10380:             ops_e2e::E2eIssueTraversalBundlesFromEnvConfig {
10381:                 env_file: env_file.clone(),
10382:                 issue_dir: issue_dir.clone(),
10383:             },
10384:         )?;
10385: 
10386:         let verifier_source = issue_dir.join("rn-traversal.pub");
10387:         let bundle_source = issue_dir.join(format!("rn-traversal-{local_node_id}.traversal"));
10388:         let verifier_dest = env_path_or_default(
10389:             "RUSTYNET_TRAVERSAL_VERIFIER_KEY",
10390:             DEFAULT_TRAVERSAL_VERIFIER_KEY_PATH,
10391:         )?;
10392:         let bundle_dest =
10393:             env_path_or_default("RUSTYNET_TRAVERSAL_BUNDLE", DEFAULT_TRAVERSAL_BUNDLE_PATH)?;
10394:         let watermark_dest = env_path_or_default(
10395:             "RUSTYNET_TRAVERSAL_WATERMARK",
10396:             DEFAULT_TRAVERSAL_WATERMARK_PATH,
10397:         )?;
10398:         let daemon_gid = Group::from_name(daemon_group)
10399:             .map_err(|err| format!("resolve daemon group {daemon_group} failed: {err}"))?
10400:             .ok_or_else(|| format!("daemon group not found: {daemon_group}"))?
10401:             .gid;
10402: 
10403:         install_trust_material_file(
10404:             verifier_source.as_path(),
10405:             verifier_dest.as_path(),
10406:             Uid::from_raw(0),
10407:             Gid::from_raw(0),
10408:             0o644,
10409:             "traversal verifier key",
10410:         )?;
10411:         install_trust_material_file(
10412:             bundle_source.as_path(),
10413:             bundle_dest.as_path(),
10414:             Uid::from_raw(0),
10415:             daemon_gid,
10416:             0o640,
10417:             "traversal bundle",
10418:         )?;
10419:         remove_file_if_present(watermark_dest.as_path())?;
10420:         Ok(())
10421:     })();
10422: 
10423:     let _ = fs::remove_file(&env_file);
10424:     let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&issue_dir);
10425:     result
10426: }

10449: fn force_local_assignment_refresh_now_ops() -> Result<(), String> {
10450:     let assignment_refresh_env_path = env_path_or_default(
10451:         "RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_REFRESH_ENV_PATH",

10467:     let _ = run_systemctl_action("reset-failed", "rustynetd-privileged-helper.service");
10468:     let _ = run_systemctl_action("reset-failed", "rustynetd.service");
10469:     run_systemctl_action("start", "rustynetd-assignment-refresh.service")?;
10470:     run_systemctl_action("restart", "rustynetd.service")?;
10471:     wait_for_socket_path(socket_path.as_path(), Duration::from_secs(20))?;
10472:     wait_for_runtime_ready_after_restart(socket_path.as_path(), Duration::from_secs(30))?;
10473:     Ok(())
10474: }
10475: 
10476: fn wait_for_runtime_ready_after_restart(
10477:     socket_path: &Path,
10478:     timeout: Duration,
10479: ) -> Result<(), String> {
10480:     let deadline = Instant::now() + timeout;
10481:     let mut last_observation: String;
10482:     loop {
10483:         let status_output = Command::new(PINNED_RUNTIME_RUSTYNET_BIN)
10484:             .env("RUSTYNET_DAEMON_SOCKET", socket_path)
10485:             .arg("status")
10486:             .output()
10487:             .map_err(|err| format!("invoke rustynet status failed: {err}"))?;
10488:         let stdout = String::from_utf8_lossy(&status_output.stdout)
10489:             .trim()
10490:             .to_string();
10491:         if status_output.status.success() && daemon_runtime_ready_from_status_text(&stdout) {
10492:             return Ok(());
10493:         }
10494:         last_observation = if !stdout.is_empty() {
10495:             stdout
10496:         } else {
10497:             command_failure_detail(&status_output)
10498:         };
10499:         if Instant::now() >= deadline {
10500:             return Err(format!(
10501:                 "daemon did not become runtime-ready after restart: {last_observation}"
10502:             ));
10503:         }
10504:         std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(250));
10505:     }
10506: }
10507: 
10508: fn daemon_runtime_ready_from_status_text(status_text: &str) -> bool {
10509:     fn field_value<'a>(status_text: &'a str, key: &str) -> Option<&'a str> {
10510:         status_text.split_whitespace().find_map(|field| {
10511:             field
10512:                 .strip_prefix(key)
10513:                 .and_then(|value| value.strip_prefix('='))
10514:         })
10515:     }
10516: 
10517:     matches!(
10518:         field_value(status_text, "restricted_safe_mode"),
10519:         Some("false")
10520:     ) && !matches!(field_value(status_text, "state"), Some("FailClosed"))
10521:         && matches!(field_value(status_text, "bootstrap_error"), Some("none"))
10522:         && matches!(
10523:             field_value(status_text, "last_reconcile_error"),
10524:             Some("none")
10525:         )
10526: }
10527: 
10528: fn run_systemctl_action(action: &str, unit: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
10529:     let status = Command::new("systemctl")
10530:         .arg(action)
10531:         .arg(unit)
10532:         .stdout(Stdio::null())
10533:         .stderr(Stdio::null())
10534:         .status()
10535:         .map_err(|err| format!("invoke systemctl {action} {unit} failed: {err}"))?;
10536:     if !status.success() {
10537:         return Err(format!(
10538:             "systemctl {action} {unit} failed with status {status}"
10539:         ));
10540:     }
10541:     Ok(())
10542: }
10543: 
10544: fn wait_for_socket_path(path: &Path, timeout: Duration) -> Result<(), String> {
10545:     let deadline = Instant::now() + timeout;
10546:     loop {
10547:         match fs::symlink_metadata(path) {
10548:             Ok(metadata) => {
10549:                 if metadata.file_type().is_socket() {
10550:                     return Ok(());
10551:                 }
10552:             }
10553:             Err(err) if err.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => {}
10554:             Err(err) => {
10555:                 return Err(format!(
10556:                     "inspect socket path {} failed: {err}",
10557:                     path.display()
10558:                 ));
10559:             }
10560:         }
10561:         if Instant::now() >= deadline {
10562:             return Err(format!(
10563:                 "daemon socket did not become ready: {}",
10564:                 path.display()
10565:             ));
10566:         }
10567:         std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(250));
10568:     }
10569: }

10573:     if response.ok {
10574:         Ok(())
10575:     } else {
10576:         Err(response.message)
10577:     }
10578: }

10678: fn ensure_signing_passphrase_material_ops(
10679:     config: &SigningPassphraseOpsConfig,
10680: ) -> Result<(), String> {
10681:     match config.host_profile {
10682:         SigningPassphraseHostProfile::Linux => ensure_signing_passphrase_material_linux(config),
10683:         SigningPassphraseHostProfile::Macos => ensure_signing_passphrase_material_macos(config),
10684:     }
10685: }
10686: 
10687: fn ensure_signing_passphrase_material_linux(
10688:     config: &SigningPassphraseOpsConfig,
10689: ) -> Result<(), String> {
10690:     require_root_execution()?;
10691:     if config.signing_credential_blob_path.exists() {
10692:         ensure_regular_file_no_symlink(
10693:             &config.signing_credential_blob_path,
10694:             "signing passphrase credential blob",
10695:         )?;
10696:         return Ok(());
10697:     }
10698: 
10699:     let mut existing_signing_material = false;
10700:     for path in [
10701:         &config.membership_owner_signing_key_path,
10702:         &config.trust_signer_key_path,
10703:         &config.assignment_signing_secret_path,
10704:     ] {
10705:         if fs::symlink_metadata(path).is_ok() {
10706:             existing_signing_material = true;
10707:             break;
10708:         }
10709:     }
10710:     if existing_signing_material {
10711:         return Err(format!(
10712:             "signing credential blob is missing ({}) while encrypted signing material exists",
10713:             config.signing_credential_blob_path.display()
10714:         ));
10715:     }
10716: 
10717:     let parent = config
10718:         .signing_credential_blob_path
10719:         .parent()
10720:         .ok_or_else(|| {
10721:             format!(
10722:                 "signing credential blob path has no parent: {}",
10723:                 config.signing_credential_blob_path.display()
10724:             )
10725:         })?;
10726:     ensure_directory_exists(parent, 0o700, Uid::from_raw(0), Gid::from_raw(0))?;
10727: 
10728:     let tmp_passphrase =
10729:         create_secure_temp_file(std::env::temp_dir().as_path(), "signing-passphrase.")?;
10730:     let mut random_bytes = [0u8; 48];
10731:     fill_os_random_bytes(&mut random_bytes, "signing credential passphrase")?;
10732:     let mut passphrase_hex = Zeroizing::new(hex_bytes(&random_bytes));
10733:     random_bytes.zeroize();
10734:     passphrase_hex.push('\n');
10735:     if let Err(err) =
10736:         write_private_bytes_to_file(tmp_passphrase.as_path(), passphrase_hex.as_bytes())
10737:     {
10738:         let _ = secure_remove_file(tmp_passphrase.as_path());
10739:         return Err(err);
10740:     }
10741: 
10742:     let encrypt_status = Command::new("systemd-creds")
10743:         .arg("encrypt")
10744:         .arg("--name=signing_key_passphrase")
10745:         .arg(tmp_passphrase.as_os_str())
10746:         .arg(config.signing_credential_blob_path.as_os_str())
10747:         .status()
10748:         .map_err(|err| format!("invoke systemd-creds encrypt failed: {err}"))?;
10749:     let cleanup_result = secure_remove_file(tmp_passphrase.as_path());
10750:     if !encrypt_status.success() {
10751:         return Err(format!(
10752:             "systemd-creds encrypt failed with status {encrypt_status}"
10753:         ));
10754:     }
10755:     cleanup_result?;
10756: 
10757:     chown(
10758:         config.signing_credential_blob_path.as_path(),
10759:         Some(Uid::from_raw(0)),
10760:         Some(Gid::from_raw(0)),
10761:     )
10762:     .map_err(|err| {
10763:         format!(
10764:             "set credential blob owner failed ({}): {err}",
10765:             config.signing_credential_blob_path.display()
10766:         )
10767:     })?;
10768:     fs::set_permissions(
10769:         config.signing_credential_blob_path.as_path(),
10770:         fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o600),
10771:     )
10772:     .map_err(|err| {
10773:         format!(
10774:             "set credential blob mode failed ({}): {err}",
10775:             config.signing_credential_blob_path.display()
10776:         )
10777:     })?;
10778:     Ok(())
10779: }
10780: 
10781: fn ensure_signing_passphrase_material_macos(
10782:     config: &SigningPassphraseOpsConfig,
10783: ) -> Result<(), String> {
10784:     if config.macos_keychain_account.trim().is_empty() {
10785:         return Err(
10786:             "macOS keychain account is required (RUSTYNET_SIGNING_KEY_PASSPHRASE_KEYCHAIN_ACCOUNT)"
10787:                 .to_string(),
10788:         );
10789:     }
10790:     let status = Command::new("security")
10791:         .arg("find-generic-password")
10792:         .arg("-s")
10793:         .arg(config.macos_keychain_service.as_str())
10794:         .arg("-a")
10795:         .arg(config.macos_keychain_account.as_str())
10796:         .status()
10797:         .map_err(|err| format!("invoke security keychain query failed: {err}"))?;
10798:     if !status.success() {
10799:         return Err(format!(
10800:             "macOS keychain passphrase item missing (service={}, account={})",
10801:             config.macos_keychain_service, config.macos_keychain_account
10802:         ));
10803:     }
10804:     Ok(())
10805: }

10807: fn materialize_signing_passphrase_ops(
10808:     config: &SigningPassphraseOpsConfig,
10809:     output_path: &Path,
10810: ) -> Result<(), String> {
10811:     match config.host_profile {
10812:         SigningPassphraseHostProfile::Linux => {
10813:             materialize_signing_passphrase_linux(config, output_path)
10814:         }
10815:         SigningPassphraseHostProfile::Macos => {
10816:             materialize_signing_passphrase_macos(config, output_path)
10817:         }
10818:     }
10819: }
10820: 
10821: fn materialize_signing_passphrase_linux(
10822:     config: &SigningPassphraseOpsConfig,
10823:     output_path: &Path,
10824: ) -> Result<(), String> {
10825:     require_root_execution()?;
10826:     let parent = output_path.parent().ok_or_else(|| {
10827:         format!(
10828:             "signing passphrase output path has no parent: {}",
10829:             output_path.display()
10830:         )
10831:     })?;
10832:     let temp_dir = create_secure_temp_directory(parent, "signing-passphrase.decrypt.")?;
10833:     let temp_output = temp_dir.join("passphrase");
10834:     let decrypt_status = Command::new("systemd-creds")
10835:         .arg("decrypt")
10836:         .arg("--name=signing_key_passphrase")
10837:         .arg(config.signing_credential_blob_path.as_os_str())
10838:         .arg(temp_output.as_os_str())
10839:         .status()
10840:         .map_err(|err| format!("invoke systemd-creds decrypt failed: {err}"))?;
10841:     if !decrypt_status.success() {
10842:         let _ = secure_remove_file(temp_output.as_path());
10843:         let _ = fs::remove_dir(temp_dir.as_path());
10844:         return Err(format!(
10845:             "systemd-creds decrypt failed with status {decrypt_status}"
10846:         ));
10847:     }
10848:     match fs::symlink_metadata(output_path) {
10849:         Ok(metadata) => {
10850:             if metadata.file_type().is_dir() {
10851:                 let _ = secure_remove_file(temp_output.as_path());
10852:                 let _ = fs::remove_dir(temp_dir.as_path());
10853:                 return Err(format!(
10854:                     "signing passphrase output must not be a directory: {}",
10855:                     output_path.display()
10856:                 ));
10857:             }
10858:             secure_remove_file(output_path)?;
10859:         }
10860:         Err(err) if err.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => {}
10861:         Err(err) => {
10862:             let _ = secure_remove_file(temp_output.as_path());
10863:             let _ = fs::remove_dir(temp_dir.as_path());
10864:             return Err(format!(
10865:                 "inspect signing passphrase output failed ({}): {err}",
10866:                 output_path.display()
10867:             ));
10868:         }
10869:     }
10870:     if let Err(err) = publish_file_with_owner_mode(
10871:         temp_output.as_path(),
10872:         output_path,
10873:         Uid::from_raw(0),
10874:         Gid::from_raw(0),
10875:         0o600,
10876:         "signing passphrase output",
10877:     ) {
10878:         let _ = secure_remove_file(temp_output.as_path());
10879:         let _ = fs::remove_dir(temp_dir.as_path());
10880:         return Err(err);
10881:     }
10882:     fs::remove_dir(temp_dir.as_path()).map_err(|err| {
10883:         format!(
10884:             "remove temporary signing passphrase directory {} failed: {err}",
10885:             temp_dir.display()
10886:         )
10887:     })?;
10888:     Ok(())
10889: }
10890: 
10891: fn materialize_signing_passphrase_macos(
10892:     config: &SigningPassphraseOpsConfig,
10893:     output_path: &Path,
10894: ) -> Result<(), String> {
10895:     let output = Command::new("security")
10896:         .arg("find-generic-password")
10897:         .arg("-s")
10898:         .arg(config.macos_keychain_service.as_str())
10899:         .arg("-a")
10900:         .arg(config.macos_keychain_account.as_str())
10901:         .arg("-w")
10902:         .output()
10903:         .map_err(|err| format!("invoke security keychain read failed: {err}"))?;
10904:     if !output.status.success() {
10905:         return Err(format!(
10906:             "failed to materialize passphrase from keychain (service={}, account={})",
10907:             config.macos_keychain_service, config.macos_keychain_account
10908:         ));
10909:     }
10910:     let passphrase = Zeroizing::new(output.stdout);
10911:     write_private_bytes_to_file(output_path, passphrase.as_slice())?;
10912:     Ok(())
10913: }
10914: 
10915: fn write_private_bytes_to_file(path: &Path, body: &[u8]) -> Result<(), String> {
10916:     if !path.is_absolute() {
10917:         return Err(format!("path must be absolute: {}", path.display()));
10918:     }
10919:     if let Ok(metadata) = fs::symlink_metadata(path) {
10920:         if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
10921:             return Err(format!("path must not be a symlink: {}", path.display()));
10922:         }
10923:         if !metadata.file_type().is_file() {
10924:             return Err(format!("path must be a regular file: {}", path.display()));
10925:         }
10926:     }
10927:     let mut options = OpenOptions::new();
10928:     options.write(true).truncate(true).create(true).mode(0o600);
10929:     let mut file = options
10930:         .open(path)
10931:         .map_err(|err| format!("open {} failed: {err}", path.display()))?;
10932:     file.write_all(body)
10933:         .map_err(|err| format!("write {} failed: {err}", path.display()))?;
10934:     file.sync_all()
10935:         .map_err(|err| format!("sync {} failed: {err}", path.display()))?;
10936:     fs::set_permissions(path, fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o600))
10937:         .map_err(|err| format!("set mode {} failed: {err}", path.display()))?;
10938:     Ok(())
10939: }
10940: 
10941: fn secure_remove_file(path: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
10942:     let metadata = match fs::symlink_metadata(path) {
10943:         Ok(metadata) => metadata,
10944:         Err(err) if err.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => return Ok(()),
10945:         Err(err) => return Err(format!("inspect {} failed: {err}", path.display())),
10946:     };
10947: 
10948:     if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
10949:         return fs::remove_file(path)
10950:             .map_err(|err| format!("remove symlink {} failed: {err}", path.display()));
10951:     }
10952:     if !metadata.file_type().is_file() {
10953:         return Err(format!(
10954:             "secure remove requires a regular file: {}",
10955:             path.display()
10956:         ));
10957:     }
10958: 
10959:     scrub_file_contents(path)?;
10960:     fs::remove_file(path).map_err(|err| format!("remove {} failed: {err}", path.display()))
10961: }
10962: 
10963: fn scrub_file_contents(path: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
10964:     let metadata = fs::metadata(path)
10965:         .map_err(|err| format!("inspect file {} failed: {err}", path.display()))?;
10966:     let mut file = OpenOptions::new()
10967:         .write(true)
10968:         .open(path)
10969:         .map_err(|err| format!("open {} failed: {err}", path.display()))?;
10970:     let mut remaining = metadata.len();
10971:     let zero_chunk = [0u8; 8192];
10972:     while remaining > 0 {
10973:         let write_len = usize::try_from(std::cmp::min(remaining, zero_chunk.len() as u64))
10974:             .map_err(|_| "internal length conversion failed".to_string())?;
10975:         file.write_all(&zero_chunk[..write_len])
10976:             .map_err(|err| format!("scrub write {} failed: {err}", path.display()))?;
10977:         remaining = remaining.saturating_sub(write_len as u64);
10978:     }
10979:     file.sync_all()
10980:         .map_err(|err| format!("sync {} failed: {err}", path.display()))?;
10981:     file.set_len(0)
10982:         .map_err(|err| format!("truncate {} failed: {err}", path.display()))?;
10983:     file.sync_all()
10984:         .map_err(|err| format!("sync {} after truncate failed: {err}", path.display()))?;
10985:     Ok(())
10986: }

10991:     if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
10992:         return Err(format!("{label} must not be a symlink: {}", path.display()));
10993:     }
10994:     if !metadata.file_type().is_file() {
10995:         return Err(format!(
10996:             "{label} must be a regular file: {}",
10997:             path.display()
10998:         ));
10999:     }
11000:     Ok(())
11001: }

11010: fn rewrite_assignment_refresh_exit_node(body: &str, exit_node_id: Option<&str>) -> String {
11011:     let mut rewritten_lines = Vec::new();
11012:     let mut inserted = false;
11013:     for line in body.lines() {
11014:         if line.starts_with("RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_EXIT_NODE_ID=") {
11015:             if !inserted {
11016:                 if let Some(exit_node_id_value) = exit_node_id {
11017:                     rewritten_lines.push(
11018:                         format_env_assignment(
11019:                             "RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_EXIT_NODE_ID",
11020:                             exit_node_id_value,
11021:                         )
11022:                         .unwrap_or_else(|err| {
11023:                             panic!(
11024:                                 "invalid assignment refresh exit node value {exit_node_id_value}: {err}"
11025:                             )
11026:                         }),
11027:                     );
11028:                 }
11029:                 inserted = true;
11030:             }
11031:             continue;
11032:         }
11033:         rewritten_lines.push(line.to_string());
11034:     }
11035:     if !inserted && let Some(exit_node_id_value) = exit_node_id {
11036:         rewritten_lines.push(
11037:             format_env_assignment("RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_EXIT_NODE_ID", exit_node_id_value)
11038:                 .unwrap_or_else(|err| {
11039:                     panic!("invalid assignment refresh exit node value {exit_node_id_value}: {err}")
11040:                 }),
11041:         );
11042:     }
11043:     if rewritten_lines.is_empty() {
11044:         return String::new();
11045:     }
11046:     format!("{}\n", rewritten_lines.join("\n"))
11047: }

11142: fn parse_bool_value(key: &str, value: &str) -> Result<bool, String> {
11143:     match value {
11144:         "true" | "TRUE" | "yes" | "YES" | "1" | "on" | "ON" => Ok(true),
11145:         "false" | "FALSE" | "no" | "NO" | "0" | "off" | "OFF" | "" => Ok(false),
11146:         _ => Err(format!("invalid boolean value for {key}: {value}")),
11147:     }

11150: fn validate_assignment_refresh_lan_routes(lan_routes: &[String]) -> Result<(), String> {
11151:     if lan_routes.is_empty() {
11152:         return Err("at least one LAN route CIDR is required".to_string());
11153:     }
11154:     let mut seen = HashSet::new();
11155:     for cidr in lan_routes {
11156:         if cidr.trim() != cidr || cidr.is_empty() {
11157:             return Err(format!("LAN route cidr must not be empty: {cidr:?}"));
11158:         }
11159:         if !validate_cidr(cidr.as_str()) {
11160:             return Err(format!("invalid LAN route cidr: {cidr}"));
11161:         }
11162:         if !seen.insert(cidr.as_str()) {
11163:             return Err(format!("duplicate LAN route cidr: {cidr}"));
11164:         }
11165:     }
11166:     Ok(())
11167: }

11169: fn status_field(status_line: &str, key: &str) -> Option<String> {
11170:     let prefix = format!("{key}=");

11172:         .split_whitespace()

11176: fn wait_for_daemon_status_field(
11177:     socket_path: &Path,
11178:     key: &str,
11179:     expected_value: &str,
11180:     timeout: Duration,
11181: ) -> Result<(), String> {
11182:     let start = Instant::now();
11183:     while start.elapsed() <= timeout {
11184:         let status = send_command_with_socket(IpcCommand::Status, socket_path.to_path_buf())?;
11185:         if status.ok
11186:             && status_field(status.message.as_str(), key).as_deref() == Some(expected_value)
11187:         {
11188:             return Ok(());
11189:         }
11190:         std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_secs(1));
11191:     }
11192:     Err(format!(
11193:         "timed out waiting for daemon status field {key}={expected_value}"
11194:     ))
11195: }

11201: fn wait_for_client_exit_route_convergence(
11202:     socket_path: &Path,
11203:     assignment_refresh_env_path: &Path,
11204:     expected_exit_node: &str,
11205:     timeout: Duration,
11206: ) -> Result<(), String> {
11207:     let start = Instant::now();
11208:     let mut next_refresh_at =
11209:         Instant::now() + Duration::from_secs(LOCAL_TRAVERSAL_CONVERGENCE_REFRESH_INTERVAL_SECS);
11210:     let mut last_status = String::new();
11211:     let mut last_route = String::new();
11212:     while start.elapsed() <= timeout {
11213:         if Instant::now() >= next_refresh_at {
11214:             refresh_local_traversal_bundle_from_assignment_env(assignment_refresh_env_path)?;
11215:             if socket_exists_and_is_socket(socket_path, "daemon socket")? {
11216:                 let _ =
11217:                     send_command_with_socket(IpcCommand::StateRefresh, socket_path.to_path_buf());
11218:             }
11219:             next_refresh_at = Instant::now()
11220:                 + Duration::from_secs(LOCAL_TRAVERSAL_CONVERGENCE_REFRESH_INTERVAL_SECS);
11221:         }
11222:         let status = send_command_with_socket(IpcCommand::Status, socket_path.to_path_buf())?;
11223:         if status.ok {
11224:             last_status = status.message.clone();
11225:             let route_output = run_command_capture("ip", &["-4", "route", "get", "1.1.1.1"])?;
11226:             last_route = String::from_utf8_lossy(&route_output.stdout)
11227:                 .trim()
11228:                 .to_string();
11229:             if status_field(status.message.as_str(), "exit_node")
11230:                 == Some(expected_exit_node.to_string())
11231:                 && daemon_runtime_ready_from_status_text(status.message.as_str())
11232:                 && route_output.status.success()
11233:                 && route_uses_rustynet0(last_route.as_str())
11234:             {
11235:                 return Ok(());
11236:             }
11237:         }
11238:         std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_secs(1));
11239:     }
11240:     Err(format!(
11241:         "timed out waiting for client exit route convergence to {expected_exit_node}: status={last_status} route={last_route}"
11242:     ))
11243: }

11245: fn apply_lan_blackhole_routes(
11246:     lan_routes: &[String],
11247:     install_blackhole: bool,
11248: ) -> Result<(), String> {
11249:     for cidr in lan_routes {
11250:         let is_ipv6 = cidr.contains(':');
11251:         let mut command = Command::new("ip");
11252:         if is_ipv6 {
11253:             command.arg("-6");
11254:         } else {
11255:             command.arg("-4");
11256:         }
11257:         command.arg("route");
11258:         if install_blackhole {
11259:             command.arg("replace").arg("blackhole").arg(cidr.as_str());
11260:         } else {
11261:             command.arg("del").arg(cidr.as_str());
11262:         }
11263:         let output = command
11264:             .arg("table")
11265:             .arg("51820")
11266:             .output()
11267:             .map_err(|err| format!("invoke ip route update for {cidr} failed: {err}"))?;
11268:         if output.status.success() {
11269:             continue;
11270:         }
11271:         if !install_blackhole {
11272:             let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr);
11273:             if stderr.contains("No such process") || stderr.contains("No such file") {
11274:                 continue;
11275:             }
11276:         }
11277:         return Err(format!(
11278:             "ip route update failed for {cidr}: {}",
11279:             String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).trim()
11280:         ));
11281:     }
11282:     Ok(())
11283: }

11294: fn env_optional_string(key: &str) -> Result<Option<String>, String> {
11295:     match std::env::var(key) {
11296:         Ok(value) => {
11297:             if value.trim().is_empty() {
11298:                 Ok(None)
11299:             } else {
11300:                 Ok(Some(value))
11301:             }
11302:         }
11303:         Err(std::env::VarError::NotPresent) => Ok(None),
11304:         Err(std::env::VarError::NotUnicode(_)) => {
11305:             Err(format!("environment variable {key} contains non-utf8 data"))
11306:         }
11307:     }
11308: }

11318: fn env_path_or_default(key: &str, default: &str) -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
11319:     if let Some(raw) = env_optional_string(key)? {
11320:         let configured_path = PathBuf::from(raw);
11321:         if !configured_path.is_absolute() {
11322:             return Err(format!(
11323:                 "path must be absolute: {}",
11324:                 configured_path.display()
11325:             ));
11326:         }
11327:         return Ok(configured_path);
11328:     }
11329: 
11330:     let default_path = PathBuf::from(default);
11331:     if default_path.is_absolute() {
11332:         return Ok(default_path);
11333:     }
11334:     let cwd = std::env::current_dir()
11335:         .map_err(|err| format!("resolve current directory failed: {err}"))?;
11336:     Ok(cwd.join(default_path))
11337: }

11365: fn validate_root_owned_passphrase_file(path: &Path, label: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
11366:     let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(path)
11367:         .map_err(|err| format!("inspect {label} failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
11368:     if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
11369:         return Err(format!("{label} must not be a symlink: {}", path.display()));
11370:     }
11371:     if !metadata.file_type().is_file() {
11372:         return Err(format!(
11373:             "{label} must reference a regular file: {}",
11374:             path.display()
11375:         ));
11376:     }
11377:     if metadata.uid() != 0 {
11378:         return Err(format!("{label} must be owned by root: {}", path.display()));
11379:     }
11380:     let mode = metadata.mode() & 0o777;
11381:     let disallowed_mode_mask = if path.starts_with("/run/credentials/") {
11382:         0o037
11383:     } else {
11384:         0o077
11385:     };
11386:     if (mode & disallowed_mode_mask) != 0 {
11387:         let expected = if path.starts_with("/run/credentials/") {
11388:             "owner-only or systemd credential mode"
11389:         } else {
11390:             "owner-only (0600)"
11391:         };
11392:         return Err(format!(
11393:             "{label} permissions too broad ({mode:03o}); expected {expected}: {}",
11394:             path.display()
11395:         ));
11396:     }
11397:     Ok(())
11398: }

11411: fn ensure_directory_exists(path: &Path, mode: u32, owner: Uid, group: Gid) -> Result<(), String> {
11412:     match fs::symlink_metadata(path) {
11413:         Ok(metadata) => {
11414:             if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
11415:                 return Err(format!(
11416:                     "directory must not be a symlink: {}",
11417:                     path.display()
11418:                 ));
11419:             }
11420:             if !metadata.file_type().is_dir() {
11421:                 return Err(format!("path must be a directory: {}", path.display()));
11422:             }
11423:             return Ok(());
11424:         }
11425:         Err(err) if err.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => {}
11426:         Err(err) => {
11427:             return Err(format!(
11428:                 "inspect directory {} failed: {err}",
11429:                 path.display()
11430:             ));
11431:         }
11432:     }
11433: 
11434:     fs::create_dir_all(path)
11435:         .map_err(|err| format!("create directory {} failed: {err}", path.display()))?;
11436:     chown(path, Some(owner), Some(group))
11437:         .map_err(|err| format!("set directory owner {} failed: {err}", path.display()))?;
11438:     fs::set_permissions(path, fs::Permissions::from_mode(mode))
11439:         .map_err(|err| format!("set directory mode {} failed: {err}", path.display()))?;
11440:     Ok(())
11441: }

11443: fn create_secure_temp_file(dir: &Path, prefix: &str) -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
11444:     let mut random_bytes = [0u8; 8];
11445:     for _ in 0..32 {
11446:         fill_os_random_bytes(&mut random_bytes, "temporary file name")?;
11447:         let candidate = dir.join(format!("{prefix}{}", hex_bytes(&random_bytes)));
11448:         let mut options = OpenOptions::new();
11449:         options.write(true).create_new(true).mode(0o600);
11450:         match options.open(&candidate) {
11451:             Ok(_) => return Ok(candidate),
11452:             Err(err) if err.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::AlreadyExists => continue,
11453:             Err(err) => {
11454:                 return Err(format!(
11455:                     "create temporary file {} failed: {err}",
11456:                     candidate.display()
11457:                 ));
11458:             }
11459:         }
11460:     }
11461:     Err(format!(
11462:         "unable to allocate secure temporary file in {}",
11463:         dir.display()
11464:     ))
11465: }
11466: 
11467: fn create_secure_temp_directory(dir: &Path, prefix: &str) -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
11468:     let mut random_bytes = [0u8; 8];
11469:     for _ in 0..32 {
11470:         fill_os_random_bytes(&mut random_bytes, "temporary directory name")?;
11471:         let candidate = dir.join(format!("{prefix}{}", hex_bytes(&random_bytes)));
11472:         match fs::create_dir(candidate.as_path()) {
11473:             Ok(()) => {
11474:                 fs::set_permissions(candidate.as_path(), fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o700))
11475:                     .map_err(|err| {
11476:                         format!(
11477:                             "set temporary directory mode {} failed: {err}",
11478:                             candidate.display()
11479:                         )
11480:                     })?;
11481:                 return Ok(candidate);
11482:             }
11483:             Err(err) if err.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::AlreadyExists => continue,
11484:             Err(err) => {
11485:                 return Err(format!(
11486:                     "create temporary directory {} failed: {err}",
11487:                     candidate.display()
11488:                 ));
11489:             }
11490:         }
11491:     }
11492:     Err(format!(
11493:         "unable to allocate secure temporary directory in {}",
11494:         dir.display()
11495:     ))
11496: }

11498: fn publish_file_with_owner_mode(

11500:     destination_path: &Path,

11502:     group: Gid,
11503:     mode: u32,

11523:     })?;

11538: fn parse_bundle_u64_field(body: &str, key: &str) -> Option<u64> {
11539:     let prefix = format!("{key}=");
11540:     for line in body.lines() {
11541:         if let Some(value) = line.strip_prefix(prefix.as_str()) {
11542:             let normalized = value
11543:                 .chars()
11544:                 .filter(|ch| !ch.is_ascii_whitespace())
11545:                 .collect::<String>();
11546:             return normalized.parse::<u64>().ok();
11547:         }
11548:     }
11549:     None
11550: }

11585: fn emit_membership_evidence(
11586:     paths: MembershipPaths,
11587:     now_unix: u64,
11588:     output_dir: PathBuf,
11589:     environment: String,
11590: ) -> Result<String, String> {
11591:     if environment.trim().is_empty() {
11592:         return Err("environment must not be empty".to_string());
11593:     }
11594: 
11595:     let (_, entries, state) = load_current_membership_state(&paths, now_unix)?;
11596:     fs::create_dir_all(&output_dir).map_err(|err| format!("create output dir failed: {err}"))?;
11597: 
11598:     let captured_at_unix = unix_now();
11599:     let active_node_count = state.active_nodes().len();
11600:     let state_root = state.state_root_hex().map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
11601:     let conformance_path = output_dir.join("membership_conformance_report.json");
11602:     let negative_path = output_dir.join("membership_negative_tests_report.json");
11603:     let recovery_path = output_dir.join("membership_recovery_report.json");
11604:     let audit_path = output_dir.join("membership_audit_integrity.log");
11605: 
11606:     write_membership_audit_log(&audit_path, &entries).map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
11607: 
11608:     let tampered_log_detected = detect_tampered_log(&paths.log_path, &output_dir)?;
11609:     let tampered_snapshot_detected = detect_tampered_snapshot(&paths.snapshot_path, &output_dir)?;
11610: 
11611:     let conformance = format!(
11612: /* ELIDED: original line had 40 backslash-quote sequences — removed to avoid DeepSeek parser failure */
11613:         escape_json(&environment),
11614:         captured_at_unix,
11615:         escape_json(&state.network_id),
11616:         state.epoch,
11617:         entries.len(),
11618:         active_node_count,
11619:         escape_json(&state_root),
11620:         escape_json(&paths.snapshot_path.display().to_string()),
11621:         escape_json(&paths.log_path.display().to_string()),
11622:     );
11623:     write_text_file(&conformance_path, &conformance)?;
11624: 
11625:     let negative_status = if tampered_log_detected && tampered_snapshot_detected {
11626:         "pass"
11627:     } else {
11628:         "fail"
11629:     };
11630:     let negative = format!(
11631: /* ELIDED: original line had 22 backslash-quote sequences — removed to avoid DeepSeek parser failure */
11632:         escape_json(&environment),
11633:         captured_at_unix,
11634:         negative_status,
11635:         tampered_log_detected,
11636:         tampered_snapshot_detected,
11637:     );
11638:     write_text_file(&negative_path, &negative)?;
11639: 
11640:     let recovery = format!(
11641: /* ELIDED: original line had 30 backslash-quote sequences — removed to avoid DeepSeek parser failure */
11642:         escape_json(&environment),
11643:         captured_at_unix,
11644:         if negative_status == "pass" {
11645:             "pass"
11646:         } else {
11647:             "fail"
11648:         },
11649:         escape_json(&audit_path.display().to_string()),
11650:         entries.len(),
11651:         state.epoch,
11652:         escape_json(&state_root),
11653:     );
11654:     write_text_file(&recovery_path, &recovery)?;
11655: 
11656:     if negative_status != "pass" {
11657:         return Err(
11658:             "membership evidence generation failed: tampering checks did not fail closed"
11659:                 .to_string(),
11660:         );
11661:     }
11662: 
11663:     Ok(format!(
11664:         "membership evidence generated: output_dir={} entries={} epoch={}",
11665:         output_dir.display(),
11666:         entries.len(),
11667:         state.epoch
11668:     ))
11669: }

11671: fn detect_tampered_log(source_path: &Path, output_dir: &Path) -> Result<bool, String> {
11672:     let tampered_path = output_dir.join("membership.log.tampered");
11673:     fs::copy(source_path, &tampered_path).map_err(|err| format!("copy log failed: {err}"))?;
11674:     let original = fs::read_to_string(&tampered_path).map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
11675:     let tampered = if let Some((head, tail)) = original.split_once("entry=") {
11676:         format!("{head}entry=999{tail}")
11677:     } else if let Some((version_line, remainder)) = original.split_once('\n') {
11678:         if !version_line.starts_with("version=") {
11679:             fs::remove_file(&tampered_path).ok();
11680:             return Err("membership log missing version line".to_string());
11681:         }
11682:         format!("version=255\n{remainder}")
11683:     } else if original.starts_with("version=") {
11684:         "version=255\n".to_string()
11685:     } else {
11686:         fs::remove_file(&tampered_path).ok();
11687:         return Err("membership log missing version line".to_string());
11688:     };
11689:     fs::write(&tampered_path, tampered).map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
11690:     let detected = load_membership_log(&tampered_path).is_err();
11691:     fs::remove_file(&tampered_path).ok();
11692:     Ok(detected)
11693: }
11694: 
11695: fn detect_tampered_snapshot(source_path: &Path, output_dir: &Path) -> Result<bool, String> {
11696:     let tampered_path = output_dir.join("membership.snapshot.tampered");
11697:     fs::copy(source_path, &tampered_path).map_err(|err| format!("copy snapshot failed: {err}"))?;
11698:     let original = fs::read_to_string(&tampered_path).map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
11699:     let mut replaced = false;
11700:     let mut tampered_lines = Vec::new();
11701:     for line in original.lines() {
11702:         if line.starts_with("digest=") && !replaced {
11703:             tampered_lines.push("digest=00".to_string());
11704:             replaced = true;
11705:         } else {
11706:             tampered_lines.push(line.to_string());
11707:         }
11708:     }
11709:     if !replaced {
11710:         fs::remove_file(&tampered_path).ok();
11711:         return Err("membership snapshot missing digest line".to_string());
11712:     }
11713:     fs::write(&tampered_path, tampered_lines.join("\n") + "\n").map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
11714:     let detected = load_membership_snapshot(&tampered_path).is_err();
11715:     fs::remove_file(&tampered_path).ok();
11716:     Ok(detected)
11717: }
11718: 
11719: fn escape_json(input: &str) -> String {
11720:     let mut out = String::with_capacity(input.len());
11721:     for ch in input.chars() {
11722:         match ch {
11723:             '"' => out.push_str("\\\""),
11724:             '\\' => out.push_str("\\\\"),
11725:             '\n' => out.push_str("\\n"),
11726:             '\r' => out.push_str("\\r"),
11727:             '\t' => out.push_str("\\t"),
11728:             _ => out.push(ch),
11729:         }
11730:     }
11731:     out
11732: }

11734: fn write_text_file(path: &Path, body: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
11735:     if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
11736:         fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|err| format!("create parent failed: {err}"))?;
11737:     }
11738:     fs::write(path, body).map_err(|err| format!("write file failed: {err}"))
11739: }

11741: fn encrypted_secret_permission_policy(path: &Path) -> KeyCustodyPermissionPolicy {
11742:     let mut policy = KeyCustodyPermissionPolicy::default();
11743:     if matches!(path.parent(), Some(parent) if parent == Path::new("/etc/rustynet")) {
11744:         // Encrypted signing artifacts currently coexist with daemon-readable verifier
11745:         // material under /etc/rustynet on Linux.
11746:         policy.required_directory_mode = 0o750;
11747:     }
11748:     policy
11749: }
11750: 
11751: fn load_signing_key(path: &Path, passphrase_path: &Path) -> Result<SigningKey, String> {
11752:     let secret = load_encrypted_secret_material(path, passphrase_path, "signing key")?;
11753:     if secret.len() != 32 {
11754:         return Err("decrypted signing key must be exactly 32 bytes".to_string());
11755:     }
11756:     let mut bytes = [0u8; 32];
11757:     bytes.copy_from_slice(secret.as_slice());
11758:     let key = SigningKey::from_bytes(&bytes);
11759:     bytes.zeroize();
11760:     Ok(key)
11761: }
11762: 
11763: fn validate_encrypted_secret_file_security(path: &Path, label: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
11764:     let metadata =
11765:         fs::symlink_metadata(path).map_err(|err| format!("inspect {label} failed: {err}"))?;
11766:     if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
11767:         return Err(format!("{label} path must not be a symlink"));
11768:     }
11769:     if !metadata.file_type().is_file() {
11770:         return Err(format!("{label} path must reference a regular file"));
11771:     }
11772: 
11773:     let mode = metadata.mode() & 0o777;
11774:     if (mode & 0o077) != 0 {
11775:         return Err(format!(
11776:             "{label} file permissions must be owner-only (0600); found {mode:03o}",
11777:         ));
11778:     }
11779: 
11780:     let expected_uid = Uid::effective().as_raw();
11781:     let owner_uid = metadata.uid();
11782:     if owner_uid != expected_uid {
11783:         return Err(format!(
11784:             "{label} file owner mismatch: expected uid {expected_uid}, found {owner_uid}"
11785:         ));
11786:     }
11787:     Ok(())
11788: }
11789: 
11790: fn load_encrypted_secret_material(
11791:     path: &Path,
11792:     passphrase_path: &Path,
11793:     label: &str,
11794: ) -> Result<Zeroizing<Vec<u8>>, String> {
11795:     if !passphrase_path.is_absolute() {
11796:         return Err(format!(
11797:             "{label} passphrase file path must be absolute: {}",
11798:             passphrase_path.display()
11799:         ));
11800:     }
11801:     validate_encrypted_secret_file_security(path, label)?;
11802:     let passphrase = read_passphrase_file_explicit(passphrase_path).map_err(|err| {
11803:         format!(
11804:             "{label} passphrase source invalid ({}): {err}",
11805:             passphrase_path.display()
11806:         )
11807:     })?;
11808:     let parent = path
11809:         .parent()
11810:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("{label} path has no parent: {}", path.display()))?;
11811:     let permission_policy = encrypted_secret_permission_policy(path);
11812:     let secret = read_encrypted_key_file(parent, path, passphrase.as_str(), permission_policy)
11813:         .map_err(|err| format!("decrypt {label} failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
11814:     Ok(Zeroizing::new(secret))
11815: }
11816: 
11817: fn persist_encrypted_secret_material(
11818:     path: &Path,
11819:     secret: &[u8],
11820:     passphrase_path: &Path,
11821:     label: &str,
11822:     force: bool,
11823: ) -> Result<(), String> {
11824:     if !passphrase_path.is_absolute() {
11825:         return Err(format!(
11826:             "{label} passphrase file path must be absolute: {}",
11827:             passphrase_path.display()
11828:         ));
11829:     }
11830:     if path.exists() {
11831:         let metadata =
11832:             fs::symlink_metadata(path).map_err(|err| format!("inspect {label} failed: {err}"))?;
11833:         if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
11834:             return Err(format!("{label} path must not be a symlink"));
11835:         }
11836:         if !metadata.file_type().is_file() {
11837:             return Err(format!("{label} path must reference a regular file"));
11838:         }
11839:         if !force {
11840:             return Err(format!(
11841:                 "{label} already exists at {}; use --force to overwrite",
11842:                 path.display()
11843:             ));
11844:         }
11845:         remove_file_if_present(path)?;
11846:     }
11847:     let passphrase = read_passphrase_file_explicit(passphrase_path).map_err(|err| {
11848:         format!(
11849:             "{label} passphrase source invalid ({}): {err}",
11850:             passphrase_path.display()
11851:         )
11852:     })?;
11853:     let parent = path
11854:         .parent()
11855:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("{label} path has no parent: {}", path.display()))?;
11856:     let permission_policy = encrypted_secret_permission_policy(path);
11857:     write_encrypted_key_file(parent, path, secret, passphrase.as_str(), permission_policy).map_err(
11858:         |err| {
11859:             format!(
11860:                 "persist encrypted {label} failed ({}): {err}",
11861:                 path.display()
11862:             )
11863:         },
11864:     )
11865: }
11866: 
11867: fn decode_hex_to_32(encoded: &str) -> Result<[u8; 32], String> {
11868:     let trimmed = encoded.trim();
11869:     if trimmed.len() != 64 {
11870:         return Err("signing key must be 32-byte hex".to_string());
11871:     }
11872:     let mut out = [0u8; 32];
11873:     let raw = trimmed.as_bytes();
11874:     let mut index = 0usize;
11875:     while index < 32 {
11876:         let hi = decode_hex_nibble(raw[index * 2])?;
11877:         let lo = decode_hex_nibble(raw[index * 2 + 1])?;
11878:         out[index] = (hi << 4) | lo;
11879:         index += 1;
11880:     }
11881:     Ok(out)
11882: }
11883: 
11884: fn decode_hex_nibble(value: u8) -> Result<u8, String> {
11885:     match value {
11886:         b'0'..=b'9' => Ok(value - b'0'),
11887:         b'a'..=b'f' => Ok(value - b'a' + 10),
11888:         b'A'..=b'F' => Ok(value - b'A' + 10),
11889:         _ => Err("invalid hex character in signing key".to_string()),
11890:     }
11891: }
11892: 
11893: fn hex_bytes(bytes: &[u8]) -> String {
11894:     let mut out = String::with_capacity(bytes.len() * 2);
11895:     for byte in bytes {
11896:         out.push_str(&format!("{byte:02x}"));
11897:     }
11898:     out
11899: }

11901: fn split_csv(value: String) -> Vec<String> {
11902:     value
11903:         .split(',')
11904:         .map(str::trim)
11905:         .filter(|entry| !entry.is_empty())
11906:         .map(ToString::to_string)
11907:         .collect()
11908: }

11910: fn collect_repeated_option_values(args: &[String], key: &str) -> Vec<String> {
11911:     let mut values = Vec::new();
11912:     let mut index = 0usize;
11913:     while index < args.len() {
11914:         if index + 1 < args.len() && !args[index + 1].starts_with("--") {
11915:             if args[index] == key {
11916:                 values.push(args[index + 1].clone());
11917:             }
11918:             index += 2;
11919:         } else {
11920:             index += 1;
11921:         }
11922:     }
11923:     values
11924: }
11925: 
11926: fn collect_repeated_option_values_allow_leading_dash(
11927:     args: &[String],
11928:     key: &str,
11929: ) -> Result<Vec<String>, String> {
11930:     let mut values = Vec::new();
11931:     let mut index = 0usize;
11932:     while index < args.len() {
11933:         if args[index] == key {
11934:             if index + 1 >= args.len() {
11935:                 return Err(format!("missing value for repeated option: {key}"));
11936:             }
11937:             values.push(args[index + 1].clone());
11938:             index += 2;
11939:             continue;
11940:         }
11941:         if index + 1 < args.len() && !args[index + 1].starts_with("--") {
11942:             index += 2;
11943:         } else {
11944:             index += 1;
11945:         }
11946:     }
11947:     Ok(values)
11948: }

11950: fn parse_assignment_nodes(encoded: &str) -> Result<Vec<AssignmentNodeSpec>, String> {
11951:     let mut nodes = Vec::new();
11952:     for raw in encoded
11953:         .split(';')
11954:         .map(str::trim)
11955:         .filter(|entry| !entry.is_empty())
11956:     {
11957:         let fields = raw.split('|').collect::<Vec<_>>();
11958:         if fields.len() < 3 || fields.len() > 7 {
11959:             return Err("invalid --nodes entry format; expected node_id|endpoint|public_key_hex[|owner|hostname|os|tags_csv]".to_string());
11960:         }
11961: 
11962:         let node_id = fields[0].trim();
11963:         if node_id.is_empty() {
11964:             return Err("node_id must not be empty in --nodes".to_string());
11965:         }
11966:         let endpoint = fields[1].trim();
11967:         endpoint
11968:             .parse::<std::net::SocketAddr>()
11969:             .map_err(|_| format!("invalid endpoint for node {node_id}: {endpoint}"))?;
11970:         let public_key = decode_hex_to_32(fields[2].trim())
11971:             .map_err(|err| format!("invalid public key for node {node_id}: {err}"))?;
11972:         let owner = fields
11973:             .get(3)
11974:             .map(|value| value.trim().to_string())
11975:             .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
11976:             .unwrap_or_else(|| node_id.to_string());
11977:         let hostname = fields
11978:             .get(4)
11979:             .map(|value| value.trim().to_string())
11980:             .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
11981:             .unwrap_or_else(|| node_id.to_string());
11982:         let os = fields
11983:             .get(5)
11984:             .map(|value| value.trim().to_string())
11985:             .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
11986:             .unwrap_or_else(|| "linux".to_string());
11987:         let tags = fields
11988:             .get(6)
11989:             .map(|value| split_csv((*value).to_string()))
11990:             .unwrap_or_default();
11991: 
11992:         nodes.push(AssignmentNodeSpec {
11993:             node_id: node_id.to_string(),
11994:             endpoint: endpoint.to_string(),
11995:             public_key,
11996:             owner,
11997:             hostname,
11998:             os,
11999:             tags,
12000:         });
12001:     }
12002:     if nodes.is_empty() {
12003:         return Err("at least one node is required in --nodes".to_string());
12004:     }
12005:     Ok(nodes)
12006: }
12007: 
12008: fn parse_assignment_allow_pairs(encoded: &str) -> Result<Vec<AssignmentAllowPair>, String> {
12009:     let mut pairs = Vec::new();
12010:     for raw in encoded
12011:         .split(';')
12012:         .map(str::trim)
12013:         .filter(|entry| !entry.is_empty())
12014:     {
12015:         let fields = raw.split('|').collect::<Vec<_>>();
12016:         if fields.len() != 2 {
12017:             return Err(
12018:                 "invalid --allow entry format; expected source_node_id|destination_node_id"
12019:                     .to_string(),
12020:             );
12021:         }
12022:         let source_node_id = fields[0].trim();
12023:         let destination_node_id = fields[1].trim();
12024:         if source_node_id.is_empty() || destination_node_id.is_empty() {
12025:             return Err("allow pair node ids must not be empty".to_string());
12026:         }
12027:         pairs.push(AssignmentAllowPair {
12028:             source_node_id: source_node_id.to_string(),
12029:             destination_node_id: destination_node_id.to_string(),
12030:         });
12031:     }
12032:     if pairs.is_empty() {
12033:         return Err("at least one allow pair is required in --allow".to_string());
12034:     }
12035:     Ok(pairs)
12036: }
12037: 
12038: fn parse_traversal_candidates(encoded: &str) -> Result<Vec<TraversalCandidateSpec>, String> {
12039:     let mut candidates = Vec::new();
12040:     for raw in encoded
12041:         .split(';')
12042:         .map(str::trim)
12043:         .filter(|entry| !entry.is_empty())
12044:     {
12045:         let fields = raw.split('|').map(str::trim).collect::<Vec<_>>();
12046:         if fields.len() < 3 || fields.len() > 4 {
12047:             return Err(
12048:                 "invalid --candidates entry format; expected type|endpoint|priority[|relay_id]"
12049:                     .to_string(),
12050:             );
12051:         }
12052:         let candidate_type = match fields[0] {
12053:             "host" => EndpointHintCandidateType::Host,
12054:             "srflx" => EndpointHintCandidateType::ServerReflexive,
12055:             "relay" => EndpointHintCandidateType::Relay,
12056:             other => {
12057:                 return Err(format!(
12058:                     "unsupported candidate type {other}; expected host|srflx|relay"
12059:                 ));
12060:             }
12061:         };
12062:         let endpoint = fields[1].to_string();
12063:         endpoint
12064:             .parse::<SocketAddr>()
12065:             .map_err(|_| format!("invalid traversal candidate endpoint: {endpoint}"))?;
12066:         let priority = fields[2]
12067:             .parse::<u16>()
12068:             .map_err(|err| format!("invalid traversal candidate priority: {err}"))?;
12069:         let relay_id = fields
12070:             .get(3)
12071:             .map(|value| value.trim().to_string())
12072:             .filter(|value| !value.is_empty());
12073:         if matches!(candidate_type, EndpointHintCandidateType::Relay) && relay_id.is_none() {
12074:             return Err("relay traversal candidates require relay_id".to_string());
12075:         }
12076:         if !matches!(candidate_type, EndpointHintCandidateType::Relay) && relay_id.is_some() {
12077:             return Err("relay_id is only valid for relay traversal candidates".to_string());
12078:         }
12079:         candidates.push(TraversalCandidateSpec {
12080:             candidate_type,
12081:             endpoint,
12082:             relay_id,
12083:             priority,
12084:         });
12085:     }
12086:     if candidates.is_empty() {
12087:         return Err("at least one traversal candidate is required in --candidates".to_string());
12088:     }
12089:     Ok(candidates)
12090: }
12091: 
12092: fn load_dns_zone_records_manifest(path: &Path) -> Result<Vec<DnsZoneRecordSpec>, String> {
12093:     let contents = fs::read_to_string(path)
12094:         .map_err(|err| format!("read dns zone records manifest failed: {err}"))?;
12095:     if contents.len() > DNS_ZONE_RECORDS_MANIFEST_MAX_BYTES {
12096:         return Err(format!(
12097:             "dns zone records manifest exceeds maximum size ({DNS_ZONE_RECORDS_MANIFEST_MAX_BYTES} bytes)"
12098:         ));
12099:     }
12100: 
12101:     let mut fields = std::collections::BTreeMap::<String, String>::new();
12102:     let mut line_count = 0usize;
12103:     for raw_line in contents.lines() {
12104:         line_count = line_count.saturating_add(1);
12105:         if line_count > DNS_ZONE_RECORDS_MANIFEST_MAX_LINES {
12106:             return Err(format!(
12107:                 "dns zone records manifest exceeds maximum line count ({DNS_ZONE_RECORDS_MANIFEST_MAX_LINES})"
12108:             ));
12109:         }
12110:         if raw_line.is_empty() {
12111:             return Err("dns zone records manifest must not contain blank lines".to_string());
12112:         }
12113:         if raw_line.len() > DNS_ZONE_RECORDS_MANIFEST_MAX_LINE_BYTES {
12114:             return Err(format!(
12115:                 "dns zone records manifest line exceeds maximum size ({DNS_ZONE_RECORDS_MANIFEST_MAX_LINE_BYTES} bytes)"
12116:             ));
12117:         }
12118:         let (raw_key, raw_value) = raw_line
12119:             .split_once('=')
12120:             .ok_or_else(|| "invalid dns zone records manifest line".to_string())?;
12121:         let key = raw_key.trim();
12122:         let value = raw_value.trim();
12123:         if key.is_empty() {
12124:             return Err("dns zone records manifest key must not be empty".to_string());
12125:         }
12126:         if key != raw_key || value != raw_value {
12127:             return Err(format!(
12128:                 "dns zone records manifest field must not contain leading or trailing whitespace: {key}"
12129:             ));
12130:         }
12131:         if key.len() > DNS_ZONE_RECORDS_MANIFEST_MAX_KEY_BYTES {
12132:             return Err(format!(
12133:                 "dns zone records manifest key exceeds maximum size ({DNS_ZONE_RECORDS_MANIFEST_MAX_KEY_BYTES} bytes)"
12134:             ));
12135:         }
12136:         if value.len() > DNS_ZONE_RECORDS_MANIFEST_MAX_VALUE_BYTES {
12137:             return Err(format!(
12138:                 "dns zone records manifest value exceeds maximum size ({DNS_ZONE_RECORDS_MANIFEST_MAX_VALUE_BYTES} bytes)"
12139:             ));
12140:         }
12141:         if key.split('.').count() > DNS_ZONE_RECORDS_MANIFEST_MAX_KEY_DEPTH {
12142:             return Err(format!(
12143:                 "dns zone records manifest key depth exceeds maximum depth ({DNS_ZONE_RECORDS_MANIFEST_MAX_KEY_DEPTH})"
12144:             ));
12145:         }
12146:         if !is_allowed_dns_zone_records_manifest_key(key) {
12147:             return Err(format!(
12148:                 "unsupported dns zone records manifest field: {key}"
12149:             ));
12150:         }
12151:         if fields.insert(key.to_string(), value.to_string()).is_some() {
12152:             return Err(format!("duplicate dns zone records manifest field: {key}"));
12153:         }
12154:     }
12155: 
12156:     if fields.is_empty() {
12157:         return Err("dns zone records manifest is empty".to_string());
12158:     }
12159:     if fields.get("version").map(String::as_str) != Some("1") {
12160:         return Err("unsupported dns zone records manifest version".to_string());
12161:     }
12162: 
12163:     let record_count = parse_dns_zone_records_manifest_usize_field(&fields, "record_count")?;
12164:     if record_count == 0 || record_count > DNS_ZONE_RECORDS_MANIFEST_MAX_RECORD_COUNT {
12165:         return Err(format!(
12166:             "dns zone records manifest record_count must be in range 1..={DNS_ZONE_RECORDS_MANIFEST_MAX_RECORD_COUNT}"
12167:         ));
12168:     }
12169: 
12170:     let mut expected_field_count = 2usize;
12171:     let mut records = Vec::with_capacity(record_count);
12172:     for index in 0..record_count {
12173:         let label = canonicalize_dns_relative_name(required_dns_zone_records_manifest_field(
12174:             &fields, index, "label",
12175:         )?)
12176:         .map_err(|err| format!("dns zone record {index} label is invalid: {err}"))?;
12177:         let target_node_id =
12178:             required_dns_zone_records_manifest_field(&fields, index, "target_node_id")?
12179:                 .trim()
12180:                 .to_string();
12181:         if target_node_id.is_empty() {
12182:             return Err(format!(
12183:                 "dns zone record {index} target_node_id must not be empty"
12184:             ));
12185:         }
12186:         let ttl_secs =
12187:             parse_dns_zone_records_manifest_indexed_u64_field(&fields, index, "ttl_secs")?;
12188:         if ttl_secs == 0 || ttl_secs > 300 {
12189:             return Err(format!(
12190:                 "dns zone record {index} ttl_secs must be in range 1..=300"
12191:             ));
12192:         }
12193:         let alias_count =
12194:             parse_dns_zone_records_manifest_indexed_usize_field(&fields, index, "alias_count")?;
12195:         if alias_count > DNS_ZONE_RECORDS_MANIFEST_MAX_ALIAS_COUNT {
12196:             return Err(format!(
12197:                 "dns zone record {index} alias_count exceeds maximum ({DNS_ZONE_RECORDS_MANIFEST_MAX_ALIAS_COUNT})"
12198:             ));
12199:         }
12200:         expected_field_count = expected_field_count
12201:             .checked_add(4)
12202:             .and_then(|value| value.checked_add(alias_count))
12203:             .ok_or_else(|| "dns zone records manifest field count overflow".to_string())?;
12204: 
12205:         let mut aliases = Vec::with_capacity(alias_count);
12206:         let mut seen_aliases = HashSet::new();
12207:         for alias_index in 0..alias_count {
12208:             let alias = canonicalize_dns_relative_name(required_dns_zone_records_manifest_alias(
12209:                 &fields,
12210:                 index,
12211:                 alias_index,
12212:             )?)
12213:             .map_err(|err| {
12214:                 format!("dns zone record {index} alias {alias_index} is invalid: {err}")
12215:             })?;
12216:             if !seen_aliases.insert(alias.clone()) {
12217:                 return Err(format!(
12218:                     "dns zone record {index} contains duplicate aliases"
12219:                 ));
12220:             }
12221:             aliases.push(alias);
12222:         }
12223: 
12224:         records.push(DnsZoneRecordSpec {
12225:             label,
12226:             target_node_id,
12227:             ttl_secs,
12228:             aliases,
12229:         });
12230:     }
12231: 
12232:     if fields.len() != expected_field_count {
12233:         return Err(format!(
12234:             "dns zone records manifest field count mismatch: expected {expected_field_count}, found {}",
12235:             fields.len()
12236:         ));
12237:     }
12238: 
12239:     Ok(records)
12240: }
12241: 
12242: fn required_dns_zone_records_manifest_field<'a>(
12243:     fields: &'a std::collections::BTreeMap<String, String>,
12244:     index: usize,
12245:     field: &str,
12246: ) -> Result<&'a str, String> {
12247:     let key = format!("record.{index}.{field}");
12248:     fields
12249:         .get(&key)
12250:         .map(String::as_str)
12251:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("missing {key}"))
12252: }
12253: 
12254: fn required_dns_zone_records_manifest_alias(
12255:     fields: &std::collections::BTreeMap<String, String>,
12256:     record_index: usize,
12257:     alias_index: usize,
12258: ) -> Result<&str, String> {
12259:     let key = format!("record.{record_index}.alias.{alias_index}");
12260:     fields
12261:         .get(&key)
12262:         .map(String::as_str)
12263:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("missing {key}"))
12264: }

12266: fn parse_dns_zone_records_manifest_usize_field(
12267:     fields: &std::collections::BTreeMap<String, String>,
12268:     key: &str,
12269: ) -> Result<usize, String> {
12270:     fields
12271:         .get(key)
12272:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("missing {key}"))?
12273:         .parse::<usize>()
12274:         .map_err(|_| format!("invalid {key}"))
12275: }

12277: fn parse_dns_zone_records_manifest_indexed_usize_field(
12278:     fields: &std::collections::BTreeMap<String, String>,
12279:     index: usize,
12280:     field: &str,
12281: ) -> Result<usize, String> {
12282:     required_dns_zone_records_manifest_field(fields, index, field)?
12283:         .parse::<usize>()

12287: fn parse_dns_zone_records_manifest_indexed_u64_field(
12288:     fields: &std::collections::BTreeMap<String, String>,
12289:     index: usize,
12290:     field: &str,
12291: ) -> Result<u64, String> {
12292:     required_dns_zone_records_manifest_field(fields, index, field)?
12293:         .parse::<u64>()
12294:         .map_err(|_| format!("invalid record.{index}.{field}"))
12295: }
