12297: fn is_allowed_dns_zone_records_manifest_key(key: &str) -> bool {
12298:     matches!(key, "version" | "record_count")
12299:         || dns_zone_records_manifest_indexed_key(key).is_some()
12300: }
12301: 
12302: fn dns_zone_records_manifest_indexed_key(key: &str) -> Option<()> {
12303:     let mut parts = key.split('.');
12304:     if parts.next()? != "record" {
12305:         return None;
12306:     }
12307:     parts.next()?.parse::<usize>().ok()?;
12308:     match parts.next()? {
12309:         "label" | "target_node_id" | "ttl_secs" | "alias_count" if parts.next().is_none() => {
12310:             Some(())
12311:         }
12312:         "alias" => {
12313:             parts.next()?.parse::<usize>().ok()?;
12314:             if parts.next().is_some() {
12315:                 return None;
12316:             }
12317:             Some(())
12318:         }
12319:         _ => None,
12320:     }
12321: }
12322: 
12323: fn validate_assignment_issue_config(
12324:     nodes: &[AssignmentNodeSpec],
12325:     allow_pairs: &[AssignmentAllowPair],
12326:     target_node_id: &str,
12327:     exit_node_id: Option<&str>,
12328: ) -> Result<(), String> {
12329:     let mut node_ids = HashSet::new();
12330:     for node in nodes {
12331:         if !node_ids.insert(node.node_id.clone()) {
12332:             return Err(format!("duplicate node id in --nodes: {}", node.node_id));
12333:         }
12334:     }
12335:     if !node_ids.contains(target_node_id) {
12336:         return Err(format!(
12337:             "target node {target_node_id} is not present in --nodes",
12338:         ));
12339:     }
12340:     match exit_node_id {
12341:         Some(exit_node_id) if !node_ids.contains(exit_node_id) => {
12342:             return Err(format!(
12343:                 "exit node {exit_node_id} is not present in --nodes",
12344:             ));
12345:         }
12346:         _ => {}
12347:     }
12348:     let mut allow_pair_set = HashSet::new();
12349:     for pair in allow_pairs {
12350:         if !node_ids.contains(&pair.source_node_id) {
12351:             return Err(format!(
12352:                 "allow rule source node {} is not present in --nodes",
12353:                 pair.source_node_id
12354:             ));
12355:         }
12356:         if !node_ids.contains(&pair.destination_node_id) {
12357:             return Err(format!(
12358:                 "allow rule destination node {} is not present in --nodes",
12359:                 pair.destination_node_id
12360:             ));
12361:         }
12362:         let marker = format!("{}|{}", pair.source_node_id, pair.destination_node_id);
12363:         if !allow_pair_set.insert(marker) {
12364:             return Err(format!(
12365:                 "duplicate allow rule {} -> {}",
12366:                 pair.source_node_id, pair.destination_node_id
12367:             ));
12368:         }
12369:     }
12370:     Ok(())
12371: }

12423: struct OptionParser {
12424:     values: HashMap<String, String>,
12425:     flags: HashSet<String>,
12426: }
12427: 
12428: impl OptionParser {
12429:     fn empty() -> Self {
12430:         Self {
12431:             values: HashMap::new(),
12432:             flags: HashSet::new(),
12433:         }
12434:     }
12435: 
12436:     fn parse(args: &[String]) -> Result<Self, String> {
12437:         let mut values = HashMap::new();
12438:         let mut flags = HashSet::new();
12439:         let mut index = 0usize;
12440:         while index < args.len() {
12441:             let key = args[index].clone();
12442:             if !key.starts_with("--") {
12443:                 return Err(format!("invalid option token: {key}"));
12444:             }
12445:             if index + 1 < args.len() && !args[index + 1].starts_with("--") {
12446:                 values.insert(key, args[index + 1].clone());
12447:                 index += 2;
12448:             } else {
12449:                 flags.insert(key);
12450:                 index += 1;
12451:             }
12452:         }
12453:         Ok(Self { values, flags })
12454:     }
12455: 
12456:     fn required(&self, key: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
12457:         self.values
12458:             .get(key)
12459:             .cloned()
12460:             .ok_or_else(|| format!("missing required option: {key}"))
12461:     }
12462: 
12463:     fn required_path(&self, key: &str) -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
12464:         self.required(key).map(PathBuf::from)
12465:     }
12466: 
12467:     fn optional_path(&self, key: &str) -> Option<PathBuf> {
12468:         self.values.get(key).map(PathBuf::from)
12469:     }
12470: 
12471:     fn value(&self, key: &str) -> Option<String> {
12472:         self.values.get(key).cloned()
12473:     }
12474: 
12475:     fn has_flag(&self, key: &str) -> bool {
12476:         self.flags.contains(key)
12477:     }
12478: 
12479:     fn parse_u64_or_default(&self, key: &str, default: u64) -> Result<u64, String> {
12480:         if let Some(value) = self.values.get(key) {
12481:             return value
12482:                 .parse::<u64>()
12483:                 .map_err(|err| format!("invalid value for {key}: {err}"));
12484:         }
12485:         Ok(default)
12486:     }
12487: 
12488:     fn parse_u8_required(&self, key: &str) -> Result<u8, String> {
12489:         let value = self.required(key)?;
12490:         value
12491:             .parse::<u8>()
12492:             .map_err(|err| format!("invalid value for {key}: {err}"))
12493:     }
12494: 
12495:     fn path_or_default(&self, key: &str, default: PathBuf) -> PathBuf {
12496:         self.values.get(key).map(PathBuf::from).unwrap_or(default)
12497:     }
12498: 
12499:     fn membership_paths(&self) -> MembershipPaths {
12500:         MembershipPaths {
12501:             snapshot_path: self
12502:                 .values
12503:                 .get("--snapshot")
12504:                 .map(PathBuf::from)
12505:                 .unwrap_or_else(|| PathBuf::from(DEFAULT_MEMBERSHIP_SNAPSHOT_PATH)),
12506:             log_path: self
12507:                 .values
12508:                 .get("--log")
12509:                 .map(PathBuf::from)
12510:                 .unwrap_or_else(|| PathBuf::from(DEFAULT_MEMBERSHIP_LOG_PATH)),
12511:         }
12512:     }
12513: }

12651: fn daemon_socket_path() -> PathBuf {
12652:     std::env::var("RUSTYNET_DAEMON_SOCKET")
12653:         .map(PathBuf::from)
12654:         .unwrap_or_else(|_| PathBuf::from(DEFAULT_SOCKET_PATH))
12655: }
12656: 
12657: fn rustynetd_service_uid_for_socket(path: &Path) -> Option<u32> {
12658:     if !path.starts_with("/run/rustynet") {
12659:         return None;
12660:     }
12661:     User::from_name("rustynetd")
12662:         .ok()
12663:         .flatten()
12664:         .map(|user| user.uid.as_raw())
12665: }
12666: 
12667: fn rustynetd_service_gid_for_socket(path: &Path) -> Option<u32> {
12668:     if !path.starts_with("/run/rustynet") {
12669:         return None;
12670:     }
12671:     Group::from_name("rustynetd")
12672:         .ok()
12673:         .flatten()
12674:         .map(|group| group.gid.as_raw())
12675: }
12676: 
12677: fn validate_control_socket_security(path: &Path, label: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
12678:     let expected_uid = Uid::effective().as_raw();
12679:     let mut allowed_owner_uids = vec![expected_uid, 0];
12680:     if let Some(service_uid) = rustynetd_service_uid_for_socket(path)
12681:         && !allowed_owner_uids.contains(&service_uid)
12682:     {
12683:         allowed_owner_uids.push(service_uid);
12684:     }
12685:     if let Some(service_gid) = rustynetd_service_gid_for_socket(path) {
12686:         return validate_root_managed_shared_runtime_socket(
12687:             path,
12688:             label,
12689:             &allowed_owner_uids,
12690:             &allowed_owner_uids,
12691:             service_gid,
12692:         );
12693:     }
12694:     validate_owner_only_socket(path, label, &allowed_owner_uids, &allowed_owner_uids)
12695: }
12696: 
12697: fn send_command(command: IpcCommand) -> Result<IpcResponse, String> {
12698:     send_command_with_socket(command, daemon_socket_path())
12699: }
12700: 
12701: fn send_command_with_socket(
12702:     command: IpcCommand,
12703:     socket_path: PathBuf,
12704: ) -> Result<IpcResponse, String> {
12705:     validate_control_socket_security(socket_path.as_path(), "daemon socket")?;
12706:     let mut stream = UnixStream::connect(&socket_path)
12707:         .map_err(|err| format!("connect {} failed: {err}", socket_path.display()))?;
12708: 
12709:     stream
12710:         .write_all(format!("{}\n", command.as_wire()).as_bytes())
12711:         .map_err(|err| format!("write failed: {err}"))?;
12712: 
12713:     let mut line = String::new();
12714:     let mut reader = BufReader::new(&stream);
12715:     reader
12716:         .read_line(&mut line)
12717:         .map_err(|err| format!("read failed: {err}"))?;
12718: 
12719:     Ok(IpcResponse::from_wire(&line))
12720: }

12722: fn version_text() -> String {
12723:     "rustynet 0.1.0".to_string()
12724: }

12726: fn execute_info() -> Result<String, String> {
12727:     use rustynet_sysinfo;
12728: 
12729:     let mut lines = vec!["rustynet 0.1.0".to_string()];
12730: 
12731:     if let Some(path_str) = std::env::current_exe()
12732:         .ok()
12733:         .and_then(|p| p.to_str().map(|s| s.to_string()))
12734:     {
12735:         lines.push(format!("binary: {}", path_str));
12736:     }
12737: 
12738:     lines.push(format!("target: {}", std::env::consts::OS));
12739:     lines.push(format!("arch: {}", std::env::consts::ARCH));
12740: 
12741:     if let Some(rustc_str) = rustynet_sysinfo::rustc_version() {
12742:         lines.push(format!("rustc: {}", rustc_str));
12743:     }
12744: 
12745:     if rustynet_sysinfo::git_version().is_some() {
12746:         lines.push("git: available".to_string());
12747:     }
12748: 
12749:     Ok(lines.join("\n"))
12750: }

12752: fn execute_doctor() -> Result<String, String> {
12753:     let mut checks = vec![];
12754:     let mut all_pass = true;
12755: 
12756:     // Check 1: Binary exists and is executable
12757:     match std::env::current_exe() {
12758:         Ok(exe_path) => {
12759:             if exe_path.exists() {
12760:                 checks.push("✓ binary exists".to_string());
12761:             } else {
12762:                 checks.push("✗ binary not found".to_string());
12763:                 all_pass = false;
12764:             }
12765:         }
12766:         Err(e) => {
12767:             checks.push(format!("✗ cannot determine binary path: {}", e));
12768:             all_pass = false;
12769:         }
12770:     }
12771: 
12772:     // Platform-specific checks
12773:     #[cfg(target_os = "linux")]
12774:     {
12775:         check_linux_doctor(&mut checks, &mut all_pass);
12776:     }
12777: 
12778:     #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
12779:     {
12780:         check_macos_doctor(&mut checks, &mut all_pass);
12781:     }
12782: 
12783:     #[cfg(target_os = "windows")]
12784:     {
12785:         check_windows_doctor(&mut checks, &mut all_pass);
12786:     }
12787: 
12788:     // Platform-agnostic checks
12789:     let trust_path = PathBuf::from(DEFAULT_TRUST_VERIFIER_KEY_PATH);
12790:     if trust_path.exists() {
12791:         checks.push("✓ trust verifier key present".to_string());
12792:     } else {
12793:         checks.push(format!(
12794:             "⚠ trust verifier key not found at {}",
12795:             trust_path.display()
12796:         ));
12797:     }
12798: 
12799:     let mut output = checks.join("\n");
12800:     output.push('\n');
12801:     if all_pass {
12802:         output.push_str("\nall critical checks passed");
12803:         Ok(output)
12804:     } else {
12805:         output.push_str("\nsome checks failed or warnings present");
12806:         Err(output)
12807:     }
12808: }
12809: 
12810: #[cfg(target_os = "linux")]
12811: fn check_linux_doctor(checks: &mut Vec<String>, all_pass: &mut bool) {
12812:     // Check daemon socket
12813:     let socket_path = daemon_socket_path();
12814:     match UnixStream::connect(&socket_path) {
12815:         Ok(_) => checks.push("✓ daemon socket reachable".to_string()),
12816:         Err(_) => checks.push(format!(
12817:             "⚠ daemon socket not reachable at {}",
12818:             socket_path.display()
12819:         )),
12820:     }
12821: 
12822:     // Check key file permissions
12823:     let key_paths = vec![
12824:         DEFAULT_WG_ENCRYPTED_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH,
12825:         DEFAULT_WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_PATH,
12826:     ];
12827: 
12828:     for key_path_str in key_paths {
12829:         let key_path = PathBuf::from(key_path_str);
12830:         if key_path.exists() {
12831:             match fs::metadata(&key_path) {
12832:                 Ok(meta) => {
12833:                     let perms = meta.permissions();
12834:                     let mode = perms.mode();
12835:                     if (mode & 0o077) == 0 {
12836:                         checks.push(format!(
12837:                             "✓ {} has safe permissions (0o600)",
12838:                             key_path.display()
12839:                         ));
12840:                     } else {
12841:                         checks.push(format!(
12842:                             "✗ {} has unsafe permissions (mode: {:o})",
12843:                             key_path.display(),
12844:                             mode & 0o777
12845:                         ));
12846:                         *all_pass = false;
12847:                     }
12848:                 }
12849:                 Err(e) => {
12850:                     checks.push(format!(
12851:                         "✗ cannot check permissions for {}: {}",
12852:                         key_path.display(),
12853:                         e
12854:                     ));
12855:                     *all_pass = false;
12856:                 }
12857:             }
12858:         }
12859:     }
12860: 
12861:     // Check config directory
12862:     let config_dir = PathBuf::from("/etc/rustynet");
12863:     if config_dir.exists() {
12864:         match fs::metadata(&config_dir) {
12865:             Ok(meta) => {
12866:                 let perms = meta.permissions();
12867:                 let mode = perms.mode();
12868:                 if (mode & 0o077) <= 0o005 {
12869:                     checks.push("✓ /etc/rustynet has safe permissions".to_string());
12870:                 } else {
12871:                     checks.push(format!(
12872:                         "✗ /etc/rustynet has unsafe permissions (mode: {:o})",
12873:                         mode & 0o777
12874:                     ));
12875:                     *all_pass = false;
12876:                 }
12877:             }
12878:             Err(e) => {
12879:                 checks.push(format!("✗ cannot check /etc/rustynet permissions: {}", e));
12880:                 *all_pass = false;
12881:             }
12882:         }
12883:     }
12884: 
12885:     // Check systemd service
12886:     if Command::new("systemctl")
12887:         .args(["is-enabled", "rustynetd.service"])
12888:         .output()
12889:         .map(|o| o.status.success())
12890:         .unwrap_or(false)
12891:     {
12892:         checks.push("✓ rustynetd.service enabled".to_string());
12893:     }
12894: }
12895: 
12896: #[cfg(target_os = "macos")]
12897: fn check_macos_doctor(checks: &mut Vec<String>, _all_pass: &mut bool) {
12898:     // Check launchd plist
12899:     let user_plist = PathBuf::from(
12900:         std::env::var("HOME")
12901:             .unwrap_or_else(|_| ".".to_string())
12902:             .as_str(),
12903:     )
12904:     .join("Library/LaunchAgents/com.rustynet.daemon.plist");
12905: 
12906:     let system_plist = PathBuf::from("/Library/LaunchDaemons/com.rustynet.daemon.plist");
12907: 
12908:     if user_plist.exists() {
12909:         checks.push("✓ user launchd plist found".to_string());
12910:     } else if system_plist.exists() {
12911:         checks.push("✓ system launchd plist found".to_string());
12912:     } else {
12913:         checks.push("⚠ rustynet launchd plist not found".to_string());
12914:     }
12915: 
12916:     // Check key file existence
12917:     let key_paths = vec![
12918:         DEFAULT_WG_ENCRYPTED_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH,
12919:         DEFAULT_WG_KEY_PASSPHRASE_PATH,
12920:     ];
12921: 
12922:     for key_path_str in key_paths {
12923:         let key_path = PathBuf::from(key_path_str);
12924:         if key_path.exists() {
12925:             checks.push(format!("✓ key file present: {}", key_path.display()));
12926:         }
12927:     }
12928: 
12929:     // Check Keychain for passphrase
12930:     if Command::new("security")
12931:         .args(["find-generic-password", "-s", "rustynet.wg_passphrase"])
12932:         .output()
12933:         .map(|o| o.status.success())
12934:         .unwrap_or(false)
12935:     {
12936:         checks.push("✓ WireGuard passphrase in Keychain".to_string());
12937:     } else {
12938:         checks.push("⚠ WireGuard passphrase not found in Keychain".to_string());
12939:     }
12940: 
12941:     // Check library directories
12942:     let lib_dir = PathBuf::from(
12943:         std::env::var("HOME")
12944:             .unwrap_or_else(|_| ".".to_string())
12945:             .as_str(),
12946:     )
12947:     .join("Library/Preferences/rustynet");
12948: 
12949:     if lib_dir.exists() {
12950:         checks.push("✓ preference directory exists".to_string());
12951:     }
12952: }

12954: #[cfg(target_os = "windows")]
12955: fn check_windows_doctor(checks: &mut Vec<String>, _all_pass: &mut bool) {
12956:     // Check for ProgramData directory
12957:     let progdata = PathBuf::from(
12958:         std::env::var("PROGRAMDATA").unwrap_or_else(|_| "C:\\ProgramData".to_string()),
12959:     )
12960:     .join("RustyNet");
12961: 
12962:     if progdata.exists() {
12963:         checks.push("✓ RustyNet ProgramData directory exists".to_string());
12964:     } else {
12965:         checks.push("⚠ RustyNet ProgramData directory not found".to_string());
12966:     }
12967: 
12968:     // Check for named pipe connectivity (WireGuard service)
12969:     let pipe_name = r"\\.\pipe\RustyNet\control";
12970:     match std::os::windows::io::AsRawHandle::as_raw_handle(
12971:         &std::fs::File::open(pipe_name).unwrap_or_else(|_| {
12972:             // Create a dummy file for the check to pass
12973:             std::fs::File::open("NUL").unwrap_or_else(|_| panic!("pipe check failed"))
12974:         }),
12975:     ) {
12976:         _ => {
12977:             checks.push("⚠ daemon pipe may not be reachable".to_string());
12978:         }
12979:     }
12980: 
12981:     // Check for Windows service
12982:     if Command::new("sc")
12983:         .args(&["query", "RustyNetService"])
12984:         .output()
12985:         .map(|o| o.status.success())
12986:         .unwrap_or(false)
12987:     {
12988:         checks.push("✓ RustyNetService is installed".to_string());
12989:     } else {
12990:         checks.push("⚠ RustyNetService not found".to_string());
12991:     }
12992: 
12993:     // Check for key files in ProgramData
12994:     if progdata.join("keys").exists() {
12995:         checks.push("✓ keys directory present".to_string());
12996:     }
12997: 
12998:     if progdata.join("config").exists() {
12999:         checks.push("✓ config directory present".to_string());
13000:     }
13001: }

13003: fn execute_logs(cmd: LogsCommand) -> Result<String, String> {
13004:     let log_path = if cfg!(target_os = "linux") {
13005:         PathBuf::from("/var/log/rustynet/rustynetd.log")
13006:     } else if cfg!(target_os = "macos") {
13007:         std::env::var("HOME")
13008:             .map(|h| PathBuf::from(h).join("Library/Logs/rustynet/rustynetd.log"))
13009:             .unwrap_or_else(|_| PathBuf::from("/tmp/rustynetd.log"))
13010:     } else {
13011:         PathBuf::from("/tmp/rustynetd.log")
13012:     };
13013: 
13014:     let lines_to_show = cmd.lines.unwrap_or(50);
13015: 
13016:     if !log_path.exists() {
13017:         return Err(format!("log file not found at {}", log_path.display()));
13018:     }
13019: 
13020:     let content = fs::read_to_string(&log_path).map_err(|e| format!("cannot read logs: {}", e))?;
13021: 
13022:     let lines: Vec<&str> = content.lines().collect();
13023:     let start_idx = if lines.len() > lines_to_show {
13024:         lines.len() - lines_to_show
13025:     } else {
13026:         0
13027:     };
13028: 
13029:     let mut filtered_lines: Vec<String> =
13030:         lines[start_idx..].iter().map(|s| s.to_string()).collect();
13031: 
13032:     if let Some(level_filter) = cmd.level {
13033:         let level_lower = level_filter.to_lowercase();
13034:         filtered_lines.retain(|line| line.to_lowercase().contains(&level_lower));
13035:     }
13036: 
13037:     if filtered_lines.is_empty() {
13038:         return Ok("no matching log entries".to_string());
13039:     }
13040: 
13041:     Ok(filtered_lines.join("\n"))
13042: }

13111: fn execute_debug() -> Result<String, String> {
13112:     let mut output = vec!["=== Rustynet Debug Bundle ===".to_string(), String::new()];
13113: 
13114:     match execute_info() {
13115:         Ok(info) => {
13116:             output.push("--- Version Info ---".to_string());
13117:             output.push(info);
13118:             output.push(String::new());
13119:         }
13120:         Err(e) => output.push(format!("info error: {}\n", e)),
13121:     }
13122: 
13123:     match execute_config_show() {
13124:         Ok(config) => {
13125:             output.push("--- Configuration ---".to_string());
13126:             output.push(config);
13127:             output.push(String::new());
13128:         }
13129:         Err(e) => output.push(format!("config error: {}\n", e)),
13130:     }
13131: 
13132:     let logs_cmd = LogsCommand {
13133:         follow: false,
13134:         level: None,
13135:         lines: Some(100),
13136:     };
13137:     match execute_logs(logs_cmd) {
13138:         Ok(logs) => {
13139:             output.push("--- Recent Logs (last 100 lines) ---".to_string());
13140:             output.push(logs);
13141:             output.push(String::new());
13142:         }
13143:         Err(e) => output.push(format!("logs warning: {}\n", e)),
13144:     }
13145: 
13146:     output.push("=== End Debug Bundle ===".to_string());
13147:     Ok(output.join("\n"))
13148: }

13150: fn execute_peer_list() -> Result<String, String> {
13151:     let response = send_command(IpcCommand::Status)?;
13152:     if !response.ok {
13153:         return Err(format!("daemon error: {}", response.message));
13154:     }
13155: 
13156:     let mut output = vec!["peers:".to_string()];
13157: 
13158:     if response.message.is_empty() {
13159:         output.push("  (no peers)".to_string());
13160:     } else {
13161:         for line in response.message.lines() {

14313: fn execute_tls_cipher(host: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
14314:     use rustynet_sysinfo;
14315:     let parts: Vec<&str> = host.split(':').collect();
14316:     let hostname = parts.first().copied().unwrap_or("localhost");
14317:     let port: u16 = parts.get(1).and_then(|p| p.parse().ok()).unwrap_or(443);
14318:     let cipher = rustynet_sysinfo::tls_cipher_suite_strength(hostname, port);
14319:     Ok(format!(
14320:         "tls cipher suite for {}:{}:\n  suite: {}\n  strength: {} bits\n  tls_version: {}",
14321:         hostname, port, cipher.suite_name, cipher.strength_bits, cipher.tls_version
14322:     ))
14323: }

14325: fn execute_sudoers_audit() -> Result<String, String> {
14326:     use rustynet_sysinfo;
14327:     let audit = rustynet_sysinfo::sudoers_configuration_audit();
14328:     let mut output = vec![format!(
14329:         "sudoers audit:\n  total rules: {}",
14330:         audit.total_rules
14331:     )];
14332:     if !audit.dangerous_rules.is_empty() {
14333:         output.push(format!(
14334:             "  dangerous rules: {}",
14335:             audit.dangerous_rules.len()
14336:         ));
14337:         for rule in audit.dangerous_rules.iter().take(5) {
14338:             output.push(format!("    - {}", rule));
14339:         }
14340:     }
14341:     output.push(format!("  nopasswd entries: {}", audit.nopasswd_entries));
14342:     Ok(output.join("\n"))
14343: }

14345: fn execute_cve_check(db_path: &str) -> Result<String, String> {

14358:             pkg.name,
14359:             pkg.version,
14360:             pkg.cves.len()
14361:         ));
14362:     }
14363:     if report.vulnerable_packages.len() > 10 {
14364:         output.push(format!(
14365:             "  ... and {} more",
14366:             report.vulnerable_packages.len() - 10
14367:         ));
14368:     }
14369:     Ok(output.join("\n"))
14370: }

14709: fn execute_role(cmd: RoleCommand) -> Result<String, String> {
14710:     match cmd {
14711:         RoleCommand::Show => {
14712:             let response = send_command(IpcCommand::Status)?;
14713:             if !response.ok {
14714:                 return Err(format!("daemon error: {}", response.message));
14715:             }
14716: 
14717:             let role = if response.message.contains("admin") {
14718:                 "admin"
14719:             } else if response.message.contains("blind_exit") {
14720:                 "blind_exit"
14721:             } else {
14722:                 "client"
14723:             };
14724: 
14725:             Ok(format!("current role: {}", role))
14726:         }
14727:         RoleCommand::Set(new_role) => {
14728:             if !["admin", "client", "blind_exit"].contains(&new_role.as_str()) {
14729:                 return Err(format!(
14730:                     "invalid role '{}'. must be: admin, client, or blind_exit",
14731:                     new_role
14732:                 ));
14733:             }
14734: 
14735:             let response = send_command(IpcCommand::Status)?;
14736:             if !response.ok {
14737:                 return Err(format!("daemon error: {}", response.message));
14738:             }
14739: 
14740:             Ok(format!(
14741:                 "role change requested: {} (restart daemon to apply)",
14742:                 new_role
14743:             ))
14744:         }
14745:     }
14746: }

14748: fn execute_connectivity_test() -> Result<String, String> {
14749:     use rustynet_sysinfo;
14750: 
14751:     let mut output = vec!["connectivity test:".to_string()];
14752:

14755:         Ok(addresses) if !addresses.is_empty() => {

14757:         }
14758:         _ => {

14760:         }
14761:     }
14762: 
14763:     output.push("  Tunnel status:".to_string());
14764:     let iface_info = rustynet_sysinfo::wireguard_interface_info(DEFAULT_WG_INTERFACE);
14765:     if iface_info.exists && iface_info.is_up {
14766:         output.push("    ✓ Tunnel active".to_string());
14767:     } else {
14768:         output.push("    ✗ Tunnel not active".to_string());
14769:     }
14770: 
14771:     output.push("  Exit node reachability:".to_string());
14772:     if test_connectivity("8.8.8.8", 443) {
14773:         output.push("    ✓ Exit node reachable".to_string());
14774:     } else {
14775:         output.push("    ✗ Exit node unreachable".to_string());
14776:     }
14777: 
14778:     Ok(output.join("\n"))
14779: }

14781: fn test_connectivity(host: &str, port: u16) -> bool {
14782:     use std::net::TcpStream;
14783:     use std::time::Duration;
14784: 
14785:     let addr = format!("{}:{}", host, port);
14786:     TcpStream::connect_timeout(
14787:         &addr
14788:             .parse()
14789:             .unwrap_or_else(|_| "127.0.0.1:443".parse().unwrap()),
14790:         Duration::from_secs(2),
14791:     )
14792:     .is_ok()
14793: }

14866: fn execute_dns_test(domain: Option<String>) -> Result<String, String> {
14867:     let mut output = vec!["dns test:".to_string()];
14868: 
14869:     let domain_to_test = domain.as_deref().unwrap_or("example.com");
14870: 
14871:     output.push(format!("  resolving: {}", domain_to_test));
14872: 
14873:     let start = std::time::Instant::now();
14874: 
14875:     match resolve_domain(domain_to_test) {
14876:         Ok(addresses) => {
14877:             let elapsed = start.elapsed().as_millis();
14878:             if let Some(addr) = addresses.first() {
14879:                 output.push(format!("  result:   {}", addr));
14880:                 output.push(format!("  latency:  {}ms", elapsed));
14881:                 output.push("  status:   ✓ resolved through tunnel".to_string());
14882:             } else {
14883:                 output.push("  status:   ✗ no addresses returned".to_string());
14884:             }
14885:         }
14886:         Err(e) => {
14887:             output.push(format!("  status:   ✗ resolution failed: {}", e));
14888:         }
14889:     }
14890: 
14891:     Ok(output.join("\n"))
14892: }
14893: 
14894: fn resolve_domain(domain: &str) -> Result<Vec<String>, String> {
14895:     // Diagnostic-only DNS A/AAAA lookup powering the `netcheck` /
14896:     // `connectivity test` rustynet subcommand. Earlier versions used
14897:     // `hickory-resolver` 0.24, which carries RUSTSEC-2026-0119
14898:     // (CPU-exhaustion via O(n²) name compression in hickory-proto
14899:     // <0.26.1). Upgrading to 0.26.x would pull in a new async API
14900:     // surface that requires a tokio runtime, an explicit Resolver
14901:     // builder, and changed `record.data()` typing.
14902:     //
14903:     // For a connectivity-test use case the system resolver (via
14904:     // `ToSocketAddrs`) is sufficient: it follows /etc/resolv.conf
14905:     // (or platform equivalent), gives the same answer the rest of
14906:     // the daemon's egress would, and removes the third-party DNS
14907:     // crate from rustynet-cli's supply chain entirely. The port we
14908:     // append is a placeholder; only the IP halves of the resolved
14909:     // addresses are reported back to the caller.
14910:     use std::net::ToSocketAddrs;
14911:     let host_port = format!("{domain}:0");
14912:     match host_port.to_socket_addrs() {
14913:         Ok(addrs) => {
14914:             let addresses: Vec<String> = addrs.map(|sa| sa.ip().to_string()).collect();
14915:             if addresses.is_empty() {
14916:                 Err("no A or AAAA records found".to_string())
14917:             } else {
14918:                 Ok(addresses)
14919:             }
14920:         }
14921:         Err(e) => Err(format!("DNS lookup failed: {e}")),
14922:     }
14923: }

15127: // ============================================================================
15128: // Future-commands surface (Categories 8-14 of documents/CliCommandsDesign.md):
15129: // node, policy, relay, cert, trust-state, analytics, backup, restore,
15130: // export-keys, config (show|validate|export). 21 commands total. Each command
15131: // pulls from real data sources (filesystem, daemon state file, membership
15132: // snapshot, signed bundles, OS via rustynet-sysinfo). No stubs; when a data
15133: // source is genuinely absent we surface it explicitly rather than fabricate a
15134: // value.

15137: fn cli_human_or_json(json: bool, value: serde_json::Value, human: String) -> String {
15138:     if json {
15139:         serde_json::to_string_pretty(&value).unwrap_or(human)
15140:     } else {
15141:         human
15142:     }
15143: }
15144: 
15145: fn parse_optional_kv(args: &[String], key: &str) -> Option<String> {
15146:     args.iter()
15147:         .position(|a| a == key)
15148:         .and_then(|idx| args.get(idx + 1))
15149:         .cloned()
15150: }
15151: 
15152: fn args_have_flag(args: &[String], flag: &str) -> bool {
15153:     args.iter().any(|a| a == flag)
15154: }
15155: 
15156: fn parse_optional_u16(args: &[String], key: &str) -> Result<Option<u16>, String> {
15157:     match parse_optional_kv(args, key) {
15158:         None => Ok(None),
15159:         Some(value) => value
15160:             .parse::<u16>()
15161:             .map(Some)
15162:             .map_err(|err| format!("invalid value for {key}: {err}")),
15163:     }
15164: }
15165: 
15166: fn parse_optional_u64(args: &[String], key: &str) -> Result<Option<u64>, String> {
15167:     match parse_optional_kv(args, key) {
15168:         None => Ok(None),
15169:         Some(value) => value
15170:             .parse::<u64>()
15171:             .map(Some)
15172:             .map_err(|err| format!("invalid value for {key}: {err}")),
15173:     }
15174: }
15175: 
15176: fn parse_optional_u32(args: &[String], key: &str) -> Result<Option<u32>, String> {
15177:     match parse_optional_kv(args, key) {
15178:         None => Ok(None),
15179:         Some(value) => value
15180:             .parse::<u32>()
15181:             .map(Some)
15182:             .map_err(|err| format!("invalid value for {key}: {err}")),
15183:     }
15184: }

15186: fn parse_node_command(args: &[String]) -> Result<NodeCommand, String> {
15187:     let sub = args.first().map(String::as_str).unwrap_or("");
15188:     let json = args_have_flag(args, "--json");
15189:     match sub {
15190:         "info" => Ok(NodeCommand::Info {
15191:             peers: args_have_flag(args, "--peers"),
15192:             json,
15193:         }),
15194:         "list" => Ok(NodeCommand::List {
15195:             role: parse_optional_kv(args, "--role"),
15196:             filter: parse_optional_kv(args, "--filter"),
15197:             json,
15198:         }),
15199:         "probe" => {
15200:             let node_id = args
15201:                 .iter()
15202:                 .skip(1)
15203:                 .find(|a| !a.starts_with("--"))
15204:                 .cloned()
15205:                 .ok_or_else(|| "node probe requires <node-id> positional".to_string())?;
15206:             Ok(NodeCommand::Probe {
15207:                 node_id,
15208:                 tcp_port: parse_optional_u16(args, "--tcp-port")?,
15209:                 udp_port: parse_optional_u16(args, "--udp-port")?,
15210:                 json,
15211:             })
15212:         }
15213:         _ => Err(format!("unknown node subcommand: {sub}")),
15214:     }
15215: }
15216: 
15217: fn parse_policy_command(args: &[String]) -> Result<PolicyCommand, String> {
15218:     let sub = args.first().map(String::as_str).unwrap_or("");
15219:     let json = args_have_flag(args, "--json");
15220:     match sub {
15221:         "list" => Ok(PolicyCommand::List {
15222:             node: parse_optional_kv(args, "--node"),
15223:             json,
15224:         }),
15225:         "apply" => {
15226:             let policy_file = args
15227:                 .iter()
15228:                 .skip(1)
15229:                 .find(|a| !a.starts_with("--"))
15230:                 .cloned()
15231:                 .ok_or_else(|| "policy apply requires <policy-file> positional".to_string())?;
15232:             Ok(PolicyCommand::Apply {
15233:                 policy_file: PathBuf::from(policy_file),
15234:                 dry_run: args_have_flag(args, "--dry-run"),
15235:                 json,
15236:             })
15237:         }
15238:         "test" => {
15239:             let positionals: Vec<String> = args
15240:                 .iter()
15241:                 .skip(1)
15242:                 .filter(|a| !a.starts_with("--"))
15243:                 .cloned()
15244:                 .collect();
15245:             if positionals.len() < 2 {
15246:                 return Err("policy test requires <source-node> <dest-node>".to_string());
15247:             }
15248:             Ok(PolicyCommand::Test {
15249:                 source_node: positionals[0].clone(),
15250:                 dest_node: positionals[1].clone(),
15251:                 protocol: parse_optional_kv(args, "--protocol"),
15252:                 port: parse_optional_u16(args, "--port")?,
15253:                 json,
15254:             })
15255:         }
15256:         _ => Err(format!("unknown policy subcommand: {sub}")),
15257:     }
15258: }
15259: 
15260: fn parse_relay_command(args: &[String]) -> Result<RelayCommand, String> {
15261:     let sub = args.first().map(String::as_str).unwrap_or("");
15262:     let json = args_have_flag(args, "--json");
15263:     match sub {
15264:         "list" => Ok(RelayCommand::List {
15265:             status: args_have_flag(args, "--status"),
15266:             json,
15267:         }),
15268:         "select" => {
15269:             let strategy = if args_have_flag(args, "--best-latency") {
15270:                 RelaySelectStrategy::BestLatency
15271:             } else if args_have_flag(args, "--least-load") {
15272:                 RelaySelectStrategy::LeastLoad
15273:             } else {
15274:                 RelaySelectStrategy::Auto
15275:             };
15276:             Ok(RelayCommand::Select { strategy, json })
15277:         }
15278:         "health" => {
15279:             let relay_id = args
15280:                 .iter()
15281:                 .skip(1)
15282:                 .find(|a| !a.starts_with("--"))
15283:                 .cloned()
15284:                 .ok_or_else(|| "relay health requires <relay-id> positional".to_string())?;
15285:             Ok(RelayCommand::Health { relay_id, json })
15286:         }
15287:         _ => Err(format!("unknown relay subcommand: {sub}")),
15288:     }
15289: }
15290: 
15291: fn parse_cert_command(args: &[String]) -> Result<CertCommand, String> {
15292:     let sub = args.first().map(String::as_str).unwrap_or("");
15293:     let json = args_have_flag(args, "--json");
15294:     match sub {
15295:         "list" => Ok(CertCommand::List {
15296:             only_expired: args_have_flag(args, "--expired"),
15297:             only_expiring_soon: args_have_flag(args, "--expiring-soon"),
15298:             json,
15299:         }),
15300:         "check" => Ok(CertCommand::Check {
15301:             strict: args_have_flag(args, "--strict"),
15302:             json,
15303:         }),
15304:         _ => Err(format!("unknown cert subcommand: {sub}")),
15305:     }
15306: }
15307: 
15308: fn parse_trust_state_command(args: &[String]) -> Result<TrustStateCommand, String> {
15309:     let sub = args.first().map(String::as_str).unwrap_or("");
15310:     if sub != "show" {
15311:         return Err(format!("unknown trust-state subcommand: {sub}"));
15312:     }
15313:     Ok(TrustStateCommand {
15314:         anchor: parse_optional_kv(args, "--anchor"),
15315:         json: args_have_flag(args, "--json"),
15316:     })
15317: }

15319: fn parse_analytics_command(args: &[String]) -> Result<AnalyticsCommand, String> {
15320:     let sub = args.first().map(String::as_str).unwrap_or("");
15321:     let json = args_have_flag(args, "--json");
15322:     match sub {
15323:         "peers" => Ok(AnalyticsCommand::Peers {
15324:             window_secs: parse_optional_u64(args, "--window")?,
15325:             sort_by: parse_optional_kv(args, "--sort"),
15326:             json,
15327:         }),
15328:         "traffic" => Ok(AnalyticsCommand::Traffic {
15329:             interval_secs: parse_optional_u64(args, "--interval")?,
15330:             top_n: parse_optional_u32(args, "--top")?,
15331:             json,
15332:         }),
15333:         "latency-heatmap" => Ok(AnalyticsCommand::LatencyHeatmap {
15334:             include_peers: args_have_flag(args, "--peers"),
15335:             include_relays: args_have_flag(args, "--relays"),
15336:             json,
15337:         }),
15338:         _ => Err(format!("unknown analytics subcommand: {sub}")),
15339:     }
15340: }

15419:                 format,

15421:                 json,

15425:     }

15430: fn read_node_id_from_env_or_file() -> Option<String> {
15431:     if let Ok(id) = std::env::var("RUSTYNET_NODE_ID")
15432:         && !id.trim().is_empty()
15433:     {
15434:         return Some(id);
15435:     }
15436:     for path in ["/etc/rustynet/node.id", "/var/lib/rustynet/node.id"] {
15437:         if let Ok(content) = std::fs::read_to_string(path) {
15438:             let trimmed = content.trim().to_string();
15439:             if !trimmed.is_empty() {
15440:                 return Some(trimmed);
15441:             }
15442:         }
15443:     }
15444:     None

15532:     SystemTime::now()
15533:         .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
15534:         .map(|d| d.as_secs())
15535:         .unwrap_or(0)

15540: fn execute_node(command: NodeCommand) -> Result<String, String> {
15541:     match command {
15542:         NodeCommand::Info { peers, json } => {
15543:             let node_id = read_node_id_from_env_or_file().unwrap_or_else(|| "unknown".to_string());
15544:             let role = read_node_role_from_env().unwrap_or_else(|| "unknown".to_string());
15545:             let public_key = read_file_to_trimmed_string(canonical_wg_public_key_path())
15546:                 .unwrap_or_else(|| "<not-provisioned>".to_string());
15547:             let trust_evidence_age_secs = std::fs::metadata(canonical_trust_evidence_path())
15548:                 .ok()
15549:                 .and_then(|m| m.modified().ok())
15550:                 .and_then(|t| t.duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH).ok())
15551:                 .map(|d| unix_now_secs().saturating_sub(d.as_secs()));
15552:             let peer_count = if peers {
15553:                 count_membership_peers().unwrap_or(0)
15554:             } else {
15555:                 0
15556:             };
15557:             let payload = json!({
15558:                 "node_id": node_id,
15559:                 "role": role,
15560:                 "public_key": public_key,
15561:                 "trust_evidence_age_secs": trust_evidence_age_secs,
15562:                 "peer_count": if peers { Some(peer_count) } else { None },
15563:             });
15564:             let mut human = format!(
15565:                 "node_id: {node_id}\nrole: {role}\npublic_key: {public_key}\ntrust_evidence_age_secs: {}\n",
15566:                 trust_evidence_age_secs
15567:                     .map(|s| s.to_string())
15568:                     .unwrap_or_else(|| "<unknown>".to_string()),
15569:             );
15570:             if peers {
15571:                 human.push_str(&format!("peer_count: {peer_count}\n"));
15572:             }
15573:             Ok(cli_human_or_json(json, payload, human))
15574:         }
15575:         NodeCommand::List { role, filter, json } => {
15576:             let nodes = read_membership_nodes().unwrap_or_default();
15577:             let filtered: Vec<_> = nodes
15578:                 .into_iter()
15579:                 .filter(|n| match (&role, n.get("role").and_then(|v| v.as_str())) {
15580:                     (Some(want), Some(have)) => want == "all" || want == have,
15581:                     (Some(_), None) => false,
15582:                     (None, _) => true,
15583:                 })
15584:                 .filter(
15585:                     |n| match (&filter, n.get("status").and_then(|v| v.as_str())) {
15586:                         (Some(want), Some(have)) => want == have,
15587:                         (Some(_), None) => false,
15588:                         (None, _) => true,
15589:                     },
15590:                 )
15591:                 .collect();
15592:             let payload = json!({ "nodes": filtered, "count": filtered.len() });
15593:             let human = filtered
15594:                 .iter()
15595:                 .map(|n| {
15596:                     let id = n.get("node_id").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).unwrap_or("?");
15597:                     let role = n.get("role").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).unwrap_or("?");
15598:                     let status = n
15599:                         .get("status")
15600:                         .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
15601:                         .unwrap_or("unknown");
15602:                     format!("{id}\t{role}\t{status}")
15603:                 })
15604:                 .collect::<Vec<_>>()
15605:                 .join("\n");
15606:             Ok(cli_human_or_json(
15607:                 json,
15608:                 payload,
15609:                 if human.is_empty() {
15610:                     "no nodes in membership snapshot".to_string()
15611:                 } else {
15612:                     human
15613:                 },
15614:             ))
15615:         }
15616:         NodeCommand::Probe {
15617:             node_id,
15618:             tcp_port,
15619:             udp_port,
15620:             json,
15621:         } => {
15622:             let endpoint = lookup_node_endpoint(&node_id);
15623:             let mut probes = Vec::new();
15624:             if let Some(ep) = endpoint.as_deref() {
15625:                 if let Some(port) = tcp_port {
15626:                     probes.push(probe_tcp(ep, port));
15627:                 }
15628:                 if let Some(port) = udp_port {
15629:                     probes.push(probe_udp(ep, port));
15630:                 }
15631:                 probes.push(probe_icmp(ep));
15632:             }
15633:             let any_reachable = probes.iter().any(|p| p.reachable);
15634:             let payload = json!({
15635:                 "node_id": node_id,
15636:                 "endpoint": endpoint,
15637:                 "probes": probes.iter().map(|p| json!({
15638:                     "transport": p.transport,
15639:                     "reachable": p.reachable,
15640:                     "latency_ms": p.latency_ms,
15641:                     "error": p.error,
15642:                 })).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
15643:                 "reachable": any_reachable,
15644:             });
15645:             let human = match endpoint.as_deref() {
15646:                 None => format!("no endpoint mapping found for node {node_id}"),
15647:                 Some(ep) => {
15648:                     let mut lines = vec![format!("node_id: {node_id}\nendpoint: {ep}")];
15649:                     for p in &probes {
15650:                         lines.push(format!(
15651:                             "  {}: reachable={} latency_ms={} error={}",
15652:                             p.transport,
15653:                             p.reachable,
15654:                             p.latency_ms.map(|m| m.to_string()).unwrap_or_default(),
15655:                             p.error.clone().unwrap_or_default(),
15656:                         ));
15657:                     }
15658:                     lines.join("\n")
15659:                 }
15660:             };
15661:             Ok(cli_human_or_json(json, payload, human))
15662:         }
15663:     }
15664: }
15665: 
15666: struct NodeProbeResult {
15667:     transport: &'static str,
15668:     reachable: bool,
15669:     latency_ms: Option<u128>,
15670:     error: Option<String>,
15671: }
15672: 
15673: fn probe_tcp(endpoint: &str, port: u16) -> NodeProbeResult {
15674:     let target = format!("{}:{port}", endpoint.split(':').next().unwrap_or(endpoint));
15675:     let start = std::time::Instant::now();
15676:     match std::net::TcpStream::connect_timeout(
15677:         &match target.to_socket_addrs().ok().and_then(|mut a| a.next()) {
15678:             Some(addr) => addr,
15679:             None => {
15680:                 return NodeProbeResult {
15681:                     transport: "tcp",
15682:                     reachable: false,
15683:                     latency_ms: None,
15684:                     error: Some(format!("resolve failed: {target}")),
15685:                 };
15686:             }
15687:         },
15688:         std::time::Duration::from_secs(3),
15689:     ) {
15690:         Ok(_) => NodeProbeResult {
15691:             transport: "tcp",
15692:             reachable: true,
15693:             latency_ms: Some(start.elapsed().as_millis()),
15694:             error: None,
15695:         },
15696:         Err(err) => NodeProbeResult {
15697:             transport: "tcp",
15698:             reachable: false,
15699:             latency_ms: None,
15700:             error: Some(err.to_string()),
15701:         },
15702:     }
15703: }
15704: 
15705: fn probe_udp(endpoint: &str, port: u16) -> NodeProbeResult {
15706:     let target = format!("{}:{port}", endpoint.split(':').next().unwrap_or(endpoint));
15707:     let socket = match std::net::UdpSocket::bind("0.0.0.0:0") {
15708:         Ok(s) => s,
15709:         Err(err) => {
15710:             return NodeProbeResult {
15711:                 transport: "udp",
15712:                 reachable: false,
15713:                 latency_ms: None,
15714:                 error: Some(err.to_string()),
15715:             };
15716:         }
15717:     };
15718:     let _ = socket.set_read_timeout(Some(std::time::Duration::from_secs(2)));
15719:     let start = std::time::Instant::now();
15720:     match socket.send_to(b"rustynet-probe", target.as_str()) {
15721:         Ok(_) => {
15722:             let mut buf = [0u8; 64];
15723:             let recv_result = socket.recv_from(&mut buf);
15724:             NodeProbeResult {
15725:                 transport: "udp",
15726:                 reachable: recv_result.is_ok(),
15727:                 latency_ms: Some(start.elapsed().as_millis()),
15728:                 error: recv_result.err().map(|e| e.to_string()),
15729:             }
15730:         }
15731:         Err(err) => NodeProbeResult {
15732:             transport: "udp",
15733:             reachable: false,
15734:             latency_ms: None,
15735:             error: Some(err.to_string()),
15736:         },
15737:     }
15738: }
15739: 
15740: fn probe_icmp(endpoint: &str) -> NodeProbeResult {
15741:     let host = endpoint.split(':').next().unwrap_or(endpoint);
15742:     let count_flag = if cfg!(target_os = "windows") {
15743:         "-n"
15744:     } else {
15745:         "-c"
15746:     };
15747:     let timeout_flag = if cfg!(target_os = "windows") {
15748:         "-w"
15749:     } else {
15750:         "-W"
15751:     };
15752:     let timeout_value = if cfg!(target_os = "windows") {
15753:         "2000"
15754:     } else {
15755:         "2"
15756:     };
15757:     let start = std::time::Instant::now();
15758:     let result = std::process::Command::new("ping")
15759:         .arg(count_flag)
15760:         .arg("1")
15761:         .arg(timeout_flag)
15762:         .arg(timeout_value)
15763:         .arg(host)
15764:         .stdout(std::process::Stdio::null())
15765:         .stderr(std::process::Stdio::null())
15766:         .status();
15767:     match result {
15768:         Ok(status) if status.success() => NodeProbeResult {
15769:             transport: "icmp",
15770:             reachable: true,
15771:             latency_ms: Some(start.elapsed().as_millis()),
15772:             error: None,
15773:         },
15774:         Ok(status) => NodeProbeResult {
15775:             transport: "icmp",
15776:             reachable: false,
15777:             latency_ms: None,
15778:             error: Some(format!("ping exit {}", status.code().unwrap_or(-1))),
15779:         },
15780:         Err(err) => NodeProbeResult {
15781:             transport: "icmp",
15782:             reachable: false,
15783:             latency_ms: None,
15784:             error: Some(err.to_string()),
15785:         },
15786:     }
15787: }
15788: 
15789: fn count_membership_peers() -> Result<usize, String> {
15790:     let path = canonical_membership_snapshot_path();
15791:     let bytes = std::fs::read(path).map_err(|e| format!("read {path}: {e}"))?;
15792:     // The snapshot is a structured binary/text record produced by `rustynetd
15793:     // membership` ops. For a robust peer count without coupling to its
15794:     // private serde shape, scan for the substring `node_id=`. Each peer
15795:     // entry serializes that exact key.
15796:     let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&bytes);
15797:     let count = text.matches("node_id=").count();
15798:     Ok(count)
15799: }
15800: 
15801: fn read_membership_nodes() -> Result<Vec<serde_json::Value>, String> {
15802:     let path = canonical_membership_snapshot_path();
15803:     let bytes = std::fs::read(path).map_err(|e| format!("read {path}: {e}"))?;
15804:     let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&bytes);
15805:     let mut nodes = Vec::new();
15806:     // Each membership-snapshot record encodes a sequence of `key=value`
15807:     // pairs separated by whitespace. Extract per-record fields by scanning
15808:     // for the `node_id=` anchor and collecting the surrounding line.
15809:     for line in text.lines() {
15810:         if !line.contains("node_id=") {
15811:             continue;
15812:         }
15813:         let mut fields = serde_json::Map::new();
15814:         for token in line.split_whitespace() {
15815:             if let Some((k, v)) = token.split_once('=') {
15816:                 fields.insert(k.to_string(), serde_json::Value::String(v.to_string()));
15817:             }
15818:         }
15819:         if !fields.is_empty() {
15820:             nodes.push(serde_json::Value::Object(fields));
15821:         }
15822:     }
15823:     Ok(nodes)
15824: }
15825: 
15826: fn lookup_node_endpoint(node_id: &str) -> Option<String> {
15827:     // Search the membership snapshot's record line for an `endpoint=<host:port>`
15828:     // (or `last_known_ip=<ip>`) field on the record matching this node_id.
15829:     let path = canonical_membership_snapshot_path();
15830:     let bytes = std::fs::read(path).ok()?;
15831:     let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&bytes);
15832:     for line in text.lines() {
15833:         if !line.contains(&format!("node_id={node_id}")) {
15834:             continue;
15835:         }
15836:         for token in line.split_whitespace() {
15837:             if let Some(value) = token.strip_prefix("endpoint=") {
15838:                 return Some(value.to_string());
15839:             }
15840:             if let Some(value) = token.strip_prefix("last_known_ip=") {
15841:                 return Some(value.to_string());
15842:             }
15843:         }
15844:     }
15845:     None
15846: }
15847: 
15848: fn execute_policy(command: PolicyCommand) -> Result<String, String> {
15849:     match command {
15850:         PolicyCommand::List { node, json } => {
15851:             let path = canonical_assignment_bundle_path();
15852:             let bytes = match std::fs::read(path) {
15853:                 Ok(b) => b,
15854:                 Err(_) => {
15855:                     let payload = json!({
15856:                         "rules": [],
15857:                         "note": format!("no assignment bundle at {path}; daemon has no policy ingested yet"),
15858:                     });
15859:                     let human = format!(
15860:                         "no assignment bundle at {path}; daemon has no policy ingested yet"
15861:                     );
15862:                     return Ok(cli_human_or_json(json, payload, human));
15863:                 }
15864:             };
15865:             let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&bytes);
15866:             let mut rules = Vec::new();
15867:             for line in text.lines() {
15868:                 let trimmed = line.trim();
15869:                 if let Some(rest) = trimmed.strip_prefix("allow=") {
15870:                     let (src, dst) = match rest.split_once('|') {
15871:                         Some(pair) => pair,
15872:                         None => continue,
15873:                     };
15874:                     if let Some(filter_node) = node.as_deref()
15875:                         && filter_node != src
15876:                         && filter_node != dst
15877:                     {
15878:                         continue;
15879:                     }
15880:                     rules.push(json!({
15881:                         "source": src,
15882:                         "destination": dst,
15883:                         "action": "allow",
15884:                     }));
15885:                 }
15886:             }
15887:             let payload = json!({ "rules": rules, "count": rules.len() });
15888:             let human = if rules.is_empty() {
15889:                 "no allow rules in current assignment bundle".to_string()
15890:             } else {
15891:                 rules
15892:                     .iter()
15893:                     .map(|r| {
15894:                         format!(
15895:                             "allow {} -> {}",
15896:                             r["source"].as_str().unwrap_or("?"),
15897:                             r["destination"].as_str().unwrap_or("?"),
15898:                         )
15899:                     })
15900:                     .collect::<Vec<_>>()
15901:                     .join("\n")
15902:             };
15903:             Ok(cli_human_or_json(json, payload, human))
15904:         }
15905:         PolicyCommand::Apply {
15906:             policy_file,
15907:             dry_run,
15908:             json,
15909:         } => {
15910:             let new_bytes = std::fs::read(&policy_file)
15911:                 .map_err(|e| format!("read {}: {e}", policy_file.display()))?;
15912:             let new_text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&new_bytes);
15913:             let new_rules: Vec<&str> = new_text
15914:                 .lines()
15915:                 .filter_map(|l| l.trim().strip_prefix("allow="))
15916:                 .collect();
15917:             let current_rules = std::fs::read(canonical_assignment_bundle_path())
15918:                 .ok()
15919:                 .map(|b| {
15920:                     String::from_utf8_lossy(&b)
15921:                         .lines()
15922:                         .filter_map(|l| l.trim().strip_prefix("allow=").map(String::from))
15923:                         .collect::<Vec<_>>()
15924:                 })
15925:                 .unwrap_or_default();
15926:             let added: Vec<&&str> = new_rules
15927:                 .iter()
15928:                 .filter(|r| !current_rules.iter().any(|c| c.as_str() == **r))
15929:                 .collect();
15930:             let new_set: std::collections::HashSet<&str> = new_rules.iter().copied().collect();
15931:             let removed: Vec<&String> = current_rules
15932:                 .iter()
15933:                 .filter(|c| !new_set.contains(c.as_str()))
15934:                 .collect();
15935:             let payload = json!({
15936:                 "policy_file": policy_file.display().to_string(),
15937:                 "dry_run": dry_run,
15938:                 "added": added.iter().map(|s| s.to_string()).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
15939:                 "removed": removed.iter().map(|s| s.to_string()).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
15940:                 "applied": !dry_run,
15941:             });
15942:             let human = format!(
15943:                 "policy diff for {}:\n  added: {}\n  removed: {}\n  applied: {}",
15944:                 policy_file.display(),
15945:                 added.len(),
15946:                 removed.len(),
15947:                 if dry_run {
15948:                     "no (dry-run)"
15949:                 } else {
15950:                     "no (signed-state apply requires `rustynet ops issue-and-distribute-assignments`; this command surfaces the diff only)"
15951:                 },
15952:             );
15953:             Ok(cli_human_or_json(json, payload, human))
15954:         }
15955:         PolicyCommand::Test {
15956:             source_node,
15957:             dest_node,
15958:             protocol,
15959:             port,
15960:             json,
15961:         } => {
15962:             let path = canonical_assignment_bundle_path();
15963:             let bytes = std::fs::read(path).map_err(|e| format!("read {path}: {e}"))?;
15964:             let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&bytes);
15965:             let mut allowed = false;
15966:             let mut matched_rule = None;
15967:             for line in text.lines() {
15968:                 if let Some(rest) = line.trim().strip_prefix("allow=")
15969:                     && let Some((src, dst)) = rest.split_once('|')
15970:                     && src == source_node
15971:                     && dst == dest_node
15972:                 {
15973:                     allowed = true;
15974:                     matched_rule = Some(rest.to_string());
15975:                     break;
15976:                 }
15977:             }
15978:             let payload = json!({
15979:                 "source": source_node,
15980:                 "destination": dest_node,
15981:                 "protocol": protocol,
15982:                 "port": port,
15983:                 "allowed": allowed,
15984:                 "matched_rule": matched_rule,
15985:             });
15986:             let human = format!(
15987:                 "{} -> {}: {}",
15988:                 source_node,
15989:                 dest_node,
15990:                 if allowed { "ALLOWED" } else { "DENIED" }
15991:             );
15992:             Ok(cli_human_or_json(json, payload, human))
15993:         }
15994:     }
15995: }
15996: 
15997: fn execute_relay(command: RelayCommand) -> Result<String, String> {
15998:     match command {
15999:         RelayCommand::List { status: _, json } => {
16000:             // Relays in Rustynet are membership nodes with role=relay or role=admin
16001:             // serving as exits. Read from the membership snapshot.
16002:             let nodes = read_membership_nodes().unwrap_or_default();
16003:             let relays: Vec<_> = nodes
16004:                 .into_iter()
16005:                 .filter(|n| {
16006:                     n.get("role")
16007:                         .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
16008:                         .is_some_and(|r| r == "relay" || r == "admin" || r == "blind_exit")
16009:                 })
16010:                 .collect();
16011:             let payload = json!({ "relays": relays, "count": relays.len() });
16012:             let human = if relays.is_empty() {
16013:                 "no relays in membership snapshot".to_string()
16014:             } else {
16015:                 relays
16016:                     .iter()
16017:                     .map(|r| {
16018:                         format!(
16019:                             "{}\t{}\t{}",
16020:                             r.get("node_id").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).unwrap_or("?"),
16021:                             r.get("role").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).unwrap_or("?"),
16022:                             r.get("endpoint").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).unwrap_or("?"),
16023:                         )
16024:                     })
16025:                     .collect::<Vec<_>>()
16026:                     .join("\n")
16027:             };
16028:             Ok(cli_human_or_json(json, payload, human))
16029:         }
16030:         RelayCommand::Select { strategy, json } => {
16031:             // Selection is a daemon-internal decision driven by the assignment
16032:             // bundle's exit_node_id field. Surface the current selection from
16033:             // the daemon state file.
16034:             let state_path = format!("{}/rustynetd.state", canonical_state_root());
16035:             let selection = read_file_to_trimmed_string(state_path.as_str())
16036:                 .and_then(|s| {
16037:                     s.lines()
16038:                         .find_map(|l| l.strip_prefix("selected_exit_node=").map(String::from))
16039:                 })
16040:                 .unwrap_or_else(|| "<none-selected>".to_string());
16041:             let payload = json!({
16042:                 "strategy": match strategy {
16043:                     RelaySelectStrategy::Auto => "auto",
16044:                     RelaySelectStrategy::BestLatency => "best-latency",
16045:                     RelaySelectStrategy::LeastLoad => "least-load",
16046:                 },
16047:                 "current_selection": selection,
16048:                 "note": "manual override via `rustynet exit-node select <id>` when not under auto-tunnel-enforce",
16049:             });
16050:             let human = format!("strategy: {strategy:?}\ncurrent_selection: {selection}");
16051:             Ok(cli_human_or_json(json, payload, human))
16052:         }
16053:         RelayCommand::Health { relay_id, json } => {
16054:             let endpoint = lookup_node_endpoint(&relay_id);
16055:             let probe = endpoint
16056:                 .as_deref()
16057:                 .map(probe_icmp)
16058:                 .unwrap_or_else(|| NodeProbeResult {
16059:                     transport: "icmp",
16060:                     reachable: false,
16061:                     latency_ms: None,
16062:                     error: Some(format!("no endpoint mapping for relay {relay_id}")),
16063:                 });
16064:             let payload = json!({
16065:                 "relay_id": relay_id,
16066:                 "endpoint": endpoint,
16067:                 "reachable": probe.reachable,
16068:                 "latency_ms": probe.latency_ms,
16069:                 "error": probe.error,
16070:             });
16071:             let human = format!(
16072:                 "relay_id: {relay_id}\nendpoint: {}\nreachable: {}\nlatency_ms: {}",
16073:                 endpoint.unwrap_or_else(|| "<unmapped>".to_string()),
16074:                 probe.reachable,
16075:                 probe.latency_ms.map(|m| m.to_string()).unwrap_or_default(),
16076:             );
16077:             Ok(cli_human_or_json(json, payload, human))
16078:         }
16079:     }
16080: }

16082: fn execute_cert(command: CertCommand) -> Result<String, String> {
16083:     let cert_files: Vec<(&str, &str)> = vec![
16084:         ("trust_verifier_key", canonical_trust_verifier_key_path()),
16085:         ("trust_evidence", canonical_trust_evidence_path()),
16086:         ("wireguard_public_key", canonical_wg_public_key_path()),
16087:     ];
16088:     match command {
16089:         CertCommand::List {
16090:             only_expired,
16091:             only_expiring_soon,
16092:             json,
16093:         } => {
16094:             let now = unix_now_secs();
16095:             let mut entries = Vec::new();
16096:             for (label, path) in cert_files {
16097:                 let metadata = std::fs::metadata(path).ok();
16098:                 let mtime_secs = metadata
16099:                     .as_ref()
16100:                     .and_then(|m| m.modified().ok())
16101:                     .and_then(|t| t.duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH).ok())
16102:                     .map(|d| d.as_secs());
16103:                 // Trust evidence's freshness window is RUSTYNET_TRUST_MAX_AGE_SECS
16104:                 // (default 300s). Treat anything over the daemon's configured
16105:                 // window as "expired"; we conservatively use 86400s here to
16106:                 // align with the lab's relaxed window. Other certs (verifier
16107:                 // key, wg pubkey) have no freshness expiry.
16108:                 let max_age_secs = match label {
16109:                     "trust_evidence" => 86_400u64,
16110:                     _ => 0,
16111:                 };
16112:                 let age_secs = mtime_secs.map(|m| now.saturating_sub(m));
16113:                 let expired = max_age_secs > 0 && age_secs.is_some_and(|a| a > max_age_secs);
16114:                 let expiring_soon = max_age_secs > 0
16115:                     && age_secs.is_some_and(|a| a > max_age_secs / 2 && a <= max_age_secs);
16116:                 if only_expired && !expired {
16117:                     continue;
16118:                 }
16119:                 if only_expiring_soon && !expiring_soon {
16120:                     continue;
16121:                 }
16122:                 entries.push(json!({
16123:                     "label": label,
16124:                     "path": path,
16125:                     "exists": metadata.is_some(),
16126:                     "size_bytes": metadata.as_ref().map(|m| m.len()),
16127:                     "mtime_unix": mtime_secs,
16128:                     "age_secs": age_secs,
16129:                     "max_age_secs": max_age_secs,
16130:                     "expired": expired,
16131:                     "expiring_soon": expiring_soon,
16132:                 }));
16133:             }
16134:             let payload = json!({ "certificates": entries, "count": entries.len() });
16135:             let human = entries
16136:                 .iter()
16137:                 .map(|e| {
16138:                     format!(
16139:                         "{}\t{}\texpired={}\texpiring_soon={}",
16140:                         e["label"].as_str().unwrap_or("?"),
16141:                         e["path"].as_str().unwrap_or("?"),
16142:                         e["expired"].as_bool().unwrap_or(false),
16143:                         e["expiring_soon"].as_bool().unwrap_or(false),
16144:                     )
16145:                 })
16146:                 .collect::<Vec<_>>()
16147:                 .join("\n");
16148:             Ok(cli_human_or_json(json, payload, human))
16149:         }
16150:         CertCommand::Check { strict, json } => {
16151:             let mut findings = Vec::new();
16152:             for (label, path) in cert_files {
16153:                 let metadata = std::fs::metadata(path).ok();
16154:                 let exists = metadata.is_some();
16155:                 let size = metadata.as_ref().map(|m| m.len()).unwrap_or(0);
16156:                 let ok = exists && size > 0;
16157:                 findings.push(json!({
16158:                     "label": label,
16159:                     "path": path,
16160:                     "ok": ok,
16161:                     "exists": exists,
16162:                     "size_bytes": size,
16163:                 }));
16164:             }
16165:             let any_failed = findings.iter().any(|f| !f["ok"].as_bool().unwrap_or(false));
16166:             let payload = json!({
16167:                 "findings": findings,
16168:                 "ok": !any_failed,
16169:                 "strict": strict,
16170:             });
16171:             let human = findings
16172:                 .iter()
16173:                 .map(|f| {
16174:                     format!(
16175:                         "{}\tok={}\texists={}\tsize_bytes={}",
16176:                         f["label"].as_str().unwrap_or("?"),
16177:                         f["ok"].as_bool().unwrap_or(false),
16178:                         f["exists"].as_bool().unwrap_or(false),
16179:                         f["size_bytes"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0),
16180:                     )
16181:                 })
16182:                 .collect::<Vec<_>>()
16183:                 .join("\n");
16184:             if strict && any_failed {
16185:                 Err(format!(
16186:                     "cert check FAILED in strict mode:\n{}",
16187:                     cli_human_or_json(json, payload, human),
16188:                 ))
16189:             } else {
16190:                 Ok(cli_human_or_json(json, payload, human))
16191:             }
16192:         }
16193:     }
16194: }
16195: 
16196: fn execute_trust_state(command: TrustStateCommand) -> Result<String, String> {
16197:     let evidence_path = canonical_trust_evidence_path();
16198:     let verifier_path = canonical_trust_verifier_key_path();
16199:     let evidence_metadata = std::fs::metadata(evidence_path).ok();
16200:     let evidence_size = evidence_metadata.as_ref().map(|m| m.len()).unwrap_or(0);
16201:     let evidence_age_secs = evidence_metadata
16202:         .as_ref()
16203:         .and_then(|m| m.modified().ok())
16204:         .and_then(|t| t.duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH).ok())
16205:         .map(|d| unix_now_secs().saturating_sub(d.as_secs()));
16206:     let verifier_pubkey =
16207:         read_file_to_trimmed_string(verifier_path).unwrap_or_else(|| "<missing>".to_string());
16208:     let payload = json!({
16209:         "verifier_key_path": verifier_path,
16210:         "verifier_key": verifier_pubkey,
16211:         "evidence_path": evidence_path,
16212:         "evidence_size_bytes": evidence_size,
16213:         "evidence_age_secs": evidence_age_secs,
16214:         "anchor_filter": command.anchor,
16215:     });
16216:     let human = format!(
16217:         "verifier_key_path: {verifier_path}\nverifier_key: {verifier_pubkey}\nevidence_path: {evidence_path}\nevidence_size_bytes: {evidence_size}\nevidence_age_secs: {}",
16218:         evidence_age_secs
16219:             .map(|s| s.to_string())
16220:             .unwrap_or_else(|| "<unknown>".to_string()),
16221:     );
16222:     Ok(cli_human_or_json(command.json, payload, human))
16223: }
