16225: fn execute_analytics(command: AnalyticsCommand) -> Result<String, String> {
16226:     match command {
16227:         AnalyticsCommand::Peers {
16228:             window_secs,
16229:             sort_by,
16230:             json,
16231:         } => {
16232:             let nodes = read_membership_nodes().unwrap_or_default();
16233:             let payload = json!({
16234:                 "window_secs": window_secs,
16235:                 "sort_by": sort_by,
16236:                 "peers": nodes,
16237:                 "count": nodes.len(),
16238:             });
16239:             let human = format!(
16240:                 "peers={} window_secs={} sort_by={}",
16241:                 nodes.len(),
16242:                 window_secs.map(|s| s.to_string()).unwrap_or_default(),
16243:                 sort_by.unwrap_or_default(),
16244:             );
16245:             Ok(cli_human_or_json(json, payload, human))
16246:         }
16247:         AnalyticsCommand::Traffic {
16248:             interval_secs,
16249:             top_n,
16250:             json,
16251:         } => {
16252:             // rustynet-sysinfo's interface_stats exposes per-interface byte
16253:             // counters via the platform-specific reader (Linux: /proc/net/dev,
16254:             // macOS: netstat, Windows: WMI). Aggregate them and sort by total
16255:             // throughput.
16256:             let stats = rustynet_sysinfo::interface_stats();
16257:             let mut interfaces: Vec<serde_json::Value> = stats
16258:                 .into_iter()
16259:                 .map(|i| {
16260:                     json!({
16261:                         "interface": i.name,
16262:                         "bytes_in": i.bytes_in,
16263:                         "bytes_out": i.bytes_out,
16264:                         "packets_in": i.packets_in,
16265:                         "packets_out": i.packets_out,
16266:                         "errors": i.errors,
16267:                         "dropped": i.dropped,
16268:                     })
16269:                 })
16270:                 .collect();
16271:             interfaces.sort_by(|a, b| {
16272:                 b["bytes_in"]
16273:                     .as_u64()
16274:                     .unwrap_or(0)
16275:                     .saturating_add(b["bytes_out"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0))
16276:                     .cmp(
16277:                         &a["bytes_in"]
16278:                             .as_u64()
16279:                             .unwrap_or(0)
16280:                             .saturating_add(a["bytes_out"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0)),
16281:                     )
16282:             });
16283:             if let Some(n) = top_n {
16284:                 interfaces.truncate(n as usize);
16285:             }
16286:             let payload = json!({
16287:                 "interval_secs": interval_secs,
16288:                 "top_n": top_n,
16289:                 "interfaces": interfaces,
16290:             });
16291:             let human = interfaces
16292:                 .iter()
16293:                 .map(|i| {
16294:                     format!(
16295:                         "{}\trx={}\ttx={}",
16296:                         i["interface"].as_str().unwrap_or("?"),
16297:                         i["bytes_in"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0),
16298:                         i["bytes_out"].as_u64().unwrap_or(0),
16299:                     )
16300:                 })
16301:                 .collect::<Vec<_>>()
16302:                 .join("\n");
16303:             Ok(cli_human_or_json(json, payload, human))
16304:         }
16305:         AnalyticsCommand::LatencyHeatmap {
16306:             include_peers,
16307:             include_relays,
16308:             json,
16309:         } => {
16310:             let nodes = read_membership_nodes().unwrap_or_default();
16311:             let mut entries = Vec::new();
16312:             for n in &nodes {
16313:                 let role = n.get("role").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
16314:                 let no_filter = !include_peers && !include_relays;
16315:                 let want_peer = include_peers && role == "client";
16316:                 let want_relay =
16317:                     include_relays && (role == "relay" || role == "admin" || role == "blind_exit");
16318:                 if !(no_filter || want_peer || want_relay) {
16319:                     continue;
16320:                 }
16321:                 let id = n.get("node_id").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).unwrap_or("?");
16322:                 let endpoint = n
16323:                     .get("endpoint")
16324:                     .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
16325:                     .or_else(|| n.get("last_known_ip").and_then(|v| v.as_str()));
16326:                 let probe = endpoint.map(probe_icmp).unwrap_or_else(|| NodeProbeResult {
16327:                     transport: "icmp",
16328:                     reachable: false,
16329:                     latency_ms: None,
16330:                     error: Some("no endpoint".to_string()),
16331:                 });
16332:                 entries.push(json!({
16333:                     "node_id": id,
16334:                     "role": role,
16335:                     "endpoint": endpoint,
16336:                     "latency_ms": probe.latency_ms,
16337:                     "reachable": probe.reachable,
16338:                 }));
16339:             }
16340:             let payload = json!({ "heatmap": entries, "count": entries.len() });
16341:             let human = entries
16342:                 .iter()
16343:                 .map(|e| {
16344:                     format!(
16345:                         "{}\t{}\tlatency_ms={}",
16346:                         e["node_id"].as_str().unwrap_or("?"),
16347:                         e["role"].as_str().unwrap_or("?"),
16348:                         e["latency_ms"]
16349:                             .as_u64()
16350:                             .map(|m| m.to_string())
16351:                             .unwrap_or_else(|| "<unreachable>".to_string()),
16352:                     )
16353:                 })
16354:                 .collect::<Vec<_>>()
16355:                 .join("\n");
16356:             Ok(cli_human_or_json(json, payload, human))
16357:         }
16358:     }
16359: }
16360: 
16361: fn execute_backup(command: BackupCommand) -> Result<String, String> {
16362:     let state_root = canonical_state_root();
16363:     let now = unix_now_secs();
16364:     std::fs::create_dir_all(&command.out_dir).map_err(|e| format!("create out_dir failed: {e}"))?;
16365:     // Write plain tar; gzip wrapping is left to external tooling so we
16366:     // don't take a flate2 dependency in rustynet-cli for one CLI feature.
16367:     // Operators can post-process with `gzip` / `zstd` / `xz` per their
16368:     // org's standard.
16369:     let archive_name = format!("rustynet-backup-{now}.tar");
16370:     let archive_path = command.out_dir.join(&archive_name);
16371:     let archive = std::fs::File::create(&archive_path)
16372:         .map_err(|e| format!("open {}: {e}", archive_path.display()))?;
16373:     {
16374:         let mut tarball = tar::Builder::new(archive);
16375:         tarball
16376:             .append_dir_all("rustynet", state_root)
16377:             .map_err(|e| format!("tar append failed: {e}"))?;
16378:         tarball
16379:             .finish()
16380:             .map_err(|e| format!("tar finish failed: {e}"))?;
16381:     }
16382:     let bytes_written = std::fs::metadata(&archive_path)
16383:         .map(|m| m.len())
16384:         .unwrap_or(0);
16385:     if command.compress {
16386:         eprintln!(
16387:             "[backup] --compress noted; archive at {} is plain tar. Wrap with `gzip` / `zstd` / `xz` externally if compression is required.",
16388:             archive_path.display()
16389:         );
16390:     }
16391:     if command.encrypt_passphrase_file.is_some() {
16392:         // Encryption path requires an audited symmetric AEAD; surface
16393:         // explicitly so an operator does not assume unencrypted output is
16394:         // protected. The backup itself is still on disk, unencrypted, and
16395:         // the operator can wrap it with their organisation's standard tool
16396:         // (age, gpg, openssl enc).
16397:         eprintln!(
16398:             "[backup] --encrypt-passphrase-file requested but at-rest encryption is not yet \
16399:              implemented in this CLI; archive at {} remains unencrypted. Wrap externally if \
16400:              encryption is required.",
16401:             archive_path.display()
16402:         );
16403:     }
16404:     let payload = json!({
16405:         "archive_path": archive_path.display().to_string(),
16406:         "bytes_written": bytes_written,
16407:         "compressed": command.compress,
16408:         "encrypted": false,
16409:     });
16410:     let human = format!(
16411:         "wrote backup to {} ({} bytes, compressed={}, encrypted=false)",
16412:         archive_path.display(),
16413:         bytes_written,
16414:         command.compress,
16415:     );
16416:     Ok(cli_human_or_json(command.json, payload, human))
16417: }
16418: 
16419: fn execute_restore_state(command: RestoreStateCommand) -> Result<String, String> {
16420:     if !command.backup_path.is_file() {
16421:         return Err(format!(
16422:             "backup file not found: {}",
16423:             command.backup_path.display()
16424:         ));
16425:     }
16426:     let archive =
16427:         std::fs::File::open(&command.backup_path).map_err(|e| format!("open backup: {e}"))?;
16428:     if command
16429:         .backup_path
16430:         .extension()
16431:         .is_some_and(|e| e == "gz" || e == "tgz")
16432:     {
16433:         return Err(format!(
16434:             "compressed backup archive {} is unsupported here; \
16435:              decompress externally (`gunzip` / `zstd -d`) and re-run \
16436:              on the plain tar file",
16437:             command.backup_path.display()
16438:         ));
16439:     }
16440:     let mut paths: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
16441:     let mut tarball = tar::Archive::new(archive);
16442:     for entry in tarball.entries().map_err(|e| format!("tar entries: {e}"))? {
16443:         let entry = entry.map_err(|e| format!("tar entry: {e}"))?;
16444:         let path = entry
16445:             .path()
16446:             .map_err(|e| format!("tar entry path: {e}"))?
16447:             .display()
16448:             .to_string();
16449:         paths.push(path);
16450:     }
16451:     let entries_seen = paths.len() as u64;
16452:     if !command.dry_run {
16453:         // Actual extraction would write files under canonical_state_root() and
16454:         // requires the daemon to be stopped to avoid clobbering live state.
16455:         // Surface the requirement honestly rather than performing a partial
16456:         // restore that races the daemon.
16457:         eprintln!(
16458:             "[restore] non-dry-run extraction of state requires the rustynetd service to be \
16459:              stopped first; this command currently lists archive contents only. Stop the \
16460:              service, extract with `tar -xf {} -C {}`, then start the service.",
16461:             command.backup_path.display(),
16462:             canonical_state_root(),
16463:         );
16464:     }
16465:     let payload = json!({
16466:         "backup_path": command.backup_path.display().to_string(),
16467:         "entries_seen": entries_seen,
16468:         "verify": command.verify,
16469:         "dry_run": command.dry_run,
16470:         "paths": paths,
16471:     });
16472:     let human = format!(
16473:         "scanned {} entries from {} (dry_run={}, verify={})",
16474:         entries_seen,
16475:         command.backup_path.display(),
16476:         command.dry_run,
16477:         command.verify,
16478:     );
16479:     Ok(cli_human_or_json(command.json, payload, human))
16480: }
16481: 
16482: fn execute_export_keys(command: ExportKeysCommand) -> Result<String, String> {
16483:     let pub_path = canonical_wg_public_key_path();
16484:     let raw = std::fs::read_to_string(pub_path)
16485:         .map_err(|e| format!("read {pub_path}: {e}"))?
16486:         .trim()
16487:         .to_string();
16488:     let serialized = match command.format {
16489:         KeyExportFormat::Raw => raw.clone(),
16490:         KeyExportFormat::Pem => {
16491:             // WireGuard keys are 32 bytes base64-encoded already; PEM-wrap
16492:             // the same payload so external tooling that expects PEM can
16493:             // ingest it directly.
16494:             format!(
16495:                 "-----BEGIN WIREGUARD PUBLIC KEY-----\n{}\n-----END WIREGUARD PUBLIC KEY-----",
16496:                 raw
16497:             )
16498:         }
16499:     };
16500:     if let Some(ref out) = command.out_path {
16501:         std::fs::write(out, serialized.as_bytes())
16502:             .map_err(|e| format!("write {}: {e}", out.display()))?;
16503:     }
16504:     let payload = json!({
16505:         "format": match command.format {
16506:             KeyExportFormat::Pem => "pem",
16507:             KeyExportFormat::Raw => "raw",
16508:         },
16509:         "out_path": command.out_path.as_ref().map(|p| p.display().to_string()),
16510:         "key": serialized,
16511:     });
16512:     let human = match &command.out_path {
16513:         Some(p) => format!("exported {} to {}", pub_path, p.display()),
16514:         None => serialized.clone(),
16515:     };
16516:     Ok(cli_human_or_json(command.json, payload, human))
16517: }
16518: 
16519: fn execute_config_subcommand(command: ConfigSubCommand) -> Result<String, String> {
16520:     let env_path = canonical_runtime_config_env_path();
16521:     let env_text = std::fs::read_to_string(env_path).unwrap_or_default();
16522:     let parsed: Vec<(String, String)> = env_text
16523:         .lines()
16524:         .filter(|l| !l.trim().is_empty() && !l.trim_start().starts_with('#'))
16525:         .filter_map(|l| {
16526:             l.split_once('=')
16527:                 .map(|(k, v)| (k.trim().to_string(), v.trim().to_string()))
16528:         })
16529:         .collect();
16530:     match command {
16531:         ConfigSubCommand::Show { section, json } => {
16532:             let filtered: Vec<_> = parsed
16533:                 .iter()
16534:                 .filter(|(k, _)| match &section {
16535:                     Some(prefix) => k.starts_with(prefix),
16536:                     None => true,
16537:                 })
16538:                 .map(|(k, v)| json!({ "key": k, "value": v }))
16539:                 .collect();
16540:             let payload = json!({
16541:                 "config_path": env_path,
16542:                 "section": section,
16543:                 "entries": filtered,
16544:             });
16545:             let human = filtered
16546:                 .iter()
16547:                 .map(|e| {
16548:                     format!(
16549:                         "{}={}",
16550:                         e["key"].as_str().unwrap_or("?"),
16551:                         e["value"].as_str().unwrap_or("")
16552:                     )
16553:                 })
16554:                 .collect::<Vec<_>>()
16555:                 .join("\n");
16556:             Ok(cli_human_or_json(json, payload, human))
16557:         }
16558:         ConfigSubCommand::Validate { strict, json } => {
16559:             let mut findings = Vec::new();
16560:             for (k, v) in &parsed {
16561:                 if v.is_empty() {
16562:                     findings.push(json!({ "key": k, "issue": "empty value" }));
16563:                 }
16564:             }
16565:             let ok = findings.is_empty();
16566:             let payload = json!({
16567:                 "config_path": env_path,
16568:                 "ok": ok,
16569:                 "findings": findings,
16570:                 "strict": strict,
16571:             });
16572:             let human = if ok {
16573:                 format!("config {env_path}: ok ({} entries)", parsed.len())
16574:             } else {
16575:                 format!("config {env_path}: {} issues found", findings.len())
16576:             };
16577:             if strict && !ok {
16578:                 Err(format!("config validate FAILED:\n{human}"))
16579:             } else {
16580:                 Ok(cli_human_or_json(json, payload, human))
16581:             }
16582:         }
16583:         ConfigSubCommand::Export {
16584:             format,
16585:             out_path,
16586:             json,
16587:         } => {
16588:             let serialized = match format {
16589:                 ConfigExportFormat::Toml => parsed
16590:                     .iter()
16591:                     .map(|(k, v)| format!("{k} = {}", serde_json::to_string(v).unwrap_or_default()))
16592:                     .collect::<Vec<_>>()
16593:                     .join("\n"),
16594:                 ConfigExportFormat::Json => {
16595:                     let map: serde_json::Map<String, serde_json::Value> = parsed
16596:                         .iter()
16597:                         .map(|(k, v)| (k.clone(), serde_json::Value::String(v.clone())))
16598:                         .collect();
16599:                     serde_json::to_string_pretty(&map).unwrap_or_default()
16600:                 }
16601:                 ConfigExportFormat::Yaml => parsed
16602:                     .iter()
16603:                     .map(|(k, v)| format!("{k}: {v}"))
16604:                     .collect::<Vec<_>>()
16605:                     .join("\n"),
16606:             };
16607:             if let Some(ref p) = out_path {
16608:                 std::fs::write(p, serialized.as_bytes())
16609:                     .map_err(|e| format!("write {}: {e}", p.display()))?;
16610:             }
16611:             let payload = json!({
16612:                 "config_path": env_path,
16613:                 "format": match format {
16614:                     ConfigExportFormat::Toml => "toml",
16615:                     ConfigExportFormat::Json => "json",
16616:                     ConfigExportFormat::Yaml => "yaml",
16617:                 },
16618:                 "out_path": out_path.as_ref().map(|p| p.display().to_string()),
16619:                 "bytes": serialized.len(),
16620:             });
16621:             let human = match &out_path {
16622:                 Some(p) => format!("exported config to {}", p.display()),
16623:                 None => serialized.clone(),
16624:             };
16625:             Ok(cli_human_or_json(json, payload, human))
16626:         }
16627:     }
16628: }

16865:     #[test]
16866:     fn phase6_parity_validation_rejects_false_readiness_control() {
16867:         let base = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(
16868:             "rustynet-phase6-validate-{}-{}",
16869:             std::process::id(),
16870:             std::time::SystemTime::now()
16871:                 .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
16872:                 .expect("system time before unix epoch")
16873:                 .as_nanos()
16874:         ));
16875:         std::fs::create_dir_all(&base).expect("create temp validation dir");
16876: 
16877:         let write_json = |path: &std::path::Path, payload: serde_json::Value| {
16878:             let mut body = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&payload).expect("serialize json");
16879:             body.push('\n');
16880:             std::fs::write(path, body).expect("write json payload");
16881:         };
16882:         let now = std::time::SystemTime::now()
16883:             .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
16884:             .expect("system time before unix epoch")
16885:             .as_secs();
16886: 
16887:         let mut sources = Vec::new();
16888:         for platform in ["linux", "macos", "windows"] {
16889:             let source = base.join(format!("platform_parity_{platform}.json"));
16890:             let route_ok = platform != "macos";
16891:             write_json(
16892:                 source.as_path(),
16893:                 serde_json::json!({
16894:                     "evidence_mode": "measured",
16895:                     "platform": platform,
16896:                     "route_hook_ready": route_ok,
16897:                     "dns_hook_ready": true,
16898:                     "firewall_hook_ready": true,
16899:                     "leak_matrix_passed": true,
16900:                     "probe_time_unix": now,
16901:                     "probe_host": format!("host-{platform}"),
16902:                     "probe_sources": {
16903:                         "route": "route probe",
16904:                         "dns": "dns probe",
16905:                         "firewall": "firewall probe",
16906:                         "leak_report": "/tmp/leak.json",
16907:                     },
16908:                 }),
16909:             );
16910:             sources.push(source.display().to_string());
16911:         }
16912: 
16913:         let report_path = base.join("platform_parity_report.json");
16914:         write_json(
16915:             report_path.as_path(),
16916:             serde_json::json!({
16917:                 "evidence_mode": "measured",
16918:                 "captured_at_unix": now,
16919:                 "environment": "ci",

19295:         let cleared = rewrite_assignment_refresh_lan_routes(existing, &[]);
19296:         assert!(!cleared.contains("RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_LAN_ROUTES="));
19297:     }

19340:     fn local_traversal_refresh_config_uses_assignment_env_specs() {
19341:         let env = concat!(
19342:             "RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_TARGET_NODE_ID=\"client-40\"\n",
19343:             "RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_NODES=\"client-40|192.168.18.40:51820|abc;exit-49|192.168.18.49:51820|def\"\n",
19344:             "RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_ALLOW=\"client-40|exit-49;exit-49|client-40\"\n",
19345:         );

19353:         );

19359:         )
19360:         .expect("refresh env body should be derived");

19362:             "NODES_SPEC=\"client-40|192.168.18.40:51820|abc;exit-49|192.168.18.49:51820|def\""
19363:         ));

19366:             "TRAVERSAL_TTL_SECS=\"{}\"",
19367:             super::LOCAL_TRAVERSAL_REFRESH_TTL_SECS
19368:         )));
19369:     }

===== /crates/rustynet-cli/src/bin/active_network_security_gates.rs =====

   1: #![forbid(unsafe_code)]
   2: 
   3: use std::env;
   4: use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
   5: use std::process::{Command, ExitStatus};
   6: 
   7: fn main() {
   8:     let code = match run() {
   9:         Ok(()) => 0,
  10:         Err(code) => code,
  11:     };
  12:     std::process::exit(code);
  13: }
  14: 
  15: fn run() -> Result<(), i32> {
  16:     let passthrough_args: Vec<String> = env::args().skip(1).collect();
  17:     let root_dir = repo_root().map_err(|err| {
  18:         eprintln!("{err}");
  19:         1
  20:     })?;
  21: 
  22:     let mut command = Command::new("cargo");
  23:     command.current_dir(root_dir).args([
  24:         "run",
  25:         "--quiet",
  26:         "-p",
  27:         "rustynet-cli",
  28:         "--",
  29:         "ops",
  30:         "run-active-network-security-gates",
  31:     ]);
  32:     command.args(passthrough_args);
  33:     let status = command.status().map_err(|err| {
  34:         eprintln!("failed to execute active network security gates: {err}");
  35:         1
  36:     })?;
  37:     if status.success() {
  38:         Ok(())
  39:     } else {
  40:         Err(status_code(status))
  41:     }
  42: }
  43: 
  44: fn repo_root() -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
  45:     let manifest_dir = PathBuf::from(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"));
  46:     manifest_dir
  47:         .parent()
  48:         .and_then(Path::parent)
  49:         .map(Path::to_path_buf)
  50:         .ok_or_else(|| {
  51:             format!(
  52:                 "failed to resolve repository root from manifest dir {}",
  53:                 manifest_dir.display()
  54:             )
  55:         })
  56: }
  57: 
  58: fn status_code(status: ExitStatus) -> i32 {
  59:     match status.code() {
  60:         Some(code) => code,
  61:         None => {
  62:             #[cfg(unix)]
  63:             {
  64:                 use std::os::unix::process::ExitStatusExt;
  65: 
  66:                 match status.signal() {
  67:                     Some(signal) => 128 + signal,
  68:                     None => 1,
  69:                 }
  70:             }
  71:             #[cfg(not(unix))]
  72:             {
  73:                 1
  74:             }
  75:         }
  76:     }
  77: }

===== /crates/rustynet-cli/src/bin/apply_cross_network_impairment_profile.rs =====

   1: #![forbid(unsafe_code)]
   2: 
   3: use std::env;
   4: use std::process::{Command, ExitStatus, Stdio};
   5: 
   6: const DEFAULT_PROFILE: &str = "none";
   7: const DEFAULT_INTERFACE: &str = "rustynet0";
   8: 
   9: #[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
  10: enum Mode {
  11:     Apply,
  12:     Clear,
  13:     Status,
  14: }
  15: 
  16: fn main() {
  17:     let code = match run() {
  18:         Ok(()) => 0,
  19:         Err(code) => code,
  20:     };
  21:     std::process::exit(code);
  22: }
  23: 
  24: fn run() -> Result<(), i32> {
  25:     let mut mode: Option<Mode> = None;
  26:     let mut profile = DEFAULT_PROFILE.to_string();
  27:     let mut interface = DEFAULT_INTERFACE.to_string();
  28: 
  29:     let args: Vec<String> = env::args().skip(1).collect();
  30:     let mut index = 0usize;
  31:     while index < args.len() {
  32:         match args[index].as_str() {
  33:             "--mode" => {
  34:                 let value = args
  35:                     .get(index + 1)
  36:                     .ok_or_else(|| print_usage_error("--mode requires a value"))?;
  37:                 mode = Some(parse_mode(value)?);
  38:                 index += 2;
  39:             }
  40:             "--profile" => {
  41:                 let value = args
  42:                     .get(index + 1)
  43:                     .ok_or_else(|| print_usage_error("--profile requires a value"))?;
  44:                 if !profile_supported(value) {
  45:                     eprintln!("unsupported impairment profile: {value}");
  46:                     return Err(2);
  47:                 }
  48:                 profile = value.clone();
  49:                 index += 2;
  50:             }
  51:             "--interface" => {
  52:                 let value = args
  53:                     .get(index + 1)
  54:                     .ok_or_else(|| print_usage_error("--interface requires a value"))?;
  55:                 if !valid_interface(value) {
  56:                     eprintln!("invalid interface: {value}");
  57:                     return Err(2);
  58:                 }
  59:                 interface = value.clone();
  60:                 index += 2;
  61:             }
  62:             "-h" | "--help" => {
  63:                 print_usage();
  64:                 return Ok(());
  65:             }
  66:             unknown => {
  67:                 eprintln!("unknown argument: {unknown}");
  68:                 print_usage();
  69:                 return Err(2);
  70:             }
  71:         }
  72:     }
  73: 
  74:     let mode = mode.ok_or_else(|| {
  75:         eprintln!("--mode is required");
  76:         2
  77:     })?;
  78: 
  79:     require_command("ip")?;
  80:     require_command("tc")?;
  81:     ensure_interface_exists(&interface)?;
  82: 
  83:     match mode {
  84:         Mode::Apply => apply_profile(&interface, &profile),
  85:         Mode::Clear => clear_profile(&interface),
  86:         Mode::Status => show_status(&interface),
  87:     }
  88: }
  89: 
  90: fn parse_mode(value: &str) -> Result<Mode, i32> {
  91:     match value {
  92:         "apply" => Ok(Mode::Apply),
  93:         "clear" => Ok(Mode::Clear),
  94:         "status" => Ok(Mode::Status),
  95:         other => {
  96:             eprintln!("unsupported mode: {other}");
  97:             Err(2)
  98:         }
  99:     }
 100: }
 101: 
 102: fn print_usage_error(message: &str) -> i32 {
 103:     eprintln!("{message}");
 104:     print_usage();
 105:     2
 106: }
 107: 
 108: fn print_usage() {
 109:     println!(
 110:         "usage: apply_cross_network_impairment_profile.sh --mode <apply|clear|status> [options]"
 111:     );
 112:     println!();
 113:     println!("options:");
 114:     println!("  --mode <mode>           apply | clear | status");
 115:     println!(
 116:         "  --profile <profile>     none | latency_50ms_loss_1pct | latency_120ms_loss_3pct | loss_5pct (default: none)"
 117:     );
 118:     println!("  --interface <iface>     network interface (default: rustynet0)");
 119:     println!("  -h, --help              show help");
 120: }
 121: 
 122: fn profile_supported(profile: &str) -> bool {
 123:     matches!(
 124:         profile,
 125:         "none" | "latency_50ms_loss_1pct" | "latency_120ms_loss_3pct" | "loss_5pct"
 126:     )
 127: }
 128: 
 129: fn valid_interface(value: &str) -> bool {
 130:     !value.is_empty()
 131:         && value
 132:             .bytes()
 133:             .all(|b| b.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || b"._:-".contains(&b))
 134: }
 135: 
 136: fn require_command(command: &str) -> Result<(), i32> {
 137:     let status = Command::new("sh")
 138:         .args(["-c", &format!("command -v {command} >/dev/null 2>&1")])
 139:         .stdin(Stdio::null())
 140:         .status()
 141:         .map_err(|err| {
 142:             eprintln!("failed to verify required command {command}: {err}");
 143:             1
 144:         })?;
 145:     if status.success() {
 146:         Ok(())
 147:     } else {
 148:         eprintln!("missing required command: {command}");
 149:         Err(1)
 150:     }
 151: }
 152: 
 153: fn ensure_interface_exists(interface: &str) -> Result<(), i32> {
 154:     let status = Command::new("ip")
 155:         .args(["link", "show", interface])
 156:         .stdin(Stdio::null())
 157:         .stdout(Stdio::null())
 158:         .stderr(Stdio::null())
 159:         .status()
 160:         .map_err(|err| {
 161:             eprintln!("failed to inspect interface {interface}: {err}");
 162:             1
 163:         })?;
 164:     if status.success() {
 165:         Ok(())
 166:     } else {
 167:         eprintln!("interface does not exist: {interface}");
 168:         Err(1)
 169:     }
 170: }
 171: 
 172: fn clear_profile(interface: &str) -> Result<(), i32> {
 173:     let _ = Command::new("tc")
 174:         .args(["qdisc", "del", "dev", interface, "root"])
 175:         .stdin(Stdio::null())
 176:         .stdout(Stdio::null())
 177:         .stderr(Stdio::null())
 178:         .status();
 179:     Ok(())
 180: }
 181: 
 182: fn show_status(interface: &str) -> Result<(), i32> {
 183:     let status = Command::new("tc")
 184:         .args(["qdisc", "show", "dev", interface])
 185:         .stdin(Stdio::null())
 186:         .status()
 187:         .map_err(|err| {
 188:             eprintln!("failed to query qdisc status: {err}");
 189:             1
 190:         })?;
 191:     if status.success() {
 192:         Ok(())
 193:     } else {
 194:         Err(status_code(status))
 195:     }
 196: }
 197: 
 198: fn apply_profile(interface: &str, profile: &str) -> Result<(), i32> {
 199:     if profile == "none" {
 200:         return clear_profile(interface);
 201:     }
 202:     let root_qdisc = current_root_qdisc(interface)?;
 203:     if let Some(existing) = root_qdisc
 204:         && existing != "noqueue"
 205:         && existing != "netem"
 206:     {
 207:         eprintln!("refusing to overwrite existing root qdisc on {interface}: {existing}");
 208:         return Err(1);
 209:     }
 210: 
 211:     let args: Vec<&str> = match profile {
 212:         "latency_50ms_loss_1pct" => vec![
 213:             "qdisc", "replace", "dev", interface, "root", "netem", "delay", "50ms", "5ms", "loss",
 214:             "1%",
 215:         ],
 216:         "latency_120ms_loss_3pct" => vec![
 217:             "qdisc", "replace", "dev", interface, "root", "netem", "delay", "120ms", "15ms",
 218:             "loss", "3%",
 219:         ],
 220:         "loss_5pct" => vec![
 221:             "qdisc", "replace", "dev", interface, "root", "netem", "loss", "5%",
 222:         ],
 223:         _ => {
 224:             eprintln!("unsupported impairment profile: {profile}");
 225:             return Err(2);
 226:         }
 227:     };
 228: 
 229:     let status = Command::new("tc")
 230:         .args(args)
 231:         .stdin(Stdio::null())
 232:         .status()
 233:         .map_err(|err| {
 234:             eprintln!("failed to apply impairment profile: {err}");
 235:             1
 236:         })?;
 237:     if status.success() {
 238:         Ok(())
 239:     } else {
 240:         Err(status_code(status))
 241:     }
 242: }
 243: 
 244: fn current_root_qdisc(interface: &str) -> Result<Option<String>, i32> {
 245:     let output = Command::new("tc")
 246:         .args(["qdisc", "show", "dev", interface])
 247:         .output()
 248:         .map_err(|err| {
 249:             eprintln!("failed to query qdisc state for {interface}: {err}");
 250:             1
 251:         })?;
 252:     if !output.status.success() {
 253:         return Err(status_code(output.status));
 254:     }
 255:     let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout);
 256:     let first_line = text.lines().next().unwrap_or_default();
 257:     let mut parts = first_line.split_whitespace();
 258:     let _ = parts.next();
 259:     let qdisc = parts.next().map(str::to_string);
 260:     Ok(qdisc)
 261: }
 262: 
 263: fn status_code(status: ExitStatus) -> i32 {
 264:     match status.code() {
 265:         Some(code) => code,
 266:         None => {
 267:             #[cfg(unix)]
 268:             {
 269:                 use std::os::unix::process::ExitStatusExt;
 270:                 match status.signal() {
 271:                     Some(signal) => 128 + signal,
 272:                     None => 1,
 273:                 }
 274:             }
 275:             #[cfg(not(unix))]
 276:             {
 277:                 1
 278:             }
 279:         }
 280:     }
 281: }

===== /crates/rustynet-cli/src/bin/bootstrap_ci_tools.rs =====

  23: fn run() -> Result<(), i32> {
  24:     let _ignored_args: Vec<OsString> = env::args_os().skip(1).collect();
  25:

  27:         install_system_packages()?;

  30:     let mut cargo_bin = cargo_bin_dir_if_present();
  31:     if !command_exists("rustup", cargo_bin.as_deref()) {

  71:             "toolchain",
  72:             "install",
  73:             security_toolchain.as_str(),
  74:             "--profile",
  75:             "minimal",
  76:         ],
  77:         cargo_bin.as_deref(),
  78:         None,
  79:         &[],
  80:     )?;
  81: 
  82:     if !version_starts_with(

  84:         &["--version"],
  85:         REQUIRED_AUDIT_VERSION_PREFIX,
  86:         cargo_bin.as_deref(),

  89:         run_command(
  90:             "cargo",
  91:             &[
  92:                 toolchain.as_str(),
  93:                 "install",
  94:                 "cargo-audit",
  95:                 "--locked",
  96:                 "--version",
  97:                 "0.22.1",
  98:                 "--force",
  99:             ],
 100:             cargo_bin.as_deref(),
 101:             None,
 102:             &[],
 103:         )?;
 104:     }
 105: 
 106:     if !version_starts_with(
 107:         "cargo-deny",
 108:         &["--version"],
 109:         REQUIRED_DENY_VERSION_PREFIX,
 110:         cargo_bin.as_deref(),
 111:     ) {
 112:         let toolchain = format!("+{security_toolchain}");
 113:         run_command(
 114:             "cargo",
 115:             &[
 116:                 toolchain.as_str(),
 117:                 "install",
 118:                 "cargo-deny",
 119:                 "--locked",
 120:                 "--force",
 121:             ],
 122:             cargo_bin.as_deref(),
 123:             None,
 124:             &[],
 125:         )?;
 126:     }
 127: 
 128:     let root_dir = repo_root().map_err(|err| {
 129:         eprintln!("{err}");
 130:         1
 131:     })?;
 132:     let audit_db_path = env::var_os("RUSTYNET_AUDIT_DB_PATH")
 133:         .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
 134:         .map(PathBuf::from)
 135:         .unwrap_or_else(|| root_dir.join(".cargo-audit-db"));
 136:     let audit_db = audit_db_path.to_str().ok_or_else(|| {

 149:             "-p",
 150:             "rustynet-cli",

 152:             "ops",

 154:             audit_db,

 158:         &[],

 164: fn bootstrap_system_packages_enabled() -> bool {

 171: fn install_system_packages() -> Result<(), i32> {
 172:     let use_sudo = current_uid().map_err(|err| {
 173:         eprintln!("{err}");
 174:         1
 175:     })? != 0;
 176:     if use_sudo && !command_exists("sudo", None) {
 177:         eprintln!("missing required command: sudo");
 178:         return Err(1);
 179:     }
 180: 
 181:     run_apt_get(use_sudo, &["update"])?;
 182:     run_apt_get(
 183:         use_sudo,
 184:         &[
 185:             "install",
 186:             "-y",
 187:             "--no-install-recommends",
 188:             "ca-certificates",
 189:             "curl",
 190:             "git",
 191:             "build-essential",
 192:             "pkg-config",
 193:             "python3",
 194:             "iproute2",
 195:             "nftables",
 196:             "wireguard-tools",
 197:         ],
 198:     )
 199: }

 201: fn run_apt_get(use_sudo: bool, args: &[&str]) -> Result<(), i32> {
 202:     let mut command = if use_sudo {
 203:         let mut cmd = Command::new("sudo");
 204:         cmd.arg("apt-get");
 205:         cmd
 206:     } else {
 207:         Command::new("apt-get")
 208:     };
 209:     command
 210:         .args(args)
 211:         .stdin(Stdio::null())
 212:         .env("DEBIAN_FRONTEND", "noninteractive");
 213:     let status = command.status().map_err(|err| {
 214:         eprintln!("failed to execute apt-get: {err}");
 215:         1
 216:     })?;
 217:     if status.success() {
 218:         Ok(())
 219:     } else {
 220:         Err(status_code(status))
 221:     }
 222: }

 224: fn install_rustup(path_prefix: Option<&Path>) -> Result<(), i32> {
 225:     let path_env = match build_path_env(path_prefix) {
 226:         Ok(path_env) => path_env,
 227:         Err(err) => {
 228:             eprintln!("{err}");
 229:             return Err(1);
 230:         }
 231:     };
 232: 
 233:     let mut curl_cmd = Command::new("curl");
 234:     curl_cmd
 235:         .args([
 236:             "--proto",
 237:             "=https",
 238:             "--tlsv1.2",
 239:             "-sSf",
 240:             "https://sh.rustup.rs",
 241:         ])
 242:         .stdin(Stdio::null())
 243:         .stdout(Stdio::piped())
 244:         .stderr(Stdio::inherit());
 245:     if let Some(path_value) = &path_env {
 246:         curl_cmd.env("PATH", path_value);
 247:     }
 248:     let mut curl_child = curl_cmd.spawn().map_err(|err| {
 249:         eprintln!("failed to start rustup installer download: {err}");
 250:         1
 251:     })?;
 252:     let curl_stdout = curl_child.stdout.take().ok_or_else(|| {
 253:         eprintln!("failed to capture rustup installer download output");
 254:         1
 255:     })?;
 256: 
 257:     let mut sh_cmd = Command::new("sh");
 258:     sh_cmd
 259:         .args([
 260:             "-s",
 261:             "--",
 262:             "-y",
 263:             "--profile",
 264:             "minimal",
 265:             "--default-toolchain",
 266:             PINNED_TOOLCHAIN,
 267:         ])
 268:         .stdin(Stdio::from(curl_stdout))
 269:         .stdout(Stdio::inherit())
 270:         .stderr(Stdio::inherit());
 271:     if let Some(path_value) = &path_env {
 272:         sh_cmd.env("PATH", path_value);
 273:     }
 274:     let sh_status = sh_cmd.status().map_err(|err| {
 275:         eprintln!("failed to execute rustup installer script: {err}");
 276:         1
 277:     })?;
 278:     let curl_status = curl_child.wait().map_err(|err| {
 279:         eprintln!("failed waiting for rustup installer download command: {err}");
 280:         1
 281:     })?;
 282:     if !curl_status.success() {
 283:         return Err(status_code(curl_status));
 284:     }
 285:     if !sh_status.success() {
 286:         return Err(status_code(sh_status));
 287:     }
 288:     Ok(())
 289: }
 290: 
 291: fn publish_github_path(cargo_bin: &Path) -> Result<(), i32> {
 292:     let Some(path_file) = env::var_os("GITHUB_PATH").filter(|value| !value.is_empty()) else {
 293:         return Ok(());
 294:     };
 295:     let mut file = OpenOptions::new()
 296:         .create(true)
 297:         .append(true)
 298:         .open(Path::new(&path_file))
 299:         .map_err(|err| {
 300:             eprintln!(
 301:                 "failed to open GITHUB_PATH target {}: {err}",
 302:                 Path::new(&path_file).display()
 303:             );
 304:             1
 305:         })?;
 306:     writeln!(file, "{}", cargo_bin.display()).map_err(|err| {
 307:         eprintln!(
 308:             "failed to append cargo bin path to GITHUB_PATH file {}: {err}",
 309:             Path::new(&path_file).display()
 310:         );
 311:         1
 312:     })?;
 313:     Ok(())
 314: }
 315: 
 316: fn run_command(
 317:     program: &str,
 318:     args: &[&str],
 319:     path_prefix: Option<&Path>,
 320:     cwd: Option<&Path>,
 321:     extra_env: &[(&str, &str)],
 322: ) -> Result<(), i32> {
 323:     let mut cmd = Command::new(program);
 324:     if let Some(path_value) = build_path_env(path_prefix).map_err(|err| {
 325:         eprintln!("{err}");
 326:         1
 327:     })? {
 328:         cmd.env("PATH", path_value);
 329:     }
 330:     if let Some(dir) = cwd {
 331:         cmd.current_dir(dir);
 332:     }
 333:     cmd.args(args).stdin(Stdio::null());
 334:     for (key, value) in extra_env {
 335:         cmd.env(key, value);
 336:     }
 337:     let status = cmd.status().map_err(|err| {
 338:         eprintln!(
 339:             "failed to run command: {} {} ({err})",
 340:             program,
 341:             args.join(" ")
 342:         );
 343:         1
 344:     })?;
 345:     if status.success() {
 346:         Ok(())
 347:     } else {
 348:         Err(status_code(status))
 349:     }
 350: }
 351: 
 352: fn version_starts_with(
 353:     program: &str,
 354:     args: &[&str],
 355:     expected_prefix: &str,
 356:     path_prefix: Option<&Path>,
 357: ) -> bool {
 358:     if !command_exists(program, path_prefix) {
 359:         return false;
 360:     }
 361:     let mut cmd = Command::new(program);
 362:     if let Ok(Some(path_value)) = build_path_env(path_prefix) {
 363:         cmd.env("PATH", path_value);
 364:     }
 365:     let output = match cmd.args(args).stdin(Stdio::null()).output() {
 366:         Ok(output) => output,
 367:         Err(_) => return false,
 368:     };
 369:     if !output.status.success() {
 370:         return false;
 371:     }
 372:     let stdout = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout);
 373:     stdout.starts_with(expected_prefix)
 374: }
 375: 
 376: fn current_uid() -> Result<u32, String> {
 377:     let output = Command::new("id")
 378:         .args(["-u"])
 379:         .stdin(Stdio::null())
 380:         .output()
 381:         .map_err(|err| format!("failed to run id -u: {err}"))?;
 382:     if !output.status.success() {
 383:         return Err(format!("id -u failed with status: {}", output.status));
 384:     }
 385:     let uid_text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout);
 386:     uid_text
 387:         .trim()
 388:         .parse::<u32>()
 389:         .map_err(|err| format!("failed to parse uid from id -u output '{uid_text}': {err}"))
 390: }
 391: 
 392: fn cargo_bin_dir_if_present() -> Option<PathBuf> {
 393:     let home = env::var_os("HOME").filter(|value| !value.is_empty())?;
 394:     let path = Path::new(&home).join(".cargo").join("bin");
 395:     if path.is_dir() { Some(path) } else { None }
 396: }
 397: 
 398: fn command_exists(name: &str, path_prefix: Option<&Path>) -> bool {
 399:     if Path::new(name).components().count() > 1 {
 400:         return Path::new(name).is_file();
 401:     }
 402:     let mut candidates = Vec::new();
 403:     if let Some(prefix) = path_prefix {
 404:         candidates.push(prefix.to_path_buf());
 405:     }
 406:     if let Some(path_var) = env::var_os("PATH") {
 407:         candidates.extend(env::split_paths(&path_var));
 408:     }
 409:     candidates.into_iter().any(|dir| {
 410:         let candidate = dir.join(name);
 411:         candidate.is_file() || is_windows_executable(name, &dir)
 412:     })
 413: }
 414: 
 415: #[cfg(windows)]
 416: fn is_windows_executable(name: &str, dir: &Path) -> bool {
 417:     dir.join(format!("{name}.exe")).is_file()
 418: }
 419: 
 420: #[cfg(not(windows))]
 421: fn is_windows_executable(_name: &str, _dir: &Path) -> bool {
 422:     false
 423: }
 424: 
 425: fn build_path_env(path_prefix: Option<&Path>) -> Result<Option<OsString>, String> {
 426:     let Some(prefix) = path_prefix else {
 427:         return Ok(None);
 428:     };
 429:     let mut paths = vec![prefix.to_path_buf()];
 430:     if let Some(path_var) = env::var_os("PATH") {
 431:         paths.extend(env::split_paths(&path_var));
 432:     }
 433:     let joined = env::join_paths(paths).map_err(|err| {
 434:         format!(
 435:             "failed to build PATH with prefix {}: {err}",
 436:             prefix.display()
 437:         )
 438:     })?;
 439:     Ok(Some(joined))
 440: }
 441: 
 442: fn repo_root() -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
 443:     let manifest_dir = PathBuf::from(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"));
 444:     manifest_dir
 445:         .parent()
 446:         .and_then(Path::parent)
 447:         .map(Path::to_path_buf)
 448:         .ok_or_else(|| {
 449:             format!(
 450:                 "failed to resolve repository root from manifest dir {}",
 451:                 manifest_dir.display()
 452:             )
 453:         })
 454: }
 455: 
 456: fn status_code(status: ExitStatus) -> i32 {
 457:     match status.code() {
 458:         Some(code) => code,
 459:         None => {
 460:             #[cfg(unix)]
 461:             {
 462:                 use std::os::unix::process::ExitStatusExt;
 463: 
 464:                 match status.signal() {
 465:                     Some(signal) => 128 + signal,
 466:                     None => 1,
 467:                 }
 468:             }
 469:             #[cfg(not(unix))]
 470:             {
 471:                 1
 472:             }
 473:         }
 474:     }
 475: }

 113: fn main() {

 115:         Ok(()) => 0,
 116:         Err(code) => code,
 117:     };
 118:     std::process::exit(code);
 119: }

 121: fn run() -> Result<(), i32> {
 122:     let mut config = Config::default();
 123:     let parse_result = parse_args_from(env::args_os(), &mut config).map_err(|err| {
 124:         eprintln!("[collect-reconnect] ERROR: {err}");
 125:         eprintln!("{}", usage());
 126:         1
 127:     })?;
 128:     if parse_result == ParseResult::Help {
 129:         print!("{}", usage());
 130:         return Ok(());
 131:     }
 132: 
 133:     ensure_linux().map_err(|err| {
 134:         eprintln!("[collect-reconnect] ERROR: {err}");
 135:         1
 136:     })?;
 137: 
 138:     let repo_root = repo_root().map_err(|err| {
 139:         eprintln!("[collect-reconnect] ERROR: {err}");
 140:         1
 141:     })?;
 142: 
 143:     let collected_at_utc = collect_utc_timestamp().map_err(|err| {
 144:         eprintln!("[collect-reconnect] ERROR: {err}");
 145:         1
 146:     })?;
 147:     let collected_at_unix = collect_unix_timestamp().map_err(|err| {
 148:         eprintln!("[collect-reconnect] ERROR: {err}");
 149:         1
 150:     })?;
 151: 
 152:     let output_path = config
 153:         .output_path
 154:         .clone()
 155:         .unwrap_or_else(|| default_output_path(&collected_at_utc));
 156:     let sudo = SudoContext::prepare(config.sudo_mode).map_err(|err| {
 157:         eprintln!("[collect-reconnect] ERROR: {err}");
 158:         1
 159:     })?;
 160: 
 161:     log(config.quiet, "Collecting Linux reconnect bundle...");
 162:     let report = build_report(
 163:         &config,
 164:         &repo_root,
 165:         &sudo,
 166:         &collected_at_utc,
 167:         collected_at_unix,
 168:     );
 169: 
 170:     write_private_file(&output_path, report.as_bytes()).map_err(|err| {
 171:         eprintln!(
 172:             "[collect-reconnect] ERROR: failed to write {}: {err}",
 173:             output_path.display()
 174:         );
 175:         1
 176:     })?;
 177: 
 178:     println!("{}", output_path.display());
 179:     Ok(())
 180: }
 181: 
 182: fn ensure_linux() -> Result<(), String> {
 183:     if env::consts::OS == "linux" {
 184:         Ok(())
 185:     } else {
 186:         Err("this collector only supports Linux hosts".to_string())
 187:     }
 188: }
 189: 
 190: fn parse_args_from<I, T>(args: I, config: &mut Config) -> Result<ParseResult, String>
 191: where
 192:     I: IntoIterator<Item = T>,
 193:     T: Into<OsString>,
 194: {
 195:     let mut iter = args.into_iter().map(Into::into);
 196:     let _program = iter.next();
 197: 
 198:     while let Some(arg) = iter.next() {
 199:         let arg = arg.to_string_lossy();
 200:         match arg.as_ref() {
 201:             "--help" | "-h" => return Ok(ParseResult::Help),
 202:             "--output" => {
 203:                 let value = next_value(&mut iter, "--output")?;
 204:                 config.output_path = Some(PathBuf::from(value));
 205:             }
 206:             "--probe-target" => {
 207:                 config
 208:                     .probe_targets
 209:                     .push(next_value(&mut iter, "--probe-target")?);
 210:             }
 211:             "--wg-interface" => {
 212:                 config.wg_interface = next_value(&mut iter, "--wg-interface")?;
 213:             }
 214:             "--daemon-socket" => {
 215:                 config.daemon_socket = PathBuf::from(next_value(&mut iter, "--daemon-socket")?);
 216:             }
 217:             "--journal-lines" => {
 218:                 let value = next_value(&mut iter, "--journal-lines")?;
 219:                 config.journal_lines = value
 220:                     .parse::<usize>()
 221:                     .map_err(|_| format!("invalid --journal-lines value: {value}"))?;
 222:                 if config.journal_lines == 0 {
 223:                     return Err("--journal-lines must be greater than zero".to_string());
 224:                 }
 225:             }
 226:             "--sudo" => {
 227:                 config.sudo_mode = parse_sudo_mode(&next_value(&mut iter, "--sudo")?)?;
 228:             }
 229:             "--quiet" => config.quiet = true,
 230:             _ => return Err(format!("unknown argument: {arg}")),
 231:         }
 232:     }
 233: 
 234:     Ok(ParseResult::Config)
 235: }
 236: 
 237: fn next_value<I>(iter: &mut I, flag: &str) -> Result<String, String>
 238: where
 239:     I: Iterator<Item = OsString>,
 240: {
 241:     iter.next()
 242:         .map(|value| value.to_string_lossy().into_owned())
 243:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("missing value for {flag}"))
 244: }
 245: 
 246: fn parse_sudo_mode(value: &str) -> Result<SudoMode, String> {
 247:     match value {
 248:         "auto" => Ok(SudoMode::Auto),
 249:         "always" => Ok(SudoMode::Always),
 250:         "never" => Ok(SudoMode::Never),
 251:         _ => Err(format!(
 252:             "invalid --sudo value: {value} (expected auto|always|never)"
 253:         )),
 254:     }
 255: }
 256: 
 257: impl SudoContext {
 258:     fn prepare(mode: SudoMode) -> Result<Self, String> {
 259:         match mode {
 260:             SudoMode::Never => Ok(Self {
 261:                 enabled: false,
 262:                 summary: "sudo disabled by operator request".to_string(),
 263:             }),
 264:             SudoMode::Auto | SudoMode::Always => {
 265:                 if !command_exists("sudo") {
 266:                     if mode == SudoMode::Always {
 267:                         return Err(
 268:                             "sudo is not available but --sudo=always was requested".to_string()
 269:                         );
 270:                     }
 271:                     return Ok(Self {
 272:                         enabled: false,
 273:                         summary: "sudo not available; privileged probes will run unprivileged"
 274:                             .to_string(),
 275:                     });
 276:                 }
 277: 
 278:                 let validation = if io::stdin().is_terminal() {
 279:                     Command::new("sudo").arg("-v").status()
 280:                 } else {
 281:                     Command::new("sudo").args(["-n", "true"]).status()
 282:                 };
 283: 
 284:                 match validation {
 285:                     Ok(status) if status.success() => Ok(Self {
 286:                         enabled: true,
 287:                         summary: "sudo available; privileged probes enabled".to_string(),
 288:                     }),
 289:                     Ok(status) => {
 290:                         if mode == SudoMode::Always {
 291:                             Err(format!(
 292:                                 "sudo validation failed with exit code {}",
 293:                                 status_code(status)
 294:                             ))
 295:                         } else {
 296:                             Ok(Self {
 297:                                 enabled: false,
 298:                                 summary: format!(
 299:                                     "sudo validation failed with exit code {}; privileged probes will run unprivileged",
 300:                                     status_code(status)
 301:                                 ),
 302:                             })
 303:                         }
 304:                     }
 305:                     Err(err) => {
 306:                         if mode == SudoMode::Always {
 307:                             Err(format!("failed to validate sudo access: {err}"))
 308:                         } else {
 309:                             Ok(Self {
 310:                                 enabled: false,
 311:                                 summary: format!(
 312:                                     "failed to validate sudo access ({err}); privileged probes will run unprivileged"
 313:                                 ),
 314:                             })
 315:                         }
 316:                     }
 317:                 }
 318:             }
 319:         }
 320:     }
 321: }
 322: 
 323: fn build_report(
 324:     config: &Config,
 325:     repo_root: &Path,
 326:     sudo: &SudoContext,
 327:     collected_at_utc: &str,
 328:     collected_at_unix: u64,
 329: ) -> String {
 330:     let mut report = String::new();
 331:     writeln!(report, "# RustyNet Linux Reconnect Bundle").unwrap();
 332:     writeln!(report).unwrap();
 333:     writeln!(report, "- captured_at_utc: {collected_at_utc}").unwrap();
 334:     writeln!(report, "- captured_at_unix: {collected_at_unix}").unwrap();
 335:     writeln!(
 336:         report,
 337:         "- daemon_socket: {}",
 338:         config.daemon_socket.display()
 339:     )
 340:     .unwrap();
 341:     writeln!(report, "- wireguard_interface: {}", config.wg_interface).unwrap();
 342:     writeln!(report, "- route_table: {DEFAULT_ROUTE_TABLE}").unwrap();
 343:     writeln!(report, "- privileged_coverage: {}", sudo.summary).unwrap();
 344:     writeln!(report).unwrap();
 345:     writeln!(
 346:         report,
 347:         "This bundle intentionally excludes private keys, passphrase files, and signing secrets."
 348:     )
 349:     .unwrap();
 350: 
 351:     let host_identity = run_first_success(
 352:         &[
 353:             CommandSpec::plain("hostnamectl status", "hostnamectl", &["status"]),
 354:             CommandSpec::plain("hostname", "hostname", &[]),
 355:         ],
 356:         sudo,
 357:     );
 358:     append_command_section(&mut report, "Host Identity", &host_identity);
 359: 
 360:     append_command_section(
 361:         &mut report,
 362:         "IPv4 Addressing",
 363:         &run_command(
 364:             CommandSpec::plain("ip -4 addr show", "ip", &["-4", "addr", "show"]),
 365:             sudo,
 366:         ),
 367:     );
 368:     let routes = run_command(CommandSpec::plain("ip route", "ip", &["route"]), sudo);
 369:     append_command_section(&mut report, "Routes", &routes);
 370:     append_command_section(
 371:         &mut report,
 372:         "Routing Rules",
 373:         &run_command(
 374:             CommandSpec::plain("ip rule show", "ip", &["rule", "show"]),
 375:             sudo,
 376:         ),
 377:     );
 378:     let route_table = run_command(
 379:         CommandSpec::plain(
 380:             "ip route show table 51820",
 381:             "ip",
 382:             &["route", "show", "table", DEFAULT_ROUTE_TABLE],
 383:         ),
 384:         sudo,
 385:     );
 386:     append_command_section(&mut report, "RustyNet Route Table", &route_table);
 387: 
 388:     let listeners = run_command(
 389:         CommandSpec::prefer_root("ss -ltnup", "ss", &["-ltnup"]),
 390:         sudo,
 391:     );
 392:     append_filtered_command_section(
 393:         &mut report,
 394:         "Relevant Listeners",
 395:         &listeners,
 396:         filter_listener_lines,
 397:     );
 398: 
 399:     let systemctl_status = run_command(
 400:         CommandSpec::prefer_root(
 401:             "systemctl status rustynetd --no-pager -l",
 402:             "systemctl",
 403:             &["status", "rustynetd", "--no-pager", "-l"],
 404:         ),
 405:         sudo,
 406:     );
 407:     append_command_section(&mut report, "rustynetd Service Status", &systemctl_status);
 408: 
 409:     let rustynet_status = run_rustynet_command(
 410:         repo_root,
 411:         &config.daemon_socket,
 412:         "status",
 413:         &[],
 414:         "cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli --bin rustynet-cli -- status",
 415:     );
 416:     append_command_section(&mut report, "RustyNet Status", &rustynet_status);
 417: 
 418:     let rustynet_netcheck = run_rustynet_command(
 419:         repo_root,
 420:         &config.daemon_socket,
 421:         "netcheck",
 422:         &[],
 423:         "cargo run --quiet -p rustynet-cli --bin rustynet-cli -- netcheck",
 424:     );
 425:     append_command_section(&mut report, "RustyNet Netcheck", &rustynet_netcheck);
 426: 
 427:     let wg_endpoints = run_command(
 428:         CommandSpec::prefer_root(
 429:             &format!("wg show {} endpoints", config.wg_interface),
 430:             "wg",
 431:             &["show", &config.wg_interface, "endpoints"],
 432:         ),
 433:         sudo,
 434:     );
 435:     append_command_section(&mut report, "WireGuard Endpoints", &wg_endpoints);
 436:     let wg_allowed_ips = run_command(
 437:         CommandSpec::prefer_root(
 438:             &format!("wg show {} allowed-ips", config.wg_interface),
 439:             "wg",
 440:             &["show", &config.wg_interface, "allowed-ips"],
 441:         ),
 442:         sudo,
 443:     );
 444:     append_command_section(&mut report, "WireGuard Allowed IPs", &wg_allowed_ips);
 445:     append_command_section(
 446:         &mut report,
 447:         "WireGuard Latest Handshakes",
 448:         &run_command(
 449:             CommandSpec::prefer_root(
 450:                 &format!("wg show {} latest-handshakes", config.wg_interface),
 451:                 "wg",
 452:                 &["show", &config.wg_interface, "latest-handshakes"],
 453:             ),
 454:             sudo,
 455:         ),
 456:     );
 457: 
 458:     let rustynetd_env = run_command(
 459:         CommandSpec::prefer_root(
 460:             &format!("cat {RUSTYNETD_ENV_PATH}"),
 461:             "cat",
 462:             &[RUSTYNETD_ENV_PATH],
 463:         ),
 464:         sudo,
 465:     );
 466:     append_filtered_env_section(
 467:         &mut report,
 468:         "rustynetd Environment Subset",
 469:         &rustynetd_env,
 470:         RUSTYNETD_ALLOWED_KEYS,
 471:         RUSTYNETD_ALLOWED_PREFIXES,
 472:     );
 473: 
 474:     let assignment_env = run_command(
 475:         CommandSpec::prefer_root(
 476:             &format!("cat {ASSIGNMENT_REFRESH_ENV_PATH}"),
 477:             "cat",
 478:             &[ASSIGNMENT_REFRESH_ENV_PATH],
 479:         ),
 480:         sudo,
 481:     );
 482:     append_filtered_env_section(
 483:         &mut report,
 484:         "Assignment Refresh Environment Subset",
 485:         &assignment_env,
 486:         ASSIGNMENT_REFRESH_ALLOWED_KEYS,
 487:         &[],
 488:     );
 489: 
 490:     append_command_section(
 491:         &mut report,
 492:         "State File mtimes",
 493:         &run_command(
 494:             CommandSpec {
 495:                 display: "stat -c %n size=%s mtime=%y <state_paths>".to_string(),
 496:                 program: "stat".to_string(),
 497:                 args: build_stat_args(),
 498:                 current_dir: None,
 499:                 env: Vec::new(),
 500:                 privilege: Privilege::PreferRoot,
 501:             },
 502:             sudo,
 503:         ),
 504:     );
 505: 
 506:     let nft_rules = run_command(
 507:         CommandSpec::prefer_root("nft list ruleset", "nft", &["list", "ruleset"]),
 508:         sudo,
 509:     );
 510:     append_filtered_command_section(
 511:         &mut report,
 512:         "Relevant nftables Rules",
 513:         &nft_rules,
 514:         filter_nft_lines,
 515:     );
 516: 
 517:     let resolved_probe_targets = resolve_probe_targets(
 518:         config,
 519:         &routes,
 520:         &route_table,
 521:         &wg_endpoints,
 522:         &wg_allowed_ips,
 523:     );
 524:     writeln!(
 525:         report,
 526:         "- probe_targets: {}",
 527:         if resolved_probe_targets.is_empty() {
 528:             "none".to_string()
 529:         } else {
 530:             resolved_probe_targets.join(", ")
 531:         }
 532:     )
 533:     .unwrap();
 534:     writeln!(report).unwrap();
 535: 
 536:     for target in &resolved_probe_targets {
 537:         append_command_section(
 538:             &mut report,
 539:             &format!("Route Probe {target}"),
 540:             &run_command(
 541:                 CommandSpec::plain(
 542:                     &format!("ip route get {target}"),
 543:                     "ip",
 544:                     &["route", "get", target],
 545:                 ),
 546:                 sudo,
 547:             ),
 548:         );
 549:         append_command_section(
 550:             &mut report,
 551:             &format!("Ping Probe {target}"),
 552:             &run_command(
 553:                 CommandSpec::plain(
 554:                     &format!("ping -c 2 -W 3 {target}"),
 555:                     "ping",
 556:                     &["-c", "2", "-W", "3", target],
 557:                 ),
 558:                 sudo,
 559:             ),
 560:         );
 561:     }
 562: 
 563:     append_command_section(
 564:         &mut report,
 565:         "Recent rustynetd Journal",
 566:         &run_command(
 567:             CommandSpec::prefer_root(
 568:                 &format!(
 569:                     "journalctl -u rustynetd -n {} --no-pager",
 570:                     config.journal_lines
 571:                 ),
 572:                 "journalctl",
 573:                 &[
 574:                     "-u",
 575:                     "rustynetd",
 576:                     "-n",
 577:                     &config.journal_lines.to_string(),
 578:                     "--no-pager",
 579:                 ],
 580:             ),
 581:             sudo,
 582:         ),
 583:     );
 584: 
 585:     report
 586: }

 588: fn build_stat_args() -> Vec<String> {
 589:     let mut args = vec!["-c".to_string(), "%n size=%s mtime=%y".to_string()];
 590:     args.extend(STATE_PATHS.iter().map(|path| (*path).to_string()));
 591:     args
 592: }
 593: 
 594: fn resolve_probe_targets(
 595:     config: &Config,
 596:     routes: &CommandRecord,
 597:     route_table: &CommandRecord,
 598:     wg_endpoints: &CommandRecord,
 599:     wg_allowed_ips: &CommandRecord,
 600: ) -> Vec<String> {
 601:     let mut targets = BTreeSet::new();
 602:     for target in &config.probe_targets {
 603:         let trimmed = target.trim();
 604:         if !trimmed.is_empty() {
 605:             targets.insert(trimmed.to_string());
 606:         }
 607:     }
 608: 
 609:     for target in auto_probe_targets(routes, route_table, wg_endpoints, wg_allowed_ips) {
 610:         targets.insert(target);
 611:     }
 612: 
 613:     targets.into_iter().collect()
 614: }
 615: 
 616: fn auto_probe_targets(
 617:     routes: &CommandRecord,
 618:     route_table: &CommandRecord,
 619:     wg_endpoints: &CommandRecord,
 620:     wg_allowed_ips: &CommandRecord,
 621: ) -> Vec<String> {
 622:     let mut targets = BTreeSet::new();
 623: 
 624:     if routes.exit_code == Some(0) {
 625:         for target in parse_default_gateway_targets(&routes.output) {
 626:             targets.insert(target);
 627:         }
 628:     }
 629:     if route_table.exit_code == Some(0) {
 630:         for target in parse_host_route_targets(&route_table.output) {
 631:             targets.insert(target);
 632:         }
 633:     }
 634:     if wg_endpoints.exit_code == Some(0) {
 635:         for target in parse_wg_endpoint_targets(&wg_endpoints.output) {
 636:             targets.insert(target);
 637:         }
 638:     }
 639:     if wg_allowed_ips.exit_code == Some(0) {
 640:         for target in parse_wg_allowed_ip_targets(&wg_allowed_ips.output) {
 641:             targets.insert(target);
 642:         }
 643:     }
 644: 
 645:     targets.into_iter().collect()
 646: }
 647: 
 648: fn parse_default_gateway_targets(output: &str) -> Vec<String> {
 649:     output
 650:         .lines()
 651:         .filter_map(|line| {
 652:             let mut parts = line.split_whitespace();
 653:             if parts.next()? != "default" || parts.next()? != "via" {
 654:                 return None;
 655:             }
 656:             parse_private_probe_ipv4(parts.next()?)
 657:         })
 658:         .collect()
 659: }
 660: 
 661: fn parse_host_route_targets(output: &str) -> Vec<String> {
 662:     output
 663:         .lines()
 664:         .filter_map(|line| {
 665:             let destination = line.split_whitespace().next()?;
 666:             parse_private_probe_cidr_or_ip(destination)
 667:         })
 668:         .collect()
 669: }
 670: 
 671: fn parse_wg_endpoint_targets(output: &str) -> Vec<String> {
 672:     output
 673:         .lines()
 674:         .filter_map(|line| {
 675:             let mut parts = line.split_whitespace();
 676:             let _peer = parts.next()?;
 677:             let endpoint = parts.next()?;
 678:             if endpoint == "(none)" || endpoint == "off" {
 679:                 return None;
 680:             }
 681:             let host = endpoint.rsplit_once(':').map_or(endpoint, |(host, _)| host);
 682:             parse_private_probe_ipv4(host.trim_matches(['[', ']']))
 683:         })
 684:         .collect()
 685: }
 686: 
 687: fn parse_wg_allowed_ip_targets(output: &str) -> Vec<String> {
 688:     let mut targets = Vec::new();
 689:     for line in output.lines() {
 690:         let mut parts = line.split_whitespace();
 691:         let Some(_peer) = parts.next() else {
 692:             continue;
 693:         };
 694:         let rest = parts.collect::<Vec<_>>().join(" ");
 695:         for entry in rest.split(',') {
 696:             if let Some(target) = parse_private_probe_cidr_or_ip(entry.trim()) {
 697:                 targets.push(target);
 698:             }
 699:         }
 700:     }
 701:     targets
 702: }
 703: 
 704: fn parse_private_probe_cidr_or_ip(value: &str) -> Option<String> {
 705:     let token = value.trim();
 706:     if token.is_empty() || token == "default" {
 707:         return None;
 708:     }
 709:     let candidate = token
 710:         .split_once('/')
 711:         .map_or(token, |(ip, prefix)| if prefix == "32" { ip } else { "" });
 712:     parse_private_probe_ipv4(candidate)
 713: }
 714: 
 715: fn parse_private_probe_ipv4(value: &str) -> Option<String> {
 716:     let octets = parse_ipv4_octets(value)?;
 717:     if is_private_or_mesh_ipv4(&octets) {
 718:         Some(value.to_string())
 719:     } else {
 720:         None
 721:     }
 722: }
 723: 
 724: fn parse_ipv4_octets(value: &str) -> Option<[u8; 4]> {
 725:     let mut octets = [0u8; 4];
 726:     let mut parts = value.split('.');
 727:     for slot in &mut octets {
 728:         *slot = parts.next()?.parse::<u8>().ok()?;
 729:     }
 730:     if parts.next().is_some() {
 731:         return None;
 732:     }
 733:     Some(octets)
 734: }
 735: 
 736: fn is_private_or_mesh_ipv4(octets: &[u8; 4]) -> bool {
 737:     match octets {
 738:         [10, _, _, _] => true,
 739:         [172, second, _, _] if (16..=31).contains(second) => true,
 740:         [192, 168, _, _] => true,
 741:         [100, second, _, _] if (64..=127).contains(second) => true,
 742:         [127, _, _, _] => true,
 743:         _ => false,
 744:     }
 745: }
 746: 
 747: #[derive(Clone)]
 748: struct CommandSpec {
 749:     display: String,
 750:     program: String,
 751:     args: Vec<String>,
 752:     current_dir: Option<PathBuf>,
 753:     env: Vec<(String, String)>,
 754:     privilege: Privilege,
 755: }
 756: 
 757: impl CommandSpec {
 758:     fn plain(display: &str, program: &str, args: &[&str]) -> Self {
 759:         Self {
 760:             display: display.to_string(),
 761:             program: program.to_string(),
 762:             args: args.iter().map(|arg| (*arg).to_string()).collect(),
 763:             current_dir: None,
 764:             env: Vec::new(),
 765:             privilege: Privilege::PlainOnly,
 766:         }
 767:     }
 768: 
 769:     fn prefer_root(display: &str, program: &str, args: &[&str]) -> Self {
 770:         Self {
 771:             display: display.to_string(),
 772:             program: program.to_string(),
 773:             args: args.iter().map(|arg| (*arg).to_string()).collect(),
 774:             current_dir: None,
 775:             env: Vec::new(),
 776:             privilege: Privilege::PreferRoot,
 777:         }
 778:     }
 779: }
 780: 
 781: fn run_first_success(specs: &[CommandSpec], sudo: &SudoContext) -> CommandRecord {
 782:     let mut last = None;
 783:     for spec in specs {
 784:         let record = run_command(spec.clone(), sudo);
 785:         if record.exit_code == Some(0) {
 786:             return record;
 787:         }
 788:         last = Some(record);
 789:     }
 790:     last.unwrap_or_else(|| CommandRecord {
 791:         command_display: "(no command)".to_string(),
 792:         exit_code: None,
 793:         output: "no commands were attempted".to_string(),
 794:         ran_with_sudo: false,
 795:     })
 796: }
 797: 
 798: fn run_rustynet_command(
 799:     repo_root: &Path,
 800:     daemon_socket: &Path,
 801:     subcommand: &str,
 802:     extra_args: &[&str],
 803:     display: &str,
 804: ) -> CommandRecord {
 805:     let mut args = vec![
 806:         "run".to_string(),
 807:         "--quiet".to_string(),
 808:         "-p".to_string(),
 809:         "rustynet-cli".to_string(),
 810:         "--bin".to_string(),
 811:         "rustynet-cli".to_string(),
 812:         "--".to_string(),
 813:         subcommand.to_string(),
 814:     ];
 815:     args.extend(extra_args.iter().map(|arg| (*arg).to_string()));
 816: 
 817:     run_command(
 818:         CommandSpec {
 819:             display: display.to_string(),
 820:             program: "cargo".to_string(),
 821:             args,
 822:             current_dir: Some(repo_root.to_path_buf()),
 823:             env: vec![(
 824:                 "RUSTYNET_DAEMON_SOCKET".to_string(),
 825:                 daemon_socket.display().to_string(),
 826:             )],
 827:             privilege: Privilege::PlainOnly,
 828:         },
 829:         &SudoContext {
 830:             enabled: false,
 831:             summary: String::new(),
 832:         },
 833:     )
 834: }
 835: 
 836: fn run_command(spec: CommandSpec, sudo: &SudoContext) -> CommandRecord {
 837:     let use_sudo = spec.privilege == Privilege::PreferRoot && sudo.enabled;
 838:     let mut command = if use_sudo {
 839:         let mut command = Command::new("sudo");
 840:         command.arg("-n").arg(&spec.program);
 841:         command
 842:     } else {
 843:         Command::new(&spec.program)
 844:     };
 845: 
 846:     if let Some(current_dir) = &spec.current_dir {
 847:         command.current_dir(current_dir);
 848:     }
 849:     for (key, value) in &spec.env {
 850:         command.env(key, value);
 851:     }
 852:     command.args(&spec.args);
 853: 
 854:     let command_display = if use_sudo {
 855:         format!("sudo -n {}", spec.display)
 856:     } else {
 857:         spec.display
 858:     };
 859: 
 860:     match command.output() {
 861:         Ok(output) => CommandRecord {
 862:             command_display,
 863:             exit_code: Some(status_code(output.status)),
 864:             output: combine_output(&output.stdout, &output.stderr),
 865:             ran_with_sudo: use_sudo,
 866:         },
 867:         Err(err) => CommandRecord {
 868:             command_display,
 869:             exit_code: None,
 870:             output: format!("failed to execute command: {err}"),
 871:             ran_with_sudo: use_sudo,
 872:         },
 873:     }
 874: }
 875: 
 876: fn status_code(status: ExitStatus) -> i32 {
 877:     match status.code() {
 878:         Some(code) => code,
 879:         None => {
 880:             #[cfg(unix)]
 881:             {
 882:                 use std::os::unix::process::ExitStatusExt;
 883:                 status.signal().map_or(1, |signal| 128 + signal)
 884:             }
 885:             #[cfg(not(unix))]
 886:             {
 887:                 1
 888:             }
 889:         }
 890:     }
 891: }
 892: 
 893: fn combine_output(stdout: &[u8], stderr: &[u8]) -> String {
 894:     let stdout = String::from_utf8_lossy(stdout).trim().to_string();
 895:     let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(stderr).trim().to_string();
 896:     match (stdout.is_empty(), stderr.is_empty()) {
 897:         (true, true) => "(no output)".to_string(),
 898:         (false, true) => stdout,
 899:         (true, false) => format!("[stderr]\n{stderr}"),
 900:         (false, false) => format!("{stdout}\n\n[stderr]\n{stderr}"),
 901:     }
 902: }
 903: 
 904: fn append_command_section(report: &mut String, title: &str, record: &CommandRecord) {
 905:     writeln!(report).unwrap();
 906:     writeln!(report, "## {title}").unwrap();
 907:     writeln!(report).unwrap();
 908:     writeln!(report, "- command: `{}`", record.command_display).unwrap();
 909:     writeln!(
 910:         report,
 911:         "- exit_code: {}",
 912:         record
 913:             .exit_code
 914:             .map(|value| value.to_string())
 915:             .unwrap_or_else(|| "launch_error".to_string())
 916:     )
 917:     .unwrap();
 918:     writeln!(
 919:         report,
 920:         "- ran_with_sudo: {}",
 921:         if record.ran_with_sudo { "yes" } else { "no" }
 922:     )
 923:     .unwrap();
 924:     writeln!(report).unwrap();
 925:     writeln!(report, "```text").unwrap();
 926:     writeln!(report, "{}", record.output).unwrap();
 927:     writeln!(report, "```").unwrap();
 928: }
 929: 
 930: fn append_filtered_command_section(
 931:     report: &mut String,
 932:     title: &str,
 933:     record: &CommandRecord,
 934:     filter: fn(&str) -> String,
 935: ) {
 936:     if record.exit_code == Some(0) {
 937:         let filtered = filter(&record.output);
 938:         let filtered_record = CommandRecord {
 939:             command_display: record.command_display.clone(),
 940:             exit_code: record.exit_code,
 941:             output: if filtered.trim().is_empty() {
 942:                 "(no matching lines)".to_string()
 943:             } else {
 944:                 filtered
 945:             },
 946:             ran_with_sudo: record.ran_with_sudo,
 947:         };
 948:         append_command_section(report, title, &filtered_record);
 949:     } else {
 950:         append_command_section(report, title, record);
 951:     }
 952: }
 953: 
 954: fn append_filtered_env_section(
 955:     report: &mut String,
 956:     title: &str,
 957:     record: &CommandRecord,
 958:     allowed_keys: &[&str],
 959:     allowed_prefixes: &[&str],
 960: ) {
 961:     if record.exit_code == Some(0) {
 962:         let filtered = filter_env_lines(&record.output, allowed_keys, allowed_prefixes);
 963:         let filtered_record = CommandRecord {
 964:             command_display: record.command_display.clone(),
 965:             exit_code: record.exit_code,
 966:             output: if filtered.trim().is_empty() {
 967:                 "(no allowed keys present)".to_string()
 968:             } else {
 969:                 filtered
 970:             },
 971:             ran_with_sudo: record.ran_with_sudo,
 972:         };
 973:         append_command_section(report, title, &filtered_record);
 974:     } else {
 975:         append_command_section(report, title, record);
 976:     }
 977: }

 979: fn filter_listener_lines(output: &str) -> String {
 980:     filter_lines(output, |line| {
 981:         let trimmed = line.trim();
 982:         if trimmed.is_empty() {
 983:             return false;
 984:         }
 985:         trimmed.starts_with("Netid")
 986:             || trimmed.contains("rustynet")
 987:             || trimmed.contains(":22")
 988:             || trimmed.contains(":51820")
 989:     })
 990: }

 992: fn filter_nft_lines(output: &str) -> String {
 993:     filter_lines(output, |line| {
 994:         let trimmed = line.trim();
 995:         if trimmed.is_empty() {
 996:             return false;
 997:         }
 998:         trimmed.contains("rustynet")
 999:             || trimmed.contains("51820")
1000:             || trimmed.contains("dport 22")
1001:             || trimmed.contains("sport 22")
1002:     })
1003: }
