1005: fn filter_lines<F>(output: &str, keep: F) -> String
1006: where
1007:     F: Fn(&str) -> bool,
1008: {
1009:     output
1010:         .lines()
1011:         .filter(|line| keep(line))
1012:         .collect::<Vec<_>>()
1013:         .join("\n")
1014: }
1015: 
1016: fn filter_env_lines(output: &str, allowed_keys: &[&str], allowed_prefixes: &[&str]) -> String {
1017:     let mut retained = Vec::new();
1018:     for line in output.lines() {
1019:         let trimmed = line.trim();
1020:         if trimmed.is_empty() || trimmed.starts_with('#') {
1021:             continue;
1022:         }
1023:         if let Some(key) = parse_env_key(trimmed)
1024:             && (allowed_keys.contains(&key)
1025:                 || allowed_prefixes
1026:                     .iter()
1027:                     .any(|prefix| key.starts_with(prefix)))
1028:         {
1029:             retained.push(trimmed.to_string());
1030:         }
1031:     }
1032:     retained.join("\n")
1033: }
1034: 
1035: fn parse_env_key(line: &str) -> Option<&str> {
1036:     let trimmed = line.trim_start();
1037:     let candidate = trimmed.strip_prefix("export ").unwrap_or(trimmed);
1038:     let equals = candidate.find('=')?;
1039:     let key = candidate[..equals].trim();
1040:     if key.is_empty() { None } else { Some(key) }
1041: }
1042: 
1043: fn command_exists(program: &str) -> bool {
1044:     env::var_os("PATH")
1045:         .into_iter()
1046:         .flat_map(|value| env::split_paths(&value).collect::<Vec<_>>())
1047:         .map(|dir| dir.join(program))
1048:         .any(|path| path.is_file())
1049: }
1050: 
1051: fn collect_utc_timestamp() -> Result<String, String> {
1052:     let output = Command::new("date")
1053:         .args(["-u", "+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"])
1054:         .output()
1055:         .map_err(|err| format!("failed to execute date: {err}"))?;
1056:     if !output.status.success() {
1057:         return Err(format!(
1058:             "date returned exit code {}",
1059:             status_code(output.status)
1060:         ));
1061:     }
1062:     Ok(String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).trim().to_string())
1063: }
1064: 
1065: fn collect_unix_timestamp() -> Result<u64, String> {
1066:     let output = Command::new("date")
1067:         .args(["-u", "+%s"])
1068:         .output()
1069:         .map_err(|err| format!("failed to execute date: {err}"))?;
1070:     if !output.status.success() {
1071:         return Err(format!(
1072:             "date returned exit code {}",
1073:             status_code(output.status)
1074:         ));
1075:     }
1076:     String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout)
1077:         .trim()
1078:         .parse::<u64>()
1079:         .map_err(|err| format!("invalid unix timestamp from date: {err}"))
1080: }

1082: fn default_output_path(collected_at_utc: &str) -> PathBuf {
1083:     let safe_timestamp = collected_at_utc
1084:         .chars()
1085:         .filter(|ch| ch.is_ascii_alphanumeric())
1086:         .collect::<String>();
1087:     let filename = format!("{DEFAULT_OUTPUT_PREFIX}-{safe_timestamp}.md");
1088:     match env::var_os("HOME") {
1089:         Some(home) => PathBuf::from(home).join(filename),
1090:         None => PathBuf::from(filename),
1091:     }
1092: }

1094: fn repo_root() -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
1095:     let manifest_dir = PathBuf::from(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"));
1096:     manifest_dir
1097:         .parent()
1098:         .and_then(Path::parent)
1099:         .map(Path::to_path_buf)
1100:         .ok_or_else(|| {
1101:             format!(
1102:                 "failed to resolve repository root from manifest dir {}",
1103:                 manifest_dir.display()
1104:             )
1105:         })

1108: #[cfg(unix)]
1109: fn write_private_file(path: &Path, contents: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {
1110:     if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
1111:         fs::create_dir_all(parent)?;
1112:     }
1113: 
1114:     let temporary = temporary_path(path);
1115:     let mut file = OpenOptions::new()
1116:         .create_new(true)
1117:         .write(true)
1118:         .mode(0o600)
1119:         .open(&temporary)?;
1120:     file.write_all(contents)?;
1121:     file.sync_all()?;
1122:     drop(file);
1123:     fs::rename(&temporary, path)?;
1124:     fs::set_permissions(path, fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o600))?;
1125:     Ok(())
1126: }
1127: 
1128: #[cfg(not(unix))]
1129: fn write_private_file(_path: &Path, _contents: &[u8]) -> io::Result<()> {
1130:     Err(io::Error::new(
1131:         io::ErrorKind::Unsupported,
1132:         "collect_linux_reconnect_bundle is only supported on Unix targets",
1133:     ))
1134: }
1135: 
1136: fn temporary_path(path: &Path) -> PathBuf {
1137:     let file_name = path
1138:         .file_name()
1139:         .map(|name| name.to_string_lossy().into_owned())
1140:         .unwrap_or_else(|| DEFAULT_OUTPUT_PREFIX.to_string());
1141:     path.with_file_name(format!("{file_name}.tmp-{}", std::process::id()))
1142: }

1144: fn usage() -> &'static str {
1145:     "collect_linux_reconnect_bundle
1146: 
1147: Usage:
1148:   ./scripts/operations/collect_linux_reconnect_bundle.sh [OPTIONS]
1149: 
1150: Options:
1151:   --output <path>            Write the markdown bundle to this path.
1152:   --probe-target <host|ip>   Add a route+ping probe target. Repeat as needed.
1153:   --wg-interface <name>      WireGuard interface to inspect (default: rustynet0).
1154:   --daemon-socket <path>     rustynetd socket path (default: /run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock).
1155:   --journal-lines <n>        Number of rustynetd journal lines to capture (default: 120).
1156:   --sudo <auto|always|never> Control privileged probing behavior (default: auto).
1157:   --quiet                    Suppress progress logs.
1158:   --help                     Show this help.
1159: 
1160: Notes:
1161:   - Output is markdown and is written with 0600 permissions.
1162:   - The collector excludes private keys, passphrases, and signing secrets.
1163:   - rustynet status/netcheck are run from the pulled repository via cargo for commit-bound evidence.
1164:   - With no --probe-target flags, the collector auto-discovers private/mesh probe targets from current routes and WireGuard state.
1165: "
1166: }

  48: fn run() -> Result<(), i32> {
  49:     let config = parse_args().map_err(|err| {
  50:         eprintln!("[collect-discovery] ERROR: {err}");
  51:         1
  52:     })?;
  53: 
  54:     let require = |name: &str| {
  55:         require_cmd(name).map_err(|err| {
  56:             eprintln!("[collect-discovery] ERROR: {err}");
  57:             1
  58:         })
  59:     };
  60: 
  61:     require("ip")?;
  62:     require("hostname")?;
  63:     require("uname")?;

  65:     let wg_available = command_exists("wg");
  66:     let jq_available = command_exists("jq");
  67:     let curl_available = command_exists("curl");
  68:     let wget_available = command_exists("wget");
  69: 
  70:     if !wg_available {
  71:         log(
  72:             config.quiet,
  73:             "WARNING: 'wg' (wireguard-tools) not found - WireGuard fields will be empty.",
  74:         );
  75:     }
  76: 
  77:     let host_name = hostname_value().map_err(|err| {
  78:         eprintln!("[collect-discovery] ERROR: {err}");
  79:         1
  80:     })?;
  81:     let os_name = run_capture("uname", &["-s"]).map_err(|err| {
  82:         eprintln!("[collect-discovery] ERROR: {err}");
  83:         1
  84:     })?;
  85:     let os_release = os_release_value();
  86:     let kernel = run_capture("uname", &["-r"]).map_err(|err| {
  87:         eprintln!("[collect-discovery] ERROR: {err}");
  88:         1
  89:     })?;
  90:     let arch = run_capture("uname", &["-m"]).map_err(|err| {
  91:         eprintln!("[collect-discovery] ERROR: {err}");
  92:         1
  93:     })?;
  94:     let collected_at_unix = run_capture("date", &["-u", "+%s"]).map_err(|err| {
  95:         eprintln!("[collect-discovery] ERROR: {err}");
  96:         1
  97:     })?;
  98:     let collected_at_iso = run_capture("date", &["-u", "+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"]).map_err(|err| {
  99:         eprintln!("[collect-discovery] ERROR: {err}");
 100:         1
 101:     })?;
 102: 
 103:     log(config.quiet, "Resolving Rustynet node identity...");
 104:     let node_id = resolve_node_id(&config, &host_name);
 105: 
 106:     log(config.quiet, "Detecting WireGuard interface...");
 107:     let wg_iface = config
 108:         .wg_iface
 109:         .clone()
 110:         .or_else(|| detect_wg_interface(wg_available))
 111:         .unwrap_or_default();
 112:     if wg_iface.is_empty() {
 113:         log(
 114:             config.quiet,
 115:             "WARNING: No WireGuard interface found. WireGuard fields will be empty.",
 116:         );
 117:     }
 118: 
 119:     log(config.quiet, "Reading WireGuard configuration...");

 121:     if !wg_public_key.is_empty() {
 122:         log(
 123:             config.quiet,
 124:             &format!("Public key read from {WG_PUBLIC_KEY_PATH}"),
 125:         );
 126:     }
 127: 
 128:     let mut wg_listen_port = String::new();
 129:     let mut wg_iface_addresses = String::new();
 130:     if !wg_iface.is_empty() && wg_available {
 131:         if let Some(wg_show_output) = read_wg_show(&wg_iface) {
 132:             if wg_public_key.is_empty() {
 133:                 wg_public_key = parse_public_key_from_wg_show(&wg_show_output);
 134:             }
 135:             wg_listen_port = parse_listen_port_from_wg_show(&wg_show_output);

 138:     }

 141:         wg_listen_port = override_port.clone();
 142:     } else if wg_listen_port.is_empty() {
 143:         wg_listen_port = DEFAULT_WG_PORT.to_string();
 144:     }

 146:     log(
 147:         config.quiet,
 148:         "Collecting local interface addresses (host candidates)...",
 149:     );
 150:     let host_candidates_raw = collect_host_candidates(&wg_iface)?;
 151: 
 152:     log(config.quiet, "Detecting public/reflexive IP address...");
 153:     let public_ip = if curl_available || wget_available {
 154:         let detected = detect_public_ip(curl_available, wget_available);
 155:         if let Some(value) = &detected {
 156:             log(config.quiet, &format!("Detected public IP: {value}"));
 157:         } else {
 158:             log(
 159:                 config.quiet,
 160:                 "WARNING: Could not detect public IP. Server-reflexive candidate will be empty.",

 173:     let first_lan_ip = host_candidates_raw

 180:     let port_forwarded_hint = if behind_nat {

 182:     } else {
 183:         "likely_yes - public IP matches local IP (no NAT detected)"
 184:     };
 185: 
 186:     log(config.quiet, "Collecting existing WireGuard peer list...");
 187:     let wg_peers_json = collect_wg_peers(&wg_iface, wg_available)?;
 188: 
 189:     log(config.quiet, "Inventorying Rustynet signed artifacts...");
 190:     let assignment_pub_key_b64 = read_verifier_key_b64(ASSIGNMENT_PUB_KEY).unwrap_or_default();
 191:     let traversal_pub_key_b64 = read_verifier_key_b64(TRAVERSAL_PUB_KEY).unwrap_or_default();
 192:     let dns_zone_pub_key_b64 = read_verifier_key_b64(DNS_ZONE_PUB_KEY).unwrap_or_default();
 193:     let trust_pub_key_b64 = read_verifier_key_b64(TRUST_PUB_KEY).unwrap_or_default();
 194: 
 195:     log(config.quiet, "Checking rustynetd service status...");
 196:     let daemon_status = daemon_status(RUSTYNET_RUN_DIR)?;
 197: 
 198:     log(config.quiet, "Building discovery bundle...");
 199:     let endpoint_candidates =
 200:         build_endpoint_candidates(&host_candidates_raw, &wg_listen_port, &public_ip);
 201:     let peer_stanza_template = build_peer_stanza_template(
 202:         &node_id,
 203:         &host_name,
 204:         &wg_public_key,
 205:         &public_ip,
 206:         &first_lan_ip,
 207:         &wg_listen_port,
 208:     );
 209: 
 210:     let discovery = json!({
 211:         "schema_version": 1,
 212:         "collected_at_unix": parse_u64(&collected_at_unix, "collected_at_unix")?,
 213:         "collected_at_iso": collected_at_iso,
 214:         "purpose": "cross_network_discovery_bundle",
 215:         "note": "Share this bundle with the remote network administrator. They need the node_identity, wireguard, endpoint_candidates, and verifier_keys sections to configure a signed traversal/assignment bundle pointing at this node.",
 216:         "node_identity": {
 217:             "node_id": node_id,
 218:             "hostname": host_name,
 219:             "os": format!("{os_name} {os_release}"),
 220:             "kernel": kernel,
 221:             "arch": arch,
 222:         },
 223:         "wireguard": {
 224:             "interface": wg_iface,
 225:             "public_key": wg_public_key,
 226:             "listen_port": parse_u64(&wg_listen_port, "wireguard.listen_port")?,
 227:             "interface_addresses": wg_iface_addresses,
 228:             "peer_stanza_template": peer_stanza_template,
 229:         },
 230:         "endpoint_candidates": endpoint_candidates,
 231:         "nat_profile": {
 232:             "behind_nat": behind_nat,
 233:             "first_lan_ip": first_lan_ip,
 234:             "detected_public_ip": public_ip,
 235:             "port_forwarded_hint": port_forwarded_hint,
 236:             "recommended_traversal_strategy": if behind_nat {
 237:                 "hole_punch_or_relay - node is behind NAT; provision relay candidate in traversal bundle"
 238:             } else {
 239:                 "direct - use server_reflexive or host candidate"
 240:             },
 241:         },
 242:         "verifier_keys": {
 243:             "note": "Remote network must trust these public keys to verify signed bundles originating from this network.",
 244:             "assignment_verifier_key_b64": assignment_pub_key_b64,
 245:             "traversal_verifier_key_b64": traversal_pub_key_b64,
 246:             "dns_zone_verifier_key_b64": dns_zone_pub_key_b64,
 247:             "trust_evidence_verifier_key_b64": trust_pub_key_b64,
 248:         },
 249:         "rustynet_artifacts": {
 250:             "assignment_bundle": artifact_entry(ASSIGNMENT_BUNDLE),
 251:             "traversal_bundle": artifact_entry(TRAVERSAL_BUNDLE),
 252:             "membership_snapshot": artifact_entry(MEMBERSHIP_SNAPSHOT),
 253:             "membership_log": artifact_entry(MEMBERSHIP_LOG),
 254:             "dns_zone_bundle": artifact_entry(DNS_ZONE_BUNDLE),
 255:             "trust_evidence": artifact_entry(TRUST_EVIDENCE),
 256:         },
 257:         "daemon_status": daemon_status,
 258:         "known_peers": wg_peers_json,
 259:         "remote_network_checklist": [
 260:             "1. Add an entry for this node in your network's membership snapshot with node_id and wireguard.public_key.",
 261:             "2. Sign a new assignment bundle that includes this node as a peer with AllowedIPs covering this node's Rustynet VPN address.",
 262:             "3. Create a traversal bundle for your nodes targeting this node using one of the endpoint_candidates (prefer server_reflexive if available, then host, then relay).",
 263:             "4. Distribute the signed assignment and traversal bundles to all nodes on your network that need to reach this node.",
 264:             "5. Verify DNS zone bundle includes a record for this node's hostname if Magic DNS is in use.",
 265:             "6. If this node is behind NAT (nat_profile.behind_nat=true), ensure a relay candidate is provisioned or port-forwarding is configured.",
 266:             "7. Confirm latest-handshake with: sudo wg show <iface> latest-handshakes (expect a recent timestamp after peering).",
 267:             "8. All bundles must be signed with keys trusted by both networks. Exchange verifier_keys.assignment_verifier_key_b64 with the remote CA.",
 268:         ],
 269:     });
 270: 
 271:     let json_output = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&discovery).map_err(|err| {
 272:         eprintln!("[collect-discovery] ERROR: failed to serialize discovery bundle: {err}");
 273:         1
 274:     })?;
 275: 
 276:     if let Some(output_path) = &config.output_path {
 277:         if let Some(parent) = output_path.parent() {
 278:             fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|err| {
 279:                 eprintln!(
 280:                     "[collect-discovery] ERROR: create output parent directory failed ({}): {err}",
 281:                     parent.display()
 282:                 );
 283:                 1
 284:             })?;
 285:         }
 286:         fs::write(output_path, &json_output).map_err(|err| {
 287:             eprintln!(
 288:                 "[collect-discovery] ERROR: write output failed ({}): {err}",
 289:                 output_path.display()
 290:             );
 291:             1
 292:         })?;
 293:         log(
 294:             config.quiet,
 295:             &format!("Discovery bundle written to: {}", output_path.display()),
 296:         );
 297:         eprintln!();
 298:         eprintln!("=== Cross-Network Discovery Summary ===");
 299:         eprintln!("  Node ID      : {node_id}");
 300:         eprintln!("  Hostname     : {host_name}");
 301:         eprintln!(
 302:             "  WG Public Key: {}",
 303:             if wg_public_key.is_empty() {
 304:                 "<not found>"
 305:             } else {
 306:                 &wg_public_key
 307:             }
 308:         );
 309:         eprintln!("  WG Port      : {wg_listen_port}");
 310:         eprintln!(
 311:             "  Public IP    : {}",
 312:             if public_ip.is_empty() {
 313:                 "<not detected>"
 314:             } else {
 315:                 &public_ip
 316:             }
 317:         );
 318:         eprintln!("  Behind NAT   : {behind_nat}");
 319:         eprintln!(
 320:             "  Daemon       : {}",
 321:             daemon_status["active"].as_str().unwrap_or("unknown")
 322:         );
 323:         eprintln!("  Output file  : {}", output_path.display());
 324:         eprintln!("=======================================");
 325:     } else if jq_available {
 326:         let status = Command::new("jq")
 327:             .arg(".")
 328:             .stdin(std::process::Stdio::piped())
 329:             .stdout(std::process::Stdio::inherit())
 330:             .spawn()
 331:             .and_then(|mut child| {
 332:                 if let Some(mut stdin) = child.stdin.take() {
 333:                     use std::io::Write;
 334:                     stdin.write_all(json_output.as_bytes())?;
 335:                 }
 336:                 child.wait()
 337:             })
 338:             .map_err(|err| {
 339:                 eprintln!("[collect-discovery] ERROR: failed to run jq: {err}");
 340:                 1
 341:             })?;
 342:         if !status.success() {
 343:             return Err(status.code().unwrap_or(1));
 344:         }
 345:     } else {
 346:         println!("{json_output}");
 347:     }
 348: 
 349:     log(config.quiet, "Done.");
 350:     Ok(())
 351: }
 352: 
 353: fn parse_args() -> Result<Config, String> {
 354:     let mut config = Config::default();
 355:     let mut args = env::args_os().skip(1).peekable();
 356: 
 357:     while let Some(arg) = args.next() {
 358:         match arg.to_string_lossy().as_ref() {
 359:             "-o" | "--output" => {
 360:                 let value = args
 361:                     .next()
 362:                     .ok_or_else(|| "missing value for --output".to_string())?;
 363:                 config.output_path = Some(PathBuf::from(value));
 364:             }
 365:             "-i" | "--interface" => {
 366:                 let value = args
 367:                     .next()
 368:                     .ok_or_else(|| "missing value for --interface".to_string())?;
 369:                 config.wg_iface = Some(os_to_string(value, "--interface")?);
 370:             }
 371:             "-p" | "--wg-port" => {
 372:                 let value = args
 373:                     .next()
 374:                     .ok_or_else(|| "missing value for --wg-port".to_string())?;
 375:                 config.wg_port_override = Some(os_to_string(value, "--wg-port")?);
 376:             }
 377:             "-n" | "--node-id" => {
 378:                 let value = args
 379:                     .next()
 380:                     .ok_or_else(|| "missing value for --node-id".to_string())?;
 381:                 config.node_id_override = Some(os_to_string(value, "--node-id")?);
 382:             }
 383:             "-q" | "--quiet" => config.quiet = true,
 384:             "-h" | "--help" => {
 385:                 print_usage();
 386:                 std::process::exit(0);
 387:             }
 388:             _ => {
 389:                 return Err(format!(
 390:                     "Unknown option: {}  (use --help for usage)",
 391:                     arg.to_string_lossy()
 392:                 ));
 393:             }
 394:         }
 395:     }
 396: 
 397:     Ok(config)
 398: }
 399: 
 400: fn print_usage() {
 401:     println!(
 402:         "collect_network_discovery_info\n\n\
 403: Usage:\n  ./collect_network_discovery_info.sh [OPTIONS]\n\n\
 404: Options:\n  -o, --output <path>      Write JSON to <path> instead of stdout\n  -i, --interface <iface>  WireGuard interface to inspect (default: auto-detect)\n  -p, --wg-port <port>     WireGuard listen port override (default: 51820)\n  -n, --node-id <id>       Rustynet node-id (default: read from config or hostname)\n  -q, --quiet              Suppress progress messages on stderr\n  -h, --help               Show this help"
 405:     );
 406: }

 408: fn log(quiet: bool, message: &str) {
 409:     if !quiet {
 410:         eprintln!("[collect-discovery] {message}");
 411:     }
 412: }

 414: fn require_cmd(name: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
 415:     if command_exists(name) {
 416:         Ok(())
 417:     } else {
 418:         Err(format!(
 419:             "Required command '{name}' not found. Install it and retry."
 420:         ))
 421:     }
 422: }
 423: 
 424: fn command_exists(command: &str) -> bool {
 425:     if Path::new(command).components().count() > 1 {
 426:         return Path::new(command).is_file();
 427:     }
 428:     let Some(path_value) = env::var_os("PATH") else {
 429:         return false;
 430:     };
 431:     env::split_paths(&path_value).any(|dir| dir.join(command).is_file())
 432: }
 433: 
 434: fn hostname_value() -> Result<String, String> {
 435:     run_capture("hostname", &["-f"])
 436:         .or_else(|_| run_capture("hostname", &[]))
 437:         .map(|value| value.trim().to_string())
 438: }
 439: 
 440: fn os_release_value() -> String {
 441:     if let Ok(text) = fs::read_to_string("/etc/os-release") {
 442:         let mut pretty = String::new();
 443:         let mut name = String::new();
 444:         for line in text.lines() {
 445:             if let Some(value) = line.strip_prefix("PRETTY_NAME=") {
 446:                 pretty = value.trim_matches('"').to_string();
 447:             } else if let Some(value) = line.strip_prefix("NAME=") {
 448:                 name = value.trim_matches('"').to_string();
 449:             }
 450:         }
 451:         if !pretty.is_empty() {
 452:             return pretty;
 453:         }
 454:         if !name.is_empty() {
 455:             return name;
 456:         }
 457:     }
 458:     if let Ok(text) = fs::read_to_string("/etc/issue") {
 459:         return text.lines().next().unwrap_or("unknown").trim().to_string();
 460:     }
 461:     "unknown".to_string()
 462: }
 463: 
 464: fn resolve_node_id(config: &Config, host_name: &str) -> String {
 465:     if let Some(node_id) = &config.node_id_override {
 466:         return node_id.clone();
 467:     }
 468:     let state_node = Path::new(RUSTYNET_STATE_DIR).join("node-id");
 469:     if let Some(value) = read_trimmed_file(&state_node)
 470:         && !value.is_empty()
 471:     {
 472:         return value;
 473:     }
 474:     let config_node = Path::new(RUSTYNET_CONFIG_DIR).join("node-id");
 475:     if let Some(value) = read_trimmed_file(&config_node)
 476:         && !value.is_empty()
 477:     {
 478:         return value;
 479:     }
 480:     if let Some(value) = resolve_node_id_from_runtime_status()
 481:         && !value.is_empty()
 482:     {
 483:         return value;
 484:     }
 485:     host_name.to_string()
 486: }
 487: 
 488: fn resolve_node_id_from_runtime_status() -> Option<String> {
 489:     let socket = format!("{RUSTYNET_RUN_DIR}/rustynetd.sock");
 490:     let direct = Command::new("rustynet")
 491:         .env("RUSTYNET_DAEMON_SOCKET", socket.as_str())
 492:         .arg("status")
 493:         .output()
 494:         .ok()
 495:         .and_then(command_output_stdout_if_success);
 496:     if let Some(status) = direct
 497:         && let Some(node_id) = parse_status_field(status.as_str(), "node_id")
 498:     {
 499:         return Some(node_id);
 500:     }
 501: 
 502:     Command::new("sudo")
 503:         .args(["-n", "env"])
 504:         .arg(format!("RUSTYNET_DAEMON_SOCKET={socket}"))
 505:         .args(["rustynet", "status"])
 506:         .output()
 507:         .ok()
 508:         .and_then(command_output_stdout_if_success)
 509:         .and_then(|status| parse_status_field(status.as_str(), "node_id"))
 510: }
 511: 
 512: fn command_output_stdout_if_success(output: Output) -> Option<String> {
 513:     if !output.status.success() {
 514:         return None;
 515:     }
 516:     let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).trim().to_string();
 517:     if text.is_empty() { None } else { Some(text) }
 518: }
 519: 
 520: fn parse_status_field(status_output: &str, field_name: &str) -> Option<String> {
 521:     let prefix = format!("{field_name}=");
 522:     status_output
 523:         .split_whitespace()
 524:         .find_map(|token| token.strip_prefix(prefix.as_str()))
 525:         .map(str::trim)
 526:         .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
 527:         .map(ToString::to_string)
 528: }
 529: 
 530: fn detect_wg_interface(wg_available: bool) -> Option<String> {
 531:     for iface in ["rustynet0", "wg0", "wg1", "rustynet1"] {
 532:         if run_status("ip", &["link", "show", iface]).is_ok() {
 533:             return Some(iface.to_string());
 534:         }
 535:     }
 536:     if wg_available
 537:         && let Ok(output) = run_capture("wg", &["show", "interfaces"])
 538:         && let Some(first) = output.split_whitespace().next()
 539:         && !first.is_empty()
 540:     {
 541:         return Some(first.to_string());
 542:     }
 543:     None
 544: }
 545: 
 546: fn read_wg_show(iface: &str) -> Option<String> {
 547:     run_capture("wg", &["show", iface]).ok().or_else(|| {
 548:         Command::new("sudo")
 549:             .args(["-n", "wg", "show", iface])
 550:             .output()
 551:             .ok()
 552:             .and_then(|output| {
 553:                 if output.status.success() {
 554:                     Some(String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).to_string())
 555:                 } else {
 556:                     None
 557:                 }
 558:             })
 559:     })
 560: }
 561: 
 562: fn parse_public_key_from_wg_show(text: &str) -> String {
 563:     text.lines()
 564:         .find_map(|line| {
 565:             line.strip_prefix("  public key:")
 566:                 .or_else(|| line.strip_prefix("public key:"))
 567:         })
 568:         .and_then(|line| line.split_whitespace().last())
 569:         .unwrap_or_default()
 570:         .to_string()
 571: }
 572: 
 573: fn parse_listen_port_from_wg_show(text: &str) -> String {
 574:     text.lines()
 575:         .find_map(|line| line.strip_prefix("listening port:"))
 576:         .and_then(|line| line.split_whitespace().last())
 577:         .unwrap_or_default()
 578:         .to_string()
 579: }
 580: 
 581: fn ip_interface_addresses(iface: &str) -> Result<String, i32> {
 582:     let output = run_capture("ip", &["-4", "addr", "show", iface]).map_err(|err| {
 583:         eprintln!("[collect-discovery] ERROR: {err}");
 584:         1
 585:     })?;
 586:     let addresses = output
 587:         .lines()
 588:         .filter(|line| line.trim_start().starts_with("inet "))
 589:         .filter_map(|line| line.split_whitespace().nth(1))
 590:         .collect::<Vec<_>>()
 591:         .join(" ");
 592:     Ok(addresses)
 593: }
 594: 
 595: fn collect_host_candidates(wg_iface: &str) -> Result<String, i32> {
 596:     let output = run_capture("ip", &["-4", "addr", "show"]).map_err(|err| {
 597:         eprintln!("[collect-discovery] ERROR: {err}");
 598:         1
 599:     })?;
 600:     let mut result = String::new();
 601:     let mut skip = false;
 602:     for line in output.lines() {
 603:         if let Some(iface) = parse_iface_header(line) {
 604:             skip = iface == "lo" || iface == wg_iface;
 605:             continue;
 606:         }
 607:         if skip {
 608:             continue;
 609:         }
 610:         if let Some(ip_cidr) = line.trim().strip_prefix("inet ") {
 611:             let mut parts = ip_cidr.split_whitespace();
 612:             if let Some(addr) = parts.next() {
 613:                 let mut addr_parts = addr.split('/');
 614:                 let ip = addr_parts.next().unwrap_or_default();
 615:                 let prefix = addr_parts.next().unwrap_or_default();
 616:                 if !ip.starts_with("169.254.") && !ip.is_empty() {
 617:                     if !result.is_empty() {
 618:                         result.push('\n');
 619:                     }
 620:                     result.push_str(ip);
 621:                     result.push(':');
 622:                     result.push_str(prefix);
 623:                 }
 624:             }
 625:         }
 626:     }
 627:     Ok(result)
 628: }
 629: 
 630: fn parse_iface_header(line: &str) -> Option<String> {
 631:     let trimmed = line.trim_start();
 632:     let (prefix, rest) = trimmed.split_once(": ")?;
 633:     if !prefix.chars().all(|ch| ch.is_ascii_digit()) {
 634:         return None;
 635:     }
 636:     Some(rest.split(':').next()?.to_string())
 637: }
 638: 
 639: fn detect_public_ip(curl_available: bool, wget_available: bool) -> Option<String> {
 640:     for service in [
 641:         "https://api4.ipify.org",
 642:         "https://icanhazip.com",
 643:         "https://ipv4.icanhazip.com",
 644:         "https://checkip.amazonaws.com",
 645:         "https://ifconfig.me/ip",
 646:     ] {
 647:         let candidate = if curl_available {
 648:             run_capture("curl", &["-s", "--max-time", "5", "--retry", "1", service]).ok()
 649:         } else if wget_available {
 650:             run_capture("wget", &["-qO-", "--timeout=5", service]).ok()
 651:         } else {
 652:             None
 653:         };
 654:         let Some(value) = candidate else {
 655:             continue;
 656:         };
 657:         let ip = value.trim();
 658:         if is_ipv4(ip) {
 659:             return Some(ip.to_string());
 660:         }
 661:     }
 662:     None
 663: }
 664: 
 665: fn collect_wg_peers(iface: &str, wg_available: bool) -> Result<Value, i32> {
 666:     if iface.is_empty() || !wg_available {
 667:         return Ok(Value::Array(Vec::new()));
 668:     }
 669:     let output = match run_capture("wg", &["show", iface, "dump"]) {
 670:         Ok(text) => text,
 671:         Err(_) => match Command::new("sudo")
 672:             .args(["-n", "wg", "show", iface, "dump"])
 673:             .output()
 674:         {
 675:             Ok(output) if output.status.success() => {
 676:                 String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).to_string()
 677:             }
 678:             _ => return Ok(Value::Array(Vec::new())),
 679:         },
 680:     };
 681:     let mut peers = Vec::new();
 682:     for (index, line) in output.lines().enumerate() {
 683:         if index == 0 {
 684:             continue;
 685:         }
 686:         let fields: Vec<&str> = line.split('\t').collect();
 687:         if fields.len() < 8 {
 688:             continue;
 689:         }
 690:         let endpoint = if fields[2] == "(none)" { "" } else { fields[2] };
 691:         peers.push(json!({
 692:             "public_key": fields[0],
 693:             "endpoint": endpoint,
 694:             "allowed_ips": fields[3],
 695:             "latest_handshake_unix": parse_u64(fields[4], "known_peers.latest_handshake_unix")?,
 696:             "rx_bytes": parse_u64(fields[5], "known_peers.rx_bytes")?,
 697:             "tx_bytes": parse_u64(fields[6], "known_peers.tx_bytes")?,
 698:         }));
 699:     }
 700:     Ok(Value::Array(peers))
 701: }
 702: 
 703: fn artifact_entry(path: &str) -> Value {
 704:     let exists = Path::new(path).is_file();
 705:     let (size_bytes, mtime_unix) = if exists {
 706:         match fs::metadata(path) {
 707:             Ok(metadata) => {
 708:                 let size = metadata.len();
 709:                 let mtime = metadata
 710:                     .modified()
 711:                     .ok()
 712:                     .and_then(|time| time.duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH).ok())
 713:                     .map(|duration| duration.as_secs())
 714:                     .unwrap_or(0);
 715:                 (size, mtime)
 716:             }
 717:             Err(_) => (0, 0),
 718:         }
 719:     } else {
 720:         (0, 0)
 721:     };
 722:     json!({
 723:         "path": path,
 724:         "exists": exists,
 725:         "size_bytes": size_bytes,
 726:         "mtime_unix": mtime_unix,
 727:     })
 728: }
 729: 
 730: fn build_endpoint_candidates(
 731:     host_candidates_raw: &str,
 732:     wg_listen_port: &str,
 733:     public_ip: &str,
 734: ) -> Value {
 735:     let mut candidates = Vec::new();
 736:     for line in host_candidates_raw.lines() {
 737:         let Some((ip, prefix)) = line.split_once(':') else {
 738:             continue;
 739:         };
 740:         let priority = if ip.starts_with("10.") {
 741:             110
 742:         } else if ip.starts_with("192.168.") {
 743:             120
 744:         } else if is_172_private(ip) {
 745:             115
 746:         } else {
 747:             100
 748:         };
 749:         candidates.push(json!({
 750:             "type": "host",
 751:             "endpoint": format!("{ip}:{wg_listen_port}"),
 752:             "address": ip,
 753:             "prefix_len": prefix,
 754:             "priority": priority,
 755:         }));
 756:     }
 757:     if !public_ip.is_empty() {
 758:         candidates.push(json!({
 759:             "type": "server_reflexive",
 760:             "endpoint": format!("{public_ip}:{wg_listen_port}"),
 761:             "address": public_ip,
 762:             "priority": 200,
 763:             "note": format!("public IP detected via HTTP echo; assumes port {wg_listen_port} is forwarded through NAT"),
 764:         }));
 765:     }
 766:     candidates.push(json!({
 767:         "type": "relay",
 768:         "endpoint": "",
 769:         "priority": 50,
 770:         "note": "relay address is assigned by the Rustynet relay fleet; provision via signed traversal bundle",
 771:     }));
 772:     Value::Array(candidates)
 773: }
 774: 
 775: fn build_peer_stanza_template(
 776:     node_id: &str,
 777:     host_name: &str,
 778:     wg_public_key: &str,
 779:     public_ip: &str,
 780:     first_lan_ip: &str,
 781:     wg_listen_port: &str,
 782: ) -> String {
 783:     if wg_public_key.is_empty() {
 784:         return String::new();
 785:     }
 786:     let mut stanza = String::new();
 787:     stanza.push_str("[Peer]\n");
 788:     stanza.push_str(&format!("# Node: {node_id}  ({host_name})\n"));
 789:     stanza.push_str(&format!("PublicKey = {wg_public_key}\n"));
 790:     if !public_ip.is_empty() {
 791:         stanza.push_str(&format!("Endpoint = {public_ip}:{wg_listen_port}\n"));
 792:     } else if !first_lan_ip.is_empty() {
 793:         stanza.push_str(&format!(
 794:             "Endpoint = {first_lan_ip}:{wg_listen_port}  # LAN only - no public IP detected\n"
 795:         ));
 796:     }
 797:     stanza.push_str("AllowedIPs = <REPLACE_WITH_RUSTYNET_VPN_CIDR>  # e.g. 100.64.0.0/10\n");
 798:     stanza.push_str("PersistentKeepalive = 25");
 799:     stanza
 800: }

 802: fn daemon_status(run_dir: &str) -> Result<Value, i32> {
 803:     let socket_path = Path::new(run_dir).join("rustynetd.sock");
 804:     let socket_present = path_is_socket(&socket_path);
 805:     if let Ok(active) = run_capture("systemctl", &["is-active", "--quiet", "rustynetd"]) {
 806:         let _ = active;
 807:         let pid = run_capture(
 808:             "systemctl",
 809:             &["show", "rustynetd", "--property=MainPID", "--value"],
 810:         )
 811:         .map_err(|err| {
 812:             eprintln!("[collect-discovery] ERROR: {err}");
 813:             1
 814:         })?;
 815:         return Ok(json!({
 816:             "active": "active",
 817:             "pid": pid.trim(),
 818:             "socket_path": socket_path.display().to_string(),
 819:             "socket_present": socket_present,
 820:         }));
 821:     }
 822:     if socket_present {
 823:         return Ok(json!({
 824:             "active": "socket_present",
 825:             "pid": "",
 826:             "socket_path": socket_path,
 827:             "socket_present": true,
 828:         }));
 829:     }
 830:     Ok(json!({
 831:         "active": "inactive",
 832:         "pid": "",
 833:         "socket_path": socket_path,
 834:         "socket_present": false,
 835:     }))
 836: }
 837: 
 838: fn run_capture(command: &str, args: &[&str]) -> Result<String, String> {
 839:     let output = Command::new(command)
 840:         .args(args)
 841:         .output()
 842:         .map_err(|err| format!("failed to run {command}: {err}"))?;
 843:     if !output.status.success() {
 844:         return Err(format!(
 845:             "{command} exited with status {}",
 846:             status_text(output.status)
 847:         ));
 848:     }
 849:     Ok(String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).trim().to_string())
 850: }
 851: 
 852: fn run_status(command: &str, args: &[&str]) -> Result<(), String> {
 853:     let status = Command::new(command)
 854:         .args(args)
 855:         .status()
 856:         .map_err(|err| format!("failed to run {command}: {err}"))?;
 857:     if status.success() {
 858:         Ok(())
 859:     } else {
 860:         Err(format!(
 861:             "{command} exited with status {}",
 862:             status_text(status)
 863:         ))
 864:     }
 865: }

 867: fn read_trimmed_file(path: impl AsRef<Path>) -> Option<String> {
 868:     fs::read_to_string(path)
 869:         .ok()
 870:         .map(|text| text.trim().to_string())
 871:         .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
 872: }
 873: 
 874: fn read_verifier_key_b64(path: impl AsRef<Path>) -> Option<String> {
 875:     let value = read_trimmed_file(path)?;
 876:     normalize_verifier_key_to_b64(value.as_str())
 877: }
 878: 
 879: fn normalize_verifier_key_to_b64(value: &str) -> Option<String> {
 880:     let trimmed = value.trim();
 881:     if trimmed.is_empty() {
 882:         return None;
 883:     }
 884:     if let Some(bytes) = decode_hex_32(trimmed) {
 885:         return Some(encode_base64(bytes.as_slice()));
 886:     }
 887:     Some(trimmed.to_string())
 888: }
 889: 
 890: fn decode_hex_32(value: &str) -> Option<[u8; 32]> {
 891:     if value.len() != 64 {
 892:         return None;
 893:     }
 894:     let mut out = [0u8; 32];
 895:     let mut index = 0usize;
 896:     while index < 32 {
 897:         let hi = decode_hex_nibble(value.as_bytes()[index * 2])?;
 898:         let lo = decode_hex_nibble(value.as_bytes()[index * 2 + 1])?;
 899:         out[index] = (hi << 4) | lo;
 900:         index += 1;
 901:     }
 902:     Some(out)
 903: }
 904: 
 905: fn decode_hex_nibble(byte: u8) -> Option<u8> {
 906:     match byte {
 907:         b'0'..=b'9' => Some(byte - b'0'),
 908:         b'a'..=b'f' => Some(byte - b'a' + 10),
 909:         b'A'..=b'F' => Some(byte - b'A' + 10),
 910:         _ => None,
 911:     }
 912: }
 913: 
 914: fn encode_base64(bytes: &[u8]) -> String {
 915:     const TABLE: &[u8; 64] = b"ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/";
 916:     let mut out = String::with_capacity(bytes.len().div_ceil(3) * 4);
 917:     let mut index = 0usize;
 918:     while index < bytes.len() {
 919:         let b0 = bytes[index];
 920:         let b1 = if index + 1 < bytes.len() {
 921:             bytes[index + 1]
 922:         } else {
 923:             0
 924:         };
 925:         let b2 = if index + 2 < bytes.len() {
 926:             bytes[index + 2]
 927:         } else {
 928:             0
 929:         };
 930: 
 931:         let s0 = b0 >> 2;
 932:         let s1 = ((b0 & 0x03) << 4) | (b1 >> 4);
 933:         let s2 = ((b1 & 0x0f) << 2) | (b2 >> 6);
 934:         let s3 = b2 & 0x3f;
 935: 
 936:         out.push(TABLE[s0 as usize] as char);
 937:         out.push(TABLE[s1 as usize] as char);
 938:         if index + 1 < bytes.len() {
 939:             out.push(TABLE[s2 as usize] as char);
 940:         } else {
 941:             out.push('=');
 942:         }
 943:         if index + 2 < bytes.len() {
 944:             out.push(TABLE[s3 as usize] as char);
 945:         } else {
 946:             out.push('=');
 947:         }
 948:         index += 3;
 949:     }
 950:     out
 951: }
 952: 
 953: fn path_is_socket(path: &Path) -> bool {
 954:     match fs::symlink_metadata(path) {
 955:         Ok(metadata) => {
 956:             #[cfg(unix)]
 957:             {
 958:                 metadata.file_type().is_socket()
 959:             }
 960:             #[cfg(not(unix))]
 961:             {
 962:                 metadata.file_type().is_file()
 963:             }
 964:         }
 965:         Err(_) => false,
 966:     }
 967: }
 968: 
 969: fn os_to_string(value: OsString, flag: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
 970:     value
 971:         .into_string()
 972:         .map_err(|_| format!("{flag} must be valid UTF-8"))
 973: }
 974: 
 975: fn parse_u64(text: &str, field: &str) -> Result<u64, i32> {
 976:     text.trim().parse::<u64>().map_err(|_| {
 977:         eprintln!("[collect-discovery] ERROR: {field} must be an integer");
 978:         1
 979:     })
 980: }
 981: 
 982: fn is_172_private(ip: &str) -> bool {
 983:     let mut parts = ip.split('.');
 984:     matches!(
 985:         (
 986:             parts.next().and_then(|v| v.parse::<u8>().ok()),
 987:             parts.next().and_then(|v| v.parse::<u8>().ok()),
 988:         ),
 989:         (Some(172), Some(second)) if (16..=31).contains(&second)
 990:     )
 991: }
 992: 
 993: fn status_text(status: ExitStatus) -> String {
 994:     status
 995:         .code()
 996:         .map(|code| code.to_string())
 997:         .unwrap_or_else(|| "signal".to_string())
 998: }
 999: 
1000: fn is_ipv4(value: &str) -> bool {
1001:     let parts: Vec<&str> = value.split('.').collect();
1002:     if parts.len() != 4 {
1003:         return false;
1004:     }
1005:     parts.into_iter().all(|part| part.parse::<u8>().is_ok())
1006: }

===== /crates/rustynet-cli/src/bin/collect_phase1_measured_env.rs =====

   1: #![forbid(unsafe_code)]
   2: 
   3: use std::env;
   4: use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
   5: use std::process::{Command, ExitStatus};
   6: 
   7: const DEFAULT_PHASE1_SOURCE: &str = "artifacts/perf/phase1/source/performance_samples.ndjson";
   8: 
   9: fn main() {
  10:     let code = match run() {
  11:         Ok(()) => 0,
  12:         Err(code) => code,
  13:     };
  14:     std::process::exit(code);
  15: }
  16: 
  17: fn run() -> Result<(), i32> {
  18:     let _ignored_args: Vec<String> = env::args().skip(1).collect();
  19:     let root_dir = repo_root().map_err(|err| {
  20:         eprintln!("{err}");
  21:         1
  22:     })?;
  23:     let mut phase1_source = PathBuf::from(
  24:         env::var("RUSTYNET_PHASE1_PERF_SAMPLES_PATH")
  25:             .ok()
  26:             .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
  27:             .unwrap_or_else(|| DEFAULT_PHASE1_SOURCE.to_string()),
  28:     );
  29:     if !phase1_source.is_absolute() {
  30:         phase1_source = root_dir.join(phase1_source);
  31:     }
  32:     if !phase1_source.is_file() {
  33:         eprintln!(
  34:             "missing measured phase1 source: {}",
  35:             phase1_source.display()
  36:         );
  37:         return Err(1);
  38:     }
  39: 
  40:     let phase1_source_utf8 = phase1_source.to_str().ok_or_else(|| {
  41:         eprintln!(
  42:             "phase1 source path is not valid UTF-8: {}",
  43:             phase1_source.display()
  44:         );
  45:         1
  46:     })?;
  47: 
  48:     let status = Command::new("cargo")
  49:         .current_dir(root_dir)
  50:         .env("RUSTYNET_PHASE1_PERF_SAMPLES_PATH", phase1_source_utf8)
  51:         .args([
  52:             "run",
  53:             "--quiet",
  54:             "-p",
  55:             "rustynet-cli",
  56:             "--",
  57:             "ops",
  58:             "collect-phase1-measured-input",
  59:         ])
  60:         .status()
  61:         .map_err(|err| {
  62:             eprintln!("failed to run collect-phase1-measured-input: {err}");
  63:             1
  64:         })?;
  65:     if status.success() {
  66:         Ok(())
  67:     } else {
  68:         Err(status_code(status))
  69:     }
  70: }
  71: 
  72: fn repo_root() -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
  73:     let manifest_dir = PathBuf::from(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"));
  74:     manifest_dir
  75:         .parent()
  76:         .and_then(Path::parent)
  77:         .map(Path::to_path_buf)
  78:         .ok_or_else(|| {
  79:             format!(
  80:                 "failed to resolve repository root from manifest dir {}",
  81:                 manifest_dir.display()
  82:             )
  83:         })
  84: }
  85: 
  86: fn status_code(status: ExitStatus) -> i32 {
  87:     match status.code() {
  88:         Some(code) => code,
  89:         None => {
  90:             #[cfg(unix)]
  91:             {
  92:                 use std::os::unix::process::ExitStatusExt;
  93:                 match status.signal() {
  94:                     Some(signal) => 128 + signal,
  95:                     None => 1,
  96:                 }
  97:             }
  98:             #[cfg(not(unix))]
  99:             {
 100:                 1
 101:             }
 102:         }
 103:     }
 104: }

  43:     } else {

  45:         Err(1)
  46:     }
  47: }

===== /crates/rustynet-cli/src/bin/install_rustynetd_service.rs =====

   1: #![forbid(unsafe_code)]
   2: 
   3: use std::env;
   4: use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
   5: use std::process::{Command, ExitStatus};
   6: 
   7: const HARDED_PATH: &str = "/usr/local/bin/rustynet";
   8: 
   9: fn main() {
  10:     let code = match run() {
  11:         Ok(()) => 0,
  12:         Err(code) => code,
  13:     };
  14:     std::process::exit(code);
  15: }
  16: 
  17: fn run() -> Result<(), i32> {
  18:     let root_dir = repo_root().map_err(|err| {
  19:         eprintln!("{err}");
  20:         1
  21:     })?;
  22:     let rustynet_bin = env::var("RUSTYNET_BIN")
  23:         .ok()
  24:         .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
  25:         .unwrap_or_else(|| HARDED_PATH.to_string());
  26:     if rustynet_bin != HARDED_PATH {
  27:         eprintln!(
  28:             "[install-systemd] one hardened path is enforced; expected {HARDED_PATH}, got: {rustynet_bin}"
  29:         );
  30:         return Err(1);
  31:     }
  32: 
  33:     let status = run_rustynet_ops(&rustynet_bin, &root_dir, &["verify-runtime-binary-custody"])?;
  34:     if !status.success() {
  35:         return Err(status_code(status));
  36:     }
  37:     let status = run_rustynet_ops(&rustynet_bin, &root_dir, &["install-systemd"])?;
  38:     if !status.success() {
  39:         return Err(status_code(status));
  40:     }
  41:     Ok(())
  42: }
  43: 
  44: fn run_rustynet_ops(rustynet_bin: &str, root_dir: &Path, args: &[&str]) -> Result<ExitStatus, i32> {
  45:     Command::new(rustynet_bin)
  46:         .current_dir(root_dir)
  47:         .env("RUSTYNET_INSTALL_SOURCE_ROOT", root_dir)
  48:         .args(["ops"])
  49:         .args(args)
  50:         .status()
  51:         .map_err(|err| {
  52:             eprintln!("failed to execute {rustynet_bin} ops {args:?}: {err}");
  53:             1
  54:         })
  55: }
  56: 
  57: fn repo_root() -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
  58:     let manifest_dir = PathBuf::from(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"));
  59:     manifest_dir
  60:         .parent()
  61:         .and_then(Path::parent)
  62:         .map(Path::to_path_buf)
  63:         .ok_or_else(|| {
  64:             format!(
  65:                 "failed to resolve repository root from manifest dir {}",
  66:                 manifest_dir.display()
  67:             )
  68:         })
  69: }

  71: fn status_code(status: ExitStatus) -> i32 {
  72:     match status.code() {
  73:         Some(code) => code,
  74:         None => {
  75:             #[cfg(unix)]
  76:             {
  77:                 use std::os::unix::process::ExitStatusExt;
  78:                 match status.signal() {
  79:                     Some(signal) => 128 + signal,
  80:                     None => 1,
  81:                 }
  82:             }
  83:             #[cfg(not(unix))]
  84:             {
  85:                 1
  86:             }
  87:         }
  88:     }

 149: pub fn ensure_safe_token(label: &str, value: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
 150:     if value.is_empty() {
 151:         return Err(format!("{label} must not be empty"));
 152:     }
 153:     let allowed = |c: char| {
 154:         c.is_ascii_alphanumeric()
 155:             || matches!(c, '.' | '_' | ':' | '/' | ',' | '@' | '+' | '=' | '-')
 156:     };
 157:     if !value.chars().all(allowed) {
 158:         return Err(format!("{label} contains unsupported characters: {value}"));
 159:     }
 160:     Ok(())
 161: }

 219: fn utm_transport_for_target(target: &str) -> Option<UtmTransport> {
 220:     if !utm_transport_enabled() {
 221:         return None;
 222:     }
 223:     for (target_key, utm_key) in [
 224:         ("EXIT_TARGET", "EXIT_UTM_NAME"),
 225:         ("CLIENT_TARGET", "CLIENT_UTM_NAME"),
 226:         ("ENTRY_TARGET", "ENTRY_UTM_NAME"),
 227:         ("AUX_TARGET", "AUX_UTM_NAME"),
 228:         ("EXTRA_TARGET", "EXTRA_UTM_NAME"),
 229:         ("FIFTH_CLIENT_TARGET", "FIFTH_CLIENT_UTM_NAME"),
 230:     ] {
 231:         let Some(mapped_target) = env_var_nonempty(target_key) else {
 232:             continue;
 233:         };
 234:         if mapped_target != target {
 235:             continue;
 236:         }
 237:         let Some(utm_name) = env_var_nonempty(utm_key) else {
 238:             continue;
 239:         };
 240:         return Some(UtmTransport {
 241:             utm_name,
 242:             user: target_user(target).to_string(),
 243:             home: target_home(target),
 244:         });
 245:     }
 246:     None

 256: fn run_status_with_timeout(command: &mut Command, timeout: Duration) -> Result<ExitStatus, String> {
 257:     let mut child = command
 258:         .spawn()
 259:         .map_err(|err| format!("spawn failed: {err}"))?;
 260:     let started_at = Instant::now();
 261:     loop {
 262:         if let Some(status) = child
 263:             .try_wait()
 264:             .map_err(|err| format!("wait failed: {err}"))?
 265:         {
 266:             return Ok(status);
 267:         }
 268:         if started_at.elapsed() >= timeout {
 269:             let _ = child.kill();
 270:             let _ = child.wait();
 271:             return Err(format!("timed out after {} seconds", timeout.as_secs()));
 272:         }
 273:         thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(PROCESS_POLL_INTERVAL_MILLIS));
 274:     }
 275: }
 276: 
 277: fn run_output_with_timeout(command: &mut Command, timeout: Duration) -> Result<Output, String> {
 278:     command.stdout(Stdio::piped()).stderr(Stdio::piped());
 279:     let mut child = command
 280:         .spawn()
 281:         .map_err(|err| format!("spawn failed: {err}"))?;
 282:     let started_at = Instant::now();
 283:     loop {
 284:         if let Some(_status) = child
 285:             .try_wait()
 286:             .map_err(|err| format!("wait failed: {err}"))?
 287:         {
 288:             return child
 289:                 .wait_with_output()
 290:                 .map_err(|err| format!("wait_with_output failed: {err}"));
 291:         }
 292:         if started_at.elapsed() >= timeout {
 293:             let _ = child.kill();
 294:             let _ = child.wait();
 295:             return Err(format!("timed out after {} seconds", timeout.as_secs()));
 296:         }
 297:         thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(PROCESS_POLL_INTERVAL_MILLIS));
 298:     }
 299: }

 301: fn utm_guest_shell_command(transport: &UtmTransport, command: &str) -> String {
 302:     let quoted_command = shell_quote(command);
 303:     if transport.user == "root" {
 304:         format!("exec /bin/bash -lc {quoted_command}")
 305:     } else {
 306:         let quoted_user = shell_quote(&transport.user);
 307:         let quoted_home = shell_quote(&transport.home);
 308:         format!(
 309:             "exec runuser -u {quoted_user} -- env HOME={quoted_home} USER={quoted_user} LOGNAME={quoted_user} PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin /bin/bash -lc {quoted_command}"
 310:         )
 311:     }
 312: }

 314: fn utm_exec_status(transport: &UtmTransport, command: &str) -> Result<ExitStatus, String> {
 315:     let utmctl = utmctl_path();
 316:     if !utmctl.is_file() {
 317:         return Err(format!(
 318:             "missing executable UTM control tool: {}",
 319:             utmctl.display()
 320:         ));
 321:     }
 322:     let mut utm = Command::new(&utmctl);
 323:     utm.args([
 324:         "exec",
 325:         transport.utm_name.as_str(),
 326:         "--cmd",
 327:         "/bin/bash",
 328:         "-lc",
 329:     ]);
 330:     utm.arg(utm_guest_shell_command(transport, command));
 331:     run_status_with_timeout(&mut utm, Duration::from_secs(UTM_EXEC_TIMEOUT_SECS)).map_err(|err| {
 332:         format!(
 333:             "failed to run utm exec against {}: {err}",
 334:             transport.utm_name
 335:         )
 336:     })
 337: }

 373: fn utm_file_push(transport: &UtmTransport, src: &Path, dst: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
 374:     let utmctl = utmctl_path();
 375:     if !utmctl.is_file() {
 376:         return Err(format!(
 377:             "missing executable UTM control tool: {}",
 378:             utmctl.display()
 379:         ));
 380:     }
 381:     let stdin = File::open(src)
 382:         .map_err(|err| format!("failed to open {} for UTM push: {err}", src.display()))?;
 383:     let mut utm = Command::new(&utmctl);
 384:     utm.args(["file", "push", transport.utm_name.as_str(), dst]);
 385:     utm.stdin(Stdio::from(stdin));
 386:     let status = run_status_with_timeout(&mut utm, Duration::from_secs(UTM_FILE_TIMEOUT_SECS))
 387:         .map_err(|err| {
 388:             format!(
 389:                 "failed to push {} to {}:{}: {err}",
 390:                 src.display(),
 391:                 transport.utm_name,
 392:                 dst
 393:             )
 394:         })?;
 395:     if !status.success() {
 396:         return Err(format!(
 397:             "push {} to {}:{} failed with status {}",
 398:             src.display(),
 399:             transport.utm_name,
 400:             dst,
 401:             status_code(status)
 402:         ));
 403:     }
 404:     if transport.user != "root" {
 405:         let chown_cmd = format!(
 406:             "chown {}:{} {}",
 407:             shell_quote(&transport.user),
 408:             shell_quote(&transport.user),
 409:             shell_quote(dst)
 410:         );
 411:         let status = utm_exec_root_status(transport, &chown_cmd)?;
 412:         if !status.success() {
 413:             return Err(format!(
 414:                 "UTM chown failed for {}:{} with status {}",
 415:                 transport.utm_name,
 416:                 dst,
 417:                 status_code(status)
 418:             ));
 419:         }
 420:     }
 421:     Ok(())
 422: }

 424: fn utm_file_pull(transport: &UtmTransport, src: &str, dst: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
 425:     let utmctl = utmctl_path();
 426:     if !utmctl.is_file() {
 427:         return Err(format!(
 428:             "missing executable UTM control tool: {}",
 429:             utmctl.display()
 430:         ));
 431:     }
 432:     let mut utm = Command::new(&utmctl);
 433:     utm.args(["file", "pull", transport.utm_name.as_str(), src]);
 434:     let output = run_output_with_timeout(&mut utm, Duration::from_secs(UTM_FILE_TIMEOUT_SECS))
 435:         .map_err(|err| format!("failed to pull {}:{}: {err}", transport.utm_name, src))?;
 436:     if !output.status.success() {
 437:         return Err(format!(

 439:             transport.utm_name,
 440:             src,
 441:             status_code(output.status)
 442:         ));
 443:     }
 444:     fs::write(dst, output.stdout).map_err(|err| format!("failed to write {}: {err}", dst.display()))
 445: }

 482: pub fn shell_quote(value: &str) -> String {
 483:     let mut out = String::from("'");
 484:     for ch in value.chars() {
 485:         if ch == '\'' {
 486:             out.push_str("'\\''");
 487:         } else {
 488:             out.push(ch);
 489:         }
 490:     }
 491:     out.push('\'');
 492:     out
 493: }
 494: 
 495: pub fn quote_env_value(value: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
 496:     if value.contains('\0') || value.contains('\n') || value.contains('\r') {
 497:         return Err("env value contains newline or NUL characters".to_string());
 498:     }
 499:     let mut quoted = String::with_capacity(value.len() + 2);
 500:     quoted.push('"');
 501:     for ch in value.chars() {
 502:         match ch {
 503:             '\\' => quoted.push_str("\\\\"),
 504:             '"' => quoted.push_str("\\\""),
 505:             '$' => quoted.push_str("\\$"),
 506:             '`' => quoted.push_str("\\`"),
 507:             _ => quoted.push(ch),
 508:         }
 509:     }
 510:     quoted.push('"');
 511:     Ok(quoted)
 512: }

 514: pub fn append_env_assignment(path: &Path, key: &str, value: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
 515:     let mut file = OpenOptions::new()
 516:         .create(true)
 517:         .append(true)
 518:         .open(path)
 519:         .map_err(|err| format!("open env file failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
 520:     let value = quote_env_value(value)?;
 521:     writeln!(file, "{key}={value}")
 522:         .map_err(|err| format!("write env assignment failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))
 523: }

 525: pub fn write_assignment_refresh_env(
 526:     path: &Path,
 527:     target_node_id: &str,
 528:     nodes_spec: &str,
 529:     allow_spec: &str,
 530:     exit_node_id: Option<&str>,
 531: ) -> Result<(), String> {
 532:     if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
 533:         fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|err| {
 534:             format!(
 535:                 "create assignment refresh env parent failed ({}): {err}",
 536:                 parent.display()
 537:             )
 538:         })?;
 539:     }
 540:     fs::write(path, b"").map_err(|err| {
 541:         format!(
 542:             "truncate assignment refresh env failed ({}): {err}",
 543:             path.display()
 544:         )
 545:     })?;
 546:     append_env_assignment(path, "RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_AUTO_REFRESH", "true")?;
 547:     append_env_assignment(path, "RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_TARGET_NODE_ID", target_node_id)?;
 548:     append_env_assignment(path, "RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_NODES", nodes_spec)?;
 549:     append_env_assignment(path, "RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_ALLOW", allow_spec)?;
 550:     append_env_assignment(
 551:         path,
 552:         "RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_SIGNING_SECRET",
 553:         "/etc/rustynet/assignment.signing.secret",
 554:     )?;
 555:     append_env_assignment(
 556:         path,
 557:         "RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_SIGNING_SECRET_PASSPHRASE_FILE",
 558:         "/run/credentials/rustynetd-assignment-refresh.service/signing_key_passphrase",
 559:     )?;
 560:     append_env_assignment(path, "RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_TTL_SECS", "300")?;
 561:     append_env_assignment(path, "RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_MIN_REMAINING_SECS", "180")?;
 562:     if let Some(exit_node_id) = exit_node_id {
 563:         append_env_assignment(path, "RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_EXIT_NODE_ID", exit_node_id)?;
 564:     }
 565:     Ok(())
 566: }
 567: 
 568: pub fn run_cargo_ops(root_dir: &Path, subcommand: &str, args: &[OsString]) -> Result<(), String> {
 569:     let status = Command::new("cargo")
 570:         .current_dir(root_dir)
 571:         .args([
 572:             "run",
 573:             "--quiet",
 574:             "-p",
 575:             "rustynet-cli",
 576:             "--",
 577:             "ops",
 578:             subcommand,
 579:         ])
 580:         .args(args.iter().map(OsString::as_os_str))
 581:         .status()
 582:         .map_err(|err| format!("failed to run ops {subcommand}: {err}"))?;
 583:     if status.success() {
 584:         Ok(())
 585:     } else {
 586:         Err(format!(
 587:             "ops {subcommand} failed with status {}",
 588:             status_code(status)
 589:         ))
 590:     }
 591: }

 593: pub fn run_cargo_bin(root_dir: &Path, bin_name: &str, args: &[OsString]) -> Result<(), String> {
 594:     let status = Command::new("cargo")
 595:         .current_dir(root_dir)
 596:         .args([
 597:             "run",
 598:             "--quiet",
 599:             "-p",
 600:             "rustynet-cli",
 601:             "--bin",
 602:             bin_name,
 603:             "--",
 604:         ])
 605:         .args(args.iter().map(OsString::as_os_str))
 606:         .status()
 607:         .map_err(|err| format!("failed to run bin {bin_name}: {err}"))?;
 608:     if status.success() {
 609:         Ok(())
 610:     } else {
 611:         Err(format!(
 612:             "bin {bin_name} failed with status {}",
 613:             status_code(status)
 614:         ))
 615:     }
 616: }

 618: pub fn ensure_pinned_known_hosts_file(path: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
 619:     if path.as_os_str().is_empty() {
 620:         return Err("pinned known_hosts file path is required".to_string());
 621:     }
 622:     if !path.is_file() {
 623:         return Err(format!(
 624:             "missing pinned known_hosts file: {}",
 625:             path.display()
 626:         ));
 627:     }
 628:     if is_symlink(path) {
 629:         return Err(format!(
 630:             "pinned known_hosts file must not be a symlink: {}",
 631:             path.display()
 632:         ));
 633:     }
 634:     run_cargo_ops(
 635:         &repo_root()?,
 636:         "check-local-file-mode",
 637:         &[
 638:             OsString::from("--path"),
 639:             path.as_os_str().to_os_string(),
 640:             OsString::from("--policy"),
 641:             OsString::from("no-group-world-write"),
 642:             OsString::from("--label"),
 643:             OsString::from("pinned known_hosts file"),
 644:         ],
 645:     )
 646: }
 647: 
 648: pub fn load_home_known_hosts_path() -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
 649:     let home = env::var_os("HOME")
 650:         .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
 651:         .ok_or_else(|| "HOME is not set".to_string())?;
 652:     Ok(PathBuf::from(home).join(".ssh/known_hosts"))
 653: }
 654: 
 655: pub fn seed_known_hosts(src: &Path, dst: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
 656:     fs::copy(src, dst).map_err(|err| {
 657:         format!(
 658:             "failed to seed known_hosts from {} to {}: {err}",
 659:             src.display(),
 660:             dst.display()
 661:         )
 662:     })?;
 663:     set_mode(dst, 0o600)?;
 664:     Ok(())
 665: }
 666: 
 667: fn known_hosts_lookup_host(host: &str, port: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
 668:     if host.is_empty() {
 669:         return Err("known_hosts lookup host must not be empty".to_string());
 670:     }
 671:     if port.is_empty() || port == "22" {
 672:         Ok(host.to_string())
 673:     } else {
 674:         Ok(format!("[{host}]:{port}"))
 675:     }
 676: }
 677: 
 678: fn ssh_g_value<'a>(resolved: &'a str, key: &str) -> Option<&'a str> {
 679:     resolved.lines().find_map(|line| {
 680:         let mut fields = line.split_whitespace();
 681:         match (fields.next(), fields.next()) {
 682:             (Some(found_key), Some(value)) if found_key == key => Some(value),
 683:             _ => None,
 684:         }
 685:     })
 686: }
 687: 
 688: fn resolved_known_hosts_candidates(target: &str, resolved: &str) -> Result<Vec<String>, String> {
 689:     let raw_host = target_address(target);
 690:     let port = ssh_g_value(resolved, "port").unwrap_or("22");
 691:     let mut lookup_candidates = Vec::new();
 692: 
 693:     if let Some(hostkeyalias) = ssh_g_value(resolved, "hostkeyalias")
 694:         && hostkeyalias != "none"
 695:     {
 696:         let lookup_host = known_hosts_lookup_host(hostkeyalias, port)?;
 697:         lookup_candidates.push(lookup_host);
 698:     }
 699: 
 700:     let raw_lookup = known_hosts_lookup_host(raw_host, port)?;
 701:     lookup_candidates.push(raw_lookup);
 702: 
 703:     if let Some(hostname) = ssh_g_value(resolved, "hostname") {
 704:         let lookup_host = known_hosts_lookup_host(hostname, port)?;
 705:         if !lookup_candidates.contains(&lookup_host) {
 706:             lookup_candidates.push(lookup_host);
 707:         }
 708:     }
 709: 
 710:     Ok(lookup_candidates)
 711: }
 712: 
 713: pub fn require_pinned_host_entry(pinned_known_hosts: &Path, target: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
 714:     if utm_transport_for_target(target).is_some() {
 715:         return Ok(());
 716:     }
 717:     let resolved = Command::new("ssh")
 718:         .args(["-G", target])
 719:         .stdin(Stdio::null())
 720:         .output()
 721:         .map_err(|err| {
 722:             format!("failed resolving SSH target for host-key verification {target}: {err}")
 723:         })?;
 724:     if !resolved.status.success() {
 725:         return Err(format!(
 726:             "failed resolving SSH target for host-key verification {target}: {}",
 727:             String::from_utf8_lossy(&resolved.stderr).trim()
 728:         ));
 729:     }
 730: 
 731:     let resolved_text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&resolved.stdout);
 732:     let lookup_candidates = resolved_known_hosts_candidates(target, &resolved_text)?;
 733:     if lookup_candidates.is_empty() {
 734:         return Err(format!(
 735:             "pinned known_hosts verification resolved no lookup candidates for {target}"
 736:         ));
 737:     }
 738: 
 739:     for lookup_host in &lookup_candidates {
 740:         let status = Command::new("ssh-keygen")
 741:             .args(["-F", lookup_host, "-f"])
 742:             .arg(pinned_known_hosts)
 743:             .stdin(Stdio::null())
 744:             .stdout(Stdio::null())
 745:             .stderr(Stdio::null())
 746:             .status()
 747:             .map_err(|err| format!("failed to run ssh-keygen -F for {lookup_host}: {err}"))?;
 748:         if status.success() {
 749:             return Ok(());
 750:         }
 751:     }
 752: 
 753:     Err(format!(
 754:         "pinned known_hosts file lacks host key for {target}; checked {} in {}",
 755:         lookup_candidates.join(", "),
 756:         pinned_known_hosts.display()
 757:     ))
 758: }
 759: 
 760: fn ssh_base_command(identity: &Path, known_hosts: &Path, target: &str) -> Command {
 761:     let mut command = Command::new("ssh");
 762:     command.args([
 763:         "-n",
 764:         "-o",
 765:         "LogLevel=ERROR",
 766:         "-o",
 767:         "BatchMode=yes",
 768:         "-o",
 769:         "StrictHostKeyChecking=yes",
 770:         "-o",
 771:         "UpdateHostKeys=no",
 772:         "-o",
 773:         &format!("UserKnownHostsFile={}", known_hosts.display()),
 774:         "-o",
 775:         "ConnectTimeout=15",
 776:         "-o",
 777:         "ServerAliveInterval=20",
 778:         "-o",
 779:         "ServerAliveCountMax=3",
 780:         "-o",
 781:         "IdentitiesOnly=yes",
 782:         "-i",
 783:     ]);
 784:     command.arg(identity);
 785:     command.arg("--");
 786:     command.arg(target);
 787:     command
 788: }
 789: 
 790: fn scp_base_command(identity: &Path, known_hosts: &Path) -> Command {
 791:     let mut command = Command::new("scp");
 792:     command.args([
 793:         "-q",
 794:         "-o",
 795:         "LogLevel=ERROR",
 796:         "-o",
 797:         "BatchMode=yes",
 798:         "-o",
 799:         "StrictHostKeyChecking=yes",
 800:         "-o",
 801:         "UpdateHostKeys=no",
 802:         "-o",
 803:         &format!("UserKnownHostsFile={}", known_hosts.display()),
 804:         "-o",
 805:         "ConnectTimeout=15",
 806:         "-o",
 807:         "IdentitiesOnly=yes",
 808:         "-i",
 809:     ]);
 810:     command.arg(identity);
 811:     command.arg("--");
 812:     command
 813: }
 814: 
 815: pub fn ssh_status(
 816:     identity: &Path,
 817:     known_hosts: &Path,
 818:     target: &str,
 819:     command: &str,
 820: ) -> Result<ExitStatus, String> {
 821:     if let Some(transport) = utm_transport_for_target(target) {
 822:         return utm_exec_status(&transport, command);
 823:     }
 824:     require_pinned_host_entry(known_hosts, target)?;
 825:     let mut ssh = ssh_base_command(identity, known_hosts, target);
 826:     ssh.arg(command);
 827:     ssh.stdin(Stdio::null())
 828:         .status()
 829:         .map_err(|err| format!("failed to run ssh against {target}: {err}"))
 830: }
 831: 
 832: pub fn ssh_output(
 833:     identity: &Path,
 834:     known_hosts: &Path,
 835:     target: &str,
 836:     command: &str,
 837: ) -> Result<String, String> {
 838:     if let Some(transport) = utm_transport_for_target(target) {
 839:         let output = utm_exec_output(&transport, command)?;
 840:         if !output.status.success() {
 841:             return Err(format!(
 842:                 "UTM command failed against {target} with status {}",
 843:                 status_code(output.status)
 844:             ));
 845:         }
 846:         return Ok(String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).to_string());
 847:     }
 848:     require_pinned_host_entry(known_hosts, target)?;
 849:     let mut ssh = ssh_base_command(identity, known_hosts, target);
 850:     ssh.arg(command);
 851:     let output = ssh
 852:         .stdin(Stdio::null())
 853:         .output()
 854:         .map_err(|err| format!("failed to run ssh against {target}: {err}"))?;
 855:     if !output.status.success() {
 856:         return Err(format!(
 857:             "ssh command failed against {target} with status {}",
 858:             status_code(output.status)
 859:         ));
 860:     }
 861:     Ok(String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).to_string())
 862: }
 863: 
 864: pub fn scp_to(
 865:     identity: &Path,
 866:     known_hosts: &Path,
 867:     src: &Path,
 868:     target: &str,
 869:     dst: &str,
 870: ) -> Result<(), String> {
 871:     if let Some(transport) = utm_transport_for_target(target) {
 872:         return utm_file_push(&transport, src, dst);
 873:     }
 874:     require_pinned_host_entry(known_hosts, target)?;
 875:     let mut scp = scp_base_command(identity, known_hosts);
 876:     scp.arg(src);
 877:     scp.arg(format!("{target}:{dst}"));
 878:     let status = scp
 879:         .stdin(Stdio::null())
 880:         .status()
 881:         .map_err(|err| format!("failed to scp {} to {target}:{dst}: {err}", src.display()))?;
 882:     if status.success() {
 883:         Ok(())
 884:     } else {
 885:         Err(format!(
 886:             "scp {} to {target}:{dst} failed with status {}",
 887:             src.display(),
 888:             status_code(status)
 889:         ))
 890:     }
 891: }
 892: 
 893: pub fn scp_from(
 894:     identity: &Path,
 895:     known_hosts: &Path,
 896:     target: &str,
 897:     src: &str,
 898:     dst: &Path,
 899: ) -> Result<(), String> {
 900:     if let Some(transport) = utm_transport_for_target(target) {
 901:         return utm_file_pull(&transport, src, dst);
 902:     }
 903:     require_pinned_host_entry(known_hosts, target)?;
 904:     let mut scp = scp_base_command(identity, known_hosts);
 905:     scp.arg(format!("{target}:{src}"));
 906:     scp.arg(dst);
 907:     let status = scp
 908:         .stdin(Stdio::null())
 909:         .status()
 910:         .map_err(|err| format!("failed to scp {target}:{src} to {}: {err}", dst.display()))?;
 911:     if status.success() {
 912:         Ok(())
 913:     } else {
 914:         Err(format!(
 915:             "scp {target}:{src} to {} failed with status {}",
 916:             dst.display(),
 917:             status_code(status)
 918:         ))
 919:     }
 920: }

 936:         return Ok(String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).to_string());
 937:     }

 939:     let mut ssh = ssh_base_command(identity, known_hosts, target);
 940:     ssh.arg(command);
 941:     let output = ssh
 942:         .stdin(Stdio::null())
 943:         .output()

 954: pub fn push_sudo_password(identity: &Path, known_hosts: &Path, target: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
 955:     verify_sudo(identity, known_hosts, target)
 956: }
 957: 
 958: pub fn verify_sudo(identity: &Path, known_hosts: &Path, target: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
 959:     let hostname_check = "current_hostname=$(hostname); if ! grep -Eq '(^|[[:space:]])'\"$current_hostname\"'([[:space:]]|$)' /etc/hosts; then printf 'local hostname %s is missing from /etc/hosts\\n' \"$current_hostname\"; exit 1; fi";
 960:     let status = ssh_status(identity, known_hosts, target, hostname_check)?;
 961:     if !status.success() {
 962:         return Err(format!("hostname verification failed for {target}"));
 963:     }
 964:     let verify_cmd = "if sudo -n -k true >/dev/null 2>&1; then :; else printf 'passwordless sudo (sudo -n) is required for live lab automation\\n'; printf 'user: %s\\n' \"$(id -un)\"; printf 'groups: %s\\n' \"$(id -Gn)\"; exit 1; fi";
 965:     let status = ssh_status(identity, known_hosts, target, verify_cmd)?;
 966:     if status.success() {
 967:         Ok(())
 968:     } else {
 969:         Err(format!(
 970:             "passwordless sudo verification failed for {target}"
 971:         ))
 972:     }
 973: }

 975: pub fn capture_root(
 976:     identity: &Path,
 977:     known_hosts: &Path,
 978:     target: &str,
 979:     body: &str,
 980: ) -> Result<String, String> {

 982:     capture_remote_stdout(identity, known_hosts, target, &command)

 985: pub fn run_root(
 986:     identity: &Path,
 987:     known_hosts: &Path,
 988:     target: &str,
 989:     body: &str,
 990: ) -> Result<(), String> {
 991:     let command = format!("sudo -n sh -lc {}", shell_quote(body));
 992:     let status = ssh_status(identity, known_hosts, target, &command)?;
 993:     if status.success() {
 994:         Ok(())
 995:     } else {
 996:         Err(format!(
 997:             "root command failed for {target} with status {}",
 998:             status_code(status)
 999:         ))
1000:     }
1001: }

1003: pub fn retry_root(
1004:     identity: &Path,
1005:     known_hosts: &Path,
1006:     target: &str,
1007:     body: &str,
1008:     attempts: usize,
1009:     sleep_secs: u64,
1010: ) -> Result<(), String> {
1011:     for attempt in 1..=attempts {
1012:         if run_root(identity, known_hosts, target, body).is_ok() {
1013:             return Ok(());
1014:         }
1015:         if attempt < attempts {
1016:             std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_secs(sleep_secs));
1017:         }
1018:     }
1019:     run_root(identity, known_hosts, target, body)
1020: }

1028:     sleep_secs: u64,
1029: ) -> Result<(), String> {
1030:     let body = format!("test -S {}", shell_quote(socket_path));
1031:     retry_root(
1032:         identity,
1033:         known_hosts,
1034:         target,
1035:         body.as_str(),
1036:         attempts,
1037:         sleep_secs,
1038:     )
1039: }

1063: pub fn issue_assignment_bundles_from_env(
1064:     identity: &Path,
1065:     known_hosts: &Path,
1066:     target: &str,
1067:     env_local: &Path,
1068:     remote_env_path: &str,
1069: ) -> Result<(), String> {
1070:     scp_to(identity, known_hosts, env_local, target, remote_env_path)?;
1071:     let command = format!(
1072:         "sudo -n rustynet ops e2e-issue-assignment-bundles-from-env --env-file {}",
1073:         shell_quote(remote_env_path)
1074:     );
1075:     let status = ssh_status(identity, known_hosts, target, &command)?;
1076:     if !status.success() {
1077:         let _ = run_root(
1078:             identity,
1079:             known_hosts,
1080:             target,
1081:             &format!("rm -f {}", shell_quote(remote_env_path)),
1082:         );
1083:         return Err(format!(
1084:             "issue assignment bundles from env failed for {target} with status {}",
1085:             status_code(status)
1086:         ));
1087:     }
1088:     run_root(
1089:         identity,
1090:         known_hosts,
1091:         target,
1092:         &format!("rm -f {}", shell_quote(remote_env_path)),
1093:     )
1094: }

1129: pub fn enforce_host(
1130:     identity: &Path,
1131:     known_hosts: &Path,
1132:     target: &str,
1133:     role: &str,
1134:     node_id: &str,
1135:     src_dir: &str,
1136:     ssh_allow_cidrs: &str,
1137: ) -> Result<(), String> {
1138:     let command = format!(
1139:         "sudo -n rustynet ops e2e-enforce-host --role {} --node-id {} --src-dir {} --ssh-allow-cidrs {}",
1140:         shell_quote(role),
