1218: pub fn collect_pubkey_hex(
1219:     identity: &Path,
1220:     known_hosts: &Path,
1221:     target: &str,
1222: ) -> Result<String, String> {
1223:     let pub_b64 = capture_root(
1224:         identity,
1225:         known_hosts,
1226:         target,
1227:         "cat /var/lib/rustynet/keys/wireguard.pub | tr -d '[:space:]'",
1228:     )?;
1229:     let pub_hex = base64_to_hex(pub_b64.trim())?;
1230:     if pub_hex.len() != 64 || !pub_hex.chars().all(|ch| ch.is_ascii_hexdigit()) {
1231:         return Err(format!("failed to decode wireguard pubkey for {target}"));
1232:     }
1233:     Ok(pub_hex)
1234: }
1235: 
1236: pub fn base64_to_hex(value: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
1237:     let decoded = decode_base64(value.trim())?;
1238:     let mut output = String::with_capacity(decoded.len() * 2);
1239:     for byte in decoded {
1240:         output.push_str(format!("{byte:02x}").as_str());
1241:     }
1242:     Ok(output)
1243: }
1244: 
1245: fn decode_base64(value: &str) -> Result<Vec<u8>, String> {
1246:     use std::collections::BTreeMap;
1247: 
1248:     const TABLE: &str = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/";
1249:     let mut reverse = BTreeMap::new();
1250:     for (index, ch) in TABLE.chars().enumerate() {
1251:         reverse.insert(ch, index as u8);
1252:     }
1253:     let clean = value
1254:         .chars()
1255:         .filter(|ch| !ch.is_ascii_whitespace())
1256:         .collect::<Vec<_>>();
1257:     if clean.is_empty() || clean.len() % 4 != 0 {
1258:         return Err("invalid base64 wireguard public key".to_string());
1259:     }
1260:     let mut output = Vec::with_capacity(clean.len() / 4 * 3);
1261:     for chunk in clean.chunks(4) {
1262:         let mut sextets = [0u8; 4];
1263:         let mut padding = 0usize;
1264:         for (index, ch) in chunk.iter().enumerate() {
1265:             if *ch == '=' {
1266:                 sextets[index] = 0;
1267:                 padding += 1;
1268:             } else if let Some(value) = reverse.get(ch) {
1269:                 sextets[index] = *value;
1270:             } else {
1271:                 return Err("invalid base64 wireguard public key".to_string());
1272:             }
1273:         }
1274:         let b0 = (sextets[0] << 2) | (sextets[1] >> 4);
1275:         let b1 = ((sextets[1] & 0x0f) << 4) | (sextets[2] >> 2);
1276:         let b2 = ((sextets[2] & 0x03) << 6) | sextets[3];
1277:         output.push(b0);
1278:         if padding < 2 {
1279:             output.push(b1);
1280:         }
1281:         if padding < 1 {
1282:             output.push(b2);
1283:         }
1284:     }
1285:     Ok(output)
1286: }

1288: pub fn git_head_commit(root_dir: &Path) -> Result<String, String> {
1289:     let output = Command::new("git")
1290:         .current_dir(root_dir)
1291:         .args(["rev-parse", "HEAD"])
1292:         .output()
1293:         .map_err(|err| format!("failed to run git rev-parse HEAD: {err}"))?;
1294:     if !output.status.success() {
1295:         return Err("git rev-parse HEAD failed".to_string());
1296:     }
1297:     let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout);
1298:     let trimmed = text.trim().to_lowercase();
1299:     if trimmed.is_empty() {
1300:         return Err("git rev-parse HEAD returned empty output".to_string());
1301:     }
1302:     Ok(trimmed)
1303: }

  41:     env::var(key)

  47: fn env_flag_truthy(value: Option<&str>) -> bool {
  48:     matches!(
  49:         value.map(|value| value.trim().to_ascii_lowercase()),
  50:         Some(flag) if matches!(flag.as_str(), "1" | "true" | "yes" | "on")
  51:     )

  54: fn utm_transport_enabled() -> bool {
  55:     env_flag_truthy(env::var("LIVE_LAB_ENABLE_UTM_TRANSPORT").ok().as_deref())

  58: fn utm_transport_for_target(target: &str) -> Option<UtmTransport> {
  59:     if !utm_transport_enabled() {
  60:         return None;
  61:     }
  62:     for (target_key, utm_key) in [
  63:         ("EXIT_TARGET", "EXIT_UTM_NAME"),
  64:         ("CLIENT_TARGET", "CLIENT_UTM_NAME"),
  65:         ("ENTRY_TARGET", "ENTRY_UTM_NAME"),
  66:         ("AUX_TARGET", "AUX_UTM_NAME"),
  67:         ("EXTRA_TARGET", "EXTRA_UTM_NAME"),
  68:         ("FIFTH_CLIENT_TARGET", "FIFTH_CLIENT_UTM_NAME"),
  69:     ] {
  70:         let Some(mapped_target) = env_var_nonempty(target_key) else {
  71:             continue;
  72:         };
  73:         if mapped_target != target {
  74:             continue;
  75:         }
  76:         let Some(utm_name) = env_var_nonempty(utm_key) else {
  77:             continue;
  78:         };
  79:         return Some(UtmTransport {
  80:             utm_name,
  81:             user: LiveLabContext::target_user(target).to_string(),
  82:             home: target_home(target),
  83:         });
  84:     }
  85:     None
  86: }

  95: fn run_status_with_timeout(command: &mut Command, timeout: Duration) -> Result<ExitStatus, String> {
  96:     let mut child = command
  97:         .spawn()
  98:         .map_err(|err| format!("spawn failed: {err}"))?;
  99:     let started_at = Instant::now();
 100:     loop {
 101:         if let Some(status) = child
 102:             .try_wait()
 103:             .map_err(|err| format!("wait failed: {err}"))?
 104:         {
 105:             return Ok(status);
 106:         }
 107:         if started_at.elapsed() >= timeout {
 108:             let _ = child.kill();
 109:             let _ = child.wait();
 110:             return Err(format!("timed out after {} seconds", timeout.as_secs()));
 111:         }
 112:         sleep(Duration::from_millis(PROCESS_POLL_INTERVAL_MILLIS));
 113:     }
 114: }
 115: 
 116: fn run_output_with_timeout(command: &mut Command, timeout: Duration) -> Result<Output, String> {
 117:     command.stdout(Stdio::piped()).stderr(Stdio::piped());
 118:     let mut child = command
 119:         .spawn()
 120:         .map_err(|err| format!("spawn failed: {err}"))?;
 121:     let started_at = Instant::now();
 122:     loop {
 123:         if let Some(_status) = child
 124:             .try_wait()
 125:             .map_err(|err| format!("wait failed: {err}"))?
 126:         {
 127:             return child
 128:                 .wait_with_output()
 129:                 .map_err(|err| format!("wait_with_output failed: {err}"));
 130:         }
 131:         if started_at.elapsed() >= timeout {
 132:             let _ = child.kill();
 133:             let _ = child.wait();
 134:             return Err(format!("timed out after {} seconds", timeout.as_secs()));
 135:         }
 136:         sleep(Duration::from_millis(PROCESS_POLL_INTERVAL_MILLIS));
 137:     }
 138: }

 140: fn utm_guest_shell_command(transport: &UtmTransport, command: &str) -> String {
 141:     let quoted_command = shell_single_quote(command);
 142:     if transport.user == "root" {
 143:         format!("exec /bin/bash -lc {quoted_command}")
 144:     } else {
 145:         let quoted_user = shell_single_quote(&transport.user);
 146:         let quoted_home = shell_single_quote(&transport.home);
 147:         format!(
 148:             "exec runuser -u {quoted_user} -- env HOME={quoted_home} USER={quoted_user} LOGNAME={quoted_user} PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin /bin/bash -lc {quoted_command}"
 149:         )
 150:     }
 151: }

 153: fn utm_exec_status(transport: &UtmTransport, command: &str) -> Result<ExitStatus, String> {
 154:     let utmctl = utmctl_path();
 155:     if !utmctl.is_file() {
 156:         return Err(format!(
 157:             "missing executable UTM control tool: {}",
 158:             utmctl.display()
 159:         ));
 160:     }
 161:     let mut utm = Command::new(&utmctl);
 162:     utm.args([
 163:         "exec",
 164:         transport.utm_name.as_str(),
 165:         "--cmd",
 166:         "/bin/bash",
 167:         "-lc",
 168:     ]);
 169:     utm.arg(utm_guest_shell_command(transport, command));
 170:     run_status_with_timeout(&mut utm, Duration::from_secs(UTM_EXEC_TIMEOUT_SECS)).map_err(|err| {
 171:         format!(
 172:             "failed to run utm exec against {}: {err}",
 173:             transport.utm_name
 174:         )
 175:     })
 176: }

 212: fn utm_file_push(transport: &UtmTransport, src: &Path, dst: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
 213:     let utmctl = utmctl_path();
 214:     if !utmctl.is_file() {
 215:         return Err(format!(
 216:             "missing executable UTM control tool: {}",
 217:             utmctl.display()
 218:         ));
 219:     }
 220:     let stdin = fs::File::open(src)
 221:         .map_err(|err| format!("failed to open {} for UTM push: {err}", src.display()))?;
 222:     let mut utm = Command::new(&utmctl);
 223:     utm.args(["file", "push", transport.utm_name.as_str(), dst]);
 224:     utm.stdin(Stdio::from(stdin));
 225:     let status = run_status_with_timeout(&mut utm, Duration::from_secs(UTM_FILE_TIMEOUT_SECS))
 226:         .map_err(|err| {
 227:             format!(
 228:                 "failed to push {} to {}:{}: {err}",
 229:                 src.display(),
 230:                 transport.utm_name,
 231:                 dst
 232:             )
 233:         })?;
 234:     if !status.success() {
 235:         return Err(format!(
 236:             "push {} to {}:{} failed with status {}",
 237:             src.display(),
 238:             transport.utm_name,
 239:             dst,
 240:             status_code(status)
 241:         ));
 242:     }
 243:     if transport.user != "root" {
 244:         let chown_cmd = format!(
 245:             "chown {}:{} {}",
 246:             shell_single_quote(&transport.user),
 247:             shell_single_quote(&transport.user),
 248:             shell_single_quote(dst)
 249:         );
 250:         let status = utm_exec_root_status(transport, &chown_cmd)?;
 251:         if !status.success() {
 252:             return Err(format!(
 253:                 "UTM chown failed for {}:{} with status {}",
 254:                 transport.utm_name,
 255:                 dst,
 256:                 status_code(status)
 257:             ));
 258:         }
 259:     }
 260:     Ok(())
 261: }
 262: 
 263: pub fn repo_root() -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
 264:     let manifest_dir = PathBuf::from(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"));
 265:     manifest_dir
 266:         .parent()
 267:         .and_then(Path::parent)
 268:         .map(Path::to_path_buf)
 269:         .ok_or_else(|| {
 270:             format!(
 271:                 "failed to resolve repository root from manifest dir {}",
 272:                 manifest_dir.display()
 273:             )
 274:         })
 275: }
 276: 
 277: pub fn status_code(status: ExitStatus) -> i32 {
 278:     match status.code() {
 279:         Some(code) => code,
 280:         None => {
 281:             #[cfg(unix)]
 282:             {
 283:                 use std::os::unix::process::ExitStatusExt;
 284:                 match status.signal() {
 285:                     Some(signal) => 128 + signal,
 286:                     None => 1,
 287:                 }
 288:             }
 289:             #[cfg(not(unix))]
 290:             {
 291:                 1
 292:             }
 293:         }
 294:     }
 295: }
 296: 
 297: pub fn read_text(path: &Path) -> Result<String, String> {
 298:     fs::read_to_string(path).map_err(|err| format!("failed to read {}: {err}", path.display()))
 299: }
 300: 
 301: fn configure_owner_only_file_open_options(options: &mut OpenOptions) {
 302:     #[cfg(unix)]
 303:     {
 304:         options.mode(0o600);
 305:     }
 306: }
 307: 
 308: fn set_path_mode(path: &Path, mode: u32) -> Result<(), String> {
 309:     #[cfg(unix)]
 310:     {
 311:         let metadata = fs::metadata(path)
 312:             .map_err(|err| format!("failed to stat {}: {err}", path.display()))?;
 313:         let mut permissions = metadata.permissions();
 314:         permissions.set_mode(mode);
 315:         fs::set_permissions(path, permissions)
 316:             .map_err(|err| format!("failed to secure {}: {err}", path.display()))?;
 317:     }
 318:     #[cfg(not(unix))]
 319:     {
 320:         let _ = (path, mode);
 321:     }
 322:     Ok(())
 323: }
 324: 
 325: pub fn write_secure_text(path: &Path, contents: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
 326:     if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
 327:         fs::create_dir_all(parent)
 328:             .map_err(|err| format!("failed to create {}: {err}", parent.display()))?;
 329:     }
 330:     let mut options = OpenOptions::new();
 331:     configure_owner_only_file_open_options(options.create(true).truncate(true).write(true));
 332:     let mut file = options
 333:         .open(path)
 334:         .map_err(|err| format!("failed to write {}: {err}", path.display()))?;
 335:     file.write_all(contents.as_bytes())
 336:         .map_err(|err| format!("failed to write {}: {err}", path.display()))?;
 337:     file.sync_all()
 338:         .map_err(|err| format!("failed to flush {}: {err}", path.display()))
 339: }
 340: 
 341: pub fn write_secure_json(path: &Path, value: &Value) -> Result<(), String> {
 342:     if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
 343:         fs::create_dir_all(parent)
 344:             .map_err(|err| format!("failed to create {}: {err}", parent.display()))?;
 345:     }
 346:     let mut options = OpenOptions::new();
 347:     configure_owner_only_file_open_options(options.create(true).truncate(true).write(true));
 348:     let file = options
 349:         .open(path)
 350:         .map_err(|err| format!("failed to write {}: {err}", path.display()))?;
 351:     serde_json::to_writer_pretty(file, value)
 352:         .map_err(|err| format!("failed to serialize {}: {err}", path.display()))
 353: }
 354: 
 355: pub fn ensure_dir_secure(path: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
 356:     fs::create_dir_all(path)
 357:         .map_err(|err| format!("failed to create {}: {err}", path.display()))?;
 358:     set_path_mode(path, 0o700)
 359: }
 360: 
 361: pub fn require_local_file_mode(path: &Path, policy: &str, label: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
 362:     let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(path)
 363:         .map_err(|err| format!("missing {label}: {} ({err})", path.display()))?;
 364:     if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
 365:         return Err(format!("{label} must not be a symlink: {}", path.display()));
 366:     }
 367:     if !metadata.file_type().is_file() {
 368:         return Err(format!(
 369:             "{label} must be a regular file: {}",
 370:             path.display()
 371:         ));
 372:     }
 373:     #[cfg(not(unix))]
 374:     {
 375:         let _ = policy;
 376:         return Ok(());
 377:     }
 378:     #[cfg(unix)]
 379:     {
 380:         let current_uid = Uid::current().as_raw();
 381:         if metadata.uid() != current_uid {
 382:             return Err(format!(
 383:                 "{label} must be owned by the current user (path: {}, owner uid: {}, current uid: {})",
 384:                 path.display(),
 385:                 metadata.uid(),
 386:                 current_uid
 387:             ));
 388:         }
 389:         let mode = metadata.mode() & 0o777;
 390:         match policy {
 391:             "owner-only" => {
 392:                 if mode & 0o077 != 0 {
 393:                     return Err(format!(
 394:                         "{label} must be owner-only (mode {:o}, path: {})",
 395:                         mode,
 396:                         path.display()
 397:                     ));
 398:                 }
 399:             }
 400:             "no-group-world-write" => {
 401:                 if mode & 0o022 != 0 {
 402:                     return Err(format!(
 403:                         "{label} must not be group/world-writable (mode {:o}, path: {})",
 404:                         mode,
 405:                         path.display()
 406:                     ));
 407:                 }
 408:             }
 409:             other => {
 410:                 return Err(format!("unsupported local file policy: {other}"));
 411:             }
 412:         }
 413:         Ok(())
 414:     }
 415: }
 416: 
 417: pub fn shell_single_quote(value: &str) -> String {
 418:     if value.is_empty() {
 419:         return "''".to_string();
 420:     }
 421:     let mut quoted = String::from("'");
 422:     for ch in value.chars() {
 423:         if ch == '\'' {
 424:             quoted.push_str("'\\''");
 425:         } else {
 426:             quoted.push(ch);
 427:         }
 428:     }
 429:     quoted.push('\'');
 430:     quoted
 431: }
 432: 
 433: #[derive(Debug, Clone)]
 434: pub struct Logger {
 435:     file: PathBuf,
 436: }
 437: 
 438: impl Logger {
 439:     pub fn new(path: &Path) -> Result<Self, String> {
 440:         if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
 441:             ensure_dir_secure(parent)?;
 442:         }
 443:         write_secure_text(path, "")?;
 444:         Ok(Self {
 445:             file: path.to_path_buf(),
 446:         })
 447:     }
 448: 
 449:     pub fn line(&self, text: impl AsRef<str>) -> Result<(), String> {
 450:         let text = text.as_ref();
 451:         let mut file = OpenOptions::new()
 452:             .append(true)
 453:             .open(&self.file)
 454:             .map_err(|err| format!("failed to append {}: {err}", self.file.display()))?;
 455:         writeln!(file, "{text}")
 456:             .map_err(|err| format!("failed to append {}: {err}", self.file.display()))?;
 457:         println!("{text}");
 458:         Ok(())
 459:     }
 460: 
 461:     pub fn raw(&self, text: impl AsRef<str>) -> Result<(), String> {
 462:         let text = text.as_ref();
 463:         if text.is_empty() {
 464:             return Ok(());
 465:         }
 466:         let mut file = OpenOptions::new()
 467:             .append(true)
 468:             .open(&self.file)
 469:             .map_err(|err| format!("failed to append {}: {err}", self.file.display()))?;
 470:         file.write_all(text.as_bytes())
 471:             .map_err(|err| format!("failed to append {}: {err}", self.file.display()))?;
 472:         if !text.ends_with('\n') {
 473:             file.write_all(b"\n")
 474:                 .map_err(|err| format!("failed to append {}: {err}", self.file.display()))?;
 475:         }
 476:         print!("{text}");
 477:         if !text.ends_with('\n') {
 478:             println!();
 479:         }
 480:         Ok(())
 481:     }
 482: 
 483:     pub fn block(&self, label: impl AsRef<str>, body: impl AsRef<str>) -> Result<(), String> {
 484:         self.line(label)?;
 485:         self.raw(body)
 486:     }
 487: }

 489: #[derive(Debug, Clone)]
 490: pub struct LiveLabContext {
 491:     pub root_dir: PathBuf,
 492:     pub ssh_identity_file: PathBuf,
 493:     pub pinned_known_hosts_file: PathBuf,
 494:     pub work_dir: PathBuf,
 495:     pub known_hosts_file: PathBuf,
 496:     verified_hosts: HashSet<String>,
 497: }
 498: 
 499: impl LiveLabContext {
 500:     pub fn new(prefix: &str, ssh_identity_file: &Path) -> Result<Self, String> {
 501:         require_local_file_mode(ssh_identity_file, "owner-only", "ssh identity file")?;
 502:         let pinned_known_hosts_file = env::var_os("LIVE_LAB_PINNED_KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE")
 503:             .map(PathBuf::from)
 504:             .unwrap_or_else(|| {
 505:                 env::var_os("HOME")
 506:                     .map(PathBuf::from)
 507:                     .unwrap_or_else(|| PathBuf::from("/root"))
 508:                     .join(".ssh/known_hosts")
 509:             });
 510:         require_local_file_mode(
 511:             pinned_known_hosts_file.as_path(),
 512:             "no-group-world-write",
 513:             "pinned known_hosts file",
 514:         )?;
 515: 
 516:         let root_dir = repo_root()?;
 517:         let work_dir = create_unique_work_dir(prefix)?;
 518:         let known_hosts_file = work_dir.join("known_hosts");
 519:         fs::copy(&pinned_known_hosts_file, &known_hosts_file).map_err(|err| {
 520:             format!(
 521:                 "failed to seed {} from {}: {err}",
 522:                 known_hosts_file.display(),
 523:                 pinned_known_hosts_file.display()
 524:             )
 525:         })?;
 526:         set_path_mode(&known_hosts_file, 0o600)?;
 527: 
 528:         Ok(Self {
 529:             root_dir,
 530:             ssh_identity_file: ssh_identity_file.to_path_buf(),
 531:             pinned_known_hosts_file,
 532:             work_dir,
 533:             known_hosts_file,
 534:             verified_hosts: HashSet::new(),
 535:         })
 536:     }
 537: 
 538:     pub fn cleanup(&self) {
 539:         let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&self.work_dir);
 540:     }
 541: 
 542:     pub fn target_user(target: &str) -> &str {
 543:         target
 544:             .split_once('@')
 545:             .map(|(user, _)| user)
 546:             .unwrap_or(target)
 547:     }
 548: 
 549:     pub fn target_address(target: &str) -> &str {
 550:         target
 551:             .split_once('@')
 552:             .map(|(_, addr)| addr)
 553:             .unwrap_or(target)
 554:     }
 555: 
 556:     pub fn resolved_target_address(target: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
 557:         if utm_transport_for_target(target).is_some() {
 558:             return Ok(Self::target_address(target).to_string());
 559:         }
 560:         let resolved = Command::new("ssh")
 561:             .args(["-G", target])
 562:             .stdin(Stdio::null())
 563:             .output()
 564:             .map_err(|err| format!("failed resolving SSH target address for {target}: {err}"))?;
 565:         if !resolved.status.success() {
 566:             return Err(format!(
 567:                 "failed resolving SSH target address for {target}: {}",
 568:                 String::from_utf8_lossy(&resolved.stderr).trim()
 569:             ));
 570:         }
 571:         let resolved_text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&resolved.stdout);
 572:         let host = resolved_target_address_from_ssh_g(target, &resolved_text);
 573:         if host.is_empty() {
 574:             Err(format!("resolved SSH target address is empty for {target}"))
 575:         } else {
 576:             Ok(host)
 577:         }
 578:     }
 579: 
 580:     pub fn remote_src_dir(target: &str) -> String {
 581:         if Self::target_user(target) == "root" {
 582:             "/root/Rustynet".to_string()
 583:         } else {
 584:             format!("/home/{}/Rustynet", Self::target_user(target))
 585:         }
 586:     }
 587: 
 588:     fn require_pinned_host_entry(&self, target: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
 589:         if utm_transport_for_target(target).is_some() {
 590:             return Ok(());
 591:         }
 592:         let resolved = Command::new("ssh")
 593:             .args(["-G", target])
 594:             .stdin(Stdio::null())
 595:             .output()
 596:             .map_err(|err| {
 597:                 format!("failed resolving SSH target for host-key verification {target}: {err}")
 598:             })?;
 599:         if !resolved.status.success() {
 600:             return Err(format!(
 601:                 "failed resolving SSH target for host-key verification {target}: {}",
 602:                 String::from_utf8_lossy(&resolved.stderr).trim()
 603:             ));
 604:         }
 605: 
 606:         let resolved_text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&resolved.stdout);
 607:         let lookup_candidates = resolved_known_hosts_candidates(target, &resolved_text)?;
 608:         if lookup_candidates.is_empty() {
 609:             return Err(format!(
 610:                 "pinned known_hosts verification resolved no lookup candidates for {target}"
 611:             ));
 612:         }
 613: 
 614:         for lookup_host in &lookup_candidates {
 615:             let output = Command::new("ssh-keygen")
 616:                 .arg("-F")
 617:                 .arg(lookup_host)
 618:                 .arg("-f")
 619:                 .arg(&self.pinned_known_hosts_file)
 620:                 .output()
 621:                 .map_err(|err| {
 622:                     format!("failed to inspect pinned known_hosts for {lookup_host}: {err}")
 623:                 })?;
 624:             if output.status.success() {
 625:                 return Ok(());
 626:             }
 627:         }
 628: 
 629:         Err(format!(
 630:             "pinned known_hosts file lacks host key for {target}; checked {} in {}",
 631:             lookup_candidates.join(", "),
 632:             self.pinned_known_hosts_file.display()
 633:         ))
 634:     }
 635: 
 636:     fn ssh_command(&self, target: &str) -> Command {
 637:         let mut command = Command::new("ssh");
 638:         command.args([
 639:             "-n",
 640:             "-o",
 641:             "LogLevel=ERROR",
 642:             "-o",
 643:             "BatchMode=yes",
 644:             "-o",
 645:             "StrictHostKeyChecking=yes",
 646:         ]);
 647:         command.arg("-o").arg(format!(
 648:             "UserKnownHostsFile={}",
 649:             self.known_hosts_file.display()
 650:         ));
 651:         command.args([
 652:             "-o",
 653:             "ConnectTimeout=15",
 654:             "-o",
 655:             "ServerAliveInterval=20",
 656:             "-o",
 657:             "ServerAliveCountMax=3",
 658:             "-o",
 659:             "IdentitiesOnly=yes",
 660:             "-i",
 661:         ]);
 662:         command.arg(&self.ssh_identity_file);
 663:         command.arg("--");
 664:         command.arg(target);
 665:         command
 666:     }
 667: 
 668:     fn run_ssh(&self, target: &str, args: &[&str], allow_failure: bool) -> Result<Output, String> {
 669:         if let Some(transport) = utm_transport_for_target(target) {
 670:             let remote_command = render_remote_argv(args)?;
 671:             let output = utm_exec_output(&transport, remote_command.as_str())?;
 672:             if !allow_failure && !output.status.success() {
 673:                 return Err(format!(
 674:                     "remote command failed on {target}: {}",
 675:                     render_failure_output(&output)
 676:                 ));
 677:             }
 678:             return Ok(output);
 679:         }
 680:         self.require_pinned_host_entry(target)?;
 681:         let remote_command = render_remote_argv(args)?;
 682:         let mut command = self.ssh_command(target);
 683:         command
 684:             .args(["sh", "-lc"])
 685:             .arg(shell_single_quote(remote_command.as_str()))
 686:             .stdin(Stdio::null());
 687:         let output = command
 688:             .output()
 689:             .map_err(|err| format!("failed to run ssh for {target}: {err}"))?;
 690:         if !allow_failure && !output.status.success() {
 691:             return Err(format!(
 692:                 "remote command failed on {target}: {}",
 693:                 render_failure_output(&output)
 694:             ));
 695:         }
 696:         Ok(output)
 697:     }
 698: 
 699:     pub fn run(&self, target: &str, args: &[&str]) -> Result<(), String> {
 700:         let output = self.run_ssh(target, args, false)?;
 701:         if output.status.success() {
 702:             Ok(())
 703:         } else {
 704:             Err(format!(
 705:                 "remote command failed on {target}: {}",
 706:                 String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).trim()
 707:             ))
 708:         }
 709:     }
 710: 
 711:     pub fn run_allow_failure(&self, target: &str, args: &[&str]) -> Result<Output, String> {
 712:         self.run_ssh(target, args, true)
 713:     }
 714: 
 715:     pub fn capture(&self, target: &str, args: &[&str]) -> Result<String, String> {
 716:         let output = self.run_ssh(target, args, false)?;
 717:         Ok(String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).into_owned())
 718:     }
 719: 
 720:     pub fn capture_allow_failure(&self, target: &str, args: &[&str]) -> Result<String, String> {
 721:         let output = self.run_ssh(target, args, true)?;
 722:         Ok(String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).into_owned())
 723:     }

 725:     pub fn scp_to(&self, src: &Path, target: &str, dst: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
 726:         if let Some(transport) = utm_transport_for_target(target) {
 727:             return utm_file_push(&transport, src, dst);
 728:         }
 729:         self.require_pinned_host_entry(target)?;
 730:         let status = Command::new("scp")
 731:             .arg("-q")
 732:             .args([
 733:                 "-o",
 734:                 "LogLevel=ERROR",
 735:                 "-o",
 736:                 "BatchMode=yes",
 737:                 "-o",
 738:                 "StrictHostKeyChecking=yes",
 739:             ])
 740:             .arg("-o")
 741:             .arg(format!(
 742:                 "UserKnownHostsFile={}",
 743:                 self.known_hosts_file.display()
 744:             ))
 745:             .args(["-o", "ConnectTimeout=15", "-o", "IdentitiesOnly=yes", "-i"])
 746:             .arg(&self.ssh_identity_file)
 747:             .arg("--")
 748:             .arg(src)
 749:             .arg(format!("{target}:{dst}"))
 750:             .status()
 751:             .map_err(|err| format!("failed to run scp to {target}: {err}"))?;
 752:         if status.success() {
 753:             Ok(())
 754:         } else {
 755:             Err(format!("scp to {target} failed"))
 756:         }
 757:     }

 759:     pub fn run_root(&self, target: &str, args: &[&str]) -> Result<(), String> {
 760:         self.run(target, &["sudo", "-n", "-k", "true"])?;
 761:         let mut full_args = vec!["sudo", "-n"];
 762:         full_args.extend_from_slice(args);
 763:         self.run(target, &full_args)
 764:     }

 790: 
 791:     pub fn capture_root_allow_failure_with_retry(
 792:         &self,
 793:         target: &str,
 794:         args: &[&str],
 795:         attempts: u32,
 796:         sleep_secs: u64,
 797:     ) -> Result<String, String> {
 798:         let mut last_err = None;
 799:         for attempt in 1..=attempts {
 800:             match self.capture_root_allow_failure(target, args) {
 801:                 Ok(output) => return Ok(output),
 802:                 Err(err) => {
 803:                     last_err = Some(err);
 804:                     if attempt < attempts {
 805:                         sleep(Duration::from_secs(sleep_secs));
 806:                     }
 807:                 }
 808:             }
 809:         }
 810:         Err(last_err.unwrap_or_else(|| "retry exhausted".to_string()))
 811:     }
 812: 
 813:     pub fn run_root_allow_failure_with_retry(
 814:         &self,
 815:         target: &str,
 816:         args: &[&str],
 817:         attempts: u32,
 818:         sleep_secs: u64,
 819:     ) -> Result<Output, String> {
 820:         let mut last_err = None;
 821:         for attempt in 1..=attempts {
 822:             match self.run_root_allow_failure(target, args) {
 823:                 Ok(output) => return Ok(output),
 824:                 Err(err) => {
 825:                     last_err = Some(err);
 826:                     if attempt < attempts {
 827:                         sleep(Duration::from_secs(sleep_secs));
 828:                     }
 829:                 }
 830:             }
 831:         }
 832:         Err(last_err.unwrap_or_else(|| "retry exhausted".to_string()))
 833:     }
 834: 
 835:     pub fn retry_root(
 836:         &self,
 837:         target: &str,
 838:         args: &[&str],
 839:         attempts: u32,
 840:         sleep_secs: u64,
 841:     ) -> Result<(), String> {
 842:         let mut last_err = None;
 843:         for attempt in 1..=attempts {
 844:             match self.run_root(target, args) {
 845:                 Ok(()) => return Ok(()),
 846:                 Err(err) => {
 847:                     last_err = Some(err);
 848:                     if attempt < attempts {
 849:                         sleep(Duration::from_secs(sleep_secs));
 850:                     }
 851:                 }
 852:             }
 853:         }
 854:         Err(last_err.unwrap_or_else(|| "retry exhausted".to_string()))
 855:     }
 856: 
 857:     pub fn wait_for_daemon_socket(
 858:         &self,
 859:         target: &str,
 860:         socket_path: &str,
 861:         attempts: u32,
 862:         sleep_secs: u64,
 863:     ) -> Result<(), String> {
 864:         self.retry_root(target, &["test", "-S", socket_path], attempts, sleep_secs)
 865:     }

 867:     pub fn verify_sudo(&self, target: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
 868:         let hostname = self.capture(target, &["hostname"])?;
 869:         let hostname = hostname.trim().to_string();
 870:         if hostname.is_empty() {
 871:             return Err(format!("failed to resolve hostname on {target}"));
 872:         }
 873:         let hosts = self.capture(target, &["cat", "/etc/hosts"])?;
 874:         if !hosts_contains_hostname(&hosts, &hostname) {
 875:             return Err(format!(
 876:                 "local hostname {hostname} is missing from /etc/hosts on {target}"
 877:             ));
 878:         }
 879:         let output = self.run_allow_failure(target, &["sudo", "-n", "-k", "true"])?;
 880:         if output.status.success() {
 881:             Ok(())
 882:         } else {
 883:             Err(format!(
 884:                 "passwordless sudo (sudo -n) is required for live lab automation on {target}"
 885:             ))
 886:         }
 887:     }

 889:     pub fn push_sudo_password(&mut self, target: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
 890:         if self.verified_hosts.contains(target) {
 891:             return Ok(());
 892:         }
 893:         self.verify_sudo(target)?;
 894:         self.verified_hosts.insert(target.to_string());
 895:         Ok(())
 896:     }

 911: fn render_failure_output(output: &Output) -> String {
 912:     let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr);
 913:     let stderr = stderr.trim();
 914:     let stdout = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout);
 915:     let stdout = stdout.trim();
 916:     if !stderr.is_empty() && !stdout.is_empty() {
 917:         format!("{stderr} (stdout: {stdout})")
 918:     } else if !stderr.is_empty() {
 919:         stderr.to_string()
 920:     } else if !stdout.is_empty() {
 921:         format!("stdout: {stdout}")
 922:     } else {
 923:         "remote command exited non-zero without output".to_string()
 924:     }
 925: }

 927: fn render_remote_argv(args: &[&str]) -> Result<String, String> {
 928:     if args.is_empty() {
 929:         return Err("refusing to run empty remote command".to_string());
 930:     }
 931:     let mut rendered = String::new();
 932:     for (index, arg) in args.iter().enumerate() {
 933:         if arg.contains('\0') {
 934:             return Err(format!(
 935:                 "remote command argument {} contains NUL byte",
 936:                 index + 1
 937:             ));
 938:         }
 939:         if arg.contains('\n') || arg.contains('\r') {
 940:             return Err(format!(
 941:                 "remote command argument {} contains newline byte",
 942:                 index + 1
 943:             ));
 944:         }
 945:         if index > 0 {
 946:             rendered.push(' ');
 947:         }
 948:         rendered.push_str(shell_single_quote(arg).as_str());
 949:     }
 950:     Ok(rendered)
 951: }

 959: fn hosts_contains_hostname(hosts: &str, hostname: &str) -> bool {
 960:     for line in hosts.lines() {
 961:         let line = line.split('#').next().unwrap_or("").trim();
 962:         if line.is_empty() {
 963:             continue;
 964:         }
 965:         for token in line.split_whitespace() {
 966:             if token == hostname {
 967:                 return true;
 968:             }
 969:         }
 970:     }
 971:     false
 972: }

 974: fn create_unique_work_dir(prefix: &str) -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
 975:     let base = env::temp_dir();
 976:     let pid = std::process::id();
 977:     let timestamp = SystemTime::now()
 978:         .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
 979:         .map_err(|err| format!("system clock before epoch: {err}"))?
 980:         .as_nanos();
 981:     let counter = TEMP_COUNTER.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
 982:     for salt in 0u32..1000 {
 983:         let candidate = base.join(format!("{prefix}.{pid}.{timestamp}.{counter}.{salt}"));
 984:         match fs::create_dir(&candidate) {
 985:             Ok(()) => {
 986:                 set_path_mode(&candidate, 0o700)?;
 987:                 return Ok(candidate);
 988:             }
 989:             Err(err) if err.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::AlreadyExists => continue,
 990:             Err(err) => {
 991:                 return Err(format!(
 992:                     "failed to create work dir {}: {err}",
 993:                     candidate.display()
 994:                 ));
 995:             }
 996:         }
 997:     }
 998:     Err(format!(
 999:         "failed to create unique work dir for prefix {prefix}"
1000:     ))
1001: }

1003: fn base64_decode(input: &str) -> Result<Vec<u8>, String> {
1004:     let mut table = [0xFFu8; 256];
1005:     for (idx, ch) in b"ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
1006:         .iter()
1007:         .enumerate()
1008:     {
1009:         table[*ch as usize] = idx as u8;
1010:     }
1011:     let compact = input
1012:         .bytes()
1013:         .filter(|byte| !byte.is_ascii_whitespace())
1014:         .collect::<Vec<_>>();
1015:     if compact.len() % 4 != 0 {
1016:         return Err("invalid base64 length".to_string());
1017:     }
1018:     let mut output = Vec::with_capacity((compact.len() / 4) * 3);
1019:     let mut index = 0usize;
1020:     while index < compact.len() {
1021:         let c0 = compact[index];
1022:         let c1 = compact[index + 1];
1023:         let c2 = compact[index + 2];
1024:         let c3 = compact[index + 3];
1025:         if c0 == b'=' || c1 == b'=' {
1026:             return Err("invalid base64 padding".to_string());
1027:         }
1028:         let v0 = table[c0 as usize];
1029:         let v1 = table[c1 as usize];
1030:         if v0 == 0xFF || v1 == 0xFF {
1031:             return Err("invalid base64 character".to_string());
1032:         }
1033:         output.push((v0 << 2) | (v1 >> 4));
1034: 
1035:         let pad2 = c2 == b'=';
1036:         let pad3 = c3 == b'=';
1037:         if pad2 {
1038:             if !pad3 {
1039:                 return Err("invalid base64 padding".to_string());
1040:             }
1041:         } else {
1042:             let v2 = table[c2 as usize];
1043:             if v2 == 0xFF {
1044:                 return Err("invalid base64 character".to_string());
1045:             }
1046:             output.push((v1 << 4) | (v2 >> 2));
1047:             if !pad3 {
1048:                 let v3 = table[c3 as usize];
1049:                 if v3 == 0xFF {
1050:                     return Err("invalid base64 character".to_string());
1051:                 }
1052:                 output.push((v2 << 6) | v3);
1053:             }
1054:         }
1055: 
1056:         if (pad2 || pad3) && index + 4 != compact.len() {
1057:             return Err("invalid base64 padding".to_string());
1058:         }
1059:         index += 4;
1060:     }
1061:     Ok(output)
1062: }
1063: 
1064: fn hex_encode_lower(bytes: &[u8]) -> String {
1065:     let mut out = String::with_capacity(bytes.len() * 2);
1066:     for byte in bytes {
1067:         use std::fmt::Write as _;
1068:         let _ = write!(&mut out, "{byte:02x}");
1069:     }
1070:     out
1071: }

1074: pub fn run_cargo_ops(

1111: fn known_hosts_lookup_host(host: &str, port: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
1112:     if host.is_empty() {
1113:         return Err("known_hosts lookup host must not be empty".to_string());
1114:     }
1115:     if port.is_empty() || port == "22" {
1116:         Ok(host.to_string())
1117:     } else {
1118:         Ok(format!("[{host}]:{port}"))
1119:     }
1120: }

1122: fn ssh_g_value<'a>(resolved: &'a str, key: &str) -> Option<&'a str> {
1123:     resolved.lines().find_map(|line| {
1124:         let mut fields = line.split_whitespace();
1125:         match (fields.next(), fields.next()) {
1126:             (Some(found_key), Some(value)) if found_key == key => Some(value),
1127:             _ => None,
1128:         }
1129:     })
1130: }

1132: fn resolved_target_address_from_ssh_g(target: &str, resolved: &str) -> String {
1133:     ssh_g_value(resolved, "hostname")
1134:         .filter(|hostname| !hostname.is_empty() && *hostname != "none")
1135:         .unwrap_or_else(|| LiveLabContext::target_address(target))
1136:         .to_string()
1137: }

1139: fn resolved_known_hosts_candidates(target: &str, resolved: &str) -> Result<Vec<String>, String> {
1140:     let raw_host = LiveLabContext::target_address(target);
1141:     let port = ssh_g_value(resolved, "port").unwrap_or("22");
1142:     let mut lookup_candidates = Vec::new();
1143: 
1144:     if let Some(hostkeyalias) = ssh_g_value(resolved, "hostkeyalias")
1145:         && hostkeyalias != "none"
1146:     {
1147:         let lookup_host = known_hosts_lookup_host(hostkeyalias, port)?;
1148:         lookup_candidates.push(lookup_host);
1149:     }
1150: 
1151:     let raw_lookup = known_hosts_lookup_host(raw_host, port)?;
1152:     lookup_candidates.push(raw_lookup);
1153: 
1154:     if let Some(hostname) = ssh_g_value(resolved, "hostname") {
1155:         let lookup_host = known_hosts_lookup_host(hostname, port)?;
1156:         if !lookup_candidates.contains(&lookup_host) {
1157:             lookup_candidates.push(lookup_host);
1158:         }
1159:     }
1160: 
1161:     Ok(lookup_candidates)
1162: }

1164: #[allow(dead_code)]
1165: pub fn run_remote_shell(
1166:     ctx: &LiveLabContext,
1167:     target: &str,
1168:     shell_command: &str,
1169: ) -> Result<Output, String> {
1170:     if let Some(transport) = utm_transport_for_target(target) {
1171:         let output = utm_exec_output(&transport, shell_command)?;
1172:         if output.status.success() {
1173:             return Ok(output);
1174:         }
1175:         return Err(format!(
1176:             "remote shell command failed on {target}: {}",
1177:             String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).trim()
1178:         ));
1179:     }
1180:     let mut command = ctx.ssh_command(target);
1181:     command
1182:         .args(["sh", "-lc"])
1183:         .arg(shell_single_quote(shell_command))
1184:         .stdin(Stdio::null());
1185:     let output = command
1186:         .output()
1187:         .map_err(|err| format!("failed to run remote shell on {target}: {err}"))?;
1188:     if output.status.success() {
1189:         Ok(output)
1190:     } else {
1191:         Err(format!(
1192:             "remote shell command failed on {target}: {}",
1193:             String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).trim()
1194:         ))
1195:     }
1196: }

 273:             )

 275:                 eprintln!("{err}");
 276:                 1
 277:             })?;
 278:         let blocked_probe = ctx
 279:             .run_root(
 280:                 &probe_host,
 281:                 &[
 282:                     "rustynet",
 283:                     "ops",

 288:                     &dns_port,

 290:                     "blocked-probe.rustynet",

 299:         } else {

 302:     }

 305:     let captured_at_unix = now_unix();
 306:     let work_dir_string = ctx.work_dir.to_string_lossy().to_string();
 307:     let report_args = vec![
 308:         "--report-path".to_string(),
 309:         report_path.to_string_lossy().to_string(),
 310:         "--dns-bind-addr".to_string(),
 311:         dns_bind_addr.clone(),
 312:         "--remote-dns-probe-status".to_string(),
 313:         remote_dns_probe_status.clone(),
 314:         "--remote-dns-probe-output".to_string(),
 315:         remote_dns_probe_output.clone(),
 316:         "--work-dir".to_string(),
 317:         work_dir_string,
 318:         "--captured-at-utc".to_string(),
 319:         captured_at_utc,
 320:         "--captured-at-unix".to_string(),
 321:         captured_at_unix,
 322:     ];
 323:     let mut host_label_args = Vec::new();
 324:     for label in &host_labels {
 325:         host_label_args.push("--host-label".to_string());
 326:         host_label_args.push(label.clone());
 327:     }
 328:     let mut cargo_args = report_args;
 329:     cargo_args.extend(host_label_args);
 330:     let cargo_refs = cargo_args.iter().map(String::as_str).collect::<Vec<_>>();
 331:     let report_status = run_cargo_ops(
 332:         &ctx.root_dir,
 333:         "write-live-linux-control-surface-report",
 334:         &cargo_refs,
 335:     )
 336:     .map_err(|err| {
 337:         eprintln!("{err}");
 338:         1
 339:     })?;
 340: 
 341:     if report_status != "pass" {
 342:         eprintln!(
 343:             "control-surface exposure test failed; see {}",
 344:             report_path.display()
 345:         );
 346:         return Err(1);
 347:     }
 348: 
 349:     logger
 350:         .line(format!(
 351:             "Control-surface exposure report written: {}",
 352:             report_path.display()
 353:         ))
 354:         .map_err(|err| {
 355:             eprintln!("{err}");
 356:             1
 357:         })?;
 358:     Ok(())
 359: }
 360: 
 361: fn append_host(labels: &mut Vec<String>, targets: &mut Vec<String>, label: &str, target: &str) {
 362:     if !target.is_empty() {
 363:         labels.push(label.to_string());
 364:         targets.push(target.to_string());
 365:     }
 366: }
 367: 
 368: fn required_value(args: &[String], idx: usize, flag: &str) -> Result<String, i32> {
 369:     if idx >= args.len() {
 370:         eprintln!("missing value for {flag}");
 371:         return Err(2);
 372:     }
 373:     Ok(args[idx].clone())
 374: }
 375: 
 376: fn print_usage() {
 377:     println!(
 378:         "usage: live_linux_control_surface_exposure_test.sh --ssh-identity-file <path> --client-host <user@host> [options]"
 379:     );
 380: }
 381: 
 382: fn write_block(path: &PathBuf, contents: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
 383:     std::fs::write(path, contents)
 384:         .map_err(|err| format!("failed to write {}: {err}", path.display()))
 385: }
 386: 
 387: fn now_unix() -> String {
 388:     SystemTime::now()
 389:         .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
 390:         .map(|duration| duration.as_secs().to_string())
 391:         .unwrap_or_else(|_| "0".to_string())
 392: }
 393: 
 394: fn now_utc() -> String {
 395:     now_unix()
 396: }

 391:         baseline_endpoints.clone(),
 392:         "--status-after-hijack".to_string(),
 393:         status_after_hijack.clone(),
 394:         "--netcheck-after-hijack".to_string(),
 395:         netcheck_after_hijack.clone(),
 396:         "--endpoints-after-hijack".to_string(),
 397:         endpoints_after_hijack.clone(),
 398:         "--status-after-recovery".to_string(),
 399:         status_after_recovery.clone(),
 400:         "--endpoints-after-recovery".to_string(),
 401:         endpoints_after_recovery.clone(),
 402:         "--captured-at-utc".to_string(),
 403:         captured_at_utc,
 404:         "--captured-at-unix".to_string(),
 405:         captured_at_unix,
 406:     ];
 407:     let report_refs = report_args.iter().map(String::as_str).collect::<Vec<_>>();
 408:     let report_status = run_cargo_ops(
 409:         &ctx.root_dir,
 410:         "write-live-linux-endpoint-hijack-report",
 411:         &report_refs,
 412:     )
 413:     .map_err(|err| {
 414:         eprintln!("{err}");
 415:         1
 416:     })?;
 417:     if report_status != "pass" {
 418:         eprintln!("endpoint hijack test failed; see {}", report_path.display());
 419:         return Err(1);
 420:     }
 421: 
 422:     logger
 423:         .line(format!(
 424:             "Endpoint hijack report written: {}",
 425:             report_path.display()
 426:         ))
 427:         .map_err(|err| {
 428:             eprintln!("{err}");
 429:             1
 430:         })?;
 431:     Ok(())
 432: }
 433: 
 434: struct EndpointHijackRollback {
 435:     ctx: LiveLabContext,
 436:     client_host: String,
 437:     assignment_path: String,
 438:     backup_path: Option<String>,
 439:     watermark_path: String,
 440:     timer_was_active: bool,
 441: }
 442: 
 443: impl Drop for EndpointHijackRollback {
 444:     fn drop(&mut self) {
 445:         let Some(backup_path) = self.backup_path.as_ref() else {
 446:             return;
 447:         };
 448:         let _ = self.ctx.run_root_allow_failure(
 449:             &self.client_host,
 450:             &["cp", backup_path, &self.assignment_path],
 451:         );
 452:         let _ = self.ctx.run_root_allow_failure(
 453:             &self.client_host,
 454:             &["rm", "-f", backup_path, &self.watermark_path],
 455:         );
 456:         let _ = self.ctx.run_root_allow_failure(
 457:             &self.client_host,
 458:             &["systemctl", "restart", "rustynetd.service"],
 459:         );
 460:         if self.timer_was_active {
 461:             let _ = self.ctx.run_root_allow_failure(
 462:                 &self.client_host,
 463:                 &["systemctl", "start", "rustynetd-assignment-refresh.timer"],
 464:             );
 465:         }
 466:     }
 467: }
 468: 
 469: fn required_value(args: &[String], idx: usize, flag: &str) -> Result<String, i32> {
 470:     if idx >= args.len() {
 471:         eprintln!("missing value for {flag}");
 472:         return Err(2);
 473:     }
 474:     Ok(args[idx].clone())
 475: }
 476: 
 477: fn print_usage() {
 478:     println!(
 479:         "usage: live_linux_endpoint_hijack_test.sh --ssh-identity-file <path> --client-host <user@host> --rogue-endpoint-ip <ipv4> [options]"
 480:     );
 481: }
 482: 
 483: fn now_unix() -> String {
 484:     SystemTime::now()
 485:         .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
 486:         .map(|duration| duration.as_secs().to_string())
 487:         .unwrap_or_else(|_| "0".to_string())
 488: }
 489: 
 490: fn now_utc() -> String {
 491:     now_unix()
 492: }

 466:     // evidence fresh enough that re-enforce here doesn't re-trip the
 467:     // gate before the route advertise lands. That is fragile; a slower
 468:     // run, a reordered stage list, or an enforce_host implementation
 469:     // that wipes trust state would put us back in two_hop's pre-fix
 470:     // failure mode. Mirror the explicit refresh from
 471:     // live_linux_two_hop_test (commit cca0418) so the route advertise
 472:     // sees fresh trust independent of the orchestrator's stage timing.
 473:     logger.line("[exit-handoff] refreshing signed trust evidence on all nodes")?;
 474:     refresh_trust_evidence(
 475:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 476:         &work_known_hosts,
 477:         &config.exit_a_host,
 478:     )?;
 479:     refresh_trust_evidence(
 480:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 481:         &work_known_hosts,
 482:         &config.exit_b_host,
 483:     )?;
 484:     refresh_trust_evidence(
 485:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 486:         &work_known_hosts,
 487:         &config.client_host,
 488:     )?;
 489: 
 490:     logger.line("[exit-handoff] advertising default route on both exits")?;
 491:     run_root(
 492:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 493:         &work_known_hosts,
 494:         &config.exit_a_host,
 495:         "env RUSTYNET_DAEMON_SOCKET=/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock rustynet route advertise 0.0.0.0/0",
 496:     )?;
 497:     run_root(
 498:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 499:         &work_known_hosts,
 500:         &config.exit_b_host,
 501:         "env RUSTYNET_DAEMON_SOCKET=/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock rustynet route advertise 0.0.0.0/0",
 502:     )?;
 503:     pin_client_to_expected_exit(
 504:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 505:         &work_known_hosts,
 506:         &config.client_host,
 507:         &config.exit_a_node_id,
 508:     )?;
 509: 
 510:     wait_for_handoff_monitor_prereqs(
 511:         &mut logger,
 512:         &config,
 513:         &work_known_hosts,
 514:         &traversal_env,
 515:         &traversal_pub_local,
 516:         &exit_a_traversal_local,
 517:         &exit_b_traversal_local,
 518:         &client_traversal_local,
 519:         &dns_verifier_local,
 520:         &dns_records_by_node,
 521:         &dns_refresh_targets,
 522:         dns_passphrase_remote.as_str(),
 523:         &nodes_spec,
 524:         &allow_spec,
 525:     )?;
 526: 
 527:     let monitor_path = config.monitor_log.clone();
 528:     write_file(&monitor_path, "")?;
 529:     let mut switch_ts = 0u64;
 530:     let mut next_coordination_refresh_ts =
 531:         next_refresh_deadline(unix_now(), config.traversal_refresh_interval_secs);
 532:     for i in 1..=config.monitor_iterations {
 533:         let ts = unix_now();
 534:         if ts >= next_coordination_refresh_ts {
 535:             logger.line(
 536:                 "[exit-handoff] refreshing signed handoff coordination during handoff monitor",
 537:             )?;
 538:             refresh_handoff_coordination(
 539:                 &config.ssh_identity_file,
 540:                 &work_known_hosts,
 541:                 &config.exit_a_host,
 542:                 &config.exit_b_host,
 543:                 &config.client_host,
 544:                 &traversal_env,
 545:                 &traversal_pub_local,
 546:                 &exit_a_traversal_local,
 547:                 &exit_b_traversal_local,
 548:                 &client_traversal_local,
 549:                 &config.exit_a_node_id,
 550:                 &config.exit_b_node_id,
 551:                 &config.client_node_id,
 552:                 &dns_verifier_local,
 553:                 &dns_records_by_node,
 554:                 &dns_refresh_targets,
 555:                 dns_passphrase_remote.as_str(),
 556:                 &nodes_spec,
 557:                 &allow_spec,
 558:             )?;
 559:             wait_for_handoff_monitor_expected_exit(
 560:                 &mut logger,
 561:                 &config,
 562:                 &work_known_hosts,
 563:                 if switch_ts == 0 {
 564:                     &config.exit_a_node_id
 565:                 } else {
 566:                     &config.exit_b_node_id
 567:                 },
 568:             )?;
 569:             next_coordination_refresh_ts = advance_periodic_refresh_deadline(
 570:                 next_coordination_refresh_ts,
 571:                 config.traversal_refresh_interval_secs,
 572:                 unix_now(),
 573:             );
 574:         }
 575:         let client_status = status(
 576:             &config.ssh_identity_file,
 577:             &work_known_hosts,
 578:             &config.client_host,
 579:         )?;
 580:         let route_line = capture_root(
 581:             &config.ssh_identity_file,
 582:             &work_known_hosts,
 583:             &config.client_host,
 584:             "ip -4 route get 1.1.1.1 2>/dev/null | head -n1 || true",
 585:         )?;
 586:         let wg_endpoints = capture_root(
 587:             &config.ssh_identity_file,
 588:             &work_known_hosts,
 589:             &config.client_host,
 590:             "wg show rustynet0 endpoints 2>/dev/null || true",
 591:         )?;
 592:         let ping_rc = match live_lab_support::ssh_status(
 593:             &config.ssh_identity_file,
 594:             &work_known_hosts,
 595:             &config.client_host,
 596:             "ping -c 1 -W 1 1.1.1.1 >/dev/null 2>&1",
 597:         ) {
 598:             Ok(status) if status.success() => 0,
 599:             Ok(status) => live_lab_support::status_code(status),
 600:             Err(_) => 1,
 601:         };
 602:         append_monitor_line(
 603:             &monitor_path,
 604:             &format!(
 605:                 "{}|iter={}|ping_rc={}|route={}|status={}|wg_endpoints={}",
 606:                 ts,
 607:                 i,
 608:                 ping_rc,
 609:                 route_line.replace('\n', " "),
 610:                 client_status.replace('\n', " "),
 611:                 wg_endpoints.replace('\n', " ")
 612:             ),
 613:         )?;
 614:         if i == config.switch_iteration {
 615:             logger
 616:                 .line("[exit-handoff] refreshing signed handoff coordination before exit switch")?;
 617:             refresh_handoff_coordination(
 618:                 &config.ssh_identity_file,
 619:                 &work_known_hosts,
 620:                 &config.exit_a_host,
 621:                 &config.exit_b_host,
 622:                 &config.client_host,
 623:                 &traversal_env,
 624:                 &traversal_pub_local,
 625:                 &exit_a_traversal_local,
 626:                 &exit_b_traversal_local,
 627:                 &client_traversal_local,
 628:                 &config.exit_a_node_id,
 629:                 &config.exit_b_node_id,
 630:                 &config.client_node_id,
 631:                 &dns_verifier_local,
 632:                 &dns_records_by_node,
 633:                 &dns_refresh_targets,
 634:                 dns_passphrase_remote.as_str(),
 635:                 &nodes_spec,
 636:                 &allow_spec,
 637:             )?;
 638:             next_coordination_refresh_ts =
 639:                 next_refresh_deadline(unix_now(), config.traversal_refresh_interval_secs);
 640:             switch_ts = ts;
 641:             logger.line(
 642:                 format!(
 643:                     "[exit-handoff] switching client exit to {}",
 644:                     config.exit_b_node_id
 645:                 )
 646:                 .as_str(),
 647:             )?;
 648:             pin_client_to_expected_exit(
 649:                 &config.ssh_identity_file,
 650:                 &work_known_hosts,
 651:                 &config.client_host,
 652:                 &config.exit_b_node_id,
 653:             )?;
 654:         }
 655:         std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_secs(1));
 656:     }
 657: 
 658:     let client_status_final = status(
 659:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 660:         &work_known_hosts,
 661:         &config.client_host,
 662:     )?;
 663:     let exit_a_status_final = status(
 664:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 665:         &work_known_hosts,
 666:         &config.exit_a_host,
 667:     )?;
 668:     let exit_b_status_final = status(
 669:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 670:         &work_known_hosts,
 671:         &config.exit_b_host,
 672:     )?;
 673:     let client_route_final = capture_root(
 674:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 675:         &work_known_hosts,
 676:         &config.client_host,
 677:         "ip -4 route get 1.1.1.1 || true",
 678:     )?;
 679:     let client_wg_endpoints_final = capture_root(
 680:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 681:         &work_known_hosts,
 682:         &config.client_host,
 683:         "wg show rustynet0 endpoints || true",
 684:     )?;
 685:     let selected_exit_peer_endpoint_final =
 686:         status_field(&client_status_final, "selected_exit_peer_endpoint").unwrap_or("none");
 687:     let selected_exit_peer_endpoint_error =
 688:         status_field(&client_status_final, "selected_exit_peer_endpoint_error").unwrap_or("none");
 689:     let cleanup_dns_refresh_cmd = format!(
 690:         "rm -f {} {} {} {}",
 691:         shell_quote(dns_passphrase_remote.as_str()),
 692:         shell_quote(DNS_ZONE_RECORDS_REMOTE),
 693:         shell_quote(DNS_ZONE_VALID_BUNDLE_REMOTE),
 694:         shell_quote(DNS_ZONE_VERIFIER_REMOTE)
 695:     );
 696:     let _ = run_root(
 697:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 698:         &work_known_hosts,
 699:         &config.exit_a_host,
 700:         cleanup_dns_refresh_cmd.as_str(),
 701:     );
 702:     let cleanup_dns_issue_dir_cmd = format!(
 703:         "rmdir {} >/dev/null 2>&1 || true",
 704:         shell_quote(DNS_ZONE_ISSUE_DIR)
 705:     );
 706:     let _ = run_root(
 707:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 708:         &work_known_hosts,
 709:         &config.exit_a_host,
 710:         cleanup_dns_issue_dir_cmd.as_str(),
 711:     );
 712:     let exit_a_nft = capture_root(
 713:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 714:         &work_known_hosts,
 715:         &config.exit_a_host,
 716:         "nft list ruleset || true",
 717:     )?;
 718:     let exit_b_nft = capture_root(
 719:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 720:         &work_known_hosts,
 721:         &config.exit_b_host,
 722:         "nft list ruleset || true",
 723:     )?;
 724: 
 725:     logger.line("[exit-handoff] final client status")?;
 726:     logger.block(&(client_status_final.clone() + "\n"))?;
 727:     logger.line("[exit-handoff] final exit A status")?;
 728:     logger.block(&(exit_a_status_final.clone() + "\n"))?;
 729:     logger.line("[exit-handoff] final exit B status")?;
 730:     logger.block(&(exit_b_status_final.clone() + "\n"))?;
 731:     logger.line("[exit-handoff] final client route")?;
 732:     logger.block(&(client_route_final.clone() + "\n"))?;
 733:     logger.line("[exit-handoff] final client selected exit peer endpoint")?;
 734:     logger.block(&(selected_exit_peer_endpoint_final.to_string() + "\n"))?;
 735:     logger.line("[exit-handoff] final client wg endpoints (debug only)")?;
 736:     logger.block(&(client_wg_endpoints_final.clone() + "\n"))?;
 737: 
 738:     let monitor_text = read_file(&monitor_path)?;
 739:     let route_leak_count = monitor_text
 740:         .lines()
 741:         .filter(|line| !line.contains("route=") || !line.contains("dev rustynet0"))
 742:         .count();
 743:     let restricted_count = monitor_text
 744:         .lines()
 745:         .filter(|line| line.contains("restricted_safe_mode=true"))
 746:         .count();
 747:     let first_switch_ts = monitor_text.lines().find_map(|line| {
 748:         let mut parts = line.split('|');
 749:         let ts = parts.next()?.parse::<u64>().ok()?;
 750:         if ts < switch_ts {
 751:             return None;
 752:         }
 753:         if line.contains(&format!("exit_node={}", config.exit_b_node_id)) {
 754:             Some(ts)
 755:         } else {
 756:             None
 757:         }
 758:     });
 759:     let reconvergence_secs = first_switch_ts
 760:         .and_then(|value| value.checked_sub(switch_ts))
 761:         .map(|value| value as i64)
 762:         .unwrap_or(-1);
 763: 
 764:     let check_handoff_reconvergence = if (0..=30).contains(&reconvergence_secs) {
 765:         "pass"
 766:     } else {
 767:         "fail"
 768:     };
 769:     let check_no_route_leak = if route_leak_count == 0 {
 770:         "pass"
 771:     } else {
 772:         "fail"
 773:     };
 774:     let check_no_restricted_safe_mode = if restricted_count == 0 {
 775:         "pass"
 776:     } else {
 777:         "fail"
 778:     };
 779:     let check_exit_b_endpoint_visible = if selected_exit_peer_endpoint_error == "none"
 780:         && selected_exit_peer_endpoint_final == format!("{exit_b_addr}:51820")
 781:         && client_status_final.contains(&format!("exit_node={}", config.exit_b_node_id))
 782:     {
 783:         "pass"
 784:     } else {
 785:         "fail"
 786:     };
 787:     let check_both_exits_nat =
 788:         if exit_a_nft.contains("masquerade") && exit_b_nft.contains("masquerade") {
 789:             "pass"
 790:         } else {
 791:             "fail"
 792:         };
 793:     let check_managed_dns_fresh_all_nodes = if managed_dns_state_is_valid(&client_status_final)
 794:         && managed_dns_state_is_valid(&exit_a_status_final)
 795:         && managed_dns_state_is_valid(&exit_b_status_final)
 796:     {
 797:         "pass"
 798:     } else {
 799:         "fail"
 800:     };
 801: 
 802:     let overall = [
 803:         check_handoff_reconvergence,
 804:         check_no_route_leak,
 805:         check_no_restricted_safe_mode,
 806:         check_exit_b_endpoint_visible,
 807:         check_both_exits_nat,
 808:         check_managed_dns_fresh_all_nodes,
 809:     ]
 810:     .into_iter()
 811:     .all(|value| value == "pass");
 812: 
 813:     let captured_at_utc = utc_now_string();
 814:     let captured_at_unix = unix_now();
 815:     let git_commit = config.git_commit.unwrap_or_else(|| {
 816:         git_head_commit(&root_dir).unwrap_or_else(|err| {
 817:             eprintln!("{err}");
 818:             std::process::exit(1);
 819:         })
 820:     });
 821: 
 822:     let report = format!(
 823: /* ELIDED: original line had 76 backslash-quote sequences — removed to avoid DeepSeek parser failure */
 824:         captured_at_utc,
 825:         captured_at_unix,
 826:         git_commit,
 827:         if overall { "pass" } else { "fail" },
 828:         config.exit_a_host,
 829:         config.exit_b_host,
 830:         config.client_host,
 831:         config.switch_iteration,
 832:         config.monitor_iterations,
 833:         reconvergence_secs,
 834:         check_handoff_reconvergence,
 835:         check_no_route_leak,
 836:         check_no_restricted_safe_mode,
 837:         check_exit_b_endpoint_visible,
 838:         check_both_exits_nat,
 839:         check_managed_dns_fresh_all_nodes,
 840:         config.log_path.display(),
 841:         config.monitor_log.display(),
 842:     );
 843:     write_file(&config.report_path, &report)?;
 844:     logger.line(
 845:         format!(
 846:             "[exit-handoff] report written: {}",
 847:             config.report_path.display()
 848:         )
 849:         .as_str(),
 850:     )?;
 851:     if !overall {
 852:         return Err("exit-handoff validation failed".to_string());
 853:     }
 854:     Ok(())
 855: }
 856: 
 857: #[derive(Debug)]
 858: struct Config {
 859:     ssh_identity_file: PathBuf,
 860:     exit_a_host: String,
 861:     exit_b_host: String,
 862:     client_host: String,
 863:     exit_a_node_id: String,
 864:     exit_b_node_id: String,
 865:     client_node_id: String,
 866:     ssh_allow_cidrs: String,
 867:     switch_iteration: usize,
 868:     monitor_iterations: usize,
 869:     traversal_ttl_secs: u64,
 870:     traversal_refresh_interval_secs: u64,
 871:     report_path: PathBuf,
 872:     log_path: PathBuf,
 873:     monitor_log: PathBuf,
 874:     pinned_known_hosts_file: Option<PathBuf>,
 875:     git_commit: Option<String>,
 876: }
 877: 
 878: impl Config {
 879:     fn parse(args: Vec<String>) -> Result<Self, String> {
 880:         let mut config = Self {
 881:             ssh_identity_file: PathBuf::new(),
 882:             exit_a_host: "debian@192.168.18.49".to_string(),
 883:             exit_b_host: "mint@192.168.18.53".to_string(),
 884:             client_host: "debian@192.168.18.65".to_string(),
 885:             exit_a_node_id: "exit-49".to_string(),
 886:             exit_b_node_id: "client-53".to_string(),
 887:             client_node_id: "client-65".to_string(),
 888:             ssh_allow_cidrs: "192.168.18.0/24".to_string(),
 889:             switch_iteration: 20,
 890:             monitor_iterations: 55,
 891:             traversal_ttl_secs: 120,
 892:             traversal_refresh_interval_secs: 60,
 893:             report_path: PathBuf::from("artifacts/phase10/live_linux_exit_handoff_report.json"),
 894:             log_path: PathBuf::from("artifacts/phase10/source/live_linux_exit_handoff.log"),
 895:             monitor_log: PathBuf::from(
 896:                 "artifacts/phase10/source/live_linux_exit_handoff_monitor.log",
 897:             ),
 898:             pinned_known_hosts_file: None,
 899:             git_commit: None,
 900:         };
 901: 
 902:         let mut iter = args.into_iter();
 903:         while let Some(arg) = iter.next() {
 904:             match arg.as_str() {
 905:                 "--ssh-identity-file" => {
 906:                     config.ssh_identity_file = PathBuf::from(next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?)
 907:                 }
 908:                 "--exit-a-host" => config.exit_a_host = next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?,
 909:                 "--exit-b-host" => config.exit_b_host = next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?,
 910:                 "--client-host" => config.client_host = next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?,
 911:                 "--exit-a-node-id" => config.exit_a_node_id = next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?,
 912:                 "--exit-b-node-id" => config.exit_b_node_id = next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?,
 913:                 "--client-node-id" => config.client_node_id = next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?,
 914:                 "--ssh-allow-cidrs" => config.ssh_allow_cidrs = next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?,
 915:                 "--switch-iteration" => {
 916:                     config.switch_iteration = next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?
 917:                         .parse()
 918:                         .map_err(|_| "switch iteration must be a positive integer".to_string())?
 919:                 }
 920:                 "--monitor-iterations" => {
 921:                     config.monitor_iterations = next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?
 922:                         .parse()
 923:                         .map_err(|_| "monitor iterations must be a positive integer".to_string())?
 924:                 }
 925:                 "--traversal-ttl-secs" => {
 926:                     config.traversal_ttl_secs = next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?
 927:                         .parse()
 928:                         .map_err(|_| "traversal ttl seconds must be an integer".to_string())?
 929:                 }
 930:                 "--report-path" => config.report_path = PathBuf::from(next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?),
 931:                 "--log-path" => config.log_path = PathBuf::from(next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?),
 932:                 "--monitor-log" => config.monitor_log = PathBuf::from(next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?),
 933:                 "--known-hosts" => {
 934:                     config.pinned_known_hosts_file =
 935:                         Some(PathBuf::from(next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?))
 936:                 }
 937:                 "--git-commit" => config.git_commit = Some(next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?),
 938:                 "-h" | "--help" => {
 939:                     print_usage();
 940:                     std::process::exit(0);
 941:                 }
 942:                 unknown => return Err(format!("unknown argument: {unknown}")),
 943:             }
 944:         }
 945: 
 946:         if config.ssh_identity_file.as_os_str().is_empty() {
 947:             return Err(
 948:                 "usage: live_linux_exit_handoff_test --ssh-identity-file <path> [options]"
 949:                     .to_string(),
 950:             );
 951:         }
 952:         validate_positive_integer("switch iteration", config.switch_iteration)?;
 953:         validate_positive_integer("monitor iterations", config.monitor_iterations)?;
 954:         if config.traversal_ttl_secs == 0 || config.traversal_ttl_secs > 120 {
 955:             return Err("traversal ttl seconds must be in the range 1..=120".to_string());
 956:         }
 957:         config.traversal_refresh_interval_secs =
 958:             traversal_refresh_interval_secs(config.traversal_ttl_secs);
 959:         for (label, value) in [
 960:             ("exit-a-host", config.exit_a_host.as_str()),
 961:             ("exit-b-host", config.exit_b_host.as_str()),
 962:             ("client-host", config.client_host.as_str()),
 963:             ("exit-a-node-id", config.exit_a_node_id.as_str()),
 964:             ("exit-b-node-id", config.exit_b_node_id.as_str()),
 965:             ("client-node-id", config.client_node_id.as_str()),
 966:             ("ssh-allow-cidrs", config.ssh_allow_cidrs.as_str()),
 967:         ] {
 968:             ensure_safe_token(label, value)?;
 969:         }
 970:         Ok(config)
 971:     }
 972: }
 973: 
 974: fn traversal_refresh_interval_secs(traversal_ttl_secs: u64) -> u64 {
 975:     let coordination_ttl_secs = traversal_ttl_secs.min(MAX_TRAVERSAL_COORDINATION_TTL_SECS);
 976:     std::cmp::max(1, coordination_ttl_secs / 2)
 977: }
 978: 
 979: fn next_refresh_deadline(now: u64, interval_secs: u64) -> u64 {
 980:     now.saturating_add(std::cmp::max(1, interval_secs))
 981: }
 982: 
 983: fn advance_periodic_refresh_deadline(previous_deadline: u64, interval_secs: u64, now: u64) -> u64 {
 984:     let interval_secs = std::cmp::max(1, interval_secs);
 985:     let mut next_deadline = previous_deadline.saturating_add(interval_secs);
 986:     while next_deadline <= now {
 987:         let advanced = next_deadline.saturating_add(interval_secs);
 988:         if advanced == next_deadline {
 989:             break;
 990:         }
 991:         next_deadline = advanced;
 992:     }
 993:     next_deadline
 994: }
 995: 
 996: fn status_field<'a>(status: &'a str, key: &str) -> Option<&'a str> {
 997:     let prefix = format!("{key}=");
 998:     status
 999:         .split_whitespace()
1000:         .find_map(|field| field.strip_prefix(prefix.as_str()))
1001: }

1009:     client_host: &str,

1077:     refresh_signed_state(identity, known_hosts, client_host)?;

1099: #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
1100: fn refresh_handoff_coordination(
1101:     identity: &Path,
1102:     known_hosts: &Path,
1103:     signer_host: &str,
1104:     exit_b_host: &str,
1105:     client_host: &str,
1106:     traversal_env: &Path,
1107:     traversal_pub_local: &Path,
1108:     exit_a_traversal_local: &Path,
1109:     exit_b_traversal_local: &Path,
1110:     client_traversal_local: &Path,
1111:     exit_a_node_id: &str,
1112:     exit_b_node_id: &str,
1113:     client_node_id: &str,
1114:     verifier_local: &Path,
1115:     records_by_node: &HashMap<String, String>,
1116:     refresh_targets: &[ManagedDnsRefreshTarget],
1117:     passphrase_remote: &str,
1118:     nodes_spec: &str,
1119:     allow_spec: &str,
1120: ) -> Result<(), String> {
1121:     refresh_traversal_bundles(
1122:         identity,
1123:         known_hosts,
1124:         signer_host,
1125:         exit_b_host,
1126:         client_host,
1127:         traversal_env,
1128:         traversal_pub_local,
1129:         exit_a_traversal_local,
1130:         exit_b_traversal_local,
1131:         client_traversal_local,
1132:         exit_a_node_id,
1133:         exit_b_node_id,
1134:         client_node_id,
1135:     )?;
1136:     refresh_dns_bundles(
1137:         identity,
1138:         known_hosts,
1139:         signer_host,
1140:         nodes_spec,
1141:         allow_spec,
1142:         passphrase_remote,
1143:         verifier_local,
1144:         records_by_node,
1145:         refresh_targets,
1146:     )?;
1147:     for target in refresh_targets {
1148:         // Keep trust evidence fresh immediately before the strict signed-state refresh.
1149:         refresh_trust_evidence(identity, known_hosts, target.host.as_str())?;
1150:         refresh_signed_state(identity, known_hosts, target.host.as_str())?;
1151:     }
1152:     Ok(())
1153: }
1154: 
1155: #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
1156: fn refresh_dns_bundles(
1157:     identity: &Path,
1158:     known_hosts: &Path,
1159:     signer_host: &str,
1160:     nodes_spec: &str,
1161:     allow_spec: &str,
1162:     passphrase_remote: &str,
1163:     verifier_local: &Path,
1164:     records_by_node: &HashMap<String, String>,
1165:     refresh_targets: &[ManagedDnsRefreshTarget],
1166: ) -> Result<(), String> {
1167:     if refresh_targets.is_empty() {
1168:         return Err("managed DNS refresh requires at least one target".to_string());
1169:     }
1170:     let mut verifier_captured = false;
1171:     for target in refresh_targets {
1172:         let records_manifest = records_by_node.get(&target.node_id).ok_or_else(|| {
1173:             format!(
1174:                 "missing scoped DNS records for exit handoff node {}",
1175:                 target.node_id
1176:             )
1177:         })?;
1178:         write_file(target.records_local.as_path(), records_manifest)?;
1179:         let records_remote = format!(
1180:             "/tmp/rn-exit-handoff-dns-records-{}.manifest",
1181:             target.node_id
1182:         );
1183:         scp_to(
1184:             identity,
1185:             known_hosts,
1186:             target.records_local.as_path(),
1187:             signer_host,
1188:             records_remote.as_str(),
1189:         )?;
1190:         let issue_cmd = format!(
1191:             "rustynet dns zone issue --signing-secret /etc/rustynet/membership.owner.key --signing-secret-passphrase-file {} --subject-node-id {} --nodes {} --allow {} --zone-name {} --records-manifest {} --output {} --verifier-key-output {}",
1192:             shell_quote(passphrase_remote),
1193:             shell_quote(target.node_id.as_str()),
1194:             shell_quote(nodes_spec),
1195:             shell_quote(allow_spec),
1196:             shell_quote(DNS_ZONE_NAME),
1197:             shell_quote(records_remote.as_str()),
1198:             shell_quote(DNS_ZONE_VALID_BUNDLE_REMOTE),
1199:             shell_quote(DNS_ZONE_VERIFIER_REMOTE),
1200:         );
1201:         run_root(identity, known_hosts, signer_host, issue_cmd.as_str())?;
1202:         let cleanup_cmd = format!("rm -f {}", shell_quote(records_remote.as_str()));
1203:         run_root(identity, known_hosts, signer_host, cleanup_cmd.as_str())?;
1204:         if !verifier_captured {
1205:             capture_root_file_to_local(
1206:                 identity,
1207:                 known_hosts,
1208:                 signer_host,
1209:                 DNS_ZONE_VERIFIER_REMOTE,
1210:                 verifier_local,
1211:             )?;
1212:             verifier_captured = true;
1213:         }
1214:         capture_root_file_to_local(
1215:             identity,
1216:             known_hosts,
1217:             signer_host,
1218:             DNS_ZONE_VALID_BUNDLE_REMOTE,
1219:             target.bundle_local.as_path(),
1220:         )?;
1221:         install_dns_bundle(
1222:             identity,
1223:             known_hosts,
1224:             target.host.as_str(),
1225:             verifier_local,
1226:             target.bundle_local.as_path(),
1227:         )?;
1228:     }
1229:     Ok(())
1230: }
