1284: fn handoff_runtime_ready(status: &str) -> bool {
1285:     status_field(status, "restricted_safe_mode") == Some("false")
1286:         && status_field(status, "bootstrap_error") == Some("none")
1287:         && status_field(status, "last_reconcile_error") == Some("none")
1288:         && status_field(status, "state") != Some("FailClosed")
1289: }
1290: 
1291: fn route_uses_rustynet0(route: &str) -> bool {
1292:     route.contains("dev rustynet0")
1293: }
1294: 
1295: fn handoff_monitor_prereqs_ready(
1296:     client_status: &str,
1297:     exit_a_status: &str,
1298:     exit_b_status: &str,
1299:     client_route: &str,
1300:     exit_a_node_id: &str,
1301: ) -> bool {
1302:     status_field(client_status, "exit_node") == Some(exit_a_node_id)
1303:         && route_uses_rustynet0(client_route)
1304:         && handoff_runtime_ready(client_status)
1305:         && managed_dns_state_is_valid(client_status)
1306:         && managed_dns_state_is_valid(exit_a_status)
1307:         && managed_dns_state_is_valid(exit_b_status)
1308: }
1309: 
1310: fn wait_for_handoff_monitor_expected_exit(
1311:     logger: &mut Logger,
1312:     config: &Config,
1313:     known_hosts: &Path,
1314:     expected_exit_node_id: &str,
1315: ) -> Result<(), String> {
1316:     logger.line(
1317:         format!(
1318:             "[exit-handoff] waiting for protected-route convergence after coordination refresh on {}",
1319:             expected_exit_node_id
1320:         )
1321:         .as_str(),
1322:     )?;
1323:     pin_client_to_expected_exit(
1324:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
1325:         known_hosts,
1326:         &config.client_host,
1327:         expected_exit_node_id,
1328:     )?;
1329:     let start_ts = unix_now();
1330:     let mut last_client_status = String::new();
1331:     let mut last_exit_a_status = String::new();
1332:     let mut last_exit_b_status = String::new();
1333:     let mut last_client_route = String::new();
1334: 
1335:     while unix_now().saturating_sub(start_ts) < HANDOFF_REFRESH_CONVERGENCE_TIMEOUT_SECS {
1336:         last_client_status = status(&config.ssh_identity_file, known_hosts, &config.client_host)?;
1337:         last_exit_a_status = status(&config.ssh_identity_file, known_hosts, &config.exit_a_host)?;
1338:         last_exit_b_status = status(&config.ssh_identity_file, known_hosts, &config.exit_b_host)?;
1339:         last_client_route = capture_root(
1340:             &config.ssh_identity_file,
1341:             known_hosts,
1342:             &config.client_host,
1343:             "ip -4 route get 1.1.1.1 2>/dev/null | head -n1 || true",
1344:         )?;
1345: 
1346:         if handoff_monitor_prereqs_ready(
1347:             &last_client_status,
1348:             &last_exit_a_status,
1349:             &last_exit_b_status,
1350:             &last_client_route,
1351:             expected_exit_node_id,
1352:         ) {
1353:             return Ok(());
1354:         }
1355: 
1356:         std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_secs(1));
1357:     }
1358: 
1359:     Err(format!(
1360:         "exit handoff protected-route convergence did not recover after coordination refresh within {}s for {}: client_route={} client_status={} exit_a_status={} exit_b_status={}",
1361:         HANDOFF_REFRESH_CONVERGENCE_TIMEOUT_SECS,
1362:         expected_exit_node_id,
1363:         last_client_route.replace('\n', " "),
1364:         last_client_status.replace('\n', " "),
1365:         last_exit_a_status.replace('\n', " "),
1366:         last_exit_b_status.replace('\n', " "),
1367:     ))
1368: }
1369: 
1370: #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
1371: fn wait_for_handoff_monitor_prereqs(
1372:     logger: &mut Logger,
1373:     config: &Config,
1374:     known_hosts: &Path,
1375:     traversal_env: &Path,
1376:     traversal_pub_local: &Path,
1377:     exit_a_traversal_local: &Path,
1378:     exit_b_traversal_local: &Path,
1379:     client_traversal_local: &Path,
1380:     dns_verifier_local: &Path,
1381:     dns_records_by_node: &HashMap<String, String>,
1382:     dns_refresh_targets: &[ManagedDnsRefreshTarget],
1383:     dns_passphrase_remote: &str,
1384:     nodes_spec: &str,
1385:     allow_spec: &str,
1386: ) -> Result<(), String> {
1387:     logger.line(
1388:         "[exit-handoff] waiting for baseline exit route and managed DNS freshness before monitor",
1389:     )?;
1390:     pin_client_to_expected_exit(
1391:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
1392:         known_hosts,
1393:         &config.client_host,
1394:         &config.exit_a_node_id,
1395:     )?;
1396:     let start_ts = unix_now();
1397:     let mut next_coordination_refresh_ts =
1398:         next_refresh_deadline(start_ts, config.traversal_refresh_interval_secs);
1399:     let mut last_client_status = String::new();
1400:     let mut last_exit_a_status = String::new();
1401:     let mut last_exit_b_status = String::new();
1402:     let mut last_client_route = String::new();
1403: 
1404:     while unix_now().saturating_sub(start_ts) < HANDOFF_PRE_MONITOR_TIMEOUT_SECS {
1405:         let ts = unix_now();
1406:         if ts >= next_coordination_refresh_ts {
1407:             logger.line(
1408:                 "[exit-handoff] refreshing signed handoff coordination during pre-monitor convergence",
1409:             )?;
1410:             refresh_handoff_coordination(
1411:                 &config.ssh_identity_file,
1412:                 known_hosts,
1413:                 &config.exit_a_host,
1414:                 &config.exit_b_host,
1415:                 &config.client_host,
1416:                 traversal_env,
1417:                 traversal_pub_local,
1418:                 exit_a_traversal_local,
1419:                 exit_b_traversal_local,
1420:                 client_traversal_local,
1421:                 &config.exit_a_node_id,
1422:                 &config.exit_b_node_id,
1423:                 &config.client_node_id,
1424:                 dns_verifier_local,
1425:                 dns_records_by_node,
1426:                 dns_refresh_targets,
1427:                 dns_passphrase_remote,
1428:                 nodes_spec,
1429:                 allow_spec,
1430:             )?;
1431:             pin_client_to_expected_exit(
1432:                 &config.ssh_identity_file,
1433:                 known_hosts,
1434:                 &config.client_host,
1435:                 &config.exit_a_node_id,
1436:             )?;
1437:             next_coordination_refresh_ts = advance_periodic_refresh_deadline(
1438:                 next_coordination_refresh_ts,
1439:                 config.traversal_refresh_interval_secs,
1440:                 unix_now(),
1441:             );
1442:         }
1443: 
1444:         last_client_status = status(&config.ssh_identity_file, known_hosts, &config.client_host)?;
1445:         last_exit_a_status = status(&config.ssh_identity_file, known_hosts, &config.exit_a_host)?;
1446:         last_exit_b_status = status(&config.ssh_identity_file, known_hosts, &config.exit_b_host)?;
1447:         last_client_route = capture_root(
1448:             &config.ssh_identity_file,
1449:             known_hosts,
1450:             &config.client_host,
1451:             "ip -4 route get 1.1.1.1 2>/dev/null | head -n1 || true",
1452:         )?;
1453: 
1454:         if handoff_monitor_prereqs_ready(
1455:             &last_client_status,
1456:             &last_exit_a_status,
1457:             &last_exit_b_status,
1458:             &last_client_route,
1459:             &config.exit_a_node_id,
1460:         ) {
1461:             return Ok(());
1462:         }
1463: 
1464:         std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_secs(1));
1465:     }
1466: 
1467:     Err(format!(
1468:         "exit handoff baseline did not converge before monitor within {}s: client_route={} client_status={} exit_a_status={} exit_b_status={}",
1469:         HANDOFF_PRE_MONITOR_TIMEOUT_SECS,
1470:         last_client_route.replace('\n', " "),
1471:         last_client_status.replace('\n', " "),
1472:         last_exit_a_status.replace('\n', " "),
1473:         last_exit_b_status.replace('\n', " "),
1474:     ))
1475: }

1477: #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
1478: struct AssignmentAuthorityScope {
1479:     node_id: String,
1480:     peer_node_ids: Vec<String>,
1481: }
1482: 
1483: #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
1484: struct ManagedDnsRecordTemplate {
1485:     label: String,
1486:     target_node_id: String,
1487:     ttl_secs: u64,
1488:     aliases: Vec<String>,
1489: }
1490: 
1491: fn managed_dns_base_records(
1492:     signer_node_id: &str,
1493:     client_node_id: &str,
1494: ) -> Vec<ManagedDnsRecordTemplate> {
1495:     vec![
1496:         ManagedDnsRecordTemplate {
1497:             label: DNS_MANAGED_LABEL.to_string(),
1498:             target_node_id: signer_node_id.to_string(),
1499:             ttl_secs: 300,
1500:             aliases: vec![DNS_MANAGED_ALIAS.to_string()],
1501:         },
1502:         ManagedDnsRecordTemplate {
1503:             label: "client".to_string(),
1504:             target_node_id: client_node_id.to_string(),
1505:             ttl_secs: 300,
1506:             aliases: Vec::new(),
1507:         },
1508:     ]
1509: }
1510: 
1511: fn managed_dns_records_manifest_for_scope(
1512:     records: &[ManagedDnsRecordTemplate],
1513:     scope: &AssignmentAuthorityScope,
1514: ) -> Result<String, String> {
1515:     let allowed_targets = scope.peer_node_ids.iter().cloned().collect::<HashSet<_>>();
1516:     let filtered = records
1517:         .iter()
1518:         .filter(|record| {
1519:             record.target_node_id == scope.node_id
1520:                 || allowed_targets.contains(&record.target_node_id)
1521:         })
1522:         .cloned()
1523:         .collect::<Vec<_>>();
1524:     if filtered.is_empty() {
1525:         return Err(format!(
1526:             "managed DNS scope for {} produced no policy-authorized records",
1527:             scope.node_id
1528:         ));
1529:     }
1530:     let mut manifest = String::new();
1531:     manifest.push_str("version=1\n");
1532:     manifest.push_str(&format!("record_count={}\n", filtered.len()));
1533:     for (index, record) in filtered.iter().enumerate() {
1534:         manifest.push_str(&format!("record.{index}.label={}\n", record.label));
1535:         manifest.push_str(&format!(
1536:             "record.{index}.target_node_id={}\n",
1537:             record.target_node_id
1538:         ));
1539:         manifest.push_str(&format!("record.{index}.ttl_secs={}\n", record.ttl_secs));
1540:         manifest.push_str(&format!(
1541:             "record.{index}.alias_count={}\n",
1542:             record.aliases.len()
1543:         ));
1544:         for (alias_index, alias) in record.aliases.iter().enumerate() {
1545:             manifest.push_str(&format!("record.{index}.alias.{alias_index}={alias}\n"));
1546:         }
1547:     }
1548:     Ok(manifest)
1549: }
1550: 
1551: fn parse_assignment_authority_scope(bundle: &str) -> Result<AssignmentAuthorityScope, String> {
1552:     let mut node_id = None;
1553:     let mut peer_node_ids = Vec::new();
1554:     for line in bundle.lines() {
1555:         if let Some(value) = line.strip_prefix("node_id=") {
1556:             let trimmed = value.trim();
1557:             if trimmed.is_empty() {
1558:                 return Err("assignment bundle node_id must not be empty".to_string());
1559:             }
1560:             node_id = Some(trimmed.to_string());
1561:             continue;
1562:         }
1563:         if let Some((prefix, value)) = line.split_once('=')
1564:             && prefix.starts_with("peer.")
1565:             && prefix.ends_with(".node_id")
1566:         {
1567:             let trimmed = value.trim();
1568:             if trimmed.is_empty() {
1569:                 return Err(format!(
1570:                     "assignment bundle peer id must not be empty: {prefix}"
1571:                 ));
1572:             }
1573:             peer_node_ids.push(trimmed.to_string());
1574:         }
1575:     }
1576:     peer_node_ids.sort();
1577:     peer_node_ids.dedup();
1578:     Ok(AssignmentAuthorityScope {
1579:         node_id: node_id.ok_or_else(|| "assignment bundle is missing node_id".to_string())?,
1580:         peer_node_ids,
1581:     })
1582: }

1734:         .create(true)
1735:         .append(true)
1736:         .open(path)
1737:         .map_err(|err| format!("open monitor log failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
1738:     writeln!(file, "{line}").map_err(|err| format!("write monitor log failed: {err}"))
1739: }

1749: fn validate_identity(path: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
1750:     if !path.is_file() {
1751:         return Err(format!("missing ssh identity file: {}", path.display()));
1752:     }
1753:     if path.is_symlink() {
1754:         return Err(format!(
1755:             "ssh identity file must not be a symlink: {}",
1756:             path.display()
1757:         ));
1758:     }
1759:     Ok(())
1760: }

1773: fn utc_now_string() -> String {
1774:     let output = std::process::Command::new("date")
1775:         .args(["-u", "+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"])
1776:         .output()
1777:         .ok();
1778:     if let Some(output) = output
1779:         && output.status.success()
1780:     {
1781:         let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).trim().to_string();
1782:         if !text.is_empty() {
1783:             return text;
1784:         }
1785:     }
1786:     "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z".to_string()
1787: }

2008:             .expect("source should refresh trust evidence inside handoff coordination");
2009:         let state_idx = source
2010:             .find("refresh_signed_state(identity, known_hosts, target.host.as_str())")
2011:             .expect("source should refresh signed state inside handoff coordination");
2012:         assert!(
2013:             trust_idx < state_idx,
2014:             "trust refresh must happen before signed state refresh in handoff coordination"

  25: #[derive(Clone, Copy)]
  26: struct DnsRefreshTarget<'a> {
  27:     host: &'a str,
  28:     node_id: &'a str,
  29:     records_local: &'a Path,
  30:     bundle_local: &'a Path,
  31: }
  32: 
  33: #[derive(Clone, Copy)]
  34: struct DnsRefreshConfig<'a> {
  35:     signer_host: &'a str,
  36:     dns_verifier_local: &'a Path,
  37:     passphrase_remote: &'a str,
  38:     nodes_spec: &'a str,
  39:     allow_spec: &'a str,
  40:     targets: &'a [DnsRefreshTarget<'a>],
  41: }
  42: 
  43: /// Assignment bundle issuance is repeated during the convergence loop so that
  44: /// `rustynet state refresh` calls on nodes never see a stale assignment bundle.
  45: /// The daemon enforces `auto_tunnel_max_age_secs = 300` (5 min); without
  46: /// periodic re-issuance the LAN-toggle stage would exceed that window.
  47: #[derive(Clone, Copy)]
  48: struct AssignmentRefreshConfig<'a> {
  49:     signer_host: &'a str,
  50:     exit_host: &'a str,
  51:     client_host: &'a str,
  52:     blind_exit_host: &'a str,
  53:     env_local: &'a Path,
  54:     assign_pub_local: &'a Path,
  55:     exit_assignment_local: &'a Path,
  56:     client_assignment_local: &'a Path,
  57:     blind_exit_assignment_local: &'a Path,
  58:     exit_node_id: &'a str,
  59:     client_node_id: &'a str,
  60:     blind_exit_node_id: &'a str,
  61: }
  62: 
  63: #[derive(Clone, Copy)]
  64: struct SignedStateRefreshConfig<'a> {
  65:     assignment: AssignmentRefreshConfig<'a>,
  66:     traversal: TraversalRefreshConfig<'a>,
  67:     dns: DnsRefreshConfig<'a>,
  68: }
  69:

  71: struct AssignmentAuthorityScope {
  72:     node_id: String,
  73:     peer_node_ids: Vec<String>,
  74: }

  79:     target_node_id: String,

  98: fn main() {
  99:     let code = match run() {
 100:         Ok(()) => 0,
 101:         Err(code) => code,
 102:     };
 103:     std::process::exit(code);
 104: }
 105: 
 106: fn run() -> Result<(), i32> {
 107:     let root_dir = repo_root().map_err(|err| {
 108:         eprintln!("{err}");
 109:         1
 110:     })?;
 111:     let args = std::env::args().skip(1).collect::<Vec<_>>();
 112:     let mut exit_host = String::from("debian@192.168.18.49");
 113:     let mut client_host = String::from("debian@192.168.18.65");
 114:     let mut blind_exit_host = String::from("fedora@192.168.18.51");
 115:     let mut exit_node_id = String::from("exit-49");
 116:     let mut client_node_id = String::from("client-65");
 117:     let mut blind_exit_node_id = String::from("client-51");

 119:     let mut ssh_identity_file = String::new();
 120:     let mut report_path = root_dir.join("artifacts/phase10/live_linux_lan_toggle_report.json");
 121:     let mut log_path = root_dir.join("artifacts/phase10/source/live_linux_lan_toggle.log");
 122: 
 123:     let mut idx = 0usize;
 124:     while idx < args.len() {
 125:         match args[idx].as_str() {
 126:             "--ssh-identity-file" => {

 128:                 ssh_identity_file = required_value(&args, idx, "--ssh-identity-file")?;
 129:             }
 130:             "--exit-host" => {
 131:                 idx += 1;
 132:                 exit_host = required_value(&args, idx, "--exit-host")?;
 133:             }
 134:             "--client-host" => {
 135:                 idx += 1;
 136:                 client_host = required_value(&args, idx, "--client-host")?;
 137:             }
 138:             "--blind-exit-host" => {
 139:                 idx += 1;
 140:                 blind_exit_host = required_value(&args, idx, "--blind-exit-host")?;
 141:             }
 142:             "--exit-node-id" => {
 143:                 idx += 1;
 144:                 exit_node_id = required_value(&args, idx, "--exit-node-id")?;
 145:             }
 146:             "--client-node-id" => {
 147:                 idx += 1;
 148:                 client_node_id = required_value(&args, idx, "--client-node-id")?;
 149:             }
 150:             "--blind-exit-node-id" => {
 151:                 idx += 1;
 152:                 blind_exit_node_id = required_value(&args, idx, "--blind-exit-node-id")?;
 153:             }
 154:             "--ssh-allow-cidrs" => {
 155:                 idx += 1;
 156:                 ssh_allow_cidrs = required_value(&args, idx, "--ssh-allow-cidrs")?;
 157:             }
 158:             "--report-path" => {
 159:                 idx += 1;
 160:                 report_path = PathBuf::from(required_value(&args, idx, "--report-path")?);
 161:             }
 162:             "--log-path" => {
 163:                 idx += 1;
 164:                 log_path = PathBuf::from(required_value(&args, idx, "--log-path")?);
 165:             }
 166:             "-h" | "--help" => {
 167:                 print_usage();

 169:             }

 171:                 eprintln!("unknown argument: {other}");

 174:             }

 177:     }

 404:     let blind_exit_dns_records_local = ctx.work_dir.join("dns-zone-records-blind-exit.manifest");
 405:     let exit_dns_local = ctx.work_dir.join("dns-zone-exit");
 406:     let client_dns_local = ctx.work_dir.join("dns-zone-client");
 407:     let blind_exit_dns_local = ctx.work_dir.join("dns-zone-blind-exit");
 408:     let dns_base_records =

 421:     )
 422:     .map_err(|err| {
 423:         eprintln!("{err}");
 424:         1
 425:     })?;
 426:     write_secure_text(
 427:         &blind_exit_dns_records_local,
 428:         &managed_dns_records_manifest_for_scope(&dns_base_records, &blind_exit_scope)?,
 429:     )
 430:     .map_err(|err| {
 431:         eprintln!("{err}");
 432:         1
 433:     })?;
 434:     let dns_passphrase_remote = ctx
 435:         .capture_root(
 436:             &exit_host,
 437:             &["mktemp", "/tmp/rn-lan-toggle-dns-passphrase.XXXXXX"],
 438:         )
 439:         .map_err(|err| {
 440:             eprintln!("{err}");
 441:             1
 442:         })?
 443:         .trim()
 444:         .to_string();
 445:     ctx.run_root(
 446:         &exit_host,
 447:         &[
 448:             "rustynet",
 449:             "ops",
 450:             "materialize-signing-passphrase",
 451:             "--output",
 452:             dns_passphrase_remote.as_str(),
 453:         ],
 454:     )
 455:     .map_err(|err| {
 456:         eprintln!("{err}");
 457:         1
 458:     })?;
 459:     ctx.run_root(
 460:         &exit_host,
 461:         &["chmod", "0600", dns_passphrase_remote.as_str()],
 462:     )
 463:     .map_err(|err| {
 464:         eprintln!("{err}");
 465:         1
 466:     })?;
 467:     ctx.run_root(
 468:         &exit_host,
 469:         &["install", "-d", "-m", "0700", DNS_ZONE_ISSUE_DIR],
 470:     )
 471:     .map_err(|err| {
 472:         eprintln!("{err}");
 473:         1
 474:     })?;
 475:     cleanup.dns_passphrase_remote = Some(dns_passphrase_remote.clone());
 476:     let traversal_refresh = TraversalRefreshConfig {
 477:         signer_host: exit_host.as_str(),
 478:         exit_host: exit_host.as_str(),
 479:         client_host: client_host.as_str(),
 480:         blind_exit_host: blind_exit_host.as_str(),
 481:         traversal_env: traversal_env.as_path(),
 482:         traversal_pub_local: traversal_pub_local.as_path(),
 483:         exit_traversal_local: exit_traversal_local.as_path(),
 484:         client_traversal_local: client_traversal_local.as_path(),
 485:         blind_exit_traversal_local: blind_exit_traversal_local.as_path(),
 486:         exit_node_id: exit_node_id.as_str(),
 487:         client_node_id: client_node_id.as_str(),
 488:         blind_exit_node_id: blind_exit_node_id.as_str(),
 489:     };
 490:     let dns_targets = [
 491:         DnsRefreshTarget {
 492:             host: exit_host.as_str(),
 493:             node_id: exit_node_id.as_str(),
 494:             records_local: exit_dns_records_local.as_path(),
 495:             bundle_local: exit_dns_local.as_path(),
 496:         },
 497:         DnsRefreshTarget {
 498:             host: client_host.as_str(),
 499:             node_id: client_node_id.as_str(),
 500:             records_local: client_dns_records_local.as_path(),
 501:             bundle_local: client_dns_local.as_path(),
 502:         },
 503:         DnsRefreshTarget {
 504:             host: blind_exit_host.as_str(),
 505:             node_id: blind_exit_node_id.as_str(),
 506:             records_local: blind_exit_dns_records_local.as_path(),
 507:             bundle_local: blind_exit_dns_local.as_path(),
 508:         },
 509:     ];
 510:     let signed_state_refresh = SignedStateRefreshConfig {
 511:         assignment: AssignmentRefreshConfig {
 512:             signer_host: exit_host.as_str(),
 513:             exit_host: exit_host.as_str(),
 514:             client_host: client_host.as_str(),
 515:             blind_exit_host: blind_exit_host.as_str(),
 516:             env_local: issue_env.as_path(),
 517:             assign_pub_local: assign_pub_local.as_path(),
 518:             exit_assignment_local: exit_assignment_local.as_path(),
 519:             client_assignment_local: client_assignment_local.as_path(),
 520:             blind_exit_assignment_local: blind_exit_assignment_local.as_path(),
 521:             exit_node_id: exit_node_id.as_str(),
 522:             client_node_id: client_node_id.as_str(),
 523:             blind_exit_node_id: blind_exit_node_id.as_str(),
 524:         },
 525:         traversal: traversal_refresh,
 526:         dns: DnsRefreshConfig {
 527:             signer_host: exit_host.as_str(),
 528:             dns_verifier_local: dns_verifier_local.as_path(),
 529:             passphrase_remote: dns_passphrase_remote.as_str(),
 530:             nodes_spec: nodes_spec.as_str(),
 531:             allow_spec: allow_spec.as_str(),
 532:             targets: &dns_targets,
 533:         },
 534:     };
 535:     logger
 536:         .line("Issuing and distributing fresh signed traversal bundles for LAN-toggle topology")
 537:         .map_err(|err| {
 538:             eprintln!("{err}");
 539:             1
 540:         })?;
 541:     refresh_signed_state_artifacts(&ctx, &logger, &signed_state_refresh)?;
 542: 
 543:     logger.line("Enforcing runtime roles").map_err(|err| {
 544:         eprintln!("{err}");
 545:         1
 546:     })?;
 547:     enforce_host(&ctx, &exit_host, "admin", &exit_node_id, &ssh_allow_cidrs)?;
 548:     enforce_host(
 549:         &ctx,
 550:         &client_host,
 551:         "client",
 552:         &client_node_id,
 553:         &ssh_allow_cidrs,
 554:     )?;
 555:     enforce_host(
 556:         &ctx,
 557:         &blind_exit_host,
 558:         "blind_exit",
 559:         &blind_exit_node_id,
 560:         &ssh_allow_cidrs,
 561:     )?;
 562:     ensure_daemon_services_ready(&ctx, &exit_host)?;
 563:     ensure_daemon_services_ready(&ctx, &client_host)?;
 564:     ensure_daemon_services_ready(&ctx, &blind_exit_host)?;
 565: 
 566:     // After enforce_host the daemons come up cold and stay in
 567:     // restricted-safe mode until they ingest fresh signed trust
 568:     // evidence. The route advertise call below is a mutating IPC
 569:     // command and is refused while restricted-safe is set, so refresh
 570:     // trust on every node first. Mirrors the equivalent step in
 571:     // live_linux_two_hop_test (commit cca0418); without it
 572:     // `route advertise 0.0.0.0/0` fails with "daemon is in
 573:     // restricted-safe mode" on the exit and the LAN-toggle stage hard-
 574:     // fails before the toggle is exercised at all.
 575:     logger
 576:         .line("Refreshing signed trust evidence on all nodes")
 577:         .map_err(|err| {
 578:             eprintln!("{err}");
 579:             1
 580:         })?;
 581:     refresh_trust_evidence(&ctx, &exit_host)?;
 582:     refresh_trust_evidence(&ctx, &client_host)?;
 583:     refresh_trust_evidence(&ctx, &blind_exit_host)?;
 584: 
 585:     // The traversal coordination records inside each signed bundle have
 586:     // a hard-capped 30-second TTL (MAX_COORDINATION_TTL_SECS in
 587:     // crates/rustynetd/src/traversal.rs). Between the initial bundle
 588:     // issuance at refresh_signed_state_artifacts above and now (post
 589:     // enforce_host x3 + ensure_daemon_services_ready x3 + refresh_
 590:     // trust_evidence x3) the coordination records have likely expired,
 591:     // each daemon's reconcile loop fails repeatedly, and reconcile_
 592:     // failures escalates to restriction_mode=Permanent (default
 593:     // max_reconcile_failures=5). The route advertise that follows then
 594:     // sees a Permanent-restricted daemon and is refused — the failure
 595:     // mode that broke live_two_hop in livelab4 even with the trust
 596:     // refresh in place.
 597:     //
 598:     // Re-issue traversal + DNS zone bundles, redistribute, then call
 599:     // `state refresh` IPC on every node. State refresh is non-mutating
 600:     // (exempt from the restricted-safe gate) and on success explicitly
 601:     // resets restriction_mode to None and clears reconcile_failures
 602:     // (daemon.rs:3506-3508). The route advertise that follows then
 603:     // sees a daemon out of restricted-safe.
 604:     refresh_signed_state_artifacts(&ctx, &logger, &signed_state_refresh)?;
 605: 
 606:     logger
 607:         .line("Advertising default route on exit")
 608:         .map_err(|err| {
 609:             eprintln!("{err}");
 610:             1
 611:         })?;
 612:     ctx.retry_root(
 613:         &exit_host,
 614:         &["rustynet", "route", "advertise", "0.0.0.0/0"],
 615:         10,
 616:         2,
 617:     )
 618:     .map_err(|err| {
 619:         eprintln!("{err}");
 620:         1
 621:     })?;

 624:         .line("Provisioning synthetic LAN subnet on exit")

 629:     let _ = ctx.run_root_allow_failure(

 801:         "pass"
 802:     } else {
 803:         "fail"
 804:     };

 806:         && lan_on_ping_status
 807:         && client_status_on.contains("lan_access=on")

 815:         "pass"
 816:     } else {
 817:         "fail"
 818:     };
 819:     let check_client_status_initial_off = if client_status_off_initial.contains("lan_access=off")
 820:         && client_status_off_initial.contains(&format!("exit_node={exit_node_id}"))
 821:     {
 822:         "pass"
 823:     } else {
 824:         "fail"
 825:     };
 826:     let check_client_status_on = if client_status_on.contains("lan_access=on") {
 827:         "pass"
 828:     } else {
 829:         "fail"
 830:     };
 831:     let check_client_status_off = if client_status_off_final.contains("lan_access=off") {
 832:         "pass"
 833:     } else {
 834:         "fail"
 835:     };
 836:     let check_blind_exit_denied = if blind_exit_denied_status == "pass"
 837:         && blind_exit_status.contains("node_role=blind_exit")
 838:         && blind_exit_status.contains("lan_access=off")
 839:     {
 840:         "pass"
 841:     } else {
 842:         "fail"
 843:     };

 845:         == "no-plaintext-passphrase-files"
 846:         && exit_plaintext_check == "no-plaintext-passphrase-files"
 847:         && blind_exit_plaintext_check == "no-plaintext-passphrase-files"
 848:     {
 849:         "pass"
 850:     } else {
 851:         "fail"
 852:     };
 853: 
 854:     let overall = if [
 855:         check_lan_off_blocks,
 856:         check_lan_on_allows,
 857:         check_lan_off_again_blocks,
 858:         check_client_status_initial_off,
 859:         check_client_status_on,
 860:         check_client_status_off,
 861:         check_blind_exit_denied,
 862:         check_no_plaintext_passphrases,
 863:     ]

 865:     .all(|value| *value == "pass")

 867:         "pass"
 868:     } else {
 869:         "fail"
 870:     };

 878:         "captured_at": captured_at_unix,

 881:         "status": overall,
 882:         "exit_host": exit_host,
 883:         "client_host": client_host,
 884:         "blind_exit_host": blind_exit_host,

 886:             "lan_off_blocks": check_lan_off_blocks,
 887:             "lan_on_allows": check_lan_on_allows,

 890:             "client_status_on": check_client_status_on,
 891:             "client_status_off": check_client_status_off,
 892:             "blind_exit_denied": check_blind_exit_denied,

 894:         },
 895:         "source_artifacts": [log_path.to_string_lossy().to_string()],
 896:     });
 897:     write_secure_json(&report_path, &report).map_err(|err| {
 898:         eprintln!("{err}");
 899:         1
 900:     })?;
 901: 
 902:     logger
 903:         .line(format!(
 904:             "LAN toggle report written: {}",
 905:             report_path.display()
 906:         ))
 907:         .map_err(|err| {
 908:             eprintln!("{err}");
 909:             1
 910:         })?;
 911:     if overall != "pass" {
 912:         return Err(1);
 913:     }
 914:     Ok(())
 915: }

 917: struct LanToggleCleanup {
 918:     ctx: LiveLabContext,
 919:     exit_host: String,
 920:     dns_passphrase_remote: Option<String>,
 921: }
 922: 
 923: impl Drop for LanToggleCleanup {
 924:     fn drop(&mut self) {
 925:         let _ = self.ctx.run_root_allow_failure(
 926:             &self.exit_host,
 927:             &["ip", "link", "delete", LAN_TEST_INTERFACE],
 928:         );
 929:         if let Some(path) = self.dns_passphrase_remote.as_deref() {
 930:             let _ = self
 931:                 .ctx
 932:                 .run_root_allow_failure(&self.exit_host, &["rm", "-f", path]);
 933:         }
 934:         let _ = self
 935:             .ctx
 936:             .run_root_allow_failure(&self.exit_host, &["rm", "-f", DNS_ZONE_VALID_BUNDLE_REMOTE]);
 937:         let _ = self
 938:             .ctx
 939:             .run_root_allow_failure(&self.exit_host, &["rm", "-f", DNS_ZONE_VERIFIER_REMOTE]);
 940:         let _ = self
 941:             .ctx
 942:             .run_root_allow_failure(&self.exit_host, &["rmdir", DNS_ZONE_ISSUE_DIR]);
 943:     }
 944: }

 946: fn apply_lan_access(
 947:     ctx: &LiveLabContext,
 948:     target: &str,
 949:     enable: bool,
 950:     lan_routes: &str,
 951: ) -> Result<(), i32> {
 952:     let output = run_lan_access_command(ctx, target, enable, lan_routes, 20)?;
 953:     if output.status.success() {
 954:         Ok(())
 955:     } else {
 956:         eprintln!(
 957:             "apply-lan-access-coupling failed on {target}: {}",
 958:             summarize_command_output(&output)
 959:         );
 960:         Err(1)
 961:     }
 962: }
 963: 
 964: fn wait_for_lan_probe_state(
 965:     ctx: &LiveLabContext,
 966:     logger: &Logger,
 967:     refresh_config: &SignedStateRefreshConfig<'_>,
 968:     last_traversal_refresh_unix: &mut u64,
 969:     target: &str,
 970:     desired_state: &str,
 971:     attempts: u32,
 972: ) -> Result<bool, i32> {
 973:     for _ in 0..attempts {
 974:         maybe_refresh_signed_state_artifacts(
 975:             ctx,
 976:             logger,
 977:             refresh_config,
 978:             last_traversal_refresh_unix,
 979:         )?;
 980:         let reachable = ctx
 981:             .run(target, &["ping", "-c", "1", "-W", "1", LAN_TEST_PROBE_IP])
 982:             .is_ok();
 983:         if desired_state == "reachable" && reachable {
 984:             return Ok(true);
 985:         }
 986:         if desired_state == "blocked" && !reachable {
 987:             return Ok(true);
 988:         }
 989:         std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_secs(1));
 990:     }
 991:     Ok(false)
 992: }
 993: 
 994: fn apply_lan_access_expect_denied(
 995:     ctx: &LiveLabContext,
 996:     target: &str,
 997:     enable: bool,
 998:     lan_routes: &str,
 999: ) -> Result<bool, i32> {
1000:     let output = run_lan_access_command(ctx, target, enable, lan_routes, 20)?;
1001:     if output.status.success() {
1002:         return Ok(false);
1003:     }
1004:     let combined = format!(
1005:         "{} {}",
1006:         String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout),
1007:         String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr)
1008:     );
1009:     if combined.contains("LAN access coupling is not permitted for blind_exit role") {
1010:         Ok(true)
1011:     } else {
1012:         eprintln!(
1013:             "unexpected blind-exit LAN coupling failure on {target}: {}",
1014:             summarize_command_output(&output)
1015:         );
1016:         Err(1)
1017:     }
1018: }
1019: 
1020: fn run_lan_access_command(
1021:     ctx: &LiveLabContext,
1022:     target: &str,
1023:     enable: bool,
1024:     lan_routes: &str,
1025:     socket_wait_attempts: u32,
1026: ) -> Result<Output, i32> {
1027:     ctx.wait_for_daemon_socket(
1028:         target,
1029:         "/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock",
1030:         socket_wait_attempts,
1031:         1,
1032:     )
1033:     .map_err(|err| {
1034:         eprintln!("{err}");
1035:         1
1036:     })?;
1037: 
1038:     let enable_flag = if enable { "true" } else { "false" };
1039:     let mut args = vec![
1040:         "rustynet",
1041:         "ops",
1042:         "apply-lan-access-coupling",
1043:         "--enable",
1044:         enable_flag,
1045:         "--env-path",
1046:         "/etc/rustynet/assignment-refresh.env",
1047:     ];
1048:     if !lan_routes.is_empty() {
1049:         args.push("--lan-routes");
1050:         args.push(lan_routes);
1051:     }
1052:     ctx.run_root_allow_failure(target, &args).map_err(|err| {
1053:         eprintln!("{err}");
1054:         1
1055:     })
1056: }
1057: 
1058: fn summarize_command_output(output: &Output) -> String {
1059:     let stdout = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).trim().to_string();
1060:     let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).trim().to_string();
1061:     if !stderr.is_empty() && !stdout.is_empty() {
1062:         format!("{stderr} (stdout: {stdout})")
1063:     } else if !stderr.is_empty() {
1064:         stderr
1065:     } else if !stdout.is_empty() {
1066:         stdout
1067:     } else {
1068:         "no output".to_string()
1069:     }
1070: }
1071: 
1072: fn wait_for_lan_access_state(
1073:     ctx: &LiveLabContext,
1074:     logger: &Logger,
1075:     refresh_config: &SignedStateRefreshConfig<'_>,
1076:     last_traversal_refresh_unix: &mut u64,
1077:     target: &str,
1078:     expected_enabled: bool,
1079:     attempts: u32,
1080: ) -> Result<bool, i32> {
1081:     let expected = if expected_enabled {
1082:         "lan_access=on"
1083:     } else {
1084:         "lan_access=off"
1085:     };
1086:     for _ in 0..attempts {
1087:         maybe_refresh_signed_state_artifacts(
1088:             ctx,
1089:             logger,
1090:             refresh_config,
1091:             last_traversal_refresh_unix,
1092:         )?;
1093:         if let Ok(status) = ctx.capture_root(target, &["rustynet", "status"])
1094:             && status.contains(expected)
1095:         {
1096:             return Ok(true);
1097:         }
1098:         std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_secs(1));
1099:     }
1100:     Ok(false)
1101: }
1102: 
1103: fn no_plaintext_passphrase_check(ctx: &LiveLabContext, target: &str) -> Result<String, i32> {
1104:     let checks = [
1105:         "/var/lib/rustynet/keys/wireguard.passphrase",
1106:         "/etc/rustynet/wireguard.passphrase",
1107:         "/etc/rustynet/signing_key_passphrase",
1108:     ];
1109:     for check in checks {
1110:         ctx.run_root(target, &["test", "!", "-e", check])
1111:             .map_err(|err| {
1112:                 eprintln!("{err}");
1113:                 1
1114:             })?;
1115:     }
1116:     Ok("no-plaintext-passphrase-files".to_string())
1117: }
1118: 
1119: fn write_assignment_env(path: &Path, items: &[(&str, &str)]) -> Result<(), i32> {
1120:     let mut contents = String::new();
1121:     for (key, value) in items {
1122:         contents.push_str(key);
1123:         contents.push('=');
1124:         contents.push_str(&quote_env_value(value)?);
1125:         contents.push('\n');
1126:     }
1127:     write_secure_text(path, &contents).map_err(|err| {
1128:         eprintln!("{err}");
1129:         1
1130:     })
1131: }
1132: 
1133: fn quote_env_value(value: &str) -> Result<String, i32> {
1134:     if value.chars().any(|ch| ch == '\n' || ch == '\r') {
1135:         eprintln!("env value contains newline characters");
1136:         return Err(1);
1137:     }
1138:     let mut escaped = String::from("\"");
1139:     for ch in value.chars() {
1140:         match ch {
1141:             '\\' => escaped.push_str("\\\\"),
1142:             '"' => escaped.push_str("\\\""),
1143:             '$' => escaped.push_str("\\$"),
1144:             '`' => escaped.push_str("\\`"),
1145:             other => escaped.push(other),
1146:         }
1147:     }
1148:     escaped.push('"');
1149:     Ok(escaped)
1150: }
1151: 
1152: fn write_assignment_refresh_env(
1153:     path: &Path,
1154:     target_node_id: &str,
1155:     nodes_spec: &str,
1156:     allow_spec: &str,
1157:     exit_node_id: Option<&str>,
1158: ) -> Result<(), i32> {
1159:     let mut items = vec![
1160:         ("RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_TARGET_NODE_ID", target_node_id),
1161:         ("RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_NODES", nodes_spec),
1162:         ("RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_ALLOW", allow_spec),
1163:         (
1164:             "RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_SIGNING_SECRET",
1165:             "/etc/rustynet/assignment.signing.secret",
1166:         ),
1167:         (
1168:             "RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_SIGNING_SECRET_PASSPHRASE_FILE",
1169:             "/run/credentials/rustynetd-assignment-refresh.service/signing_key_passphrase",
1170:         ),
1171:         ("RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_TTL_SECS", "300"),
1172:         ("RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_MIN_REMAINING_SECS", "180"),
1173:     ];
1174:     let exit_node_storage;
1175:     if let Some(exit_node_id) = exit_node_id {
1176:         exit_node_storage = exit_node_id.to_string();
1177:         items.push(("RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_EXIT_NODE_ID", &exit_node_storage));
1178:     }
1179:     write_assignment_env(path, &items)
1180: }

1182: fn capture_remote_file(
1183:     ctx: &LiveLabContext,
1184:     target: &str,
1185:     remote_path: &str,
1186:     local_path: &Path,
1187: ) -> Result<(), i32> {
1188:     let contents = ctx
1189:         .capture_root(target, &["cat", remote_path])
1190:         .map_err(|err| {
1191:             eprintln!("{err}");
1192:             1
1193:         })?;
1194:     write_secure_text(local_path, &contents).map_err(|err| {
1195:         eprintln!("{err}");
1196:         1
1197:     })
1198: }

1200: fn install_assignment_bundle(
1201:     ctx: &LiveLabContext,
1202:     target: &str,
1203:     pubkey_local: &Path,
1204:     bundle_local: &Path,
1205: ) -> Result<(), i32> {
1206:     ctx.scp_to(pubkey_local, target, "/tmp/rn-assignment.pub")
1207:         .map_err(|err| {
1208:             eprintln!("{err}");
1209:             1
1210:         })?;
1211:     ctx.scp_to(bundle_local, target, "/tmp/rn-assignment.bundle")
1212:         .map_err(|err| {

1447: #[derive(Clone, Copy)]
1448: struct TraversalRefreshConfig<'a> {
1449:     signer_host: &'a str,
1450:     exit_host: &'a str,
1451:     client_host: &'a str,
1452:     blind_exit_host: &'a str,
1453:     traversal_env: &'a Path,
1454:     traversal_pub_local: &'a Path,
1455:     exit_traversal_local: &'a Path,
1456:     client_traversal_local: &'a Path,
1457:     blind_exit_traversal_local: &'a Path,
1458:     exit_node_id: &'a str,
1459:     client_node_id: &'a str,
1460:     blind_exit_node_id: &'a str,
1461: }
1462: 
1463: fn refresh_signed_state_artifacts(
1464:     ctx: &LiveLabContext,
1465:     logger: &Logger,
1466:     config: &SignedStateRefreshConfig<'_>,
1467: ) -> Result<(), i32> {
1468:     // Re-issue assignment bundles before refreshing state so that the daemon's
1469:     // 300-second max-age check never sees a stale bundle during long convergence
1470:     // loops that span multiple traversal refresh cycles.
1471:     refresh_assignment_bundles(ctx, logger, &config.assignment)?;
1472:     refresh_traversal_bundles(ctx, logger, &config.traversal)?;
1473:     refresh_dns_zone_bundles(ctx, logger, &config.dns)?;
1474:     for target in config.dns.targets {
1475:         refresh_trust_evidence(ctx, target.host)?;
1476:         refresh_signed_state_now(ctx, target.host)?;
1477:     }
1478:     Ok(())
1479: }
1480: 
1481: fn refresh_assignment_bundles(
1482:     ctx: &LiveLabContext,
1483:     logger: &Logger,
1484:     config: &AssignmentRefreshConfig<'_>,
1485: ) -> Result<(), i32> {
1486:     logger
1487:         .line("Refreshing signed assignment bundles for LAN-toggle participants")
1488:         .map_err(|err| {
1489:             eprintln!("{err}");
1490:             1
1491:         })?;
1492:     issue_assignment_bundles_from_env(
1493:         ctx,
1494:         config.signer_host,
1495:         config.env_local,
1496:         "/tmp/rn_issue_lan.env",
1497:     )?;
1498:     capture_remote_file(
1499:         ctx,
1500:         config.signer_host,
1501:         "/run/rustynet/assignment-issue/rn-assignment.pub",
1502:         config.assign_pub_local,
1503:     )?;
1504:     capture_remote_file(
1505:         ctx,
1506:         config.signer_host,
1507:         &format!(
1508:             "/run/rustynet/assignment-issue/rn-assignment-{}.assignment",
1509:             config.exit_node_id
1510:         ),
1511:         config.exit_assignment_local,
1512:     )?;
1513:     capture_remote_file(
1514:         ctx,
1515:         config.signer_host,
1516:         &format!(
1517:             "/run/rustynet/assignment-issue/rn-assignment-{}.assignment",
1518:             config.client_node_id
1519:         ),
1520:         config.client_assignment_local,
1521:     )?;
1522:     capture_remote_file(
1523:         ctx,
1524:         config.signer_host,
1525:         &format!(
1526:             "/run/rustynet/assignment-issue/rn-assignment-{}.assignment",
1527:             config.blind_exit_node_id
1528:         ),
1529:         config.blind_exit_assignment_local,
1530:     )?;
1531:     install_assignment_bundle(
1532:         ctx,
1533:         config.exit_host,
1534:         config.assign_pub_local,
1535:         config.exit_assignment_local,
1536:     )?;
1537:     install_assignment_bundle(
1538:         ctx,
1539:         config.client_host,
1540:         config.assign_pub_local,
1541:         config.client_assignment_local,
1542:     )?;
1543:     install_assignment_bundle(
1544:         ctx,
1545:         config.blind_exit_host,
1546:         config.assign_pub_local,
1547:         config.blind_exit_assignment_local,
1548:     )?;
1549:     Ok(())
1550: }
1551: 
1552: fn refresh_traversal_bundles(
1553:     ctx: &LiveLabContext,
1554:     logger: &Logger,
1555:     config: &TraversalRefreshConfig<'_>,
1556: ) -> Result<(), i32> {
1557:     logger
1558:         .line("Refreshing signed traversal bundles for LAN-toggle participants")
1559:         .map_err(|err| {
1560:             eprintln!("{err}");
1561:             1
1562:         })?;
1563:     issue_traversal_bundles_from_env(
1564:         ctx,
1565:         config.signer_host,
1566:         config.traversal_env,
1567:         "/tmp/rn_issue_lan_traversal.env",
1568:     )?;
1569:     capture_remote_file(
1570:         ctx,
1571:         config.signer_host,
1572:         "/run/rustynet/traversal-issue/rn-traversal.pub",
1573:         config.traversal_pub_local,
1574:     )?;
1575:     capture_remote_file(
1576:         ctx,
1577:         config.signer_host,
1578:         &format!(
1579:             "/run/rustynet/traversal-issue/rn-traversal-{}.traversal",
1580:             config.exit_node_id
1581:         ),
1582:         config.exit_traversal_local,
1583:     )?;
1584:     capture_remote_file(
1585:         ctx,
1586:         config.signer_host,
1587:         &format!(
1588:             "/run/rustynet/traversal-issue/rn-traversal-{}.traversal",
1589:             config.client_node_id
1590:         ),
1591:         config.client_traversal_local,
1592:     )?;
1593:     capture_remote_file(
1594:         ctx,
1595:         config.signer_host,
1596:         &format!(
1597:             "/run/rustynet/traversal-issue/rn-traversal-{}.traversal",
1598:             config.blind_exit_node_id
1599:         ),
1600:         config.blind_exit_traversal_local,
1601:     )?;
1602:     install_traversal_bundle(
1603:         ctx,
1604:         config.exit_host,
1605:         config.traversal_pub_local,
1606:         config.exit_traversal_local,
1607:     )?;
1608:     install_traversal_bundle(
1609:         ctx,
1610:         config.client_host,
1611:         config.traversal_pub_local,
1612:         config.client_traversal_local,
1613:     )?;
1614:     install_traversal_bundle(
1615:         ctx,
1616:         config.blind_exit_host,
1617:         config.traversal_pub_local,
1618:         config.blind_exit_traversal_local,
1619:     )?;
1620:     refresh_signed_state(ctx, config.exit_host)?;
1621:     refresh_signed_state(ctx, config.client_host)?;
1622:     refresh_signed_state(ctx, config.blind_exit_host)?;
1623:     Ok(())
1624: }
1625: 
1626: fn refresh_dns_zone_bundles(
1627:     ctx: &LiveLabContext,
1628:     logger: &Logger,
1629:     config: &DnsRefreshConfig<'_>,
1630: ) -> Result<(), i32> {
1631:     logger
1632:         .line("Refreshing signed DNS zone bundles for LAN-toggle participants")
1633:         .map_err(|err| {
1634:             eprintln!("{err}");
1635:             1
1636:         })?;
1637:     for target in config.targets {
1638:         let remote_records = format!("/tmp/rn-lan-toggle-dns-records-{}.manifest", target.node_id);
1639:         ctx.scp_to(
1640:             target.records_local,
1641:             config.signer_host,
1642:             remote_records.as_str(),
1643:         )
1644:         .map_err(|err| {
1645:             eprintln!("{err}");
1646:             1
1647:         })?;
1648:         ctx.run_root(
1649:             config.signer_host,
1650:             &[
1651:                 "rustynet",
1652:                 "dns",
1653:                 "zone",
1654:                 "issue",
1655:                 "--signing-secret",
1656:                 "/etc/rustynet/membership.owner.key",
1657:                 "--signing-secret-passphrase-file",
1658:                 config.passphrase_remote,
1659:                 "--subject-node-id",
1660:                 target.node_id,
1661:                 "--nodes",
1662:                 config.nodes_spec,
1663:                 "--allow",
1664:                 config.allow_spec,
1665:                 "--zone-name",
1666:                 DNS_ZONE_NAME,
1667:                 "--records-manifest",
1668:                 remote_records.as_str(),
1669:                 "--output",
1670:                 DNS_ZONE_VALID_BUNDLE_REMOTE,
1671:                 "--verifier-key-output",
1672:                 DNS_ZONE_VERIFIER_REMOTE,
1673:             ],
1674:         )
1675:         .map_err(|err| {
1676:             eprintln!("{err}");
1677:             1
1678:         })?;
1679:         let _ =
1680:             ctx.run_root_allow_failure(config.signer_host, &["rm", "-f", remote_records.as_str()]);
1681:         capture_remote_file(
1682:             ctx,
1683:             config.signer_host,
1684:             DNS_ZONE_VERIFIER_REMOTE,
1685:             config.dns_verifier_local,
1686:         )?;
1687:         capture_remote_file(
1688:             ctx,
1689:             config.signer_host,
1690:             DNS_ZONE_VALID_BUNDLE_REMOTE,
1691:             target.bundle_local,
1692:         )?;
1693:         install_dns_zone_bundle(
1694:             ctx,
1695:             target.host,
1696:             config.dns_verifier_local,
1697:             target.bundle_local,
1698:         )?;
1699:     }
1700:     Ok(())
1701: }
1702: 
1703: fn maybe_refresh_signed_state_artifacts(
1704:     ctx: &LiveLabContext,
1705:     logger: &Logger,
1706:     config: &SignedStateRefreshConfig<'_>,
1707:     last_traversal_refresh_unix: &mut u64,
1708: ) -> Result<(), i32> {
1709:     let now = unix_now();
1710:     if now.saturating_sub(*last_traversal_refresh_unix)
1711:         >= traversal_refresh_interval_secs(MAX_TRAVERSAL_COORDINATION_TTL_SECS)
1712:     {
1713:         refresh_signed_state_artifacts(ctx, logger, config)?;
1714:         *last_traversal_refresh_unix = unix_now();
1715:     }
1716:     Ok(())
1717: }
1718: 
1719: fn traversal_refresh_interval_secs(coordination_ttl_secs: u64) -> u64 {
1720:     let bounded_ttl_secs = coordination_ttl_secs.clamp(1, MAX_TRAVERSAL_COORDINATION_TTL_SECS);
1721:     std::cmp::max(1, bounded_ttl_secs / 2)
1722: }
1723: 
1724: fn refresh_signed_state(ctx: &LiveLabContext, target: &str) -> Result<(), i32> {
1725:     ctx.run_root(
1726:         target,
1727:         &[
1728:             "env",
1729:             "RUSTYNET_DAEMON_SOCKET=/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock",
1730:             "rustynet",
1731:             "state",
1732:             "refresh",
1733:         ],
1734:     )
1735:     .map_err(|err| {
1736:         eprintln!("{err}");
1737:         1
1738:     })
1739: }
1740: 
1741: fn refresh_signed_state_now(ctx: &LiveLabContext, target: &str) -> Result<(), i32> {
1742:     ctx.wait_for_daemon_socket(target, "/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock", 20, 2)
1743:         .map_err(|err| {
1744:             eprintln!("{err}");
1745:             1
1746:         })?;
1747:     refresh_signed_state(ctx, target)
1748: }
1749: 
1750: fn refresh_trust_evidence(ctx: &LiveLabContext, target: &str) -> Result<(), i32> {
1751:     ctx.wait_for_daemon_socket(target, "/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock", 20, 2)
1752:         .map_err(|err| {
1753:             eprintln!("{err}");
1754:             1
1755:         })?;
1756:     ctx.run_root(target, &["rustynet", "ops", "refresh-signed-trust"])
1757:         .map_err(|err| {
1758:             eprintln!("{err}");
1759:             1
1760:         })
1761: }

1821: fn enforce_host(
1822:     ctx: &LiveLabContext,
1823:     target: &str,
1824:     role: &str,
1825:     node_id: &str,
1826:     ssh_allow_cidrs: &str,
1827: ) -> Result<(), i32> {
1828:     let src_dir = LiveLabContext::remote_src_dir_for(target);
1829:     ctx.run_root(
1830:         target,
1831:         &[
1832:             "rustynet",
1833:             "ops",
1834:             "e2e-enforce-host",
1835:             "--role",
1836:             role,
1837:             "--node-id",
1838:             node_id,
1839:             "--src-dir",
1840:             &src_dir,
1841:             "--ssh-allow-cidrs",
1842:             ssh_allow_cidrs,
1843:         ],
1844:     )
1845:     .map_err(|err| {
1846:         eprintln!("{err}");
1847:         1
1848:     })
1849: }
1850: 
1851: fn ensure_daemon_services_ready(ctx: &LiveLabContext, target: &str) -> Result<(), i32> {
1852:     let _ = ctx.run_root_allow_failure(
1853:         target,
1854:         &[
1855:             "systemctl",
1856:             "reset-failed",
1857:             "rustynetd.service",
1858:             "rustynetd-privileged-helper.service",
1859:         ],
1860:     );
1861:     ctx.run_root(
1862:         target,
1863:         &[
1864:             "systemctl",
1865:             "restart",
1866:             "rustynetd-privileged-helper.service",
1867:         ],
1868:     )
1869:     .map_err(|err| {
1870:         eprintln!("{err}");
1871:         1
1872:     })?;
1873:     ctx.run_root(target, &["systemctl", "restart", "rustynetd.service"])
1874:         .map_err(|err| {
1875:             eprintln!("{err}");
1876:             1
1877:         })?;
1878:     ctx.wait_for_daemon_socket(target, "/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock", 20, 2)
1879:         .map_err(|err| {
1880:             eprintln!("{err}");
1881:             1
1882:         })?;
1883:     Ok(())

1913: fn managed_dns_records_manifest_for_scope(
1914:     records: &[ManagedDnsRecordTemplate],
1915:     scope: &AssignmentAuthorityScope,
1916: ) -> Result<String, i32> {
1917:     let allowed_targets = scope.peer_node_ids.iter().cloned().collect::<HashSet<_>>();
1918:     let filtered = records
1919:         .iter()
1920:         .filter(|record| {
1921:             record.target_node_id == scope.node_id
1922:                 || allowed_targets.contains(&record.target_node_id)
1923:         })
1924:         .cloned()
1925:         .collect::<Vec<_>>();
1926:     if filtered.is_empty() {
1927:         eprintln!(
1928:             "managed DNS scope for {} produced no policy-authorized records",
1929:             scope.node_id
1930:         );
1931:         return Err(1);
1932:     }
1933:     let mut manifest = String::new();
1934:     manifest.push_str("version=1\n");
1935:     manifest.push_str(&format!("record_count={}\n", filtered.len()));
1936:     for (index, record) in filtered.iter().enumerate() {
1937:         manifest.push_str(&format!("record.{index}.label={}\n", record.label));
1938:         manifest.push_str(&format!(
1939:             "record.{index}.target_node_id={}\n",
1940:             record.target_node_id
1941:         ));
1942:         manifest.push_str(&format!("record.{index}.ttl_secs={}\n", record.ttl_secs));
1943:         manifest.push_str(&format!(
1944:             "record.{index}.alias_count={}\n",
1945:             record.aliases.len()
1946:         ));
1947:         for (alias_index, alias) in record.aliases.iter().enumerate() {
1948:             manifest.push_str(&format!("record.{index}.alias.{alias_index}={alias}\n"));
1949:         }
1950:     }
1951:     Ok(manifest)
1952: }
1953: 
1954: fn parse_assignment_authority_scope(bundle: &str) -> Result<AssignmentAuthorityScope, i32> {
1955:     let mut node_id = None;
1956:     let mut peer_node_ids = Vec::new();
1957:     for line in bundle.lines() {
1958:         if let Some(value) = line.strip_prefix("node_id=") {
1959:             let trimmed = value.trim();
1960:             if trimmed.is_empty() {
1961:                 eprintln!("assignment bundle node_id must not be empty");
1962:                 return Err(1);
1963:             }
1964:             node_id = Some(trimmed.to_string());
1965:             continue;
1966:         }
1967:         if let Some((prefix, value)) = line.split_once('=')
1968:             && prefix.starts_with("peer.")
1969:             && prefix.ends_with(".node_id")
1970:         {
1971:             let trimmed = value.trim();
1972:             if trimmed.is_empty() {
1973:                 eprintln!("assignment bundle peer id must not be empty: {prefix}");
1974:                 return Err(1);
1975:             }
1976:             peer_node_ids.push(trimmed.to_string());
1977:         }
1978:     }
1979:     peer_node_ids.sort();
1980:     peer_node_ids.dedup();
1981:     match node_id {
1982:         Some(node_id) => Ok(AssignmentAuthorityScope {
1983:             node_id,
1984:             peer_node_ids,
1985:         }),
1986:         None => {
1987:             eprintln!("assignment bundle is missing node_id");
1988:             Err(1)
1989:         }
1990:     }
1991: }
1992: 
1993: fn git_commit(root_dir: &Path) -> String {
1994:     if let Ok(value) = std::env::var("RUSTYNET_EXPECTED_GIT_COMMIT") {
1995:         return value.trim().to_lowercase();
1996:     }
1997:     let output = std::process::Command::new("git")
1998:         .current_dir(root_dir)
1999:         .args(["rev-parse", "HEAD"])
2000:         .output();
2001:     match output {
2002:         Ok(output) if output.status.success() => String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout)
2003:             .trim()
2004:             .to_lowercase(),
2005:         _ => "unknown".to_string(),
2006:     }
2007: }

2009: fn required_value(args: &[String], idx: usize, flag: &str) -> Result<String, i32> {
2010:     if idx >= args.len() {
2011:         eprintln!("missing value for {flag}");
2012:         return Err(2);
2013:     }
2014:     Ok(args[idx].clone())
2015: }

2021: fn now_unix() -> String {
2022:     SystemTime::now()
2023:         .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
2024:         .map(|duration| duration.as_secs().to_string())
2025:         .unwrap_or_else(|_| "0".to_string())
2026: }

2029:     SystemTime::now()
2030:         .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
2031:         .map(|duration| duration.as_secs())
2032:         .unwrap_or(0)
2033: }

 769: 
 770: #[derive(Debug, Clone)]
 771: struct Config {
 772:     ssh_identity_file: String,
 773:     signer_host: String,
 774:     client_host: String,
 775:     signer_node_id: String,
 776:     client_node_id: String,
 777:     ssh_allow_cidrs: String,
 778:     report_path: PathBuf,
 779:     log_path: PathBuf,
 780:     zone_name: String,
 781:     dns_interface: String,
 782:     dns_bind_addr: String,
 783:     managed_peers: Vec<ManagedPeerSpec>,
 784: }
 785: 
 786: impl Config {
 787:     fn parse(args: Vec<String>) -> Result<Self, String> {
 788:         let mut config = Self {
 789:             ssh_identity_file: String::new(),
 790:             signer_host: "debian@192.168.18.49".to_string(),
 791:             client_host: "ubuntu@192.168.18.52".to_string(),
 792:             signer_node_id: "exit-49".to_string(),
 793:             client_node_id: "client-52".to_string(),
 794:             ssh_allow_cidrs: "192.168.18.0/24".to_string(),
 795:             report_path: PathBuf::from("artifacts/phase10/source/managed_dns_report.json"),
 796:             log_path: PathBuf::from("artifacts/phase10/source/managed_dns_report.log"),
 797:             zone_name: "rustynet".to_string(),
 798:             dns_interface: "rustynet0".to_string(),
 799:             dns_bind_addr: "127.0.0.1:53535".to_string(),
 800:             managed_peers: Vec::new(),
 801:         };
 802: 
 803:         let mut iter = args.into_iter();
 804:         while let Some(arg) = iter.next() {
 805:             match arg.as_str() {
 806:                 "--ssh-identity-file" => config.ssh_identity_file = next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?,
 807:                 "--signer-host" => config.signer_host = next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?,
 808:                 "--client-host" => config.client_host = next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?,
 809:                 "--signer-node-id" => config.signer_node_id = next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?,
 810:                 "--client-node-id" => config.client_node_id = next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?,
 811:                 "--ssh-allow-cidrs" => config.ssh_allow_cidrs = next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?,
 812:                 "--report-path" => config.report_path = PathBuf::from(next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?),
 813:                 "--log-path" => config.log_path = PathBuf::from(next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?),
 814:                 "--zone-name" => config.zone_name = next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?,
 815:                 "--dns-interface" => config.dns_interface = next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?,
 816:                 "--dns-bind-addr" => config.dns_bind_addr = next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?,
 817:                 "--managed-peer" => {
 818:                     let value = next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?;
 819:                     config.managed_peers.push(parse_managed_peer_spec(&value)?);
 820:                 }
 821:                 "-h" | "--help" => {
 822:                     print_usage();
 823:                     std::process::exit(0);
 824:                 }
 825:                 unknown => return Err(format!("unknown argument: {unknown}")),
 826:             }
 827:         }
 828: 
 829:         if config.ssh_identity_file.is_empty() {
 830:             return Err(
 831:                 "usage: live_linux_managed_dns_test --ssh-identity-file <path> [options]"
 832:                     .to_string(),
 833:             );
 834:         }
 835:         Ok(config)
 836:     }
 837: 
 838:     fn managed_fqdn(&self) -> String {
 839:         format!("{MANAGED_LABEL}.{}", self.zone_name)
 840:     }
 841: 
 842:     fn managed_alias_fqdn(&self) -> String {
 843:         format!("{MANAGED_ALIAS}.{}", self.zone_name)
 844:     }
 845: 
 846:     fn dns_server(&self) -> String {
 847:         self.dns_bind_addr
 848:             .split_once(':')
 849:             .map(|(server, _)| server.to_string())
 850:             .unwrap_or_else(|| self.dns_bind_addr.clone())
 851:     }
 852: 
 853:     fn dns_port(&self) -> String {
 854:         self.dns_bind_addr
 855:             .split_once(':')
 856:             .map(|(_, port)| port.to_string())
 857:             .unwrap_or_else(|| "53535".to_string())
 858:     }
 859: }
 860: 
 861: fn validate_targets(config: &Config) -> Result<(), String> {
 862:     for (label, value) in [
 863:         ("signer-host", config.signer_host.as_str()),
 864:         ("client-host", config.client_host.as_str()),
 865:         ("signer-node-id", config.signer_node_id.as_str()),
 866:         ("client-node-id", config.client_node_id.as_str()),
 867:         ("ssh-allow-cidrs", config.ssh_allow_cidrs.as_str()),
 868:         ("zone-name", config.zone_name.as_str()),
 869:         ("dns-interface", config.dns_interface.as_str()),
 870:         ("dns-bind-addr", config.dns_bind_addr.as_str()),
 871:     ] {
 872:         ensure_safe_token(label, value)?;
 873:     }
 874:     let mut seen_node_ids = HashSet::new();
 875:     let mut seen_hosts = HashSet::new();
 876:     for (label, value) in [
 877:         ("signer-node-id", config.signer_node_id.as_str()),
 878:         ("client-node-id", config.client_node_id.as_str()),
 879:     ] {
 880:         if !seen_node_ids.insert(value.to_string()) {
 881:             return Err(format!("{label} is duplicated: {value}"));
 882:         }
 883:     }
 884:     for (label, value) in [
 885:         ("signer-host", config.signer_host.as_str()),
 886:         ("client-host", config.client_host.as_str()),
 887:     ] {
 888:         if !seen_hosts.insert(value.to_string()) {
 889:             return Err(format!("{label} is duplicated: {value}"));
 890:         }
 891:     }
 892:     for peer in &config.managed_peers {
 893:         ensure_safe_token("--managed-peer node-id", peer.node_id.as_str())?;
 894:         ensure_safe_token("--managed-peer host", peer.host.as_str())?;
 895:         if !seen_node_ids.insert(peer.node_id.clone()) {
 896:             return Err(format!(
 897:                 "--managed-peer node-id duplicates an existing node id: {}",
 898:                 peer.node_id
 899:             ));
 900:         }
 901:         if !seen_hosts.insert(peer.host.clone()) {
 902:             return Err(format!(
 903:                 "--managed-peer host duplicates an existing host: {}",
 904:                 peer.host
 905:             ));
 906:         }
 907:     }
 908:     let _ = config
 909:         .dns_bind_addr
 910:         .split_once(':')
 911:         .ok_or_else(|| "dns-bind-addr must be <ip:port>".to_string())?
 912:         .1
 913:         .parse::<u16>()
 914:         .map_err(|err| format!("invalid dns-bind-addr port: {err}"))?;
 915:     Ok(())
 916: }
 917:

 974: fn issue_dns_bundle(issue: DnsIssueContext<'_>, bundle: DnsBundleSpec<'_>) -> Result<(), String> {
 975:     let output_path = format!("{}/{}", issue.issue_dir, bundle.output_name);
 976:     let verifier_key_output = format!("{}/rn-dns-zone.pub", issue.issue_dir);
 977:     let generated_at_string = bundle.timing.generated_at.map(|value| value.to_string());
 978:     let nonce_string = bundle.timing.nonce.map(|value| value.to_string());
 979:     let mut args = vec![
 980:         "rustynet",
 981:         "dns",
 982:         "zone",
 983:         "issue",
 984:         "--signing-secret",
 985:         "/etc/rustynet/membership.owner.key",
 986:         "--signing-secret-passphrase-file",
 987:         issue.passphrase_file,
 988:         "--subject-node-id",
 989:         bundle.subject_node_id,
 990:         "--nodes",
 991:         issue.nodes_spec,
 992:         "--allow",
 993:         issue.allow_spec,
 994:         "--records-manifest",
 995:         bundle.records_manifest_remote,
 996:         "--output",
 997:         output_path.as_str(),
 998:         "--verifier-key-output",
 999:         verifier_key_output.as_str(),
1000:         "--zone-name",
1001:         issue.zone_name,
1002:         "--ttl-secs",
1003:         "300",
1004:     ];
1005:     if bundle.timing.generated_at.is_some() {
1006:         args.push("--generated-at");
1007:         if let Some(generated_at_string) = generated_at_string.as_ref() {
1008:             args.push(generated_at_string.as_str());
1009:         }
1010:     }
1011:     if bundle.timing.nonce.is_some() {
1012:         args.push("--nonce");
1013:         if let Some(nonce_string) = nonce_string.as_ref() {
1014:             args.push(nonce_string.as_str());
1015:         }
1016:     }
1017:     issue.ctx.run_root(issue.signer_host, &args)?;
1018:     Ok(())
1019: }

1035: fn install_dns_bundle(
1036:     ctx: &LiveLabContext,
1037:     client_host: &str,
1038:     verifier_local: &Path,
1039:     bundle_local: &Path,

1044: fn install_dns_bundle_with_options(
1045:     ctx: &LiveLabContext,
1046:     client_host: &str,
1047:     verifier_local: &Path,
1048:     bundle_local: &Path,
1049:     clear_watermark: bool,
1050: ) -> Result<(), String> {
1051:     retry_remote_step(
1052:         &format!("install managed DNS bundle on {client_host}"),
1053:         SOAK_SSH_RETRY_ATTEMPTS,
1054:         SOAK_SSH_RETRY_SLEEP_SECS,
1055:         || {
1056:             ctx.scp_to(verifier_local, client_host, "/tmp/rn-dns-zone.pub")?;
1057:             ctx.scp_to(bundle_local, client_host, "/tmp/rn-dns-zone.bundle")?;
1058:             ctx.run_root(
1059:                 client_host,
1060:                 &[
1061:                     "install",
1062:                     "-d",
1063:                     "-m",
1064:                     "0750",
1065:                     "-o",
1066:                     "rustynetd",
1067:                     "-g",
1068:                     "root",
1069:                     "/etc/rustynet",
1070:                 ],
1071:             )?;
1072:             ctx.run_root(
1073:                 client_host,
1074:                 &[
1075:                     "install",
1076:                     "-m",
1077:                     "0644",
1078:                     "-o",
1079:                     "root",
1080:                     "-g",
1081:                     "root",
1082:                     "/tmp/rn-dns-zone.pub",
1083:                     "/etc/rustynet/dns-zone.pub",
1084:                 ],
1085:             )?;
1086:             ctx.run_root(
1087:                 client_host,
1088:                 &[
1089:                     "install",
1090:                     "-m",
1091:                     "0640",
1092:                     "-o",
1093:                     "root",
1094:                     "-g",
1095:                     "rustynetd",
1096:                     "/tmp/rn-dns-zone.bundle",
1097:                     "/var/lib/rustynet/rustynetd.dns-zone",
1098:                 ],
1099:             )?;
1100:             ctx.run_root(
1101:                 client_host,
1102:                 if clear_watermark {
1103:                     &[
1104:                         "rm",
1105:                         "-f",
1106:                         "/var/lib/rustynet/rustynetd.dns-zone.watermark",
1107:                         "/tmp/rn-dns-zone.pub",
1108:                         "/tmp/rn-dns-zone.bundle",
1109:                     ]
1110:                 } else {
1111:                     &[
1112:                         "rm",
1113:                         "-f",
1114:                         "/tmp/rn-dns-zone.pub",
1115:                         "/tmp/rn-dns-zone.bundle",
1116:                     ]
1117:                 },
1118:             )?;
1119:             Ok(())
1120:         },
1121:     )
1122: }

1124: fn refresh_traversal_bundles(
1125:     ctx: &LiveLabContext,
1126:     config: &Config,
1127:     workspace: &Path,
1128:     host_by_node: &HashMap<String, String>,
1129:     nodes_spec: &str,
1130:     allow_spec: &str,
1131: ) -> Result<(), String> {
1132:     retry_remote_step(
1133:         &format!("refresh traversal bundles from {}", config.signer_host),
1134:         SOAK_SSH_RETRY_ATTEMPTS,
1135:         SOAK_SSH_RETRY_SLEEP_SECS,
1136:         || {
1137:             let traversal_env = workspace.join("rn_issue_dns_traversal.env");
1138:             write_env_file(
1139:                 &traversal_env,
1140:                 &[("NODES_SPEC", nodes_spec), ("ALLOW_SPEC", allow_spec)],
1141:             )?;
1142:             let remote_env_path = TRAVERSAL_ENV_REMOTE;
1143:             ctx.scp_to(&traversal_env, &config.signer_host, remote_env_path)?;
1144:             ctx.run_root(
1145:                 &config.signer_host,
1146:                 &[
1147:                     "rustynet",
1148:                     "ops",
1149:                     "e2e-issue-traversal-bundles-from-env",
1150:                     "--env-file",
1151:                     remote_env_path,
1152:                 ],
1153:             )?;
1154:             ctx.run_root_allow_failure(&config.signer_host, &["rm", "-f", remote_env_path])?;
1155: 
1156:             let traversal_pub_local = workspace.join("traversal.pub");
1157:             capture_remote_text(
1158:                 ctx,
1159:                 &config.signer_host,
1160:                 TRAVERSAL_PUB_REMOTE,
1161:                 &traversal_pub_local,
1162:             )?;
1163:             for (node_id, host) in sorted_node_host_pairs(host_by_node) {
1164:                 let traversal_remote = traversal_bundle_remote_path(node_id.as_str());
1165:                 let traversal_local = workspace.join(format!("traversal-{node_id}.bundle"));
1166:                 capture_remote_text(
1167:                     ctx,
1168:                     &config.signer_host,
1169:                     traversal_remote.as_str(),
1170:                     &traversal_local,
1171:                 )?;
1172:                 install_traversal_bundle(ctx, &host, &traversal_pub_local, &traversal_local)?;
1173:             }
1174:             ctx.run_root_allow_failure(&config.signer_host, &["rm", "-rf", TRAVERSAL_ISSUE_DIR])?;
1175:             Ok(())
1176:         },
1177:     )
1178: }
1179: 
1180: fn sorted_node_host_pairs(host_by_node: &HashMap<String, String>) -> Vec<(String, String)> {
1181:     let mut entries = host_by_node
1182:         .iter()
1183:         .map(|(node_id, host)| (node_id.clone(), host.clone()))
1184:         .collect::<Vec<_>>();
1185:     entries.sort_by(|left, right| left.0.cmp(&right.0).then(left.1.cmp(&right.1)));
1186:     entries
1187: }

1190:     host_by_node: &HashMap<String, String>,
1191:     client_host: &str,
1192: ) -> Vec<(String, String)> {
1193:     sorted_node_host_pairs(host_by_node)
1194:         .into_iter()
1195:         .filter(|(_, host)| host != client_host)
1196:         .collect()
1197: }

1266: fn restart_managed_dns_stack(ctx: &LiveLabContext, client_host: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
1267:     ctx.run_root_allow_failure(
1268:         client_host,
1269:         &[
1270:             "systemctl",
1271:             "stop",
1272:             "rustynetd-managed-dns.service",
1273:             "rustynetd.service",
1274:             "rustynetd-privileged-helper.service",
1275:         ],
1276:     )?;
1277:     ctx.run_root_allow_failure(
1278:         client_host,
1279:         &[
1280:             "systemctl",
1281:             "reset-failed",
1282:             "rustynetd.service",
1283:             "rustynetd-managed-dns.service",
1284:             "rustynetd-privileged-helper.service",
1285:         ],
1286:     )?;
1287:     ctx.retry_root(
1288:         client_host,
1289:         &["systemctl", "start", "rustynetd-privileged-helper.service"],
1290:         5,
1291:         2,
1292:     )?;
1293:     ctx.retry_root(
1294:         client_host,
1295:         &[
1296:             "systemctl",
1297:             "is-active",
1298:             "rustynetd-privileged-helper.service",
1299:         ],
1300:         15,
1301:         2,
1302:     )?;
1303:     ctx.retry_root(
1304:         client_host,
1305:         &["systemctl", "start", "rustynetd.service"],
1306:         5,
1307:         2,
1308:     )?;
1309:     ctx.wait_for_daemon_socket(client_host, "/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock", 20, 2)?;
1310:     ctx.retry_root(
1311:         client_host,
1312:         &[
1313:             "env",
1314:             "RUSTYNET_DAEMON_SOCKET=/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock",
1315:             "rustynet",
1316:             "state",
1317:             "refresh",
1318:         ],
1319:         5,
1320:         2,
1321:     )?;
1322:     ctx.retry_root(
1323:         client_host,
1324:         &["systemctl", "restart", "rustynetd-managed-dns.service"],
1325:         5,
1326:         2,
1327:     )?;
1328:     ctx.retry_root(
1329:         client_host,
1330:         &["systemctl", "is-active", "rustynetd-managed-dns.service"],
1331:         15,
1332:         2,
1333:     )?;
1334:     wait_for_dns_inspect_state(ctx, client_host, Some("valid"), 20, 2)?;
1335:     Ok(())
1336: }

1347: fn build_authorized_allow_spec(
1348:     assignment_scopes: &HashMap<String, AssignmentAuthorityScope>,
1349:     host_by_node: &HashMap<String, String>,
1350: ) -> Result<String, String> {
1351:     let mut pairs = Vec::new();
1352:     for node_id in sorted_node_host_pairs(host_by_node)
1353:         .into_iter()
1354:         .map(|(node_id, _)| node_id)
1355:     {
1356:         let scope = assignment_scopes
1357:             .get(&node_id)
1358:             .ok_or_else(|| format!("missing assignment authority scope for {node_id}"))?;
1359:         for peer_node_id in &scope.peer_node_ids {
1360:             if !host_by_node.contains_key(peer_node_id.as_str()) {
1361:                 return Err(format!(
1362:                     "assignment bundle for {node_id} references unmanaged peer {peer_node_id}"
1363:                 ));
1364:             }
1365:             pairs.push(format!("{node_id}|{peer_node_id}"));
1366:         }
1367:     }
1368:     pairs.sort();
1369:     pairs.dedup();
1370:     if pairs.is_empty() {
1371:         return Err(
1372:             "managed DNS traversal issuance requires at least one authorized allow pair"
1373:                 .to_string(),
1374:         );
1375:     }
1376:     Ok(pairs.join(";"))
1377: }
1378: 
1379: fn capture_assignment_authority_scopes(
1380:     ctx: &LiveLabContext,
1381:     host_by_node: &HashMap<String, String>,
1382: ) -> Result<HashMap<String, AssignmentAuthorityScope>, String> {
1383:     let mut scopes = HashMap::new();
1384:     for (node_id, host) in sorted_node_host_pairs(host_by_node) {
1385:         let assignment_bundle =
1386:             ctx.capture_root(&host, &["cat", "/var/lib/rustynet/rustynetd.assignment"])?;
1387:         let scope = parse_assignment_authority_scope(&assignment_bundle)?;
1388:         if scope.node_id != node_id {
1389:             return Err(format!(
1390:                 "assignment bundle subject {subject} does not match expected node {expected} on {host}",
1391:                 subject = scope.node_id,
1392:                 expected = node_id,
1393:             ));
1394:         }
1395:         scopes.insert(node_id, scope);
1396:     }
1397:     Ok(scopes)
1398: }
1399: 
1400: #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
1401: struct AssignmentAuthorityScope {
1402:     node_id: String,
1403:     peer_node_ids: Vec<String>,
1404: }
