1406: #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
1407: struct ManagedDnsRecordTemplate {
1408:     label: String,
1409:     target_node_id: String,
1410:     ttl_secs: u64,
1411:     aliases: Vec<String>,
1412: }
1413: 
1414: fn managed_dns_base_records(
1415:     signer_node_id: &str,
1416:     client_node_id: &str,
1417: ) -> Vec<ManagedDnsRecordTemplate> {
1418:     vec![
1419:         ManagedDnsRecordTemplate {
1420:             label: MANAGED_LABEL.to_string(),
1421:             target_node_id: signer_node_id.to_string(),
1422:             ttl_secs: 300,
1423:             aliases: vec![MANAGED_ALIAS.to_string()],
1424:         },
1425:         ManagedDnsRecordTemplate {
1426:             label: "client".to_string(),
1427:             target_node_id: client_node_id.to_string(),
1428:             ttl_secs: 300,
1429:             aliases: Vec::new(),
1430:         },
1431:     ]
1432: }
1433: 
1434: fn managed_dns_replay_records(
1435:     records: &[ManagedDnsRecordTemplate],
1436:     signer_node_id: &str,
1437: ) -> Result<Vec<ManagedDnsRecordTemplate>, String> {
1438:     let mut replay_records = records.to_vec();
1439:     let signer_record = replay_records
1440:         .iter_mut()
1441:         .find(|record| record.target_node_id == signer_node_id)
1442:         .ok_or_else(|| {
1443:             format!("managed DNS replay probe could not find signer record for {signer_node_id}")
1444:         })?;
1445:     if signer_record
1446:         .aliases
1447:         .iter()
1448:         .any(|alias| alias == REPLAY_PROBE_ALIAS)
1449:     {
1450:         return Err(format!(
1451:             "managed DNS replay probe alias already present: {REPLAY_PROBE_ALIAS}"
1452:         ));
1453:     }
1454:     signer_record.aliases.push(REPLAY_PROBE_ALIAS.to_string());
1455:     Ok(replay_records)
1456: }
1457: 
1458: fn managed_dns_records_manifest_for_scope(
1459:     records: &[ManagedDnsRecordTemplate],
1460:     scope: &AssignmentAuthorityScope,
1461: ) -> Result<String, String> {
1462:     let allowed_targets = scope.peer_node_ids.iter().cloned().collect::<HashSet<_>>();
1463:     let filtered = records
1464:         .iter()
1465:         .filter(|record| {
1466:             record.target_node_id == scope.node_id
1467:                 || allowed_targets.contains(&record.target_node_id)
1468:         })
1469:         .cloned()
1470:         .collect::<Vec<_>>();
1471:     if filtered.is_empty() {
1472:         return Err(format!(
1473:             "managed DNS scope for {} produced no policy-authorized records",
1474:             scope.node_id
1475:         ));
1476:     }
1477:     let mut manifest = String::new();
1478:     manifest.push_str("version=1\n");
1479:     manifest.push_str(&format!("record_count={}\n", filtered.len()));
1480:     for (index, record) in filtered.iter().enumerate() {
1481:         manifest.push_str(&format!("record.{index}.label={}\n", record.label));
1482:         manifest.push_str(&format!(
1483:             "record.{index}.target_node_id={}\n",
1484:             record.target_node_id
1485:         ));
1486:         manifest.push_str(&format!("record.{index}.ttl_secs={}\n", record.ttl_secs));
1487:         manifest.push_str(&format!(
1488:             "record.{index}.alias_count={}\n",
1489:             record.aliases.len()
1490:         ));
1491:         for (alias_index, alias) in record.aliases.iter().enumerate() {
1492:             manifest.push_str(&format!("record.{index}.alias.{alias_index}={alias}\n"));
1493:         }
1494:     }
1495:     Ok(manifest)
1496: }
1497: 
1498: fn parse_assignment_authority_scope(bundle: &str) -> Result<AssignmentAuthorityScope, String> {
1499:     let mut node_id = None;
1500:     let mut peer_node_ids = Vec::new();
1501:     for line in bundle.lines() {
1502:         if let Some(value) = line.strip_prefix("node_id=") {
1503:             let trimmed = value.trim();
1504:             if trimmed.is_empty() {
1505:                 return Err("assignment bundle node_id must not be empty".to_string());
1506:             }
1507:             node_id = Some(trimmed.to_string());
1508:             continue;
1509:         }
1510:         if let Some((prefix, value)) = line.split_once('=')
1511:             && prefix.starts_with("peer.")
1512:             && prefix.ends_with(".node_id")
1513:         {
1514:             let trimmed = value.trim();
1515:             if trimmed.is_empty() {
1516:                 return Err(format!(
1517:                     "assignment bundle peer id must not be empty: {prefix}"
1518:                 ));
1519:             }
1520:             peer_node_ids.push(trimmed.to_string());
1521:         }
1522:     }
1523:     peer_node_ids.sort();
1524:     peer_node_ids.dedup();
1525:     Ok(AssignmentAuthorityScope {
1526:         node_id: node_id.ok_or_else(|| "assignment bundle is missing node_id".to_string())?,
1527:         peer_node_ids,
1528:     })
1529: }
1530: 
1531: fn rewrite_bundle_line_value(
1532:     bundle: &str,
1533:     field_key: &str,
1534:     new_value: &str,
1535: ) -> Result<String, String> {
1536:     let prefix = format!("{field_key}=");
1537:     let mut updated = Vec::new();
1538:     let mut replaced = false;
1539:     for line in bundle.lines() {
1540:         if !replaced && line.starts_with(prefix.as_str()) {
1541:             updated.push(format!("{prefix}{new_value}"));
1542:             replaced = true;
1543:         } else {
1544:             updated.push(line.to_string());
1545:         }
1546:     }
1547:     if !replaced {
1548:         return Err(format!(
1549:             "dns bundle field not found for rewrite: {field_key}"
1550:         ));
1551:     }
1552:     Ok(updated.join("\n") + "\n")
1553: }
1554: 
1555: fn rewrite_bundle_signature(bundle: &str, fill: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
1556:     let mut updated = Vec::new();
1557:     let mut replaced = false;
1558:     for line in bundle.lines() {
1559:         if !replaced && line.starts_with("signature=") {
1560:             let hex = line.trim_start_matches("signature=");
1561:             if hex.is_empty() {
1562:                 return Err("dns bundle signature line must not be empty".to_string());
1563:             }
1564:             updated.push(format!("signature={}", fill.repeat(hex.len())));
1565:             replaced = true;
1566:         } else {
1567:             updated.push(line.to_string());
1568:         }
1569:     }
1570:     if !replaced {
1571:         return Err("dns bundle is missing signature line".to_string());
1572:     }
1573:     Ok(updated.join("\n") + "\n")
1574: }

1579: }

1588: fn exercise_invalid_bundle_case(
1589:     validation: ManagedDnsValidationContext<'_>,
1590:     case: InvalidBundleCaseSpec<'_>,
1591: ) -> Result<InvalidBundleCaseResult, String> {
1592:     validation.logger.line(
1593:         format!(
1594:             "[managed-dns] installing {case_label} managed DNS bundle on {}",
1595:             validation.config.client_host,
1596:             case_label = case.case_label,
1597:         )
1598:         .as_str(),
1599:     )?;
1600:     install_dns_bundle_with_options(
1601:         validation.dns_issue.ctx,
1602:         &validation.config.client_host,
1603:         validation.verifier_local,
1604:         case.bundle_local,
1605:         case.clear_watermark,
1606:     )?;
1607:     refresh_traversal_bundles(
1608:         validation.dns_issue.ctx,
1609:         validation.config,
1610:         validation.workspace,
1611:         validation.host_by_node,
1612:         validation.dns_issue.nodes_spec,
1613:         validation.dns_issue.allow_spec,
1614:     )?;
1615:     let dns_inspect = restart_managed_dns_stack_allow_invalid_dns(
1616:         validation.dns_issue.ctx,
1617:         &validation.config.client_host,
1618:     )?;
1619:     let rustynetd_state = validation
1620:         .dns_issue
1621:         .ctx
1622:         .capture_root_allow_failure_with_retry(
1623:             &validation.config.client_host,
1624:             &["systemctl", "is-active", "rustynetd.service"],
1625:             SOAK_SSH_RETRY_ATTEMPTS,
1626:             SOAK_SSH_RETRY_SLEEP_SECS,
1627:         )?;
1628:     let rustynetd_journal = validation
1629:         .dns_issue
1630:         .ctx
1631:         .capture_root_allow_failure_with_retry(
1632:             &validation.config.client_host,
1633:             &[
1634:                 "journalctl",
1635:                 "-u",
1636:                 "rustynetd.service",
1637:                 "-n",
1638:                 "40",
1639:                 "--no-pager",
1640:             ],
1641:             SOAK_SSH_RETRY_ATTEMPTS,
1642:             SOAK_SSH_RETRY_SLEEP_SECS,
1643:         )?;
1644:     let direct_query = remote_dns_query_capture_allow_failure(
1645:         validation.dns_issue.ctx,
1646:         &validation.config.client_host,
1647:         validation.config,
1648:         &validation.config.managed_fqdn(),
1649:     )?;
1650:     let direct_query_log = if direct_query.payload.trim().is_empty() && direct_query.command_failed
1651:     {
1652:         format!(
1653:             "{{\"error\":\"query command failed closed\",\"failure_reason\":{}}}",
1654:             serde_json::to_string(&direct_query.failure_reason)
1655:                 .map_err(|err| format!("serialize DNS query failure reason failed: {err}"))?
1656:         )
1657:     } else {
1658:         direct_query.payload.clone()
1659:     };
1660: 
1661:     validation.logger.block(
1662:         format!(
1663:             "[managed-dns] {case_label} dns inspect",
1664:             case_label = case.case_label
1665:         )
1666:         .as_str(),
1667:         &dns_inspect,
1668:     )?;
1669:     validation.logger.block(
1670:         format!(
1671:             "[managed-dns] {case_label} rustynetd state",
1672:             case_label = case.case_label
1673:         )
1674:         .as_str(),
1675:         &rustynetd_state,
1676:     )?;
1677:     validation.logger.block(
1678:         format!(
1679:             "[managed-dns] {case_label} rustynetd journal",
1680:             case_label = case.case_label
1681:         )
1682:         .as_str(),
1683:         &rustynetd_journal,
1684:     )?;
1685:     validation.logger.block(
1686:         format!(
1687:             "[managed-dns] {case_label} loopback DNS query",
1688:             case_label = case.case_label
1689:         )
1690:         .as_str(),
1691:         &direct_query_log,
1692:     )?;
1693: 
1694:     let passed = managed_dns_invalid_state_observed(
1695:         dns_inspect.as_str(),
1696:         rustynetd_journal.as_str(),
1697:         case.expected_reason_fragments,
1698:     ) && dns_query_failed_closed(
1699:         validation.root_dir,
1700:         direct_query.payload.as_str(),
1701:         direct_query.command_failed,
1702:     )?;
1703: 
1704:     Ok(InvalidBundleCaseResult { passed })
1705: }
1706: 
1707: fn restart_managed_dns_stack_allow_invalid_dns(
1708:     ctx: &LiveLabContext,
1709:     client_host: &str,
1710: ) -> Result<String, String> {
1711:     ctx.run_root_allow_failure(
1712:         client_host,
1713:         &[
1714:             "systemctl",
1715:             "stop",
1716:             "rustynetd-managed-dns.service",
1717:             "rustynetd.service",
1718:             "rustynetd-privileged-helper.service",
1719:         ],
1720:     )?;
1721:     ctx.run_root_allow_failure(
1722:         client_host,
1723:         &[
1724:             "systemctl",
1725:             "reset-failed",
1726:             "rustynetd.service",
1727:             "rustynetd-managed-dns.service",
1728:             "rustynetd-privileged-helper.service",
1729:         ],
1730:     )?;
1731:     ctx.retry_root(
1732:         client_host,
1733:         &["systemctl", "start", "rustynetd-privileged-helper.service"],
1734:         5,
1735:         2,
1736:     )?;
1737:     ctx.retry_root(
1738:         client_host,
1739:         &[
1740:             "systemctl",
1741:             "is-active",
1742:             "rustynetd-privileged-helper.service",
1743:         ],
1744:         15,
1745:         2,
1746:     )?;
1747:     ctx.run_root_allow_failure(client_host, &["systemctl", "start", "rustynetd.service"])?;
1748:     ctx.run_root_allow_failure(
1749:         client_host,
1750:         &["systemctl", "restart", "rustynetd-managed-dns.service"],
1751:     )?;
1752:     ctx.wait_for_daemon_socket(client_host, "/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock", 20, 2)?;
1753:     wait_for_dns_inspect_state(ctx, client_host, None, 20, 2)
1754: }
1755: 
1756: fn restore_valid_bundle_after_invalid_case(
1757:     validation: ManagedDnsValidationContext<'_>,
1758:     restore: RestoreValidBundleSpec<'_>,
1759: ) -> Result<(), String> {
1760:     retry_remote_step(
1761:         &format!(
1762:             "restore valid managed DNS bundle on {}",
1763:             validation.config.client_host
1764:         ),
1765:         SOAK_SSH_RETRY_ATTEMPTS,
1766:         SOAK_SSH_RETRY_SLEEP_SECS,
1767:         || {
1768:             issue_and_capture_valid_client_bundle(
1769:                 validation.dns_issue,
1770:                 DnsBundleCaptureSpec {
1771:                     bundle: DnsBundleSpec {
1772:                         subject_node_id: &validation.config.client_node_id,
1773:                         records_manifest_remote: DNS_RECORDS_REMOTE,
1774:                         output_name: restore.output_name,
1775:                         timing: DnsBundleTiming {
1776:                             generated_at: None,
1777:                             nonce: None,
1778:                         },
1779:                     },
1780:                     bundle_local: restore.valid_bundle_local,
1781:                 },
1782:             )?;
1783:             install_dns_bundle(
1784:                 validation.dns_issue.ctx,
1785:                 &validation.config.client_host,
1786:                 validation.verifier_local,
1787:                 restore.valid_bundle_local,
1788:             )?;
1789:             refresh_traversal_bundles(
1790:                 validation.dns_issue.ctx,
1791:                 validation.config,
1792:                 validation.workspace,
1793:                 validation.host_by_node,
1794:                 validation.dns_issue.nodes_spec,
1795:                 validation.dns_issue.allow_spec,
1796:             )?;
1797:             restart_managed_dns_stack(validation.dns_issue.ctx, &validation.config.client_host)
1798:         },
1799:     )
1800: }
1801: 
1802: fn retry_remote_step<T, F>(
1803:     label: &str,
1804:     attempts: u32,
1805:     sleep_secs: u64,
1806:     mut operation: F,
1807: ) -> Result<T, String>
1808: where
1809:     F: FnMut() -> Result<T, String>,
1810: {
1811:     let mut last_err = None;
1812:     for attempt in 1..=attempts {
1813:         match operation() {
1814:             Ok(value) => return Ok(value),
1815:             Err(err) => {
1816:                 last_err = Some(err);
1817:                 if attempt < attempts {
1818:                     sleep(std::time::Duration::from_secs(sleep_secs));
1819:                 }
1820:             }
1821:         }
1822:     }
1823:     Err(format!(
1824:         "{label} failed after {attempts} attempts: {}",
1825:         last_err.unwrap_or_else(|| "retry exhausted".to_string())
1826:     ))
1827: }
1828: 
1829: fn wait_for_dns_inspect_state(
1830:     ctx: &LiveLabContext,
1831:     client_host: &str,
1832:     expected_state: Option<&str>,
1833:     attempts: u32,
1834:     sleep_secs: u64,
1835: ) -> Result<String, String> {
1836:     let mut last_output = None;
1837:     for attempt in 1..=attempts {
1838:         let output = ctx.capture_root_allow_failure_with_retry(
1839:             client_host,
1840:             &[
1841:                 "env",
1842:                 "RUSTYNET_DAEMON_SOCKET=/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock",
1843:                 "rustynet",
1844:                 "dns",
1845:                 "inspect",
1846:             ],
1847:             SOAK_SSH_RETRY_ATTEMPTS,
1848:             SOAK_SSH_RETRY_SLEEP_SECS,
1849:         )?;
1850:         if dns_inspect_readback_ready(output.as_str())
1851:             && dns_inspect_matches_expected_state(output.as_str(), expected_state)
1852:         {
1853:             return Ok(output);
1854:         }
1855:         last_output = Some(output);
1856:         if attempt < attempts {
1857:             sleep(std::time::Duration::from_secs(sleep_secs));
1858:         }
1859:     }
1860:     Err(format!(
1861:         "managed DNS inspect did not converge on {client_host}: {}",
1862:         last_output
1863:             .map(|output| output.trim().to_string())
1864:             .filter(|output| !output.is_empty())
1865:             .unwrap_or_else(|| "empty output".to_string())
1866:     ))
1867: }
1868: 
1869: fn dns_inspect_readback_ready(output: &str) -> bool {
1870:     let trimmed = output.trim();
1871:     if trimmed.is_empty() {
1872:         return false;
1873:     }
1874:     let normalized = normalize_reason_text(trimmed);
1875:     !normalized.contains("daemon unreachable")
1876:         && !normalized.contains("inspect daemon socket failed")
1877: }
1878: 
1879: fn dns_inspect_matches_expected_state(output: &str, expected_state: Option<&str>) -> bool {
1880:     match expected_state {
1881:         Some(state) => output.contains(&format!("dns inspect: state={state}")),
1882:         None => output.contains("dns inspect: state="),
1883:     }
1884: }
1885: 
1886: fn managed_dns_invalid_state_observed(
1887:     dns_inspect: &str,
1888:     rustynetd_journal: &str,
1889:     expected_reason_fragments: &[&str],
1890: ) -> bool {
1891:     if dns_inspect.contains("dns inspect: state=invalid")
1892:         && contains_all_reason_fragments(dns_inspect, expected_reason_fragments)
1893:     {
1894:         return true;
1895:     }
1896:     let journal_lower = rustynetd_journal.to_ascii_lowercase();
1897:     let journal_has_preflight_marker = journal_lower.contains("dns zone preflight failed")
1898:         || journal_lower.contains("dns zone preflight skipped invalid managed dns bundle");
1899:     journal_has_preflight_marker
1900:         && contains_all_reason_fragments(rustynetd_journal, expected_reason_fragments)
1901: }
1902: 
1903: fn contains_all_reason_fragments(haystack: &str, expected_reason_fragments: &[&str]) -> bool {
1904:     let normalized_haystack = normalize_reason_text(haystack);
1905:     expected_reason_fragments.iter().all(|fragment| {
1906:         let normalized_fragment = normalize_reason_text(fragment);
1907:         normalized_haystack.contains(normalized_fragment.as_str())
1908:     })
1909: }
1910: 
1911: fn normalize_reason_text(value: &str) -> String {
1912:     value.to_ascii_lowercase().replace('_', " ")
1913: }
1914: 
1915: fn dns_query_failed_closed(
1916:     root_dir: &Path,
1917:     direct_query: &str,
1918:     command_failed: bool,
1919: ) -> Result<bool, String> {
1920:     if direct_query.trim().is_empty() {
1921:         return Ok(command_failed);
1922:     }
1923:     let rcode = json_field(root_dir, direct_query, "rcode")?;
1924:     let error = json_field(root_dir, direct_query, "error")?;
1925:     Ok(rcode != "0" || !error.trim().is_empty())
1926: }

1928: fn capture_remote_text(
1929:     ctx: &LiveLabContext,
1930:     host: &str,
1931:     remote_path: &str,
1932:     local_path: &Path,
1933: ) -> Result<(), String> {
1934:     let body = ctx.capture_root(host, &["cat", remote_path])?;
1935:     write_secure_text(local_path, &body)
1936: }

1938: fn run_cargo_ops_capture(
1939:     root_dir: &Path,
1940:     subcommand: &str,
1941:     args: &[&str],
1942: ) -> Result<String, String> {
1943:     let output = Command::new("cargo")
1944:         .current_dir(root_dir)
1945:         .args([
1946:             "run",
1947:             "--quiet",
1948:             "-p",
1949:             "rustynet-cli",
1950:             "--",
1951:             "ops",
1952:             subcommand,
1953:         ])
1954:         .args(args)
1955:         .output()
1956:         .map_err(|err| format!("failed to run cargo ops {subcommand}: {err}"))?;
1957:     if !output.status.success() {
1958:         return Err(format!(
1959:             "cargo ops {subcommand} failed with status {}: {}",
1960:             live_lab_support::status_code(output.status),
1961:             String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).trim()
1962:         ));
1963:     }
1964:     Ok(String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).into_owned())
1965: }

1967: fn remote_dns_query_capture(
1968:     ctx: &LiveLabContext,
1969:     host: &str,
1970:     config: &Config,
1971:     qname: &str,
1972: ) -> Result<String, String> {
1973:     ctx.capture_root(
1974:         host,
1975:         &[
1976:             "rustynet",
1977:             "ops",
1978:             "e2e-dns-query",
1979:             "--server",
1980:             &config.dns_server(),
1981:             "--port",
1982:             &config.dns_port(),
1983:             "--qname",
1984:             qname,
1985:             "--timeout-ms",
1986:             "3000",
1987:         ],
1988:     )
1989: }

1991: fn remote_dns_query_capture_allow_failure(
1992:     ctx: &LiveLabContext,
1993:     host: &str,
1994:     config: &Config,
1995:     qname: &str,
1996: ) -> Result<RemoteDnsQueryCapture, String> {
1997:     let output = ctx.run_root_allow_failure_with_retry(
1998:         host,
1999:         &[
2000:             "rustynet",
2001:             "ops",
2002:             "e2e-dns-query",
2003:             "--server",
2004:             &config.dns_server(),
2005:             "--port",
2006:             &config.dns_port(),
2007:             "--qname",
2008:             qname,
2009:             "--timeout-ms",
2010:             "3000",
2011:         ],
2012:         SOAK_SSH_RETRY_ATTEMPTS,
2013:         SOAK_SSH_RETRY_SLEEP_SECS,
2014:     )?;
2015:     Ok(RemoteDnsQueryCapture {
2016:         payload: String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).into_owned(),
2017:         command_failed: !output.status.success(),
2018:         failure_reason: render_remote_output(&output),
2019:     })
2020: }
2021: 
2022: fn render_remote_output(output: &Output) -> String {
2023:     let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr);
2024:     let stderr = stderr.trim();
2025:     let stdout = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout);
2026:     let stdout = stdout.trim();
2027:     if !stderr.is_empty() && !stdout.is_empty() {
2028:         format!("{stderr} (stdout: {stdout})")
2029:     } else if !stderr.is_empty() {
2030:         stderr.to_string()
2031:     } else if !stdout.is_empty() {
2032:         format!("stdout: {stdout}")
2033:     } else {
2034:         "remote command exited non-zero without output".to_string()
2035:     }
2036: }

2038: fn json_field(root_dir: &Path, payload: &str, field: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
2039:     run_cargo_ops_capture(
2040:         root_dir,
2041:         "read-json-field",
2042:         &["--payload", payload, "--field", field],
2043:     )
2044:     .map(|value| value.trim().to_string())
2045: }

2069: fn format_env_assignment(key: &str, value: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
2070:     validate_env_key(key)?;
2071:     Ok(format!("{key}={}", quote_env_value(value)?))
2072: }

2074: fn validate_env_key(key: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
2075:     if key.is_empty()
2076:         || !key
2077:             .chars()
2078:             .all(|ch| ch.is_ascii_uppercase() || ch.is_ascii_digit() || ch == '_')
2079:     {
2080:         return Err(format!("invalid env key: {key}"));
2081:     }
2082:     Ok(())
2083: }
2084: 
2085: fn quote_env_value(value: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
2086:     if value.contains('\0') || value.contains('\n') || value.contains('\r') {
2087:         return Err("env value must not contain newline or NUL characters".to_string());
2088:     }
2089:     let mut quoted = String::from("\"");
2090:     for ch in value.chars() {
2091:         match ch {
2092:             '\\' => quoted.push_str("\\\\"),
2093:             '"' => quoted.push_str("\\\""),
2094:             '$' => quoted.push_str("\\$"),
2095:             '`' => quoted.push_str("\\`"),
2096:             _ => quoted.push(ch),
2097:         }
2098:     }
2099:     quoted.push('"');
2100:     Ok(quoted)
2101: }

2103: fn ensure_safe_token(label: &str, value: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
2104:     if value.is_empty() {
2105:         return Err(format!("{label} must not be empty"));
2106:     }
2107:     let allowed = |ch: char| {
2108:         ch.is_ascii_alphanumeric()
2109:             || matches!(ch, '.' | '_' | ':' | '/' | ',' | '@' | '+' | '=' | '-')
2110:     };
2111:     if !value.chars().all(allowed) {
2112:         return Err(format!("{label} contains unsupported characters: {value}"));
2113:     }
2114:     Ok(())
2115: }
2116: 
2117: fn ensure_safe_spec(label: &str, value: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
2118:     if value.is_empty() {
2119:         return Err(format!("{label} must not be empty"));
2120:     }
2121:     let allowed = |ch: char| {
2122:         ch.is_ascii_alphanumeric()
2123:             || matches!(
2124:                 ch,
2125:                 '.' | '_' | ':' | '/' | ',' | '@' | '+' | '=' | '-' | '|' | ';'
2126:             )
2127:     };
2128:     if !value.chars().all(allowed) {
2129:         return Err(format!("{label} contains unsupported characters: {value}"));
2130:     }
2131:     Ok(())
2132: }

2147: fn parse_managed_peer_spec(value: &str) -> Result<ManagedPeerSpec, String> {
2148:     let trimmed = value.trim();
2149:     let (node_id_raw, host_raw) = trimmed.split_once('|').ok_or_else(|| {
2150:         format!("invalid --managed-peer value (expected <node-id>|<user@host>): {value}")
2151:     })?;
2152:     let node_id = node_id_raw.trim();
2153:     let host = host_raw.trim();
2154:     if node_id.is_empty() || host.is_empty() {
2155:         return Err(format!(
2156:             "invalid --managed-peer value (node-id and host must be non-empty): {value}"
2157:         ));
2158:     }
2159:     Ok(ManagedPeerSpec {
2160:         node_id: node_id.to_string(),
2161:         host: host.to_string(),
2162:     })
2163: }

2170: fn utc_now_string() -> String {
2171:     let output = Command::new("date")
2172:         .args(["-u", "+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"])
2173:         .output()
2174:         .ok();
2175:     if let Some(output) = output
2176:         && output.status.success()
2177:     {
2178:         let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).trim().to_string();
2179:         if !text.is_empty() {
2180:             return text;
2181:         }
2182:     }
2183:     "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z".to_string()
2184: }

2190:         .unwrap_or(0)
2191: }

2193: fn git_commit(root_dir: &Path) -> String {
2194:     if let Ok(value) = env::var("RUSTYNET_EXPECTED_GIT_COMMIT") {
2195:         return value.trim().to_lowercase();
2196:     }
2197:     let output = Command::new("git")
2198:         .current_dir(root_dir)
2199:         .args(["rev-parse", "HEAD"])
2200:         .output();
2201:     match output {
2202:         Ok(output) if output.status.success() => String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout)
2203:             .trim()
2204:             .to_lowercase(),
2205:         _ => "unknown".to_string(),
2206:     }
2207: }

2209: fn require_command(command: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
2210:     let status = Command::new("sh")
2211:         .args([
2212:             "-lc",
2213:             &format!("command -v {} >/dev/null 2>&1", shell_single_quote(command)),
2214:         ])
2215:         .status()
2216:         .map_err(|err| format!("failed to probe command {command}: {err}"))?;
2217:     if status.success() {
2218:         Ok(())
2219:     } else {
2220:         Err(format!("missing required command: {command}"))
2221:     }
2222: }

  73: fn run() -> Result<(), String> {
  74:     let args: Vec<String> = env::args().skip(1).collect();
  75:     let config = Config::parse(args)?;
  76:     let root_dir = live_lab_support::repo_root()?;
  77: 
  78:     for command in [
  79:         "cargo",
  80:         "git",
  81:         "ssh",
  82:         "scp",
  83:         "ssh-keygen",
  84:         "awk",
  85:         "sed",
  86:         "openssl",
  87:         "xxd",
  88:         "mktemp",
  89:         "chmod",
  90:         "tr",
  91:     ] {
  92:         require_command(command)?;
  93:     }
  94: 
  95:     if !config.ssh_identity_file.is_file() {
  96:         return Err(format!(
  97:             "missing ssh identity file: {}",
  98:             config.ssh_identity_file.display()
  99:         ));
 100:     }
 101:     if config.ssh_identity_file.is_symlink() {
 102:         return Err(format!(
 103:             "ssh identity file must not be a symlink: {}",
 104:             config.ssh_identity_file.display()
 105:         ));
 106:     }
 107:     live_lab_support::run_cargo_ops(
 108:         &root_dir,
 109:         "check-local-file-mode",
 110:         &[
 111:             OsString::from("--path"),
 112:             config.ssh_identity_file.clone().into_os_string(),
 113:             OsString::from("--policy"),
 114:             OsString::from("owner-only"),
 115:             OsString::from("--label"),
 116:             OsString::from("ssh identity file"),
 117:         ],
 118:     )?;
 119: 
 120:     let pinned_known_hosts = match &config.pinned_known_hosts_file {
 121:         Some(path) => path.clone(),
 122:         None => live_lab_support::load_home_known_hosts_path()?,
 123:     };
 124:     live_lab_support::ensure_pinned_known_hosts_file(&pinned_known_hosts)?;
 125: 
 126:     let workspace = create_workspace("role-switch-live")?;
 127:     let work_known_hosts = workspace.path().join("known_hosts");
 128:     live_lab_support::seed_known_hosts(&pinned_known_hosts, &work_known_hosts)?;
 129:     let mut logger = Logger::new(&config.log_path)?;
 130:     let mut source_body = String::new();
 131:     let git_commit = config.git_commit.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| {
 132:         git_head_commit(&root_dir).unwrap_or_else(|err| {
 133:             eprintln!("{err}");
 134:             std::process::exit(1);
 135:         })
 136:     });
 137:     let captured_at_unix = unix_now();
 138:     let captured_at_utc = utc_now_string();
 139:     source_body.push_str("# Role Switch Matrix (current commit)\n\n");
 140:     source_body.push_str(format!("Captured at: {captured_at_utc}\n\n").as_str());
 141: 
 142:     let tmp_json = workspace.path().join("role_switch_hosts.json");
 143:     write_file(&tmp_json, "{}\n")?;
 144: 
 145:     logger.line("[role-switch] starting live role-switch matrix validation")?;
 146: 
 147:     let signed_state_refresh = build_signed_state_refresh_context(&config)?;
 148:     let mut run_context = RoleSwitchRunContext {
 149:         logger: &mut logger,
 150:         identity: &config.ssh_identity_file,
 151:         known_hosts: &work_known_hosts,
 152:         ssh_allow_cidrs: &config.ssh_allow_cidrs,
 153:         hosts_json_path: &tmp_json,
 154:         workspace_dir: workspace.path(),
 155:         signed_state_refresh: signed_state_refresh.as_ref(),
 156:     };
 157: 
 158:     let mut overall_status = "pass".to_string();
 159:     for host in [
 160:         HostSwitchSpec {
 161:             host: &config.debian_host,
 162:             os_id: "debian13",
 163:             temp_role: "admin",
 164:             node_id: &config.debian_node_id,
 165:         },
 166:         HostSwitchSpec {
 167:             host: &config.fedora_host,
 168:             os_id: "fedora",
 169:             temp_role: "blind_exit",
 170:             node_id: &config.fedora_node_id,
 171:         },
 172:         HostSwitchSpec {
 173:             host: &config.ubuntu_host,
 174:             os_id: "ubuntu",
 175:             temp_role: "admin",
 176:             node_id: &config.ubuntu_node_id,
 177:         },
 178:         HostSwitchSpec {
 179:             host: &config.mint_host,
 180:             os_id: "mint",
 181:             temp_role: "admin",
 182:             node_id: &config.mint_node_id,
 183:         },
 184:     ] {
 185:         process_host(
 186:             &mut run_context,
 187:             host,
 188:             &mut source_body,
 189:             &mut overall_status,
 190:         )?;
 191:     }
 192: 
 193:     write_file(&config.source_path, &source_body)?;
 194: 
 195:     run_cargo_ops(
 196:         &root_dir,
 197:         "write-role-switch-matrix-report",
 198:         &[
 199:             OsString::from("--hosts-json-path"),
 200:             tmp_json.as_os_str().to_os_string(),
 201:             OsString::from("--report-path"),
 202:             config.report_path.clone().into_os_string(),
 203:             OsString::from("--source-path"),
 204:             config.source_path.clone().into_os_string(),
 205:             OsString::from("--git-commit"),
 206:             OsString::from(git_commit),
 207:             OsString::from("--captured-at-unix"),
 208:             OsString::from(captured_at_unix.to_string()),
 209:             OsString::from("--overall-status"),
 210:             OsString::from(overall_status.clone()),
 211:         ],
 212:     )?;
 213: 
 214:     logger.line(format!("role_switch_report={}", config.report_path.display()).as_str())?;
 215:     logger.line(format!("role_switch_source={}", config.source_path.display()).as_str())?;
 216: 
 217:     if overall_status != "pass" {
 218:         return Err("role-switch matrix validation failed".to_string());
 219:     }
 220: 
 221:     Ok(())
 222: }
 223: 
 224: #[derive(Debug)]
 225: struct Config {
 226:     ssh_identity_file: PathBuf,
 227:     exit_host: String,
 228:     exit_node_id: String,
 229:     debian_host: String,
 230:     debian_node_id: String,
 231:     ubuntu_host: String,
 232:     ubuntu_node_id: String,
 233:     fedora_host: String,
 234:     fedora_node_id: String,
 235:     mint_host: String,
 236:     mint_node_id: String,
 237:     ssh_allow_cidrs: String,
 238:     report_path: PathBuf,
 239:     source_path: PathBuf,
 240:     log_path: PathBuf,
 241:     pinned_known_hosts_file: Option<PathBuf>,
 242:     git_commit: Option<String>,
 243:     traversal_env_file: Option<PathBuf>,
 244:     dns_zone_env_file: Option<PathBuf>,
 245: }
 246: 
 247: impl Config {
 248:     fn parse(args: Vec<String>) -> Result<Self, String> {
 249:         let mut config = Self {
 250:             ssh_identity_file: PathBuf::new(),
 251:             exit_host: "debian@192.168.18.50".to_string(),
 252:             exit_node_id: "exit-50".to_string(),
 253:             debian_host: "debian@192.168.18.65".to_string(),
 254:             debian_node_id: "client-65".to_string(),
 255:             ubuntu_host: "ubuntu@192.168.18.52".to_string(),
 256:             ubuntu_node_id: "client-52".to_string(),
 257:             fedora_host: "fedora@192.168.18.51".to_string(),
 258:             fedora_node_id: "client-51".to_string(),
 259:             mint_host: "mint@192.168.18.53".to_string(),
 260:             mint_node_id: "client-53".to_string(),
 261:             ssh_allow_cidrs: "192.168.18.0/24".to_string(),
 262:             report_path: PathBuf::from("artifacts/phase10/role_switch_matrix_report.json"),
 263:             source_path: PathBuf::from("artifacts/phase10/source/role_switch_matrix.md"),
 264:             log_path: PathBuf::from("artifacts/phase10/source/live_linux_role_switch_matrix.log"),
 265:             pinned_known_hosts_file: None,
 266:             git_commit: None,
 267:             traversal_env_file: None,
 268:             dns_zone_env_file: None,
 269:         };
 270: 
 271:         let mut iter = args.into_iter();
 272:         while let Some(arg) = iter.next() {
 273:             match arg.as_str() {
 274:                 "--ssh-identity-file" => {
 275:                     config.ssh_identity_file = PathBuf::from(next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?)
 276:                 }
 277:                 "--exit-host" => config.exit_host = next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?,
 278:                 "--exit-node-id" => config.exit_node_id = next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?,
 279:                 "--debian-host" => config.debian_host = next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?,
 280:                 "--debian-node-id" => config.debian_node_id = next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?,
 281:                 "--ubuntu-host" => config.ubuntu_host = next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?,
 282:                 "--ubuntu-node-id" => config.ubuntu_node_id = next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?,
 283:                 "--fedora-host" => config.fedora_host = next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?,
 284:                 "--fedora-node-id" => config.fedora_node_id = next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?,
 285:                 "--mint-host" => config.mint_host = next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?,
 286:                 "--mint-node-id" => config.mint_node_id = next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?,
 287:                 "--ssh-allow-cidrs" => config.ssh_allow_cidrs = next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?,
 288:                 "--report-path" => config.report_path = PathBuf::from(next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?),
 289:                 "--source-path" => config.source_path = PathBuf::from(next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?),
 290:                 "--log-path" => config.log_path = PathBuf::from(next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?),
 291:                 "--known-hosts" => {
 292:                     config.pinned_known_hosts_file =
 293:                         Some(PathBuf::from(next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?))
 294:                 }
 295:                 "--git-commit" => config.git_commit = Some(next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?),
 296:                 "--traversal-env-file" => {
 297:                     config.traversal_env_file = Some(PathBuf::from(next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?))
 298:                 }
 299:                 "--dns-zone-env-file" => {
 300:                     config.dns_zone_env_file = Some(PathBuf::from(next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?))
 301:                 }
 302:                 "-h" | "--help" => {
 303:                     print_usage();
 304:                     std::process::exit(0);
 305:                 }
 306:                 unknown => return Err(format!("unknown argument: {unknown}")),
 307:             }
 308:         }
 309: 
 310:         if config.ssh_identity_file.as_os_str().is_empty() {
 311:             return Err(
 312:                 "usage: live_linux_role_switch_matrix_test --ssh-identity-file <path> [options]"
 313:                     .to_string(),
 314:             );
 315:         }
 316:         for (label, value) in [
 317:             ("debian-host", config.debian_host.as_str()),
 318:             ("debian-node-id", config.debian_node_id.as_str()),
 319:             ("exit-host", config.exit_host.as_str()),
 320:             ("exit-node-id", config.exit_node_id.as_str()),
 321:             ("ubuntu-host", config.ubuntu_host.as_str()),
 322:             ("ubuntu-node-id", config.ubuntu_node_id.as_str()),
 323:             ("fedora-host", config.fedora_host.as_str()),
 324:             ("fedora-node-id", config.fedora_node_id.as_str()),
 325:             ("mint-host", config.mint_host.as_str()),
 326:             ("mint-node-id", config.mint_node_id.as_str()),
 327:             ("ssh-allow-cidrs", config.ssh_allow_cidrs.as_str()),
 328:         ] {
 329:             live_lab_support::ensure_safe_token(label, value)?;
 330:         }
 331:         if let Some(path) = &config.traversal_env_file
 332:             && !path.is_file()
 333:         {
 334:             return Err(format!("missing traversal env file: {}", path.display()));
 335:         }
 336:         if let Some(path) = &config.dns_zone_env_file
 337:             && !path.is_file()
 338:         {
 339:             return Err(format!("missing dns zone env file: {}", path.display()));
 340:         }
 341:         Ok(config)
 342:     }
 343: }
 344: 
 345: fn build_signed_state_refresh_context(
 346:     config: &Config,
 347: ) -> Result<Option<SignedStateRefreshContext>, String> {
 348:     match (
 349:         config.traversal_env_file.as_ref(),
 350:         config.dns_zone_env_file.as_ref(),
 351:     ) {
 352:         (None, None) => Ok(None),
 353:         (Some(_), None) => Err(
 354:             "role-switch signed-state refresh requires --dns-zone-env-file when --traversal-env-file is set"
 355:                 .to_string(),
 356:         ),
 357:         (None, Some(_)) => Err(
 358:             "role-switch signed-state refresh requires --traversal-env-file when --dns-zone-env-file is set"
 359:                 .to_string(),
 360:         ),
 361:         (Some(traversal_env_file), Some(dns_zone_env_file)) => {
 362:             Ok(Some(SignedStateRefreshContext {
 363:                 traversal_env_file: traversal_env_file.clone(),
 364:                 dns_zone_env_file: dns_zone_env_file.clone(),
 365:                 exit_host: config.exit_host.clone(),
 366:                 targets: vec![
 367:                     SignedStateRefreshTarget {
 368:                         host: config.exit_host.clone(),
 369:                         node_id: config.exit_node_id.clone(),
 370:                     },
 371:                     SignedStateRefreshTarget {
 372:                         host: config.debian_host.clone(),
 373:                         node_id: config.debian_node_id.clone(),
 374:                     },
 375:                     SignedStateRefreshTarget {
 376:                         host: config.ubuntu_host.clone(),
 377:                         node_id: config.ubuntu_node_id.clone(),
 378:                     },
 379:                     SignedStateRefreshTarget {
 380:                         host: config.fedora_host.clone(),
 381:                         node_id: config.fedora_node_id.clone(),
 382:                     },
 383:                     SignedStateRefreshTarget {
 384:                         host: config.mint_host.clone(),
 385:                         node_id: config.mint_node_id.clone(),
 386:                     },
 387:                 ],
 388:             }))
 389:         }
 390:     }
 391: }
 392: 
 393: fn process_host(
 394:     context: &mut RoleSwitchRunContext<'_>,
 395:     spec: HostSwitchSpec<'_>,
 396:     source_body: &mut String,
 397:     overall_status: &mut String,
 398: ) -> Result<(), String> {
 399:     context.logger.line(
 400:         format!(
 401:             "[role-switch] {} {} -> {}",
 402:             spec.os_id, spec.host, spec.temp_role
 403:         )
 404:         .as_str(),
 405:     )?;
 406:     let (baseline, baseline_exit) = {
 407:         let mut client_role = ClientRoleContext {
 408:             logger: &mut *context.logger,
 409:             identity: context.identity,
 410:             known_hosts: context.known_hosts,
 411:             host: spec.host,
 412:             node_id: spec.node_id,
 413:             ssh_allow_cidrs: context.ssh_allow_cidrs,
 414:             workspace_dir: context.workspace_dir,
 415:             signed_state_refresh: context.signed_state_refresh,
 416:         };
 417:         let baseline = ensure_client_role(&mut client_role)?;
 418:         let baseline_exit = field_value(&baseline, "exit_node");
 419:         (baseline, baseline_exit)
 420:     };
 421: 
 422:     switch_role(
 423:         context.identity,
 424:         context.known_hosts,
 425:         spec.host,
 426:         spec.temp_role,
 427:         spec.node_id,
 428:         context.ssh_allow_cidrs,
 429:     )?;
 430:     if let Some(refresh) = context.signed_state_refresh {
 431:         refresh_signed_state_for_transition(
 432:             context.logger,
 433:             context.identity,
 434:             context.known_hosts,
 435:             context.workspace_dir,
 436:             refresh,
 437:             spec.host,
 438:             format!(
 439:                 "before waiting for {} to settle as {}",
 440:                 spec.node_id, spec.temp_role
 441:             )
 442:             .as_str(),
 443:         )?;
 444:     }
 445:     let after_temp = wait_for_role(
 446:         context.identity,
 447:         context.known_hosts,
 448:         spec.host,
 449:         spec.temp_role,
 450:     )?;
 451: 
 452:     let mut switch_execution = "fail";
 453:     let mut post_switch_reconcile = "fail";
 454:     let mut policy_still_enforced = "fail";
 455:     let mut least_privilege_preserved = "fail";
 456: 
 457:     if spec.temp_role == "blind_exit" {
 458:         if route_advertise_denied(context.identity, context.known_hosts, spec.host)? {
 459:             policy_still_enforced = "pass";
 460:         }
 461:         if exit_select_denied(
 462:             context.identity,
 463:             context.known_hosts,
 464:             spec.host,
 465:             &baseline_exit,
 466:         )? && lan_toggle_denied(context.identity, context.known_hosts, spec.host)?
 467:         {
 468:             least_privilege_preserved = "pass";
 469:         }
 470:     } else if route_advertise_denied(context.identity, context.known_hosts, spec.host)? {
 471:         policy_still_enforced = "pass";
 472:         least_privilege_preserved = "pass";
 473:     }
 474: 
 475:     let mut restore_context = ClientRoleContext {
 476:         logger: &mut *context.logger,
 477:         identity: context.identity,
 478:         known_hosts: context.known_hosts,
 479:         host: spec.host,
 480:         node_id: spec.node_id,
 481:         ssh_allow_cidrs: context.ssh_allow_cidrs,
 482:         workspace_dir: context.workspace_dir,
 483:         signed_state_refresh: context.signed_state_refresh,
 484:     };
 485:     let after_restore =
 486:         ensure_client_role_with_expected_exit(&mut restore_context, Some(&baseline_exit))?;
 487: 
 488:     if field_value(&after_temp, "node_role") == spec.temp_role
 489:         && field_value(&after_restore, "node_role") == "client"
 490:     {
 491:         switch_execution = "pass";
 492:     }
 493: 
 494:     if spec.temp_role == "blind_exit" {
 495:         if field_value(&after_temp, "serving_exit_node") == "true"
 496:             && field_value(&after_temp, "exit_node") == "none"
 497:             && field_value(&after_temp, "lan_access") == "off"
 498:             && !baseline_exit.is_empty()
 499:             && baseline_exit != "none"
 500:             && client_exit_route_converged(&after_restore, &baseline_exit)
 501:         {
 502:             post_switch_reconcile = "pass";
 503:         }
 504:     } else if !baseline_exit.is_empty()
 505:         && baseline_exit != "none"
 506:         && field_value(&after_temp, "serving_exit_node") == "false"
 507:         && field_value(&after_temp, "exit_node") == baseline_exit
 508:         && client_exit_route_converged(&after_restore, &baseline_exit)
 509:     {
 510:         post_switch_reconcile = "pass";
 511:     }
 512: 
 513:     source_body.push_str(format!("## {} ({})\n", spec.os_id, spec.host).as_str());
 514:     source_body.push_str(format!("- baseline: {}\n", sanitize_line(&baseline)).as_str());
 515:     source_body.push_str(format!("- after_temp: {}\n", sanitize_line(&after_temp)).as_str());
 516:     source_body
 517:         .push_str(format!("- after_restore: {}\n\n", sanitize_line(&after_restore)).as_str());
 518: 
 519:     run_cargo_ops(
 520:         &live_lab_support::repo_root()?,
 521:         "update-role-switch-host-result",
 522:         &[
 523:             OsString::from("--hosts-json-path"),
 524:             context.hosts_json_path.as_os_str().to_os_string(),
 525:             OsString::from("--os-id"),
 526:             OsString::from(spec.os_id),
 527:             OsString::from("--temp-role"),
 528:             OsString::from(spec.temp_role),
 529:             OsString::from("--switch-execution"),
 530:             OsString::from(switch_execution),
 531:             OsString::from("--post-switch-reconcile"),
 532:             OsString::from(post_switch_reconcile),
 533:             OsString::from("--policy-still-enforced"),
 534:             OsString::from(policy_still_enforced),
 535:             OsString::from("--least-privilege-preserved"),
 536:             OsString::from(least_privilege_preserved),
 537:         ],
 538:     )?;
 539: 
 540:     if switch_execution != "pass"
 541:         || post_switch_reconcile != "pass"
 542:         || policy_still_enforced != "pass"
 543:         || least_privilege_preserved != "pass"
 544:     {
 545:         *overall_status = "fail".to_string();
 546:     }
 547:     Ok(())
 548: }
 549: 
 550: fn switch_role(
 551:     identity: &Path,
 552:     known_hosts: &Path,
 553:     host: &str,
 554:     role: &str,
 555:     node_id: &str,
 556:     ssh_allow_cidrs: &str,
 557: ) -> Result<(), String> {
 558:     enforce_host(
 559:         identity,
 560:         known_hosts,
 561:         host,
 562:         role,
 563:         node_id,
 564:         &remote_src_dir(host),
 565:         ssh_allow_cidrs,
 566:     )?;
 567:     wait_for_daemon_socket(
 568:         identity,
 569:         known_hosts,
 570:         host,
 571:         "/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock",
 572:         20,
 573:         2,
 574:     )?;
 575:     // After enforce_host the daemon comes up cold and stays in
 576:     // restricted-safe mode until it ingests fresh signed trust
 577:     // evidence. Callers of switch_role typically follow up with a
 578:     // mutating IPC command (apply_role_coupling, route advertise,
 579:     // exit-node select) before refresh_signed_state_for_transition
 580:     // gets a chance to run, so refresh trust here as part of the
 581:     // switch contract. Mirrors the explicit pre-mutation refresh
 582:     // pattern from live_linux_two_hop_test (commit cca0418) and
 583:     // live_linux_lan_toggle_test (commit fc648df).
 584:     refresh_trust_evidence(identity, known_hosts, host)
 585: }
 586: 
 587: fn ensure_client_role(context: &mut ClientRoleContext<'_>) -> Result<String, String> {
 588:     ensure_client_role_with_expected_exit(context, None)
 589: }
 590: 
 591: fn ensure_client_role_with_expected_exit(
 592:     context: &mut ClientRoleContext<'_>,
 593:     expected_exit: Option<&str>,
 594: ) -> Result<String, String> {
 595:     let baseline =
 596:         capture_client_role_snapshot(context.identity, context.known_hosts, context.host)?;
 597:     let baseline_exit = expected_exit
 598:         .filter(|value| !value.is_empty() && *value != "none")
 599:         .map(|value| value.to_string())
 600:         .unwrap_or_else(|| field_value(&baseline, "exit_node"));
 601:     if baseline_exit.is_empty() || baseline_exit == "none" {
 602:         if role_runtime_ready(&baseline, "client") {
 603:             return Ok(baseline);
 604:         }
 605:     } else if client_exit_route_converged(&baseline, &baseline_exit) {
 606:         return Ok(baseline);
 607:     }
 608: 
 609:     switch_role(
 610:         context.identity,
 611:         context.known_hosts,
 612:         context.host,
 613:         "client",
 614:         context.node_id,
 615:         context.ssh_allow_cidrs,
 616:     )?;
 617:     if baseline_exit.is_empty() || baseline_exit == "none" {
 618:         apply_role_coupling(
 619:             context.identity,
 620:             context.known_hosts,
 621:             context.host,
 622:             "client",
 623:             None,
 624:             false,
 625:             "/etc/rustynet/assignment-refresh.env",
 626:         )?;
 627:     } else {
 628:         apply_role_coupling(
 629:             context.identity,
 630:             context.known_hosts,
 631:             context.host,
 632:             "client",
 633:             Some(baseline_exit.as_str()),
 634:             false,
 635:             "/etc/rustynet/assignment-refresh.env",
 636:         )?;
 637:     }
 638:     force_runtime_state_refresh(context.identity, context.known_hosts, context.host)?;
 639:     if let Some(refresh) = context.signed_state_refresh {
 640:         refresh_signed_state_for_transition(
 641:             context.logger,
 642:             context.identity,
 643:             context.known_hosts,
 644:             context.workspace_dir,
 645:             refresh,
 646:             context.host,
 647:             format!("before restoring {} to client", context.node_id).as_str(),
 648:         )?;
 649:     }
 650:     let after_switch = wait_for_role(
 651:         context.identity,
 652:         context.known_hosts,
 653:         context.host,
 654:         "client",
 655:     )?;
 656:     let restore_exit = expected_exit
 657:         .filter(|value| !value.is_empty() && *value != "none")
 658:         .map(|value| value.to_string())
 659:         .unwrap_or_else(|| field_value(&after_switch, "exit_node"));
 660:     if restore_exit.is_empty() || restore_exit == "none" {
 661:         Ok(after_switch)
 662:     } else {
 663:         wait_for_client_exit_route_convergence(
 664:             context.identity,
 665:             context.known_hosts,
 666:             context.host,
 667:             &restore_exit,
 668:         )
 669:     }
 670: }
 671: 
 672: fn refresh_signed_state_for_transition(
 673:     logger: &mut Logger,
 674:     identity: &Path,
 675:     known_hosts: &Path,
 676:     workspace_dir: &Path,
 677:     refresh: &SignedStateRefreshContext,
 678:     target_host: &str,
 679:     reason: &str,
 680: ) -> Result<(), String> {
 681:     refresh_traversal_bundles_for_transition(
 682:         logger,
 683:         identity,
 684:         known_hosts,
 685:         workspace_dir,
 686:         refresh,
 687:         reason,
 688:     )?;
 689:     refresh_dns_zone_bundles_for_transition(identity, known_hosts, workspace_dir, refresh)?;
 690:     for target in &refresh.targets {
 691:         refresh_trust_evidence(identity, known_hosts, target.host.as_str())?;
 692:         refresh_signed_state(identity, known_hosts, target.host.as_str())?;
 693:     }
 694:     force_runtime_state_refresh_targets_ordered(
 695:         identity,
 696:         known_hosts,
 697:         refresh.targets.as_slice(),
 698:         refresh.exit_host.as_str(),
 699:         target_host,
 700:     )?;
 701:     Ok(())
 702: }

 704: fn refresh_traversal_bundles_for_transition(
 705:     logger: &mut Logger,
 706:     identity: &Path,
 707:     known_hosts: &Path,
 708:     workspace_dir: &Path,
 709:     refresh: &SignedStateRefreshContext,
 710:     reason: &str,
 711: ) -> Result<(), String> {
 712:     let issue_dir = workspace_dir.join(format!(
 713:         "role-switch-traversal-{}-{}",
 714:         sanitize_path_component(reason),
 715:         unix_now()
 716:     ));
 717:     let remote_env_path = "/tmp/rn-role-switch-traversal.env";
 718:     let remote_issue_dir = "/run/rustynet/role-switch-traversal-issue";
 719:     logger.line(format!("[role-switch] refresh traversal {reason}").as_str())?;
 720:     fs::create_dir_all(&issue_dir).map_err(|err| {
 721:         format!(
 722:             "failed to create role-switch traversal workspace {}: {err}",
 723:             issue_dir.display()
 724:         )
 725:     })?;
 726:     scp_to(
 727:         identity,
 728:         known_hosts,
 729:         refresh.traversal_env_file.as_path(),
 730:         refresh.exit_host.as_str(),
 731:         remote_env_path,
 732:     )?;
 733:     if let Err(err) = run_root(
 734:         identity,
 735:         known_hosts,
 736:         refresh.exit_host.as_str(),
 737:         format!(
 738:             "rustynet ops e2e-issue-traversal-bundles-from-env --env-file '{remote_env_path}' --issue-dir '{remote_issue_dir}'"
 739:         )
 740:         .as_str(),
 741:     ) {
 742:         let _ = run_root(
 743:             identity,
 744:             known_hosts,
 745:             refresh.exit_host.as_str(),
 746:             format!("rm -f '{remote_env_path}'").as_str(),
 747:         );
 748:         return Err(err);
 749:     }
 750:     let _ = run_root(
 751:         identity,
 752:         known_hosts,
 753:         refresh.exit_host.as_str(),
 754:         format!("rm -f '{remote_env_path}'").as_str(),
 755:     );
 756: 
 757:     let verifier_key = issue_dir.join("rn-traversal.pub");
 758:     capture_root_file_to_path(
 759:         identity,
 760:         known_hosts,
 761:         refresh.exit_host.as_str(),
 762:         &format!("{remote_issue_dir}/rn-traversal.pub"),
 763:         verifier_key.as_path(),
 764:     )?;
 765: 
 766:     for target in &refresh.targets {
 767:         let bundle = issue_dir.join(format!("rn-traversal-{}.traversal", target.node_id));
 768:         capture_root_file_to_path(
 769:             identity,
 770:             known_hosts,
 771:             refresh.exit_host.as_str(),
 772:             &format!(
 773:                 "{remote_issue_dir}/rn-traversal-{}.traversal",
 774:                 target.node_id
 775:             ),
 776:             bundle.as_path(),
 777:         )?;
 778:         scp_to(
 779:             identity,
 780:             known_hosts,
 781:             verifier_key.as_path(),
 782:             target.host.as_str(),
 783:             "/tmp/rn-traversal.pub",
 784:         )?;
 785:         scp_to(
 786:             identity,
 787:             known_hosts,
 788:             bundle.as_path(),
 789:             target.host.as_str(),
 790:             "/tmp/rn-traversal.bundle",
 791:         )?;
 792:         run_root(
 793:             identity,
 794:             known_hosts,
 795:             target.host.as_str(),
 796:             "if ! getent group rustynetd >/dev/null 2>&1; then groupadd --system rustynetd; fi && install -d -m 0750 -o root -g rustynetd /etc/rustynet && install -d -m 0700 -o rustynetd -g rustynetd /var/lib/rustynet && install -m 0644 -o root -g root /tmp/rn-traversal.pub /etc/rustynet/traversal.pub && install -m 0640 -o root -g rustynetd /tmp/rn-traversal.bundle /var/lib/rustynet/rustynetd.traversal && rm -f /var/lib/rustynet/rustynetd.traversal.watermark /tmp/rn-traversal.pub /tmp/rn-traversal.bundle",
 797:         )?;
 798:     }
 799: 
 800:     Ok(())
 801: }

 803: fn refresh_dns_zone_bundles_for_transition(
 804:     identity: &Path,
 805:     known_hosts: &Path,
 806:     workspace_dir: &Path,
 807:     refresh: &SignedStateRefreshContext,
 808: ) -> Result<(), String> {
 809:     let issue_dir = workspace_dir.join(format!("role-switch-dns-{}", unix_now()));
 810:     let remote_env_path = "/tmp/rn-role-switch-dns.env";
 811:     let remote_issue_dir = "/run/rustynet/dns-zone-issue";
 812:     fs::create_dir_all(&issue_dir).map_err(|err| {
 813:         format!(
 814:             "failed to create role-switch dns workspace {}: {err}",
 815:             issue_dir.display()
 816:         )
 817:     })?;
 818:     scp_to(
 819:         identity,
 820:         known_hosts,
 821:         refresh.dns_zone_env_file.as_path(),
 822:         refresh.exit_host.as_str(),
 823:         remote_env_path,
 824:     )?;
 825:     if let Err(err) = run_root(
 826:         identity,
 827:         known_hosts,
 828:         refresh.exit_host.as_str(),
 829:         format!(
 830:             "rustynet ops e2e-issue-dns-zone-bundles-from-env --env-file '{remote_env_path}' --issue-dir '{remote_issue_dir}'"
 831:         )
 832:         .as_str(),
 833:     ) {
 834:         let _ = run_root(
 835:             identity,
 836:             known_hosts,
 837:             refresh.exit_host.as_str(),
 838:             format!("rm -f '{remote_env_path}'").as_str(),
 839:         );
 840:         return Err(err);
 841:     }
 842:     let _ = run_root(
 843:         identity,
 844:         known_hosts,
 845:         refresh.exit_host.as_str(),
 846:         format!("rm -f '{remote_env_path}'").as_str(),
 847:     );
 848: 
 849:     let verifier_key = issue_dir.join("rn-dns-zone.pub");
 850:     capture_root_file_to_path(
 851:         identity,
 852:         known_hosts,
 853:         refresh.exit_host.as_str(),
 854:         &format!("{remote_issue_dir}/rn-dns-zone.pub"),
 855:         verifier_key.as_path(),
 856:     )?;
 857: 
 858:     for target in &refresh.targets {
 859:         let bundle = issue_dir.join(format!("rn-dns-zone-{}.dns-zone", target.node_id));
 860:         capture_root_file_to_path(
 861:             identity,
 862:             known_hosts,
 863:             refresh.exit_host.as_str(),
 864:             &format!("{remote_issue_dir}/rn-dns-zone-{}.dns-zone", target.node_id),

 866:         )?;
 867:         install_dns_zone_bundle(
 868:             identity,
 869:             known_hosts,
 870:             target.host.as_str(),
 871:             verifier_key.as_path(),
 872:             bundle.as_path(),
 873:         )?;
 874:     }
 875:     Ok(())
 876: }
 877: 
 878: fn capture_root_file_to_path(
 879:     identity: &Path,
 880:     known_hosts: &Path,
 881:     host: &str,
 882:     remote_path: &str,
 883:     local_path: &Path,
 884: ) -> Result<(), String> {
 885:     let command = format!("cat {}", shell_quote(remote_path));
 886:     let contents = capture_root(identity, known_hosts, host, command.as_str())?;
 887:     if let Some(parent) = local_path.parent() {
 888:         fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|err| {
 889:             format!(
 890:                 "failed to create local traversal capture dir {}: {err}",
 891:                 parent.display()
 892:             )
 893:         })?;
 894:     }
 895:     fs::write(local_path, contents).map_err(|err| {
 896:         format!(
 897:             "failed to write captured traversal file {}: {err}",
 898:             local_path.display()
 899:         )
 900:     })
 901: }
 902: 
 903: fn force_runtime_state_refresh_targets_ordered(
 904:     identity: &Path,
 905:     known_hosts: &Path,
 906:     targets: &[SignedStateRefreshTarget],
 907:     exit_host: &str,
 908:     target_host: &str,
 909: ) -> Result<(), String> {
 910:     for target in targets
 911:         .iter()
 912:         .filter(|target| target.host.as_str() != exit_host && target.host.as_str() != target_host)
 913:     {
 914:         force_runtime_state_refresh(identity, known_hosts, target.host.as_str())?;
 915:     }
 916:     if exit_host != target_host {
 917:         let exit_target = targets
 918:             .iter()
 919:             .find(|target| target.host.as_str() == exit_host)
 920:             .ok_or_else(|| format!("missing exit traversal refresh target: {exit_host}"))?;
 921:         force_runtime_state_refresh(identity, known_hosts, exit_target.host.as_str())?;
 922:     }
 923:     let restore_target = targets
 924:         .iter()
 925:         .find(|target| target.host.as_str() == target_host)
 926:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("missing restore traversal refresh target: {target_host}"))?;
 927:     force_runtime_state_refresh(identity, known_hosts, restore_target.host.as_str())?;
 928:     Ok(())
 929: }

1021: fn capture_client_role_snapshot(
1022:     identity: &Path,
1023:     known_hosts: &Path,
1024:     host: &str,
1025: ) -> Result<String, String> {
1026:     let status_output = status(identity, known_hosts, host)?;
1027:     let status_line = read_last_matching_line(&status_output, "node_id=");
1028:     if status_line.is_empty() {
1029:         return Ok(status_line);
1030:     }
1031:     let route_output = capture_root(
1032:         identity,
1033:         known_hosts,
1034:         host,
1035:         "ip -4 route get 1.1.1.1 || true",
1036:     )?;
1037:     let route_line = sanitize_line(route_output.trim());
1038:     if route_line.is_empty() {
1039:         Ok(status_line)
1040:     } else {
1041:         Ok(format!("{status_line} route={route_line}"))
1042:     }
1043: }
1044: 
1045: fn wait_for_role(
1046:     identity: &Path,
1047:     known_hosts: &Path,
1048:     host: &str,
1049:     role: &str,
1050: ) -> Result<String, String> {
1051:     let mut last = String::new();
1052:     for _ in 0..40 {
1053:         last = status(identity, known_hosts, host)?;
1054:         let status_line = read_last_matching_line(&last, "node_id=");
1055:         if role_runtime_ready(&status_line, role) {
1056:             return Ok(status_line);
1057:         }
1058:         std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_secs(2));
1059:     }
1060:     Err(format!(
1061:         "timed out waiting for {host} to reach role {role}: {}",
1062:         read_last_matching_line(&last, "node_id=")
1063:     ))
1064: }
1065: 
1066: fn role_runtime_ready(status_line: &str, role: &str) -> bool {
1067:     field_value(status_line, "node_role") == role
1068:         && field_value(status_line, "restricted_safe_mode") == "false"
1069:         && field_value(status_line, "state") != "FailClosed"
1070:         && field_value(status_line, "bootstrap_error") == "none"
1071:         && field_value(status_line, "last_reconcile_error") == "none"
1072: }
1073: 
1074: fn client_exit_route_converged(status_line: &str, expected_exit: &str) -> bool {
1075:     role_runtime_ready(status_line, "client")
1076:         && field_value(status_line, "exit_node") == expected_exit
1077:         && route_uses_rustynet0(status_line)
1078: }
1079: 
1080: fn route_uses_rustynet0(route: &str) -> bool {
1081:     route.contains("dev rustynet0")
1082: }
1083: 
1084: fn wait_for_client_exit_route_convergence(
1085:     identity: &Path,
1086:     known_hosts: &Path,
1087:     host: &str,
1088:     expected_exit: &str,
1089: ) -> Result<String, String> {
1090:     let start = Instant::now();
1091:     let timeout = Duration::from_secs(ROLE_SWITCH_ROUTE_CONVERGENCE_TIMEOUT_SECS);
1092:     let mut last_status = String::new();
1093:     let mut last_route = String::new();
1094:     while start.elapsed() <= timeout {
1095:         last_status = status(identity, known_hosts, host)?;
1096:         let status_line = read_last_matching_line(&last_status, "node_id=");
1097:         let route = capture_root(
1098:             identity,
1099:             known_hosts,
1100:             host,
1101:             "ip -4 route get 1.1.1.1 || true",
1102:         )?;
1103:         last_route = route.trim().to_string();
1104:         let combined = if last_route.is_empty() {
1105:             status_line.clone()
1106:         } else {
1107:             format!("{status_line} route={}", sanitize_line(&last_route))
1108:         };
1109:         if client_exit_route_converged(&combined, expected_exit) {
1110:             return Ok(combined);
1111:         }
1112:         std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_secs(1));
1113:     }
1114:     Err(format!(
1115:         "timed out waiting for {host} to restore client route convergence via rustynet0 for exit {expected_exit}: status={} route={}",
1116:         read_last_matching_line(&last_status, "node_id="),
1117:         sanitize_line(&last_route)
1118:     ))
1119: }

1121: fn route_advertise_denied(identity: &Path, known_hosts: &Path, host: &str) -> Result<bool, String> {
1122:     let command = "env RUSTYNET_DAEMON_SOCKET=/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock rustynet route advertise 10.250.0.0/16 >/dev/null 2>&1 && exit 1 || exit 0";
1123:     let status = ssh_status(
1124:         identity,
1125:         known_hosts,
1126:         host,
1127:         &format!("sudo -n sh -lc {}", shell_quote(command)),
1128:     )?;
1129:     Ok(status.success())
1130: }

1146:         identity,
1147:         known_hosts,

1165: fn sanitize_line(value: &str) -> String {
1166:     value
1167:         .chars()
1168:         .map(|ch| {
1169:             if matches!(ch, '\t' | '\r' | '\n') {
1170:                 ' '
1171:             } else {
1172:                 ch
1173:             }
1174:         })
1175:         .collect::<String>()
1176:         .split_whitespace()
1177:         .collect::<Vec<_>>()
1178:         .join(" ")
1179: }
1180: 
1181: fn sanitize_path_component(value: &str) -> String {
1182:     value
1183:         .chars()
1184:         .map(|ch| if ch.is_ascii_alphanumeric() { ch } else { '-' })
1185:         .collect::<String>()
1186:         .trim_matches('-')
1187:         .to_string()
1188: }
1189: 
1190: fn next_value(iter: &mut std::vec::IntoIter<String>, flag: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
1191:     iter.next()
1192:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("{flag} requires a value"))
1193: }

1198:     );

1201: fn utc_now_string() -> String {
1202:     let output = Command::new("date")
1203:         .args(["-u", "+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"])
1204:         .output()
1205:         .ok();

 389: struct ProbeCleanup {
 390:     ctx: LiveLabContext,
 391:     host: String,
 392:     pid_path: String,
 393:     log_path: String,
 394: }
 395: 
 396: impl Drop for ProbeCleanup {
 397:     fn drop(&mut self) {
 398:         if let Ok(pid_text) = self
 399:             .ctx
 400:             .capture_root_allow_failure(&self.host, &["cat", &self.pid_path])
 401:             && let Ok(pid) = pid_text.trim().parse::<i32>()
 402:         {
 403:             let pid_string = pid.to_string();
 404:             let _ = self
 405:                 .ctx
 406:                 .run_root_allow_failure(&self.host, &["kill", &pid_string]);
 407:         }
 408:         let _ = self
 409:             .ctx
 410:             .run_root_allow_failure(&self.host, &["rm", "-f", &self.pid_path, &self.log_path]);
 411:     }
 412: }
 413: 
 414: fn start_probe_server(
 415:     ctx: &LiveLabContext,
 416:     host: &str,
 417:     probe_ip: &str,
 418:     probe_port: &str,
 419:     probe_pid_path: &str,
 420:     probe_log_path: &str,
 421: ) -> Result<(), i32> {
 422:     let shell_command = format!(
 423:         "nohup rustynet ops e2e-http-probe-server --bind-ip {} --port {} --response-body {} >{} 2>&1 </dev/null & echo $! > {}",
 424:         live_lab_support::shell_single_quote(probe_ip),
 425:         live_lab_support::shell_single_quote(probe_port),
 426:         live_lab_support::shell_single_quote("probe-ok"),
 427:         live_lab_support::shell_single_quote(probe_log_path),
 428:         live_lab_support::shell_single_quote(probe_pid_path),
 429:     );
 430:     live_lab_support::run_remote_shell(ctx, host, &shell_command)
 431:         .map(|_| ())
 432:         .map_err(|err| {
 433:             eprintln!("{err}");
 434:             1
 435:         })
 436: }
 437: 
 438: fn required_value(args: &[String], idx: usize, flag: &str) -> Result<String, i32> {
 439:     if idx >= args.len() {
 440:         eprintln!("missing value for {flag}");
 441:         return Err(2);
 442:     }
 443:     Ok(args[idx].clone())
 444: }
 445: 
 446: fn print_usage() {
 447:     println!(
 448:         "usage: live_linux_server_ip_bypass_test.sh --ssh-identity-file <path> --client-host <user@host> --probe-host <user@host> [options]"
 449:     );
 450: }
 451: 
 452: fn now_unix() -> String {
 453:     SystemTime::now()
 454:         .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
 455:         .map(|duration| duration.as_secs().to_string())
 456:         .unwrap_or_else(|_| "0".to_string())
 457: }
 458: 
 459: fn now_utc() -> String {
 460:     now_unix()
 461: }
