  12:     Logger, append_env_assignment, capture_root, create_workspace, enforce_host,
  13:     ensure_pinned_known_hosts_file, ensure_safe_spec, ensure_safe_token, git_head_commit,
  14:     issue_assignment_bundles_from_env, issue_traversal_bundles_from_env,
  15:     load_home_known_hosts_path, no_plaintext_passphrase_check, remote_src_dir, require_command,
  16:     resolved_target_address, retry_root, run_root, scp_to, seed_known_hosts, shell_quote,
  17:     ssh_status, status, status_code, unix_now, wait_for_daemon_socket,
  18:     write_assignment_refresh_env, write_file,
  19: };
  20: 
  21: fn main() {
  22:     if let Err(err) = run() {
  23:         eprintln!("{err}");
  24:         std::process::exit(1);
  25:     }
  26: }
  27: 
  28: fn run() -> Result<(), String> {
  29:     let args: Vec<String> = env::args().skip(1).collect();
  30:     let config = Config::parse(args)?;
  31:     let root_dir = live_lab_support::repo_root()?;
  32: 
  33:     for command in [
  34:         "cargo",
  35:         "git",
  36:         "ssh",
  37:         "scp",
  38:         "ssh-keygen",
  39:         "awk",
  40:         "sed",
  41:         "openssl",
  42:         "xxd",
  43:         "mktemp",
  44:         "chmod",
  45:         "tr",
  46:     ] {
  47:         require_command(command)?;
  48:     }
  49: 
  50:     validate_identity(&config.ssh_identity_file)?;
  51:     let pinned_known_hosts = match &config.pinned_known_hosts_file {
  52:         Some(path) => path.clone(),
  53:         None => load_home_known_hosts_path()?,
  54:     };
  55:     ensure_pinned_known_hosts_file(&pinned_known_hosts)?;
  56: 
  57:     let workspace = create_workspace("two-hop-live")?;
  58:     let work_known_hosts = workspace.path().join("known_hosts");
  59:     seed_known_hosts(&pinned_known_hosts, &work_known_hosts)?;
  60:     let mut logger = Logger::new(&config.log_path)?;
  61:     logger.line("[two-hop] starting live two-hop validation")?;
  62: 
  63:     for host in [
  64:         &config.final_exit_host,
  65:         &config.client_host,
  66:         &config.entry_host,
  67:         &config.second_client_host,
  68:     ] {
  69:         verify_sudo(&config.ssh_identity_file, &work_known_hosts, host)?;
  70:     }
  71: 
  72:     logger.line("[two-hop] collecting wireguard public keys")?;
  73:     let final_exit_pub_hex = live_lab_support::collect_pubkey_hex(
  74:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
  75:         &work_known_hosts,
  76:         &config.final_exit_host,
  77:     )?;
  78:     let client_pub_hex = live_lab_support::collect_pubkey_hex(
  79:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
  80:         &work_known_hosts,
  81:         &config.client_host,
  82:     )?;
  83:     let entry_pub_hex = live_lab_support::collect_pubkey_hex(
  84:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
  85:         &work_known_hosts,
  86:         &config.entry_host,
  87:     )?;
  88:     let second_client_pub_hex = live_lab_support::collect_pubkey_hex(
  89:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
  90:         &work_known_hosts,
  91:         &config.second_client_host,
  92:     )?;
  93: 
  94:     let final_exit_addr = resolved_target_address(&config.final_exit_host)?;
  95:     let client_addr = resolved_target_address(&config.client_host)?;
  96:     let entry_addr = resolved_target_address(&config.entry_host)?;
  97:     let second_client_addr = resolved_target_address(&config.second_client_host)?;
  98: 
  99:     let nodes_spec = format!(
 100:         "{}|{}:51820|{};{}|{}:51820|{};{}|{}:51820|{};{}|{}:51820|{}",
 101:         config.final_exit_node_id,
 102:         final_exit_addr,
 103:         final_exit_pub_hex,
 104:         config.client_node_id,
 105:         client_addr,
 106:         client_pub_hex,
 107:         config.entry_node_id,
 108:         entry_addr,
 109:         entry_pub_hex,
 110:         config.second_client_node_id,
 111:         second_client_addr,
 112:         second_client_pub_hex,
 113:     );
 114:     let allow_spec = format!(
 115:         "{}|{};{}|{};{}|{};{}|{};{}|{};{}|{};{}|{};{}|{}",
 116:         config.client_node_id,
 117:         config.entry_node_id,
 118:         config.entry_node_id,
 119:         config.client_node_id,
 120:         config.client_node_id,
 121:         config.final_exit_node_id,
 122:         config.final_exit_node_id,
 123:         config.client_node_id,
 124:         config.entry_node_id,
 125:         config.final_exit_node_id,
 126:         config.final_exit_node_id,
 127:         config.entry_node_id,
 128:         config.second_client_node_id,
 129:         config.final_exit_node_id,
 130:         config.final_exit_node_id,
 131:         config.second_client_node_id,
 132:     );
 133:     let assignments_spec = format!(
 134:         "{}|-;{}|{};{}|{};{}|{}",
 135:         config.final_exit_node_id,
 136:         config.client_node_id,
 137:         config.entry_node_id,
 138:         config.entry_node_id,
 139:         config.final_exit_node_id,
 140:         config.second_client_node_id,
 141:         config.final_exit_node_id,
 142:     );
 143:     ensure_safe_spec("NODES_SPEC", &nodes_spec)?;
 144:     ensure_safe_spec("ALLOW_SPEC", &allow_spec)?;
 145:     ensure_safe_spec("ASSIGNMENTS_SPEC", &assignments_spec)?;
 146: 
 147:     let issue_env = workspace.path().join("rn_issue_twohop.env");
 148:     write_file(&issue_env, "")?;
 149:     append_env_assignment(&issue_env, "FINAL_EXIT_NODE_ID", &config.final_exit_node_id)?;
 150:     append_env_assignment(&issue_env, "CLIENT_NODE_ID", &config.client_node_id)?;
 151:     append_env_assignment(&issue_env, "ENTRY_NODE_ID", &config.entry_node_id)?;
 152:     append_env_assignment(
 153:         &issue_env,
 154:         "SECOND_CLIENT_NODE_ID",
 155:         &config.second_client_node_id,
 156:     )?;
 157:     append_env_assignment(&issue_env, "NODES_SPEC", &nodes_spec)?;
 158:     append_env_assignment(&issue_env, "ALLOW_SPEC", &allow_spec)?;
 159:     append_env_assignment(&issue_env, "ASSIGNMENTS_SPEC", &assignments_spec)?;
 160: 
 161:     logger.line(
 162:         format!(
 163:             "[two-hop] issuing signed two-hop assignments on {}",
 164:             config.final_exit_host
 165:         )
 166:         .as_str(),
 167:     )?;
 168:     issue_assignment_bundles_from_env(
 169:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 170:         &work_known_hosts,
 171:         &config.final_exit_host,
 172:         &issue_env,
 173:         "/tmp/rn_issue_twohop.env",
 174:     )?;
 175: 
 176:     let assign_pub_local = workspace.path().join("assignment.pub");
 177:     let final_exit_assignment_local = workspace.path().join("assignment-final-exit");
 178:     let client_assignment_local = workspace.path().join("assignment-client");
 179:     let entry_assignment_local = workspace.path().join("assignment-entry");
 180:     let second_client_assignment_local = workspace.path().join("assignment-second-client");
 181: 
 182:     capture_root_file_to_local(
 183:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 184:         &work_known_hosts,
 185:         &config.final_exit_host,
 186:         "/run/rustynet/assignment-issue/rn-assignment.pub",
 187:         &assign_pub_local,
 188:     )?;
 189:     capture_root_file_to_local(
 190:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 191:         &work_known_hosts,
 192:         &config.final_exit_host,
 193:         &format!(
 194:             "/run/rustynet/assignment-issue/rn-assignment-{}.assignment",
 195:             config.final_exit_node_id
 196:         ),
 197:         &final_exit_assignment_local,
 198:     )?;
 199:     capture_root_file_to_local(
 200:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 201:         &work_known_hosts,
 202:         &config.final_exit_host,
 203:         &format!(
 204:             "/run/rustynet/assignment-issue/rn-assignment-{}.assignment",
 205:             config.client_node_id
 206:         ),
 207:         &client_assignment_local,
 208:     )?;
 209:     capture_root_file_to_local(
 210:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 211:         &work_known_hosts,
 212:         &config.final_exit_host,
 213:         &format!(
 214:             "/run/rustynet/assignment-issue/rn-assignment-{}.assignment",
 215:             config.entry_node_id
 216:         ),
 217:         &entry_assignment_local,
 218:     )?;
 219:     capture_root_file_to_local(
 220:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 221:         &work_known_hosts,
 222:         &config.final_exit_host,
 223:         &format!(
 224:             "/run/rustynet/assignment-issue/rn-assignment-{}.assignment",
 225:             config.second_client_node_id
 226:         ),
 227:         &second_client_assignment_local,
 228:     )?;
 229: 
 230:     logger.line("[two-hop] distributing signed assignments")?;
 231:     install_assignment_bundle(
 232:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 233:         &work_known_hosts,
 234:         &config.final_exit_host,
 235:         &assign_pub_local,
 236:         &final_exit_assignment_local,
 237:     )?;
 238:     install_assignment_bundle(
 239:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 240:         &work_known_hosts,
 241:         &config.client_host,
 242:         &assign_pub_local,
 243:         &client_assignment_local,
 244:     )?;
 245:     install_assignment_bundle(
 246:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 247:         &work_known_hosts,
 248:         &config.entry_host,
 249:         &assign_pub_local,
 250:         &entry_assignment_local,
 251:     )?;
 252:     install_assignment_bundle(
 253:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 254:         &work_known_hosts,
 255:         &config.second_client_host,
 256:         &assign_pub_local,
 257:         &second_client_assignment_local,
 258:     )?;
 259: 
 260:     let final_exit_refresh_local = workspace.path().join("assignment-refresh-final-exit.env");
 261:     let client_refresh_local = workspace.path().join("assignment-refresh-client.env");
 262:     let entry_refresh_local = workspace.path().join("assignment-refresh-entry.env");
 263:     let second_client_refresh_local = workspace
 264:         .path()
 265:         .join("assignment-refresh-second-client.env");
 266:     write_assignment_refresh_env(
 267:         &final_exit_refresh_local,
 268:         &config.final_exit_node_id,
 269:         &nodes_spec,
 270:         &allow_spec,
 271:         None,
 272:     )?;
 273:     write_assignment_refresh_env(
 274:         &client_refresh_local,
 275:         &config.client_node_id,
 276:         &nodes_spec,
 277:         &allow_spec,
 278:         Some(&config.entry_node_id),
 279:     )?;
 280:     write_assignment_refresh_env(
 281:         &entry_refresh_local,
 282:         &config.entry_node_id,
 283:         &nodes_spec,
 284:         &allow_spec,
 285:         Some(&config.final_exit_node_id),
 286:     )?;
 287:     write_assignment_refresh_env(
 288:         &second_client_refresh_local,
 289:         &config.second_client_node_id,
 290:         &nodes_spec,
 291:         &allow_spec,
 292:         Some(&config.final_exit_node_id),
 293:     )?;
 294: 
 295:     install_assignment_refresh_env(
 296:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 297:         &work_known_hosts,
 298:         &config.final_exit_host,
 299:         &final_exit_refresh_local,
 300:     )?;
 301:     install_assignment_refresh_env(
 302:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 303:         &work_known_hosts,
 304:         &config.client_host,
 305:         &client_refresh_local,
 306:     )?;
 307:     install_assignment_refresh_env(
 308:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 309:         &work_known_hosts,
 310:         &config.entry_host,
 311:         &entry_refresh_local,
 312:     )?;
 313:     install_assignment_refresh_env(
 314:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 315:         &work_known_hosts,
 316:         &config.second_client_host,
 317:         &second_client_refresh_local,
 318:     )?;
 319: 
 320:     let traversal_env = workspace.path().join("rn_issue_twohop_traversal.env");
 321:     write_file(&traversal_env, "")?;
 322:     append_env_assignment(&traversal_env, "NODES_SPEC", &nodes_spec)?;
 323:     append_env_assignment(&traversal_env, "ALLOW_SPEC", &allow_spec)?;
 324: 
 325:     logger.line("[two-hop] issuing signed traversal bundles for two-hop topology")?;
 326:     issue_traversal_bundles_from_env(
 327:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 328:         &work_known_hosts,
 329:         &config.final_exit_host,
 330:         &traversal_env,
 331:         "/tmp/rn_issue_twohop_traversal.env",
 332:     )?;
 333: 
 334:     let traversal_pub_local = workspace.path().join("traversal.pub");
 335:     let final_exit_traversal_local = workspace.path().join("traversal-final-exit");
 336:     let client_traversal_local = workspace.path().join("traversal-client");
 337:     let entry_traversal_local = workspace.path().join("traversal-entry");
 338:     let second_client_traversal_local = workspace.path().join("traversal-second-client");
 339:     capture_root_file_to_local(
 340:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 341:         &work_known_hosts,
 342:         &config.final_exit_host,
 343:         "/run/rustynet/traversal-issue/rn-traversal.pub",
 344:         &traversal_pub_local,
 345:     )?;
 346:     capture_root_file_to_local(
 347:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 348:         &work_known_hosts,
 349:         &config.final_exit_host,
 350:         &format!(
 351:             "/run/rustynet/traversal-issue/rn-traversal-{}.traversal",
 352:             config.final_exit_node_id
 353:         ),
 354:         &final_exit_traversal_local,
 355:     )?;
 356:     capture_root_file_to_local(
 357:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 358:         &work_known_hosts,
 359:         &config.final_exit_host,
 360:         &format!(
 361:             "/run/rustynet/traversal-issue/rn-traversal-{}.traversal",
 362:             config.client_node_id
 363:         ),
 364:         &client_traversal_local,
 365:     )?;
 366:     capture_root_file_to_local(
 367:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 368:         &work_known_hosts,
 369:         &config.final_exit_host,
 370:         &format!(
 371:             "/run/rustynet/traversal-issue/rn-traversal-{}.traversal",
 372:             config.entry_node_id
 373:         ),
 374:         &entry_traversal_local,
 375:     )?;
 376:     capture_root_file_to_local(
 377:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 378:         &work_known_hosts,
 379:         &config.final_exit_host,
 380:         &format!(
 381:             "/run/rustynet/traversal-issue/rn-traversal-{}.traversal",
 382:             config.second_client_node_id
 383:         ),
 384:         &second_client_traversal_local,
 385:     )?;
 386: 
 387:     logger.line("[two-hop] distributing signed traversal bundles")?;
 388:     install_traversal_bundle(
 389:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 390:         &work_known_hosts,
 391:         &config.final_exit_host,
 392:         &traversal_pub_local,
 393:         &final_exit_traversal_local,
 394:     )?;
 395:     install_traversal_bundle(
 396:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 397:         &work_known_hosts,
 398:         &config.client_host,
 399:         &traversal_pub_local,
 400:         &client_traversal_local,
 401:     )?;
 402:     install_traversal_bundle(
 403:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 404:         &work_known_hosts,
 405:         &config.entry_host,
 406:         &traversal_pub_local,
 407:         &entry_traversal_local,
 408:     )?;
 409:     install_traversal_bundle(
 410:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 411:         &work_known_hosts,
 412:         &config.second_client_host,
 413:         &traversal_pub_local,
 414:         &second_client_traversal_local,
 415:     )?;
 416: 
 417:     let dns_zone_name =
 418:         env::var("RUSTYNET_DNS_ZONE_NAME").unwrap_or_else(|_| "rustynet".to_string());
 419:     ensure_safe_token("dns-zone-name", dns_zone_name.as_str())?;
 420:     let dns_zone_env = workspace.path().join("rn_issue_twohop_dns_zone.env");
 421:     write_file(&dns_zone_env, "")?;
 422:     append_env_assignment(&dns_zone_env, "NODES_SPEC", &nodes_spec)?;
 423:     append_env_assignment(&dns_zone_env, "ALLOW_SPEC", &allow_spec)?;
 424:     append_env_assignment(&dns_zone_env, "DNS_ZONE_NAME", &dns_zone_name)?;
 425: 
 426:     logger.line("[two-hop] issuing signed DNS zone bundles for two-hop topology")?;
 427:     issue_dns_zone_bundles_from_env(
 428:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 429:         &work_known_hosts,
 430:         &config.final_exit_host,
 431:         &dns_zone_env,
 432:         "/tmp/rn_issue_twohop_dns_zone.env",
 433:     )?;
 434: 
 435:     let dns_zone_pub_local = workspace.path().join("dns-zone.pub");
 436:     let final_exit_dns_zone_local = workspace.path().join("dns-zone-final-exit");
 437:     let client_dns_zone_local = workspace.path().join("dns-zone-client");
 438:     let entry_dns_zone_local = workspace.path().join("dns-zone-entry");
 439:     let second_client_dns_zone_local = workspace.path().join("dns-zone-second-client");
 440:     capture_root_file_to_local(
 441:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 442:         &work_known_hosts,
 443:         &config.final_exit_host,
 444:         "/run/rustynet/dns-zone-issue/rn-dns-zone.pub",
 445:         &dns_zone_pub_local,
 446:     )?;
 447:     capture_root_file_to_local(
 448:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 449:         &work_known_hosts,
 450:         &config.final_exit_host,
 451:         &format!(
 452:             "/run/rustynet/dns-zone-issue/rn-dns-zone-{}.dns-zone",
 453:             config.final_exit_node_id
 454:         ),
 455:         &final_exit_dns_zone_local,
 456:     )?;
 457:     capture_root_file_to_local(
 458:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 459:         &work_known_hosts,
 460:         &config.final_exit_host,
 461:         &format!(
 462:             "/run/rustynet/dns-zone-issue/rn-dns-zone-{}.dns-zone",
 463:             config.client_node_id
 464:         ),
 465:         &client_dns_zone_local,
 466:     )?;
 467:     capture_root_file_to_local(
 468:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 469:         &work_known_hosts,
 470:         &config.final_exit_host,
 471:         &format!(
 472:             "/run/rustynet/dns-zone-issue/rn-dns-zone-{}.dns-zone",
 473:             config.entry_node_id
 474:         ),
 475:         &entry_dns_zone_local,
 476:     )?;
 477:     capture_root_file_to_local(
 478:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 479:         &work_known_hosts,
 480:         &config.final_exit_host,
 481:         &format!(
 482:             "/run/rustynet/dns-zone-issue/rn-dns-zone-{}.dns-zone",
 483:             config.second_client_node_id
 484:         ),
 485:         &second_client_dns_zone_local,
 486:     )?;
 487: 
 488:     logger.line("[two-hop] distributing signed DNS zone bundles")?;
 489:     install_dns_zone_bundle(
 490:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 491:         &work_known_hosts,
 492:         &config.final_exit_host,
 493:         &dns_zone_pub_local,
 494:         &final_exit_dns_zone_local,
 495:     )?;
 496:     install_dns_zone_bundle(
 497:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 498:         &work_known_hosts,
 499:         &config.client_host,
 500:         &dns_zone_pub_local,
 501:         &client_dns_zone_local,
 502:     )?;
 503:     install_dns_zone_bundle(
 504:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 505:         &work_known_hosts,
 506:         &config.entry_host,
 507:         &dns_zone_pub_local,
 508:         &entry_dns_zone_local,
 509:     )?;
 510:     install_dns_zone_bundle(
 511:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 512:         &work_known_hosts,
 513:         &config.second_client_host,
 514:         &dns_zone_pub_local,
 515:         &second_client_dns_zone_local,
 516:     )?;
 517: 
 518:     logger.line("[two-hop] enforcing runtime roles")?;
 519:     enforce_host(
 520:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 521:         &work_known_hosts,
 522:         &config.final_exit_host,
 523:         "admin",
 524:         &config.final_exit_node_id,
 525:         &remote_src_dir(&config.final_exit_host),
 526:         &config.ssh_allow_cidrs,
 527:     )?;
 528:     enforce_host(
 529:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 530:         &work_known_hosts,
 531:         &config.client_host,
 532:         "client",
 533:         &config.client_node_id,
 534:         &remote_src_dir(&config.client_host),
 535:         &config.ssh_allow_cidrs,
 536:     )?;
 537:     enforce_host(
 538:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 539:         &work_known_hosts,
 540:         &config.entry_host,
 541:         "admin",
 542:         &config.entry_node_id,
 543:         &remote_src_dir(&config.entry_host),
 544:         &config.ssh_allow_cidrs,
 545:     )?;
 546:     enforce_host(
 547:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 548:         &work_known_hosts,
 549:         &config.second_client_host,
 550:         "client",
 551:         &config.second_client_node_id,
 552:         &remote_src_dir(&config.second_client_host),
 553:         &config.ssh_allow_cidrs,
 554:     )?;
 555:     wait_for_daemon_socket(
 556:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 557:         &work_known_hosts,
 558:         &config.final_exit_host,
 559:         "/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock",
 560:         20,
 561:         2,
 562:     )?;
 563:     wait_for_daemon_socket(
 564:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 565:         &work_known_hosts,
 566:         &config.client_host,
 567:         "/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock",
 568:         20,
 569:         2,
 570:     )?;
 571:     wait_for_daemon_socket(
 572:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 573:         &work_known_hosts,
 574:         &config.entry_host,
 575:         "/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock",
 576:         20,
 577:         2,
 578:     )?;
 579:     wait_for_daemon_socket(
 580:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 581:         &work_known_hosts,
 582:         &config.second_client_host,
 583:         "/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock",
 584:         20,
 585:         2,
 586:     )?;
 587: 
 588:     // After enforce_host the daemon comes up cold and stays in
 589:     // restricted-safe mode until it ingests fresh signed trust evidence.
 590:     // The route advertise call below is a mutating IPC command and is
 591:     // refused while restricted-safe is set, so refresh trust on every
 592:     // node first. Mirrors the exit_handoff test's pre-route-advertise
 593:     // refresh; without it `route advertise 0.0.0.0/0` fails with
 594:     // "daemon is in restricted-safe mode" on the final exit.
 595:     logger.line("[two-hop] refreshing signed trust evidence on all nodes")?;
 596:     refresh_trust_evidence(
 597:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 598:         &work_known_hosts,
 599:         &config.final_exit_host,
 600:     )?;
 601:     refresh_trust_evidence(
 602:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 603:         &work_known_hosts,
 604:         &config.entry_host,
 605:     )?;
 606:     refresh_trust_evidence(
 607:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 608:         &work_known_hosts,
 609:         &config.client_host,
 610:     )?;
 611:     refresh_trust_evidence(
 612:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 613:         &work_known_hosts,
 614:         &config.second_client_host,
 615:     )?;
 616: 
 617:     // The traversal coordination records inside each signed bundle have a
 618:     // hard-capped 30-second TTL (MAX_COORDINATION_TTL_SECS in
 619:     // crates/rustynetd/src/traversal.rs). Between the initial issuance
 620:     // above and now (post enforce_host x4 + wait_for_socket x4 +
 621:     // refresh_trust_evidence x4) significantly more than 30s have
 622:     // elapsed, so each daemon's reconcile loop sees the stored
 623:     // coordination as expired, fails 5+ times, and escalates to
 624:     // restriction_mode=Permanent. Once Permanent, the next mutating
 625:     // IPC (route advertise below) is refused with "daemon is in
 626:     // restricted-safe mode" — the failure mode that broke this stage
 627:     // in livelab4 even with the trust refresh in place.
 628:     //
 629:     // Re-issue + re-distribute traversal bundles so each peer has a
 630:     // freshly-signed coordination record (new 30s TTL window starting
 631:     // now), then run `state refresh` IPC on every node. State refresh
 632:     // is non-mutating (exempt from the restricted-safe gate) and on
 633:     // success explicitly resets restriction_mode to None and clears
 634:     // reconcile_failures (daemon.rs:3506-3508). The route advertise
 635:     // that follows then sees a daemon out of restricted-safe.
 636:     logger.line("[two-hop] re-issuing signed traversal bundles before route advertise")?;
 637:     issue_traversal_bundles_from_env(
 638:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 639:         &work_known_hosts,
 640:         &config.final_exit_host,
 641:         &traversal_env,
 642:         "/tmp/rn_issue_twohop_traversal.env",
 643:     )?;
 644:     capture_root_file_to_local(
 645:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 646:         &work_known_hosts,
 647:         &config.final_exit_host,
 648:         &format!(
 649:             "/run/rustynet/traversal-issue/rn-traversal-{}.traversal",
 650:             config.final_exit_node_id
 651:         ),
 652:         &final_exit_traversal_local,
 653:     )?;
 654:     capture_root_file_to_local(
 655:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 656:         &work_known_hosts,
 657:         &config.final_exit_host,
 658:         &format!(
 659:             "/run/rustynet/traversal-issue/rn-traversal-{}.traversal",
 660:             config.client_node_id
 661:         ),
 662:         &client_traversal_local,
 663:     )?;
 664:     capture_root_file_to_local(
 665:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 666:         &work_known_hosts,
 667:         &config.final_exit_host,
 668:         &format!(
 669:             "/run/rustynet/traversal-issue/rn-traversal-{}.traversal",
 670:             config.entry_node_id
 671:         ),
 672:         &entry_traversal_local,
 673:     )?;
 674:     capture_root_file_to_local(
 675:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 676:         &work_known_hosts,
 677:         &config.final_exit_host,
 678:         &format!(
 679:             "/run/rustynet/traversal-issue/rn-traversal-{}.traversal",
 680:             config.second_client_node_id
 681:         ),
 682:         &second_client_traversal_local,
 683:     )?;
 684:     install_traversal_bundle(
 685:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 686:         &work_known_hosts,
 687:         &config.final_exit_host,
 688:         &traversal_pub_local,
 689:         &final_exit_traversal_local,
 690:     )?;
 691:     install_traversal_bundle(
 692:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 693:         &work_known_hosts,
 694:         &config.client_host,
 695:         &traversal_pub_local,
 696:         &client_traversal_local,
 697:     )?;
 698:     install_traversal_bundle(
 699:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 700:         &work_known_hosts,
 701:         &config.entry_host,
 702:         &traversal_pub_local,
 703:         &entry_traversal_local,
 704:     )?;
 705:     install_traversal_bundle(
 706:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 707:         &work_known_hosts,
 708:         &config.second_client_host,
 709:         &traversal_pub_local,
 710:         &second_client_traversal_local,
 711:     )?;
 712: 
 713:     logger.line("[two-hop] forcing signed-state refresh to clear restricted-safe")?;
 714:     refresh_signed_state(
 715:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 716:         &work_known_hosts,
 717:         &config.final_exit_host,
 718:     )?;
 719:     refresh_signed_state(
 720:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 721:         &work_known_hosts,
 722:         &config.client_host,
 723:     )?;
 724:     refresh_signed_state(
 725:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 726:         &work_known_hosts,
 727:         &config.entry_host,
 728:     )?;
 729:     refresh_signed_state(
 730:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 731:         &work_known_hosts,
 732:         &config.second_client_host,
 733:     )?;
 734: 
 735:     logger.line("[two-hop] advertising default route on final exit and entry relay")?;
 736:     run_root(
 737:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 738:         &work_known_hosts,
 739:         &config.final_exit_host,
 740:         "env RUSTYNET_DAEMON_SOCKET=/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock rustynet route advertise 0.0.0.0/0",
 741:     )?;
 742:     run_root(
 743:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 744:         &work_known_hosts,
 745:         &config.entry_host,
 746:         "env RUSTYNET_DAEMON_SOCKET=/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock rustynet route advertise 0.0.0.0/0",
 747:     )?;
 748:     refresh_signed_state(
 749:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 750:         &work_known_hosts,
 751:         &config.final_exit_host,
 752:     )?;
 753:     refresh_signed_state(
 754:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 755:         &work_known_hosts,
 756:         &config.client_host,
 757:     )?;
 758:     refresh_signed_state(
 759:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 760:         &work_known_hosts,
 761:         &config.entry_host,
 762:     )?;
 763:     refresh_signed_state(
 764:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 765:         &work_known_hosts,
 766:         &config.second_client_host,
 767:     )?;
 768: 
 769:     let mut client_status = String::new();
 770:     let mut entry_status = String::new();
 771:     let mut final_exit_status = String::new();
 772:     let mut second_client_status = String::new();
 773:     let mut client_route = String::new();
 774:     let mut second_client_route = String::new();
 775:     for attempt in 0..=20 {
 776:         client_status = status(
 777:             &config.ssh_identity_file,
 778:             &work_known_hosts,
 779:             &config.client_host,
 780:         )?;
 781:         entry_status = status(
 782:             &config.ssh_identity_file,
 783:             &work_known_hosts,
 784:             &config.entry_host,
 785:         )?;
 786:         final_exit_status = status(
 787:             &config.ssh_identity_file,
 788:             &work_known_hosts,
 789:             &config.final_exit_host,
 790:         )?;
 791:         second_client_status = status(
 792:             &config.ssh_identity_file,
 793:             &work_known_hosts,
 794:             &config.second_client_host,
 795:         )?;
 796:         client_route = capture_root(
 797:             &config.ssh_identity_file,
 798:             &work_known_hosts,
 799:             &config.client_host,
 800:             "ip -4 route get 1.1.1.1 || true",
 801:         )?;
 802:         second_client_route = capture_root(
 803:             &config.ssh_identity_file,
 804:             &work_known_hosts,
 805:             &config.second_client_host,
 806:             "ip -4 route get 1.1.1.1 || true",
 807:         )?;
 808:         if two_hop_runtime_ready(
 809:             &config,
 810:             &client_status,
 811:             &entry_status,
 812:             &final_exit_status,
 813:             &second_client_status,
 814:             &client_route,
 815:             &second_client_route,
 816:         ) {
 817:             break;
 818:         }
 819:         if attempt < 20 {
 820:             if attempt % 5 == 4 {
 821:                 refresh_signed_state(
 822:                     &config.ssh_identity_file,
 823:                     &work_known_hosts,
 824:                     &config.final_exit_host,
 825:                 )?;
 826:                 refresh_signed_state(
 827:                     &config.ssh_identity_file,
 828:                     &work_known_hosts,
 829:                     &config.client_host,
 830:                 )?;
 831:                 refresh_signed_state(
 832:                     &config.ssh_identity_file,
 833:                     &work_known_hosts,
 834:                     &config.entry_host,
 835:                 )?;
 836:                 refresh_signed_state(
 837:                     &config.ssh_identity_file,
 838:                     &work_known_hosts,
 839:                     &config.second_client_host,
 840:                 )?;
 841:             }
 842:             std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_secs(2));
 843:         }
 844:     }
 845:     let entry_wg_endpoints = capture_root(
 846:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 847:         &work_known_hosts,
 848:         &config.entry_host,
 849:         "wg show rustynet0 endpoints || true",
 850:     )?;
 851:     let entry_managed_peer_endpoints =
 852:         status_field(&entry_status, "managed_peer_endpoints").unwrap_or_else(|| "none".to_string());
 853:     let entry_managed_peer_endpoints_error =
 854:         status_field(&entry_status, "managed_peer_endpoints_error")
 855:             .unwrap_or_else(|| "none".to_string());
 856:     let client_plaintext_check = no_plaintext_passphrase_check(
 857:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 858:         &work_known_hosts,
 859:         &config.client_host,
 860:     )?;
 861:     let entry_plaintext_check = no_plaintext_passphrase_check(
 862:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 863:         &work_known_hosts,
 864:         &config.entry_host,
 865:     )?;
 866:     let final_exit_plaintext_check = no_plaintext_passphrase_check(
 867:         &config.ssh_identity_file,
 868:         &work_known_hosts,
 869:         &config.final_exit_host,
 870:     )?;
 871: 
 872:     logger.line("[two-hop] final client status")?;
 873:     logger.block(&(client_status.clone() + "\n"))?;
 874:     logger.line("[two-hop] final entry status")?;
 875:     logger.block(&(entry_status.clone() + "\n"))?;
 876:     logger.line("[two-hop] final exit status")?;
 877:     logger.block(&(final_exit_status.clone() + "\n"))?;
 878:     logger.line("[two-hop] final second client status")?;
 879:     logger.block(&(second_client_status.clone() + "\n"))?;
 880:     logger.line("[two-hop] client route")?;
 881:     logger.block(&(client_route.clone() + "\n"))?;
 882:     logger.line("[two-hop] second client route")?;
 883:     logger.block(&(second_client_route.clone() + "\n"))?;
 884:     logger.line("[two-hop] entry managed peer endpoints (backend-authoritative)")?;
 885:     logger.block(&(entry_managed_peer_endpoints.clone() + "\n"))?;
 886:     logger.line("[two-hop] entry wg endpoints (debug only)")?;
 887:     logger.block(&(entry_wg_endpoints.clone() + "\n"))?;
 888: 
 889:     let check_client_exit_is_entry = if client_status
 890:         .contains(&format!("exit_node={}", config.entry_node_id))
 891:         && client_status.contains("state=ExitActive")
 892:     {
 893:         "pass"
 894:     } else {
 895:         "fail"
 896:     };
 897:     let check_entry_exit_is_final =
 898:         if entry_status.contains(&format!("exit_node={}", config.final_exit_node_id)) {
 899:             "pass"
 900:         } else {
 901:             "fail"
 902:         };
 903:     let check_entry_serves_exit = if entry_status.contains("serving_exit_node=true") {
 904:         "pass"
 905:     } else {
 906:         "fail"
 907:     };
 908:     let check_final_exit_serves = if final_exit_status.contains("serving_exit_node=true") {
 909:         "pass"
 910:     } else {
 911:         "fail"
 912:     };
 913:     let check_client_route_rustynet = if client_route.contains("dev rustynet0") {
 914:         "pass"
 915:     } else {
 916:         "fail"
 917:     };
 918:     let check_second_client_route_rustynet = if second_client_route.contains("dev rustynet0") {
 919:         "pass"
 920:     } else {
 921:         "fail"
 922:     };
 923:     let check_managed_dns_fresh_all_nodes = if managed_dns_state_is_valid(&client_status)
 924:         && managed_dns_state_is_valid(&entry_status)
 925:         && managed_dns_state_is_valid(&final_exit_status)
 926:         && managed_dns_state_is_valid(&second_client_status)
 927:     {
 928:         "pass"
 929:     } else {
 930:         "fail"
 931:     };
 932:     let check_entry_managed_peer_endpoints_visible = if managed_peer_endpoints_include(
 933:         &entry_managed_peer_endpoints,
 934:         &entry_managed_peer_endpoints_error,
 935:         &[
 936:             (&config.client_node_id, client_addr.as_str(), 51820),
 937:             (&config.final_exit_node_id, final_exit_addr.as_str(), 51820),
 938:         ],
 939:     ) {
 940:         "pass"
 941:     } else {
 942:         "fail"
 943:     };
 944:     let check_no_plaintext_passphrases = if client_plaintext_check.trim()
 945:         == "no-plaintext-passphrase-files"
 946:         && entry_plaintext_check.trim() == "no-plaintext-passphrase-files"
 947:         && final_exit_plaintext_check.trim() == "no-plaintext-passphrase-files"
 948:     {
 949:         "pass"
 950:     } else {
 951:         "fail"
 952:     };
 953: 
 954:     let overall = [
 955:         check_client_exit_is_entry,
 956:         check_entry_exit_is_final,
 957:         check_entry_serves_exit,
 958:         check_final_exit_serves,
 959:         check_client_route_rustynet,
 960:         check_second_client_route_rustynet,
 961:         check_managed_dns_fresh_all_nodes,
 962:         check_entry_managed_peer_endpoints_visible,
 963:         check_no_plaintext_passphrases,
 964:     ]
 965:     .into_iter()
 966:     .all(|value| value == "pass");
 967: 
 968:     let captured_at_utc = utc_now_string();
 969:     let captured_at_unix = unix_now();
 970:     let git_commit = config.git_commit.unwrap_or_else(|| {
 971:         git_head_commit(&root_dir).unwrap_or_else(|err| {
 972:             eprintln!("{err}");
 973:             std::process::exit(1);
 974:         })
 975:     });
 976: 
 977:     let report = format!(
 978: /* ELIDED: original line had 102 backslash-quote sequences — removed to avoid DeepSeek parser failure */
 979:         captured_at_utc,
 980:         captured_at_unix,
 981:         git_commit,
 982:         if overall { "pass" } else { "fail" },
 983:         config.final_exit_host,
 984:         config.client_host,
 985:         config.entry_host,
 986:         config.second_client_host,
 987:         check_client_exit_is_entry,
 988:         check_entry_exit_is_final,
 989:         check_entry_serves_exit,
 990:         check_final_exit_serves,
 991:         check_client_route_rustynet,
 992:         check_second_client_route_rustynet,
 993:         check_managed_dns_fresh_all_nodes,
 994:         check_entry_managed_peer_endpoints_visible,
 995:         check_entry_managed_peer_endpoints_visible,
 996:         check_no_plaintext_passphrases,
 997:         config.log_path.display(),
 998:     );
 999:     write_file(&config.report_path, &report)?;
1000:     logger.line(format!("[two-hop] report written: {}", config.report_path.display()).as_str())?;
1001:     if !overall {
1002:         return Err("two-hop validation failed".to_string());
1003:     }
1004: 
1005:     Ok(())
1006: }

1008: #[derive(Debug)]
1009: struct Config {
1010:     ssh_identity_file: PathBuf,
1011:     final_exit_host: String,
1012:     client_host: String,
1013:     entry_host: String,
1014:     second_client_host: String,
1015:     final_exit_node_id: String,
1016:     client_node_id: String,
1017:     entry_node_id: String,
1018:     second_client_node_id: String,
1019:     ssh_allow_cidrs: String,
1020:     report_path: PathBuf,
1021:     log_path: PathBuf,
1022:     pinned_known_hosts_file: Option<PathBuf>,
1023:     git_commit: Option<String>,
1024: }
1025: 
1026: impl Config {
1027:     fn parse(args: Vec<String>) -> Result<Self, String> {
1028:         let mut config = Self {
1029:             ssh_identity_file: PathBuf::new(),
1030:             final_exit_host: "debian@192.168.18.49".to_string(),
1031:             client_host: "debian@192.168.18.65".to_string(),
1032:             entry_host: "ubuntu@192.168.18.52".to_string(),
1033:             second_client_host: "fedora@192.168.18.51".to_string(),
1034:             final_exit_node_id: "exit-49".to_string(),
1035:             client_node_id: "client-65".to_string(),
1036:             entry_node_id: "client-52".to_string(),
1037:             second_client_node_id: "client-51".to_string(),
1038:             ssh_allow_cidrs: "192.168.18.0/24".to_string(),
1039:             report_path: PathBuf::from("artifacts/phase10/live_linux_two_hop_report.json"),
1040:             log_path: PathBuf::from("artifacts/phase10/source/live_linux_two_hop.log"),
1041:             pinned_known_hosts_file: None,
1042:             git_commit: None,
1043:         };
1044: 
1045:         let mut iter = args.into_iter();
1046:         while let Some(arg) = iter.next() {
1047:             match arg.as_str() {
1048:                 "--ssh-identity-file" => {
1049:                     config.ssh_identity_file = PathBuf::from(next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?)
1050:                 }
1051:                 "--final-exit-host" => config.final_exit_host = next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?,
1052:                 "--client-host" => config.client_host = next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?,
1053:                 "--entry-host" => config.entry_host = next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?,
1054:                 "--second-client-host" => config.second_client_host = next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?,
1055:                 "--final-exit-node-id" => config.final_exit_node_id = next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?,
1056:                 "--client-node-id" => config.client_node_id = next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?,
1057:                 "--entry-node-id" => config.entry_node_id = next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?,
1058:                 "--second-client-node-id" => {
1059:                     config.second_client_node_id = next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?
1060:                 }
1061:                 "--ssh-allow-cidrs" => config.ssh_allow_cidrs = next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?,
1062:                 "--report-path" => config.report_path = PathBuf::from(next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?),
1063:                 "--log-path" => config.log_path = PathBuf::from(next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?),
1064:                 "--known-hosts" => {
1065:                     config.pinned_known_hosts_file =
1066:                         Some(PathBuf::from(next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?))
1067:                 }
1068:                 "--git-commit" => config.git_commit = Some(next_value(&mut iter, &arg)?),
1069:                 "-h" | "--help" => {
1070:                     print_usage();
1071:                     std::process::exit(0);
1072:                 }
1073:                 unknown => return Err(format!("unknown argument: {unknown}")),
1074:             }
1075:         }
1076: 
1077:         if config.ssh_identity_file.as_os_str().is_empty() {
1078:             return Err(
1079:                 "usage: live_linux_two_hop_test --ssh-identity-file <path> [options]".to_string(),
1080:             );
1081:         }
1082:         for (label, value) in [
1083:             ("final-exit-host", config.final_exit_host.as_str()),
1084:             ("client-host", config.client_host.as_str()),
1085:             ("entry-host", config.entry_host.as_str()),
1086:             ("second-client-host", config.second_client_host.as_str()),
1087:             ("final-exit-node-id", config.final_exit_node_id.as_str()),
1088:             ("client-node-id", config.client_node_id.as_str()),
1089:             ("entry-node-id", config.entry_node_id.as_str()),
1090:             (
1091:                 "second-client-node-id",
1092:                 config.second_client_node_id.as_str(),
1093:             ),
1094:             ("ssh-allow-cidrs", config.ssh_allow_cidrs.as_str()),
1095:         ] {
1096:             ensure_safe_token(label, value)?;
1097:         }
1098:         Ok(config)
1099:     }
1100: }

1102: fn verify_sudo(identity: &Path, known_hosts: &Path, host: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
1103:     live_lab_support::verify_sudo(identity, known_hosts, host)
1104: }

1106: fn validate_identity(path: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
1107:     if !path.is_file() {
1108:         return Err(format!("missing ssh identity file: {}", path.display()));
1109:     }
1110:     if path.is_symlink() {
1111:         return Err(format!(
1112:             "ssh identity file must not be a symlink: {}",
1113:             path.display()
1114:         ));
1115:     }
1116:     Ok(())
1117: }

1119: fn install_assignment_bundle(
1120:     identity: &Path,
1121:     known_hosts: &Path,
1122:     target: &str,
1123:     assignment_pub_local: &Path,
1124:     assignment_bundle_local: &Path,
1125: ) -> Result<(), String> {
1126:     scp_to(
1127:         identity,
1128:         known_hosts,
1129:         assignment_pub_local,
1130:         target,
1131:         "/tmp/rn-assignment.pub",

1232: fn install_dns_zone_bundle(
1233:     identity: &Path,
1234:     known_hosts: &Path,
1235:     target: &str,
1236:     dns_zone_pub_local: &Path,
1237:     dns_zone_bundle_local: &Path,
1238: ) -> Result<(), String> {
1239:     scp_to(
1240:         identity,
1241:         known_hosts,
1242:         dns_zone_pub_local,
1243:         target,
1244:         "/tmp/rn-dns-zone.pub",
1245:     )?;
1246:     scp_to(
1247:         identity,
1248:         known_hosts,
1249:         dns_zone_bundle_local,
1250:         target,
1251:         "/tmp/rn-dns-zone.bundle",
1252:     )?;
1253:     // Use retry_root for the install commands: the soak drives rapid rustynetd restarts on
1254:     // the same hosts immediately before this stage, which can cause transient SSH status 255
1255:     // (connection-level failure) if the daemon restart briefly disrupts host networking.
1256:     retry_root(
1257:         identity,
1258:         known_hosts,
1259:         target,
1260:         "install -d -m 0750 -o root -g rustynetd /etc/rustynet",
1261:         3,
1262:         5,
1263:     )?;
1264:     retry_root(
1265:         identity,
1266:         known_hosts,
1267:         target,
1268:         "install -m 0644 -o root -g root /tmp/rn-dns-zone.pub /etc/rustynet/dns-zone.pub && install -m 0640 -o root -g rustynetd /tmp/rn-dns-zone.bundle /var/lib/rustynet/rustynetd.dns-zone && rm -f /var/lib/rustynet/rustynetd.dns-zone.watermark /tmp/rn-dns-zone.pub /tmp/rn-dns-zone.bundle",
1269:         3,
1270:         5,
1271:     )
1272: }

1274: fn issue_dns_zone_bundles_from_env(
1275:     identity: &Path,
1276:     known_hosts: &Path,
1277:     target: &str,
1278:     env_local: &Path,
1279:     remote_env_path: &str,
1280: ) -> Result<(), String> {
1281:     scp_to(identity, known_hosts, env_local, target, remote_env_path)?;
1282:     let command = format!(
1283:         "sudo -n rustynet ops e2e-issue-dns-zone-bundles-from-env --env-file {}",
1284:         shell_quote(remote_env_path)
1285:     );
1286:     let status = ssh_status(identity, known_hosts, target, &command)?;
1287:     if !status.success() {
1288:         let _ = run_root(
1289:             identity,
1290:             known_hosts,
1291:             target,
1292:             &format!("rm -f {}", shell_quote(remote_env_path)),
1293:         );
1294:         return Err(format!(
1295:             "issue dns zone bundles from env failed for {target} with status {}",
1296:             status_code(status)
1297:         ));
1298:     }
1299:     run_root(
1300:         identity,
1301:         known_hosts,
1302:         target,
1303:         &format!("rm -f {}", shell_quote(remote_env_path)),
1304:     )
1305: }

1343: fn two_hop_runtime_ready(
1344:     config: &Config,
1345:     client_status: &str,
1346:     entry_status: &str,
1347:     final_exit_status: &str,
1348:     second_client_status: &str,
1349:     client_route: &str,
1350:     second_client_route: &str,
1351: ) -> bool {
1352:     client_status.contains(&format!("exit_node={}", config.entry_node_id))
1353:         && client_status.contains("state=ExitActive")
1354:         && managed_dns_state_is_valid(client_status)
1355:         && entry_status.contains(&format!("exit_node={}", config.final_exit_node_id))
1356:         && entry_status.contains("serving_exit_node=true")
1357:         && managed_dns_state_is_valid(entry_status)
1358:         && final_exit_status.contains("serving_exit_node=true")
1359:         && managed_dns_state_is_valid(final_exit_status)
1360:         && second_client_status.contains(&format!("exit_node={}", config.final_exit_node_id))
1361:         && second_client_status.contains("state=ExitActive")
1362:         && managed_dns_state_is_valid(second_client_status)
1363:         && client_route.contains("dev rustynet0")
1364:         && second_client_route.contains("dev rustynet0")
1365: }

1367: fn peer_endpoint_summary_contains(summary: &str, node_id: &str, addr: &str, port: u16) -> bool {
1368:     let expected = format!("{node_id}/{addr}:{port}");
1369:     summary.split('+').any(|entry| entry == expected)
1370: }

1373:     summary: &str,

1375:     expected_endpoints: &[(&str, &str, u16)],

1377:     error == "none"
1378:         && expected_endpoints.iter().all(|(node_id, addr, port)| {
1379:             peer_endpoint_summary_contains(summary, node_id, addr, *port)

1389: fn utc_now_string() -> String {
1390:     let output = std::process::Command::new("date")
1391:         .args(["-u", "+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"])
1392:         .output()
1393:         .ok();
1394:     if let Some(output) = output
1395:         && output.status.success()
1396:     {
1397:         let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).trim().to_string();
1398:         if !text.is_empty() {
1399:             return text;
1400:         }
1401:     }
1402:     "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z".to_string()
1403: }

  50: fn main() {
  51:     let code = match run() {
  52:         Ok(()) => 0,
  53:         Err(code) => code,
  54:     };
  55:     std::process::exit(code);
  56: }
  57: 
  58: fn run() -> Result<(), i32> {
  59:     let _ignored_args: Vec<String> = env::args().skip(1).collect();
  60:     let root_dir = repo_root().map_err(|err| {
  61:         eprintln!("{err}");
  62:         1
  63:     })?;
  64: 
  65:     println!("[macos-smoke] validating hardened macOS startup contracts in start.sh");
  66:     for (pattern, target, error_message) in REQUIRED_PATTERNS {
  67:         let should_match = *pattern != "install_macos_unprivileged_wireguard_tools";
  68:         let matched = run_rg(&root_dir, pattern, target)?;
  69:         if should_match && !matched {
  70:             eprintln!("[macos-smoke] {error_message}");
  71:             return Err(1);
  72:         }
  73:         if !should_match && matched {
  74:             eprintln!("[macos-smoke] {error_message}");
  75:             return Err(1);
  76:         }
  77:     }
  78: 
  79:     let status = Command::new("bash")
  80:         .current_dir(&root_dir)
  81:         .args(["-n", "start.sh"])
  82:         .stdin(Stdio::null())
  83:         .status()
  84:         .map_err(|err| {
  85:             eprintln!("[macos-smoke] failed to run bash -n start.sh: {err}");
  86:             1
  87:         })?;
  88:     if !status.success() {
  89:         eprintln!("[macos-smoke] start.sh syntax check failed");
  90:         return Err(status_code(status));
  91:     }
  92: 
  93:     println!("[macos-smoke] running targeted macOS dataplane security tests");
  94:     run_required_test(
  95:         &root_dir,
  96:         "rustynetd",
  97:         "phase10::tests::macos_render_pf_rules_enforces_dns_fail_closed_when_enabled",
  98:     )?;
  99:     run_required_test(
 100:         &root_dir,
 101:         "rustynetd",
 102:         "phase10::tests::macos_dns_rule_parser_accepts_port_alias_output",
 103:     )?;
 104:     run_required_test(
 105:         &root_dir,
 106:         "rustynet-backend-wireguard",
 107:         "tests::macos_backend_reports_ipv6_not_supported_until_parity_is_implemented",
 108:     )?;
 109: 
 110:     Ok(())
 111: }

===== /crates/rustynet-cli/src/bin/membership_incident_drill.rs =====

   1: #![forbid(unsafe_code)]
   2: 
   3: use std::env;
   4: use std::fs;
   5: use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
   6: use std::process::{Command, ExitStatus};
   7: 
   8: const DEFAULT_OUTPUT_DIR: &str = "artifacts/membership";
   9: const DEFAULT_MEMBERSHIP_SNAPSHOT_PATH: &str = "/var/lib/rustynet/membership.snapshot";
  10: const DEFAULT_MEMBERSHIP_LOG_PATH: &str = "/var/lib/rustynet/membership.log";
  11: const DEFAULT_EVIDENCE_ENVIRONMENT: &str = "incident-drill";
  12: 
  13: fn main() {
  14:     let code = match run() {
  15:         Ok(()) => 0,
  16:         Err(code) => code,
  17:     };
  18:     std::process::exit(code);
  19: }
  20: 
  21: fn run() -> Result<(), i32> {
  22:     let mut args = env::args().skip(1);
  23:     let output_dir_arg = args.next();
  24:     if args.next().is_some() {
  25:         eprintln!("usage: membership_incident_drill [output-dir]");
  26:         return Err(2);
  27:     }
  28: 
  29:     let root_dir = repo_root().map_err(|err| {
  30:         eprintln!("{err}");
  31:         1
  32:     })?;
  33:     let output_dir = output_dir_arg.unwrap_or_else(|| DEFAULT_OUTPUT_DIR.to_string());
  34:     let output_dir = resolve_path(&root_dir, Path::new(&output_dir));
  35:     fs::create_dir_all(&output_dir).map_err(|err| {
  36:         eprintln!(
  37:             "failed to create membership drill output dir {}: {err}",
  38:             output_dir.display()
  39:         );
  40:         1
  41:     })?;
  42: 
  43:     let snapshot = env::var("RUSTYNET_MEMBERSHIP_SNAPSHOT_PATH")
  44:         .ok()
  45:         .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
  46:         .unwrap_or_else(|| DEFAULT_MEMBERSHIP_SNAPSHOT_PATH.to_string());
  47:     let log = env::var("RUSTYNET_MEMBERSHIP_LOG_PATH")
  48:         .ok()
  49:         .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
  50:         .unwrap_or_else(|| DEFAULT_MEMBERSHIP_LOG_PATH.to_string());
  51:     let environment = env::var("RUSTYNET_MEMBERSHIP_EVIDENCE_ENVIRONMENT")
  52:         .ok()
  53:         .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
  54:         .unwrap_or_else(|| DEFAULT_EVIDENCE_ENVIRONMENT.to_string());
  55: 
  56:     run_membership_generate_evidence(&root_dir, &snapshot, &log, &output_dir, &environment)?;
  57:     verify_artifacts(&output_dir)?;
  58:     write_summary_log(&root_dir, &output_dir)?;
  59: 
  60:     println!(
  61:         "membership incident drill complete: {}",
  62:         output_dir.display()
  63:     );
  64:     Ok(())
  65: }
  66: 
  67: fn run_membership_generate_evidence(
  68:     root_dir: &Path,
  69:     snapshot: &str,
  70:     log: &str,
  71:     output_dir: &Path,
  72:     environment: &str,
  73: ) -> Result<(), i32> {
  74:     let status = Command::new("cargo")
  75:         .current_dir(root_dir)
  76:         .args([
  77:             "run",
  78:             "--quiet",
  79:             "-p",
  80:             "rustynet-cli",
  81:             "--",
  82:             "membership",
  83:             "generate-evidence",
  84:             "--snapshot",
  85:             snapshot,
  86:             "--log",
  87:             log,
  88:             "--output-dir",
  89:         ])
  90:         .arg(output_dir)
  91:         .args(["--environment", environment])
  92:         .status()
  93:         .map_err(|err| {
  94:             eprintln!("failed to run membership generate-evidence: {err}");
  95:             1
  96:         })?;
  97:     if status.success() {
  98:         Ok(())
  99:     } else {
 100:         Err(status_code(status))
 101:     }
 102: }
 103: 
 104: fn verify_artifacts(output_dir: &Path) -> Result<(), i32> {
 105:     let required = [
 106:         output_dir.join("membership_conformance_report.json"),
 107:         output_dir.join("membership_negative_tests_report.json"),
 108:         output_dir.join("membership_recovery_report.json"),
 109:         output_dir.join("membership_audit_integrity.log"),
 110:     ];
 111:     for artifact in &required {
 112:         if !artifact.is_file() {
 113:             eprintln!("missing membership drill artifact: {}", artifact.display());
 114:             return Err(1);
 115:         }
 116:     }
 117: 
 118:     for artifact in &required[..3] {
 119:         let text = fs::read_to_string(artifact).map_err(|err| {
 120:             eprintln!("failed to read artifact {}: {err}", artifact.display());
 121:             1
 122:         })?;
 123:         if !text.contains(r#""evidence_mode":"measured""#)
 124:             && !text.contains(r#""evidence_mode": "measured""#)
 125:         {
 126:             eprintln!("artifact is not measured evidence: {}", artifact.display());
 127:             return Err(1);
 128:         }
 129:         if !text.contains("\"captured_at_unix\"") {
 130:             eprintln!(
 131:                 "artifact missing captured_at_unix metadata: {}",
 132:                 artifact.display()
 133:             );
 134:             return Err(1);
 135:         }
 136:         if !text.contains("\"environment\"") {
 137:             eprintln!(
 138:                 "artifact missing environment metadata: {}",
 139:                 artifact.display()
 140:             );
 141:             return Err(1);
 142:         }
 143:         if !text.contains(r#""status":"pass""#) && !text.contains(r#""status": "pass""#) {
 144:             eprintln!("membership drill failed: {}", artifact.display());
 145:             return Err(1);
 146:         }
 147:     }
 148: 
 149:     Ok(())
 150: }
 151: 
 152: fn write_summary_log(root_dir: &Path, output_dir: &Path) -> Result<(), i32> {
 153:     let timestamp = Command::new("date")
 154:         .current_dir(root_dir)
 155:         .args(["-u", "+%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ"])
 156:         .output()
 157:         .map_err(|err| {
 158:             eprintln!("failed to run date -u for membership drill summary: {err}");
 159:             1
 160:         })?;
 161:     if !timestamp.status.success() {
 162:         return Err(status_code(timestamp.status));
 163:     }
 164:     let timestamp_text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&timestamp.stdout)
 165:         .trim()
 166:         .to_string();
 167:     let summary = format!(
 168:         "timestamp_utc={timestamp}\nscenario=approver_compromise_recovery\nconformance=pass\nnegative=pass\nrecovery=pass\naudit_log={}/membership_audit_integrity.log\n",
 169:         output_dir.display(),
 170:         timestamp = timestamp_text
 171:     );
 172:     fs::write(output_dir.join("drill_summary.log"), summary).map_err(|err| {
 173:         eprintln!(
 174:             "failed to write membership drill summary {}: {err}",
 175:             output_dir.join("drill_summary.log").display()
 176:         );
 177:         1
 178:     })
 179: }
 180: 
 181: fn resolve_path(root_dir: &Path, path: &Path) -> PathBuf {
 182:     if path.is_absolute() {
 183:         path.to_path_buf()
 184:     } else {
 185:         root_dir.join(path)
 186:     }
 187: }
 188: 
 189: fn repo_root() -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
 190:     let manifest_dir = PathBuf::from(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"));
 191:     manifest_dir
 192:         .parent()
 193:         .and_then(Path::parent)
 194:         .map(Path::to_path_buf)
 195:         .ok_or_else(|| {
 196:             format!(
 197:                 "failed to resolve repository root from manifest dir {}",
 198:                 manifest_dir.display()
 199:             )
 200:         })
 201: }
 202: 
 203: fn status_code(status: ExitStatus) -> i32 {
 204:     match status.code() {
 205:         Some(code) => code,
 206:         None => {
 207:             #[cfg(unix)]
 208:             {
 209:                 use std::os::unix::process::ExitStatusExt;
 210:                 match status.signal() {
 211:                     Some(signal) => 128 + signal,
 212:                     None => 1,
 213:                 }
 214:             }
 215:             #[cfg(not(unix))]
 216:             {
 217:                 1
 218:             }
 219:         }
 220:     }
 221: }

   8: 
   9: fn main() {
  10:     let code = match run() {

  17: fn run() -> Result<(), i32> {
  18:     let root_dir = repo_root().map_err(|err| {
  19:         eprintln!("{err}");
  20:         1
  21:     })?;
  22: 
  23:     if current_os() != "Linux" {
  24:         eprintln!("no-leak dataplane gate requires Linux");
  25:         return Err(1);
  26:     }
  27:     if current_uid()? != 0 {
  28:         eprintln!("no-leak dataplane gate requires root privileges");
  29:         return Err(1);
  30:     }
  31: 
  32:     let report_path = env::var_os("RUSTYNET_NO_LEAK_REPORT_PATH")
  33:         .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())

  37:         .current_dir(&root_dir)

  39:         .status()
  40:         .map_err(|err| {
  41:             eprintln!("failed to execute no-leak e2e script: {err}");
  42:             1
  43:         })?;

  45:         return Err(status_code(status));
  46:     }

  54:             "rustynet-cli",

  64:             1
  65:         })?;
  66:     if verify_status.success() {
  67:         Ok(())
  68:     } else {
  69:         Err(status_code(verify_status))
  70:     }
  71: }
  72: 
  73: fn current_os() -> String {
  74:     Command::new("uname")
  75:         .arg("-s")
  76:         .output()
  77:         .map(|output| String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).trim().to_string())
  78:         .unwrap_or_else(|_| String::new())
  79: }
  80: 
  81: fn current_uid() -> Result<u32, i32> {
  82:     let output = Command::new("id").args(["-u"]).output().map_err(|err| {
  83:         eprintln!("failed to determine uid: {err}");
  84:         1
  85:     })?;
  86:     if !output.status.success() {
  87:         eprintln!("failed to determine uid");
  88:         return Err(1);
  89:     }
  90:     let value = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout);
  91:     value.trim().parse::<u32>().map_err(|err| {
  92:         eprintln!("failed to parse uid: {err}");
  93:         1
  94:     })
  95: }

  35:         .or_else(|| env::var_os("RUSTYNET_PHASE10_OUT_DIR").filter(|value| !value.is_empty()))
  36:         .unwrap_or_else(|| OsString::from(DEFAULT_PHASE10_ARTIFACT_DIR));

  40:     let required_nat_profiles = env::var_os("RUSTYNET_PHASE10_CROSS_NETWORK_NAT_PROFILES")
  41:         .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
  42:         .unwrap_or_else(|| OsString::from(DEFAULT_REQUIRED_NAT_PROFILES));
  43:     let artifact_dir_path = PathBuf::from(&artifact_dir);

 119: fn require_command(command: &str) -> Result<(), i32> {
 120:     if command_exists(command) {
 121:         Ok(())
 122:     } else {
 123:         eprintln!("missing required command: {command}");
 124:         Err(1)
 125:     }
 126: }
 127: 
 128: fn command_exists(command: &str) -> bool {
 129:     if Path::new(command).components().count() > 1 {
 130:         return Path::new(command).is_file();
 131:     }
 132:     let Some(path_value) = env::var_os("PATH") else {
 133:         return false;
 134:     };
 135:     env::split_paths(&path_value).any(|dir| dir.join(command).is_file())
 136: }
 137: 
 138: fn get_head_commit(root_dir: &Path) -> Result<OsString, String> {
 139:     let output = Command::new("git")
 140:         .current_dir(root_dir)
 141:         .args(["rev-parse", "HEAD"])
 142:         .output()
 143:         .map_err(|err| format!("failed to run git rev-parse HEAD: {err}"))?;
 144:     if !output.status.success() {
 145:         return Err("git rev-parse HEAD failed".to_string());
 146:     }
 147:     let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout);
 148:     let trimmed = text.trim();
 149:     if trimmed.is_empty() {
 150:         return Err("git rev-parse HEAD returned empty output".to_string());
 151:     }
 152:     Ok(OsString::from(trimmed))
 153: }
 154: 
 155: fn run_bin(root_dir: &Path, bin_name: &str, args: &[OsString]) -> Result<(), i32> {
 156:     let mut command = Command::new("cargo");
 157:     command.current_dir(root_dir).args([
 158:         "run",
 159:         "--quiet",
 160:         "-p",
 161:         "rustynet-cli",
 162:         "--bin",
 163:         bin_name,
 164:         "--",
 165:     ]);
 166:     command.args(args.iter().map(OsString::as_os_str));
 167:     let status = command.status().map_err(|err| {
 168:         eprintln!("failed to run bin {bin_name}: {err}");
 169:         1
 170:     })?;
 171:     if status.success() {
 172:         Ok(())
 173:     } else {
 174:         Err(status_code(status))
 175:     }
 176: }
 177: 
 178: fn run_ops(root_dir: &Path, ops_subcommand: &str, args: &[OsString]) -> Result<(), i32> {
 179:     let mut command = Command::new("cargo");
 180:     command.current_dir(root_dir).args([
 181:         "run",
 182:         "--quiet",
 183:         "-p",
 184:         "rustynet-cli",
 185:         "--",
 186:         "ops",
 187:         ops_subcommand,
 188:     ]);
 189:     command.args(args.iter().map(OsString::as_os_str));
 190:     let status = command.status().map_err(|err| {
 191:         eprintln!("failed to run ops {ops_subcommand}: {err}");
 192:         1
 193:     })?;
 194:     if status.success() {
 195:         Ok(())
 196:     } else {
 197:         Err(status_code(status))
 198:     }
 199: }
 200: 
 201: fn repo_root() -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
 202:     let manifest_dir = PathBuf::from(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"));
 203:     manifest_dir
 204:         .parent()
 205:         .and_then(Path::parent)
 206:         .map(Path::to_path_buf)
 207:         .ok_or_else(|| {
 208:             format!(
 209:                 "failed to resolve repository root from manifest dir {}",
 210:                 manifest_dir.display()
 211:             )
 212:         })
 213: }
 214: 
 215: fn status_code(status: ExitStatus) -> i32 {
 216:     match status.code() {
 217:         Some(code) => code,
 218:         None => {
 219:             #[cfg(unix)]
 220:             {
 221:                 use std::os::unix::process::ExitStatusExt;
 222: 
 223:                 match status.signal() {
 224:                     Some(signal) => 128 + signal,
 225:                     None => 1,
 226:                 }
 227:             }
 228:             #[cfg(not(unix))]
 229:             {
 230:                 1
 231:             }
 232:         }
 233:     }
 234: }

 148: fn resolve_source_path(root_dir: &Path, raw: OsString) -> PathBuf {
 149:     let path = PathBuf::from(raw);
 150:     if path.is_absolute() {
 151:         path
 152:     } else {
 153:         root_dir.join(path)
 154:     }
 155: }
 156: 
 157: fn path_to_utf8(path: &Path, label: &str) -> Result<String, i32> {
 158:     path.to_str().map(|value| value.to_string()).ok_or_else(|| {
 159:         eprintln!("{label} is not valid UTF-8: {}", path.display());
 160:         1
 161:     })
 162: }
 163: 
 164: fn run_command(
 165:     program: &str,
 166:     args: &[&str],
 167:     cwd: Option<&Path>,
 168:     extra_env: &[(&str, &str)],
 169: ) -> Result<(), i32> {
 170:     let mut command = Command::new(program);
 171:     if let Some(dir) = cwd {
 172:         command.current_dir(dir);
 173:     }
 174:     command.args(args).stdin(std::process::Stdio::null());
 175:     for (key, value) in extra_env {
 176:         command.env(key, value);
 177:     }
 178:     let status = command.status().map_err(|err| {
 179:         eprintln!("failed to run {program}: {err}");
 180:         1
 181:     })?;
 182:     if status.success() {
 183:         Ok(())
 184:     } else {
 185:         Err(status_code(status))
 186:     }
 187: }
 188: 
 189: fn repo_root() -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
 190:     let manifest_dir = PathBuf::from(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"));
 191:     manifest_dir
 192:         .parent()
 193:         .and_then(Path::parent)
 194:         .map(Path::to_path_buf)
 195:         .ok_or_else(|| {
 196:             format!(
 197:                 "failed to resolve repository root from manifest dir {}",
 198:                 manifest_dir.display()
 199:             )
 200:         })
 201: }
 202: 
 203: fn status_code(status: ExitStatus) -> i32 {
 204:     match status.code() {
 205:         Some(code) => code,
 206:         None => {
 207:             #[cfg(unix)]
 208:             {
 209:                 use std::os::unix::process::ExitStatusExt;
 210: 
 211:                 match status.signal() {
 212:                     Some(signal) => 128 + signal,
 213:                     None => 1,
 214:                 }
 215:             }
 216:             #[cfg(not(unix))]
 217:             {
 218:                 1

 152: fn run_required_test(root_dir: &Path, package: &str, test_filter: &str) -> Result<(), i32> {
 153:     run_command(
 154:         "cargo",
 155:         &[
 156:             "run",
 157:             "--quiet",
 158:             "-p",
 159:             "rustynet-cli",
 160:             "--bin",
 161:             "run_required_test",
 162:             "--",
 163:             package,
 164:             test_filter,
 165:         ],
 166:         Some(root_dir),
 167:         &[],
 168:     )

 170: 
 171: fn run_command(
 172:     program: &str,
 173:     args: &[&str],
 174:     cwd: Option<&Path>,
 175:     extra_env: &[(&str, &str)],
 176: ) -> Result<(), i32> {
 177:     let mut command = Command::new(program);
 178:     if let Some(dir) = cwd {
 179:         command.current_dir(dir);
 180:     }
 181:     command.args(args).stdin(std::process::Stdio::null());
 182:     for (key, value) in extra_env {
 183:         command.env(key, value);
 184:     }
 185:     let status = command.status().map_err(|err| {
 186:         eprintln!("failed to run {program}: {err}");
 187:         1
 188:     })?;
 189:     if status.success() {
 190:         Ok(())
 191:     } else {
 192:         Err(status_code(status))
 193:     }
 194: }
 195: 
 196: fn resolve_source_path(root_dir: &Path, raw: OsString) -> PathBuf {
 197:     let path = PathBuf::from(raw);
 198:     if path.is_absolute() {
 199:         path
 200:     } else {
 201:         root_dir.join(path)
 202:     }
 203: }
 204: 
 205: fn repo_root() -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
 206:     let manifest_dir = PathBuf::from(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"));
 207:     manifest_dir
 208:         .parent()
 209:         .and_then(Path::parent)
 210:         .map(Path::to_path_buf)
 211:         .ok_or_else(|| {
 212:             format!(
 213:                 "failed to resolve repository root from manifest dir {}",
 214:                 manifest_dir.display()
 215:             )
 216:         })
 217: }
 218: 
 219: fn status_code(status: ExitStatus) -> i32 {
 220:     match status.code() {
 221:         Some(code) => code,
 222:         None => {
 223:             #[cfg(unix)]
 224:             {
 225:                 use std::os::unix::process::ExitStatusExt;
 226: 
 227:                 match status.signal() {
 228:                     Some(signal) => 128 + signal,
 229:                     None => 1,
 230:                 }
 231:             }
 232:             #[cfg(not(unix))]
 233:             {
 234:                 1
 235:             }
 236:         }
 237:     }
 238: }

 150: 
 151: fn run_step<F>(
 152:     report: &mut GateExecutionReport,
 153:     report_path: &Path,
 154:     step_id: &str,
 155:     action: F,
 156: ) -> Result<(), i32>
 157: where
 158:     F: FnOnce() -> Result<(), StepExecutionError>,
 159: {
 160:     let step = report.step_mut(step_id).ok_or_else(|| {
 161:         eprintln!("phase5 gate report is missing step definition: {step_id}");
 162:         1
 163:     })?;
 164:     match action() {
 165:         Ok(()) => {
 166:             step.status = GateStepStatus::ExecutedPassed;
 167:             step.exit_code = Some(0);
 168:             step.detail = None;
 169:             write_report(report_path, report)
 170:         }
 171:         Err(err) => {
 172:             step.status = GateStepStatus::ExecutedFailed;
 173:             step.exit_code = Some(err.exit_code);
 174:             step.detail = Some(err.detail);
 175:             report.overall_status = GateRunStatus::ExecutedFailed;
 176:             write_report(report_path, report)?;
 177:             Err(err.exit_code)
 178:         }
 179:     }
 180: }

 182: fn run_script(root_dir: &Path, script: &str, args: &[&str]) -> Result<(), StepExecutionError> {
 183:     let script_path = root_dir.join(script);
 184:     let status = Command::new(&script_path)
 185:         .current_dir(root_dir)
 186:         .args(args)
 187:         .status()
 188:         .map_err(|err| StepExecutionError {
 189:             exit_code: 1,
 190:             detail: format!("failed to execute script {}: {err}", script_path.display()),
 191:         })?;
 192:     if status.success() {
 193:         Ok(())
 194:     } else {
 195:         Err(StepExecutionError {
 196:             exit_code: status_code(status),
 197:             detail: format!("script failed: {}", script_path.display()),
 198:         })
 199:     }
 200: }
 201: 
 202: fn run_ops(root_dir: &Path, ops_subcommand: &str, args: &[&str]) -> Result<(), StepExecutionError> {
 203:     let status = Command::new("cargo")
 204:         .current_dir(root_dir)
 205:         .args([
 206:             "run",
 207:             "--quiet",
 208:             "-p",
 209:             "rustynet-cli",
 210:             "--",
 211:             "ops",
 212:             ops_subcommand,
 213:         ])
 214:         .args(args)
 215:         .status()
 216:         .map_err(|err| StepExecutionError {
 217:             exit_code: 1,
 218:             detail: format!("failed to run ops {ops_subcommand}: {err}"),
 219:         })?;
 220:     if status.success() {
 221:         Ok(())
 222:     } else {
 223:         Err(StepExecutionError {
 224:             exit_code: status_code(status),
 225:             detail: format!("ops {ops_subcommand} failed"),
 226:         })
 227:     }
 228: }
 229: 
 230: fn run_command(
 231:     root_dir: &Path,
 232:     program: &str,
 233:     args: &[&str],
 234:     env_pairs: &[(&str, &str)],
 235: ) -> Result<(), StepExecutionError> {
 236:     let status = Command::new(program)
 237:         .current_dir(root_dir)
 238:         .args(args)
 239:         .envs(env_pairs.iter().copied())
 240:         .status()
 241:         .map_err(|err| StepExecutionError {
 242:             exit_code: 1,
 243:             detail: format!("failed to execute command {program}: {err}"),
 244:         })?;
 245:     if status.success() {
 246:         Ok(())
 247:     } else {
 248:         Err(StepExecutionError {
 249:             exit_code: status_code(status),
 250:             detail: format!("command failed: {program} {}", args.join(" ")),
 251:         })
 252:     }
 253: }

 255: fn require_files(root_dir: &Path, paths: &[&str], label: &str) -> Result<(), StepExecutionError> {
 256:     let missing: Vec<String> = paths
 257:         .iter()
 258:         .map(|path| root_dir.join(path))
 259:         .filter(|path| !path.is_file())
 260:         .map(|path| path.display().to_string())
 261:         .collect();
 262:     if missing.is_empty() {
 263:         Ok(())
 264:     } else {
 265:         Err(StepExecutionError {
 266:             exit_code: 1,
 267:             detail: format!("missing {label}: {}", missing.join(", ")),
 268:         })
 269:     }
 270: }

 272: fn write_report(path: &Path, report: &mut GateExecutionReport) -> Result<(), i32> {
 273:     if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
 274:         fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|err| {
 275:             eprintln!(
 276:                 "failed to create report directory {}: {err}",
 277:                 parent.display()
 278:             );
 279:             1
 280:         })?;
 281:     }
 282:     report.generated_at_unix = now_unix().map_err(|err| {
 283:         eprintln!("{err}");
 284:         1
 285:     })?;
 286:     let json = serde_json::to_vec_pretty(report).map_err(|err| {
 287:         eprintln!("failed to serialize phase5 gate report: {err}");
 288:         1
 289:     })?;
 290:     fs::write(path, json).map_err(|err| {
 291:         eprintln!(
 292:             "failed to write phase5 gate report {}: {err}",
 293:             path.display()
 294:         );
 295:         1
 296:     })
 297: }
 298: 
 299: fn now_unix() -> Result<u64, String> {
 300:     SystemTime::now()
 301:         .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
 302:         .map(|duration| duration.as_secs())
 303:         .map_err(|err| format!("clock failure while generating phase5 gate report: {err}"))
 304: }

 309:         .parent()
 310:         .and_then(Path::parent)
 311:         .map(Path::to_path_buf)
 312:         .ok_or_else(|| {
 313:             format!(
 314:                 "failed to resolve repository root from manifest dir {}",
 315:                 manifest_dir.display()
 316:             )
 317:         })
 318: }

 335:                 1

 341: #[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq)]
 342: #[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
 343: enum GateRunStatus {
 344:     ExecutedPassed,
 345:     ExecutedFailed,
 346: }
 347: 
 348: #[derive(Clone, Copy, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq)]
 349: #[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
 350: enum GateStepStatus {
 351:     ExecutedPassed,
 352:     ExecutedFailed,
 353:     NotExecuted,
 354: }
 355: 
 356: #[derive(Clone, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq)]
 357: struct GateStepReport {
 358:     id: String,
 359:     description: String,
 360:     command: Vec<String>,
 361:     #[serde(default, skip_serializing_if = "Vec::is_empty")]
 362:     expected_paths: Vec<String>,
 363:     status: GateStepStatus,
 364:     #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
 365:     exit_code: Option<i32>,
 366:     #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
 367:     detail: Option<String>,
 368: }
 369: 
 370: impl GateStepReport {
 371:     fn new(id: &str, description: &str, command: &[&str]) -> Self {
 372:         Self {
 373:             id: id.to_string(),
 374:             description: description.to_string(),
 375:             command: command.iter().map(|item| (*item).to_string()).collect(),
 376:             expected_paths: Vec::new(),
 377:             status: GateStepStatus::NotExecuted,
 378:             exit_code: None,
 379:             detail: None,
 380:         }
 381:     }
 382: 
 383:     fn with_expected_paths(mut self, paths: &[&str]) -> Self {
 384:         self.expected_paths = paths.iter().map(|path| (*path).to_string()).collect();
 385:         self
 386:     }
 387: }
 388: 
 389: #[derive(Clone, Debug, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq)]
 390: struct GateExecutionReport {
 391:     schema_version: u32,
 392:     gate: String,
 393:     overall_status: GateRunStatus,
 394:     generated_at_unix: u64,
 395:     required_step_ids: Vec<String>,
 396:     steps: Vec<GateStepReport>,
 397: }
 398:

 407:                 .iter()

 410:             steps: vec![
 411:                 GateStepReport::new(
 412:                     "cargo_fmt",
 413:                     "run cargo fmt --all -- --check",
 414:                     &["cargo", "fmt", "--all", "--", "--check"],
 415:                 ),
 416:                 GateStepReport::new(
 417:                     "cargo_clippy",
