 543: #[cfg(test)]
 544: mod tests {
 545:     use super::{
 546:         GateExecutionReport, GateRunStatus, GateStepStatus, REQUIRED_PHASE5_STEP_IDS, write_report,
 547:     };
 548:     use std::env;
 549:     use std::fs;
 550:     use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
 551:     use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering};
 552:     use std::time::{SystemTime, UNIX_EPOCH};
 553: 
 554:     static TEMP_DIR_COUNTER: AtomicU64 = AtomicU64::new(0);
 555: 
 556:     struct TempDirGuard {
 557:         path: PathBuf,
 558:     }
 559: 
 560:     impl TempDirGuard {
 561:         fn create() -> Result<Self, String> {
 562:             let base_dir = env::temp_dir();
 563:             let pid = std::process::id();
 564:             let now_nanos = SystemTime::now()
 565:                 .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
 566:                 .map_err(|err| format!("clock failure while creating temp dir: {err}"))?
 567:                 .as_nanos();
 568: 
 569:             for attempt in 0..100u64 {
 570:                 let counter = TEMP_DIR_COUNTER.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
 571:                 let candidate = base_dir.join(format!(
 572:                     "rustynet-phase5-gates-test-{pid}-{now_nanos}-{counter}-{attempt}"
 573:                 ));
 574:                 match fs::create_dir(&candidate) {
 575:                     Ok(()) => return Ok(Self { path: candidate }),
 576:                     Err(err) if err.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::AlreadyExists => continue,
 577:                     Err(err) => {
 578:                         return Err(format!(
 579:                             "failed to create temp dir {}: {err}",
 580:                             candidate.display()
 581:                         ));
 582:                     }
 583:                 }
 584:             }
 585: 
 586:             Err("failed to create temp dir: exhausted unique path attempts".to_string())
 587:         }
 588: 
 589:         fn path(&self) -> &Path {
 590:             self.path.as_path()
 591:         }
 592:     }
 593: 
 594:     impl Drop for TempDirGuard {
 595:         fn drop(&mut self) {
 596:             let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&self.path);
 597:         }
 598:     }
 599:

 613:         let mut report = GateExecutionReport::phase5();

 615:         report.step_mut("cargo_fmt").unwrap().exit_code = Some(0);
 616:         report.step_mut("cargo_clippy").unwrap().status = GateStepStatus::ExecutedFailed;
 617:         report.step_mut("cargo_clippy").unwrap().exit_code = Some(101);
 618:         report.step_mut("cargo_clippy").unwrap().detail =
 619:             Some("command failed: cargo clippy".to_string());
 620:         report.overall_status = GateRunStatus::ExecutedFailed;
 621: 
 622:         assert_eq!(
 623:             report.step_mut("cargo_check").unwrap().status,
 624:             GateStepStatus::NotExecuted
 625:         );
 626:         assert_eq!(
 627:             report.step_mut("cargo_clippy").unwrap().status,
 628:             GateStepStatus::ExecutedFailed
 629:         );
 630:     }

 146: fn run_script(root_dir: &Path, script: &str, args: &[&str]) -> Result<(), i32> {
 147:     let status = Command::new(root_dir.join(script))
 148:         .current_dir(root_dir)
 149:         .args(args)
 150:         .status()
 151:         .map_err(|err| {
 152:             eprintln!(
 153:                 "failed to execute script {}: {err}",
 154:                 root_dir.join(script).display()
 155:             );
 156:             1
 157:         })?;
 158:     if status.success() {
 159:         Ok(())
 160:     } else {
 161:         Err(status_code(status))
 162:     }
 163: }
 164: 
 165: fn run_required_test(
 166:     root_dir: &Path,
 167:     package: &str,
 168:     test_filter: &str,
 169:     extra_args: &[&str],
 170: ) -> Result<(), i32> {
 171:     let status = Command::new("cargo")
 172:         .current_dir(root_dir)
 173:         .args([
 174:             "run",
 175:             "--quiet",
 176:             "-p",
 177:             "rustynet-cli",
 178:             "--bin",
 179:             "run_required_test",
 180:             "--",
 181:             package,
 182:             test_filter,
 183:         ])
 184:         .args(extra_args)
 185:         .status()
 186:         .map_err(|err| {
 187:             eprintln!(
 188:                 "failed to execute required test helper for package={package} filter={test_filter}: {err}"
 189:             );
 190:             1
 191:         })?;
 192:     if status.success() {
 193:         Ok(())
 194:     } else {
 195:         Err(status_code(status))
 196:     }
 197: }
 198: 
 199: fn run_ops_with_env(
 200:     root_dir: &Path,
 201:     ops_subcommand: &str,
 202:     env_pairs: &[(&str, &str)],
 203:     args: &[&str],
 204: ) -> Result<(), i32> {
 205:     let status = Command::new("cargo")
 206:         .current_dir(root_dir)
 207:         .args([
 208:             "run",
 209:             "--quiet",
 210:             "-p",
 211:             "rustynet-cli",
 212:             "--",
 213:             "ops",
 214:             ops_subcommand,
 215:         ])
 216:         .args(args)
 217:         .envs(env_pairs.iter().copied())
 218:         .status()
 219:         .map_err(|err| {
 220:             eprintln!("failed to run ops {ops_subcommand}: {err}");
 221:             1
 222:         })?;
 223:     if status.success() {
 224:         Ok(())
 225:     } else {
 226:         Err(status_code(status))
 227:     }
 228: }
 229: 
 230: fn run_command(
 231:     root_dir: &Path,
 232:     program: &str,
 233:     args: &[&str],
 234:     env_pairs: &[(&str, &str)],
 235: ) -> Result<(), i32> {
 236:     let status = Command::new(program)
 237:         .current_dir(root_dir)
 238:         .args(args)
 239:         .envs(env_pairs.iter().copied())
 240:         .status()
 241:         .map_err(|err| {
 242:             eprintln!("failed to execute command {program}: {err}");
 243:             1
 244:         })?;
 245:     if status.success() {
 246:         Ok(())
 247:     } else {
 248:         Err(status_code(status))
 249:     }
 250: }
 251: 
 252: fn require_file(path: &Path) -> Result<(), i32> {
 253:     if path.is_file() {
 254:         Ok(())
 255:     } else {
 256:         eprintln!(
 257:             "missing beta release integrity artifact: {}",
 258:             path.display()
 259:         );
 260:         Err(1)
 261:     }
 262: }
 263: 
 264: fn repo_root() -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
 265:     let manifest_dir = PathBuf::from(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"));
 266:     manifest_dir
 267:         .parent()
 268:         .and_then(Path::parent)
 269:         .map(Path::to_path_buf)
 270:         .ok_or_else(|| {
 271:             format!(
 272:                 "failed to resolve repository root from manifest dir {}",
 273:                 manifest_dir.display()
 274:             )
 275:         })
 276: }
 277: 
 278: fn status_code(status: ExitStatus) -> i32 {
 279:     match status.code() {
 280:         Some(code) => code,
 281:         None => {
 282:             #[cfg(unix)]
 283:             {
 284:                 use std::os::unix::process::ExitStatusExt;
 285: 
 286:                 match status.signal() {
 287:                     Some(signal) => 128 + signal,
 288:                     None => 1,
 289:                 }
 290:             }
 291:             #[cfg(not(unix))]
 292:             {
 293:                 1
 294:             }
 295:         }
 296:     }
 297: }

 131: fn run_cargo(root_dir: &Path, args: &[&str], extra_env: &[(&str, &str)]) -> Result<(), i32> {
 132:     let mut command = Command::new("cargo");
 133:     command
 134:         .current_dir(root_dir)
 135:         .args(args)
 136:         .stdin(Stdio::null());
 137:     for (key, value) in extra_env {

 141:         eprintln!("failed to run cargo {args:?}: {err}");
 142:         1

 144:     if status.success() {
 145:         Ok(())
 146:     } else {
 147:         Err(status_code(status))
 148:     }
 149: }

 151: fn run_script(root_dir: &Path, script: &str, args: &[&str]) -> Result<(), i32> {
 152:     let status = Command::new(script)
 153:         .current_dir(root_dir)
 154:         .args(args)
 155:         .status()
 156:         .map_err(|err| {
 157:             eprintln!("failed to run script {script}: {err}");
 158:             1
 159:         })?;

 167: fn repo_root() -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
 168:     let manifest_dir = PathBuf::from(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"));
 169:     manifest_dir
 170:         .parent()
 171:         .and_then(Path::parent)
 172:         .map(Path::to_path_buf)
 173:         .ok_or_else(|| {
 174:             format!(
 175:                 "failed to resolve repository root from manifest dir {}",
 176:                 manifest_dir.display()
 177:             )
 178:         })
 179: }
 180: 
 181: fn status_code(status: ExitStatus) -> i32 {
 182:     match status.code() {
 183:         Some(code) => code,
 184:         None => {
 185:             #[cfg(unix)]
 186:             {
 187:                 use std::os::unix::process::ExitStatusExt;
 188: 
 189:                 match status.signal() {
 190:                     Some(signal) => 128 + signal,
 191:                     None => 1,
 192:                 }
 193:             }
 194:             #[cfg(not(unix))]
 195:             {
 196:                 1
 197:             }
 198:         }
 199:     }
 200: }

===== /crates/rustynet-cli/src/bin/real_wireguard_exitnode_e2e.rs =====

  12: 
  13: static CLEANUP_RUNNING: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);
  14: 
  15: const NFT_RULES: &str = r#"table inet rustynet_e2e {
  16:   chain forward {
  17:     type filter hook forward priority 0; policy drop;
  18:     ct state established,related accept
  19:     iifname "wg0" oifname "veth_ei_e" accept
  20:   }
  21: }

  24:   chain postrouting {
  25:     type nat hook postrouting priority 100; policy accept;
  26:     oifname "veth_ei_e" ip saddr 100.64.0.0/10 masquerade
  27:   }
  28: }
  29: "#;
  30: 
  31: struct Cleanup {
  32:     ns_client: String,
  33:     ns_exit: String,
  34:     ns_inet: String,
  35:     ns_lan: String,
  36:     key_dir: PathBuf,
  37: }
  38: 
  39: impl Cleanup {
  40:     fn run(&self) {
  41:         if CLEANUP_RUNNING.swap(true, Ordering::SeqCst) {
  42:             return;
  43:         }
  44:         for namespace in [&self.ns_client, &self.ns_exit, &self.ns_inet, &self.ns_lan] {
  45:             let _ = run_status(cmd("ip", &["netns", "del", namespace]));
  46:         }
  47:         let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&self.key_dir);
  48:         CLEANUP_RUNNING.store(false, Ordering::SeqCst);
  49:     }
  50: }
  51: 
  52: impl Drop for Cleanup {
  53:     fn drop(&mut self) {
  54:         self.run();
  55:     }
  56: }
  57: 
  58: fn main() -> ExitCode {
  59:     if let Err(err) = run() {
  60:         eprintln!("{err}");
  61:         return ExitCode::from(1);
  62:     }
  63:     ExitCode::SUCCESS
  64: }

 383: fn current_uid() -> Result<u32, String> {
 384:     let output = command_output(cmd("id", &["-u"]))?;
 385:     let text = String::from_utf8(output).map_err(|e| format!("id -u output not utf8: {e}"))?;
 386:     text.trim()
 387:         .parse::<u32>()
 388:         .map_err(|e| format!("parse id -u: {e}"))
 389: }
 390: 
 391: fn require_command(command: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
 392:     let status = run_status(cmd("command", &["-v", command]));
 393:     match status {
 394:         Ok(0) => Ok(()),
 395:         Ok(_) => Err(format!("missing required command: {command}")),
 396:         Err(_) => {
 397:             let status = run_status(cmd("which", &[command]));
 398:             match status {
 399:                 Ok(0) => Ok(()),
 400:                 _ => Err(format!("missing required command: {command}")),
 401:             }
 402:         }
 403:     }
 404: }
 405: 
 406: fn run_expect_success_ns<const N: usize>(namespace: &str, args: [&str; N]) -> bool {
 407:     run_status(ns_command(namespace, args)).is_ok_and(|code| code == 0)
 408: }
 409: 
 410: fn run_expect_failure_ns<const N: usize>(namespace: &str, args: [&str; N]) -> bool {
 411:     run_status(ns_command(namespace, args)).is_ok_and(|code| code != 0)
 412: }
 413: 
 414: fn run_ns_ok<const N: usize>(namespace: &str, args: [&str; N]) -> Result<(), String> {
 415:     run_ok(ns_command(namespace, args))
 416: }
 417: 
 418: fn run_ns_quiet_ok<const N: usize>(namespace: &str, args: [&str; N]) -> Result<(), String> {
 419:     let mut command = ns_command(namespace, args);
 420:     command.stdout(Stdio::null());
 421:     run_ok(command)
 422: }
 423: 
 424: fn run_ns_stdin_ok<const N: usize>(
 425:     namespace: &str,
 426:     args: [&str; N],
 427:     stdin_data: &str,
 428: ) -> Result<(), String> {
 429:     let mut command = ns_command(namespace, args);
 430:     command.stdin(Stdio::piped()).stdout(Stdio::null());
 431:     let mut child = command
 432:         .spawn()
 433:         .map_err(|e| format!("spawn command with stdin: {e}"))?;
 434:     if let Some(mut stdin) = child.stdin.take() {
 435:         stdin
 436:             .write_all(stdin_data.as_bytes())
 437:             .map_err(|e| format!("write stdin: {e}"))?;
 438:     }
 439:     let status = child.wait().map_err(|e| format!("wait command: {e}"))?;
 440:     if status.success() {
 441:         Ok(())
 442:     } else {
 443:         Err(format!("command failed with status {status}"))
 444:     }
 445: }
 446: 
 447: fn spawn_ns_quiet<const N: usize>(
 448:     namespace: &str,
 449:     args: [&str; N],
 450: ) -> Result<process::Child, String> {
 451:     let mut command = ns_command(namespace, args);
 452:     command.stdout(Stdio::null()).stderr(Stdio::null());
 453:     command.spawn().map_err(|e| format!("spawn command: {e}"))
 454: }

 456: fn ns_command<const N: usize>(namespace: &str, args: [&str; N]) -> Command {
 457:     let mut command = cmd("ip", &[]);
 458:     command.arg("netns").arg("exec").arg(namespace);
 459:     command.args(args);
 460:     command
 461: }
 462: 
 463: fn cmd(program: &str, args: &[&str]) -> Command {
 464:     let mut command = Command::new(program);
 465:     command.args(args);
 466:     command.env("PATH", secure_path());
 467:     command
 468: }
 469: 
 470: fn secure_path() -> OsString {
 471:     let current = env::var_os("PATH").unwrap_or_default();
 472:     let mut value = OsString::from("/usr/local/sbin:/usr/sbin:/sbin:");
 473:     value.push(current);
 474:     value
 475: }
 476: 
 477: fn run_ok(mut command: Command) -> Result<(), String> {
 478:     let status = command.status().map_err(|e| format!("run command: {e}"))?;
 479:     if status.success() {
 480:         Ok(())
 481:     } else {
 482:         Err(format!("command failed with status {status}"))
 483:     }
 484: }
 485: 
 486: fn run_status(mut command: Command) -> Result<i32, String> {
 487:     let status = command.status().map_err(|e| format!("run command: {e}"))?;
 488:     Ok(status.code().unwrap_or(1))
 489: }
 490: 
 491: fn command_output(mut command: Command) -> Result<Vec<u8>, String> {
 492:     let output = command.output().map_err(|e| format!("run command: {e}"))?;
 493:     if output.status.success() {
 494:         Ok(output.stdout)
 495:     } else {
 496:         Err(format!("command failed with status {}", output.status))
 497:     }
 498: }

 500: fn generate_wg_key(namespace: &str, output_path: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
 501:     let output = command_output(ns_command(namespace, ["wg", "genkey"]))?;
 502:     fs::write(output_path, output)
 503:         .map_err(|e| format!("write wg key {}: {e}", output_path.display()))
 504: }
 505: 
 506: fn generate_wg_pubkey(namespace: &str, key_path: &Path, output_path: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
 507:     let key_text =
 508:         fs::read(key_path).map_err(|e| format!("read key {}: {e}", key_path.display()))?;
 509:     let mut command = ns_command(namespace, ["wg", "pubkey"]);
 510:     command.stdin(Stdio::piped()).stdout(Stdio::piped());
 511:     let mut child = command
 512:         .spawn()
 513:         .map_err(|e| format!("spawn wg pubkey: {e}"))?;
 514:     if let Some(mut stdin) = child.stdin.take() {
 515:         stdin
 516:             .write_all(&key_text)
 517:             .map_err(|e| format!("write wg pubkey stdin: {e}"))?;
 518:     }
 519:     let output = child
 520:         .wait_with_output()
 521:         .map_err(|e| format!("wait wg pubkey: {e}"))?;
 522:     if !output.status.success() {
 523:         return Err(format!("wg pubkey failed with status {}", output.status));
 524:     }
 525:     fs::write(output_path, output.stdout)
 526:         .map_err(|e| format!("write pubkey {}: {e}", output_path.display()))
 527: }
 528: 
 529: fn read_trimmed(path: &Path) -> Result<String, String> {
 530:     let text = fs::read_to_string(path).map_err(|e| format!("read {}: {e}", path.display()))?;
 531:     Ok(text.trim().to_owned())
 532: }
 533: 
 534: fn path_str(path: &Path) -> Result<&str, String> {
 535:     path.to_str()
 536:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("path is not valid utf-8: {}", path.display()))
 537: }
 538: 
 539: fn send_udp_probe(namespace: &str, ip: &str, port: &str, payload: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
 540:     let mut command = Command::new("ip");
 541:     command
 542:         .arg("netns")
 543:         .arg("exec")
 544:         .arg(namespace)
 545:         .arg("env")
 546:         .arg(format!("RUSTYNET_UDP_PAYLOAD={payload}"))
 547:         .arg("timeout")
 548:         .arg("2")
 549:         .arg("bash")
 550:         .arg("-lc")
 551:         .arg(format!(
 552:             "printf '%s' \"$RUSTYNET_UDP_PAYLOAD\" >/dev/udp/{ip}/{port}"
 553:         ));
 554:     run_ok(command)
 555: }
 556: 
 557: fn write_json_report(
 558:     report_path: &Path,
 559:     exit_status: &str,
 560:     lan_off_status: &str,
 561:     lan_on_status: &str,
 562:     dns_up_status: &str,
 563:     kill_switch_status: &str,
 564:     dns_down_status: &str,
 565: ) -> Result<(), String> {
 566:     let environment =
 567:         env::var("RUSTYNET_PHASE10_E2E_ENVIRONMENT").unwrap_or_else(|_| "lab-netns".to_owned());
 568:     let (captured_at_utc, captured_at_unix) = utc_now()?;
 569:     let root = repo_root()?;
 570:     let mut command = cmd(
 571:         "cargo",
 572:         &[
 573:             "run",
 574:             "--quiet",
 575:             "-p",
 576:             "rustynet-cli",
 577:             "--",
 578:             "ops",
 579:             "write-real-wireguard-exitnode-e2e-report",
 580:             "--report-path",
 581:             path_str(report_path)?,
 582:             "--exit-status",
 583:             exit_status,
 584:             "--lan-off-status",
 585:             lan_off_status,
 586:             "--lan-on-status",
 587:             lan_on_status,
 588:             "--dns-up-status",
 589:             dns_up_status,
 590:             "--kill-switch-status",
 591:             kill_switch_status,
 592:             "--dns-down-status",
 593:             dns_down_status,
 594:             "--environment",
 595:             &environment,
 596:             "--captured-at-utc",
 597:             &captured_at_utc,
 598:             "--captured-at-unix",
 599:             &captured_at_unix,
 600:         ],
 601:     );
 602:     command.current_dir(root);
 603:     let output = command_output(command)?;
 604:     let text =
 605:         String::from_utf8(output).map_err(|e| format!("report writer output not utf8: {e}"))?;
 606:     if text.trim() == "pass" {
 607:         Ok(())
 608:     } else {
 609:         Err(format!("report writer returned {}", text.trim()))
 610:     }
 611: }
 612: 
 613: fn repo_root() -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
 614:     let manifest_dir = PathBuf::from(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"));
 615:     manifest_dir
 616:         .ancestors()
 617:         .nth(2)
 618:         .map(Path::to_path_buf)
 619:         .ok_or_else(|| "unable to resolve repository root".to_owned())
 620: }
 621: 
 622: fn utc_now() -> Result<(String, String), String> {
 623:     let now = SystemTime::now()
 624:         .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
 625:         .map_err(|e| format!("system clock before unix epoch: {e}"))?;
 626:     let unix = now.as_secs();
 627:     let timestamp = command_output(cmd("date", &["-u", "+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"]))?;
 628:     let text = String::from_utf8(timestamp).map_err(|e| format!("date output not utf8: {e}"))?;
 629:     Ok((text.trim().to_owned(), unix.to_string()))
 630: }

 320: fn current_uid() -> Result<u32, String> {

 328: fn require_command(command: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
 329:     if run_status(cmd("which", &[command])).is_ok_and(|code| code == 0) {
 330:         Ok(())
 331:     } else {
 332:         Err(format!("missing required command: {command}"))
 333:     }

 336: fn ns_command<const N: usize>(namespace: &str, args: [&str; N]) -> Command {
 337:     let mut command = cmd("ip", &[]);
 338:     command.arg("netns").arg("exec").arg(namespace);
 339:     command.args(args);
 340:     command
 341: }

 343: fn cmd(program: &str, args: &[&str]) -> Command {
 344:     let mut command = Command::new(program);
 345:     command.args(args);
 346:     command.env("PATH", secure_path());
 347:     command
 348: }

 350: fn secure_path() -> std::ffi::OsString {
 351:     let current = env::var_os("PATH").unwrap_or_default();
 352:     let mut value = std::ffi::OsString::from("/usr/local/sbin:/usr/sbin:/sbin:");
 353:     value.push(current);
 354:     value
 355: }

 367: fn run_expect_success_ns<const N: usize>(namespace: &str, args: [&str; N]) -> bool {
 368:     run_status(ns_command(namespace, args)).is_ok_and(|code| code == 0)
 369: }

 371: fn run_expect_failure_ns<const N: usize>(namespace: &str, args: [&str; N]) -> bool {
 372:     run_status(ns_command(namespace, args)).is_ok_and(|code| code != 0)

 375: fn run_ns_stdin_ok<const N: usize>(
 376:     namespace: &str,
 377:     args: [&str; N],
 378:     stdin_data: &str,
 379: ) -> Result<(), String> {
 380:     let mut command = ns_command(namespace, args);
 381:     command.stdin(Stdio::piped()).stdout(Stdio::null());
 382:     let mut child = command
 383:         .spawn()
 384:         .map_err(|e| format!("spawn command with stdin: {e}"))?;
 385:     if let Some(mut stdin) = child.stdin.take() {
 386:         stdin
 387:             .write_all(stdin_data.as_bytes())
 388:             .map_err(|e| format!("write stdin: {e}"))?;
 389:     }
 390:     let status = child.wait().map_err(|e| format!("wait command: {e}"))?;
 391:     if status.success() {
 392:         Ok(())
 393:     } else {
 394:         Err(format!("command failed with status {status}"))
 395:     }
 396: }
 397: 
 398: fn run_ok(mut command: Command) -> Result<(), String> {
 399:     let status = command.status().map_err(|e| format!("run command: {e}"))?;
 400:     if status.success() {
 401:         Ok(())
 402:     } else {
 403:         Err(format!("command failed with status {status}"))
 404:     }
 405: }

 407: fn run_status(mut command: Command) -> Result<i32, String> {
 408:     let status = command.status().map_err(|e| format!("run command: {e}"))?;
 409:     Ok(status.code().unwrap_or(1))
 410: }

 412: fn command_output(mut command: Command) -> Result<Vec<u8>, String> {
 413:     let output = command.output().map_err(|e| format!("run command: {e}"))?;
 414:     if output.status.success() {
 415:         Ok(output.stdout)
 416:     } else {
 417:         Err(format!("command failed with status {}", output.status))
 418:     }
 419: }

 421: fn generate_wg_key(namespace: &str, output_path: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
 422:     let output = command_output(ns_command(namespace, ["wg", "genkey"]))?;
 423:     fs::write(output_path, output)
 424:         .map_err(|e| format!("write wg key {}: {e}", output_path.display()))
 425: }
 426: 
 427: fn generate_wg_pubkey(namespace: &str, key_path: &Path, output_path: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
 428:     let key_text =
 429:         fs::read(key_path).map_err(|e| format!("read key {}: {e}", key_path.display()))?;
 430:     let mut command = ns_command(namespace, ["wg", "pubkey"]);
 431:     command.stdin(Stdio::piped()).stdout(Stdio::piped());
 432:     let mut child = command
 433:         .spawn()
 434:         .map_err(|e| format!("spawn wg pubkey: {e}"))?;
 435:     if let Some(mut stdin) = child.stdin.take() {
 436:         stdin
 437:             .write_all(&key_text)
 438:             .map_err(|e| format!("write wg pubkey stdin: {e}"))?;
 439:     }
 440:     let output = child
 441:         .wait_with_output()
 442:         .map_err(|e| format!("wait wg pubkey: {e}"))?;
 443:     if !output.status.success() {
 444:         return Err(format!("wg pubkey failed with status {}", output.status));
 445:     }
 446:     fs::write(output_path, output.stdout)
 447:         .map_err(|e| format!("write pubkey {}: {e}", output_path.display()))
 448: }

 450: fn read_trimmed(path: &Path) -> Result<String, String> {
 451:     let text = fs::read_to_string(path).map_err(|e| format!("read {}: {e}", path.display()))?;
 452:     Ok(text.trim().to_owned())
 453: }

 456:     path.to_str()
 457:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("path is not valid utf-8: {}", path.display()))
 458: }

 460: fn spawn_ns_tcpdump(namespace: &str, output_path: &Path) -> Result<process::Child, String> {
 461:     let mut command = ns_command(
 462:         namespace,
 463:         [
 464:             "tcpdump",

 476: }

 479:     let _ = Command::new("kill").arg(pid.to_string()).status();
 480: }

 482: fn send_udp_probe(namespace: &str, ip: &str, port: &str, payload: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
 483:     let mut command = Command::new("ip");
 484:     command
 485:         .arg("netns")
 486:         .arg("exec")
 487:         .arg(namespace)
 488:         .arg("env")
 489:         .arg(format!("RUSTYNET_UDP_PAYLOAD={payload}"))
 490:         .arg("timeout")
 491:         .arg("2")
 492:         .arg("bash")
 493:         .arg("-lc")
 494:         .arg(format!(
 495:             "printf '%s' \"$RUSTYNET_UDP_PAYLOAD\" >/dev/udp/{ip}/{port}"
 496:         ));
 497:     run_ok(command)
 498: }

 500: fn write_json_report(
 501:     report_path: &Path,
 502:     load_pcap: &Path,
 503:     down_pcap: &Path,
 504:     tunnel_up_status: &str,
 505:     load_ping_status: &str,
 506:     tunnel_down_block_status: &str,
 507: ) -> Result<(), String> {
 508:     let environment =
 509:         env::var("RUSTYNET_NO_LEAK_ENVIRONMENT").unwrap_or_else(|_| "lab-netns".to_owned());
 510:     let (captured_at_utc, captured_at_unix) = utc_now()?;
 511:     let root = repo_root()?;
 512:     let mut command = cmd(
 513:         "cargo",
 514:         &[
 515:             "run",
 516:             "--quiet",
 517:             "-p",
 518:             "rustynet-cli",
 519:             "--",
 520:             "ops",
 521:             "write-real-wireguard-no-leak-under-load-report",
 522:             "--report-path",
 523:             path_str(report_path)?,
 524:             "--load-pcap",
 525:             path_str(load_pcap)?,
 526:             "--down-pcap",
 527:             path_str(down_pcap)?,
 528:             "--tunnel-up-status",
 529:             tunnel_up_status,
 530:             "--load-ping-status",
 531:             load_ping_status,
 532:             "--tunnel-down-block-status",
 533:             tunnel_down_block_status,
 534:             "--environment",
 535:             &environment,
 536:             "--captured-at-utc",
 537:             &captured_at_utc,
 538:             "--captured-at-unix",
 539:             &captured_at_unix,
 540:         ],
 541:     );
 542:     command.current_dir(root);
 543:     let output = command_output(command)?;
 544:     let text =
 545:         String::from_utf8(output).map_err(|e| format!("report writer output not utf8: {e}"))?;
 546:     if text.trim() == "pass" {
 547:         Ok(())
 548:     } else {
 549:         Err(format!("report writer returned {}", text.trim()))
 550:     }
 551: }
 552: 
 553: fn repo_root() -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
 554:     let manifest_dir = PathBuf::from(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"));
 555:     manifest_dir
 556:         .ancestors()
 557:         .nth(2)
 558:         .map(Path::to_path_buf)
 559:         .ok_or_else(|| "unable to resolve repository root".to_owned())
 560: }
 561: 
 562: fn utc_now() -> Result<(String, String), String> {
 563:     let now = SystemTime::now()
 564:         .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
 565:         .map_err(|e| format!("system clock before unix epoch: {e}"))?;
 566:     let unix = now.as_secs();
 567:     let timestamp = command_output(cmd("date", &["-u", "+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"]))?;
 568:     let text = String::from_utf8(timestamp).map_err(|e| format!("date output not utf8: {e}"))?;
 569:     Ok((text.trim().to_owned(), unix.to_string()))
 570: }

  63: struct SshContext {
  64:     base: Vec<String>,
  65:     sudo_mode: String,
  66:     ssh_user: String,
  67: }
  68: 
  69: impl SshContext {
  70:     fn needs_sudo(&self) -> bool {
  71:         match self.sudo_mode.as_str() {
  72:             "never" => false,
  73:             "always" => true,
  74:             "auto" => self.ssh_user != "root",
  75:             _ => false,
  76:         }
  77:     }
  78: 
  79:     fn remote_exec(&self, target: &str, args: &[&str]) -> Result<(), String> {
  80:         let mut command = Command::new(&self.base[0]);
  81:         command.args(&self.base[1..]);
  82:         command.arg(target);
  83:         command.args(args);
  84:         run_ok(command)
  85:     }
  86: 
  87:     fn remote_exec_root(&self, target: &str, args: &[&str]) -> Result<(), String> {
  88:         if self.needs_sudo() {
  89:             let mut prefixed = vec!["sudo", "-n", "--"];
  90:             prefixed.extend_from_slice(args);
  91:             self.remote_exec(target, &prefixed)
  92:         } else {
  93:             self.remote_exec(target, args)
  94:         }
  95:     }
  96: 
  97:     fn capture_remote_root(&self, target: &str, args: &[&str]) -> String {
  98:         let mut command = Command::new(&self.base[0]);
  99:         command.args(&self.base[1..]);
 100:         command.arg(target);
 101:         if self.needs_sudo() {
 102:             command.args(["sudo", "-n", "--"]);
 103:         }
 104:         command.args(args);
 105:         match command.output() {
 106:             Ok(output) => {
 107:                 let mut combined = output.stdout;
 108:                 combined.extend_from_slice(&output.stderr);
 109:                 String::from_utf8_lossy(&combined).into_owned()
 110:             }
 111:             Err(_) => String::new(),
 112:         }
 113:     }
 114: }

 399: fn parse_args(args: Vec<String>) -> Result<Config, String> {
 400:     let mut report_path = DEFAULT_REPORT_PATH.to_owned();
 401:     let mut ssh_port = "22".to_owned();
 402:     let mut ssh_user = "root".to_owned();
 403:     let mut ssh_identity = String::new();
 404:     let mut ssh_sudo_mode = "auto".to_owned();
 405:     let mut ssh_known_hosts_file = env::var("SSH_KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE").unwrap_or_default();
 406:     let mut exit_host = String::new();
 407:     let mut client_host = String::new();
 408:     let mut rogue_endpoint_ip = String::new();
 409:     let mut forward_args = Vec::new();
 410: 
 411:     let mut index = 0;
 412:     while index < args.len() {
 413:         match args[index].as_str() {
 414:             "--hijack-report-path" => {
 415:                 let value = args
 416:                     .get(index + 1)
 417:                     .ok_or_else(|| "missing value for --hijack-report-path".to_owned())?;
 418:                 report_path = value.clone();
 419:                 index += 2;
 420:             }
 421:             "--rogue-endpoint-ip" => {
 422:                 let value = args
 423:                     .get(index + 1)
 424:                     .ok_or_else(|| "missing value for --rogue-endpoint-ip".to_owned())?;
 425:                 rogue_endpoint_ip = value.clone();
 426:                 index += 2;
 427:             }
 428:             "--exit-host" => {
 429:                 let value = args
 430:                     .get(index + 1)
 431:                     .ok_or_else(|| "missing value for --exit-host".to_owned())?;
 432:                 exit_host = value.clone();
 433:                 forward_args.push(args[index].clone());
 434:                 forward_args.push(value.clone());
 435:                 index += 2;
 436:             }
 437:             "--client-host" => {
 438:                 let value = args
 439:                     .get(index + 1)
 440:                     .ok_or_else(|| "missing value for --client-host".to_owned())?;
 441:                 client_host = value.clone();
 442:                 forward_args.push(args[index].clone());
 443:                 forward_args.push(value.clone());
 444:                 index += 2;
 445:             }
 446:             "--ssh-user"
 447:             | "--ssh-port"
 448:             | "--ssh-identity"
 449:             | "--ssh-sudo"
 450:             | "--ssh-known-hosts-file" => {
 451:                 let value = args
 452:                     .get(index + 1)
 453:                     .ok_or_else(|| format!("missing value for {}", args[index]))?;
 454:                 match args[index].as_str() {
 455:                     "--ssh-user" => ssh_user = value.clone(),
 456:                     "--ssh-port" => ssh_port = value.clone(),
 457:                     "--ssh-identity" => ssh_identity = value.clone(),
 458:                     "--ssh-sudo" => ssh_sudo_mode = value.clone(),
 459:                     "--ssh-known-hosts-file" => ssh_known_hosts_file = value.clone(),
 460:                     _ => {}
 461:                 }
 462:                 forward_args.push(args[index].clone());
 463:                 forward_args.push(value.clone());
 464:                 index += 2;
 465:             }
 466:             other => {
 467:                 forward_args.push(other.to_owned());
 468:                 index += 1;
 469:             }
 470:         }
 471:     }
 472: 
 473:     if exit_host.is_empty() || client_host.is_empty() {
 474:         return Err("--exit-host and --client-host are required".to_owned());
 475:     }
 476:     if rogue_endpoint_ip.is_empty() {
 477:         return Err("--rogue-endpoint-ip is required".to_owned());
 478:     }
 479: 
 480:     Ok(Config {
 481:         report_path,
 482:         ssh_port,
 483:         ssh_user,
 484:         ssh_identity,
 485:         ssh_sudo_mode,
 486:         ssh_known_hosts_file,
 487:         exit_host,
 488:         client_host,
 489:         rogue_endpoint_ip,
 490:         forward_args,
 491:     })
 492: }

 494: fn validate_common_inputs(
 495:     exit_host: &str,
 496:     client_host: &str,
 497:     ssh_port: &str,
 498:     ssh_identity: &str,
 499:     ssh_sudo_mode: &str,
 500:     ssh_known_hosts_file: &str,
 501: ) -> Result<(), String> {
 502:     let _ = (exit_host, client_host);
 503:     if ssh_port.parse::<u16>().is_err() {
 504:         return Err("--ssh-port must be numeric".to_owned());
 505:     }
 506:     if !ssh_identity.is_empty() && !Path::new(ssh_identity).is_file() {
 507:         return Err(format!("--ssh-identity does not exist: {ssh_identity}"));
 508:     }
 509:     match ssh_sudo_mode {
 510:         "auto" | "always" | "never" => {}
 511:         _ => return Err("--ssh-sudo must be one of: auto|always|never".to_owned()),
 512:     }
 513:     run_ok({
 514:         let mut command = Command::new("cargo");
 515:         command
 516:             .args([
 517:                 "run",
 518:                 "--quiet",
 519:                 "-p",
 520:                 "rustynet-cli",
 521:                 "--",
 522:                 "ops",
 523:                 "check-local-file-mode",
 524:                 "--path",
 525:                 ssh_known_hosts_file,
 526:                 "--policy",
 527:                 "no-group-world-write",
 528:                 "--label",
 529:                 "pinned SSH known_hosts file",
 530:             ])
 531:             .current_dir(repo_root()?)
 532:             .stdout(Stdio::null());
 533:         command
 534:     })?;
 535:     Ok(())
 536: }

 538: fn resolve_known_hosts(value: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
 539:     let mut candidate = value.to_owned();
 540:     if candidate.is_empty() {
 541:         let home = env::var("HOME").map_err(|e| format!("resolve HOME: {e}"))?;
 542:         let default_path = Path::new(&home).join(".ssh/known_hosts");
 543:         if default_path.is_file() {
 544:             candidate = default_path.to_string_lossy().into_owned();
 545:         }
 546:     }
 547:     if candidate.is_empty() {
 548:         return Err(
 549:             "--ssh-known-hosts-file is required (or pre-populate ~/.ssh/known_hosts)".to_owned(),
 550:         );
 551:     }
 552:     let path = Path::new(&candidate);
 553:     if !path.is_file() {
 554:         return Err(format!("missing pinned SSH known_hosts file: {candidate}"));
 555:     }
 556:     if fs::symlink_metadata(path)
 557:         .map_err(|e| format!("stat known_hosts: {e}"))?
 558:         .file_type()
 559:         .is_symlink()
 560:     {
 561:         return Err(format!(
 562:             "pinned SSH known_hosts file must not be a symlink: {candidate}"
 563:         ));
 564:     }
 565:     Ok(candidate)
 566: }
 567: 
 568: fn ensure_known_host(known_hosts_file: &str, host: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
 569:     let status = Command::new("ssh-keygen")
 570:         .args(["-F", host, "-f", known_hosts_file])
 571:         .stdout(Stdio::null())
 572:         .stderr(Stdio::null())
 573:         .status()
 574:         .map_err(|e| format!("run ssh-keygen: {e}"))?;
 575:     if status.success() {
 576:         Ok(())
 577:     } else {
 578:         Err(format!(
 579:             "pinned SSH known_hosts file lacks host key for {host}: {known_hosts_file}"
 580:         ))
 581:     }
 582: }
 583: 
 584: fn build_ssh_context(config: &Config) -> SshContext {
 585:     let mut base = vec![
 586:         "ssh".to_owned(),
 587:         "-o".to_owned(),
 588:         "BatchMode=yes".to_owned(),
 589:         "-o".to_owned(),
 590:         "StrictHostKeyChecking=yes".to_owned(),
 591:         "-o".to_owned(),
 592:         format!("UserKnownHostsFile={}", config.ssh_known_hosts_file),
 593:         "-o".to_owned(),
 594:         "ConnectTimeout=15".to_owned(),
 595:         "-p".to_owned(),
 596:         config.ssh_port.clone(),
 597:     ];
 598:     if !config.ssh_identity.is_empty() {
 599:         base.push("-i".to_owned());
 600:         base.push(config.ssh_identity.clone());
 601:     }
 602:     SshContext {
 603:         base,
 604:         sudo_mode: config.ssh_sudo_mode.clone(),
 605:         ssh_user: config.ssh_user.clone(),
 606:     }
 607: }

 609: fn require_command(command: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
 610:     let status = Command::new("which")
 611:         .arg(command)
 612:         .stdout(Stdio::null())
 613:         .stderr(Stdio::null())
 614:         .status()
 615:         .map_err(|e| format!("run which: {e}"))?;
 616:     if status.success() {
 617:         Ok(())
 618:     } else {
 619:         Err(format!("missing required command: {command}"))
 620:     }
 621: }
 622: 
 623: fn run_ok(mut command: Command) -> Result<(), String> {
 624:     let status = command.status().map_err(|e| format!("run command: {e}"))?;
 625:     if status.success() {
 626:         Ok(())
 627:     } else {
 628:         Err(format!("command failed with status {status}"))
 629:     }
 630: }
 631: 
 632: fn command_stdout(mut command: Command) -> Result<String, String> {
 633:     let output = command.output().map_err(|e| format!("run command: {e}"))?;
 634:     if !output.status.success() {
 635:         return Err(format!("command failed with status {}", output.status));
 636:     }
 637:     String::from_utf8(output.stdout).map_err(|e| format!("command output not utf8: {e}"))
 638: }
 639: 
 640: fn repo_root() -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
 641:     let manifest_dir = PathBuf::from(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"));
 642:     manifest_dir
 643:         .ancestors()
 644:         .nth(2)
 645:         .map(Path::to_path_buf)
 646:         .ok_or_else(|| "unable to resolve repository root".to_owned())
 647: }
 648: 
 649: fn unix_now() -> Result<u64, String> {
 650:     SystemTime::now()
 651:         .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
 652:         .map(|duration| duration.as_secs())
 653:         .map_err(|e| format!("system clock before unix epoch: {e}"))
 654: }
 655: 
 656: fn utc_now() -> Result<(String, String), String> {
 657:     let unix = unix_now()?.to_string();
 658:     let output = Command::new("date")
 659:         .args(["-u", "+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"])
 660:         .output()
 661:         .map_err(|e| format!("run date: {e}"))?;
 662:     if !output.status.success() {
 663:         return Err(format!("date failed with status {}", output.status));
 664:     }
 665:     let utc = String::from_utf8(output.stdout).map_err(|e| format!("date output not utf8: {e}"))?;
 666:     Ok((utc.trim().to_owned(), unix))
 667: }

  27: struct Cleanup<'a> {
  28:     ssh: &'a SshContext,
  29:     client_target: String,
  30:     backup_path: String,
  31:     assignment_timer_was_active: bool,
  32: }
  33: 
  34: impl Drop for Cleanup<'_> {
  35:     fn drop(&mut self) {
  36:         if self.backup_path.is_empty() {
  37:             return;
  38:         }
  39:         let _ = self
  40:             .ssh
  41:             .remote_exec_root(&self.client_target, &["test", "-f", &self.backup_path]);
  42:         let _ = self.ssh.remote_exec_root(
  43:             &self.client_target,
  44:             &["cp", &self.backup_path, ASSIGNMENT_PATH],
  45:         );
  46:         let _ = self.ssh.remote_exec_root(
  47:             &self.client_target,
  48:             &["rm", "-f", &self.backup_path, ASSIGNMENT_WATERMARK_PATH],
  49:         );
  50:         let _ = self
  51:             .ssh
  52:             .remote_exec_root(&self.client_target, &["systemctl", "restart", "rustynetd"]);
  53:         if self.assignment_timer_was_active {
  54:             let _ = self.ssh.remote_exec_root(
  55:                 &self.client_target,
  56:                 &["systemctl", "start", "rustynetd-assignment-refresh.timer"],
  57:             );
  58:         }
  59:     }
  60: }
  61: 
  62: struct SshContext {
  63:     base: Vec<String>,
  64:     sudo_mode: String,
  65:     ssh_user: String,
  66: }
  67: 
  68: impl SshContext {
  69:     fn needs_sudo(&self) -> bool {
  70:         match self.sudo_mode.as_str() {
  71:             "never" => false,
  72:             "always" => true,
  73:             "auto" => self.ssh_user != "root",
  74:             _ => false,
  75:         }
  76:     }
  77: 
  78:     fn remote_exec(&self, target: &str, args: &[&str]) -> Result<(), String> {
  79:         let mut command = Command::new(&self.base[0]);
  80:         command.args(&self.base[1..]).arg(target).args(args);
  81:         run_ok(command)
  82:     }
  83: 
  84:     fn remote_exec_root(&self, target: &str, args: &[&str]) -> Result<(), String> {
  85:         if self.needs_sudo() {
  86:             let mut prefixed = vec!["sudo", "-n", "--"];
  87:             prefixed.extend_from_slice(args);
  88:             self.remote_exec(target, &prefixed)
  89:         } else {
  90:             self.remote_exec(target, args)
  91:         }
  92:     }
  93: 
  94:     fn capture_remote_root(&self, target: &str, args: &[&str]) -> String {
  95:         let mut command = Command::new(&self.base[0]);
  96:         command.args(&self.base[1..]).arg(target);
  97:         if self.needs_sudo() {
  98:             command.args(["sudo", "-n", "--"]);
  99:         }
 100:         command.args(args);
 101:         match command.output() {
 102:             Ok(output) => {
 103:                 let mut combined = output.stdout;
 104:                 combined.extend_from_slice(&output.stderr);
 105:                 String::from_utf8_lossy(&combined).into_owned()
 106:             }
 107:             Err(_) => String::new(),
 108:         }
 109:     }
 110: }
 111: 
 112: fn main() -> ExitCode {
 113:     match run() {
 114:         Ok(()) => ExitCode::SUCCESS,
 115:         Err(err) => {
 116:             eprintln!("{err}");
 117:             ExitCode::from(1)
 118:         }
 119:     }
 120: }
 121: 
 122: fn run() -> Result<(), String> {
 123:     let mut config = parse_args(env::args().skip(1).collect())?;
 124:     config.ssh_known_hosts_file = resolve_known_hosts(&config.ssh_known_hosts_file)?;
 125:     let root_dir = repo_root()?;
 126:     env::set_current_dir(&root_dir).map_err(|e| format!("cd {}: {e}", root_dir.display()))?;

 369: fn parse_args(args: Vec<String>) -> Result<Config, String> {
 370:     let mut report_path = DEFAULT_REPORT_PATH.to_owned();
 371:     let mut ssh_port = "22".to_owned();
 372:     let mut ssh_user = "root".to_owned();
 373:     let mut ssh_identity = String::new();
 374:     let mut ssh_sudo_mode = "auto".to_owned();
 375:     let mut ssh_known_hosts_file = env::var("SSH_KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE").unwrap_or_default();
 376:     let mut exit_host = String::new();
 377:     let mut client_host = String::new();
 378:     let mut forward_args = Vec::new();
 379: 
 380:     let mut index = 0;
 381:     while index < args.len() {
 382:         match args[index].as_str() {
 383:             "--tamper-report-path" => {
 384:                 let value = args
 385:                     .get(index + 1)
 386:                     .ok_or_else(|| "missing value for --tamper-report-path".to_owned())?;
 387:                 report_path = value.clone();
 388:                 index += 2;
 389:             }
 390:             "--exit-host"
 391:             | "--client-host"
 392:             | "--ssh-user"
 393:             | "--ssh-port"
 394:             | "--ssh-identity"
 395:             | "--ssh-sudo"
 396:             | "--ssh-known-hosts-file" => {
 397:                 let value = args
 398:                     .get(index + 1)
 399:                     .ok_or_else(|| format!("missing value for {}", args[index]))?;
 400:                 match args[index].as_str() {
 401:                     "--exit-host" => exit_host = value.clone(),
 402:                     "--client-host" => client_host = value.clone(),
 403:                     "--ssh-user" => ssh_user = value.clone(),
 404:                     "--ssh-port" => ssh_port = value.clone(),
 405:                     "--ssh-identity" => ssh_identity = value.clone(),
 406:                     "--ssh-sudo" => ssh_sudo_mode = value.clone(),
 407:                     "--ssh-known-hosts-file" => ssh_known_hosts_file = value.clone(),
 408:                     _ => {}
 409:                 }
 410:                 forward_args.push(args[index].clone());
 411:                 forward_args.push(value.clone());
 412:                 index += 2;
 413:             }
 414:             other => {
 415:                 forward_args.push(other.to_owned());
 416:                 index += 1;
 417:             }
 418:         }
 419:     }
 420: 
 421:     if exit_host.is_empty() || client_host.is_empty() {
 422:         return Err("--exit-host and --client-host are required".to_owned());
 423:     }
 424: 
 425:     Ok(Config {
 426:         report_path,
 427:         ssh_port,
 428:         ssh_user,
 429:         ssh_identity,
 430:         ssh_sudo_mode,
 431:         ssh_known_hosts_file,
 432:         exit_host,
 433:         client_host,
 434:         forward_args,
 435:     })
 436: }

 438: fn validate_common_inputs(
 439:     ssh_port: &str,
 440:     ssh_identity: &str,
 441:     ssh_sudo_mode: &str,
 442:     ssh_known_hosts_file: &str,
 443: ) -> Result<(), String> {
 444:     if ssh_port.parse::<u16>().is_err() {
 445:         return Err("--ssh-port must be numeric".to_owned());
 446:     }
 447:     if !ssh_identity.is_empty() && !Path::new(ssh_identity).is_file() {
 448:         return Err(format!("--ssh-identity does not exist: {ssh_identity}"));
 449:     }
 450:     match ssh_sudo_mode {
 451:         "auto" | "always" | "never" => {}
 452:         _ => return Err("--ssh-sudo must be one of: auto|always|never".to_owned()),
 453:     }
 454:     run_ok({
 455:         let mut command = Command::new("cargo");
 456:         command
 457:             .args([
 458:                 "run",
 459:                 "--quiet",
 460:                 "-p",
 461:                 "rustynet-cli",
 462:                 "--",
 463:                 "ops",
 464:                 "check-local-file-mode",
 465:                 "--path",
 466:                 ssh_known_hosts_file,
 467:                 "--policy",
 468:                 "no-group-world-write",
 469:                 "--label",
 470:                 "pinned SSH known_hosts file",
 471:             ])
 472:             .current_dir(repo_root()?)
 473:             .stdout(Stdio::null());
 474:         command
 475:     })?;
 476:     Ok(())
 477: }
 478: 
 479: fn resolve_known_hosts(value: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
 480:     let mut candidate = value.to_owned();
 481:     if candidate.is_empty() {
 482:         let home = env::var("HOME").map_err(|e| format!("resolve HOME: {e}"))?;
 483:         let default_path = Path::new(&home).join(".ssh/known_hosts");
 484:         if default_path.is_file() {
 485:             candidate = default_path.to_string_lossy().into_owned();
 486:         }
 487:     }
 488:     if candidate.is_empty() {
 489:         return Err(
 490:             "--ssh-known-hosts-file is required (or pre-populate ~/.ssh/known_hosts)".to_owned(),
 491:         );
 492:     }
 493:     let path = Path::new(&candidate);
 494:     if !path.is_file() {
 495:         return Err(format!("missing pinned SSH known_hosts file: {candidate}"));
 496:     }
 497:     if fs::symlink_metadata(path)
 498:         .map_err(|e| format!("stat known_hosts: {e}"))?
 499:         .file_type()
 500:         .is_symlink()
 501:     {
 502:         return Err(format!(
 503:             "pinned SSH known_hosts file must not be a symlink: {candidate}"
 504:         ));
 505:     }
 506:     Ok(candidate)
 507: }
 508: 
 509: fn ensure_known_host(known_hosts_file: &str, host: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
 510:     let status = Command::new("ssh-keygen")
 511:         .args(["-F", host, "-f", known_hosts_file])
 512:         .stdout(Stdio::null())
 513:         .stderr(Stdio::null())
 514:         .status()
 515:         .map_err(|e| format!("run ssh-keygen: {e}"))?;
 516:     if status.success() {
 517:         Ok(())
 518:     } else {
 519:         Err(format!(
 520:             "pinned SSH known_hosts file lacks host key for {host}: {known_hosts_file}"
 521:         ))
 522:     }
 523: }
 524: 
 525: fn build_ssh_context(config: &Config) -> SshContext {
 526:     let mut base = vec![
 527:         "ssh".to_owned(),
 528:         "-o".to_owned(),
 529:         "BatchMode=yes".to_owned(),
 530:         "-o".to_owned(),
 531:         "StrictHostKeyChecking=yes".to_owned(),
 532:         "-o".to_owned(),
 533:         format!("UserKnownHostsFile={}", config.ssh_known_hosts_file),
 534:         "-o".to_owned(),
 535:         "ConnectTimeout=15".to_owned(),
 536:         "-p".to_owned(),
 537:         config.ssh_port.clone(),
 538:     ];
 539:     if !config.ssh_identity.is_empty() {
 540:         base.push("-i".to_owned());
 541:         base.push(config.ssh_identity.clone());
 542:     }
 543:     SshContext {
 544:         base,
 545:         sudo_mode: config.ssh_sudo_mode.clone(),
 546:         ssh_user: config.ssh_user.clone(),
 547:     }
 548: }
 549: 
 550: fn require_command(command: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
 551:     let status = Command::new("which")
 552:         .arg(command)
 553:         .stdout(Stdio::null())
 554:         .stderr(Stdio::null())
 555:         .status()
 556:         .map_err(|e| format!("run which: {e}"))?;
 557:     if status.success() {
 558:         Ok(())
 559:     } else {
 560:         Err(format!("missing required command: {command}"))
 561:     }
 562: }
 563: 
 564: fn run_ok(mut command: Command) -> Result<(), String> {
 565:     let status = command.status().map_err(|e| format!("run command: {e}"))?;
 566:     if status.success() {
 567:         Ok(())
 568:     } else {
 569:         Err(format!("command failed with status {status}"))
 570:     }
 571: }
 572: 
 573: fn command_stdout(mut command: Command) -> Result<String, String> {
 574:     let output = command.output().map_err(|e| format!("run command: {e}"))?;
 575:     if !output.status.success() {
 576:         return Err(format!("command failed with status {}", output.status));
 577:     }
 578:     String::from_utf8(output.stdout).map_err(|e| format!("command output not utf8: {e}"))
 579: }
 580: 
 581: fn repo_root() -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
 582:     let manifest_dir = PathBuf::from(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"));
 583:     manifest_dir
 584:         .ancestors()
 585:         .nth(2)
 586:         .map(Path::to_path_buf)
 587:         .ok_or_else(|| "unable to resolve repository root".to_owned())
 588: }
 589: 
 590: fn unix_now() -> Result<u64, String> {
 591:     SystemTime::now()
 592:         .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
 593:         .map(|duration| duration.as_secs())
 594:         .map_err(|e| format!("system clock before unix epoch: {e}"))
 595: }
 596: 
 597: fn utc_now() -> Result<(String, String), String> {
 598:     let unix = unix_now()?.to_string();
 599:     let output = Command::new("date")
 600:         .args(["-u", "+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"])
 601:         .output()
 602:         .map_err(|e| format!("run date: {e}"))?;
 603:     if !output.status.success() {
 604:         return Err(format!("date failed with status {}", output.status));
 605:     }
 606:     let utc = String::from_utf8(output.stdout).map_err(|e| format!("date output not utf8: {e}"))?;
 607:     Ok((utc.trim().to_owned(), unix))
 608: }

  41: fn run() -> Result<(), i32> {
  42:     let _ignored_args: Vec<OsString> = env::args_os().skip(1).collect();
  43:     let root_dir = repo_root().map_err(|err| {
  44:         eprintln!("{err}");
  45:         1
  46:     })?;

  48:         .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
  49:         .map(PathBuf::from)
  50:         .unwrap_or_else(|| root_dir.join(DEFAULT_BUNDLE_PATH));
  51:     let phase5_report_path = env::var_os("RUSTYNET_PHASE5_GATE_REPORT_PATH")
  52:         .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
  53:         .map(PathBuf::from)
  54:         .unwrap_or_else(|| root_dir.join(DEFAULT_PHASE5_REPORT_PATH));
  55: 
  56:     let mut bundle = ReleaseReadinessBundle::new(&phase5_report_path);
  57:     write_bundle(&bundle_path, &mut bundle)?;
  58: 
  59:     run_step(&mut bundle, &bundle_path, "phase5_gates", || {
  60:         run_script(&root_dir, "scripts/ci/phase5_gates.sh", &[])
  61:     })?;
  62:     run_step(
  63:         &mut bundle,
  64:         &bundle_path,
  65:         "validate_phase5_gate_report",
  66:         || validate_phase5_gate_report(&phase5_report_path),

  69:         run_script(&root_dir, "scripts/ci/phase10_gates.sh", &[])
  70:     })?;
  71:     run_step(&mut bundle, &bundle_path, "require_readiness_docs", || {
  72:         require_files(&root_dir, REQUIRED_DOCS, "required readiness document")
  73:     })?;
  74: 
  75:     bundle.overall_status = GateRunStatus::ExecutedPassed;
  76:     write_bundle(&bundle_path, &mut bundle)?;
  77:     println!("Release readiness gates: PASS");
  78:     Ok(())
  79: }
  80: 
  81: fn run_step<F>(
  82:     bundle: &mut ReleaseReadinessBundle,
  83:     bundle_path: &Path,
  84:     step_id: &str,
  85:     action: F,
  86: ) -> Result<(), i32>
  87: where
  88:     F: FnOnce() -> Result<(), StepExecutionError>,
  89: {
  90:     let step = bundle.step_mut(step_id).ok_or_else(|| {
  91:         eprintln!("release readiness bundle is missing step definition: {step_id}");
  92:         1
  93:     })?;
  94:     match action() {
  95:         Ok(()) => {
  96:             step.status = GateStepStatus::ExecutedPassed;
  97:             step.exit_code = Some(0);
  98:             step.detail = None;
  99:             write_bundle(bundle_path, bundle)
 100:         }
 101:         Err(err) => {
 102:             step.status = GateStepStatus::ExecutedFailed;
 103:             step.exit_code = Some(err.exit_code);
 104:             step.detail = Some(err.detail);
 105:             bundle.overall_status = GateRunStatus::ExecutedFailed;
 106:             write_bundle(bundle_path, bundle)?;
 107:             Err(err.exit_code)
 108:         }
 109:     }
 110: }

 112: fn run_script(root_dir: &Path, script: &str, args: &[&str]) -> Result<(), StepExecutionError> {
 113:     let script_path = root_dir.join(script);
 114:     let status = Command::new(&script_path)
 115:         .current_dir(root_dir)
 116:         .args(args)
 117:         .status()
 118:         .map_err(|err| StepExecutionError {
 119:             exit_code: 1,
 120:             detail: format!("failed to execute script {}: {err}", script_path.display()),
 121:         })?;
 122:     if status.success() {
 123:         Ok(())
 124:     } else {
 125:         Err(StepExecutionError {
 126:             exit_code: status_code(status),
 127:             detail: format!("script failed: {}", script_path.display()),
 128:         })
 129:     }
 130: }
 131: 
 132: fn validate_phase5_gate_report(report_path: &Path) -> Result<(), StepExecutionError> {
 133:     let report = read_phase5_gate_report(report_path)?;
 134:     if report.gate != "phase5_ci_gates" {
 135:         return Err(StepExecutionError {
 136:             exit_code: 1,
 137:             detail: format!(
 138:                 "phase5 gate report at {} has unexpected gate name {}",
 139:                 report_path.display(),
 140:                 report.gate
 141:             ),
 142:         });
 143:     }
 144:     if report.overall_status != GateRunStatus::ExecutedPassed {
 145:         return Err(StepExecutionError {
 146:             exit_code: 1,
 147:             detail: format!(
 148:                 "phase5 gate report at {} does not record executed_passed status",
 149:                 report_path.display()
 150:             ),
 151:         });
 152:     }
 153:     for required_step in REQUIRED_PHASE5_STEP_IDS {
 154:         if !report
 155:             .required_step_ids
 156:             .iter()
 157:             .any(|step| step == required_step)
 158:         {
 159:             return Err(StepExecutionError {
 160:                 exit_code: 1,
 161:                 detail: format!(
 162:                     "phase5 gate report at {} is missing required step id {}",
 163:                     report_path.display(),
 164:                     required_step
 165:                 ),
 166:             });
 167:         }
 168:         let step = report
 169:             .steps
 170:             .iter()
 171:             .find(|step| step.id == *required_step)
 172:             .ok_or_else(|| StepExecutionError {
 173:                 exit_code: 1,
 174:                 detail: format!(
 175:                     "phase5 gate report at {} is missing required step {}",
 176:                     report_path.display(),
 177:                     required_step
 178:                 ),
 179:             })?;
 180:         if step.status != GateStepStatus::ExecutedPassed {
 181:             return Err(StepExecutionError {
 182:                 exit_code: 1,
 183:                 detail: format!(
 184:                     "phase5 gate report at {} records {} as {:?}, expected executed_passed",
 185:                     report_path.display(),
 186:                     required_step,
 187:                     step.status
 188:                 ),
 189:             });
 190:         }
 191:     }
 192:     Ok(())
 193: }
 194: 
 195: fn read_phase5_gate_report(report_path: &Path) -> Result<Phase5GateReport, StepExecutionError> {
 196:     let raw = fs::read_to_string(report_path).map_err(|err| StepExecutionError {
 197:         exit_code: 1,
 198:         detail: format!(
 199:             "failed to read phase5 gate report {}: {err}",
 200:             report_path.display()
 201:         ),
 202:     })?;
 203:     serde_json::from_str(&raw).map_err(|err| StepExecutionError {
 204:         exit_code: 1,
 205:         detail: format!(
 206:             "failed to parse phase5 gate report {}: {err}",
 207:             report_path.display()
 208:         ),
 209:     })
 210: }

 212: fn require_files(root_dir: &Path, paths: &[&str], label: &str) -> Result<(), StepExecutionError> {
 213:     let missing: Vec<String> = paths
 214:         .iter()
 215:         .map(|path| root_dir.join(path))
 216:         .filter(|path| !path.is_file())
 217:         .map(|path| path.display().to_string())
 218:         .collect();
 219:     if missing.is_empty() {
 220:         Ok(())
 221:     } else {
 222:         Err(StepExecutionError {
 223:             exit_code: 1,
 224:             detail: format!("missing {label}: {}", missing.join(", ")),
 225:         })
 226:     }
 227: }
 228: 
 229: fn write_bundle(path: &Path, bundle: &mut ReleaseReadinessBundle) -> Result<(), i32> {
 230:     if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
 231:         fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|err| {
 232:             eprintln!(
 233:                 "failed to create bundle directory {}: {err}",
 234:                 parent.display()
 235:             );
 236:             1
 237:         })?;
 238:     }
 239:     bundle.generated_at_unix = now_unix().map_err(|err| {
 240:         eprintln!("{err}");
 241:         1
 242:     })?;
 243:     let json = serde_json::to_vec_pretty(bundle).map_err(|err| {
 244:         eprintln!("failed to serialize release readiness bundle: {err}");
 245:         1
 246:     })?;
 247:     fs::write(path, json).map_err(|err| {
 248:         eprintln!(
 249:             "failed to write release readiness bundle {}: {err}",
 250:             path.display()
 251:         );
 252:         1
 253:     })
 254: }
 255: 
 256: fn now_unix() -> Result<u64, String> {
 257:     SystemTime::now()
 258:         .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
 259:         .map(|duration| duration.as_secs())
 260:         .map_err(|err| format!("clock failure while generating release readiness bundle: {err}"))
 261: }
 262: 
 263: fn repo_root() -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
 264:     let manifest_dir = PathBuf::from(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"));
 265:     manifest_dir
 266:         .parent()
 267:         .and_then(Path::parent)
 268:         .map(Path::to_path_buf)
 269:         .ok_or_else(|| {
 270:             format!(
 271:                 "failed to resolve repository root from manifest dir {}",
 272:                 manifest_dir.display()
 273:             )
 274:         })
 275: }
 276: 
 277: fn status_code(status: ExitStatus) -> i32 {
 278:     match status.code() {
 279:         Some(code) => code,
 280:         None => {
 281:             #[cfg(unix)]
 282:             {
 283:                 use std::os::unix::process::ExitStatusExt;
 284: 
 285:                 match status.signal() {
 286:                     Some(signal) => 128 + signal,
 287:                     None => 1,
 288:                 }
 289:             }
 290:             #[cfg(not(unix))]
 291:             {
 292:                 1
 293:             }
 294:         }
 295:     }
 296: }

 429: #[cfg(test)]
 430: mod tests {
 431:     use super::{
 432:         GateRunStatus, GateStepStatus, REQUIRED_PHASE5_STEP_IDS, ReleaseReadinessBundle,
 433:         read_phase5_gate_report, validate_phase5_gate_report,
 434:     };
 435:     use std::env;
 436:     use std::fs;
 437:     use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
 438:     use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering};
 439:     use std::time::{SystemTime, UNIX_EPOCH};
 440: 
 441:     static TEMP_DIR_COUNTER: AtomicU64 = AtomicU64::new(0);
 442: 
 443:     struct TempDirGuard {
 444:         path: PathBuf,
 445:     }
 446: 
 447:     impl TempDirGuard {
 448:         fn create() -> Result<Self, String> {
 449:             let base_dir = env::temp_dir();
 450:             let pid = std::process::id();
 451:             let now_nanos = SystemTime::now()
 452:                 .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
 453:                 .map_err(|err| format!("clock failure while creating temp dir: {err}"))?
 454:                 .as_nanos();
 455: 
 456:             for attempt in 0..100u64 {
 457:                 let counter = TEMP_DIR_COUNTER.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);
 458:                 let candidate = base_dir.join(format!(
 459:                     "rustynet-release-readiness-test-{pid}-{now_nanos}-{counter}-{attempt}"
 460:                 ));
 461:                 match fs::create_dir(&candidate) {
 462:                     Ok(()) => return Ok(Self { path: candidate }),
 463:                     Err(err) if err.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::AlreadyExists => continue,
 464:                     Err(err) => {
 465:                         return Err(format!(
 466:                             "failed to create temp dir {}: {err}",
 467:                             candidate.display()
 468:                         ));
 469:                     }
 470:                 }
 471:             }
 472: 
 473:             Err("failed to create temp dir: exhausted unique path attempts".to_string())
 474:         }
 475: 
 476:         fn path(&self) -> &Path {
 477:             self.path.as_path()
 478:         }
 479:     }
 480: 
 481:     impl Drop for TempDirGuard {
 482:         fn drop(&mut self) {
 483:             let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&self.path);
 484:         }
 485:     }
 486: 
 487:     fn write_phase5_report(temp_dir: &Path, audit_status: GateStepStatus) -> PathBuf {
 488:         let report_path = temp_dir.join("phase5_gate_report.json");
 489:         let steps: Vec<serde_json::Value> = REQUIRED_PHASE5_STEP_IDS
 490:             .iter()
 491:             .map(|step| {
 492:                 let status = if *step == "cargo_audit" {
 493:                     audit_status
 494:                 } else {
 495:                     GateStepStatus::ExecutedPassed
 496:                 };
 497:                 serde_json::json!({
 498:                     "id": step,
 499:                     "status": status,
 500:                 })
 501:             })
 502:             .collect();
 503:         let report = serde_json::json!({
 504:             "gate": "phase5_ci_gates",
 505:             "overall_status": GateRunStatus::ExecutedPassed,
 506:             "required_step_ids": REQUIRED_PHASE5_STEP_IDS,
 507:             "steps": steps,
 508:         });
 509:         fs::write(
 510:             &report_path,
 511:             serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&report).expect("serialize phase5 report"),
 512:         )
 513:         .expect("write phase5 report");
 514:         report_path
 515:     }
 516:

  18: 
  19: fn run_ops_with_passthrough(ops_subcommand: &str) -> Result<(), i32> {
  20:     let passthrough_args: Vec<String> = env::args().skip(1).collect();
  21:     let root_dir = repo_root().map_err(|err| {
  22:         eprintln!("{err}");
  23:         1
  24:     })?;
  25: 
  26:     let mut command = Command::new("cargo");
  27:     command.current_dir(root_dir).args([
  28:         "run",
  29:         "--quiet",
  30:         "-p",
  31:         "rustynet-cli",
  32:         "--",
  33:         "ops",
  34:         ops_subcommand,
  35:     ]);
  36:     command.args(passthrough_args);
  37:     let status = command.status().map_err(|err| {
  38:         eprintln!("failed to run ops {ops_subcommand}: {err}");
  39:         1
  40:     })?;
  41:     if status.success() {
  42:         Ok(())
  43:     } else {
  44:         Err(status_code(status))
  45:     }
  46: }
  47: 
  48: fn repo_root() -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
  49:     let manifest_dir = PathBuf::from(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"));
  50:     manifest_dir
  51:         .parent()
  52:         .and_then(Path::parent)
  53:         .map(Path::to_path_buf)
  54:         .ok_or_else(|| {
  55:             format!(
  56:                 "failed to resolve repository root from manifest dir {}",
  57:                 manifest_dir.display()
  58:             )
  59:         })
  60: }
  61: 
  62: fn status_code(status: ExitStatus) -> i32 {
  63:     match status.code() {
  64:         Some(code) => code,
  65:         None => {
  66:             #[cfg(unix)]
  67:             {
  68:                 use std::os::unix::process::ExitStatusExt;
  69:                 match status.signal() {
  70:                     Some(signal) => 128 + signal,
  71:                     None => 1,
  72:                 }
  73:             }
  74:             #[cfg(not(unix))]
  75:             {
  76:                 1
  77:             }
  78:         }
  79:     }
  80: }

===== /crates/rustynet-cli/src/bin/run_required_test.rs =====

   1: #![forbid(unsafe_code)]
   2: 
   3: use std::env;
   4: use std::ffi::OsString;
   5: use std::fs::{self, File, OpenOptions};

  11: fn main() {
  12:     let code = match run() {
  13:         Ok(()) => 0,
  14:         Err(code) => code,
  15:     };
  16:     std::process::exit(code);
  17: }
  18: 
  19: fn run() -> Result<(), i32> {
  20:     let mut args = env::args_os();
  21:     let program = args
  22:         .next()
  23:         .unwrap_or_else(|| OsString::from("run_required_test"));
  24:     let mut remaining: Vec<OsString> = args.collect();
  25:     if remaining.len() < 2 {
  26:         eprintln!(
  27:             "usage: {} <cargo-package> <test-filter> [cargo-test-args...]",
  28:             program.to_string_lossy()
  29:         );
  30:         return Err(2);
  31:     }
  32: 
  33:     let package = remaining.remove(0);
  34:     let test_filter = remaining.remove(0);
  35:     let extra_args = remaining;
  36:     let tmp_output = TempOutputGuard::create().map_err(|err| {
  37:         eprintln!("{err}");
  38:         1
  39:     })?;
  40: 
  41:     let output_file = OpenOptions::new()
  42:         .write(true)
  43:         .open(tmp_output.path())
  44:         .map_err(|err| {
  45:             eprintln!(
  46:                 "failed to open temporary output file ({}): {err}",
  47:                 tmp_output.path().display()
  48:             );
  49:             1
  50:         })?;
  51:     let mut cmd = Command::new("cargo");
  52:     cmd.arg("test")
  53:         .arg("-p")
  54:         .arg(&package)
  55:         .arg(&test_filter)
  56:         .args(&extra_args)
  57:         .args(["--", "--nocapture"])
  58:         .stdin(Stdio::null())
  59:         .stdout(Stdio::from(output_file.try_clone().map_err(|err| {
  60:             eprintln!(
  61:                 "failed to clone output file handle ({}): {err}",
  62:                 tmp_output.path().display()
  63:             );
  64:             1
  65:         })?))
  66:         .stderr(Stdio::from(output_file));
  67:     let status = cmd.status().map_err(|err| {
  68:         eprintln!("failed to run cargo test: {err}");
  69:         1
  70:     })?;
  71:     if !status.success() {
  72:         dump_file(tmp_output.path(), &mut io::stderr().lock())?;
  73:         eprintln!(
  74:             "required test failed: package={} filter={}",
  75:             package.to_string_lossy(),
  76:             test_filter.to_string_lossy()
  77:         );
  78:         return Err(1);
  79:     }
  80: 
  81:     dump_file(tmp_output.path(), &mut io::stdout().lock())?;
  82:     verify_required_test_output(tmp_output.path(), &package, &test_filter)
  83: }
  84: 
  85: fn verify_required_test_output(
  86:     output: &Path,
  87:     package: &OsString,
  88:     test_filter: &OsString,
  89: ) -> Result<(), i32> {
  90:     let output_utf8 = output.to_str().ok_or_else(|| {
  91:         eprintln!(
  92:             "required test output path is not UTF-8: {}",
  93:             output.display()
  94:         );
  95:         1
  96:     })?;
  97:     let package_utf8 = package.to_str().ok_or_else(|| {
  98:         eprintln!("package value is not UTF-8: {}", package.to_string_lossy());
  99:         1
 100:     })?;
 101:     let filter_utf8 = test_filter.to_str().ok_or_else(|| {
 102:         eprintln!(
 103:             "test filter value is not UTF-8: {}",
 104:             test_filter.to_string_lossy()
 105:         );
 106:         1
 107:     })?;
 108:     let status = Command::new("cargo")
 109:         .args([
 110:             "run",
 111:             "--quiet",
 112:             "-p",
 113:             "rustynet-cli",
 114:             "--",
 115:             "ops",
 116:             "verify-required-test-output",
 117:             "--output",
 118:             output_utf8,
 119:             "--package",
 120:             package_utf8,
 121:             "--test-filter",
 122:             filter_utf8,
 123:         ])
 124:         .stdin(Stdio::null())
 125:         .status()
 126:         .map_err(|err| {
 127:             eprintln!("failed to run verify-required-test-output command: {err}");
 128:             1
 129:         })?;
 130:     if status.success() {
 131:         Ok(())
 132:     } else {
 133:         Err(status_code(status))
 134:     }
 135: }
