 137: fn dump_file(path: &Path, writer: &mut dyn Write) -> Result<(), i32> {
 138:     let mut file = File::open(path).map_err(|err| {
 139:         eprintln!("failed to read output file ({}): {err}", path.display());
 140:         1
 141:     })?;
 142:     let mut data = Vec::new();
 143:     file.read_to_end(&mut data).map_err(|err| {
 144:         eprintln!("failed to read output file ({}): {err}", path.display());
 145:         1
 146:     })?;
 147:     writer.write_all(&data).map_err(|err| {
 148:         eprintln!("failed to write command output stream: {err}");
 149:         1
 150:     })?;
 151:     writer.flush().map_err(|err| {
 152:         eprintln!("failed to flush command output stream: {err}");
 153:         1
 154:     })?;
 155:     Ok(())
 156: }
 157: 
 158: fn status_code(status: ExitStatus) -> i32 {
 159:     match status.code() {
 160:         Some(code) => code,
 161:         None => {
 162:             #[cfg(unix)]
 163:             {
 164:                 use std::os::unix::process::ExitStatusExt;
 165: 
 166:                 match status.signal() {
 167:                     Some(signal) => 128 + signal,
 168:                     None => 1,
 169:                 }
 170:             }
 171:             #[cfg(not(unix))]
 172:             {
 173:                 1
 174:             }
 175:         }
 176:     }
 177: }
 178: 
 179: struct TempOutputGuard {
 180:     path: PathBuf,
 181: }
 182: 
 183: impl TempOutputGuard {
 184:     fn create() -> Result<Self, String> {
 185:         let base = env::var_os("TMPDIR")
 186:             .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
 187:             .map(PathBuf::from)
 188:             .unwrap_or_else(|| PathBuf::from("/tmp"));
 189:         fs::create_dir_all(&base).map_err(|err| {
 190:             format!(
 191:                 "failed to create temp output directory {}: {err}",
 192:                 base.display()
 193:             )
 194:         })?;
 195: 
 196:         let pid = std::process::id();
 197:         for attempt in 0_u32..256 {
 198:             let nanos = SystemTime::now()
 199:                 .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
 200:                 .map(|duration| duration.as_nanos())
 201:                 .unwrap_or(0);
 202:             let path = base.join(format!(
 203:                 "rustynet-required-test.{pid}.{nanos}.{attempt}.tmp"
 204:             ));
 205:             match OpenOptions::new().write(true).create_new(true).open(&path) {
 206:                 Ok(_) => return Ok(Self { path }),
 207:                 Err(err) if err.kind() == io::ErrorKind::AlreadyExists => continue,
 208:                 Err(err) => {
 209:                     return Err(format!(
 210:                         "failed to create temporary output file ({}): {err}",
 211:                         path.display()
 212:                     ));
 213:                 }
 214:             }
 215:         }
 216: 
 217:         Err(format!(
 218:             "failed to allocate unique temporary output file under {}",
 219:             base.display()
 220:         ))
 221:     }
 222: 
 223:     fn path(&self) -> &Path {
 224:         self.path.as_path()
 225:     }
 226: }
 227: 
 228: impl Drop for TempOutputGuard {
 229:     fn drop(&mut self) {
 230:         if let Err(err) = fs::remove_file(&self.path)
 231:             && err.kind() != io::ErrorKind::NotFound
 232:         {
 233:             eprintln!(
 234:                 "warning: failed to remove temporary output file ({}): {err}",
 235:                 self.path.display()
 236:             );
 237:         }
 238:     }
 239: }

===== /crates/rustynet-cli/src/bin/rustynet-windows-trust-cli.rs =====

   1: #![forbid(unsafe_code)]
   2: 
   3: use std::env;
   4: use std::fs;
   5: use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
   6: use std::time::{SystemTime, UNIX_EPOCH};
   7: 
   8: use ed25519_dalek::{Signer, SigningKey};
   9: use rand::{TryRngCore, rngs::OsRng};
  10: use rustynet_crypto::{
  11:     KeyCustodyPermissionPolicy, read_encrypted_key_file, write_encrypted_key_file,
  12: };
  13: use rustynetd::key_material::read_passphrase_file_explicit;
  14: use zeroize::{Zeroize, Zeroizing};
  15: 
  16: fn main() {
  17:     match run() {
  18:         Ok(message) => {
  19:             println!("{message}");
  20:         }
  21:         Err(err) => {
  22:             eprintln!("error: {err}");
  23:             std::process::exit(1);
  24:         }
  25:     }
  26: }
  27: 
  28: fn run() -> Result<String, String> {
  29:     let args = env::args().skip(1).collect::<Vec<_>>();
  30:     match args.as_slice() {
  31:         [scope, action, rest @ ..] if scope == "trust" && action == "keygen" => {
  32:             let parser = OptionParser::parse(rest)?;
  33:             trust_keygen(
  34:                 parser.required_path("--signing-key-output")?,
  35:                 parser.required_path("--signing-key-passphrase-file")?,
  36:                 parser.required_path("--verifier-key-output")?,
  37:                 parser.has_flag("--force"),
  38:             )
  39:         }
  40:         [scope, action, rest @ ..] if scope == "trust" && action == "export-verifier-key" => {
  41:             let parser = OptionParser::parse(rest)?;
  42:             trust_export_verifier_key(
  43:                 parser.required_path("--signing-key")?,
  44:                 parser.required_path("--signing-key-passphrase-file")?,
  45:                 parser.required_path("--output")?,
  46:             )
  47:         }
  48:         [scope, action, rest @ ..] if scope == "trust" && action == "issue" => {
  49:             let parser = OptionParser::parse(rest)?;
  50:             trust_issue(
  51:                 parser.required_path("--signing-key")?,
  52:                 parser.required_path("--signing-key-passphrase-file")?,
  53:                 parser.required_path("--output")?,
  54:                 parser.parse_u64_or_default("--updated-at-unix", unix_now())?,
  55:                 parser.parse_u64_or_default("--nonce", generate_nonce())?,
  56:             )
  57:         }
  58:         _ => Err("usage: rustynet trust <keygen|export-verifier-key|issue> [options]".to_string()),
  59:     }
  60: }
  61: 
  62: #[derive(Debug)]
  63: struct OptionParser<'a> {
  64:     args: &'a [String],
  65: }
  66: 
  67: impl<'a> OptionParser<'a> {
  68:     fn parse(args: &'a [String]) -> Result<Self, String> {
  69:         let parser = Self { args };
  70:         let mut index = 0usize;
  71:         while index < args.len() {
  72:             if !args[index].starts_with("--") {
  73:                 return Err(format!("unexpected positional argument: {}", args[index]));
  74:             }
  75:             if parser.is_flag(args[index].as_str()) {
  76:                 index += 1;
  77:             } else {
  78:                 if index + 1 >= args.len() || args[index + 1].starts_with("--") {
  79:                     return Err(format!("missing value for option {}", args[index]));
  80:                 }
  81:                 index += 2;
  82:             }
  83:         }
  84:         Ok(parser)
  85:     }
  86: 
  87:     fn is_flag(&self, key: &str) -> bool {
  88:         key == "--force"
  89:     }
  90: 
  91:     fn has_flag(&self, key: &str) -> bool {
  92:         self.args.iter().any(|arg| arg == key)
  93:     }
  94: 
  95:     fn required_path(&self, key: &str) -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
  96:         self.required_value(key).map(PathBuf::from)
  97:     }
  98: 
  99:     fn required_value(&self, key: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
 100:         let mut index = 0usize;
 101:         while index < self.args.len() {
 102:             if self.args[index] == key {
 103:                 if index + 1 >= self.args.len() || self.args[index + 1].starts_with("--") {
 104:                     return Err(format!("missing value for option {key}"));
 105:                 }
 106:                 return Ok(self.args[index + 1].clone());
 107:             }
 108:             index += 1;
 109:         }
 110:         Err(format!("missing required option {key}"))
 111:     }
 112: 
 113:     fn parse_u64_or_default(&self, key: &str, default: u64) -> Result<u64, String> {
 114:         let mut index = 0usize;
 115:         while index < self.args.len() {
 116:             if self.args[index] == key {
 117:                 if index + 1 >= self.args.len() || self.args[index + 1].starts_with("--") {
 118:                     return Err(format!("missing value for option {key}"));
 119:                 }
 120:                 return self.args[index + 1]
 121:                     .parse::<u64>()
 122:                     .map_err(|err| format!("invalid {key} value: {err}"));
 123:             }
 124:             index += 1;
 125:         }
 126:         Ok(default)
 127:     }
 128: }
 129: 
 130: fn trust_keygen(
 131:     signing_key_path: PathBuf,
 132:     signing_key_passphrase_path: PathBuf,
 133:     verifier_key_output_path: PathBuf,
 134:     force: bool,
 135: ) -> Result<String, String> {
 136:     let mut seed = [0u8; 32];
 137:     fill_os_random_bytes(&mut seed, "trust signing key")?;
 138:     persist_encrypted_secret_material(
 139:         &signing_key_path,
 140:         &seed,
 141:         &signing_key_passphrase_path,
 142:         "trust signing key",
 143:         force,
 144:     )?;
 145:     let signing_key = SigningKey::from_bytes(&seed);
 146:     seed.zeroize();
 147:     write_text_file(
 148:         &verifier_key_output_path,
 149:         &format!("{}\n", hex_bytes(signing_key.verifying_key().as_bytes())),
 150:     )?;
 151:     Ok(format!(
 152:         "trust signing key initialized: signing_key={} verifier_key_output={}",
 153:         signing_key_path.display(),
 154:         verifier_key_output_path.display()
 155:     ))
 156: }
 157: 
 158: fn trust_export_verifier_key(
 159:     signing_key_path: PathBuf,
 160:     signing_key_passphrase_path: PathBuf,
 161:     output_path: PathBuf,
 162: ) -> Result<String, String> {
 163:     let signing_key = load_signing_key(&signing_key_path, &signing_key_passphrase_path)?;
 164:     write_text_file(
 165:         &output_path,
 166:         &format!("{}\n", hex_bytes(signing_key.verifying_key().as_bytes())),
 167:     )?;
 168:     Ok(format!(
 169:         "trust verifier key exported: signing_key={} output={}",
 170:         signing_key_path.display(),
 171:         output_path.display()
 172:     ))
 173: }
 174: 
 175: fn trust_issue(
 176:     signing_key_path: PathBuf,
 177:     signing_key_passphrase_path: PathBuf,
 178:     output_path: PathBuf,
 179:     updated_at_unix: u64,
 180:     nonce: u64,
 181: ) -> Result<String, String> {
 182:     let signing_key = load_signing_key(&signing_key_path, &signing_key_passphrase_path)?;
 183:     let payload = format!(
 184:         "version=2\ntls13_valid=true\nsigned_control_valid=true\nsigned_data_age_secs=0\nclock_skew_secs=0\nupdated_at_unix={updated_at_unix}\nnonce={nonce}\n"
 185:     );
 186:     let signature = signing_key.sign(payload.as_bytes());
 187:     write_text_file(
 188:         &output_path,
 189:         &format!("{payload}signature={}\n", hex_bytes(&signature.to_bytes())),
 190:     )?;
 191:     Ok(format!(
 192:         "trust evidence issued: output={} updated_at_unix={} nonce={}",
 193:         output_path.display(),
 194:         updated_at_unix,
 195:         nonce
 196:     ))
 197: }
 198: 
 199: fn persist_encrypted_secret_material(
 200:     path: &Path,
 201:     secret: &[u8],
 202:     passphrase_path: &Path,
 203:     label: &str,
 204:     force: bool,
 205: ) -> Result<(), String> {
 206:     if !passphrase_path.is_absolute() {
 207:         return Err(format!(
 208:             "{label} passphrase file path must be absolute: {}",
 209:             passphrase_path.display()
 210:         ));
 211:     }
 212:     if path.exists() {
 213:         let metadata =
 214:             fs::symlink_metadata(path).map_err(|err| format!("inspect {label} failed: {err}"))?;
 215:         if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
 216:             return Err(format!("{label} path must not be a symlink"));
 217:         }
 218:         if !metadata.file_type().is_file() {
 219:             return Err(format!("{label} path must reference a regular file"));
 220:         }
 221:         if !force {
 222:             return Err(format!(
 223:                 "{label} already exists at {}; use --force to overwrite",
 224:                 path.display()
 225:             ));
 226:         }
 227:         fs::remove_file(path).map_err(|err| format!("remove old {label} failed: {err}"))?;
 228:     }
 229:     let passphrase = read_passphrase_file_explicit(passphrase_path).map_err(|err| {
 230:         format!(
 231:             "{label} passphrase source invalid ({}): {err}",
 232:             passphrase_path.display()
 233:         )
 234:     })?;
 235:     let parent = path
 236:         .parent()
 237:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("{label} path has no parent: {}", path.display()))?;
 238:     write_encrypted_key_file(
 239:         parent,
 240:         path,
 241:         secret,
 242:         passphrase.as_str(),
 243:         encrypted_secret_permission_policy(path),
 244:     )
 245:     .map_err(|err| {
 246:         format!(
 247:             "persist encrypted {label} failed ({}): {err}",
 248:             path.display()
 249:         )
 250:     })
 251: }
 252: 
 253: fn load_signing_key(path: &Path, passphrase_path: &Path) -> Result<SigningKey, String> {
 254:     let secret = load_encrypted_secret_material(path, passphrase_path, "signing key")?;
 255:     if secret.len() != 32 {
 256:         return Err("decrypted signing key must be exactly 32 bytes".to_string());
 257:     }
 258:     let mut bytes = [0u8; 32];
 259:     bytes.copy_from_slice(secret.as_slice());
 260:     let key = SigningKey::from_bytes(&bytes);
 261:     bytes.zeroize();
 262:     Ok(key)
 263: }
 264: 
 265: fn load_encrypted_secret_material(
 266:     path: &Path,
 267:     passphrase_path: &Path,
 268:     label: &str,
 269: ) -> Result<Zeroizing<Vec<u8>>, String> {
 270:     if !passphrase_path.is_absolute() {
 271:         return Err(format!(
 272:             "{label} passphrase file path must be absolute: {}",
 273:             passphrase_path.display()
 274:         ));
 275:     }
 276:     if !path.is_file() {
 277:         return Err(format!("{label} path must reference a regular file"));
 278:     }
 279:     let passphrase = read_passphrase_file_explicit(passphrase_path).map_err(|err| {
 280:         format!(
 281:             "{label} passphrase source invalid ({}): {err}",
 282:             passphrase_path.display()
 283:         )
 284:     })?;
 285:     let parent = path
 286:         .parent()
 287:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("{label} path has no parent: {}", path.display()))?;
 288:     let secret = read_encrypted_key_file(
 289:         parent,
 290:         path,
 291:         passphrase.as_str(),
 292:         encrypted_secret_permission_policy(path),
 293:     )
 294:     .map_err(|err| format!("decrypt {label} failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
 295:     Ok(Zeroizing::new(secret))
 296: }
 297: 
 298: fn encrypted_secret_permission_policy(_path: &Path) -> KeyCustodyPermissionPolicy {
 299:     KeyCustodyPermissionPolicy::default()
 300: }
 301: 
 302: fn write_text_file(path: &Path, body: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
 303:     if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
 304:         fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|err| format!("create parent failed: {err}"))?;
 305:     }
 306:     fs::write(path, body).map_err(|err| format!("write file failed: {err}"))
 307: }
 308: 
 309: fn fill_os_random_bytes(bytes: &mut [u8], label: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
 310:     OsRng
 311:         .try_fill_bytes(bytes)
 312:         .map_err(|err| format!("os randomness unavailable for {label}: {err}"))
 313: }

 315: fn unix_now() -> u64 {
 316:     SystemTime::now()
 317:         .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
 318:         .map(|duration| duration.as_secs())
 319:         .unwrap_or(0)
 320: }
 321: 
 322: fn generate_nonce() -> u64 {
 323:     let nanos = SystemTime::now()
 324:         .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
 325:         .map(|duration| duration.as_nanos())
 326:         .unwrap_or(0);
 327:     (nanos & u128::from(u64::MAX)) as u64
 328: }
 329: 
 330: fn hex_bytes(bytes: &[u8]) -> String {
 331:     let mut out = String::with_capacity(bytes.len() * 2);
 332:     for byte in bytes {
 333:         out.push_str(&format!("{byte:02x}"));
 334:     }
 335:     out
 336: }

 112: fn find_root_dir() -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
 113:     let exe =
 114:         env::current_exe().map_err(|err| format!("failed to resolve current executable: {err}"))?;
 115:     let mut dir = exe
 116:         .parent()
 117:         .ok_or_else(|| {
 118:             format!(
 119:                 "failed to resolve executable parent directory: {}",
 120:                 exe.display()
 121:             )
 122:         })?
 123:         .to_path_buf();
 124: 
 125:     loop {
 126:         if dir.join("Cargo.toml").is_file()
 127:             && dir.join("scripts/ci/secrets_hygiene_gates.sh").is_file()
 128:         {
 129:             return Ok(dir);
 130:         }
 131:         if !dir.pop() {
 132:             return Err("failed to locate repository root from current executable".to_string());
 133:         }
 134:     }
 135: }

 137: fn require_command(cmd: &str) -> Result<(), i32> {
 138:     let check = format!("command -v {cmd} >/dev/null 2>&1");
 139:     let status = Command::new("sh")
 140:         .args(["-c", check.as_str()])
 141:         .stdin(Stdio::null())
 142:         .stdout(Stdio::null())
 143:         .stderr(Stdio::null())
 144:         .status();
 145: 
 146:     match status {
 147:         Ok(exit_status) if exit_status.success() => Ok(()),
 148:         Ok(_) | Err(_) => {
 149:             eprintln!("missing required command: {cmd}");
 150:             Err(1)
 151:         }
 152:     }
 153: }

 155: fn run_required_test(package: &str, test_filter: &str) -> Result<(), i32> {
 156:     let tmp_output = TempOutputGuard::create().map_err(|err| {
 157:         eprintln!("{err}");
 158:         1
 159:     })?;
 160:     let output_file = OpenOptions::new()
 161:         .write(true)
 162:         .open(tmp_output.path())
 163:         .map_err(|err| {
 164:             eprintln!(
 165:                 "failed to open required test output file ({}): {err}",
 166:                 tmp_output.path().display()
 167:             );
 168:             1
 169:         })?;
 170:     let status = Command::new("cargo")
 171:         .args(["test", "-p", package, test_filter])
 172:         .args(["--", "--nocapture"])
 173:         .stdin(Stdio::null())
 174:         .stdout(Stdio::from(output_file.try_clone().map_err(|err| {
 175:             eprintln!(
 176:                 "failed to clone required test output file handle ({}): {err}",
 177:                 tmp_output.path().display()
 178:             );
 179:             1
 180:         })?))
 181:         .stderr(Stdio::from(output_file))
 182:         .spawn()
 183:         .map_err(|err| {
 184:             eprintln!("failed to run cargo test for package={package} filter={test_filter}: {err}");
 185:             1
 186:         })?
 187:         .wait()
 188:         .map_err(|err| {
 189:             eprintln!(
 190:                 "failed to wait for cargo test for package={package} filter={test_filter}: {err}"
 191:             );
 192:             1
 193:         })?;
 194: 
 195:     if !status.success() {
 196:         dump_file_to_stderr(tmp_output.path())?;
 197:         eprintln!("required test failed: package={package} filter={test_filter}");
 198:         return Err(1);
 199:     }
 200: 
 201:     dump_file_to_stdout(tmp_output.path())?;
 202:     verify_required_test_output(tmp_output.path(), package, test_filter)
 203: }

 208:             "run",
 209:             "--quiet",
 210:             "-p",
 211:             "rustynet-cli",
 212:             "--",
 213:             "ops",
 214:             "verify-required-test-output",
 215:             "--output",
 216:             output.to_str().ok_or_else(|| {
 217:                 eprintln!(
 218:                     "required test output path is not valid UTF-8: {}",
 219:                     output.display()
 220:                 );
 221:                 1
 222:             })?,
 223:             "--package",
 224:             package,
 225:             "--test-filter",
 226:             test_filter,
 227:         ])
 228:         .stdin(Stdio::null())
 229:         .status()
 230:         .map_err(|err| {
 231:             eprintln!(
 232:                 "failed to run required test verification for package={package} filter={test_filter}: {err}"
 233:             );
 234:             1
 235:         })?;
 236: 
 237:     if status.success() { Ok(()) } else { Err(1) }
 238: }

 240: fn run_command(args: &[&str]) -> Result<(), i32> {
 241:     let status = Command::new("cargo")
 242:         .args(args)
 243:         .stdin(Stdio::null())
 244:         .status()
 245:         .map_err(|err| {
 246:             eprintln!("failed to run cargo {}: {err}", args.join(" "));
 247:             1
 248:         })?;
 249: 
 250:     if status.success() { Ok(()) } else { Err(1) }
 251: }

 253: struct TempOutputGuard {
 254:     path: PathBuf,
 255: }
 256: 
 257: impl TempOutputGuard {
 258:     fn create() -> Result<Self, String> {
 259:         let temp_dir = env::temp_dir();
 260:         let pid = std::process::id();
 261:         let nanos = SystemTime::now()
 262:             .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
 263:             .map_err(|err| format!("clock failure while creating temp file: {err}"))?
 264:             .as_nanos();
 265: 
 266:         for attempt in 0..100u64 {
 267:             let candidate = temp_dir.join(format!(
 268:                 "rustynet-required-test-{pid}-{nanos}-{attempt}.log"
 269:             ));
 270:             match OpenOptions::new()
 271:                 .create_new(true)
 272:                 .write(true)
 273:                 .open(&candidate)
 274:             {
 275:                 Ok(_) => return Ok(Self { path: candidate }),
 276:                 Err(err) if err.kind() == io::ErrorKind::AlreadyExists => continue,
 277:                 Err(err) => {
 278:                     return Err(format!(
 279:                         "failed to create required test output file ({}): {err}",
 280:                         candidate.display()
 281:                     ));
 282:                 }
 283:             }
 284:         }
 285: 
 286:         Err("failed to create required test output file after exhausting unique paths".to_string())
 287:     }
 288: 
 289:     fn path(&self) -> &Path {
 290:         self.path.as_path()
 291:     }
 292: }
 293: 
 294: impl Drop for TempOutputGuard {
 295:     fn drop(&mut self) {
 296:         let _ = fs::remove_file(&self.path);
 297:     }
 298: }
 299: 
 300: fn dump_file_to_stdout(path: &Path) -> Result<(), i32> {
 301:     let mut file = File::open(path).map_err(|err| {
 302:         eprintln!(
 303:             "failed to read required test output file ({}): {err}",
 304:             path.display()
 305:         );
 306:         1
 307:     })?;
 308:     let mut buffer = Vec::new();
 309:     file.read_to_end(&mut buffer).map_err(|err| {
 310:         eprintln!(
 311:             "failed to read required test output file ({}): {err}",
 312:             path.display()
 313:         );
 314:         1
 315:     })?;
 316:     io::stdout().write_all(&buffer).map_err(|err| {
 317:         eprintln!("failed to write required test output to stdout: {err}");
 318:         1
 319:     })?;
 320:     io::stdout().flush().map_err(|err| {
 321:         eprintln!("failed to flush stdout: {err}");
 322:         1
 323:     })
 324: }
 325: 
 326: fn dump_file_to_stderr(path: &Path) -> Result<(), i32> {
 327:     let mut file = File::open(path).map_err(|err| {
 328:         eprintln!(
 329:             "failed to read required test output file ({}): {err}",
 330:             path.display()
 331:         );
 332:         1
 333:     })?;
 334:     let mut buffer = Vec::new();
 335:     file.read_to_end(&mut buffer).map_err(|err| {
 336:         eprintln!(
 337:             "failed to read required test output file ({}): {err}",
 338:             path.display()
 339:         );
 340:         1
 341:     })?;
 342:     io::stderr().write_all(&buffer).map_err(|err| {
 343:         eprintln!("failed to write required test output to stderr: {err}");
 344:         1
 345:     })?;
 346:     io::stderr().flush().map_err(|err| {
 347:         eprintln!("failed to flush stderr: {err}");
 348:         1
 349:     })
 350: }

 285: fn run_expect_fail(root_dir: &Path, script_path: &str, args: &[&str]) -> Result<(), String> {
 286:     let status = run_bash(root_dir, script_path, args)?;
 287:     if status.success() {
 288:         return Err(format!(
 289:             "expected validator to fail without live lab prerequisites: {script_path}"
 290:         ));
 291:     }
 292:     Ok(())
 293: }
 294: 
 295: fn run_cargo_ops(root_dir: &Path, args: &[&str]) -> Result<(), String> {
 296:     let status = run_cargo(root_dir, args)?;
 297:     if status.success() {
 298:         return Ok(());
 299:     }
 300:     Err(format!(
 301:         "cargo run failed for ops command {:?} with status {:?}",
 302:         args,
 303:         status.code()
 304:     ))
 305: }
 306: 
 307: fn run_bash(root_dir: &Path, script_path: &str, args: &[&str]) -> Result<ExitStatus, String> {
 308:     Command::new("bash")
 309:         .current_dir(root_dir)
 310:         .arg(script_path)
 311:         .args(args)
 312:         .stdin(Stdio::null())
 313:         .stdout(Stdio::inherit())
 314:         .stderr(Stdio::inherit())
 315:         .status()
 316:         .map_err(|err| format!("failed to run {script_path}: {err}"))
 317: }
 318: 
 319: fn run_cargo(root_dir: &Path, args: &[&str]) -> Result<ExitStatus, String> {
 320:     Command::new("cargo")
 321:         .current_dir(root_dir)
 322:         .args([
 323:             "run",
 324:             "--quiet",
 325:             "-p",
 326:             "rustynet-cli",
 327:             "--bin",
 328:             "rustynet-cli",
 329:             "--",
 330:         ])
 331:         .args(args)
 332:         .stdin(Stdio::null())
 333:         .stdout(Stdio::inherit())
 334:         .stderr(Stdio::inherit())
 335:         .status()
 336:         .map_err(|err| format!("failed to run cargo: {err}"))
 337: }
 338: 
 339: struct TempDir {
 340:     path: PathBuf,
 341: }
 342: 
 343: impl TempDir {
 344:     fn create() -> Result<Self, String> {
 345:         let path = env::temp_dir().join(format!(
 346:             "rustynet-test-cross-network-remote-exit-skeleton-validators-{}-{}",
 347:             std::process::id(),
 348:             unique_suffix()?
 349:         ));
 350:         fs::create_dir(&path)
 351:             .map_err(|err| format!("create temp dir failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
 352:         Ok(Self { path })
 353:     }
 354: 
 355:     fn path(&self) -> &Path {
 356:         self.path.as_path()
 357:     }
 358: }
 359: 
 360: impl Drop for TempDir {
 361:     fn drop(&mut self) {
 362:         let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&self.path);
 363:     }
 364: }
 365: 
 366: fn unique_suffix() -> Result<u128, String> {
 367:     std::time::SystemTime::now()
 368:         .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
 369:         .map(|duration| duration.as_nanos())
 370:         .map_err(|err| format!("clock failure while creating temp dir: {err}"))
 371: }

===== /crates/rustynet-cli/src/bin/test_validate_cross_network_nat_matrix.rs =====

   8: const DEFAULT_PHASE10_ARTIFACT_DIR: &str = "artifacts/phase10";
   9: const DEFAULT_PHASE10_MAX_EVIDENCE_AGE_SECONDS: &str = "2678400";
  10: const DEFAULT_REQUIRED_NAT_PROFILES: &str = "baseline_lan";
  11: const DEFAULT_NAT_MATRIX_OUTPUT_BASENAME: &str =
  12:     "cross_network_remote_exit_nat_matrix_validation.md";

  14: fn main() {
  15:     let code = match run() {
  16:         Ok(()) => 0,
  17:         Err(code) => code,
  18:     };
  19:     std::process::exit(code);
  20: }
  21: 
  22: fn run() -> Result<(), i32> {
  23:     let args: Vec<OsString> = env::args_os().skip(1).collect();
  24:     if !args.is_empty() {
  25:         eprintln!("test_validate_cross_network_nat_matrix does not accept options");
  26:         return Err(2);
  27:     }
  28: 
  29:     let root_dir = repo_root().map_err(report_err)?;
  30:     require_command("cargo")?;
  31:     require_command("git")?;
  32: 
  33:     let artifact_dir = env::var_os("RUSTYNET_PHASE10_ARTIFACT_DIR")
  34:         .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
  35:         .or_else(|| env::var_os("RUSTYNET_PHASE10_OUT_DIR").filter(|value| !value.is_empty()))
  36:         .unwrap_or_else(|| OsString::from(DEFAULT_PHASE10_ARTIFACT_DIR));
  37:     let artifact_dir_path = PathBuf::from(&artifact_dir);
  38:     let required_nat_profiles = env::var_os("RUSTYNET_PHASE10_CROSS_NETWORK_NAT_PROFILES")
  39:         .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
  40:         .unwrap_or_else(|| OsString::from(DEFAULT_REQUIRED_NAT_PROFILES));
  41:     let max_evidence_age_seconds = env::var_os("RUSTYNET_PHASE10_MAX_EVIDENCE_AGE_SECONDS")
  42:         .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
  43:         .unwrap_or_else(|| OsString::from(DEFAULT_PHASE10_MAX_EVIDENCE_AGE_SECONDS));
  44:     let output = env::var_os("RUSTYNET_PHASE10_CROSS_NETWORK_EXIT_NAT_MATRIX_OUTPUT")
  45:         .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
  46:         .unwrap_or_else(|| {
  47:             artifact_dir_path
  48:                 .join(DEFAULT_NAT_MATRIX_OUTPUT_BASENAME)
  49:                 .as_os_str()
  50:                 .to_os_string()
  51:         });
  52:     let expected_commit = env::var_os("RUSTYNET_PHASE10_CROSS_NETWORK_EXIT_EXPECTED_GIT_COMMIT")
  53:         .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
  54:         .unwrap_or(get_head_commit(&root_dir).map_err(report_err)?);
  55: 
  56:     run_ops(
  57:         &root_dir,
  58:         "validate-cross-network-nat-matrix",
  59:         &[
  60:             OsString::from("--artifact-dir"),
  61:             artifact_dir,
  62:             OsString::from("--required-nat-profiles"),
  63:             required_nat_profiles,
  64:             OsString::from("--expected-git-commit"),
  65:             expected_commit,
  66:             OsString::from("--require-pass-status"),
  67:             OsString::from("--max-evidence-age-seconds"),
  68:             max_evidence_age_seconds,
  69:             OsString::from("--output"),
  70:             output,
  71:         ],
  72:     )?;
  73: 
  74:     println!("Cross-network NAT matrix validation: PASS");
  75:     Ok(())
  76: }
  77: 
  78: fn require_command(command: &str) -> Result<(), i32> {
  79:     if command_exists(command) {
  80:         Ok(())
  81:     } else {
  82:         eprintln!("missing required command: {command}");
  83:         Err(1)
  84:     }
  85: }
  86: 
  87: fn command_exists(command: &str) -> bool {
  88:     if Path::new(command).components().count() > 1 {
  89:         return Path::new(command).is_file();
  90:     }
  91:     let Some(path_value) = env::var_os("PATH") else {
  92:         return false;
  93:     };
  94:     env::split_paths(&path_value).any(|dir| dir.join(command).is_file())
  95: }
  96: 
  97: fn get_head_commit(root_dir: &Path) -> Result<OsString, String> {
  98:     let output = Command::new("git")
  99:         .current_dir(root_dir)
 100:         .args(["rev-parse", "HEAD"])
 101:         .output()
 102:         .map_err(|err| format!("failed to run git rev-parse HEAD: {err}"))?;
 103:     if !output.status.success() {
 104:         return Err("git rev-parse HEAD failed".to_string());
 105:     }
 106:     let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout);
 107:     let trimmed = text.trim();
 108:     if trimmed.is_empty() {
 109:         return Err("git rev-parse HEAD returned empty output".to_string());
 110:     }
 111:     Ok(OsString::from(trimmed))
 112: }
 113: 
 114: fn run_ops(root_dir: &Path, ops_subcommand: &str, args: &[OsString]) -> Result<(), i32> {
 115:     let mut command = Command::new("cargo");
 116:     command.current_dir(root_dir).args([
 117:         "run",
 118:         "--quiet",
 119:         "-p",
 120:         "rustynet-cli",
 121:         "--",
 122:         "ops",
 123:         ops_subcommand,
 124:     ]);
 125:     command.args(args.iter().map(OsString::as_os_str));
 126:     let status = command.status().map_err(|err| {
 127:         eprintln!("failed to run ops {ops_subcommand}: {err}");
 128:         1
 129:     })?;
 130:     if status.success() {
 131:         Ok(())
 132:     } else {
 133:         Err(status_code(status))
 134:     }
 135: }
 136: 
 137: fn repo_root() -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
 138:     let manifest_dir = PathBuf::from(env!("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR"));
 139:     manifest_dir
 140:         .parent()
 141:         .and_then(Path::parent)
 142:         .map(Path::to_path_buf)
 143:         .ok_or_else(|| {
 144:             format!(
 145:                 "failed to resolve repository root from manifest dir {}",
 146:                 manifest_dir.display()
 147:             )
 148:         })
 149: }
 150: 
 151: fn report_err(err: String) -> i32 {
 152:     eprintln!("{err}");
 153:     1
 154: }
 155: 
 156: fn status_code(status: ExitStatus) -> i32 {
 157:     match status.code() {
 158:         Some(code) => code,
 159:         None => {
 160:             #[cfg(unix)]
 161:             {
 162:                 use std::os::unix::process::ExitStatusExt;
 163: 
 164:                 match status.signal() {
 165:                     Some(signal) => 128 + signal,
 166:                     None => 1,
 167:                 }
 168:             }
 169:             #[cfg(not(unix))]

 171:                 1
 172:             }
 173:         }

===== /crates/rustynet-cli/src/bin/test_validate_network_discovery_bundle.rs =====

   2: 
   3: use std::env;
   4: use std::ffi::OsString;
   5: use std::fs;
   6: use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
   7: use std::process::{Command, ExitStatus};
   8: 
   9: const DEFAULT_PHASE10_ARTIFACT_DIR: &str = "artifacts/phase10";
  10: const DEFAULT_MAX_AGE_SECONDS: &str = "2678400";
  11: const DEFAULT_OUTPUT_BASENAME: &str = "discovery-validation.md";
  12: const DEFAULT_DISCOVERY_GLOB_PREFIX: &str = "discovery";
  13: const DEFAULT_DISCOVERY_EXTENSION: &str = "json";
  14: 
  15: fn main() {
  16:     if let Err(err) = run() {
  17:         eprintln!("{err}");
  18:         std::process::exit(1);
  19:     }
  20: }
  21: 
  22: fn run() -> Result<(), String> {
  23:     let args: Vec<OsString> = env::args_os().skip(1).collect();
  24:     if !args.is_empty() {
  25:         return Err("test_validate_network_discovery_bundle does not accept options".to_string());
  26:     }
  27: 
  28:     let root_dir = repo_root()?;
  29:     require_command("cargo")?;
  30: 
  31:     let artifact_dir = env::var_os("RUSTYNET_PHASE10_ARTIFACT_DIR")
  32:         .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
  33:         .or_else(|| env::var_os("RUSTYNET_PHASE10_OUT_DIR").filter(|value| !value.is_empty()))
  34:         .unwrap_or_else(|| OsString::from(DEFAULT_PHASE10_ARTIFACT_DIR));
  35:     let artifact_dir_path = PathBuf::from(&artifact_dir);
  36:     let max_age_seconds = env::var_os("RUSTYNET_PHASE10_NETWORK_DISCOVERY_MAX_AGE_SECONDS")
  37:         .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
  38:         .unwrap_or_else(|| OsString::from(DEFAULT_MAX_AGE_SECONDS));
  39:     let output = env::var_os("RUSTYNET_PHASE10_NETWORK_DISCOVERY_OUTPUT")
  40:         .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
  41:         .unwrap_or_else(|| {
  42:             artifact_dir_path
  43:                 .join(DEFAULT_OUTPUT_BASENAME)
  44:                 .as_os_str()
  45:                 .to_os_string()
  46:         });
  47: 
  48:     let bundles = bundle_args(&artifact_dir_path)?;
  49:     if bundles.is_empty() {
  50:         return Err(format!(
  51:             "no network discovery bundles found under {}",
  52:             artifact_dir_path.display()
  53:         ));
  54:     }
  55: 
  56:     let mut ops_args = Vec::with_capacity(2 + (bundles.len() * 2) + 4);
  57:     for bundle in bundles {
  58:         ops_args.push(OsString::from("--bundle"));
  59:         ops_args.push(bundle);
  60:     }
  61:     ops_args.push(OsString::from("--max-age-seconds"));
  62:     ops_args.push(max_age_seconds);
  63:     ops_args.push(OsString::from("--require-verifier-keys"));
  64:     ops_args.push(OsString::from("--require-daemon-active"));
  65:     ops_args.push(OsString::from("--require-socket-present"));
  66:     ops_args.push(OsString::from("--output"));
  67:     ops_args.push(output);
  68: 
  69:     run_ops(&root_dir, "validate-network-discovery-bundle", &ops_args)?;
  70:     println!("Network discovery bundle validation: PASS");
  71:     Ok(())
  72: }
  73: 
  74: fn bundle_args(artifact_dir: &Path) -> Result<Vec<OsString>, String> {
  75:     if let Some(explicit) = env::var_os("RUSTYNET_PHASE10_NETWORK_DISCOVERY_BUNDLES") {
  76:         let value = explicit.to_string_lossy();
  77:         let mut out = Vec::new();
  78:         for raw in value
  79:             .split(',')
  80:             .map(str::trim)
  81:             .filter(|entry| !entry.is_empty())
  82:         {
  83:             out.push(OsString::from(raw));
  84:         }
  85:         return Ok(out);
  86:     }
  87: 
  88:     let mut bundles = Vec::new();
  89:     let entries = fs::read_dir(artifact_dir).map_err(|err| {
  90:         format!(
  91:             "list artifact directory failed ({}): {err}",
  92:             artifact_dir.display()
  93:         )
  94:     })?;
  95:     for entry in entries {
  96:         let entry = entry.map_err(|err| format!("read directory entry failed: {err}"))?;
  97:         let path = entry.path();
  98:         let Some(file_name) = path.file_name().and_then(|value| value.to_str()) else {
  99:             continue;
 100:         };
 101:         let Some(extension) = path.extension().and_then(|value| value.to_str()) else {
 102:             continue;
 103:         };
 104:         if extension == DEFAULT_DISCOVERY_EXTENSION
 105:             && file_name.starts_with(DEFAULT_DISCOVERY_GLOB_PREFIX)
 106:         {
 107:             bundles.push(path.into_os_string());
 108:         }
 109:     }
 110:     bundles.sort();
 111:     Ok(bundles)
 112: }
 113:

 115:     if command_exists(command) {
 116:         Ok(())
 117:     } else {
 118:         Err(format!("missing required command: {command}"))
 119:     }
 120: }
 121: 
 122: fn command_exists(command: &str) -> bool {
 123:     if Path::new(command).components().count() > 1 {
 124:         return Path::new(command).is_file();
 125:     }
 126:     let Some(path_value) = env::var_os("PATH") else {
 127:         return false;
 128:     };
 129:     env::split_paths(&path_value).any(|dir| dir.join(command).is_file())
 130: }

 135:         "run",
 136:         "--quiet",
 137:         "-p",
 138:         "rustynet-cli",
 139:         "--",
 140:         "ops",
 141:         ops_subcommand,
 142:     ]);
 143:     command.args(args.iter().map(OsString::as_os_str));
 144:     let status = command
 145:         .status()
 146:         .map_err(|err| format!("failed to run ops {ops_subcommand}: {err}"))?;
 147:     if status.success() {
 148:         Ok(())
 149:     } else {
 150:         Err(format!(
 151:             "ops {ops_subcommand} failed with status {}",
 152:             status_code(status)

 154:     }

   1: pub(crate) fn format_env_assignment(key: &str, value: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
   2:     validate_env_key(key)?;
   3:     let quoted = quote_env_value(value)?;
   4:     Ok(format!("{key}={quoted}"))
   5: }
   6: 
   7: pub(crate) fn parse_env_value(raw: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
   8:     let trimmed = raw.trim();
   9:     if trimmed.is_empty() {
  10:         return Ok(String::new());
  11:     }
  12:     if trimmed.contains('\0') {
  13:         return Err("env-file values must not contain NUL bytes".to_string());
  14:     }
  15:     if trimmed.starts_with('"') {
  16:         return parse_double_quoted_env_value(trimmed);
  17:     }
  18:     if trimmed.starts_with('\'') {
  19:         return parse_single_quoted_env_value(trimmed);
  20:     }
  21:     Ok(trimmed.to_string())
  22: }
  23: 
  24: fn validate_env_key(key: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
  25:     if key.is_empty()
  26:         || !key
  27:             .chars()
  28:             .all(|ch| ch.is_ascii_uppercase() || ch.is_ascii_digit() || ch == '_')
  29:     {
  30:         return Err(format!("invalid env-file key: {key}"));
  31:     }
  32:     Ok(())
  33: }
  34: 
  35: fn quote_env_value(value: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
  36:     if value.contains('\0') || value.contains('\n') || value.contains('\r') {
  37:         return Err("env-file values must not contain NUL or newline characters".to_string());
  38:     }
  39: 
  40:     let mut quoted = String::with_capacity(value.len() + 2);
  41:     quoted.push('"');
  42:     for ch in value.chars() {
  43:         match ch {
  44:             '\\' => quoted.push_str("\\\\"),
  45:             '"' => quoted.push_str("\\\""),
  46:             '$' => quoted.push_str("\\$"),
  47:             '`' => quoted.push_str("\\`"),
  48:             _ => quoted.push(ch),
  49:         }
  50:     }
  51:     quoted.push('"');
  52:     Ok(quoted)
  53: }
  54: 
  55: fn parse_double_quoted_env_value(raw: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
  56:     if !raw.ends_with('"') || raw.len() < 2 {
  57:         return Err(format!("unterminated double-quoted env-file value: {raw}"));
  58:     }
  59:     let mut decoded = String::with_capacity(raw.len().saturating_sub(2));
  60:     let mut chars = raw[1..raw.len() - 1].chars();
  61:     while let Some(ch) = chars.next() {
  62:         if ch == '\\' {
  63:             let escaped = chars
  64:                 .next()
  65:                 .ok_or_else(|| format!("trailing escape in env-file value: {raw}"))?;
  66:             decoded.push(escaped);
  67:             continue;
  68:         }
  69:         decoded.push(ch);
  70:     }
  71:     Ok(decoded)
  72: }
  73: 
  74: fn parse_single_quoted_env_value(raw: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
  75:     if !raw.ends_with('\'') || raw.len() < 2 {
  76:         return Err(format!("unterminated single-quoted env-file value: {raw}"));
  77:     }
  78:     Ok(raw[1..raw.len() - 1].to_string())
  79: }
  80:

   6: #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
   7: pub struct LiveLabWorkerResult {
   8:     pub stage_name: String,
   9:     pub label: String,
  10:     pub target: String,
  11:     pub node_id: String,
  12:     pub role: String,
  13:     pub rc: i64,
  14:     pub started_at: String,
  15:     pub finished_at: String,
  16:     pub log_path: String,
  17:     pub snapshot_path: String,
  18:     pub route_policy_path: String,
  19:     pub dns_state_path: String,
  20:     pub primary_failure_reason: String,
  21: }
  22: 
  23: fn read_tsv(path: &Path) -> Vec<Vec<String>> {
  24:     if !path.exists() {
  25:         return Vec::new();
  26:     }
  27:     let Ok(body) = fs::read_to_string(path) else {
  28:         return Vec::new();
  29:     };
  30:     body.lines()
  31:         .filter(|line| !line.is_empty())
  32:         .map(|line| {
  33:             line.split('\t')
  34:                 .map(ToString::to_string)
  35:                 .collect::<Vec<_>>()
  36:         })
  37:         .filter(|row| !row.is_empty())
  38:         .collect()
  39: }
  40: 
  41: fn parse_worker_result_row(stage_name: &str, row: &[String]) -> Option<LiveLabWorkerResult> {
  42:     if row.len() >= 13 {
  43:         return Some(LiveLabWorkerResult {
  44:             stage_name: row[0].clone(),
  45:             label: row[1].clone(),
  46:             target: row[2].clone(),
  47:             node_id: row[3].clone(),
  48:             role: row[4].clone(),
  49:             rc: row[5].parse::<i64>().unwrap_or(1),
  50:             started_at: row[6].clone(),
  51:             finished_at: row[7].clone(),
  52:             log_path: row[8].clone(),
  53:             snapshot_path: row[9].clone(),
  54:             route_policy_path: row[10].clone(),
  55:             dns_state_path: row[11].clone(),
  56:             primary_failure_reason: row[12].clone(),
  57:         });
  58:     }
  59:     if row.len() == 6 {
  60:         return Some(LiveLabWorkerResult {
  61:             stage_name: stage_name.to_string(),
  62:             label: row[0].clone(),
  63:             target: row[1].clone(),
  64:             node_id: row[2].clone(),
  65:             role: row[3].clone(),
  66:             rc: row[4].parse::<i64>().unwrap_or(1),
  67:             started_at: String::new(),
  68:             finished_at: String::new(),
  69:             log_path: row[5].clone(),
  70:             snapshot_path: String::new(),
  71:             route_policy_path: String::new(),
  72:             dns_state_path: String::new(),
  73:             primary_failure_reason: String::new(),
  74:         });
  75:     }
  76:     None
  77: }
  78: 
  79: pub fn read_parallel_stage_results(
  80:     report_dir: &Path,
  81:     stage_name: &str,
  82: ) -> Vec<LiveLabWorkerResult> {
  83:     let results_path = report_dir
  84:         .join("state")
  85:         .join(format!("parallel-{stage_name}"))
  86:         .join("results.tsv");
  87:     read_tsv(results_path.as_path())
  88:         .into_iter()
  89:         .filter_map(|row| parse_worker_result_row(stage_name, row.as_slice()))
  90:         .collect()
  91: }

 325: fn unix_now() -> u64 {
 326:     SystemTime::now()
 327:         .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
 328:         .unwrap_or_default()
 329:         .as_secs()

 332: fn resolve_path(path: &Path) -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
 333:     if path.is_absolute() {
 334:         return Ok(path.to_path_buf());
 335:     }
 336:     let cwd = std::env::current_dir()
 337:         .map_err(|err| format!("resolve current directory failed: {err}"))?;
 338:     Ok(cwd.join(path))
 339: }
 340: 
 341: fn canonical_existing_file(path: &Path) -> Option<PathBuf> {
 342:     let resolved = resolve_path(path).ok()?;
 343:     if !resolved.exists() {
 344:         return None;
 345:     }
 346:     fs::canonicalize(resolved).ok()
 347: }
 348: 
 349: fn non_empty_option(value: Option<String>) -> Option<String> {
 350:     value.and_then(|entry| {
 351:         let trimmed = entry.trim();
 352:         if trimmed.is_empty() {
 353:             None
 354:         } else {
 355:             Some(trimmed.to_string())
 356:         }
 357:     })
 358: }

 360: fn collect_existing_artifacts(paths: &[PathBuf]) -> Vec<String> {
 361:     let mut collected = Vec::new();
 362:     for path in paths {
 363:         if let Some(canonical) = canonical_existing_file(path.as_path()) {
 364:             collected.push(canonical.display().to_string());
 365:         }
 366:     }
 367:     collected
 368: }

 370: fn extract_inline_field(line: &str, key: &str) -> Option<String> {
 371:     let prefix = format!("{key}=");
 372:     line.split_whitespace()
 373:         .find_map(|token| token.strip_prefix(prefix.as_str()))
 374:         .map(str::trim)
 375:         .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
 376:         .map(str::to_string)
 377: }
 378: 
 379: fn extract_optional_u64_inline_field(line: &str, key: &str) -> Result<Option<u64>, String> {
 380:     match extract_inline_field(line, key) {
 381:         Some(value) if value == "none" => Ok(None),
 382:         Some(value) => value
 383:             .parse::<u64>()
 384:             .map(Some)
 385:             .map_err(|err| format!("status line {key} invalid: {err}")),
 386:         None => Ok(None),
 387:     }
 388: }
 389: 
 390: fn path_evidence_from_status_line(status_line: &str) -> Result<Value, String> {
 391:     let path_mode = extract_inline_field(status_line, "path_mode")
 392:         .ok_or_else(|| "status line missing path_mode".to_string())?;
 393:     let path_reason = extract_inline_field(status_line, "path_reason")
 394:         .ok_or_else(|| "status line missing path_reason".to_string())?;
 395:     let path_programmed_mode = extract_inline_field(status_line, "path_programmed_mode")
 396:         .ok_or_else(|| "status line missing path_programmed_mode".to_string())?;
 397:     let transport_socket_identity_state =
 398:         extract_inline_field(status_line, "transport_socket_identity_state")
 399:             .ok_or_else(|| "status line missing transport_socket_identity_state".to_string())?;
 400:     let transport_socket_identity_error =
 401:         extract_inline_field(status_line, "transport_socket_identity_error")
 402:             .ok_or_else(|| "status line missing transport_socket_identity_error".to_string())?;
 403:     let path_live_proven = match extract_inline_field(status_line, "path_live_proven")
 404:         .ok_or_else(|| "status line missing path_live_proven".to_string())?
 405:         .as_str()
 406:     {
 407:         "true" => true,
 408:         "false" => false,
 409:         other => {
 410:             return Err(format!(
 411:                 "status line path_live_proven must be true|false, got {other}"
 412:             ));
 413:         }
 414:     };
 415:     let path_latest_live_handshake_unix =
 416:         extract_optional_u64_inline_field(status_line, "path_latest_live_handshake_unix")?;
 417:     let relay_session_state = extract_inline_field(status_line, "relay_session_state");
 418:     let traversal_alarm_state = extract_inline_field(status_line, "traversal_alarm_state");
 419:     let traversal_alarm_reason = extract_inline_field(status_line, "traversal_alarm_reason");
 420:     let dns_alarm_state = extract_inline_field(status_line, "dns_alarm_state");
 421:     let dns_alarm_reason = extract_inline_field(status_line, "dns_alarm_reason");
 422:     let traversal_error = extract_inline_field(status_line, "traversal_error");
 423:     let transport_socket_identity_label =
 424:         extract_inline_field(status_line, "transport_socket_identity_label");
 425:     let transport_socket_identity_local_addr =
 426:         extract_inline_field(status_line, "transport_socket_identity_local_addr");
 427:     let traversal_probe_result = extract_inline_field(status_line, "traversal_probe_result");
 428:     let traversal_probe_reason = extract_inline_field(status_line, "traversal_probe_reason");
 429:     let traversal_endpoint_change_events =
 430:         extract_optional_u64_inline_field(status_line, "traversal_endpoint_change_events")?;
 431:     let stun_transport_port_binding =
 432:         extract_inline_field(status_line, "stun_transport_port_binding");
 433: 
 434:     Ok(json!({
 435:         "path_mode": path_mode,
 436:         "path_reason": path_reason,
 437:         "path_programmed_mode": path_programmed_mode,
 438:         "path_live_proven": path_live_proven,
 439:         "path_latest_live_handshake_unix": path_latest_live_handshake_unix,
 440:         "relay_session_state": relay_session_state,
 441:         "traversal_alarm_state": traversal_alarm_state,
 442:         "traversal_alarm_reason": traversal_alarm_reason,
 443:         "dns_alarm_state": dns_alarm_state,
 444:         "dns_alarm_reason": dns_alarm_reason,
 445:         "traversal_error": traversal_error,
 446:         "transport_socket_identity_state": transport_socket_identity_state,
 447:         "transport_socket_identity_error": transport_socket_identity_error,
 448:         "transport_socket_identity_label": transport_socket_identity_label,
 449:         "transport_socket_identity_local_addr": transport_socket_identity_local_addr,
 450:         "traversal_probe_result": traversal_probe_result,
 451:         "traversal_probe_reason": traversal_probe_reason,
 452:         "traversal_endpoint_change_events": traversal_endpoint_change_events,
 453:         "stun_transport_port_binding": stun_transport_port_binding,
 454:     }))
 455: }

 457: fn artifact_list_has_basename(entries: &[Value], basename: &str) -> bool {
 458:     entries.iter().any(|entry| {
 459:         entry.as_str().is_some_and(|raw_path| {
 460:             Path::new(raw_path)
 461:                 .file_name()
 462:                 .and_then(|value| value.to_str())
 463:                 == Some(basename)
 464:         })
 465:     })

 468: fn path_evidence_from_report(path: &Path) -> Result<Value, String> {
 469:     let report_path = resolve_path(path)?;
 470:     let payload = parse_report_payload(report_path.as_path())?;
 471:     payload
 472:         .as_object()
 473:         .and_then(|object| object.get("path_evidence"))
 474:         .cloned()
 475:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("{}: report is missing path_evidence", report_path.display()))
 476: }

 478: fn resolve_optional_path_evidence(
 479:     status: &str,
 480:     path_status_line: Option<String>,
 481:     path_evidence_report: Option<PathBuf>,
 482: ) -> Result<Option<Value>, String> {
 483:     let resolved = if let Some(status_line) = non_empty_option(path_status_line) {
 484:         path_evidence_from_status_line(status_line.as_str()).map(Some)
 485:     } else if let Some(path_evidence_report) = path_evidence_report {
 486:         path_evidence_from_report(path_evidence_report.as_path()).map(Some)
 487:     } else {
 488:         Ok(None)
 489:     };
 490: 
 491:     match resolved {
 492:         Ok(path_evidence) => Ok(path_evidence),
 493:         Err(_err) if status == CHECK_FAIL => Ok(None),
 494:         Err(err) => Err(err),
 495:     }
 496: }

 498: fn current_git_commit() -> Result<String, String> {
 499:     if let Ok(value) = std::env::var("RUSTYNET_EXPECTED_GIT_COMMIT") {
 500:         let normalized = value.trim().to_ascii_lowercase();
 501:         if !normalized.is_empty() {
 502:             return Ok(normalized);
 503:         }
 504:     }
 505:     let output = Command::new("git")
 506:         .args(["rev-parse", "HEAD"])
 507:         .output()
 508:         .map_err(|err| format!("resolve git commit failed: {err}"))?;
 509:     if !output.status.success() {
 510:         let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr);
 511:         return Err(format!("resolve git commit failed: {}", stderr.trim()));
 512:     }
 513:     let commit = String::from_utf8(output.stdout)
 514:         .map_err(|err| format!("decode git commit failed: {err}"))?
 515:         .trim()
 516:         .to_ascii_lowercase();
 517:     if commit.is_empty() {
 518:         return Err("resolve git commit failed: empty output".to_string());
 519:     }
 520:     Ok(commit)
 521: }

 523: fn parse_check_overrides(items: &[String]) -> Result<HashMap<String, String>, String> {
 524:     let mut overrides = HashMap::new();
 525:     for item in items {
 526:         let Some((raw_key, raw_value)) = item.split_once('=') else {
 527:             return Err(format!(
 528:                 "invalid --check value {item:?}; expected key=pass|fail"
 529:             ));
 530:         };
 531:         let key = raw_key.trim();
 532:         let value = raw_value.trim();
 533:         if key.is_empty() {
 534:             return Err(format!(
 535:                 "invalid --check value {item:?}; key must be non-empty"
 536:             ));
 537:         }
 538:         if value != CHECK_PASS && value != CHECK_FAIL {
 539:             return Err(format!(
 540:                 "invalid --check value {item:?}; expected key=pass|fail"
 541:             ));
 542:         }
 543:         overrides.insert(key.to_string(), value.to_string());
 544:     }
 545:     Ok(overrides)
 546: }

 548: fn is_lower_hex_commit(value: &str) -> bool {
 549:     value.len() == 40
 550:         && value
 551:             .bytes()
 552:             .all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_digit() || (b'a'..=b'f').contains(&byte))
 553: }
