 555: fn resolve_artifact_path(report_path: &Path, raw: &str) -> PathBuf {
 556:     let candidate = PathBuf::from(raw);
 557:     if candidate.is_absolute() {
 558:         return candidate;
 559:     }
 560:     let base = report_path
 561:         .parent()
 562:         .map(Path::to_path_buf)
 563:         .unwrap_or_else(|| PathBuf::from("."));
 564:     base.join(candidate)
 565: }
 566: 
 567: fn path_is_within(candidate: &Path, root: &Path) -> bool {
 568:     let canonical_candidate = fs::canonicalize(candidate);
 569:     let canonical_root = fs::canonicalize(root);
 570:     match (canonical_candidate, canonical_root) {
 571:         (Ok(candidate), Ok(root)) => candidate.starts_with(root),
 572:         _ => false,
 573:     }
 574: }
 575: 
 576: fn value_as_non_empty_string(value: Option<&Value>) -> Option<String> {
 577:     value.and_then(Value::as_str).and_then(|entry| {
 578:         let trimmed = entry.trim();
 579:         if trimmed.is_empty() {
 580:             None
 581:         } else {
 582:             Some(trimmed.to_string())
 583:         }
 584:     })
 585: }
 586: 
 587: fn resolve_artifact_by_basename(
 588:     report_path: &Path,
 589:     entries: &[Value],
 590:     basename: &str,
 591: ) -> Result<Option<PathBuf>, String> {
 592:     let mut matches = entries
 593:         .iter()
 594:         .filter_map(Value::as_str)
 595:         .map(|raw_path| resolve_artifact_path(report_path, raw_path))
 596:         .filter(|artifact_path| {
 597:             artifact_path.file_name().and_then(|value| value.to_str()) == Some(basename)
 598:         })
 599:         .collect::<Vec<_>>();
 600:     if matches.len() > 1 {
 601:         return Err(format!(
 602:             "{}: source_artifacts contains duplicate basename {:?}",
 603:             report_path.display(),
 604:             basename
 605:         ));
 606:     }
 607:     Ok(matches.pop())
 608: }
 609: 
 610: fn parse_key_value_artifact(path: &Path) -> Result<HashMap<String, String>, String> {
 611:     let body = fs::read_to_string(path)
 612:         .map_err(|err| format!("{}: read key/value artifact failed: {err}", path.display()))?;
 613:     let mut out = HashMap::new();
 614:     for (line_index, line) in body.lines().enumerate() {
 615:         let trimmed = line.trim();
 616:         if trimmed.is_empty() {
 617:             continue;
 618:         }
 619:         let Some((raw_key, raw_value)) = trimmed.split_once('=') else {
 620:             return Err(format!(
 621:                 "{}: malformed key/value line {}",
 622:                 path.display(),
 623:                 line_index + 1
 624:             ));
 625:         };
 626:         let key = raw_key.trim();
 627:         if key.is_empty() {
 628:             return Err(format!(
 629:                 "{}: empty key on line {}",
 630:                 path.display(),
 631:                 line_index + 1
 632:             ));
 633:         }
 634:         if out
 635:             .insert(key.to_string(), raw_value.trim().to_string())
 636:             .is_some()
 637:         {
 638:             return Err(format!("{}: duplicate key {:?}", path.display(), key));
 639:         }
 640:     }
 641:     Ok(out)
 642: }
 643: 
 644: fn validate_ssh_trust_summary_artifact(path: &Path) -> Vec<String> {
 645:     let mut problems = Vec::new();
 646:     let summary = match parse_key_value_artifact(path) {
 647:         Ok(summary) => summary,
 648:         Err(err) => return vec![err],
 649:     };
 650: 
 651:     let expect_non_empty = |key: &str, problems: &mut Vec<String>| -> Option<String> {
 652:         let value = summary.get(key).cloned().unwrap_or_default();
 653:         if value.trim().is_empty() {
 654:             problems.push(format!(
 655:                 "{}: {key} must be a non-empty string",
 656:                 path.display()
 657:             ));
 658:             None
 659:         } else {
 660:             Some(value)
 661:         }
 662:     };
 663: 
 664:     if summary.get("schema_version").map(String::as_str) != Some("1") {
 665:         problems.push(format!("{}: schema_version must equal 1", path.display()));
 666:     }
 667:     if expect_non_empty("pinned_known_hosts_file", &mut problems).is_none() {
 668:         // recorded in problems
 669:     }
 670:     let pinned_known_hosts_sha256 = expect_non_empty("pinned_known_hosts_sha256", &mut problems);
 671:     if pinned_known_hosts_sha256.as_deref().is_some_and(|value| {
 672:         value.len() != 64
 673:             || !value
 674:                 .bytes()
 675:                 .all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_digit() || (b'a'..=b'f').contains(&byte))
 676:     }) {
 677:         problems.push(format!(
 678:             "{}: pinned_known_hosts_sha256 must be a 64-character lowercase hex digest",
 679:             path.display()
 680:         ));
 681:     }
 682:     if summary.get("all_targets_pinned").map(String::as_str) != Some("true") {
 683:         problems.push(format!(
 684:             "{}: all_targets_pinned must equal true",
 685:             path.display()
 686:         ));
 687:     }
 688:     if summary
 689:         .get("all_targets_passwordless_sudo")
 690:         .map(String::as_str)
 691:         != Some("true")
 692:     {
 693:         problems.push(format!(
 694:             "{}: all_targets_passwordless_sudo must equal true",
 695:             path.display()
 696:         ));
 697:     }
 698: 
 699:     let target_count = summary
 700:         .get("target_count")
 701:         .and_then(|value| value.parse::<usize>().ok());
 702:     let Some(target_count) = target_count else {
 703:         problems.push(format!(
 704:             "{}: target_count must be a positive integer",
 705:             path.display()
 706:         ));
 707:         return problems;
 708:     };
 709:     if target_count == 0 {
 710:         problems.push(format!(
 711:             "{}: target_count must be a positive integer",
 712:             path.display()
 713:         ));
 714:     }
 715: 
 716:     for index in 0..target_count {
 717:         let target_key = format!("target[{index}].target");
 718:         let checked_candidates_key = format!("target[{index}].checked_candidates");
 719:         let matched_candidate_key = format!("target[{index}].matched_candidate");
 720:         let host_key_status_key = format!("target[{index}].host_key_status");
 721:         let passwordless_sudo_status_key = format!("target[{index}].passwordless_sudo_status");
 722:         let configured_transport_key = format!("target[{index}].configured_transport");
 723: 
 724:         let checked_candidates = expect_non_empty(checked_candidates_key.as_str(), &mut problems);
 725:         let matched_candidate = expect_non_empty(matched_candidate_key.as_str(), &mut problems);
 726:         let _target = expect_non_empty(target_key.as_str(), &mut problems);
 727:         let configured_transport =
 728:             expect_non_empty(configured_transport_key.as_str(), &mut problems);
 729:         if configured_transport
 730:             .as_deref()
 731:             .is_some_and(|value| !matches!(value, "ssh" | "utm"))
 732:         {
 733:             problems.push(format!(
 734:                 "{}: {configured_transport_key} must equal ssh or utm",
 735:                 path.display()
 736:             ));
 737:         }
 738:         if summary
 739:             .get(host_key_status_key.as_str())
 740:             .map(String::as_str)
 741:             != Some(CHECK_PASS)
 742:         {
 743:             problems.push(format!(
 744:                 "{}: {host_key_status_key} must equal pass",
 745:                 path.display()
 746:             ));
 747:         }
 748:         if summary
 749:             .get(passwordless_sudo_status_key.as_str())
 750:             .map(String::as_str)
 751:             != Some(CHECK_PASS)
 752:         {
 753:             problems.push(format!(
 754:                 "{}: {passwordless_sudo_status_key} must equal pass",
 755:                 path.display()
 756:             ));
 757:         }
 758:         if let (Some(checked_candidates), Some(matched_candidate)) =
 759:             (checked_candidates.as_deref(), matched_candidate.as_deref())
 760:         {
 761:             let matched = checked_candidates
 762:                 .split(',')
 763:                 .map(str::trim)
 764:                 .any(|candidate| candidate == matched_candidate);
 765:             if !matched {
 766:                 problems.push(format!(
 767:                     "{}: {matched_candidate_key} must appear in {checked_candidates_key}",
 768:                     path.display()
 769:                 ));
 770:             }
 771:         }
 772:     }
 773: 
 774:     problems
 775: }
 776: 
 777: fn parse_json_object_file(path: &Path, label: &str) -> Result<Map<String, Value>, String> {
 778:     let body = fs::read_to_string(path)
 779:         .map_err(|err| format!("{}: read {label} failed: {err}", path.display()))?;
 780:     let payload: Value = serde_json::from_str(&body)
 781:         .map_err(|err| format!("{}: invalid {label} JSON ({err})", path.display()))?;
 782:     payload
 783:         .as_object()
 784:         .cloned()
 785:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("{}: {label} must be a JSON object", path.display()))
 786: }
 787: 
 788: fn validate_soak_monitor_summary_artifact(path: &Path) -> Vec<String> {
 789:     let mut problems = Vec::new();
 790:     let payload = match parse_json_object_file(path, "soak monitor summary") {
 791:         Ok(payload) => payload,
 792:         Err(err) => return vec![err],
 793:     };
 794: 
 795:     let read_u64 = |field: &str, problems: &mut Vec<String>| -> Option<u64> {
 796:         let value = payload.get(field).and_then(Value::as_u64);
 797:         if value.is_none() {
 798:             problems.push(format!(
 799:                 "{}: {field} must be a non-negative integer",
 800:                 path.display()
 801:             ));
 802:         }
 803:         value
 804:     };
 805:     let read_status = |field: &str, problems: &mut Vec<String>| -> Option<String> {
 806:         let value = value_as_non_empty_string(payload.get(field));
 807:         if value.is_none() {
 808:             problems.push(format!(
 809:                 "{}: {field} must be a non-empty string",
 810:                 path.display()
 811:             ));
 812:         }
 813:         value
 814:     };
 815: 
 816:     let samples = read_u64("samples", &mut problems);
 817:     let failing_samples = read_u64("failing_samples", &mut problems);
 818:     let max_consecutive_failures_observed =
 819:         read_u64("max_consecutive_failures_observed", &mut problems);
 820:     let elapsed_secs = read_u64("elapsed_secs", &mut problems);
 821:     let required_soak_duration_secs = read_u64("required_soak_duration_secs", &mut problems);
 822:     let allowed_failing_samples = read_u64("allowed_failing_samples", &mut problems);
 823:     let allowed_max_consecutive_failures =
 824:         read_u64("allowed_max_consecutive_failures", &mut problems);
 825:     let direct_samples = read_u64("direct_samples", &mut problems);
 826:     let relay_samples = read_u64("relay_samples", &mut problems);
 827:     let fail_closed_samples = read_u64("fail_closed_samples", &mut problems);
 828:     let other_path_samples = read_u64("other_path_samples", &mut problems);
 829:     let path_transition_count = read_u64("path_transition_count", &mut problems);
 830:     let status_mismatch_samples = read_u64("status_mismatch_samples", &mut problems);
 831:     let route_mismatch_samples = read_u64("route_mismatch_samples", &mut problems);
 832:     let endpoint_mismatch_samples = read_u64("endpoint_mismatch_samples", &mut problems);
 833:     let dns_alarm_bad_samples = read_u64("dns_alarm_bad_samples", &mut problems);
 834:     let transport_identity_failures = read_u64("transport_identity_failures", &mut problems);
 835:     let endpoint_change_events_start = read_u64("endpoint_change_events_start", &mut problems);
 836:     let endpoint_change_events_end = read_u64("endpoint_change_events_end", &mut problems);
 837:     let endpoint_change_events_delta = read_u64("endpoint_change_events_delta", &mut problems);
 838: 
 839:     let direct_remote_exit_ready = read_status("direct_remote_exit_ready", &mut problems);
 840:     let post_soak_bypass_ready = read_status("post_soak_bypass_ready", &mut problems);
 841:     let no_plaintext_passphrase_files = read_status("no_plaintext_passphrase_files", &mut problems);
 842:     let first_non_direct_reason = read_status("first_non_direct_reason", &mut problems);
 843:     let first_failure_reason = read_status("first_failure_reason", &mut problems);
 844:     let last_path_mode = read_status("last_path_mode", &mut problems);
 845:     let last_path_reason = read_status("last_path_reason", &mut problems);
 846:     let long_soak_stable = read_status("long_soak_stable", &mut problems);
 847: 
 848:     if let (
 849:         Some(samples),
 850:         Some(direct_samples),
 851:         Some(relay_samples),
 852:         Some(fail_closed_samples),
 853:         Some(other_path_samples),
 854:     ) = (
 855:         samples,
 856:         direct_samples,
 857:         relay_samples,
 858:         fail_closed_samples,
 859:         other_path_samples,
 860:     ) && direct_samples + relay_samples + fail_closed_samples + other_path_samples != samples
 861:     {
 862:         problems.push(format!(
 863:             "{}: direct/relay/fail_closed/other sample counts must sum to samples",
 864:             path.display()
 865:         ));
 866:     }
 867:     if let (Some(start), Some(end), Some(delta)) = (
 868:         endpoint_change_events_start,
 869:         endpoint_change_events_end,
 870:         endpoint_change_events_delta,
 871:     ) {
 872:         if end < start {
 873:             problems.push(format!(
 874:                 "{}: endpoint_change_events_end must be >= endpoint_change_events_start",
 875:                 path.display()
 876:             ));
 877:         }
 878:         if end.saturating_sub(start) != delta {
 879:             problems.push(format!(
 880:                 "{}: endpoint_change_events_delta must equal end-start",
 881:                 path.display()
 882:             ));
 883:         }
 884:     }
 885: 
 886:     if elapsed_secs
 887:         .zip(required_soak_duration_secs)
 888:         .is_some_and(|(elapsed, required)| elapsed < required)
 889:     {
 890:         problems.push(format!(
 891:             "{}: elapsed_secs must be >= required_soak_duration_secs",
 892:             path.display()
 893:         ));
 894:     }
 895:     if failing_samples
 896:         .zip(allowed_failing_samples)
 897:         .is_some_and(|(failing, allowed)| failing > allowed)
 898:     {
 899:         problems.push(format!(
 900:             "{}: failing_samples must be <= allowed_failing_samples",
 901:             path.display()
 902:         ));
 903:     }
 904:     if max_consecutive_failures_observed
 905:         .zip(allowed_max_consecutive_failures)
 906:         .is_some_and(|(observed, allowed)| observed > allowed)
 907:     {
 908:         problems.push(format!(
 909:             "{}: max_consecutive_failures_observed must be <= allowed_max_consecutive_failures",
 910:             path.display()
 911:         ));
 912:     }
 913: 
 914:     if direct_remote_exit_ready.as_deref() != Some(CHECK_PASS) {
 915:         problems.push(format!(
 916:             "{}: direct_remote_exit_ready must equal pass",
 917:             path.display()
 918:         ));
 919:     }
 920:     if post_soak_bypass_ready.as_deref() != Some(CHECK_PASS) {
 921:         problems.push(format!(
 922:             "{}: post_soak_bypass_ready must equal pass",
 923:             path.display()
 924:         ));
 925:     }
 926:     if no_plaintext_passphrase_files.as_deref() != Some(CHECK_PASS) {
 927:         problems.push(format!(
 928:             "{}: no_plaintext_passphrase_files must equal pass",
 929:             path.display()
 930:         ));
 931:     }
 932:     if long_soak_stable.as_deref() != Some(CHECK_PASS) {
 933:         problems.push(format!(
 934:             "{}: long_soak_stable must equal pass",
 935:             path.display()
 936:         ));
 937:     }
 938:     if direct_samples != samples {
 939:         problems.push(format!(
 940:             "{}: direct_samples must equal samples for authoritative direct-path soak evidence",
 941:             path.display()
 942:         ));
 943:     }
 944:     for (field, value) in [
 945:         ("relay_samples", relay_samples),
 946:         ("fail_closed_samples", fail_closed_samples),
 947:         ("other_path_samples", other_path_samples),
 948:         ("path_transition_count", path_transition_count),
 949:         ("status_mismatch_samples", status_mismatch_samples),
 950:         ("route_mismatch_samples", route_mismatch_samples),
 951:         ("endpoint_mismatch_samples", endpoint_mismatch_samples),
 952:         ("dns_alarm_bad_samples", dns_alarm_bad_samples),
 953:         ("transport_identity_failures", transport_identity_failures),
 954:         ("failing_samples", failing_samples),
 955:         (
 956:             "max_consecutive_failures_observed",
 957:             max_consecutive_failures_observed,
 958:         ),
 959:     ] {
 960:         if value.is_some_and(|entry| entry != 0) {
 961:             problems.push(format!(
 962:                 "{}: {field} must equal 0 for authoritative direct-path soak evidence",
 963:                 path.display()
 964:             ));
 965:         }
 966:     }
 967:     if first_non_direct_reason.as_deref() != Some("none") {
 968:         problems.push(format!(
 969:             "{}: first_non_direct_reason must equal none for authoritative direct-path soak evidence",
 970:             path.display()
 971:         ));
 972:     }
 973:     if first_failure_reason.as_deref() != Some("none") {
 974:         problems.push(format!(
 975:             "{}: first_failure_reason must equal none for authoritative direct-path soak evidence",
 976:             path.display()
 977:         ));
 978:     }
 979:     if last_path_mode.as_deref() != Some("direct_active") {
 980:         problems.push(format!(
 981:             "{}: last_path_mode must equal direct_active",
 982:             path.display()
 983:         ));
 984:     }
 985:     if last_path_reason
 986:         .as_deref()
 987:         .is_none_or(|value| value.trim().is_empty() || value == "none")
 988:     {
 989:         problems.push(format!(
 990:             "{}: last_path_reason must be a non-empty direct-path reason",
 991:             path.display()
 992:         ));
 993:     }
 994: 
 995:     problems
 996: }
 997: 
 998: fn validate_report_payload(
 999:     report_path: &Path,
1000:     payload: &Value,
1001:     max_evidence_age_seconds: Option<u64>,
1002:     now_unix_override: Option<u64>,
1003: ) -> Vec<String> {
1004:     let mut problems = Vec::new();
1005:     let Some(payload_object) = payload.as_object() else {
1006:         return vec![format!(
1007:             "{}: report must be a JSON object",
1008:             report_path.display()
1009:         )];
1010:     };
1011: 
1012:     let suite = payload_object
1013:         .get("suite")
1014:         .and_then(Value::as_str)
1015:         .unwrap_or_default();
1016:     let Some(spec) = report_spec_by_suite(suite) else {
1017:         let known = REPORT_SPECS
1018:             .iter()
1019:             .map(|entry| entry.suite)
1020:             .collect::<Vec<_>>()
1021:             .join(", ");
1022:         return vec![format!(
1023:             "{}: unknown suite {suite:?}; expected one of {known}",
1024:             report_path.display()
1025:         )];
1026:     };
1027: 
1028:     if let Some(filename) = report_path.file_name().and_then(|value| value.to_str())
1029:         && let Some(expected) = report_spec_by_filename(filename)
1030:         && expected.suite != spec.suite
1031:     {
1032:         problems.push(format!(
1033:             "filename {filename:?} does not match suite {:?}",
1034:             spec.suite
1035:         ));
1036:     }
1037: 
1038:     if payload_object.get("schema_version").and_then(Value::as_i64) != Some(SCHEMA_VERSION) {
1039:         problems.push(format!("schema_version must equal {SCHEMA_VERSION}"));
1040:     }
1041:     if payload_object.get("phase").and_then(Value::as_str) != Some(PHASE_NAME) {
1042:         problems.push(format!("phase must equal {PHASE_NAME:?}"));
1043:     }
1044:     if payload_object.get("evidence_mode").and_then(Value::as_str) != Some(EVIDENCE_MODE) {
1045:         problems.push(format!("evidence_mode must equal {EVIDENCE_MODE:?}"));
1046:     }
1047: 
1048:     if value_as_non_empty_string(payload_object.get("environment")).is_none() {
1049:         problems.push("environment must be a non-empty string".to_string());
1050:     }
1051: 
1052:     let captured_at_unix = payload_object
1053:         .get("captured_at_unix")
1054:         .and_then(Value::as_u64)
1055:         .filter(|value| *value > 0);
1056:     let now_unix = now_unix_override.unwrap_or_else(unix_now);
1057:     match captured_at_unix {
1058:         Some(captured) => {
1059:             if captured > now_unix.saturating_add(300) {
1060:                 problems.push("captured_at_unix is too far in the future".to_string());
1061:             }
1062:             if let Some(max_age) = max_evidence_age_seconds
1063:                 && now_unix.saturating_sub(captured) > max_age
1064:             {
1065:                 problems.push("captured_at_unix is stale".to_string());
1066:             }
1067:         }
1068:         None => problems.push("captured_at_unix must be a positive integer".to_string()),
1069:     }
1070: 
1071:     let git_commit = payload_object
1072:         .get("git_commit")
1073:         .and_then(Value::as_str)
1074:         .unwrap_or_default();
1075:     if !is_lower_hex_commit(git_commit) {
1076:         problems.push("git_commit must be a 40-character lowercase hex commit id".to_string());
1077:     }
1078: 
1079:     let status = payload_object
1080:         .get("status")
1081:         .and_then(Value::as_str)
1082:         .unwrap_or_default();
1083:     if status != CHECK_PASS && status != CHECK_FAIL {
1084:         problems.push("status must be 'pass' or 'fail'".to_string());
1085:     }
1086: 
1087:     match payload_object
1088:         .get("participants")
1089:         .and_then(Value::as_object)
1090:     {
1091:         Some(participants) => {
1092:             for field in spec.required_participants {
1093:                 if value_as_non_empty_string(participants.get(*field)).is_none() {
1094:                     problems.push(format!("participants.{field} must be a non-empty string"));
1095:                 }
1096:             }
1097:         }
1098:         None => problems.push("participants must be an object".to_string()),
1099:     }
1100: 
1101:     match payload_object
1102:         .get("network_context")
1103:         .and_then(Value::as_object)
1104:     {
1105:         Some(network_context) => {
1106:             for field in spec.required_network_fields {
1107:                 if value_as_non_empty_string(network_context.get(*field)).is_none() {
1108:                     problems.push(format!(
1109:                         "network_context.{field} must be a non-empty string"
1110:                     ));
1111:                 }
1112:             }
1113:             let client_network_id =
1114:                 value_as_non_empty_string(network_context.get("client_network_id"));
1115:             let exit_network_id = value_as_non_empty_string(network_context.get("exit_network_id"));
1116:             if let (Some(client), Some(exit)) = (client_network_id, exit_network_id)
1117:                 && client == exit
1118:             {
1119:                 problems.push("client_network_id and exit_network_id must differ".to_string());
1120:             }
1121:         }
1122:         None => problems.push("network_context must be an object".to_string()),
1123:     }
1124: 
1125:     let report_dir = report_path
1126:         .parent()
1127:         .map(Path::to_path_buf)
1128:         .unwrap_or_else(|| PathBuf::from("."));
1129:     let repo_root = std::env::current_dir().unwrap_or_else(|_| PathBuf::from("."));
1130:     for field_name in ["source_artifacts", "log_artifacts"] {
1131:         match payload_object.get(field_name).and_then(Value::as_array) {
1132:             Some(entries) if !entries.is_empty() => {
1133:                 for entry in entries {
1134:                     let Some(raw_path) = entry.as_str() else {
1135:                         problems.push(format!("{field_name} contains an invalid path entry"));
1136:                         continue;
1137:                     };
1138:                     if raw_path.trim().is_empty() {
1139:                         problems.push(format!("{field_name} contains an invalid path entry"));
1140:                         continue;
1141:                     }
1142:                     if raw_path
1143:                         .chars()
1144:                         .any(|value| matches!(value, '\n' | '\r' | '\t'))
1145:                     {
1146:                         problems.push(format!(
1147:                             "{field_name} contains control characters in path entry"
1148:                         ));
1149:                         continue;
1150:                     }
1151:                     let artifact_path = resolve_artifact_path(report_path, raw_path);
1152:                     if !artifact_path.exists() {
1153:                         problems.push(format!("{field_name} path does not exist: {raw_path}"));
1154:                         continue;
1155:                     }
1156:                     match fs::symlink_metadata(&artifact_path) {
1157:                         Ok(metadata) => {
1158:                             if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
1159:                                 problems.push(format!(
1160:                                     "{field_name} path must not be a symlink: {raw_path}"
1161:                                 ));
1162:                                 continue;
1163:                             }
1164:                             if !metadata.file_type().is_file() {
1165:                                 problems.push(format!(
1166:                                     "{field_name} path must be a regular file: {raw_path}"
1167:                                 ));
1168:                                 continue;
1169:                             }
1170:                         }
1171:                         Err(err) => {
1172:                             problems.push(format!(
1173:                                 "{field_name} path metadata check failed ({raw_path}): {err}"
1174:                             ));
1175:                             continue;
1176:                         }
1177:                     }
1178:                     if !path_is_within(&artifact_path, &report_dir)
1179:                         && !path_is_within(&artifact_path, &repo_root)
1180:                     {
1181:                         problems.push(format!(
1182:                             "{field_name} path must stay within report directory or repository root: {raw_path}"
1183:                         ));
1184:                     }
1185:                 }
1186:             }
1187:             _ => problems.push(format!("{field_name} must be a non-empty list")),
1188:         }
1189:     }
1190: 
1191:     let checks = payload_object.get("checks").and_then(Value::as_object);
1192:     match checks {
1193:         Some(check_map) => {
1194:             for check_name in spec.required_checks {
1195:                 let value = check_map
1196:                     .get(*check_name)
1197:                     .and_then(Value::as_str)
1198:                     .unwrap_or_default();
1199:                 if value != CHECK_PASS && value != CHECK_FAIL {
1200:                     problems.push(format!(
1201:                         "checks.{check_name} must be one of [\"fail\", \"pass\"], got {value:?}"
1202:                     ));
1203:                 }
1204:             }
1205:         }
1206:         None => problems.push("checks must be an object".to_string()),
1207:     }
1208: 
1209:     let failure_summary = payload_object
1210:         .get("failure_summary")
1211:         .and_then(Value::as_str)
1212:         .unwrap_or_default()
1213:         .to_string();
1214:     if status == CHECK_PASS {
1215:         if let Some(check_map) = checks {
1216:             let failing = spec
1217:                 .required_checks
1218:                 .iter()
1219:                 .filter(|name| check_map.get(**name).and_then(Value::as_str) != Some(CHECK_PASS))
1220:                 .copied()
1221:                 .collect::<Vec<_>>();
1222:             if !failing.is_empty() {
1223:                 problems.push(format!(
1224:                     "status=pass requires all required checks to pass; failing checks: {}",
1225:                     failing.join(", ")
1226:                 ));
1227:             }
1228:         }
1229:         if !failure_summary.trim().is_empty() {
1230:             problems.push("failure_summary must be absent or empty when status=pass".to_string());
1231:         }
1232:     } else if status == CHECK_FAIL {
1233:         if failure_summary.trim().is_empty() {
1234:             problems.push("failure_summary must be non-empty when status=fail".to_string());
1235:         }
1236:         if let Some(check_map) = checks {
1237:             let all_required_checks_pass = spec
1238:                 .required_checks
1239:                 .iter()
1240:                 .all(|name| check_map.get(*name).and_then(Value::as_str) == Some(CHECK_PASS));
1241:             if all_required_checks_pass {
1242:                 problems
1243:                     .push("status=fail requires at least one required check to fail".to_string());
1244:             }
1245:         }
1246:     }
1247: 
1248:     let path_evidence = payload_object
1249:         .get("path_evidence")
1250:         .and_then(Value::as_object);
1251:     let requires_live_path_evidence =
1252:         status == CHECK_PASS && !matches!(spec.suite, "cross_network_traversal_adversarial");
1253:     if requires_live_path_evidence && path_evidence.is_none() {
1254:         problems.push("path_evidence must be present for pass reports".to_string());
1255:     }
1256:     if let Some(path_evidence) = path_evidence {
1257:         let path_mode = value_as_non_empty_string(path_evidence.get("path_mode"));
1258:         let path_reason = value_as_non_empty_string(path_evidence.get("path_reason"));
1259:         let path_programmed_mode =
1260:             value_as_non_empty_string(path_evidence.get("path_programmed_mode"));
1261:         let path_live_proven = path_evidence
1262:             .get("path_live_proven")
1263:             .and_then(Value::as_bool);
1264:         let path_latest_live_handshake_unix = path_evidence
1265:             .get("path_latest_live_handshake_unix")
1266:             .and_then(Value::as_u64)
1267:             .filter(|value| *value > 0);
1268:         let relay_session_state =
1269:             value_as_non_empty_string(path_evidence.get("relay_session_state"));
1270:         let traversal_alarm_state =
1271:             value_as_non_empty_string(path_evidence.get("traversal_alarm_state"));
1272:         let traversal_alarm_reason =
1273:             value_as_non_empty_string(path_evidence.get("traversal_alarm_reason"));
1274:         let dns_alarm_state = value_as_non_empty_string(path_evidence.get("dns_alarm_state"));
1275:         let dns_alarm_reason = value_as_non_empty_string(path_evidence.get("dns_alarm_reason"));
1276:         let traversal_error = value_as_non_empty_string(path_evidence.get("traversal_error"));
1277:         let transport_socket_identity_state =
1278:             value_as_non_empty_string(path_evidence.get("transport_socket_identity_state"));
1279:         let transport_socket_identity_error =
1280:             value_as_non_empty_string(path_evidence.get("transport_socket_identity_error"));
1281:         let transport_socket_identity_label =
1282:             value_as_non_empty_string(path_evidence.get("transport_socket_identity_label"));
1283:         let transport_socket_identity_local_addr =
1284:             value_as_non_empty_string(path_evidence.get("transport_socket_identity_local_addr"));
1285: 
1286:         if requires_live_path_evidence {
1287:             if path_mode.is_none() {
1288:                 problems.push("path_evidence.path_mode must be a non-empty string".to_string());
1289:             }
1290:             if path_reason.is_none() {
1291:                 problems.push("path_evidence.path_reason must be a non-empty string".to_string());
1292:             }
1293:             if path_programmed_mode.is_none() {
1294:                 problems.push(
1295:                     "path_evidence.path_programmed_mode must be a non-empty string".to_string(),
1296:                 );
1297:             }
1298:             if path_live_proven != Some(true) {
1299:                 problems.push("path_evidence.path_live_proven must be true".to_string());
1300:             }
1301:             if path_latest_live_handshake_unix.is_none() {
1302:                 problems.push(
1303:                     "path_evidence.path_latest_live_handshake_unix must be a positive integer"
1304:                         .to_string(),
1305:                 );
1306:             }
1307:             if transport_socket_identity_state.as_deref()
1308:                 != Some("authoritative_backend_shared_transport")
1309:             {
1310:                 problems.push(
1311:                     "path_evidence.transport_socket_identity_state must equal authoritative_backend_shared_transport for pass reports"
1312:                         .to_string(),
1313:                 );
1314:             }
1315:             if transport_socket_identity_error.as_deref() != Some("none") {
1316:                 problems.push(
1317:                     "path_evidence.transport_socket_identity_error must equal none for pass reports"
1318:                         .to_string(),
1319:                 );
1320:             }
1321:             if transport_socket_identity_label
1322:                 .as_deref()
1323:                 .is_none_or(|value| value == "none")
1324:             {
1325:                 problems.push(
1326:                     "path_evidence.transport_socket_identity_label must be a non-empty backend identity label"
1327:                         .to_string(),
1328:                 );
1329:             }
1330:             if transport_socket_identity_local_addr
1331:                 .as_deref()
1332:                 .is_none_or(|value| value == "none")
1333:             {
1334:                 problems.push(
1335:                     "path_evidence.transport_socket_identity_local_addr must be a non-empty backend local address"
1336:                         .to_string(),
1337:                 );
1338:             }
1339:             if traversal_alarm_state
1340:                 .as_deref()
1341:                 .is_some_and(|value| matches!(value, "critical" | "error" | "missing"))
1342:             {
1343:                 problems.push(
1344:                     "path_evidence.traversal_alarm_state must not be critical|error|missing for pass reports"
1345:                         .to_string(),
1346:                 );
1347:             }
1348:             if dns_alarm_state
1349:                 .as_deref()
1350:                 .is_some_and(|value| matches!(value, "critical" | "error" | "missing"))
1351:             {
1352:                 problems.push(
1353:                     "path_evidence.dns_alarm_state must not be critical|error|missing for pass reports"
1354:                         .to_string(),
1355:                 );
1356:             }
1357:             if traversal_error
1358:                 .as_deref()
1359:                 .is_some_and(|value| value != "none")
1360:             {
1361:                 problems.push(
1362:                     "path_evidence.traversal_error must equal none for pass reports".to_string(),
1363:                 );
1364:             }
1365:             if traversal_alarm_reason
1366:                 .as_deref()
1367:                 .is_some_and(|value| value != "none")
1368:             {
1369:                 problems.push(
1370:                     "path_evidence.traversal_alarm_reason must equal none for pass reports"
1371:                         .to_string(),
1372:                 );
1373:             }
1374:             if dns_alarm_reason
1375:                 .as_deref()
1376:                 .is_some_and(|value| value != "none")
1377:             {
1378:                 problems.push(
1379:                     "path_evidence.dns_alarm_reason must equal none for pass reports".to_string(),
1380:                 );
1381:             }
1382:         }
1383: 
1384:         if let Some(path_mode) = path_mode.as_deref() {
1385:             if requires_live_path_evidence && path_mode.ends_with("_programmed") {
1386:                 problems.push(
1387:                     "path_evidence.path_mode must represent a live path, not a programmed path"
1388:                         .to_string(),
1389:                 );
1390:             }
1391:             match spec.suite {
1392:                 "cross_network_direct_remote_exit" if status == CHECK_PASS => {
1393:                     if path_mode != "direct_active" {
1394:                         problems.push(
1395:                             "direct remote-exit pass reports require path_evidence.path_mode=direct_active"
1396:                                 .to_string(),
1397:                         );
1398:                     }
1399:                 }
1400:                 "cross_network_relay_remote_exit" if status == CHECK_PASS => {
1401:                     if path_mode != "relay_active" {
1402:                         problems.push(
1403:                             "relay remote-exit pass reports require path_evidence.path_mode=relay_active"
1404:                                 .to_string(),
1405:                         );
1406:                     }
1407:                     if relay_session_state.as_deref() != Some("live") {
1408:                         problems.push(
1409:                             "relay remote-exit pass reports require path_evidence.relay_session_state=live"
1410:                                 .to_string(),
1411:                         );
1412:                     }
1413:                 }
1414:                 "cross_network_failback_roaming" if status == CHECK_PASS => {
1415:                     if path_mode != "direct_active" {
1416:                         problems.push(
1417:                             "failback pass reports require path_evidence.path_mode=direct_active"
1418:                                 .to_string(),
1419:                         );
1420:                     }
1421:                 }
1422:                 _ => {}
1423:             }
1424:         }
1425:     }
1426: 
1427:     if status == CHECK_PASS {
1428:         if let Some(entries) = payload_object
1429:             .get("source_artifacts")
1430:             .and_then(Value::as_array)
1431:         {
1432:             for basename in spec.required_pass_source_artifacts {
1433:                 if !artifact_list_has_basename(entries, basename) {
1434:                     problems.push(format!(
1435:                         "source_artifacts must include measured evidence file {basename:?}"
1436:                     ));
1437:                 }
1438:             }
1439:             for basename in spec
1440:                 .required_pass_source_artifacts
1441:                 .iter()
1442:                 .copied()
1443:                 .filter(|basename| basename.ends_with("_ssh_trust_summary.txt"))
1444:             {
1445:                 match resolve_artifact_by_basename(report_path, entries, basename) {
1446:                     Ok(Some(path)) => {
1447:                         problems.extend(validate_ssh_trust_summary_artifact(path.as_path()))
1448:                     }
1449:                     Ok(None) => {}
1450:                     Err(err) => problems.push(err),
1451:                 }
1452:             }
1453:             if spec.suite == "cross_network_remote_exit_soak" {
1454:                 match resolve_artifact_by_basename(
1455:                     report_path,
1456:                     entries,
1457:                     "cross_network_remote_exit_soak_monitor_summary.json",
1458:                 ) {
1459:                     Ok(Some(path)) => {
1460:                         problems.extend(validate_soak_monitor_summary_artifact(path.as_path()))
1461:                     }
1462:                     Ok(None) => {}
1463:                     Err(err) => problems.push(err),
1464:                 }
1465:             }
1466:         }
1467:         if let Some(entries) = payload_object
1468:             .get("log_artifacts")
1469:             .and_then(Value::as_array)
1470:         {
1471:             for basename in spec.required_pass_log_artifacts {
1472:                 if !artifact_list_has_basename(entries, basename) {
1473:                     problems.push(format!(
1474:                         "log_artifacts must include measured evidence file {basename:?}"
1475:                     ));
1476:                 }
1477:             }
1478:         }
1479:     }
1480: 
1481:     problems
1482:         .into_iter()
1483:         .map(|problem| format!("{}: {problem}", report_path.display()))
1484:         .collect()
1485: }

1487: fn collect_report_paths(
1488:     reports: &[PathBuf],
1489:     artifact_dir: Option<PathBuf>,
1490: ) -> Result<Vec<PathBuf>, String> {
1491:     if !reports.is_empty() {
1492:         let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(reports.len());
1493:         for path in reports {
1494:             out.push(resolve_path(path)?);
1495:         }
1496:         return Ok(out);
1497:     }
1498:     let base_dir = match artifact_dir {
1499:         Some(path) => resolve_path(&path)?,
1500:         None => resolve_path(Path::new(DEFAULT_ARTIFACT_DIR))?,
1501:     };
1502:     let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(REPORT_SPECS.len());
1503:     for spec in REPORT_SPECS {
1504:         out.push(base_dir.join(spec.filename));
1505:     }
1506:     Ok(out)
1507: }
1508: 
1509: fn parse_report_payload(path: &Path) -> Result<Value, String> {
1510:     let body = fs::read_to_string(path)
1511:         .map_err(|err| format!("{}: read report failed: {err}", path.display()))?;
1512:     let payload: Value = serde_json::from_str(&body)
1513:         .map_err(|err| format!("{}: invalid JSON ({err})", path.display()))?;
1514:     if !payload.is_object() {
1515:         return Err(format!("{}: report must be a JSON object", path.display()));
1516:     }
1517:     Ok(payload)
1518: }

1520: fn markdown_for_schema_validation(report_paths: &[PathBuf], errors: &[String]) -> String {
1521:     let mut lines = vec![
1522:         "# Cross-Network Remote Exit Report Validation".to_string(),
1523:         String::new(),
1524:         "## Reports".to_string(),
1525:         String::new(),
1526:     ];
1527:     for path in report_paths {
1528:         lines.push(format!("- `{}`", path.display()));
1529:     }
1530:     lines.push(String::new());
1531:     if errors.is_empty() {
1532:         lines.push("## Result".to_string());
1533:         lines.push(String::new());
1534:         lines.push(
1535:             "All supplied cross-network remote-exit reports matched the required schema."
1536:                 .to_string(),
1537:         );
1538:         lines.push(String::new());
1539:     } else {
1540:         lines.push("## Errors".to_string());
1541:         lines.push(String::new());
1542:         for error in errors {
1543:             lines.push(format!("- {error}"));
1544:         }
1545:         lines.push(String::new());
1546:     }
1547:     lines.join("\n")
1548: }

1550: fn parse_csv_unique(raw: &str) -> Vec<String> {
1551:     let mut out = Vec::new();
1552:     let mut seen = HashSet::new();
1553:     for entry in raw
1554:         .split(',')
1555:         .map(str::trim)
1556:         .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
1557:     {
1558:         if seen.insert(entry.to_string()) {
1559:             out.push(entry.to_string());
1560:         }
1561:     }
1562:     out
1563: }

1565: fn normalize_required_nat_profiles(required_nat_profiles: &[String]) -> Vec<String> {
1566:     if required_nat_profiles.is_empty() {
1567:         return parse_csv_unique(DEFAULT_REQUIRED_NAT_PROFILES);
1568:     }
1569:     let joined = required_nat_profiles.join(",");
1570:     let parsed = parse_csv_unique(&joined);
1571:     if parsed.is_empty() {
1572:         parse_csv_unique(DEFAULT_REQUIRED_NAT_PROFILES)
1573:     } else {
1574:         parsed
1575:     }
1576: }

1578: fn validate_report_paths(
1579:     report_paths: &[PathBuf],
1580:     max_evidence_age_seconds: u64,
1581:     expected_git_commit: Option<&str>,
1582:     require_pass_status: bool,
1583: ) -> Vec<String> {
1584:     let mut errors = Vec::new();
1585: 
1586:     for path in report_paths {
1587:         if !path.is_file() {
1588:             errors.push(format!("{}: missing report file", path.display()));
1589:             continue;
1590:         }
1591:         let payload = match parse_report_payload(path) {
1592:             Ok(payload) => payload,
1593:             Err(err) => {
1594:                 errors.push(err);
1595:                 continue;
1596:             }
1597:         };
1598:         errors.extend(validate_report_payload(
1599:             path,
1600:             &payload,
1601:             Some(max_evidence_age_seconds),
1602:             None,
1603:         ));
1604:         if let Some(expected) = expected_git_commit {
1605:             let got = payload
1606:                 .as_object()
1607:                 .and_then(|value| value.get("git_commit"))
1608:                 .and_then(Value::as_str)
1609:                 .unwrap_or_default();
1610:             if got != expected {
1611:                 errors.push(format!(
1612:                     "{}: git_commit {:?} does not match expected {:?}",
1613:                     path.display(),
1614:                     got,
1615:                     expected
1616:                 ));
1617:             }
1618:         }
1619:         if require_pass_status {
1620:             let status = payload
1621:                 .as_object()
1622:                 .and_then(|value| value.get("status"))
1623:                 .and_then(Value::as_str)
1624:                 .unwrap_or_default();
1625:             if status != CHECK_PASS {
1626:                 errors.push(format!(
1627:                     "{}: status must be 'pass' for gate usage",
1628:                     path.display()
1629:                 ));
1630:             }
1631:         }
1632:     }
1633: 
1634:     errors
1635: }
1636: 
1637: fn collect_matrix_paths(
1638:     reports: &[PathBuf],
1639:     artifact_dir: Option<PathBuf>,
1640: ) -> Result<Vec<PathBuf>, String> {
1641:     if !reports.is_empty() {
1642:         let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(reports.len());
1643:         for path in reports {
1644:             out.push(resolve_path(path)?);
1645:         }
1646:         return Ok(out);
1647:     }
1648:     let base_dir = match artifact_dir {
1649:         Some(path) => resolve_path(&path)?,
1650:         None => resolve_path(Path::new(DEFAULT_ARTIFACT_DIR))?,
1651:     };
1652:     if !base_dir.is_dir() {
1653:         return Ok(Vec::new());
1654:     }
1655:     let mut out = Vec::new();
1656:     let entries = fs::read_dir(&base_dir).map_err(|err| {
1657:         format!(
1658:             "list artifact directory failed ({}): {err}",
1659:             base_dir.display()
1660:         )
1661:     })?;
1662:     for entry in entries {
1663:         let entry = entry.map_err(|err| format!("read directory entry failed: {err}"))?;
1664:         let path = entry.path();
1665:         if path.extension().and_then(|value| value.to_str()) == Some("json") {
1666:             out.push(path);
1667:         }
1668:     }
1669:     out.sort();
1670:     Ok(out)
1671: }
1672: 
1673: pub fn default_required_nat_profiles() -> Vec<String> {
1674:     parse_csv_unique(DEFAULT_REQUIRED_NAT_PROFILES)
1675: }
1676: 
1677: pub fn validate_cross_network_remote_exit_readiness(
1678:     artifact_dir: &Path,
1679:     max_evidence_age_seconds: u64,
1680:     expected_git_commit: Option<&str>,
1681:     required_nat_profiles: &[String],
1682: ) -> Result<(), String> {
1683:     let report_paths = collect_report_paths(&[], Some(artifact_dir.to_path_buf()))?;
1684:     let mut errors = validate_report_paths(
1685:         &report_paths,
1686:         max_evidence_age_seconds,
1687:         expected_git_commit,
1688:         true,
1689:     );
1690: 
1691:     let matrix_paths = collect_matrix_paths(&[], Some(artifact_dir.to_path_buf()))?;
1692:     let (records, matrix_errors) = discover_matrix_records(
1693:         &matrix_paths,
1694:         max_evidence_age_seconds,
1695:         expected_git_commit,
1696:         true,
1697:     );
1698:     errors.extend(matrix_errors);
1699: 
1700:     let normalized_profiles = normalize_required_nat_profiles(required_nat_profiles);
1701:     errors.extend(validate_matrix(&records, &normalized_profiles));
1702: 
1703:     if errors.is_empty() {
1704:         Ok(())
1705:     } else {
1706:         Err(errors.join("\n"))
1707:     }
1708: }
1709: 
1710: fn discover_matrix_records(
1711:     report_paths: &[PathBuf],
1712:     max_evidence_age_seconds: u64,
1713:     expected_git_commit: Option<&str>,
1714:     require_pass_status: bool,
1715: ) -> (Vec<ReportRecord>, Vec<String>) {
1716:     let known_suites = REPORT_SPECS
1717:         .iter()
1718:         .map(|spec| spec.suite)
1719:         .collect::<HashSet<_>>();
1720:     let mut records = Vec::new();
1721:     let mut errors = Vec::new();
1722: 
1723:     for path in report_paths {
1724:         if !path.is_file() {
1725:             errors.push(format!("{}: missing report file", path.display()));
1726:             continue;
1727:         }
1728:         let payload = match parse_report_payload(path) {
1729:             Ok(payload) => payload,
1730:             Err(err) => {
1731:                 errors.push(err);
1732:                 continue;
1733:             }
1734:         };
1735:         let suite = payload
1736:             .as_object()
1737:             .and_then(|value| value.get("suite"))
1738:             .and_then(Value::as_str)
1739:             .unwrap_or_default()
1740:             .to_string();
1741:         if !known_suites.contains(suite.as_str()) {
1742:             continue;
1743:         }
1744: 
1745:         errors.extend(validate_report_payload(
1746:             path,
1747:             &payload,
1748:             Some(max_evidence_age_seconds),
1749:             None,
1750:         ));
1751:         if let Some(expected) = expected_git_commit {
1752:             let got = payload
1753:                 .as_object()
1754:                 .and_then(|value| value.get("git_commit"))
1755:                 .and_then(Value::as_str)
1756:                 .unwrap_or_default();
1757:             if got != expected {
1758:                 errors.push(format!(
1759:                     "{}: git_commit {:?} does not match expected {:?}",
1760:                     path.display(),
1761:                     got,
1762:                     expected
1763:                 ));
1764:             }
1765:         }
1766:         let status = payload
1767:             .as_object()
1768:             .and_then(|value| value.get("status"))
1769:             .and_then(Value::as_str)
1770:             .unwrap_or_default()
1771:             .to_string();
1772:         if require_pass_status && status != CHECK_PASS {
1773:             errors.push(format!(
1774:                 "{}: status must be 'pass' for matrix validation",
1775:                 path.display()
1776:             ));
1777:         }
1778: 
1779:         let Some(network_context) = payload
1780:             .as_object()
1781:             .and_then(|value| value.get("network_context"))
1782:             .and_then(Value::as_object)
1783:         else {
1784:             errors.push(format!(
1785:                 "{}: network_context must be an object",
1786:                 path.display()
1787:             ));
1788:             continue;
1789:         };
1790:         let nat_profile = value_as_non_empty_string(network_context.get("nat_profile"));
1791:         if nat_profile.is_none() {
1792:             errors.push(format!(
1793:                 "{}: network_context.nat_profile must be non-empty",
1794:                 path.display()
1795:             ));
1796:             continue;
1797:         }
1798:         let impairment_profile =
1799:             value_as_non_empty_string(network_context.get("impairment_profile"));
1800:         if impairment_profile.is_none() {
1801:             errors.push(format!(
1802:                 "{}: network_context.impairment_profile must be non-empty",
1803:                 path.display()
1804:             ));
1805:             continue;
1806:         }
1807:         records.push(ReportRecord {
1808:             path: path.clone(),
1809:             suite,
1810:             nat_profile: nat_profile.unwrap_or_default(),
1811:             impairment_profile: impairment_profile.unwrap_or_default(),
1812:             status,
1813:         });
1814:     }
1815: 
1816:     (records, errors)
1817: }
1818: 
1819: fn validate_matrix(records: &[ReportRecord], required_nat_profiles: &[String]) -> Vec<String> {
1820:     let mut errors = Vec::new();
1821:     if required_nat_profiles.is_empty() {
1822:         errors.push("required_nat_profiles must not be empty".to_string());
1823:         return errors;
1824:     }
1825: 
1826:     for spec in REPORT_SPECS {
1827:         for profile in required_nat_profiles {
1828:             let found = records
1829:                 .iter()
1830:                 .any(|record| record.suite == spec.suite && record.nat_profile == *profile);
1831:             if !found {
1832:                 errors.push(format!(
1833:                     "missing matrix evidence: suite={} nat_profile={}",
1834:                     spec.suite, profile
1835:                 ));
1836:             }
1837:         }
1838:     }
1839: 
1840:     errors
1841: }
1842: 
1843: fn markdown_for_nat_matrix(
1844:     report_paths: &[PathBuf],
1845:     required_nat_profiles: &[String],
1846:     records: &[ReportRecord],
1847:     errors: &[String],
1848: ) -> String {
1849:     let mut lines = vec![
1850:         "# Cross-Network NAT Matrix Validation".to_string(),
1851:         String::new(),
1852:         "## Required NAT Profiles".to_string(),
1853:         String::new(),
1854:     ];
1855:     for profile in required_nat_profiles {
1856:         lines.push(format!("- `{profile}`"));
1857:     }
1858:     lines.push(String::new());
1859:     lines.push("## Reports Considered".to_string());
1860:     lines.push(String::new());
1861:     if report_paths.is_empty() {
1862:         lines.push("- none".to_string());
1863:     } else {
1864:         for path in report_paths {
1865:             lines.push(format!("- `{}`", path.display()));
1866:         }
1867:     }
1868:     lines.push(String::new());
1869:     lines.push("## Matrix Records".to_string());
1870:     lines.push(String::new());
1871:     if records.is_empty() {
1872:         lines.push("- none".to_string());
1873:     } else {
1874:         let mut sorted = records.iter().collect::<Vec<_>>();
1875:         sorted.sort_by(|left, right| {
1876:             left.suite
1877:                 .cmp(&right.suite)
1878:                 .then_with(|| left.nat_profile.cmp(&right.nat_profile))
1879:                 .then_with(|| left.path.cmp(&right.path))
1880:         });
1881:         for record in sorted {
1882:             lines.push(format!(
1883:                 "- suite=`{}` nat_profile=`{}` impairment_profile=`{}` status=`{}` path=`{}`",
1884:                 record.suite,
1885:                 record.nat_profile,
1886:                 record.impairment_profile,
1887:                 record.status,
1888:                 record.path.display()
1889:             ));
1890:         }
1891:     }
1892:     lines.push(String::new());
1893:     lines.push("## Result".to_string());
1894:     lines.push(String::new());
1895:     if errors.is_empty() {
1896:         lines.push("Matrix validation passed.".to_string());
1897:     } else {
1898:         for error in errors {
1899:             lines.push(format!("- {error}"));
1900:         }
1901:     }
1902:     lines.push(String::new());
1903:     lines.join("\n")
1904: }

1906: fn write_markdown(path: &Path, body: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
1907:     if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
1908:         fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|err| {
1909:             format!(
1910:                 "create output parent directory failed ({}): {err}",
1911:                 parent.display()
1912:             )
1913:         })?;
1914:     }
1915:     fs::write(path, body).map_err(|err| format!("write output failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))
1916: }

1918: pub fn execute_ops_generate_cross_network_remote_exit_report(
1919:     config: GenerateCrossNetworkRemoteExitReportConfig,
1920: ) -> Result<String, String> {
1921:     let spec = report_spec_by_suite(config.suite.as_str()).ok_or_else(|| {
1922:         let known = REPORT_SPECS
1923:             .iter()
1924:             .map(|entry| entry.suite)
1925:             .collect::<Vec<_>>()
1926:             .join(", ");
1927:         format!(
1928:             "unknown suite {:?}; expected one of {known}",
1929:             config.suite.as_str()
1930:         )
1931:     })?;
1932: 
1933:     let status = config.status.trim().to_string();
1934:     if status != CHECK_PASS && status != CHECK_FAIL {
1935:         return Err("status must be pass or fail".to_string());
1936:     }
1937: 
1938:     let report_path = resolve_path(&config.report_path)?;
1939:     let log_path = resolve_path(&config.log_path)?;
1940:     if let Some(parent) = report_path.parent() {
1941:         fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|err| {
1942:             format!(
1943:                 "create report output directory failed ({}): {err}",
1944:                 parent.display()
1945:             )
1946:         })?;
1947:     }
1948:     if let Some(parent) = log_path.parent() {
1949:         fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|err| {
1950:             format!(
1951:                 "create log output directory failed ({}): {err}",
1952:                 parent.display()
1953:             )
1954:         })?;
1955:     }
1956:     if !log_path.exists() {
1957:         fs::write(&log_path, "").map_err(|err| {
1958:             format!(
1959:                 "initialize log artifact failed ({}): {err}",
1960:                 log_path.display()
1961:             )
1962:         })?;
1963:     }
1964: 
1965:     let check_overrides = parse_check_overrides(&config.check_overrides)?;
1966:     let mut checks = Map::new();
1967:     for check in spec.required_checks {
1968:         checks.insert((*check).to_string(), Value::String(CHECK_FAIL.to_string()));
1969:     }
1970:     for (key, value) in check_overrides {
1971:         checks.insert(key, Value::String(value));
1972:     }
1973: 
1974:     let mut participants = Map::new();
1975:     if let Some(value) = non_empty_option(config.client_host) {
1976:         participants.insert("client_host".to_string(), Value::String(value));
1977:     }
1978:     if let Some(value) = non_empty_option(config.exit_host) {
1979:         participants.insert("exit_host".to_string(), Value::String(value));
1980:     }
1981:     if let Some(value) = non_empty_option(config.relay_host) {
1982:         participants.insert("relay_host".to_string(), Value::String(value));
1983:     }
1984:     if let Some(value) = non_empty_option(config.probe_host) {
1985:         participants.insert("probe_host".to_string(), Value::String(value));
1986:     }
1987: 
1988:     let mut network_context = Map::new();
1989:     if let Some(value) = non_empty_option(config.client_network_id) {
1990:         network_context.insert("client_network_id".to_string(), Value::String(value));
1991:     }
1992:     if let Some(value) = non_empty_option(config.exit_network_id) {
1993:         network_context.insert("exit_network_id".to_string(), Value::String(value));
1994:     }
1995:     if let Some(value) = non_empty_option(config.relay_network_id) {
1996:         network_context.insert("relay_network_id".to_string(), Value::String(value));
1997:     }
1998:     if !config.nat_profile.trim().is_empty() {
1999:         network_context.insert(
2000:             "nat_profile".to_string(),
2001:             Value::String(config.nat_profile.trim().to_string()),
2002:         );
2003:     }
2004:     if !config.impairment_profile.trim().is_empty() {
2005:         network_context.insert(
2006:             "impairment_profile".to_string(),
2007:             Value::String(config.impairment_profile.trim().to_string()),
2008:         );
2009:     }
2010: 
2011:     let mut source_artifact_inputs = Vec::with_capacity(config.source_artifacts.len());
2012:     source_artifact_inputs.extend(config.source_artifacts.iter().cloned());
2013:     let source_artifacts = collect_existing_artifacts(&source_artifact_inputs);
2014: 
2015:     let mut log_artifact_inputs = Vec::with_capacity(config.log_artifacts.len() + 1);
2016:     log_artifact_inputs.push(log_path.clone());
2017:     log_artifact_inputs.extend(config.log_artifacts.iter().cloned());
2018:     let log_artifacts = collect_existing_artifacts(&log_artifact_inputs);
2019: 
2020:     let mut payload = json!({
2021:         "schema_version": SCHEMA_VERSION,
2022:         "phase": PHASE_NAME,
2023:         "suite": spec.suite,
2024:         "environment": if config.environment.trim().is_empty() { "live_linux_skeleton".to_string() } else { config.environment.trim().to_string() },
2025:         "evidence_mode": EVIDENCE_MODE,
2026:         "captured_at_unix": unix_now(),
2027:         "git_commit": current_git_commit()?,
2028:         "status": status,
2029:         "participants": Value::Object(participants),
2030:         "network_context": Value::Object(network_context),
2031:         "checks": Value::Object(checks),
2032:         "source_artifacts": source_artifacts,
2033:         "log_artifacts": log_artifacts,
2034:         "implementation_state": if config.implementation_state.trim().is_empty() {
2035:             "not_implemented".to_string()
2036:         } else {
2037:             config.implementation_state.trim().to_string()
2038:         },
2039:     });
2040:     if let Some(path_evidence) = resolve_optional_path_evidence(
2041:         &status,
2042:         config.path_status_line,
2043:         config.path_evidence_report,
2044:     )? {
2045:         payload
2046:             .as_object_mut()
2047:             .expect("payload object")
2048:             .insert("path_evidence".to_string(), path_evidence);
2049:     }
2050:     if status == CHECK_FAIL {
2051:         let failure_summary = if config.failure_summary.trim().is_empty() {
2052:             format!("{} is not implemented yet", spec.title)
2053:         } else {
2054:             config.failure_summary.trim().to_string()
2055:         };
2056:         if let Some(object) = payload.as_object_mut() {
2057:             object.insert(
2058:                 "failure_summary".to_string(),
2059:                 Value::String(failure_summary),
2060:             );
2061:         }
2062:     }
2063: 
2064:     let problems = validate_report_payload(&report_path, &payload, None, None);
2065:     if !problems.is_empty() {
2066:         return Err(problems.join("\n"));
2067:     }
2068: 
2069:     let rendered = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&payload)
2070:         .map_err(|err| format!("serialize report failed: {err}"))?;
2071:     fs::write(&report_path, format!("{rendered}\n"))
2072:         .map_err(|err| format!("write report failed ({}): {err}", report_path.display()))?;
2073: 
2074:     Ok(format!(
2075:         "cross-network report generated: suite={} status={} output={}",
2076:         spec.suite,
2077:         status,
2078:         report_path.display()
2079:     ))
2080: }

2159: 
2160: fn same_prefix(
2161:     ip_a: IpAddr,
2162:     ip_b: IpAddr,
2163:     ipv4_prefix: u8,
2164:     ipv6_prefix: u8,
2165: ) -> Result<bool, String> {
2166:     match (ip_a, ip_b) {
2167:         (IpAddr::V4(a), IpAddr::V4(b)) => {
2168:             if ipv4_prefix > 32 {
2169:                 return Err(format!("invalid IPv4 prefix length: {ipv4_prefix}"));
2170:             }
2171:             let mask = if ipv4_prefix == 0 {
2172:                 0u32
2173:             } else {
2174:                 u32::MAX << (32 - ipv4_prefix)
2175:             };
2176:             let a_bits = u32::from(a);
2177:             let b_bits = u32::from(b);
2178:             Ok((a_bits & mask) == (b_bits & mask))
2179:         }
2180:         (IpAddr::V6(a), IpAddr::V6(b)) => {
2181:             if ipv6_prefix > 128 {
2182:                 return Err(format!("invalid IPv6 prefix length: {ipv6_prefix}"));
2183:             }
2184:             let mask = if ipv6_prefix == 0 {
2185:                 0u128
2186:             } else {
2187:                 u128::MAX << (128 - ipv6_prefix)
2188:             };
2189:             let a_bits = u128::from_be_bytes(a.octets());
2190:             let b_bits = u128::from_be_bytes(b.octets());
2191:             Ok((a_bits & mask) == (b_bits & mask))
2192:         }
2193:         _ => Err("ip-a and ip-b must use the same IP family".to_string()),
2194:     }
2195: }

2197: pub fn execute_ops_classify_cross_network_topology(
2198:     config: ClassifyCrossNetworkTopologyConfig,
2199: ) -> Result<String, String> {
2200:     let ip_a = parse_ip_addr("ip-a", &config.ip_a)?;
2201:     let ip_b = parse_ip_addr("ip-b", &config.ip_b)?;
2202:     let same = same_prefix(ip_a, ip_b, config.ipv4_prefix, config.ipv6_prefix)?;
2203:     Ok(if same {
2204:         CHECK_FAIL.to_string()
2205:     } else {
2206:         CHECK_PASS.to_string()
2207:     })
2208: }

2210: pub fn execute_ops_read_cross_network_report_fields(
2211:     config: ReadCrossNetworkReportFieldsConfig,
2212: ) -> Result<String, String> {
2213:     if !config.include_status && config.checks.is_empty() && config.network_fields.is_empty() {
2214:         return Err(
2215:             "at least one output selector is required (--include-status, --check, or --network-field)"
2216:                 .to_string(),
2217:         );
2218:     }
2219: 
2220:     let report_path = resolve_path(config.report_path.as_path())?;
2221:     let payload = parse_report_payload(report_path.as_path())?;
2222:     let object = payload
2223:         .as_object()
2224:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("{}: report must be a JSON object", report_path.display()))?;
2225: 
2226:     let default_value = if config.default_value.is_empty() {
2227:         CHECK_FAIL.to_string()
2228:     } else {
2229:         config.default_value
2230:     };
2231:     let mut values = Vec::new();
2232:     if config.include_status {
2233:         values.push(
2234:             object
2235:                 .get("status")
2236:                 .and_then(Value::as_str)
2237:                 .map(str::to_string)
2238:                 .unwrap_or_else(|| default_value.clone()),
2239:         );
2240:     }
2241: 
2242:     let checks = object.get("checks").and_then(Value::as_object);
2243:     for key in config.checks {
2244:         let name = key.trim();
2245:         if name.is_empty() {
2246:             return Err("check selector must not be empty".to_string());
2247:         }
2248:         values.push(
2249:             checks
2250:                 .and_then(|items| items.get(name))
2251:                 .and_then(Value::as_str)
2252:                 .map(str::to_string)
2253:                 .unwrap_or_else(|| default_value.clone()),
2254:         );
2255:     }
2256: 
2257:     let network = object.get("network_context").and_then(Value::as_object);
2258:     for key in config.network_fields {
2259:         let name = key.trim();
2260:         if name.is_empty() {
2261:             return Err("network-field selector must not be empty".to_string());
2262:         }
2263:         values.push(
2264:             network
2265:                 .and_then(|items| items.get(name))
2266:                 .and_then(Value::as_str)
2267:                 .map(str::to_string)
2268:                 .unwrap_or_else(|| default_value.clone()),
2269:         );
2270:     }
2271: 
2272:     Ok(values.join("\n"))
2273: }

2275: pub fn execute_ops_choose_cross_network_roam_alias(
2276:     config: ChooseCrossNetworkRoamAliasConfig,
2277: ) -> Result<String, String> {
2278:     let exit_ip = parse_ip_addr("exit-ip", &config.exit_ip)?;
2279:     match exit_ip {
2280:         IpAddr::V4(exit_v4) => {
2281:             if config.ipv4_prefix > 32 {
2282:                 return Err(format!(
2283:                     "invalid IPv4 prefix length: {}",
2284:                     config.ipv4_prefix
2285:                 ));
2286:             }
2287:             if config.ipv4_prefix == 32 {
2288:                 return Err(
2289:                     "cannot choose roam alias in /32; IPv4 prefix must allow host space"
2290:                         .to_string(),
2291:                 );
2292:             }
2293:             let mut used = HashSet::new();
2294:             for raw in &config.used_ips {
2295:                 let parsed = parse_ip_addr("used-ip", raw)?;
2296:                 let IpAddr::V4(value) = parsed else {
2297:                     return Err("all --used-ip values must match exit-ip family".to_string());
2298:                 };
2299:                 used.insert(u32::from(value));
2300:             }
2301: 
2302:             let exit_bits = u32::from(exit_v4);
2303:             used.insert(exit_bits);
2304:             let mask = if config.ipv4_prefix == 0 {
2305:                 0u32
2306:             } else {
2307:                 u32::MAX << (32 - config.ipv4_prefix)
2308:             };
2309:             let network = exit_bits & mask;
2310:             let broadcast = network | !mask;
2311:             for candidate in (network + 1..broadcast).rev() {
2312:                 if !used.contains(&candidate) {
2313:                     let ip = std::net::Ipv4Addr::from(candidate);
2314:                     return Ok(format!("{ip}\n{}", config.ipv4_prefix));
2315:                 }
2316:             }
2317:             Err("failed to find available IPv4 roam alias in selected prefix".to_string())
2318:         }
2319:         IpAddr::V6(exit_v6) => {
2320:             if config.ipv6_prefix > 128 {
2321:                 return Err(format!(
2322:                     "invalid IPv6 prefix length: {}",
2323:                     config.ipv6_prefix
2324:                 ));
2325:             }
2326:             if config.ipv6_prefix == 128 {
2327:                 return Err(
2328:                     "cannot choose roam alias in /128; IPv6 prefix must allow host space"
2329:                         .to_string(),
2330:                 );
2331:             }
2332:             let mut used = HashSet::new();
2333:             for raw in &config.used_ips {
2334:                 let parsed = parse_ip_addr("used-ip", raw)?;
2335:                 let IpAddr::V6(value) = parsed else {
2336:                     return Err("all --used-ip values must match exit-ip family".to_string());
2337:                 };
2338:                 used.insert(u128::from_be_bytes(value.octets()));
2339:             }
2340: 
2341:             let exit_bits = u128::from_be_bytes(exit_v6.octets());
2342:             used.insert(exit_bits);
2343:             let mask = if config.ipv6_prefix == 0 {
2344:                 0u128
2345:             } else {
2346:                 u128::MAX << (128 - config.ipv6_prefix)
2347:             };
2348:             let network = exit_bits & mask;
2349:             let host_mask = !mask;
2350:             let exit_host = exit_bits & host_mask;
2351: 
2352:             for offset in 0x100u128..=0x1_0000u128 {
2353:                 let host = exit_host.wrapping_add(offset) & host_mask;
2354:                 let candidate = network | host;
2355:                 if candidate != exit_bits && !used.contains(&candidate) {
2356:                     let ip = std::net::Ipv6Addr::from(candidate.to_be_bytes());
2357:                     return Ok(format!("{ip}\n{}", config.ipv6_prefix));
2358:                 }
2359:             }
2360:             Err("failed to find available IPv6 roam alias in selected prefix".to_string())
2361:         }
2362:     }
2363: }
