2466:     fn report_payload_for_test(
2467:         spec: &CrossNetworkReportSpec,
2468:         artifact_dir: &Path,
2469:         status: &str,
2470:     ) -> Result<Value, String> {
2471:         let source_path = artifact_dir.join(format!("{}_source.txt", spec.suite));
2472:         let log_path = artifact_dir.join(format!("{}_log.txt", spec.suite));
2473:         fs::write(&source_path, "measured source\n")
2474:             .map_err(|err| format!("write source artifact failed: {err}"))?;
2475:         fs::write(&log_path, "measured log\n")
2476:             .map_err(|err| format!("write log artifact failed: {err}"))?;
2477:         let mut source_artifacts = vec![source_path.display().to_string()];
2478:         let mut log_artifacts = vec![log_path.display().to_string()];
2479:         for basename in spec.required_pass_source_artifacts {
2480:             let artifact_path = artifact_dir.join(basename);
2481:             write_test_source_artifact(spec, artifact_path.as_path(), basename)?;
2482:             source_artifacts.push(artifact_path.display().to_string());
2483:         }
2484:         for basename in spec.required_pass_log_artifacts {
2485:             let artifact_path = artifact_dir.join(basename);
2486:             fs::write(&artifact_path, format!("measured {basename}\n")).map_err(|err| {
2487:                 format!(
2488:                     "write log artifact failed ({}): {err}",
2489:                     artifact_path.display()
2490:                 )
2491:             })?;
2492:             log_artifacts.push(artifact_path.display().to_string());
2493:         }
2494: 
2495:         let mut participants = Map::new();
2496:         for field in spec.required_participants {
2497:             participants.insert(
2498:                 (*field).to_string(),
2499:                 Value::String(format!("{field}-value")),
2500:             );
2501:         }
2502: 
2503:         let mut network_context = Map::new();
2504:         network_context.insert(
2505:             "client_network_id".to_string(),
2506:             Value::String("net-client".to_string()),
2507:         );
2508:         network_context.insert(
2509:             "exit_network_id".to_string(),
2510:             Value::String("net-exit".to_string()),
2511:         );
2512:         network_context.insert(
2513:             "nat_profile".to_string(),
2514:             Value::String("baseline_lan".to_string()),
2515:         );
2516:         network_context.insert(
2517:             "impairment_profile".to_string(),
2518:             Value::String("none".to_string()),
2519:         );
2520:         if spec.required_network_fields.contains(&"relay_network_id") {
2521:             network_context.insert(
2522:                 "relay_network_id".to_string(),
2523:                 Value::String("net-relay".to_string()),
2524:             );
2525:         }
2526: 
2527:         let mut checks = Map::new();
2528:         for check in spec.required_checks {
2529:             checks.insert((*check).to_string(), Value::String(CHECK_PASS.to_string()));
2530:         }
2531: 
2532:         let path_mode = match spec.suite {
2533:             "cross_network_direct_remote_exit" => "direct_active",
2534:             "cross_network_relay_remote_exit" => "relay_active",
2535:             "cross_network_failback_roaming" => "direct_active",
2536:             _ => "direct_active",
2537:         };
2538:         let path_programmed_mode = match spec.suite {
2539:             "cross_network_relay_remote_exit" => "relay_programmed",
2540:             _ => "direct_programmed",
2541:         };
2542:         let relay_session_state = if spec.suite == "cross_network_relay_remote_exit" {
2543:             "live"
2544:         } else {
2545:             "unused"
2546:         };
2547: 
2548:         let mut payload = json!({
2549:             "schema_version": SCHEMA_VERSION,
2550:             "phase": PHASE_NAME,
2551:             "suite": spec.suite,
2552:             "environment": "unit_test",
2553:             "evidence_mode": EVIDENCE_MODE,
2554:             "captured_at_unix": unix_now(),
2555:             "git_commit": TEST_GIT_COMMIT,
2556:             "status": status,
2557:             "participants": Value::Object(participants),
2558:             "network_context": Value::Object(network_context),
2559:             "checks": Value::Object(checks),
2560:             "source_artifacts": source_artifacts,
2561:             "log_artifacts": log_artifacts,
2562:             "implementation_state": "live_measured_validator",
2563:         });
2564:         if status == CHECK_PASS && spec.suite != "cross_network_traversal_adversarial" {
2565:             payload.as_object_mut().expect("payload object").insert(
2566:                 "path_evidence".to_string(),
2567:                 json!({
2568:                     "path_mode": path_mode,
2569:                     "path_reason": "fresh_handshake_observed",
2570:                     "path_programmed_mode": path_programmed_mode,
2571:                     "path_live_proven": true,
2572:                     "path_latest_live_handshake_unix": unix_now(),
2573:                     "relay_session_state": relay_session_state,
2574:                     "traversal_alarm_state": "ok",
2575:                     "traversal_alarm_reason": "none",
2576:                     "dns_alarm_state": "ok",
2577:                     "dns_alarm_reason": "none",
2578:                     "traversal_error": "none",
2579:                     "transport_socket_identity_state": "authoritative_backend_shared_transport",
2580:                     "transport_socket_identity_error": "none",
2581:                     "transport_socket_identity_label": "udp4:51820",
2582:                     "transport_socket_identity_local_addr": "192.0.2.10:51820",
2583:                     "traversal_probe_result": "pass",
2584:                     "traversal_probe_reason": "fresh_handshake_observed",
2585:                     "traversal_endpoint_change_events": 0,
2586:                     "stun_transport_port_binding": "192.0.2.10:51820",
2587:                 }),
2588:             );
2589:         }
2590:         if status == CHECK_FAIL {
2591:             payload.as_object_mut().expect("payload object").insert(
2592:                 "failure_summary".to_string(),
2593:                 Value::String("simulated failure".to_string()),
2594:             );
2595:         }
2596:         Ok(payload)
2597:     }

2599:     fn write_test_source_artifact(
2600:         spec: &CrossNetworkReportSpec,
2601:         artifact_path: &Path,
2602:         basename: &str,
2603:     ) -> Result<(), String> {
2604:         let artifact_body = if basename.ends_with("_ssh_trust_summary.txt") {
2605:             let target_count = spec.required_participants.len();
2606:             let mut lines = vec![
2607:                 "schema_version=1".to_string(),
2608:                 format!("generated_at_unix={}", unix_now()),
2609:                 "pinned_known_hosts_file=/tmp/rustynet-known_hosts".to_string(),
2610:                 format!("pinned_known_hosts_sha256={}", "b".repeat(64)),
2611:                 format!("target_count={target_count}"),
2612:             ];
2613:             for index in 0..target_count {
2614:                 lines.push(format!("target[{index}].target=host-{index}"));
2615:                 lines.push(format!("target[{index}].configured_transport=utm"));
2616:                 lines.push(format!(
2617:                     "target[{index}].checked_candidates=host-{index},192.0.2.{}",
2618:                     index + 10
2619:                 ));
2620:                 lines.push(format!("target[{index}].matched_candidate=host-{index}"));
2621:                 lines.push(format!("target[{index}].host_key_status=pass"));
2622:                 lines.push(format!("target[{index}].passwordless_sudo_status=pass"));
2623:             }
2624:             lines.push("all_targets_pinned=true".to_string());
2625:             lines.push("all_targets_passwordless_sudo=true".to_string());
2626:             format!("{}\n", lines.join("\n"))
2627:         } else if basename == "cross_network_remote_exit_soak_monitor_summary.json" {
2628:             serde_json::to_string_pretty(&json!({
2629:                 "samples": 24,
2630:                 "failing_samples": 0,
2631:                 "max_consecutive_failures_observed": 0,
2632:                 "elapsed_secs": 120,
2633:                 "required_soak_duration_secs": 120,
2634:                 "allowed_failing_samples": 2,
2635:                 "allowed_max_consecutive_failures": 1,
2636:                 "direct_remote_exit_ready": "pass",
2637:                 "post_soak_bypass_ready": "pass",
2638:                 "no_plaintext_passphrase_files": "pass",
2639:                 "direct_samples": 24,
2640:                 "relay_samples": 0,
2641:                 "fail_closed_samples": 0,
2642:                 "other_path_samples": 0,
2643:                 "path_transition_count": 0,
2644:                 "status_mismatch_samples": 0,
2645:                 "route_mismatch_samples": 0,
2646:                 "endpoint_mismatch_samples": 0,
2647:                 "dns_alarm_bad_samples": 0,
2648:                 "transport_identity_failures": 0,
2649:                 "endpoint_change_events_start": 1,
2650:                 "endpoint_change_events_end": 1,
2651:                 "endpoint_change_events_delta": 0,
2652:                 "first_non_direct_reason": "none",
2653:                 "last_path_mode": "direct_active",
2654:                 "last_path_reason": "fresh_handshake_observed",
2655:                 "first_failure_reason": "none",
2656:                 "long_soak_stable": "pass",
2657:             }))
2658:             .map(|rendered| format!("{rendered}\n"))
2659:             .map_err(|err| format!("serialize soak monitor summary failed: {err}"))?
2660:         } else if basename.ends_with(".json") {
2661:             "{\n  \"status\": \"pass\"\n}\n".to_string()
2662:         } else {
2663:             format!("measured {basename}\n")
2664:         };
2665:         fs::write(artifact_path, artifact_body).map_err(|err| {
2666:             format!(
2667:                 "write source artifact failed ({}): {err}",
2668:                 artifact_path.display()
2669:             )
2670:         })
2671:     }

2673:     fn write_valid_report(artifact_dir: &Path, suite: &str) -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
2674:         let spec = report_spec_by_suite(suite).ok_or_else(|| format!("unknown suite {suite}"))?;
2675:         let report_path = artifact_dir.join(spec.filename);
2676:         let payload = report_payload_for_test(spec, artifact_dir, CHECK_PASS)?;
2677:         let rendered = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&payload)
2678:             .map_err(|err| format!("serialize test report failed: {err}"))?;
2679:         fs::write(&report_path, format!("{rendered}\n")).map_err(|err| {
2680:             format!(
2681:                 "write test report failed ({}): {err}",
2682:                 report_path.display()
2683:             )
2684:         })?;
2685:         Ok(report_path)
2686:     }

2999:             "expected soak relay-sample rejection, got: {errors:?}"

3026:                 "path_evidence.traversal_alarm_state must not be critical|error|missing for pass reports"
3027:             )),
3028:             "expected critical traversal alarm rejection, got: {errors:?}"
3029:         );

 131: impl Workspace {
 132:     fn new(seed_known_hosts: &Path) -> Result<Self, String> {
 133:         let unique = unique_suffix();
 134:         let temp_dir = PathBuf::from(format!("/tmp/rnre.{unique}"));
 135:         fs::create_dir_all(&temp_dir).map_err(|err| {
 136:             format!(
 137:                 "failed to create temporary workspace {}: {err}",
 138:                 temp_dir.display()
 139:             )
 140:         })?;
 141:         set_unix_mode(temp_dir.as_path(), 0o700)?;
 142:         let control_dir = temp_dir.join("c");
 143:         fs::create_dir_all(&control_dir).map_err(|err| {
 144:             format!(
 145:                 "failed to create ssh control dir {}: {err}",
 146:                 control_dir.display()
 147:             )
 148:         })?;
 149:         set_unix_mode(control_dir.as_path(), 0o700)?;
 150:         let known_hosts = temp_dir.join("known_hosts");
 151:         fs::copy(seed_known_hosts, &known_hosts).map_err(|err| {
 152:             format!(
 153:                 "failed to seed {} from {}: {err}",
 154:                 known_hosts.display(),
 155:                 seed_known_hosts.display()
 156:             )
 157:         })?;
 158:         set_unix_mode(known_hosts.as_path(), 0o600)?;
 159: 
 160:         Ok(Self {
 161:             temp_dir: temp_dir.clone(),
 162:             control_dir,
 163:             known_hosts,
 164:             local_archive: temp_dir.join("repo.tar"),
 165:             bootstrap_script_local: temp_dir.join("remote-bootstrap-host.sh"),
 166:             membership_snapshot_local: temp_dir.join("membership.snapshot"),
 167:             membership_log_local: temp_dir.join("membership.log"),
 168:             assignment_pub_local: temp_dir.join("assignment.pub"),
 169:             assignment_exit_local: temp_dir.join("exit.assignment"),
 170:             assignment_client_local: temp_dir.join("client.assignment"),
 171:             traversal_pub_local: temp_dir.join("traversal.pub"),
 172:             traversal_exit_local: temp_dir.join("exit.traversal"),
 173:             traversal_client_local: temp_dir.join("client.traversal"),
 174:             assignment_refresh_exit_local: temp_dir.join("assignment-refresh-exit.env"),
 175:             assignment_refresh_client_local: temp_dir.join("assignment-refresh-client.env"),
 176:         })
 177:     }

 186: #[derive(Default)]
 187: struct CheckReport {
 188:     checks: Vec<(String, String, String)>,
 189:     fail_count: usize,
 190: }
 191: 
 192: impl CheckReport {
 193:     fn add(&mut self, name: &str, status: &str, detail: String) {
 194:         self.checks
 195:             .push((name.to_string(), status.to_string(), detail));
 196:         if status != "PASS" {
 197:             self.fail_count += 1;
 198:         }
 199:     }
 200: 
 201:     fn contains_or_fail(&mut self, name: &str, haystack: &str, needle: &str) {
 202:         if haystack.contains(needle) {
 203:             self.add(name, "PASS", format!("found '{needle}'"));
 204:         } else {
 205:             self.add(name, "FAIL", format!("missing '{needle}'"));
 206:         }
 207:     }
 208: }

 210: pub fn execute_ops_e2e_bootstrap_host(
 211:     role: String,
 212:     node_id: String,
 213:     network_id: String,
 214:     src_dir: PathBuf,
 215:     ssh_allow_cidrs: String,
 216:     skip_apt: bool,
 217: ) -> Result<String, String> {
 218:     ensure_running_as_root()?;
 219:     ensure_safe_token("role", role.as_str())?;
 220:     ensure_safe_token("node-id", node_id.as_str())?;
 221:     ensure_safe_token("network-id", network_id.as_str())?;
 222:     ensure_safe_token("ssh-allow-cidrs", ssh_allow_cidrs.as_str())?;
 223:     if !src_dir.is_absolute() {
 224:         return Err(format!("--src-dir must be absolute: {}", src_dir.display()));
 225:     }
 226:     let src_dir_text = src_dir.display().to_string();
 227:     ensure_safe_token("src-dir", src_dir_text.as_str())?;
 228:     if !src_dir.is_dir() {
 229:         return Err(format!("source dir is missing: {}", src_dir.display()));
 230:     }
 231:     let backend_mode = e2e_backend_mode_from_env()?;
 232: 
 233:     let daemon_binary = format!("{}/target/release/rustynetd", src_dir.display());
 234:     run_status(
 235:         "install",
 236:         &[
 237:             "-m",
 238:             "0755",
 239:             daemon_binary.as_str(),
 240:             "/usr/local/bin/rustynetd",
 241:         ],
 242:         &[],
 243:         "installing rustynetd failed during e2e bootstrap",
 244:     )?;
 245:     let cli_binary = format!("{}/target/release/rustynet-cli", src_dir.display());
 246:     run_status(
 247:         "install",
 248:         &["-m", "0755", cli_binary.as_str(), "/usr/local/bin/rustynet"],
 249:         &[],
 250:         "installing rustynet CLI failed during e2e bootstrap",
 251:     )?;
 252:     ensure_system_group("rustynetd")?;
 253:     ensure_executable_file(
 254:         Path::new("/usr/local/bin/rustynetd"),
 255:         "installed rustynetd binary",
 256:     )?;
 257:     ensure_executable_file(
 258:         Path::new("/usr/local/bin/rustynet"),
 259:         "installed rustynet CLI",
 260:     )?;
 261: 
 262:     if !skip_apt {
 263:         install_linux_e2e_prerequisites()?;
 264:         let required_toolchain = ensure_pinned_rust_toolchain(src_dir.as_path())?;
 265:         let cargo_proxy = rustup_proxy_path("cargo")?;
 266:         let cargo_proxy_text = cargo_proxy.display().to_string();
 267:         let manifest_path = format!("{}/Cargo.toml", src_dir.display());
 268:         run_status(
 269:             cargo_proxy_text.as_str(),
 270:             &[
 271:                 "build",
 272:                 "--release",
 273:                 "-p",
 274:                 "rustynetd",
 275:                 "-p",
 276:                 "rustynet-cli",
 277:                 "--manifest-path",
 278:                 manifest_path.as_str(),
 279:             ],
 280:             &[],
 281:             format!(
 282:                 "remote release build failed during e2e bootstrap with toolchain {required_toolchain}"
 283:             )
 284:             .as_str(),
 285:         )?;
 286:     }
 287: 
 288:     for service in [
 289:         "rustynetd.service",
 290:         "rustynetd-privileged-helper.service",
 291:         "rustynetd-trust-refresh.service",
 292:         "rustynetd-trust-refresh.timer",
 293:         "rustynetd-assignment-refresh.service",
 294:         "rustynetd-assignment-refresh.timer",
 295:     ] {
 296:         run_allow_failure("systemctl", &["disable", "--now", service], &[]);
 297:     }
 298:     run_allow_failure(
 299:         "systemctl",
 300:         &["disable", "rustynetd-managed-dns.service"],
 301:         &[],
 302:     );
 303:     if run_status(
 304:         "resolvectl",
 305:         &["status"],
 306:         &[],
 307:         "managed DNS status probe failed",
 308:     )
 309:     .is_ok()
 310:     {
 311:         run_allow_failure(
 312:             "timeout",
 313:             &["30", "systemctl", "stop", "rustynetd-managed-dns.service"],
 314:             &[],
 315:         );
 316:     } else {
 317:         run_allow_failure("systemctl", &["kill", "rustynetd-managed-dns.service"], &[]);
 318:     }
 319:     run_allow_failure(
 320:         "systemctl",
 321:         &["reset-failed", "rustynetd-managed-dns.service"],
 322:         &[],
 323:     );
 324:     run_allow_failure("pkill", &["-f", "rustynetd daemon"], &[]);
 325:     run_allow_failure("pkill", &["-f", "rustynetd privileged-helper"], &[]);
 326:     run_allow_failure("ip", &["link", "delete", "rustynet0"], &[]);
 327:     clear_rustynet_nftables_state()?;
 328: 
 329:     let _ = fs::remove_dir_all("/etc/rustynet");
 330:     let _ = fs::remove_dir_all("/var/lib/rustynet");
 331:     let _ = fs::remove_dir_all("/run/rustynet");
 332: 
 333:     run_status(
 334:         "install",
 335:         &["-d", "-m", "0700", "/etc/rustynet/credentials"],
 336:         &[],
 337:         "creating credentials directory failed",
 338:     )?;
 339:     run_status(
 340:         "install",
 341:         &["-d", "-m", "0700", "/var/lib/rustynet/keys"],
 342:         &[],
 343:         "creating key directory failed",
 344:     )?;
 345:     run_status(
 346:         "install",
 347:         &["-d", "-m", "0700", "/run/rustynet"],
 348:         &[],
 349:         "creating runtime directory failed",
 350:     )?;
 351: 
 352:     let passphrase_path = format!(
 353:         "/tmp/rustynet-passphrase.{}.{}",
 354:         std::process::id(),
 355:         unique_suffix()
 356:     );
 357:     let bootstrap_result = (|| -> Result<(), String> {
 358:         let mut passphrase_bytes = [0u8; 48];
 359:         fill_os_random_bytes(&mut passphrase_bytes, "bootstrap passphrase")?;
 360:         let mut passphrase_hex = String::with_capacity(passphrase_bytes.len() * 2 + 1);
 361:         for byte in passphrase_bytes {
 362:             write!(&mut passphrase_hex, "{byte:02x}")
 363:                 .map_err(|err| format!("formatting bootstrap passphrase failed: {err}"))?;
 364:         }
 365:         passphrase_hex.push('\n');
 366:         fs::write(passphrase_path.as_str(), passphrase_hex.as_bytes())
 367:             .map_err(|err| format!("writing bootstrap passphrase failed: {err}"))?;
 368:         set_unix_mode(Path::new(passphrase_path.as_str()), 0o600)?;
 369:         passphrase_hex.zeroize();
 370:         passphrase_bytes.zeroize();
 371: 
 372:         run_status(
 373:             "rustynetd",
 374:             &[
 375:                 "key",
 376:                 "init",
 377:                 "--runtime-private-key",
 378:                 "/run/rustynet/wireguard.key",
 379:                 "--encrypted-private-key",
 380:                 "/var/lib/rustynet/keys/wireguard.key.enc",
 381:                 "--public-key",
 382:                 "/var/lib/rustynet/keys/wireguard.pub",
 383:                 "--passphrase-file",
 384:                 passphrase_path.as_str(),
 385:                 "--force",
 386:             ],
 387:             &[],
 388:             "rustynetd key init failed during e2e bootstrap",
 389:         )?;
 390: 
 391:         run_status(
 392:             "systemd-creds",
 393:             &[
 394:                 "encrypt",
 395:                 "--name=wg_key_passphrase",
 396:                 passphrase_path.as_str(),
 397:                 "/etc/rustynet/credentials/wg_key_passphrase.cred",
 398:             ],
 399:             &[],
 400:             "encrypting wg passphrase credential failed",
 401:         )?;
 402:         run_status(
 403:             "chown",
 404:             &[
 405:                 "root:root",
 406:                 "/etc/rustynet/credentials/wg_key_passphrase.cred",
 407:             ],
 408:             &[],
 409:             "chown wg credential failed",
 410:         )?;
 411:         run_status(
 412:             "chmod",
 413:             &["0600", "/etc/rustynet/credentials/wg_key_passphrase.cred"],
 414:             &[],
 415:             "chmod wg credential failed",
 416:         )?;
 417: 
 418:         run_status(
 419:             "systemd-creds",
 420:             &[
 421:                 "encrypt",
 422:                 "--name=signing_key_passphrase",
 423:                 passphrase_path.as_str(),
 424:                 "/etc/rustynet/credentials/signing_key_passphrase.cred",
 425:             ],
 426:             &[],
 427:             "encrypting signing passphrase credential failed",
 428:         )?;
 429:         run_status(
 430:             "chown",
 431:             &[
 432:                 "root:root",
 433:                 "/etc/rustynet/credentials/signing_key_passphrase.cred",
 434:             ],
 435:             &[],
 436:             "chown signing credential failed",
 437:         )?;
 438:         run_status(
 439:             "chmod",
 440:             &[
 441:                 "0600",
 442:                 "/etc/rustynet/credentials/signing_key_passphrase.cred",
 443:             ],
 444:             &[],
 445:             "chmod signing credential failed",
 446:         )?;
 447:         run_allow_failure("rm", &["-f", "/run/rustynet/wireguard.key"], &[]);
 448: 
 449:         run_status(
 450:             "rustynetd",
 451:             &[
 452:                 "membership",
 453:                 "init",
 454:                 "--snapshot",
 455:                 "/var/lib/rustynet/membership.snapshot",
 456:                 "--log",
 457:                 "/var/lib/rustynet/membership.log",
 458:                 "--watermark",
 459:                 "/var/lib/rustynet/membership.watermark",
 460:                 "--owner-signing-key",
 461:                 "/etc/rustynet/membership.owner.key",
 462:                 "--owner-signing-key-passphrase-file",
 463:                 passphrase_path.as_str(),
 464:                 "--node-id",
 465:                 node_id.as_str(),
 466:                 "--network-id",
 467:                 network_id.as_str(),
 468:                 "--force",
 469:             ],
 470:             &[],
 471:             "membership init failed during e2e bootstrap",
 472:         )?;
 473: 
 474:         run_status(
 475:             "rustynet",
 476:             &[
 477:                 "trust",
 478:                 "keygen",

 480:                 "/etc/rustynet/trust-evidence.key",
 481:                 "--signing-key-passphrase-file",
 482:                 passphrase_path.as_str(),
 483:                 "--verifier-key-output",
 484:                 "/etc/rustynet/trust-evidence.pub",
 485:                 "--force",
 486:             ],
 487:             &[],
 488:             "trust keygen failed during e2e bootstrap",
 489:         )?;
 490:         run_status(
 491:             "chmod",

 493:             &[],
 494:             "chmod trust verifier key failed",

 570:                 (
 571:                     "RUSTYNET_TRUST_EVIDENCE",
 572:                     "/var/lib/rustynet/rustynetd.trust",
 573:                 ),
 574:                 (
 575:                     "RUSTYNET_TRUST_SIGNER_KEY",
 576:                     "/etc/rustynet/trust-evidence.key",
 577:                 ),
 578:                 (
 579:                     "RUSTYNET_TRUST_SIGNING_KEY_PASSPHRASE_FILE",
 580:                     passphrase_path.as_str(),
 581:                 ),
 582:                 ("RUSTYNET_DAEMON_GROUP", "rustynetd"),
 583:                 ("RUSTYNET_TRUST_AUTO_REFRESH", "true"),
 584:             ],
 585:             "refresh trust failed during e2e bootstrap",
 586:         )?;
 587:         Ok(())
 588:     })();
 589:     secure_remove_file(Path::new(passphrase_path.as_str()));
 590:     bootstrap_result?;
 591: 
 592:     Ok(format!(
 593:         "e2e bootstrap host complete: role={} node_id={} src_dir={}",
 594:         role,
 595:         node_id,
 596:         src_dir.display()
 597:     ))
 598: }

 600: /// Enforce baseline runtime configuration on the local host.
 601: ///
 602: /// On Linux, delegates to `rustynet ops install-systemd`.
 603: /// On Windows, delegates to `rustynet ops install-windows-service`.
 604: #[cfg(not(windows))]
 605: pub fn execute_ops_e2e_enforce_host(
 606:     role: String,
 607:     node_id: String,
 608:     src_dir: PathBuf,
 609:     ssh_allow_cidrs: String,
 610: ) -> Result<String, String> {
 611:     ensure_running_as_root()?;
 612:     ensure_safe_token("role", role.as_str())?;
 613:     ensure_safe_token("node-id", node_id.as_str())?;
 614:     ensure_safe_token("ssh-allow-cidrs", ssh_allow_cidrs.as_str())?;
 615:     if !src_dir.is_absolute() {
 616:         return Err(format!("--src-dir must be absolute: {}", src_dir.display()));
 617:     }
 618:     let src_dir_text = src_dir.display().to_string();
 619:     ensure_safe_token("src-dir", src_dir_text.as_str())?;
 620:     let auto_refresh = Path::new("/etc/rustynet/trust-evidence.key").is_file();
 621:     let assignment_auto_refresh = Path::new("/etc/rustynet/assignment.signing.secret").is_file()
 622:         && Path::new("/etc/rustynet/assignment-refresh.env").is_file();
 623:     let backend_mode = e2e_backend_mode_from_env()?;
 624: 
 625:     let mut install_env = vec![
 626:         ("RUSTYNET_NODE_ID", node_id.as_str()),
 627:         ("RUSTYNET_NODE_ROLE", role.as_str()),
 628:         (
 629:             "RUSTYNET_TRUST_AUTO_REFRESH",
 630:             if auto_refresh { "true" } else { "false" },
 631:         ),
 632:         (
 633:             "RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_AUTO_REFRESH",
 634:             if assignment_auto_refresh {
 635:                 "true"
 636:             } else {
 637:                 "false"
 638:             },
 639:         ),
 640:         ("RUSTYNET_AUTO_TUNNEL_ENFORCE", "true"),
 641:         ("RUSTYNET_WG_LISTEN_PORT", "51820"),
 642:         ("RUSTYNET_FAIL_CLOSED_SSH_ALLOW", "true"),
 643:         (
 644:             "RUSTYNET_FAIL_CLOSED_SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS",
 645:             ssh_allow_cidrs.as_str(),
 646:         ),
 647:         ("RUSTYNET_INSTALL_SOURCE_ROOT", src_dir_text.as_str()),
 648:     ];
 649:     if let Some(value) = backend_mode.as_deref() {
 650:         install_env.push(("RUSTYNET_BACKEND", value));
 651:     }
 652:     run_status(
 653:         "rustynet",
 654:         &["ops", "install-systemd"],
 655:         install_env.as_slice(),
 656:         "install-systemd enforce pass failed",
 657:     )?;
 658: 
 659:     Ok(format!(
 660:         "e2e enforce host complete: role={role} node_id={node_id}",
 661:     ))
 662: }

 664: /// Enforce baseline runtime configuration on the local Windows host.
 665: ///
 666: /// Delegates to `rustynet ops install-windows-service`, which runs the
 667: /// `Install-RustyNetWindowsService.ps1` PowerShell helper from `src_dir`.
 668: #[cfg(windows)]
 669: pub fn execute_ops_e2e_enforce_host(
 670:     role: String,
 671:     node_id: String,
 672:     src_dir: PathBuf,
 673:     ssh_allow_cidrs: String,
 674: ) -> Result<String, String> {
 675:     ensure_running_as_root()?;
 676:     ensure_safe_token("role", role.as_str())?;
 677:     ensure_safe_token("node-id", node_id.as_str())?;
 678:     ensure_safe_token("ssh-allow-cidrs", ssh_allow_cidrs.as_str())?;
 679:     if !src_dir.is_absolute() {
 680:         return Err(format!("--src-dir must be absolute: {}", src_dir.display()));
 681:     }
 682:     let src_dir_text = src_dir.display().to_string();
 683:     // Windows paths contain backslashes; skip safe-token check and rely on is_absolute guard.
 684:     let config_dir = Path::new(r"C:\ProgramData\RustyNet\config");
 685:     let auto_refresh = config_dir.join("trust-evidence.key").is_file();
 686:     let assignment_auto_refresh = config_dir.join("assignment.signing.secret").is_file()
 687:         && config_dir.join("assignment-refresh.env").is_file();
 688:     let backend_mode = e2e_backend_mode_from_env()?;
 689: 
 690:     let mut install_env = vec![
 691:         ("RUSTYNET_NODE_ID", node_id.as_str()),
 692:         ("RUSTYNET_NODE_ROLE", role.as_str()),
 693:         (
 694:             "RUSTYNET_TRUST_AUTO_REFRESH",
 695:             if auto_refresh { "true" } else { "false" },
 696:         ),
 697:         (
 698:             "RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_AUTO_REFRESH",
 699:             if assignment_auto_refresh {
 700:                 "true"
 701:             } else {
 702:                 "false"
 703:             },
 704:         ),
 705:         ("RUSTYNET_AUTO_TUNNEL_ENFORCE", "true"),
 706:         ("RUSTYNET_WG_LISTEN_PORT", "51820"),
 707:         ("RUSTYNET_INSTALL_SOURCE_ROOT", src_dir_text.as_str()),
 708:     ];
 709:     if let Some(value) = backend_mode.as_deref() {
 710:         install_env.push(("RUSTYNET_BACKEND", value));
 711:     }
 712:     run_status(
 713:         "rustynet",
 714:         &["ops", "install-windows-service"],
 715:         install_env.as_slice(),
 716:         "install-windows-service enforce pass failed",
 717:     )?;
 718: 
 719:     Ok(format!(
 720:         "e2e enforce host complete: role={role} node_id={node_id}",
 721:     ))
 722: }

 724: /// Install the `rustynetd` Windows service.
 725: ///
 726: /// Runs `Install-RustyNetWindowsService.ps1` from the source root resolved via
 727: /// `RUSTYNET_INSTALL_SOURCE_ROOT` or the current working directory.
 728: /// Requires Administrator privileges.
 729: ///
 730: /// On non-Windows hosts this always returns an error.
 731: #[cfg(not(windows))]
 732: pub fn execute_ops_install_windows_service() -> Result<String, String> {
 733:     Err("ops install-windows-service is only supported on Windows hosts".to_string())
 734: }
 735: 
 736: /// Install the `rustynetd` Windows service.
 737: ///
 738: /// Runs `Install-RustyNetWindowsService.ps1` from the source root resolved via
 739: /// `RUSTYNET_INSTALL_SOURCE_ROOT` or the current working directory.
 740: /// Requires Administrator privileges.
 741: #[cfg(windows)]
 742: pub fn execute_ops_install_windows_service() -> Result<String, String> {
 743:     ensure_running_as_root()?;
 744:     let source_root = resolve_windows_install_source_root()?;
 745:     let script_path = source_root
 746:         .join("scripts")
 747:         .join("bootstrap")
 748:         .join("windows")
 749:         .join("Install-RustyNetWindowsService.ps1");
 750:     if !script_path.is_file() {
 751:         return Err(format!(
 752:             "Windows service install script not found at {}; \
 753:              ensure RUSTYNET_INSTALL_SOURCE_ROOT points to the repo root",
 754:             script_path.display()
 755:         ));
 756:     }
 757:     let script_str = script_path.to_string_lossy().to_string();
 758:     let source_root_str = source_root.to_string_lossy().to_string();
 759:     run_status(
 760:         "powershell.exe",
 761:         &[
 762:             "-NoProfile",
 763:             "-ExecutionPolicy",
 764:             "Bypass",
 765:             "-File",
 766:             script_str.as_str(),
 767:             "-RustyNetRoot",
 768:             source_root_str.as_str(),
 769:             "-InstallRoot",
 770:             r"C:\Program Files\RustyNet",
 771:             "-StateRoot",
 772:             r"C:\ProgramData\RustyNet",
 773:             "-ServiceName",
 774:             "RustyNet",
 775:         ],
 776:         &[],
 777:         "Windows service install script failed",
 778:     )?;
 779:     Ok("RustyNet Windows service installed and started".to_string())
 780: }
 781: 
 782: #[cfg(windows)]
 783: fn resolve_windows_install_source_root() -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
 784:     if let Ok(candidate) = std::env::var("RUSTYNET_INSTALL_SOURCE_ROOT") {
 785:         let path = PathBuf::from(candidate);
 786:         if !path.is_absolute() {
 787:             return Err(format!(
 788:                 "RUSTYNET_INSTALL_SOURCE_ROOT must be an absolute path: {}",
 789:                 path.display()
 790:             ));
 791:         }
 792:         return Ok(path);
 793:     }
 794:     std::env::current_dir().map_err(|err| format!("failed to resolve working directory: {err}"))
 795: }
 796: 
 797: pub fn execute_ops_e2e_membership_add(
 798:     client_node_id: String,
 799:     client_pubkey_hex: String,
 800:     owner_approver_id: String,
 801: ) -> Result<String, String> {
 802:     ensure_running_as_root()?;
 803:     ensure_safe_token("client-node-id", client_node_id.as_str())?;
 804:     ensure_safe_token("owner-approver-id", owner_approver_id.as_str())?;
 805:     ensure_hex_32("client-pubkey-hex", client_pubkey_hex.as_str())?;
 806: 
 807:     let passphrase_path = format!(
 808:         "/tmp/rustynet-membership-passphrase.{}.{}",
 809:         std::process::id(),
 810:         unique_suffix()
 811:     );
 812:     let work_dir = PathBuf::from(format!(
 813:         "/tmp/rustynet-membership-update.{}.{}",
 814:         std::process::id(),
 815:         unique_suffix()
 816:     ));
 817:     fs::create_dir_all(work_dir.as_path())
 818:         .map_err(|err| format!("failed creating {}: {err}", work_dir.display()))?;
 819:     set_unix_mode(work_dir.as_path(), 0o700)?;
 820:     let record_path = work_dir.join("add.record");
 821:     let signed_path = work_dir.join("add.signed");
 822: 
 823:     let result = (|| -> Result<(), String> {
 824:         run_status(
 825:             "systemd-creds",
 826:             &[
 827:                 "decrypt",
 828:                 "--name=signing_key_passphrase",
 829:                 "/etc/rustynet/credentials/signing_key_passphrase.cred",
 830:                 passphrase_path.as_str(),
 831:             ],
 832:             &[],
 833:             "decrypting signing passphrase credential failed",
 834:         )?;
 835:         set_unix_mode(Path::new(passphrase_path.as_str()), 0o600)?;
 836:         set_membership_state_permissions_local(ROOT_OWNER_GROUP)?;
 837: 
 838:         run_status(
 839:             "rustynet",
 840:             &[
 841:                 "membership",
 842:                 "propose-add",
 843:                 "--node-id",
 844:                 client_node_id.as_str(),
 845:                 "--node-pubkey",
 846:                 client_pubkey_hex.as_str(),
 847:                 "--owner",
 848:                 client_node_id.as_str(),
 849:                 "--output",
 850:                 record_path.to_string_lossy().as_ref(),
 851:                 "--snapshot",
 852:                 "/var/lib/rustynet/membership.snapshot",
 853:                 "--log",
 854:                 "/var/lib/rustynet/membership.log",
 855:             ],
 856:             &[],
 857:             "membership propose-add failed",
 858:         )?;
 859:         run_status(
 860:             "rustynet",
 861:             &[
 862:                 "membership",
 863:                 "sign-update",
 864:                 "--record",
 865:                 record_path.to_string_lossy().as_ref(),
 866:                 "--approver-id",
 867:                 owner_approver_id.as_str(),
 868:                 "--signing-key",
 869:                 "/etc/rustynet/membership.owner.key",
 870:                 "--signing-key-passphrase-file",
 871:                 passphrase_path.as_str(),
 872:                 "--output",
 873:                 signed_path.to_string_lossy().as_ref(),
 874:             ],
 875:             &[],
 876:             "membership sign-update failed",
 877:         )?;
 878:         run_status(
 879:             "rustynet",
 880:             &[
 881:                 "membership",
 882:                 "apply-update",
 883:                 "--signed-update",
 884:                 signed_path.to_string_lossy().as_ref(),
 885:                 "--snapshot",
 886:                 "/var/lib/rustynet/membership.snapshot",
 887:                 "--log",
 888:                 "/var/lib/rustynet/membership.log",
 889:             ],
 890:             &[],
 891:             "membership apply-update failed",
 892:         )?;
 893:         Ok(())
 894:     })();
 895:     let restore_result = set_membership_state_permissions_local(MEMBERSHIP_STATE_OWNER_GROUP);
 896:     secure_remove_file(Path::new(passphrase_path.as_str()));
 897:     let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(work_dir);
 898:     match (result, restore_result) {
 899:         (Ok(()), Ok(())) => {}
 900:         (Err(err), Ok(())) => return Err(err),
 901:         (Ok(()), Err(restore_err)) => return Err(restore_err),
 902:         (Err(err), Err(restore_err)) => {
 903:             return Err(format!(
 904:                 "{err}; membership ownership restore failed: {restore_err}"
 905:             ));
 906:         }
 907:     }
 908: 
 909:     Ok(format!(
 910:         "e2e membership add complete: client_node_id={client_node_id}",
 911:     ))
 912: }
 913: 
 914: pub fn execute_ops_e2e_issue_assignments(
 915:     exit_node_id: String,
 916:     client_node_id: String,
 917:     exit_endpoint: String,
 918:     client_endpoint: String,
 919:     exit_pubkey_hex: String,
 920:     client_pubkey_hex: String,
 921:     artifact_dir: Option<PathBuf>,
 922: ) -> Result<String, String> {
 923:     ensure_running_as_root()?;
 924:     for (label, value) in [
 925:         ("exit-node-id", exit_node_id.as_str()),
 926:         ("client-node-id", client_node_id.as_str()),
 927:         ("exit-endpoint", exit_endpoint.as_str()),
 928:         ("client-endpoint", client_endpoint.as_str()),
 929:     ] {
 930:         ensure_safe_token(label, value)?;
 931:     }
 932:     ensure_hex_32("exit-pubkey-hex", exit_pubkey_hex.as_str())?;
 933:     ensure_hex_32("client-pubkey-hex", client_pubkey_hex.as_str())?;
 934: 
 935:     let artifact_dir = artifact_dir.unwrap_or_else(|| {
 936:         PathBuf::from(format!(
 937:             "/run/rustynet/e2e-issue-artifacts.{}.{}",
 938:             std::process::id(),
 939:             unique_suffix()
 940:         ))
 941:     });
 942:     if !artifact_dir.is_absolute() {
 943:         return Err(format!(
 944:             "--artifact-dir must be an absolute path: {}",
 945:             artifact_dir.display()
 946:         ));
 947:     }
 948:     let artifact_dir_text = artifact_dir.display().to_string();
 949:     ensure_safe_remote_path(artifact_dir_text.as_str())?;
 950:     match fs::symlink_metadata(&artifact_dir) {
 951:         Ok(metadata) => {
 952:             if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
 953:                 return Err(format!(
 954:                     "--artifact-dir must not be a symlink: {}",
 955:                     artifact_dir.display()
 956:                 ));
 957:             }
 958:             if !metadata.is_dir() {
 959:                 return Err(format!(
 960:                     "--artifact-dir must be a directory: {}",
 961:                     artifact_dir.display()
 962:                 ));
 963:             }
 964:         }
 965:         Err(err) if err.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => {
 966:             fs::create_dir_all(&artifact_dir).map_err(|create_err| {
 967:                 format!(
 968:                     "failed to create artifact directory {}: {create_err}",
 969:                     artifact_dir.display()
 970:                 )
 971:             })?;
 972:         }
 973:         Err(err) => {
 974:             return Err(format!(
 975:                 "failed to inspect artifact directory {}: {err}",
 976:                 artifact_dir.display()
 977:             ));
 978:         }
 979:     }
 980:     set_unix_mode(artifact_dir.as_path(), 0o700)?;
 981: 
 982:     let assignment_pub_path = artifact_dir.join("rustynet-assignment.pub");
 983:     let assignment_exit_path = artifact_dir.join("rustynet-exit.assignment");
 984:     let assignment_client_path = artifact_dir.join("rustynet-client.assignment");
 985:     let traversal_pub_path = artifact_dir.join("rustynet-traversal.pub");
 986:     let traversal_exit_path = artifact_dir.join("rustynet-exit.traversal");
 987:     let traversal_client_path = artifact_dir.join("rustynet-client.traversal");
 988:     for output_path in [
 989:         assignment_pub_path.as_path(),
 990:         assignment_exit_path.as_path(),
 991:         assignment_client_path.as_path(),
 992:         traversal_pub_path.as_path(),
 993:         traversal_exit_path.as_path(),
 994:         traversal_client_path.as_path(),
 995:     ] {
 996:         if output_path.exists() {
 997:             return Err(format!(
 998:                 "artifact output path already exists: {}",
 999:                 output_path.display()
1000:             ));
1001:         }
1002:     }
1003: 
1004:     let assignment_pub_path_text = assignment_pub_path.display().to_string();
1005:     let assignment_exit_path_text = assignment_exit_path.display().to_string();
1006:     let assignment_client_path_text = assignment_client_path.display().to_string();
1007: 
1008:     let passphrase_path = format!(
1009:         "/tmp/rustynet-assignment-passphrase.{}.{}",
1010:         std::process::id(),
1011:         unique_suffix()
1012:     );
1013:     let result = (|| -> Result<(), String> {
1014:         run_status(
1015:             "systemd-creds",
1016:             &[
1017:                 "decrypt",
1018:                 "--name=signing_key_passphrase",
1019:                 "/etc/rustynet/credentials/signing_key_passphrase.cred",
1020:                 passphrase_path.as_str(),
1021:             ],
1022:             &[],
1023:             "decrypting assignment signing passphrase failed",
1024:         )?;
1025:         set_unix_mode(Path::new(passphrase_path.as_str()), 0o600)?;
1026: 
1027:         if !Path::new("/etc/rustynet/assignment.signing.secret").is_file() {
1028:             run_status(
1029:                 "rustynet",
1030:                 &[
1031:                     "assignment",
1032:                     "init-signing-secret",
1033:                     "--output",
1034:                     "/etc/rustynet/assignment.signing.secret",
1035:                     "--signing-secret-passphrase-file",
1036:                     passphrase_path.as_str(),
1037:                     "--force",
1038:                 ],
1039:                 &[],
1040:                 "initializing assignment signing secret failed",
1041:             )?;
1042:         }
1043: 
1044:         let nodes_spec = format!(
1045:             "{exit_node_id}|{exit_endpoint}|{exit_pubkey_hex};{client_node_id}|{client_endpoint}|{client_pubkey_hex}",
1046:         );
1047:         let allow_spec =
1048:             format!("{client_node_id}|{exit_node_id};{exit_node_id}|{client_node_id}",);
1049: 
1050:         run_status(
1051:             "rustynet",
1052:             &[
1053:                 "assignment",
1054:                 "issue",
1055:                 "--target-node-id",
1056:                 exit_node_id.as_str(),
1057:                 "--nodes",
1058:                 nodes_spec.as_str(),
1059:                 "--allow",
1060:                 allow_spec.as_str(),
1061:                 "--signing-secret",
1062:                 "/etc/rustynet/assignment.signing.secret",
1063:                 "--signing-secret-passphrase-file",
1064:                 passphrase_path.as_str(),
1065:                 "--output",
1066:                 assignment_exit_path_text.as_str(),
1067:                 "--verifier-key-output",
1068:                 assignment_pub_path_text.as_str(),
1069:                 "--ttl-secs",
1070:                 "300",
1071:             ],
1072:             &[],
1073:             "issuing exit assignment failed",
1074:         )?;
1075:         run_status(
1076:             "rustynet",
1077:             &[
1078:                 "assignment",
1079:                 "issue",
1080:                 "--target-node-id",
1081:                 client_node_id.as_str(),
1082:                 "--nodes",
1083:                 nodes_spec.as_str(),
1084:                 "--allow",
1085:                 allow_spec.as_str(),
1086:                 "--signing-secret",
1087:                 "/etc/rustynet/assignment.signing.secret",
1088:                 "--signing-secret-passphrase-file",
1089:                 passphrase_path.as_str(),
1090:                 "--output",
1091:                 assignment_client_path_text.as_str(),
1092:                 "--verifier-key-output",
1093:                 assignment_pub_path_text.as_str(),
1094:                 "--exit-node-id",
1095:                 exit_node_id.as_str(),
1096:                 "--ttl-secs",
1097:                 "300",
1098:             ],
1099:             &[],
1100:             "issuing client assignment failed",
1101:         )?;
1102: 
1103:         let signing_secret = crate::load_assignment_signing_secret(
1104:             Path::new("/etc/rustynet/assignment.signing.secret"),
1105:             Path::new(passphrase_path.as_str()),
1106:         )?;
1107:         let traversal_artifacts = issue_two_node_traversal_artifacts(
1108:             signing_secret.as_slice(),
1109:             exit_node_id.as_str(),
1110:             client_node_id.as_str(),
1111:             exit_endpoint.as_str(),
1112:             client_endpoint.as_str(),
1113:             exit_pubkey_hex.as_str(),
1114:             client_pubkey_hex.as_str(),
1115:         )?;
1116:         fs::write(
1117:             traversal_pub_path.as_path(),
1118:             format!("{}\n", traversal_artifacts.verifier_key_hex),
1119:         )
1120:         .map_err(|err| format!("write traversal verifier key failed: {err}"))?;
1121:         fs::write(
1122:             traversal_exit_path.as_path(),
1123:             traversal_artifacts.exit_bundle_wire,
1124:         )
1125:         .map_err(|err| format!("write exit traversal bundle failed: {err}"))?;
1126:         fs::write(
1127:             traversal_client_path.as_path(),
1128:             traversal_artifacts.client_bundle_wire,
1129:         )
1130:         .map_err(|err| format!("write client traversal bundle failed: {err}"))?;
1131:         for output_path in [
1132:             assignment_pub_path.as_path(),
1133:             assignment_exit_path.as_path(),
1134:             assignment_client_path.as_path(),
1135:             traversal_pub_path.as_path(),
1136:             traversal_exit_path.as_path(),
1137:             traversal_client_path.as_path(),
1138:         ] {
1139:             set_unix_mode(output_path, 0o600)?;
1140:         }
1141:         Ok(())
1142:     })();
1143:     secure_remove_file(Path::new(passphrase_path.as_str()));
1144:     result?;
1145: 
1146:     Ok(format!(
1147:         "e2e assignment issuance complete: exit_node_id={exit_node_id} client_node_id={client_node_id} artifact_dir={}",
1148:         artifact_dir.display(),
1149:     ))
1150: }

1194: pub fn execute_ops_e2e_issue_assignment_bundles_from_env(
1195:     config: E2eIssueAssignmentBundlesFromEnvConfig,
1196: ) -> Result<String, String> {
1197:     ensure_running_as_root()?;
1198:     let env_values = load_simple_env_file(config.env_file.as_path(), "assignment env file")?;
1199:     let nodes_spec = env_required_value(&env_values, "NODES_SPEC", "assignment env file")?;
1200:     let allow_spec = env_required_value(&env_values, "ALLOW_SPEC", "assignment env file")?;
1201:     let assignments_spec =
1202:         env_required_value(&env_values, "ASSIGNMENTS_SPEC", "assignment env file")?;
1203:     ensure_safe_spec("nodes-spec", nodes_spec.as_str())?;
1204:     ensure_safe_spec("allow-spec", allow_spec.as_str())?;
1205:     ensure_safe_spec("assignments-spec", assignments_spec.as_str())?;
1206: 
1207:     let nodes = parse_generic_nodes(nodes_spec.as_str())?;
1208:     let known_node_ids = nodes
1209:         .iter()
1210:         .map(|node| node.node_id.clone())
1211:         .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
1212:     let allow_pairs = parse_generic_allow_specs(allow_spec.as_str())?;
1213:     let assignment_specs = parse_generic_assignment_specs(assignments_spec.as_str())?;
1214:     prepare_clean_issue_dir(config.issue_dir.as_path(), "assignment issue dir")?;
1215: 
1216:     for pair in &allow_pairs {
1217:         if !known_node_ids.contains(pair.target_node_id.as_str()) {
1218:             return Err(format!(
1219:                 "target node {} from ALLOW_SPEC is missing in NODES_SPEC",
1220:                 pair.target_node_id
1221:             ));
1222:         }
1223:         if !known_node_ids.contains(pair.source_node_id.as_str()) {
1224:             return Err(format!(
1225:                 "source node {} from ALLOW_SPEC is missing in NODES_SPEC",
1226:                 pair.source_node_id
1227:             ));
1228:         }
1229:     }
1230: 
1231:     for assignment in &assignment_specs {
1232:         if !known_node_ids.contains(assignment.target_node_id.as_str()) {
1233:             return Err(format!(
1234:                 "assignment target node is missing from NODES_SPEC: {}",
1235:                 assignment.target_node_id
1236:             ));
1237:         }
1238:         if let Some(exit_node_id) = assignment.exit_node_id.as_ref()
1239:             && !known_node_ids.contains(exit_node_id.as_str())
1240:         {
1241:             return Err(format!(
1242:                 "assignment exit node is missing from NODES_SPEC: {exit_node_id}"
1243:             ));
1244:         }
1245:     }
1246: 
1247:     let verifier_key_output = config.issue_dir.join("rn-assignment.pub");
1248:     let passphrase_path = materialize_signing_passphrase_temp("rustynet-assignment-passphrase")?;
1249:     let result = (|| -> Result<(), String> {
1250:         ensure_regular_file(
1251:             Path::new("/etc/rustynet/assignment.signing.secret"),
1252:             "assignment signing secret",
1253:         )?;
1254:         let signing_secret = crate::load_assignment_signing_secret(
1255:             Path::new("/etc/rustynet/assignment.signing.secret"),
1256:             Path::new(passphrase_path.as_str()),
1257:         )?;
1258:         let (verifier_key_hex, bundles) = issue_assignment_bundle_artifacts(
1259:             signing_secret.as_slice(),
1260:             nodes.as_slice(),
1261:             allow_pairs.as_slice(),
1262:             assignment_specs.as_slice(),
1263:             300,
1264:         )?;
1265:         for bundle in &bundles {
1266:             let output_path = config.issue_dir.join(format!(
1267:                 "rn-assignment-{}.assignment",
1268:                 bundle.target_node_id
1269:             ));
1270:             fs::write(output_path.as_path(), bundle.wire.as_bytes()).map_err(|err| {
1271:                 format!(
1272:                     "write assignment bundle failed ({}): {err}",
1273:                     output_path.display()
1274:                 )
1275:             })?;
1276:         }
1277:         fs::write(
1278:             verifier_key_output.as_path(),
1279:             format!("{verifier_key_hex}\n").as_bytes(),
1280:         )
1281:         .map_err(|err| {
1282:             format!(
1283:                 "write assignment verifier key failed ({}): {err}",
1284:                 verifier_key_output.display()
1285:             )
1286:         })?;
1287:         set_unix_mode(verifier_key_output.as_path(), 0o600)?;
1288:         for assignment in &assignment_specs {
1289:             let output_path = config.issue_dir.join(format!(
1290:                 "rn-assignment-{}.assignment",
1291:                 assignment.target_node_id
1292:             ));
1293:             set_unix_mode(output_path.as_path(), 0o600)?;
1294:         }
1295:         Ok(())
1296:     })();
1297:     secure_remove_file(Path::new(passphrase_path.as_str()));
1298:     result?;
1299: 
1300:     Ok(format!(
1301:         "e2e assignment bundle issuance complete: env_file={} issue_dir={}",
1302:         config.env_file.display(),
1303:         config.issue_dir.display()
1304:     ))
1305: }
1306: 
1307: pub fn execute_ops_e2e_issue_traversal_bundles_from_env(
1308:     config: E2eIssueTraversalBundlesFromEnvConfig,
1309: ) -> Result<String, String> {
1310:     ensure_running_as_root()?;
1311:     let env_values = load_simple_env_file(config.env_file.as_path(), "traversal env file")?;
1312:     let nodes_spec = env_required_value(&env_values, "NODES_SPEC", "traversal env file")?;
1313:     let allow_spec = env_required_value(&env_values, "ALLOW_SPEC", "traversal env file")?;
1314:     ensure_safe_spec("nodes-spec", nodes_spec.as_str())?;
1315:     ensure_safe_spec("allow-spec", allow_spec.as_str())?;
1316:     let ttl_secs = env_values
1317:         .get("TRAVERSAL_TTL_SECS")
1318:         .map(|value| {
1319:             value
1320:                 .parse::<u64>()
1321:                 .map_err(|err| format!("invalid TRAVERSAL_TTL_SECS in traversal env file: {err}"))
1322:         })
1323:         .transpose()?
1324:         .unwrap_or(120);
1325:     if ttl_secs == 0 || ttl_secs > 120 {
1326:         return Err(format!(
1327:             "TRAVERSAL_TTL_SECS must be a positive integer <= 120 (got: {ttl_secs})"
1328:         ));
1329:     }
1330: 
1331:     let nodes = parse_generic_nodes(nodes_spec.as_str())?;
1332:     if nodes.len() < 2 {
1333:         return Err("traversal issue requires at least two nodes in NODES_SPEC".to_string());
1334:     }
1335:     let endpoints_by_node = nodes
1336:         .iter()
1337:         .map(|node| (node.node_id.clone(), node.endpoint.clone()))
1338:         .collect::<BTreeMap<_, _>>();
1339:     let allow_pairs = parse_generic_allow_specs(allow_spec.as_str())?;
1340:     for pair in &allow_pairs {
1341:         if !endpoints_by_node.contains_key(pair.target_node_id.as_str()) {
1342:             return Err(format!(
1343:                 "target node {} from ALLOW_SPEC is missing in NODES_SPEC",
1344:                 pair.target_node_id
1345:             ));
1346:         }
1347:         if !endpoints_by_node.contains_key(pair.source_node_id.as_str()) {
1348:             return Err(format!(
1349:                 "source node {} from ALLOW_SPEC is missing in NODES_SPEC",
1350:                 pair.source_node_id
1351:             ));
1352:         }
1353:     }
1354:     prepare_clean_issue_dir(config.issue_dir.as_path(), "traversal issue dir")?;
1355: 
1356:     let verifier_key_output = config.issue_dir.join("rn-traversal.pub");
1357:     let passphrase_path = materialize_signing_passphrase_temp("rustynet-traversal-passphrase")?;
1358:     let result = (|| -> Result<(), String> {
1359:         ensure_regular_file(
1360:             Path::new("/etc/rustynet/assignment.signing.secret"),
1361:             "assignment signing secret",
1362:         )?;
1363:         let signing_secret = crate::load_assignment_signing_secret(
1364:             Path::new("/etc/rustynet/assignment.signing.secret"),
1365:             Path::new(passphrase_path.as_str()),
1366:         )?;
1367:         let traversal_artifacts = issue_traversal_bundle_artifacts(
1368:             signing_secret.as_slice(),
1369:             nodes.as_slice(),
1370:             allow_pairs.as_slice(),
1371:             ttl_secs,
1372:         )?;
1373:         for pair_bundle in &traversal_artifacts.pair_bundles {
1374:             let pair_path = config.issue_dir.join(format!(
1375:                 "rn-traversal-{}-{}.bundle",
1376:                 pair_bundle.source_node_id, pair_bundle.target_node_id
1377:             ));
1378:             fs::write(pair_path.as_path(), pair_bundle.wire.as_bytes()).map_err(|err| {
1379:                 format!(
1380:                     "write traversal pair bundle failed ({}): {err}",
1381:                     pair_path.display()
1382:                 )
1383:             })?;
1384:         }
1385: 
1386:         let mut aggregate_paths = Vec::new();
1387:         for node in &nodes {
1388:             let aggregate_path = config
1389:                 .issue_dir
1390:                 .join(format!("rn-traversal-{}.traversal", node.node_id));
1391:             let aggregate = traversal_artifacts
1392:                 .aggregate_bundles
1393:                 .get(node.node_id.as_str())
1394:                 .cloned()
1395:                 .unwrap_or_default();
1396:             fs::write(aggregate_path.as_path(), aggregate.as_bytes()).map_err(|err| {
1397:                 format!(
1398:                     "write aggregated traversal bundle failed ({}): {err}",
1399:                     aggregate_path.display()
1400:                 )
1401:             })?;
1402:             aggregate_paths.push(aggregate_path);
1403:         }
1404: 
1405:         fs::write(
1406:             verifier_key_output.as_path(),
1407:             format!("{}\n", traversal_artifacts.verifier_key_hex).as_bytes(),
1408:         )
1409:         .map_err(|err| {
1410:             format!(
1411:                 "write traversal verifier key failed ({}): {err}",
1412:                 verifier_key_output.display()
1413:             )
1414:         })?;
1415:         set_unix_mode(verifier_key_output.as_path(), 0o600)?;
1416:         for pair_bundle in &traversal_artifacts.pair_bundles {
1417:             let pair_path = config.issue_dir.join(format!(
1418:                 "rn-traversal-{}-{}.bundle",
1419:                 pair_bundle.source_node_id, pair_bundle.target_node_id
1420:             ));
1421:             set_unix_mode(pair_path.as_path(), 0o600)?;
1422:         }
1423:         for aggregate_path in &aggregate_paths {
1424:             set_unix_mode(aggregate_path.as_path(), 0o600)?;
1425:         }
1426:         Ok(())
1427:     })();
1428:     secure_remove_file(Path::new(passphrase_path.as_str()));
1429:     result?;
1430: 
1431:     Ok(format!(
1432:         "e2e traversal bundle issuance complete: env_file={} issue_dir={}",
1433:         config.env_file.display(),
1434:         config.issue_dir.display()
1435:     ))
1436: }

1438: pub fn execute_ops_e2e_issue_dns_zone_bundles_from_env(
1439:     config: E2eIssueDnsZoneBundlesFromEnvConfig,
1440: ) -> Result<String, String> {
1441:     ensure_running_as_root()?;
1442:     let env_values = load_simple_env_file(config.env_file.as_path(), "dns zone env file")?;
1443:     let nodes_spec = env_required_value(&env_values, "NODES_SPEC", "dns zone env file")?;
1444:     let allow_spec = env_required_value(&env_values, "ALLOW_SPEC", "dns zone env file")?;
1445:     ensure_safe_spec("nodes-spec", nodes_spec.as_str())?;
1446:     ensure_safe_spec("allow-spec", allow_spec.as_str())?;
1447:     let zone_name = env_values
1448:         .get("DNS_ZONE_NAME")
1449:         .cloned()
1450:         .unwrap_or_else(|| "rustynet".to_string());
1451:     ensure_safe_token("dns-zone-name", zone_name.as_str())?;
1452:     let ttl_secs = env_values
1453:         .get("DNS_ZONE_TTL_SECS")
1454:         .map(|value| {
1455:             value
1456:                 .parse::<u64>()
1457:                 .map_err(|err| format!("invalid DNS_ZONE_TTL_SECS in dns zone env file: {err}"))
1458:         })
1459:         .transpose()?
1460:         .unwrap_or(300);
1461:     if ttl_secs == 0 || ttl_secs > 300 {
1462:         return Err(format!(
1463:             "DNS_ZONE_TTL_SECS must be a positive integer <= 300 (got: {ttl_secs})"
1464:         ));
1465:     }
1466: 
1467:     let nodes = parse_generic_nodes(nodes_spec.as_str())?;
1468:     if nodes.is_empty() {
1469:         return Err("dns zone issue requires at least one node in NODES_SPEC".to_string());
1470:     }
1471:     let known_node_ids = nodes
1472:         .iter()
1473:         .map(|node| node.node_id.clone())
1474:         .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
1475:     let allow_pairs = parse_generic_allow_specs(allow_spec.as_str())?;
1476:     for pair in &allow_pairs {
1477:         if !known_node_ids.contains(pair.target_node_id.as_str()) {
1478:             return Err(format!(
1479:                 "target node {} from ALLOW_SPEC is missing in NODES_SPEC",
1480:                 pair.target_node_id
1481:             ));
1482:         }
1483:         if !known_node_ids.contains(pair.source_node_id.as_str()) {
1484:             return Err(format!(
1485:                 "source node {} from ALLOW_SPEC is missing in NODES_SPEC",
1486:                 pair.source_node_id
1487:             ));
1488:         }
1489:     }
1490:     prepare_clean_issue_dir(config.issue_dir.as_path(), "dns zone issue dir")?;
1491: 
1492:     let verifier_key_output = config.issue_dir.join("rn-dns-zone.pub");
1493:     let passphrase_path = materialize_signing_passphrase_temp("rustynet-dns-zone-passphrase")?;
1494:     let result = (|| -> Result<(), String> {
1495:         ensure_regular_file(
1496:             Path::new("/etc/rustynet/membership.owner.key"),
1497:             "membership owner signing key",
1498:         )?;
1499:         let signing_secret = crate::load_assignment_signing_secret(
1500:             Path::new("/etc/rustynet/membership.owner.key"),
1501:             Path::new(passphrase_path.as_str()),
1502:         )?;
1503:         let (verifier_key_hex, bundles) = issue_dns_zone_bundle_artifacts(
1504:             signing_secret.as_slice(),
1505:             nodes.as_slice(),
1506:             allow_pairs.as_slice(),
1507:             zone_name.as_str(),
1508:             ttl_secs,
1509:         )?;
1510:         for bundle in &bundles {
1511:             let output_path = config
1512:                 .issue_dir
1513:                 .join(format!("rn-dns-zone-{}.dns-zone", bundle.subject_node_id));
1514:             fs::write(output_path.as_path(), bundle.wire.as_bytes()).map_err(|err| {
1515:                 format!(
1516:                     "write dns zone bundle failed ({}): {err}",
1517:                     output_path.display()
1518:                 )
1519:             })?;
1520:             set_unix_mode(output_path.as_path(), 0o600)?;
1521:         }
1522:         fs::write(
1523:             verifier_key_output.as_path(),
1524:             format!("{verifier_key_hex}\n").as_bytes(),
1525:         )
1526:         .map_err(|err| {
1527:             format!(
1528:                 "write dns zone verifier key failed ({}): {err}",
1529:                 verifier_key_output.display()
1530:             )
1531:         })?;
1532:         set_unix_mode(verifier_key_output.as_path(), 0o600)?;
1533:         Ok(())
1534:     })();
1535:     secure_remove_file(Path::new(passphrase_path.as_str()));
1536:     result?;
1537: 
1538:     Ok(format!(
1539:         "e2e dns zone bundle issuance complete: env_file={} issue_dir={} zone_name={} ttl_secs={}",

1541:         config.issue_dir.display(),
1542:         zone_name,
1543:         ttl_secs
