1546: 
1547: struct TwoNodeTraversalArtifacts {
1548:     verifier_key_hex: String,
1549:     exit_bundle_wire: String,
1550:     client_bundle_wire: String,
1551: }
1552: 
1553: fn assignment_verifier_key_hex(signing_secret: &[u8]) -> String {
1554:     ControlPlaneCore::new(signing_secret.to_vec(), PolicySet::default())
1555:         .assignment_verifier_key_hex()
1556: }
1557: 
1558: fn traversal_verifier_key_hex(signing_secret: &[u8]) -> String {
1559:     ControlPlaneCore::new(signing_secret.to_vec(), PolicySet::default())
1560:         .endpoint_hint_verifier_key_hex()
1561: }
1562: 
1563: fn issue_two_node_traversal_artifacts(
1564:     signing_secret: &[u8],
1565:     exit_node_id: &str,
1566:     client_node_id: &str,
1567:     exit_endpoint: &str,
1568:     client_endpoint: &str,
1569:     exit_pubkey_hex: &str,
1570:     client_pubkey_hex: &str,
1571: ) -> Result<TwoNodeTraversalArtifacts, String> {
1572:     ensure_hex_32("exit-pubkey-hex", exit_pubkey_hex)?;
1573:     ensure_hex_32("client-pubkey-hex", client_pubkey_hex)?;
1574:     let now_unix = unix_now();
1575:     let policy = PolicySet {
1576:         rules: vec![
1577:             PolicyRule {
1578:                 src: format!("node:{exit_node_id}"),
1579:                 dst: format!("node:{client_node_id}"),
1580:                 protocol: Protocol::Any,
1581:                 action: RuleAction::Allow,
1582:             },
1583:             PolicyRule {
1584:                 src: format!("node:{client_node_id}"),
1585:                 dst: format!("node:{exit_node_id}"),
1586:                 protocol: Protocol::Any,
1587:                 action: RuleAction::Allow,
1588:             },
1589:         ],
1590:     };
1591:     let core = ControlPlaneCore::new(signing_secret.to_vec(), policy);
1592:     core.nodes
1593:         .upsert(NodeMetadata {
1594:             node_id: exit_node_id.to_string(),
1595:             hostname: exit_node_id.to_string(),
1596:             os: "linux".to_string(),
1597:             tags: Vec::new(),
1598:             owner: exit_node_id.to_string(),
1599:             endpoint: exit_endpoint.to_string(),
1600:             last_seen_unix: now_unix,
1601:             public_key: decode_hex_32(exit_pubkey_hex)?,
1602:         })
1603:         .map_err(|err| format!("register exit node failed: {err}"))?;
1604:     core.nodes
1605:         .upsert(NodeMetadata {
1606:             node_id: client_node_id.to_string(),
1607:             hostname: client_node_id.to_string(),
1608:             os: "linux".to_string(),
1609:             tags: Vec::new(),
1610:             owner: client_node_id.to_string(),
1611:             endpoint: client_endpoint.to_string(),
1612:             last_seen_unix: now_unix,
1613:             public_key: decode_hex_32(client_pubkey_hex)?,
1614:         })
1615:         .map_err(|err| format!("register client node failed: {err}"))?;
1616: 
1617:     let exit_bundle = core
1618:         .signed_endpoint_hint_bundle(EndpointHintBundleRequest {
1619:             source_node_id: exit_node_id.to_string(),
1620:             target_node_id: client_node_id.to_string(),
1621:             generated_at_unix: now_unix,
1622:             ttl_secs: 120,
1623:             nonce: traversal_nonce(now_unix, 0),
1624:             candidates: vec![EndpointHintCandidate {
1625:                 candidate_type: EndpointHintCandidateType::Host,
1626:                 endpoint: client_endpoint.to_string(),
1627:                 relay_id: None,
1628:                 priority: 900,
1629:             }],
1630:         })
1631:         .map_err(|err| format!("issue exit traversal bundle failed: {err}"))?;
1632:     if !core.verify_signed_endpoint_hint_bundle(&exit_bundle) {
1633:         return Err("self-verify failed for exit traversal bundle".to_string());
1634:     }
1635: 
1636:     let client_bundle = core
1637:         .signed_endpoint_hint_bundle(EndpointHintBundleRequest {
1638:             source_node_id: client_node_id.to_string(),
1639:             target_node_id: exit_node_id.to_string(),
1640:             generated_at_unix: now_unix,
1641:             ttl_secs: 120,
1642:             nonce: traversal_nonce(now_unix, 1),
1643:             candidates: vec![EndpointHintCandidate {
1644:                 candidate_type: EndpointHintCandidateType::Host,
1645:                 endpoint: exit_endpoint.to_string(),
1646:                 relay_id: None,
1647:                 priority: 900,
1648:             }],
1649:         })
1650:         .map_err(|err| format!("issue client traversal bundle failed: {err}"))?;
1651:     if !core.verify_signed_endpoint_hint_bundle(&client_bundle) {
1652:         return Err("self-verify failed for client traversal bundle".to_string());
1653:     }
1654: 
1655:     Ok(TwoNodeTraversalArtifacts {
1656:         verifier_key_hex: core.endpoint_hint_verifier_key_hex(),
1657:         exit_bundle_wire: ControlPlaneCore::signed_endpoint_hint_bundle_to_wire(&exit_bundle),
1658:         client_bundle_wire: ControlPlaneCore::signed_endpoint_hint_bundle_to_wire(&client_bundle),
1659:     })
1660: }
1661: 
1662: fn control_plane_core_from_generic_specs(
1663:     signing_secret: &[u8],
1664:     nodes: &[GenericTraversalNodeSpec],
1665:     allow_pairs: &[GenericTraversalAllowSpec],
1666: ) -> Result<ControlPlaneCore, String> {
1667:     let policy = PolicySet {
1668:         rules: allow_pairs
1669:             .iter()
1670:             .map(|pair| PolicyRule {
1671:                 src: format!("node:{}", pair.source_node_id),
1672:                 dst: format!("node:{}", pair.target_node_id),
1673:                 protocol: Protocol::Any,
1674:                 action: RuleAction::Allow,
1675:             })
1676:             .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
1677:     };
1678:     let core = ControlPlaneCore::new(signing_secret.to_vec(), policy);
1679:     let now_unix = unix_now();
1680:     for node in nodes {
1681:         core.nodes
1682:             .upsert(NodeMetadata {
1683:                 node_id: node.node_id.clone(),
1684:                 hostname: node.node_id.clone(),
1685:                 os: "linux".to_string(),
1686:                 tags: Vec::new(),
1687:                 owner: node.node_id.clone(),
1688:                 endpoint: node.endpoint.clone(),
1689:                 last_seen_unix: now_unix,
1690:                 public_key: node.public_key,
1691:             })
1692:             .map_err(|err| format!("register node failed: {err}"))?;
1693:     }
1694:     Ok(core)
1695: }
1696: 
1697: fn issue_assignment_bundle_artifacts(
1698:     signing_secret: &[u8],
1699:     nodes: &[GenericTraversalNodeSpec],
1700:     allow_pairs: &[GenericTraversalAllowSpec],
1701:     assignment_specs: &[GenericAssignmentSpec],
1702:     ttl_secs: u64,
1703: ) -> Result<(String, Vec<IssuedAssignmentBundle>), String> {
1704:     let core = control_plane_core_from_generic_specs(signing_secret, nodes, allow_pairs)?;
1705:     let generated_at_unix = unix_now();
1706:     let bundles = assignment_specs
1707:         .iter()
1708:         .enumerate()
1709:         .map(|(index, assignment)| {
1710:             let bundle = core
1711:                 .signed_auto_tunnel_bundle(AutoTunnelBundleRequest {
1712:                     node_id: assignment.target_node_id.clone(),
1713:                     generated_at_unix,
1714:                     ttl_secs,
1715:                     nonce: crate::generate_assignment_nonce().saturating_add(index as u64),
1716:                     mesh_cidr: "100.64.0.0/10".to_string(),
1717:                     exit_node_id: assignment.exit_node_id.clone(),
1718:                     lan_routes: Vec::new(),
1719:                 })
1720:                 .map_err(|err| format!("issue assignment bundle failed: {err}"))?;
1721:             if !core.verify_signed_auto_tunnel_bundle(&bundle) {
1722:                 return Err(format!(
1723:                     "self-verify failed for assignment bundle target {}",
1724:                     assignment.target_node_id
1725:                 ));
1726:             }
1727:             Ok(IssuedAssignmentBundle {
1728:                 target_node_id: assignment.target_node_id.clone(),
1729:                 wire: ControlPlaneCore::signed_auto_tunnel_bundle_to_wire(&bundle),
1730:             })
1731:         })
1732:         .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?;
1733:     Ok((assignment_verifier_key_hex(signing_secret), bundles))
1734: }
1735: 
1736: fn issue_traversal_bundle_artifacts(
1737:     signing_secret: &[u8],
1738:     nodes: &[GenericTraversalNodeSpec],
1739:     allow_pairs: &[GenericTraversalAllowSpec],
1740:     ttl_secs: u64,
1741: ) -> Result<IssuedTraversalArtifacts, String> {
1742:     let endpoints_by_node = nodes
1743:         .iter()
1744:         .map(|node| (node.node_id.clone(), node.endpoint.clone()))
1745:         .collect::<BTreeMap<_, _>>();
1746:     let core = control_plane_core_from_generic_specs(signing_secret, nodes, allow_pairs)?;
1747:     let generated_at_unix = unix_now();
1748:     let snapshot_nonce = traversal_nonce(generated_at_unix, 0);
1749:     let coordination_ttl_secs = ttl_secs.min(30);
1750:     let mut aggregate_bundles = BTreeMap::<String, String>::new();
1751:     let mut pair_bundles = Vec::new();
1752:     let mut emitted_coordination_pairs = BTreeSet::new();
1753: 
1754:     for pair in allow_pairs {
1755:         let target_endpoint = endpoints_by_node
1756:             .get(pair.target_node_id.as_str())
1757:             .ok_or_else(|| {
1758:                 format!(
1759:                     "target node {} from ALLOW_SPEC is missing in NODES_SPEC",
1760:                     pair.target_node_id
1761:                 )
1762:             })?;
1763:         let bundle = core
1764:             .signed_endpoint_hint_bundle(EndpointHintBundleRequest {
1765:                 source_node_id: pair.source_node_id.clone(),
1766:                 target_node_id: pair.target_node_id.clone(),
1767:                 generated_at_unix,
1768:                 ttl_secs,
1769:                 nonce: snapshot_nonce,
1770:                 candidates: vec![EndpointHintCandidate {
1771:                     candidate_type: EndpointHintCandidateType::Host,
1772:                     endpoint: target_endpoint.clone(),
1773:                     relay_id: None,
1774:                     priority: 900,
1775:                 }],
1776:             })
1777:             .map_err(|err| format!("issue traversal bundle failed: {err}"))?;
1778:         if !core.verify_signed_endpoint_hint_bundle(&bundle) {
1779:             return Err(format!(
1780:                 "self-verify failed for traversal bundle {} -> {}",
1781:                 pair.source_node_id, pair.target_node_id
1782:             ));
1783:         }
1784:         let wire = ControlPlaneCore::signed_endpoint_hint_bundle_to_wire(&bundle);
1785:         aggregate_bundles
1786:             .entry(pair.source_node_id.clone())
1787:             .or_default()
1788:             .push_str(format!("{wire}\n").as_str());
1789:         pair_bundles.push(IssuedTraversalPairBundle {
1790:             source_node_id: pair.source_node_id.clone(),
1791:             target_node_id: pair.target_node_id.clone(),
1792:             wire,
1793:         });
1794: 
1795:         let coordination_key = traversal_coordination_pair_key(
1796:             pair.source_node_id.as_str(),
1797:             pair.target_node_id.as_str(),
1798:         );
1799:         if !emitted_coordination_pairs.insert(coordination_key) {
1800:             continue;
1801:         }
1802: 
1803:         let signed_coordination = core
1804:             .signed_traversal_coordination_record(TraversalCoordinationRecord {
1805:                 session_id: random_nonzero_coordination_bytes(),
1806:                 probe_start_unix: generated_at_unix,
1807:                 node_a: pair.source_node_id.clone(),
1808:                 node_b: pair.target_node_id.clone(),
1809:                 issued_at_unix: generated_at_unix,
1810:                 expires_at_unix: generated_at_unix.saturating_add(coordination_ttl_secs),
1811:                 nonce: random_nonzero_coordination_bytes(),
1812:             })
1813:             .map_err(|err| format!("issue traversal coordination failed: {err}"))?;
1814:         if !core.verify_signed_traversal_coordination_record(&signed_coordination) {
1815:             return Err(format!(
1816:                 "self-verify failed for traversal coordination {} <-> {}",
1817:                 pair.source_node_id, pair.target_node_id
1818:             ));
1819:         }
1820: 
1821:         let coordination_wire = signed_traversal_coordination_record_to_wire(&signed_coordination);
1822:         aggregate_bundles
1823:             .entry(pair.source_node_id.clone())
1824:             .or_default()
1825:             .push_str(format!("{coordination_wire}\n").as_str());
1826:         aggregate_bundles
1827:             .entry(pair.target_node_id.clone())
1828:             .or_default()
1829:             .push_str(format!("{coordination_wire}\n").as_str());
1830:     }
1831: 
1832:     Ok(IssuedTraversalArtifacts {
1833:         verifier_key_hex: traversal_verifier_key_hex(signing_secret),
1834:         pair_bundles,
1835:         aggregate_bundles,
1836:     })
1837: }
1838: 
1839: fn issue_dns_zone_bundle_artifacts(
1840:     signing_secret: &[u8],
1841:     nodes: &[GenericTraversalNodeSpec],
1842:     allow_pairs: &[GenericTraversalAllowSpec],
1843:     zone_name: &str,
1844:     ttl_secs: u64,
1845: ) -> Result<(String, Vec<IssuedDnsZoneBundle>), String> {
1846:     let core = control_plane_core_from_generic_specs(signing_secret, nodes, allow_pairs)?;
1847:     let generated_at_unix = unix_now();
1848:     let nodes_by_id = nodes
1849:         .iter()
1850:         .map(|node| (node.node_id.clone(), node))
1851:         .collect::<BTreeMap<_, _>>();
1852:     let mut visible_targets_by_subject = BTreeMap::<String, BTreeSet<String>>::new();
1853:     for node in nodes {
1854:         visible_targets_by_subject
1855:             .entry(node.node_id.clone())
1856:             .or_default()
1857:             .insert(node.node_id.clone());
1858:     }
1859:     for pair in allow_pairs {
1860:         visible_targets_by_subject
1861:             .entry(pair.source_node_id.clone())
1862:             .or_default()
1863:             .insert(pair.target_node_id.clone());
1864:     }
1865: 
1866:     let bundles = nodes
1867:         .iter()
1868:         .enumerate()
1869:         .map(|(index, subject)| {
1870:             let visible_targets = visible_targets_by_subject
1871:                 .get(subject.node_id.as_str())
1872:                 .cloned()
1873:                 .unwrap_or_else(|| {
1874:                     let mut only_self = BTreeSet::new();
1875:                     only_self.insert(subject.node_id.clone());
1876:                     only_self
1877:                 });
1878:             let records = visible_targets
1879:                 .into_iter()
1880:                 .map(|target_node_id| {
1881:                     let target = nodes_by_id.get(&target_node_id).ok_or_else(|| {
1882:                         format!("dns zone target {target_node_id} is missing from NODES_SPEC")
1883:                     })?;
1884:                     Ok(DnsRecordRequest {
1885:                         label: target.node_id.clone(),
1886:                         target_node_id,
1887:                         ttl_secs,
1888:                         rr_type: DnsRecordType::A,
1889:                         target_addr_kind: DnsTargetAddrKind::MeshIpv4,
1890:                         aliases: Vec::new(),
1891:                     })
1892:                 })
1893:                 .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, String>>()?;
1894:             let bundle = core
1895:                 .signed_dns_zone_bundle(SignedDnsZoneBundleRequest {
1896:                     zone_name: zone_name.to_string(),
1897:                     subject_node_id: subject.node_id.clone(),
1898:                     generated_at_unix,
1899:                     ttl_secs,
1900:                     nonce: crate::generate_assignment_nonce().saturating_add(index as u64),
1901:                     records,
1902:                 })
1903:                 .map_err(|err| format!("issue dns zone bundle failed: {err}"))?;
1904:             if !core.verify_signed_dns_zone_bundle(&bundle) {
1905:                 return Err(format!(
1906:                     "self-verify failed for dns zone bundle subject {}",
1907:                     subject.node_id
1908:                 ));
1909:             }
1910:             Ok(IssuedDnsZoneBundle {
1911:                 subject_node_id: subject.node_id.clone(),
1912:                 wire: ControlPlaneCore::signed_dns_zone_bundle_to_wire(&bundle),
1913:             })
1914:         })
1915:         .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, String>>()?;
1916: 
1917:     Ok((core.dns_zone_verifier_key_hex(), bundles))
1918: }
1919: 
1920: fn traversal_nonce(now_unix: u64, offset: u64) -> u64 {
1921:     now_unix
1922:         .saturating_mul(1_000)
1923:         .saturating_add(u64::from(std::process::id()))
1924:         .saturating_add(offset)
1925: }
1926: 
1927: fn traversal_coordination_pair_key(left: &str, right: &str) -> (String, String) {
1928:     if left <= right {
1929:         (left.to_string(), right.to_string())
1930:     } else {
1931:         (right.to_string(), left.to_string())
1932:     }
1933: }
1934: 
1935: fn random_nonzero_coordination_bytes() -> [u8; 16] {
1936:     let mut bytes = [0u8; 16];
1937:     while bytes.iter().all(|value| *value == 0) {
1938:         OsRng
1939:             .try_fill_bytes(&mut bytes)
1940:             .expect("os randomness unavailable for traversal coordination bytes");
1941:     }
1942:     bytes
1943: }
1944: 
1945: fn signed_traversal_coordination_record_to_wire(
1946:     record: &SignedTraversalCoordinationRecord,
1947: ) -> String {
1948:     format!("{}signature={}\n", record.payload, record.signature_hex)
1949: }

1951: pub fn execute_ops_run_debian_two_node_e2e(

1957:     let report_path = if config.report_path.is_absolute() {
1958:         config.report_path.clone()
1959:     } else {
1960:         repo_root.join(&config.report_path)
1961:     };
1962:     ensure_command_exists("git")?;
1963:     ensure_command_exists("ssh")?;
1964:     ensure_command_exists("ssh-keygen")?;
1965:     ensure_command_exists("tar")?;

1969:     let workspace = Workspace::new(known_hosts_source.as_path())?;
1970: 
1971:     let exit_target = qualify_target(config.exit_host.as_str(), config.ssh_user.as_str());
1972:     let client_target = qualify_target(config.client_host.as_str(), config.ssh_user.as_str());
1973:     ensure_known_hosts_has_entry(
1974:         known_hosts_source.as_path(),

3204: fn validate_config(config: &DebianTwoNodeE2eConfig) -> Result<(), String> {
3205:     if config.exit_host.trim().is_empty()
3206:         || config.client_host.trim().is_empty()
3207:         || config.ssh_allow_cidrs.trim().is_empty()
3208:     {
3209:         return Err("--exit-host, --client-host, and --ssh-allow-cidrs are required".to_string());
3210:     }
3211:     if !config.remote_root.is_absolute() {
3212:         return Err(format!(
3213:             "--remote-root must be absolute: {}",
3214:             config.remote_root.display()
3215:         ));
3216:     }
3217:     if let Some(identity) = config.ssh_identity.as_ref()
3218:         && !identity.is_file()
3219:     {
3220:         return Err(format!(
3221:             "--ssh-identity does not exist: {}",
3222:             identity.display()
3223:         ));
3224:     }
3225:     for (label, value) in [
3226:         ("exit-node-id", config.exit_node_id.as_str()),
3227:         ("client-node-id", config.client_node_id.as_str()),
3228:         ("network-id", config.network_id.as_str()),
3229:         ("remote-root", &config.remote_root.display().to_string()),
3230:         ("ssh-allow-cidrs", config.ssh_allow_cidrs.as_str()),
3231:     ] {
3232:         ensure_safe_token(label, value)?;
3233:     }
3234:     Ok(())
3235: }
3236: 
3237: fn ensure_safe_token(label: &str, value: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
3238:     if value.is_empty() {
3239:         return Err(format!("{label} must not be empty"));
3240:     }
3241:     let allowed = |c: char| {
3242:         c.is_ascii_alphanumeric()
3243:             || matches!(c, '.' | '_' | ':' | '/' | ',' | '@' | '+' | '=' | '-')
3244:     };
3245:     if !value.chars().all(allowed) {
3246:         return Err(format!("{label} contains unsupported characters: {value}"));
3247:     }
3248:     Ok(())
3249: }
3250: 
3251: fn ensure_safe_spec(label: &str, value: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
3252:     if value.is_empty() {
3253:         return Err(format!("{label} must not be empty"));
3254:     }
3255:     let allowed = |c: char| {
3256:         c.is_ascii_alphanumeric()
3257:             || matches!(
3258:                 c,
3259:                 '.' | '_' | ':' | '/' | ',' | '@' | '+' | '=' | '-' | '|' | ';'
3260:             )
3261:     };
3262:     if !value.chars().all(allowed) {
3263:         return Err(format!("{label} contains unsupported characters: {value}"));
3264:     }
3265:     Ok(())
3266: }

3272: fn ensure_regular_file(path: &Path, label: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
3273:     let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(path)
3274:         .map_err(|err| format!("{label} missing ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
3275:     if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
3276:         return Err(format!("{label} must not be a symlink: {}", path.display()));
3277:     }
3278:     if !metadata.is_file() {
3279:         return Err(format!("{label} must be a file: {}", path.display()));
3280:     }
3281:     Ok(())
3282: }

3284: fn validate_env_key_like(key: &str) -> bool {
3285:     !key.is_empty()
3286:         && key
3287:             .chars()
3288:             .all(|ch| ch.is_ascii_uppercase() || ch.is_ascii_digit() || ch == '_')
3289: }

3291: fn load_simple_env_file(path: &Path, label: &str) -> Result<BTreeMap<String, String>, String> {
3292:     if !path.is_absolute() {
3293:         return Err(format!("{label} path must be absolute: {}", path.display()));
3294:     }
3295:     ensure_regular_file(path, label)?;
3296:     let body = fs::read_to_string(path)
3297:         .map_err(|err| format!("read {label} failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
3298:     let mut values = BTreeMap::new();
3299:     for (index, line) in body.lines().enumerate() {
3300:         let trimmed = line.trim();
3301:         if trimmed.is_empty() || trimmed.starts_with('#') {
3302:             continue;
3303:         }
3304:         let Some((key, raw_value)) = trimmed.split_once('=') else {
3305:             return Err(format!(
3306:                 "{label} line {} is missing '=': {trimmed}",
3307:                 index + 1
3308:             ));
3309:         };
3310:         if !validate_env_key_like(key) {
3311:             return Err(format!("{label} line {} has invalid key: {key}", index + 1));
3312:         }
3313:         let value = crate::env_file::parse_env_value(raw_value).map_err(|err| {
3314:             format!(
3315:                 "{label} line {} has invalid value for {key}: {err}",
3316:                 index + 1
3317:             )
3318:         })?;
3319:         if values.insert(key.to_string(), value).is_some() {
3320:             return Err(format!("{label} contains duplicate key: {key}"));
3321:         }
3322:     }
3323:     Ok(values)
3324: }

3326: fn env_required_value(
3327:     values: &BTreeMap<String, String>,
3328:     key: &str,
3329:     label: &str,
3330: ) -> Result<String, String> {
3331:     let value = values
3332:         .get(key)
3333:         .cloned()
3334:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("{label} is missing required key {key}"))?;
3335:     if value.trim().is_empty() {
3336:         return Err(format!("{label} key {key} must not be empty"));
3337:     }
3338:     Ok(value)
3339: }

3341: fn parse_generic_nodes(encoded: &str) -> Result<Vec<GenericTraversalNodeSpec>, String> {
3342:     let mut nodes = Vec::new();
3343:     for entry in encoded.split(';') {
3344:         let trimmed = entry.trim();
3345:         if trimmed.is_empty() {
3346:             continue;
3347:         }
3348:         let parts = trimmed.split('|').collect::<Vec<_>>();
3349:         if parts.len() < 3 {
3350:             return Err(format!(
3351:                 "invalid NODES_SPEC entry {trimmed:?}; expected node_id|endpoint|public_key_hex[|...]"
3352:             ));
3353:         }
3354:         let node_id = parts[0].trim();
3355:         let endpoint = parts[1].trim();
3356:         let public_key_hex = parts[2].trim();
3357:         ensure_safe_token("node-id", node_id)?;
3358:         ensure_safe_token("endpoint", endpoint)?;
3359:         ensure_hex_32("node-public-key-hex", public_key_hex)?;
3360:         nodes.push(GenericTraversalNodeSpec {
3361:             node_id: node_id.to_string(),
3362:             endpoint: endpoint.to_string(),
3363:             public_key: decode_hex_32(public_key_hex)?,
3364:         });
3365:     }
3366:     if nodes.is_empty() {
3367:         return Err("NODES_SPEC must include at least one node".to_string());
3368:     }
3369:     Ok(nodes)
3370: }
3371: 
3372: fn parse_generic_allow_specs(encoded: &str) -> Result<Vec<GenericTraversalAllowSpec>, String> {
3373:     let mut pairs = Vec::new();
3374:     for entry in encoded.split(';') {
3375:         let trimmed = entry.trim();
3376:         if trimmed.is_empty() {
3377:             continue;
3378:         }
3379:         let Some((source_node_id, target_node_id)) = trimmed.split_once('|') else {
3380:             return Err(format!(
3381:                 "invalid ALLOW_SPEC entry {trimmed:?}; expected source|target"
3382:             ));
3383:         };
3384:         ensure_safe_token("source-node-id", source_node_id)?;
3385:         ensure_safe_token("target-node-id", target_node_id)?;
3386:         pairs.push(GenericTraversalAllowSpec {
3387:             source_node_id: source_node_id.to_string(),
3388:             target_node_id: target_node_id.to_string(),
3389:         });
3390:     }
3391:     if pairs.is_empty() {
3392:         return Err("ALLOW_SPEC must include at least one allow pair".to_string());
3393:     }
3394:     Ok(pairs)
3395: }

3397: fn parse_generic_assignment_specs(encoded: &str) -> Result<Vec<GenericAssignmentSpec>, String> {
3398:     let mut assignments = Vec::new();
3399:     for entry in encoded.split(';') {
3400:         let trimmed = entry.trim();
3401:         if trimmed.is_empty() {
3402:             continue;
3403:         }
3404:         let Some((target_node_id, raw_exit_node_id)) = trimmed.split_once('|') else {
3405:             return Err(format!(
3406:                 "invalid ASSIGNMENTS_SPEC entry {trimmed:?}; expected target|exit_or_dash"
3407:             ));
3408:         };
3409:         ensure_safe_token("target-node-id", target_node_id)?;
3410:         let exit_node_id = match raw_exit_node_id.trim() {
3411:             "" | "-" => None,
3412:             value => {
3413:                 ensure_safe_token("exit-node-id", value)?;
3414:                 Some(value.to_string())
3415:             }
3416:         };
3417:         assignments.push(GenericAssignmentSpec {
3418:             target_node_id: target_node_id.to_string(),
3419:             exit_node_id,
3420:         });
3421:     }
3422:     if assignments.is_empty() {
3423:         return Err("ASSIGNMENTS_SPEC must include at least one target".to_string());
3424:     }
3425:     Ok(assignments)
3426: }

3428: fn prepare_clean_issue_dir(path: &Path, label: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
3429:     if !path.is_absolute() {
3430:         return Err(format!("{label} path must be absolute: {}", path.display()));
3431:     }
3432:     ensure_safe_remote_path(path.display().to_string().as_str())?;
3433:     match fs::symlink_metadata(path) {
3434:         Ok(metadata) => {
3435:             if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
3436:                 return Err(format!("{label} must not be a symlink: {}", path.display()));
3437:             }
3438:             if !metadata.is_dir() {
3439:                 return Err(format!("{label} must be a directory: {}", path.display()));
3440:             }
3441:             fs::remove_dir_all(path)
3442:                 .map_err(|err| format!("remove {label} failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
3443:         }
3444:         Err(err) if err.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => {}
3445:         Err(err) => {
3446:             return Err(format!(
3447:                 "inspect {label} failed ({}): {err}",
3448:                 path.display()
3449:             ));
3450:         }
3451:     }
3452:     fs::create_dir_all(path)
3453:         .map_err(|err| format!("create {label} failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
3454:     set_unix_mode(path, 0o700)?;
3455:     Ok(())
3456: }

3475: fn ensure_hex_32(label: &str, value: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
3476:     if value.len() != 64 || !value.chars().all(|ch| ch.is_ascii_hexdigit()) {
3477:         return Err(format!("{label} must be 64 hex characters"));
3478:     }
3479:     Ok(())
3480: }
3481: 
3482: fn decode_hex_32(value: &str) -> Result<[u8; 32], String> {
3483:     ensure_hex_32("hex", value)?;
3484:     let mut out = [0u8; 32];
3485:     for (index, chunk) in value.as_bytes().chunks_exact(2).enumerate() {
3486:         let hi = decode_hex_nibble(chunk[0]).ok_or_else(|| "invalid hex".to_string())?;
3487:         let lo = decode_hex_nibble(chunk[1]).ok_or_else(|| "invalid hex".to_string())?;
3488:         out[index] = (hi << 4) | lo;
3489:     }
3490:     Ok(out)
3491: }
3492: 
3493: fn decode_hex_nibble(value: u8) -> Option<u8> {
3494:     match value {
3495:         b'0'..=b'9' => Some(value - b'0'),
3496:         b'a'..=b'f' => Some(value - b'a' + 10),
3497:         b'A'..=b'F' => Some(value - b'A' + 10),
3498:         _ => None,
3499:     }
3500: }

3506:         Err(std::env::VarError::NotUnicode(_)) => {
3507:             Err("RUSTYNET_BACKEND must be valid UTF-8".to_string())

3536: /// On Windows, `net session` succeeds only when the caller holds a local
3537: /// Administrator token.  This is the standard zero-dependency elevation check.
3538: #[cfg(windows)]
3539: fn ensure_running_as_root() -> Result<(), String> {

3541:         .args(["session"])
3542:         .output()
3543:         .map_err(|err| format!("admin privilege check failed: {err}"))?;

3545:         return Ok(());

3550: fn run_status(
3551:     program: &str,
3552:     args: &[&str],
3553:     envs: &[(&str, &str)],
3554:     context: &str,
3555: ) -> Result<(), String> {
3556:     let mut command = Command::new(program);
3557:     command.args(args);
3558:     for (key, value) in envs {
3559:         command.env(key, value);
3560:     }
3561:     let output = command
3562:         .output()
3563:         .map_err(|err| format!("{context}: failed to spawn {program}: {err}"))?;
3564:     if output.status.success() {
3565:         return Ok(());
3566:     }
3567:     let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).trim().to_string();
3568:     let stdout = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).trim().to_string();
3569:     let detail = match (stdout.is_empty(), stderr.is_empty()) {
3570:         (true, true) => "no stdout/stderr output".to_string(),
3571:         (true, false) => format!("stderr={stderr}"),
3572:         (false, true) => format!("stdout={stdout}"),
3573:         (false, false) => format!("stdout={stdout}; stderr={stderr}"),
3574:     };
3575:     Err(format!(
3576:         "{context}: status={} {}",
3577:         output.status.code().unwrap_or(-1),
3578:         detail
3579:     ))
3580: }

3583:     let mut command = Command::new(program);
3584:     command.args(args);
3585:     for (key, value) in envs {
3586:         command.env(key, value);
3587:     }
3588:     let _ = command.output();
3589: }

3610: fn capture_stdout(program: &str, args: &[&str], envs: &[(&str, &str)]) -> Result<String, String> {

3612:     command.args(args);

3615:     }

3617:         .output()
3618:         .map_err(|err| format!("failed to spawn {program}: {err}"))?;

3620:         return Err(format!(

3629: fn extract_first_ipv4(output: &str) -> Option<&str> {
3630:     for line in output.lines() {
3631:         let tokens = line.split_whitespace().collect::<Vec<_>>();
3632:         for (index, token) in tokens.iter().enumerate() {
3633:             if *token == "inet" {
3634:                 let cidr = tokens.get(index + 1)?;
3635:                 let address = cidr.split('/').next().unwrap_or_default();
3636:                 if !address.is_empty() {
3637:                     return Some(address);
3638:                 }
3639:             }
3640:         }
3641:     }
3642:     None
3643: }

3660: fn install_linux_e2e_prerequisites() -> Result<(), String> {
3661:     let os_release = fs::read_to_string("/etc/os-release")
3662:         .map_err(|err| format!("failed to read /etc/os-release: {err}"))?;
3663:     let os_id = parse_os_release_value(os_release.as_str(), "ID");

3666:         || os_like
3667:             .split_whitespace()
3668:             .any(|value| value == "fedora" || value == "rhel");

3670:         || os_id == "ubuntu"
3671:         || os_id == "linuxmint"
3672:         || os_like
3673:             .split_whitespace()
3674:             .any(|value| value == "debian" || value == "ubuntu");
3675: 
3676:     if is_fedora_like {
3677:         run_status(
3678:             "dnf",
3679:             &[
3680:                 "install",
3681:                 "-y",
3682:                 "ca-certificates",
3683:                 "curl",
3684:                 "git",
3685:                 "gcc",
3686:                 "gcc-c++",
3687:                 "make",
3688:                 "pkgconf-pkg-config",
3689:                 "openssl-devel",
3690:                 "sqlite-devel",
3691:                 "clang",
3692:                 "llvm",
3693:                 "nftables",
3694:                 "wireguard-tools",
3695:                 "openssl",
3696:                 "rustup",
3697:             ],
3698:             &[],
3699:             "dnf install failed during e2e bootstrap",
3700:         )?;
3701:         return Ok(());
3702:     }
3703: 
3704:     if is_debian_like {
3705:         run_status(
3706:             "apt-get",
3707:             &["update"],
3708:             &[],
3709:             "apt update failed during e2e bootstrap",
3710:         )?;
3711:         run_status(
3712:             "apt-get",
3713:             &[
3714:                 "install",
3715:                 "-y",
3716:                 "--no-install-recommends",
3717:                 "ca-certificates",
3718:                 "curl",
3719:                 "git",
3720:                 "build-essential",
3721:                 "pkg-config",
3722:                 "libssl-dev",
3723:                 "libsqlite3-dev",
3724:                 "clang",
3725:                 "llvm",
3726:                 "nftables",
3727:                 "wireguard-tools",
3728:                 "openssl",
3729:                 "systemd-resolved",
3730:                 "libnss-resolve",
3731:                 "rustup",
3732:             ],
3733:             &[],
3734:             "apt install failed during e2e bootstrap",
3735:         )?;
3736:         return Ok(());
3737:     }
3738: 
3739:     Err(format!(
3740:         "unsupported Linux distribution for e2e bootstrap (ID={os_id}, ID_LIKE={os_like})"
3741:     ))
3742: }

3744: fn parse_os_release_value(contents: &str, key: &str) -> String {
3745:     let prefix = format!("{key}=");
3746:     contents
3747:         .lines()
3748:         .find_map(|line| line.strip_prefix(prefix.as_str()))
3749:         .map(|value| value.trim_matches('"').to_string())
3750:         .unwrap_or_default()
3751: }

3753: fn rust_toolchain_channel(repo_root: &Path) -> Result<String, String> {
3754:     let toolchain_path = repo_root.join("rust-toolchain.toml");
3755:     let contents = fs::read_to_string(toolchain_path.as_path()).map_err(|err| {
3756:         format!(
3757:             "failed to read required toolchain file {}: {err}",
3758:             toolchain_path.display()
3759:         )
3760:     })?;
3761:     for line in contents.lines() {
3762:         let trimmed = line.trim();
3763:         if !trimmed.starts_with("channel") {
3764:             continue;
3765:         }
3766:         let Some((_, value)) = trimmed.split_once('=') else {
3767:             continue;
3768:         };
3769:         let channel = value.trim().trim_matches('"').to_string();
3770:         if !channel.is_empty() {
3771:             return Ok(channel);
3772:         }
3773:     }
3774:     Err(format!(
3775:         "failed to parse required toolchain channel from {}",
3776:         toolchain_path.display()
3777:     ))
3778: }
3779: 
3780: fn rustup_proxy_path(tool: &str) -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
3781:     let home = env::var_os("HOME")
3782:         .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
3783:         .map(PathBuf::from)
3784:         .unwrap_or_else(|| PathBuf::from("/root"));
3785:     let path = home.join(".cargo").join("bin").join(tool);
3786:     if is_executable(path.as_path()) {
3787:         return Ok(path);
3788:     }
3789:     Err(format!(
3790:         "missing rustup-managed {tool} proxy at {}; run rustup toolchain bootstrap first",
3791:         path.display()
3792:     ))
3793: }
3794: 
3795: fn rustup_bootstrap_path() -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
3796:     if let Ok(path) = rustup_proxy_path("rustup") {
3797:         return Ok(path);
3798:     }
3799:     for candidate in [
3800:         "/usr/bin/rustup",
3801:         "/bin/rustup",
3802:         "/usr/bin/rustup-init",
3803:         "/bin/rustup-init",
3804:     ] {
3805:         let path = PathBuf::from(candidate);
3806:         if is_executable(path.as_path()) {
3807:             return Ok(path);
3808:         }
3809:     }
3810:     Err("missing rustup bootstrap binary; expected rustup or rustup-init".to_string())
3811: }

3813: fn ensure_pinned_rust_toolchain(repo_root: &Path) -> Result<String, String> {
3814:     let toolchain = rust_toolchain_channel(repo_root)?;
3815:     let bootstrap_path = rustup_bootstrap_path()?;
3816:     let bootstrap_text = bootstrap_path.display().to_string();
3817:     if rustup_proxy_path("rustup").is_err()
3818:         && bootstrap_path
3819:             .file_name()
3820:             .and_then(|value| value.to_str())
3821:             .is_some_and(|name| name == "rustup-init")
3822:     {
3823:         run_status(
3824:             bootstrap_text.as_str(),
3825:             &[
3826:                 "-y",
3827:                 "--profile",
3828:                 "minimal",
3829:                 "--default-toolchain",
3830:                 toolchain.as_str(),
3831:                 "--component",
3832:                 "rustfmt",
3833:                 "--component",
3834:                 "clippy",
3835:             ],
3836:             &[],
3837:             "initializing rustup failed during e2e bootstrap",
3838:         )?;
3839:     }
3840:     let rustup_cli = rustup_proxy_path("rustup").unwrap_or(bootstrap_path);
3841:     let rustup_cli_text = rustup_cli.display().to_string();
3842:     let existing_rustc = capture_stdout(
3843:         rustup_cli_text.as_str(),
3844:         &["run", toolchain.as_str(), "rustc", "--version"],
3845:         &[],
3846:     );
3847:     let existing_cargo = capture_stdout(
3848:         rustup_cli_text.as_str(),
3849:         &["run", toolchain.as_str(), "cargo", "--version"],
3850:         &[],
3851:     );
3852:     run_status(
3853:         rustup_cli_text.as_str(),
3854:         &["set", "profile", "minimal"],
3855:         &[],
3856:         "setting rustup profile failed during e2e bootstrap",
3857:     )?;
3858:     if existing_rustc.is_err() || existing_cargo.is_err() {
3859:         run_status(
3860:             rustup_cli_text.as_str(),
3861:             &[
3862:                 "toolchain",
3863:                 "install",
3864:                 toolchain.as_str(),
3865:                 "--profile",
3866:                 "minimal",
3867:                 "--component",
3868:                 "rustfmt",
3869:                 "--component",
3870:                 "clippy",
3871:             ],
3872:             &[],
3873:             "installing pinned rust toolchain failed during e2e bootstrap",
3874:         )?;
3875:     }
3876:     run_status(
3877:         rustup_cli_text.as_str(),
3878:         &["default", toolchain.as_str()],
3879:         &[],
3880:         "setting default rust toolchain failed during e2e bootstrap",
3881:     )?;
3882:     let rustc_version = capture_stdout(
3883:         rustup_cli_text.as_str(),
3884:         &["run", toolchain.as_str(), "rustc", "--version"],
3885:         &[],
3886:     )
3887:     .map_err(|err| format!("verifying pinned rust toolchain failed: {err}"))?;
3888:     if rustc_version.trim().is_empty() {
3889:         return Err("pinned rust toolchain verification returned empty rustc version".to_string());
3890:     }
3891:     rustup_proxy_path("cargo")?;
3892:     rustup_proxy_path("rustc")?;
3893:     Ok(toolchain)
3894: }

3896: fn resolve_repo_root() -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
3897:     let output = Command::new("git")
3898:         .args(["rev-parse", "--show-toplevel"])
3899:         .output()
3900:         .map_err(|err| format!("failed to resolve repository root via git: {err}"))?;
3901:     if !output.status.success() {
3902:         return Err(format!(
3903:             "git rev-parse --show-toplevel failed: {}",
3904:             String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).trim()
3905:         ));
3906:     }
3907:     let root = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).trim().to_string();
3908:     if root.is_empty() {
3909:         return Err("repository root path is empty".to_string());
3910:     }
3911:     Ok(PathBuf::from(root))
3912: }

3914: fn rev_parse_short(repo_root: &Path, repo_ref: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
3915:     let status = Command::new("git")
3916:         .arg("-C")
3917:         .arg(repo_root)
3918:         .args(["rev-parse", "--verify", &format!("{repo_ref}^{{commit}}")])
3919:         .status()
3920:         .map_err(|err| format!("git rev-parse verify failed to start: {err}"))?;
3921:     if !status.success() {
3922:         return Err(format!("invalid git ref: {repo_ref}"));
3923:     }
3924:     let output = Command::new("git")
3925:         .arg("-C")
3926:         .arg(repo_root)
3927:         .args(["rev-parse", "--short", &format!("{repo_ref}^{{commit}}")])
3928:         .output()
3929:         .map_err(|err| format!("git rev-parse short failed to start: {err}"))?;
3930:     if !output.status.success() {
3931:         return Err(format!(
3932:             "git rev-parse short failed: {}",
3933:             String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).trim()
3934:         ));
3935:     }
3936:     Ok(String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).trim().to_string())
3937: }

3939: fn ensure_command_exists(command: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
3940:     let Some(paths) = env::var_os("PATH") else {
3941:         return Err(format!(
3942:             "PATH is not set; missing required local command: {command}"
3943:         ));
3944:     };
3945:     for dir in env::split_paths(&paths) {
3946:         let candidate = dir.join(command);
3947:         if is_executable(candidate.as_path()) {
3948:             return Ok(());
3949:         }
3950:     }
3951:     Err(format!("missing required local command: {command}"))
3952: }
3953: 
3954: fn is_executable(path: &Path) -> bool {
3955:     if !path.is_file() {
3956:         return false;
3957:     }
3958:     #[cfg(unix)]
3959:     {
3960:         use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
3961:         if let Ok(metadata) = fs::metadata(path) {
3962:             return metadata.permissions().mode() & 0o111 != 0;
3963:         }
3964:         false
3965:     }
3966:     #[cfg(not(unix))]
3967:     {
3968:         true
3969:     }
3970: }
3971: 
3972: fn ensure_executable_file(path: &Path, label: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
3973:     if is_executable(path) {
3974:         return Ok(());
3975:     }
3976:     Err(format!(
3977:         "{label} is missing or not executable: {}",
3978:         path.display()
3979:     ))
3980: }

3982: fn resolve_ssh_known_hosts_file(path: Option<&Path>) -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
3983:     let resolved = if let Some(path) = path {
3984:         path.to_path_buf()
3985:     } else {
3986:         let Some(home) = env::var_os("HOME") else {
3987:             return Err(
3988:                 "missing pinned known_hosts file; provide --ssh-known-hosts-file or set HOME"
3989:                     .to_string(),
3990:             );
3991:         };
3992:         PathBuf::from(home).join(".ssh/known_hosts")
3993:     };
3994:     let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(&resolved).map_err(|err| {
3995:         format!(
3996:             "pinned known_hosts file check failed for {}: {err}",
3997:             resolved.display()
3998:         )
3999:     })?;
4000:     if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
4001:         return Err(format!(
4002:             "pinned known_hosts file must not be a symlink: {}",
4003:             resolved.display()
4004:         ));
4005:     }
4006:     if !metadata.file_type().is_file() {
4007:         return Err(format!(
4008:             "pinned known_hosts file is not a regular file: {}",
4009:             resolved.display()
4010:         ));
4011:     }
4012:     #[cfg(unix)]
4013:     {
4014:         use std::os::unix::fs::MetadataExt;
4015:         let mode = metadata.mode() & 0o777;
4016:         if mode & 0o022 != 0 {
4017:             return Err(format!(
4018:                 "pinned known_hosts file must not be group/world writable: {:03o} ({})",
4019:                 mode,
4020:                 resolved.display()
4021:             ));
4022:         }
4023:     }
4024:     Ok(resolved)
4025: }

4027: fn ensure_known_hosts_has_entry(known_hosts: &Path, host: &str, port: u16) -> Result<(), String> {
4028:     let lookup_host = if port == 22 {
4029:         host.to_string()
4030:     } else {
4031:         format!("[{host}]:{port}")
4032:     };
4033:     let output = Command::new("ssh-keygen")
4034:         .args(["-F", lookup_host.as_str(), "-f"])
4035:         .arg(known_hosts)
4036:         .output()
4037:         .map_err(|err| {
4038:             format!("failed checking pinned known_hosts entry for {lookup_host}: {err}")
4039:         })?;
4040:     if output.status.success() {
4041:         return Ok(());
4042:     }
4043:     Err(format!(
4044:         "pinned known_hosts file {} lacks host key for {lookup_host}",
4045:         known_hosts.display()
4046:     ))
4047: }

4049: fn clear_rustynet_nftables_state() -> Result<(), String> {
4050:     for _attempt in 0..3 {
4051:         let table_listing = capture_stdout("nft", &["list", "tables"], &[]).unwrap_or_default();
4052:         for line in table_listing.lines() {
4053:             let tokens = line.split_whitespace().collect::<Vec<_>>();
4054:             if tokens.len() == 3 && tokens[0] == "table" && tokens[2].starts_with("rustynet") {
4055:                 run_allow_failure("nft", &["flush", "table", tokens[1], tokens[2]], &[]);
4056:                 run_allow_failure("nft", &["delete", "table", tokens[1], tokens[2]], &[]);
4057:             }
4058:         }
4059:         let residual = capture_stdout("nft", &["list", "tables"], &[]).unwrap_or_default();
4060:         if !residual.lines().any(|line| {
4061:             line.split_whitespace()
4062:                 .nth(2)
4063:                 .is_some_and(|name| name.starts_with("rustynet"))
4064:         }) {
4065:             return Ok(());
4066:         }
4067:         std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_secs(1));
4068:     }
4069:     Err("residual rustynet nftables state remained after cleanup".to_string())
4070: }

4072: fn qualify_target(raw: &str, ssh_user: &str) -> Target {
4073:     if raw.contains('@') {
4074:         let address = raw.split('@').nth(1).unwrap_or_default().to_string();
4075:         return Target {
4076:             qualified: raw.to_string(),
4077:             address,
4078:         };
4079:     }
4080:     Target {
4081:         qualified: format!("{ssh_user}@{raw}"),
4082:         address: raw.to_string(),
4083:     }
4084: }

4086: fn target_needs_sudo(target: &str, mode: SshSudoMode) -> bool {
4087:     match mode {
4088:         SshSudoMode::Always => true,
4089:         SshSudoMode::Never => false,
4090:         SshSudoMode::Auto => target.split('@').next().unwrap_or_default() != "root",
4091:     }
4092: }

4094: fn load_sudo_password(path: Option<&Path>, required: bool) -> Result<String, String> {
4095:     if !required {
4096:         return Ok(String::new());
4097:     }
4098:     let Some(path) = path else {
4099:         return Err(
4100:             "sudo is required for non-root SSH targets; provide --sudo-password-file".to_string(),
4101:         );
4102:     };
4103:     let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(path)
4104:         .map_err(|err| format!("sudo password file check failed: {err}"))?;
4105:     if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
4106:         return Err(format!(
4107:             "--sudo-password-file must not be a symlink: {}",
4108:             path.display()
4109:         ));
4110:     }
4111:     #[cfg(unix)]
4112:     {
4113:         use std::os::unix::fs::MetadataExt;
4114:         let mode = metadata.mode() & 0o777;
4115:         if mode != 0o600 {
4116:             return Err(format!(
4117:                 "--sudo-password-file must be mode 0600; found {:03o} ({})",
4118:                 mode,
4119:                 path.display()
4120:             ));
4121:         }
4122:     }
4123:     let contents = fs::read_to_string(path).map_err(|err| {
4124:         format!(
4125:             "failed to read sudo password file {}: {err}",
4126:             path.display()
4127:         )
4128:     })?;
4129:     let first_line = contents
4130:         .lines()
4131:         .next()
4132:         .unwrap_or_default()
4133:         .trim()
4134:         .to_string();
4135:     if first_line.is_empty() {
4136:         return Err(
4137:             "--sudo-password-file must contain a non-empty password on first line".to_string(),
4138:         );
4139:     }
4140:     Ok(first_line)
4141: }

4143: fn build_ssh_base_options(
4144:     workspace: &Workspace,
4145:     port: u16,
4146:     identity: Option<&PathBuf>,
4147: ) -> Vec<OsString> {
4148:     let mut options = vec![

4183: fn open_master(options: &[OsString], host: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
4184:     let output = Command::new("ssh")
4185:         .args(options)
4186:         .arg(host)
4187:         .arg("true")
4188:         .output()
4189:         .map_err(|err| format!("failed opening ssh control master for {host}: {err}"))?;
4190:     if !output.status.success() {
4191:         return Err(format!(
4192:             "failed opening ssh control master for {host}: {}",
4193:             String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).trim()
4194:         ));
4195:     }
4196:     Ok(())
4197: }

4199: fn close_open_masters(options: &[OsString], hosts: &[String]) {

4201:         let _ = Command::new("ssh")
4202:             .args(options)
4203:             .arg("-O")
4204:             .arg("exit")
4205:             .arg(host)
4206:             .status();
4207:     }

4210: fn create_git_archive(repo_root: &Path, repo_ref: &str, output_path: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
4211:     let output_file = File::create(output_path)
4212:         .map_err(|err| format!("failed to create {}: {err}", output_path.display()))?;
4213:     let status = Command::new("git")
4214:         .arg("-C")
4215:         .arg(repo_root)
4216:         .args(["archive", "--format=tar", repo_ref])
4217:         .stdout(Stdio::from(output_file))
4218:         .status()
4219:         .map_err(|err| format!("git archive failed to start: {err}"))?;
4220:     if !status.success() {
4221:         return Err("git archive failed".to_string());
4222:     }
4223:     Ok(())
4224: }

4226: fn run_remote_program(
4227:     options: &[OsString],
4228:     host: &str,
4229:     sudo_password: Option<&str>,
4230:     program: &str,
4231:     args: &[&str],
4232:     envs: &[(&str, &str)],
4233:     allow_failure: bool,
4234: ) -> Result<Output, String> {
4235:     let mut command = Command::new("ssh");
4236:     command.args(options).arg(host);
4237:     if sudo_password.is_some() {
4238:         command
4239:             .arg("sudo")
4240:             .arg("-S")
4241:             .arg("-p")
4242:             .arg(REMOTE_SUDO_PROMPT);
4243:     }
4244:     if !envs.is_empty() {
4245:         command.arg("env");
4246:         for (key, value) in envs {
4247:             ensure_safe_token("remote-env-key", key)?;
4248:             ensure_safe_token("remote-env-value", value)?;
4249:             command.arg(format!("{key}={value}"));
4250:         }
4251:     }
4252:     command.arg(program);
4253:     command.args(args);
4254: 
4255:     let mut payload = Vec::new();
4256:     if let Some(password) = sudo_password {
4257:         payload.extend_from_slice(password.as_bytes());
4258:         payload.push(b'\n');
4259:     }
4260: 
4261:     let output = run_command_with_input_allow_failure(command, payload.as_slice())?;
4262:     if !allow_failure && !output.status.success() {
4263:         return Err(format!(
4264:             "remote command failed on {host}: {program} {}: {}",
4265:             args.join(" "),
4266:             String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).trim()
4267:         ));
4268:     }
4269:     Ok(output)
4270: }
4271: 
4272: fn run_remote_program_checked(
4273:     options: &[OsString],
4274:     host: &str,
4275:     sudo_password: Option<&str>,
4276:     program: &str,
4277:     args: &[&str],
4278:     envs: &[(&str, &str)],
4279: ) -> Result<(), String> {
4280:     run_remote_program(options, host, sudo_password, program, args, envs, false).map(|_| ())
4281: }

4283: fn capture_remote_program_output(
4284:     options: &[OsString],
4285:     host: &str,
4286:     sudo_password: Option<&str>,
4287:     program: &str,
4288:     args: &[&str],
4289:     envs: &[(&str, &str)],
4290:     allow_failure: bool,
4291: ) -> Result<String, String> {
4292:     let output = run_remote_program(
4293:         options,
4294:         host,
4295:         sudo_password,
4296:         program,
4297:         args,
4298:         envs,
4299:         allow_failure,
4300:     )?;
4301:     Ok(String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).to_string())
4302: }

4304: fn copy_local_archive_to_host(
4305:     options: &[OsString],
4306:     host: &str,
4307:     needs_sudo: bool,
4308:     sudo_password: &str,
4309:     local_archive: &Path,
4310:     remote_src_dir: &str,
4311: ) -> Result<(), String> {
4312:     ensure_safe_remote_path(remote_src_dir)?;
4313:     let sudo = if needs_sudo {
4314:         Some(sudo_password)
4315:     } else {
4316:         None
4317:     };
4318:     run_remote_program_checked(options, host, sudo, "rm", &["-rf", remote_src_dir], &[])?;
4319:     run_remote_program_checked(
4320:         options,
4321:         host,
4322:         sudo,
4323:         "install",
4324:         &["-d", "-m", "0755", remote_src_dir],
4325:         &[],
4326:     )?;
4327: 
4328:     let archive_bytes = fs::read(local_archive)
4329:         .map_err(|err| format!("failed to read {}: {err}", local_archive.display()))?;
4330:     let mut command = Command::new("ssh");
4331:     command.args(options).arg(host);
4332:     if needs_sudo {
4333:         command
4334:             .arg("sudo")
4335:             .arg("-S")
4336:             .arg("-p")
4337:             .arg(REMOTE_SUDO_PROMPT)
4338:             .arg("tar")
4339:             .arg("-xf")
4340:             .arg("-")
4341:             .arg("-C")
4342:             .arg(remote_src_dir);
4343:     } else {
4344:         command
4345:             .arg("tar")
4346:             .arg("-xf")
4347:             .arg("-")
4348:             .arg("-C")
4349:             .arg(remote_src_dir);
4350:     }
4351:     let mut payload = Vec::new();
4352:     if needs_sudo {
4353:         payload.extend_from_slice(sudo_password.as_bytes());
4354:         payload.push(b'\n');
4355:     }
4356:     payload.extend_from_slice(&archive_bytes);
4357:     run_command_with_input(command, payload.as_slice()).map(|_| ())
4358: }

4360: fn write_debian_remote_bootstrap_script(path: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
4361:     let script = r#"#!/usr/bin/env bash
4362: set -euo pipefail
4363: 
4364: if [[ $# -ne 6 ]]; then
4365:   echo "usage: remote-bootstrap-host.sh <role> <node-id> <network-id> <src-dir> <ssh-allow-cidrs> <skip-apt>" >&2
4366:   exit 2
4367: fi
4368: 
4369: ROLE="$1"
4370: NODE_ID="$2"
4371: NETWORK_ID="$3"
4372: SRC_DIR="$4"
4373: SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS="$5"
4374: SKIP_APT="$6"
4375: 
4376: export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
4377: 
4378: repair_local_hostname_resolution() {
4379:   local current_hostname
4380:   current_hostname="$(hostname)"
4381:   [[ -n "${current_hostname}" ]] || return 0
4382:   if grep -Eq "(^|[[:space:]])${current_hostname}([[:space:]]|$)" /etc/hosts; then
4383:     return 0
4384:   fi
4385:   printf '\n127.0.1.1\t%s\n' "${current_hostname}" >> /etc/hosts
4386: }
4387: 
4388: repair_local_nsswitch_hosts() {
4389:   if grep -Eq '^[[:space:]]*hosts:.*\bresolve\b' /etc/nsswitch.conf; then
4390:     sed -i 's/^[[:space:]]*hosts:.*/hosts:          files dns/' /etc/nsswitch.conf
4391:   fi
4392: }
4393: 
4394: is_valid_dns_resolver_literal() {
4395:   local resolver="$1"
4396:   if [[ "$resolver" =~ ^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}$ ]]; then
4397:     local IFS='.'
4398:     local octets=()
4399:     local octet
4400:     read -r -a octets <<< "$resolver"
4401:     [[ "${#octets[@]}" -eq 4 ]] || return 1
4402:     for octet in "${octets[@]}"; do
4403:       [[ "$octet" =~ ^[0-9]{1,3}$ ]] || return 1
4404:       ((octet >= 0 && octet <= 255)) || return 1
4405:     done
4406:     return 0
4407:   fi
4408:   [[ "$resolver" =~ ^[0-9A-Fa-f:]+$ ]]
4409: }
4410: 
4411: is_loopback_dns_resolver() {
4412:   local resolver="$1"
4413:   case "$resolver" in
4414:     127.*|::1|0.0.0.0|::)
4415:       return 0
4416:       ;;
4417:     *)
4418:       return 1
4419:       ;;
4420:   esac
4421: }
4422: 
4423: append_unique_dns_resolver() {
4424:   local resolver="$1"
4425:   local existing
4426:   for existing in "${TRUSTED_DNS_RESOLVERS[@]:-}"; do
4427:     if [[ "$existing" == "$resolver" ]]; then
4428:       return 0
4429:     fi
4430:   done
4431:   TRUSTED_DNS_RESOLVERS+=("$resolver")
4432: }
4433: 
4434: collect_trusted_dns_resolvers_from_profile() {
4435:   local raw configured resolver
4436:   raw="${RUSTYNET_BOOTSTRAP_TRUSTED_DNS_RESOLVERS:-}"
4437:   [[ -n "$raw" ]] || return 0
4438:   configured="${raw//,/ }"
4439:   for resolver in $configured; do
4440:     resolver="${resolver%%\%*}"
4441:     if ! is_valid_dns_resolver_literal "$resolver"; then
4442:       echo "invalid resolver in RUSTYNET_BOOTSTRAP_TRUSTED_DNS_RESOLVERS: ${resolver}" >&2
4443:       return 1
4444:     fi
4445:     if is_loopback_dns_resolver "$resolver"; then
4446:       echo "loopback resolver is not allowed in RUSTYNET_BOOTSTRAP_TRUSTED_DNS_RESOLVERS: ${resolver}" >&2
4447:       return 1
4448:     fi
4449:     append_unique_dns_resolver "$resolver"
4450:   done
4451: }
4452: 
4453: collect_trusted_dns_resolvers_from_file() {
4454:   local path="$1"
4455:   local resolver
4456:   [[ -f "$path" ]] || return 0
4457:   while IFS= read -r resolver; do
4458:     resolver="${resolver%%\%*}"
4459:     resolver="${resolver#"${resolver%%[![:space:]]*}"}"
4460:     resolver="${resolver%"${resolver##*[![:space:]]}"}"
4461:     [[ -n "$resolver" ]] || continue
4462:     if ! is_valid_dns_resolver_literal "$resolver"; then
4463:       continue
4464:     fi
4465:     if is_loopback_dns_resolver "$resolver"; then
4466:       continue
4467:     fi
4468:     append_unique_dns_resolver "$resolver"
4469:   done < <(awk '$1 == "nameserver" { print $2 }' "$path")
4470: }
4471: 
4472: repair_local_dns_resolution() {
4473:   local resolver tmp_resolv backup_resolv
4474:   TRUSTED_DNS_RESOLVERS=()
4475:   if timeout 5 getent hosts static.rust-lang.org >/dev/null 2>&1; then
4476:     return 0
4477:   fi
4478:   collect_trusted_dns_resolvers_from_profile || return 1
4479:   collect_trusted_dns_resolvers_from_file /run/systemd/resolve/resolv.conf
4480:   collect_trusted_dns_resolvers_from_file /etc/resolv.conf
4481:   if [[ "${#TRUSTED_DNS_RESOLVERS[@]}" -eq 0 ]]; then
4482:     echo "DNS repair failed: no trusted resolver sources found in host configuration/profile" >&2
4483:     return 1
4484:   fi
4485: 
4486:   tmp_resolv="$(mktemp /tmp/rn-resolv.XXXXXX)"
4487:   backup_resolv="$(mktemp /tmp/rn-resolv-backup.XXXXXX)"
4488:   if [[ -f /etc/resolv.conf ]]; then
4489:     cp -L /etc/resolv.conf "$backup_resolv" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
4490:   fi
4491:   {
4492:     for resolver in "${TRUSTED_DNS_RESOLVERS[@]}"; do
4493:       printf 'nameserver %s\n' "${resolver}"
4494:     done
4495:     printf 'options timeout:2 attempts:2\n'
4496:   } > "$tmp_resolv"
4497:   install -m 0644 "$tmp_resolv" /etc/resolv.conf
4498:   rm -f "$tmp_resolv"
4499:   if timeout 5 getent hosts static.rust-lang.org >/dev/null 2>&1; then
4500:     rm -f "$backup_resolv"
4501:     return 0
4502:   fi
4503:   if [[ -s "$backup_resolv" ]]; then
4504:     install -m 0644 "$backup_resolv" /etc/resolv.conf
4505:   fi
4506:   rm -f "$backup_resolv"
4507:   echo "DNS repair failed for static.rust-lang.org via trusted resolvers: ${TRUSTED_DNS_RESOLVERS[*]}" >&2
4508:   return 1
4509: }

4511: install_prereqs() {
4512:   local attempt
4513:   local -a apt_network_opts=(
4514:     -o Acquire::Retries=3
4515:     -o Acquire::ForceIPv4=true
4516:     -o Acquire::http::Timeout=60
4517:     -o Acquire::https::Timeout=60
4518:     -o Dpkg::Use-Pty=0
4519:   )
4520:   for attempt in 1 2 3; do
4521:     DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update "${apt_network_opts[@]}"
4522:     if DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
4523:       "${apt_network_opts[@]}" \
4524:     ca-certificates \
4525:     curl \
4526:     git \
4527:     build-essential \
4528:     pkg-config \
4529:     libssl-dev \
4530:     libsqlite3-dev \
4531:     clang \
4532:     llvm \
4533:     nftables \
4534:     wireguard-tools \
4535:     openssl \
4536:     systemd-resolved \
4537:     rustup; then
4538:       return 0
4539:     fi
4540:     if [[ "${attempt}" -lt 3 ]]; then
4541:       echo "[bootstrap] apt-get install attempt ${attempt} failed; retrying after DNS repair" >&2
4542:       DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get clean >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
4543:       repair_local_dns_resolution
4544:       sleep 2
4545:     fi
4546:   done
4547:   echo "[bootstrap] apt-get install failed after retries" >&2
4548:   return 1
4549: }

4551: clear_residual_rustynet_state() {
4552:   local kind family table
4553:   for unit in rustynetd.service rustynetd-privileged-helper.service rustynetd-trust-refresh.service rustynetd-trust-refresh.timer rustynetd-assignment-refresh.service rustynetd-assignment-refresh.timer rustynetd-managed-dns.service; do
4554:     systemctl disable --now "${unit}" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
4555:   done
4556:   pkill -f 'rustynetd daemon' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
4557:   pkill -f 'rustynetd privileged-helper' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
4558:   pkill -f 'apt-get install' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
4559:   pkill -f 'apt-get update' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
4560:   pkill -f '/usr/lib/apt/methods/' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
4561:   pkill -f 'dpkg' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
4562:   ip link delete rustynet0 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
4563:   for _ in 1 2 3; do
4564:     nft list tables 2>/dev/null | while read -r kind family table; do
4565:       [ "${kind}" = "table" ] || continue
4566:       case "${table}" in
4567:         rustynet*)

4704: fn run_remote_rustynet_ops_command(
4705:     options: &[OsString],
4706:     host: &str,
4707:     needs_sudo: bool,
4708:     sudo_password: &str,
4709:     ops_args: &[&str],
4710: ) -> Result<(), String> {

4715:     }

4717:     run_remote_program_command(

4728: fn run_remote_program_command(
4729:     options: &[OsString],
4730:     host: &str,
4731:     needs_sudo: bool,
4732:     sudo_password: &str,
4733:     envs: &[(&str, &str)],
4734:     program: &str,
4735:     args: &[&str],
4736: ) -> Result<(), String> {
4737:     let mut command = Command::new("ssh");
4738:     command.args(options).arg(host);
4739:     if needs_sudo {
4740:         command
4741:             .arg("sudo")
4742:             .arg("-S")
4743:             .arg("-p")
4744:             .arg(REMOTE_SUDO_PROMPT);
4745:     }
4746:     if !envs.is_empty() {
4747:         command.arg("env");
4748:         for (key, value) in envs {
4749:             ensure_safe_token("remote-env-key", key)?;
4750:             ensure_safe_token("remote-env-value", value)?;
4751:             command.arg(format!("{key}={value}"));
4752:         }
4753:     }
4754:     command.arg(program);
4755:     command.args(args);
4756: 
4757:     let mut payload = Vec::new();
4758:     if needs_sudo {
4759:         payload.extend_from_slice(sudo_password.as_bytes());
4760:         payload.push(b'\n');
4761:     }
4762:     run_command_with_input(command, payload.as_slice()).map(|_| ())
4763: }

4765: fn copy_remote_file_to_local(
4766:     options: &[OsString],
4767:     host: &str,
4768:     sudo_password: Option<&str>,
4769:     remote_path: &str,
4770:     local_path: &Path,
4771: ) -> Result<(), String> {
4772:     ensure_safe_remote_path(remote_path)?;
4773:     let output = capture_remote_program_output(
4774:         options,
4775:         host,
4776:         sudo_password,
4777:         "cat",
4778:         &[remote_path],
4779:         &[],
4780:         false,

4786: #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
4787: fn copy_local_file_to_remote(
4788:     options: &[OsString],
4789:     host: &str,
4790:     needs_sudo: bool,
4791:     sudo_password: &str,
4792:     local_path: &Path,
4793:     remote_path: &str,
4794:     owner_user: &str,
4795:     owner_group: &str,
4796:     mode: &str,
4797: ) -> Result<(), String> {
4798:     ensure_safe_remote_path(remote_path)?;
4799:     ensure_safe_token("owner-user", owner_user)?;
4800:     ensure_safe_token("owner-group", owner_group)?;
4801:     ensure_safe_token("mode", mode)?;
4802:     let bytes = fs::read(local_path)
4803:         .map_err(|err| format!("failed to read {}: {err}", local_path.display()))?;
4804:     let mut command = Command::new("ssh");
4805:     command.args(options).arg(host);
4806:     if needs_sudo {
4807:         command
4808:             .arg("sudo")
4809:             .arg("-S")
4810:             .arg("-p")
4811:             .arg(REMOTE_SUDO_PROMPT);
4812:     }
4813:     command
4814:         .arg("install")
4815:         .arg("-D")
4816:         .arg("-m")
4817:         .arg(mode)
4818:         .arg("-o")
4819:         .arg(owner_user)
4820:         .arg("-g")
4821:         .arg(owner_group)
4822:         .arg("/dev/stdin")
4823:         .arg(remote_path);
4824:     let mut payload = Vec::new();
4825:     if needs_sudo {
4826:         payload.extend_from_slice(sudo_password.as_bytes());
4827:         payload.push(b'\n');
4828:     }
4829:     payload.extend_from_slice(bytes.as_slice());
4830:     run_command_with_input(command, payload.as_slice()).map(|_| ())
4831: }

4833: struct RemoteRetryProgram<'a> {
4834:     attempts: u32,
4835:     sleep_secs: u64,
4836:     program: &'a str,
4837:     args: &'a [&'a str],
4838:     envs: &'a [(&'a str, &'a str)],
4839: }
4840: 
4841: fn retry_remote_program(
4842:     options: &[OsString],
4843:     host: &str,
4844:     sudo_password: Option<&str>,
4845:     retry: RemoteRetryProgram<'_>,
4846: ) -> Result<(), String> {
4847:     for attempt in 1..=retry.attempts {
4848:         match run_remote_program_checked(
4849:             options,
4850:             host,
4851:             sudo_password,
4852:             retry.program,
4853:             retry.args,
4854:             retry.envs,
4855:         ) {
4856:             Ok(()) => return Ok(()),
4857:             Err(err) if attempt < retry.attempts => {
4858:                 let _ = err;
4859:                 std::thread::sleep(std::time::Duration::from_secs(retry.sleep_secs));
4860:             }
4861:             Err(err) => return Err(err),
4862:         }
4863:     }
4864:     Err("retry exhausted".to_string())
4865: }

4905: fn set_membership_state_permissions_local(owner_group: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
4906:     let existing_paths = MEMBERSHIP_STATE_PATHS
4907:         .iter()
4908:         .copied()
4909:         .filter(|path| Path::new(path).exists())
4910:         .collect::<Vec<_>>();
4911:     if existing_paths.is_empty() {
4912:         return Ok(());
4913:     }
4914: 
4915:     let output = Command::new("chown")
4916:         .arg(owner_group)
4917:         .args(existing_paths.iter().copied())
4918:         .output()
4919:         .map_err(|err| format!("membership state chown spawn failed: {err}"))?;
4920:     if !output.status.success() {
4921:         let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).trim().to_string();
4922:         let stdout = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).trim().to_string();
4923:         let detail = match (stdout.is_empty(), stderr.is_empty()) {
4924:             (true, true) => "no stdout/stderr output".to_string(),
4925:             (true, false) => format!("stderr={stderr}"),
4926:             (false, true) => format!("stdout={stdout}"),
4927:             (false, false) => format!("stdout={stdout}; stderr={stderr}"),
4928:         };
4929:         return Err(format!(
4930:             "membership state chown failed: status={} {detail}",
4931:             output.status.code().unwrap_or(-1)
4932:         ));
4933:     }
4934: 
4935:     for path in existing_paths {
4936:         set_unix_mode(Path::new(path), 0o600)?;
4937:     }
4938:     Ok(())
4939: }

4960: fn run_command_with_input(command: Command, input: &[u8]) -> Result<Output, String> {
4961:     let output = run_command_with_input_allow_failure(command, input)?;
4962:     if !output.status.success() {
4963:         return Err(format!(
4964:             "command failed: {}",
4965:             String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).trim()
4966:         ));
4967:     }
4968:     Ok(output)
4969: }
4970: 
4971: fn run_command_with_input_allow_failure(
4972:     mut command: Command,
4973:     input: &[u8],
4974: ) -> Result<Output, String> {
4975:     let child = command
4976:         .stdin(Stdio::piped())
4977:         .stdout(Stdio::piped())
4978:         .stderr(Stdio::piped())
4979:         .spawn()
4980:         .map_err(|err| format!("failed to spawn command: {err}"))?;
4981:     let mut child = child;
4982:     if let Some(mut stdin) = child.stdin.take() {
4983:         stdin
4984:             .write_all(input)
4985:             .map_err(|err| format!("failed to write command stdin: {err}"))?;
4986:     }
4987:     let output = child
4988:         .wait_with_output()
4989:         .map_err(|err| format!("failed waiting for command: {err}"))?;
4990:     Ok(output)
4991: }

4993: fn set_unix_mode(path: &Path, mode: u32) -> Result<(), String> {
4994:     #[cfg(unix)]
4995:     {
4996:         use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
4997:         let permissions = fs::Permissions::from_mode(mode);
4998:         fs::set_permissions(path, permissions)
4999:             .map_err(|err| format!("failed setting permissions on {}: {err}", path.display()))?;
5000:     }
5001:     Ok(())
5002: }

5010: }

5012: fn base64_to_hex(value: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
5013:     let decoded = decode_base64(value.trim())?;
5014:     let mut output = String::with_capacity(decoded.len() * 2);
5015:     for byte in decoded {
5016:         output.push_str(format!("{byte:02x}").as_str());
5017:     }
5018:     Ok(output)
5019: }
5020: 
5021: fn decode_base64(value: &str) -> Result<Vec<u8>, String> {
5022:     const TABLE: &str = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/";
5023:     let mut reverse = BTreeMap::new();
5024:     for (index, ch) in TABLE.chars().enumerate() {
5025:         reverse.insert(ch, index as u8);
5026:     }
5027:     let clean = value
5028:         .chars()
5029:         .filter(|ch| !ch.is_ascii_whitespace())
5030:         .collect::<Vec<_>>();
5031:     if clean.is_empty() || clean.len() % 4 != 0 {
5032:         return Err("invalid base64 wireguard public key".to_string());
5033:     }
5034:     let mut output = Vec::with_capacity(clean.len() / 4 * 3);
5035:     for chunk in clean.chunks(4) {
5036:         let mut sextets = [0u8; 4];
5037:         let mut padding = 0usize;
5038:         for (index, ch) in chunk.iter().enumerate() {
5039:             if *ch == '=' {
5040:                 sextets[index] = 0;
5041:                 padding += 1;
5042:             } else if let Some(value) = reverse.get(ch) {
5043:                 sextets[index] = *value;
5044:             } else {
5045:                 return Err("invalid base64 wireguard public key".to_string());
5046:             }
5047:         }
5048:         let b0 = (sextets[0] << 2) | (sextets[1] >> 4);
5049:         let b1 = ((sextets[1] & 0x0f) << 4) | (sextets[2] >> 2);
5050:         let b2 = ((sextets[2] & 0x03) << 6) | sextets[3];
5051:         output.push(b0);
5052:         if padding < 2 {
5053:             output.push(b1);
5054:         }
5055:         if padding < 1 {
5056:             output.push(b2);
5057:         }
5058:     }
5059:     Ok(output)
5060: }
5061: 
5062: fn extract_last_assignment_generated(status_line: &str) -> Option<u64> {
5063:     let marker = "last_assignment=";
5064:     let start = status_line.find(marker)?;
5065:     let rest = &status_line[start + marker.len()..];
5066:     let generated = rest.split(':').next()?;
5067:     generated.trim().parse::<u64>().ok()
5068: }

5140:     }
5141:     fs::write(path, content.as_bytes())
5142:         .map_err(|err| format!("failed writing {}: {err}", path.display()))?;
5143:     set_unix_mode(path, 0o600)?;
5144:     Ok(())
5145: }
5146: 
5147: struct ReportInputs {
5148:     generated_at_utc: String,
5149:     commit_sha: String,
5150:     exit_target: String,
5151:     client_target: String,
5152:     exit_node_id: String,
5153:     client_node_id: String,
5154:     network_id: String,
5155:     ssh_allow_cidrs: String,
5156:     report: CheckReport,
5157:     exit_status: String,
5158:     exit_status_after_refresh: String,
5159:     client_status: String,
5160:     client_status_after_refresh: String,
5161:     client_route: String,
5162:     exit_wg_show: String,
5163: }
5164: 
5165: fn write_report(path: &Path, input: ReportInputs) -> Result<(), String> {
5166:     if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
5167:         fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|err| {
5168:             format!(
5169:                 "failed creating report directory {}: {err}",
5170:                 parent.display()
5171:             )
5172:         })?;
5173:     }
5174:     let mut report = String::new();
5175:     report.push_str("# Debian Two-Node Clean Install + Tunnel Validation\n\n");
5176:     report.push_str(format!("- generated_at_utc: {}\n", input.generated_at_utc).as_str());
5177:     report.push_str(format!("- commit: {}\n", input.commit_sha).as_str());
5178:     report.push_str(format!("- exit_host: {}\n", input.exit_target).as_str());
5179:     report.push_str(format!("- client_host: {}\n", input.client_target).as_str());
5180:     report.push_str(format!("- exit_node_id: {}\n", input.exit_node_id).as_str());
5181:     report.push_str(format!("- client_node_id: {}\n", input.client_node_id).as_str());
5182:     report.push_str(format!("- network_id: {}\n", input.network_id).as_str());
5183:     report.push_str(format!("- ssh_allow_cidrs: {}\n\n", input.ssh_allow_cidrs).as_str());
5184:     report.push_str("## Checks\n\n");
5185:     report.push_str("| Check | Status | Detail |\n|---|---|---|\n");
5186:     for (name, status, detail) in input.report.checks {
5187:         report.push_str(format!("| {name} | {status} | {detail} |\n").as_str());
5188:     }
5189:     report.push_str("\n## Exit Status\n\n```text\n");
5190:     report.push_str(input.exit_status.as_str());
5191:     report.push_str("\n```\n\n## Exit Status After Assignment Refresh Window\n\n```text\n");
5192:     report.push_str(input.exit_status_after_refresh.as_str());
5193:     report.push_str("\n```\n\n## Client Status\n\n```text\n");
5194:     report.push_str(input.client_status.as_str());
5195:     report.push_str("\n```\n\n## Client Status After Assignment Refresh Window\n\n```text\n");
5196:     report.push_str(input.client_status_after_refresh.as_str());
5197:     report.push_str("\n```\n\n## Client Route Check\n\n```text\n");
5198:     report.push_str(input.client_route.as_str());
5199:     report.push_str("\n```\n\n## Exit WireGuard\n\n```text\n");
5200:     report.push_str(input.exit_wg_show.as_str());
5201:     report.push_str("\n```\n");
5202: 
5203:     fs::write(path, report.as_bytes())
5204:         .map_err(|err| format!("failed writing report {}: {err}", path.display()))
5205: }
5206: 
5207: fn utc_timestamp() -> String {
5208:     let output = Command::new("date")
5209:         .args(["-u", "+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"])
5210:         .output();
5211:     match output {
5212:         Ok(output) if output.status.success() => {
5213:             String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).trim().to_string()
5214:         }
5215:         _ => "unknown".to_string(),
5216:     }
5217: }
5218: 
5219: pub fn wait_for_daemon_socket_locally(
5220:     socket_path: &str,
5221:     attempts: usize,
5222:     sleep_secs: u64,
5223: ) -> Result<(), String> {
5224:     for i in 1..=attempts {
5225:         if Path::new(socket_path).exists()
5226:             && let Ok(metadata) = std::fs::metadata(socket_path)
5227:             && metadata.file_type().is_socket()
5228:         {
5229:             return Ok(());
5230:         }
5231:         if i < attempts {
5232:             std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_secs(sleep_secs));
5233:         }
5234:     }
5235:     Err(format!("daemon socket not ready after {attempts} attempts"))
5236: }

5238: pub fn execute_ops_e2e_worker_refresh_trust_evidence(
5239:     label: String,
5240:     target: String,
5241:     node_id: String,
5242: ) -> Result<String, String> {
5243:     println!("[trust-refresh] {label} {target} ({node_id})");
5244:     ensure_running_as_root()?;
5245:     wait_for_daemon_socket_locally("/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock", 20, 2)?;
5246:     run_status(
5247:         "rustynet",
5248:         &["ops", "refresh-signed-trust"],
5249:         &[],
5250:         "failed to refresh signed trust",
5251:     )?;
5252:     Ok(format!("trust evidence refreshed for {node_id}"))
5253: }
