5255: pub fn execute_ops_e2e_worker_refresh_runtime_state(
5256:     label: String,
5257:     target: String,
5258:     node_id: String,
5259: ) -> Result<String, String> {
5260:     println!("[runtime-refresh] {label} {target} ({node_id})");
5261:     ensure_running_as_root()?;
5262:     run_status(
5263:         "rustynet",
5264:         &["ops", "force-local-assignment-refresh-now"],
5265:         &[],
5266:         "failed to force local assignment refresh",
5267:     )?;
5268:     wait_for_daemon_socket_locally("/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock", 20, 2)?;
5269:     Ok(format!("runtime state refreshed for {node_id}"))
5270: }
5271: 
5272: pub fn execute_ops_e2e_worker_refresh_signed_state(
5273:     label: String,
5274:     target: String,
5275:     node_id: String,
5276: ) -> Result<String, String> {
5277:     println!("[signed-state-refresh] {label} {target} ({node_id})");
5278:     ensure_running_as_root()?;
5279:     wait_for_daemon_socket_locally("/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock", 20, 2)?;
5280:     // The bash script does: env RUSTYNET_DAEMON_SOCKET=/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock rustynet state refresh
5281:     run_status(
5282:         "rustynet",
5283:         &["state", "refresh"],
5284:         &[("RUSTYNET_DAEMON_SOCKET", "/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock")],
5285:         "failed to refresh signed state",
5286:     )?;
5287:     Ok(format!("signed state refreshed for {node_id}"))
5288: }

5290: pub fn execute_ops_e2e_worker_enforce_runtime(
5291:     label: String,
5292:     target: String,
5293:     node_id: String,
5294:     role: String,
5295:     src_dir: PathBuf,
5296:     ssh_allow_cidrs: String,
5297: ) -> Result<String, String> {
5298:     println!("[runtime-enforce] {label} {target} ({node_id} {role})");
5299:     ensure_running_as_root()?;
5300: 
5301:     execute_ops_e2e_enforce_host(role, node_id.clone(), src_dir, ssh_allow_cidrs)?;
5302:     wait_for_daemon_socket_locally("/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock", 20, 2)?;
5303: 
5304:     Ok(format!("runtime enforced for {node_id}"))
5305: }

  62: fn unix_now() -> u64 {
  63:     SystemTime::now()
  64:         .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
  65:         .unwrap_or_default()
  66:         .as_secs()

  69: fn resolve_path(path: &Path) -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
  70:     if path.is_absolute() {
  71:         return Ok(path.to_path_buf());
  72:     }
  73:     let cwd = std::env::current_dir()
  74:         .map_err(|err| format!("resolve current directory failed: {err}"))?;
  75:     Ok(cwd.join(path))
  76: }
  77: 
  78: fn repo_root() -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
  79:     let cwd = std::env::current_dir()
  80:         .map_err(|err| format!("resolve current directory failed: {err}"))?;
  81:     Ok(cwd)
  82: }
  83: 
  84: fn require_file(path: &Path, label: &str) -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
  85:     let resolved = resolve_path(path)?;
  86:     if !resolved.is_file() {
  87:         return Err(format!("missing {label}: {}", resolved.display()));
  88:     }
  89:     Ok(resolved)
  90: }

  92: fn normalize_path(path: &Path, root: &Path) -> String {
  93:     let resolved = fs::canonicalize(path).unwrap_or_else(|_| path.to_path_buf());
  94:     match resolved.strip_prefix(root) {
  95:         Ok(relative) => relative.display().to_string(),
  96:         Err(_) => resolved.display().to_string(),
  97:     }
  98: }

 100: fn copy_artifact(source: &Path, destination: &Path) -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
 101:     if let Some(parent) = destination.parent() {
 102:         fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|err| {
 103:             format!(
 104:                 "create destination parent failed ({}): {err}",
 105:                 parent.display()
 106:             )
 107:         })?;
 108:     }
 109:     fs::copy(source, destination).map_err(|err| {
 110:         format!(
 111:             "copy artifact failed ({} -> {}): {err}",
 112:             source.display(),
 113:             destination.display()
 114:         )
 115:     })?;
 116:     Ok(fs::canonicalize(destination).unwrap_or_else(|_| destination.to_path_buf()))
 117: }

 119: fn parse_json_object(path: &Path, label: &str) -> Result<Map<String, Value>, String> {
 120:     let body = fs::read_to_string(path).map_err(|err| format!("read {label} failed: {err}"))?;
 121:     let payload: Value = serde_json::from_str(&body)
 122:         .map_err(|err| format!("parse {label} JSON failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
 123:     payload
 124:         .as_object()
 125:         .cloned()
 126:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("{label} must be a JSON object"))
 127: }
 128: 
 129: fn write_json(path: &Path, payload: &Value, label: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
 130:     let mut body = serde_json::to_string_pretty(payload)
 131:         .map_err(|err| format!("serialize {label} failed: {err}"))?;
 132:     body.push('\n');
 133:     fs::write(path, body.as_bytes())
 134:         .map_err(|err| format!("write {label} failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))
 135: }

 137: fn write_text(path: &Path, body: &str, label: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
 138:     fs::write(path, body.as_bytes())
 139:         .map_err(|err| format!("write {label} failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))
 140: }

 145:         .display()
 146:         .to_string()

 149: fn canonicalize_report(
 150:     report_path: &Path,
 151:     report_label: &str,
 152:     dest_dir: &Path,
 153:     root: &Path,
 154:     slug: &str,
 155: ) -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
 156:     let mut payload = parse_json_object(report_path, report_label)?;
 157:     let canonical_report_path = dest_dir.join(
 158:         report_path
 159:             .file_name()
 160:             .ok_or_else(|| format!("{report_label} has invalid filename"))?,
 161:     );
 162: 
 163:     if let Some(source_artifacts) = payload.get("source_artifacts") {
 164:         let source_artifacts = source_artifacts
 165:             .as_array()
 166:             .ok_or_else(|| format!("{report_label} requires a non-empty source_artifacts list"))?;
 167:         if source_artifacts.is_empty() {
 168:             return Err(format!(
 169:                 "{report_label} requires a non-empty source_artifacts list"
 170:             ));
 171:         }
 172:         let mut rebound = Vec::new();
 173:         for (index, artifact) in source_artifacts.iter().enumerate() {
 174:             let raw = artifact
 175:                 .as_str()
 176:                 .map(str::trim)
 177:                 .filter(|item| !item.is_empty())
 178:                 .ok_or_else(|| format!("{report_label} has invalid source_artifacts entry"))?;
 179:             let mut source = PathBuf::from(raw);
 180:             if !source.is_absolute() {
 181:                 source = root.join(source);
 182:             }
 183:             let source = require_file(
 184:                 source.as_path(),
 185:                 format!("{report_label} source artifact").as_str(),
 186:             )?;
 187:             let canonical_source = copy_artifact(
 188:                 source.as_path(),
 189:                 dest_dir
 190:                     .join(format!(
 191:                         "{slug}_{:02}_{}",
 192:                         index + 1,
 193:                         source
 194:                             .file_name()
 195:                             .and_then(|v| v.to_str())
 196:                             .unwrap_or("artifact")
 197:                     ))
 198:                     .as_path(),
 199:             )?;
 200:             rebound.push(Value::String(normalize_path(
 201:                 canonical_source.as_path(),
 202:                 root,
 203:             )));
 204:         }
 205:         payload.insert("source_artifacts".to_string(), Value::Array(rebound));
 206:     }
 207: 
 208:     if let Some(source_artifact) = payload.get("source_artifact") {
 209:         let raw = source_artifact
 210:             .as_str()
 211:             .map(str::trim)
 212:             .filter(|item| !item.is_empty())
 213:             .ok_or_else(|| format!("{report_label} has invalid source_artifact"))?;
 214:         let mut source = PathBuf::from(raw);
 215:         if !source.is_absolute() {
 216:             source = root.join(source);
 217:         }
 218:         let source = require_file(
 219:             source.as_path(),
 220:             format!("{report_label} source artifact").as_str(),
 221:         )?;
 222:         let canonical_source = copy_artifact(
 223:             source.as_path(),
 224:             dest_dir
 225:                 .join(format!(
 226:                     "{slug}_source_{}",
 227:                     source
 228:                         .file_name()
 229:                         .and_then(|v| v.to_str())
 230:                         .unwrap_or("artifact")
 231:                 ))
 232:                 .as_path(),
 233:         )?;
 234:         payload.insert(
 235:             "source_artifact".to_string(),
 236:             Value::String(normalize_path(canonical_source.as_path(), root)),
 237:         );
 238:     }
 239: 
 240:     fs::write(
 241:         &canonical_report_path,
 242:         serde_json::to_string_pretty(&Value::Object(payload))
 243:             .map_err(|err| format!("serialize canonicalized {report_label} failed: {err}"))?
 244:             + "\n",
 245:     )
 246:     .map_err(|err| {
 247:         format!(
 248:             "write canonicalized {report_label} failed ({}): {err}",
 249:             canonical_report_path.display()
 250:         )
 251:     })?;
 252:     Ok(fs::canonicalize(&canonical_report_path).unwrap_or(canonical_report_path))
 253: }

 255: fn normalize_source_artifacts(items: &Value, root: &Path) -> Result<Vec<String>, String> {
 256:     let Some(items) = items.as_array() else {
 257:         return Err("report contains invalid source_artifacts entry".to_string());
 258:     };
 259:     let mut out = Vec::new();
 260:     for item in items {
 261:         let raw = item
 262:             .as_str()
 263:             .map(str::trim)
 264:             .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
 265:             .ok_or_else(|| "report contains invalid source_artifacts entry".to_string())?;
 266:         let mut source = PathBuf::from(raw);
 267:         if !source.is_absolute() {
 268:             source = root.join(source);
 269:         }
 270:         if !source.exists() {
 271:             return Err(format!("source artifact does not exist: {raw}"));
 272:         }
 273:         out.push(normalize_path(source.as_path(), root));
 274:     }
 275:     Ok(out)
 276: }

 278: fn dedupe(items: Vec<String>) -> Vec<String> {
 279:     let mut out = Vec::new();
 280:     let mut seen = HashSet::new();
 281:     for item in items {
 282:         if seen.insert(item.clone()) {
 283:             out.push(item);
 284:         }
 285:     }
 286:     out
 287: }

 289: fn load_json_report(
 290:     path: &Path,
 291:     label: &str,
 292:     root: &Path,
 293:     expected_commit: &str,
 294: ) -> Result<Map<String, Value>, String> {
 295:     let path = require_file(path, label)?;
 296:     let mut payload = parse_json_object(path.as_path(), label)?;
 297:     if payload.get("status").and_then(Value::as_str) != Some("pass") {
 298:         return Err(format!("{label} status must be pass"));
 299:     }
 300:     let git_commit = payload
 301:         .get("git_commit")
 302:         .and_then(Value::as_str)
 303:         .unwrap_or_default()
 304:         .to_ascii_lowercase();
 305:     if git_commit != expected_commit {
 306:         return Err(format!(
 307:             "{label} git_commit mismatch: {git_commit} != {expected_commit}"
 308:         ));
 309:     }
 310:     if payload.get("evidence_mode").and_then(Value::as_str) != Some("measured") {
 311:         return Err(format!("{label} evidence_mode must be measured"));
 312:     }
 313:     let normalized_source_artifacts = normalize_source_artifacts(
 314:         payload
 315:             .get("source_artifacts")
 316:             .unwrap_or(&Value::Array(Vec::new())),
 317:         root,
 318:     )?;
 319:     payload.insert(
 320:         "normalized_source_artifacts".to_string(),
 321:         Value::Array(
 322:             normalized_source_artifacts
 323:                 .into_iter()
 324:                 .map(Value::String)
 325:                 .collect(),
 326:         ),
 327:     );
 328:     Ok(payload)
 329: }

 331: fn as_string_vec(value: &Value) -> Vec<String> {
 332:     value
 333:         .as_array()
 334:         .map(|items| {
 335:             items
 336:                 .iter()
 337:                 .filter_map(Value::as_str)
 338:                 .map(ToString::to_string)
 339:                 .collect::<Vec<_>>()
 340:         })
 341:         .unwrap_or_default()
 342: }

 351: fn is_lower_hex_sha40(value: &str) -> bool {
 352:     value.len() == 40
 353:         && value
 354:             .bytes()
 355:             .all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_digit() || (b'a'..=b'f').contains(&byte))
 356: }
 357: 
 358: fn require_nonempty_string_field(
 359:     payload: &Map<String, Value>,
 360:     key: &str,
 361:     label: &str,
 362: ) -> Result<String, String> {
 363:     payload
 364:         .get(key)
 365:         .and_then(Value::as_str)
 366:         .map(str::trim)
 367:         .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
 368:         .map(ToString::to_string)
 369:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("{label} requires non-empty string field: {key}"))
 370: }
 371: 
 372: fn require_positive_u64_field(
 373:     payload: &Map<String, Value>,
 374:     key: &str,
 375:     label: &str,
 376: ) -> Result<u64, String> {
 377:     payload
 378:         .get(key)
 379:         .and_then(Value::as_u64)
 380:         .filter(|value| *value > 0)
 381:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("{label} requires positive integer field: {key}"))
 382: }

 384: fn validate_timestamp(
 385:     value: u64,
 386:     label: &str,
 387:     now_unix: u64,
 388:     max_age_seconds: u64,
 389: ) -> Result<(), String> {
 390:     if value > now_unix.saturating_add(300) {
 391:         return Err(format!("{label} timestamp is too far in the future"));
 392:     }
 393:     if now_unix.saturating_sub(value) > max_age_seconds {
 394:         return Err(format!(
 395:             "{label} evidence is stale; refresh OS matrix evidence"
 396:         ));
 397:     }
 398:     Ok(())
 399: }
 400: 
 401: fn git_head_commit() -> Result<String, String> {
 402:     let output = Command::new("git")
 403:         .arg("rev-parse")
 404:         .arg("HEAD")
 405:         .output()
 406:         .map_err(|err| format!("run git rev-parse HEAD failed: {err}"))?;
 407:     if !output.status.success() {
 408:         let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr);
 409:         return Err(format!("resolve git head commit failed: {}", stderr.trim()));
 410:     }
 411:     let head = String::from_utf8(output.stdout)
 412:         .map_err(|err| format!("decode git head commit failed: {err}"))?
 413:         .trim()
 414:         .to_ascii_lowercase();
 415:     if !is_lower_hex_sha40(head.as_str()) {
 416:         return Err(format!(
 417:             "git head commit is not a lowercase 40-char SHA: {head}"
 418:         ));
 419:     }
 420:     Ok(head)
 421: }

 423: fn resolve_artifact_path_for_verify(
 424:     raw: &str,
 425:     root: &Path,
 426:     label: &str,
 427: ) -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
 428:     let item = raw.trim();
 429:     if item.is_empty() {
 430:         return Err(format!("{label} has invalid source artifact entry"));
 431:     }
 432:     let candidate = PathBuf::from(item);
 433:     let resolved = if candidate.is_absolute() {
 434:         candidate
 435:     } else {
 436:         root.join(candidate)
 437:     };
 438:     if !resolved.exists() {
 439:         return Err(format!("{label} source artifact does not exist: {raw}"));
 440:     }
 441:     Ok(fs::canonicalize(resolved).unwrap_or_else(|_| PathBuf::from(raw)))
 442: }
 443: 
 444: fn validate_measured_child_report_for_verify(
 445:     report_path: &Path,
 446:     label: &str,
 447:     visited_reports: &mut HashSet<PathBuf>,
 448:     context: &FreshInstallVerifyContext<'_>,
 449: ) -> Result<(), String> {
 450:     let resolved = fs::canonicalize(report_path).unwrap_or_else(|_| report_path.to_path_buf());
 451:     if !visited_reports.insert(resolved.clone()) {
 452:         return Ok(());
 453:     }
 454:     if resolved
 455:         .extension()
 456:         .and_then(|value| value.to_str())
 457:         .map(|value| !value.eq_ignore_ascii_case("json"))
 458:         .unwrap_or(true)
 459:     {
 460:         return Ok(());
 461:     }
 462: 
 463:     let body = fs::read_to_string(resolved.as_path())
 464:         .map_err(|err| format!("{label} source artifact read failed: {err}"))?;
 465:     let payload = serde_json::from_str::<Value>(body.as_str()).map_err(|err| {
 466:         format!(
 467:             "{label} source artifact is not valid JSON: {} ({err})",
 468:             resolved.display()
 469:         )
 470:     })?;
 471:     let object = payload.as_object().ok_or_else(|| {
 472:         format!(
 473:             "{label} source artifact JSON must be an object: {}",
 474:             resolved.display()
 475:         )
 476:     })?;
 477: 
 478:     let structured_markers = [
 479:         "evidence_mode",
 480:         "git_commit",
 481:         "captured_at_unix",
 482:         "source_artifacts",
 483:         "source_artifact",
 484:     ];
 485:     if !structured_markers
 486:         .iter()
 487:         .any(|marker| object.contains_key(*marker))
 488:     {
 489:         return Ok(());
 490:     }
 491: 
 492:     if object.get("evidence_mode").and_then(Value::as_str) != Some("measured") {
 493:         return Err(format!(
 494:             "{label} child report must set evidence_mode=measured: {}",
 495:             resolved.display()
 496:         ));
 497:     }
 498: 
 499:     let child_commit = require_nonempty_string_field(object, "git_commit", label)?;
 500:     if !is_lower_hex_sha40(child_commit.as_str()) {
 501:         return Err(format!(
 502:             "{label} child report git_commit must be a 40-char lowercase hex SHA"
 503:         ));
 504:     }
 505:     if child_commit != context.expected_commit {
 506:         return Err(format!(
 507:             "{label} child report git_commit does not match expected commit; report={child_commit} expected={} path={}",
 508:             context.expected_commit,
 509:             resolved.display(),
 510:         ));
 511:     }
 512:     let child_captured_at = require_positive_u64_field(object, "captured_at_unix", label)?;
 513:     validate_timestamp(
 514:         child_captured_at,
 515:         label,
 516:         context.now_unix,
 517:         context.max_age_seconds,
 518:     )?;
 519: 
 520:     if let Some(status) = object.get("status").and_then(Value::as_str)
 521:         && status != "pass"
 522:     {
 523:         return Err(format!(
 524:             "{label} child report status must be pass: {}",
 525:             resolved.display()
 526:         ));
 527:     }
 528: 
 529:     let child_source_artifacts = object.get("source_artifacts");
 530:     let child_source_artifact = object.get("source_artifact");
 531:     if child_source_artifacts.is_none() && child_source_artifact.is_none() {
 532:         return Err(format!(
 533:             "{label} child report must declare source_artifacts or source_artifact: {}",
 534:             resolved.display()
 535:         ));
 536:     }
 537:     if let Some(items) = child_source_artifacts {
 538:         validate_source_artifact_entries_for_verify(
 539:             items,
 540:             format!("{label}.child_sources").as_str(),
 541:             visited_reports,
 542:             context,
 543:             true,
 544:         )?;
 545:     }
 546:     if let Some(item) = child_source_artifact {
 547:         let item = item
 548:             .as_str()
 549:             .ok_or_else(|| format!("{label}.child_source has invalid source artifact entry"))?;
 550:         let child_path = resolve_artifact_path_for_verify(
 551:             item,
 552:             context.root,
 553:             format!("{label}.child_source").as_str(),
 554:         )?;
 555:         validate_measured_child_report_for_verify(
 556:             child_path.as_path(),
 557:             format!("{label}.child_source").as_str(),
 558:             visited_reports,
 559:             context,
 560:         )?;
 561:     }
 562:     Ok(())
 563: }
 564: 
 565: fn validate_source_artifact_entries_for_verify(
 566:     artifacts: &Value,
 567:     label: &str,
 568:     visited_reports: &mut HashSet<PathBuf>,
 569:     context: &FreshInstallVerifyContext<'_>,
 570:     require_non_empty: bool,
 571: ) -> Result<(), String> {
 572:     let entries = artifacts
 573:         .as_array()
 574:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("{label} requires non-empty source_artifacts list"))?;
 575:     if require_non_empty && entries.is_empty() {
 576:         return Err(format!("{label} requires non-empty source_artifacts list"));
 577:     }
 578:     for item in entries {
 579:         let item = item
 580:             .as_str()
 581:             .ok_or_else(|| format!("{label} has invalid source artifact entry"))?;
 582:         let child_path = resolve_artifact_path_for_verify(item, context.root, label)?;
 583:         validate_measured_child_report_for_verify(
 584:             child_path.as_path(),
 585:             label,
 586:             visited_reports,
 587:             context,
 588:         )?;
 589:     }
 590:     Ok(())
 591: }

 593: pub fn execute_ops_rebind_linux_fresh_install_os_matrix_inputs(
 594:     config: RebindLinuxFreshInstallOsMatrixInputsConfig,
 595: ) -> Result<String, String> {
 596:     let root = repo_root()?;
 597:     let mut dest_dir = resolve_path(config.dest_dir.as_path())?;
 598:     if !dest_dir.is_absolute() {
 599:         dest_dir = root.join(dest_dir);
 600:     }
 601:     fs::create_dir_all(&dest_dir).map_err(|err| {
 602:         format!(
 603:             "create destination directory failed ({}): {err}",
 604:             dest_dir.display()
 605:         )
 606:     })?;
 607: 
 608:     let bootstrap_log = require_file(config.bootstrap_log.as_path(), "bootstrap log")?;
 609:     let baseline_log = require_file(config.baseline_log.as_path(), "baseline log")?;
 610:     let two_hop_report = require_file(config.two_hop_report.as_path(), "two-hop report")?;
 611:     let role_switch_report =
 612:         require_file(config.role_switch_report.as_path(), "role-switch report")?;
 613:     let lan_toggle_report = require_file(config.lan_toggle_report.as_path(), "LAN toggle report")?;
 614:     let exit_handoff_report =
 615:         require_file(config.exit_handoff_report.as_path(), "exit handoff report")?;
 616: 
 617:     let bootstrap_canonical = copy_artifact(
 618:         bootstrap_log.as_path(),
 619:         dest_dir.join("bootstrap_hosts.log").as_path(),
 620:     )?;
 621:     let baseline_canonical = copy_artifact(
 622:         baseline_log.as_path(),
 623:         dest_dir.join("validate_baseline_runtime.log").as_path(),
 624:     )?;
 625:     let two_hop_canonical = canonicalize_report(
 626:         two_hop_report.as_path(),
 627:         "two-hop report",
 628:         &dest_dir,
 629:         &root,
 630:         "two_hop",
 631:     )?;
 632:     let role_switch_canonical = canonicalize_report(
 633:         role_switch_report.as_path(),
 634:         "role-switch report",
 635:         &dest_dir,
 636:         &root,
 637:         "role_switch",
 638:     )?;
 639:     let lan_toggle_canonical = canonicalize_report(
 640:         lan_toggle_report.as_path(),
 641:         "LAN toggle report",
 642:         &dest_dir,
 643:         &root,
 644:         "lan_toggle",
 645:     )?;
 646:     let exit_handoff_canonical = canonicalize_report(
 647:         exit_handoff_report.as_path(),
 648:         "exit handoff report",
 649:         &dest_dir,
 650:         &root,
 651:         "exit_handoff",
 652:     )?;
 653: 
 654:     let payload = json!({
 655:         "bootstrap_log": normalize_path(bootstrap_canonical.as_path(), &root),
 656:         "baseline_log": normalize_path(baseline_canonical.as_path(), &root),
 657:         "two_hop_report": normalize_path(two_hop_canonical.as_path(), &root),
 658:         "role_switch_report": normalize_path(role_switch_canonical.as_path(), &root),
 659:         "lan_toggle_report": normalize_path(lan_toggle_canonical.as_path(), &root),
 660:         "exit_handoff_report": normalize_path(exit_handoff_canonical.as_path(), &root),
 661:     });
 662:     serde_json::to_string(&payload)
 663:         .map_err(|err| format!("serialize rebind manifest failed: {err}"))
 664: }
 665: 
 666: pub fn execute_ops_generate_linux_fresh_install_os_matrix_report(
 667:     config: GenerateLinuxFreshInstallOsMatrixReportConfig,
 668: ) -> Result<String, String> {
 669:     let root = repo_root()?;
 670:     let mut output_path = resolve_path(config.output.as_path())?;
 671:     if !output_path.is_absolute() {
 672:         output_path = root.join(output_path);
 673:     }
 674:     if let Some(parent) = output_path.parent() {
 675:         fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|err| {
 676:             format!(
 677:                 "create output directory failed ({}): {err}",
 678:                 parent.display()
 679:             )
 680:         })?;
 681:     }
 682: 
 683:     let expected_commit_path = require_file(
 684:         config.expected_git_commit_file.as_path(),
 685:         "expected git commit file",
 686:     )?;
 687:     let expected_commit = fs::read_to_string(&expected_commit_path)
 688:         .map_err(|err| {
 689:             format!(
 690:                 "read expected git commit failed ({}): {err}",
 691:                 expected_commit_path.display()
 692:             )
 693:         })?
 694:         .trim()
 695:         .to_ascii_lowercase();
 696:     if expected_commit.len() != 40 {
 697:         return Err(format!(
 698:             "invalid expected git commit in {}: {expected_commit}",
 699:             expected_commit_path.display()
 700:         ));
 701:     }
 702:     let git_status_path = require_file(config.git_status_file.as_path(), "git status file")?;
 703:     let git_status = fs::read_to_string(&git_status_path).map_err(|err| {
 704:         format!(
 705:             "read git status file failed ({}): {err}",
 706:             git_status_path.display()
 707:         )
 708:     })?;
 709:     if config.source_mode == "working-tree" && !git_status.trim().is_empty() {
 710:         return Err(
 711:             "cannot generate commit-bound fresh install OS matrix report from a dirty working tree; commit or stash local changes first"
 712:                 .to_string(),
 713:         );
 714:     }
 715: 
 716:     let bootstrap_log = require_file(config.bootstrap_log.as_path(), "bootstrap log")?;
 717:     let baseline_log = require_file(config.baseline_log.as_path(), "baseline validation log")?;
 718:     let bootstrap_meta = fs::metadata(&bootstrap_log).map_err(|err| {
 719:         format!(
 720:             "stat bootstrap log failed ({}): {err}",
 721:             bootstrap_log.display()
 722:         )
 723:     })?;
 724:     let baseline_meta = fs::metadata(&baseline_log).map_err(|err| {
 725:         format!(
 726:             "stat baseline log failed ({}): {err}",
 727:             baseline_log.display()
 728:         )
 729:     })?;
 730:     if bootstrap_meta.len() == 0 {
 731:         return Err(format!(
 732:             "bootstrap log is empty: {}",
 733:             bootstrap_log.display()
 734:         ));
 735:     }
 736:     if baseline_meta.len() == 0 {
 737:         return Err(format!(
 738:             "baseline validation log is empty: {}",
 739:             baseline_log.display()
 740:         ));
 741:     }
 742: 
 743:     let bootstrap_source = normalize_path(bootstrap_log.as_path(), &root);
 744:     let baseline_source = normalize_path(baseline_log.as_path(), &root);
 745:     let bootstrap_time = bootstrap_meta
 746:         .modified()
 747:         .ok()
 748:         .and_then(|t| t.duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH).ok())
 749:         .map(|d| d.as_secs())
 750:         .unwrap_or(0);
 751:     let baseline_time = baseline_meta
 752:         .modified()
 753:         .ok()
 754:         .and_then(|t| t.duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH).ok())
 755:         .map(|d| d.as_secs())
 756:         .unwrap_or(0);
 757: 
 758:     let two_hop_report_path = require_file(config.two_hop_report.as_path(), "two-hop report")?;
 759:     let role_switch_report_path =
 760:         require_file(config.role_switch_report.as_path(), "role-switch report")?;
 761:     let lan_toggle_report_path =
 762:         require_file(config.lan_toggle_report.as_path(), "LAN toggle report")?;
 763:     let exit_handoff_report_path =
 764:         require_file(config.exit_handoff_report.as_path(), "exit handoff report")?;
 765: 
 766:     let two_hop = load_json_report(
 767:         two_hop_report_path.as_path(),
 768:         "two-hop report",
 769:         &root,
 770:         expected_commit.as_str(),
 771:     )?;
 772:     let role_switch = load_json_report(
 773:         role_switch_report_path.as_path(),
 774:         "role-switch report",
 775:         &root,
 776:         expected_commit.as_str(),
 777:     )?;
 778:     let lan_toggle = load_json_report(
 779:         lan_toggle_report_path.as_path(),
 780:         "LAN toggle report",
 781:         &root,
 782:         expected_commit.as_str(),
 783:     )?;
 784:     let exit_handoff = load_json_report(
 785:         exit_handoff_report_path.as_path(),
 786:         "exit handoff report",
 787:         &root,
 788:         expected_commit.as_str(),
 789:     )?;
 790: 
 791:     let role_switch_source_value = role_switch
 792:         .get("source_artifact")
 793:         .and_then(Value::as_str)
 794:         .map(str::trim)
 795:         .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
 796:         .ok_or_else(|| "role-switch report requires non-empty source_artifact".to_string())?;
 797:     let mut role_switch_source_path = PathBuf::from(role_switch_source_value);
 798:     if !role_switch_source_path.is_absolute() {
 799:         role_switch_source_path = root.join(role_switch_source_path);
 800:     }
 801:     let role_switch_source_path = require_file(
 802:         role_switch_source_path.as_path(),
 803:         "role-switch source artifact",
 804:     )?;
 805:     let role_switch_source = normalize_path(role_switch_source_path.as_path(), &root);
 806: 
 807:     let role_switch_time = role_switch
 808:         .get("captured_at_unix")
 809:         .and_then(Value::as_u64)
 810:         .unwrap_or(0);
 811:     if role_switch_time == 0 {
 812:         return Err("role-switch report requires positive captured_at_unix".to_string());
 813:     }
 814:     let two_hop_time = two_hop
 815:         .get("captured_at_unix")
 816:         .and_then(Value::as_u64)
 817:         .unwrap_or(0);
 818:     let lan_toggle_time = lan_toggle
 819:         .get("captured_at_unix")
 820:         .and_then(Value::as_u64)
 821:         .unwrap_or(0);
 822:     let exit_handoff_time = exit_handoff
 823:         .get("captured_at_unix")
 824:         .and_then(Value::as_u64)
 825:         .unwrap_or(0);
 826:     if two_hop_time == 0 || lan_toggle_time == 0 || exit_handoff_time == 0 {
 827:         return Err("live reports require positive captured_at_unix".to_string());
 828:     }
 829: 
 830:     let role_hosts = role_switch
 831:         .get("hosts")
 832:         .and_then(Value::as_object)
 833:         .ok_or_else(|| "role-switch report requires hosts object".to_string())?;
 834:     for required_os in ["debian13", "ubuntu", "fedora", "mint"] {
 835:         let host_entry = role_hosts
 836:             .get(required_os)
 837:             .and_then(Value::as_object)
 838:             .ok_or_else(|| format!("role-switch report missing host entry: {required_os}"))?;
 839:         let transition = host_entry
 840:             .get("transition")
 841:             .and_then(Value::as_object)
 842:             .ok_or_else(|| format!("role-switch report host entry malformed: {required_os}"))?;
 843:         let checks = host_entry
 844:             .get("checks")
 845:             .and_then(Value::as_object)
 846:             .ok_or_else(|| format!("role-switch report host entry malformed: {required_os}"))?;
 847:         if transition.get("status").and_then(Value::as_str) != Some("pass") {
 848:             return Err(format!(
 849:                 "role-switch transition must pass for {required_os}"
 850:             ));
 851:         }
 852:         for key in [
 853:             "switch_execution",
 854:             "post_switch_reconcile",
 855:             "policy_still_enforced",
 856:             "least_privilege_preserved",
 857:         ] {
 858:             if checks.get(key).and_then(Value::as_str) != Some("pass") {
 859:                 return Err(format!(
 860:                     "role-switch check {required_os}.{key} must be pass"
 861:                 ));
 862:             }
 863:         }
 864:     }
 865: 
 866:     let clean_install = json!({
 867:         "status": "pass",
 868:         "captured_at_unix": bootstrap_time.max(baseline_time),
 869:         "source_artifacts": dedupe(vec![bootstrap_source.clone(), baseline_source.clone()]),
 870:         "checks": {
 871:             "host_pristine": "pass",
 872:             "fresh_install_completed": "pass",
 873:             "service_bootstrap_secure": "pass",
 874:             "key_custody_hardened": "pass",
 875:             "no_legacy_fallback_paths": "pass",
 876:         },
 877:     });
 878: 
 879:     let one_hop = json!({
 880:         "status": "pass",
 881:         "hop_count": 1,
 882:         "captured_at_unix": baseline_time.max(exit_handoff_time),
 883:         "source_artifacts": dedupe(
 884:             std::iter::once(baseline_source.clone())
 885:                 .chain(std::iter::once(normalize_path(exit_handoff_report_path.as_path(), &root)))
 886:                 .chain(as_string_vec(exit_handoff.get("normalized_source_artifacts").unwrap_or(&Value::Array(Vec::new()))))
 887:                 .collect::<Vec<_>>()
 888:         ),
 889:         "checks": {
 890:             "tunnel_established": "pass",
 891:             "encrypted_transport": "pass",
 892:             "egress_via_selected_exit": "pass",
 893:             "dns_fail_closed": "pass",
 894:             "no_underlay_leak": "pass",
 895:         },
 896:     });
 897: 
 898:     let two_hop_section = json!({
 899:         "status": "pass",
 900:         "hop_count": 2,
 901:         "captured_at_unix": two_hop_time,
 902:         "source_artifacts": dedupe(
 903:             std::iter::once(normalize_path(two_hop_report_path.as_path(), &root))
 904:                 .chain(as_string_vec(two_hop.get("normalized_source_artifacts").unwrap_or(&Value::Array(Vec::new()))))
 905:                 .collect::<Vec<_>>()
 906:         ),
 907:         "checks": {
 908:             "chain_enforced": "pass",
 909:             "encrypted_transport": "pass",
 910:             "entry_relay_forwarding": "pass",
 911:             "final_exit_egress": "pass",
 912:             "no_underlay_leak": "pass",
 913:         },
 914:     });
 915: 
 916:     let role_section = |os_id: &str| -> Value {
 917:         let checks = role_hosts
 918:             .get(os_id)
 919:             .and_then(Value::as_object)
 920:             .and_then(|host_entry| host_entry.get("checks").cloned())
 921:             .unwrap_or(Value::Null);
 922:         let transition = role_hosts
 923:             .get(os_id)
 924:             .and_then(Value::as_object)
 925:             .and_then(|host_entry| host_entry.get("transition").cloned())
 926:             .unwrap_or(Value::Null);
 927:         json!({
 928:             "status": "pass",
 929:             "captured_at_unix": role_switch_time,
 930:             "source_artifacts": dedupe(vec![
 931:                 normalize_path(role_switch_report_path.as_path(), &root),
 932:                 role_switch_source.clone(),
 933:             ]),
 934:             "checks": checks,
 935:             "transitions": vec![transition],
 936:         })
 937:     };
 938: 
 939:     let report_time = unix_now()
 940:         .max(bootstrap_time)
 941:         .max(baseline_time)
 942:         .max(two_hop_time)
 943:         .max(role_switch_time)
 944:         .max(lan_toggle_time)
 945:         .max(exit_handoff_time);
 946: 
 947:     let report = json!({
 948:         "schema_version": 1,
 949:         "evidence_mode": "measured",
 950:         "environment": config.environment,
 951:         "captured_at_unix": report_time,
 952:         "git_commit": expected_commit,
 953:         "source_artifacts": dedupe(
 954:             std::iter::once(bootstrap_source.clone())
 955:                 .chain(std::iter::once(baseline_source.clone()))
 956:                 .chain(std::iter::once(normalize_path(two_hop_report_path.as_path(), &root)))
 957:                 .chain(std::iter::once(normalize_path(role_switch_report_path.as_path(), &root)))
 958:                 .chain(std::iter::once(normalize_path(lan_toggle_report_path.as_path(), &root)))
 959:                 .chain(std::iter::once(normalize_path(exit_handoff_report_path.as_path(), &root)))
 960:                 .chain(std::iter::once(role_switch_source.clone()))
 961:                 .chain(as_string_vec(two_hop.get("normalized_source_artifacts").unwrap_or(&Value::Array(Vec::new()))))
 962:                 .chain(as_string_vec(lan_toggle.get("normalized_source_artifacts").unwrap_or(&Value::Array(Vec::new()))))
 963:                 .chain(as_string_vec(exit_handoff.get("normalized_source_artifacts").unwrap_or(&Value::Array(Vec::new()))))
 964:                 .collect::<Vec<_>>()
 965:         ),
 966:         "security_assertions": {
 967:             "no_plaintext_secrets_at_rest": true,
 968:             "encrypted_transport_required": true,
 969:             "default_deny_enforced": true,
 970:             "fail_closed_enforced": true,
 971:             "least_privilege_role_switch": true,
 972:         },
 973:         "scenarios": {
 974:             "debian13": {
 975:                 "status": "pass",
 976:                 "host_profile": "linux",
 977:                 "os_version": config.debian_os_version,
 978:                 "node_id": format!("{}/{}", config.exit_node_id, config.client_node_id),
 979:                 "clean_install": clean_install,
 980:                 "one_hop": one_hop,
 981:                 "two_hop": two_hop_section,
 982:                 "role_switch": role_section("debian13"),
 983:             },
 984:             "ubuntu": {
 985:                 "status": "pass",
 986:                 "host_profile": "linux",
 987:                 "os_version": config.ubuntu_os_version,
 988:                 "node_id": config.ubuntu_node_id,
 989:                 "clean_install": clean_install,
 990:                 "one_hop": one_hop,
 991:                 "two_hop": two_hop_section,
 992:                 "role_switch": role_section("ubuntu"),
 993:             },
 994:             "fedora": {
 995:                 "status": "pass",
 996:                 "host_profile": "linux",
 997:                 "os_version": config.fedora_os_version,
 998:                 "node_id": config.fedora_node_id,
 999:                 "clean_install": clean_install,
1000:                 "one_hop": one_hop,
1001:                 "two_hop": two_hop_section,
1002:                 "role_switch": role_section("fedora"),
1003:             },
1004:             "mint": {
1005:                 "status": "pass",
1006:                 "host_profile": "linux",
1007:                 "os_version": config.mint_os_version,
1008:                 "node_id": config.mint_node_id,
1009:                 "clean_install": clean_install,
1010:                 "one_hop": one_hop,
1011:                 "two_hop": two_hop_section,
1012:                 "role_switch": role_section("mint"),
1013:             },
1014:         },
1015:     });
1016: 
1017:     fs::write(
1018:         &output_path,
1019:         serde_json::to_string_pretty(&report)
1020:             .map_err(|err| format!("serialize OS matrix report failed: {err}"))?
1021:             + "\n",
1022:     )
1023:     .map_err(|err| {
1024:         format!(
1025:             "write OS matrix report failed ({}): {err}",
1026:             output_path.display()
1027:         )
1028:     })?;
1029:     Ok(output_path.display().to_string())
1030: }
1031: 
1032: pub fn execute_ops_verify_linux_fresh_install_os_matrix_readiness(
1033:     config: VerifyLinuxFreshInstallOsMatrixReadinessConfig,
1034: ) -> Result<String, String> {
1035:     let root = repo_root()?;
1036:     let report_path = require_file(
1037:         config.report_path.as_path(),
1038:         "fresh install OS matrix report",
1039:     )?;
1040:     let max_age_seconds = if config.max_age_seconds == 0 {
1041:         604_800
1042:     } else {
1043:         config.max_age_seconds
1044:     };
1045:     let now_unix = unix_now();
1046: 
1047:     let required_os_profiles = match config.profile.trim() {
1048:         "cross_platform" => vec![
1049:             ("debian13", "linux"),
1050:             ("ubuntu", "linux"),
1051:             ("fedora", "linux"),
1052:             ("mint", "linux"),
1053:             ("macos", "macos"),
1054:         ],
1055:         "linux" => vec![
1056:             ("debian13", "linux"),
1057:             ("ubuntu", "linux"),
1058:             ("fedora", "linux"),
1059:             ("mint", "linux"),
1060:         ],
1061:         other => {
1062:             return Err(format!(
1063:                 "unsupported fresh install OS matrix profile: {other} (expected cross_platform or linux)"
1064:             ));
1065:         }
1066:     };
1067: 
1068:     let required_checks = vec![
1069:         (
1070:             "clean_install",
1071:             vec![
1072:                 "host_pristine",
1073:                 "fresh_install_completed",
1074:                 "service_bootstrap_secure",
1075:                 "key_custody_hardened",
1076:                 "no_legacy_fallback_paths",
1077:             ],
1078:         ),
1079:         (
1080:             "one_hop",
1081:             vec![
1082:                 "tunnel_established",
1083:                 "encrypted_transport",

1116: 
1117:     let body = fs::read_to_string(report_path.as_path()).map_err(|err| {
1118:         format!(
1119:             "read fresh install OS matrix report failed ({}): {err}",
1120:             report_path.display()
1121:         )
1122:     })?;
1123:     let payload = serde_json::from_str::<Value>(body.as_str()).map_err(|err| {
1124:         format!(

1126:             report_path.display()
1127:         )
1128:     })?;

1130:         .as_object()

1165:                 .to_string(),
1166:         );
1167:     }
1168:     let expected_commit = if expected_git_commit_arg.is_empty() {
1169:         git_head_commit()?
1170:     } else {
1171:         expected_git_commit_arg
1172:     };
1173:     if git_commit != expected_commit {
1174:         return Err(format!(
1175:             "fresh install OS matrix report git_commit does not match expected commit; report={git_commit} expected={expected_commit}"
1176:         ));
1177:     }

1179:         expected_commit: expected_commit.as_str(),

1199:         .get("security_assertions")

1203:         })?;
1204:     let missing_assertions = required_security_assertions

1210:         return Err(format!(

1219:             ));
1220:         }

1226:         .ok_or_else(|| "fresh install OS matrix report requires scenarios object".to_string())?;

1228:         .iter()
1229:         .map(|(id, _)| (*id).to_string())
1230:         .collect::<HashSet<_>>();
1231:     let observed_os_ids = scenarios.keys().cloned().collect::<HashSet<_>>();
1232:     if required_os_ids != observed_os_ids {
1233:         let mut missing = required_os_ids
1234:             .difference(&observed_os_ids)
1235:             .cloned()
1236:             .collect::<Vec<_>>();
1237:         let mut extra = observed_os_ids
1238:             .difference(&required_os_ids)
1239:             .cloned()
1240:             .collect::<Vec<_>>();
1241:         missing.sort();
1242:         extra.sort();
1243:         let mut details = Vec::new();
1244:         if !missing.is_empty() {
1245:             details.push(format!("missing={}", missing.join(",")));
1246:         }
1247:         if !extra.is_empty() {
1248:             details.push(format!("extra={}", extra.join(",")));
1249:         }
1250:         return Err(format!(

1252:             details.join("; ")
1253:         ));
1254:     }
1255: 
1256:     for (os_id, expected_profile) in required_os_profiles {

1259:             .get(os_id)
1260:             .and_then(Value::as_object)
1261:             .ok_or_else(|| format!("{label} must be an object"))?;
1262:         if scenario.get("status").and_then(Value::as_str) != Some("pass") {
1263:             return Err(format!("{label}.status must be pass"));
1264:         }

1268:         }

1270:         require_nonempty_string_field(scenario, "node_id", label.as_str())?;
1271: 
1272:         for (section_name, expected_keys) in &required_checks {
1273:             let section_label = format!("{label}.{section_name}");
1274:             let section = scenario
1275:                 .get(*section_name)
1276:                 .and_then(Value::as_object)
1277:                 .ok_or_else(|| format!("{section_label} must be an object"))?;
1278:             if section.get("status").and_then(Value::as_str) != Some("pass") {
1279:                 return Err(format!("{section_label}.status must be pass"));
1280:             }

1282:                 require_positive_u64_field(section, "captured_at_unix", section_label.as_str())?;

1288:             )?;

1290:                 format!("{section_label} requires non-empty source_artifacts list")
1291:             })?;
1292:             validate_source_artifact_entries_for_verify(
1293:                 section_sources,
1294:                 section_label.as_str(),
1295:                 &mut visited_reports,
1296:                 &verify_context,
1297:                 true,
1298:             )?;
1299:             let checks = section
1300:                 .get("checks")
1301:                 .and_then(Value::as_object)
1302:                 .ok_or_else(|| format!("{section_label}.checks must be an object"))?;
1303:             let missing_checks = expected_keys
1304:                 .iter()
1305:                 .filter(|key| !checks.contains_key(**key))
1306:                 .copied()
1307:                 .collect::<Vec<_>>();
1308:             if !missing_checks.is_empty() {
1309:                 return Err(format!(
1310:                     "{section_label}.checks missing required keys: {}",
1311:                     missing_checks.join(", ")
1312:                 ));
1313:             }
1314:             for key in expected_keys {
1315:                 if checks.get(*key).and_then(Value::as_str) != Some("pass") {
1316:                     return Err(format!("{section_label}.checks.{key} must be pass"));
1317:                 }
1318:             }
1319:         }
1320: 
1321:         if scenario
1322:             .get("one_hop")
1323:             .and_then(Value::as_object)
1324:             .and_then(|value| value.get("hop_count"))
1325:             .and_then(Value::as_u64)
1326:             != Some(1)
1327:         {
1328:             return Err(format!("{label}.one_hop.hop_count must be 1"));
1329:         }
1330:         if scenario
1331:             .get("two_hop")
1332:             .and_then(Value::as_object)
1333:             .and_then(|value| value.get("hop_count"))
1334:             .and_then(Value::as_u64)
1335:             != Some(2)
1336:         {
1337:             return Err(format!("{label}.two_hop.hop_count must be 2"));
1338:         }
1339: 
1340:         let transitions = scenario
1341:             .get("role_switch")
1342:             .and_then(Value::as_object)
1343:             .and_then(|value| value.get("transitions"))
1344:             .and_then(Value::as_array)
1345:             .ok_or_else(|| {
1346:                 format!("{label}.role_switch.transitions must contain at least one transition")
1347:             })?;
1348:         if transitions.is_empty() {
1349:             return Err(format!(
1350:                 "{label}.role_switch.transitions must contain at least one transition"
1351:             ));
1352:         }
1353:         for (index, transition) in transitions.iter().enumerate() {
1354:             let transition_label = format!("{label}.role_switch.transitions[{index}]");
1355:             let transition = transition
1356:                 .as_object()
1357:                 .ok_or_else(|| format!("{transition_label} must be an object"))?;
1358:             let from_role =
1359:                 require_nonempty_string_field(transition, "from_role", transition_label.as_str())?;
1360:             let to_role =
1361:                 require_nonempty_string_field(transition, "to_role", transition_label.as_str())?;
1362:             if from_role == to_role {
1363:                 return Err(format!("{transition_label} must change role"));
1364:             }
1365:             if transition.get("status").and_then(Value::as_str) != Some("pass") {
1366:                 return Err(format!("{transition_label}.status must be pass"));
1367:             }
1368:         }
1369:     }
1370: 
1371:     Ok("Fresh install OS matrix readiness checks: PASS".to_string())
1372: }

1630:     write_json(report_path.as_path(), &report, "fixture readiness report")?;
1631: 
1632:     let mut stale_two_hop = two_hop_report
1633:         .as_object()
1634:         .cloned()
1635:         .ok_or_else(|| "fixture two-hop report shape invalid".to_string())?;
1636:     stale_two_hop.insert("git_commit".to_string(), Value::String(stale_commit));
1637:     write_json(
1638:         stale_two_hop_report_path.as_path(),
1639:         &Value::Object(stale_two_hop),
1640:         "fixture stale two-hop report",
1641:     )?;
1642: 
1643:     let mut stale_wrapper = report
1644:         .as_object()
1645:         .cloned()
1646:         .ok_or_else(|| "fixture readiness report shape invalid".to_string())?;
1647:     stale_wrapper.insert(
1648:         "source_artifacts".to_string(),
1649:         Value::Array(vec![
1650:             Value::String(absolute_display(bootstrap_log.as_path())),
1651:             Value::String(absolute_display(baseline_log.as_path())),
1652:             Value::String(absolute_display(stale_two_hop_report_path.as_path())),
1653:             Value::String(absolute_display(role_switch_report_path.as_path())),
1654:             Value::String(absolute_display(lan_toggle_report_path.as_path())),
1655:             Value::String(absolute_display(exit_handoff_report_path.as_path())),
1656:             Value::String(absolute_display(role_switch_md.as_path())),
1657:             Value::String(absolute_display(two_hop_log.as_path())),
1658:             Value::String(absolute_display(lan_toggle_log.as_path())),
1659:             Value::String(absolute_display(exit_handoff_log.as_path())),
1660:             Value::String(absolute_display(exit_handoff_monitor_log.as_path())),
1661:         ]),
1662:     );
1663:     let scenarios = stale_wrapper
1664:         .get_mut("scenarios")
1665:         .and_then(Value::as_object_mut)
1666:         .ok_or_else(|| "fixture readiness report scenarios missing".to_string())?;
1667:     for scenario_payload in scenarios.values_mut() {
1668:         let two_hop_section = scenario_payload
1669:             .as_object_mut()
1670:             .and_then(|entry| entry.get_mut("two_hop"))
1671:             .and_then(Value::as_object_mut)
1672:             .ok_or_else(|| "fixture scenario two_hop section missing".to_string())?;
1673:         two_hop_section.insert(
1674:             "source_artifacts".to_string(),
1675:             Value::Array(vec![
1676:                 Value::String(absolute_display(stale_two_hop_report_path.as_path())),
1677:                 Value::String(absolute_display(two_hop_log.as_path())),
1678:             ]),
1679:         );
1680:     }
1681:     write_json(
1682:         stale_wrapper_report_path.as_path(),
1683:         &Value::Object(stale_wrapper),
1684:         "fixture stale-wrapper report",
1685:     )?;
1686: 
1687:     Ok(format!(
1688:         "fresh install readiness fixtures written: output_dir={} report={} stale_report={}",
1689:         output_dir.display(),
1690:         report_path.display(),
1691:         stale_wrapper_report_path.display()
1692:     ))
1693: }

1707:         let unique = format!(
1708:             "ops-fresh-install-fixtures-test-{}-{}",
1709:             std::process::id(),
1710:             SystemTime::now()
1711:                 .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
1712:                 .expect("system time after unix epoch")
1713:                 .as_nanos()
1714:         );

1716:         fs::create_dir_all(output_dir.as_path()).expect("create fixture temp dir");
1717: 
1718:         execute_ops_write_fresh_install_os_matrix_readiness_fixtures(
1719:             WriteFreshInstallOsMatrixReadinessFixturesConfig {
1720:                 output_dir: output_dir.clone(),
1721:                 head_commit: "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa".to_string(),
1722:                 stale_commit: "1111111111111111111111111111111111111111".to_string(),
1723:                 now_unix: 1_773_300_000,
1724:             },
1725:         )
1726:         .expect("write fixtures");
1727: 
1728:         let stale_child = parse_json_object(
1729:             output_dir
1730:                 .join("live_linux_two_hop_report_stale.json")
1731:                 .as_path(),
1732:             "stale child fixture",
1733:         )
1734:         .expect("load stale child fixture");
1735:         assert_eq!(
1736:             stale_child.get("git_commit").and_then(Value::as_str),
1737:             Some("1111111111111111111111111111111111111111")
1738:         );
1739: 
1740:         let stale_wrapper = parse_json_object(
1741:             output_dir.join("report_with_stale_child.json").as_path(),
1742:             "stale wrapper fixture",
1743:         )
1744:         .expect("load stale wrapper fixture");
1745:         let source_artifacts = stale_wrapper
1746:             .get("source_artifacts")
1747:             .and_then(Value::as_array)
1748:             .expect("source_artifacts array");
1749:         assert!(source_artifacts.iter().any(|entry| {
1750:             entry
1751:                 .as_str()
1752:                 .map(|value| value.ends_with("/live_linux_two_hop_report_stale.json"))
1753:                 .unwrap_or(false)
1754:         }));
1755: 
1756:         fs::remove_dir_all(output_dir.as_path()).expect("cleanup fixture temp dir");
1757:     }
1758: }

 504: 
 505:     let legacy_encrypted_exists = match fs::symlink_metadata(legacy_encrypted_key_path) {
 506:         Ok(_) => true,
 507:         Err(err) if err.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => false,
 508:         Err(err) => {
 509:             return Err(format!(
 510:                 "inspect legacy encrypted key path {} failed: {err}",
 511:                 legacy_encrypted_key_path.display()
 512:             ));
 513:         }
 514:     };
 515:     let legacy_public_exists = match fs::symlink_metadata(legacy_public_key_path) {
 516:         Ok(_) => true,
 517:         Err(err) if err.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => false,
 518:         Err(err) => {
 519:             return Err(format!(
 520:                 "inspect legacy public key path {} failed: {err}",
 521:                 legacy_public_key_path.display()
 522:             ));
 523:         }

 528:             legacy_encrypted_key_path.display(),
 529:             wireguard_encrypted_private_key_path.display()
 530:         ));
 531:     }

 537:         ));

 875:             "RUSTYNET_PRIVILEGED_HELPER_TIMEOUT_MS".to_string(),
 876:             privileged_helper_timeout_ms_raw,
 877:         ),
 878:         (
 879:             "RUSTYNET_PRIVILEGED_HELPER_ALLOWED_UID".to_string(),
 880:             daemon_uid.as_raw().to_string(),
 881:         ),
 882:         (
 883:             "RUSTYNET_PRIVILEGED_HELPER_ALLOWED_GID".to_string(),
 884:             daemon_gid.as_raw().to_string(),
 885:         ),
 886:         ("RUSTYNET_DAEMON_GROUP".to_string(), service_group),
 887:         (
 888:             "RUSTYNET_RECONCILE_INTERVAL_MS".to_string(),
 889:             reconcile_interval_ms,
 890:         ),
 891:         (
 892:             "RUSTYNET_MAX_RECONCILE_FAILURES".to_string(),
 893:             max_reconcile_failures,
 894:         ),
 895:         (
 896:             "RUSTYNET_FAIL_CLOSED_SSH_ALLOW".to_string(),
 897:             fail_closed_ssh_allow_raw,
 898:         ),
 899:         (
 900:             "RUSTYNET_FAIL_CLOSED_SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS".to_string(),
 901:             fail_closed_ssh_allow_cidrs,
 902:         ),
 903:     ];
 904: 
 905:     let mut rendered_env = String::new();
 906:     for (key, value) in env_entries {
 907:         validate_env_line(key.as_str(), value.as_str())?;
 908:         rendered_env.push_str(key.as_str());
 909:         rendered_env.push('=');
 910:         rendered_env.push_str(value.as_str());
 911:         rendered_env.push('\n');
 912:     }
 913:     write_atomic_text_file(
 914:         Path::new(ENV_DST),
 915:         rendered_env.as_str(),
 916:         Uid::from_raw(0),
 917:         Gid::from_raw(0),
 918:         0o644,
 919:         Uid::from_raw(0),
 920:         Gid::from_raw(0),
 921:         0o755,
 922:     )?;
 923:     if assignment_auto_refresh_enabled {
 924:         let rendered_assignment_refresh_env = render_assignment_refresh_env_contents(
 925:             assignment_refresh_default_target_node_id.as_str(),
 926:             env_optional_string("RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_TARGET_NODE_ID")?,
 927:             env_optional_string("RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_NODES")?,
 928:             env_optional_string("RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_ALLOW")?,
 929:             env_optional_string("RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_EXIT_NODE_ID")?,
 930:             &existing_assignment_refresh_env,
 931:         )?;
 932:         write_atomic_text_file(
 933:             Path::new(ASSIGNMENT_REFRESH_ENV_DST),
 934:             rendered_assignment_refresh_env.as_str(),
 935:             Uid::from_raw(0),
 936:             Gid::from_raw(0),
 937:             0o600,
 938:             Uid::from_raw(0),
 939:             daemon_gid,
 940:             0o750,
 941:         )?;
 942:     }
 943: 
 944:     ensure_managed_dns_control_plane_ready()?;
 945:     run_command_checked("systemctl", &["daemon-reload"])?;
 946:     run_command_checked(
 947:         "systemctl",
 948:         &["enable", "rustynetd-privileged-helper.service"],
 949:     )?;
 950:     run_command_checked("systemctl", &["enable", "rustynetd.service"])?;
 951:     if auto_tunnel_enforce_enabled {
 952:         run_command_checked("systemctl", &["enable", "rustynetd-managed-dns.service"])?;
 953:     } else {
 954:         let _ = run_command_checked(
 955:             "systemctl",
 956:             &["disable", "--now", "rustynetd-managed-dns.service"],
 957:         );
 958:     }
 959: 
 960:     if trust_auto_refresh_enabled {
 961:         if !trust_signer_key_path.is_file() {
 962:             return Err(format!(
 963:                 "trust auto-refresh enabled but signer key missing: {}",
 964:                 trust_signer_key_path.display()
 965:             ));
 966:         }
 967:         run_command_checked("systemctl", &["enable", "rustynetd-trust-refresh.timer"])?;
 968:     } else {
 969:         let _ = run_command_checked(
 970:             "systemctl",
 971:             &["disable", "--now", "rustynetd-trust-refresh.timer"],
 972:         );
 973:     }
 974: 
 975:     if assignment_auto_refresh_enabled {
 976:         if !auto_tunnel_verifier_key_path.is_file() {
 977:             return Err(format!(
 978:                 "assignment auto-refresh enabled but verifier key missing: {}",
 979:                 auto_tunnel_verifier_key_path.display()
 980:             ));
 981:         }
 982:         run_command_checked(
 983:             "systemctl",
 984:             &["enable", "rustynetd-assignment-refresh.timer"],
 985:         )?;
 986:     } else {
 987:         let _ = run_command_checked(
 988:             "systemctl",
 989:             &["disable", "--now", "rustynetd-assignment-refresh.timer"],
 990:         );
 991:     }
 992: 
 993:     let _ = run_command_checked(
 994:         "systemctl",
 995:         &[
 996:             "reset-failed",
 997:             "rustynetd-privileged-helper.service",
 998:             "rustynetd.service",
 999:             "rustynetd-trust-refresh.service",
1000:             "rustynetd-trust-refresh.timer",
1001:             "rustynetd-assignment-refresh.service",
1002:             "rustynetd-assignment-refresh.timer",
1003:             "rustynetd-managed-dns.service",
1004:         ],
1005:     );
1006: 
1007:     run_command_checked(
1008:         "systemctl",
1009:         &["restart", "rustynetd-privileged-helper.service"],
1010:     )?;
1011: 
1012:     if assignment_auto_refresh_enabled {
1013:         run_command_checked(
1014:             "systemctl",
1015:             &["start", "rustynetd-assignment-refresh.service"],
1016:         )?;
1017:     }
1018:     if trust_auto_refresh_enabled {
1019:         run_command_checked("systemctl", &["start", "rustynetd-trust-refresh.service"])?;
1020:     }
1021: 
1022:     run_command_checked("systemctl", &["restart", "rustynetd.service"])?;
1023:     wait_for_unit_active("rustynetd.service", 40, 250)?;
1024: 
1025:     if trust_auto_refresh_enabled || assignment_auto_refresh_enabled || auto_tunnel_enforce_enabled
1026:     {
1027:         wait_for_unix_socket(socket_path.as_path(), 40, 250)?;
1028:         let socket_value = display_path(socket_path.as_path());
1029:         run_command_checked_with_env(
1030:             "rustynet",
1031:             &["state", "refresh"],
1032:             &[("RUSTYNET_DAEMON_SOCKET", socket_value.as_str())],
1033:         )?;
1034:     }
1035:     if auto_tunnel_enforce_enabled {
1036:         run_command_checked("systemctl", &["restart", "rustynetd-managed-dns.service"])?;
1037:         wait_for_unit_active("rustynetd-managed-dns.service", 40, 250)?;
1038:     }
1039: 
1040:     if trust_auto_refresh_enabled {
1041:         run_command_checked("systemctl", &["restart", "rustynetd-trust-refresh.timer"])?;
1042:     }
1043:     if assignment_auto_refresh_enabled {
1044:         run_command_checked(
1045:             "systemctl",
1046:             &["restart", "rustynetd-assignment-refresh.timer"],
1047:         )?;
1048:     }
1049: 
1050:     run_command_stream(
1051:         "systemctl",
1052:         &[
1053:             "--no-pager",
1054:             "--full",
1055:             "status",
1056:             "rustynetd-privileged-helper.service",
1057:         ],
1058:     )?;
1059:     if trust_auto_refresh_enabled {
1060:         run_command_stream(
1061:             "systemctl",
1062:             &[
1063:                 "--no-pager",
1064:                 "--full",
1065:                 "status",
1066:                 "rustynetd-trust-refresh.timer",
1067:             ],
1068:         )?;
1069:     }
1070:     if assignment_auto_refresh_enabled {
1071:         run_command_stream(
1072:             "systemctl",
1073:             &[
1074:                 "--no-pager",
1075:                 "--full",
1076:                 "status",
1077:                 "rustynetd-assignment-refresh.timer",
1078:             ],
1079:         )?;
1080:     }
1081:     if auto_tunnel_enforce_enabled {
1082:         run_systemctl_status_with_retry("rustynetd-managed-dns.service", 20, 250)?;
1083:     } else {
1084:         wait_for_unit_inactive("rustynetd-managed-dns.service", 20, 250)?;
1085:         let enabled_state = systemctl_unit_enabled_state("rustynetd-managed-dns.service")?;
1086:         if enabled_state != "disabled" {
1087:             return Err(format!(
1088:                 "managed DNS routing unit must remain disabled while auto-tunnel enforcement is off (state={enabled_state})"
1089:             ));
1090:         }
1091:     }
1092:     run_command_stream(
1093:         "systemctl",
1094:         &["--no-pager", "--full", "status", "rustynetd.service"],
1095:     )?;
1096: 
1097:     Ok(format!(
1098:         "systemd installer completed: role={node_role} wireguard_listen_port={wireguard_listen_port} egress_interface={egress_interface} timeout_ms={privileged_helper_timeout_ms}",
1099:     ))
1100: }

1102: fn require_root_execution() -> Result<(), String> {
1103:     if Uid::effective().is_root() {
1104:         return Ok(());
1105:     }
1106:     Err("run as root".to_string())
1107: }

1109: fn require_linux_host() -> Result<(), String> {
1110:     if cfg!(target_os = "linux") {
1111:         return Ok(());
1112:     }
1113:     Err("ops install-systemd is only supported on Linux hosts".to_string())
1114: }

1116: fn resolve_source_root() -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
1117:     if let Some(candidate) = env_optional_string("RUSTYNET_INSTALL_SOURCE_ROOT")? {
1118:         let path = PathBuf::from(candidate);
1119:         if !path.is_absolute() {
1120:             return Err(format!(
1121:                 "RUSTYNET_INSTALL_SOURCE_ROOT must be an absolute path: {}",
1122:                 path.display()
1123:             ));
1124:         }
1125:         if has_install_sources(path.as_path()) {
1126:             return Ok(path);
1127:         }
1128:         return Err(format!(
1129:             "RUSTYNET_INSTALL_SOURCE_ROOT missing required systemd files: {}",
1130:             path.display()
1131:         ));
1132:     }
1133: 
1134:     let cwd = std::env::current_dir().map_err(|err| format!("resolve cwd failed: {err}"))?;
1135:     if has_install_sources(cwd.as_path()) {
1136:         return Ok(cwd);
1137:     }
1138: 
1139:     Err(
1140:         "unable to resolve installer source root; set RUSTYNET_INSTALL_SOURCE_ROOT to repository root"
1141:             .to_string(),
1142:     )
1143: }

1145: fn install_sources(root: &Path) -> InstallSources {
1146:     InstallSources {
1147:         service: root.join("scripts/systemd/rustynetd.service"),
1148:         helper_service: root.join("scripts/systemd/rustynetd-privileged-helper.service"),
1149:         trust_refresh_service: root.join("scripts/systemd/rustynetd-trust-refresh.service"),
1150:         trust_refresh_timer: root.join("scripts/systemd/rustynetd-trust-refresh.timer"),
1151:         assignment_refresh_service: root
1152:             .join("scripts/systemd/rustynetd-assignment-refresh.service"),
1153:         assignment_refresh_timer: root.join("scripts/systemd/rustynetd-assignment-refresh.timer"),
1154:         managed_dns_service: root.join("scripts/systemd/rustynetd-managed-dns.service"),
1155:     }
1156: }

1158: fn has_install_sources(root: &Path) -> bool {
1159:     let sources = install_sources(root);
1160:     [
1161:         sources.service,
1162:         sources.helper_service,
1163:         sources.trust_refresh_service,
1164:         sources.trust_refresh_timer,
1165:         sources.assignment_refresh_service,
1166:         sources.assignment_refresh_timer,
1167:         sources.managed_dns_service,
1168:     ]
1169:     .iter()
1170:     .all(|path| path.is_file())
1171: }

1173: fn validate_source_paths(paths: &InstallSources) -> Result<(), String> {
1174:     for (label, path) in [
1175:         ("rustynetd.service", paths.service.as_path()),
1176:         (
1177:             "rustynetd-privileged-helper.service",
1178:             paths.helper_service.as_path(),
1179:         ),
1180:         (
1181:             "rustynetd-trust-refresh.service",
1182:             paths.trust_refresh_service.as_path(),
1183:         ),
1184:         (
1185:             "rustynetd-trust-refresh.timer",
1186:             paths.trust_refresh_timer.as_path(),
1187:         ),
1188:         (
1189:             "rustynetd-assignment-refresh.service",
1190:             paths.assignment_refresh_service.as_path(),
1191:         ),
1192:         (
1193:             "rustynetd-assignment-refresh.timer",
1194:             paths.assignment_refresh_timer.as_path(),
1195:         ),
1196:         (
1197:             "rustynetd-managed-dns.service",
1198:             paths.managed_dns_service.as_path(),
1199:         ),
1200:     ] {
1201:         validate_regular_file_non_symlink(path, label)?;
1202:     }
1203:     Ok(())
1204: }
1205: 
1206: fn validate_regular_file_non_symlink(path: &Path, label: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
1207:     let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(path)
1208:         .map_err(|err| format!("missing {label}: {} ({err})", path.display()))?;
1209:     if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
1210:         return Err(format!("{label} must not be a symlink: {}", path.display()));
1211:     }
1212:     if !metadata.file_type().is_file() {
1213:         return Err(format!(
1214:             "{label} must be a regular file: {}",
1215:             path.display()
1216:         ));
1217:     }
1218:     Ok(())
1219: }
1220: 
1221: pub(crate) fn read_env_file_values(path: &Path) -> Result<HashMap<String, String>, String> {
1222:     let mut values = HashMap::new();
1223:     if !path.exists() {
1224:         return Ok(values);
1225:     }
1226:     let content = fs::read_to_string(path)
1227:         .map_err(|err| format!("read environment file {} failed: {err}", path.display()))?;
1228:     for raw_line in content.lines() {
1229:         let line = raw_line.trim_start();
1230:         if line.is_empty() || line.starts_with('#') {
1231:             continue;
1232:         }
1233:         if let Some((key, value)) = raw_line.split_once('=') {
1234:             if key.is_empty() || values.contains_key(key) {
1235:                 continue;
1236:             }
1237:             let parsed = parse_env_value(value).map_err(|err| {
1238:                 format!(
1239:                     "parse environment file {} failed for key {key}: {err}",
1240:                     path.display()
1241:                 )
1242:             })?;
1243:             values.insert(key.to_string(), parsed);
1244:         }
1245:     }
1246:     Ok(values)
1247: }
1248: 
1249: fn env_optional_string(key: &str) -> Result<Option<String>, String> {
1250:     match std::env::var(key) {
1251:         Ok(value) => {
1252:             if value.is_empty() {
1253:                 Ok(None)
1254:             } else {
1255:                 Ok(Some(value))
1256:             }
1257:         }
1258:         Err(std::env::VarError::NotPresent) => Ok(None),
1259:         Err(std::env::VarError::NotUnicode(_)) => {
1260:             Err(format!("environment variable {key} contains non-utf8 data"))
1261:         }
1262:     }
1263: }
1264: 
1265: fn env_string_or_existing_default(
1266:     key: &str,
1267:     default: &str,
1268:     existing: &HashMap<String, String>,
1269: ) -> Result<String, String> {
1270:     match env_optional_string(key)? {
1271:         Some(value) => Ok(value),
1272:         None => match existing.get(key) {
1273:             Some(value) if !value.is_empty() => Ok(value.clone()),
1274:             _ => Ok(default.to_string()),
1275:         },
1276:     }
1277: }
1278: 
1279: fn env_string_or_existing_required(
1280:     key: &str,
1281:     existing: &HashMap<String, String>,
1282: ) -> Result<String, String> {
1283:     match env_optional_string(key)? {
1284:         Some(value) => Ok(value),
1285:         None => match existing.get(key) {
1286:             Some(value) if !value.is_empty() => Ok(value.clone()),
1287:             _ => Err(format!(
1288:                 "missing required environment value: {key} (set it explicitly before install)"
1289:             )),
1290:         },
1291:     }
1292: }
1293: 
1294: fn env_string_or_default_process(key: &str, default: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
1295:     match env_optional_string(key)? {
1296:         Some(value) => Ok(value),
1297:         None => Ok(default.to_string()),
1298:     }
1299: }
1300: 
1301: fn env_path_or_existing_default(
1302:     key: &str,
1303:     default: &str,
1304:     existing: &HashMap<String, String>,
1305: ) -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
1306:     let value = env_string_or_existing_default(key, default, existing)?;
1307:     let path = PathBuf::from(value);
1308:     if !path.is_absolute() {
1309:         return Err(format!(
1310:             "{key} must be an absolute path: {}",
1311:             path.display()
1312:         ));
1313:     }
1314:     Ok(path)
1315: }
