1317: fn validate_node_role(value: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
1318:     match value {
1319:         "admin" | "client" | "blind_exit" => Ok(()),
1320:         _ => Err(format!(
1321:             "invalid node role: {value} (expected admin|client|blind_exit)"
1322:         )),
1323:     }
1324: }
1325: 
1326: fn parse_install_bool(key: &str, value: &str) -> Result<bool, String> {
1327:     match value {
1328:         "true" | "1" | "yes" => Ok(true),
1329:         "false" | "0" | "no" => Ok(false),
1330:         _ => Err(format!(
1331:             "invalid {} value: {} (expected true|false)",
1332:             key.to_lowercase().replace('_', " "),
1333:             value
1334:         )),
1335:     }
1336: }
1337: 
1338: fn parse_nonzero_u64(key: &str, value: &str) -> Result<u64, String> {
1339:     let parsed = value.parse::<u64>().map_err(|_| {
1340:         format!(
1341:             "invalid {}: {}",
1342:             key.to_lowercase().replace('_', " "),
1343:             value
1344:         )
1345:     })?;
1346:     if parsed == 0 {
1347:         return Err(format!(
1348:             "invalid {}: {}",
1349:             key.to_lowercase().replace('_', " "),
1350:             value
1351:         ));
1352:     }
1353:     Ok(parsed)
1354: }
1355: 
1356: fn parse_traversal_stun_servers_install(value: &str) -> Result<Vec<SocketAddr>, String> {
1357:     value
1358:         .split(',')
1359:         .map(str::trim)
1360:         .filter(|entry| !entry.is_empty())
1361:         .map(|entry| {
1362:             entry
1363:                 .parse::<SocketAddr>()
1364:                 .map_err(|err| format!("invalid traversal stun servers entry {entry}: {err}"))
1365:         })
1366:         .collect()
1367: }
1368: 
1369: fn parse_dns_resolver_bind_addr_install(value: &str) -> Result<SocketAddr, String> {
1370:     let addr = value
1371:         .parse::<SocketAddr>()
1372:         .map_err(|err| format!("invalid dns resolver bind addr: {err}"))?;
1373:     if !addr.ip().is_loopback() {
1374:         return Err("dns resolver bind addr must be loopback".to_string());
1375:     }
1376:     if !matches!(addr.ip(), IpAddr::V4(_)) {
1377:         return Err(
1378:             "dns resolver bind addr for managed DNS routing must be an IPv4 loopback address"
1379:                 .to_string(),
1380:         );
1381:     }
1382:     Ok(addr)
1383: }
1384: 
1385: fn parse_wireguard_port(value: &str) -> Result<u16, String> {
1386:     let port = value
1387:         .parse::<u16>()
1388:         .map_err(|_| format!("invalid wireguard listen port: {value} (expected 1-65535)"))?;
1389:     if port == 0 {
1390:         return Err(format!(
1391:             "invalid wireguard listen port: {value} (expected 1-65535)"
1392:         ));
1393:     }
1394:     Ok(port)
1395: }
1396: 
1397: fn detect_default_egress_interface() -> Result<String, String> {
1398:     let output = run_command_capture("ip", &["-o", "-4", "route", "show", "to", "default"])?;
1399:     if let Some(interface) = parse_first_route_interface(output.as_str()) {
1400:         return Ok(interface);
1401:     }
1402:     Err("unable to detect default egress interface; set RUSTYNET_EGRESS_INTERFACE".to_string())
1403: }
1404: 
1405: fn resolve_egress_interface(
1406:     explicit_egress: Option<String>,
1407:     existing_egress: Option<String>,
1408:     selected_exit_endpoint: Option<&str>,
1409: ) -> Result<String, String> {
1410:     if let Some(endpoint) = selected_exit_endpoint {
1411:         let derived = detect_egress_interface_for_endpoint(endpoint)?;
1412:         if let Some(explicit_value) = explicit_egress.as_deref()
1413:             && !explicit_value.trim().is_empty()
1414:             && explicit_value != derived
1415:         {
1416:             return Err(format!(
1417:                 "explicit egress interface {explicit_value} does not route to selected exit endpoint {endpoint}; expected {derived}"
1418:             ));
1419:         }
1420:         return Ok(derived);
1421:     }
1422: 
1423:     if let Some(value) = explicit_egress
1424:         && !value.trim().is_empty()
1425:     {
1426:         return Ok(value);
1427:     }
1428:     if let Some(value) = existing_egress
1429:         && !value.trim().is_empty()
1430:     {
1431:         return Ok(value);
1432:     }
1433:     detect_default_egress_interface()
1434: }
1435: 
1436: fn detect_egress_interface_for_endpoint(endpoint: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
1437:     let socket_addr = endpoint
1438:         .parse::<SocketAddr>()
1439:         .map_err(|_| format!("invalid selected-exit endpoint format: {endpoint}"))?;
1440:     detect_egress_interface_for_ip(socket_addr.ip())
1441: }
1442: 
1443: fn detect_egress_interface_for_ip(ip: IpAddr) -> Result<String, String> {
1444:     let (args_prefix, ip_arg) = match ip {
1445:         IpAddr::V4(value) => (vec!["-o", "-4", "route", "get"], value.to_string()),
1446:         IpAddr::V6(value) => (vec!["-o", "-6", "route", "get"], value.to_string()),
1447:     };
1448:     let mut args = args_prefix;
1449:     args.push(ip_arg.as_str());
1450:     let output = run_command_capture("ip", args.as_slice())?;
1451:     if let Some(interface) = parse_first_route_interface(output.as_str()) {
1452:         return Ok(interface);
1453:     }
1454:     Err(format!(
1455:         "unable to detect egress interface for selected exit destination {ip}"
1456:     ))
1457: }
1458: 
1459: fn parse_first_route_interface(output: &str) -> Option<String> {
1460:     output
1461:         .lines()
1462:         .find_map(parse_dev_interface_token)
1463:         .map(|value| value.to_string())
1464: }
1465: 
1466: fn parse_dev_interface_token(line: &str) -> Option<&str> {
1467:     let tokens = line.split_whitespace().collect::<Vec<_>>();
1468:     for (idx, token) in tokens.iter().enumerate() {
1469:         if *token == "dev" {
1470:             return tokens.get(idx + 1).copied();
1471:         }
1472:     }
1473:     tokens.get(4).copied()
1474: }
1475: 
1476: fn detect_selected_exit_endpoint_for_egress(
1477:     assignment_bundle_path: &Path,
1478:     assignment_refresh_env_path: &Path,
1479: ) -> Result<Option<String>, String> {
1480:     let preferred_exit_node_id = read_assignment_refresh_exit_node_id(assignment_refresh_env_path)?;
1481:     if !assignment_bundle_path.exists() {
1482:         if let Some(exit_node_id) = preferred_exit_node_id {
1483:             return Err(format!(
1484:                 "selected exit node {exit_node_id} is set but assignment bundle is missing: {}",
1485:                 assignment_bundle_path.display()
1486:             ));
1487:         }
1488:         return Ok(None);
1489:     }
1490:     if !assignment_bundle_path.is_file() {
1491:         return Err(format!(
1492:             "assignment bundle path must be a regular file: {}",
1493:             assignment_bundle_path.display()
1494:         ));
1495:     }
1496:     let fields = read_env_file_values(assignment_bundle_path)?;
1497:     let selected_exit_node_id =
1498:         resolve_selected_exit_node_id(&fields, preferred_exit_node_id.as_deref());
1499:     let Some(exit_node_id) = selected_exit_node_id else {
1500:         return Ok(None);
1501:     };
1502:     let endpoint = assignment_peer_endpoint(&fields, exit_node_id.as_str())?;
1503:     Ok(Some(endpoint))
1504: }
1505: 
1506: fn read_assignment_refresh_exit_node_id(path: &Path) -> Result<Option<String>, String> {
1507:     if !path.exists() {
1508:         return Ok(None);
1509:     }
1510:     let values = read_env_file_values(path)?;
1511:     let raw = match values.get("RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_EXIT_NODE_ID") {
1512:         Some(value) => value.trim(),
1513:         None => return Ok(None),
1514:     };
1515:     if raw.is_empty() {
1516:         return Ok(None);
1517:     }
1518:     if !is_valid_assignment_node_id(raw) {
1519:         return Err(format!(
1520:             "invalid RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_EXIT_NODE_ID in {}: {}",
1521:             path.display(),
1522:             raw
1523:         ));
1524:     }
1525:     Ok(Some(raw.to_string()))
1526: }
1527: 
1528: fn render_assignment_refresh_env_contents(
1529:     fallback_target_node_id: &str,
1530:     target_node_id_raw: Option<String>,
1531:     nodes_spec_raw: Option<String>,
1532:     allow_spec_raw: Option<String>,
1533:     exit_node_id_raw: Option<String>,
1534:     existing: &HashMap<String, String>,
1535: ) -> Result<String, String> {
1536:     let target_node_id = resolve_assignment_refresh_value(
1537:         "RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_TARGET_NODE_ID",
1538:         target_node_id_raw,
1539:         existing,
1540:         Some(fallback_target_node_id),
1541:     )?;
1542:     if !is_valid_assignment_node_id(target_node_id.as_str()) {
1543:         return Err(format!(
1544:             "assignment auto-refresh requires a valid RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_TARGET_NODE_ID; unsupported characters in {target_node_id}",
1545:         ));
1546:     }
1547: 
1548:     let nodes_spec = resolve_assignment_refresh_value(
1549:         "RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_NODES",
1550:         nodes_spec_raw,
1551:         existing,
1552:         None,
1553:     )?;
1554:     let allow_spec = resolve_assignment_refresh_value(
1555:         "RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_ALLOW",
1556:         allow_spec_raw,
1557:         existing,
1558:         None,
1559:     )?;
1560:     let exit_node_id = resolve_assignment_refresh_optional_value(
1561:         "RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_EXIT_NODE_ID",
1562:         exit_node_id_raw,
1563:         existing,
1564:     )?;
1565:     if let Some(value) = exit_node_id.as_deref()
1566:         && !is_valid_assignment_node_id(value)
1567:     {
1568:         return Err(format!(
1569:             "assignment auto-refresh requires a valid RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_EXIT_NODE_ID; unsupported characters in {value}",
1570:         ));
1571:     }
1572: 
1573:     let mut rendered = String::new();
1574:     rendered.push_str(
1575:         format_env_assignment(
1576:             "RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_TARGET_NODE_ID",
1577:             target_node_id.as_str(),
1578:         )?
1579:         .as_str(),
1580:     );
1581:     rendered.push('\n');
1582:     rendered.push_str(
1583:         format_env_assignment("RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_NODES", nodes_spec.as_str())?.as_str(),
1584:     );
1585:     rendered.push('\n');
1586:     rendered.push_str(
1587:         format_env_assignment("RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_ALLOW", allow_spec.as_str())?.as_str(),
1588:     );
1589:     rendered.push('\n');
1590:     if let Some(value) = exit_node_id {
1591:         rendered.push_str(
1592:             format_env_assignment("RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_EXIT_NODE_ID", value.as_str())?.as_str(),
1593:         );
1594:         rendered.push('\n');
1595:     }
1596:     Ok(rendered)
1597: }
1598: 
1599: fn resolve_assignment_refresh_value(
1600:     key: &str,
1601:     explicit: Option<String>,
1602:     existing: &HashMap<String, String>,
1603:     fallback: Option<&str>,
1604: ) -> Result<String, String> {
1605:     let resolved = explicit
1606:         .or_else(|| existing.get(key).cloned())
1607:         .unwrap_or_else(|| fallback.unwrap_or_default().to_string())
1608:         .trim()
1609:         .to_string();
1610:     if resolved.is_empty() {
1611:         return Err(format!(
1612:             "assignment auto-refresh requires {key}; set it explicitly or provide it in {ASSIGNMENT_REFRESH_ENV_DST}"
1613:         ));
1614:     }
1615:     validate_env_line(key, resolved.as_str())?;
1616:     Ok(resolved)
1617: }
1618: 
1619: fn resolve_assignment_refresh_optional_value(
1620:     key: &str,
1621:     explicit: Option<String>,
1622:     existing: &HashMap<String, String>,
1623: ) -> Result<Option<String>, String> {
1624:     let Some(raw) = explicit.or_else(|| existing.get(key).cloned()) else {
1625:         return Ok(None);
1626:     };
1627:     let normalized = raw.trim().to_string();
1628:     if normalized.is_empty() {
1629:         return Ok(None);
1630:     }
1631:     validate_env_line(key, normalized.as_str())?;
1632:     Ok(Some(normalized))
1633: }
1634: 
1635: fn is_valid_assignment_node_id(value: &str) -> bool {
1636:     !value.is_empty()
1637:         && value
1638:             .chars()
1639:             .all(|ch| ch.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(ch, '.' | '_' | ':' | '-'))
1640: }
1641: 
1642: fn resolve_selected_exit_node_id(
1643:     fields: &HashMap<String, String>,
1644:     preferred_exit_node_id: Option<&str>,
1645: ) -> Option<String> {
1646:     if let Some(value) = preferred_exit_node_id
1647:         && !value.trim().is_empty()
1648:     {
1649:         return Some(value.to_string());
1650:     }
1651: 
1652:     let route_count = fields
1653:         .get("route_count")
1654:         .and_then(|value| value.parse::<usize>().ok())
1655:         .unwrap_or(0)
1656:         .min(MAX_ASSIGNMENT_ROUTE_SCAN);
1657: 
1658:     for index in 0..route_count {
1659:         let destination_key = format!("route.{index}.destination_cidr");
1660:         let kind_key = format!("route.{index}.kind");
1661:         let via_key = format!("route.{index}.via_node");
1662:         let Some(destination) = fields.get(destination_key.as_str()) else {
1663:             continue;
1664:         };
1665:         let Some(kind) = fields.get(kind_key.as_str()) else {
1666:             continue;
1667:         };
1668:         let Some(via_node) = fields.get(via_key.as_str()) else {
1669:             continue;
1670:         };
1671:         let destination = destination.trim();
1672:         let kind = kind.trim();
1673:         let via_node = via_node.trim();
1674:         if destination == DEFAULT_EXIT_ROUTE_CIDR && kind == "exit_default" && !via_node.is_empty()
1675:         {
1676:             return Some(via_node.to_string());
1677:         }
1678:     }
1679: 
1680:     for (key, value) in fields {
1681:         let Some(index) = parse_indexed_key_component(key.as_str(), "route.", ".destination_cidr")
1682:         else {
1683:             continue;
1684:         };
1685:         if value.trim() != DEFAULT_EXIT_ROUTE_CIDR {
1686:             continue;
1687:         }
1688:         let kind_key = format!("route.{index}.kind");
1689:         let via_key = format!("route.{index}.via_node");
1690:         let Some(kind) = fields.get(kind_key.as_str()) else {
1691:             continue;
1692:         };
1693:         let Some(via_node) = fields.get(via_key.as_str()) else {
1694:             continue;
1695:         };
1696:         let kind = kind.trim();
1697:         let via_node = via_node.trim();
1698:         if kind == "exit_default" && !via_node.is_empty() {
1699:             return Some(via_node.to_string());
1700:         }
1701:     }
1702: 
1703:     None
1704: }
1705: 
1706: fn assignment_peer_endpoint(
1707:     fields: &HashMap<String, String>,
1708:     target_node_id: &str,
1709: ) -> Result<String, String> {
1710:     let peer_count = fields
1711:         .get("peer_count")
1712:         .and_then(|value| value.parse::<usize>().ok())
1713:         .unwrap_or(0)
1714:         .min(MAX_ASSIGNMENT_PEER_SCAN);
1715: 
1716:     for index in 0..peer_count {
1717:         let node_id_key = format!("peer.{index}.node_id");
1718:         let endpoint_key = format!("peer.{index}.endpoint");
1719:         let Some(node_id) = fields.get(node_id_key.as_str()) else {
1720:             continue;
1721:         };
1722:         if node_id.trim() != target_node_id {
1723:             continue;
1724:         }
1725:         let endpoint = fields.get(endpoint_key.as_str()).ok_or_else(|| {
1726:             format!("assignment bundle missing endpoint for selected exit node {target_node_id}")
1727:         })?;
1728:         let endpoint = endpoint.trim();
1729:         endpoint.parse::<SocketAddr>().map_err(|_| {
1730:             format!("assignment bundle has invalid endpoint for selected exit node {target_node_id}: {endpoint}")
1731:         })?;
1732:         return Ok(endpoint.to_string());
1733:     }
1734: 
1735:     for (key, value) in fields {
1736:         let Some(index) = parse_indexed_key_component(key.as_str(), "peer.", ".node_id") else {
1737:             continue;
1738:         };
1739:         if value.trim() != target_node_id {
1740:             continue;
1741:         }
1742:         let endpoint_key = format!("peer.{index}.endpoint");
1743:         let endpoint = fields.get(endpoint_key.as_str()).ok_or_else(|| {
1744:             format!("assignment bundle missing endpoint for selected exit node {target_node_id}")
1745:         })?;
1746:         let endpoint = endpoint.trim();
1747:         endpoint.parse::<SocketAddr>().map_err(|_| {
1748:             format!("assignment bundle has invalid endpoint for selected exit node {target_node_id}: {endpoint}")
1749:         })?;
1750:         return Ok(endpoint.to_string());
1751:     }
1752: 
1753:     Err(format!(
1754:         "assignment bundle missing selected exit node peer entry: {target_node_id}"
1755:     ))
1756: }
1757: 
1758: fn parse_indexed_key_component(key: &str, prefix: &str, suffix: &str) -> Option<usize> {
1759:     if !key.starts_with(prefix) || !key.ends_with(suffix) {
1760:         return None;
1761:     }
1762:     let middle = &key[prefix.len()..key.len().saturating_sub(suffix.len())];
1763:     if middle.is_empty() || !middle.bytes().all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_digit()) {
1764:         return None;
1765:     }
1766:     middle.parse::<usize>().ok()
1767: }

1769: fn ensure_interface_exists(interface: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
1770:     run_command_checked("ip", &["link", "show", interface])
1771:         .map_err(|_| format!("egress interface does not exist: {interface}"))
1772: }
1773: 
1774: fn ensure_group_exists(group_name: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
1775:     if lookup_gid_optional(group_name)?.is_some() {
1776:         return Ok(());
1777:     }
1778:     run_command_checked("groupadd", &["--system", group_name])?;
1779:     if lookup_gid_optional(group_name)?.is_none() {
1780:         return Err(format!("failed to create system group: {group_name}"));
1781:     }
1782:     Ok(())
1783: }
1784: 
1785: fn ensure_user_exists(user_name: &str, group_name: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
1786:     if lookup_uid_optional(user_name)?.is_some() {
1787:         return Ok(());
1788:     }
1789:     run_command_checked(
1790:         "useradd",
1791:         &[
1792:             "--system",
1793:             "--gid",
1794:             group_name,
1795:             "--home-dir",
1796:             "/nonexistent",
1797:             "--shell",
1798:             "/usr/sbin/nologin",
1799:             user_name,
1800:         ],
1801:     )?;
1802:     if lookup_uid_optional(user_name)?.is_none() {
1803:         return Err(format!("failed to create system user: {user_name}"));
1804:     }
1805:     Ok(())
1806: }
1807: 
1808: fn lookup_gid_optional(group_name: &str) -> Result<Option<Gid>, String> {
1809:     Group::from_name(group_name)
1810:         .map_err(|err| format!("resolve group {group_name} failed: {err}"))
1811:         .map(|group| group.map(|entry| entry.gid))
1812: }
1813: 
1814: fn lookup_gid(group_name: &str) -> Result<Gid, String> {
1815:     lookup_gid_optional(group_name)?
1816:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("group not found after setup: {group_name}"))
1817: }
1818: 
1819: fn lookup_uid_optional(user_name: &str) -> Result<Option<Uid>, String> {
1820:     User::from_name(user_name)
1821:         .map_err(|err| format!("resolve user {user_name} failed: {err}"))
1822:         .map(|user| user.map(|entry| entry.uid))
1823: }
1824: 
1825: fn lookup_uid(user_name: &str) -> Result<Uid, String> {
1826:     lookup_uid_optional(user_name)?
1827:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("user not found after setup: {user_name}"))
1828: }

1830: fn ensure_directory_with_owner_mode(
1831:     path: &Path,
1832:     mode: u32,
1833:     owner: Uid,
1834:     group: Gid,
1835: ) -> Result<(), String> {
1836:     match fs::symlink_metadata(path) {
1837:         Ok(metadata) => {
1838:             if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
1839:                 return Err(format!(
1840:                     "directory must not be a symlink: {}",
1841:                     path.display()
1842:                 ));
1843:             }
1844:             if !metadata.file_type().is_dir() {
1845:                 return Err(format!("path must be a directory: {}", path.display()));
1846:             }
1847:         }
1848:         Err(err) if err.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => {
1849:             fs::create_dir_all(path).map_err(|create_err| {
1850:                 format!("create directory {} failed: {create_err}", path.display())
1851:             })?;
1852:         }
1853:         Err(err) => {
1854:             return Err(format!(
1855:                 "inspect directory {} failed: {err}",
1856:                 path.display()
1857:             ));
1858:         }
1859:     }
1860: 
1861:     chown(path, Some(owner), Some(group))
1862:         .map_err(|err| format!("set directory owner {} failed: {err}", path.display()))?;
1863:     fs::set_permissions(path, fs::Permissions::from_mode(mode))
1864:         .map_err(|err| format!("set directory mode {} failed: {err}", path.display()))?;
1865:     Ok(())
1866: }
1867: 
1868: fn ensure_parent_dir_if_missing(
1869:     target: &Path,
1870:     owner: Uid,
1871:     group: Gid,
1872:     mode: u32,
1873: ) -> Result<(), String> {
1874:     let parent = target
1875:         .parent()
1876:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("target path has no parent directory: {}", target.display()))?;
1877:     match fs::symlink_metadata(parent) {
1878:         Ok(metadata) => {
1879:             if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
1880:                 return Err(format!(
1881:                     "parent directory must not be a symlink: {}",
1882:                     parent.display()
1883:                 ));
1884:             }
1885:             if !metadata.file_type().is_dir() {
1886:                 return Err(format!(
1887:                     "parent path is not a directory: {}",
1888:                     parent.display()
1889:                 ));
1890:             }
1891:             Ok(())
1892:         }
1893:         Err(err) if err.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => {
1894:             fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|create_err| {
1895:                 format!("create directory {} failed: {create_err}", parent.display())
1896:             })?;
1897:             chown(parent, Some(owner), Some(group)).map_err(|chown_err| {
1898:                 format!(
1899:                     "set directory owner {} failed: {chown_err}",
1900:                     parent.display()
1901:                 )
1902:             })?;
1903:             fs::set_permissions(parent, fs::Permissions::from_mode(mode)).map_err(|perm_err| {
1904:                 format!("set directory mode {} failed: {perm_err}", parent.display())
1905:             })?;
1906:             Ok(())
1907:         }
1908:         Err(err) => Err(format!(
1909:             "inspect directory {} failed: {err}",
1910:             parent.display()
1911:         )),
1912:     }
1913: }

1915: fn install_file(
1916:     source: &Path,
1917:     destination: &Path,
1918:     mode: u32,
1919:     owner: Uid,
1920:     group: Gid,
1921:     label: &str,
1922: ) -> Result<(), String> {
1923:     copy_file_with_owner_mode(source, destination, owner, group, mode, label)
1924: }
1925: 
1926: fn copy_file_with_owner_mode(
1927:     source: &Path,
1928:     destination: &Path,
1929:     owner: Uid,
1930:     group: Gid,
1931:     mode: u32,
1932:     label: &str,
1933: ) -> Result<(), String> {
1934:     validate_regular_file_non_symlink(source, label)?;
1935: 
1936:     match fs::symlink_metadata(destination) {
1937:         Ok(metadata) => {
1938:             if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
1939:                 return Err(format!(
1940:                     "destination must not be a symlink: {}",
1941:                     destination.display()
1942:                 ));
1943:             }
1944:             if metadata.file_type().is_dir() {
1945:                 return Err(format!(
1946:                     "destination must be a file path: {}",
1947:                     destination.display()
1948:                 ));
1949:             }
1950:         }
1951:         Err(err) if err.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => {}
1952:         Err(err) => {
1953:             return Err(format!(
1954:                 "inspect destination {} failed: {err}",
1955:                 destination.display()
1956:             ));
1957:         }
1958:     }
1959: 
1960:     fs::copy(source, destination).map_err(|err| {
1961:         format!(
1962:             "install {label} {} -> {} failed: {err}",
1963:             source.display(),
1964:             destination.display()
1965:         )
1966:     })?;
1967: 
1968:     chown(destination, Some(owner), Some(group))
1969:         .map_err(|err| format!("set {label} owner {} failed: {err}", destination.display()))?;
1970:     fs::set_permissions(destination, fs::Permissions::from_mode(mode))
1971:         .map_err(|err| format!("set {label} mode {} failed: {err}", destination.display()))?;
1972:     Ok(())
1973: }
1974: 
1975: fn set_owner_mode_if_exists(path: &Path, owner: Uid, group: Gid, mode: u32) -> Result<(), String> {
1976:     match fs::symlink_metadata(path) {
1977:         Ok(metadata) => {
1978:             if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
1979:                 return Err(format!("path must not be a symlink: {}", path.display()));
1980:             }
1981:             chown(path, Some(owner), Some(group))
1982:                 .map_err(|err| format!("set owner {} failed: {err}", path.display()))?;
1983:             fs::set_permissions(path, fs::Permissions::from_mode(mode))
1984:                 .map_err(|err| format!("set mode {} failed: {err}", path.display()))?;
1985:             Ok(())
1986:         }
1987:         Err(err) if err.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => Ok(()),
1988:         Err(err) => Err(format!("inspect {} failed: {err}", path.display())),
1989:     }
1990: }

1992: fn set_owner_mode_on_key_custody_artifacts(
1993:     encrypted_key_path: &Path,
1994:     owner: Uid,
1995:     group: Gid,
1996:     mode: u32,
1997: ) -> Result<(), String> {
1998:     let parent = encrypted_key_path.parent().ok_or_else(|| {
1999:         format!(
2000:             "encrypted key path has no parent directory: {}",
2001:             encrypted_key_path.display()
2002:         )
2003:     })?;
2004:     let entries = fs::read_dir(parent).map_err(|err| {
2005:         format!(
2006:             "read key custody directory {} failed: {err}",
2007:             parent.display()
2008:         )
2009:     })?;
2010:     for entry in entries {
2011:         let entry = entry.map_err(|err| {
2012:             format!(
2013:                 "read key custody entry in {} failed: {err}",
2014:                 parent.display()
2015:             )
2016:         })?;
2017:         let file_name = entry.file_name();
2018:         let file_name = file_name.to_string_lossy();
2019:         if !is_private_key_custody_artifact_name(file_name.as_ref()) {
2020:             continue;
2021:         }
2022:         let path = entry.path();
2023:         let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(path.as_path()).map_err(|err| {
2024:             format!(
2025:                 "inspect key custody artifact {} failed: {err}",
2026:                 path.display()
2027:             )
2028:         })?;
2029:         if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
2030:             return Err(format!(
2031:                 "key custody artifact must not be a symlink: {}",
2032:                 path.display()
2033:             ));
2034:         }
2035:         if !metadata.file_type().is_file() {
2036:             return Err(format!(
2037:                 "key custody artifact must be a regular file: {}",
2038:                 path.display()
2039:             ));
2040:         }
2041:         chown(path.as_path(), Some(owner), Some(group)).map_err(|err| {
2042:             format!(
2043:                 "set key custody artifact owner {} failed: {err}",
2044:                 path.display()
2045:             )
2046:         })?;
2047:         fs::set_permissions(path.as_path(), fs::Permissions::from_mode(mode)).map_err(|err| {
2048:             format!(
2049:                 "set key custody artifact mode {} failed: {err}",
2050:                 path.display()
2051:             )
2052:         })?;
2053:     }
2054:     Ok(())
2055: }

2057: fn is_private_key_custody_artifact_name(file_name: &str) -> bool {
2058:     const PREFIX: [u8; 11] = [
2059:         b'w', b'g', b'-', b'p', b'r', b'i', b'v', b'a', b't', b'e', b'-',
2060:     ];
2061:     let bytes = file_name.as_bytes();
2062:     bytes.len() >= PREFIX.len() && bytes[..PREFIX.len()] == PREFIX && file_name.ends_with(".enc")
2063: }

2065: fn secure_remove_file(path: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
2066:     let metadata = match fs::symlink_metadata(path) {
2067:         Ok(metadata) => metadata,
2068:         Err(err) if err.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => return Ok(()),
2069:         Err(err) => return Err(format!("inspect {} failed: {err}", path.display())),
2070:     };
2071: 
2072:     if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
2073:         fs::remove_file(path)
2074:             .map_err(|err| format!("remove symlink {} failed: {err}", path.display()))?;
2075:         return Ok(());
2076:     }
2077: 
2078:     if !metadata.file_type().is_file() {
2079:         return Err(format!(
2080:             "secure remove requires a regular file: {}",
2081:             path.display()
2082:         ));
2083:     }
2084: 
2085:     scrub_file_contents(path)?;
2086:     fs::remove_file(path).map_err(|err| format!("remove {} failed: {err}", path.display()))?;
2087:     Ok(())
2088: }
2089: 
2090: fn scrub_file_contents(path: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
2091:     let metadata = fs::metadata(path)
2092:         .map_err(|err| format!("inspect file {} failed: {err}", path.display()))?;
2093:     let mut file = OpenOptions::new()
2094:         .write(true)
2095:         .open(path)
2096:         .map_err(|err| format!("open {} failed: {err}", path.display()))?;
2097:     let mut remaining = metadata.len();
2098:     let zero_chunk = [0u8; 8192];
2099:     while remaining > 0 {
2100:         let write_len = usize::try_from(std::cmp::min(remaining, zero_chunk.len() as u64))
2101:             .map_err(|_| "internal length conversion failed".to_string())?;
2102:         file.write_all(&zero_chunk[..write_len])
2103:             .map_err(|err| format!("scrub write {} failed: {err}", path.display()))?;
2104:         remaining = remaining.saturating_sub(write_len as u64);
2105:     }
2106:     file.sync_all()
2107:         .map_err(|err| format!("sync {} failed: {err}", path.display()))?;
2108:     file.set_len(0)
2109:         .map_err(|err| format!("truncate {} failed: {err}", path.display()))?;
2110:     file.sync_all()
2111:         .map_err(|err| format!("sync {} after truncate failed: {err}", path.display()))?;
2112:     Ok(())
2113: }

2115: fn bytes_to_hex(input: &[u8]) -> String {
2116:     const HEX: &[u8; 16] = b"0123456789abcdef";
2117:     let mut out = String::with_capacity(input.len() * 2);
2118:     for byte in input {
2119:         out.push(HEX[(byte >> 4) as usize] as char);
2120:         out.push(HEX[(byte & 0x0f) as usize] as char);
2121:     }
2122:     out
2123: }

2125: fn create_secure_temp_file(dir: &Path, prefix: &str) -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
2126:     let mut random_bytes = [0u8; 8];
2127:     for _ in 0..32 {
2128:         fill_os_random_bytes(&mut random_bytes, "temporary filename")?;
2129:         let candidate = dir.join(format!("{prefix}{}", bytes_to_hex(&random_bytes)));
2130:         let mut options = OpenOptions::new();
2131:         options.write(true).create_new(true).mode(0o600);
2132:         match options.open(&candidate) {
2133:             Ok(_) => return Ok(candidate),
2134:             Err(err) if err.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::AlreadyExists => continue,
2135:             Err(err) => {
2136:                 return Err(format!(
2137:                     "create temporary file {} failed: {err}",
2138:                     candidate.display()
2139:                 ));
2140:             }
2141:         }
2142:     }
2143:     Err(format!(
2144:         "unable to allocate secure temporary file in {}",
2145:         dir.display()
2146:     ))
2147: }

2149: fn publish_file_with_owner_mode(
2150:     source_tmp_path: &Path,
2151:     destination_path: &Path,
2152:     owner: Uid,
2153:     group: Gid,
2154:     mode: u32,
2155:     label: &str,
2156: ) -> Result<(), String> {
2157:     chown(source_tmp_path, Some(owner), Some(group)).map_err(|err| {
2158:         format!(
2159:             "set {label} owner {} failed: {err}",
2160:             source_tmp_path.display()
2161:         )
2162:     })?;
2163:     fs::set_permissions(source_tmp_path, fs::Permissions::from_mode(mode)).map_err(|err| {
2164:         format!(
2165:             "set {label} mode {} failed: {err}",
2166:             source_tmp_path.display()
2167:         )
2168:     })?;
2169:     fs::rename(source_tmp_path, destination_path).map_err(|err| {
2170:         format!(
2171:             "publish {label} to {} failed: {err}",
2172:             destination_path.display()
2173:         )
2174:     })?;
2175:     Ok(())
2176: }

2178: #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
2179: fn write_atomic_text_file(
2180:     target: &Path,
2181:     body: &str,
2182:     owner: Uid,
2183:     group: Gid,
2184:     mode: u32,
2185:     parent_owner: Uid,
2186:     parent_group: Gid,
2187:     parent_mode: u32,
2188: ) -> Result<(), String> {
2189:     let parent = target
2190:         .parent()
2191:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("target path has no parent: {}", target.display()))?;
2192:     ensure_directory_with_owner_mode(parent, parent_mode, parent_owner, parent_group)?;
2193: 
2194:     let tmp = create_secure_temp_file(parent, "rustynetd.env.tmp.")?;
2195:     {
2196:         let mut file = OpenOptions::new()
2197:             .write(true)
2198:             .truncate(true)
2199:             .open(tmp.as_path())
2200:             .map_err(|err| format!("open temporary file {} failed: {err}", tmp.display()))?;
2201:         file.write_all(body.as_bytes())
2202:             .map_err(|err| format!("write temporary file {} failed: {err}", tmp.display()))?;
2203:         file.sync_all()
2204:             .map_err(|err| format!("sync temporary file {} failed: {err}", tmp.display()))?;
2205:     }
2206:     publish_file_with_owner_mode(
2207:         tmp.as_path(),
2208:         target,
2209:         owner,
2210:         group,
2211:         mode,
2212:         "environment file",
2213:     )
2214: }

2216: fn run_command_capture(command: &str, args: &[&str]) -> Result<String, String> {
2217:     let output = Command::new(command)
2218:         .args(args)
2219:         .output()
2220:         .map_err(|err| format!("execute {} failed: {err}", format_command(command, args)))?;
2221: 
2222:     if !output.status.success() {
2223:         let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).trim().to_string();
2224:         let stdout = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).trim().to_string();
2225:         let details = if !stderr.is_empty() { stderr } else { stdout };
2226:         return Err(format!(
2227:             "command failed ({}): {}",
2228:             format_command(command, args),
2229:             details
2230:         ));
2231:     }
2232: 
2233:     String::from_utf8(output.stdout).map_err(|err| {
2234:         format!(
2235:             "decode output for {} failed: {err}",
2236:             format_command(command, args)
2237:         )
2238:     })
2239: }

2260:         let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).trim().to_string();
2261:         let stdout = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).trim().to_string();

2264:             "command failed ({}): {}",
2265:             format_command(command, args),
2266:             details
2267:         ));

2286: fn wait_for_unix_socket(path: &Path, attempts: usize, sleep_ms: u64) -> Result<(), String> {
2287:     let mut last_state = "missing".to_string();
2288:     for attempt in 1..=attempts {
2289:         match fs::symlink_metadata(path) {
2290:             Ok(metadata) => {
2291:                 if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
2292:                     last_state = "symlink".to_string();
2293:                 } else if metadata.file_type().is_socket() {
2294:                     return Ok(());
2295:                 } else {
2296:                     last_state = "not-socket".to_string();
2297:                 }
2298:             }
2299:             Err(err) => {
2300:                 last_state = err.to_string();
2301:             }
2302:         }
2303:         if attempt < attempts {
2304:             sleep(Duration::from_millis(sleep_ms));
2305:         }
2306:     }
2307:     Err(format!(
2308:         "daemon socket {} failed to become available after {attempts} attempts (last_state={last_state})",
2309:         path.display()
2310:     ))
2311: }

2313: fn wait_for_unit_active(unit: &str, attempts: usize, sleep_ms: u64) -> Result<(), String> {
2314:     let mut last_state = String::new();
2315:     for attempt in 1..=attempts {
2316:         let output = Command::new("systemctl")
2317:             .args(["is-active", unit])
2318:             .output()
2319:             .map_err(|err| format!("execute systemctl is-active {unit} failed: {err}"))?;
2320:         let stdout = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).trim().to_string();
2321:         let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).trim().to_string();
2322:         last_state = if !stdout.is_empty() {
2323:             stdout
2324:         } else if !stderr.is_empty() {
2325:             stderr
2326:         } else {
2327:             "unknown".to_string()
2328:         };
2329:         if output.status.success() && last_state == "active" {
2330:             return Ok(());
2331:         }
2332:         if attempt < attempts {
2333:             sleep(Duration::from_millis(sleep_ms));
2334:         }
2335:     }
2336:     Err(format!(
2337:         "systemd unit {unit} failed to reach active state after {attempts} attempts (last_state={last_state})",
2338:     ))
2339: }

2341: fn ensure_managed_dns_control_plane_ready() -> Result<(), String> {
2342:     if !Path::new("/usr/bin/resolvectl").is_file() {
2343:         return Err(
2344:             "managed DNS routing requires /usr/bin/resolvectl; install and enable systemd-resolved before running install-systemd"
2345:                 .to_string(),
2346:         );
2347:     }
2348: 
2349:     if let Err(initial_err) = run_command_checked("resolvectl", &["status"]) {
2350:         run_command_checked("systemctl", &["reload", "dbus"])?;
2351:         run_command_checked("systemctl", &["restart", "systemd-resolved.service"])?;
2352:         if let Err(retry_err) = run_command_checked("resolvectl", &["status"]) {
2353:             return Err(format!(
2354:                 "managed DNS control plane is unhealthy after dbus reload and systemd-resolved restart: initial_check={initial_err}; retry_check={retry_err}"
2355:             ));
2356:         }
2357:     }
2358: 
2359:     Ok(())
2360: }

2362: fn run_command_stream(command: &str, args: &[&str]) -> Result<(), String> {

2377: fn run_systemctl_status_with_retry(
2378:     unit: &str,
2379:     attempts: usize,
2380:     sleep_ms: u64,
2381: ) -> Result<(), String> {
2382:     let status_args = ["--no-pager", "--full", "status", unit];
2383:     let command_text = format_command("systemctl", &status_args);
2384:     let mut last_state = "unknown".to_string();
2385:     let mut last_exit = "unknown".to_string();
2386:     for attempt in 1..=attempts {
2387:         let output = Command::new("systemctl")
2388:             .args(status_args)
2389:             .output()
2390:             .map_err(|err| format!("execute {command_text} failed: {err}"))?;
2391:         if !output.stdout.is_empty() {
2392:             print!("{}", String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout));
2393:         }
2394:         if !output.stderr.is_empty() {
2395:             eprint!("{}", String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr));
2396:         }
2397:         if output.status.success() {
2398:             return Ok(());
2399:         }
2400:         last_exit = format!("{}", output.status);
2401:         last_state = systemctl_unit_active_state(unit)?;
2402:         if attempt < attempts && systemctl_state_retryable(last_state.as_str()) {
2403:             sleep(Duration::from_millis(sleep_ms));
2404:             continue;
2405:         }
2406:         return Err(format!(
2407:             "command failed: {command_text} (exit={last_exit}, active_state={last_state}, attempt={attempt}/{attempts})"
2408:         ));
2409:     }
2410:     Err(format!(
2411:         "command failed: {command_text} (exit={last_exit}, active_state={last_state})"
2412:     ))
2413: }
2414: 
2415: fn systemctl_unit_active_state(unit: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
2416:     let output = Command::new("systemctl")
2417:         .args(["is-active", unit])
2418:         .output()
2419:         .map_err(|err| format!("execute systemctl is-active {unit} failed: {err}"))?;
2420:     let stdout = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).trim().to_string();
2421:     if !stdout.is_empty() {
2422:         return Ok(stdout);
2423:     }
2424:     let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).trim().to_string();
2425:     if !stderr.is_empty() {
2426:         return Ok(stderr);
2427:     }
2428:     Ok("unknown".to_string())
2429: }

2436:     let stdout = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).trim().to_string();
2437:     if !stdout.is_empty() {
2438:         return Ok(stdout);
2439:     }
2440:     let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).trim().to_string();
2441:     if !stderr.is_empty() {
2442:         return Ok(stderr);

2447: fn systemctl_state_retryable(state: &str) -> bool {
2448:     matches!(
2449:         state,
2450:         "activating" | "deactivating" | "reloading" | "inactive" | "unknown"
2451:     )
2452: }

2454: fn wait_for_unit_inactive(unit: &str, attempts: usize, sleep_ms: u64) -> Result<(), String> {
2455:     let mut last_state = "unknown".to_string();
2456:     for attempt in 1..=attempts {
2457:         last_state = systemctl_unit_active_state(unit)?;
2458:         if last_state == "inactive" {
2459:             return Ok(());
2460:         }
2461:         if attempt < attempts
2462:             && matches!(
2463:                 last_state.as_str(),
2464:                 "activating" | "deactivating" | "reloading" | "active" | "unknown"
2465:             )
2466:         {
2467:             sleep(Duration::from_millis(sleep_ms));
2468:             continue;
2469:         }
2470:         return Err(format!(
2471:             "systemd unit {unit} failed to reach inactive state after {attempts} attempts (last_state={last_state}, attempt={attempt}/{attempts})"
2472:         ));
2473:     }
2474:     Err(format!(
2475:         "systemd unit {unit} failed to reach inactive state after {attempts} attempts (last_state={last_state})"
2476:     ))
2477: }

2481:         return command.to_string();
2482:     }
2483:     format!("{} {}", command, args.join(" "))
2484: }

2486: #[cfg(test)]
2487: fn installer_unit_start_order(
2488:     trust_auto_refresh_enabled: bool,
2489:     assignment_auto_refresh_enabled: bool,
2490:     auto_tunnel_enforce_enabled: bool,
2491: ) -> Vec<&'static str> {
2492:     let mut order = vec!["restart rustynetd-privileged-helper.service"];
2493:     if assignment_auto_refresh_enabled {
2494:         order.push("start rustynetd-assignment-refresh.service (strict pre-daemon)");
2495:     }
2496:     if trust_auto_refresh_enabled {
2497:         order.push("start rustynetd-trust-refresh.service (strict pre-daemon)");
2498:     }
2499:     order.push("restart rustynetd.service");
2500:     order.push("wait rustynetd.service active");
2501:     if trust_auto_refresh_enabled || assignment_auto_refresh_enabled || auto_tunnel_enforce_enabled
2502:     {
2503:         order.push("run rustynet state refresh (strict)");
2504:     }
2505:     if auto_tunnel_enforce_enabled {
2506:         order.push("restart rustynetd-managed-dns.service");
2507:         order.push("wait rustynetd-managed-dns.service active");
2508:     }
2509:     if trust_auto_refresh_enabled {
2510:         order.push("restart rustynetd-trust-refresh.timer");
2511:     }
2512:     if assignment_auto_refresh_enabled {
2513:         order.push("restart rustynetd-assignment-refresh.timer");
2514:     }
2515:     order
2516: }

2526: fn validate_env_line(key: &str, value: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
2527:     if key.is_empty() {
2528:         return Err("environment key must not be empty".to_string());
2529:     }
2530:     if key.contains('\n') || key.contains('\r') || key.contains('\0') {
2531:         return Err(format!("environment key contains unsafe characters: {key}"));
2532:     }
2533:     if value.contains('\n') || value.contains('\r') || value.contains('\0') {
2534:         return Err(format!(
2535:             "environment value contains unsafe characters: {key}"
2536:         ));
2537:     }
2538:     Ok(())
2539: }

===== /crates/rustynet-cli/src/ops_live_lab_failure_digest.rs =====

   1: #![forbid(unsafe_code)]
   2: 
   3: use std::collections::HashSet;
   4: use std::fs;

   7: use crate::live_lab_results::{LiveLabWorkerResult, read_parallel_stage_results};
   8: use serde_json::json;
   9: 
  10: #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
  11: pub struct GenerateLiveLinuxLabFailureDigestConfig {
  12:     pub nodes_tsv: PathBuf,
  13:     pub stages_tsv: PathBuf,
  14:     pub report_dir: PathBuf,
  15:     pub run_id: String,
  16:     pub network_id: String,

  19:     pub output_md: PathBuf,

  21: 
  22: fn stage_text(stage_name: &str, status: &str) -> Option<&'static str> {
  23:     match (stage_name, status) {
  24:         ("preflight", "pass") => Some("local prerequisites are ready"),
  25:         ("preflight", "fail") => Some("local prerequisite validation failed"),
  26:         ("prepare_source_archive", "pass") => Some("deploy source archive prepared successfully"),
  27:         ("prepare_source_archive", "fail") => Some("deploy source archive preparation failed"),
  28:         ("prime_remote_access", "pass") => {
  29:             Some("all targeted nodes accepted remote SSH and sudo priming")
  30:         }
  31:         ("prime_remote_access", "fail") => {
  32:             Some("remote SSH or sudo priming failed on one or more targeted nodes")
  33:         }
  34:         ("cleanup_hosts", "pass") => {
  35:             Some("all targeted nodes cleaned prior RustyNet state successfully")
  36:         }
  37:         ("cleanup_hosts", "fail") => {
  38:             Some("prior RustyNet state cleanup failed on one or more targeted nodes")
  39:         }
  40:         ("bootstrap_hosts", "pass") => {
  41:             Some("all targeted nodes bootstrapped and compiled RustyNet successfully")
  42:         }
  43:         ("bootstrap_hosts", "fail") => {
  44:             Some("bootstrap or compile failed on one or more targeted nodes")
  45:         }
  46:         ("collect_pubkeys", "pass") => {
  47:             Some("all targeted nodes exported WireGuard public keys successfully")
  48:         }
  49:         ("collect_pubkeys", "fail") => {
  50:             Some("WireGuard public key collection failed on one or more targeted nodes")
  51:         }
  52:         ("membership_setup", "pass") => {
  53:             Some("primary exit applied signed membership updates successfully")
  54:         }
  55:         ("membership_setup", "fail") => Some("signed membership setup failed on the primary exit"),
  56:         ("distribute_membership_state", "pass") => {
  57:             Some("membership state distributed to all targeted peer nodes successfully")
  58:         }
  59:         ("distribute_membership_state", "fail") => {
  60:             Some("membership state distribution failed on one or more targeted peer nodes")
  61:         }
  62:         ("issue_and_distribute_assignments", "pass") => Some(
  63:             "signed assignments were issued and distributed to all targeted nodes successfully",
  64:         ),
  65:         ("issue_and_distribute_assignments", "fail") => {
  66:             Some("assignment issuance or distribution failed on one or more targeted nodes")
  67:         }
  68:         ("enforce_baseline_runtime", "pass") => {
  69:             Some("all targeted nodes enforced baseline runtime successfully")
  70:         }
  71:         ("enforce_baseline_runtime", "fail") => {
  72:             Some("baseline runtime enforcement failed on one or more targeted nodes")
  73:         }
  74:         ("validate_baseline_runtime", "pass") => {
  75:             Some("all targeted nodes connected to the network correctly under baseline validation")
  76:         }
  77:         ("validate_baseline_runtime", "fail") => {
  78:             Some("baseline network validation failed on one or more targeted nodes")
  79:         }
  80:         ("live_role_switch_matrix", "pass") => Some("controlled role-switch validation passed"),
  81:         ("live_role_switch_matrix", "fail") => Some("controlled role-switch validation failed"),
  82:         ("live_exit_handoff", "pass") => Some("live exit handoff validation passed"),
  83:         ("live_exit_handoff", "fail") => Some("live exit handoff validation failed"),
  84:         ("live_two_hop", "pass") => Some("live two-hop validation passed"),
  85:         ("live_two_hop", "fail") => Some("live two-hop validation failed"),
  86:         ("live_lan_toggle", "pass") => Some("LAN toggle and blind-exit validation passed"),
  87:         ("live_lan_toggle", "fail") => Some("LAN toggle or blind-exit validation failed"),
  88:         ("fresh_install_os_matrix_report", "pass") => {
  89:             Some("commit-bound fresh install OS matrix evidence was generated successfully")
  90:         }
  91:         ("fresh_install_os_matrix_report", "fail") => {
  92:             Some("fresh install OS matrix evidence generation failed")
  93:         }
  94:         ("local_full_gate_suite", "pass") => Some("local full gate suite passed"),
  95:         ("local_full_gate_suite", "fail") => Some("local full gate suite failed"),
  96:         ("extended_soak", "pass") => Some("extended soak and reboot recovery validation passed"),
  97:         ("extended_soak", "fail") => Some("extended soak or reboot recovery validation failed"),
  98:         _ => None,
  99:     }
 100: }

 102: fn reboot_check_reason_text(check: &str) -> Option<&'static str> {
 103:     match check {
 104:         "exit_reboot_returns" => Some("exit did not return on SSH after reboot"),
 105:         "exit_boot_id_changes" => Some("exit reboot was not proven by a new boot_id"),
 106:         "post_exit_reboot_twohop" => Some("two-hop validation failed after exit reboot"),
 107:         "client_reboot_returns" => Some("client did not return on SSH after reboot"),
 108:         "client_boot_id_changes" => Some("client reboot was not proven by a new boot_id"),
 109:         "post_client_reboot_twohop" => Some("two-hop validation failed after client reboot"),
 110:         "client_failure_salvage_twohop" => {
 111:             Some("salvage two-hop validation failed after the client reboot outage")
 112:         }
 113:         _ => None,
 114:     }
 115: }
 116: 
 117: fn resolve_path(path: &Path) -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
 118:     if path.is_absolute() {
 119:         return Ok(path.to_path_buf());
 120:     }
 121:     let cwd = std::env::current_dir()
 122:         .map_err(|err| format!("resolve current directory failed: {err}"))?;
 123:     Ok(cwd.join(path))
 124: }
 125: 
 126: fn read_tsv(path: &Path) -> Vec<Vec<String>> {
 127:     if !path.exists() {
 128:         return Vec::new();
 129:     }
 130:     let Ok(body) = fs::read_to_string(path) else {
 131:         return Vec::new();
 132:     };
 133:     body.lines()
 134:         .filter(|line| !line.is_empty())
 135:         .map(|line| {
 136:             line.split('\t')
 137:                 .map(ToString::to_string)
 138:                 .collect::<Vec<_>>()
 139:         })
 140:         .filter(|row| !row.is_empty())
 141:         .collect()
 142: }
 143: 
 144: fn strip_ansi_escape(line: &str) -> String {
 145:     let mut out = String::with_capacity(line.len());
 146:     let mut chars = line.chars().peekable();
 147:     while let Some(ch) = chars.next() {
 148:         if ch == '\u{1b}' {
 149:             if matches!(chars.peek(), Some('[')) {
 150:                 let _ = chars.next();
 151:                 for next in chars.by_ref() {
 152:                     if next.is_ascii_alphabetic() {
 153:                         break;
 154:                     }
 155:                 }
 156:                 continue;
 157:             }
 158:             continue;
 159:         }
 160:         out.push(ch);
 161:     }
 162:     out
 163: }
 164: 
 165: fn sanitize_line(line: &str) -> String {
 166:     strip_ansi_escape(line).trim().to_string()
 167: }
 168: 
 169: fn is_ignored_line(line: &str) -> bool {
 170:     if line.starts_with("[stage:")
 171:         && (line.contains("] START") || line.contains("] PASS") || line.contains("] FAIL"))
 172:     {
 173:         return true;
 174:     }
 175:     line.starts_with("[parallel:") || line.starts_with("----- ")
 176: }
 177: 
 178: fn shorten(text: &str, max_len: usize) -> String {
 179:     if text.len() <= max_len {
 180:         return text.to_string();
 181:     }
 182:     format!("{}...", text[..max_len.saturating_sub(3)].trim_end())
 183: }
 184: 
 185: fn matches_preferred_reason(line: &str) -> bool {
 186:     let lowered = line.to_ascii_lowercase();
 187:     lowered.contains("error:")
 188:         || lowered.contains("fail")
 189:         || lowered.contains("timed out")
 190:         || lowered.contains("timeout")
 191:         || lowered.contains("permission denied")
 192:         || (lowered.contains("auth") && lowered.contains("fail"))
 193:         || lowered.contains("missing")
 194:         || lowered.contains("invalid")
 195:         || lowered.contains("mismatch")
 196:         || lowered.contains("does not exist")
 197:         || lowered.contains("no such")
 198:         || lowered.contains("unreachable")
 199: }
 200: 
 201: fn extract_likely_reason(log_path: &Path) -> String {
 202:     if !log_path.exists() {
 203:         return "log file missing".to_string();
 204:     }
 205:     let lines = match fs::read_to_string(log_path) {
 206:         Ok(body) => body.lines().map(ToString::to_string).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
 207:         Err(_) => return "log file unreadable".to_string(),
 208:     };
 209:     let mut candidates = Vec::new();
 210:     for raw_line in lines {
 211:         let line = sanitize_line(raw_line.as_str());
 212:         if line.is_empty() || is_ignored_line(line.as_str()) {
 213:             continue;
 214:         }
 215:         candidates.push(line);
 216:     }
 217:     if candidates.is_empty() {
 218:         return "see full log".to_string();
 219:     }
 220:     for line in candidates.iter().rev() {
 221:         if matches_preferred_reason(line.as_str()) {
 222:             return shorten(line.as_str(), 220);
 223:         }
 224:     }
 225:     shorten(
 226:         candidates
 227:             .last()
 228:             .map(String::as_str)
 229:             .unwrap_or("see full log"),
 230:         220,
 231:     )
 232: }
 233: 
 234: fn extract_extended_soak_reason(report_dir: &Path) -> Option<String> {
 235:     let report_path = report_dir.join("live_linux_reboot_recovery_report.json");
 236:     if !report_path.exists() {
 237:         return None;
 238:     }
 239:     let payload: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(
 240:         fs::read_to_string(&report_path)
 241:             .ok()
 242:             .as_deref()
 243:             .unwrap_or_default(),
 244:     )
 245:     .ok()?;
 246: 
 247:     if let Some(failure_reasons) = payload.get("failure_reasons").and_then(|v| v.as_array()) {
 248:         let cleaned = failure_reasons
 249:             .iter()
 250:             .filter_map(|item| item.as_str().map(str::trim))
 251:             .filter(|item| !item.is_empty())
 252:             .map(ToString::to_string)
 253:             .collect::<Vec<_>>();
 254:         if !cleaned.is_empty() {
 255:             return Some(shorten(cleaned.join("; ").as_str(), 220));
 256:         }
 257:     }
 258: 
 259:     let mut reasons = Vec::new();
 260:     if let Some(checks) = payload.get("checks").and_then(|v| v.as_object()) {
 261:         for (name, value) in checks {
 262:             if value.as_str() == Some("fail")
 263:                 && let Some(reason) = reboot_check_reason_text(name.as_str())
 264:             {
 265:                 reasons.push(reason.to_string());
 266:             }
 267:         }
 268:     }
 269: 
 270:     if let Some(observations) = payload.get("observations").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
 271:         for line in observations
 272:             .lines()
 273:             .map(str::trim)
 274:             .filter(|line| !line.is_empty())
 275:         {
 276:             match line {
 277:                 "client_reboot_wait=fail" => {
 278:                     reasons.push("client reboot wait timed out".to_string())
 279:                 }
 280:                 "exit_reboot_wait=fail" => reasons.push("exit reboot wait timed out".to_string()),
 281:                 "exit_post=" => {
 282:                     reasons.push("exit post-reboot boot_id capture was empty".to_string())
 283:                 }
 284:                 "client_post=" => {
 285:                     reasons.push("client post-reboot boot_id capture was empty".to_string())
 286:                 }
 287:                 _ if line.starts_with("ssh_port22_hosts=") => reasons.push(line.to_string()),
 288:                 _ => {}
 289:             }
 290:         }
 291:     }
 292: 
 293:     if reasons.is_empty() {
 294:         return None;
 295:     }
 296:     let mut deduped = Vec::new();
 297:     let mut seen = HashSet::new();
 298:     for reason in reasons {
 299:         if seen.insert(reason.clone()) {
 300:             deduped.push(reason);
 301:         }
 302:     }
 303:     Some(shorten(deduped.join("; ").as_str(), 220))
 304: }
 305: 
 306: fn extract_stage_reason(stage_name: &str, report_dir: &Path, log_path: &Path) -> String {
 307:     if stage_name == "extended_soak"
 308:         && let Some(reason) = extract_extended_soak_reason(report_dir)
 309:     {
 310:         return reason;
 311:     }
 312:     extract_likely_reason(log_path)
 313: }
 314: 
 315: fn worker_likely_reason(worker: &LiveLabWorkerResult) -> String {
 316:     if !worker.primary_failure_reason.trim().is_empty() {
 317:         return worker.primary_failure_reason.clone();
 318:     }
 319:     extract_likely_reason(Path::new(worker.log_path.as_str()))
 320: }
 321: 
 322: fn stage_sentence(
 323:     stage_name: &str,
 324:     status: &str,
 325:     worker_results: &[LiveLabWorkerResult],
 326: ) -> String {
 327:     if status == "pass" {
 328:         return stage_text(stage_name, "pass")
 329:             .unwrap_or("stage passed")
 330:             .to_string();
 331:     }
 332:     if status == "skipped" {
 333:         return "stage skipped".to_string();
 334:     }
 335:     if !worker_results.is_empty() {
 336:         let total = worker_results.len();
 337:         let failed = worker_results.iter().filter(|item| item.rc != 0).count();
 338:         let base = stage_text(stage_name, "fail").unwrap_or("stage failed");
 339:         return format!("{base} ({failed}/{total} targeted nodes failed)");
 340:     }
 341:     stage_text(stage_name, "fail")
 342:         .unwrap_or("stage failed")
 343:         .to_string()
 344: }
 345: 
 346: pub fn execute_ops_generate_live_linux_lab_failure_digest(
 347:     config: GenerateLiveLinuxLabFailureDigestConfig,
 348: ) -> Result<String, String> {
 349:     let report_dir = resolve_path(config.report_dir.as_path())?;
 350:     let nodes_tsv = resolve_path(config.nodes_tsv.as_path())?;
 351:     let stages_tsv = resolve_path(config.stages_tsv.as_path())?;
 352:     let output_json = resolve_path(config.output_json.as_path())?;
 353:     let output_md = resolve_path(config.output_md.as_path())?;
 354: 
 355:     let nodes = read_tsv(nodes_tsv.as_path())
 356:         .into_iter()
 357:         .filter(|row| row.len() == 4)
 358:         .map(|row| {
 359:             json!({
 360:                 "label": row[0],
 361:                 "target": row[1],
 362:                 "node_id": row[2],
 363:                 "bootstrap_role": row[3],
 364:             })
 365:         })
 366:         .collect::<Vec<_>>();
 367: 
 368:     let mut stages = Vec::new();
 369:     let mut failed_stages = Vec::new();
 370:     for row in read_tsv(stages_tsv.as_path()) {
 371:         if row.len() != 8 {
 372:             continue;
 373:         }
 374:         let stage_name = row[0].clone();
 375:         let severity = row[1].clone();
 376:         let status = row[2].clone();
 377:         let rc = row[3].parse::<i64>().unwrap_or(1);
 378:         let log_path = row[4].clone();
 379:         let message = row[5].clone();
 380:         let started_at = row[6].clone();
 381:         let finished_at = row[7].clone();
 382:         let worker_results = read_parallel_stage_results(report_dir.as_path(), stage_name.as_str());
 383:         let failed_workers = worker_results
 384:             .iter()
 385:             .filter(|item| item.rc != 0)
 386:             .map(|item| {
 387:                 json!({
 388:                     "label": item.label,
 389:                     "target": item.target,
 390:                     "node_id": item.node_id,
 391:                     "role": item.role,
 392:                     "rc": item.rc,
 393:                     "started_at": item.started_at,
 394:                     "finished_at": item.finished_at,
 395:                     "log_path": item.log_path,
 396:                     "snapshot_path": item.snapshot_path,
 397:                     "route_policy_path": item.route_policy_path,
 398:                     "dns_state_path": item.dns_state_path,
 399:                     "primary_failure_reason": item.primary_failure_reason,
 400:                     "likely_reason": worker_likely_reason(item),
 401:                 })
 402:             })
 403:             .collect::<Vec<_>>();
 404:         let mut likely_reason = extract_stage_reason(
 405:             stage_name.as_str(),
 406:             report_dir.as_path(),
 407:             Path::new(log_path.as_str()),
 408:         );
 409:         if let Some(first_failed) = worker_results.iter().find(|item| item.rc != 0) {
 410:             likely_reason = worker_likely_reason(first_failed);
 411:         }
 412:         let condensed_result =
 413:             stage_sentence(stage_name.as_str(), status.as_str(), &worker_results);
 414:         let stage_entry = json!({
 415:             "stage": stage_name,
 416:             "severity": severity,
 417:             "status": status,
 418:             "rc": rc,
 419:             "description": message,
 420:             "started_at": started_at,
 421:             "finished_at": finished_at,
 422:             "log_path": log_path,
 423:             "condensed_result": condensed_result,
 424:             "primary_failure_reason": likely_reason,
 425:             "likely_reason": likely_reason,
 426:             "failed_workers": failed_workers,
 427:         });
 428:         if stage_entry.get("status").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) == Some("fail") {
 429:             failed_stages.push(stage_entry.clone());
 430:         }
 431:         stages.push(stage_entry);
 432:     }
 433: 
 434:     let first_failure = failed_stages
 435:         .first()
 436:         .cloned()
 437:         .unwrap_or(serde_json::Value::Null);
 438:     let digest = json!({
 439:         "schema_version": 1,
 440:         "run_id": config.run_id,
 441:         "network_id": config.network_id,
 442:         "report_dir": report_dir.display().to_string(),
 443:         "overall_status": config.overall_status,
 444:         "node_count": nodes.len(),
 445:         "nodes": nodes,
 446:         "stages": stages,
 447:         "failed_stage_count": failed_stages.len(),
 448:         "first_failure": first_failure,
 449:     });
 450: 
 451:     let mut lines = vec![
 452:         format!(
 453:             "# Live Linux Lab Failure Digest ({})",
 454:             digest
 455:                 .get("run_id")
 456:                 .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
 457:                 .unwrap_or("unknown")
 458:         ),
 459:         String::new(),
 460:         format!(
 461:             "- overall_status: `{}`",
 462:             digest
 463:                 .get("overall_status")
 464:                 .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
 465:                 .unwrap_or("unknown")
 466:         ),
 467:         format!(
 468:             "- report_dir: `{}`",
 469:             digest
 470:                 .get("report_dir")
 471:                 .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
 472:                 .unwrap_or("unknown")
 473:         ),
 474:         format!("- node_count: `{}`", nodes.len()),
 475:         String::new(),
 476:         "## Condensed Checks".to_string(),
 477:         String::new(),
 478:     ];
 479: 
 480:     if digest
 481:         .get("stages")
 482:         .and_then(|v| v.as_array())
 483:         .is_none_or(|stages| stages.is_empty())
 484:     {
 485:         lines.push("- no stage results recorded yet".to_string());
 486:     } else if let Some(stages_array) = digest.get("stages").and_then(|v| v.as_array()) {
 487:         for stage in stages_array {
 488:             lines.push(format!(
 489:                 "- `{}` `{}`: {}",
 490:                 stage
 491:                     .get("status")
 492:                     .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
 493:                     .unwrap_or("unknown")
 494:                     .to_ascii_uppercase(),
 495:                 stage
 496:                     .get("stage")
 497:                     .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
 498:                     .unwrap_or("unknown"),
 499:                 stage
 500:                     .get("condensed_result")
 501:                     .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
 502:                     .unwrap_or("stage result unavailable"),
 503:             ));
 504:         }
 505:     }
 506: 
 507:     lines.extend([
 508:         "".to_string(),
 509:         "## Failure Focus".to_string(),
 510:         "".to_string(),
 511:     ]);
 512:     if first_failure.is_null() {
 513:         lines.push("- no failed stage recorded".to_string());
 514:     } else {
 515:         lines.push(format!(
 516:             "- first_failed_stage: `{}`",
 517:             first_failure
 518:                 .get("stage")
 519:                 .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
 520:                 .unwrap_or("unknown")
 521:         ));
 522:         lines.push(format!(
 523:             "- severity: `{}`",
 524:             first_failure
 525:                 .get("severity")
 526:                 .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
 527:                 .unwrap_or("unknown")
 528:         ));
 529:         lines.push(format!(
 530:             "- rc: `{}`",
 531:             first_failure
 532:                 .get("rc")
 533:                 .and_then(|v| v.as_i64())
 534:                 .unwrap_or(1)
 535:         ));
 536:         lines.push(format!(
 537:             "- likely_reason: {}",
 538:             first_failure
 539:                 .get("likely_reason")
 540:                 .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
 541:                 .unwrap_or("unknown")
 542:         ));
 543:         lines.push(format!(
 544:             "- full_log: `{}`",
 545:             first_failure
 546:                 .get("log_path")
 547:                 .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
 548:                 .unwrap_or("unknown")
 549:         ));
 550:         if let Some(failed_workers) = first_failure
 551:             .get("failed_workers")
 552:             .and_then(|v| v.as_array())
 553:             .filter(|items| !items.is_empty())
 554:         {
 555:             lines.extend([String::new(), "### Failed Nodes".to_string(), String::new()]);
 556:             for worker in failed_workers {
 557:                 lines.push(format!(
 558:                     "- `{}` `{}` (`{}`): rc={} reason={} log=`{}` snapshot=`{}`",
 559:                     worker
 560:                         .get("label")
 561:                         .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
 562:                         .unwrap_or("unknown"),
 563:                     worker
 564:                         .get("target")
 565:                         .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
 566:                         .unwrap_or("unknown"),
 567:                     worker
 568:                         .get("node_id")
 569:                         .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
 570:                         .unwrap_or("unknown"),
 571:                     worker.get("rc").and_then(|v| v.as_i64()).unwrap_or(1),
 572:                     worker
 573:                         .get("likely_reason")
 574:                         .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
 575:                         .unwrap_or("unknown"),
 576:                     worker
 577:                         .get("log_path")
 578:                         .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
 579:                         .unwrap_or("unknown"),
 580:                     worker
 581:                         .get("snapshot_path")
 582:                         .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
 583:                         .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
 584:                         .unwrap_or("n/a"),
 585:                 ));
 586:             }
 587:         }
 588:     }
 589: 
 590:     if let Some(parent) = output_json.parent() {
 591:         fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|err| {
 592:             format!(
 593:                 "create output directory failed ({}): {err}",
 594:                 parent.display()
 595:             )
 596:         })?;
 597:     }
 598:     if let Some(parent) = output_md.parent() {
 599:         fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|err| {
 600:             format!(
 601:                 "create output directory failed ({}): {err}",
 602:                 parent.display()
 603:             )
 604:         })?;
 605:     }
 606:     fs::write(
 607:         &output_json,
 608:         serde_json::to_string_pretty(&digest)
 609:             .map_err(|err| format!("serialize digest failed: {err}"))?
 610:             + "\n",
 611:     )
 612:     .map_err(|err| {
 613:         format!(
 614:             "write digest json failed ({}): {err}",
 615:             output_json.display()
 616:         )
 617:     })?;
 618:     fs::write(&output_md, lines.join("\n") + "\n").map_err(|err| {
 619:         format!(
 620:             "write digest markdown failed ({}): {err}",
 621:             output_md.display()
 622:         )
 623:     })?;
 624: 
 625:     Ok(format!(
 626:         "live lab failure digest generated: json={} md={}",
 627:         output_json.display(),
 628:         output_md.display()
 629:     ))
 630: }

 302: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
 303: enum FileModePolicy {
 304:     OwnerOnly,
 305:     NoGroupWorldWrite,
 306: }

 314: fn parse_file_mode_policy(raw: &str) -> Result<FileModePolicy, String> {
 315:     match raw.trim() {
 316:         "owner-only" => Ok(FileModePolicy::OwnerOnly),
 317:         "no-group-world-write" => Ok(FileModePolicy::NoGroupWorldWrite),
 318:         other => Err(format!(
 319:             "invalid --policy {other:?}; expected owner-only or no-group-world-write"
 320:         )),
 321:     }
 322: }
 323: 
 324: fn resolve_path(path: &Path) -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
 325:     if path.is_absolute() {
 326:         return Ok(path.to_path_buf());
 327:     }
 328:     let cwd = std::env::current_dir()
 329:         .map_err(|err| format!("resolve current directory failed: {err}"))?;
 330:     Ok(cwd.join(path))
 331: }
 332: 
 333: fn read_tsv_rows(path: &Path) -> Result<Vec<Vec<String>>, String> {
 334:     let body = fs::read_to_string(path)
 335:         .map_err(|err| format!("read tsv failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
 336:     Ok(body
 337:         .lines()
 338:         .filter(|line| !line.trim().is_empty())
 339:         .map(|line| {
 340:             line.split('\t')
 341:                 .map(ToString::to_string)
 342:                 .collect::<Vec<_>>()
 343:         })
 344:         .collect::<Vec<_>>())
 345: }
 346: 
 347: fn ensure_parent_dir(path: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
 348:     if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
 349:         fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|err| {
 350:             format!(
 351:                 "create output directory failed ({}): {err}",
 352:                 parent.display()
 353:             )
 354:         })?;
 355:     }
 356:     Ok(())
 357: }
 358: 
 359: fn write_json_pretty(path: &Path, payload: &Value) -> Result<(), String> {
 360:     ensure_parent_dir(path)?;
 361:     let body = serde_json::to_string_pretty(payload)
 362:         .map_err(|err| format!("serialize JSON failed: {err}"))?;
 363:     fs::write(path, format!("{body}\n"))
 364:         .map_err(|err| format!("write JSON failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))
 365: }
 366: 
 367: fn absolute_path_string(path: &Path) -> Result<String, String> {
 368:     Ok(resolve_path(path)?.display().to_string())
 369: }
 370: 
 371: fn is_word_boundary(ch: Option<char>) -> bool {
 372:     match ch {
 373:         None => true,
 374:         Some(value) => !(value.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || value == '_'),
 375:     }
 376: }
 377: 
 378: fn redact_first_keyword_value(line: &str, keyword: &str) -> Option<String> {
 379:     let lowered = line.to_ascii_lowercase();
 380:     let keyword_len = keyword.len();
 381:     let mut search_from = 0usize;
 382:     while search_from + keyword_len <= lowered.len() {
 383:         let offset = lowered[search_from..].find(keyword)?;
 384:         let start = search_from + offset;
 385:         let end = start + keyword_len;
 386:         let before = line[..start].chars().next_back();
 387:         let after = line[end..].chars().next();
 388:         if !is_word_boundary(before) || !is_word_boundary(after) {
 389:             search_from = end;
 390:             continue;
 391:         }
 392:         let bytes = line.as_bytes();
 393:         let mut sep_index = end;
 394:         while sep_index < bytes.len() && bytes[sep_index].is_ascii_whitespace() {
 395:             sep_index += 1;
 396:         }
 397:         if sep_index >= bytes.len() || !matches!(bytes[sep_index], b':' | b'=') {
 398:             search_from = end;
 399:             continue;
 400:         }
 401:         let mut value_start = sep_index + 1;
 402:         while value_start < bytes.len() && bytes[value_start].is_ascii_whitespace() {
 403:             value_start += 1;
 404:         }
 405:         if value_start >= bytes.len() {
 406:             return None;
 407:         }
 408:         let mut value_end = value_start;
 409:         while value_end < bytes.len() && !bytes[value_end].is_ascii_whitespace() {
 410:             value_end += 1;
 411:         }
 412:         let mut out = String::with_capacity(line.len());
 413:         out.push_str(&line[..value_start]);
 414:         out.push_str("<redacted>");
 415:         out.push_str(&line[value_end..]);
 416:         return Some(out);
 417:     }
 418:     None
 419: }
 420: 
 421: fn redact_forensics_line(line: &str) -> String {
 422:     let upper = line.to_ascii_uppercase();
 423:     if upper.contains("PRIVATE KEY-----")
 424:         || (upper.contains("BEGIN ") && upper.contains("PRIVATE KEY"))
 425:     {
 426:         return "[REDACTED sensitive key material]".to_string();
 427:     }
 428:     let mut out = line.to_string();
 429:     for keyword in ["passphrase", "password", "secret", "token"] {
 430:         if let Some(updated) = redact_first_keyword_value(out.as_str(), keyword) {
 431:             out = updated;
 432:         }
 433:     }
 434:     out
 435: }
 436: 
 437: fn redact_forensics_payload(input: &str) -> String {
 438:     let mut lines = input
 439:         .lines()
 440:         .map(redact_forensics_line)
 441:         .collect::<Vec<String>>();
 442:     if lines.is_empty() {
 443:         return String::new();
 444:     }
 445:     let mut body = lines.join("\n");
 446:     if input.ends_with('\n') {
 447:         body.push('\n');
 448:     }
 449:     lines.clear();
 450:     body
 451: }
 452: 
 453: fn parse_network_prefix(prefix: &str) -> Result<[u8; 3], String> {
 454:     let parts = prefix.trim().split('.').map(str::trim).collect::<Vec<_>>();
 455:     if parts.len() != 3 {
 456:         return Err(format!(
 457:             "invalid --network-prefix {prefix:?}; expected a.b.c"
 458:         ));
 459:     }
 460:     let mut octets = [0u8; 3];
 461:     for (index, part) in parts.iter().enumerate() {
 462:         octets[index] = part
 463:             .parse::<u8>()
 464:             .map_err(|err| format!("invalid --network-prefix {prefix:?}: {err}"))?;
 465:     }
 466:     Ok(octets)
 467: }

 469: fn reboot_reason_for_check(check: &str) -> Option<&'static str> {
 470:     match check {
 471:         "exit_reboot_returns" => Some("exit did not return on SSH after reboot"),
 472:         "exit_boot_id_changes" => Some("exit reboot was not proven by a new boot_id"),
 473:         "post_exit_reboot_managed_dns_refresh" => {
 474:             Some("managed DNS refresh failed after exit reboot")
 475:         }
 476:         "post_exit_reboot_twohop" => Some("two-hop validation failed after exit reboot"),
 477:         "client_reboot_returns" => Some("client did not return on SSH after reboot"),
 478:         "client_boot_id_changes" => Some("client reboot was not proven by a new boot_id"),
 479:         "post_client_reboot_managed_dns_refresh" => {
 480:             Some("managed DNS refresh failed after client reboot")
 481:         }
 482:         "post_client_reboot_twohop" => Some("two-hop validation failed after client reboot"),
 483:         "client_failure_salvage_twohop" => {
 484:             Some("salvage two-hop validation failed after the client reboot outage")
 485:         }
 486:         _ => None,
 487:     }
 488: }

 490: fn unix_now() -> u64 {
 491:     SystemTime::now()
 492:         .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
 493:         .unwrap_or_default()
 494:         .as_secs()
 495: }
 496: 
 497: fn collected_at_utc_now() -> String {
 498:     Command::new("date")
 499:         .arg("-u")
 500:         .arg("+%FT%TZ")
 501:         .output()
 502:         .ok()
 503:         .filter(|output| output.status.success())
 504:         .and_then(|output| String::from_utf8(output.stdout).ok())
 505:         .map(|text| text.trim().to_string())
 506:         .filter(|text| !text.is_empty())
 507:         .unwrap_or_else(|| format!("unix:{}", unix_now()))
 508: }
