 510: fn sha256_hex_for_file(path: &Path) -> Result<String, String> {
 511:     let bytes =
 512:         fs::read(path).map_err(|err| format!("read file failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
 513:     let digest = Sha256::digest(bytes.as_slice());
 514:     Ok(format!("{digest:x}"))
 515: }
 516: 
 517: fn walk_stage_files_recursive(
 518:     root: &Path,
 519:     current: &Path,
 520:     excluded_output: Option<&Path>,
 521:     files: &mut Vec<PathBuf>,
 522: ) -> Result<(), String> {
 523:     let mut entries = fs::read_dir(current)
 524:         .map_err(|err| format!("read directory failed ({}): {err}", current.display()))?
 525:         .filter_map(Result::ok)
 526:         .collect::<Vec<_>>();
 527:     entries.sort_by_key(|entry| entry.file_name());
 528:     for entry in entries {
 529:         let path = entry.path();
 530:         let resolved = resolve_path(path.as_path())?;
 531:         if excluded_output == Some(resolved.as_path()) {
 532:             continue;
 533:         }
 534:         let file_type = entry
 535:             .file_type()
 536:             .map_err(|err| format!("read file type failed ({}): {err}", entry.path().display()))?;
 537:         if file_type.is_dir() {
 538:             walk_stage_files_recursive(root, resolved.as_path(), excluded_output, files)?;
 539:             continue;
 540:         }
 541:         if file_type.is_file() {
 542:             if !resolved.starts_with(root) {
 543:                 return Err(format!(
 544:                     "stage artifact escaped stage root: {} not under {}",
 545:                     resolved.display(),
 546:                     root.display()
 547:                 ));
 548:             }
 549:             files.push(resolved);
 550:             continue;
 551:         }
 552:         if file_type.is_symlink() {
 553:             return Err(format!(
 554:                 "stage artifact must not be a symlink: {}",
 555:                 resolved.display()
 556:             ));
 557:         }
 558:         return Err(format!(
 559:             "unsupported stage artifact type: {}",
 560:             resolved.display()
 561:         ));
 562:     }
 563:     Ok(())
 564: }

 585: fn parse_pass_fail(value: &str, label: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
 586:     let normalized = value.trim();
 587:     if normalized == CHECK_PASS || normalized == CHECK_FAIL {
 588:         Ok(normalized.to_string())
 589:     } else {
 590:         Err(format!("{label} must be pass or fail (got: {value:?})"))
 591:     }
 592: }
 593: 
 594: fn parse_pass_fail_skip(value: &str, label: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
 595:     let normalized = value.trim();
 596:     if normalized == CHECK_PASS || normalized == CHECK_FAIL || normalized == CHECK_SKIPPED {
 597:         Ok(normalized.to_string())
 598:     } else {
 599:         Err(format!(
 600:             "{label} must be pass, fail, or skipped (got: {value:?})"
 601:         ))
 602:     }
 603: }
 604: 
 605: fn decode_tcpdump_lines(path: &Path) -> Result<Vec<String>, String> {
 606:     let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(path)
 607:         .map_err(|err| format!("stat pcap failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
 608:     if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
 609:         return Err(format!(
 610:             "pcap path must not be a symlink: {}",
 611:             path.display()
 612:         ));
 613:     }
 614:     if !metadata.file_type().is_file() {
 615:         return Err(format!(
 616:             "pcap path must be a regular file: {}",
 617:             path.display()
 618:         ));
 619:     }
 620:     let output = Command::new("tcpdump")
 621:         .arg("-nn")
 622:         .arg("-r")
 623:         .arg(path)
 624:         .output()
 625:         .map_err(|err| format!("tcpdump decode failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
 626:     if !output.status.success() && output.status.code() != Some(1) {
 627:         let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr);
 628:         return Err(format!(
 629:             "tcpdump decode failed ({}): {}",
 630:             path.display(),
 631:             stderr.trim()
 632:         ));
 633:     }
 634:     let stdout = String::from_utf8(output.stdout)
 635:         .map_err(|err| format!("decode tcpdump output failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
 636:     Ok(stdout.lines().map(ToString::to_string).collect())
 637: }

 639: fn count_no_leak_tunnel_packets(lines: &[String]) -> u64 {
 640:     lines
 641:         .iter()
 642:         .filter(|line| {
 643:             line.contains("IP 172.16.10.2.") && line.contains(" > 172.16.10.1.51820: UDP")
 644:         })
 645:         .count() as u64

 651:         .filter(|line| line.contains("IP 172.16.10.2") && line.contains(" > 198.18.0.1"))

 655: fn validate_dns_qname(raw: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
 656:     let qname = raw.trim().trim_end_matches('.').to_string();
 657:     if qname.is_empty() {
 658:         return Err("qname must not be empty".to_string());
 659:     }
 660:     if qname.len() > 253 {
 661:         return Err("qname exceeds maximum DNS length".to_string());
 662:     }
 663:     for label in qname.split('.') {
 664:         if label.is_empty() || label.len() > 63 {
 665:             return Err(format!("invalid DNS label length in qname: {label:?}"));
 666:         }
 667:         if !label.bytes().all(|byte| {
 668:             matches!(
 669:                 byte,
 670:                 b'a'..=b'z' | b'A'..=b'Z' | b'0'..=b'9' | b'-' | b'_'
 671:             )
 672:         }) {
 673:             return Err(format!("invalid DNS label in qname: {label:?}"));
 674:         }
 675:     }
 676:     Ok(qname)
 677: }
 678: 
 679: fn build_dns_query_packet(qname: &str) -> Vec<u8> {
 680:     let mut packet = Vec::with_capacity(128);
 681:     packet.extend_from_slice(&0x1337u16.to_be_bytes());
 682:     packet.extend_from_slice(&0x0100u16.to_be_bytes());
 683:     packet.extend_from_slice(&1u16.to_be_bytes());
 684:     packet.extend_from_slice(&0u16.to_be_bytes());
 685:     packet.extend_from_slice(&0u16.to_be_bytes());
 686:     packet.extend_from_slice(&0u16.to_be_bytes());
 687:     for label in qname.split('.') {
 688:         packet.push(label.len() as u8);
 689:         packet.extend_from_slice(label.as_bytes());
 690:     }
 691:     packet.push(0);
 692:     packet.extend_from_slice(&1u16.to_be_bytes());
 693:     packet.extend_from_slice(&1u16.to_be_bytes());
 694:     packet
 695: }
 696: 
 697: fn skip_dns_name(packet: &[u8], mut offset: usize) -> Result<usize, String> {
 698:     let mut labels_seen = 0usize;
 699:     loop {
 700:         if offset >= packet.len() {
 701:             return Err("dns response truncated while reading name".to_string());
 702:         }
 703:         let len = packet[offset];
 704:         if len & 0b1100_0000 == 0b1100_0000 {
 705:             if offset + 1 >= packet.len() {
 706:                 return Err("dns response truncated while reading compression pointer".to_string());
 707:             }
 708:             return Ok(offset + 2);
 709:         }
 710:         if len == 0 {
 711:             return Ok(offset + 1);
 712:         }
 713:         if len & 0b1100_0000 != 0 {
 714:             return Err("dns response contains invalid label encoding".to_string());
 715:         }
 716:         let label_len = len as usize;
 717:         if label_len > 63 {
 718:             return Err("dns response contains oversized label".to_string());
 719:         }
 720:         offset += 1;
 721:         if offset + label_len > packet.len() {
 722:             return Err("dns response truncated while reading label bytes".to_string());
 723:         }
 724:         offset += label_len;
 725:         labels_seen += 1;
 726:         if labels_seen > 128 {
 727:             return Err("dns response name parse exceeded label limit".to_string());
 728:         }
 729:     }
 730: }
 731: 
 732: fn decode_first_dns_answer(
 733:     response: &[u8],
 734:     rcode: i64,
 735:     answer_count: u64,
 736: ) -> Result<(i64, u64, String, u64), String> {
 737:     if response.len() < 12 {
 738:         return Err("dns response header is too short".to_string());
 739:     }
 740:     let mut offset = 12usize;
 741:     offset = skip_dns_name(response, offset)?;
 742:     if offset + 4 > response.len() {
 743:         return Err("dns response truncated in question tail".to_string());
 744:     }
 745:     offset += 4;
 746: 
 747:     let mut answer_ip = String::new();
 748:     let mut answer_ttl = 0u64;
 749:     if answer_count > 0 {
 750:         offset = skip_dns_name(response, offset)?;
 751:         if offset + 10 > response.len() {
 752:             return Err("dns response truncated in answer header".to_string());
 753:         }
 754:         let rr_type = u16::from_be_bytes([response[offset], response[offset + 1]]);
 755:         let rr_class = u16::from_be_bytes([response[offset + 2], response[offset + 3]]);
 756:         let ttl = u32::from_be_bytes([
 757:             response[offset + 4],
 758:             response[offset + 5],
 759:             response[offset + 6],
 760:             response[offset + 7],
 761:         ]);
 762:         let rdlen = u16::from_be_bytes([response[offset + 8], response[offset + 9]]) as usize;
 763:         offset += 10;
 764:         if offset + rdlen > response.len() {
 765:             return Err("dns response truncated in answer payload".to_string());
 766:         }
 767:         if rr_type == 1 && rr_class == 1 && rdlen == 4 {
 768:             let addr = Ipv4Addr::new(
 769:                 response[offset],
 770:                 response[offset + 1],
 771:                 response[offset + 2],
 772:                 response[offset + 3],
 773:             );
 774:             answer_ip = addr.to_string();
 775:             answer_ttl = ttl as u64;
 776:         }
 777:     }
 778:     Ok((rcode, answer_count, answer_ip, answer_ttl))
 779: }
 780: 
 781: fn is_plaintext_no_leak_report(payload: &Map<String, Value>) -> Result<(), String> {
 782:     if payload.get("status").and_then(Value::as_str) != Some(CHECK_PASS) {
 783:         return Err("no-leak dataplane report status must be pass".to_string());
 784:     }
 785:     let checks = payload
 786:         .get("checks")
 787:         .and_then(Value::as_object)
 788:         .ok_or_else(|| "no-leak dataplane report must contain non-empty checks".to_string())?;
 789:     if checks.is_empty() {
 790:         return Err("no-leak dataplane report must contain non-empty checks".to_string());
 791:     }
 792:     let failed = checks
 793:         .iter()
 794:         .filter_map(|(key, value)| {
 795:             if value.as_str() == Some(CHECK_PASS) {
 796:                 None
 797:             } else {
 798:                 Some(key.clone())
 799:             }
 800:         })
 801:         .collect::<Vec<_>>();
 802:     if failed.is_empty() {
 803:         Ok(())
 804:     } else {
 805:         Err(format!(
 806:             "no-leak dataplane checks failed: {}",
 807:             failed.join(", ")
 808:         ))
 809:     }
 810: }

 812: fn read_json_object_or_empty(path: &Path) -> Result<Map<String, Value>, String> {
 813:     if !path.exists() {
 814:         return Ok(Map::new());
 815:     }
 816:     let body = fs::read_to_string(path)
 817:         .map_err(|err| format!("read JSON failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
 818:     if body.trim().is_empty() {
 819:         return Ok(Map::new());
 820:     }
 821:     let parsed: Value = serde_json::from_str(body.as_str())
 822:         .map_err(|err| format!("parse JSON failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
 823:     let object = parsed
 824:         .as_object()
 825:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("JSON root must be an object ({})", path.display()))?;
 826:     Ok(object.clone())
 827: }
 828: 
 829: fn parse_cidr(value: &str) -> Result<ParsedCidr, String> {
 830:     let trimmed = value.trim();
 831:     let (ip_raw, prefix_raw) = trimmed
 832:         .split_once('/')
 833:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("invalid CIDR {trimmed:?}"))?;
 834:     let ip = ip_raw
 835:         .parse::<IpAddr>()
 836:         .map_err(|err| format!("invalid CIDR IP {ip_raw:?}: {err}"))?;
 837:     let prefix = prefix_raw
 838:         .parse::<u8>()
 839:         .map_err(|err| format!("invalid CIDR prefix {prefix_raw:?}: {err}"))?;
 840:     match ip {
 841:         IpAddr::V4(ipv4) => {
 842:             if prefix > 32 {
 843:                 return Err(format!("invalid IPv4 CIDR prefix: {prefix}"));
 844:             }
 845:             let mask = if prefix == 0 {
 846:                 0u32
 847:             } else {
 848:                 u32::MAX << (32 - prefix)
 849:             };
 850:             let network = u32::from(ipv4) & mask;
 851:             Ok(ParsedCidr::V4 { network, prefix })
 852:         }
 853:         IpAddr::V6(ipv6) => {
 854:             if prefix > 128 {
 855:                 return Err(format!("invalid IPv6 CIDR prefix: {prefix}"));
 856:             }
 857:             let mask = if prefix == 0 {
 858:                 0u128
 859:             } else {
 860:                 u128::MAX << (128 - prefix)
 861:             };
 862:             let network = u128::from_be_bytes(ipv6.octets()) & mask;
 863:             Ok(ParsedCidr::V6 { network, prefix })
 864:         }
 865:     }
 866: }
 867: 
 868: fn canonicalize_ipv4_cidr(raw: &str, label: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
 869:     let parsed = parse_cidr(raw).map_err(|err| format!("invalid {label}: {err}"))?;
 870:     match parsed {
 871:         ParsedCidr::V4 { network, prefix } => {
 872:             if prefix == 32 {
 873:                 return Err(format!("{label} must not be an IPv4 host route"));
 874:             }
 875:             Ok(format!("{}/{}", Ipv4Addr::from(network), prefix))
 876:         }
 877:         ParsedCidr::V6 { .. } => Err(format!("{label} must be an IPv4 CIDR")),
 878:     }
 879: }
 880: 
 881: fn cidr_is_host_route(cidr: &ParsedCidr) -> bool {
 882:     match cidr {
 883:         ParsedCidr::V4 { prefix, .. } => *prefix == 32,
 884:         ParsedCidr::V6 { prefix, .. } => *prefix == 128,
 885:     }
 886: }

 888: fn is_peer_endpoint_key(key: &str) -> bool {
 889:     if !key.starts_with("peer.") || !key.ends_with(".endpoint") {
 890:         return false;
 891:     }
 892:     let Some(middle) = key.strip_prefix("peer.") else {
 893:         return false;
 894:     };
 895:     let Some(index) = middle.strip_suffix(".endpoint") else {
 896:         return false;
 897:     };
 898:     !index.is_empty() && index.chars().all(|ch| ch.is_ascii_digit())
 899: }

 901: fn split_endpoint_host_port(value: &str) -> Option<(&str, &str)> {
 902:     let trimmed = value.trim();
 903:     let (host, port) = trimmed.rsplit_once(':')?;
 904:     if host.trim().is_empty() || port.trim().is_empty() {
 905:         return None;
 906:     }
 907:     Some((host.trim(), port.trim()))
 908: }

 910: pub fn execute_ops_check_local_file_mode(
 911:     config: CheckLocalFileModeConfig,
 912: ) -> Result<String, String> {
 913:     let path = resolve_path(config.path.as_path())?;
 914:     let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(path.as_path())
 915:         .map_err(|err| format!("stat failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
 916:     if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
 917:         return Err(format!("path must not be a symlink: {}", path.display()));
 918:     }
 919:     if !metadata.file_type().is_file() && !metadata.file_type().is_socket() {
 920:         return Err(format!("path must be a regular file: {}", path.display()));
 921:     }
 922:     let mode = metadata.mode() & 0o777;
 923:     let label = if config.label.trim().is_empty() {
 924:         "file".to_string()
 925:     } else {
 926:         config.label.trim().to_string()
 927:     };
 928:     match parse_file_mode_policy(config.policy.as_str())? {
 929:         FileModePolicy::OwnerOnly => {
 930:             if mode & 0o077 != 0 {
 931:                 return Err(format!(
 932:                     "{label} must be owner-only (0400/0600): {} ({mode:03o})",
 933:                     path.display()
 934:                 ));
 935:             }
 936:         }
 937:         FileModePolicy::NoGroupWorldWrite => {
 938:             if mode & 0o022 != 0 {
 939:                 return Err(format!(
 940:                     "{label} must not be group/world writable: {} ({mode:03o})",
 941:                     path.display()
 942:                 ));
 943:             }
 944:         }
 945:     }
 946:     Ok(format!("{mode:03o}"))
 947: }

 957: pub fn execute_ops_write_cross_network_forensics_manifest(
 958:     config: WriteCrossNetworkForensicsManifestConfig,
 959: ) -> Result<String, String> {
 960:     let stage_dir = resolve_path(config.stage_dir.as_path())?;
 961:     let output = resolve_path(config.output.as_path())?;
 962:     if !stage_dir.is_dir() {
 963:         return Err(format!(
 964:             "stage-dir must be an existing directory: {}",
 965:             stage_dir.display()
 966:         ));
 967:     }
 968: 
 969:     let mut node_dirs = fs::read_dir(stage_dir.as_path())
 970:         .map_err(|err| format!("read stage-dir failed ({}): {err}", stage_dir.display()))?
 971:         .filter_map(Result::ok)
 972:         .filter(|entry| entry.file_type().map(|kind| kind.is_dir()).unwrap_or(false))
 973:         .collect::<Vec<_>>();
 974:     node_dirs.sort_by_key(|entry| entry.file_name());
 975: 
 976:     let mut nodes = Vec::new();
 977:     for node_dir in node_dirs {
 978:         let node_path = node_dir.path();
 979:         let mut files = fs::read_dir(node_path.as_path())
 980:             .map_err(|err| {
 981:                 format!(
 982:                     "read node forensics directory failed ({}): {err}",
 983:                     node_path.display()
 984:                 )
 985:             })?
 986:             .filter_map(Result::ok)
 987:             .filter(|entry| {
 988:                 entry
 989:                     .file_type()
 990:                     .map(|kind| kind.is_file())
 991:                     .unwrap_or(false)
 992:             })
 993:             .map(|entry| {
 994:                 fs::canonicalize(entry.path()).unwrap_or_else(|_| {
 995:                     resolve_path(entry.path().as_path()).unwrap_or_else(|_| entry.path())
 996:                 })
 997:             })
 998:             .collect::<Vec<_>>();
 999:         files.sort();
1000:         nodes.push(json!({
1001:             "label": node_dir.file_name().to_string_lossy().to_string(),
1002:             "files": files.into_iter().map(|path| path.display().to_string()).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
1003:         }));
1004:     }
1005: 
1006:     let payload = json!({
1007:         "schema_version": 1,
1008:         "mode": "cross_network_failure_forensics",
1009:         "stage": config.stage,
1010:         "collected_at_utc": config.collected_at_utc,
1011:         "bundle_dir": absolute_path_string(stage_dir.as_path())?,
1012:         "nodes": nodes,
1013:     });
1014:     write_json_pretty(output.as_path(), &payload)?;
1015:     Ok(output.display().to_string())
1016: }

1018: pub fn execute_ops_write_live_lab_stage_artifact_index(
1019:     config: WriteLiveLabStageArtifactIndexConfig,
1020: ) -> Result<String, String> {
1021:     let stage_name = config.stage_name.trim();
1022:     if stage_name.is_empty() {
1023:         return Err("stage-name is required".to_string());
1024:     }
1025: 
1026:     let stage_dir = resolve_path(config.stage_dir.as_path())?;
1027:     let output = resolve_path(config.output.as_path())?;
1028:     if !stage_dir.is_dir() {
1029:         return Err(format!(
1030:             "stage-dir must be an existing directory: {}",
1031:             stage_dir.display()
1032:         ));
1033:     }
1034: 
1035:     let mut files = Vec::new();
1036:     walk_stage_files_recursive(
1037:         stage_dir.as_path(),
1038:         stage_dir.as_path(),
1039:         Some(output.as_path()),
1040:         &mut files,
1041:     )?;
1042: 
1043:     let mut entries = Vec::new();
1044:     let mut total_bytes = 0u64;
1045:     for path in files {
1046:         let metadata = fs::metadata(path.as_path())
1047:             .map_err(|err| format!("stat failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
1048:         if !metadata.is_file() {
1049:             return Err(format!(
1050:                 "stage artifact must be a regular file: {}",
1051:                 path.display()
1052:             ));
1053:         }
1054:         let relative_path = path
1055:             .strip_prefix(stage_dir.as_path())
1056:             .unwrap_or(path.as_path())
1057:             .display()
1058:             .to_string();
1059:         let size_bytes = metadata.len();
1060:         total_bytes = total_bytes.saturating_add(size_bytes);
1061:         entries.push(json!({
1062:             "relative_path": relative_path,
1063:             "size_bytes": size_bytes,
1064:             "sha256": sha256_hex_for_file(path.as_path())?,
1065:         }));
1066:     }
1067: 
1068:     let payload = json!({
1069:         "schema_version": 1,
1070:         "mode": "live_lab_stage_artifact_index",
1071:         "stage_name": stage_name,
1072:         "stage_dir": stage_dir.display().to_string(),
1073:         "collected_at_utc": collected_at_utc_now(),
1074:         "file_count": entries.len(),
1075:         "total_bytes": total_bytes,
1076:         "files": entries,
1077:     });
1078:     write_json_pretty(output.as_path(), &payload)?;
1079:     Ok(output.display().to_string())
1080: }

1090: pub fn execute_ops_validate_cross_network_forensics_bundle(
1091:     config: ValidateCrossNetworkForensicsBundleConfig,
1092: ) -> Result<String, String> {
1093:     let stage_name = config.stage_name.trim();
1094:     if stage_name.is_empty() {
1095:         return Err("stage-name is required".to_string());
1096:     }
1097: 
1098:     let nodes_tsv = resolve_path(config.nodes_tsv.as_path())?;
1099:     let stage_dir = resolve_path(config.stage_dir.as_path())?;
1100:     let output = resolve_path(config.output.as_path())?;
1101:     if !stage_dir.is_dir() {
1102:         return Err(format!(
1103:             "stage-dir must be an existing directory: {}",
1104:             stage_dir.display()
1105:         ));
1106:     }
1107: 
1108:     let rows = read_tsv_rows(nodes_tsv.as_path())?;
1109:     if rows.is_empty() {
1110:         return Err(format!(
1111:             "nodes-tsv must contain at least one row: {}",
1112:             nodes_tsv.display()
1113:         ));
1114:     }
1115: 
1116:     let required_stage_files = ["manifest.json", "route_matrix.txt", "cluster_snapshot.txt"];
1117:     let mut missing_files = Vec::new();
1118:     let mut empty_files = Vec::new();
1119:     let mut invalid_files = Vec::new();
1120:     let mut nodes = Vec::new();
1121: 
1122:     for file_name in required_stage_files {
1123:         let path = stage_dir.join(file_name);
1124:         if !path.exists() {
1125:             missing_files.push(path.display().to_string());
1126:             continue;
1127:         }
1128:         let metadata = fs::metadata(path.as_path())
1129:             .map_err(|err| format!("stat failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
1130:         if metadata.len() == 0 {
1131:             empty_files.push(path.display().to_string());
1132:         }
1133:     }
1134: 
1135:     let manifest_path = stage_dir.join("manifest.json");
1136:     if manifest_path.exists() {
1137:         let body = fs::read_to_string(manifest_path.as_path())
1138:             .map_err(|err| format!("read JSON failed ({}): {err}", manifest_path.display()))?;
1139:         if body.trim().is_empty() {
1140:             empty_files.push(manifest_path.display().to_string());
1141:         } else {
1142:             match serde_json::from_str::<Value>(body.as_str()) {
1143:                 Ok(manifest) => {
1144:                     let manifest_mode = manifest
1145:                         .get("mode")
1146:                         .and_then(Value::as_str)
1147:                         .unwrap_or_default();
1148:                     let manifest_stage = manifest
1149:                         .get("stage")
1150:                         .and_then(Value::as_str)
1151:                         .unwrap_or_default();
1152:                     let manifest_bundle_dir = manifest
1153:                         .get("bundle_dir")
1154:                         .and_then(Value::as_str)
1155:                         .unwrap_or_default();
1156:                     let manifest_nodes = manifest
1157:                         .get("nodes")
1158:                         .and_then(Value::as_array)
1159:                         .map(|nodes| nodes.len())
1160:                         .unwrap_or_default();
1161:                     if manifest_mode != "cross_network_failure_forensics" {
1162:                         invalid_files.push(format!(
1163:                             "{}: unexpected mode {manifest_mode:?}",
1164:                             manifest_path.display()
1165:                         ));
1166:                     }
1167:                     if manifest_stage != stage_name {
1168:                         invalid_files.push(format!(
1169:                             "{}: unexpected stage {manifest_stage:?}",
1170:                             manifest_path.display()
1171:                         ));
1172:                     }
1173:                     if manifest_bundle_dir != stage_dir.display().to_string() {
1174:                         invalid_files.push(format!(
1175:                             "{}: unexpected bundle_dir {manifest_bundle_dir:?}",
1176:                             manifest_path.display()
1177:                         ));
1178:                     }
1179:                     if manifest_nodes != rows.len() {
1180:                         invalid_files.push(format!(
1181:                             "{}: manifest node count {manifest_nodes} does not match topology node count {}",
1182:                             manifest_path.display(),
1183:                             rows.len()
1184:                         ));
1185:                     }
1186:                 }
1187:                 Err(err) => {
1188:                     invalid_files.push(format!(
1189:                         "{}: parse JSON failed: {err}",
1190:                         manifest_path.display()
1191:                     ));
1192:                 }
1193:             }
1194:         }
1195:     }
1196: 
1197:     for row in rows {
1198:         if row.len() != 4 {
1199:             return Err(format!(
1200:                 "nodes-tsv rows must contain 4 columns: {}",
1201:                 nodes_tsv.display()
1202:             ));
1203:         }
1204: 
1205:         let label = row[0].clone();
1206:         let target = row[1].clone();
1207:         let node_id = row[2].clone();
1208:         let role = row[3].clone();
1209:         let node_dir = stage_dir.join(label.as_str());
1210:         let mut node_missing_files = Vec::new();
1211:         let mut node_empty_files = Vec::new();
1212: 
1213:         for file_name in expected_forensics_node_files() {
1214:             let path = node_dir.join(file_name);
1215:             let relative_path = path
1216:                 .strip_prefix(stage_dir.as_path())
1217:                 .unwrap_or(path.as_path())
1218:                 .display()
1219:                 .to_string();
1220:             if !path.exists() {
1221:                 node_missing_files.push(relative_path.clone());
1222:                 missing_files.push(relative_path);
1223:                 continue;
1224:             }
1225:             let metadata = fs::metadata(path.as_path())
1226:                 .map_err(|err| format!("stat failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
1227:             if metadata.len() == 0 {
1228:                 node_empty_files.push(relative_path.clone());
1229:                 empty_files.push(relative_path);
1230:             }
1231:         }
1232: 
1233:         nodes.push(json!({
1234:             "label": label,
1235:             "target": target,
1236:             "node_id": node_id,
1237:             "role": role,
1238:             "node_dir": node_dir.display().to_string(),
1239:             "missing_files": node_missing_files,
1240:             "empty_files": node_empty_files,
1241:         }));
1242:     }
1243: 
1244:     let bundle_status =
1245:         if missing_files.is_empty() && empty_files.is_empty() && invalid_files.is_empty() {
1246:             CHECK_PASS
1247:         } else {
1248:             CHECK_FAIL
1249:         };
1250:     let payload = json!({
1251:         "schema_version": 1,
1252:         "mode": "cross_network_forensics_bundle_validation",
1253:         "stage_name": stage_name,
1254:         "stage_dir": stage_dir.display().to_string(),
1255:         "collected_at_utc": collected_at_utc_now(),
1256:         "bundle_status": bundle_status,
1257:         "node_count": nodes.len(),
1258:         "required_stage_files": required_stage_files,
1259:         "required_node_files": expected_forensics_node_files(),
1260:         "missing_file_count": missing_files.len(),
1261:         "empty_file_count": empty_files.len(),
1262:         "invalid_file_count": invalid_files.len(),
1263:         "missing_files": missing_files,
1264:         "empty_files": empty_files,
1265:         "invalid_files": invalid_files,
1266:         "nodes": nodes,
1267:     });
1268:     write_json_pretty(output.as_path(), &payload)?;
1269:     if bundle_status != CHECK_PASS {
1270:         return Err("cross-network forensics bundle validation failed".to_string());
1271:     }
1272:     Ok(output.display().to_string())
1273: }

1275: pub fn execute_ops_write_cross_network_preflight_report(

1313: pub fn execute_ops_write_live_linux_reboot_recovery_report(
1314:     config: WriteLiveLinuxRebootRecoveryReportConfig,
1315: ) -> Result<String, String> {
1316:     let report_path = resolve_path(config.report_path.as_path())?;
1317:     let observations_path = resolve_path(config.observations_path.as_path())?;
1318:     let exit_return = parse_pass_fail_skip(config.exit_return.as_str(), "--exit-return")?;
1319:     let exit_boot_change =
1320:         parse_pass_fail_skip(config.exit_boot_change.as_str(), "--exit-boot-change")?;
1321:     let post_exit_dns_refresh = parse_pass_fail_skip(
1322:         config.post_exit_dns_refresh.as_str(),
1323:         "--post-exit-dns-refresh",
1324:     )?;
1325:     let post_exit_twohop =
1326:         parse_pass_fail_skip(config.post_exit_twohop.as_str(), "--post-exit-twohop")?;
1327:     let client_return = parse_pass_fail_skip(config.client_return.as_str(), "--client-return")?;
1328:     let client_boot_change =
1329:         parse_pass_fail_skip(config.client_boot_change.as_str(), "--client-boot-change")?;
1330:     let post_client_dns_refresh = parse_pass_fail_skip(
1331:         config.post_client_dns_refresh.as_str(),
1332:         "--post-client-dns-refresh",
1333:     )?;
1334:     let post_client_twohop =
1335:         parse_pass_fail_skip(config.post_client_twohop.as_str(), "--post-client-twohop")?;
1336:     let salvage_twohop = parse_pass_fail_skip(config.salvage_twohop.as_str(), "--salvage-twohop")?;
1337:     let observations = fs::read(observations_path.as_path())
1338:         .map(|bytes| String::from_utf8_lossy(bytes.as_slice()).to_string())
1339:         .unwrap_or_default();
1340: 
1341:     let checks = [
1342:         ("exit_reboot_returns", exit_return),
1343:         ("exit_boot_id_changes", exit_boot_change),
1344:         (
1345:             "post_exit_reboot_managed_dns_refresh",
1346:             post_exit_dns_refresh,
1347:         ),
1348:         ("post_exit_reboot_twohop", post_exit_twohop),
1349:         ("client_reboot_returns", client_return),
1350:         ("client_boot_id_changes", client_boot_change),
1351:         (
1352:             "post_client_reboot_managed_dns_refresh",
1353:             post_client_dns_refresh,
1354:         ),
1355:         ("post_client_reboot_twohop", post_client_twohop),
1356:         ("client_failure_salvage_twohop", salvage_twohop),
1357:     ];
1358: 
1359:     let relevant = checks
1360:         .iter()
1361:         .filter(|(_, value)| value.as_str() != CHECK_SKIPPED)
1362:         .collect::<Vec<_>>();
1363:     let status = if !relevant.is_empty()
1364:         && relevant
1365:             .iter()
1366:             .all(|(_, value)| value.as_str() == CHECK_PASS)
1367:     {
1368:         CHECK_PASS
1369:     } else {
1370:         CHECK_FAIL
1371:     };
1372: 
1373:     let mut failure_reasons = checks
1374:         .iter()
1375:         .filter_map(|(name, value)| {
1376:             if value.as_str() == CHECK_FAIL {
1377:                 reboot_reason_for_check(name).map(ToString::to_string)
1378:             } else {
1379:                 None
1380:             }
1381:         })
1382:         .collect::<Vec<_>>();
1383: 
1384:     for line in observations
1385:         .lines()
1386:         .map(str::trim)
1387:         .filter(|line| !line.is_empty())
1388:     {
1389:         match line {
1390:             "client_reboot_wait=fail" => {
1391:                 failure_reasons.push("client reboot wait timed out".to_string())
1392:             }
1393:             "exit_reboot_wait=fail" => {
1394:                 failure_reasons.push("exit reboot wait timed out".to_string())
1395:             }
1396:             "exit_post=" => {
1397:                 failure_reasons.push("exit post-reboot boot_id capture was empty".to_string())
1398:             }
1399:             "client_post=" => {
1400:                 failure_reasons.push("client post-reboot boot_id capture was empty".to_string())
1401:             }
1402:             _ => {}
1403:         }
1404:     }
1405: 
1406:     let checks_json = checks
1407:         .iter()
1408:         .map(|(name, value)| (name.to_string(), Value::String(value.clone())))
1409:         .collect::<Map<_, _>>();
1410:     let payload = json!({
1411:         "schema_version": 1,
1412:         "mode": "live_linux_reboot_recovery",
1413:         "status": status,
1414:         "checks": Value::Object(checks_json),
1415:         "boot_ids": {
1416:             "exit_pre": config.exit_pre,
1417:             "exit_post": config.exit_post,
1418:             "client_pre": config.client_pre,
1419:             "client_post": config.client_post,
1420:         },
1421:         "failure_reasons": failure_reasons,
1422:         "observations": observations.trim(),
1423:     });
1424: 
1425:     write_json_pretty(report_path.as_path(), &payload)?;
1426:     if status != CHECK_PASS {
1427:         return Err("live_linux_reboot_recovery report status is fail".to_string());
1428:     }
1429:     Ok(report_path.display().to_string())
1430: }

1432: pub fn execute_ops_write_live_linux_lab_run_summary(

1435:     let nodes_tsv = resolve_path(config.nodes_tsv.as_path())?;

1470:                 .iter()
1471:                 .find(|worker| worker.rc != 0)
1472:                 .map(|worker| worker.primary_failure_reason.clone())

1475:                 "stage": stage_name,
1476:                 "severity": row[1],
1477:                 "status": row[2],
1478:                 "rc": rc,
1479:                 "log_path": row[4],
1480:                 "message": row[5],
1481:                 "started_at": row[6],
1482:                 "finished_at": row[7],
1483:                 "failed_worker_count": failed_worker_count,
1484:                 "primary_failure_reason": primary_failure_reason,
1485:                 "worker_results": worker_results
1486:                     .into_iter()
1487:                     .map(|worker: LiveLabWorkerResult| {
1488:                         json!({
1489:                             "label": worker.label,
1490:                             "target": worker.target,
1491:                             "node_id": worker.node_id,
1492:                             "role": worker.role,
1493:                             "rc": worker.rc,
1494:                             "started_at": worker.started_at,
1495:                             "finished_at": worker.finished_at,
1496:                             "log_path": worker.log_path,
1497:                             "snapshot_path": worker.snapshot_path,
1498:                             "route_policy_path": worker.route_policy_path,
1499:                             "dns_state_path": worker.dns_state_path,
1500:                             "primary_failure_reason": worker.primary_failure_reason,
1501:                         })
1502:                     })
1503:                     .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
1504:             })
1505:         })
1506:         .collect::<Vec<_>>();
1507: 
1508:     let payload = json!({
1509:         "schema_version": 1,
1510:         "run_id": config.run_id,
1511:         "network_id": config.network_id,
1512:         "report_dir": report_dir.display().to_string(),
1513:         "overall_status": config.overall_status,
1514:         "started_at_local": config.started_at_local,
1515:         "started_at_utc": config.started_at_utc,
1516:         "started_at_unix": config.started_at_unix,
1517:         "finished_at_local": config.finished_at_local,
1518:         "finished_at_utc": config.finished_at_utc,
1519:         "finished_at_unix": config.finished_at_unix,
1520:         "elapsed_secs": config.elapsed_secs,
1521:         "elapsed_human": config.elapsed_human,
1522:         "nodes": nodes,
1523:         "stages": stages,
1524:     });
1525:     write_json_pretty(summary_json.as_path(), &payload)?;
1526: 
1527:     let mut lines = Vec::new();

1529:         "# Live Linux Lab Orchestrator Summary ({})",
1530:         payload
1531:             .get("run_id")
1532:             .and_then(Value::as_str)
1533:             .unwrap_or("unknown")
1534:     ));
1535:     lines.push(String::new());
1536:     lines.push(format!(
1537:         "- overall_status: `{}`",
1538:         payload
1539:             .get("overall_status")
1540:             .and_then(Value::as_str)
1541:             .unwrap_or("unknown")
1542:     ));
1543:     lines.push(format!(
1544:         "- network_id: `{}`",
1545:         payload
1546:             .get("network_id")
1547:             .and_then(Value::as_str)
1548:             .unwrap_or("unknown")
1549:     ));
1550:     lines.push(format!(
1551:         "- report_dir: `{}`",
1552:         payload
1553:             .get("report_dir")
1554:             .and_then(Value::as_str)
1555:             .unwrap_or("unknown")
1556:     ));
1557:     lines.push(format!(
1558:         "- started_at_local: `{}`",
1559:         payload
1560:             .get("started_at_local")
1561:             .and_then(Value::as_str)
1562:             .unwrap_or("unknown")
1563:     ));
1564:     lines.push(format!(
1565:         "- started_at_utc: `{}`",
1566:         payload
1567:             .get("started_at_utc")
1568:             .and_then(Value::as_str)
1569:             .unwrap_or("unknown")
1570:     ));

1572:         "- finished_at_local: `{}`",
1573:         payload

1575:             .and_then(Value::as_str)
1576:             .unwrap_or("unknown")
1577:     ));
1578:     lines.push(format!(

1581:             .get("finished_at_utc")
1582:             .and_then(Value::as_str)
1583:             .unwrap_or("unknown")
1584:     ));

1586:         "- elapsed: `{}`",
1587:         payload
1588:             .get("elapsed_human")
1589:             .and_then(Value::as_str)
1590:             .unwrap_or("unknown")
1591:     ));
1592:     lines.push(String::new());
1593:     lines.push("## Nodes".to_string());
1594:     lines.push(String::new());
1595:     if let Some(node_array) = payload.get("nodes").and_then(Value::as_array) {
1596:         for node in node_array {
1597:             lines.push(format!(
1598:                 "- `{}`: `{}` (`{}`, bootstrap role `{}`)",
1599:                 node.get("label")
1600:                     .and_then(Value::as_str)
1601:                     .unwrap_or("unknown"),
1602:                 node.get("target")
1603:                     .and_then(Value::as_str)
1604:                     .unwrap_or("unknown"),
1605:                 node.get("node_id")
1606:                     .and_then(Value::as_str)
1607:                     .unwrap_or("unknown"),
1608:                 node.get("bootstrap_role")
1609:                     .and_then(Value::as_str)
1610:                     .unwrap_or("unknown"),
1611:             ));
1612:         }
1613:     }
1614:     lines.push(String::new());
1615:     lines.push("## Stages".to_string());
1616:     lines.push(String::new());
1617:     if let Some(stage_array) = payload.get("stages").and_then(Value::as_array) {
1618:         for stage in stage_array {
1619:             lines.push(format!(
1620:                 "- `{}` [{}] -> `{}` (rc={})",
1621:                 stage
1622:                     .get("stage")
1623:                     .and_then(Value::as_str)
1624:                     .unwrap_or("unknown"),
1625:                 stage
1626:                     .get("severity")
1627:                     .and_then(Value::as_str)
1628:                     .unwrap_or("unknown"),
1629:                 stage
1630:                     .get("status")
1631:                     .and_then(Value::as_str)
1632:                     .unwrap_or("unknown"),
1633:                 stage.get("rc").and_then(Value::as_i64).unwrap_or(1),
1634:             ));
1635:             lines.push(format!(
1636:                 "  log: `{}`",
1637:                 stage
1638:                     .get("log_path")
1639:                     .and_then(Value::as_str)
1640:                     .unwrap_or("unknown")
1641:             ));
1642:             lines.push(format!(
1643:                 "  detail: {}",
1644:                 stage
1645:                     .get("message")
1646:                     .and_then(Value::as_str)
1647:                     .unwrap_or("stage detail unavailable")
1648:             ));
1649:             if let Some(worker_results) = stage.get("worker_results").and_then(Value::as_array)
1650:                 && !worker_results.is_empty()
1651:             {
1652:                 lines.push(format!(
1653:                     "  workers: {}/{} failed",
1654:                     stage
1655:                         .get("failed_worker_count")
1656:                         .and_then(Value::as_u64)
1657:                         .unwrap_or(0),
1658:                     worker_results.len()
1659:                 ));
1660:                 if let Some(first_failed) = worker_results
1661:                     .iter()
1662:                     .find(|worker| worker.get("rc").and_then(Value::as_i64).unwrap_or(0) != 0)
1663:                 {
1664:                     lines.push(format!(
1665:                         "  first_failed_node: `{}` reason={}",
1666:                         first_failed
1667:                             .get("label")
1668:                             .and_then(Value::as_str)
1669:                             .unwrap_or("unknown"),
1670:                         first_failed
1671:                             .get("primary_failure_reason")
1672:                             .and_then(Value::as_str)
1673:                             .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
1674:                             .unwrap_or("see worker log")
1675:                     ));
1676:                     if let Some(snapshot_path) = first_failed
1677:                         .get("snapshot_path")
1678:                         .and_then(Value::as_str)
1679:                         .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
1680:                     {
1681:                         lines.push(format!("  snapshot: `{snapshot_path}`"));
1682:                     }
1683:                 }
1684:             }
1685:         }
1686:     }
1687:     ensure_parent_dir(summary_md.as_path())?;
1688:     fs::write(summary_md.as_path(), lines.join("\n") + "\n").map_err(|err| {
1689:         format!(
1690:             "write markdown summary failed ({}): {err}",
1691:             summary_md.display()
1692:         )
1693:     })?;
1694: 
1695:     Ok(format!(
1696:         "live lab run summary generated: json={} md={}",
1697:         summary_json.display(),
1698:         summary_md.display()
1699:     ))
1700: }
1701: 
1702: pub fn execute_ops_scan_ipv4_port_range(config: ScanIpv4PortRangeConfig) -> Result<String, String> {
1703:     if config.start_host == 0 {
1704:         return Err("--start-host must be between 1 and 254".to_string());
1705:     }
1706:     if config.end_host == 0 {
1707:         return Err("--end-host must be between 1 and 254".to_string());
1708:     }
1709:     if config.start_host > config.end_host {
1710:         return Err("--start-host must be <= --end-host".to_string());
1711:     }
1712:     let prefix = parse_network_prefix(config.network_prefix.as_str())?;
1713:     let timeout = Duration::from_millis(config.timeout_ms.max(1));
1714:     let output_key = if config.output_key.trim().is_empty() {
1715:         "hosts=".to_string()
1716:     } else {
1717:         config.output_key
1718:     };
1719:     let mut hits = Vec::new();
1720:     for host in config.start_host..=config.end_host {
1721:         let ip = Ipv4Addr::new(prefix[0], prefix[1], prefix[2], host);
1722:         let addr = SocketAddr::V4(SocketAddrV4::new(ip, config.port));
1723:         if TcpStream::connect_timeout(&addr, timeout).is_ok() {
1724:             hits.push(ip.to_string());
1725:         }
1726:     }
1727:     Ok(format!("{output_key}{}", hits.join(",")))
1728: }

1808: pub fn execute_ops_write_live_linux_server_ip_bypass_report(
1809:     config: WriteLiveLinuxServerIpBypassReportConfig,
1810: ) -> Result<String, String> {
1811:     let report_path = resolve_path(config.report_path.as_path())?;
1812:     let probe_ip = config
1813:         .probe_ip
1814:         .trim()
1815:         .parse::<Ipv4Addr>()
1816:         .map_err(|err| format!("invalid probe IP {:?}: {err}", config.probe_ip))?;
1817:     let probe_from_client_status = parse_pass_fail(
1818:         config.probe_from_client_status.as_str(),
1819:         "probe-from-client-status",
1820:     )?;
1821:     let captured_at_unix = if config.captured_at_unix == 0 {
1822:         unix_now()
1823:     } else {
1824:         config.captured_at_unix
1825:     };
1826:     let captured_at = if config.captured_at_utc.trim().is_empty() {
1827:         format!("{captured_at_unix}")
1828:     } else {
1829:         config.captured_at_utc.trim().to_string()
1830:     };
1831: 
1832:     let mut allowed_networks = Vec::new();
1833:     for part in config
1834:         .allowed_management_cidrs
1835:         .split(',')
1836:         .map(str::trim)
1837:         .filter(|entry| !entry.is_empty())
1838:     {
1839:         allowed_networks.push((part.to_string(), parse_cidr(part)?));
1840:     }
1841: 
1842:     let internet_route_ok = config.client_internet_route.contains("dev rustynet0");
1843:     let probe_route_direct = !config.client_probe_route.contains("dev rustynet0")
1844:         && config
1845:             .client_probe_route
1846:             .contains(probe_ip.to_string().as_str());
1847:     let probe_host_self_reachable = config.probe_self_test.contains("probe-ok");
1848: 
1849:     let mut unexpected_bypass_routes = Vec::new();
1850:     for raw_line in config.client_table_51820.lines() {
1851:         let line = raw_line.trim();
1852:         if line.is_empty() || line.contains("dev rustynet0") || line.starts_with("default ") {
1853:             continue;
1854:         }
1855:         let Some(first) = line.split_whitespace().next() else {
1856:             continue;
1857:         };
1858:         let parsed = match parse_cidr(first) {
1859:             Ok(value) => value,
1860:             Err(_) => continue,
1861:         };
1862:         if cidr_is_host_route(&parsed) {
1863:             continue;
1864:         }
1865:         let allowed = allowed_networks
1866:             .iter()
1867:             .any(|(_, allowed)| *allowed == parsed);
1868:         if !allowed {
1869:             unexpected_bypass_routes.push(line.to_string());
1870:         }
1871:     }
1872: 
1873:     let checks = json!({
1874:         "internet_route_via_rustynet0": if internet_route_ok { CHECK_PASS } else { CHECK_FAIL },
1875:         "probe_host_self_service_reachable": if probe_host_self_reachable { CHECK_PASS } else { CHECK_FAIL },
1876:         "probe_endpoint_route_direct_not_tunnelled": if probe_route_direct { CHECK_PASS } else { CHECK_FAIL },
1877:         "probe_service_blocked_from_client": probe_from_client_status,
1878:         "no_unexpected_bypass_routes": if unexpected_bypass_routes.is_empty() { CHECK_PASS } else { CHECK_FAIL },
1879:     });
1880: 
1881:     let overall = if checks
1882:         .as_object()
1883:         .map(|items| items.values().all(|v| v.as_str() == Some(CHECK_PASS)))
1884:         .unwrap_or(false)
1885:     {
1886:         CHECK_PASS
1887:     } else {
1888:         CHECK_FAIL
1889:     };
1890: 
1891:     let payload = json!({
1892:         "phase": "phase10",
1893:         "mode": "live_linux_server_ip_bypass",
1894:         "evidence_mode": "measured",
1895:         "captured_at": captured_at,
1896:         "captured_at_unix": captured_at_unix,
1897:         "status": overall,
1898:         "probe_host_ip": probe_ip.to_string(),
1899:         "probe_port": config.probe_port,
1900:         "checks": checks,
1901:         "evidence": {
1902:             "client_internet_route": config.client_internet_route,
1903:             "client_probe_route": config.client_probe_route,
1904:             "client_table_51820": config.client_table_51820,
1905:             "client_endpoints": config.client_endpoints,
1906:             "probe_self_test": config.probe_self_test,
1907:             "client_probe_output": config.probe_from_client_output,
1908:             "unexpected_bypass_routes": unexpected_bypass_routes,
1909:             "allowed_management_cidrs": allowed_networks.into_iter().map(|(raw, _)| raw).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
1910:         }
1911:     });
1912:     write_json_pretty(report_path.as_path(), &payload)?;
1913:     Ok(payload
1914:         .get("status")
1915:         .and_then(Value::as_str)
1916:         .unwrap_or(CHECK_FAIL)
1917:         .to_string())
1918: }

1920: pub fn execute_ops_write_live_linux_control_surface_report(
1921:     config: WriteLiveLinuxControlSurfaceReportConfig,
1922: ) -> Result<String, String> {
1923:     let report_path = resolve_path(config.report_path.as_path())?;
1924:     let work_dir = resolve_path(config.work_dir.as_path())?;
1925:     if !work_dir.is_dir() {
1926:         return Err(format!(
1927:             "work-dir must be an existing directory: {}",
1928:             work_dir.display()
1929:         ));
1930:     }
1931:     if config.host_labels.is_empty() {
1932:         return Err("at least one --host-label is required".to_string());
1933:     }
1934: 
1935:     let Some((dns_host, dns_port)) = config.dns_bind_addr.rsplit_once(':') else {
1936:         return Err(format!(
1937:             "invalid --dns-bind-addr {:?}; expected host:port",
1938:             config.dns_bind_addr
1939:         ));
1940:     };
1941:     let dns_port_num = dns_port
1942:         .parse::<u16>()
1943:         .map_err(|err| format!("invalid dns bind port {dns_port:?}: {err}"))?;
1944:     if dns_host.trim().is_empty() {
1945:         return Err("dns bind host must not be empty".to_string());
1946:     }
1947:     let allowed_udp = format!("{}:{}", dns_host.trim(), dns_port_num);
1948:     let remote_dns_probe_status = parse_pass_fail_skip(
1949:         config.remote_dns_probe_status.as_str(),
1950:         "remote-dns-probe-status",
1951:     )?;
1952:     let captured_at_unix = if config.captured_at_unix == 0 {
1953:         unix_now()
1954:     } else {
1955:         config.captured_at_unix
1956:     };
1957:     let captured_at = if config.captured_at_utc.trim().is_empty() {
1958:         format!("{captured_at_unix}")
1959:     } else {
1960:         config.captured_at_utc.trim().to_string()
1961:     };
1962: 
1963:     let mut host_results = Map::new();
1964:     let mut overall = CHECK_PASS.to_string();
1965:     for label in &config.host_labels {
1966:         let daemon_meta = fs::read_to_string(work_dir.join(format!("{label}.daemon_socket.txt")))
1967:             .map_err(|err| format!("read {label} daemon metadata failed: {err}"))?;
1968:         let helper_meta = fs::read_to_string(work_dir.join(format!("{label}.helper_socket.txt")))
1969:             .map_err(|err| format!("read {label} helper metadata failed: {err}"))?;
1970:         let listeners_raw =
1971:             fs::read_to_string(work_dir.join(format!("{label}.inet_listeners.txt")))
1972:                 .map_err(|err| format!("read {label} listener capture failed: {err}"))?;
1973:         let dns_service_state =
1974:             fs::read_to_string(work_dir.join(format!("{label}.managed_dns_state.txt")))
1975:                 .map_err(|err| format!("read {label} DNS service state failed: {err}"))?;
1976: 
1977:         let daemon_meta_trimmed = daemon_meta.trim().to_string();
1978:         let helper_meta_trimmed = helper_meta.trim().to_string();
1979:         let daemon_parts = daemon_meta_trimmed.split('|').collect::<Vec<_>>();
1980:         let helper_parts = helper_meta_trimmed.split('|').collect::<Vec<_>>();
1981:         let daemon_owner = daemon_parts.get(2).copied().unwrap_or_default();
1982:         let daemon_group = daemon_parts.get(3).copied().unwrap_or_default();
1983:         let daemon_owner_ok = daemon_owner == "root" || daemon_owner == "rustynetd";
1984:         let daemon_ok = daemon_parts.len() == 4
1985:             && daemon_parts[0] == "socket"
1986:             && daemon_parts[1] == "600"
1987:             && daemon_owner_ok
1988:             && daemon_group == daemon_owner;
1989:         let helper_ok = helper_parts.len() == 4
1990:             && helper_parts[0] == "socket"
1991:             && helper_parts[1] == "660"
1992:             && helper_parts[2] == "root";
1993: 
1994:         let mut tcp_listener_ok = true;
1995:         let mut udp_listener_ok = true;
1996:         let mut rustynet_listener_lines = Vec::new();
1997:         for line in listeners_raw
1998:             .lines()
1999:             .map(str::trim)
2000:             .filter(|line| !line.is_empty())
2001:         {
2002:             if !line.contains("rustynetd") {
2003:                 continue;
2004:             }
2005:             rustynet_listener_lines.push(line.to_string());
2006:             let parts = line.split_whitespace().collect::<Vec<_>>();
2007:             if parts.len() < 5 {
2008:                 tcp_listener_ok = false;
2009:                 udp_listener_ok = false;
2010:                 continue;
2011:             }
2012:             let proto = parts[0];
2013:             let local_addr = parts[4];
2014:             if proto.starts_with("tcp") {
2015:                 tcp_listener_ok = false;
2016:             } else if proto.starts_with("udp") {
2017:                 if local_addr != allowed_udp {
2018:                     udp_listener_ok = false;
2019:                 }
2020:             } else {
2021:                 udp_listener_ok = false;
2022:             }
2023:         }
2024: 
2025:         if !daemon_ok || !helper_ok || !tcp_listener_ok || !udp_listener_ok {
2026:             overall = CHECK_FAIL.to_string();
2027:         }
2028: 
2029:         host_results.insert(
2030:             label.to_string(),
2031:             json!({
2032:                 "checks": {
2033:                     "daemon_socket_secure": if daemon_ok { CHECK_PASS } else { CHECK_FAIL },
2034:                     "helper_socket_secure": if helper_ok { CHECK_PASS } else { CHECK_FAIL },
2035:                     "no_rustynet_tcp_listener": if tcp_listener_ok { CHECK_PASS } else { CHECK_FAIL },
2036:                     "rustynet_udp_loopback_only": if udp_listener_ok { CHECK_PASS } else { CHECK_FAIL },
2037:                 },
2038:                 "evidence": {
2039:                     "daemon_socket_meta": daemon_meta_trimmed,
2040:                     "helper_socket_meta": helper_meta_trimmed,
2041:                     "managed_dns_service_state": dns_service_state.trim(),
2042:                     "rustynet_listener_lines": rustynet_listener_lines,
2043:                 }
2044:             }),
2045:         );
2046:     }
2047: 
2048:     if remote_dns_probe_status == CHECK_FAIL {
2049:         overall = CHECK_FAIL.to_string();
2050:     }
2051: 
2052:     let all_daemon_ok = host_results.values().all(|value| {
2053:         value
2054:             .get("checks")
2055:             .and_then(|checks| checks.get("daemon_socket_secure"))
2056:             .and_then(Value::as_str)
2057:             == Some(CHECK_PASS)
2058:     });
2059:     let all_helper_ok = host_results.values().all(|value| {
2060:         value
2061:             .get("checks")
2062:             .and_then(|checks| checks.get("helper_socket_secure"))
2063:             .and_then(Value::as_str)
2064:             == Some(CHECK_PASS)
2065:     });
2066:     let all_no_tcp = host_results.values().all(|value| {
2067:         value
2068:             .get("checks")
2069:             .and_then(|checks| checks.get("no_rustynet_tcp_listener"))
2070:             .and_then(Value::as_str)
2071:             == Some(CHECK_PASS)
2072:     });
2073:     let all_udp_loopback = host_results.values().all(|value| {
2074:         value
2075:             .get("checks")
2076:             .and_then(|checks| checks.get("rustynet_udp_loopback_only"))
2077:             .and_then(Value::as_str)
2078:             == Some(CHECK_PASS)
2079:     });
2080: 
2081:     let payload = json!({
2082:         "phase": "phase10",
2083:         "mode": "live_linux_control_surface_exposure",
2084:         "evidence_mode": "measured",
2085:         "captured_at": captured_at,
2086:         "captured_at_unix": captured_at_unix,
2087:         "status": overall,
2088:         "dns_bind_addr": config.dns_bind_addr,
2089:         "checks": {
2090:             "all_daemon_sockets_secure": if all_daemon_ok { CHECK_PASS } else { CHECK_FAIL },
2091:             "all_helper_sockets_secure": if all_helper_ok { CHECK_PASS } else { CHECK_FAIL },
2092:             "no_rustynet_tcp_listeners": if all_no_tcp { CHECK_PASS } else { CHECK_FAIL },
2093:             "rustynet_udp_loopback_only": if all_udp_loopback { CHECK_PASS } else { CHECK_FAIL },
2094:             "remote_underlay_dns_probe_blocked": remote_dns_probe_status,
2095:         },
2096:         "hosts": Value::Object(host_results),
2097:         "evidence": {
2098:             "remote_underlay_dns_probe_output": config.remote_dns_probe_output,
2099:         },
2100:     });
2101:     write_json_pretty(report_path.as_path(), &payload)?;
2102:     Ok(payload
2103:         .get("status")
2104:         .and_then(Value::as_str)
2105:         .unwrap_or(CHECK_FAIL)
2106:         .to_string())
2107: }

2109: pub fn execute_ops_rewrite_assignment_peer_endpoint_ip(
2110:     config: RewriteAssignmentPeerEndpointIpConfig,
2111: ) -> Result<String, String> {
2112:     let assignment_path = resolve_path(config.assignment_path.as_path())?;
2113:     let endpoint_ip = config
2114:         .endpoint_ip
2115:         .trim()
2116:         .parse::<Ipv4Addr>()
2117:         .map_err(|err| {
2118:             format!(
2119:                 "invalid endpoint IPv4 address {:?}: {err}",
2120:                 config.endpoint_ip
2121:             )
2122:         })?
2123:         .to_string();
2124:     let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(assignment_path.as_path()).map_err(|err| {
2125:         format!(
2126:             "stat assignment path failed ({}): {err}",
2127:             assignment_path.display()
2128:         )
2129:     })?;
2130:     if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
2131:         return Err(format!(
2132:             "assignment path must not be a symlink: {}",
2133:             assignment_path.display()
2134:         ));
2135:     }
2136:     if !metadata.file_type().is_file() {
2137:         return Err(format!(
2138:             "assignment path must be a regular file: {}",
2139:             assignment_path.display()
2140:         ));
2141:     }
2142: 
2143:     let body = fs::read_to_string(assignment_path.as_path()).map_err(|err| {
2144:         format!(
2145:             "read assignment path failed ({}): {err}",
2146:             assignment_path.display()
2147:         )
2148:     })?;
2149:     let mut replaced = 0usize;
2150:     let mut updated = Vec::new();
2151:     for line in body.lines() {
2152:         let mut line_out = line.to_string();
2153:         if let Some((key, value)) = line.split_once('=')
2154:             && is_peer_endpoint_key(key.trim())
2155:         {
2156:             let (_, port) = split_endpoint_host_port(value).ok_or_else(|| {
2157:                 format!(
2158:                     "invalid peer endpoint value {:?} in {}",
2159:                     value.trim(),
2160:                     assignment_path.display()
2161:                 )
2162:             })?;
2163:             let port_num = port.parse::<u16>().map_err(|err| {
2164:                 format!(
2165:                     "invalid endpoint port {:?} in {}: {err}",
2166:                     port,
2167:                     assignment_path.display()
2168:                 )
2169:             })?;
2170:             line_out = format!("{}={endpoint_ip}:{port_num}", key.trim());
2171:             replaced += 1;
2172:         }
2173:         updated.push(line_out);
2174:     }
2175:     if replaced == 0 {
2176:         return Err(format!(
2177:             "failed to locate peer endpoint fields in assignment bundle ({})",
2178:             assignment_path.display()
2179:         ));
2180:     }
2181:     fs::write(
2182:         assignment_path.as_path(),
2183:         format!("{}\n", updated.join("\n")),
2184:     )
2185:     .map_err(|err| {
2186:         format!(
2187:             "write assignment path failed ({}): {err}",
2188:             assignment_path.display()
2189:         )
2190:     })?;
2191:     Ok(replaced.to_string())
2192: }

2194: pub fn execute_ops_rewrite_assignment_mesh_cidr(

2196: ) -> Result<String, String> {

2200:         format!(
2201:             "stat assignment path failed ({}): {err}",

2203:         )
2204:     })?;

2206:         return Err(format!(
2207:             "assignment path must not be a symlink: {}",
2208:             assignment_path.display()
2209:         ));
2210:     }
2211:     if !metadata.file_type().is_file() {
2212:         return Err(format!(
2213:             "assignment path must be a regular file: {}",
2214:             assignment_path.display()
2215:         ));
2216:     }
2217:

2220:             "read assignment path failed ({}): {err}",
2221:             assignment_path.display()
2222:         )
2223:     })?;
2224:     let mut rewritten = false;
2225:     let mut updated = Vec::new();

2236:     if !rewritten {
2237:         return Err(format!(
2238:             "failed to locate mesh_cidr field in assignment bundle ({})",
2239:             assignment_path.display()
2240:         ));
2241:     }
2242:     fs::write(
2243:         assignment_path.as_path(),
2244:         format!("{}\n", updated.join("\n")),
2245:     )
2246:     .map_err(|err| {
2247:         format!(
2248:             "write assignment path failed ({}): {err}",
2249:             assignment_path.display()
2250:         )
2251:     })?;
2252:     Ok(mesh_cidr)
2253: }

2504: pub fn execute_ops_e2e_dns_query(config: E2eDnsQueryConfig) -> Result<String, String> {
2505:     let server = config
2506:         .server
2507:         .trim()
2508:         .parse::<IpAddr>()
2509:         .map_err(|err| format!("invalid --server value {:?}: {err}", config.server))?;
2510:     let qname = validate_dns_qname(config.qname.as_str())?;
2511:     let timeout_ms = if config.timeout_ms == 0 {
2512:         1000
2513:     } else {
2514:         config.timeout_ms.min(60_000)
2515:     };
2516:     let socket = UdpSocket::bind(dns_query_bind_addr(server))
2517:         .map_err(|err| format!("bind UDP socket failed: {err}"))?;
2518:     let timeout = Duration::from_millis(timeout_ms);
2519:     socket
2520:         .set_read_timeout(Some(timeout))
2521:         .map_err(|err| format!("set UDP read timeout failed: {err}"))?;
2522:     socket
2523:         .set_write_timeout(Some(timeout))
2524:         .map_err(|err| format!("set UDP write timeout failed: {err}"))?;
2525: 
2526:     let packet = build_dns_query_packet(qname.as_str());
2527:     let server_addr = SocketAddr::new(server, config.port);
2528:     let mut result = json!({
2529:         "rcode": -1,
2530:         "answer_count": 0,
2531:         "answer_ip": "",
2532:         "answer_ttl": 0,
2533:         "error": "",
2534:     });
2535: 
2536:     let query_outcome = (|| -> Result<(), String> {
2537:         socket
2538:             .send_to(packet.as_slice(), server_addr)
2539:             .map_err(|err| format!("dns query send failed: {err}"))?;
2540:         let mut response = [0u8; 512];
2541:         let (size, _) = socket
2542:             .recv_from(&mut response)
2543:             .map_err(|err| format!("dns query receive failed: {err}"))?;
2544:         if size < 12 {
2545:             return Err("dns response too short".to_string());
2546:         }
2547:         let flags = u16::from_be_bytes([response[2], response[3]]);
2548:         let rcode = (flags & 0x000F) as i64;
2549:         let answer_count = u16::from_be_bytes([response[6], response[7]]) as u64;
2550:         let (rcode, answer_count, answer_ip, answer_ttl) =
2551:             decode_first_dns_answer(&response[..size], rcode, answer_count)?;
2552:         result["rcode"] = Value::from(rcode);
2553:         result["answer_count"] = Value::from(answer_count);
2554:         result["answer_ip"] = Value::from(answer_ip);
2555:         result["answer_ttl"] = Value::from(answer_ttl);
2556:         Ok(())
2557:     })();
2558: 
2559:     if let Err(err) = query_outcome {
2560:         result["error"] = Value::from(err);
2561:     }
2562:     let output =
2563:         serde_json::to_string(&result).map_err(|err| format!("serialize JSON failed: {err}"))?;
2564:     if config.fail_on_no_response
2565:         && result
2566:             .get("error")
2567:             .and_then(Value::as_str)
2568:             .map(|value| !value.is_empty())
2569:             .unwrap_or(false)
2570:     {
2571:         return Err(result
2572:             .get("error")
2573:             .and_then(Value::as_str)
2574:             .unwrap_or("dns query failed")
2575:             .to_string());
2576:     }
2577:     Ok(output)
2578: }
2579: 
2580: fn dns_query_bind_addr(server: IpAddr) -> SocketAddr {
2581:     match server {
2582:         IpAddr::V4(addr) if addr.is_loopback() => {
2583:             SocketAddr::V4(SocketAddrV4::new(Ipv4Addr::LOCALHOST, 0))
2584:         }
2585:         IpAddr::V4(_) => SocketAddr::V4(SocketAddrV4::new(Ipv4Addr::UNSPECIFIED, 0)),
2586:         IpAddr::V6(addr) if addr.is_loopback() => {
2587:             SocketAddr::new(IpAddr::V6(Ipv6Addr::LOCALHOST), 0)
2588:         }
2589:         IpAddr::V6(_) => SocketAddr::new(IpAddr::V6(Ipv6Addr::UNSPECIFIED), 0),
2590:     }
2591: }

2593: pub fn execute_ops_e2e_http_probe_server(
2594:     config: E2eHttpProbeServerConfig,
2595: ) -> Result<String, String> {
2596:     let bind_ip = config
2597:         .bind_ip
2598:         .trim()
2599:         .parse::<Ipv4Addr>()
2600:         .map_err(|err| format!("invalid --bind-ip value {:?}: {err}", config.bind_ip))?;
2601:     let response_body = if config.response_body.is_empty() {
2602:         "probe-ok".to_string()
2603:     } else {
2604:         config.response_body
2605:     };
2606:     let listener = TcpListener::bind(SocketAddrV4::new(bind_ip, config.port))
2607:         .map_err(|err| format!("bind HTTP probe server failed: {err}"))?;
2608:     for incoming in listener.incoming() {
2609:         let mut stream = match incoming {
2610:             Ok(value) => value,
2611:             Err(_) => continue,
2612:         };
2613:         let _ = stream.set_read_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(2)));
2614:         let _ = stream.set_write_timeout(Some(Duration::from_secs(2)));
2615:         let mut request_buf = [0u8; 1024];
2616:         let _ = stream.read(&mut request_buf);
2617:         let body = response_body.as_bytes();
2618:         let header = format!(
2619:             "HTTP/1.1 200 OK\r\nContent-Type: text/plain\r\nContent-Length: {}\r\nConnection: close\r\n\r\n",
2620:             body.len()
2621:         );
2622:         if stream.write_all(header.as_bytes()).is_err() {
2623:             continue;
2624:         }
2625:         let _ = stream.write_all(body);
2626:         let _ = stream.flush();
2627:     }
2628:     Err("HTTP probe server listener terminated unexpectedly".to_string())
2629: }

2631: pub fn execute_ops_e2e_http_probe_client(
2632:     config: E2eHttpProbeClientConfig,
2633: ) -> Result<String, String> {
2634:     let host = config
2635:         .host
2636:         .trim()
2637:         .parse::<IpAddr>()
2638:         .map_err(|err| format!("invalid --host value {:?}: {err}", config.host))?;
2639:     let timeout_ms = if config.timeout_ms == 0 {
2640:         2000
2641:     } else {
2642:         config.timeout_ms.min(60_000)
2643:     };
2644:     let timeout = Duration::from_millis(timeout_ms);
2645:     let target = SocketAddr::new(host, config.port);
2646:     let mut stream = TcpStream::connect_timeout(&target, timeout)
2647:         .map_err(|err| format!("TCP connect failed: {err}"))?;
2648:     stream
2649:         .set_read_timeout(Some(timeout))
2650:         .map_err(|err| format!("set TCP read timeout failed: {err}"))?;
2651:     stream
2652:         .set_write_timeout(Some(timeout))
2653:         .map_err(|err| format!("set TCP write timeout failed: {err}"))?;
2654:     stream
2655:         .write_all(b"GET / HTTP/1.0\r\nHost: probe\r\n\r\n")
2656:         .map_err(|err| format!("TCP probe write failed: {err}"))?;
2657:     let mut response = vec![0u8; 4096];
2658:     let read_size = stream
2659:         .read(response.as_mut_slice())
2660:         .map_err(|err| format!("TCP probe read failed: {err}"))?;
2661:     let response_text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&response[..read_size]).to_string();
2662:     if !response_text.contains(config.expect_marker.as_str()) {
2663:         return Err("probe marker missing from response".to_string());
2664:     }
2665:     Ok(config.expect_marker)
2666: }

2668: pub fn execute_ops_read_json_field(config: ReadJsonFieldConfig) -> Result<String, String> {
2669:     let payload = serde_json::from_str::<Value>(config.payload.as_str())
2670:         .map_err(|err| format!("parse --payload JSON failed: {err}"))?;
2671:     let object = payload
2672:         .as_object()
2673:         .ok_or_else(|| "--payload must be a JSON object".to_string())?;
2674:     let value = object.get(config.field.as_str());
2675:     match value {
2676:         None => Ok(String::new()),
2677:         Some(Value::Null) => Ok(String::new()),
2678:         Some(Value::Bool(flag)) => {
2679:             if *flag {
2680:                 Ok("true".to_string())
2681:             } else {
2682:                 Ok("false".to_string())
2683:             }
2684:         }
2685:         Some(Value::String(text)) => Ok(text.clone()),
2686:         Some(Value::Number(number)) => Ok(number.to_string()),
2687:         Some(other) => {
2688:             serde_json::to_string(other).map_err(|err| format!("serialize field failed: {err}"))
2689:         }
2690:     }
2691: }

2693: pub fn execute_ops_extract_managed_dns_expected_ip(
2694:     config: ExtractManagedDnsExpectedIpConfig,
2695: ) -> Result<String, String> {
2696:     let fqdn = config.fqdn.trim().to_string();
2697:     if fqdn.is_empty() {
2698:         return Err("--fqdn must be non-empty".to_string());
2699:     }
2700:     let fqdn_token = format!("fqdn={fqdn}");
2701:     for line in config.inspect_output.lines() {
2702:         let tokens = line.split_whitespace().collect::<Vec<_>>();
2703:         if tokens.contains(&fqdn_token.as_str()) {
2704:             for token in &tokens {
2705:                 if let Some(value) = token.strip_prefix("expected_ip=") {
2706:                     return Ok(value.to_string());
2707:                 }
2708:             }
2709:         }
2710: 
2711:         for (index, token) in tokens.iter().enumerate() {
2712:             let Some(record_token) = token.strip_prefix("record.") else {
2713:                 continue;
2714:             };
2715:             let Some((record_index, token_fqdn)) = record_token.split_once(".fqdn=") else {
2716:                 continue;
2717:             };
2718:             if token_fqdn != fqdn {
2719:                 continue;
2720:             }
2721: 
2722:             let expected_ip_prefix = format!("record.{record_index}.expected_ip=");
2723:             for candidate in &tokens {
2724:                 if let Some(value) = candidate.strip_prefix(expected_ip_prefix.as_str()) {
2725:                     return Ok(value.to_string());
2726:                 }
2727:             }
2728: 
2729:             for candidate in tokens.iter().skip(index + 1) {
2730:                 if let Some(value) = candidate.strip_prefix("expected_ip=") {
2731:                     return Ok(value.to_string());
2732:                 }
2733:             }
2734:         }
2735:     }
2736:     Ok(String::new())
2737: }
2738: 
2739: pub fn execute_ops_write_active_network_signed_state_tamper_report(
2740:     config: WriteActiveNetworkSignedStateTamperReportConfig,
2741: ) -> Result<String, String> {
2742:     let report_path = resolve_path(config.report_path.as_path())?;
2743:     let baseline_status = parse_pass_fail(config.baseline_status.as_str(), "--baseline-status")?;
2744:     let tamper_reject_status = parse_pass_fail(
2745:         config.tamper_reject_status.as_str(),
2746:         "--tamper-reject-status",
2747:     )?;
2748:     let fail_closed_status =
2749:         parse_pass_fail(config.fail_closed_status.as_str(), "--fail-closed-status")?;
2750:     let netcheck_fail_closed_status = parse_pass_fail(
2751:         config.netcheck_fail_closed_status.as_str(),
2752:         "--netcheck-fail-closed-status",
2753:     )?;
2754:     let recovery_status = parse_pass_fail(config.recovery_status.as_str(), "--recovery-status")?;
2755:     let captured_at_unix = if config.captured_at_unix == 0 {
2756:         unix_now()
2757:     } else {
2758:         config.captured_at_unix
2759:     };
2760:     let captured_at = if config.captured_at_utc.trim().is_empty() {
2761:         format!("{captured_at_unix}")
2762:     } else {
2763:         config.captured_at_utc.trim().to_string()
2764:     };
2765: 
2766:     let checks = json!({
2767:         "baseline_two_node_e2e": baseline_status,
2768:         "tampered_signed_assignment_rejected": tamper_reject_status,
2769:         "fail_closed_engaged": fail_closed_status,
2770:         "netcheck_reports_fail_closed": netcheck_fail_closed_status,
2771:         "recovery_restored_secure_runtime": recovery_status,
2772:     });
2773:     let status = if checks
2774:         .as_object()
2775:         .map(|items| {
2776:             items
2777:                 .values()
2778:                 .all(|value| value.as_str() == Some(CHECK_PASS))
2779:         })
2780:         .unwrap_or(false)
2781:     {
2782:         CHECK_PASS
2783:     } else {
2784:         CHECK_FAIL
2785:     };
2786:     let payload = json!({
2787:         "phase": "phase10",
2788:         "mode": "active_network_signed_state_tamper",
2789:         "evidence_mode": "measured",
2790:         "captured_at": captured_at,
2791:         "captured_at_unix": captured_at_unix,
2792:         "status": status,
2793:         "hosts": {
2794:             "exit_host": config.exit_host,
2795:             "client_host": config.client_host,
2796:         },
2797:         "checks": checks,
2798:         "evidence": {
2799:             "status_after_tamper": config.status_after_tamper,
2800:             "netcheck_after_tamper": config.netcheck_after_tamper,
2801:             "status_after_recovery": config.status_after_recovery,
2802:         },
2803:     });
2804:     write_json_pretty(report_path.as_path(), &payload)?;
2805:     Ok(payload
2806:         .get("status")
2807:         .and_then(Value::as_str)
2808:         .unwrap_or(CHECK_FAIL)
2809:         .to_string())
2810: }
