2812: pub fn execute_ops_write_active_network_rogue_path_hijack_report(
2813:     config: WriteActiveNetworkRoguePathHijackReportConfig,
2814: ) -> Result<String, String> {
2815:     let report_path = resolve_path(config.report_path.as_path())?;
2816:     let rogue_endpoint_ip = config
2817:         .rogue_endpoint_ip
2818:         .trim()
2819:         .parse::<Ipv4Addr>()
2820:         .map_err(|err| {
2821:             format!(
2822:                 "invalid rogue endpoint IPv4 address {:?}: {err}",
2823:                 config.rogue_endpoint_ip
2824:             )
2825:         })?
2826:         .to_string();
2827:     let baseline_status = parse_pass_fail(config.baseline_status.as_str(), "--baseline-status")?;
2828:     let hijack_reject_status = parse_pass_fail(
2829:         config.hijack_reject_status.as_str(),
2830:         "--hijack-reject-status",
2831:     )?;
2832:     let fail_closed_status =
2833:         parse_pass_fail(config.fail_closed_status.as_str(), "--fail-closed-status")?;
2834:     let netcheck_fail_closed_status = parse_pass_fail(
2835:         config.netcheck_fail_closed_status.as_str(),
2836:         "--netcheck-fail-closed-status",
2837:     )?;
2838:     let no_rogue_endpoint_status = parse_pass_fail(
2839:         config.no_rogue_endpoint_status.as_str(),
2840:         "--no-rogue-endpoint-status",
2841:     )?;
2842:     let recovery_status = parse_pass_fail(config.recovery_status.as_str(), "--recovery-status")?;
2843:     let recovery_endpoint_status = parse_pass_fail(
2844:         config.recovery_endpoint_status.as_str(),
2845:         "--recovery-endpoint-status",
2846:     )?;
2847:     let captured_at_unix = if config.captured_at_unix == 0 {
2848:         unix_now()
2849:     } else {
2850:         config.captured_at_unix
2851:     };
2852:     let captured_at = if config.captured_at_utc.trim().is_empty() {
2853:         format!("{captured_at_unix}")
2854:     } else {
2855:         config.captured_at_utc.trim().to_string()
2856:     };
2857: 
2858:     let checks = json!({
2859:         "baseline_two_node_e2e": baseline_status,
2860:         "forged_endpoint_assignment_rejected": hijack_reject_status,
2861:         "fail_closed_engaged": fail_closed_status,
2862:         "netcheck_reports_fail_closed": netcheck_fail_closed_status,
2863:         "rogue_endpoint_not_adopted": no_rogue_endpoint_status,
2864:         "recovery_restored_secure_runtime": recovery_status,
2865:         "recovery_keeps_rogue_endpoint_rejected": recovery_endpoint_status,
2866:     });
2867:     let status = if checks
2868:         .as_object()
2869:         .map(|items| {
2870:             items
2871:                 .values()
2872:                 .all(|value| value.as_str() == Some(CHECK_PASS))
2873:         })
2874:         .unwrap_or(false)
2875:     {
2876:         CHECK_PASS
2877:     } else {
2878:         CHECK_FAIL
2879:     };
2880:     let payload = json!({
2881:         "phase": "phase10",
2882:         "mode": "active_network_rogue_path_hijack",
2883:         "evidence_mode": "measured",
2884:         "captured_at": captured_at,
2885:         "captured_at_unix": captured_at_unix,
2886:         "status": status,
2887:         "hosts": {
2888:             "exit_host": config.exit_host,
2889:             "client_host": config.client_host,
2890:         },
2891:         "rogue_endpoint_ip": rogue_endpoint_ip,
2892:         "checks": checks,
2893:         "evidence": {
2894:             "wg_endpoints_before": config.endpoints_before,
2895:             "wg_endpoints_after_hijack": config.endpoints_after_hijack,
2896:             "wg_endpoints_after_recovery": config.endpoints_after_recovery,
2897:             "status_after_hijack": config.status_after_hijack,
2898:             "netcheck_after_hijack": config.netcheck_after_hijack,
2899:             "status_after_recovery": config.status_after_recovery,
2900:         },
2901:     });
2902:     write_json_pretty(report_path.as_path(), &payload)?;
2903:     Ok(payload
2904:         .get("status")
2905:         .and_then(Value::as_str)
2906:         .unwrap_or(CHECK_FAIL)
2907:         .to_string())
2908: }

3519:         fs::write(stage_dir.join("alpha.txt"), "alpha").expect("alpha write");

3653:             "client\tdebian@client\tclient-1\tclient\n",
3654:         )
3655:         .expect("nodes write");
3656: 
3657:         let output = stage_dir.join("bundle_validation.json");
3658:         let err = execute_ops_validate_cross_network_forensics_bundle(
3659:             ValidateCrossNetworkForensicsBundleConfig {
3660:                 nodes_tsv: stage_dir.join("nodes.tsv"),
3661:                 stage_name: "cross_network_direct_remote_exit".to_string(),
3662:                 stage_dir: stage_dir.clone(),
3663:                 output: output.clone(),
3664:             },
3665:         )
3666:         .expect_err("bundle validation should fail");
3667:         assert!(err.contains("bundle validation failed"));
3668: 
3669:         let payload: Value =
3670:             serde_json::from_str(&fs::read_to_string(output.as_path()).expect("validation json"))
3671:                 .expect("validation json parses");
3672:         assert_eq!(
3673:             payload.get("bundle_status").and_then(Value::as_str),
3674:             Some("fail")
3675:         );
3676:         assert!(
3677:             payload
3678:                 .get("missing_file_count")
3679:                 .and_then(Value::as_u64)
3680:                 .unwrap_or_default()
3681:                 > 0
3682:         );
3683: 
3684:         let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(stage_dir);
3685:     }
3686: }

  49: fn resolve_path(path: &Path) -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
  50:     if path.is_absolute() {
  51:         return Ok(path.to_path_buf());
  52:     }
  53:     let cwd = std::env::current_dir()
  54:         .map_err(|err| format!("resolve current directory failed: {err}"))?;
  55:     Ok(cwd.join(path))
  56: }

  58: fn decode_base64(value: &str) -> Result<Vec<u8>, String> {
  59:     const TABLE: &str = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/";
  60:     let mut reverse = BTreeMap::new();
  61:     for (index, ch) in TABLE.chars().enumerate() {
  62:         reverse.insert(ch, index as u8);
  63:     }
  64:     let clean = value
  65:         .chars()
  66:         .filter(|ch| !ch.is_ascii_whitespace())
  67:         .collect::<Vec<_>>();
  68:     if clean.is_empty() || clean.len() % 4 != 0 {
  69:         return Err("invalid base64".to_string());
  70:     }
  71:     let mut output = Vec::with_capacity(clean.len() / 4 * 3);
  72:     for chunk in clean.chunks(4) {
  73:         let mut sextets = [0u8; 4];
  74:         let mut padding = 0usize;
  75:         for (index, ch) in chunk.iter().enumerate() {
  76:             if *ch == '=' {
  77:                 sextets[index] = 0;
  78:                 padding += 1;
  79:             } else if let Some(value) = reverse.get(ch) {
  80:                 sextets[index] = *value;
  81:             } else {
  82:                 return Err("invalid base64".to_string());
  83:             }
  84:         }
  85:         let b0 = (sextets[0] << 2) | (sextets[1] >> 4);
  86:         let b1 = ((sextets[1] & 0x0f) << 4) | (sextets[2] >> 2);
  87:         let b2 = ((sextets[2] & 0x03) << 6) | sextets[3];
  88:         output.push(b0);
  89:         if padding < 2 {
  90:             output.push(b1);
  91:         }
  92:         if padding < 1 {
  93:             output.push(b2);
  94:         }
  95:     }
  96:     Ok(output)
  97: }
  98: 
  99: fn decode_b64_32(value: &str) -> bool {
 100:     match decode_base64(value) {
 101:         Ok(decoded) => decoded.len() == 32,
 102:         Err(_) => false,
 103:     }
 104: }

 106: fn valid_node_id(value: &str) -> bool {
 107:     !value.is_empty()
 108:         && value
 109:             .bytes()
 110:             .all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(byte, b'.' | b'_' | b'-'))
 111: }

 113: fn valid_host_like(value: &str) -> bool {
 114:     !value.is_empty()
 115:         && value
 116:             .bytes()
 117:             .all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(byte, b'.' | b'_' | b':' | b'-'))
 118: }

 120: fn validate_host_endpoint(endpoint: &str) -> bool {
 121:     let Some((host, raw_port)) = endpoint.rsplit_once(':') else {
 122:         return false;
 123:     };
 124:     if host.is_empty() || raw_port.is_empty() || !raw_port.bytes().all(|byte| byte.is_ascii_digit())
 125:     {
 126:         return false;
 127:     }
 128:     let Ok(port) = raw_port.parse::<u16>() else {
 129:         return false;
 130:     };
 131:     if port == 0 {
 132:         return false;
 133:     }
 134:     if host.parse::<IpAddr>().is_ok() {
 135:         return true;
 136:     }
 137:     valid_host_like(host)
 138: }

 140: fn validate_absolute_path(raw: Option<&Value>) -> bool {
 141:     matches!(raw, Some(Value::String(value)) if value.starts_with('/'))

 144: fn validate_no_secrets(payload: &Value, problems: &mut Vec<String>, path: &str) {
 145:     match payload {
 146:         Value::Object(object) => {
 147:             for (key, value) in object {
 148:                 let lowered = key.to_ascii_lowercase();
 149:                 if FORBIDDEN_KEY_NAME_TOKENS
 150:                     .iter()
 151:                     .any(|token| lowered.contains(token))
 152:                 {
 153:                     problems.push(format!("{path}.{key}: forbidden secret-like key name"));
 154:                 }
 155:                 validate_no_secrets(value, problems, format!("{path}.{key}").as_str());
 156:             }
 157:         }
 158:         Value::Array(array) => {
 159:             for (index, item) in array.iter().enumerate() {
 160:                 validate_no_secrets(item, problems, format!("{path}[{index}]").as_str());
 161:             }
 162:         }
 163:         Value::String(value) => {
 164:             for token in FORBIDDEN_STRING_TOKENS {
 165:                 if value.contains(token) {
 166:                     problems.push(format!(
 167:                         "{path}: contains forbidden secret-like token {token:?}"
 168:                     ));
 169:                 }
 170:             }
 171:         }
 172:         _ => {}
 173:     }
 174: }

 520: fn render_markdown(results: &[(PathBuf, Vec<String>)]) -> String {
 521:     let mut lines = vec![
 522:         "# Network Discovery Bundle Validation".to_string(),
 523:         String::new(),
 524:     ];
 525:     for (bundle_path, errors) in results {
 526:         lines.push(format!("## `{}`", bundle_path.display()));
 527:         lines.push(String::new());
 528:         if errors.is_empty() {
 529:             lines.push("- Validation passed.".to_string());
 530:         } else {
 531:             for error in errors {
 532:                 lines.push(format!("- {error}"));
 533:             }
 534:         }
 535:         lines.push(String::new());
 536:     }
 537:     lines.join("\n")
 538: }

 540: fn write_markdown(path: &Path, body: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
 541:     if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
 542:         fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|err| {
 543:             format!(
 544:                 "create output parent directory failed ({}): {err}",
 545:                 parent.display()
 546:             )
 547:         })?;
 548:     }
 549:     fs::write(path, body).map_err(|err| format!("write output failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))
 550: }
 551: 
 552: pub fn execute_ops_validate_network_discovery_bundle(
 553:     config: ValidateNetworkDiscoveryBundleConfig,
 554: ) -> Result<String, String> {
 555:     if config.max_age_seconds == 0 {
 556:         return Err("--max-age-seconds must be > 0".to_string());
 557:     }
 558:     if config.bundles.is_empty() {
 559:         return Err("at least one bundle path is required (--bundle or --bundles)".to_string());
 560:     }
 561: 
 562:     let validation_config = ValidationConfig {
 563:         max_age_seconds: config.max_age_seconds,
 564:         require_verifier_keys: config.require_verifier_keys,
 565:         require_daemon_active: config.require_daemon_active,
 566:         require_socket_present: config.require_socket_present,
 567:     };
 568: 
 569:     let mut results = Vec::new();
 570:     let mut overall_errors = Vec::new();
 571:     for bundle in &config.bundles {
 572:         let bundle_path = resolve_path(bundle)?;
 573:         if !bundle_path.is_file() {
 574:             let errors = vec![format!(
 575:                 "{}: bundle file does not exist",
 576:                 bundle_path.display()
 577:             )];
 578:             overall_errors.extend(errors.iter().cloned());
 579:             results.push((bundle_path, errors));
 580:             continue;
 581:         }
 582:         let body = fs::read_to_string(&bundle_path)
 583:             .map_err(|err| format!("{}: read bundle failed: {err}", bundle_path.display()))?;
 584:         let payload: Value = match serde_json::from_str(&body) {
 585:             Ok(payload) => payload,
 586:             Err(err) => {
 587:                 let errors = vec![format!("{}: invalid JSON ({err})", bundle_path.display())];
 588:                 overall_errors.extend(errors.iter().cloned());
 589:                 results.push((bundle_path, errors));
 590:                 continue;
 591:             }
 592:         };
 593:         let errors = validate_bundle(&bundle_path, &payload, &validation_config);
 594:         overall_errors.extend(errors.iter().cloned());
 595:         results.push((bundle_path, errors));
 596:     }
 597: 
 598:     if let Some(output) = config.output {
 599:         let output_path = resolve_path(&output)?;
 600:         write_markdown(output_path.as_path(), render_markdown(&results).as_str())?;
 601:     }
 602: 
 603:     if overall_errors.is_empty() {
 604:         Ok("network discovery bundle validation passed".to_string())
 605:     } else {
 606:         Err(overall_errors.join("\n"))
 607:     }
 608: }

  70: fn normalize_filter(label: &str, value: Option<String>) -> Result<Option<String>, String> {
  71:     let Some(value) = value else {
  72:         return Ok(None);
  73:     };

  75:     if trimmed.is_empty() {
  76:         return Ok(None);

  82: fn ensure_peer_store_paths(config_dir: &Path, peers_file: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
  83:     ensure_absolute_path("config-dir", config_dir)?;
  84:     ensure_absolute_path("peers-file", peers_file)?;

  91:     }

  94:         format!(

  98:     })?;

 115:     })?;

 117:         format!(
 118:             "failed to canonicalize peer-store parent {}: {err}",
 119:             parent.display()
 120:         )
 121:     })?;
 122:     if config_canonical != parent_canonical {
 123:         return Err(format!(
 124:             "peer-store parent mismatch after canonicalization: peers_file={} config_dir={}",
 125:             peers_file.display(),

 127:         ));
 128:     }

 133: fn ensure_absolute_path(label: &str, path: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {

 140: fn ensure_config_dir(config_dir: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
 141:     if let Ok(metadata) = fs::symlink_metadata(config_dir) {
 142:         if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
 143:             return Err(format!(
 144:                 "refusing to use symlink config directory: {}",
 145:                 config_dir.display()
 146:             ));
 147:         }
 148:         if !metadata.is_dir() {
 149:             return Err(format!(
 150:                 "refusing to use non-directory config path: {}",
 151:                 config_dir.display()
 152:             ));
 153:         }
 154:     } else {
 155:         fs::create_dir_all(config_dir).map_err(|err| {
 156:             format!(
 157:                 "failed to create config directory {}: {err}",
 158:                 config_dir.display()
 159:             )
 160:         })?;
 161:     }
 162:     ensure_unix_owner(config_dir, "config directory")?;
 163:     set_unix_mode(config_dir, 0o700)?;
 164:     Ok(())
 165: }
 166: 
 167: fn ensure_peer_file(peers_file: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
 168:     if let Ok(metadata) = fs::symlink_metadata(peers_file) {
 169:         if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
 170:             return Err(format!(
 171:                 "refusing to use symlink peer store: {}",
 172:                 peers_file.display()
 173:             ));
 174:         }
 175:         if !metadata.is_file() {
 176:             return Err(format!(
 177:                 "refusing to use non-regular peer store path: {}",
 178:                 peers_file.display()
 179:             ));
 180:         }
 181:     } else {
 182:         create_peer_file(peers_file)?;
 183:     }
 184: 
 185:     ensure_unix_owner(peers_file, "peer store")?;
 186:     set_unix_mode(peers_file, 0o600)?;
 187:     Ok(())
 188: }
 189: 
 190: fn create_peer_file(peers_file: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
 191:     let mut file = match OpenOptions::new()
 192:         .write(true)
 193:         .create_new(true)
 194:         .open(peers_file)
 195:     {
 196:         Ok(file) => file,
 197:         Err(err) if err.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::AlreadyExists => {
 198:             return Ok(());
 199:         }
 200:         Err(err) => {
 201:             return Err(format!(
 202:                 "failed to initialize secure peer store {}: {err}",
 203:                 peers_file.display()
 204:             ));
 205:         }
 206:     };
 207:     file.write_all(b"# name|node_id|public_key|endpoint|cidr|role\n")
 208:         .map_err(|err| {
 209:             format!(
 210:                 "failed to write peer-store header {}: {err}",
 211:                 peers_file.display()
 212:             )
 213:         })?;
 214:     file.sync_all()
 215:         .map_err(|err| format!("failed to sync peer store {}: {err}", peers_file.display()))
 216: }

 218: fn ensure_unix_owner(path: &Path, label: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
 219:     use std::os::unix::fs::MetadataExt;
 220: 
 221:     let metadata = fs::metadata(path)
 222:         .map_err(|err| format!("failed to inspect {label} {}: {err}", path.display()))?;
 223:     let owner_uid = metadata.uid();
 224:     let expected_uid = Uid::effective().as_raw();
 225:     if owner_uid != expected_uid {
 226:         return Err(format!(
 227:             "{label} owner is not trusted (path={}, uid={owner_uid}, expected_uid={expected_uid})",
 228:             path.display()
 229:         ));
 230:     }
 231:     Ok(())
 232: }
 233: 
 234: fn set_unix_mode(path: &Path, mode: u32) -> Result<(), String> {
 235:     use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
 236:     let permissions = fs::Permissions::from_mode(mode);
 237:     fs::set_permissions(path, permissions).map_err(|err| {
 238:         format!(
 239:             "failed setting mode {:03o} on {}: {err}",
 240:             mode,
 241:             path.display()
 242:         )
 243:     })
 244: }

 246: fn load_peer_records(peers_file: &Path) -> Result<Vec<PeerRecord>, String> {
 247:     let file = File::open(peers_file)
 248:         .map_err(|err| format!("failed reading peer store {}: {err}", peers_file.display()))?;
 249:     let reader = BufReader::new(file);
 250: 
 251:     let mut records = Vec::new();
 252:     for (index, line_result) in reader.lines().enumerate() {
 253:         let line_no = index + 1;
 254:         let line = line_result.map_err(|err| {
 255:             format!(
 256:                 "failed reading peer store line {line_no} ({}): {err}",
 257:                 peers_file.display()
 258:             )
 259:         })?;
 260:         if line.is_empty() || line.starts_with('#') {
 261:             continue;
 262:         }
 263: 
 264:         let parts = line.split('|').collect::<Vec<_>>();
 265:         if parts.len() > 6 {
 266:             return Err(format!(
 267:                 "peer store line {line_no} is malformed (too many fields)"
 268:             ));
 269:         }
 270: 
 271:         let mut fields = vec![String::new(); 6];
 272:         for (field_index, field_value) in parts.into_iter().enumerate() {
 273:             fields[field_index] = field_value.to_string();
 274:         }
 275: 
 276:         ensure_peer_field_safe("name", fields[0].as_str(), Some(line_no))?;
 277:         ensure_peer_field_safe("node_id", fields[1].as_str(), Some(line_no))?;
 278:         ensure_peer_field_safe("public_key", fields[2].as_str(), Some(line_no))?;
 279:         ensure_peer_field_safe("endpoint", fields[3].as_str(), Some(line_no))?;
 280:         ensure_peer_field_safe("cidr", fields[4].as_str(), Some(line_no))?;
 281:         ensure_peer_field_safe("role", fields[5].as_str(), Some(line_no))?;
 282: 
 283:         records.push(PeerRecord {
 284:             name: fields[0].clone(),
 285:             node_id: fields[1].clone(),
 286:             public_key: fields[2].clone(),
 287:             endpoint: fields[3].clone(),
 288:             cidr: fields[4].clone(),
 289:             role: fields[5].clone(),
 290:         });
 291:     }
 292: 
 293:     Ok(records)
 294: }
 295: 
 296: fn ensure_peer_field_safe(label: &str, value: &str, line_no: Option<usize>) -> Result<(), String> {
 297:     if value.contains('|') {
 298:         return Err(field_error(
 299:             label,
 300:             "contains forbidden delimiter '|'",
 301:             line_no,
 302:         ));
 303:     }
 304:     if value.contains('\n') || value.contains('\r') {
 305:         return Err(field_error(
 306:             label,
 307:             "contains forbidden newline characters",
 308:             line_no,
 309:         ));
 310:     }
 311:     if value.chars().any(|ch| ch.is_control()) {
 312:         return Err(field_error(
 313:             label,
 314:             "contains forbidden control characters",
 315:             line_no,
 316:         ));
 317:     }
 318:     Ok(())
 319: }
 320: 
 321: fn field_error(label: &str, message: &str, line_no: Option<usize>) -> String {
 322:     match line_no {
 323:         Some(line_no) => format!("peer store line {line_no} field '{label}' {message}"),
 324:         None => format!("peer store field '{label}' {message}"),
 325:     }
 326: }

  87: impl Phase1MetricAccumulator {
  88:     fn consume_object(&mut self, entry: &Map<String, Value>, label: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
  89:         let idle_cpu_percent = phase1_require_metric(entry, PHASE1_IDLE_CPU_ALIASES, label)?;
  90:         let idle_memory_mb = phase1_require_metric(entry, PHASE1_IDLE_MEMORY_ALIASES, label)?;
  91:         let reconnect_seconds = phase1_require_metric(entry, PHASE1_RECONNECT_ALIASES, label)?;
  92:         let route_policy_apply_p95_seconds =
  93:             phase1_require_metric(entry, PHASE1_ROUTE_APPLY_ALIASES, label)?;
  94:         let throughput_overhead_percent =
  95:             phase1_require_metric(entry, PHASE1_THROUGHPUT_ALIASES, label)?;
  96:         let backend_throughput_overhead_percent =
  97:             phase1_require_metric(entry, PHASE1_BACKEND_THROUGHPUT_ALIASES, label)?;
  98: 
  99:         self.sample_count += 1;
 100:         phase1_update_max(&mut self.idle_cpu_percent, idle_cpu_percent);
 101:         phase1_update_max(&mut self.idle_memory_mb, idle_memory_mb);
 102:         phase1_update_max(&mut self.reconnect_seconds, reconnect_seconds);
 103:         phase1_update_max(
 104:             &mut self.route_policy_apply_p95_seconds,
 105:             route_policy_apply_p95_seconds,
 106:         );
 107:         phase1_update_max(
 108:             &mut self.throughput_overhead_percent,
 109:             throughput_overhead_percent,
 110:         );
 111:         phase1_update_max(
 112:             &mut self.backend_throughput_overhead_percent,
 113:             backend_throughput_overhead_percent,
 114:         );
 115:         Ok(())
 116:     }
 117: 
 118:     fn into_measured_input(self, source_path: PathBuf) -> Result<Phase1MeasuredInput, String> {
 119:         if self.sample_count == 0 {
 120:             return Err(format!(
 121:                 "no measured entries found in {}",
 122:                 source_path.display()
 123:             ));
 124:         }
 125:         Ok(Phase1MeasuredInput {
 126:             source_path,
 127:             sample_count: self.sample_count,
 128:             idle_cpu_percent: self
 129:                 .idle_cpu_percent
 130:                 .ok_or_else(|| "missing idle_cpu_percent metric".to_string())?,
 131:             idle_memory_mb: self
 132:                 .idle_memory_mb
 133:                 .ok_or_else(|| "missing idle_memory_mb metric".to_string())?,
 134:             reconnect_seconds: self
 135:                 .reconnect_seconds
 136:                 .ok_or_else(|| "missing reconnect_seconds metric".to_string())?,
 137:             route_policy_apply_p95_seconds: self
 138:                 .route_policy_apply_p95_seconds
 139:                 .ok_or_else(|| "missing route_policy_apply_p95_seconds metric".to_string())?,
 140:             throughput_overhead_percent: self
 141:                 .throughput_overhead_percent
 142:                 .ok_or_else(|| "missing throughput_overhead_percent metric".to_string())?,
 143:             backend_throughput_overhead_percent: self
 144:                 .backend_throughput_overhead_percent
 145:                 .ok_or_else(|| "missing backend_throughput_overhead_percent metric".to_string())?,
 146:         })
 147:     }
 148: }
 149: 
 150: fn phase1_update_max(current: &mut Option<f64>, value: f64) {
 151:     let next = match current {
 152:         Some(existing) => (*existing).max(value),
 153:         None => value,
 154:     };
 155:     *current = Some(next);
 156: }
 157: 
 158: fn phase1_value_as_number(value: &Value) -> Option<f64> {
 159:     if value.is_boolean() {
 160:         return None;
 161:     }
 162:     let numeric = value.as_f64()?;
 163:     if !numeric.is_finite() || numeric < 0.0 {
 164:         return None;
 165:     }
 166:     Some(numeric)
 167: }
 168: 
 169: fn phase1_require_metric(
 170:     entry: &Map<String, Value>,
 171:     aliases: &[&str],
 172:     label: &str,
 173: ) -> Result<f64, String> {
 174:     for alias in aliases {
 175:         if let Some(value) = entry.get(*alias).and_then(phase1_value_as_number) {
 176:             return Ok(value);
 177:         }
 178:     }
 179:     Err(format!(
 180:         "missing required metric in {label}; expected one of: {}",
 181:         aliases.join(", ")
 182:     ))
 183: }
 184: 
 185: fn phase1_resolve_path(raw_path: &str) -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
 186:     let trimmed = raw_path.trim();
 187:     if trimmed.is_empty() {
 188:         return Err("path must not be empty".to_string());
 189:     }
 190:     let path = PathBuf::from(trimmed);
 191:     if path.is_absolute() {
 192:         return Ok(path);
 193:     }
 194:     let cwd = std::env::current_dir()
 195:         .map_err(|err| format!("resolve current directory failed: {err}"))?;
 196:     Ok(cwd.join(path))
 197: }
 198: 
 199: fn env_optional_string(key: &str) -> Result<Option<String>, String> {
 200:     match std::env::var(key) {
 201:         Ok(value) => {
 202:             if value.trim().is_empty() {
 203:                 Ok(None)
 204:             } else {
 205:                 Ok(Some(value))
 206:             }
 207:         }
 208:         Err(std::env::VarError::NotPresent) => Ok(None),
 209:         Err(std::env::VarError::NotUnicode(_)) => {
 210:             Err(format!("environment variable {key} contains non-utf8 data"))
 211:         }
 212:     }
 213: }
 214: 
 215: fn phase1_path_from_env_or_default(key: &str, default: &str) -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
 216:     let raw = env_optional_string(key)?.unwrap_or_else(|| default.to_string());
 217:     phase1_resolve_path(raw.as_str())
 218: }
 219: 
 220: fn parse_bool_value(key: &str, value: &str) -> Result<bool, String> {
 221:     match value {
 222:         "true" | "TRUE" | "yes" | "YES" | "1" | "on" | "ON" => Ok(true),
 223:         "false" | "FALSE" | "no" | "NO" | "0" | "off" | "OFF" | "" => Ok(false),
 224:         _ => Err(format!("invalid boolean value for {key}: {value}")),
 225:     }
 226: }
 227: 
 228: fn parse_env_bool_with_default(key: &str, default: &str) -> Result<bool, String> {
 229:     let value = env_optional_string(key)?.unwrap_or_else(|| default.to_string());
 230:     parse_bool_value(key, value.as_str())
 231: }

 233: fn phase1_validate_non_writable_by_group_or_world(
 234:     path: &Path,
 235:     metadata: &fs::Metadata,
 236:     label: &str,
 237: ) -> Result<(), String> {
 238:     let mode = metadata.permissions().mode();
 239:     if mode & 0o022 != 0 {
 240:         return Err(format!(
 241:             "{label} must not be group/world writable ({} mode {:o})",
 242:             path.display(),
 243:             mode & 0o777
 244:         ));
 245:     }
 246:     Ok(())
 247: }
 248: 
 249: fn phase1_validate_trusted_owner(
 250:     path: &Path,
 251:     metadata: &fs::Metadata,
 252:     label: &str,
 253: ) -> Result<(), String> {
 254:     let owner_uid = metadata.uid();
 255:     let expected_uid = Uid::effective().as_raw();
 256:     if owner_uid != expected_uid {
 257:         return Err(format!(
 258:             "{label} owner is not trusted ({} uid={owner_uid} expected_uid={expected_uid})",
 259:             path.display()
 260:         ));
 261:     }
 262:     Ok(())
 263: }
 264: 
 265: fn phase1_harden_file_write_bits_if_needed(
 266:     path: &Path,
 267:     metadata: fs::Metadata,
 268:     label: &str,
 269: ) -> Result<fs::Metadata, String> {
 270:     phase1_validate_trusted_owner(path, &metadata, label)?;
 271:     let mode = metadata.permissions().mode();
 272:     if mode & 0o022 != 0 {
 273:         let hardened_mode = mode & !0o022;
 274:         fs::set_permissions(path, fs::Permissions::from_mode(hardened_mode)).map_err(|err| {
 275:             format!(
 276:                 "failed to harden {label} write bits ({} mode {:o} -> {:o}): {err}",
 277:                 path.display(),
 278:                 mode & 0o777,
 279:                 hardened_mode & 0o777
 280:             )
 281:         })?;
 282:     }
 283:     let refreshed_metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(path).map_err(|err| {
 284:         format!(
 285:             "inspect {label} failed after hardening ({}): {err}",
 286:             path.display()
 287:         )
 288:     })?;
 289:     phase1_validate_non_writable_by_group_or_world(path, &refreshed_metadata, label)?;
 290:     Ok(refreshed_metadata)
 291: }
 292: 
 293: fn phase1_harden_directory_write_bits_if_needed(
 294:     path: &Path,
 295:     metadata: fs::Metadata,
 296:     label: &str,
 297: ) -> Result<fs::Metadata, String> {
 298:     phase1_validate_trusted_owner(path, &metadata, label)?;
 299:     let mode = metadata.permissions().mode();
 300:     if mode & 0o022 != 0 {
 301:         let hardened_mode = mode & !0o022;
 302:         fs::set_permissions(path, fs::Permissions::from_mode(hardened_mode)).map_err(|err| {
 303:             format!(
 304:                 "failed to harden {label} write bits ({} mode {:o} -> {:o}): {err}",
 305:                 path.display(),
 306:                 mode & 0o777,
 307:                 hardened_mode & 0o777
 308:             )
 309:         })?;
 310:     }
 311:     let refreshed_metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(path).map_err(|err| {
 312:         format!(
 313:             "inspect {label} failed after hardening ({}): {err}",
 314:             path.display()
 315:         )
 316:     })?;
 317:     if refreshed_metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
 318:         return Err(format!("{label} must not be a symlink: {}", path.display()));
 319:     }
 320:     if !refreshed_metadata.file_type().is_dir() {
 321:         return Err(format!("{label} must be a directory: {}", path.display()));
 322:     }
 323:     phase1_validate_non_writable_by_group_or_world(path, &refreshed_metadata, label)?;
 324:     Ok(refreshed_metadata)
 325: }
 326: 
 327: fn phase1_validate_secure_directory(path: &Path, label: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
 328:     let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(path)
 329:         .map_err(|err| format!("inspect {label} failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
 330:     if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
 331:         return Err(format!("{label} must not be a symlink: {}", path.display()));
 332:     }
 333:     if !metadata.file_type().is_dir() {
 334:         return Err(format!("{label} must be a directory: {}", path.display()));
 335:     }
 336:     let _ = phase1_harden_directory_write_bits_if_needed(path, metadata, label)?;
 337:     Ok(())
 338: }
 339: 
 340: fn phase1_validate_source_path(path: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
 341:     let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(path).map_err(|err| {
 342:         format!(
 343:             "phase1 metrics source path does not exist: {} ({err})",
 344:             path.display()
 345:         )
 346:     })?;
 347:     if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
 348:         return Err(format!(
 349:             "phase1 metrics source path must not be a symlink: {}",
 350:             path.display()
 351:         ));
 352:     }
 353:     if !metadata.file_type().is_file() {
 354:         return Err(format!(
 355:             "phase1 metrics source path must be a regular file: {}",
 356:             path.display()
 357:         ));
 358:     }
 359:     if metadata.len() == 0 {
 360:         return Err(format!(
 361:             "phase1 metrics source file is empty: {}",
 362:             path.display()
 363:         ));
 364:     }
 365:     let _ = phase1_harden_file_write_bits_if_needed(path, metadata, "phase1 metrics source file")?;
 366:     Ok(())
 367: }

 369: fn resolve_phase1_measured_source_path() -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
 370:     let configured_path = env_optional_string("RUSTYNET_PHASE1_PERF_SAMPLES_PATH")?.ok_or_else(
 371:         || {
 372:             "missing required measured source path: RUSTYNET_PHASE1_PERF_SAMPLES_PATH\n\
 373:              fallback source discovery is disabled for phase1 security gating.\n\
 374:              expected canonical source (default): artifacts/perf/phase1/source/performance_samples.ndjson"
 375:                 .to_string()
 376:         },
 377:     )?;
 378:     let resolved = phase1_resolve_path(configured_path.as_str())?;
 379:     phase1_validate_source_path(resolved.as_path())?;
 380:     Ok(resolved)
 381: }

 383: fn read_json_value(path: &Path, label: &str) -> Result<Value, String> {
 384:     let body = fs::read_to_string(path)
 385:         .map_err(|err| format!("read {label} failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
 386:     serde_json::from_str(body.as_str())
 387:         .map_err(|err| format!("parse {label} failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))
 388: }
 389: 
 390: fn phase1_collect_measured_input_from_source(
 391:     source_path: &Path,
 392: ) -> Result<Phase1MeasuredInput, String> {
 393:     phase1_validate_source_path(source_path)?;
 394:     let mut accumulator = Phase1MetricAccumulator::default();
 395:     let extension = source_path
 396:         .extension()
 397:         .and_then(|value| value.to_str())
 398:         .unwrap_or_default()
 399:         .to_ascii_lowercase();
 400: 
 401:     if extension == "ndjson" {
 402:         let file = fs::File::open(source_path).map_err(|err| {
 403:             format!(
 404:                 "open measured phase1 source failed ({}): {err}",
 405:                 source_path.display()
 406:             )
 407:         })?;
 408:         let reader = BufReader::new(file);
 409:         for (line_index, line_result) in reader.lines().enumerate() {
 410:             let line_number = line_index + 1;
 411:             let line = line_result.map_err(|err| {
 412:                 format!(
 413:                     "read measured source line failed ({}:{}): {err}",
 414:                     source_path.display(),
 415:                     line_number
 416:                 )
 417:             })?;
 418:             let stripped = line.trim();
 419:             if stripped.is_empty() {
 420:                 continue;
 421:             }
 422:             let value: Value = serde_json::from_str(stripped).map_err(|err| {
 423:                 format!(
 424:                     "invalid ndjson at {}:{}: {err}",
 425:                     source_path.display(),
 426:                     line_number
 427:                 )
 428:             })?;
 429:             let object = value.as_object().ok_or_else(|| {
 430:                 format!(
 431:                     "invalid ndjson object at {}:{}",
 432:                     source_path.display(),
 433:                     line_number
 434:                 )
 435:             })?;
 436:             if let Some(mode) = object.get("evidence_mode").and_then(Value::as_str)
 437:                 && mode != "measured"
 438:             {
 439:                 return Err(format!(
 440:                     "ndjson source is not measured evidence at {}:{}: evidence_mode={mode}",
 441:                     source_path.display(),
 442:                     line_number
 443:                 ));
 444:             }
 445:             accumulator.consume_object(
 446:                 object,
 447:                 format!("{}:{}", source_path.display(), line_number).as_str(),
 448:             )?;
 449:         }
 450:         return accumulator.into_measured_input(source_path.to_path_buf());
 451:     }
 452: 
 453:     let payload = read_json_value(source_path, "phase1 measured source payload")?;
 454:     let payload_object = payload
 455:         .as_object()
 456:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("json source must be object: {}", source_path.display()))?;
 457:     if let Some(mode) = payload_object.get("evidence_mode").and_then(Value::as_str)
 458:         && mode != "measured"
 459:     {
 460:         return Err(format!(
 461:             "json source is not measured evidence ({}): evidence_mode={mode}",
 462:             source_path.display()
 463:         ));
 464:     }
 465: 
 466:     if let Some(metrics) = payload_object.get("metrics").and_then(Value::as_array) {
 467:         let mut flattened = Map::new();
 468:         for (index, metric) in metrics.iter().enumerate() {
 469:             let metric_object = metric.as_object().ok_or_else(|| {
 470:                 format!(
 471:                     "invalid metrics entry at index {index} in {}: expected object",
 472:                     source_path.display()
 473:                 )
 474:             })?;
 475:             let Some(name) = metric_object.get("name").and_then(Value::as_str) else {
 476:                 continue;
 477:             };
 478:             let Some(value) = metric_object.get("value").and_then(phase1_value_as_number) else {
 479:                 continue;
 480:             };
 481:             flattened.insert(name.to_string(), json!(value));
 482:         }
 483:         for key in [
 484:             "idle_cpu_percent",
 485:             "idle_memory_mb",
 486:             "idle_rss_mb",
 487:             "reconnect_seconds",
 488:             "reconnect_p95_seconds",
 489:             "route_apply_p95_seconds",
 490:             "route_apply_seconds_p95",
 491:             "throughput_overhead_percent",
 492:             "throughput_overhead_vs_wireguard_percent",
 493:             "backend_throughput_overhead_percent",
 494:             "backend_overhead_percent",
 495:         ] {
 496:             if !flattened.contains_key(key)
 497:                 && let Some(value) = payload_object.get(key).and_then(phase1_value_as_number)
 498:             {
 499:                 flattened.insert(key.to_string(), json!(value));
 500:             }
 501:         }
 502:         accumulator.consume_object(&flattened, source_path.display().to_string().as_str())?;
 503:         return accumulator.into_measured_input(source_path.to_path_buf());
 504:     }
 505: 
 506:     accumulator.consume_object(payload_object, source_path.display().to_string().as_str())?;
 507:     accumulator.into_measured_input(source_path.to_path_buf())
 508: }
 509: 
 510: fn create_secure_temp_file(dir: &Path, prefix: &str) -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
 511:     fs::create_dir_all(dir)
 512:         .map_err(|err| format!("create temp directory {} failed: {err}", dir.display()))?;
 513:     phase1_validate_secure_directory(dir, "phase1 temp directory")?;
 514:     let pid = std::process::id();
 515:     let nonce = SystemTime::now()
 516:         .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
 517:         .map_err(|err| format!("system time before unix epoch: {err}"))?
 518:         .as_nanos();
 519:     for counter in 0..32u32 {
 520:         let candidate = dir.join(format!("{prefix}{pid}-{nonce}-{counter}"));
 521:         let file_open = OpenOptions::new()
 522:             .create_new(true)
 523:             .read(true)
 524:             .write(true)
 525:             .mode(0o600)
 526:             .open(&candidate);
 527:         match file_open {
 528:             Ok(_) => return Ok(candidate),
 529:             Err(err) if err.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::AlreadyExists => continue,
 530:             Err(err) => {
 531:                 return Err(format!(
 532:                     "create secure temp file {} failed: {err}",
 533:                     candidate.display()
 534:                 ));
 535:             }
 536:         }
 537:     }
 538:     Err(format!(
 539:         "unable to allocate secure temporary file in {}",
 540:         dir.display()
 541:     ))
 542: }
 543: 
 544: fn phase1_write_measured_input_artifact(
 545:     output_path: &Path,
 546:     measured_input: &Phase1MeasuredInput,
 547: ) -> Result<(), String> {
 548:     if output_path.exists() {
 549:         let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(output_path).map_err(|err| {
 550:             format!(
 551:                 "inspect phase1 measured output path failed ({}): {err}",
 552:                 output_path.display()
 553:             )
 554:         })?;
 555:         if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
 556:             return Err(format!(
 557:                 "phase1 measured output path must not be a symlink: {}",
 558:                 output_path.display()
 559:             ));
 560:         }
 561:         if !metadata.file_type().is_file() {
 562:             return Err(format!(
 563:                 "phase1 measured output path must be a file: {}",
 564:                 output_path.display()
 565:             ));
 566:         }
 567:         let _ = phase1_harden_file_write_bits_if_needed(
 568:             output_path,
 569:             metadata,
 570:             "phase1 measured output file",
 571:         )?;
 572:     }
 573: 
 574:     let parent = output_path.parent().ok_or_else(|| {
 575:         format!(
 576:             "phase1 measured output path has no parent: {}",
 577:             output_path.display()
 578:         )
 579:     })?;
 580:     fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|err| {
 581:         format!(
 582:             "create phase1 measured output directory failed ({}): {err}",
 583:             parent.display()
 584:         )
 585:     })?;
 586:     phase1_validate_secure_directory(parent, "phase1 measured output directory")?;
 587: 
 588:     let temp_output = create_secure_temp_file(parent, "phase1-measured-input.")?;
 589:     let payload = json!({
 590:         "phase": "phase1",
 591:         "suite": "measured_input_collector",
 592:         "evidence_mode": "measured",
 593:         "captured_at_unix": unix_now(),
 594:         "sample_count": measured_input.sample_count,
 595:         "source_path": measured_input.source_path.display().to_string(),
 596:         "metrics": {
 597:             "idle_cpu_percent": measured_input.idle_cpu_percent,
 598:             "idle_memory_mb": measured_input.idle_memory_mb,
 599:             "reconnect_seconds": measured_input.reconnect_seconds,
 600:             "route_policy_apply_p95_seconds": measured_input.route_policy_apply_p95_seconds,
 601:             "throughput_overhead_percent": measured_input.throughput_overhead_percent,
 602:             "backend_throughput_overhead_percent": measured_input.backend_throughput_overhead_percent,
 603:         },
 604:     });
 605:     let mut body = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&payload)
 606:         .map_err(|err| format!("serialize phase1 measured output failed: {err}"))?;
 607:     body.push('\n');
 608: 
 609:     {
 610:         let mut file = OpenOptions::new()
 611:             .write(true)
 612:             .truncate(true)
 613:             .mode(0o600)
 614:             .open(&temp_output)
 615:             .map_err(|err| {
 616:                 format!(
 617:                     "open phase1 temp output failed ({}): {err}",
 618:                     temp_output.display()
 619:                 )
 620:             })?;
 621:         file.write_all(body.as_bytes()).map_err(|err| {
 622:             format!(
 623:                 "write phase1 measured output failed ({}): {err}",
 624:                 temp_output.display()
 625:             )
 626:         })?;
 627:         file.sync_all().map_err(|err| {
 628:             format!(
 629:                 "sync phase1 measured output failed ({}): {err}",
 630:                 temp_output.display()
 631:             )
 632:         })?;
 633:     }
 634: 
 635:     fs::set_permissions(&temp_output, fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o600)).map_err(|err| {
 636:         format!(
 637:             "set phase1 measured output mode failed ({}): {err}",
 638:             temp_output.display()
 639:         )
 640:     })?;
 641:     fs::rename(&temp_output, output_path).map_err(|err| {
 642:         format!(
 643:             "publish phase1 measured output failed ({}): {err}",
 644:             output_path.display()
 645:         )
 646:     })?;
 647:     fs::set_permissions(output_path, fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o600)).map_err(|err| {
 648:         format!(
 649:             "set phase1 measured output mode failed ({}): {err}",
 650:             output_path.display()
 651:         )
 652:     })?;
 653: 
 654:     Ok(())
 655: }
 656: 
 657: fn collect_phase1_measured_input_artifact() -> Result<(Phase1MeasuredInput, PathBuf), String> {
 658:     let source_path = resolve_phase1_measured_source_path()?;
 659:     let measured_input = phase1_collect_measured_input_from_source(source_path.as_path())?;
 660:     let output_path = phase1_path_from_env_or_default(
 661:         "RUSTYNET_PHASE1_MEASURED_INPUT_OUT",
 662:         DEFAULT_PHASE1_MEASURED_INPUT_PATH,
 663:     )?;
 664:     phase1_write_measured_input_artifact(output_path.as_path(), &measured_input)?;
 665:     Ok((measured_input, output_path))
 666: }

 668: pub fn execute_ops_collect_phase1_measured_input() -> Result<String, String> {
 669:     let (measured_input, output_path) = collect_phase1_measured_input_artifact()?;
 670:     Ok(format!(
 671:         "phase1 measured input generated: path={} samples={} source={}",
 672:         output_path.display(),
 673:         measured_input.sample_count,
 674:         measured_input.source_path.display()
 675:     ))
 676: }

 678: fn phase1_parse_metric_env(
 679:     key: &str,
 680:     missing_env: &mut Vec<String>,
 681: ) -> Result<Option<f64>, String> {
 682:     let Some(raw) = env_optional_string(key)? else {
 683:         missing_env.push(key.to_string());
 684:         return Ok(None);
 685:     };
 686:     let value = raw
 687:         .parse::<f64>()
 688:         .map_err(|err| format!("invalid numeric value for {key}: {err}"))?;
 689:     if !value.is_finite() || value < 0.0 {
 690:         return Err(format!(
 691:             "invalid numeric value for {key}: must be finite and >= 0"
 692:         ));
 693:     }
 694:     Ok(Some(value))
 695: }

 697: fn phase1_metrics_from_env(
 698:     missing_env: &mut Vec<String>,
 699: ) -> Result<Option<Phase1MeasuredInput>, String> {
 700:     let idle_cpu_percent =
 701:         phase1_parse_metric_env("RUSTYNET_PHASE1_IDLE_CPU_PERCENT", missing_env)?;
 702:     let idle_memory_mb = phase1_parse_metric_env("RUSTYNET_PHASE1_IDLE_MEMORY_MB", missing_env)?;
 703:     let reconnect_seconds =
 704:         phase1_parse_metric_env("RUSTYNET_PHASE1_RECONNECT_SECONDS", missing_env)?;
 705:     let route_policy_apply_p95_seconds = phase1_parse_metric_env(
 706:         "RUSTYNET_PHASE1_ROUTE_POLICY_APPLY_P95_SECONDS",
 707:         missing_env,
 708:     )?;
 709:     let throughput_overhead_percent =
 710:         phase1_parse_metric_env("RUSTYNET_PHASE1_THROUGHPUT_OVERHEAD_PERCENT", missing_env)?;
 711:     let backend_throughput_overhead_percent = phase1_parse_metric_env(
 712:         "RUSTYNET_PHASE1_BACKEND_THROUGHPUT_OVERHEAD_PERCENT",
 713:         missing_env,
 714:     )?;
 715: 
 716:     if !missing_env.is_empty() {
 717:         return Ok(None);
 718:     }
 719: 
 720:     let source_path = match env_optional_string("RUSTYNET_PHASE1_METRICS_SOURCE")? {
 721:         Some(value) => {
 722:             let resolved = phase1_resolve_path(value.as_str())?;
 723:             phase1_validate_source_path(resolved.as_path())?;
 724:             resolved
 725:         }
 726:         None => PathBuf::from("env"),
 727:     };
 728: 
 729:     Ok(Some(Phase1MeasuredInput {
 730:         source_path,
 731:         sample_count: 1,
 732:         idle_cpu_percent: idle_cpu_percent
 733:             .ok_or_else(|| "missing RUSTYNET_PHASE1_IDLE_CPU_PERCENT".to_string())?,
 734:         idle_memory_mb: idle_memory_mb
 735:             .ok_or_else(|| "missing RUSTYNET_PHASE1_IDLE_MEMORY_MB".to_string())?,
 736:         reconnect_seconds: reconnect_seconds
 737:             .ok_or_else(|| "missing RUSTYNET_PHASE1_RECONNECT_SECONDS".to_string())?,
 738:         route_policy_apply_p95_seconds: route_policy_apply_p95_seconds
 739:             .ok_or_else(|| "missing RUSTYNET_PHASE1_ROUTE_POLICY_APPLY_P95_SECONDS".to_string())?,
 740:         throughput_overhead_percent: throughput_overhead_percent
 741:             .ok_or_else(|| "missing RUSTYNET_PHASE1_THROUGHPUT_OVERHEAD_PERCENT".to_string())?,
 742:         backend_throughput_overhead_percent: backend_throughput_overhead_percent.ok_or_else(
 743:             || "missing RUSTYNET_PHASE1_BACKEND_THROUGHPUT_OVERHEAD_PERCENT".to_string(),
 744:         )?,
 745:     }))
 746: }

 748: fn phase1_apply_metrics_to_command(command: &mut Command, metrics: &Phase1MeasuredInput) {
 749:     if metrics.source_path != Path::new("env") {
 750:         command.env(
 751:             "RUSTYNET_PHASE1_METRICS_SOURCE",
 752:             metrics.source_path.as_os_str(),
 753:         );
 754:     }
 755:     command
 756:         .env(
 757:             "RUSTYNET_PHASE1_IDLE_CPU_PERCENT",
 758:             format!("{:.6}", metrics.idle_cpu_percent),
 759:         )
 760:         .env(
 761:             "RUSTYNET_PHASE1_IDLE_MEMORY_MB",
 762:             format!("{:.6}", metrics.idle_memory_mb),
 763:         )
 764:         .env(
 765:             "RUSTYNET_PHASE1_RECONNECT_SECONDS",
 766:             format!("{:.6}", metrics.reconnect_seconds),
 767:         )
 768:         .env(
 769:             "RUSTYNET_PHASE1_ROUTE_POLICY_APPLY_P95_SECONDS",
 770:             format!("{:.6}", metrics.route_policy_apply_p95_seconds),
 771:         )
 772:         .env(
 773:             "RUSTYNET_PHASE1_THROUGHPUT_OVERHEAD_PERCENT",
 774:             format!("{:.6}", metrics.throughput_overhead_percent),
 775:         )
 776:         .env(
 777:             "RUSTYNET_PHASE1_BACKEND_THROUGHPUT_OVERHEAD_PERCENT",
 778:             format!("{:.6}", metrics.backend_throughput_overhead_percent),
 779:         );
 780: }

 782: fn phase1_run_runtime_baseline(
 783:     runtime_report: &Path,
 784:     metrics: &Phase1MeasuredInput,
 785: ) -> Result<(), String> {
 786:     let mut command = Command::new("cargo");
 787:     command
 788:         .arg("run")
 789:         .arg("--locked")
 790:         .arg("-p")
 791:         .arg("rustynetd")
 792:         .arg("--")
 793:         .arg("--emit-phase1-baseline")
 794:         .arg(runtime_report.as_os_str());
 795:     phase1_apply_metrics_to_command(&mut command, metrics);
 796: 
 797:     let status = command
 798:         .status()
 799:         .map_err(|err| format!("invoke phase1 runtime baseline command failed: {err}"))?;
 800:     if !status.success() {
 801:         return Err(format!(
 802:             "phase1 runtime baseline command failed with status {status}"
 803:         ));
 804:     }
 805:     Ok(())
 806: }

 837: fn phase1_validate_report(
 838:     report_path: &Path,
 839:     report_label: &str,
 840:     required_metric_names: &[&str],
 841: ) -> Result<(), String> {
 842:     let payload = read_json_value(report_path, report_label)?;
 843:     let payload_object = payload.as_object().ok_or_else(|| {
 844:         format!(
 845:             "{report_label} must be a JSON object: {}",
 846:             report_path.display()
 847:         )
 848:     })?;
 849:     let metrics = payload_object
 850:         .get("metrics")
 851:         .and_then(Value::as_array)
 852:         .ok_or_else(|| {
 853:             format!(
 854:                 "{report_label} missing metrics array: {}",
 855:                 report_path.display()
 856:             )
 857:         })?;
 858:     if metrics.is_empty() {
 859:         return Err(format!(
 860:             "{report_label} metrics array is empty: {}",
 861:             report_path.display()
 862:         ));
 863:     }
 864: 
 865:     let mut present_metrics = HashMap::new();
 866:     for metric in metrics {
 867:         let metric_object = metric.as_object().ok_or_else(|| {
 868:             format!(
 869:                 "{report_label} metric entry is not an object: {}",
 870:                 report_path.display()
 871:             )
 872:         })?;
 873:         let name = metric_object
 874:             .get("name")
 875:             .and_then(Value::as_str)
 876:             .ok_or_else(|| {
 877:                 format!(
 878:                     "{report_label} metric entry missing name: {}",
 879:                     report_path.display()
 880:                 )
 881:             })?;
 882:         let metric_value = metric_object
 883:             .get("value")
 884:             .and_then(phase1_value_as_number)
 885:             .ok_or_else(|| {
 886:                 format!(
 887:                     "{report_label} metric '{name}' missing numeric value: {}",
 888:                     report_path.display()
 889:                 )
 890:             })?;
 891:         if !metric_value.is_finite() || metric_value < 0.0 {
 892:             return Err(format!(
 893:                 "{report_label} metric '{name}' has invalid value {metric_value}: {}",
 894:                 report_path.display()
 895:             ));
 896:         }
 897:         let status = metric_object
 898:             .get("status")
 899:             .and_then(Value::as_str)
 900:             .ok_or_else(|| {
 901:                 format!(
 902:                     "{report_label} metric '{name}' missing status: {}",
 903:                     report_path.display()
 904:                 )
 905:             })?;
 906:         if status == "fail" {
 907:             return Err(format!(
 908:                 "{report_label} contains failing metric '{name}': {}",
 909:                 report_path.display()
 910:             ));
 911:         }
 912:         if status == "not_measurable" {
 913:             return Err(format!(
 914:                 "{report_label} contains non-measured metric '{name}': {}",
 915:                 report_path.display()
 916:             ));
 917:         }
 918:         if metric_object
 919:             .get("reason")
 920:             .and_then(Value::as_str)
 921:             .is_some_and(|reason| {
 922:                 reason == "measurement_unavailable" || reason == "measurement_invalid"
 923:             })
 924:         {
 925:             return Err(format!(
 926:                 "{report_label} contains unavailable/invalid measurement for metric '{name}': {}",
 927:                 report_path.display()
 928:             ));
 929:         }
 930:         present_metrics.insert(name.to_string(), true);
 931:     }
 932: 
 933:     for required_metric_name in required_metric_names {
 934:         if !present_metrics.contains_key(*required_metric_name) {
 935:             return Err(format!(
 936:                 "{report_label} missing required metric '{}': {}",
 937:                 required_metric_name,
 938:                 report_path.display()
 939:             ));
 940:         }
 941:     }
 942:     Ok(())
 943: }
 944: 
 945: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
 946: enum UnsafeScannerState {
 947:     Normal,
 948:     LineComment,
 949:     BlockComment,
 950:     String,
 951:     Char,
 952:     RawString,
 953: }
 954: 
 955: fn unsafe_scanner_is_ident_start(byte: u8) -> bool {
 956:     byte == b'_' || byte.is_ascii_alphabetic()
 957: }
 958: 
 959: fn unsafe_scanner_is_ident_continue(byte: u8) -> bool {
 960:     unsafe_scanner_is_ident_start(byte) || byte.is_ascii_digit()
 961: }
 962: 
 963: fn unsafe_scanner_advance(
 964:     bytes: &[u8],
 965:     index: usize,
 966:     line: &mut usize,
 967:     column: &mut usize,
 968: ) -> usize {
 969:     if bytes[index] == b'\n' {
 970:         *line += 1;
 971:         *column = 1;
 972:     } else {
 973:         *column += 1;
 974:     }
 975:     index + 1
 976: }
 977: 
 978: fn scan_rust_source_text_for_unsafe(source: &str) -> Vec<(usize, usize)> {
 979:     let bytes = source.as_bytes();
 980:     let mut findings = Vec::new();
 981: 
 982:     let mut index = 0usize;
 983:     let mut line = 1usize;
 984:     let mut column = 1usize;
 985:     let mut state = UnsafeScannerState::Normal;
 986:     let mut block_depth = 0usize;
 987:     let mut raw_hashes = 0usize;
 988: 
 989:     while index < bytes.len() {
 990:         let byte = bytes[index];
 991: 
 992:         match state {
 993:             UnsafeScannerState::Normal => {
 994:                 if byte == b'/' && index + 1 < bytes.len() && bytes[index + 1] == b'/' {
 995:                     index = unsafe_scanner_advance(bytes, index, &mut line, &mut column);
 996:                     index = unsafe_scanner_advance(bytes, index, &mut line, &mut column);
 997:                     state = UnsafeScannerState::LineComment;
 998:                     continue;
 999:                 }
1000: 
1001:                 if byte == b'/' && index + 1 < bytes.len() && bytes[index + 1] == b'*' {
1002:                     index = unsafe_scanner_advance(bytes, index, &mut line, &mut column);
1003:                     index = unsafe_scanner_advance(bytes, index, &mut line, &mut column);
1004:                     state = UnsafeScannerState::BlockComment;
1005:                     block_depth = 1;
1006:                     continue;
1007:                 }
1008: 
1009:                 if byte == b'"' {
1010:                     index = unsafe_scanner_advance(bytes, index, &mut line, &mut column);
1011:                     state = UnsafeScannerState::String;
1012:                     continue;
1013:                 }
1014: 
1015:                 if byte == b'\'' {
1016:                     if index + 1 < bytes.len() && unsafe_scanner_is_ident_start(bytes[index + 1]) {
1017:                         let is_char_literal = index + 2 < bytes.len() && bytes[index + 2] == b'\'';
1018:                         if !is_char_literal {
1019:                             index = unsafe_scanner_advance(bytes, index, &mut line, &mut column);
1020:                             while index < bytes.len()
1021:                                 && unsafe_scanner_is_ident_continue(bytes[index])
1022:                             {
1023:                                 index =
1024:                                     unsafe_scanner_advance(bytes, index, &mut line, &mut column);
1025:                             }
1026:                             continue;
1027:                         }
1028:                     }
1029:                     index = unsafe_scanner_advance(bytes, index, &mut line, &mut column);
1030:                     state = UnsafeScannerState::Char;
1031:                     continue;
1032:                 }
1033: 
1034:                 if byte == b'r' {
1035:                     let mut candidate = index + 1;
1036:                     let mut hashes = 0usize;
1037:                     while candidate < bytes.len() && bytes[candidate] == b'#' {
1038:                         candidate += 1;
1039:                         hashes += 1;
1040:                     }
1041:                     if candidate < bytes.len() && bytes[candidate] == b'"' {
1042:                         while index <= candidate {
1043:                             index = unsafe_scanner_advance(bytes, index, &mut line, &mut column);
1044:                         }
1045:                         state = UnsafeScannerState::RawString;
1046:                         raw_hashes = hashes;
1047:                         continue;
1048:                     }
1049:                 }
1050: 
1051:                 if unsafe_scanner_is_ident_start(byte) {
1052:                     let token_line = line;
1053:                     let token_column = column;
1054:                     let token_start = index;
1055:                     while index < bytes.len() && unsafe_scanner_is_ident_continue(bytes[index]) {
1056:                         index = unsafe_scanner_advance(bytes, index, &mut line, &mut column);
1057:                     }
1058:                     if &bytes[token_start..index] == b"unsafe" {
1059:                         findings.push((token_line, token_column));
1060:                     }
1061:                     continue;
1062:                 }
1063: 
1064:                 index = unsafe_scanner_advance(bytes, index, &mut line, &mut column);
1065:             }
1066:             UnsafeScannerState::LineComment => {
1067:                 if byte == b'\n' {
1068:                     index = unsafe_scanner_advance(bytes, index, &mut line, &mut column);
1069:                     state = UnsafeScannerState::Normal;
1070:                     continue;
1071:                 }
1072:                 index = unsafe_scanner_advance(bytes, index, &mut line, &mut column);
1073:             }
1074:             UnsafeScannerState::BlockComment => {
1075:                 if byte == b'/' && index + 1 < bytes.len() && bytes[index + 1] == b'*' {
1076:                     index = unsafe_scanner_advance(bytes, index, &mut line, &mut column);
1077:                     index = unsafe_scanner_advance(bytes, index, &mut line, &mut column);
1078:                     block_depth += 1;
1079:                     continue;
1080:                 }
1081:                 if byte == b'*' && index + 1 < bytes.len() && bytes[index + 1] == b'/' {
1082:                     index = unsafe_scanner_advance(bytes, index, &mut line, &mut column);
1083:                     index = unsafe_scanner_advance(bytes, index, &mut line, &mut column);
1084:                     block_depth = block_depth.saturating_sub(1);
1085:                     if block_depth == 0 {
1086:                         state = UnsafeScannerState::Normal;
1087:                     }
1088:                     continue;
1089:                 }
1090:                 index = unsafe_scanner_advance(bytes, index, &mut line, &mut column);
1091:             }
1092:             UnsafeScannerState::String => {
1093:                 if byte == b'\\' {
1094:                     index = unsafe_scanner_advance(bytes, index, &mut line, &mut column);
1095:                     if index < bytes.len() {
1096:                         index = unsafe_scanner_advance(bytes, index, &mut line, &mut column);
1097:                     }
1098:                     continue;
1099:                 }
1100:                 if byte == b'"' {
1101:                     index = unsafe_scanner_advance(bytes, index, &mut line, &mut column);
1102:                     state = UnsafeScannerState::Normal;
1103:                     continue;
1104:                 }
1105:                 index = unsafe_scanner_advance(bytes, index, &mut line, &mut column);
1106:             }
1107:             UnsafeScannerState::Char => {
1108:                 if byte == b'\\' {
1109:                     index = unsafe_scanner_advance(bytes, index, &mut line, &mut column);
1110:                     if index < bytes.len() {
1111:                         index = unsafe_scanner_advance(bytes, index, &mut line, &mut column);
1112:                     }
1113:                     continue;
1114:                 }
1115:                 if byte == b'\'' {
1116:                     index = unsafe_scanner_advance(bytes, index, &mut line, &mut column);
1117:                     state = UnsafeScannerState::Normal;
1118:                     continue;
1119:                 }
1120:                 index = unsafe_scanner_advance(bytes, index, &mut line, &mut column);
1121:             }
1122:             UnsafeScannerState::RawString => {
1123:                 if byte == b'"' {
1124:                     let suffix_start = index + 1;
1125:                     let suffix_end = suffix_start + raw_hashes;
1126:                     if suffix_end <= bytes.len()
1127:                         && bytes[suffix_start..suffix_end]
1128:                             .iter()
1129:                             .all(|candidate| *candidate == b'#')
1130:                     {
1131:                         index = unsafe_scanner_advance(bytes, index, &mut line, &mut column);
1132:                         for _ in 0..raw_hashes {
1133:                             index = unsafe_scanner_advance(bytes, index, &mut line, &mut column);
1134:                         }
1135:                         state = UnsafeScannerState::Normal;
1136:                         continue;
1137:                     }
1138:                 }
1139:                 index = unsafe_scanner_advance(bytes, index, &mut line, &mut column);
1140:             }
1141:         }
1142:     }
1143: 
1144:     findings
1145: }
1146: 
1147: fn run_unsafe_scanner_self_tests() -> Result<(), String> {
1148:     let cases = [
1149:         (
1150:             "lifetime_only",
1151:             "fn keep<'a>(value: &'a str) -> &'a str { value }\n",
1152:             0usize,
1153:         ),
1154:         (
1155:             "lifetime_plus_unsafe_block",
1156:             "fn keep<'a>(value: &'a str) -> &'a str { value }\nfn bad() { unsafe { let _x = 1; } }\n",
1157:             1usize,
1158:         ),
1159:         (
1160:             "comments_and_strings",
1161:             "// unsafe should not match here\nconst NOTE: &str = \"unsafe in string\";\n",
1162:             0usize,
1163:         ),
1164:     ];
1165: 
1166:     for (name, source, expected_count) in cases {
1167:         let findings = scan_rust_source_text_for_unsafe(source);
1168:         if findings.len() != expected_count {
1169:             return Err(format!(
1170:                 "unsafe scanner self-test failed for {name}: expected {expected_count} findings, got {}",
1171:                 findings.len()
1172:             ));
1173:         }
1174:     }
1175: 
1176:     Ok(())
1177: }
1178: 
1179: fn collect_rust_source_paths(root: &Path) -> Result<Vec<PathBuf>, String> {
1180:     if !root.exists() {
1181:         return Err(format!("source root does not exist: {}", root.display()));
1182:     }
1183:     if !root.is_dir() {
1184:         return Err(format!(
1185:             "source root is not a directory: {}",
1186:             root.display()
1187:         ));
1188:     }
1189: 
1190:     let mut pending = vec![root.to_path_buf()];
1191:     let mut files = Vec::new();
1192:     while let Some(dir) = pending.pop() {
1193:         let mut entries = fs::read_dir(&dir)
1194:             .map_err(|err| format!("read directory failed ({}): {err}", dir.display()))?
1195:             .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()
1196:             .map_err(|err| format!("read directory entry failed ({}): {err}", dir.display()))?;
1197:         entries.sort_by_key(|entry| entry.path());
1198: 
1199:         for entry in entries {
1200:             let path = entry.path();
1201:             let file_type = entry
1202:                 .file_type()
1203:                 .map_err(|err| format!("inspect path type failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
1204: 
1205:             if file_type.is_symlink() {
1206:                 return Err(format!(
1207:                     "unsafe source scan refuses symlink path; remove symlink or scan concrete paths only: {}",
1208:                     path.display()
1209:                 ));
1210:             }
1211: 
1212:             if file_type.is_dir() {
1213:                 if path
1214:                     .file_name()
1215:                     .and_then(|value| value.to_str())
1216:                     .is_some_and(|value| value == "target")
1217:                 {
1218:                     continue;
1219:                 }
1220:                 pending.push(path);
1221:                 continue;
1222:             }
1223: 
1224:             if file_type.is_file() && path.extension().is_some_and(|value| value == "rs") {
1225:                 files.push(path);
1226:             }
1227:         }
1228:     }
1229:     files.sort();
1230:     Ok(files)
1231: }
1232: 
1233: /// Crates whose `unsafe` blocks the no-unsafe scanner is permitted to
1234: /// see. Rustynet's general policy is `#![forbid(unsafe_code)]` across
1235: /// every workspace crate, but a small set of crates wrap unavoidable
1236: /// platform FFI (Windows-sys, DPAPI, named-pipe SDDL inspection,
1237: /// WinVerifyTrust, etc.) where every Win32 call is itself an `unsafe`
1238: /// extern "system" function. Routing those through a single audited
1239: /// FFI crate keeps the rest of the workspace genuinely unsafe-free
1240: /// while still letting the daemon talk to the OS.
1241: ///
1242: /// To extend this list:
1243: /// 1. The crate's whole purpose must be platform FFI / `unsafe`-bearing
1244: ///    syscalls, with the unsafe code reviewable in isolation.
1245: /// 2. The crate must keep `#![deny(unsafe_op_in_unsafe_fn)]` or stronger
1246: ///    locally so each unsafe block has its own explicit safety
1247: ///    justification.
1248: /// 3. Document the rationale in the same commit that adds it here.
1249: ///
1250: /// Each entry matches the leading segments of the path **as the
1251: /// scanner emits it** — i.e. relative to `--root`. The orchestrator
1252: /// invokes the gate with `--root crates/`, so paths arrive shaped like
1253: /// `<crate-name>/src/...`. Including `crates/` in the prefix would
1254: /// mismatch.
1255: const UNSAFE_SCAN_ALLOWED_CRATE_PREFIXES: &[&str] = &[
1256:     // Win32 FFI bindings: WinVerifyTrust, DPAPI, named-pipe SDDL
1257:     // inspection, and similar platform calls land here. Adding
1258:     // `#![forbid(unsafe_code)]` to this crate is impossible — every
1259:     // windows-sys call is unsafe by Rust's FFI rules — so the gate
1260:     // accepts unsafe in this crate by name and relies on per-crate
1261:     // review for safety.
1262:     "rustynet-windows-native/",
1263: ];
1264: 
1265: fn unsafe_scan_path_is_allowlisted(repo_relative: &str) -> bool {
1266:     UNSAFE_SCAN_ALLOWED_CRATE_PREFIXES
1267:         .iter()
1268:         .any(|prefix| repo_relative.starts_with(prefix))
1269: }
1270: 
1271: pub fn execute_ops_check_no_unsafe_rust_sources(
1272:     config: CheckNoUnsafeRustSourcesConfig,
1273: ) -> Result<String, String> {
1274:     run_unsafe_scanner_self_tests()?;
1275: 
1276:     let root = phase1_resolve_path(config.root.to_string_lossy().as_ref())?;
1277:     let rust_sources = collect_rust_source_paths(root.as_path())?;
1278:     let mut findings = Vec::new();
1279: 
1280:     for source_path in rust_sources {
1281:         let repo_relative = source_path
1282:             .strip_prefix(root.as_path())
1283:             .map(|relative| relative.to_string_lossy().replace('\\', "/"))
1284:             .unwrap_or_else(|_| source_path.to_string_lossy().to_string());
1285:         if unsafe_scan_path_is_allowlisted(repo_relative.as_str()) {
1286:             continue;
1287:         }
1288:         let source = fs::read_to_string(&source_path)
1289:             .map_err(|err| format!("read Rust source failed ({}): {err}", source_path.display()))?;
1290:         for (line, column) in scan_rust_source_text_for_unsafe(source.as_str()) {
1291:             findings.push(format!(
1292:                 "{}:{line}:{column}: unsafe keyword detected",
1293:                 source_path.display()
1294:             ));
1295:         }
1296:     }
1297: 
1298:     if !findings.is_empty() {
1299:         return Err(format!(
1300:             "unsafe keyword usage is forbidden in repository Rust sources:\n{}",
1301:             findings.join("\n")
1302:         ));
1303:     }
1304: 
1305:     Ok("Unsafe code checks: PASS".to_string())
1306: }
