1308: fn parse_two_digits(value: &str, field: &str) -> Result<u32, String> {
1309:     if value.len() != 2 || !value.chars().all(|ch| ch.is_ascii_digit()) {
1310:         return Err(format!("invalid numeric field for {field}: {value}"));
1311:     }
1312:     value
1313:         .parse::<u32>()
1314:         .map_err(|err| format!("invalid numeric field for {field}: {err}"))
1315: }
1316: 
1317: fn parse_four_digits(value: &str, field: &str) -> Result<i32, String> {
1318:     if value.len() != 4 || !value.chars().all(|ch| ch.is_ascii_digit()) {
1319:         return Err(format!("invalid numeric field for {field}: {value}"));
1320:     }
1321:     value
1322:         .parse::<i32>()
1323:         .map_err(|err| format!("invalid numeric field for {field}: {err}"))
1324: }
1325: 
1326: fn is_leap_year(year: i32) -> bool {
1327:     (year % 4 == 0 && year % 100 != 0) || (year % 400 == 0)
1328: }
1329: 
1330: fn days_in_month(year: i32, month: u32) -> Option<u32> {
1331:     let days = match month {
1332:         1 | 3 | 5 | 7 | 8 | 10 | 12 => 31,
1333:         4 | 6 | 9 | 11 => 30,
1334:         2 if is_leap_year(year) => 29,
1335:         2 => 28,
1336:         _ => return None,
1337:     };
1338:     Some(days)
1339: }
1340: 
1341: fn days_from_civil(year: i32, month: u32, day: u32) -> i64 {
1342:     let mut y = i64::from(year);
1343:     let m = i64::from(month);
1344:     let d = i64::from(day);
1345:     y -= if m <= 2 { 1 } else { 0 };
1346:     let era = if y >= 0 { y } else { y - 399 } / 400;
1347:     let yoe = y - era * 400;
1348:     let doy = (153 * (m + if m > 2 { -3 } else { 9 }) + 2) / 5 + d - 1;
1349:     let doe = yoe * 365 + yoe / 4 - yoe / 100 + doy;
1350:     era * 146_097 + doe - 719_468
1351: }
1352: 
1353: fn parse_utc_to_unix(value: &str, field: &str) -> Result<i64, String> {
1354:     let trimmed = value.trim();
1355:     if trimmed.is_empty() {
1356:         return Err(format!("missing or invalid UTC field: {field}"));
1357:     }
1358: 
1359:     let (datetime_part, offset_seconds) = if let Some(stripped) = trimmed.strip_suffix('Z') {
1360:         (stripped, 0i64)
1361:     } else {
1362:         let tz_start = trimmed
1363:             .char_indices()
1364:             .rev()
1365:             .find_map(|(index, ch)| {
1366:                 if index > 10 && (ch == '+' || ch == '-') {
1367:                     Some(index)
1368:                 } else {
1369:                     None
1370:                 }
1371:             })
1372:             .ok_or_else(|| format!("invalid UTC timestamp for {field}: {value}"))?;
1373:         let (base, zone) = trimmed.split_at(tz_start);
1374:         if zone.len() != 6 || &zone[3..4] != ":" {
1375:             return Err(format!("invalid UTC timestamp for {field}: {value}"));
1376:         }
1377:         let sign = if &zone[0..1] == "+" { 1i64 } else { -1i64 };
1378:         let offset_hour = parse_two_digits(&zone[1..3], field)?;
1379:         let offset_minute = parse_two_digits(&zone[4..6], field)?;
1380:         if offset_hour > 23 || offset_minute > 59 {
1381:             return Err(format!("invalid UTC timestamp for {field}: {value}"));
1382:         }
1383:         let total = i64::from(offset_hour) * 3600 + i64::from(offset_minute) * 60;
1384:         (base, sign * total)
1385:     };
1386: 
1387:     let (date_part, time_part) = datetime_part
1388:         .split_once('T')
1389:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("invalid UTC timestamp for {field}: {value}"))?;
1390:     let date_fields = date_part.split('-').collect::<Vec<_>>();
1391:     if date_fields.len() != 3 {
1392:         return Err(format!("invalid UTC timestamp for {field}: {value}"));
1393:     }
1394:     let year = parse_four_digits(date_fields[0], field)?;
1395:     let month = parse_two_digits(date_fields[1], field)?;
1396:     let day = parse_two_digits(date_fields[2], field)?;
1397:     let max_day = days_in_month(year, month)
1398:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("invalid UTC timestamp for {field}: {value}"))?;
1399:     if day == 0 || day > max_day {
1400:         return Err(format!("invalid UTC timestamp for {field}: {value}"));
1401:     }
1402: 
1403:     let (time_core, fraction) = match time_part.split_once('.') {
1404:         Some((core, frac)) => (core, Some(frac)),
1405:         None => (time_part, None),
1406:     };
1407:     if let Some(frac) = fraction
1408:         && (frac.is_empty() || !frac.chars().all(|ch| ch.is_ascii_digit()))
1409:     {
1410:         return Err(format!("invalid UTC timestamp for {field}: {value}"));
1411:     }
1412:     let time_fields = time_core.split(':').collect::<Vec<_>>();
1413:     if time_fields.len() != 3 {
1414:         return Err(format!("invalid UTC timestamp for {field}: {value}"));
1415:     }
1416:     let hour = parse_two_digits(time_fields[0], field)?;
1417:     let minute = parse_two_digits(time_fields[1], field)?;
1418:     let second = parse_two_digits(time_fields[2], field)?;
1419:     if hour > 23 || minute > 59 || second > 59 {
1420:         return Err(format!("invalid UTC timestamp for {field}: {value}"));
1421:     }
1422: 
1423:     let date_seconds = days_from_civil(year, month, day)
1424:         .checked_mul(86_400)
1425:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("invalid UTC timestamp for {field}: {value}"))?;
1426:     let time_seconds = i64::from(hour) * 3600 + i64::from(minute) * 60 + i64::from(second);
1427:     date_seconds
1428:         .checked_add(time_seconds)
1429:         .and_then(|result| result.checked_sub(offset_seconds))
1430:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("invalid UTC timestamp for {field}: {value}"))
1431: }
1432: 
1433: fn require_non_empty_string_field<'a>(
1434:     payload: &'a Map<String, Value>,
1435:     key: &str,
1436:     label: &str,
1437: ) -> Result<&'a str, String> {
1438:     payload
1439:         .get(key)
1440:         .and_then(Value::as_str)
1441:         .map(str::trim)
1442:         .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
1443:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("{label} missing non-empty string field: {key}"))
1444: }
1445: 
1446: pub fn execute_ops_check_dependency_exceptions(
1447:     config: CheckDependencyExceptionsConfig,
1448: ) -> Result<String, String> {
1449:     let path = phase1_resolve_path(config.path.to_string_lossy().as_ref())?;
1450:     if !path.exists() {
1451:         return Err(format!(
1452:             "missing dependency exception file: {}",
1453:             path.display()
1454:         ));
1455:     }
1456:     let payload = read_json_value(path.as_path(), "dependency exception file")?;
1457:     let payload_object = payload.as_object().ok_or_else(|| {
1458:         format!(
1459:             "dependency exception file must be a JSON object: {}",
1460:             path.display()
1461:         )
1462:     })?;
1463:     let exceptions = payload_object
1464:         .get("exceptions")
1465:         .and_then(Value::as_array)
1466:         .cloned()
1467:         .unwrap_or_default();
1468:     let required_fields = BTreeSet::from([
1469:         "id",
1470:         "crate",
1471:         "reason",
1472:         "owner",
1473:         "approved_by",
1474:         "expires_utc",
1475:     ]);
1476:     let now_unix = unix_now() as i64;
1477: 
1478:     for entry in exceptions {
1479:         let exception = entry
1480:             .as_object()
1481:             .ok_or_else(|| "dependency exception entry must be a JSON object".to_string())?;
1482:         let present = exception
1483:             .keys()
1484:             .map(String::as_str)
1485:             .collect::<BTreeSet<_>>();
1486:         let missing = required_fields
1487:             .difference(&present)
1488:             .copied()
1489:             .collect::<Vec<_>>();
1490:         if !missing.is_empty() {
1491:             return Err(format!(
1492:                 "dependency exception missing fields: [{}]",
1493:                 missing.join(", ")
1494:             ));
1495:         }
1496: 
1497:         let exception_id = require_non_empty_string_field(exception, "id", "dependency exception")?;
1498:         let expires_utc =
1499:             require_non_empty_string_field(exception, "expires_utc", "dependency exception")?;
1500:         let expires_unix = parse_utc_to_unix(expires_utc, "dependency exception expires_utc")?;
1501:         if expires_unix <= now_unix {
1502:             return Err(format!("dependency exception expired: {exception_id}"));
1503:         }
1504:     }
1505: 
1506:     Ok("Dependency exception policy check: PASS".to_string())
1507: }

1509: fn load_perf_metrics(path: &Path, label: &str) -> Result<HashMap<String, f64>, String> {
1510:     let payload = read_json_value(path, label)?;
1511:     let payload_object = payload
1512:         .as_object()
1513:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("{label} must be a JSON object: {}", path.display()))?;
1514:     let metrics = payload_object
1515:         .get("metrics")
1516:         .and_then(Value::as_array)
1517:         .ok_or_else(|| {
1518:             format!(
1519:                 "{label} metrics must be a non-empty array: {}",
1520:                 path.display()
1521:             )
1522:         })?;
1523:     if metrics.is_empty() {
1524:         return Err(format!(
1525:             "{label} metrics must be a non-empty array: {}",
1526:             path.display()
1527:         ));
1528:     }
1529: 
1530:     let mut values = HashMap::new();
1531:     for metric in metrics {
1532:         let metric_object = metric
1533:             .as_object()
1534:             .ok_or_else(|| format!("{label} metric entry must be object: {}", path.display()))?;
1535:         let metric_name = metric_object
1536:             .get("name")
1537:             .and_then(Value::as_str)
1538:             .map(str::trim)
1539:             .filter(|name| !name.is_empty())
1540:             .ok_or_else(|| format!("{label} metric missing non-empty name: {}", path.display()))?;
1541:         let metric_value = metric_object
1542:             .get("value")
1543:             .and_then(phase1_value_as_number)
1544:             .ok_or_else(|| {
1545:                 format!(
1546:                     "{label} metric '{metric_name}' missing numeric value: {}",
1547:                     path.display()
1548:                 )
1549:             })?;
1550:         if !metric_value.is_finite() || metric_value < 0.0 {
1551:             return Err(format!(
1552:                 "{label} metric '{metric_name}' has invalid numeric value: {}",
1553:                 metric_object.get("value").cloned().unwrap_or(Value::Null)
1554:             ));
1555:         }
1556:         if metric_object
1557:             .get("status")
1558:             .and_then(Value::as_str)
1559:             .is_some_and(|status| status == "fail" || status == "not_measurable")
1560:         {
1561:             let status = metric_object
1562:                 .get("status")
1563:                 .and_then(Value::as_str)
1564:                 .unwrap_or("unknown");
1565:             return Err(format!(
1566:                 "{label} metric '{metric_name}' has failing status: {status}"
1567:             ));
1568:         }
1569:         values.insert(metric_name.to_string(), metric_value);
1570:     }
1571: 
1572:     Ok(values)
1573: }
1574: 
1575: fn require_perf_metric(
1576:     metrics: &HashMap<String, f64>,
1577:     name: &str,
1578:     label: &str,
1579: ) -> Result<f64, String> {
1580:     metrics
1581:         .get(name)
1582:         .copied()
1583:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("{label} missing required metric: {name}"))
1584: }

1586: pub fn execute_ops_check_perf_regression(
1587:     config: CheckPerfRegressionConfig,
1588: ) -> Result<String, String> {
1589:     let phase1_report_path =
1590:         phase1_resolve_path(config.phase1_report_path.to_string_lossy().as_ref())?;
1591:     let phase3_report_path =
1592:         phase1_resolve_path(config.phase3_report_path.to_string_lossy().as_ref())?;
1593: 
1594:     if !phase1_report_path.is_file() {
1595:         return Err(format!(
1596:             "missing phase1 report: {}",
1597:             phase1_report_path.display()
1598:         ));
1599:     }
1600:     if !phase3_report_path.is_file() {
1601:         return Err(format!(
1602:             "missing phase3 report: {}",
1603:             phase3_report_path.display()
1604:         ));
1605:     }
1606: 
1607:     let phase1_metrics = load_perf_metrics(phase1_report_path.as_path(), "phase1 report")?;
1608:     let phase3_metrics = load_perf_metrics(phase3_report_path.as_path(), "phase3 report")?;
1609:     let idle_cpu = require_perf_metric(&phase1_metrics, "idle_cpu_percent", "phase1 report")?;
1610:     let idle_memory = require_perf_metric(&phase1_metrics, "idle_memory_mb", "phase1 report")?;
1611:     let route_apply = require_perf_metric(
1612:         &phase1_metrics,
1613:         "route_policy_apply_p95_seconds",
1614:         "phase1 report",
1615:     )?;
1616:     let peer_sessions = require_perf_metric(&phase3_metrics, "peer_sessions", "phase3 report")?;
1617: 
1618:     if idle_cpu > 2.0 {
1619:         return Err(format!("idle cpu regression detected: {idle_cpu}"));
1620:     }
1621:     if idle_memory > 120.0 {
1622:         return Err(format!("idle memory regression detected: {idle_memory}"));
1623:     }
1624:     if route_apply > 2.0 {
1625:         return Err(format!(
1626:             "route apply latency regression detected: {route_apply}"
1627:         ));
1628:     }
1629:     if peer_sessions < 6.0 {
1630:         return Err(format!(
1631:             "phase3 mesh benchmark too small: peer_sessions={peer_sessions}"
1632:         ));
1633:     }
1634: 
1635:     Ok("Performance regression gate: PASS".to_string())
1636: }

1638: fn secrets_hygiene_error(summary: &str, details: &[String]) -> String {
1639:     let mut lines = Vec::new();
1640:     lines.push(format!("[secrets-hygiene] {summary}"));
1641:     for detail in details.iter().take(20) {
1642:         lines.push(format!("  - {detail}"));
1643:     }
1644:     if details.len() > 20 {
1645:         lines.push(format!(
1646:             "  - ... {} additional violation(s)",
1647:             details.len() - 20
1648:         ));
1649:     }
1650:     lines.join("\n")
1651: }

1653: fn parse_git_tracked_files(root: &Path) -> Result<Vec<PathBuf>, String> {
1654:     let output = Command::new("git")
1655:         .arg("-C")
1656:         .arg(root)
1657:         .arg("ls-files")
1658:         .arg("-z")
1659:         .output()
1660:         .map_err(|err| format!("invoke git ls-files failed ({}): {err}", root.display()))?;
1661:     if !output.status.success() {
1662:         return Err(format!(
1663:             "git ls-files failed for secrets hygiene scan root {} with status {}",
1664:             root.display(),
1665:             output.status
1666:         ));
1667:     }
1668: 
1669:     let mut files = Vec::new();
1670:     for entry in output.stdout.split(|byte| *byte == 0) {
1671:         if entry.is_empty() {
1672:             continue;
1673:         }
1674:         let path_text = std::str::from_utf8(entry)
1675:             .map_err(|_| "git ls-files emitted non-utf8 path".to_string())?;
1676:         let relative = PathBuf::from(path_text);
1677:         if relative.is_absolute() {
1678:             return Err(format!(
1679:                 "git ls-files returned absolute path, refusing scan: {}",
1680:                 relative.display()
1681:             ));
1682:         }
1683:         if relative
1684:             .components()
1685:             .any(|component| matches!(component, Component::ParentDir))
1686:         {
1687:             return Err(format!(
1688:                 "git ls-files returned parent-traversal path, refusing scan: {}",
1689:                 relative.display()
1690:             ));
1691:         }
1692:         files.push(relative);
1693:     }
1694:     files.sort();
1695:     Ok(files)
1696: }
1697: 
1698: fn collect_workspace_files(
1699:     root: &Path,
1700:     excluded_roots: &BTreeSet<&str>,
1701: ) -> Result<Vec<PathBuf>, String> {
1702:     let mut pending = vec![root.to_path_buf()];
1703:     let mut files = Vec::new();
1704: 
1705:     while let Some(dir) = pending.pop() {
1706:         let mut entries = fs::read_dir(&dir)
1707:             .map_err(|err| format!("read directory failed ({}): {err}", dir.display()))?
1708:             .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()
1709:             .map_err(|err| format!("read directory entry failed ({}): {err}", dir.display()))?;
1710:         entries.sort_by_key(|entry| entry.path());
1711: 
1712:         for entry in entries {
1713:             let path = entry.path();
1714:             let relative = path.strip_prefix(root).map_err(|err| {
1715:                 format!(
1716:                     "resolve relative workspace path failed ({}): {err}",
1717:                     path.display()
1718:                 )
1719:             })?;
1720:             if relative.components().any(|component| {
1721:                 excluded_roots.contains(component.as_os_str().to_string_lossy().as_ref())
1722:             }) {
1723:                 continue;
1724:             }
1725:             let file_type = entry
1726:                 .file_type()
1727:                 .map_err(|err| format!("inspect path type failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
1728:             if file_type.is_symlink() {
1729:                 continue;
1730:             }
1731:             if file_type.is_dir() {
1732:                 pending.push(path);
1733:                 continue;
1734:             }
1735:             if file_type.is_file() {
1736:                 files.push(path);
1737:             }
1738:         }
1739:     }
1740: 
1741:     files.sort();
1742:     Ok(files)
1743: }

1745: fn read_text_lossy(path: &Path) -> Result<String, String> {
1746:     let bytes =
1747:         fs::read(path).map_err(|err| format!("read file failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
1748:     Ok(String::from_utf8_lossy(bytes.as_slice()).to_string())
1749: }

1751: fn is_secret_value_char(ch: char) -> bool {
1752:     ch.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(ch, '+' | '/' | '=' | '_' | '-')
1753: }
1754: 
1755: fn is_word_char_byte(byte: u8) -> bool {
1756:     byte == b'_' || byte.is_ascii_alphanumeric()
1757: }
1758: 
1759: fn keyword_has_word_boundaries(text: &str, start: usize, length: usize) -> bool {
1760:     let bytes = text.as_bytes();
1761:     let end = start + length;
1762:     let starts_at_boundary = start == 0 || !is_word_char_byte(bytes[start - 1]);
1763:     let ends_at_boundary = end >= bytes.len() || !is_word_char_byte(bytes[end]);
1764:     starts_at_boundary && ends_at_boundary
1765: }
1766: 
1767: fn is_bearer_char(ch: char) -> bool {
1768:     ch.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(ch, '.' | '_' | '~' | '-')
1769: }
1770: 
1771: fn extract_secret_assignment_excerpt(line: &str) -> Option<String> {
1772:     let lower = line.to_ascii_lowercase();
1773:     let keywords = [
1774:         "passphrase",
1775:         "password",
1776:         "api_key",
1777:         "api-key",
1778:         "secret",
1779:         "token",
1780:     ];
1781:     for keyword in keywords {
1782:         let mut search_start = 0usize;
1783:         while let Some(index) = lower[search_start..].find(keyword) {
1784:             let keyword_index = search_start + index;
1785:             if !keyword_has_word_boundaries(lower.as_str(), keyword_index, keyword.len()) {
1786:                 search_start = keyword_index + keyword.len();
1787:                 if search_start >= lower.len() {
1788:                     break;
1789:                 }
1790:                 continue;
1791:             }
1792:             let delimiter_window_end = (keyword_index + keyword.len() + 24).min(line.len());
1793:             for delimiter in [':', '='] {
1794:                 if let Some(offset) = line[keyword_index..delimiter_window_end].find(delimiter) {
1795:                     let delimiter_index = keyword_index + offset;
1796:                     // Reject matches where word characters appear between the keyword and the
1797:                     // delimiter: that means this is a natural-language sentence
1798:                     // (e.g. "passphrase hygiene result:") not a key-value assignment
1799:                     // (e.g. "passphrase: abc" or "\"passphrase\": \"abc\"").
1800:                     let gap = &line[keyword_index + keyword.len()..delimiter_index];
1801:                     if gap.chars().any(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || c == '_') {
1802:                         continue;
1803:                     }
1804:                     let mut value = line[delimiter_index + 1..].trim_start();
1805:                     if value.starts_with('"') || value.starts_with('\'') {
1806:                         value = &value[1..];
1807:                     }
1808:                     let token = value
1809:                         .chars()
1810:                         .take_while(|candidate| is_secret_value_char(*candidate))
1811:                         .collect::<String>();
1812:                     let remainder = value[token.len()..].trim_start();
1813:                     if remainder.starts_with("::") || remainder.starts_with('(') {
1814:                         continue;
1815:                     }
1816:                     if token.len() >= 16 {
1817:                         return Some(line.trim().chars().take(80).collect::<String>());
1818:                     }
1819:                 }
1820:             }
1821:             search_start = keyword_index + keyword.len();
1822:             if search_start >= lower.len() {
1823:                 break;
1824:             }
1825:         }
1826:     }
1827:     None
1828: }
1829: 
1830: fn extract_bearer_excerpt(line: &str) -> Option<String> {
1831:     let lower = line.to_ascii_lowercase();
1832:     let mut search_start = 0usize;
1833:     while let Some(index) = lower[search_start..].find("bearer ") {
1834:         let token_start = search_start + index + "bearer ".len();
1835:         let token = line[token_start..]
1836:             .chars()
1837:             .take_while(|candidate| is_bearer_char(*candidate))
1838:             .collect::<String>();
1839:         if token.len() >= 20 {
1840:             return Some(line.trim().chars().take(80).collect::<String>());
1841:         }
1842:         search_start = token_start;
1843:         if search_start >= lower.len() {
1844:             break;
1845:         }
1846:     }
1847:     None
1848: }
1849: 
1850: fn line_contains_forbidden_inline_passphrase_flag(line: &str) -> bool {
1851:     let passphrase_flag = concat!("--pass", "phrase");
1852:     let mut search_start = 0usize;
1853:     while let Some(index) = line[search_start..].find(passphrase_flag) {
1854:         let flag_start = search_start + index;
1855:         let suffix = &line[flag_start + passphrase_flag.len()..];
1856:         if !suffix.starts_with("-file") {
1857:             return true;
1858:         }
1859:         search_start = flag_start + passphrase_flag.len();
1860:         if search_start >= line.len() {
1861:             break;
1862:         }
1863:     }
1864:     false
1865: }
1866: 
1867: fn parse_mktemp_secret_variable(line: &str) -> Option<String> {
1868:     let trimmed = line.trim();
1869:     let assignment = trimmed.strip_prefix("local ").unwrap_or(trimmed);
1870:     let (variable, value) = assignment.split_once('=')?;
1871:     let variable = variable.trim();
1872:     if variable.is_empty() {
1873:         return None;
1874:     }
1875:     let mut characters = variable.chars();
1876:     let first = characters.next()?;
1877:     if !(first == '_' || first.is_ascii_alphabetic()) {
1878:         return None;
1879:     }
1880:     if !characters.all(|character| character == '_' || character.is_ascii_alphanumeric()) {
1881:         return None;
1882:     }
1883:     if value.trim() != "$(mktemp)" {
1884:         return None;
1885:     }
1886:     let lowered = variable.to_ascii_lowercase();
1887:     if !(lowered.contains("passphrase")
1888:         || lowered.contains("secret")
1889:         || lowered.contains("private")
1890:         || lowered.contains("signing"))
1891:     {
1892:         return None;
1893:     }
1894:     Some(variable.to_string())
1895: }

1897: pub fn execute_ops_check_secrets_hygiene(
1898:     config: CheckSecretsHygieneConfig,
1899: ) -> Result<String, String> {
1900:     let root = phase1_resolve_path(config.root.to_string_lossy().as_ref())?;
1901:     if !root.is_dir() {
1902:         return Err(format!(
1903:             "secrets hygiene scan root must be a directory: {}",
1904:             root.display()
1905:         ));
1906:     }
1907: 
1908:     let tracked_files = parse_git_tracked_files(root.as_path())?;
1909:     let runtime_secret_basenames = BTreeSet::from([
1910:         "membership.owner.key",
1911:         "trust-evidence.key",
1912:         "assignment.signing.secret",
1913:         "wireguard.passphrase",
1914:         "wireguard.key",
1915:     ]);
1916: 
1917:     let tracked_secret_artifacts = tracked_files
1918:         .iter()
1919:         .filter_map(|path| {
1920:             path.file_name()
1921:                 .and_then(|name| name.to_str())
1922:                 .filter(|name| runtime_secret_basenames.contains(*name))
1923:                 .map(|_| path.display().to_string())
1924:         })
1925:         .collect::<Vec<_>>();
1926:     if !tracked_secret_artifacts.is_empty() {
1927:         return Err(secrets_hygiene_error(
1928:             "tracked plaintext runtime secret artifacts are forbidden",
1929:             tracked_secret_artifacts.as_slice(),
1930:         ));
1931:     }
1932: 
1933:     let excluded_roots = BTreeSet::from([".git", "target", ".cargo-home", ".ci-home"]);
1934:     let workspace_files = collect_workspace_files(root.as_path(), &excluded_roots)?;
1935:     let mut workspace_secret_artifacts = Vec::new();
1936:     for file in &workspace_files {
1937:         let relative = file.strip_prefix(root.as_path()).map_err(|err| {
1938:             format!(
1939:                 "resolve relative workspace path failed ({}): {err}",
1940:                 file.display()
1941:             )
1942:         })?;
1943:         if relative
1944:             .file_name()
1945:             .and_then(|name| name.to_str())
1946:             .is_some_and(|name| runtime_secret_basenames.contains(name))
1947:         {
1948:             workspace_secret_artifacts.push(relative.display().to_string());
1949:         }
1950:     }
1951:     if !workspace_secret_artifacts.is_empty() {
1952:         workspace_secret_artifacts.sort();
1953:         return Err(secrets_hygiene_error(
1954:             "workspace contains runtime plaintext secret artifacts (must be encrypted-at-rest or removed)",
1955:             workspace_secret_artifacts.as_slice(),
1956:         ));
1957:     }
1958: 
1959:     let artifact_suffixes = BTreeSet::from([".json", ".log", ".ndjson", ".txt", ".env"]);
1960:     let artifact_roots = ["artifacts", "tmp", "tmpcfg"]
1961:         .into_iter()
1962:         .map(|suffix| root.join(suffix))
1963:         .collect::<Vec<_>>();
1964:     let mut artifact_leaks = Vec::new();
1965:     for artifact_root in artifact_roots {
1966:         if !artifact_root.exists() {
1967:             continue;
1968:         }
1969:         if !artifact_root.is_dir() {
1970:             continue;
1971:         }
1972:         let artifact_files = collect_workspace_files(artifact_root.as_path(), &BTreeSet::new())?;
1973:         for file in artifact_files {
1974:             if file
1975:                 .file_name()
1976:                 .and_then(|name| name.to_str())
1977:                 .is_some_and(|name| name == ".gitkeep")
1978:             {
1979:                 continue;
1980:             }
1981:             let extension = file
1982:                 .extension()
1983:                 .and_then(|value| value.to_str())
1984:                 .map(|value| format!(".{}", value.to_ascii_lowercase()));
1985:             if extension
1986:                 .as_deref()
1987:                 .is_none_or(|value| !artifact_suffixes.contains(value))
1988:             {
1989:                 continue;
1990:             }
1991: 
1992:             let text = read_text_lossy(file.as_path())?;
1993:             let relative = file
1994:                 .strip_prefix(root.as_path())
1995:                 .map_err(|err| {
1996:                     format!(
1997:                         "resolve artifact relative path failed ({}): {err}",
1998:                         file.display()
1999:                     )
2000:                 })?
2001:                 .display()
2002:                 .to_string();
2003:             for line in text.lines() {
2004:                 let upper = line.to_ascii_uppercase();
2005:                 if upper.contains("-----BEGIN ") && upper.contains("PRIVATE KEY-----") {
2006:                     artifact_leaks.push(format!(
2007:                         "{relative} [private-key-block] -> {}",
2008:                         line.trim().chars().take(80).collect::<String>()
2009:                     ));
2010:                     break;
2011:                 }
2012:                 if let Some(excerpt) = extract_secret_assignment_excerpt(line) {
2013:                     artifact_leaks.push(format!("{relative} [secret-assignment] -> {excerpt}"));
2014:                     break;
2015:                 }
2016:                 if let Some(excerpt) = extract_bearer_excerpt(line) {
2017:                     artifact_leaks.push(format!("{relative} [bearer-token] -> {excerpt}"));
2018:                     break;
2019:                 }
2020:             }
2021:         }
2022:     }
2023:     if !artifact_leaks.is_empty() {
2024:         artifact_leaks.sort();
2025:         return Err(secrets_hygiene_error(
2026:             "artifact/log leak scan detected possible secrets",
2027:             artifact_leaks.as_slice(),
2028:         ));
2029:     }
2030: 
2031:     let mut argv_violations = Vec::new();
2032:     for relative in &tracked_files {
2033:         let extension = relative.extension().and_then(|value| value.to_str());
2034:         if !matches!(extension, Some("rs" | "sh" | "service" | "timer")) {
2035:             continue;
2036:         }
2037:         if relative == Path::new("scripts/ci/secrets_hygiene_gates.sh") {
2038:             continue;
2039:         }
2040:         let absolute = root.join(relative);
2041:         if !absolute.is_file() {
2042:             continue;
2043:         }
2044:         let text = read_text_lossy(absolute.as_path())?;
2045:         for (line_index, line) in text.lines().enumerate() {
2046:             let line_number = line_index + 1;
2047:             if line_contains_forbidden_inline_passphrase_flag(line) {
2048:                 argv_violations.push(format!(
2049:                     "{}:{line_number} contains forbidden inline secret argv flag ({}{}{}) -> {}",
2050:                     relative.display(),
2051:                     concat!("--pass", "phrase"),
2052:                     "(?!-",
2053:                     "file)",
2054:                     line.trim()
2055:                 ));
2056:             }
2057:             for flag in [
2058:                 concat!("--pass", "word"),
2059:                 concat!("--secret", "-value"),
2060:                 concat!("--token", "-value"),
2061:             ] {
2062:                 if line.contains(flag) {
2063:                     argv_violations.push(format!(
2064:                         "{}:{line_number} contains forbidden inline secret argv flag ({flag}) -> {}",
2065:                         relative.display(),
2066:                         line.trim()
2067:                     ));
2068:                 }
2069:             }
2070:         }
2071:     }
2072:     if !argv_violations.is_empty() {
2073:         argv_violations.sort();
2074:         return Err(secrets_hygiene_error(
2075:             "inline secret argv flags detected",
2076:             argv_violations.as_slice(),
2077:         ));
2078:     }
2079: 
2080:     let mut rm_violations = Vec::new();
2081:     let sensitive_names = [
2082:         "membership.owner.key",
2083:         "trust-evidence.key",
2084:         "assignment.signing.secret",
2085:         "wireguard.passphrase",
2086:         "wireguard.key",
2087:     ];
2088:     let mut mktemp_violations = Vec::new();
2089:     for relative in &tracked_files {
2090:         if relative.extension().and_then(|value| value.to_str()) != Some("sh") {
2091:             continue;
2092:         }
2093:         let absolute = root.join(relative);
2094:         if !absolute.is_file() {
2095:             continue;
2096:         }
2097:         let text = read_text_lossy(absolute.as_path())?;
2098:         for (line_index, line) in text.lines().enumerate() {
2099:             let line_number = line_index + 1;
2100:             if line.contains("rm -f") && sensitive_names.iter().any(|name| line.contains(name)) {
2101:                 rm_violations.push(format!(
2102:                     "{}:{line_number} -> {}",
2103:                     relative.display(),
2104:                     line.trim()
2105:                 ));
2106:             }
2107:             if let Some(variable) = parse_mktemp_secret_variable(line) {
2108:                 let braced = format!("${{{variable}}}");
2109:                 let chmod_plain = format!("chmod 600 \"{braced}\"");
2110:                 let chmod_run_root = format!("run_root chmod 600 \"{braced}\"");
2111:                 let cleanup_plain = format!("secure_remove_file \"{braced}\"");
2112:                 let cleanup_scope = format!("secure_remove_file_with_scope \"{braced}\"");
2113: 
2114:                 if !text.contains(chmod_plain.as_str()) && !text.contains(chmod_run_root.as_str()) {
2115:                     mktemp_violations.push(format!(
2116:                         "{}:{line_number} missing chmod 600 for mktemp secret variable {}",
2117:                         relative.display(),
2118:                         variable
2119:                     ));
2120:                 }
2121:                 if !text.contains(cleanup_plain.as_str()) && !text.contains(cleanup_scope.as_str())
2122:                 {
2123:                     mktemp_violations.push(format!(
2124:                         "{}:{line_number} missing secure-remove cleanup for mktemp secret variable {}",
2125:                         relative.display(),
2126:                         variable
2127:                     ));
2128:                 }
2129:             }
2130:         }
2131:     }
2132: 
2133:     if !rm_violations.is_empty() {
2134:         rm_violations.sort();
2135:         return Err(secrets_hygiene_error(
2136:             "shell scripts use rm -f on sensitive key/passphrase artifacts",
2137:             rm_violations.as_slice(),
2138:         ));
2139:     }
2140: 
2141:     if !mktemp_violations.is_empty() {
2142:         mktemp_violations.sort();
2143:         return Err(secrets_hygiene_error(
2144:             "mktemp secret handling is missing strict tmp-mode or secure cleanup",
2145:             mktemp_violations.as_slice(),
2146:         ));
2147:     }
2148: 
2149:     Ok("Secrets hygiene gate: PASS".to_string())
2150: }

2152: fn unix_now() -> u64 {
2153:     SystemTime::now()
2154:         .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
2155:         .unwrap_or_default()
2156:         .as_secs()
2157: }

 136: fn env_optional_string(key: &str) -> Result<Option<String>, String> {
 137:     match std::env::var(key) {
 138:         Ok(value) => {
 139:             let trimmed = value.trim();
 140:             if trimmed.is_empty() {
 141:                 Ok(None)
 142:             } else {
 143:                 Ok(Some(trimmed.to_string()))
 144:             }
 145:         }
 146:         Err(std::env::VarError::NotPresent) => Ok(None),
 147:         Err(std::env::VarError::NotUnicode(_)) => {
 148:             Err(format!("environment variable {key} contains non-utf8 data"))
 149:         }
 150:     }
 151: }
 152: 
 153: fn required_env_string(key: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
 154:     env_optional_string(key)?.ok_or_else(|| format!("missing required environment variable: {key}"))
 155: }
 156: 
 157: fn resolve_path(raw: &str) -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
 158:     let trimmed = raw.trim();
 159:     if trimmed.is_empty() {
 160:         return Err("path must not be empty".to_string());
 161:     }
 162:     let path = PathBuf::from(trimmed);
 163:     if path.is_absolute() {
 164:         return Ok(path);
 165:     }
 166:     let cwd = std::env::current_dir()
 167:         .map_err(|err| format!("resolve current directory failed: {err}"))?;
 168:     Ok(cwd.join(path))
 169: }
 170: 
 171: fn path_from_env_or_default(key: &str, default: &str) -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
 172:     let raw = env_optional_string(key)?.unwrap_or_else(|| default.to_string());
 173:     resolve_path(raw.as_str())
 174: }
 175: 
 176: fn phase10_artifact_dir_from_env() -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
 177:     if let Some(value) = env_optional_string("RUSTYNET_PHASE10_ARTIFACT_DIR")? {
 178:         return resolve_path(value.as_str());
 179:     }
 180:     path_from_env_or_default("RUSTYNET_PHASE10_OUT_DIR", DEFAULT_PHASE10_OUT_DIR)
 181: }

 183: fn env_u64_with_default(key: &str, default: u64) -> Result<u64, String> {
 184:     match env_optional_string(key)? {
 185:         Some(raw) => raw
 186:             .parse::<u64>()
 187:             .map_err(|err| format!("invalid integer value for {key}: {err}")),
 188:         None => Ok(default),
 189:     }
 190: }

 192: fn unix_now() -> u64 {
 193:     SystemTime::now()
 194:         .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
 195:         .unwrap_or_default()
 196:         .as_secs()
 197: }

 199: fn hex_encode(bytes: &[u8]) -> String {
 200:     let mut out = String::with_capacity(bytes.len() * 2);
 201:     for byte in bytes {
 202:         out.push_str(&format!("{byte:02x}"));
 203:     }
 204:     out
 205: }
 206: 
 207: fn decode_hex_to_fixed<const N: usize>(value: &str) -> Result<[u8; N], String> {
 208:     let normalized = value.trim();
 209:     if normalized.len() != N * 2 {
 210:         return Err(format!("expected {} hex characters", N * 2));
 211:     }
 212:     let mut out = [0u8; N];
 213:     let bytes = normalized.as_bytes();
 214:     for (index, slot) in out.iter_mut().enumerate().take(N) {
 215:         let offset = index * 2;
 216:         let hi = (bytes[offset] as char)
 217:             .to_digit(16)
 218:             .ok_or_else(|| "invalid hex character".to_string())?;
 219:         let lo = (bytes[offset + 1] as char)
 220:             .to_digit(16)
 221:             .ok_or_else(|| "invalid hex character".to_string())?;
 222:         *slot = ((hi << 4) | lo) as u8;
 223:     }
 224:     Ok(out)
 225: }
 226: 
 227: fn sha256_hex(bytes: &[u8]) -> String {
 228:     let digest = Sha256::digest(bytes);
 229:     hex_encode(&digest)
 230: }
 231: 
 232: fn sha256_file_hex(path: &Path) -> Result<String, String> {
 233:     let body = fs::read(path).map_err(|err| format!("read {} failed: {err}", path.display()))?;
 234:     Ok(sha256_hex(&body))
 235: }
 236: 
 237: fn ensure_regular_file(path: &Path, label: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
 238:     let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(path)
 239:         .map_err(|err| format!("missing required {label}: {} ({err})", path.display()))?;
 240:     if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
 241:         return Err(format!("{label} must not be a symlink: {}", path.display()));
 242:     }
 243:     if !metadata.file_type().is_file() {
 244:         return Err(format!(
 245:             "{label} must be a regular file: {}",
 246:             path.display()
 247:         ));
 248:     }
 249:     Ok(())
 250: }
 251: 
 252: fn ensure_trusted_owner(path: &Path, metadata: &fs::Metadata, label: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
 253:     let owner_uid = metadata.uid();
 254:     let expected_uid = Uid::effective().as_raw();
 255:     if owner_uid != expected_uid {
 256:         return Err(format!(
 257:             "{label} owner is not trusted ({} uid={owner_uid} expected_uid={expected_uid})",
 258:             path.display()
 259:         ));
 260:     }
 261:     Ok(())
 262: }
 263: 
 264: fn enforce_owner_only_mode(path: &Path, label: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
 265:     let mut metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(path)
 266:         .map_err(|err| format!("inspect {label} failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
 267:     ensure_trusted_owner(path, &metadata, label)?;
 268:     let mode = metadata.permissions().mode() & 0o777;
 269:     if mode & 0o077 != 0 {
 270:         let hardened_mode = mode & !0o077;
 271:         fs::set_permissions(path, fs::Permissions::from_mode(hardened_mode)).map_err(|err| {
 272:             format!(
 273:                 "failed to harden {label} mode ({} mode {:o} -> {:o}): {err}",
 274:                 path.display(),
 275:                 mode,
 276:                 hardened_mode
 277:             )
 278:         })?;
 279:         metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(path)
 280:             .map_err(|err| format!("inspect {label} failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
 281:         ensure_trusted_owner(path, &metadata, label)?;
 282:     }
 283:     let mode = metadata.permissions().mode() & 0o777;
 284:     if mode & 0o077 != 0 {
 285:         return Err(format!(
 286:             "{label} must not be group/world accessible (expected <= 0600): {}",
 287:             path.display()
 288:         ));
 289:     }
 290:     Ok(())
 291: }
 292: 
 293: fn ensure_secure_parent_directory(path: &Path, label: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
 294:     let parent = path
 295:         .parent()
 296:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("{label} has no parent directory: {}", path.display()))?;
 297:     let parent_label = format!("{label} parent");
 298:     let mut metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(parent).map_err(|err| {
 299:         format!(
 300:             "inspect {label} parent failed ({}): {err}",
 301:             parent.display()
 302:         )
 303:     })?;
 304:     if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
 305:         return Err(format!(
 306:             "{label} parent must not be a symlink: {}",
 307:             parent.display()
 308:         ));
 309:     }
 310:     if !metadata.file_type().is_dir() {
 311:         return Err(format!(
 312:             "{label} parent must be a directory: {}",
 313:             parent.display()
 314:         ));
 315:     }
 316:     ensure_trusted_owner(parent, &metadata, parent_label.as_str())?;
 317:     let mode = metadata.permissions().mode() & 0o777;
 318:     if mode & 0o077 != 0 {
 319:         let hardened_mode = mode & !0o077;
 320:         fs::set_permissions(parent, fs::Permissions::from_mode(hardened_mode)).map_err(|err| {
 321:             format!(
 322:                 "failed to harden {label} parent mode ({} mode {:o} -> {:o}): {err}",
 323:                 parent.display(),
 324:                 mode,
 325:                 hardened_mode
 326:             )
 327:         })?;
 328:         metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(parent).map_err(|err| {
 329:             format!(
 330:                 "inspect {label} parent failed ({}): {err}",
 331:                 parent.display()
 332:             )
 333:         })?;
 334:         ensure_trusted_owner(parent, &metadata, parent_label.as_str())?;
 335:     }
 336:     let mode = metadata.permissions().mode() & 0o777;
 337:     if mode & 0o077 != 0 {
 338:         return Err(format!(
 339:             "{label} parent must not be group/world accessible (expected <= 0700): {}",
 340:             parent.display()
 341:         ));
 342:     }
 343:     Ok(())
 344: }
 345: 
 346: fn ensure_secure_directory(path: &Path, label: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
 347:     if path.exists() {
 348:         let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(path)
 349:             .map_err(|err| format!("inspect {label} failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
 350:         if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
 351:             return Err(format!("{label} must not be a symlink: {}", path.display()));
 352:         }
 353:         if !metadata.file_type().is_dir() {
 354:             return Err(format!("{label} must be a directory: {}", path.display()));
 355:         }
 356:     } else {
 357:         fs::create_dir_all(path)
 358:             .map_err(|err| format!("create {label} failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
 359:     }
 360:     fs::set_permissions(path, fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o700))
 361:         .map_err(|err| format!("set {label} mode failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
 362:     let mode = fs::symlink_metadata(path)
 363:         .map_err(|err| format!("inspect {label} failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?
 364:         .permissions()
 365:         .mode()
 366:         & 0o777;
 367:     if mode & 0o077 != 0 {
 368:         return Err(format!(
 369:             "{label} must not be group/world accessible (expected <= 0700): {}",
 370:             path.display()
 371:         ));
 372:     }
 373:     Ok(())
 374: }
 375: 
 376: fn secure_regular_file_exists(path: &Path, label: &str) -> Result<bool, String> {
 377:     match fs::symlink_metadata(path) {
 378:         Ok(metadata) => {
 379:             if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
 380:                 return Err(format!("{label} must not be a symlink: {}", path.display()));
 381:             }
 382:             if !metadata.file_type().is_file() {
 383:                 return Err(format!(
 384:                     "{label} must be a regular file: {}",
 385:                     path.display()
 386:                 ));
 387:             }
 388:             Ok(true)
 389:         }
 390:         Err(err) if err.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => Ok(false),
 391:         Err(err) => Err(format!(
 392:             "inspect {label} failed ({}): {err}",
 393:             path.display()
 394:         )),
 395:     }
 396: }
 397: 
 398: fn load_key_hex_from_secure_path(path: &Path, label: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
 399:     ensure_secure_parent_directory(path, label)?;
 400:     ensure_regular_file(path, label)?;
 401:     enforce_owner_only_mode(path, label)?;
 402:     let raw = fs::read_to_string(path)
 403:         .map_err(|err| format!("read {label} failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
 404:     let normalized = raw.trim();
 405:     if normalized.is_empty() {
 406:         return Err(format!("{label} must not be empty: {}", path.display()));
 407:     }
 408:     Ok(normalized.to_string())
 409: }

 434: fn write_phase10_provenance_keypair(
 435:     signing_key_path: &Path,
 436:     verifier_key_path: &Path,
 437: ) -> Result<(), String> {
 438:     let signing_parent = signing_key_path.parent().ok_or_else(|| {
 439:         format!(
 440:             "phase10 provenance signing key path has no parent: {}",
 441:             signing_key_path.display()
 442:         )
 443:     })?;
 444:     ensure_secure_directory(signing_parent, "phase10 provenance key directory")?;
 445: 
 446:     let verifier_parent = verifier_key_path.parent().ok_or_else(|| {
 447:         format!(
 448:             "phase10 provenance verifier key path has no parent: {}",
 449:             verifier_key_path.display()
 450:         )
 451:     })?;
 452:     if verifier_parent != signing_parent {
 453:         ensure_secure_directory(verifier_parent, "phase10 provenance key directory")?;
 454:     }
 455: 
 456:     let mut signing_seed = [0u8; 32];
 457:     fill_os_random_bytes(&mut signing_seed, "phase10 provenance signing seed")?;
 458:     let signing_key = SigningKey::from_bytes(&signing_seed);
 459:     let verifier_key = signing_key.verifying_key();
 460:     let mut signing_key_hex = hex_encode(&signing_seed);
 461:     let mut signing_key_body = signing_key_hex.clone();
 462:     signing_key_body.push('\n');
 463:     let verifier_key_body = format!("{}\n", hex_encode(verifier_key.as_bytes()));
 464:     let write_result = (|| {
 465:         write_secure_bytes(signing_key_path, signing_key_body.as_bytes())?;
 466:         write_secure_bytes(verifier_key_path, verifier_key_body.as_bytes())?;
 467:         Ok(())
 468:     })();
 469:     signing_seed.zeroize();
 470:     signing_key_hex.zeroize();
 471:     signing_key_body.zeroize();
 472:     write_result
 473: }
 474: 
 475: fn ensure_phase10_provenance_keypair_exists() -> Result<(), String> {
 476:     let signing_key_path = phase10_signing_key_path_from_env_or_default()?;
 477:     let verifier_key_path = phase10_verifier_key_path_from_env_or_default()?;
 478:     if !signing_key_path.is_absolute() {
 479:         return Err(format!(
 480:             "{PHASE10_PROVENANCE_SIGNING_KEY_PATH_ENV} must resolve to an absolute path"
 481:         ));
 482:     }
 483:     if !verifier_key_path.is_absolute() {
 484:         return Err(format!(
 485:             "{PHASE10_PROVENANCE_VERIFIER_KEY_PATH_ENV} must resolve to an absolute path"
 486:         ));
 487:     }
 488: 
 489:     let signing_exists =
 490:         secure_regular_file_exists(signing_key_path.as_path(), "phase10 provenance signing key")?;
 491:     let verifier_exists = secure_regular_file_exists(
 492:         verifier_key_path.as_path(),
 493:         "phase10 provenance verifier key",
 494:     )?;
 495: 
 496:     match (signing_exists, verifier_exists) {
 497:         (true, true) => Ok(()),
 498:         (false, false) => {
 499:             write_phase10_provenance_keypair(signing_key_path.as_path(), verifier_key_path.as_path())
 500:         }
 501:         _ => Err(
 502:             "phase10 provenance key material is incomplete: signing and verifier keys must either both exist or both be absent".to_string(),
 503:         ),
 504:     }
 505: }

 507: fn load_phase10_signing_key() -> Result<SigningKey, String> {
 508:     let key_path = phase10_signing_key_path_from_env_or_default()?;
 509:     if !key_path.is_absolute() {
 510:         return Err(format!(
 511:             "{PHASE10_PROVENANCE_SIGNING_KEY_PATH_ENV} must resolve to an absolute path"
 512:         ));
 513:     }
 514:     let key_hex =
 515:         load_key_hex_from_secure_path(key_path.as_path(), "phase10 provenance signing key")?;
 516:     let seed = decode_hex_to_fixed::<32>(key_hex.as_str())
 517:         .map_err(|err| format!("invalid phase10 provenance signing key hex: {err}"))?;
 518:     Ok(SigningKey::from_bytes(&seed))
 519: }
 520: 
 521: fn load_phase10_verifier_key() -> Result<VerifyingKey, String> {
 522:     let key_path = phase10_verifier_key_path_from_env_or_default()?;
 523:     if !key_path.is_absolute() {
 524:         return Err(format!(
 525:             "{PHASE10_PROVENANCE_VERIFIER_KEY_PATH_ENV} must resolve to an absolute path"
 526:         ));
 527:     }
 528:     let key_hex =
 529:         load_key_hex_from_secure_path(key_path.as_path(), "phase10 provenance verifier key")?;
 530:     let key_bytes = decode_hex_to_fixed::<32>(key_hex.as_str())
 531:         .map_err(|err| format!("invalid phase10 provenance verifier key hex: {err}"))?;
 532:     VerifyingKey::from_bytes(&key_bytes)
 533:         .map_err(|err| format!("parse phase10 provenance verifier key failed: {err}"))
 534: }

 536: fn validate_phase10_host_identity(host_identity: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
 537:     if host_identity.len() > 128 {
 538:         return Err("phase10 provenance host identity must be <= 128 characters".to_string());
 539:     }
 540:     if !host_identity
 541:         .chars()
 542:         .all(|ch| ch.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(ch, '-' | '_' | '.' | ':' | '/'))
 543:     {
 544:         return Err("phase10 provenance host identity contains unsupported characters".to_string());
 545:     }
 546:     Ok(host_identity.to_string())
 547: }

 551:         Some(value) => validate_phase10_host_identity(value.as_str()),
 552:         None => Ok(DEFAULT_PHASE10_PROVENANCE_HOST_ID.to_string()),
 553:     }
 554: }

 688: fn current_git_commit() -> Result<String, String> {
 689:     let output = Command::new("git")
 690:         .arg("rev-parse")
 691:         .arg("HEAD")
 692:         .stdout(Stdio::piped())
 693:         .stderr(Stdio::piped())
 694:         .output()
 695:         .map_err(|err| format!("invoke git rev-parse HEAD failed: {err}"))?;
 696:     if !output.status.success() {
 697:         return Err(format!(
 698:             "git rev-parse HEAD failed with status {}",
 699:             output.status
 700:         ));
 701:     }
 702:     let commit = String::from_utf8(output.stdout)
 703:         .map_err(|err| format!("decode git commit output failed: {err}"))?
 704:         .trim()
 705:         .to_ascii_lowercase();
 706:     if commit.len() != 40 || !commit.chars().all(|ch| ch.is_ascii_hexdigit()) {
 707:         return Err(format!(
 708:             "git rev-parse HEAD returned invalid commit: {commit}"
 709:         ));
 710:     }
 711:     Ok(commit)
 712: }
 713: 
 714: fn read_sha256_digest_file(path: &Path, label: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
 715:     let body = read_utf8_regular_file_with_max_bytes(path, label, 256)?;
 716:     let digest = body.trim();
 717:     if digest.len() != 64 || !digest.chars().all(|ch| ch.is_ascii_hexdigit()) {
 718:         return Err(format!(
 719:             "{label} must contain a 64-character hex sha256 digest: {}",
 720:             path.display()
 721:         ));
 722:     }
 723:     Ok(digest.to_ascii_lowercase())
 724: }

 726: fn write_release_provenance_keypair(
 727:     signing_key_path: &Path,
 728:     verifier_key_path: &Path,
 729: ) -> Result<(), String> {
 730:     let signing_parent = signing_key_path.parent().ok_or_else(|| {
 731:         format!(
 732:             "release provenance signing key path has no parent: {}",
 733:             signing_key_path.display()
 734:         )
 735:     })?;
 736:     ensure_secure_directory(signing_parent, "release provenance key directory")?;
 737: 
 738:     let verifier_parent = verifier_key_path.parent().ok_or_else(|| {
 739:         format!(
 740:             "release provenance verifier key path has no parent: {}",
 741:             verifier_key_path.display()
 742:         )
 743:     })?;
 744:     if verifier_parent != signing_parent {
 745:         ensure_secure_directory(verifier_parent, "release provenance key directory")?;
 746:     }
 747: 
 748:     let mut signing_seed = [0u8; 32];
 749:     fill_os_random_bytes(&mut signing_seed, "release provenance signing seed")?;
 750:     let signing_key = SigningKey::from_bytes(&signing_seed);
 751:     let verifier_key = signing_key.verifying_key();
 752:     let mut signing_key_hex = hex_encode(&signing_seed);
 753:     let mut signing_key_body = signing_key_hex.clone();
 754:     signing_key_body.push('\n');
 755:     let verifier_key_body = format!("{}\n", hex_encode(verifier_key.as_bytes()));
 756:     let write_result = (|| {
 757:         write_secure_bytes(signing_key_path, signing_key_body.as_bytes())?;
 758:         write_secure_bytes(verifier_key_path, verifier_key_body.as_bytes())?;
 759:         Ok(())
 760:     })();
 761:     signing_seed.zeroize();
 762:     signing_key_hex.zeroize();
 763:     signing_key_body.zeroize();
 764:     write_result
 765: }
 766: 
 767: fn ensure_release_provenance_keypair_exists() -> Result<(), String> {
 768:     let signing_key_path = release_signing_key_path_from_env_or_default()?;
 769:     let verifier_key_path = release_verifier_key_path_from_env_or_default()?;
 770:     if !signing_key_path.is_absolute() {
 771:         return Err(format!(
 772:             "{RELEASE_PROVENANCE_SIGNING_KEY_PATH_ENV} must resolve to an absolute path"
 773:         ));
 774:     }
 775:     if !verifier_key_path.is_absolute() {
 776:         return Err(format!(
 777:             "{RELEASE_PROVENANCE_VERIFIER_KEY_PATH_ENV} must resolve to an absolute path"
 778:         ));
 779:     }
 780: 
 781:     let signing_exists =
 782:         secure_regular_file_exists(signing_key_path.as_path(), "release provenance signing key")?;
 783:     let verifier_exists = secure_regular_file_exists(
 784:         verifier_key_path.as_path(),
 785:         "release provenance verifier key",
 786:     )?;
 787: 
 788:     match (signing_exists, verifier_exists) {
 789:         (true, true) => Ok(()),
 790:         (false, false) => write_release_provenance_keypair(
 791:             signing_key_path.as_path(),
 792:             verifier_key_path.as_path(),
 793:         ),
 794:         _ => Err(
 795:             "release provenance key material is incomplete: signing and verifier keys must either both exist or both be absent".to_string(),
 796:         ),
 797:     }
 798: }

 800: fn load_release_signing_key() -> Result<SigningKey, String> {
 801:     let key_path = release_signing_key_path_from_env_or_default()?;
 802:     if !key_path.is_absolute() {
 803:         return Err(format!(
 804:             "{RELEASE_PROVENANCE_SIGNING_KEY_PATH_ENV} must resolve to an absolute path"
 805:         ));
 806:     }
 807:     let key_hex =
 808:         load_key_hex_from_secure_path(key_path.as_path(), "release provenance signing key")?;
 809:     let seed = decode_hex_to_fixed::<32>(key_hex.as_str())
 810:         .map_err(|err| format!("invalid release provenance signing key hex: {err}"))?;
 811:     Ok(SigningKey::from_bytes(&seed))
 812: }
 813: 
 814: fn load_release_verifier_key() -> Result<VerifyingKey, String> {
 815:     let key_path = release_verifier_key_path_from_env_or_default()?;
 816:     if !key_path.is_absolute() {
 817:         return Err(format!(
 818:             "{RELEASE_PROVENANCE_VERIFIER_KEY_PATH_ENV} must resolve to an absolute path"
 819:         ));
 820:     }
 821:     let key_hex =
 822:         load_key_hex_from_secure_path(key_path.as_path(), "release provenance verifier key")?;
 823:     let key_bytes = decode_hex_to_fixed::<32>(key_hex.as_str())
 824:         .map_err(|err| format!("invalid release provenance verifier key hex: {err}"))?;
 825:     VerifyingKey::from_bytes(&key_bytes)
 826:         .map_err(|err| format!("parse release provenance verifier key failed: {err}"))
 827: }

 829: fn read_utf8_regular_file_with_max_bytes(
 830:     path: &Path,
 831:     label: &str,
 832:     max_bytes: u64,
 833: ) -> Result<String, String> {
 834:     ensure_regular_file(path, label)?;
 835:     let metadata = fs::metadata(path)
 836:         .map_err(|err| format!("inspect {label} failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
 837:     if metadata.len() > max_bytes {
 838:         return Err(format!(
 839:             "{label} exceeds maximum size ({} bytes > {} bytes): {}",
 840:             metadata.len(),
 841:             max_bytes,
 842:             path.display()
 843:         ));
 844:     }
 845:     let body =
 846:         fs::read(path).map_err(|err| format!("read {label} failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
 847:     if (body.len() as u64) > max_bytes {
 848:         return Err(format!(
 849:             "{label} exceeds maximum size after read ({} bytes > {} bytes): {}",
 850:             body.len(),
 851:             max_bytes,
 852:             path.display()
 853:         ));
 854:     }
 855:     String::from_utf8(body)
 856:         .map_err(|err| format!("decode {label} as utf-8 failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))
 857: }
 858: 
 859: fn read_json_object(path: &Path, label: &str) -> Result<Map<String, Value>, String> {
 860:     let body = read_utf8_regular_file_with_max_bytes(path, label, MAX_PHASE10_JSON_SOURCE_BYTES)?;
 861:     let value: Value = serde_json::from_str(body.as_str())
 862:         .map_err(|err| format!("parse {label} failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
 863:     value
 864:         .as_object()
 865:         .cloned()
 866:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("{label} must be a JSON object: {}", path.display()))
 867: }

 869: fn create_secure_temp_file(dir: &Path, prefix: &str) -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
 870:     fs::create_dir_all(dir)
 871:         .map_err(|err| format!("create directory {} failed: {err}", dir.display()))?;
 872:     let pid = std::process::id();
 873:     let nonce = SystemTime::now()
 874:         .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
 875:         .map_err(|err| format!("system time before unix epoch: {err}"))?
 876:         .as_nanos();
 877:     for counter in 0..32u32 {
 878:         let candidate = dir.join(format!("{prefix}{pid}-{nonce}-{counter}"));
 879:         match OpenOptions::new()
 880:             .create_new(true)
 881:             .read(true)
 882:             .write(true)
 883:             .mode(0o600)
 884:             .open(&candidate)
 885:         {
 886:             Ok(_) => return Ok(candidate),
 887:             Err(err) if err.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::AlreadyExists => continue,
 888:             Err(err) => {
 889:                 return Err(format!(
 890:                     "create secure temporary file failed ({}): {err}",
 891:                     candidate.display()
 892:                 ));
 893:             }
 894:         }
 895:     }
 896:     Err(format!(
 897:         "unable to allocate secure temporary file in {}",
 898:         dir.display()
 899:     ))
 900: }
 901: 
 902: fn write_secure_bytes(path: &Path, body: &[u8]) -> Result<(), String> {
 903:     let parent = path
 904:         .parent()
 905:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("path has no parent: {}", path.display()))?;
 906:     fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|err| {
 907:         format!(
 908:             "create output directory failed ({}): {err}",
 909:             parent.display()
 910:         )
 911:     })?;
 912: 
 913:     if path.exists() {
 914:         let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(path)
 915:             .map_err(|err| format!("inspect output path failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
 916:         if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
 917:             return Err(format!(
 918:                 "output path must not be a symlink: {}",
 919:                 path.display()
 920:             ));
 921:         }
 922:         if !metadata.file_type().is_file() {
 923:             return Err(format!("output path must be a file: {}", path.display()));
 924:         }
 925:     }
 926: 
 927:     let temp_path = create_secure_temp_file(parent, "ops-evidence.")?;
 928:     {
 929:         let mut file = OpenOptions::new()
 930:             .write(true)
 931:             .truncate(true)
 932:             .mode(0o600)
 933:             .open(temp_path.as_path())
 934:             .map_err(|err| format!("open temp output failed ({}): {err}", temp_path.display()))?;
 935:         file.write_all(body)
 936:             .map_err(|err| format!("write temp output failed ({}): {err}", temp_path.display()))?;
 937:         file.sync_all()
 938:             .map_err(|err| format!("sync temp output failed ({}): {err}", temp_path.display()))?;
 939:     }
 940:     fs::set_permissions(temp_path.as_path(), fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o600)).map_err(|err| {
 941:         format!(
 942:             "set temp output mode failed ({}): {err}",
 943:             temp_path.display()
 944:         )
 945:     })?;
 946:     fs::rename(temp_path.as_path(), path)
 947:         .map_err(|err| format!("publish output failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
 948:     fs::set_permissions(path, fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o600))
 949:         .map_err(|err| format!("set output mode failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
 950:     Ok(())
 951: }
 952: 
 953: fn write_json_secure(path: &Path, payload: &Value) -> Result<(), String> {
 954:     let mut body = serde_json::to_string_pretty(payload)
 955:         .map_err(|err| format!("serialize json failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
 956:     body.push('\n');
 957:     write_secure_bytes(path, body.as_bytes())
 958: }

 966:             "{label} failed with status {status} ({script_path})"
 967:         ));

 970: }

 986: fn ensure_directory(path: &Path, label: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
 987:     if path.exists() {
 988:         let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(path)
 989:             .map_err(|err| format!("inspect {label} failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
 990:         if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
 991:             return Err(format!("{label} must not be a symlink: {}", path.display()));
 992:         }

 994:             return Err(format!("{label} must be a directory: {}", path.display()));
 995:         }

 998:     fs::create_dir_all(path)

1002: fn read_ndjson_objects(path: &Path, label: &str) -> Result<Vec<Map<String, Value>>, String> {
1003:     let body = fs::read_to_string(path)
1004:         .map_err(|err| format!("read {label} failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
1005:     let mut entries = Vec::new();
1006:     for (line_number, line) in body.lines().enumerate() {
1007:         let trimmed = line.trim();
1008:         if trimmed.is_empty() {
1009:             continue;
1010:         }
1011:         let value: Value = serde_json::from_str(trimmed).map_err(|err| {
1012:             format!(
1013:                 "invalid ndjson at {}:{} ({label}): {err}",
1014:                 path.display(),
1015:                 line_number + 1
1016:             )
1017:         })?;
1018:         let object = value.as_object().ok_or_else(|| {
1019:             format!(
1020:                 "invalid ndjson object at {}:{} ({label})",
1021:                 path.display(),
1022:                 line_number + 1
1023:             )
1024:         })?;
1025:         entries.push(object.clone());
1026:     }
1027:     if entries.is_empty() {
1028:         return Err(format!("no entries in ndjson source: {}", path.display()));
1029:     }
1030:     Ok(entries)
1031: }

1037:         .truncate(true)

1040:         .map_err(|err| format!("open log file failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))

1043: fn run_logged_command(
1044:     mut command: Command,
1045:     log_path: &Path,
1046:     label: &str,
1047: ) -> Result<std::process::ExitStatus, String> {
1048:     let stdout = open_secure_log_file(log_path)?;
1049:     let stderr = stdout
1050:         .try_clone()
1051:         .map_err(|err| format!("clone log file failed ({}): {err}", log_path.display()))?;
1052:     let status = command
1053:         .stdout(Stdio::from(stdout))
1054:         .stderr(Stdio::from(stderr))
1055:         .status()
1056:         .map_err(|err| format!("invoke {label} failed: {err}"))?;
1057:     fs::set_permissions(log_path, fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o600))
1058:         .map_err(|err| format!("set log mode failed ({}): {err}", log_path.display()))?;
1059:     Ok(status)
1060: }

1062: fn phase9_backend_leakage_pattern() -> String {
1063:     "(wireguard|wg[-_]|wgctrl)".to_string()
1064: }

1066: fn run_phase9_backend_probes(
1067:     source_dir: &Path,
1068:     run_backend_probes: bool,
1069: ) -> Result<Phase9BackendProbeStatus, String> {
1070:     let mut status = Phase9BackendProbeStatus {
1071:         conformance_wireguard: false,
1072:         conformance_backend_api: false,
1073:         protocol_leakage_detected: true,
1074:     };
1075:     if !run_backend_probes {
1076:         return Ok(status);
1077:     }
1078: 
1079:     let wireguard_log = source_dir.join("backend_conformance_wireguard.log");
1080:     let backend_wireguard = run_logged_command(
1081:         {
1082:             let mut command = Command::new("cargo");
1083:             command.args([
1084:                 "test",
1085:                 "-p",
1086:                 "rustynet-backend-wireguard",
1087:                 "--test",
1088:                 "conformance",
1089:                 "--all-features",
1090:             ]);
1091:             command
1092:         },
1093:         wireguard_log.as_path(),
1094:         "phase9 wireguard backend conformance",
1095:     )?;
1096:     status.conformance_wireguard = backend_wireguard.success();
1097: 
1098:     let backend_api_log = source_dir.join("backend_conformance_api.log");
1099:     let backend_api = run_logged_command(
1100:         {
1101:             let mut command = Command::new("cargo");
1102:             command.args([
1103:                 "test",
1104:                 "-p",
1105:                 "rustynet-backend-api",
1106:                 "--all-targets",
1107:                 "--all-features",
1108:             ]);
1109:             command
1110:         },
1111:         backend_api_log.as_path(),
1112:         "phase9 backend api conformance",
1113:     )?;
1114:     status.conformance_backend_api = backend_api.success();
1115: 
1116:     let leakage_log = source_dir.join("backend_leakage_scan.log");
1117:     let leakage_scan = run_logged_command(
1118:         {
1119:             let mut command = Command::new("rg");
1120:             command.arg("-n");
1121:             command.arg("-i");
1122:             command.arg(phase9_backend_leakage_pattern());
1123:             for target in PHASE9_BACKEND_SCAN_TARGETS {
1124:                 command.arg(target);
1125:             }
1126:             command
1127:         },
1128:         leakage_log.as_path(),
1129:         "phase9 backend leakage scan",
1130:     )?;
1131:     match leakage_scan.code() {
1132:         Some(0) => status.protocol_leakage_detected = true,
1133:         Some(1) => status.protocol_leakage_detected = false,
1134:         Some(code) => {
1135:             return Err(format!(
1136:                 "backend leakage scan failed unexpectedly (status {code}); see {}",
1137:                 leakage_log.display()
1138:             ));
1139:         }
1140:         None => {
1141:             return Err(format!(
1142:                 "backend leakage scan terminated unexpectedly; see {}",
1143:                 leakage_log.display()
1144:             ));
1145:         }
1146:     }
1147: 
1148:     Ok(status)
1149: }

1162: fn parse_two_digits(value: &str, field: &str) -> Result<u32, String> {
1163:     if value.len() != 2 || !value.chars().all(|ch| ch.is_ascii_digit()) {
1164:         return Err(format!("invalid numeric field for {field}: {value}"));
1165:     }
1166:     value
1167:         .parse::<u32>()
1168:         .map_err(|err| format!("invalid numeric field for {field}: {err}"))
1169: }
1170: 
1171: fn parse_four_digits(value: &str, field: &str) -> Result<i32, String> {
1172:     if value.len() != 4 || !value.chars().all(|ch| ch.is_ascii_digit()) {
1173:         return Err(format!("invalid numeric field for {field}: {value}"));
1174:     }
1175:     value
1176:         .parse::<i32>()
1177:         .map_err(|err| format!("invalid numeric field for {field}: {err}"))
1178: }

1180: fn is_leap_year(year: i32) -> bool {
1181:     (year % 4 == 0 && year % 100 != 0) || (year % 400 == 0)
1182: }
1183: 
1184: fn days_in_month(year: i32, month: u32) -> Option<u32> {
1185:     let days = match month {
1186:         1 | 3 | 5 | 7 | 8 | 10 | 12 => 31,
1187:         4 | 6 | 9 | 11 => 30,
1188:         2 if is_leap_year(year) => 29,
1189:         2 => 28,
1190:         _ => return None,
1191:     };
1192:     Some(days)
1193: }
1194: 
1195: fn days_from_civil(year: i32, month: u32, day: u32) -> i64 {
1196:     let mut y = i64::from(year);
1197:     let m = i64::from(month);
1198:     let d = i64::from(day);
1199:     y -= if m <= 2 { 1 } else { 0 };
1200:     let era = if y >= 0 { y } else { y - 399 } / 400;
1201:     let yoe = y - era * 400;
1202:     let doy = (153 * (m + if m > 2 { -3 } else { 9 }) + 2) / 5 + d - 1;
1203:     let doe = yoe * 365 + yoe / 4 - yoe / 100 + doy;
1204:     era * 146_097 + doe - 719_468
1205: }
1206: 
1207: fn parse_utc_to_unix(value: &str, field: &str) -> Result<i64, String> {
1208:     let trimmed = value.trim();
1209:     if trimmed.is_empty() {
1210:         return Err(format!("missing or invalid UTC field: {field}"));
1211:     }
1212: 
1213:     let (datetime_part, offset_seconds) = if let Some(stripped) = trimmed.strip_suffix('Z') {
1214:         (stripped, 0i64)
1215:     } else {
1216:         let tz_start = trimmed
1217:             .char_indices()
1218:             .rev()
1219:             .find_map(|(index, ch)| {
1220:                 if index > 10 && (ch == '+' || ch == '-') {
1221:                     Some(index)
1222:                 } else {
1223:                     None
1224:                 }
1225:             })
1226:             .ok_or_else(|| format!("invalid UTC timestamp for {field}: {value}"))?;
1227:         let (base, zone) = trimmed.split_at(tz_start);
1228:         if zone.len() != 6 {
1229:             return Err(format!("invalid UTC timestamp for {field}: {value}"));
1230:         }
1231:         if &zone[3..4] != ":" {
1232:             return Err(format!("invalid UTC timestamp for {field}: {value}"));
1233:         }
1234:         let sign = if &zone[0..1] == "+" { 1i64 } else { -1i64 };
1235:         let offset_hour = parse_two_digits(&zone[1..3], field)?;
1236:         let offset_minute = parse_two_digits(&zone[4..6], field)?;
1237:         if offset_hour > 23 || offset_minute > 59 {
1238:             return Err(format!("invalid UTC timestamp for {field}: {value}"));
1239:         }
1240:         let total = i64::from(offset_hour) * 3600 + i64::from(offset_minute) * 60;
1241:         (base, sign * total)
1242:     };
1243: 
1244:     let (date_part, time_part) = datetime_part
1245:         .split_once('T')
1246:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("invalid UTC timestamp for {field}: {value}"))?;
1247:     let date_fields = date_part.split('-').collect::<Vec<_>>();
1248:     if date_fields.len() != 3 {
1249:         return Err(format!("invalid UTC timestamp for {field}: {value}"));
1250:     }
1251:     let year = parse_four_digits(date_fields[0], field)?;
1252:     let month = parse_two_digits(date_fields[1], field)?;
1253:     let day = parse_two_digits(date_fields[2], field)?;
1254:     let max_day = days_in_month(year, month)
1255:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("invalid UTC timestamp for {field}: {value}"))?;
1256:     if day == 0 || day > max_day {
1257:         return Err(format!("invalid UTC timestamp for {field}: {value}"));
1258:     }
1259: 
1260:     let (time_core, fraction) = match time_part.split_once('.') {
1261:         Some((core, frac)) => (core, Some(frac)),
1262:         None => (time_part, None),
1263:     };
1264:     if let Some(frac) = fraction
1265:         && (frac.is_empty() || !frac.chars().all(|ch| ch.is_ascii_digit()))
1266:     {
1267:         return Err(format!("invalid UTC timestamp for {field}: {value}"));
1268:     }
1269:     let time_fields = time_core.split(':').collect::<Vec<_>>();
1270:     if time_fields.len() != 3 {
1271:         return Err(format!("invalid UTC timestamp for {field}: {value}"));
1272:     }
1273:     let hour = parse_two_digits(time_fields[0], field)?;
1274:     let minute = parse_two_digits(time_fields[1], field)?;
1275:     let second = parse_two_digits(time_fields[2], field)?;
1276:     if hour > 23 || minute > 59 || second > 59 {
1277:         return Err(format!("invalid UTC timestamp for {field}: {value}"));
1278:     }
1279: 
1280:     let date_seconds = days_from_civil(year, month, day)
1281:         .checked_mul(86_400)
1282:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("invalid UTC timestamp for {field}: {value}"))?;
1283:     let time_seconds = i64::from(hour) * 3600 + i64::from(minute) * 60 + i64::from(second);
1284:     date_seconds
1285:         .checked_add(time_seconds)
1286:         .and_then(|value| value.checked_sub(offset_seconds))
1287:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("invalid UTC timestamp for {field}: {value}"))
1288: }
1289: 
1290: fn phase9_entry_numeric(
1291:     entry: &Map<String, Value>,
1292:     keys: &[&str],
1293:     label: &str,
1294: ) -> Result<f64, String> {
1295:     for key in keys {
1296:         if let Some(value) = entry.get(*key).and_then(Value::as_f64) {
1297:             return Ok(value);
1298:         }
1299:     }
1300:     Err(format!(
1301:         "missing numeric field for {label}; expected one of {}",
1302:         keys.join(",")
1303:     ))
1304: }
1305: 
1306: fn phase9_value_or_null(entry: &Map<String, Value>, key: &str) -> Value {
1307:     entry.get(key).cloned().unwrap_or(Value::Null)
1308: }
1309: 
1310: fn phase9_bool_or_default(entry: &Map<String, Value>, key: &str) -> bool {
1311:     entry.get(key).and_then(Value::as_bool).unwrap_or(false)
1312: }
1313: 
1314: fn phase9_enforce_timestamp_freshness(
1315:     timestamp_unix: i64,
1316:     label: &str,
1317:     now_unix: i64,
1318: ) -> Result<(), String> {
1319:     if timestamp_unix > now_unix + 300 {
1320:         return Err(format!("{label} timestamp is too far in the future"));
1321:     }
1322:     if now_unix - timestamp_unix > DEFAULT_PHASE9_MAX_SOURCE_AGE_SECONDS {
1323:         return Err(format!(
1324:             "{label} evidence is stale; recollect measured source data"
1325:         ));
1326:     }
1327:     Ok(())
1328: }
