1661: fn phase10_require_measured_source(
1662:     payload: &Map<String, Value>,
1663:     source_path: &Path,
1664:     label: &str,
1665: ) -> Result<(), String> {
1666:     let evidence_mode = payload
1667:         .get("evidence_mode")
1668:         .and_then(Value::as_str)
1669:         .ok_or_else(|| {
1670:             format!(
1671:                 "{label} source must set evidence_mode=measured: {}",
1672:                 source_path.display()
1673:             )
1674:         })?;
1675:     if evidence_mode != "measured" {
1676:         return Err(format!(
1677:             "{label} source must set evidence_mode=measured: {}",
1678:             source_path.display()
1679:         ));
1680:     }
1681:     Ok(())
1682: }
1683: 
1684: fn phase10_require_positive_unix_timestamp(
1685:     payload: &Map<String, Value>,
1686:     source_path: &Path,
1687:     label: &str,
1688: ) -> Result<i64, String> {
1689:     let value = payload.get("captured_at_unix").ok_or_else(|| {
1690:         format!(
1691:             "{label} source requires captured_at_unix: {}",
1692:             source_path.display()
1693:         )
1694:     })?;
1695:     let parsed = if let Some(v) = value.as_i64() {
1696:         v
1697:     } else if let Some(v) = value.as_u64() {
1698:         i64::try_from(v).map_err(|_| {
1699:             format!(
1700:                 "{label} source has out-of-range captured_at_unix: {}",
1701:                 source_path.display()
1702:             )
1703:         })?
1704:     } else {
1705:         return Err(format!(
1706:             "{label} source requires integer captured_at_unix: {}",
1707:             source_path.display()
1708:         ));
1709:     };
1710:     if parsed <= 0 {
1711:         return Err(format!(
1712:             "{label} source requires positive captured_at_unix: {}",
1713:             source_path.display()
1714:         ));
1715:     }
1716:     Ok(parsed)
1717: }
1718: 
1719: fn phase10_validate_source_freshness(
1720:     source_captured_at_unix: i64,
1721:     source_path: &Path,
1722:     label: &str,
1723:     now_unix: i64,
1724:     max_source_age_seconds: i64,
1725: ) -> Result<(), String> {
1726:     if source_captured_at_unix > now_unix + 300 {
1727:         return Err(format!(
1728:             "{label} source timestamp is too far in the future: {}",
1729:             source_path.display()
1730:         ));
1731:     }
1732:     if now_unix - source_captured_at_unix > max_source_age_seconds {
1733:         return Err(format!(
1734:             "{label} source evidence is stale; recollect measured data: {}",
1735:             source_path.display()
1736:         ));
1737:     }
1738:     Ok(())
1739: }
1740: 
1741: fn phase10_require_status_pass(
1742:     payload: &Map<String, Value>,
1743:     source_path: &Path,
1744:     label: &str,
1745: ) -> Result<(), String> {
1746:     if payload.get("status").and_then(Value::as_str) != Some("pass") {
1747:         return Err(format!(
1748:             "{label} source must report status=pass: {}",
1749:             source_path.display()
1750:         ));
1751:     }
1752:     Ok(())
1753: }

1755: fn phase10_validate_checks_all_pass(
1756:     payload: &Map<String, Value>,
1757:     source_path: &Path,
1758:     label: &str,
1759: ) -> Result<(), String> {
1760:     let checks = payload
1761:         .get("checks")
1762:         .and_then(Value::as_object)
1763:         .ok_or_else(|| {
1764:             format!(
1765:                 "{label} source must include non-empty checks object: {}",
1766:                 source_path.display()
1767:             )
1768:         })?;
1769:     if checks.is_empty() {
1770:         return Err(format!(
1771:             "{label} source must include non-empty checks object: {}",
1772:             source_path.display()
1773:         ));
1774:     }
1775:     for (key, value) in checks {
1776:         if value.as_str() != Some("pass") {
1777:             return Err(format!(
1778:                 "{label} source check must pass ({key}) in {}",
1779:                 source_path.display()
1780:             ));
1781:         }
1782:     }
1783:     Ok(())
1784: }

1786: fn phase10_require_named_checks_pass(
1787:     payload: &Map<String, Value>,
1788:     source_path: &Path,
1789:     label: &str,
1790:     required_checks: &[&str],
1791: ) -> Result<(), String> {
1792:     let checks = payload
1793:         .get("checks")
1794:         .and_then(Value::as_object)
1795:         .ok_or_else(|| {
1796:             format!(
1797:                 "{label} source must include non-empty checks object: {}",
1798:                 source_path.display()
1799:             )
1800:         })?;
1801:     for check_name in required_checks {
1802:         if checks.get(*check_name).and_then(Value::as_str) != Some("pass") {
1803:             return Err(format!(
1804:                 "{label} source check must pass ({check_name}) in {}",
1805:                 source_path.display()
1806:             ));
1807:         }
1808:     }
1809:     Ok(())
1810: }

1812: fn phase10_require_non_empty_environment(
1813:     payload: &Map<String, Value>,
1814:     source_path: &Path,
1815:     label: &str,
1816: ) -> Result<(), String> {
1817:     let environment = payload
1818:         .get("environment")
1819:         .and_then(Value::as_str)
1820:         .map(str::trim)
1821:         .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
1822:         .ok_or_else(|| {
1823:             format!(
1824:                 "{label} source must include non-empty environment: {}",
1825:                 source_path.display()
1826:             )
1827:         })?;
1828:     let _ = environment;
1829:     Ok(())
1830: }

1832: fn phase10_validate_source_artifacts_entries(
1833:     payload: &Map<String, Value>,
1834:     source_path: &Path,
1835:     label: &str,
1836: ) -> Result<(), String> {
1837:     let source_artifacts = payload
1838:         .get("source_artifacts")
1839:         .and_then(Value::as_array)
1840:         .ok_or_else(|| {
1841:             format!(
1842:                 "{label} source must include non-empty source_artifacts list: {}",
1843:                 source_path.display()
1844:             )
1845:         })?;
1846:     if source_artifacts.is_empty() {
1847:         return Err(format!(
1848:             "{label} source must include non-empty source_artifacts list: {}",
1849:             source_path.display()
1850:         ));
1851:     }
1852: 
1853:     let cwd = std::env::current_dir()
1854:         .map_err(|err| format!("resolve current directory failed: {err}"))?;
1855:     for entry in source_artifacts {
1856:         let source = entry
1857:             .as_str()
1858:             .map(str::trim)
1859:             .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
1860:             .ok_or_else(|| {
1861:                 format!(
1862:                     "{label} source has invalid source_artifacts entry: {}",
1863:                     source_path.display()
1864:                 )
1865:             })?;
1866:         let candidate = if Path::new(source).is_absolute() {
1867:             PathBuf::from(source)
1868:         } else {
1869:             cwd.join(source)
1870:         };
1871:         if !candidate.exists() {
1872:             return Err(format!("{label} source artifact does not exist: {source}"));
1873:         }
1874:     }
1875:     Ok(())
1876: }

1878: fn phase10_validate_perf_budget(
1879:     payload: &Map<String, Value>,
1880:     source_path: &Path,
1881: ) -> Result<(), String> {
1882:     if payload.get("soak_status").and_then(Value::as_str) != Some("pass") {
1883:         return Err(format!(
1884:             "perf_budget_report source must report soak_status=pass: {}",
1885:             source_path.display()
1886:         ));
1887:     }
1888:     let metrics = payload
1889:         .get("metrics")
1890:         .and_then(Value::as_array)
1891:         .ok_or_else(|| {
1892:             format!(
1893:                 "perf_budget_report source must include non-empty metrics list: {}",
1894:                 source_path.display()
1895:             )
1896:         })?;
1897:     if metrics.is_empty() {
1898:         return Err(format!(
1899:             "perf_budget_report source must include non-empty metrics list: {}",
1900:             source_path.display()
1901:         ));
1902:     }
1903:     for metric in metrics {
1904:         let metric_object = metric.as_object().ok_or_else(|| {
1905:             format!(
1906:                 "perf_budget_report metrics entries must be objects: {}",
1907:                 source_path.display()
1908:             )
1909:         })?;
1910:         if metric_object.get("status").and_then(Value::as_str) != Some("pass") {
1911:             return Err(format!(
1912:                 "perf_budget_report source must not contain failing metrics: {}",
1913:                 source_path.display()
1914:             ));
1915:         }
1916:     }
1917:     Ok(())
1918: }

1920: fn phase10_validate_required_perf_metrics(
1921:     payload: &Map<String, Value>,
1922:     source_path: &Path,
1923: ) -> Result<(), String> {
1924:     let required_metric_names = [
1925:         "idle_cpu_percent",
1926:         "idle_rss_mb",
1927:         "reconnect_seconds",
1928:         "route_apply_p95_seconds",
1929:         "throughput_overhead_percent",
1930:     ];
1931:     let metrics = payload
1932:         .get("metrics")
1933:         .and_then(Value::as_array)
1934:         .ok_or_else(|| {
1935:             format!(
1936:                 "perf_budget_report source must include non-empty metrics list: {}",
1937:                 source_path.display()
1938:             )
1939:         })?;
1940:     let mut seen = std::collections::BTreeSet::new();
1941:     for metric in metrics {
1942:         let metric_object = metric.as_object().ok_or_else(|| {
1943:             format!(
1944:                 "perf_budget_report metrics entries must be objects: {}",
1945:                 source_path.display()
1946:             )
1947:         })?;
1948:         let name = metric_object
1949:             .get("name")
1950:             .and_then(Value::as_str)
1951:             .map(str::trim)
1952:             .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
1953:             .ok_or_else(|| {
1954:                 format!(
1955:                     "perf_budget_report metric is missing name: {}",
1956:                     source_path.display()
1957:                 )
1958:             })?;
1959:         if metric_object.get("status").and_then(Value::as_str) != Some("pass") {
1960:             return Err(format!(
1961:                 "perf_budget_report metric did not pass ({name}) in {}",
1962:                 source_path.display()
1963:             ));
1964:         }
1965:         if required_metric_names.contains(&name) {
1966:             seen.insert(name.to_string());
1967:         }
1968:     }
1969:     let missing = required_metric_names
1970:         .iter()
1971:         .filter(|name| !seen.contains(**name))
1972:         .copied()
1973:         .collect::<Vec<_>>();
1974:     if !missing.is_empty() {
1975:         return Err(format!(
1976:             "perf_budget_report missing required metrics: {}",
1977:             missing.join(", ")
1978:         ));
1979:     }
1980:     Ok(())
1981: }

1983: fn contains_generation_marker(log_body: &str) -> bool {
1984:     for token in log_body.split(|ch: char| ch.is_ascii_whitespace() || ch == ',' || ch == ';') {
1985:         let Some(rest) = token.strip_prefix("generation=") else {
1986:             continue;
1987:         };
1988:         if !rest.is_empty() && rest.chars().all(|ch| ch.is_ascii_digit()) {
1989:             return true;
1990:         }
1991:     }
1992:     false
1993: }

2257: struct ReleaseProvenanceBuildInputs<'a> {
2258:     artifact_path: &'a Path,
2259:     sbom_path: &'a Path,
2260:     sbom_digest_path: &'a Path,
2261:     generated_at_unix: u64,
2262:     host_identity: &'a str,
2263:     release_track: &'a str,
2264:     signing_key: &'a SigningKey,
2265:     verifier_key: &'a VerifyingKey,

2267: 
2268: fn build_release_provenance_document(
2269:     inputs: &ReleaseProvenanceBuildInputs<'_>,
2270: ) -> Result<Value, String> {
2271:     let release_track = validate_release_track(inputs.release_track)?;
2272:     let artifact_path = canonical_file_display(inputs.artifact_path, "release artifact")?;
2273:     let sbom_path = canonical_file_display(inputs.sbom_path, "release sbom")?;
2274:     let sbom_digest_path = canonical_file_display(inputs.sbom_digest_path, "release sbom digest")?;
2275: 
2276:     let artifact_sha256 = sha256_file_hex(Path::new(artifact_path.as_str()))?;
2277:     let sbom_sha256 = sha256_file_hex(Path::new(sbom_path.as_str()))?;
2278:     let sbom_digest_value =
2279:         read_sha256_digest_file(Path::new(sbom_digest_path.as_str()), "release sbom digest")?;
2280:     if sbom_digest_value != sbom_sha256 {
2281:         return Err("release sbom digest file does not match sbom content digest".to_string());
2282:     }
2283:     let artifact_size_bytes = fs::metadata(Path::new(artifact_path.as_str()))
2284:         .map_err(|err| format!("inspect release artifact metadata failed: {err}"))?
2285:         .len();
2286: 
2287:     let command_digest_sha256 = sha256_hex(RELEASE_PROVENANCE_COMMAND_LITERAL.as_bytes());
2288:     let verifier_key_hex = hex_encode(inputs.verifier_key.as_bytes());
2289:     let signer_fingerprint = sha256_hex(inputs.verifier_key.as_bytes());
2290:     let signer_key_id = format!("ed25519:{}", &signer_fingerprint[..16]);
2291:     let payload = release_provenance_payload(&ReleaseProvenancePayload {
2292:         generated_at_unix: inputs.generated_at_unix,
2293:         host_identity: inputs.host_identity,
2294:         command_digest_sha256: command_digest_sha256.as_str(),
2295:         signer_key_id: signer_key_id.as_str(),
2296:         verifier_key_hex: verifier_key_hex.as_str(),
2297:         release_track: release_track.as_str(),
2298:         artifact_path: artifact_path.as_str(),
2299:         artifact_sha256: artifact_sha256.as_str(),
2300:         artifact_size_bytes,
2301:         sbom_path: sbom_path.as_str(),
2302:         sbom_sha256: sbom_sha256.as_str(),
2303:         sbom_digest_path: sbom_digest_path.as_str(),
2304:         sbom_digest_value: sbom_digest_value.as_str(),
2305:     });
2306:     let signature = inputs.signing_key.sign(payload.as_bytes());
2307: 
2308:     Ok(json!({
2309:         "schema_version": RELEASE_PROVENANCE_SCHEMA_VERSION,
2310:         "phase": "release",
2311:         "generated_at_unix": inputs.generated_at_unix,
2312:         "host_identity": inputs.host_identity,
2313:         "command_digest_sha256": command_digest_sha256,
2314:         "signer_key_id": signer_key_id,
2315:         "verifier_key_hex": verifier_key_hex,
2316:         "release_track": release_track,
2317:         "artifact_path": artifact_path,
2318:         "artifact_sha256": artifact_sha256,
2319:         "artifact_size_bytes": artifact_size_bytes,
2320:         "sbom_path": sbom_path,
2321:         "sbom_sha256": sbom_sha256,
2322:         "sbom_digest_path": sbom_digest_path,
2323:         "sbom_digest_value": sbom_digest_value,
2324:         "signature_hex": hex_encode(&signature.to_bytes()),
2325:     }))
2326: }

2328: fn build_phase10_provenance_document(
2329:     source_dir: &Path,
2330:     out_dir: &Path,
2331:     generated_at_unix: u64,
2332:     host_identity: &str,
2333:     signing_key: &SigningKey,
2334:     verifier_key: &VerifyingKey,
2335: ) -> Result<Value, String> {
2336:     let command_digest_sha256 = sha256_hex(PHASE10_PROVENANCE_COMMAND_LITERAL.as_bytes());
2337:     let verifier_key_hex = hex_encode(verifier_key.as_bytes());
2338:     let signer_fingerprint = sha256_hex(verifier_key.as_bytes());
2339:     let signer_key_id = format!("ed25519:{}", &signer_fingerprint[..16]);
2340: 
2341:     let mut entries = Vec::new();
2342:     for (label, role, path, is_json) in phase10_expected_provenance_entries(source_dir, out_dir) {
2343:         let canonical_path = canonical_file_display(path.as_path(), label)?;
2344:         let artifact_sha256 = sha256_file_hex(Path::new(canonical_path.as_str()))?;
2345:         let captured_at_unix = if is_json {
2346:             phase10_json_captured_at_unix(Path::new(canonical_path.as_str()), label)?
2347:         } else {
2348:             generated_at_unix
2349:         };
2350:         let payload = phase10_provenance_payload(&Phase10ProvenancePayload {
2351:             generated_at_unix,
2352:             host_identity,
2353:             command_digest_sha256: command_digest_sha256.as_str(),
2354:             signer_key_id: signer_key_id.as_str(),
2355:             verifier_key_hex: verifier_key_hex.as_str(),
2356:             label,
2357:             role,
2358:             artifact_path: canonical_path.as_str(),
2359:             artifact_sha256: artifact_sha256.as_str(),
2360:             captured_at_unix,
2361:         });
2362:         let signature = signing_key.sign(payload.as_bytes());
2363:         entries.push(json!({
2364:             "label": label,
2365:             "role": role,
2366:             "artifact_path": canonical_path,
2367:             "artifact_sha256": artifact_sha256,
2368:             "captured_at_unix": captured_at_unix,
2369:             "signature_hex": hex_encode(&signature.to_bytes()),
2370:         }));
2371:     }
2372: 
2373:     Ok(json!({
2374:         "schema_version": PHASE10_PROVENANCE_SCHEMA_VERSION,
2375:         "phase": "phase10",
2376:         "generated_at_unix": generated_at_unix,
2377:         "host_identity": host_identity,
2378:         "command_digest_sha256": command_digest_sha256,
2379:         "signer_key_id": signer_key_id,
2380:         "verifier_key_hex": verifier_key_hex,
2381:         "entries": entries,
2382:     }))
2383: }

2385: fn object_string_field(
2386:     object: &Map<String, Value>,
2387:     key: &str,
2388:     label: &str,
2389: ) -> Result<String, String> {
2390:     object
2391:         .get(key)
2392:         .and_then(Value::as_str)
2393:         .map(str::trim)
2394:         .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
2395:         .map(ToString::to_string)
2396:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("{label} missing non-empty string field: {key}"))
2397: }

2399: fn object_u64_field(object: &Map<String, Value>, key: &str, label: &str) -> Result<u64, String> {
2400:     object
2401:         .get(key)
2402:         .and_then(Value::as_u64)
2403:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("{label} missing positive integer field: {key}"))
2404: }

2406: fn verify_phase10_provenance_document(
2407:     source_dir: &Path,
2408:     out_dir: &Path,
2409:     expected_host_identity: &str,
2410:     verifier_key: &VerifyingKey,
2411:     max_provenance_age_seconds: i64,
2412: ) -> Result<(), String> {
2413:     let provenance_path = phase10_provenance_path(out_dir);
2414:     let document = read_json_object(provenance_path.as_path(), "phase10 provenance attestation")?;
2415:     if object_u64_field(
2416:         &document,
2417:         "schema_version",
2418:         "phase10 provenance attestation",
2419:     )? != PHASE10_PROVENANCE_SCHEMA_VERSION
2420:     {
2421:         return Err("phase10 provenance attestation schema_version mismatch".to_string());
2422:     }
2423:     if object_string_field(&document, "phase", "phase10 provenance attestation")? != "phase10" {
2424:         return Err("phase10 provenance attestation must set phase=phase10".to_string());
2425:     }
2426:     let generated_at_unix = object_u64_field(
2427:         &document,
2428:         "generated_at_unix",
2429:         "phase10 provenance attestation",
2430:     )?;
2431:     let now_unix =
2432:         i64::try_from(unix_now()).map_err(|_| "current unix time out of range".to_string())?;
2433:     let generated_at = i64::try_from(generated_at_unix)
2434:         .map_err(|_| "generated_at_unix out of range".to_string())?;
2435:     if generated_at > now_unix + 300 {
2436:         return Err(
2437:             "phase10 provenance attestation generated_at_unix is in the future".to_string(),
2438:         );
2439:     }
2440:     if now_unix - generated_at > max_provenance_age_seconds {
2441:         return Err("phase10 provenance attestation is stale".to_string());
2442:     }
2443: 
2444:     let host_identity =
2445:         object_string_field(&document, "host_identity", "phase10 provenance attestation")?;
2446:     if host_identity != expected_host_identity {
2447:         return Err("phase10 provenance host identity mismatch".to_string());
2448:     }
2449:     let command_digest = object_string_field(
2450:         &document,
2451:         "command_digest_sha256",
2452:         "phase10 provenance attestation",
2453:     )?;
2454:     let expected_command_digest = sha256_hex(PHASE10_PROVENANCE_COMMAND_LITERAL.as_bytes());
2455:     if command_digest != expected_command_digest {
2456:         return Err("phase10 provenance command digest mismatch".to_string());
2457:     }
2458:     let signer_key_id =
2459:         object_string_field(&document, "signer_key_id", "phase10 provenance attestation")?;
2460:     let verifier_key_hex = object_string_field(
2461:         &document,
2462:         "verifier_key_hex",
2463:         "phase10 provenance attestation",
2464:     )?;
2465:     if verifier_key_hex != hex_encode(verifier_key.as_bytes()) {
2466:         return Err("phase10 provenance verifier key mismatch".to_string());
2467:     }
2468: 
2469:     let mut expected = std::collections::BTreeMap::new();
2470:     for (label, role, path, is_json) in phase10_expected_provenance_entries(source_dir, out_dir) {
2471:         let canonical = canonical_file_display(path.as_path(), label)?;
2472:         expected.insert(label.to_string(), (role.to_string(), canonical, is_json));
2473:     }
2474: 
2475:     let entries = document
2476:         .get("entries")
2477:         .and_then(Value::as_array)
2478:         .ok_or_else(|| "phase10 provenance attestation missing entries array".to_string())?;
2479:     if entries.len() != expected.len() {
2480:         return Err("phase10 provenance attestation entry count mismatch".to_string());
2481:     }
2482: 
2483:     let mut seen = std::collections::BTreeSet::new();
2484:     for entry in entries {
2485:         let entry_obj = entry
2486:             .as_object()
2487:             .ok_or_else(|| "phase10 provenance entry must be a JSON object".to_string())?;
2488:         let label = object_string_field(entry_obj, "label", "phase10 provenance entry")?;
2489:         if !seen.insert(label.clone()) {
2490:             return Err(format!(
2491:                 "phase10 provenance contains duplicate label: {label}"
2492:             ));
2493:         }
2494:         let (expected_role, expected_path, is_json) = expected
2495:             .get(label.as_str())
2496:             .ok_or_else(|| format!("phase10 provenance contains unexpected label: {label}"))?
2497:             .clone();
2498: 
2499:         let role = object_string_field(entry_obj, "role", "phase10 provenance entry")?;
2500:         if role != expected_role {
2501:             return Err(format!("phase10 provenance role mismatch for {label}"));
2502:         }
2503: 
2504:         let artifact_path =
2505:             object_string_field(entry_obj, "artifact_path", "phase10 provenance entry")?;
2506:         if artifact_path != expected_path {
2507:             return Err(format!("phase10 provenance path mismatch for {label}"));
2508:         }
2509:         let artifact_sha256 =
2510:             object_string_field(entry_obj, "artifact_sha256", "phase10 provenance entry")?;
2511:         let actual_sha256 = sha256_file_hex(Path::new(artifact_path.as_str()))?;
2512:         if artifact_sha256 != actual_sha256 {
2513:             return Err(format!("phase10 provenance digest mismatch for {label}"));
2514:         }
2515: 
2516:         let captured_at_unix =
2517:             object_u64_field(entry_obj, "captured_at_unix", "phase10 provenance entry")?;
2518:         let captured_at = i64::try_from(captured_at_unix)
2519:             .map_err(|_| format!("phase10 provenance captured_at_unix out of range for {label}"))?;
2520:         if captured_at > now_unix + 300 {
2521:             return Err(format!(
2522:                 "phase10 provenance captured_at_unix is in the future for {label}"
2523:             ));
2524:         }
2525:         if now_unix - captured_at > max_provenance_age_seconds {
2526:             return Err(format!(
2527:                 "phase10 provenance captured_at_unix is stale for {label}"
2528:             ));
2529:         }
2530:         if is_json {
2531:             let observed =
2532:                 phase10_json_captured_at_unix(Path::new(artifact_path.as_str()), label.as_str())?;
2533:             if observed != captured_at_unix {
2534:                 return Err(format!(
2535:                     "phase10 provenance captured_at_unix mismatch for {label}"
2536:                 ));
2537:             }
2538:         } else if captured_at_unix != generated_at_unix {
2539:             return Err(format!(
2540:                 "phase10 provenance log captured_at_unix must match generated_at_unix for {label}"
2541:             ));
2542:         }
2543: 
2544:         let signature_hex =
2545:             object_string_field(entry_obj, "signature_hex", "phase10 provenance entry")?;
2546:         let signature_bytes = decode_hex_to_fixed::<64>(signature_hex.as_str()).map_err(|err| {
2547:             format!("phase10 provenance signature parse failed for {label}: {err}")
2548:         })?;
2549:         let payload = phase10_provenance_payload(&Phase10ProvenancePayload {
2550:             generated_at_unix,
2551:             host_identity: host_identity.as_str(),
2552:             command_digest_sha256: command_digest.as_str(),
2553:             signer_key_id: signer_key_id.as_str(),
2554:             verifier_key_hex: verifier_key_hex.as_str(),
2555:             label: label.as_str(),
2556:             role: role.as_str(),
2557:             artifact_path: artifact_path.as_str(),
2558:             artifact_sha256: artifact_sha256.as_str(),
2559:             captured_at_unix,
2560:         });
2561:         let signature = Signature::from_bytes(&signature_bytes);
2562:         verifier_key
2563:             .verify(payload.as_bytes(), &signature)
2564:             .map_err(|_| format!("phase10 provenance signature verification failed for {label}"))?;
2565:     }
2566: 
2567:     if seen.len() != expected.len() {
2568:         return Err("phase10 provenance attestation missing required entries".to_string());
2569:     }
2570:     Ok(())
2571: }

2573: struct ReleaseProvenanceVerifyInputs<'a> {

2575:     expected_artifact_path: &'a Path,

2581:     max_provenance_age_seconds: i64,

2584: fn verify_release_provenance_document(
2585:     inputs: &ReleaseProvenanceVerifyInputs<'_>,
2586: ) -> Result<(), String> {
2587:     let expected_release_track = validate_release_track(inputs.expected_release_track)?;
2588:     let provenance = read_json_object(inputs.provenance_path, "release provenance attestation")?;
2589:     if object_u64_field(
2590:         &provenance,
2591:         "schema_version",
2592:         "release provenance attestation",
2593:     )? != RELEASE_PROVENANCE_SCHEMA_VERSION
2594:     {
2595:         return Err("release provenance schema_version mismatch".to_string());
2596:     }
2597:     if object_string_field(&provenance, "phase", "release provenance attestation")? != "release" {
2598:         return Err("release provenance must set phase=release".to_string());
2599:     }
2600: 
2601:     let generated_at_unix = object_u64_field(
2602:         &provenance,
2603:         "generated_at_unix",
2604:         "release provenance attestation",
2605:     )?;
2606:     let now_unix =
2607:         i64::try_from(unix_now()).map_err(|_| "current unix time out of range".to_string())?;
2608:     let generated_at = i64::try_from(generated_at_unix)
2609:         .map_err(|_| "release provenance generated_at_unix out of range".to_string())?;
2610:     if generated_at > now_unix + 300 {
2611:         return Err("release provenance generated_at_unix is in the future".to_string());
2612:     }
2613:     if now_unix - generated_at > inputs.max_provenance_age_seconds {
2614:         return Err("release provenance attestation is stale".to_string());
2615:     }
2616: 
2617:     let host_identity = object_string_field(
2618:         &provenance,
2619:         "host_identity",
2620:         "release provenance attestation",
2621:     )?;
2622:     if host_identity != inputs.expected_host_identity {
2623:         return Err("release provenance host identity mismatch".to_string());
2624:     }
2625: 
2626:     let release_track = object_string_field(
2627:         &provenance,
2628:         "release_track",
2629:         "release provenance attestation",
2630:     )?;
2631:     let release_track = validate_release_track(release_track.as_str())?;
2632:     if release_track != expected_release_track {
2633:         return Err("release provenance release_track mismatch".to_string());
2634:     }
2635: 
2636:     let command_digest = object_string_field(
2637:         &provenance,
2638:         "command_digest_sha256",
2639:         "release provenance attestation",
2640:     )?;
2641:     let expected_command_digest = sha256_hex(RELEASE_PROVENANCE_COMMAND_LITERAL.as_bytes());
2642:     if command_digest != expected_command_digest {
2643:         return Err("release provenance command digest mismatch".to_string());
2644:     }
2645: 
2646:     let signer_key_id = object_string_field(
2647:         &provenance,
2648:         "signer_key_id",
2649:         "release provenance attestation",
2650:     )?;
2651:     let verifier_key_hex = object_string_field(
2652:         &provenance,
2653:         "verifier_key_hex",
2654:         "release provenance attestation",
2655:     )?;
2656:     if verifier_key_hex != hex_encode(inputs.verifier_key.as_bytes()) {
2657:         return Err("release provenance verifier key mismatch".to_string());
2658:     }
2659: 
2660:     let artifact_path = object_string_field(
2661:         &provenance,
2662:         "artifact_path",
2663:         "release provenance attestation",
2664:     )?;
2665:     let expected_artifact =
2666:         canonical_file_display(inputs.expected_artifact_path, "release artifact")?;
2667:     if artifact_path != expected_artifact {
2668:         return Err("release provenance artifact path mismatch".to_string());
2669:     }
2670:     let artifact_sha256 = object_string_field(
2671:         &provenance,
2672:         "artifact_sha256",
2673:         "release provenance attestation",
2674:     )?;
2675:     let actual_artifact_sha256 = sha256_file_hex(Path::new(artifact_path.as_str()))?;
2676:     if artifact_sha256 != actual_artifact_sha256 {
2677:         return Err("release provenance artifact digest mismatch".to_string());
2678:     }
2679:     let artifact_size_bytes = object_u64_field(
2680:         &provenance,
2681:         "artifact_size_bytes",
2682:         "release provenance attestation",
2683:     )?;
2684:     let actual_artifact_size = fs::metadata(Path::new(artifact_path.as_str()))
2685:         .map_err(|err| format!("inspect release artifact metadata failed: {err}"))?
2686:         .len();
2687:     if artifact_size_bytes != actual_artifact_size {
2688:         return Err("release provenance artifact size mismatch".to_string());
2689:     }
2690: 
2691:     let sbom_path =
2692:         object_string_field(&provenance, "sbom_path", "release provenance attestation")?;
2693:     let expected_sbom = canonical_file_display(inputs.expected_sbom_path, "release sbom")?;
2694:     if sbom_path != expected_sbom {
2695:         return Err("release provenance sbom path mismatch".to_string());
2696:     }
2697:     let sbom_sha256 =
2698:         object_string_field(&provenance, "sbom_sha256", "release provenance attestation")?;
2699:     let actual_sbom_sha256 = sha256_file_hex(Path::new(sbom_path.as_str()))?;
2700:     if sbom_sha256 != actual_sbom_sha256 {
2701:         return Err("release provenance sbom digest mismatch".to_string());
2702:     }
2703: 
2704:     let sbom_digest_path = object_string_field(
2705:         &provenance,
2706:         "sbom_digest_path",
2707:         "release provenance attestation",
2708:     )?;
2709:     let expected_sbom_digest =
2710:         canonical_file_display(inputs.expected_sbom_digest_path, "release sbom digest")?;
2711:     if sbom_digest_path != expected_sbom_digest {
2712:         return Err("release provenance sbom digest path mismatch".to_string());
2713:     }
2714:     let sbom_digest_value = object_string_field(
2715:         &provenance,
2716:         "sbom_digest_value",
2717:         "release provenance attestation",
2718:     )?;
2719:     let actual_sbom_digest_value =
2720:         read_sha256_digest_file(Path::new(sbom_digest_path.as_str()), "release sbom digest")?;
2721:     if sbom_digest_value != actual_sbom_digest_value || sbom_digest_value != sbom_sha256 {
2722:         return Err("release provenance sbom digest value mismatch".to_string());
2723:     }
2724: 
2725:     let signature_hex = object_string_field(
2726:         &provenance,
2727:         "signature_hex",
2728:         "release provenance attestation",
2729:     )?;
2730:     let signature_bytes = decode_hex_to_fixed::<64>(signature_hex.as_str())
2731:         .map_err(|err| format!("release provenance signature parse failed: {err}"))?;
2732:     let payload = release_provenance_payload(&ReleaseProvenancePayload {
2733:         generated_at_unix,
2734:         host_identity: host_identity.as_str(),
2735:         command_digest_sha256: command_digest.as_str(),
2736:         signer_key_id: signer_key_id.as_str(),
2737:         verifier_key_hex: verifier_key_hex.as_str(),
2738:         release_track: release_track.as_str(),
2739:         artifact_path: artifact_path.as_str(),
2740:         artifact_sha256: artifact_sha256.as_str(),
2741:         artifact_size_bytes,
2742:         sbom_path: sbom_path.as_str(),
2743:         sbom_sha256: sbom_sha256.as_str(),
2744:         sbom_digest_path: sbom_digest_path.as_str(),
2745:         sbom_digest_value: sbom_digest_value.as_str(),
2746:     });
2747:     let signature = Signature::from_bytes(&signature_bytes);
2748:     inputs
2749:         .verifier_key
2750:         .verify(payload.as_bytes(), &signature)
2751:         .map_err(|_| "release provenance signature verification failed".to_string())?;
2752:     Ok(())
2753: }

2755: fn phase9_validate_source_artifacts_field(
2756:     document: &Map<String, Value>,
2757:     label: &str,
2758: ) -> Result<(), String> {
2759:     let sources = document
2760:         .get("source_artifacts")
2761:         .and_then(Value::as_array)
2762:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("{label} missing non-empty source_artifacts array"))?;
2763:     if sources.is_empty() {
2764:         return Err(format!("{label} source_artifacts array must not be empty"));
2765:     }
2766:     for source in sources {
2767:         let source_str = source
2768:             .as_str()
2769:             .map(str::trim)
2770:             .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
2771:             .ok_or_else(|| format!("{label} has invalid source_artifacts entry"))?;
2772:         let source_path = Path::new(source_str);
2773:         if !source_path.exists() {
2774:             return Err(format!(
2775:                 "{label} source artifact does not exist: {}",
2776:                 source_path.display()
2777:             ));
2778:         }
2779:     }
2780:     Ok(())
2781: }

2783: fn phase9_parse_measured_artifact_document(
2784:     artifact_path: &Path,
2785:     label: &str,
2786: ) -> Result<(u64, String), String> {
2787:     let document = read_json_object(artifact_path, label)?;
2788:     if document.get("gate_passed").is_some() {
2789:         return Err(format!("{label} must not include gate_passed field"));
2790:     }
2791:     let evidence_mode = object_string_field(&document, "evidence_mode", label)?;
2792:     if evidence_mode != "measured" {
2793:         return Err(format!("{label} must set evidence_mode=measured"));
2794:     }
2795:     let captured_at_unix = object_u64_field(&document, "captured_at_unix", label)?;
2796:     let environment = object_string_field(&document, "environment", label)?;
2797:     phase9_validate_source_artifacts_field(&document, label)?;
2798:     Ok((captured_at_unix, environment))
2799: }

2801: fn phase6_report_captured_at_unix(report_path: &Path) -> Result<u64, String> {
2802:     let report = read_json_object(report_path, "phase6 parity report")?;
2803:     if report.get("gate_passed").is_some() {
2804:         return Err("phase6 parity report must not include gate_passed field".to_string());
2805:     }
2806:     let evidence_mode = object_string_field(&report, "evidence_mode", "phase6 parity report")?;
2807:     if evidence_mode != "measured" {
2808:         return Err("phase6 parity report must set evidence_mode=measured".to_string());
2809:     }
2810:     let _ = object_string_field(&report, "environment", "phase6 parity report")?;
2811:     phase9_validate_source_artifacts_field(&report, "phase6 parity report")?;
2812:     object_u64_field(&report, "captured_at_unix", "phase6 parity report")
2813: }

2815: fn phase9_require_measured_evidence_metadata(
2816:     document: &Map<String, Value>,
2817:     label: &str,
2818:     now_unix: i64,
2819:     max_evidence_age_seconds: i64,
2820: ) -> Result<(), String> {
2821:     if document.get("gate_passed").is_some() {
2822:         return Err(format!(
2823:             "{label} contains deprecated gate_passed toggle; gate pass must be derived, not asserted"
2824:         ));
2825:     }
2826:     if document.get("evidence_mode").and_then(Value::as_str) != Some("measured") {
2827:         return Err(format!("{label} must set evidence_mode=measured"));
2828:     }
2829: 
2830:     let captured_at_unix = object_u64_field(document, "captured_at_unix", label)?;
2831:     if captured_at_unix == 0 {
2832:         return Err(format!(
2833:             "{label} requires positive integer captured_at_unix"
2834:         ));
2835:     }
2836:     let captured_at_i64 = i64::try_from(captured_at_unix)
2837:         .map_err(|_| format!("{label} captured_at_unix out of range"))?;
2838:     if captured_at_i64 > now_unix + 300 {
2839:         return Err(format!("{label} captured_at_unix is too far in the future"));
2840:     }
2841:     if now_unix - captured_at_i64 > max_evidence_age_seconds {
2842:         return Err(format!(
2843:             "{label} evidence is too old; regenerate with fresh measurements"
2844:         ));
2845:     }
2846: 
2847:     let environment = object_string_field(document, "environment", label)?;
2848:     if environment.trim().is_empty() {
2849:         return Err(format!(
2850:             "{label} requires non-empty string field: environment"
2851:         ));
2852:     }
2853: 
2854:     phase9_validate_source_artifacts_field(document, label)
2855: }

2876: fn phase9_require_integer(
2877:     document: &Map<String, Value>,
2878:     key: &str,
2879:     label: &str,
2880: ) -> Result<i64, String> {
2881:     if let Some(value) = document.get(key).and_then(Value::as_i64) {
2882:         return Ok(value);
2883:     }
2884:     if let Some(value) = document.get(key).and_then(Value::as_u64) {
2885:         return i64::try_from(value)
2886:             .map_err(|_| format!("{label} integer field out of range: {key}"));
2887:     }
2888:     Err(format!("{label} requires integer field: {key}"))
2889: }

2898:         .and_then(Value::as_f64)
2899:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("{label} requires numeric field: {key}"))
2900: }

2902: fn phase9_contains_any_case_insensitive(value: &str, tokens: &[&str]) -> bool {
2903:     let lowered = value.to_ascii_lowercase();
2904:     tokens.iter().any(|token| lowered.contains(token))
2905: }

2907: fn parse_required_test_output_total_passed(output: &str) -> u64 {
2908:     const PREFIX: &str = "test result: ok.";
2909:     output
2910:         .lines()
2911:         .filter_map(|line| {
2912:             let remainder = line.trim().strip_prefix(PREFIX)?;
2913:             let mut fields = remainder.split_whitespace();
2914:             let passed = fields.next()?.parse::<u64>().ok()?;
2915:             if fields.next() != Some("passed;") {
2916:                 return None;
2917:             }
2918:             Some(passed)
2919:         })
2920:         .sum()
2921: }

2989:         return Err("phase6 parity attestation must set phase=phase6".to_string());
2990:     }
2991: 
2992:     let generated_at_unix = object_u64_field(

2994:         "generated_at_unix",
2995:         "phase6 parity attestation",
2996:     )?;
2997:     let now_unix =
2998:         i64::try_from(unix_now()).map_err(|_| "current unix time out of range".to_string())?;
2999:     let generated_at = i64::try_from(generated_at_unix)
3000:         .map_err(|_| "phase6 parity generated_at_unix out of range".to_string())?;
3001:     if generated_at > now_unix + 300 {
3002:         return Err("phase6 parity generated_at_unix is in the future".to_string());
3003:     }
3004:     if now_unix - generated_at > inputs.max_attestation_age_seconds {
3005:         return Err("phase6 parity attestation is stale".to_string());
3006:     }
3007: 
3008:     let host_identity =
3009:         object_string_field(&attestation, "host_identity", "phase6 parity attestation")?;
3010:     if host_identity != inputs.expected_host_identity {
3011:         return Err("phase6 parity host identity mismatch".to_string());
3012:     }
3013:

3015:         &attestation,

3017:         "phase6 parity attestation",

3019:     let expected_command_digest = sha256_hex(PHASE6_PARITY_ATTESTATION_COMMAND_LITERAL.as_bytes());
3020:     if command_digest != expected_command_digest {
3021:         return Err("phase6 parity command digest mismatch".to_string());
3022:     }
3023: 
3024:     let signer_key_id =
3025:         object_string_field(&attestation, "signer_key_id", "phase6 parity attestation")?;
3026:     let expected_signer_fingerprint = sha256_hex(inputs.verifier_key.as_bytes());
3027:     let expected_signer_key_id = format!("ed25519:{}", &expected_signer_fingerprint[..16]);
3028:     if signer_key_id != expected_signer_key_id {
3029:         return Err("phase6 parity signer key id mismatch".to_string());
3030:     }
3031:     let verifier_key_hex = object_string_field(
3032:         &attestation,
3033:         "verifier_key_hex",
3034:         "phase6 parity attestation",
3035:     )?;
3036:     if verifier_key_hex != hex_encode(inputs.verifier_key.as_bytes()) {
3037:         return Err("phase6 parity verifier key mismatch".to_string());
3038:     }
3039: 
3040:     let git_commit = object_string_field(&attestation, "git_commit", "phase6 parity attestation")?;
3041:     if git_commit != inputs.expected_git_commit {
3042:         return Err("phase6 parity git commit mismatch".to_string());
3043:     }
3044: 
3045:     let report_path =
3046:         object_string_field(&attestation, "report_path", "phase6 parity attestation")?;
3047:     let expected_report =
3048:         canonical_file_display(inputs.expected_report_path, "phase6 parity report")?;
3049:     if report_path != expected_report {
3050:         return Err("phase6 parity report path mismatch".to_string());
3051:     }
3052:     let report_sha256 =
3053:         object_string_field(&attestation, "report_sha256", "phase6 parity attestation")?;
3054:     let actual_report_sha256 = sha256_file_hex(Path::new(report_path.as_str()))?;
3055:     if report_sha256 != actual_report_sha256 {
3056:         return Err("phase6 parity report digest mismatch".to_string());
3057:     }
3058: 
3059:     let report_captured_at_unix = object_u64_field(
3060:         &attestation,
3061:         "report_captured_at_unix",
3062:         "phase6 parity attestation",
3063:     )?;
3064:     let report_captured_at = i64::try_from(report_captured_at_unix)
3065:         .map_err(|_| "phase6 parity report_captured_at_unix out of range".to_string())?;
3066:     if report_captured_at > now_unix + 300 {
3067:         return Err("phase6 parity report_captured_at_unix is in the future".to_string());
3068:     }
3069:     if now_unix - report_captured_at > inputs.max_attestation_age_seconds {
3070:         return Err("phase6 parity report_captured_at_unix is stale".to_string());
3071:     }
3072:     let observed_report_captured_at =
3073:         phase6_report_captured_at_unix(Path::new(report_path.as_str()))?;
3074:     if report_captured_at_unix != observed_report_captured_at {
3075:         return Err("phase6 parity report captured_at_unix mismatch".to_string());
3076:     }
3077: 
3078:     let signature_hex =
3079:         object_string_field(&attestation, "signature_hex", "phase6 parity attestation")?;
3080:     let signature_bytes = decode_hex_to_fixed::<64>(signature_hex.as_str())
3081:         .map_err(|err| format!("phase6 parity signature parse failed: {err}"))?;
3082:     let payload = phase6_parity_attestation_payload(&Phase6ParityAttestationPayload {
3083:         generated_at_unix,
3084:         host_identity: host_identity.as_str(),
3085:         command_digest_sha256: command_digest.as_str(),
3086:         signer_key_id: signer_key_id.as_str(),
3087:         verifier_key_hex: verifier_key_hex.as_str(),
3088:         git_commit: git_commit.as_str(),
3089:         report_path: report_path.as_str(),
3090:         report_sha256: report_sha256.as_str(),
3091:         report_captured_at_unix,
3092:     });
3093:     let signature = Signature::from_bytes(&signature_bytes);
3094:     inputs
3095:         .verifier_key
3096:         .verify(payload.as_bytes(), &signature)
3097:         .map_err(|_| "phase6 parity signature verification failed".to_string())?;
3098:     Ok(())
3099: }

3280: 
3281:     let mut seen = std::collections::BTreeSet::new();
3282:     let mut observed_entries = std::collections::BTreeMap::new();
3283:     for entry in entries {
3284:         let entry_object = entry.as_object().ok_or_else(|| {
3285:             "phase9 evidence attestation artifact entry must be object".to_string()
3286:         })?;
3287:         let name = object_string_field(entry_object, "name", "phase9 evidence artifact entry")?;
3288:         if !seen.insert(name.clone()) {
3289:             return Err(format!(
3290:                 "phase9 evidence attestation has duplicate artifact: {name}"
3291:             ));
3292:         }
3293:         let expected_path = expected_paths.get(name.as_str()).ok_or_else(|| {
3294:             format!("phase9 evidence attestation has unexpected artifact: {name}")
3295:         })?;
3296:         let artifact_path = object_string_field(
3297:             entry_object,
3298:             "artifact_path",
3299:             "phase9 evidence artifact entry",
3300:         )?;
3301:         if artifact_path != *expected_path {
3302:             return Err(format!("phase9 evidence artifact path mismatch for {name}"));
3303:         }
3304: 
3305:         let artifact_sha256 = object_string_field(
3306:             entry_object,
3307:             "artifact_sha256",
3308:             "phase9 evidence artifact entry",
3309:         )?;
3310:         let actual_artifact_sha256 = sha256_file_hex(Path::new(artifact_path.as_str()))?;
3311:         if artifact_sha256 != actual_artifact_sha256 {
3312:             return Err(format!(
3313:                 "phase9 evidence artifact digest mismatch for {name}"
3314:             ));
3315:         }
3316: 
3317:         let captured_at_unix = object_u64_field(
3318:             entry_object,
3319:             "captured_at_unix",
3320:             "phase9 evidence artifact entry",
3321:         )?;
3322:         let captured_at = i64::try_from(captured_at_unix)
3323:             .map_err(|_| format!("phase9 evidence captured_at_unix out of range for {name}"))?;
3324:         if captured_at > now_unix + 300 {
3325:             return Err(format!(
3326:                 "phase9 evidence captured_at_unix is in the future for {name}"
3327:             ));
3328:         }
3329:         if now_unix - captured_at > inputs.max_attestation_age_seconds {
3330:             return Err(format!(
3331:                 "phase9 evidence captured_at_unix is stale for {name}"
3332:             ));
3333:         }
3334: 
3335:         let label = format!("phase9 evidence artifact {name}");
3336:         let (artifact_captured_at, artifact_environment) = phase9_parse_measured_artifact_document(
3337:             Path::new(artifact_path.as_str()),
3338:             label.as_str(),
3339:         )?;
3340:         if artifact_captured_at != captured_at_unix {
3341:             return Err(format!(
3342:                 "phase9 evidence captured_at_unix mismatch for {name}"
3343:             ));
3344:         }
3345:         if artifact_environment != environment {
3346:             return Err(format!("phase9 evidence environment mismatch for {name}"));
3347:         }
3348: 
3349:         observed_entries.insert(
3350:             name.clone(),
3351:             Phase9EvidenceArtifactEntry {
3352:                 name,
3353:                 artifact_path,
3354:                 artifact_sha256,
3355:                 captured_at_unix,
3356:             },
3357:         );
3358:     }
3359: 
3360:     if seen.len() != PHASE9_REQUIRED_ARTIFACTS.len() {
3361:         return Err("phase9 evidence attestation missing required artifacts".to_string());
3362:     }
3363: 
3364:     let mut ordered_entries = Vec::with_capacity(PHASE9_REQUIRED_ARTIFACTS.len());
3365:     for required_name in PHASE9_REQUIRED_ARTIFACTS {
3366:         let Some(entry) = observed_entries.remove(*required_name) else {
3367:             return Err(format!(
3368:                 "phase9 evidence attestation missing required artifact: {required_name}"
3369:             ));
3370:         };
3371:         ordered_entries.push(entry);
3372:     }
3373:     if !observed_entries.is_empty() {
3374:         return Err("phase9 evidence attestation contains unexpected artifacts".to_string());
3375:     }
3376: 
3377:     let signature_hex =
3378:         object_string_field(&attestation, "signature_hex", "phase9 evidence attestation")?;
3379:     let signature_bytes = decode_hex_to_fixed::<64>(signature_hex.as_str())
3380:         .map_err(|err| format!("phase9 evidence signature parse failed: {err}"))?;
3381:     let payload = phase9_evidence_attestation_payload(&Phase9EvidenceAttestationPayload {
3382:         generated_at_unix,
3383:         host_identity: host_identity.as_str(),
3384:         command_digest_sha256: command_digest.as_str(),
3385:         signer_key_id: signer_key_id.as_str(),
3386:         verifier_key_hex: verifier_key_hex.as_str(),
3387:         git_commit: git_commit.as_str(),
3388:         environment: environment.as_str(),
3389:         artifacts: ordered_entries.as_slice(),
3390:     });
3391:     let signature = Signature::from_bytes(&signature_bytes);
3392:     inputs
3393:         .verifier_key
3394:         .verify(payload.as_bytes(), &signature)
3395:         .map_err(|_| "phase9 evidence signature verification failed".to_string())?;
3396:     Ok(())
3397: }

3399: fn write_phase9_evidence_attestation(out_dir: &Path, environment: &str) -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
3400:     ensure_release_provenance_keypair_exists()?;
3401:     let signing_key = load_release_signing_key()?;
3402:     let verifier_key = load_release_verifier_key()?;
3403:     let derived_verifier_key = signing_key.verifying_key();
3404:     if derived_verifier_key.as_bytes() != verifier_key.as_bytes() {
3405:         return Err(
3406:             "phase9 evidence key mismatch: signing key does not match verifier key".to_string(),
3407:         );
3408:     }
3409: 
3410:     let generated_at_unix = unix_now();
3411:     let host_identity = release_host_identity_from_env_or_default()?;
3412:     let git_commit = current_git_commit()?;
3413:     let attestation_document =
3414:         build_phase9_evidence_attestation_document(&Phase9EvidenceAttestationBuildInputs {
3415:             out_dir,
3416:             environment,
3417:             generated_at_unix,
3418:             host_identity: host_identity.as_str(),
3419:             git_commit: git_commit.as_str(),
3420:             signing_key: &signing_key,
3421:             verifier_key: &verifier_key,
3422:         })?;
3423:     let attestation_path = phase9_evidence_attestation_path_from_env_or_default()?;
3424:     write_json_secure(attestation_path.as_path(), &attestation_document)?;
3425:     Ok(attestation_path)
3426: }

3785:     }
3786:     if phase9_require_bool(
3787:         &backend,
3788:         "protocol_leakage_detected",
3789:         "backend_agility_report",
3790:     )? {
3791:         return Err("backend agility gate failed: protocol leakage detected".to_string());
3792:     }
3793:     let evidence_commands = backend
3794:         .get("evidence_commands")
3795:         .and_then(Value::as_array)
3796:         .ok_or_else(|| {
3797:             "backend agility gate failed: evidence_commands must be a non-empty list".to_string()
3798:         })?;
3799:     if evidence_commands.is_empty() {
3800:         return Err(
3801:             "backend agility gate failed: evidence_commands must be a non-empty list".to_string(),
3802:         );
3803:     }
3804:     for value in evidence_commands {
3805:         let command = value
3806:             .as_str()
3807:             .map(str::trim)
3808:             .filter(|entry| !entry.is_empty())
3809:             .ok_or_else(|| {
3810:                 "backend agility gate failed: invalid command in evidence_commands".to_string()
3811:             })?;
3812:         if phase9_contains_any_case_insensitive(command, &["backend-stub", "stub-backend"]) {
3813:             return Err(
3814:                 "backend agility gate failed: stub backend command is not valid evidence"
3815:                     .to_string(),
3816:             );
3817:         }
3818:     }
3819: 
3820:     let crypto_path = out_dir.join("crypto_deprecation_schedule.json");
3821:     let crypto = read_json_object(crypto_path.as_path(), "crypto_deprecation_schedule")?;
3822:     phase9_require_measured_evidence_metadata(
3823:         &crypto,
3824:         "crypto_deprecation_schedule",
3825:         now_unix,
3826:         max_evidence_age_seconds,
3827:     )?;
3828:     let entries = crypto
3829:         .get("entries")
3830:         .and_then(Value::as_array)
3831:         .ok_or_else(|| "crypto schedule gate failed: no deprecation entries present".to_string())?;
3832:     if entries.is_empty() {
3833:         return Err("crypto schedule gate failed: no deprecation entries present".to_string());
3834:     }
3835:     for entry in entries {
3836:         let entry_obj = entry
3837:             .as_object()
3838:             .ok_or_else(|| "crypto schedule gate failed: invalid entry type".to_string())?;
3839:         let deprecates_at = phase9_require_string(
3840:             entry_obj,
3841:             "deprecates_at_utc",
3842:             "crypto deprecation schedule entry",
3843:         )?;
3844:         let removal_at = phase9_require_string(
3845:             entry_obj,
3846:             "removal_at_utc",
3847:             "crypto deprecation schedule entry",
3848:         )?;
3849:         let deprecates_at_unix =
3850:             parse_utc_to_unix(deprecates_at.as_str(), "crypto deprecates_at_utc")?;
3851:         let removal_at_unix = parse_utc_to_unix(removal_at.as_str(), "crypto removal_at_utc")?;
3852:         if removal_at_unix <= deprecates_at_unix {
3853:             return Err(
3854:                 "crypto schedule gate failed: removal timestamp must be after deprecation timestamp"
3855:                     .to_string(),
3856:             );
3857:         }
3858:     }
3859:     if phase9_require_bool(
3860:         &crypto,
3861:         "exceptions_default_enabled",
3862:         "crypto_deprecation_schedule",
3863:     )? {
3864:         return Err(
3865:             "crypto schedule gate failed: insecure exceptions must be disabled by default"
3866:                 .to_string(),
3867:         );
3868:     }
3869:     if !phase9_require_bool(
3870:         &crypto,
3871:         "exceptions_require_risk_acceptance",
3872:         "crypto_deprecation_schedule",
3873:     )? {
3874:         return Err(
3875:             "crypto schedule gate failed: exceptions must require risk acceptance".to_string(),
3876:         );
3877:     }
3878:     if !phase9_require_bool(
3879:         &crypto,
3880:         "exceptions_auto_expire",
3881:         "crypto_deprecation_schedule",
3882:     )? {
3883:         return Err("crypto schedule gate failed: exceptions must auto-expire".to_string());
3884:     }
3885: 
3886:     Ok(format!(
3887:         "phase9 readiness checks passed: {}",
3888:         out_dir.display()
3889:     ))
3890: }

4588: pub fn execute_ops_sign_release_artifact() -> Result<String, String> {
4589:     let artifact_path = release_artifact_path_from_env_or_default()?;
4590:     let sbom_path = release_sbom_path_from_env_or_default()?;
4591:     let sbom_digest_path = release_sbom_sha256_path_from_env_or_default()?;
4592:     let provenance_path = release_provenance_path_from_env_or_default()?;
4593:     let release_track = release_track_from_env_or_default()?;
4594:     let host_identity = release_host_identity_from_env_or_default()?;
4595: 
4596:     ensure_release_provenance_keypair_exists()?;
4597:     let signing_key = load_release_signing_key()?;
4598:     let verifier_key = load_release_verifier_key()?;
4599:     let derived_verifier_key = signing_key.verifying_key();
4600:     if derived_verifier_key.as_bytes() != verifier_key.as_bytes() {
4601:         return Err(
4602:             "release provenance key mismatch: signing key does not match verifier key".to_string(),
4603:         );
4604:     }
4605: 
4606:     let generated_at_unix = unix_now();
4607:     let provenance = build_release_provenance_document(&ReleaseProvenanceBuildInputs {
4608:         artifact_path: artifact_path.as_path(),
4609:         sbom_path: sbom_path.as_path(),
4610:         sbom_digest_path: sbom_digest_path.as_path(),
4611:         generated_at_unix,
4612:         host_identity: host_identity.as_str(),
4613:         release_track: release_track.as_str(),
4614:         signing_key: &signing_key,
4615:         verifier_key: &verifier_key,
4616:     })?;
4617:     write_json_secure(provenance_path.as_path(), &provenance)?;
4618: 
4619:     verify_release_provenance_document(&ReleaseProvenanceVerifyInputs {
4620:         provenance_path: provenance_path.as_path(),
4621:         expected_artifact_path: artifact_path.as_path(),
4622:         expected_sbom_path: sbom_path.as_path(),
4623:         expected_sbom_digest_path: sbom_digest_path.as_path(),
4624:         expected_host_identity: host_identity.as_str(),
4625:         expected_release_track: release_track.as_str(),
4626:         verifier_key: &verifier_key,
4627:         max_provenance_age_seconds: release_max_provenance_age_seconds_from_env()?,
4628:     })?;
4629: 
4630:     Ok(format!(
4631:         "release provenance signed and verified: artifact={} sbom={} provenance={} release_track={}",
4632:         artifact_path.display(),
4633:         sbom_path.display(),
4634:         provenance_path.display(),
4635:         release_track
4636:     ))
4637: }

 157: pub fn execute_ops_generate_attack_matrix(
 158:     config: GenerateAttackMatrixConfig,
 159: ) -> Result<String, String> {
 160:     let attacks = parse_attacks(config.attacks.as_str())?;
 161:     let nodes = parse_nodes(config.nodes.as_str())?;
 162:     let rows = build_attack_rows(&attacks, &nodes)?;
 163:     let output_path = resolve_path(config.output.as_path())?;
 164:     ensure_parent_dir(output_path.as_path())?;
 165:     match config.format.as_str() {
 166:         "json" => {
 167:             let payload = json!({
 168:                 "nodes": nodes.iter().map(|node| json!({
 169:                     "label": node.label,
 170:                     "role": node.role,
 171:                 })).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
 172:                 "attacks": rows.iter().map(|row| json!({
 173:                     "attack_key": row.attack_key,
 174:                     "attack_family": row.attack_family,
 175:                     "primary_nodes": row.primary_nodes,
 176:                     "hypothesis": row.hypothesis,
 177:                     "expected_secure_behavior": row.expected_secure_behavior,
 178:                     "result": row.result,
 179:                     "evidence": row.evidence,
 180:                 })).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
 181:             });
 182:             fs::write(
 183:                 output_path.as_path(),
 184:                 serde_json::to_string_pretty(&payload)
 185:                     .map_err(|err| format!("encode attack matrix json failed: {err}"))?
 186:                     + "\n",
 187:             )
 188:             .map_err(|err| format!("write {} failed: {err}", output_path.display()))?;
 189:         }
 190:         "md" => {
 191:             fs::write(
 192:                 output_path.as_path(),
 193:                 render_attack_matrix_markdown(&rows, &nodes),
 194:             )
 195:             .map_err(|err| format!("write {} failed: {err}", output_path.display()))?;
 196:         }
 197:         other => {
 198:             return Err(format!(
 199:                 "invalid --format value {other:?}; expected md or json"
 200:             ));
 201:         }
 202:     }
 203:     Ok(format!("wrote attack matrix {}", output_path.display()))
 204: }

 206: pub fn execute_ops_generate_assessment_from_matrix(
 207:     config: GenerateAssessmentFromMatrixConfig,
 208: ) -> Result<String, String> {
 209:     let matrix_path = resolve_path(config.matrix_json.as_path())?;
 210:     let matrix = load_matrix_payload(matrix_path.as_path())?;
 211:     let output_path = resolve_path(config.output.as_path())?;
 212:     ensure_parent_dir(output_path.as_path())?;
 213:     let topology = config.topology.unwrap_or_else(|| {
 214:         matrix
 215:             .nodes
 216:             .iter()
 217:             .map(|node| format!("{} ({})", node.label, node.role))
 218:             .collect::<Vec<_>>()
 219:             .join(", ")
 220:     });
 221:     let rendered = render_assessment_markdown(
 222:         config.project.as_str(),
 223:         matrix.attacks.as_slice(),
 224:         topology.as_str(),
 225:         config.authorization.as_str(),
 226:     );
 227:     fs::write(output_path.as_path(), rendered)
 228:         .map_err(|err| format!("write {} failed: {err}", output_path.display()))?;
 229:     Ok(format!(
 230:         "wrote assessment scaffold {}",
 231:         output_path.display()
 232:     ))
 233: }

 235: pub fn execute_ops_validate_live_lab_reports(
 236:     config: ValidateLiveLabReportsConfig,
 237: ) -> Result<String, String> {
 238:     let report_paths =
 239:         collect_report_paths(config.reports.as_slice(), config.report_dir.as_deref())?;
 240:     let errors = validate_report_paths(report_paths.as_slice())?;
 241:     if let Some(output) = config.output {
 242:         let output_path = resolve_path(output.as_path())?;
 243:         ensure_parent_dir(output_path.as_path())?;
 244:         fs::write(
 245:             output_path.as_path(),
 246:             render_validation_markdown(report_paths.as_slice(), errors.as_slice()),
 247:         )
 248:         .map_err(|err| format!("write {} failed: {err}", output_path.display()))?;
 249:     }
 250:     if errors.is_empty() {
 251:         Ok(format!(
 252:             "validated {} live-lab report(s)",
 253:             report_paths.len()
 254:         ))
 255:     } else {
 256:         Err(errors.join("\n"))
 257:     }
 258: }

 260: pub fn execute_ops_evaluate_live_coverage_promotion(
 261:     config: EvaluateLiveCoveragePromotionConfig,
 262: ) -> Result<String, String> {
 263:     let report_paths =
 264:         collect_report_paths(config.reports.as_slice(), config.report_dir.as_deref())?;
 265:     let specs = selected_validation_specs(config.targets.as_str())?;
 266:     let loaded = load_reports_by_mode(report_paths.as_slice())?;
 267:     let mut rows = Vec::new();
 268:     let mut failed = false;
 269:     for spec in specs {
 270:         let evaluation = evaluate_spec(spec, &loaded)?;
 271:         if !evaluation.eligible {
 272:             failed = true;
 273:         }
 274:         rows.push(evaluation);
 275:     }
 276:     let output_path = resolve_path(config.output.as_path())?;
 277:     ensure_parent_dir(output_path.as_path())?;
 278:     fs::write(
 279:         output_path.as_path(),
 280:         render_promotion_markdown(rows.as_slice()),
 281:     )
 282:     .map_err(|err| format!("write {} failed: {err}", output_path.display()))?;
 283:     if failed {
 284:         Err(format!(
 285:             "live coverage promotion blocked; see {}",
 286:             output_path.display()
 287:         ))
 288:     } else {
 289:         Ok(format!(
 290:             "live coverage promotion eligible; wrote {}",
 291:             output_path.display()
 292:         ))
 293:     }
 294: }

 296: fn parse_attacks(raw: &str) -> Result<Vec<String>, String> {
 297:     let attacks = split_csv_string(raw);
 298:     if attacks.is_empty() {
 299:         return Err("no attack keys supplied".to_string());
 300:     }
 301:     for attack in &attacks {
 302:         if attack_spec(attack.as_str()).is_none() {
 303:             return Err(format!("unknown attack keys: {attack}"));
 304:         }
 305:     }
 306:     Ok(attacks)
 307: }
 308: 
 309: fn attack_spec(key: &str) -> Option<&'static AttackSpec> {
 310:     ATTACK_SPECS.iter().find(|spec| spec.key == key)
 311: }
 312: 
 313: fn parse_nodes(raw: &str) -> Result<Vec<NodeSpec>, String> {
 314:     let mut nodes = Vec::new();
 315:     for item in split_csv_string(raw) {
 316:         let Some((label, role)) = item.split_once(':') else {
 317:             return Err(format!("invalid node spec: {item}"));
 318:         };
 319:         let label = label.trim();
 320:         let role = role.trim();
 321:         if label.is_empty() || role.is_empty() {
 322:             return Err(format!("invalid node spec: {item}"));
 323:         }
 324:         nodes.push(NodeSpec {
 325:             label: label.to_string(),
 326:             role: role.to_string(),
 327:         });
 328:     }
 329:     if nodes.is_empty() {
 330:         return Err("no nodes supplied".to_string());
 331:     }
 332:     Ok(nodes)
 333: }
 334: 
 335: fn build_attack_rows(attacks: &[String], nodes: &[NodeSpec]) -> Result<Vec<AttackRow>, String> {
 336:     let mut rows = Vec::new();
 337:     for attack in attacks {
 338:         let spec =
 339:             attack_spec(attack.as_str()).ok_or_else(|| format!("unknown attack keys: {attack}"))?;
 340:         rows.push(AttackRow {
 341:             attack_key: spec.key.to_string(),
 342:             attack_family: spec.title.to_string(),
 343:             primary_nodes: suggested_targets(spec.key, nodes),
 344:             hypothesis: spec.hypothesis.to_string(),
 345:             expected_secure_behavior: spec.expected.to_string(),
 346:             result: "[pass/fail/blocked/skipped]".to_string(),
 347:             evidence: "[fill in logs, tests, reports]".to_string(),
 348:         });
 349:     }
 350:     Ok(rows)
 351: }
 352: 
 353: fn suggested_targets(attack_key: &str, nodes: &[NodeSpec]) -> String {
 354:     let roles: HashSet<&str> = nodes.iter().map(|node| node.role.as_str()).collect();
 355:     if matches!(
 356:         attack_key,
 357:         "route-hijack" | "dns-integrity" | "control-plane-replay"
 358:     ) && roles.contains("admin")
 359:     {
 360:         return nodes
 361:             .iter()
 362:             .filter(|node| node.role == "admin")
 363:             .map(|node| node.label.clone())
 364:             .collect::<Vec<_>>()
 365:             .join(", ");
 366:     }
 367:     if matches!(
 368:         attack_key,
 369:         "local-socket-spoofing" | "secret-custody" | "missing-state-fail-closed"
 370:     ) {
 371:         return nodes
 372:             .iter()
 373:             .map(|node| node.label.clone())
 374:             .collect::<Vec<_>>()
 375:             .join(", ");
 376:     }
 377:     if attack_key == "host-trust-downgrade" {
 378:         return format!(
 379:             "operator -> {}",
 380:             nodes
 381:                 .iter()
 382:                 .map(|node| node.label.clone())
 383:                 .collect::<Vec<_>>()
 384:                 .join(", ")
 385:         );
 386:     }
 387:     if attack_key == "traversal-abuse" {
 388:         let preferred = nodes
 389:             .iter()
 390:             .filter(|node| matches!(node.role.as_str(), "client" | "admin" | "relay" | "entry"))
 391:             .map(|node| node.label.clone())
 392:             .collect::<Vec<_>>();
 393:         if !preferred.is_empty() {
 394:             return preferred.join(", ");
 395:         }
 396:     }
 397:     if attack_key == "helper-input-abuse" {
 398:         let preferred = nodes
 399:             .iter()
 400:             .filter(|node| matches!(node.role.as_str(), "client" | "admin"))
 401:             .map(|node| node.label.clone())
 402:             .collect::<Vec<_>>();
 403:         if !preferred.is_empty() {
 404:             return preferred.join(", ");
 405:         }
 406:     }
 407:     nodes
 408:         .iter()
 409:         .map(|node| node.label.clone())
 410:         .collect::<Vec<_>>()
 411:         .join(", ")
 412: }
 413: 
 414: fn render_attack_matrix_markdown(rows: &[AttackRow], nodes: &[NodeSpec]) -> String {
 415:     let node_summary = nodes
 416:         .iter()
 417:         .map(|node| format!("{} ({})", node.label, node.role))
 418:         .collect::<Vec<_>>()
 419:         .join(", ");
 420:     let mut lines = vec![
 421:         "# Attack Matrix".to_string(),
 422:         "".to_string(),
 423:         "## Lab Nodes".to_string(),
 424:         "".to_string(),
 425:         format!("- {node_summary}"),
 426:         "".to_string(),
 427:         "## Planned Attacks".to_string(),
 428:         "".to_string(),
 429:         "| Attack Family | Primary Nodes | Hypothesis | Expected Secure Behavior | Result | Evidence |".to_string(),
 430:         "| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |".to_string(),
 431:     ];
 432:     for row in rows {
 433:         lines.push(format!(
 434:             "| {} | {} | {} | {} | {} | {} |",
 435:             row.attack_family,
 436:             row.primary_nodes,
 437:             row.hypothesis,
 438:             row.expected_secure_behavior,
 439:             row.result,
 440:             row.evidence
 441:         ));
 442:     }
 443:     lines.push(String::new());
 444:     lines.join("\n")
 445: }

 450: }
 451: 
 452: fn load_matrix_payload(path: &Path) -> Result<AssessmentMatrix, String> {
 453:     let payload = load_json_object(path)?;
 454:     let nodes_value = payload
 455:         .get("nodes")
 456:         .ok_or_else(|| "matrix payload must contain 'nodes' and 'attacks' arrays".to_string())?;
 457:     let attacks_value = payload
 458:         .get("attacks")
 459:         .ok_or_else(|| "matrix payload must contain 'nodes' and 'attacks' arrays".to_string())?;
 460:     let nodes_array = nodes_value
 461:         .as_array()
 462:         .ok_or_else(|| "matrix payload must contain 'nodes' and 'attacks' arrays".to_string())?;
 463:     let attacks_array = attacks_value
 464:         .as_array()
 465:         .ok_or_else(|| "matrix payload must contain 'nodes' and 'attacks' arrays".to_string())?;
 466: 
 467:     let mut nodes = Vec::new();
 468:     for node in nodes_array {
 469:         let object = node
 470:             .as_object()
 471:             .ok_or_else(|| "invalid node entry in matrix payload".to_string())?;
 472:         let label = require_non_empty_string_field(
 473:             object,
 474:             "label",
 475:             "invalid node entry in matrix payload",
 476:         )?;
 477:         let role =
 478:             require_non_empty_string_field(object, "role", "invalid node entry in matrix payload")?;
 479:         nodes.push(NodeSpec { label, role });
 480:     }
 481: 
 482:     let required_attack_fields = [
 483:         "attack_key",
 484:         "attack_family",
 485:         "primary_nodes",
 486:         "hypothesis",
 487:         "expected_secure_behavior",
 488:         "result",
 489:         "evidence",
 490:     ];
 491:     let mut attacks = Vec::new();
 492:     for attack in attacks_array {
 493:         let object = attack
 494:             .as_object()
 495:             .ok_or_else(|| "invalid attack entry in matrix payload".to_string())?;
 496:         let mut missing = Vec::new();
 497:         for field in required_attack_fields {
 498:             if object.get(field).and_then(Value::as_str).is_none() {
 499:                 missing.push(field);
 500:             }
 501:         }
 502:         if !missing.is_empty() {
 503:             return Err(format!(
 504:                 "invalid attack entry in matrix payload; missing fields: {}",
 505:                 missing.join(", ")
 506:             ));
 507:         }
 508:         attacks.push(AttackRow {
 509:             attack_key: object["attack_key"]
 510:                 .as_str()
 511:                 .unwrap_or_default()
 512:                 .to_string(),
 513:             attack_family: object["attack_family"]
 514:                 .as_str()
 515:                 .unwrap_or_default()
 516:                 .to_string(),
 517:             primary_nodes: object["primary_nodes"]
 518:                 .as_str()
 519:                 .unwrap_or_default()
 520:                 .to_string(),
 521:             hypothesis: object["hypothesis"]
 522:                 .as_str()
 523:                 .unwrap_or_default()
 524:                 .to_string(),
 525:             expected_secure_behavior: object["expected_secure_behavior"]
 526:                 .as_str()
 527:                 .unwrap_or_default()
 528:                 .to_string(),
 529:             result: object["result"].as_str().unwrap_or_default().to_string(),
 530:             evidence: object["evidence"].as_str().unwrap_or_default().to_string(),
 531:         });
 532:     }
 533: 
 534:     Ok(AssessmentMatrix { nodes, attacks })
 535: }

 537: fn render_assessment_markdown(
 538:     project: &str,
 539:     attacks: &[AttackRow],
 540:     topology: &str,
 541:     authorization: &str,
 542: ) -> String {
 543:     let generated_at = utc_timestamp();
 544:     let attack_lines = if attacks.is_empty() {
 545:         "- [fill in attack families]".to_string()
 546:     } else {
 547:         attacks
 548:             .iter()
 549:             .map(|attack| format!("- {}", attack.attack_family))
 550:             .collect::<Vec<_>>()
 551:             .join("\n")
 552:     };
 553:     let mut matrix_lines = vec![
 554:         "| Attack Family | Primary Nodes | Hypothesis | Expected Secure Behavior | Result | Evidence |"
 555:             .to_string(),
 556:         "| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |".to_string(),
 557:     ];
 558:     for attack in attacks {
 559:         matrix_lines.push(format!(
 560:             "| {} | {} | {} | {} | {} | {} |",
 561:             attack.attack_family,
 562:             attack.primary_nodes,
 563:             attack.hypothesis,
 564:             attack.expected_secure_behavior,
 565:             attack.result,
 566:             attack.evidence
 567:         ));
 568:     }
 569:     format!(
 570:         "# {project} Adversarial Hardening Assessment\n\nGenerated: {generated_at}\n\n## Scope And Authorization\n\n- Lab-only authorization confirmed: {authorization}\n- In-scope systems:\n- Out-of-scope systems:\n- Success criteria:\n\n## Topology\n\n{topology}\n\n## Attack Plan\n\n{attack_lines}\n\n## Attack Matrix\n\n{}\n\n## Findings\n\n### [Severity] [Title]\n\n- Attack family:\n- Evidence:\n- Affected files/subsystems:\n- Expected secure behavior:\n- Actual behavior:\n- Remediation:\n- Required regression test or gate:\n\n## Code Audit Notes\n\n- Trust boundaries reviewed:\n- Privileged boundaries reviewed:\n- Fallback or legacy paths found:\n- Tests and gates reviewed:\n\n## Recommended Hardening Work\n\n1. [Highest-priority change]\n2. [Next change]\n3. [Next change]\n\n## Verification Plan\n\n1. [Unit or integration test]\n2. [Gate or live lab validation]\n3. [Evidence artifact to regenerate]\n",
 571:         matrix_lines.join("\n")
 572:     )
 573: }
