 575: fn collect_report_paths(
 576:     reports: &[PathBuf],
 577:     report_dir: Option<&Path>,
 578: ) -> Result<Vec<PathBuf>, String> {
 579:     let mut paths = Vec::new();
 580:     for path in reports {
 581:         paths.push(resolve_path(path.as_path())?);
 582:     }
 583:     if let Some(report_dir) = report_dir {
 584:         collect_json_files(resolve_path(report_dir)?.as_path(), &mut paths)?;
 585:     }
 586:     let mut deduped = Vec::new();
 587:     let mut seen = HashSet::new();
 588:     for path in paths {
 589:         if seen.insert(path.clone()) {
 590:             deduped.push(path);
 591:         }
 592:     }
 593:     if deduped.is_empty() {
 594:         return Err("no report files supplied".to_string());
 595:     }
 596:     Ok(deduped)
 597: }
 598: 
 599: fn collect_json_files(dir: &Path, out: &mut Vec<PathBuf>) -> Result<(), String> {
 600:     let metadata =
 601:         fs::metadata(dir).map_err(|err| format!("read {} failed: {err}", dir.display()))?;
 602:     if !metadata.is_dir() {
 603:         return Err(format!("{} is not a directory", dir.display()));
 604:     }
 605:     let mut entries = fs::read_dir(dir)
 606:         .map_err(|err| format!("read {} failed: {err}", dir.display()))?
 607:         .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()
 608:         .map_err(|err| format!("read {} failed: {err}", dir.display()))?;
 609:     entries.sort_by_key(|entry| entry.path());
 610:     for entry in entries {
 611:         let path = entry.path();
 612:         let file_type = entry
 613:             .file_type()
 614:             .map_err(|err| format!("inspect {} failed: {err}", path.display()))?;
 615:         if file_type.is_dir() {
 616:             collect_json_files(path.as_path(), out)?;
 617:         } else if file_type.is_file()
 618:             && path.extension().and_then(|value| value.to_str()) == Some("json")
 619:         {
 620:             out.push(path);
 621:         }
 622:     }
 623:     Ok(())
 624: }
 625: 
 626: fn validate_report_paths(report_paths: &[PathBuf]) -> Result<Vec<String>, String> {
 627:     let mut errors = Vec::new();
 628:     for path in report_paths {
 629:         let payload = load_json_object(path.as_path())?;
 630:         errors.extend(validate_report_payload(path.as_path(), &payload));
 631:     }
 632:     Ok(errors)
 633: }
 634: 
 635: fn validate_report_payload(path: &Path, payload: &serde_json::Map<String, Value>) -> Vec<String> {
 636:     let mut problems = Vec::new();
 637:     let Some(mode) = payload.get("mode").and_then(Value::as_str) else {
 638:         return vec![format!(
 639:             "{}: missing or invalid 'mode' field",
 640:             path.display()
 641:         )];
 642:     };
 643:     let Some(spec) = validation_spec_by_mode(mode) else {
 644:         return vec![format!("{}: unknown report mode '{mode}'", path.display())];
 645:     };
 646:     for field in spec.required_report_fields {
 647:         if !payload.contains_key(*field) {
 648:             problems.push(format!(
 649:                 "{}: missing required field '{}'",
 650:                 path.display(),
 651:                 field
 652:             ));
 653:         }
 654:     }
 655:     if payload.get("evidence_mode").and_then(Value::as_str) != Some(EVIDENCE_MODE_MEASURED) {
 656:         problems.push(format!(
 657:             "{}: field 'evidence_mode' must equal '{}'",
 658:             path.display(),
 659:             EVIDENCE_MODE_MEASURED
 660:         ));
 661:     }
 662:     let Some(checks) = payload.get("checks").and_then(Value::as_object) else {
 663:         problems.push(format!(
 664:             "{}: field 'checks' must be an object",
 665:             path.display()
 666:         ));
 667:         return problems;
 668:     };
 669:     for check_name in spec.required_check_keys {
 670:         match checks.get(*check_name).and_then(Value::as_str) {
 671:             None => problems.push(format!(
 672:                 "{}: missing required check '{}'",
 673:                 path.display(),
 674:                 check_name
 675:             )),
 676:             Some(value)
 677:                 if !matches!(value, CHECK_PASS | CHECK_FAIL | CHECK_SKIP | CHECK_SKIPPED) =>
 678:             {
 679:                 problems.push(format!(
 680:                     "{}: check '{}' must be one of pass/fail/skip/skipped, got {:?}",
 681:                     path.display(),
 682:                     check_name,
 683:                     value
 684:                 ));
 685:             }
 686:             Some(_) => {}
 687:         }
 688:     }
 689:     match payload.get("captured_at_unix").and_then(Value::as_u64) {
 690:         Some(value) if value > 0 => {}
 691:         _ => problems.push(format!(
 692:             "{}: field 'captured_at_unix' must be a positive integer",
 693:             path.display()
 694:         )),
 695:     }
 696:     if !matches!(
 697:         payload.get("status").and_then(Value::as_str),
 698:         Some(STATUS_PASS | STATUS_FAIL)
 699:     ) {
 700:         problems.push(format!(
 701:             "{}: field 'status' must be 'pass' or 'fail'",
 702:             path.display()
 703:         ));
 704:     }
 705:     problems
 706: }

 708: fn render_validation_markdown(report_paths: &[PathBuf], errors: &[String]) -> String {
 709:     let mut lines = vec![
 710:         "# Rustynet Live-Lab Report Validation".to_string(),
 711:         "".to_string(),
 712:         "## Reports".to_string(),
 713:         "".to_string(),
 714:     ];
 715:     for path in report_paths {
 716:         lines.push(format!("- `{}`", path.display()));
 717:     }
 718:     lines.push(String::new());

 720:         lines.extend([

 724:             "".to_string(),

 726:     } else {
 727:         lines.extend(["## Errors".to_string(), "".to_string()]);
 728:         for error in errors {
 729:             lines.push(format!("- {error}"));
 730:         }
 731:         lines.push(String::new());
 732:     }
 733:     lines.join("\n")
 734: }

 744: fn selected_validation_specs(raw: &str) -> Result<Vec<&'static LiveValidationSpec>, String> {
 745:     if raw.trim().eq_ignore_ascii_case("all") {
 746:         return Ok(catalog_sorted_validation_specs());
 747:     }
 748:     let keys = split_csv_string(raw);
 749:     if keys.is_empty() {
 750:         return Err("no targets supplied".to_string());
 751:     }
 752:     let mut specs = Vec::new();
 753:     let mut unknown = Vec::new();
 754:     for key in keys {
 755:         if let Some(spec) = validation_spec_by_key(key.as_str()) {
 756:             specs.push(spec);
 757:         } else {
 758:             unknown.push(key);
 759:         }
 760:     }
 761:     if !unknown.is_empty() {
 762:         return Err(format!("unknown targets: {}", unknown.join(", ")));
 763:     }
 764:     Ok(specs)
 765: }

 767: fn load_reports_by_mode(
 768:     report_paths: &[PathBuf],

 786: struct PromotionRow {
 787:     validation: String,
 788:     targets: String,
 789:     eligible: bool,
 790:     reason: String,
 791:     report_path: String,
 792: }
 793: 
 794: fn evaluate_spec(
 795:     spec: &LiveValidationSpec,
 796:     loaded: &HashMap<String, LoadedReportRecord>,
 797: ) -> Result<PromotionRow, String> {
 798:     let Some(record) = loaded.get(spec.mode) else {
 799:         return Ok(PromotionRow {
 800:             validation: spec.key.to_string(),
 801:             targets: spec.coverage_targets.join(", "),
 802:             eligible: false,
 803:             reason: "required live report missing".to_string(),
 804:             report_path: "[missing]".to_string(),
 805:         });
 806:     };
 807:     let payload_object = record
 808:         .payload
 809:         .as_object()
 810:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("report must be a JSON object: {}", record.path.display()))?;
 811:     let schema_errors = validate_report_payload(record.path.as_path(), payload_object);
 812:     if !schema_errors.is_empty() {
 813:         return Ok(PromotionRow {
 814:             validation: spec.key.to_string(),
 815:             targets: spec.coverage_targets.join(", "),
 816:             eligible: false,
 817:             reason: "report schema validation failed".to_string(),
 818:             report_path: record.path.display().to_string(),
 819:         });
 820:     }
 821:     if payload_object.get("status").and_then(Value::as_str) != Some(STATUS_PASS) {
 822:         return Ok(PromotionRow {
 823:             validation: spec.key.to_string(),
 824:             targets: spec.coverage_targets.join(", "),
 825:             eligible: false,
 826:             reason: "report status is not pass".to_string(),
 827:             report_path: record.path.display().to_string(),
 828:         });
 829:     }
 830:     let Some(checks) = payload_object.get("checks").and_then(Value::as_object) else {
 831:         return Ok(PromotionRow {
 832:             validation: spec.key.to_string(),
 833:             targets: spec.coverage_targets.join(", "),
 834:             eligible: false,
 835:             reason: "report checks object is missing or invalid".to_string(),
 836:             report_path: record.path.display().to_string(),
 837:         });
 838:     };
 839:     let failing = spec
 840:         .required_check_keys
 841:         .iter()
 842:         .filter(|name| checks.get(**name).and_then(Value::as_str) != Some(CHECK_PASS))
 843:         .copied()
 844:         .collect::<Vec<_>>();
 845:     if !failing.is_empty() {
 846:         return Ok(PromotionRow {
 847:             validation: spec.key.to_string(),
 848:             targets: spec.coverage_targets.join(", "),
 849:             eligible: false,
 850:             reason: format!("required checks did not all pass: {}", failing.join(", ")),
 851:             report_path: record.path.display().to_string(),
 852:         });
 853:     }
 854:     Ok(PromotionRow {
 855:         validation: spec.key.to_string(),
 856:         targets: spec.coverage_targets.join(", "),
 857:         eligible: true,
 858:         reason: "all required checks passed".to_string(),
 859:         report_path: record.path.display().to_string(),
 860:     })
 861: }

 863: fn render_promotion_markdown(rows: &[PromotionRow]) -> String {
 864:     let mut lines = vec![
 865:         "# Rustynet Live Coverage Promotion Gate".to_string(),
 866:         "".to_string(),
 867:         "| Validation | Comparative Targets | Eligible | Reason | Report |".to_string(),
 868:         "| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |".to_string(),

 870:     for row in rows {
 871:         lines.push(format!(
 872:             "| {} | {} | {} | {} | `{}` |",
 873:             row.validation, row.targets, row.eligible, row.reason, row.report_path
 874:         ));
 875:     }
 876:     lines.push(String::new());
 877:     lines.join("\n")
 878: }

 880: fn load_json_value(path: &Path) -> Result<Value, String> {
 881:     let body =
 882:         fs::read_to_string(path).map_err(|err| format!("read {} failed: {err}", path.display()))?;
 883:     serde_json::from_str(&body).map_err(|err| format!("parse {} failed: {err}", path.display()))
 884: }
 885: 
 886: fn load_json_object(path: &Path) -> Result<serde_json::Map<String, Value>, String> {
 887:     let value = load_json_value(path)?;
 888:     value
 889:         .as_object()
 890:         .cloned()
 891:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("report must be a JSON object: {}", path.display()))
 892: }

 894: fn ensure_parent_dir(path: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
 895:     let Some(parent) = path.parent() else {
 896:         return Ok(());
 897:     };
 898:     fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|err| format!("create {} failed: {err}", parent.display()))
 899: }
 900: 
 901: fn resolve_path(path: &Path) -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
 902:     if path.is_absolute() {
 903:         return Ok(path.to_path_buf());
 904:     }
 905:     let cwd = std::env::current_dir()
 906:         .map_err(|err| format!("resolve current directory failed: {err}"))?;
 907:     Ok(cwd.join(path))
 908: }
 909: 
 910: fn require_non_empty_string_field(
 911:     object: &serde_json::Map<String, Value>,
 912:     field: &str,
 913:     error: &str,
 914: ) -> Result<String, String> {
 915:     object
 916:         .get(field)
 917:         .and_then(Value::as_str)
 918:         .map(str::trim)
 919:         .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
 920:         .map(str::to_string)
 921:         .ok_or_else(|| error.to_string())
 922: }
 923: 
 924: fn split_csv_string(raw: &str) -> Vec<String> {
 925:     raw.split(',')
 926:         .map(str::trim)
 927:         .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
 928:         .map(str::to_string)
 929:         .collect()
 930: }
 931: 
 932: fn unix_now() -> u64 {
 933:     SystemTime::now()
 934:         .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
 935:         .unwrap_or_default()
 936:         .as_secs()
 937: }
 938: 
 939: fn utc_timestamp() -> String {
 940:     let output = Command::new("date")
 941:         .args(["-u", "+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"])
 942:         .stdout(Stdio::piped())
 943:         .stderr(Stdio::null())
 944:         .output();
 945:     match output {
 946:         Ok(output) if output.status.success() => String::from_utf8(output.stdout)
 947:             .unwrap_or_else(|_| "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z\n".to_string())
 948:             .trim()
 949:             .to_string(),
 950:         _ => format!("{}", unix_now()),
 951:     }
 952: }

 196: pub fn execute_ops_generate_live_lab_findings(
 197:     config: GenerateLiveLabFindingsConfig,
 198: ) -> Result<String, String> {
 199:     let report_paths =
 200:         collect_report_paths(config.reports.as_slice(), config.report_dir.as_deref())?;
 201:     let mut findings = Vec::new();
 202:     let mut passes = Vec::new();
 203:     let mut schema_problems = Vec::new();
 204:     for report_path in &report_paths {
 205:         let payload = load_json_object(report_path.as_path())?;
 206:         schema_problems.extend(validate_findings_report_schema(
 207:             report_path.as_path(),
 208:             &payload,
 209:         ));
 210:         let (report_findings, report_passes) = derive_findings(report_path.as_path(), &payload);
 211:         findings.extend(report_findings);
 212:         passes.extend(report_passes);
 213:     }
 214:     let output_path = resolve_path(config.output.as_path())?;
 215:     ensure_parent_dir(output_path.as_path())?;
 216:     fs::write(
 217:         output_path.as_path(),
 218:         render_findings_markdown(
 219:             findings.as_slice(),
 220:             passes.as_slice(),
 221:             schema_problems.as_slice(),
 222:             report_paths.as_slice(),
 223:         ),
 224:     )
 225:     .map_err(|err| format!("write {} failed: {err}", output_path.display()))?;
 226:     Ok(format!("wrote live-lab findings {}", output_path.display()))
 227: }

 229: pub fn execute_ops_generate_comparative_exploit_coverage(
 230:     config: GenerateComparativeExploitCoverageConfig,
 231: ) -> Result<String, String> {
 232:     let workspace = resolve_path(config.workspace.as_path())?;
 233:     let entries = select_comparative_entries(
 234:         parse_optional_filter(config.projects.as_str())?,
 235:         parse_optional_filter(config.attack_families.as_str())?,
 236:     )?;
 237:     let command_results = if config.run_local_tests {
 238:         Some(run_comparative_commands(
 239:             workspace.as_path(),
 240:             collect_comparative_command_keys(entries.as_slice()),
 241:             config.max_output_chars,
 242:         )?)
 243:     } else {
 244:         None
 245:     };
 246:     let output_path = resolve_path(config.output.as_path())?;
 247:     ensure_parent_dir(output_path.as_path())?;
 248:     let rendered = match config.format.as_str() {
 249:         "md" => render_comparative_markdown(entries.as_slice(), command_results.as_deref()),
 250:         "json" => render_comparative_json(entries.as_slice(), command_results.as_deref())?,
 251:         other => {
 252:             return Err(format!(
 253:                 "invalid --format value {other:?}; expected md or json"
 254:             ));
 255:         }
 256:     };
 257:     fs::write(output_path.as_path(), rendered)
 258:         .map_err(|err| format!("write {} failed: {err}", output_path.display()))?;
 259:     Ok(format!(
 260:         "wrote comparative exploit coverage {}",
 261:         output_path.display()
 262:     ))
 263: }

 265: pub fn execute_ops_run_live_lab_validations(
 266:     config: RunLiveLabValidationsConfig,
 267: ) -> Result<String, String> {
 268:     if config.skip_ssh_reachability_preflight && !config.dry_run {
 269:         return Err("--skip-ssh-reachability-preflight is only allowed with --dry-run".to_string());
 270:     }
 271:     let repo_root = resolve_path(config.repo_root.as_path())?;
 272:     let report_dir = if let Some(path) = config.report_dir.as_ref() {
 273:         resolve_path(path.as_path())?
 274:     } else {
 275:         repo_root
 276:             .join("artifacts")
 277:             .join("phase10")
 278:             .join("live_skill_runs")
 279:             .join(timestamp_for_path())
 280:     };
 281:     fs::create_dir_all(report_dir.as_path())
 282:         .map_err(|err| format!("create {} failed: {err}", report_dir.display()))?;
 283:     let findings_output = config
 284:         .findings_output
 285:         .as_ref()
 286:         .map(|path| resolve_path(path.as_path()))
 287:         .transpose()?
 288:         .unwrap_or_else(|| report_dir.join("live_lab_findings.md"));
 289:     let schema_output = config
 290:         .schema_output
 291:         .as_ref()
 292:         .map(|path| resolve_path(path.as_path()))
 293:         .transpose()?
 294:         .unwrap_or_else(|| report_dir.join("live_lab_schema_validation.md"));
 295:     let promotion_output = config
 296:         .promotion_output
 297:         .as_ref()
 298:         .map(|path| resolve_path(path.as_path()))
 299:         .transpose()?
 300:         .unwrap_or_else(|| report_dir.join("live_lab_coverage_promotion.md"));
 301:     let summary_output = config
 302:         .summary_output
 303:         .as_ref()
 304:         .map(|path| resolve_path(path.as_path()))
 305:         .transpose()?
 306:         .unwrap_or_else(|| report_dir.join("live_lab_validation_summary.md"));
 307: 
 308:     let specs = selected_validation_specs(config.validations.as_str())?;
 309:     require_validation_args(specs.as_slice(), &config)?;
 310:     let known_hosts_path = run_preflight(&config)?;
 311: 
 312:     let mut results = Vec::new();
 313:     let mut report_paths = Vec::new();
 314:     for spec in &specs {
 315:         let (command, report_path) =
 316:             build_validation_command(spec, &config, repo_root.as_path(), report_dir.as_path())?;
 317:         let result = if config.dry_run {
 318:             ValidationRunResult {
 319:                 validation_key: spec.key.to_string(),
 320:                 command,
 321:                 rc: 0,
 322:                 stderr: String::new(),
 323:                 report_path,
 324:             }
 325:         } else {
 326:             run_validation(
 327:                 spec.key,
 328:                 command,
 329:                 report_path,
 330:                 repo_root.as_path(),
 331:                 known_hosts_path.as_path(),
 332:             )?
 333:         };
 334:         if result.report_path.exists() {
 335:             report_paths.push(result.report_path.clone());
 336:         }
 337:         results.push(result);
 338:     }
 339: 
 340:     if config.dry_run {
 341:         write_placeholder_file(
 342:             findings_output.as_path(),
 343:             "# Dry Run\n\nNo findings were generated because the runner was executed with `--dry-run`.\n",
 344:         )?;
 345:         write_placeholder_file(
 346:             schema_output.as_path(),
 347:             "# Dry Run\n\nNo schema validation was performed because the runner was executed with `--dry-run`.\n",
 348:         )?;
 349:         write_placeholder_file(
 350:             promotion_output.as_path(),
 351:             "# Dry Run\n\nNo coverage promotion evaluation was performed because the runner was executed with `--dry-run`.\n",
 352:         )?;
 353:         write_summary(
 354:             summary_output.as_path(),
 355:             render_live_validation_summary(
 356:                 results.as_slice(),
 357:                 known_hosts_path.as_path(),
 358:                 0,
 359:                 0,
 360:                 0,
 361:                 findings_output.as_path(),
 362:                 schema_output.as_path(),
 363:                 promotion_output.as_path(),
 364:             ),
 365:         )?;
 366:         return Ok(format!(
 367:             "completed live-lab validation dry run under {}",
 368:             report_dir.display()
 369:         ));
 370:     }
 371: 
 372:     if report_paths.is_empty() {
 373:         write_summary(
 374:             summary_output.as_path(),
 375:             render_live_validation_summary(
 376:                 results.as_slice(),
 377:                 known_hosts_path.as_path(),
 378:                 1,
 379:                 1,
 380:                 1,
 381:                 findings_output.as_path(),
 382:                 schema_output.as_path(),
 383:                 promotion_output.as_path(),
 384:             ),
 385:         )?;
 386:         return Err(format!(
 387:             "live-lab validations produced no reports under {}",
 388:             report_dir.display()
 389:         ));
 390:     }
 391: 
 392:     let schema_rc = match execute_ops_validate_live_lab_reports(ValidateLiveLabReportsConfig {
 393:         reports: report_paths.clone(),
 394:         report_dir: None,
 395:         output: Some(schema_output.clone()),
 396:     }) {
 397:         Ok(_) => 0,
 398:         Err(_) => 1,
 399:     };
 400:     let findings_rc = match execute_ops_generate_live_lab_findings(GenerateLiveLabFindingsConfig {
 401:         reports: report_paths.clone(),
 402:         report_dir: None,
 403:         output: findings_output.clone(),
 404:     }) {
 405:         Ok(_) => 0,
 406:         Err(_) => 1,
 407:     };
 408:     let promotion_rc =
 409:         match execute_ops_evaluate_live_coverage_promotion(EvaluateLiveCoveragePromotionConfig {
 410:             reports: report_paths.clone(),
 411:             report_dir: None,
 412:             targets: specs
 413:                 .iter()
 414:                 .map(|spec| spec.key)
 415:                 .collect::<Vec<_>>()
 416:                 .join(","),
 417:             output: promotion_output.clone(),
 418:         }) {
 419:             Ok(_) => 0,
 420:             Err(_) => 1,
 421:         };
 422:     write_summary(
 423:         summary_output.as_path(),
 424:         render_live_validation_summary(
 425:             results.as_slice(),
 426:             known_hosts_path.as_path(),
 427:             schema_rc,
 428:             findings_rc,
 429:             promotion_rc,
 430:             findings_output.as_path(),
 431:             schema_output.as_path(),
 432:             promotion_output.as_path(),
 433:         ),
 434:     )?;
 435:     if results.iter().any(|result| result.rc != 0)
 436:         || schema_rc != 0
 437:         || findings_rc != 0
 438:         || promotion_rc != 0
 439:     {
 440:         return Err(format!(
 441:             "live-lab validations blocked; see {}",
 442:             summary_output.display()
 443:         ));
 444:     }
 445:     Ok(format!(
 446:         "completed live-lab validations under {}",
 447:         report_dir.display()
 448:     ))
 449: }
 450: 
 451: fn selected_validation_specs(
 452:     raw: &str,
 453: ) -> Result<Vec<&'static crate::security_audit_catalog::ValidationSpec>, String> {
 454:     if raw.trim().eq_ignore_ascii_case("all") {
 455:         return Ok(sorted_validation_specs());
 456:     }
 457:     let keys = split_csv(raw);
 458:     if keys.is_empty() {
 459:         return Err("no validation keys supplied".to_string());
 460:     }
 461:     let mut specs = Vec::new();
 462:     let mut unknown = Vec::new();
 463:     for key in keys {
 464:         if let Some(spec) = validation_spec_by_key(key.as_str()) {
 465:             specs.push(spec);
 466:         } else {
 467:             unknown.push(key);
 468:         }
 469:     }
 470:     if !unknown.is_empty() {
 471:         return Err(format!("unknown validation keys: {}", unknown.join(", ")));
 472:     }
 473:     Ok(specs)
 474: }
 475: 
 476: fn require_validation_args(
 477:     specs: &[&crate::security_audit_catalog::ValidationSpec],
 478:     config: &RunLiveLabValidationsConfig,
 479: ) -> Result<(), String> {
 480:     let mut missing = Vec::new();
 481:     for spec in specs {
 482:         for arg in spec.required_args {
 483:             if validation_arg_value(config, arg).is_none() {
 484:                 missing.push(format!("{}:{arg}", spec.key));
 485:             }
 486:         }
 487:     }
 488:     if missing.is_empty() {
 489:         Ok(())
 490:     } else {
 491:         Err(format!(
 492:             "missing required arguments for live validation run: {}",
 493:             missing.join(", ")
 494:         ))
 495:     }
 496: }
 497: 
 498: fn validation_arg_value<'a>(
 499:     config: &'a RunLiveLabValidationsConfig,
 500:     arg_name: &str,
 501: ) -> Option<&'a str> {
 502:     match arg_name {
 503:         "exit_host" => config.exit_host.as_deref(),
 504:         "client_host" => config.client_host.as_deref(),
 505:         "entry_host" => config.entry_host.as_deref(),
 506:         "aux_host" => config.aux_host.as_deref(),
 507:         "extra_host" => config.extra_host.as_deref(),
 508:         "probe_host" => config.probe_host.as_deref(),
 509:         "dns_bind_addr" => config.dns_bind_addr.as_deref(),
 510:         "ssh_allow_cidrs" => config.ssh_allow_cidrs.as_deref(),
 511:         "probe_port" => config.probe_port.as_deref(),
 512:         "rogue_endpoint_ip" => config.rogue_endpoint_ip.as_deref(),
 513:         "socket_path" => config.socket_path.as_deref(),
 514:         "assignment_path" => config.assignment_path.as_deref(),
 515:         _ => None,
 516:     }
 517: }
 518: 
 519: fn resolve_known_hosts_path(raw: Option<&Path>) -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
 520:     if let Some(path) = raw {
 521:         return resolve_path(path);
 522:     }
 523:     let default =
 524:         PathBuf::from(env::var("HOME").map_err(|err| format!("resolve HOME failed: {err}"))?)
 525:             .join(".ssh")
 526:             .join("known_hosts");
 527:     if default.is_file() {
 528:         return resolve_path(default.as_path());
 529:     }
 530:     Err("a pinned SSH known_hosts file is required; pass --ssh-known-hosts-file".to_string())
 531: }
 532: 
 533: fn run_preflight(config: &RunLiveLabValidationsConfig) -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
 534:     for command in ["ssh", "expect", "ssh-keygen"] {
 535:         require_command_available(command)?;
 536:     }
 537:     let known_hosts_path = resolve_known_hosts_path(config.ssh_known_hosts_file.as_deref())?;
 538:     require_known_hosts_file(known_hosts_path.as_path())?;
 539:     let targets = selected_targets(config);
 540:     preflight_pinned_host_entries(targets.as_slice(), known_hosts_path.as_path())?;
 541:     if config.skip_ssh_reachability_preflight {
 542:         return Ok(known_hosts_path);
 543:     }
 544:     for target in &targets {
 545:         ssh_reachability_check(
 546:             target.as_str(),
 547:             config.ssh_password_file.as_path(),
 548:             known_hosts_path.as_path(),
 549:             config.connect_timeout_secs,
 550:         )?;
 551:     }
 552:     for target in &targets {
 553:         remote_runtime_requirements_check(
 554:             target.as_str(),
 555:             config.ssh_password_file.as_path(),
 556:             known_hosts_path.as_path(),
 557:             config.connect_timeout_secs,
 558:         )?;
 559:     }
 560:     Ok(known_hosts_path)
 561: }
 562: 
 563: fn require_command_available(command: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
 564:     if command_exists(command) {
 565:         Ok(())
 566:     } else {
 567:         Err(format!(
 568:             "missing required command for live-lab preflight: {command}"
 569:         ))
 570:     }
 571: }
 572: 
 573: fn command_exists(command: &str) -> bool {
 574:     let Some(path) = env::var_os("PATH") else {
 575:         return false;
 576:     };
 577:     env::split_paths(&path).any(|dir| {
 578:         let candidate = dir.join(command);
 579:         candidate.is_file()
 580:     })
 581: }
 582: 
 583: fn require_known_hosts_file(path: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
 584:     let metadata = fs::symlink_metadata(path).map_err(|err| {
 585:         format!(
 586:             "missing pinned SSH known_hosts file: {} ({err})",
 587:             path.display()
 588:         )
 589:     })?;
 590:     if metadata.file_type().is_symlink() {
 591:         return Err(format!(
 592:             "pinned SSH known_hosts file must not be a symlink: {}",
 593:             path.display()
 594:         ));
 595:     }
 596:     if !metadata.is_file() {
 597:         return Err(format!(
 598:             "missing pinned SSH known_hosts file: {}",
 599:             path.display()
 600:         ));
 601:     }
 602:     #[cfg(unix)]
 603:     {
 604:         use std::os::unix::fs::PermissionsExt;
 605:         let mode = metadata.permissions().mode() & 0o777;
 606:         if mode & 0o022 != 0 {
 607:             return Err(format!(
 608:                 "pinned SSH known_hosts file must not be group/world writable: {} ({mode:03o})",
 609:                 path.display()
 610:             ));
 611:         }
 612:     }
 613:     Ok(())
 614: }
 615: 
 616: fn selected_targets(config: &RunLiveLabValidationsConfig) -> Vec<String> {
 617:     let ordered = [
 618:         config.exit_host.as_deref(),
 619:         config.client_host.as_deref(),
 620:         config.entry_host.as_deref(),
 621:         config.aux_host.as_deref(),
 622:         config.extra_host.as_deref(),
 623:         config.probe_host.as_deref(),
 624:     ];
 625:     let mut deduped = Vec::new();
 626:     let mut seen = HashSet::new();
 627:     for target in ordered.into_iter().flatten() {
 628:         if seen.insert(target.to_string()) {
 629:             deduped.push(target.to_string());
 630:         }
 631:     }
 632:     deduped
 633: }
 634: 
 635: fn preflight_pinned_host_entries(
 636:     targets: &[String],
 637:     known_hosts_path: &Path,
 638: ) -> Result<(), String> {
 639:     let mut missing = Vec::new();
 640:     for target in targets {
 641:         let host = target_host(target.as_str());
 642:         let output = Command::new("ssh-keygen")
 643:             .arg("-F")
 644:             .arg(host.as_str())
 645:             .arg("-f")
 646:             .arg(known_hosts_path)
 647:             .output()
 648:             .map_err(|err| format!("ssh-keygen -F {host} failed: {err}"))?;
 649:         if !output.status.success() {
 650:             missing.push(host);
 651:         }
 652:     }
 653:     if missing.is_empty() {
 654:         Ok(())
 655:     } else {
 656:         missing.sort();
 657:         missing.dedup();
 658:         Err(format!(
 659:             "pinned known_hosts file lacks host keys for: {} ({})",
 660:             missing.join(", "),
 661:             known_hosts_path.display()
 662:         ))
 663:     }
 664: }
 665: 
 666: fn target_host(target: &str) -> String {
 667:     target
 668:         .split_once('@')
 669:         .map(|(_, host)| host)
 670:         .unwrap_or(target)
 671:         .to_string()
 672: }
 673: 
 674: fn ssh_reachability_check(
 675:     target: &str,
 676:     password_file: &Path,
 677:     known_hosts_path: &Path,
 678:     connect_timeout_secs: u64,
 679: ) -> Result<(), String> {
 680:     let output = run_expect_script(
 681:         SSH_PREFLIGHT_EXPECT_SCRIPT,
 682:         &[
 683:             password_file.to_string_lossy().to_string(),
 684:             known_hosts_path.to_string_lossy().to_string(),
 685:             target.to_string(),
 686:             connect_timeout_secs.to_string(),
 687:         ],
 688:     )?;
 689:     if output.status.success() {
 690:         Ok(())
 691:     } else {
 692:         let detail = non_empty_output(output.stderr, output.stdout)
 693:             .unwrap_or_else(|| format!("SSH preflight failed for {target}"));
 694:         Err(format!("SSH preflight failed for {target}: {detail}"))
 695:     }
 696: }
 697: 
 698: fn remote_runtime_requirements_check(
 699:     target: &str,
 700:     password_file: &Path,
 701:     known_hosts_path: &Path,
 702:     connect_timeout_secs: u64,
 703: ) -> Result<(), String> {
 704:     let output = run_expect_script(
 705:         SSH_CAPTURE_EXPECT_SCRIPT,
 706:         &[
 707:             password_file.to_string_lossy().to_string(),
 708:             known_hosts_path.to_string_lossy().to_string(),
 709:             target.to_string(),
 710:             connect_timeout_secs.to_string(),
 711:             REMOTE_RUNTIME_REQUIREMENTS_COMMAND.to_string(),
 712:         ],
 713:     )?;
 714:     if output.status.success() {
 715:         Ok(())
 716:     } else {
 717:         let detail = non_empty_output(output.stdout, output.stderr)
 718:             .unwrap_or_else(|| "missing remote prerequisite".to_string());
 719:         Err(format!(
 720:             "remote prerequisite preflight failed for {target}: {detail}"
 721:         ))
 722:     }
 723: }
 724: 
 725: fn run_expect_script(script: &str, args: &[String]) -> Result<std::process::Output, String> {
 726:     Command::new("expect")
 727:         .arg("-c")
 728:         .arg(script)
 729:         .args(args)
 730:         .output()
 731:         .map_err(|err| format!("expect invocation failed: {err}"))
 732: }
 733: 
 734: fn build_validation_command(
 735:     spec: &crate::security_audit_catalog::ValidationSpec,
 736:     config: &RunLiveLabValidationsConfig,
 737:     repo_root: &Path,
 738:     report_dir: &Path,
 739: ) -> Result<(Vec<String>, PathBuf), String> {
 740:     let script_path = repo_root.join(spec.script_path);
 741:     if !script_path.is_file() {
 742:         return Err(format!(
 743:             "validation script missing: {}",
 744:             script_path.display()
 745:         ));
 746:     }
 747:     let report_path = report_dir.join(spec.default_report_name);
 748:     let log_path = report_dir.join(spec.default_report_name.replace(".json", ".log"));
 749:     let mut command = vec![
 750:         script_path.display().to_string(),
 751:         "--ssh-password-file".to_string(),
 752:         resolve_path(config.ssh_password_file.as_path())?
 753:             .display()
 754:             .to_string(),
 755:         "--sudo-password-file".to_string(),
 756:         resolve_path(config.sudo_password_file.as_path())?
 757:             .display()
 758:             .to_string(),
 759:         "--report-path".to_string(),
 760:         report_path.display().to_string(),
 761:         "--log-path".to_string(),
 762:         log_path.display().to_string(),
 763:     ];
 764:     for arg_name in spec.supported_args {
 765:         if let Some(value) = validation_arg_value(config, arg_name)
 766:             && let Some(flag) = validation_arg_flag(arg_name)
 767:         {
 768:             command.push(flag.to_string());
 769:             command.push(value.to_string());
 770:         }
 771:     }
 772:     Ok((command, report_path))
 773: }
 774: 
 775: fn run_validation(
 776:     validation_key: &str,
 777:     command: Vec<String>,
 778:     report_path: PathBuf,
 779:     cwd: &Path,
 780:     known_hosts_path: &Path,
 781: ) -> Result<ValidationRunResult, String> {
 782:     let mut child_env = env::vars_os().collect::<HashMap<_, _>>();
 783:     child_env.insert(
 784:         "LIVE_LAB_PINNED_KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE".into(),
 785:         known_hosts_path.as_os_str().to_os_string(),
 786:     );
 787:     let output = Command::new(
 788:         command
 789:             .first()
 790:             .ok_or_else(|| "empty validation command".to_string())?,
 791:     )
 792:     .args(&command[1..])
 793:     .current_dir(cwd)
 794:     .envs(child_env)
 795:     .output()
 796:     .map_err(|err| format!("run validation {validation_key} failed: {err}"))?;
 797:     Ok(ValidationRunResult {
 798:         validation_key: validation_key.to_string(),
 799:         command,
 800:         rc: output.status.code().unwrap_or(1),
 801:         stderr: String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).trim().to_string(),
 802:         report_path,
 803:     })
 804: }
 805: 
 806: #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
 807: fn render_live_validation_summary(
 808:     results: &[ValidationRunResult],
 809:     known_hosts_path: &Path,
 810:     schema_rc: i32,
 811:     findings_rc: i32,
 812:     promotion_rc: i32,
 813:     findings_output: &Path,
 814:     schema_output: &Path,
 815:     promotion_output: &Path,
 816: ) -> String {
 817:     let mut lines = vec![
 818:         "# Rustynet Live-Lab Validation Run".to_string(),
 819:         "".to_string(),
 820:         "## Validator Commands".to_string(),
 821:         "".to_string(),
 822:         "| Validation | Exit Code | Report Path |".to_string(),
 823:         "| --- | --- | --- |".to_string(),
 824:     ];
 825:     for result in results {
 826:         lines.push(format!(
 827:             "| {} | {} | `{}` |",
 828:             result.validation_key,
 829:             result.rc,
 830:             result.report_path.display()
 831:         ));
 832:     }
 833:     lines.extend([
 834:         "".to_string(),
 835:         "## Consolidated Outputs".to_string(),
 836:         "".to_string(),
 837:         format!(
 838:             "- Pinned SSH known_hosts file: `{}`",
 839:             known_hosts_path.display()
 840:         ),
 841:         format!("- Findings report: `{}`", findings_output.display()),
 842:         format!("- Findings generation exit code: `{findings_rc}`"),
 843:         format!("- Schema validation report: `{}`", schema_output.display()),
 844:         format!("- Schema validation exit code: `{schema_rc}`"),
 845:         format!(
 846:             "- Coverage promotion report: `{}`",
 847:             promotion_output.display()
 848:         ),
 849:         format!("- Coverage promotion exit code: `{promotion_rc}`"),
 850:         "".to_string(),
 851:     ]);
 852:     for result in results {
 853:         lines.extend([
 854:             format!("### {}", result.validation_key),
 855:             "".to_string(),
 856:             format!("- Command: `{}`", result.command.join(" ")),
 857:             format!("- Exit code: `{}`", result.rc),
 858:             "- stderr:".to_string(),
 859:             "```text".to_string(),
 860:             if result.stderr.is_empty() {
 861:                 "[no stderr]".to_string()
 862:             } else {
 863:                 result.stderr.clone()
 864:             },
 865:             "```".to_string(),
 866:             "".to_string(),
 867:         ]);
 868:     }
 869:     lines.join("\n")
 870: }

 875: }

 877: fn write_summary(path: &Path, body: String) -> Result<(), String> {
 878:     ensure_parent_dir(path)?;
 879:     fs::write(path, body).map_err(|err| format!("write {} failed: {err}", path.display()))
 880: }
 881: 
 882: fn collect_report_paths(
 883:     reports: &[PathBuf],
 884:     report_dir: Option<&Path>,
 885: ) -> Result<Vec<PathBuf>, String> {
 886:     let mut paths = Vec::new();
 887:     for path in reports {
 888:         paths.push(resolve_path(path.as_path())?);
 889:     }
 890:     if let Some(report_dir) = report_dir {
 891:         collect_json_files(resolve_path(report_dir)?.as_path(), &mut paths)?;
 892:     }
 893:     let mut deduped = Vec::new();
 894:     let mut seen = HashSet::new();
 895:     for path in paths {
 896:         if seen.insert(path.clone()) {
 897:             deduped.push(path);
 898:         }
 899:     }
 900:     if deduped.is_empty() {
 901:         return Err("no report files supplied".to_string());
 902:     }
 903:     Ok(deduped)
 904: }
 905: 
 906: fn collect_json_files(dir: &Path, out: &mut Vec<PathBuf>) -> Result<(), String> {
 907:     let metadata =
 908:         fs::metadata(dir).map_err(|err| format!("read {} failed: {err}", dir.display()))?;
 909:     if !metadata.is_dir() {
 910:         return Err(format!("{} is not a directory", dir.display()));
 911:     }
 912:     let mut entries = fs::read_dir(dir)
 913:         .map_err(|err| format!("read {} failed: {err}", dir.display()))?
 914:         .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()
 915:         .map_err(|err| format!("read {} failed: {err}", dir.display()))?;
 916:     entries.sort_by_key(|entry| entry.path());
 917:     for entry in entries {
 918:         let path = entry.path();
 919:         let file_type = entry
 920:             .file_type()
 921:             .map_err(|err| format!("inspect {} failed: {err}", path.display()))?;
 922:         if file_type.is_dir() {
 923:             collect_json_files(path.as_path(), out)?;
 924:         } else if file_type.is_file()
 925:             && path.extension().and_then(|value| value.to_str()) == Some("json")
 926:         {
 927:             out.push(path);
 928:         }
 929:     }
 930:     Ok(())
 931: }
 932: 
 933: fn derive_findings(
 934:     report_path: &Path,
 935:     payload: &serde_json::Map<String, Value>,
 936: ) -> (Vec<Finding>, Vec<PassingCheck>) {
 937:     let mut findings = Vec::new();
 938:     let mut passes = Vec::new();
 939:     let mode = payload.get("mode").and_then(Value::as_str);
 940:     let status = payload
 941:         .get("status")
 942:         .and_then(Value::as_str)
 943:         .unwrap_or_default();
 944:     let checks = payload.get("checks").and_then(Value::as_object);
 945:     let Some(spec) = mode.and_then(validation_spec_by_mode) else {
 946:         if status != STATUS_PASS {
 947:             findings.push(Finding {
 948:                 severity: "high".to_string(),
 949:                 title: format!("Unknown report mode failed: {}", mode.unwrap_or("[missing]")),
 950:                 exploit_family: "unknown".to_string(),
 951:                 mode_title: mode.unwrap_or("[missing]").to_string(),
 952:                 report_path: report_path.display().to_string(),
 953:                 check_name: "[mode]".to_string(),
 954:                 rationale: "The live-lab report failed, but the skill does not yet know how to map this mode into enforcement points.".to_string(),
 955:                 affected_files: Vec::new(),
 956:                 evidence_summary: summarize_evidence(payload, 600),
 957:             });
 958:         }
 959:         return (findings, passes);
 960:     };
 961: 
 962:     let Some(checks) = checks else {
 963:         findings.push(Finding {
 964:             severity: "high".to_string(),
 965:             title: format!("{} report schema invalid", spec.title),
 966:             exploit_family: spec.exploit_family.to_string(),
 967:             mode_title: spec.title.to_string(),
 968:             report_path: report_path.display().to_string(),
 969:             check_name: "[schema]".to_string(),
 970:             rationale: "The report did not contain a usable checks object, so the live result cannot be trusted.".to_string(),
 971:             affected_files: spec
 972:                 .affected_files
 973:                 .iter()
 974:                 .map(|path| (*path).to_string())
 975:                 .collect(),
 976:             evidence_summary: summarize_evidence(payload, 600),
 977:         });
 978:         return (findings, passes);
 979:     };
 980: 
 981:     for (check_name, value) in checks {
 982:         match value.as_str() {
 983:             Some(CHECK_PASS) => {
 984:                 passes.push(PassingCheck {
 985:                     mode_title: spec.title.to_string(),
 986:                     check_name: check_name.clone(),
 987:                     report_path: report_path.display().to_string(),
 988:                 });
 989:             }
 990:             Some(CHECK_SKIP | CHECK_SKIPPED) => {
 991:                 findings.push(make_finding(
 992:                     "medium",
 993:                     format!("{} check skipped: {check_name}", spec.title),
 994:                     "A skipped adversarial check leaves the corresponding exploit class unvalidated on the live lab.".to_string(),
 995:                     spec,
 996:                     report_path,
 997:                     payload,
 998:                     check_name,
 999:                 ));
1000:             }
1001:             _ => {
1002:                 let metadata = validation_check_metadata(spec, check_name)
1003:                     .copied()
1004:                     .unwrap_or(CheckMetadata {
1005:                         severity: "high",
1006:                         title: "",
1007:                         rationale: "",
1008:                     });
1009:                 let title = if metadata.title.is_empty() {
1010:                     format!("{}: {check_name}", spec.unknown_failure_title)
1011:                 } else {
1012:                     metadata.title.to_string()
1013:                 };
1014:                 let rationale = if metadata.rationale.is_empty() {
1015:                     "A live-lab check failed and needs manual review because the skill does not yet have a more specific mapping for it.".to_string()
1016:                 } else {
1017:                     metadata.rationale.to_string()
1018:                 };
1019:                 let severity = if metadata.severity.is_empty() {
1020:                     "high"
1021:                 } else {
1022:                     metadata.severity
1023:                 };
1024:                 findings.push(make_finding(
1025:                     severity,
1026:                     title,
1027:                     rationale,
1028:                     spec,
1029:                     report_path,
1030:                     payload,
1031:                     check_name,
1032:                 ));
1033:             }
1034:         }
1035:     }
1036: 
1037:     if status != STATUS_PASS && findings.is_empty() {
1038:         findings.push(make_finding(
1039:             "high",
1040:             spec.unknown_failure_title.to_string(),
1041:             "The report status failed even though no individual failed checks were extracted."
1042:                 .to_string(),
1043:             spec,
1044:             report_path,
1045:             payload,
1046:             "[status]",
1047:         ));
1048:     }
1049:     (findings, passes)
1050: }
1051: 
1052: fn make_finding(
1053:     severity: &str,
1054:     title: String,
1055:     rationale: String,
1056:     spec: &crate::security_audit_catalog::ValidationSpec,
1057:     report_path: &Path,
1058:     payload: &serde_json::Map<String, Value>,
1059:     check_name: &str,
1060: ) -> Finding {
1061:     Finding {
1062:         severity: severity.to_string(),
1063:         title,
1064:         exploit_family: spec.exploit_family.to_string(),
1065:         mode_title: spec.title.to_string(),
1066:         report_path: report_path.display().to_string(),
1067:         check_name: check_name.to_string(),
1068:         rationale,
1069:         affected_files: spec
1070:             .affected_files
1071:             .iter()
1072:             .map(|path| (*path).to_string())
1073:             .collect(),
1074:         evidence_summary: summarize_evidence(payload, 600),
1075:     }
1076: }
1077: 
1078: fn validate_findings_report_schema(
1079:     path: &Path,
1080:     payload: &serde_json::Map<String, Value>,
1081: ) -> Vec<String> {
1082:     let mut problems = Vec::new();
1083:     for key in ["mode", "status", "checks", "evidence_mode"] {
1084:         if !payload.contains_key(key) {
1085:             problems.push(format!(
1086:                 "{}: missing required field '{}'",
1087:                 path.display(),
1088:                 key
1089:             ));
1090:         }
1091:     }
1092:     if payload.get("mode").is_some() && payload.get("mode").and_then(Value::as_str).is_none() {
1093:         problems.push(format!("{}: field 'mode' must be a string", path.display()));
1094:     }
1095:     if payload.get("status").is_some() && payload.get("status").and_then(Value::as_str).is_none() {
1096:         problems.push(format!(
1097:             "{}: field 'status' must be a string",
1098:             path.display()
1099:         ));
1100:     }
1101:     if payload.get("checks").is_some() && payload.get("checks").and_then(Value::as_object).is_none()
1102:     {
1103:         problems.push(format!(
1104:             "{}: field 'checks' must be an object",
1105:             path.display()
1106:         ));
1107:     }
1108:     if payload.get("evidence_mode").and_then(Value::as_str) != Some(EVIDENCE_MODE_MEASURED) {
1109:         problems.push(format!(
1110:             "{}: field 'evidence_mode' must be '{}'",
1111:             path.display(),
1112:             EVIDENCE_MODE_MEASURED
1113:         ));
1114:     }
1115:     problems
1116: }

1118: fn render_findings_markdown(
1119:     findings: &[Finding],
1120:     passes: &[PassingCheck],
1121:     schema_problems: &[String],
1122:     analyzed_reports: &[PathBuf],
1123: ) -> String {
1124:     let mut ordered_findings = findings.to_vec();
1125:     ordered_findings.sort_by_key(|finding| {
1126:         (
1127:             severity_order(finding.severity.as_str()),
1128:             finding.mode_title.clone(),
1129:             finding.title.clone(),
1130:         )
1131:     });
1132:     let mut lines = vec![
1133:         "# Rustynet Live-Lab Security Findings".to_string(),
1134:         "".to_string(),
1135:         format!("Generated: {}", utc_timestamp()),
1136:         "".to_string(),
1137:         "## Summary".to_string(),
1138:         "".to_string(),
1139:         format!("- Reports analyzed: {}", analyzed_reports.len()),
1140:         format!("- Findings: {}", ordered_findings.len()),
1141:         format!("- Passing checks recorded: {}", passes.len()),
1142:         format!("- Schema problems: {}", schema_problems.len()),
1143:         "".to_string(),
1144:         "## Reports".to_string(),
1145:         "".to_string(),
1146:     ];
1147:     for report in analyzed_reports {
1148:         lines.push(format!("- `{}`", report.display()));
1149:     }
1150:     lines.push(String::new());
1151:     if ordered_findings.is_empty() {
1152:         lines.extend([
1153:             "## Findings".to_string(),
1154:             "".to_string(),
1155:             "No failing or skipped checks were found in the supplied reports.".to_string(),
1156:             "".to_string(),
1157:         ]);
1158:     } else {
1159:         lines.extend(["## Findings".to_string(), "".to_string()]);
1160:         for finding in &ordered_findings {
1161:             lines.extend([
1162:                 format!(
1163:                     "### [{}] {}",
1164:                     finding.severity.to_uppercase(),
1165:                     finding.title
1166:                 ),
1167:                 "".to_string(),
1168:                 format!("- Exploit family: `{}`", finding.exploit_family),
1169:                 format!("- Validation mode: {}", finding.mode_title),
1170:                 format!("- Report: `{}`", finding.report_path),
1171:                 format!("- Failing check: `{}`", finding.check_name),
1172:                 format!("- Why it matters: {}", finding.rationale),
1173:                 format!(
1174:                     "- Likely affected files: {}",
1175:                     if finding.affected_files.is_empty() {
1176:                         "[unknown]".to_string()
1177:                     } else {
1178:                         finding
1179:                             .affected_files
1180:                             .iter()
1181:                             .map(|path| format!("`{path}`"))
1182:                             .collect::<Vec<_>>()
1183:                             .join(", ")
1184:                     }
1185:                 ),
1186:                 format!("- Evidence summary: {}", finding.evidence_summary),
1187:                 "".to_string(),
1188:             ]);
1189:         }
1190:     }
1191:     if !schema_problems.is_empty() {
1192:         lines.extend(["## Schema Problems".to_string(), "".to_string()]);
1193:         for problem in schema_problems {
1194:             lines.push(format!("- {problem}"));
1195:         }
1196:         lines.push(String::new());
1197:     }
1198:     lines.extend(["## Passing Checks".to_string(), "".to_string()]);
1199:     if passes.is_empty() {
1200:         lines.push("No passing checks were recorded.".to_string());
1201:     } else {
1202:         let mut ordered_passes = passes.to_vec();
1203:         ordered_passes.sort_by_key(|passed| (passed.mode_title.clone(), passed.check_name.clone()));
1204:         for passed in ordered_passes {
1205:             lines.push(format!(
1206:                 "- {}: `{}` in `{}`",
1207:                 passed.mode_title, passed.check_name, passed.report_path
1208:             ));
1209:         }
1210:     }
1211:     lines.extend([
1212:         "".to_string(),
1213:         "## Next Actions".to_string(),
1214:         "".to_string(),
1215:         "1. Fix every `critical` finding before treating the corresponding exploit class as covered.".to_string(),
1216:         "2. Re-run the specific live validation report after each fix; do not rely on adjacent unit tests alone.".to_string(),
1217:         "3. If a report had schema problems, repair the reporting path before trusting any pass/fail outcome from that validator.".to_string(),
1218:         "".to_string(),
1219:     ]);
1220:     lines.join("\n")
1221: }

1223: fn severity_order(severity: &str) -> usize {
1224:     match severity {
1225:         "critical" => 0,
1226:         "high" => 1,
1227:         "medium" => 2,
1228:         "low" => 3,
1229:         _ => usize::MAX,
1230:     }
1231: }
1232: 
1233: fn summarize_evidence(payload: &serde_json::Map<String, Value>, limit: usize) -> String {
1234:     let Some(evidence) = payload.get("evidence").and_then(Value::as_object) else {
1235:         return "[no structured evidence present]".to_string();
1236:     };
1237:     if evidence.is_empty() {
1238:         return "[no structured evidence present]".to_string();
1239:     }
1240:     let mut keys = evidence.keys().cloned().collect::<Vec<_>>();
1241:     keys.sort();
1242:     let mut parts = Vec::new();
1243:     for key in keys {
1244:         let mut rendered = stringify_json_value(evidence.get(key.as_str()).unwrap_or(&Value::Null));
1245:         if rendered.len() > 160 {
1246:             rendered.truncate(160);
1247:             rendered.push_str("...");
1248:         }
1249:         parts.push(format!("{key}={rendered}"));
1250:     }
1251:     let mut summary = parts.join("; ");
1252:     if summary.len() > limit {
1253:         summary.truncate(limit);
1254:         summary.push_str("...");
1255:     }
1256:     summary
1257: }
1258: 
1259: fn stringify_json_value(value: &Value) -> String {
1260:     match value {
1261:         Value::String(text) => text.trim().to_string(),
1262:         other => {
1263:             serde_json::to_string(other).unwrap_or_else(|_| "\"[unserializable]\"".to_string())
1264:         }
1265:     }
1266: }
1267: 
1268: fn parse_optional_filter(raw: &str) -> Result<Option<HashSet<String>>, String> {
1269:     if raw.trim().eq_ignore_ascii_case("all") {
1270:         return Ok(None);
1271:     }
1272:     let values = split_csv(raw)
1273:         .into_iter()
1274:         .map(|item| item.to_lowercase())
1275:         .collect::<HashSet<_>>();
1276:     if values.is_empty() {
1277:         return Err("empty filter supplied".to_string());
1278:     }
1279:     Ok(Some(values))
1280: }

1282: fn select_comparative_entries(
1283:     projects: Option<HashSet<String>>,
1284:     families: Option<HashSet<String>>,
1285: ) -> Result<Vec<&'static ComparativeCatalogEntry>, String> {
1286:     let mut entries = Vec::new();
1287:     for entry in COMPARATIVE_CATALOG {
1288:         if let Some(projects) = &projects
1289:             && !projects.contains(&entry.project.to_lowercase())
1290:         {
1291:             continue;
1292:         }
1293:         if let Some(families) = &families
1294:             && !families.contains(&entry.attack_family.to_lowercase())
1295:         {
1296:             continue;
1297:         }
1298:         entries.push(entry);
1299:     }
1300:     if entries.is_empty() {
1301:         Err("no entries matched the selected filters".to_string())
1302:     } else {
1303:         Ok(entries)
1304:     }
1305: }

1307: fn collect_comparative_command_keys(entries: &[&ComparativeCatalogEntry]) -> Vec<&'static str> {
1308:     let mut ordered = Vec::new();
1309:     let mut seen = HashSet::new();
1310:     for entry in entries {
1311:         for key in entry.command_keys {
1312:             if seen.insert(*key) {
1313:                 ordered.push(*key);
1314:             }
1315:         }
1316:     }
1317:     ordered
1318: }

1320: fn run_comparative_commands(
1321:     workspace: &Path,
1322:     command_keys: Vec<&'static str>,
1323:     max_output_chars: usize,
1324: ) -> Result<Vec<ComparativeCommandResult>, String> {
1325:     let mut results = Vec::new();
1326:     for key in command_keys {
1327:         let spec = comparative_command_spec(key)
1328:             .ok_or_else(|| format!("missing comparative command spec: {key}"))?;
1329:         let output = Command::new(spec.argv[0])
1330:             .args(&spec.argv[1..])
1331:             .current_dir(workspace)
1332:             .output()
1333:             .map_err(|err| format!("run comparative command {key} failed: {err}"))?;
1334:         let mut combined = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).to_string();
1335:         if !output.stderr.is_empty() {
1336:             if !combined.is_empty() {
1337:                 combined.push('\n');
1338:             }
1339:             combined.push_str(String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).as_ref());
1340:         }
1341:         let combined = truncate_output(combined.trim().to_string(), max_output_chars);
1342:         let rc = output.status.code().unwrap_or(1);
1343:         results.push(ComparativeCommandResult {
1344:             key: key.to_string(),
1345:             label: spec.label.to_string(),
1346:             argv: spec.argv.iter().map(|value| (*value).to_string()).collect(),
1347:             rc,
1348:             status: if rc == 0 { "pass" } else { "fail" }.to_string(),
1349:             output: combined,
1350:         });
1351:     }
1352:     Ok(results)
1353: }
1354: 
1355: fn truncate_output(mut text: String, limit: usize) -> String {
1356:     if text.len() > limit {
1357:         text.truncate(limit);
1358:         text.push_str("\n...[truncated]");
1359:     }
1360:     text
1361: }

1493: fn render_comparative_json(
1494:     entries: &[&ComparativeCatalogEntry],
1495:     command_results: Option<&[ComparativeCommandResult]>,
1496: ) -> Result<String, String> {
1497:     let payload = json!({
1498:         "entries": entries.iter().map(|entry| json!({
1499:             "project": entry.project,
1500:             "incident": entry.incident,
1501:             "date": entry.date,
1502:             "exploit_class": entry.exploit_class,
1503:             "summary": entry.summary,
1504:             "rustynet_analog": entry.rustynet_analog,
1505:             "attack_family": entry.attack_family,
1506:             "coverage_status": entry.coverage_status,
1507:             "command_keys": entry.command_keys,
1508:             "live_validation_scripts": entry.live_validation_scripts,
1509:             "expected_secure_result": entry.expected_secure_result,
1510:             "sources": entry.sources,
1511:         })).collect::<Vec<_>>(),
1512:         "command_results": command_results.map(|results| results.iter().map(|result| json!({
1513:             "key": result.key,
1514:             "label": result.label,
1515:             "argv": result.argv,
1516:             "rc": result.rc,
1517:             "status": result.status,
1518:             "output": result.output,
1519:         })).collect::<Vec<_>>()),
1520:         "status_counts": comparative_status_counts(entries),
1521:     });
1522:     serde_json::to_string_pretty(&payload)
1523:         .map(|text| text + "\n")
1524:         .map_err(|err| format!("encode comparative coverage json failed: {err}"))
1525: }

1527: fn comparative_status_counts(entries: &[&ComparativeCatalogEntry]) -> HashMap<&'static str, usize> {
1528:     let mut counts = HashMap::from([
1529:         ("covered", 0usize),
1530:         ("partially_covered", 0usize),
1531:         ("architecturally_not_applicable", 0usize),
1532:         ("future_surface_gap", 0usize),
1533:     ]);
1534:     for entry in entries {
1535:         *counts.entry(entry.coverage_status).or_insert(0) += 1;
1536:     }
1537:     counts
1538: }

1548: fn ensure_parent_dir(path: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
1549:     let Some(parent) = path.parent() else {
1550:         return Ok(());
1551:     };

1555: fn resolve_path(path: &Path) -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
1556:     if path.is_absolute() {
1557:         Ok(path.to_path_buf())
1558:     } else {
1559:         let cwd =
1560:             env::current_dir().map_err(|err| format!("resolve current directory failed: {err}"))?;
1561:         Ok(cwd.join(path))
1562:     }
1563: }

1574:     let body =
1575:         fs::read_to_string(path).map_err(|err| format!("read {} failed: {err}", path.display()))?;
1576:     serde_json::from_str(&body).map_err(|err| format!("parse {} failed: {err}", path.display()))
1577: }

1579: fn non_empty_output(primary: Vec<u8>, secondary: Vec<u8>) -> Option<String> {
1580:     let primary = String::from_utf8_lossy(&primary).trim().to_string();
1581:     if !primary.is_empty() {
1582:         return Some(primary);
1583:     }
1584:     let secondary = String::from_utf8_lossy(&secondary).trim().to_string();
1585:     if !secondary.is_empty() {
1586:         Some(secondary)
1587:     } else {
1588:         None
1589:     }
1590: }

1592: fn timestamp_for_path() -> String {
1593:     let secs = SystemTime::now()
1594:         .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
1595:         .map(|duration| duration.as_secs())
1596:         .unwrap_or(0);
1597:     secs.to_string()
1598: }

1600: fn utc_timestamp() -> String {
1601:     let output = Command::new("date")
1602:         .arg("-u")
1603:         .arg("+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%SZ")
1604:         .output();
1605:     match output {
1606:         Ok(output) if output.status.success() => {
1607:             let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).trim().to_string();
1608:             if text.is_empty() {
1609:                 "[unknown]".to_string()
1610:             } else {
1611:                 text
1612:             }
1613:         }
1614:         _ => "[unknown]".to_string(),
1615:     }
1616: }

===== /crates/rustynet-cli/src/ops_write_daemon_env.rs =====

   1: use std::env;
   2: use std::path::PathBuf;
   3: use std::process::Command;
   4: 
   5: use crate::ops_install_systemd::read_env_file_values;
   6: 
   7: pub fn execute_ops_write_daemon_env(
   8:     config_path: PathBuf,
   9:     egress_interface: Option<String>,
  10: ) -> Result<String, String> {
  11:     // 1. Load wizard.env config
  12:     let mut config = read_env_file_values(&config_path).map_err(|e| {
  13:         format!(
  14:             "failed to read config file {}: {}",
  15:             config_path.display(),
  16:             e
  17:         )
  18:     })?;
  19: 
  20:     // 2. Apply policy logic (defaults and enforcement)
  21: 
  22:     // Default: NODE_ROLE
  23:     let setup_complete = config
  24:         .get("SETUP_COMPLETE")
  25:         .map(|s| s.as_str())
  26:         .unwrap_or("0");
  27:     if !config.contains_key("NODE_ROLE") {
  28:         let default_role = if setup_complete == "1" {
  29:             "admin"
  30:         } else {
  31:             "client"
  32:         };
  33:         config.insert("NODE_ROLE".to_string(), default_role.to_string());
  34:     }
  35: 
  36:     // Validate NODE_ROLE
  37:     let node_role = {
  38:         let role = config.get("NODE_ROLE").unwrap(); // Safe because inserted above
  39:         match role.as_str() {
  40:             "admin" | "client" | "blind_exit" => role.clone(),
  41:             _ => {
  42:                 eprintln!("[warn] Invalid NODE_ROLE='{role}', defaulting to 'client'.");
  43:                 "client".to_string()
  44:             }
  45:         }
  46:     };
  47:     // Re-insert normalized role if it was invalid
  48:     if config.get("NODE_ROLE").unwrap() != &node_role {
  49:         config.insert("NODE_ROLE".to_string(), node_role.clone());
  50:     }
  51: 
  52:     // enforce_role_policy_defaults logic
  53:     if node_role == "client" {
  54:         // Force specific settings for client
  55:         if let Some(profile) = config.get("DEFAULT_LAUNCH_PROFILE") {
  56:             match profile.as_str() {
  57:                 "quick-exit-node" | "quick-hybrid" => {
  58:                     eprintln!(
  59:                         "[warn] Launch profile '{profile}' is admin-only; forcing 'quick-connect' for client role."
  60:                     );
  61:                     config.insert(
  62:                         "DEFAULT_LAUNCH_PROFILE".to_string(),
  63:                         "quick-connect".to_string(),
  64:                     );
  65:                 }
  66:                 _ => {}
  67:             }
  68:         }
  69:         config.insert("AUTO_PORT_FORWARD_EXIT".to_string(), "0".to_string());
  70:     } else if node_role == "blind_exit" {
  71:         // Force settings for blind_exit
  72:         if config.get("DEFAULT_LAUNCH_PROFILE").map(|s| s.as_str()) != Some("quick-exit-node") {
  73:             eprintln!("[warn] blind_exit role enforces default launch profile 'quick-exit-node'.");
  74:             config.insert(
  75:                 "DEFAULT_LAUNCH_PROFILE".to_string(),
  76:                 "quick-exit-node".to_string(),
  77:             );
  78:         }
  79:         config.insert("EXIT_CHAIN_HOPS".to_string(), "1".to_string());
  80:         config.remove("EXIT_CHAIN_ENTRY_NODE_ID");
  81:         config.remove("EXIT_CHAIN_FINAL_NODE_ID");
  82:         config.insert("AUTO_LAUNCH_ON_START".to_string(), "1".to_string());
  83:         config.remove("AUTO_LAUNCH_EXIT_NODE_ID");
  84:         config.insert("AUTO_LAUNCH_LAN_MODE".to_string(), "off".to_string());
  85:         config.insert("FAIL_CLOSED_SSH_ALLOW".to_string(), "0".to_string());
  86:         config.remove("FAIL_CLOSED_SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS");
  87:     }
  88: 
  89:     // Manual peer override is disabled
  90:     config.insert("MANUAL_PEER_OVERRIDE".to_string(), "0".to_string());
  91: 
  92:     // enforce_backend_mode
  93:     if !config.contains_key("BACKEND_MODE") {
  94:         config.insert("BACKEND_MODE".to_string(), "linux-wireguard".to_string());
  95:     }
  96: 
  97:     // enforce_auto_tunnel_policy
  98:     if config.get("AUTO_TUNNEL_ENFORCE").map(|s| s.as_str()) != Some("1") {
  99:         eprintln!(
 100:             "[warn] Unsigned/manual tunnel assignment is not allowed by default; forcing AUTO_TUNNEL_ENFORCE=1."
 101:         );
 102:         config.insert("AUTO_TUNNEL_ENFORCE".to_string(), "1".to_string());
 103:     }
 104: 
 105:     // enforce_fail_closed_ssh_policy
 106:     if config.get("FAIL_CLOSED_SSH_ALLOW").map(|s| s.as_str()) != Some("1") {
 107:         config.insert("FAIL_CLOSED_SSH_ALLOW".to_string(), "0".to_string());
 108:         config.remove("FAIL_CLOSED_SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS");
 109:     } else if config
 110:         .get("FAIL_CLOSED_SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS")
 111:         .map(|s| s.trim())
 112:         .unwrap_or("")
 113:         .is_empty()
 114:     {
 115:         return Err(
 116:             "FAIL_CLOSED_SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS is required when FAIL_CLOSED_SSH_ALLOW=1".to_string(),
 117:         );
 118:     }
 119: 
 120:     // enforce_wg_listen_port_policy
 121:     if let Some(port) = config.get("WG_LISTEN_PORT") {
 122:         if let Ok(p) = port.parse::<u16>() {
 123:             if p == 0 {
 124:                 return Err(format!(
 125:                     "Invalid WG_LISTEN_PORT '{port}'. Expected numeric range 1..65535."
 126:                 ));
 127:             }
 128:         } else {
 129:             return Err(format!(
 130:                 "Invalid WG_LISTEN_PORT '{port}'. Expected numeric range 1..65535."
 131:             ));
 132:         }
 133:     }
 134: 
 135:     // enforce_auto_port_forward_policy
 136:     if config.get("AUTO_PORT_FORWARD_EXIT").map(|s| s.as_str()) != Some("1") {
 137:         config.insert("AUTO_PORT_FORWARD_EXIT".to_string(), "0".to_string());
 138:     } else {
 139:         // Check lease secs
 140:         if let Some(lease) = config.get("AUTO_PORT_FORWARD_LEASE_SECS") {
 141:             if let Ok(l) = lease.parse::<u64>() {
 142:                 if l < 60 {
 143:                     return Err(format!(
 144:                         "Invalid AUTO_PORT_FORWARD_LEASE_SECS '{lease}'. Expected numeric value >= 60."
 145:                     ));
 146:                 }
 147:             } else {
 148:                 return Err(format!(
 149:                     "Invalid AUTO_PORT_FORWARD_LEASE_SECS '{lease}'. Expected numeric value >= 60."
 150:                 ));
 151:             }
 152:         }
 153:         // Role check
 154:         if node_role == "client" {
 155:             eprintln!(
 156:                 "[warn] Auto port-forward applies only to exit-serving roles. Forcing AUTO_PORT_FORWARD_EXIT=0 for role '{node_role}'."
 157:             );
 158:             config.insert("AUTO_PORT_FORWARD_EXIT".to_string(), "0".to_string());
 159:         }
 160:     }
 161: 
 162:     // 3. Override Egress Interface if provided
 163:     if let Some(egress) = egress_interface {
 164:         config.insert("EGRESS_INTERFACE".to_string(), egress);
 165:     }
 166: 
 167:     // 4. Invoke the single hardened install-systemd path with child-local env overrides.
 168:     let rustynet_bin = env::current_exe()
 169:         .map_err(|e| format!("failed to resolve current rustynet binary: {e}"))?;
 170:     let mut command = Command::new(rustynet_bin);
 171:     command.arg("ops").arg("install-systemd");
 172:     for (key, value) in config {
 173:         let env_key = if key.starts_with("RUSTYNET_") {
 174:             key
 175:         } else {
 176:             format!("RUSTYNET_{key}")
 177:         };
 178:         command.env(env_key, value);
 179:     }
 180:     let output = command
 181:         .output()
 182:         .map_err(|e| format!("failed to execute rustynet ops install-systemd: {e}"))?;
 183:     if output.status.success() {
 184:         let stdout = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).trim().to_string();
 185:         if stdout.is_empty() {
 186:             Ok("systemd environment written and install-systemd completed".to_string())
 187:         } else {
 188:             Ok(stdout)
 189:         }
 190:     } else {
 191:         let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).trim().to_string();
 192:         let stdout = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout).trim().to_string();
 193:         let detail = if !stderr.is_empty() {
 194:             stderr
 195:         } else if !stdout.is_empty() {
 196:             stdout
 197:         } else {
 198:             format!("child exited with status {}", output.status)
 199:         };
 200:         Err(format!("rustynet ops install-systemd failed: {detail}"))
 201:     }
 202: }

===== /crates/rustynet-cli/src/vm_lab/bootstrap/mod.rs =====

   1: use super::*;
   2: use std::path::Path;
   3: use std::time::Duration;
   4: 
   5: pub(super) mod windows;
   6: 
   7: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
   8: pub(super) enum BootstrapPhase {
   9:     SyncSource,
  10:     BuildRelease,
  11:     SmokeServiceHost,
  12:     InstallRelease,
  13:     RestartRuntime,
  14:     VerifyRuntime,
  15:     All,
  16: }
  17: 
  18: impl BootstrapPhase {
  19:     pub(super) fn parse(value: &str) -> Result<Self, String> {
  20:         match value.trim().to_ascii_lowercase().replace('_', "-").as_str() {
  21:             "sync-source" => Ok(Self::SyncSource),
  22:             "build-release" => Ok(Self::BuildRelease),
  23:             "smoke-service-host" => Ok(Self::SmokeServiceHost),
  24:             "install-release" => Ok(Self::InstallRelease),
  25:             "restart-runtime" => Ok(Self::RestartRuntime),
  26:             "verify-runtime" => Ok(Self::VerifyRuntime),
  27:             "all" => Ok(Self::All),
  28:             other => Err(format!(
  29:                 "unsupported vm-lab bootstrap phase: {other} (expected sync-source|build-release|smoke-service-host|install-release|restart-runtime|verify-runtime|all)"
  30:             )),
  31:         }
  32:     }
  33: 
  34:     pub(super) fn as_str(self) -> &'static str {
  35:         match self {
  36:             Self::SyncSource => "sync-source",
  37:             Self::BuildRelease => "build-release",
  38:             Self::SmokeServiceHost => "smoke-service-host",
  39:             Self::InstallRelease => "install-release",
  40:             Self::RestartRuntime => "restart-runtime",
  41:             Self::VerifyRuntime => "verify-runtime",
  42:             Self::All => "all",
  43:         }
  44:     }
  45: }
  46: 
  47: pub(super) struct BootstrapPhaseContext<'a> {
  48:     pub(super) ssh_user: Option<&'a str>,
  49:     pub(super) ssh_identity_file: Option<&'a Path>,
  50:     pub(super) known_hosts_path: Option<&'a Path>,
  51:     pub(super) workdir: &'a str,
  52:     pub(super) repo_url: Option<&'a str>,
  53:     pub(super) branch: &'a str,
  54:     pub(super) remote: &'a str,
  55:     pub(super) timeout: Duration,
  56: }
  57: 
  58: pub(super) trait VmBootstrapProvider {
  59:     fn platform(&self) -> VmGuestPlatform;
  60:     fn execute_phase(
  61:         &self,
  62:         phase: BootstrapPhase,
  63:         target: &RemoteTarget,
  64:         context: &BootstrapPhaseContext<'_>,
  65:     ) -> Result<(), String>;
  66: }
  67: 
  68: pub(super) fn execute_bootstrap_phase_for_target(
  69:     phase: &str,
  70:     target: &RemoteTarget,
  71:     context: &BootstrapPhaseContext<'_>,
  72: ) -> Result<(), String> {
  73:     let phase = BootstrapPhase::parse(phase)?;
  74:     match target.platform_profile.platform {
  75:         VmGuestPlatform::Linux => {
  76:             super::execute_legacy_posix_bootstrap_phase_for_target(phase, target, context)
  77:         }
  78:         VmGuestPlatform::Macos => Err(format!(
  79:             "bootstrap phase {} is not yet implemented for macOS targets in the provider layer: {}",
  80:             phase.as_str(),
  81:             target.label
  82:         )),
  83:         VmGuestPlatform::Windows => {
  84:             let provider: &dyn VmBootstrapProvider = &windows::WINDOWS_BOOTSTRAP_PROVIDER;
  85:             if provider.platform() != target.platform_profile.platform {
  86:                 return Err(format!(
  87:                     "bootstrap provider platform mismatch for {}: expected {}, got {}",
  88:                     target.label,
  89:                     target.platform_profile.platform.as_str(),
  90:                     provider.platform().as_str()
  91:                 ));
  92:             }
  93:             provider.execute_phase(phase, target, context)
  94:         }
  95:         VmGuestPlatform::Ios | VmGuestPlatform::Android => Err(format!(
  96:             "bootstrap phase {} is intentionally scaffold-only for platform {}: {}",
  97:             phase.as_str(),
  98:             target.platform_profile.platform.as_str(),
  99:             target.label
 100:         )),
 101:     }
 102: }
