  41: fn local_utm_result_file_supported_for_phase(phase: BootstrapPhase, target: &RemoteTarget) -> bool {
  42:     // The result-file path uses utmctl exec + utm_staging_dir to run a
  43:     // wrapper that writes captured output and rc to files inside the
  44:     // staging directory. Both halves work because the staging dir is
  45:     // SYSTEM-writable (lives under C:\Users\<user>\, outside the
  46:     // hardened state tree) — see remote_target_windows_utm_staging_dir
  47:     // in vm_lab/mod.rs.
  48:     matches!(
  49:         windows_local_utm_execution_authority(target, false),
  50:         Some(WindowsLocalUtmExecutionAuthority::StatusProbeResultFile)
  51:     ) && matches!(
  52:         phase,
  53:         BootstrapPhase::BuildRelease
  54:             | BootstrapPhase::InstallRelease
  55:             | BootstrapPhase::RestartRuntime
  56:             | BootstrapPhase::VerifyRuntime
  57:     )
  58: }
  59: 
  60: fn build_windows_build_release_report_paths(
  61:     target: &RemoteTarget,
  62: ) -> Result<(String, String, String), String> {
  63:     let remote_root = windows_orchestration_root(target);
  64:     ensure_no_control_chars("Windows build-release report root", remote_root.as_str())?;
  65:     let report_root = format!(
  66:         r"{}\build-release\bootstrap-{}-build-release-{}",
  67:         remote_root.trim_end_matches(['\\', '/']),
  68:         sanitize_label_for_path(target.label.as_str()),
  69:         unique_suffix()
  70:     );
  71:     Ok((
  72:         report_root.clone(),
  73:         format!(r"{report_root}\manifest.json"),
  74:         format!(r"{report_root}\probe.json"),
  75:     ))
  76: }
  77: 
  78: fn build_windows_bootstrap_build_release_result_script(
  79:     remote_path: &str,
  80:     args: &[String],
  81:     remote_manifest_path: &str,
  82:     remote_probe_path: &str,
  83: ) -> Result<String, String> {
  84:     let mut helper_args = args.to_vec();
  85:     helper_args.push("-ResultPath".to_string());
  86:     helper_args.push(remote_manifest_path.to_string());
  87:     let helper_command = build_windows_helper_command(remote_path, helper_args.as_slice())?;
  88:     Ok(format!(
  89:         "Set-StrictMode -Version Latest; \
  90:          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; \
  91:          $ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'; \
  92:          $manifestPath = {manifest_path}; \
  93:          $probePath = {probe_path}; \
  94:          $reportRoot = Split-Path -Path $manifestPath -Parent; \
  95:          $stdoutPath = Join-Path $reportRoot 'stdout.txt'; \
  96:          $stderrPath = Join-Path $reportRoot 'stderr.txt'; \
  97:          $exitCodePath = Join-Path $reportRoot 'exit_code.txt'; \
  98:          $toolchainPath = Join-Path $reportRoot 'toolchain.txt'; \
  99:          $markerPath = Join-Path $reportRoot 'complete.marker'; \
 100:          $probeParent = Split-Path -Path $probePath -Parent; \
 101:          if ($probeParent -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $probeParent)) {{ \
 102:            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $probeParent -Force | Out-Null \
 103:          }}; \
 104:          if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $probePath) {{ \
 105:            Remove-Item -LiteralPath $probePath -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue \
 106:          }}; \
 107:          $helperFailure = ''; \
 108:          try {{ \
 109:            {helper_command}; \
 110:          }} catch {{ \
 111:            $helperFailure = if ($_.Exception -and $_.Exception.Message) {{ $_.Exception.Message.Trim() }} else {{ ($_ | Out-String).Trim() }} \
 112:          }}; \
 113:          $body = ''; \
 114:          $validationFailure = ''; \
 115:          if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $manifestPath)) {{ \
 116:            if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($helperFailure)) {{ \
 117:              $validationFailure = ('Windows bootstrap build-release helper did not write manifest: {{0}}' -f $manifestPath) \
 118:            }} else {{ \
 119:              $validationFailure = $helperFailure \
 120:            }} \
 121:          }} elseif (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $markerPath)) {{ \
 122:            if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($helperFailure)) {{ \
 123:              $validationFailure = ('Windows bootstrap build-release helper did not write complete.marker: {{0}}' -f $markerPath) \
 124:            }} else {{ \
 125:              $validationFailure = $helperFailure \
 126:            }} \
 127:          }} else {{ \
 128:            try {{ \
 129:              $body = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $manifestPath -Encoding UTF8; \
 130:              if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($body)) {{ \
 131:                throw ('Windows bootstrap build-release helper wrote empty manifest: {{0}}' -f $manifestPath) \
 132:              }}; \
 133:              $report = $body | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction Stop; \
 134:              foreach ($requiredField in @('phase', 'status', 'reason', 'report_root', 'stdout_path', 'stderr_path', 'exit_code_path', 'toolchain_path', 'manifest_path', 'complete_marker_path')) {{ \
 135:                $value = $report.$requiredField; \
 136:                if ($null -eq $value -or ([string]$value).Trim().Length -eq 0) {{ \
 137:                  throw ('Windows bootstrap build-release manifest missing field: {{0}}' -f $requiredField) \
 138:                }} \
 139:              }}; \
 140:              if ([string]$report.phase -ne 'build-release') {{ \
 141:                throw ('Windows bootstrap build-release manifest reported unexpected phase: {{0}}' -f [string]$report.phase) \
 142:              }}; \
 143:              if ([string]$report.report_root -ne $reportRoot) {{ \
 144:                throw ('Windows bootstrap build-release manifest reported unexpected report_root: {{0}}' -f [string]$report.report_root) \
 145:              }}; \
 146:              if ([string]$report.manifest_path -ne $manifestPath) {{ \
 147:                throw ('Windows bootstrap build-release manifest reported unexpected manifest_path: {{0}}' -f [string]$report.manifest_path) \
 148:              }}; \
 149:              if ([string]$report.complete_marker_path -ne $markerPath) {{ \
 150:                throw ('Windows bootstrap build-release manifest reported unexpected complete_marker_path: {{0}}' -f [string]$report.complete_marker_path) \
 151:              }}; \
 152:              foreach ($requiredPath in @($stdoutPath, $stderrPath, $exitCodePath, $toolchainPath, $markerPath)) {{ \
 153:                if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $requiredPath)) {{ \
 154:                  throw ('Windows bootstrap build-release missing report file: {{0}}' -f $requiredPath) \
 155:                }} \
 156:              }}; \
 157:            }} catch {{ \
 158:              $validationFailure = if ($_.Exception -and $_.Exception.Message) {{ $_.Exception.Message.Trim() }} else {{ ($_ | Out-String).Trim() }} \
 159:            }} \
 160:          }}; \
 161:          if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($validationFailure)) {{ \
 162:            $body = ([ordered]@{{ \
 163:              phase = 'build-release'; \
 164:              status = 'fail'; \
 165:              reason = $validationFailure; \
 166:              report_root = $reportRoot; \
 167:              stdout_path = $stdoutPath; \
 168:              stderr_path = $stderrPath; \
 169:              exit_code_path = $exitCodePath; \
 170:              toolchain_path = $toolchainPath; \
 171:              manifest_path = $manifestPath; \
 172:              complete_marker_path = $markerPath; \
 173:              exit_code = 1; \
 174:              stderr_tail = ''; \
 175:              notes = @('build-release-wrapper-fallback') \
 176:            }} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress) \
 177:          }}; \
 178:          Set-Content -LiteralPath $probePath -Value $body -Encoding UTF8; \
 179:          if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($validationFailure)) {{ exit 1 }}",
 180:         manifest_path = powershell_quote(remote_manifest_path)?,
 181:         probe_path = powershell_quote(remote_probe_path)?,
 182:         helper_command = helper_command,
 183:     ))
 184: }

 201: fn build_bootstrap_script_invocation(
 202:     phase: BootstrapPhase,
 203:     target_label: &str,
 204:     context: &BootstrapPhaseContext<'_>,
 205: ) -> Result<WindowsHelperScriptSpec, String> {
 206:     let mut args = vec![
 207:         "-Phase".to_string(),
 208:         phase.as_str().to_string(),
 209:         "-RustyNetRoot".to_string(),
 210:         context.workdir.to_string(),
 211:         "-Branch".to_string(),
 212:         context.branch.to_string(),
 213:     ];
 214: 
 215:     match phase {
 216:         BootstrapPhase::SyncSource => {
 217:             let repo_url = context.repo_url.ok_or_else(|| {
 218:                 format!(
 219:                     "Windows bootstrap phase {} requires --repo-url for {}",
 220:                     phase.as_str(),
 221:                     target_label
 222:                 )
 223:             })?;
 224:             ensure_no_control_chars("repo URL", repo_url)?;
 225:             args.push("-SourceMode".to_string());
 226:             args.push("git".to_string());
 227:             args.push("-RepoUrl".to_string());
 228:             args.push(repo_url.to_string());
 229:         }
 230:         BootstrapPhase::BuildRelease => {}
 231:         BootstrapPhase::SmokeServiceHost => {
 232:             return Err(format!(
 233:                 "bootstrap script invocation is not used for Windows phase {} on {}",
 234:                 phase.as_str(),
 235:                 target_label
 236:             ));
 237:         }
 238:         BootstrapPhase::InstallRelease
 239:         | BootstrapPhase::RestartRuntime
 240:         | BootstrapPhase::VerifyRuntime
 241:         | BootstrapPhase::All => {
 242:             return Err(format!(
 243:                 "bootstrap script invocation is not used for Windows phase {} on {}",
 244:                 phase.as_str(),
 245:                 target_label
 246:             ));
 247:         }
 248:     }
 249: 
 250:     Ok(WindowsHelperScriptSpec {
 251:         helper_file_name: WINDOWS_BOOTSTRAP_HELPER_FILE,
 252:         remote_file_name: WINDOWS_BOOTSTRAP_HELPER_FILE,
 253:         args,
 254:     })
 255: }

 310: fn build_windows_diagnostics_invocation(
 311:     target: &RemoteTarget,
 312:     phase: BootstrapPhase,
 313: ) -> Result<WindowsHelperScriptSpec, String> {
 314:     let remote_root = windows_orchestration_root(target);
 315:     ensure_no_control_chars("Windows diagnostics root", remote_root.as_str())?;
 316:     let output_root = format!(
 317:         r"{}\diagnostics\bootstrap-{}-{}-{}",
 318:         remote_root.trim_end_matches(['\\', '/']),
 319:         sanitize_label_for_path(target.label.as_str()),
 320:         phase.as_str(),
 321:         unique_suffix()
 322:     );
 323:     Ok(WindowsHelperScriptSpec {
 324:         helper_file_name: WINDOWS_COLLECT_DIAGNOSTICS_HELPER_FILE,
 325:         remote_file_name: WINDOWS_COLLECT_DIAGNOSTICS_HELPER_FILE,
 326:         args: vec!["-OutputRoot".to_string(), output_root],
 327:     })
 328: }

 330: fn build_windows_restart_runtime_script() -> Result<String, String> {
 331:     Ok(format!(
 332:         "Set-StrictMode -Version Latest; \
 333:          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; \
 334:          $serviceName = {service_name}; \
 335:          $service = Get-Service -Name $serviceName -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; \
 336:          if (-not $service) {{ throw \"Windows runtime service is not installed: $serviceName\" }}; \
 337:          try {{ \
 338:            if ($service.Status -eq 'Running') {{ Restart-Service -Name $serviceName -ErrorAction Stop }} else {{ Start-Service -Name $serviceName -ErrorAction Stop }} \
 339:          }} catch {{ \
 340:            Write-Output (\"service-control-error=\" + $_.Exception.Message) \
 341:          }}; \
 342:          Start-Sleep -Seconds 3; \
 343:          $refreshed = Get-Service -Name $serviceName -ErrorAction Stop; \
 344:          Write-Output (\"service-status=\" + [string]$refreshed.Status)",
 345:         service_name = powershell_quote(WINDOWS_SERVICE_NAME)?,
 346:     ))
 347: }
 348: 
 349: fn parse_windows_build_release_report_output(
 350:     output: &str,
 351:     target_label: &str,
 352: ) -> Result<(), String> {
 353:     let trimmed = output.trim();
 354:     if trimmed.is_empty() {
 355:         return Err(format!(
 356:             "Windows bootstrap build-release produced no report for {target_label}"
 357:         ));
 358:     }
 359:     let parsed: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(trimmed).map_err(|err| {
 360:         format!("Windows bootstrap build-release did not emit valid JSON for {target_label}: {err}")
 361:     })?;
 362:     let status = parsed
 363:         .get("status")
 364:         .and_then(|value| value.as_str())
 365:         .unwrap_or("fail");
 366:     let reason = parsed
 367:         .get("reason")
 368:         .and_then(|value| value.as_str())
 369:         .filter(|value| !value.trim().is_empty())
 370:         .unwrap_or("windows-build-release-failed");
 371:     let report_root = parsed
 372:         .get("report_root")
 373:         .and_then(|value| value.as_str())
 374:         .filter(|value| !value.trim().is_empty())
 375:         .ok_or_else(|| {
 376:             format!(
 377:                 "Windows bootstrap build-release report was missing report_root for {target_label}"
 378:             )
 379:         })?;
 380:     let exit_code = parsed
 381:         .get("exit_code")
 382:         .map(|value| value.to_string())
 383:         .unwrap_or_else(|| "unknown".to_string());
 384:     let stderr_tail = parsed
 385:         .get("stderr_tail")
 386:         .and_then(|value| value.as_str())
 387:         .filter(|value| !value.trim().is_empty());
 388:     if status == "pass" {
 389:         return Ok(());
 390:     }
 391:     let mut details = vec![
 392:         format!("reason={reason}"),
 393:         format!("report_root={report_root}"),
 394:     ];
 395:     details.push(format!("exit_code={exit_code}"));
 396:     if let Some(scope) = parsed
 397:         .get("toolchain_scope")
 398:         .and_then(|value| value.as_str())
 399:         .filter(|value| !value.trim().is_empty())
 400:     {
 401:         details.push(format!("toolchain_scope={scope}"));
 402:     }
 403:     if let Some(stderr_tail) = stderr_tail {
 404:         details.push(format!("stderr_tail={stderr_tail}"));
 405:     }
 406:     Err(format!(
 407:         "Windows bootstrap build-release reported status={status} for {} {}",
 408:         target_label,
 409:         details.join(" ")
 410:     ))
 411: }
 412: 
 413: fn parse_windows_runtime_report_output(
 414:     output: &str,
 415:     helper_label: &str,
 416:     target_label: &str,
 417: ) -> Result<(), String> {
 418:     let trimmed = output.trim();
 419:     if trimmed.is_empty() {
 420:         return Err(format!(
 421:             "{helper_label} produced no output for {target_label}"
 422:         ));
 423:     }
 424:     let parsed: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(trimmed).map_err(|err| {
 425:         format!("{helper_label} did not emit valid JSON for {target_label}: {err}")
 426:     })?;
 427:     let status = parsed
 428:         .get("status")
 429:         .and_then(|value| value.as_str())
 430:         .unwrap_or("fail");
 431:     if status == "pass" {
 432:         return Ok(());
 433:     }
 434:     let reason = parsed
 435:         .get("reason")
 436:         .and_then(|value| value.as_str())
 437:         .filter(|value| !value.trim().is_empty());
 438:     let service_status = parsed
 439:         .get("service_status")
 440:         .and_then(|value| value.as_str())
 441:         .filter(|value| !value.trim().is_empty());
 442:     let backend_label = parsed
 443:         .get("backend_label")
 444:         .and_then(|value| value.as_str())
 445:         .filter(|value| !value.trim().is_empty());
 446:     let start_error = parsed
 447:         .get("start_error")
 448:         .and_then(|value| value.as_str())
 449:         .filter(|value| !value.trim().is_empty());
 450:     let failure_step = parsed
 451:         .get("failure_step")
 452:         .and_then(|value| value.as_str())
 453:         .filter(|value| !value.trim().is_empty());
 454:     let runtime_probe_mode = parsed
 455:         .get("runtime_signals")
 456:         .and_then(|value| value.get("probe_mode"))
 457:         .and_then(|value| value.as_str())
 458:         .filter(|value| !value.trim().is_empty());
 459:     let runtime_probe_excerpt = parsed
 460:         .get("runtime_signals")
 461:         .and_then(|value| value.get("probe_excerpt"))
 462:         .and_then(|value| value.as_str())
 463:         .map(str::trim)
 464:         .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
 465:         .map(|value| value.chars().take(160).collect::<String>());
 466:     let notes = parsed
 467:         .get("notes")
 468:         .and_then(|value| value.as_array())
 469:         .map(|items| {
 470:             items
 471:                 .iter()
 472:                 .filter_map(|value| value.as_str())
 473:                 .collect::<Vec<_>>()
 474:                 .join(", ")
 475:         })
 476:         .filter(|notes| !notes.is_empty());
 477:     let mut details = Vec::new();
 478:     if let Some(reason) = reason {
 479:         details.push(format!("reason={reason}"));
 480:     }
 481:     if let Some(service_status) = service_status {
 482:         details.push(format!("service_status={service_status}"));
 483:     }
 484:     if let Some(backend_label) = backend_label {
 485:         details.push(format!("backend_label={backend_label}"));
 486:     }
 487:     if let Some(start_error) = start_error {
 488:         details.push(format!("start_error={start_error}"));
 489:     }
 490:     if let Some(failure_step) = failure_step {
 491:         details.push(format!("failure_step={failure_step}"));
 492:     }
 493:     if let Some(runtime_probe_mode) = runtime_probe_mode {
 494:         details.push(format!("runtime_probe_mode={runtime_probe_mode}"));
 495:     }
 496:     if let Some(runtime_probe_excerpt) = runtime_probe_excerpt {
 497:         details.push(format!("runtime_probe_excerpt={runtime_probe_excerpt}"));
 498:     }
 499:     if let Some(notes) = notes {
 500:         details.push(format!("notes={notes}"));
 501:     }
 502:     let detail_suffix = if details.is_empty() {
 503:         String::new()
 504:     } else {
 505:         format!(" {}", details.join(" "))
 506:     };
 507:     Err(format!(
 508:         "{helper_label} reported status={status} for {target_label}{detail_suffix}"
 509:     ))
 510: }
 511: 
 512: fn parse_windows_service_host_smoke_output(output: &str, target_label: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
 513:     let trimmed = output.trim();
 514:     if trimmed.is_empty() {
 515:         return Err(format!(
 516:             "Windows service-host smoke helper produced no output for {target_label}"
 517:         ));
 518:     }
 519:     let parsed: serde_json::Value = serde_json::from_str(trimmed).map_err(|err| {
 520:         format!(
 521:             "Windows service-host smoke helper did not emit valid JSON for {target_label}: {err}"
 522:         )
 523:     })?;
 524:     let status = parsed
 525:         .get("status")
 526:         .and_then(|value| value.as_str())
 527:         .unwrap_or("fail");
 528:     let reason = parsed
 529:         .get("reason")
 530:         .and_then(|value| value.as_str())
 531:         .unwrap_or("");
 532:     let backend_label = parsed
 533:         .get("backend_label")
 534:         .and_then(|value| value.as_str())
 535:         .unwrap_or("");
 536:     let host_surface_validated = parsed
 537:         .get("host_surface_validated")
 538:         .and_then(|value| value.as_bool())
 539:         .unwrap_or(false);
 540:     let failure_step = parsed
 541:         .get("failure_step")
 542:         .and_then(|value| value.as_str())
 543:         .unwrap_or("");
 544:     let runtime_probe_mode = parsed
 545:         .get("runtime_signals")
 546:         .and_then(|value| value.get("probe_mode"))
 547:         .and_then(|value| value.as_str())
 548:         .unwrap_or("");
 549:     let runtime_probe_excerpt = parsed
 550:         .get("runtime_signals")
 551:         .and_then(|value| value.get("probe_excerpt"))
 552:         .and_then(|value| value.as_str())
 553:         .map(str::trim)
 554:         .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
 555:         .map(|value| value.chars().take(160).collect::<String>())
 556:         .unwrap_or_default();
 557:     let cleanup_status = parsed
 558:         .get("cleanup_status")
 559:         .and_then(|value| value.as_str())
 560:         .unwrap_or("");
 561: 
 562:     if !host_surface_validated {
 563:         return Err(format!(
 564:             "Windows service-host smoke helper reported status={status} reason={reason} host_surface_validated=false failure_step={failure_step} runtime_probe_mode={runtime_probe_mode} runtime_probe_excerpt={runtime_probe_excerpt} for {target_label}"
 565:         ));
 566:     }
 567:     if cleanup_status != "removed" {
 568:         return Err(format!(
 569:             "Windows service-host smoke helper reported status={status} cleanup_status={cleanup_status} for {target_label}"
 570:         ));
 571:     }
 572:     if status == "pass" {
 573:         return Ok(());
 574:     }
 575:     if status == "blocked"
 576:         && reason == "windows-runtime-backend-explicitly-unsupported"
 577:         && backend_label == "windows-unsupported"
 578:     {
 579:         return Ok(());
 580:     }
 581: 
 582:     Err(format!(
 583:         "Windows service-host smoke helper reported status={status} reason={reason} backend_label={backend_label} failure_step={failure_step} runtime_probe_mode={runtime_probe_mode} runtime_probe_excerpt={runtime_probe_excerpt} for {target_label}"
 584:     ))
 585: }

 587: #[cfg(test)]
 588: fn build_windows_service_host_smoke_validation_script(
 589:     remote_path: &str,
 590:     args: &[String],
 591:     remote_result_path: &str,
 592: ) -> Result<String, String> {
 593:     let mut helper_args = args.to_vec();
 594:     helper_args.push("-OutputPath".to_string());
 595:     helper_args.push(remote_result_path.to_string());
 596:     let helper_command = build_windows_helper_command(remote_path, helper_args.as_slice())?;
 597:     Ok(format!(
 598:         "Set-StrictMode -Version Latest; \
 599:          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; \
 600:          $resultPath = {result_path}; \
 601:          $resultParent = Split-Path -Path $resultPath -Parent; \
 602:          if ($resultParent -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $resultParent)) {{ \
 603:            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $resultParent -Force | Out-Null \
 604:          }}; \
 605:          if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $resultPath) {{ \
 606:            Remove-Item -LiteralPath $resultPath -Force \
 607:          }}; \
 608:          {helper_command}; \
 609:          if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $resultPath)) {{ \
 610:            throw ('Windows service-host smoke helper did not write result file: {{0}}' -f $resultPath) \
 611:          }}; \
 612:          $report = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $resultPath -Encoding UTF8 | ConvertFrom-Json; \
 613:          if (-not $report.host_surface_validated) {{ \
 614:            throw 'Windows service-host smoke helper reported host_surface_validated=false' \
 615:          }}; \
 616:          if ($report.cleanup_status -ne 'removed') {{ \
 617:            throw ('Windows service-host smoke helper left cleanup_status={{0}}' -f [string]$report.cleanup_status) \
 618:          }}; \
 619:          if ($report.status -eq 'pass') {{ return }}; \
 620:          if ($report.status -eq 'blocked' -and $report.reason -eq 'windows-runtime-backend-explicitly-unsupported' -and $report.backend_label -eq 'windows-unsupported') {{ return }}; \
 621:          throw ('Windows service-host smoke helper reported status={{0}} reason={{1}} backend_label={{2}}' -f [string]$report.status, [string]$report.reason, [string]$report.backend_label)",
 622:         result_path = powershell_quote(remote_result_path)?,
 623:         helper_command = helper_command,
 624:     ))
 625: }

 627: #[cfg(test)]
 628: fn build_windows_runtime_report_validation_script(
 629:     remote_path: &str,
 630:     args: &[String],
 631:     remote_result_path: &str,
 632:     helper_label: &str,
 633: ) -> Result<String, String> {
 634:     ensure_no_control_chars("Windows runtime helper label", helper_label)?;
 635:     let mut helper_args = args.to_vec();
 636:     helper_args.push("-OutputPath".to_string());
 637:     helper_args.push(remote_result_path.to_string());
 638:     let helper_command = build_windows_helper_command(remote_path, helper_args.as_slice())?;
 639:     Ok(format!(
 640:         "Set-StrictMode -Version Latest; \
 641:          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; \
 642:          $ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'; \
 643:          $validationRc = 1; \
 644:          $validationMessage = ''; \
 645:          $resultPath = {result_path}; \
 646:          $resultParent = Split-Path -Path $resultPath -Parent; \
 647:          if ($resultParent -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $resultParent)) {{ \
 648:            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $resultParent -Force | Out-Null \
 649:          }}; \
 650:          if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $resultPath) {{ \
 651:            Remove-Item -LiteralPath $resultPath -Force \
 652:          }}; \
 653:          try {{ \
 654:            {helper_command}; \
 655:            if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $resultPath)) {{ \
 656:              $validationMessage = ('{helper_label} did not write result file: {{0}}' -f $resultPath) \
 657:            }} else {{ \
 658:              $body = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $resultPath -Encoding UTF8; \
 659:              if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($body)) {{ \
 660:                $validationMessage = ('{helper_label} wrote empty result file: {{0}}' -f $resultPath) \
 661:              }} else {{ \
 662:                $report = $body | ConvertFrom-Json; \
 663:                if ($report.status -eq 'pass') {{ \
 664:                  $validationRc = 0 \
 665:                }} else {{ \
 666:                  $validationMessage = ('{helper_label} reported status={{0}} reason={{1}} backend_label={{2}} service_status={{3}} start_error={{4}} result_path={{5}}' -f [string]$report.status, [string]$report.reason, [string]$report.backend_label, [string]$report.service_status, [string]$report.start_error, $resultPath) \
 667:                }} \
 668:              }} \
 669:            }} \
 670:          }} catch {{ \
 671:            $validationMessage = (($_ | Out-String).Trim()) \
 672:          }}; \
 673:          if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($validationMessage)) {{ Write-Output $validationMessage }}; \
 674:          Write-Output ('__RUSTYNET_VM_LAB_RC__={{0}}' -f $validationRc)",
 675:         result_path = powershell_quote(remote_result_path)?,
 676:         helper_command = helper_command,
 677:         helper_label = helper_label,
 678:     ))
 679: }

 682: fn build_windows_diagnostics_validation_script(

 697:          if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $manifestPath)) {{ \
 698:            throw ('Windows diagnostics helper did not create manifest: {{0}}' -f $manifestPath) \

 700:          $null = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $manifestPath -Encoding UTF8 | ConvertFrom-Json",

 705: 
 706: fn build_windows_diagnostics_result_file_script(
 707:     remote_path: &str,
 708:     args: &[String],
 709:     output_root: &str,
 710:     remote_result_path: &str,
 711: ) -> Result<String, String> {
 712:     let helper_command = build_windows_helper_command(remote_path, args)?;
 713:     Ok(format!(
 714:         "Set-StrictMode -Version Latest; \
 715:          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; \
 716:          $ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'; \
 717:          $outputRoot = {output_root}; \
 718:          $resultPath = {result_path}; \
 719:          $resultParent = Split-Path -Path $resultPath -Parent; \
 720:          if ($resultParent -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $resultParent)) {{ \
 721:            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $resultParent -Force | Out-Null \
 722:          }}; \
 723:          if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $resultPath) {{ \
 724:            Remove-Item -LiteralPath $resultPath -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue \
 725:          }}; \
 726:          $report = $null; \
 727:          $helperFailure = ''; \
 728:          try {{ \
 729:            {helper_command}; \
 730:          }} catch {{ \
 731:            $helperFailure = if ($_.Exception -and $_.Exception.Message) {{ $_.Exception.Message.Trim() }} else {{ ($_ | Out-String).Trim() }} \
 732:          }}; \
 733:          try {{ \
 734:            if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $outputRoot)) {{ \
 735:              if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($helperFailure)) {{ \
 736:                throw ('Windows diagnostics helper did not create output root: {{0}}' -f $outputRoot) \
 737:              }}; \
 738:              throw $helperFailure \
 739:            }}; \
 740:            $manifestPath = Join-Path $outputRoot 'manifest.json'; \
 741:            if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $manifestPath)) {{ \
 742:              if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($helperFailure)) {{ \
 743:                throw ('Windows diagnostics helper did not create manifest: {{0}}' -f $manifestPath) \
 744:              }}; \
 745:              throw $helperFailure \
 746:            }}; \
 747:            $null = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $manifestPath -Encoding UTF8 | ConvertFrom-Json; \
 748:            $report = [ordered]@{{ status = 'pass'; output_root = $outputRoot }} \
 749:          }} catch {{ \
 750:            $detail = if ($_.Exception -and $_.Exception.Message) {{ $_.Exception.Message.Trim() }} else {{ ($_ | Out-String).Trim() }}; \
 751:            if (-not $detail) {{ $detail = 'windows-diagnostics-helper-failed' }}; \
 752:            $report = [ordered]@{{ status = 'fail'; reason = $detail; output_root = $outputRoot }} \
 753:          }}; \
 754:          $report | ConvertTo-Json -Compress | Set-Content -LiteralPath $resultPath -Encoding UTF8; \
 755:          if ($report.status -ne 'pass') {{ exit 1 }}",
 756:         output_root = powershell_quote(output_root)?,
 757:         result_path = powershell_quote(remote_result_path)?,
 758:         helper_command = helper_command,
 759:     ))
 760: }
 761: 
 762: impl WindowsBootstrapProvider {
 763:     fn helper_context<'a>(
 764:         &self,
 765:         target: &'a RemoteTarget,
 766:         context: &'a BootstrapPhaseContext<'a>,
 767:     ) -> RemoteFallbackContext<'a> {
 768:         RemoteFallbackContext {
 769:             target,
 770:             ssh_user_override: context.ssh_user,
 771:             ssh_identity_file: context.ssh_identity_file,
 772:             known_hosts_path: context.known_hosts_path,
 773:             timeout: context.timeout,
 774:         }
 775:     }
 776: 
 777:     fn invoke_helper_status(
 778:         &self,
 779:         target: &RemoteTarget,
 780:         context: &BootstrapPhaseContext<'_>,
 781:         invocation: WindowsHelperScriptSpec,
 782:         label: &str,
 783:     ) -> Result<(), String> {
 784:         let helper_context = self.helper_context(target, context);
 785:         let status = invoke_windows_helper_script_for_target(
 786:             &helper_context,
 787:             WindowsHelperInvocation {
 788:                 helper_file_name: invocation.helper_file_name,
 789:                 remote_file_name: invocation.remote_file_name,
 790:                 args: invocation.args.as_slice(),
 791:             },
 792:         )?;
 793:         ensure_success_status(status, label)
 794:     }
 795: 
 796:     fn capture_helper_output(
 797:         &self,
 798:         target: &RemoteTarget,
 799:         context: &BootstrapPhaseContext<'_>,
 800:         invocation: WindowsHelperScriptSpec,
 801:         label: &str,
 802:     ) -> Result<String, String> {
 803:         let helper_context = self.helper_context(target, context);
 804:         capture_windows_helper_script_output_for_target(
 805:             &helper_context,
 806:             invocation.helper_file_name,
 807:             invocation.remote_file_name,
 808:             invocation.args.as_slice(),
 809:         )
 810:         .map_err(|err| format!("{label} failed for {}: {err}", target.label))
 811:     }
 812: 
 813:     fn run_helper_via_local_utm_result_file(
 814:         &self,
 815:         target: &RemoteTarget,
 816:         context: &BootstrapPhaseContext<'_>,
 817:         invocation: WindowsHelperScriptSpec,
 818:         label: &str,
 819:     ) -> Result<(), String> {
 820:         let helper_context = self.helper_context(target, context);
 821:         let (utm_name, _) = remote_target_local_utm(helper_context.target).ok_or_else(|| {
 822:             format!(
 823:                 "{label} requested local UTM result-file mode for non-UTM target {}",
 824:                 target.label
 825:             )
 826:         })?;
 827:         let local_path = windows_helper_script_local_path(invocation.helper_file_name);
 828:         let remote_path = stage_windows_helper_script_from_path_with_phase(
 829:             &helper_context,
 830:             local_path.as_path(),
 831:             invocation.remote_file_name,
 832:             RemoteTransportPhase::AccessEstablishment,
 833:         )?;
 834:         let remote_result_name = format!(
 835:             "{}.result.{}.json",
 836:             sanitize_label_for_path(invocation.remote_file_name),
 837:             unique_suffix()
 838:         );
 839:         let remote_result_path =
 840:             windows_helper_script_remote_path(helper_context.target, remote_result_name.as_str())?;
 841:         let output = execute_windows_local_utm_result_file_probe(
 842:             utm_name,
 843:             label,
 844:             helper_context.timeout,
 845:             remote_result_path.as_str(),
 846:             |remote_result_path| {
 847:                 build_windows_result_file_helper_invocation_script(
 848:                     remote_path.as_str(),
 849:                     invocation.args.as_slice(),
 850:                     remote_result_path,
 851:                     label,
 852:                 )
 853:             },
 854:         )
 855:         .map_err(|err| format!("{label} failed for {}: {err}", target.label))?;
 856:         parse_windows_runtime_report_output(output.as_str(), label, target.label.as_str())
 857:     }
 858: 
 859:     fn run_build_release_via_local_utm_report(
 860:         &self,
 861:         target: &RemoteTarget,
 862:         context: &BootstrapPhaseContext<'_>,
 863:         invocation: WindowsHelperScriptSpec,
 864:     ) -> Result<(), String> {
 865:         let helper_context = self.helper_context(target, context);
 866:         let (utm_name, _) = remote_target_local_utm(helper_context.target).ok_or_else(|| {
 867:             format!(
 868:                 "Windows bootstrap build-release requested local UTM report mode for non-UTM target {}",
 869:                 target.label
 870:             )
 871:         })?;
 872:         stage_windows_helper_support_files(&helper_context, invocation.helper_file_name)?;
 873:         let unique_bootstrap_name = format!("Bootstrap-RustyNetWindows.{}.ps1", unique_suffix());
 874:         let remote_path = stage_windows_helper_script_from_path_with_phase(
 875:             &helper_context,
 876:             windows_bootstrap_helper_script_local_path().as_path(),
 877:             unique_bootstrap_name.as_str(),
 878:             RemoteTransportPhase::AccessEstablishment,
 879:         )?;
 880:         let (_report_root, remote_manifest_path, remote_probe_path) =
 881:             build_windows_build_release_report_paths(helper_context.target)?;
 882:         let manifest_path = remote_manifest_path.clone();
 883:         let output = execute_windows_local_utm_result_file_probe(
 884:             utm_name,
 885:             "Windows bootstrap build-release",
 886:             helper_context.timeout,
 887:             remote_probe_path.as_str(),
 888:             |remote_probe_path| {
 889:                 build_windows_bootstrap_build_release_result_script(
 890:                     remote_path.as_str(),
 891:                     invocation.args.as_slice(),
 892:                     manifest_path.as_str(),
 893:                     remote_probe_path,
 894:                 )
 895:             },
 896:         )
 897:         .map_err(|err| {
 898:             format!(
 899:                 "Windows bootstrap build-release failed for {}: {err}",
 900:                 target.label
 901:             )
 902:         })?;
 903:         parse_windows_build_release_report_output(output.as_str(), target.label.as_str())
 904:     }
 905: 
 906:     fn collect_failure_diagnostics(
 907:         &self,
 908:         phase: BootstrapPhase,
 909:         target: &RemoteTarget,
 910:         context: &BootstrapPhaseContext<'_>,
 911:     ) -> Result<String, String> {
 912:         if matches!(
 913:             windows_local_utm_execution_authority(target, false),
 914:             Some(WindowsLocalUtmExecutionAuthority::StatusProbeResultFile)
 915:         ) {
 916:             let helper_context = self.helper_context(target, context);
 917:             let invocation = build_windows_diagnostics_invocation(target, phase)?;
 918:             let remote_path = stage_windows_helper_script_from_path_with_phase(
 919:                 &helper_context,
 920:                 windows_diagnostics_helper_script_local_path().as_path(),
 921:                 invocation.remote_file_name,
 922:                 RemoteTransportPhase::AccessEstablishment,
 923:             )?;
 924:             let output_root = invocation
 925:                 .args
 926:                 .chunks(2)
 927:                 .find_map(|chunk| match chunk {
 928:                     [flag, value] if flag == "-OutputRoot" => Some(value.as_str()),
 929:                     _ => None,
 930:                 })
 931:                 .ok_or_else(|| {
 932:                     format!(
 933:                         "Windows diagnostics invocation did not provide -OutputRoot for {}",
 934:                         target.label
 935:                     )
 936:                 })?;
 937:             let remote_result_name = format!(
 938:                 "{}.result.{}.json",
 939:                 sanitize_label_for_path(invocation.remote_file_name),
 940:                 unique_suffix()
 941:             );
 942:             let remote_result_path = windows_helper_script_remote_path(
 943:                 helper_context.target,
 944:                 remote_result_name.as_str(),
 945:             )?;
 946:             let output = execute_windows_local_utm_result_file_probe(
 947:                 remote_target_local_utm(helper_context.target)
 948:                     .expect("validated local UTM target")
 949:                     .0,
 950:                 "Windows diagnostics helper",
 951:                 helper_context.timeout,
 952:                 remote_result_path.as_str(),
 953:                 |remote_result_path| {
 954:                     build_windows_diagnostics_result_file_script(
 955:                         remote_path.as_str(),
 956:                         invocation.args.as_slice(),
 957:                         output_root,
 958:                         remote_result_path,
 959:                     )
 960:                 },
 961:             )
 962:             .map_err(|err| {
 963:                 format!(
 964:                     "Windows diagnostics helper failed for {}: {err}",
 965:                     target.label
 966:                 )
 967:             })?;
 968:             let parsed: serde_json::Value =
 969:                 serde_json::from_str(output.as_str()).map_err(|err| {
 970:                     format!(
 971:                         "Windows diagnostics helper returned invalid JSON for {}: {err}",
 972:                         target.label
 973:                     )
 974:                 })?;
 975:             let status = parsed
 976:                 .get("status")
 977:                 .and_then(|value| value.as_str())
 978:                 .unwrap_or("fail");
 979:             if status != "pass" {
 980:                 let reason = parsed
 981:                     .get("reason")
 982:                     .and_then(|value| value.as_str())
 983:                     .unwrap_or("windows-diagnostics-helper-failed");
 984:                 return Err(format!(
 985:                     "Windows diagnostics helper failed for {}: {} (output_root={output_root})",
 986:                     target.label, reason
 987:                 ));
 988:             }
 989:             return Ok(output_root.to_string());
 990:         }
 991:         let invocation = build_windows_diagnostics_invocation(target, phase)?;
 992:         let output =
 993:             self.capture_helper_output(target, context, invocation, "Windows diagnostics helper")?;
 994:         let output_root = output.trim();
 995:         if output_root.is_empty() {
 996:             return Err(format!(
 997:                 "Windows diagnostics helper produced no output for {}",
 998:                 target.label
 999:             ));
1000:         }
1001:         Ok(output_root.to_string())
1002:     }
1003: 
1004:     fn with_failure_diagnostics<F>(
1005:         &self,
1006:         phase: BootstrapPhase,
1007:         target: &RemoteTarget,
1008:         context: &BootstrapPhaseContext<'_>,
1009:         operation: F,
1010:     ) -> Result<(), String>
1011:     where
1012:         F: FnOnce() -> Result<(), String>,
1013:     {
1014:         operation().map_err(|err| {
1015:             if err.contains("requires --repo-url") {
1016:                 return err;
1017:             }
1018:             format_windows_phase_failure_with_diagnostics(
1019:                 err.as_str(),
1020:                 target.label.as_str(),
1021:                 self.collect_failure_diagnostics(phase, target, context),
1022:             )
1023:         })
1024:     }
1025: 
1026:     fn ensure_proven_access_for_phase(
1027:         &self,
1028:         phase: BootstrapPhase,
1029:         target: &RemoteTarget,
1030:         context: &BootstrapPhaseContext<'_>,
1031:     ) -> Result<(), String> {
1032:         if !phase_requires_proven_access(phase)
1033:             || local_utm_result_file_supported_for_phase(phase, target)
1034:         {
1035:             return Ok(());
1036:         }
1037:         ensure_windows_runtime_access_ready_for_target(
1038:             target,
1039:             context.ssh_user,
1040:             context.ssh_identity_file,
1041:             context.known_hosts_path,
1042:             context.timeout,
1043:         )
1044:         .map_err(|err| render_windows_access_gate_error(phase, target.label.as_str(), err.as_str()))
1045:     }
1046: 
1047:     fn execute_single_phase(
1048:         &self,
1049:         phase: BootstrapPhase,
1050:         target: &RemoteTarget,
1051:         context: &BootstrapPhaseContext<'_>,
1052:     ) -> Result<(), String> {
1053:         self.ensure_proven_access_for_phase(phase, target, context)?;
1054:         match phase {
1055:             BootstrapPhase::SyncSource => {
1056:                 let invocation =
1057:                     build_bootstrap_script_invocation(phase, target.label.as_str(), context)?;
1058:                 self.invoke_helper_status(
1059:                     target,
1060:                     context,
1061:                     invocation,
1062:                     "Windows bootstrap sync-source",
1063:                 )
1064:             }
1065:             BootstrapPhase::BuildRelease => {
1066:                 let invocation =
1067:                     build_bootstrap_script_invocation(phase, target.label.as_str(), context)?;
1068:                 if local_utm_result_file_supported_for_phase(BootstrapPhase::BuildRelease, target) {
1069:                     self.run_build_release_via_local_utm_report(target, context, invocation)
1070:                 } else {
1071:                     self.invoke_helper_status(
1072:                         target,
1073:                         context,
1074:                         invocation,
1075:                         "Windows bootstrap build-release",
1076:                     )
1077:                 }
1078:             }
1079:             BootstrapPhase::SmokeServiceHost => {
1080:                 let invocation = build_windows_service_host_smoke_invocation(context);
1081:                 match windows_local_utm_execution_authority(target, false) {
1082:                     Some(WindowsLocalUtmExecutionAuthority::StatusProbeResultFile) => {
1083:                         let helper_context = self.helper_context(target, context);
1084:                         let (utm_name, _) = remote_target_local_utm(helper_context.target)
1085:                             .expect("validated local UTM target");
1086:                         let local_path = windows_service_host_smoke_helper_script_local_path();
1087:                         let remote_path = stage_windows_helper_script_from_path_with_phase(
1088:                             &helper_context,
1089:                             local_path.as_path(),
1090:                             invocation.remote_file_name,
1091:                             RemoteTransportPhase::AccessEstablishment,
1092:                         )?;
1093:                         let remote_result_name = format!(
1094:                             "{}.result.{}.json",
1095:                             sanitize_label_for_path(invocation.remote_file_name),
1096:                             unique_suffix()
1097:                         );
1098:                         let remote_result_path = windows_helper_script_remote_path(
1099:                             helper_context.target,
1100:                             remote_result_name.as_str(),
1101:                         )?;
1102:                         let output = execute_windows_local_utm_result_file_probe(
1103:                             utm_name,
1104:                             "Windows service-host smoke helper",
1105:                             helper_context.timeout,
1106:                             remote_result_path.as_str(),
1107:                             |remote_result_path| {
1108:                                 build_windows_result_file_helper_invocation_script(
1109:                                     remote_path.as_str(),
1110:                                     invocation.args.as_slice(),
1111:                                     remote_result_path,
1112:                                     "Windows service-host smoke helper",
1113:                                 )
1114:                             },
1115:                         )
1116:                         .map_err(|err| {
1117:                             format!(
1118:                                 "Windows service-host smoke helper failed for {}: {err}",
1119:                                 target.label
1120:                             )
1121:                         })?;
1122:                         parse_windows_service_host_smoke_output(
1123:                             output.as_str(),
1124:                             target.label.as_str(),
1125:                         )
1126:                     }
1127:                     _ => {
1128:                         let output = self.capture_helper_output(
1129:                             target,
1130:                             context,
1131:                             invocation,
1132:                             "Windows service-host smoke helper",
1133:                         )?;
1134:                         parse_windows_service_host_smoke_output(
1135:                             output.as_str(),
1136:                             target.label.as_str(),
1137:                         )
1138:                     }
1139:                 }
1140:             }
1141:             BootstrapPhase::InstallRelease => {
1142:                 let invocation = build_windows_service_install_invocation(context);
1143:                 if local_utm_result_file_supported_for_phase(BootstrapPhase::InstallRelease, target)
1144:                 {
1145:                     self.run_helper_via_local_utm_result_file(
1146:                         target,
1147:                         context,
1148:                         invocation,
1149:                         "Windows service install helper",
1150:                     )
1151:                 } else {
1152:                     let output = self.capture_helper_output(
1153:                         target,
1154:                         context,
1155:                         invocation,
1156:                         "Windows service install helper",
1157:                     )?;
1158:                     parse_windows_runtime_report_output(
1159:                         output.as_str(),
1160:                         "Windows service install helper",
1161:                         target.label.as_str(),
1162:                     )
1163:                 }
1164:             }
1165:             BootstrapPhase::RestartRuntime => {
1166:                 let phase = if local_utm_result_file_supported_for_phase(
1167:                     BootstrapPhase::RestartRuntime,
1168:                     target,
1169:                 ) {
1170:                     RemoteTransportPhase::AccessEstablishment
1171:                 } else {
1172:                     RemoteTransportPhase::PostBootstrap
1173:                 };
1174:                 capture_remote_shell_command_for_target_with_phase(
1175:                     target,
1176:                     context.ssh_user,
1177:                     context.ssh_identity_file,
1178:                     context.known_hosts_path,
1179:                     build_windows_restart_runtime_script()?.as_str(),
1180:                     context.timeout,
1181:                     phase,
1182:                 )
1183:                 .map_err(|err| {
1184:                     format!("Windows restart-runtime failed for {}: {err}", target.label)
1185:                 })?;
1186:                 let output = self.capture_helper_output(
1187:                     target,
1188:                     context,
1189:                     build_windows_verify_invocation(context),
1190:                     "Windows verify helper after restart-runtime",
1191:                 )?;
1192:                 parse_windows_runtime_report_output(
1193:                     output.as_str(),
1194:                     "Windows verify helper after restart-runtime",
1195:                     target.label.as_str(),
1196:                 )
1197:             }
1198:             BootstrapPhase::VerifyRuntime => {
1199:                 let invocation = build_windows_verify_invocation(context);
1200:                 if local_utm_result_file_supported_for_phase(BootstrapPhase::VerifyRuntime, target)
1201:                 {
1202:                     self.run_helper_via_local_utm_result_file(
1203:                         target,
1204:                         context,
1205:                         invocation,
1206:                         "Windows verify helper",
1207:                     )
1208:                 } else {
1209:                     let output = self.capture_helper_output(
1210:                         target,
1211:                         context,
1212:                         invocation,
1213:                         "Windows verify helper",
1214:                     )?;
1215:                     parse_windows_runtime_report_output(
1216:                         output.as_str(),
1217:                         "Windows verify helper",
1218:                         target.label.as_str(),
1219:                     )
1220:                 }
1221:             }
1222:             BootstrapPhase::All => {
1223:                 for subphase in [
1224:                     BootstrapPhase::SyncSource,
1225:                     BootstrapPhase::BuildRelease,
1226:                     BootstrapPhase::SmokeServiceHost,
1227:                     BootstrapPhase::InstallRelease,
1228:                     BootstrapPhase::RestartRuntime,
1229:                     BootstrapPhase::VerifyRuntime,
1230:                 ] {
1231:                     self.execute_phase(subphase, target, context)?;
1232:                 }
1233:                 Ok(())
1234:             }
1235:         }
1236:     }
1237: }
1238: 
1239: impl VmBootstrapProvider for WindowsBootstrapProvider {
1240:     fn platform(&self) -> VmGuestPlatform {
1241:         VmGuestPlatform::Windows
1242:     }
1243: 
1244:     fn execute_phase(
1245:         &self,
1246:         phase: BootstrapPhase,
1247:         target: &RemoteTarget,
1248:         context: &BootstrapPhaseContext<'_>,
1249:     ) -> Result<(), String> {
1250:         if target.platform_profile.platform != VmGuestPlatform::Windows {
1251:             return Err(format!(
1252:                 "Windows bootstrap provider received non-Windows target: {}",
1253:                 target.label
1254:             ));
1255:         }
1256: 
1257:         if phase == BootstrapPhase::All {
1258:             return self.execute_single_phase(phase, target, context);
1259:         }
1260: 
1261:         self.with_failure_diagnostics(phase, target, context, || {
1262:             self.execute_single_phase(phase, target, context)
1263:         })
1264:     }
1265: }

  237: /// Standalone Windows-only security validation. Skips the Linux fleet entirely

  239: /// W2.1 security verifiers) against a single Windows UTM guest. Useful for

  256:     /// recorded as a waived pass rather than a hard failure so that

  264:     pub distribute_windows_assignment_bundle: Option<PathBuf>,

  269: pub fn run_validate_windows_security(
  270:     config: &VmLabValidateWindowsSecurityConfig,
  271: ) -> Result<String, String> {
  272:     std::fs::create_dir_all(&config.report_dir).map_err(|err| {
  273:         format!(
  274:             "create report dir {} failed: {err}",
  275:             config.report_dir.display()
  276:         )
  277:     })?;
  278:     let outcomes = run_windows_orchestration_stages_with_options(
  279:         config.windows_vm.as_str(),
  280:         config.inventory_path.as_path(),
  281:         config.ssh_identity_file.as_path(),
  282:         config.known_hosts_path.as_deref(),
  283:         config.ssh_port,
  284:         config.utm_documents_root.as_deref(),
  285:         config.utmctl_path.as_deref(),
  286:         config.dry_run,
  287:         config.report_dir.as_path(),
  288:         WindowsOrchestrationOptions {
  289:             skip_access_bootstrap: config.skip_access_bootstrap,
  290:             skip_install: config.skip_install,
  291:             no_fail_on_authenticode: config.no_fail_on_authenticode,
  292:             distribute_windows_membership_bundle: config
  293:                 .distribute_windows_membership_bundle
  294:                 .clone(),
  295:             distribute_windows_assignment_bundle: config
  296:                 .distribute_windows_assignment_bundle
  297:                 .clone(),
  298:             distribute_windows_traversal_bundle: config.distribute_windows_traversal_bundle.clone(),
  299:             distribute_windows_dns_zone_bundle: config.distribute_windows_dns_zone_bundle.clone(),
  300:             // Verifier-key distribution opts in via the orchestrate-live-lab
  301:             // path (which auto-populates them from the local report state
  302:             // dir). vm-lab-validate-windows-security has not yet grown CLI
  303:             // flags for these; default to None so the verifier-key stages
  304:             // emit Skipped with "no local bundle path provided".
  305:             ..Default::default()
  306:         },
  307:     );
  308:     let summary_path = config.report_dir.join("windows_security_validation.json");
  309:     let payload = serde_json::json!({
  310:         "schema_version": 1,
  311:         "windows_vm": config.windows_vm,
  312:         "dry_run": config.dry_run,
  313:         "stages": outcomes
  314:             .iter()
  315:             .map(|o| {
  316:                 serde_json::json!({
  317:                     "stage": o.stage,
  318:                     "status": format!("{:?}", o.status).to_ascii_lowercase(),
  319:                     "summary": o.summary,
  320:                     "artifacts": o.artifacts.clone(),
  321:                 })
  322:             })
  323:             .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
  324:     });
  325:     let serialized = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&payload)
  326:         .map_err(|err| format!("serialize Windows security validation report failed: {err}"))?;
  327:     std::fs::write(summary_path.as_path(), serialized.as_str()).map_err(|err| {
  328:         format!(
  329:             "write Windows security validation report to {} failed: {err}",
  330:             summary_path.display()
  331:         )
  332:     })?;
  333:     println!("{serialized}");
  334:     let any_failed = outcomes.iter().any(|o| o.status == VmLabStageStatus::Fail);
  335:     if any_failed {
  336:         return Err(format!(
  337:             "Windows security validation reported one or more stage failures; report at {}",
  338:             summary_path.display()
  339:         ));
  340:     }
  341:     Ok(format!(
  342:         "Windows security validation passed for {}; report at {}",
  343:         config.windows_vm,
  344:         summary_path.display()
  345:     ))
  346: }

  348: /// Operator-facing config for the `vm-lab-distribute-windows-state`
  349: /// subcommand: pure distribution path. Pushes one or more pre-built
  350: /// signed bundles to a reviewed Windows guest without running the
  351: /// security validators. Use when the security validators have already
  352: /// passed in a prior run and you only want to refresh trust state.
  353: ///
  354: /// At least one of the four bundle paths must be `Some`. The
  355: /// validator path
  356: /// (`vm-lab-validate-windows-security --distribute-windows-*-bundle`)
  357: /// is the right call when validators + distribution should run in the
  358: /// same invocation.
  359: #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
  360: pub struct VmLabDistributeWindowsStateConfig {
  361:     pub inventory_path: PathBuf,
  362:     pub windows_vm: String,
  363:     pub ssh_identity_file: PathBuf,
  364:     pub known_hosts_path: Option<PathBuf>,
  365:     pub report_dir: PathBuf,
  366:     pub dry_run: bool,
  367:     pub membership_bundle: Option<PathBuf>,
  368:     pub assignment_bundle: Option<PathBuf>,
  369:     pub traversal_bundle: Option<PathBuf>,
  370:     pub dns_zone_bundle: Option<PathBuf>,
  371: }
  372: 
  373: /// Pure-distribution dispatch: walks the four optional bundle paths
  374: /// and calls the corresponding `run_distribute_windows_*_stage`
  375: /// wrapper for each one provided. Writes a typed JSON report under
  376: /// `<report_dir>/windows_state_distribution.json` mirroring the
  377: /// validate-windows-security report shape so downstream tooling can
  378: /// consume both with one parser.
  379: pub fn run_distribute_windows_state(
  380:     config: &VmLabDistributeWindowsStateConfig,
  381: ) -> Result<String, String> {
  382:     let any_bundle = config.membership_bundle.is_some()
  383:         || config.assignment_bundle.is_some()
  384:         || config.traversal_bundle.is_some()
  385:         || config.dns_zone_bundle.is_some();
  386:     if !any_bundle {
  387:         return Err(
  388:             "at least one of --membership-bundle, --assignment-bundle, --traversal-bundle, --dns-zone-bundle is required"
  389:                 .to_string(),
  390:         );
  391:     }
  392: 
  393:     std::fs::create_dir_all(&config.report_dir).map_err(|err| {
  394:         format!(
  395:             "create report dir {} failed: {err}",
  396:             config.report_dir.display()
  397:         )
  398:     })?;
  399:     let logs_dir = config.report_dir.join("logs");
  400:     let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(&logs_dir);
  401: 
  402:     type DistributeFn =
  403:         fn(&str, &Path, &Path, Option<&Path>, &Path) -> Result<(String, String), (String, String)>;
  404: 
  405:     let dispatch_one = |stage_name: &'static str,
  406:                         log_filename: &str,
  407:                         bundle: Option<&Path>,
  408:                         dispatch: DistributeFn|
  409:      -> VmLabStageOutcome {
  410:         let log_path = logs_dir.join(log_filename);
  411:         if config.dry_run {
  412:             return stage_outcome(
  413:                 stage_name,
  414:                 VmLabStageStatus::Skipped,
  415:                 format!(
  416:                     "dry-run: would distribute {stage_name} bundle to {}",
  417:                     config.windows_vm
  418:                 ),
  419:                 vec![],
  420:             );
  421:         }
  422:         let Some(bundle_path) = bundle else {
  423:             return stage_outcome(
  424:                 stage_name,
  425:                 VmLabStageStatus::Skipped,
  426:                 format!("skipped: no local bundle path provided for {stage_name}"),
  427:                 vec![],
  428:             );
  429:         };
  430:         match dispatch(
  431:             config.windows_vm.as_str(),
  432:             config.inventory_path.as_path(),
  433:             config.ssh_identity_file.as_path(),
  434:             config.known_hosts_path.as_deref(),
  435:             bundle_path,
  436:         ) {
  437:             Ok((summary, raw_report)) => {
  438:                 let log_body = if raw_report.is_empty() {
  439:                     summary.clone()
  440:                 } else {
  441:                     format!("{summary}\n--- raw report ---\n{raw_report}")
  442:                 };
  443:                 let _ = std::fs::write(log_path.as_path(), log_body.as_str());
  444:                 stage_outcome(stage_name, VmLabStageStatus::Pass, summary, vec![log_path])
  445:             }
  446:             Err((reason, raw_report)) => {
  447:                 let log_body = if raw_report.is_empty() {
  448:                     reason.clone()
  449:                 } else {
  450:                     format!("{reason}\n--- raw report ---\n{raw_report}")
  451:                 };
  452:                 let _ = std::fs::write(log_path.as_path(), log_body.as_str());
  453:                 stage_outcome(
  454:                     stage_name,
  455:                     VmLabStageStatus::Fail,
  456:                     format!(
  457:                         "{stage_name} distribution failed for {}: {reason}",
  458:                         config.windows_vm
  459:                     ),
  460:                     vec![log_path],
  461:                 )
  462:             }
  463:         }
  464:     };
  465: 
  466:     let outcomes: Vec<VmLabStageOutcome> = [
  467:         dispatch_one(
  468:             "distribute_windows_membership",
  469:             "distribute_windows_membership.log",
  470:             config.membership_bundle.as_deref(),
  471:             run_distribute_windows_membership_stage,
  472:         ),
  473:         dispatch_one(
  474:             "distribute_windows_assignment",
  475:             "distribute_windows_assignment.log",
  476:             config.assignment_bundle.as_deref(),
  477:             run_distribute_windows_assignment_stage,
  478:         ),
  479:         dispatch_one(
  480:             "distribute_windows_traversal",
  481:             "distribute_windows_traversal.log",
  482:             config.traversal_bundle.as_deref(),
  483:             run_distribute_windows_traversal_stage,
  484:         ),
  485:         dispatch_one(
  486:             "distribute_windows_dns_zone",
  487:             "distribute_windows_dns_zone.log",
  488:             config.dns_zone_bundle.as_deref(),
  489:             run_distribute_windows_dns_zone_stage,
  490:         ),
  491:     ]
  492:     .to_vec();
  493: 
  494:     let summary_path = config.report_dir.join("windows_state_distribution.json");
  495:     let payload = serde_json::json!({
  496:         "schema_version": 1,
  497:         "windows_vm": config.windows_vm,
  498:         "dry_run": config.dry_run,
  499:         "stages": outcomes
  500:             .iter()
  501:             .map(|o| {
  502:                 serde_json::json!({
  503:                     "stage": o.stage,
  504:                     "status": format!("{:?}", o.status).to_ascii_lowercase(),
  505:                     "summary": o.summary,
  506:                     "artifacts": o.artifacts.clone(),
  507:                 })
  508:             })
  509:             .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
  510:     });
  511:     let serialized = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&payload)
  512:         .map_err(|err| format!("serialize Windows state distribution report failed: {err}"))?;
  513:     std::fs::write(summary_path.as_path(), serialized.as_str()).map_err(|err| {
  514:         format!(
  515:             "write Windows state distribution report to {} failed: {err}",
  516:             summary_path.display()
  517:         )
  518:     })?;
  519:     println!("{serialized}");
  520:     let any_failed = outcomes.iter().any(|o| o.status == VmLabStageStatus::Fail);
  521:     if any_failed {
  522:         return Err(format!(
  523:             "Windows state distribution reported one or more stage failures; report at {}",
  524:             summary_path.display()
  525:         ));
  526:     }
  527:     Ok(format!(
  528:         "Windows state distribution completed for {}; report at {}",
  529:         config.windows_vm,
  530:         summary_path.display()
  531:     ))
  532: }
  533: 
  534: /// Reviewed source paths on the Linux exit guest. Match the
  535: /// `RUSTYNET_*_BUNDLE` environment variables baked into the
  536: /// `scripts/systemd/rustynetd.service` unit file.
  537: pub const LINUX_EXIT_MEMBERSHIP_SNAPSHOT_PATH: &str = "/var/lib/rustynet/membership.snapshot";
  538: pub const LINUX_EXIT_ASSIGNMENT_BUNDLE_PATH: &str = "/var/lib/rustynet/rustynetd.assignment";
  539: pub const LINUX_EXIT_TRAVERSAL_BUNDLE_PATH: &str = "/var/lib/rustynet/rustynetd.traversal";
  540: pub const LINUX_EXIT_DNS_ZONE_BUNDLE_PATH: &str = "/var/lib/rustynet/rustynetd.dns-zone";
  541: 
  542: /// Operator-facing config for the
  543: /// `vm-lab-pull-windows-state-from-linux-exit` subcommand.
  544: ///
  545: /// Pulls the four signed bundles from the canonical Linux exit
  546: /// locations down to a local staging directory. The output paths can
  547: /// then be fed straight into
  548: /// `vm-lab-distribute-windows-state --membership-bundle … --assignment-bundle …`
  549: /// to push them onto a Windows guest, closing the heterogeneous
  550: /// (Linux exit → orchestrator host → Windows peer) loop end-to-end.
  551: ///
  552: /// The pull step is read-only on the Linux exit: the daemon's
  553: /// canonical bundle paths are owned by the `rustynetd` group with
  554: /// `0640` perms, but the SCP probe runs as a non-root user (the
  555: /// inventory's configured `ssh_user` if any, otherwise the SSH
  556: /// default). Operators must ensure their SSH user has read access to
  557: /// `/var/lib/rustynet/` on the Linux exit (typically by adding the
  558: /// user to the `rustynetd` group); the helper surfaces SCP exit
  559: /// codes so a permission failure is honest, not silent.
  560: #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
  561: pub struct VmLabPullWindowsStateFromLinuxExitConfig {
  562:     pub inventory_path: PathBuf,
  563:     pub linux_exit_alias: String,
  564:     pub ssh_identity_file: PathBuf,
  565:     pub known_hosts_path: Option<PathBuf>,
  566:     pub dest_dir: PathBuf,
  567:     pub report_dir: PathBuf,
  568:     pub dry_run: bool,
  569: }
  570: 
  571: /// Output paths after a successful
  572: /// `run_pull_windows_state_from_linux_exit`. Each field is the local
  573: /// path of the pulled bundle, suitable for feeding into
  574: /// `VmLabDistributeWindowsStateConfig`.
  575: #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
  576: pub struct PulledLinuxExitBundles {
  577:     pub membership_snapshot: PathBuf,
  578:     pub assignment_bundle: PathBuf,
  579:     pub traversal_bundle: PathBuf,
  580:     pub dns_zone_bundle: PathBuf,
  581: }
  582: 
  583: /// Pull the four signed bundles from a Linux exit guest down to a
  584: /// local staging directory. Writes a typed JSON report under
  585: /// `<report_dir>/windows_state_pull_from_linux_exit.json` with one
  586: /// entry per bundle (name + status + local_path + summary). On Pass
  587: /// the local paths are returned in `PulledLinuxExitBundles`. On Fail
  588: /// the function returns an `Err` with the report path so operators
  589: /// can see exactly which bundle's SCP failed and why.
  590: pub fn run_pull_windows_state_from_linux_exit(
  591:     config: &VmLabPullWindowsStateFromLinuxExitConfig,
  592: ) -> Result<(String, PulledLinuxExitBundles), String> {
  593:     std::fs::create_dir_all(&config.report_dir).map_err(|err| {
  594:         format!(
  595:             "create report dir {} failed: {err}",
  596:             config.report_dir.display()
  597:         )
  598:     })?;
  599:     std::fs::create_dir_all(&config.dest_dir).map_err(|err| {
  600:         format!(
  601:             "create dest dir {} failed: {err}",
  602:             config.dest_dir.display()
  603:         )
  604:     })?;
  605: 
  606:     let membership_local = config.dest_dir.join("membership.snapshot");
  607:     let assignment_local = config.dest_dir.join("rustynetd.assignment");
  608:     let traversal_local = config.dest_dir.join("rustynetd.traversal");
  609:     let dns_zone_local = config.dest_dir.join("rustynetd.dns-zone");
  610: 
  611:     let bundles: [(&str, &str, &Path); 4] = [
  612:         (
  613:             "membership_snapshot",
  614:             LINUX_EXIT_MEMBERSHIP_SNAPSHOT_PATH,
  615:             membership_local.as_path(),
  616:         ),
  617:         (
  618:             "assignment_bundle",
  619:             LINUX_EXIT_ASSIGNMENT_BUNDLE_PATH,
  620:             assignment_local.as_path(),
  621:         ),
  622:         (
  623:             "traversal_bundle",
  624:             LINUX_EXIT_TRAVERSAL_BUNDLE_PATH,
  625:             traversal_local.as_path(),
  626:         ),
  627:         (
  628:             "dns_zone_bundle",
  629:             LINUX_EXIT_DNS_ZONE_BUNDLE_PATH,
  630:             dns_zone_local.as_path(),
  631:         ),
  632:     ];
  633: 
  634:     let mut outcomes: Vec<VmLabStageOutcome> = Vec::new();
  635: 
  636:     if config.dry_run {
  637:         for (label, src, dst) in bundles.iter() {
  638:             outcomes.push(stage_outcome(
  639:                 label,
  640:                 VmLabStageStatus::Skipped,
  641:                 format!(
  642:                     "dry-run: would scp {src} from {} to {}",
  643:                     config.linux_exit_alias,
  644:                     dst.display()
  645:                 ),
  646:                 vec![],
  647:             ));
  648:         }
  649:     } else {
  650:         let targets = resolve_remote_targets(
  651:             config.inventory_path.as_path(),
  652:             std::slice::from_ref(&config.linux_exit_alias),
  653:             false,
  654:             &[],
  655:         )?;
  656:         let target = targets
  657:             .into_iter()
  658:             .next()
  659:             .ok_or_else(|| format!("no target resolved for alias {}", config.linux_exit_alias))?;
  660:         if target.platform_profile.platform != VmGuestPlatform::Linux {
  661:             return Err(format!(
  662:                 "alias {} resolved to non-Linux platform: {} (pull source must be a Linux exit)",
  663:                 config.linux_exit_alias,
  664:                 target.platform_profile.platform.as_str()
  665:             ));
  666:         }
  667:         let timeout = timeout_or_default(0, DEFAULT_RUN_TIMEOUT_SECS);
  668: 
  669:         for (label, src, dst) in bundles.iter() {
  670:             let result = scp_from_remote(
  671:                 &target,
  672:                 None,
  673:                 Some(config.ssh_identity_file.as_path()),
  674:                 config.known_hosts_path.as_deref(),
  675:                 src,
  676:                 dst,
  677:                 timeout,
  678:             );
  679:             let outcome = match result {
  680:                 Ok(status) if status.success() => {
  681:                     if !dst.is_file() {
  682:                         stage_outcome(
  683:                             label,
  684:                             VmLabStageStatus::Fail,
  685:                             format!(
  686:                                 "scp reported success but local destination is missing: {}",
  687:                                 dst.display()
  688:                             ),
  689:                             vec![],
  690:                         )
  691:                     } else {
  692:                         stage_outcome(
  693:                             label,
  694:                             VmLabStageStatus::Pass,
  695:                             format!(
  696:                                 "pulled {src} from {} to {}",
  697:                                 config.linux_exit_alias,
  698:                                 dst.display()
  699:                             ),
  700:                             vec![dst.to_path_buf()],
  701:                         )
  702:                     }
  703:                 }
  704:                 Ok(status) => stage_outcome(
  705:                     label,
  706:                     VmLabStageStatus::Fail,
  707:                     format!(
  708:                         "scp of {src} from {} exited non-zero: {}",
  709:                         config.linux_exit_alias,
  710:                         status_code(status)
  711:                     ),
  712:                     vec![],
  713:                 ),
  714:                 Err(err) => stage_outcome(
  715:                     label,
  716:                     VmLabStageStatus::Fail,
  717:                     format!(
  718:                         "scp of {src} from {} failed: {err}",
  719:                         config.linux_exit_alias
  720:                     ),
  721:                     vec![],
  722:                 ),
  723:             };
  724:             outcomes.push(outcome);
  725:         }
  726:     }
  727: 
  728:     let summary_path = config
  729:         .report_dir
  730:         .join("windows_state_pull_from_linux_exit.json");
  731:     let payload = serde_json::json!({
  732:         "schema_version": 1,
  733:         "linux_exit_alias": config.linux_exit_alias,
  734:         "dest_dir": config.dest_dir.display().to_string(),
  735:         "dry_run": config.dry_run,
  736:         "stages": outcomes
  737:             .iter()
  738:             .map(|o| {
  739:                 serde_json::json!({
  740:                     "stage": o.stage,
  741:                     "status": format!("{:?}", o.status).to_ascii_lowercase(),
  742:                     "summary": o.summary,
  743:                     "artifacts": o.artifacts.clone(),
  744:                 })
  745:             })
  746:             .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
  747:     });
  748:     let serialized = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&payload)
  749:         .map_err(|err| format!("serialize Windows state pull report failed: {err}"))?;
  750:     std::fs::write(summary_path.as_path(), serialized.as_str()).map_err(|err| {
  751:         format!(
  752:             "write Windows state pull report to {} failed: {err}",
  753:             summary_path.display()
  754:         )
  755:     })?;
  756:     println!("{serialized}");
  757: 
  758:     let any_failed = outcomes.iter().any(|o| o.status == VmLabStageStatus::Fail);
  759:     if any_failed {
  760:         return Err(format!(
  761:             "Windows state pull from Linux exit reported one or more bundle failures; report at {}",
  762:             summary_path.display()
  763:         ));
  764:     }
  765: 
  766:     Ok((
  767:         format!(
  768:             "Windows state pulled from Linux exit {}; report at {}",
  769:             config.linux_exit_alias,
  770:             summary_path.display()
  771:         ),
  772:         PulledLinuxExitBundles {
  773:             membership_snapshot: membership_local,
  774:             assignment_bundle: assignment_local,
  775:             traversal_bundle: traversal_local,
  776:             dns_zone_bundle: dns_zone_local,
  777:         },
  778:     ))
  779: }

  791:     pub fifth_client_vm: Option<String>,
  792:     pub ssh_identity_file: PathBuf,
  793:     pub known_hosts_path: Option<PathBuf>,
  794:     pub require_same_network: bool,
  795:     pub script_path: PathBuf,
  796:     pub report_dir: PathBuf,
  797:     pub source_mode: Option<String>,
  798:     pub repo_ref: Option<String>,
  799:     pub max_parallel_node_workers: Option<usize>,
  800:     pub skip_gates: bool,

  813:     /// Alias of an optional Windows 11 UTM VM to bootstrap and validate as a client node.

  815:     /// Windows-specific bootstrap and validation stages after all Linux stages pass.

  817:     /// Skip all Linux stages and run only the Windows bootstrap and validation stages.
  818:     /// Requires `--windows-vm`. Use when the Linux lab is already known-good and only
  819:     /// the Windows client path needs to be exercised.
