  822:     /// recorded as a waived pass rather than a hard failure, allowing
  823:     /// `validate_windows_mesh_join` to proceed. Use for dev/lab builds
  824:     /// that are not yet Authenticode-signed.
  825:     pub no_fail_on_authenticode: bool,
  826:     /// When true, after the live-lab install + 5-node test path completes,
  827:     /// dispatch the new `rustynetd linux-*-check` daemon-side validator
  828:     /// chainer against every selected Linux alias. Adds 6 stages × N peers
  829:     /// to the orchestration report. Off by default to keep existing
  830:     /// orchestrate-live-lab latency unchanged; flip on when the operator
  831:     /// wants live-evidence proof that each Linux peer's daemon-side state
  832:     /// matches the reviewed posture (W3.2-followup-7 verifier set).
  833:     pub validate_linux_daemon_state: bool,
  834:     /// When non-empty, route to the Rust-native `NodeAdapter` pipeline
  835:     /// instead of the bash orchestrator. Each entry is parsed from a
  836:     /// `--node <alias>:<role>` CLI flag. (W5.1 opt-in; W5.6 wires the
  837:     /// translation + routing surface; default flips to Rust path once
  838:     /// W5.5 cross-orchestrator parity evidence is captured.)
  839:     pub node_assignments: Vec<orchestrator::role_assignment::NodeRoleAssignment>,
  840:     /// Transitional escape hatch (W5.6, removed in W5.7). When set, force
  841:     /// the bash orchestrator path even if other flags would otherwise
  842:     /// route to the Rust orchestrator. Mutually exclusive with `--node`
  843:     /// because the bash orchestrator does not consume `<alias>:<role>`
  844:     /// pairs and would silently ignore them.
  845:     pub legacy_bash_orchestrator: bool,
  846:     /// CIDR list (comma-separated, e.g. `192.168.64.0/24`) propagated to
  847:     /// the Linux bootstrap script as `SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS`. The Rust path
  848:     /// pipes it into `rustynet ops e2e-bootstrap-host --ssh-allow-cidrs`,
  849:     /// which rejects an empty value, so the flag is effectively required
  850:     /// for `--node`-driven live lab runs.
  851:     pub orchestrate_ssh_allow_cidrs: Option<String>,
  852: }

  854: /// Validate cross-flag invariants for `vm-lab-orchestrate-live-lab`.
  855: ///
  856: /// Currently:
  857: /// - `--legacy-bash-orchestrator` is mutually exclusive with `--node`
  858: ///   (the bash path cannot consume role assignments; silently ignoring
  859: ///   them would mask operator intent).
  860: pub fn validate_orchestrate_live_lab_config(
  861:     config: &VmLabOrchestrateLiveLabConfig,
  862: ) -> Result<(), String> {
  863:     if config.legacy_bash_orchestrator && !config.node_assignments.is_empty() {
  864:         return Err(
  865:             "--legacy-bash-orchestrator is mutually exclusive with --node; \
  866:              pass either the legacy --*-vm flag set or --node assignments, not both"
  867:                 .to_string(),
  868:         );
  869:     }
  870:     Ok(())
  871: }
  872: 
  873: /// Configuration for `vm-lab-diff-orchestrator-parity`. The subcommand is
  874: /// the W5.5 evidence harness: takes two `parity_input.json` snapshots
  875: /// (one bash, one Rust), emits a machine-readable parity diff to
  876: /// `--output`, and exits non-zero on any drift.
  877: #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
  878: pub struct VmLabDiffOrchestratorParityConfig {
  879:     pub left_path: PathBuf,
  880:     pub right_path: PathBuf,
  881:     pub output_path: PathBuf,
  882: }
  883: 
  884: pub fn execute_ops_vm_lab_diff_orchestrator_parity(
  885:     config: VmLabDiffOrchestratorParityConfig,
  886: ) -> Result<String, String> {
  887:     let left_bytes = fs::read(&config.left_path).map_err(|err| {
  888:         format!(
  889:             "read left parity input '{}': {err}",
  890:             config.left_path.display()
  891:         )
  892:     })?;
  893:     let right_bytes = fs::read(&config.right_path).map_err(|err| {
  894:         format!(
  895:             "read right parity input '{}': {err}",
  896:             config.right_path.display()
  897:         )
  898:     })?;
  899:     let left: orchestrator::report::LiveLabRunReport = serde_json::from_slice(&left_bytes)
  900:         .map_err(|err| {
  901:             format!(
  902:                 "parse left parity input '{}': {err}",
  903:                 config.left_path.display()
  904:             )
  905:         })?;
  906:     let right: orchestrator::report::LiveLabRunReport = serde_json::from_slice(&right_bytes)
  907:         .map_err(|err| {
  908:             format!(
  909:                 "parse right parity input '{}': {err}",
  910:                 config.right_path.display()
  911:             )
  912:         })?;
  913:     let diff = orchestrator::parity::diff_live_lab_reports(&left, &right);
  914:     let body =
  915:         serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&diff).map_err(|err| format!("serialize parity diff: {err}"))?;
  916:     if let Some(parent) = config.output_path.parent()
  917:         && !parent.as_os_str().is_empty()
  918:     {
  919:         fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|err| {
  920:             format!(
  921:                 "create parity diff output directory '{}': {err}",
  922:                 parent.display()
  923:             )
  924:         })?;
  925:     }
  926:     fs::write(&config.output_path, &body).map_err(|err| {
  927:         format!(
  928:             "write parity diff to '{}': {err}",
  929:             config.output_path.display()
  930:         )
  931:     })?;
  932:     let summary = format!(
  933:         "parity_diff: pass={} stages={} stages_only_left={} stages_only_right={} \
  934:          node_count_left={} node_count_right={}",
  935:         diff.overall_parity_pass,
  936:         diff.stages.len(),
  937:         diff.stages_only_in_left.len(),
  938:         diff.stages_only_in_right.len(),
  939:         diff.node_count_left,
  940:         diff.node_count_right,
  941:     );
  942:     if diff.overall_parity_pass {
  943:         Ok(summary)
  944:     } else {
  945:         Err(summary)
  946:     }
  947: }
  948: 
  949: /// Build the deprecation-warning lines (newline-free, one per item) that
  950: /// callers should emit on stderr when the operator invoked
  951: /// `vm-lab-orchestrate-live-lab` with the legacy `--*-vm` flag set but
  952: /// without `--node` and without `--legacy-bash-orchestrator`.
  953: ///
  954: /// The warning is informational only: routing is unchanged for now (the
  955: /// bash orchestrator stays default until W5.5 parity is proven). Once
  956: /// proven, the default flips and the warning escalates the operator's
  957: /// migration path.
  958: pub fn legacy_role_flags_deprecation_warnings(
  959:     config: &VmLabOrchestrateLiveLabConfig,
  960: ) -> Vec<String> {
  961:     if config.legacy_bash_orchestrator || !config.node_assignments.is_empty() {
  962:         return Vec::new();
  963:     }
  964:     let any_legacy_role_flag_set = config.exit_vm.is_some()
  965:         || config.client_vm.is_some()
  966:         || config.entry_vm.is_some()
  967:         || config.aux_vm.is_some()
  968:         || config.extra_vm.is_some()
  969:         || config.fifth_client_vm.is_some()
  970:         || config.windows_vm.is_some();
  971:     if !any_legacy_role_flag_set {
  972:         return Vec::new();
  973:     }
  974:     vec![
  975:         "deprecated: --exit-vm/--client-vm/--entry-vm/--aux-vm/--extra-vm/\
  976:          --fifth-client-vm/--windows-vm are transitional aliases; prefer \
  977:          repeated --node <alias>:<role> flags for the same role assignment."
  978:             .to_string(),
  979:         "the bash orchestrator remains the default execution path; once \
  980:          W5.5 cross-orchestrator parity evidence is captured the Rust \
  981:          orchestrator becomes default and the legacy flags will translate \
  982:          to --node automatically. Pass --legacy-bash-orchestrator to lock \
  983:          in the bash path explicitly."
  984:             .to_string(),
  985:     ]
  986: }

 1238: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
 1239: #[serde(rename_all = "snake_case")]
 1240: pub enum VmGuestPlatform {
 1241:     Linux,
 1242:     Macos,
 1243:     Windows,
 1244:     Ios,
 1245:     Android,
 1246: }
 1247: 
 1248: impl VmGuestPlatform {
 1249:     fn parse(value: &str) -> Result<Self, String> {
 1250:         match value.trim().to_ascii_lowercase().as_str() {
 1251:             "linux" | "debian" | "ubuntu" | "fedora" | "mint" => Ok(Self::Linux),
 1252:             "macos" | "mac_os" | "osx" | "mac" | "darwin" => Ok(Self::Macos),
 1253:             "windows" | "windows11" | "windows_11" | "win11" | "windows10" | "windows_10" => {
 1254:                 Ok(Self::Windows)
 1255:             }
 1256:             "ios" | "iphoneos" | "ipad_os" | "ipados" => Ok(Self::Ios),
 1257:             "android" => Ok(Self::Android),
 1258:             other => Err(format!("unsupported vm guest platform: {other}")),
 1259:         }
 1260:     }
 1261: 
 1262:     fn infer(
 1263:         explicit: Option<Self>,
 1264:         os_name: Option<&str>,
 1265:         alias: &str,
 1266:         utm_name: Option<&str>,
 1267:     ) -> Self {
 1268:         if let Some(platform) = explicit {
 1269:             return platform;
 1270:         }
 1271: 
 1272:         let mut haystacks = vec![alias.to_ascii_lowercase()];
 1273:         if let Some(value) = os_name {
 1274:             haystacks.push(value.to_ascii_lowercase());
 1275:         }
 1276:         if let Some(value) = utm_name {
 1277:             haystacks.push(value.to_ascii_lowercase());
 1278:         }
 1279: 
 1280:         if haystacks.iter().any(|value| {
 1281:             value.contains("windows") || value.contains("win11") || value.contains("win10")
 1282:         }) {
 1283:             Self::Windows
 1284:         } else if haystacks.iter().any(|value| {
 1285:             value.contains("macos")
 1286:                 || value.contains("mac os")
 1287:                 || value.contains("os x")
 1288:                 || value.contains("darwin")
 1289:         }) {
 1290:             Self::Macos
 1291:         } else if haystacks.iter().any(|value| {
 1292:             value.contains("ios") || value.contains("iphone") || value.contains("ipad")
 1293:         }) {
 1294:             Self::Ios
 1295:         } else if haystacks.iter().any(|value| value.contains("android")) {
 1296:             Self::Android
 1297:         } else {
 1298:             Self::Linux
 1299:         }
 1300:     }
 1301: 
 1302:     fn as_str(self) -> &'static str {
 1303:         match self {
 1304:             Self::Linux => "linux",
 1305:             Self::Macos => "macos",
 1306:             Self::Windows => "windows",
 1307:             Self::Ios => "ios",
 1308:             Self::Android => "android",
 1309:         }
 1310:     }
 1311: }

 1326:             "unsupported" | "none" => Ok(Self::Unsupported),

 1400: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
 1401: pub struct VmPlatformProfile {
 1402:     pub platform: VmGuestPlatform,
 1403:     pub remote_shell: VmRemoteShell,
 1404:     pub guest_exec_mode: VmGuestExecMode,
 1405:     pub service_manager: VmServiceManager,

 1408: fn controller_utm_name(controller: Option<&VmController>) -> Option<&str> {
 1409:     match controller {
 1410:         Some(VmController::LocalUtm { utm_name, .. }) => Some(utm_name.as_str()),
 1411:         None => None,
 1412:     }
 1413: }
 1414: 
 1415: fn default_platform_profile(platform: VmGuestPlatform) -> VmPlatformProfile {
 1416:     match platform {
 1417:         VmGuestPlatform::Linux => VmPlatformProfile {
 1418:             platform,
 1419:             remote_shell: VmRemoteShell::Posix,
 1420:             guest_exec_mode: VmGuestExecMode::LinuxBash,
 1421:             service_manager: VmServiceManager::Systemd,
 1422:         },
 1423:         VmGuestPlatform::Macos => VmPlatformProfile {
 1424:             platform,
 1425:             remote_shell: VmRemoteShell::Posix,
 1426:             guest_exec_mode: VmGuestExecMode::MacosPosix,
 1427:             service_manager: VmServiceManager::Launchd,
 1428:         },
 1429:         VmGuestPlatform::Windows => VmPlatformProfile {
 1430:             platform,
 1431:             remote_shell: VmRemoteShell::Powershell,
 1432:             guest_exec_mode: VmGuestExecMode::WindowsPowershell,
 1433:             service_manager: VmServiceManager::WindowsService,
 1434:         },
 1435:         VmGuestPlatform::Ios | VmGuestPlatform::Android => VmPlatformProfile {
 1436:             platform,
 1437:             remote_shell: VmRemoteShell::Unsupported,
 1438:             guest_exec_mode: VmGuestExecMode::Unsupported,
 1439:             service_manager: VmServiceManager::Unsupported,
 1440:         },
 1441:     }
 1442: }
 1443: 
 1444: fn effective_platform_profile(
 1445:     explicit_platform: Option<VmGuestPlatform>,
 1446:     explicit_remote_shell: Option<VmRemoteShell>,
 1447:     explicit_guest_exec_mode: Option<VmGuestExecMode>,
 1448:     explicit_service_manager: Option<VmServiceManager>,
 1449:     os_name: Option<&str>,
 1450:     alias: &str,
 1451:     controller: Option<&VmController>,
 1452: ) -> VmPlatformProfile {
 1453:     let platform = VmGuestPlatform::infer(
 1454:         explicit_platform,
 1455:         os_name,
 1456:         alias,
 1457:         controller_utm_name(controller),
 1458:     );
 1459:     let defaults = default_platform_profile(platform);
 1460:     VmPlatformProfile {
 1461:         platform,
 1462:         remote_shell: explicit_remote_shell.unwrap_or(defaults.remote_shell),
 1463:         guest_exec_mode: explicit_guest_exec_mode.unwrap_or(defaults.guest_exec_mode),
 1464:         service_manager: explicit_service_manager.unwrap_or(defaults.service_manager),
 1465:     }
 1466: }

 1468: fn default_rustynet_src_dir_for_profile(
 1469:     profile: VmPlatformProfile,
 1470:     ssh_user: Option<&str>,
 1471: ) -> String {
 1472:     match profile.platform {
 1473:         VmGuestPlatform::Linux => match ssh_user {
 1474:             Some("root") => "/root/Rustynet".to_string(),
 1475:             Some(user) => format!("/home/{user}/Rustynet"),
 1476:             None => "/home/debian/Rustynet".to_string(),
 1477:         },
 1478:         VmGuestPlatform::Macos => match ssh_user {
 1479:             Some("root") => "/var/root/Rustynet".to_string(),
 1480:             Some(user) => format!("/Users/{user}/Rustynet"),
 1481:             None => "/Users/Shared/Rustynet".to_string(),
 1482:         },
 1483:         VmGuestPlatform::Windows => r"C:\Rustynet".to_string(),
 1484:         VmGuestPlatform::Ios => "/var/mobile/Rustynet-unsupported".to_string(),
 1485:         VmGuestPlatform::Android => "/data/local/tmp/Rustynet-unsupported".to_string(),
 1486:     }
 1487: }
 1488: 
 1489: fn default_remote_temp_dir_for_profile(profile: VmPlatformProfile) -> String {
 1490:     match profile.platform {
 1491:         VmGuestPlatform::Linux => "/var/tmp".to_string(),
 1492:         VmGuestPlatform::Macos => "/private/var/tmp".to_string(),
 1493:         VmGuestPlatform::Windows => r"C:\ProgramData\Rustynet\vm-lab".to_string(),
 1494:         VmGuestPlatform::Ios => "/var/mobile/tmp/rustynet-unsupported".to_string(),
 1495:         VmGuestPlatform::Android => "/data/local/tmp/rustynet-unsupported".to_string(),
 1496:     }
 1497: }
 1498: 
 1499: /// Default per-platform staging directory for utmctl host→guest file
 1500: /// operations. Distinct from `remote_temp_dir` (used for SCP-side scratch)
 1501: /// because the QEMU/SPICE guest agent runs as `NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM` on
 1502: /// Windows, while the SSH user is the lab account; SCP and utmctl therefore
 1503: /// hit different ACL surfaces. The staging dir must grant SYSTEM access and
 1504: /// must live outside the runtime state tree so that state-tree hardening
 1505: /// (icacls /grant:r /T) cannot strip the SYSTEM ACE and break the control
 1506: /// channel.
 1507: fn default_utm_staging_dir_for_profile(
 1508:     profile: VmPlatformProfile,
 1509:     ssh_user: Option<&str>,
 1510: ) -> Option<String> {
 1511:     match profile.platform {
 1512:         VmGuestPlatform::Windows => {
 1513:             let user = ssh_user.unwrap_or("Public");
 1514:             Some(format!(r"C:\Users\{user}\rustynet-utm-stage"))
 1515:         }
 1516:         // Linux/macOS guest agents typically run with the same identity
 1517:         // surface as SSH, so utmctl reuses `remote_temp_dir`. Returning
 1518:         // None signals "use remote_temp_dir as the utmctl staging root".
 1519:         VmGuestPlatform::Linux
 1520:         | VmGuestPlatform::Macos
 1521:         | VmGuestPlatform::Ios
 1522:         | VmGuestPlatform::Android => None,
 1523:     }
 1524: }
 1525: 
 1526: fn windows_helper_script_local_path(file_name: &str) -> PathBuf {
 1527:     let canonical = workspace_root_path()
 1528:         .join(WINDOWS_BOOTSTRAP_HELPER_ROOT)
 1529:         .join(file_name);
 1530:     if canonical.is_file() {
 1531:         canonical
 1532:     } else {
 1533:         workspace_root_path()
 1534:             .join(WINDOWS_COMPAT_VM_LAB_HELPER_ROOT)
 1535:             .join(file_name)
 1536:     }
 1537: }

 2001: /// Reboots a target host using SSH and systemctl reboot
 2002: #[allow(dead_code)]
 2003: pub fn run_host_reboot(target: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
 2004:     // Create a command to run via SSH
 2005:     let mut cmd = Command::new("ssh");
 2006:     cmd.arg(target);
 2007:     cmd.arg("sudo -n systemctl reboot");
 2008: 
 2009:     // Execute the command with a timeout of 20 seconds
 2010:     let output =
 2011:         run_output_with_timeout(&mut cmd, timeout_or_default(20, DEFAULT_RUN_TIMEOUT_SECS))
 2012:             .map_err(|e| format!("Failed to execute reboot command: {e}"))?;
 2013: 
 2014:     // The command may fail (e.g., if host is unreachable), but we don't want to fail the entire process
 2015:     // as reboot is expected to fail immediately
 2016:     if !output.status.success() {
 2017:         eprintln!(
 2018:             "Warning: Reboot command failed for target {}: {}",
 2019:             target,
 2020:             String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr)
 2021:         );
 2022:     }
 2023: 
 2024:     Ok(())
 2025: }

 2064: fn sha256_hex_bytes(bytes: &[u8]) -> String {
 2065:     let mut hasher = Sha256::new();
 2066:     hasher.update(bytes);
 2067:     format!("{:x}", hasher.finalize())
 2068: }
 2069: 
 2070: fn file_sha256_hex(path: &Path) -> Result<String, String> {
 2071:     let bytes = fs::read(path)
 2072:         .map_err(|err| format!("read for sha256 failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
 2073:     Ok(sha256_hex_bytes(bytes.as_slice()))
 2074: }

 2098: fn git_head_commit() -> Result<String, String> {
 2099:     let mut command = Command::new("git");
 2100:     command.current_dir(workspace_root_path());
 2101:     command.args(["rev-parse", "HEAD"]);
 2102:     let output = run_output_with_timeout(
 2103:         &mut command,
 2104:         timeout_or_default(30, DEFAULT_RUN_TIMEOUT_SECS),
 2105:     )?;
 2106:     if !output.status.success() {
 2107:         return Err(format!(
 2108:             "git rev-parse HEAD failed with status {}",
 2109:             status_code(output.status)
 2110:         ));
 2111:     }
 2112:     let stdout = String::from_utf8(output.stdout)
 2113:         .map_err(|err| format!("git rev-parse HEAD returned non-UTF-8 output: {err}"))?;
 2114:     let commit = stdout.trim().to_ascii_lowercase();
 2115:     if commit.len() != 40
 2116:         || !commit
 2117:             .chars()
 2118:             .all(|ch| ch.is_ascii_hexdigit() && !ch.is_ascii_uppercase())
 2119:     {
 2120:         return Err(format!(
 2121:             "git rev-parse HEAD returned invalid commit: {commit}"
 2122:         ));
 2123:     }
 2124:     Ok(commit)
 2125: }

 2134:         source_mode: source_mode.to_string(),
 2135:         repo_ref: repo_ref.map(ToOwned::to_owned),
 2136:     })
 2137: }

 2169: fn validate_file_binding(
 2170:     label: &str,
 2171:     actual: &LiveLabFileBinding,
 2172:     current: &LiveLabFileBinding,
 2173: ) -> Result<(), String> {
 2174:     if actual.path != current.path || actual.sha256 != current.sha256 {
 2175:         return Err(format!(
 2176:             "setup manifest {label} provenance mismatch: actual={} current={}",
 2177:             serde_json::to_string(actual)
 2178:                 .unwrap_or_else(|_| format!("<{label}-actual-serialize-error>")),
 2179:             serde_json::to_string(current)
 2180:                 .unwrap_or_else(|_| format!("<{label}-current-serialize-error>"))
 2181:         ));
 2182:     }
 2183:     Ok(())
 2184: }
 2185: 
 2186: fn report_dir_contains_regular_entries(report_dir: &Path) -> Result<bool, String> {
 2187:     if !report_dir.exists() {
 2188:         return Ok(false);
 2189:     }
 2190:     if !report_dir.is_dir() {
 2191:         return Err(format!(
 2192:             "report directory path is not a directory: {}",
 2193:             report_dir.display()
 2194:         ));
 2195:     }
 2196:     let mut pending = vec![report_dir.to_path_buf()];
 2197:     while let Some(dir) = pending.pop() {
 2198:         for entry in fs::read_dir(&dir)
 2199:             .map_err(|err| format!("read report directory failed ({}): {err}", dir.display()))?
 2200:         {
 2201:             let entry = entry.map_err(|err| {
 2202:                 format!("iterate report directory failed ({}): {err}", dir.display())
 2203:             })?;
 2204:             let file_type = entry.file_type().map_err(|err| {
 2205:                 format!(
 2206:                     "read report directory entry type failed ({}): {err}",
 2207:                     entry.path().display()
 2208:                 )
 2209:             })?;
 2210:             if file_type.is_dir() {
 2211:                 pending.push(entry.path());
 2212:             } else {
 2213:                 return Ok(true);
 2214:             }
 2215:         }
 2216:     }
 2217:     Ok(false)
 2218: }
 2219: 
 2220: fn ensure_report_dir_fresh(report_dir: &Path, command_name: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
 2221:     if !report_dir.exists() {
 2222:         return Ok(());
 2223:     }
 2224:     if report_dir_contains_regular_entries(report_dir)? {
 2225:         return Err(format!(
 2226:             "{command_name} refuses to reuse non-empty report dir {}; use a new report dir or the matching provenance-bound resume path",
 2227:             report_dir.display()
 2228:         ));
 2229:     }
 2230:     Ok(())
 2231: }
 2232: 
 2233: /// Like `report_dir_contains_regular_entries`, but skips named top-level subdirectories of
 2234: /// `report_dir` when deciding whether the directory is "non-empty". Subdirectories deeper than
 2235: /// the first level are still fully checked.
 2236: fn report_dir_contains_regular_entries_except(
 2237:     report_dir: &Path,
 2238:     exempt_top_level_names: &[&str],
 2239: ) -> Result<bool, String> {
 2240:     if !report_dir.exists() {
 2241:         return Ok(false);
 2242:     }
 2243:     if !report_dir.is_dir() {
 2244:         return Err(format!(
 2245:             "report directory path is not a directory: {}",
 2246:             report_dir.display()
 2247:         ));
 2248:     }
 2249:     let exempt_paths: Vec<PathBuf> = exempt_top_level_names
 2250:         .iter()
 2251:         .map(|name| report_dir.join(name))
 2252:         .collect();
 2253:     let mut pending = vec![report_dir.to_path_buf()];
 2254:     while let Some(dir) = pending.pop() {
 2255:         for entry in fs::read_dir(&dir)
 2256:             .map_err(|err| format!("read report directory failed ({}): {err}", dir.display()))?
 2257:         {
 2258:             let entry = entry.map_err(|err| {
 2259:                 format!("iterate report directory failed ({}): {err}", dir.display())
 2260:             })?;
 2261:             let entry_path = entry.path();
 2262:             // Only exempt entries that are direct children of the root report dir.
 2263:             if dir == report_dir && exempt_paths.contains(&entry_path) {
 2264:                 continue;
 2265:             }
 2266:             let file_type = entry.file_type().map_err(|err| {
 2267:                 format!(
 2268:                     "read report directory entry type failed ({}): {err}",
 2269:                     entry_path.display()
 2270:                 )
 2271:             })?;
 2272:             if file_type.is_dir() {
 2273:                 pending.push(entry_path);
 2274:             } else {
 2275:                 return Ok(true);
 2276:             }
 2277:         }
 2278:     }
 2279:     Ok(false)
 2280: }
 2281: 
 2282: /// Like `ensure_report_dir_fresh`, but exempts the named top-level subdirectories from the
 2283: /// non-empty check. Used when an outer command (e.g. `vm-lab-orchestrate-live-lab`) has
 2284: /// already claimed the report dir and populated a specific metadata subdirectory before
 2285: /// invoking this command.
 2286: fn ensure_report_dir_fresh_except(
 2287:     report_dir: &Path,
 2288:     command_name: &str,
 2289:     exempt_top_level_names: &[&str],
 2290: ) -> Result<(), String> {
 2291:     if !report_dir.exists() {
 2292:         return Ok(());
 2293:     }
 2294:     if report_dir_contains_regular_entries_except(report_dir, exempt_top_level_names)? {
 2295:         return Err(format!(
 2296:             "{command_name} refuses to reuse non-empty report dir {}; use a new report dir or the matching provenance-bound resume path",
 2297:             report_dir.display()
 2298:         ));
 2299:     }
 2300:     Ok(())
 2301: }

 2339:         .map_err(|err| format!("serialize setup manifest failed: {err}"))?;

 2341:         .map_err(|err| format!("write setup manifest failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))
 2342: }

 2381: fn initial_report_state(
 2382:     report_dir: &Path,
 2383:     _manifest: &LiveLabSetupManifest,
 2384: ) -> Result<LiveLabReportState, String> {
 2385:     let now = SystemTime::now()
 2386:         .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
 2387:         .map_err(|err| format!("clock failure while building report state: {err}"))?
 2388:         .as_secs();
 2389:     Ok(LiveLabReportState {
 2390:         version: 1,
 2391:         created_at_unix: now,
 2392:         updated_at_unix: now,
 2393:         report_dir_path: normalize_manifest_path(report_dir),
 2394:         report_dir_sha256: report_dir_sha256(report_dir),
 2395:         setup_manifest_sha256: setup_manifest_sha256(report_dir)?,
 2396:         setup_complete: false,
 2397:         run_complete: false,
 2398:         run_passed: false,
 2399:         full_release_gate_requested: false,
 2400:         full_release_evidence_complete: false,
 2401:         last_run: None,
 2402:     })
 2403: }

 2405: fn update_report_state_setup_complete(report_dir: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
 2406:     let mut state = read_report_state(report_dir)?;
 2407:     state.updated_at_unix = SystemTime::now()
 2408:         .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
 2409:         .map_err(|err| format!("clock failure while updating setup state: {err}"))?
 2410:         .as_secs();
 2411:     state.setup_manifest_sha256 = setup_manifest_sha256(report_dir)?;
 2412:     state.setup_complete = true;
 2413:     state.run_complete = false;
 2414:     state.run_passed = false;
 2415:     state.full_release_gate_requested = false;
 2416:     state.full_release_evidence_complete = false;
 2417:     state.last_run = None;
 2418:     write_report_state(report_dir, &state)
 2419: }

 2421: fn build_run_provenance(
 2422:     profile_path: &Path,
 2423:     script_path: &Path,
 2424:     source_mode: &str,
 2425:     repo_ref: Option<&str>,
 2426:     flags: &LiveLabRunModeFlags,
 2427: ) -> Result<LiveLabRunProvenance, String> {
 2428:     Ok(LiveLabRunProvenance {
 2429:         invoked_at_unix: SystemTime::now()
 2430:             .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
 2431:             .map_err(|err| format!("clock failure while building run provenance: {err}"))?
 2432:             .as_secs(),
 2433:         profile: file_binding(profile_path)?,
 2434:         profile_semantic_sha256: semantic_live_lab_profile_sha256(profile_path)?,
 2435:         script: file_binding(script_path)?,
 2436:         wrapper_source: current_wrapper_source_binding()?,
 2437:         wrapper_version: env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION").to_string(),
 2438:         git: current_git_provenance(source_mode, repo_ref)?,
 2439:         run_flags: flags.clone(),
 2440:     })
 2441: }

 2443: fn update_report_state_after_run(
 2444:     report_dir: &Path,
 2445:     run_provenance: LiveLabRunProvenance,
 2446:     run_passed: bool,
 2447:     full_release_gate_requested: bool,
 2448:     full_release_evidence_complete: bool,
 2449: ) -> Result<(), String> {
 2450:     let mut state = read_report_state(report_dir)?;
 2451:     state.updated_at_unix = SystemTime::now()
 2452:         .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
 2453:         .map_err(|err| format!("clock failure while updating run state: {err}"))?
 2454:         .as_secs();
 2455:     state.setup_manifest_sha256 = setup_manifest_sha256(report_dir)?;
 2456:     state.setup_complete = live_lab_setup_complete(report_dir)?;
 2457:     state.run_complete = true;
 2458:     state.run_passed = run_passed;
 2459:     state.full_release_gate_requested = full_release_gate_requested;
 2460:     state.full_release_evidence_complete = full_release_evidence_complete;
 2461:     state.last_run = Some(run_provenance);
 2462:     write_report_state(report_dir, &state)
 2463: }

 2465: fn validate_setup_manifest(
 2466:     report_dir: &Path,
 2467:     expected: &LiveLabSetupManifestExpectation,
 2468: ) -> Result<(), String> {
 2469:     let actual = read_setup_manifest(report_dir)?;
 2470:     if actual.version != 2 {
 2471:         return Err(format!(
 2472:             "unsupported setup manifest version {} in {}",
 2473:             actual.version,
 2474:             report_dir.join(SETUP_MANIFEST_RELATIVE_PATH).display()
 2475:         ));
 2476:     }
 2477:     let expected_report_dir_path = normalize_manifest_path(expected.report_dir.as_path());
 2478:     let expected_report_dir_sha256 = report_dir_sha256(expected.report_dir.as_path());
 2479:     if actual.report_dir_path != expected_report_dir_path
 2480:         || actual.report_dir_sha256 != expected_report_dir_sha256
 2481:     {
 2482:         return Err(format!(
 2483: /* ELIDED: original line had 16 backslash-quote sequences — removed to avoid DeepSeek parser failure */
 2484:             actual.report_dir_path,
 2485:             actual.report_dir_sha256,
 2486:             expected_report_dir_path,
 2487:             expected_report_dir_sha256
 2488:         ));
 2489:     }
 2490:     let current_profile = file_binding(expected.profile_path.as_path())?;
 2491:     validate_file_binding("profile", &actual.profile, &current_profile)?;
 2492:     let current_profile_semantic_sha256 =
 2493:         semantic_live_lab_profile_sha256(expected.profile_path.as_path())?;
 2494:     if actual.profile_semantic_sha256 != current_profile_semantic_sha256 {
 2495:         return Err(format!(
 2496:             "setup manifest profile semantic provenance mismatch: actual={} current={}",
 2497:             actual.profile_semantic_sha256, current_profile_semantic_sha256
 2498:         ));
 2499:     }
 2500:     let current_script = file_binding(expected.script_path.as_path())?;
 2501:     validate_file_binding("script", &actual.script, &current_script)?;
 2502:     let current_inventory_binding = match expected.inventory_path.as_deref() {
 2503:         Some(path) => Some(file_binding(path)?),
 2504:         None => actual
 2505:             .inventory
 2506:             .as_ref()
 2507:             .map(|binding| file_binding(Path::new(binding.path.as_str())))
 2508:             .transpose()?,
 2509:     };
 2510:     match (&actual.inventory, &current_inventory_binding) {
 2511:         (Some(actual_binding), Some(current_binding)) => {
 2512:             validate_file_binding("inventory", actual_binding, current_binding)?
 2513:         }
 2514:         (None, None) => {}
 2515:         (Some(_), None) | (None, Some(_)) => {
 2516:             return Err("setup manifest inventory provenance mismatch".to_string());
 2517:         }
 2518:     }
 2519:     let current_wrapper_source = current_wrapper_source_binding()?;
 2520:     validate_file_binding(
 2521:         "wrapper_source",
 2522:         &actual.wrapper_source,
 2523:         &current_wrapper_source,
 2524:     )?;
 2525:     if actual.wrapper_version != env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION") {
 2526:         return Err(format!(
 2527:             "setup manifest wrapper version mismatch: actual={} current={}",
 2528:             actual.wrapper_version,
 2529:             env!("CARGO_PKG_VERSION")
 2530:         ));
 2531:     }
 2532:     let current_git =
 2533:         current_git_provenance(expected.source_mode.as_str(), expected.repo_ref.as_deref())?;
 2534:     if actual.git != current_git {
 2535:         return Err(format!(
 2536:             "setup manifest git provenance mismatch: actual={} current={}",
 2537:             serde_json::to_string(&actual.git)
 2538:                 .unwrap_or_else(|_| "<git-serialize-error>".to_string()),
 2539:             serde_json::to_string(&current_git)
 2540:                 .unwrap_or_else(|_| "<git-serialize-error>".to_string())
 2541:         ));
 2542:     }
 2543:     if let Some(value) = expected.require_same_network
 2544:         && actual.setup_flags.require_same_network != Some(value)
 2545:     {
 2546:         return Err(format!(
 2547:             "setup manifest require_same_network mismatch: actual={} current={value}",
 2548:             actual
 2549:                 .setup_flags
 2550:                 .require_same_network
 2551:                 .map(|flag| flag.to_string())
 2552:                 .unwrap_or_else(|| "none".to_string())
 2553:         ));
 2554:     }
 2555:     if let Some(value) = expected.dry_run
 2556:         && actual.setup_flags.dry_run != value
 2557:     {
 2558:         return Err(format!(
 2559:             "setup manifest dry_run mismatch: actual={} current={value}",
 2560:             actual.setup_flags.dry_run
 2561:         ));
 2562:     }
 2563:     if let Some(value) = expected.max_parallel_node_workers
 2564:         && actual.setup_flags.max_parallel_node_workers != Some(value)
 2565:     {
 2566:         return Err(format!(
 2567:             "setup manifest max_parallel_node_workers mismatch: actual={} current={value}",
 2568:             actual
 2569:                 .setup_flags
 2570:                 .max_parallel_node_workers
 2571:                 .map(|v| v.to_string())
 2572:                 .unwrap_or_else(|| "none".to_string())
 2573:         ));
 2574:     }
 2575:     Ok(())
 2576: }
 2577: 
 2578: fn validate_report_state(report_dir: &Path) -> Result<LiveLabReportState, String> {
 2579:     let state = read_report_state(report_dir)?;
 2580:     if state.version != 1 {
 2581:         return Err(format!(
 2582:             "unsupported report state version {} in {}",
 2583:             state.version,
 2584:             report_dir.join(REPORT_STATE_RELATIVE_PATH).display()
 2585:         ));
 2586:     }
 2587:     let expected_report_dir_path = normalize_manifest_path(report_dir);
 2588:     let expected_report_dir_sha256 = report_dir_sha256(report_dir);
 2589:     if state.report_dir_path != expected_report_dir_path
 2590:         || state.report_dir_sha256 != expected_report_dir_sha256
 2591:     {
 2592:         return Err(format!(
 2593: /* ELIDED: original line had 16 backslash-quote sequences — removed to avoid DeepSeek parser failure */
 2594:             state.report_dir_path,
 2595:             state.report_dir_sha256,
 2596:             expected_report_dir_path,
 2597:             expected_report_dir_sha256
 2598:         ));
 2599:     }
 2600:     let expected_setup_manifest_sha256 = setup_manifest_sha256(report_dir)?;
 2601:     if state.setup_manifest_sha256 != expected_setup_manifest_sha256 {
 2602:         return Err(format!(
 2603:             "report state setup manifest provenance mismatch: actual={} current={}",
 2604:             state.setup_manifest_sha256, expected_setup_manifest_sha256
 2605:         ));
 2606:     }
 2607:     Ok(state)
 2608: }

 2610: fn resolve_setup_selection_from_existing_manifest(
 2611:     report_dir: &Path,
 2612: ) -> Result<LiveLabSetupSelection, String> {
 2613:     let manifest = read_setup_manifest(report_dir)?;
 2614:     let profile_path = PathBuf::from(manifest.profile.path);
 2615:     ensure_local_regular_file_path(profile_path.as_path(), "existing live-lab profile")?;
 2616:     execute_ops_vm_lab_validate_live_lab_profile(VmLabValidateLiveLabProfileConfig {
 2617:         profile_path: profile_path.clone(),
 2618:         expected_backend: None,
 2619:         expected_source_mode: None,
 2620:         require_five_node: false,
 2621:     })?;
 2622:     Ok(LiveLabSetupSelection {
 2623:         profile_path,
 2624:         profile_generated: false,
 2625:         profile_generation_summary: None,
 2626:     })

 2628: 
 2629: fn resolve_run_setup_reuse(
 2630:     report_dir: &Path,
 2631:     profile_path: &Path,
 2632:     script_path: &Path,
 2633:     source_mode: &str,
 2634:     repo_ref: Option<&str>,
 2635:     skip_setup: bool,
 2636: ) -> Result<bool, String> {
 2637:     if !report_dir.exists() {
 2638:         if skip_setup {
 2639:             return Err(format!(
 2640:                 "vm-lab-run-live-lab --skip-setup requires an existing provenance-bound setup report dir: {}",
 2641:                 report_dir.display()
 2642:             ));
 2643:         }
 2644:         return Ok(false);
 2645:     }
 2646:     let has_regular_entries = report_dir_contains_regular_entries(report_dir)?;
 2647:     if !has_regular_entries {
 2648:         if skip_setup {
 2649:             return Err(format!(
 2650:                 "vm-lab-run-live-lab --skip-setup requires a populated provenance-bound setup report dir: {}",
 2651:                 report_dir.display()
 2652:             ));
 2653:         }
 2654:         return Ok(false);
 2655:     }
 2656:     let expectation = LiveLabSetupManifestExpectation {
 2657:         report_dir: report_dir.to_path_buf(),
 2658:         profile_path: profile_path.to_path_buf(),
 2659:         script_path: script_path.to_path_buf(),
 2660:         inventory_path: None,
 2661:         source_mode: source_mode.to_string(),
 2662:         repo_ref: repo_ref.map(ToOwned::to_owned),
 2663:         require_same_network: None,
 2664:         dry_run: None,
 2665:         max_parallel_node_workers: None,
 2666:     };
 2667:     validate_setup_manifest(report_dir, &expectation)?;
 2668:     let report_state = validate_report_state(report_dir)?;
 2669:     if !report_state.setup_complete {
 2670:         return Err(format!(
 2671:             "report dir {} cannot be reused because setup is not complete",
 2672:             report_dir.display()
 2673:         ));
 2674:     }
 2675:     if report_state.run_complete || report_state.last_run.is_some() {
 2676:         return Err(format!(
 2677:             "report dir {} already contains run provenance; use a fresh report dir for a new run",
 2678:             report_dir.display()
 2679:         ));
 2680:     }
 2681:     if !live_lab_setup_complete(report_dir)? {
 2682:         return Err(format!(
 2683:             "report dir {} is missing completed setup stage evidence",
 2684:             report_dir.display()
 2685:         ));
 2686:     }
 2687:     if live_lab_report_has_non_setup_stage_records(report_dir)? {
 2688:         return Err(format!(
 2689:             "report dir {} already contains non-setup stage records and cannot be reused for a fresh run",
 2690:             report_dir.display()
 2691:         ));
 2692:     }
 2693:     Ok(true)
 2694: }
 2695: 
 2696: impl VmLabIterationValidationStep {
 2697:     fn label(&self) -> String {
 2698:         match self {
 2699:             Self::FmtCheck => "fmt".to_string(),
 2700:             Self::CargoCheckPackage { package } => format!("check:{package}"),
 2701:             Self::CargoCheckBin { package, bin } => format!("check-bin:{package}:{bin}"),
 2702:             Self::CargoTestPackage { package, filter } => match filter {
 2703:                 Some(filter) => format!("test:{package}:{filter}"),
 2704:                 None => format!("test:{package}"),
 2705:             },
 2706:             Self::CargoTestBin {
 2707:                 package,
 2708:                 bin,
 2709:                 filter,
 2710:             } => match filter {
 2711:                 Some(filter) => format!("test-bin:{package}:{bin}:{filter}"),
 2712:                 None => format!("test-bin:{package}:{bin}"),
 2713:             },
 2714:         }
 2715:     }
 2716: }
 2717: 
 2718: pub fn parse_vm_lab_iteration_validation_step_spec(
 2719:     value: &str,
 2720: ) -> Result<VmLabIterationValidationStep, String> {
 2721:     ensure_no_control_chars("validation step", value)?;
 2722:     let parts = value.split(':').collect::<Vec<_>>();
 2723:     match parts.as_slice() {
 2724:         ["fmt"] => Ok(VmLabIterationValidationStep::FmtCheck),
 2725:         ["check", package] => {
 2726:             ensure_no_control_chars("validation package", package)?;
 2727:             Ok(VmLabIterationValidationStep::CargoCheckPackage {
 2728:                 package: (*package).to_string(),
 2729:             })
 2730:         }
 2731:         ["check-bin", package, bin] => {
 2732:             ensure_no_control_chars("validation package", package)?;
 2733:             ensure_no_control_chars("validation binary", bin)?;
 2734:             Ok(VmLabIterationValidationStep::CargoCheckBin {
 2735:                 package: (*package).to_string(),
 2736:                 bin: (*bin).to_string(),
 2737:             })
 2738:         }
 2739:         ["test", package] => {
 2740:             ensure_no_control_chars("validation package", package)?;
 2741:             Ok(VmLabIterationValidationStep::CargoTestPackage {
 2742:                 package: (*package).to_string(),
 2743:                 filter: None,
 2744:             })
 2745:         }
 2746:         ["test", package, filter] => {
 2747:             ensure_no_control_chars("validation package", package)?;
 2748:             ensure_no_control_chars("validation test filter", filter)?;
 2749:             Ok(VmLabIterationValidationStep::CargoTestPackage {
 2750:                 package: (*package).to_string(),
 2751:                 filter: Some((*filter).to_string()),
 2752:             })
 2753:         }
 2754:         ["test-bin", package, bin] => {
 2755:             ensure_no_control_chars("validation package", package)?;
 2756:             ensure_no_control_chars("validation binary", bin)?;
 2757:             Ok(VmLabIterationValidationStep::CargoTestBin {
 2758:                 package: (*package).to_string(),
 2759:                 bin: (*bin).to_string(),
 2760:                 filter: None,
 2761:             })
 2762:         }
 2763:         ["test-bin", package, bin, filter] => {
 2764:             ensure_no_control_chars("validation package", package)?;
 2765:             ensure_no_control_chars("validation binary", bin)?;
 2766:             ensure_no_control_chars("validation test filter", filter)?;
 2767:             Ok(VmLabIterationValidationStep::CargoTestBin {
 2768:                 package: (*package).to_string(),
 2769:                 bin: (*bin).to_string(),
 2770:                 filter: Some((*filter).to_string()),
 2771:             })
 2772:         }
 2773:         _ => Err(format!(
 2774:             "unsupported validation step: {value} (expected fmt|check:<package>|check-bin:<package>:<bin>|test:<package>[:filter]|test-bin:<package>:<bin>[:filter])"
 2775:         )),
 2776:     }
 2777: }

 2779: pub fn execute_ops_vm_lab_list(config: VmLabListConfig) -> Result<String, String> {
 2780:     let inventory = load_inventory(config.inventory_path.as_path())?;
 2781:     let mut lines = vec![format!(
 2782:         "vm_lab_inventory path={}",
 2783:         config.inventory_path.display()
 2784:     )];
 2785:     for entry in inventory {
 2786:         let controller_summary = match entry.controller {
 2787:             Some(VmController::LocalUtm {
 2788:                 ref utm_name,
 2789:                 ref bundle_path,
 2790:             }) => format!(
 2791:                 "controller=local_utm utm_name={} bundle_path={}",
 2792:                 utm_name,
 2793:                 bundle_path.display()
 2794:             ),
 2795:             None => "controller=none".to_string(),
 2796:         };
 2797:         lines.push(format!(
 2798:             "alias={} ssh_target={} ssh_user={} os={} last_known_ip={} parent_device={} last_known_network={} network_group={} node_id={} lab_role={} mesh_ip={} exit_capable={} relay_capable={} rustynet_src_dir={} {}",
 2799:             entry.alias,
 2800:             entry.ssh_target,
 2801:             entry
 2802:                 .ssh_user
 2803:                 .unwrap_or_else(|| "<ssh-default>".to_string()),
 2804:             entry.os.unwrap_or_else(|| "<unknown>".to_string()),
 2805:             entry
 2806:                 .last_known_ip
 2807:                 .unwrap_or_else(|| "<unknown>".to_string()),
 2808:             entry
 2809:                 .parent_device
 2810:                 .unwrap_or_else(|| "<unknown>".to_string()),
 2811:             entry
 2812:                 .last_known_network
 2813:                 .unwrap_or_else(|| "<unknown>".to_string()),
 2814:             entry
 2815:                 .network_group
 2816:                 .unwrap_or_else(|| "<unset>".to_string()),
 2817:             entry.node_id.unwrap_or_else(|| "<unset>".to_string()),
 2818:             entry.lab_role.unwrap_or_else(|| "<unset>".to_string()),
 2819:             entry.mesh_ip.unwrap_or_else(|| "<unset>".to_string()),
 2820:             entry
 2821:                 .exit_capable
 2822:                 .map(|value| value.to_string())
 2823:                 .unwrap_or_else(|| "<unset>".to_string()),
 2824:             entry
 2825:                 .relay_capable
 2826:                 .map(|value| value.to_string())
 2827:                 .unwrap_or_else(|| "<unset>".to_string()),
 2828:             entry
 2829:                 .rustynet_src_dir
 2830:                 .unwrap_or_else(|| "<unset>".to_string()),
 2831:             controller_summary
 2832:         ));
 2833:     }
 2834:     Ok(lines.join("\n"))
 2835: }

 2837: pub fn execute_ops_vm_lab_discover_local_utm(
 2838:     config: VmLabDiscoverLocalUtmConfig,
 2839: ) -> Result<String, String> {
 2840:     let documents_root = match config.utm_documents_root.as_deref() {
 2841:         Some(path) => resolve_path(path)?,
 2842:         None => default_utm_documents_root()?,
 2843:     };
 2844:     if !documents_root.is_dir() {
 2845:         return Err(format!(
 2846:             "UTM documents root must be an existing directory: {}",
 2847:             documents_root.display()
 2848:         ));
 2849:     }
 2850: 
 2851:     let discovered_bundle_paths = discover_local_utm_bundle_paths(documents_root.as_path())?;
 2852:     if discovered_bundle_paths.is_empty() {
 2853:         return Err(format!(
 2854:             "no UTM bundle directories found under {}",
 2855:             documents_root.display()
 2856:         ));
 2857:     }
 2858: 
 2859:     let utmctl_path = config
 2860:         .utmctl_path
 2861:         .as_deref()
 2862:         .map(resolve_path)
 2863:         .transpose()?
 2864:         .unwrap_or_else(default_utmctl_path);
 2865:     let timeout = timeout_or_default(config.timeout_secs, DEFAULT_UTM_IP_DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT_SECS);
 2866:     let ssh_port = if config.ssh_port == 0 {
 2867:         22
 2868:     } else {
 2869:         config.ssh_port
 2870:     };
 2871: 
 2872:     let (inventory, inventory_error) = match config.inventory_path.as_deref() {
 2873:         Some(path) if path.exists() => match load_inventory(path) {
 2874:             Ok(entries) => (entries, None),
 2875:             Err(err) => (Vec::new(), Some(err)),
 2876:         },
 2877:         Some(path) => (
 2878:             Vec::new(),
 2879:             Some(format!("inventory path does not exist: {}", path.display())),
 2880:         ),
 2881:         None => (Vec::new(), None),
 2882:     };
 2883: 
 2884:     let mut entries = Vec::new();
 2885:     let mut matched_inventory_count = 0usize;
 2886:     let mut process_present_count = 0usize;
 2887:     let mut live_ip_count = 0usize;
 2888:     let mut ssh_port_open_count = 0usize;
 2889:     let mut ready_count = 0usize;
 2890:     let mut ready_inventory_states = Vec::new();
 2891: 
 2892:     for bundle_path in discovered_bundle_paths {
 2893:         let utm_name = bundle_path
 2894:             .file_stem()
 2895:             .and_then(|value| value.to_str())
 2896:             .ok_or_else(|| {
 2897:                 format!(
 2898:                     "discovered UTM bundle has no valid UTF-8 bundle name: {}",
 2899:                     bundle_path.display()
 2900:                 )
 2901:             })?
 2902:             .to_string();
 2903:         let inventory_match = inventory.iter().find(|entry| {
 2904:             matches_local_utm_inventory_entry(entry, bundle_path.as_path(), utm_name.as_str())
 2905:         });
 2906:         let process_probe = local_utm_process_present_with_probes(
 2907:             utmctl_path.as_path(),
 2908:             Path::new("ps"),
 2909:             utm_name.as_str(),
 2910:             bundle_path.as_path(),
 2911:             timeout,
 2912:         );
 2913:         let process_present = process_probe.as_ref().copied().unwrap_or(false);
 2914:         if process_present {
 2915:             process_present_count += 1;
 2916:         }
 2917:         let process_state = match process_probe {
 2918:             Ok(value) => ProbeState::Ok { value },
 2919:             Err(err) => ProbeState::Error { reason: err },
 2920:         };
 2921: 
 2922:         let mut discovery_notes = Vec::new();
 2923:         let mut live_ip_source = "unavailable".to_string();
 2924:         let mut live_ip = None;
 2925:         let mut authoritative_ssh_target = None;
 2926:         let mut authoritative_target_present = false;
 2927:         let mut advisory_ssh_target = None;
 2928:         let mut ssh_target_source = "unavailable".to_string();
 2929:         let mut ssh_user = None;
 2930:         let mut inventory_alias = None;
 2931:         let mut inventory_node_id = None;
 2932:         let mut inventory_lab_role = None;
 2933:         let mut inventory_ssh_target = None;
 2934:         let mut inventory_ssh_user = None;
 2935:         let mut inventory_last_known_ip = None;
 2936:         let mut inventory_mesh_ip = None;
 2937:         let mut inventory_controller_bundle_path = None;
 2938:         let mut inventory_controller_utm_name = None;
 2939:         let discovery_platform_profile = if let Some(entry) = inventory_match {
 2940:             matched_inventory_count += 1;
 2941:             inventory_alias = Some(entry.alias.clone());
 2942:             inventory_node_id = entry.node_id.clone();
 2943:             inventory_lab_role = entry.lab_role.clone();
 2944:             inventory_ssh_target = Some(entry.ssh_target.clone());
 2945:             inventory_ssh_user = entry.ssh_user.clone();
 2946:             inventory_last_known_ip = entry.last_known_ip.clone();
 2947:             inventory_mesh_ip = entry.mesh_ip.clone();
 2948:             if let Some(VmController::LocalUtm {
 2949:                 utm_name: entry_utm_name,
 2950:                 bundle_path: entry_bundle_path,
 2951:             }) = entry.controller.as_ref()
 2952:             {
 2953:                 inventory_controller_bundle_path = Some(entry_bundle_path.display().to_string());
 2954:                 inventory_controller_utm_name = Some(entry_utm_name.clone());
 2955:             }
 2956:             let resolved_target =
 2957:                 resolved_inventory_ssh_target_with_utmctl(entry, utmctl_path.as_path());
 2958:             authoritative_ssh_target = Some(resolved_target.clone());
 2959:             authoritative_target_present = true;
 2960:             ssh_target_source = "inventory".to_string();
 2961:             ssh_user = entry.ssh_user.clone();
 2962:             if let Some(ip) = resolve_local_utm_live_host(entry, utmctl_path.as_path()) {
 2963:                 live_ip_source = "utmctl".to_string();
 2964:                 live_ip = Some(ip);
 2965:             } else if let Some(ip) = entry.last_known_ip.as_deref() {
 2966:                 live_ip_source = "inventory.last_known_ip".to_string();
 2967:                 live_ip = Some(ip.to_string());
 2968:                 discovery_notes
 2969:                     .push("utmctl-ip-address-unavailable-using-inventory-fallback".to_string());
 2970:             }
 2971:             entry.platform_profile()
 2972:         } else {
 2973:             let inferred_platform =
 2974:                 VmGuestPlatform::infer(None, None, utm_name.as_str(), Some(utm_name.as_str()));
 2975:             let profile = default_platform_profile(inferred_platform);
 2976:             if let Some(ip) = resolve_local_utm_live_host_by_name(
 2977:                 utm_name.as_str(),
 2978:                 None,
 2979:                 None,
 2980:                 utmctl_path.as_path(),
 2981:             ) {
 2982:                 live_ip_source = "utmctl".to_string();
 2983:                 live_ip = Some(ip);
 2984:             }
 2985:             if let Some(ip) = live_ip.clone() {
 2986:                 ssh_target_source =
 2987:                     format!("platform-aware-unmatched-{}", inferred_platform.as_str());
 2988:                 advisory_ssh_target =
 2989:                     unmatched_local_utm_advisory_target(inferred_platform, ip.as_str());
 2990:                 if inferred_platform == VmGuestPlatform::Linux {
 2991:                     ssh_user = Some("debian".to_string());
 2992:                 } else {
 2993:                     discovery_notes.push(
 2994:                         "windows-utm-discovered-without-inventory-no-linux-user-assumed"
 2995:                             .to_string(),
 2996:                     );
 2997:                 }
 2998:             }
 2999:             profile
 3000:         };
 3001:         let discovery_platform = discovery_platform_profile.platform;
 3002: 
 3003:         let live_ip_state = match live_ip.clone() {
 3004:             Some(ip) if live_ip_source == "utmctl" => ProbeState::Ok { value: ip },
 3005:             Some(ip) if live_ip_source == "inventory.last_known_ip" => ProbeState::Fallback {
 3006:                 value: ip,
 3007:                 reason: "utmctl-ip-address-unavailable".to_string(),
 3008:             },
 3009:             Some(ip) => ProbeState::Fallback {
 3010:                 value: ip,
 3011:                 reason: format!("live-ip-source={live_ip_source}"),
 3012:             },
 3013:             None => ProbeState::Missing {
 3014:                 reason: "live-ip-unavailable".to_string(),
 3015:             },
 3016:         };
 3017:         if matches!(
 3018:             live_ip_state,
 3019:             ProbeState::Ok { .. } | ProbeState::Fallback { .. }
 3020:         ) {
 3021:             live_ip_count += 1;
 3022:         }
 3023: 
 3024:         let mut ssh_port_status = "skipped".to_string();
 3025:         let mut ssh_port_error = None;
 3026:         if let Some(ip) = live_ip.as_deref() {
 3027:             match probe_tcp_port_status(ip, ssh_port, timeout) {
 3028:                 Ok((status, error)) => {
 3029:                     ssh_port_status = status;
 3030:                     ssh_port_error = error;
 3031:                 }
 3032:                 Err(err) => {
 3033:                     ssh_port_status = "unknown".to_string();
 3034:                     ssh_port_error = Some(err);
 3035:                 }
 3036:             }
 3037:         }
 3038:         let ssh_port_state = match ssh_port_status.as_str() {
 3039:             "open" => ProbeState::Ok {
 3040:                 value: PortStatus::Open,
 3041:             },
 3042:             "skipped" => ProbeState::Missing {
 3043:                 reason: "no-live-ip".to_string(),
 3044:             },
 3045:             "unknown" => ProbeState::Error {
 3046:                 reason: ssh_port_error
 3047:                     .clone()
 3048:                     .unwrap_or_else(|| "tcp-port-probe-failed".to_string()),
 3049:             },
 3050:             value => ProbeState::Fallback {
 3051:                 value: if value == "closed" {
 3052:                     port_status_from_probe_error(ssh_port_error.as_deref())
 3053:                 } else {
 3054:                     port_status_from_probe(value)
 3055:                 },
 3056:                 reason: ssh_port_error
 3057:                     .clone()
 3058:                     .unwrap_or_else(|| format!("ssh-port-status={value}")),
 3059:             },
 3060:         };
 3061:         let windows_ssh_probe_state = if discovery_platform == VmGuestPlatform::Windows {
 3062:             if !process_present {
 3063:                 Some(ProbeState::Missing {
 3064:                     reason: "process-not-ready".to_string(),
 3065:                 })
 3066:             } else if live_ip.is_some() {
 3067:                 Some(probe_windows_local_utm_ssh_readiness(
 3068:                     utm_name.as_str(),
 3069:                     timeout,
 3070:                 ))
 3071:             } else {
 3072:                 Some(ProbeState::Missing {
 3073:                     reason: "live-ip-not-authoritative".to_string(),
 3074:                 })
 3075:             }
 3076:         } else {
 3077:             None
 3078:         };
 3079:         let known_hosts_state = if discovery_platform == VmGuestPlatform::Windows {
 3080:             windows_discovery_known_hosts_state(
 3081:                 authoritative_ssh_target.as_deref(),
 3082:                 live_ip.as_deref(),
 3083:                 ssh_port,
 3084:                 config.known_hosts_path.as_deref(),
 3085:             )
 3086:         } else {
 3087:             None
 3088:         };
 3089:         let ssh_auth_state = match (
 3090:             live_ip.as_deref(),
 3091:             ssh_user.as_deref(),
 3092:             authoritative_ssh_target
 3093:                 .as_deref()
 3094:                 .or(advisory_ssh_target.as_deref()),
 3095:         ) {
 3096:             (None, _, _) => ProbeState::Missing {
 3097:                 reason: "no-live-ip".to_string(),
 3098:             },
 3099:             (_, None, _) => ProbeState::Missing {
 3100:                 reason: "no-ssh-user".to_string(),
 3101:             },
 3102:             (_, _, None) => ProbeState::Missing {
 3103:                 reason: "no-ssh-target".to_string(),
 3104:             },
 3105:             (_, _, Some(_)) if ssh_port_status != "open" => ProbeState::Missing {
 3106:                 reason: format!("ssh-port-status={ssh_port_status}"),
 3107:             },
 3108:             (Some(_), Some(ssh_user), Some(ssh_target)) => {
 3109:                 match ssh_auth_probe_command(discovery_platform_profile) {
 3110:                     Ok(probe_command) => match run_remote_shell_command(
 3111:                         ssh_target,
 3112:                         Some(ssh_user),
 3113:                         config.ssh_identity_file.as_deref(),
 3114:                         config.known_hosts_path.as_deref(),
 3115:                         probe_command,
 3116:                         timeout,
 3117:                     ) {
 3118:                         Ok(status) if status.success() => ProbeState::Ok {
 3119:                             value: "ok".to_string(),
 3120:                         },
 3121:                         Ok(status) => ProbeState::Fallback {
 3122:                             value: format!("failed-exit-{}", status_code(status)),
 3123:                             reason: "ssh-auth-command-failed".to_string(),
 3124:                         },
 3125:                         Err(err) => ProbeState::Error { reason: err },
 3126:                     },
 3127:                     Err(err) => ProbeState::Error { reason: err },
 3128:                 }
 3129:             }
 3130:         };
 3131:         let readiness = build_utm_readiness(UtmReadinessInputs {
 3132:             platform: discovery_platform,
 3133:             process_state: &process_state,
 3134:             live_ip_state: &live_ip_state,
 3135:             ssh_port_state: &ssh_port_state,
 3136:             ssh_auth_state: &ssh_auth_state,
 3137:             authoritative_target_present,
 3138:             known_hosts_state: known_hosts_state.as_ref(),
 3139:             windows_ssh_probe_state: windows_ssh_probe_state.as_ref(),
 3140:         });
 3141:         if ssh_port_status == "open" {
 3142:             ssh_port_open_count += 1;
 3143:         }
 3144:         let ready = if discovery_platform == VmGuestPlatform::Windows {
 3145:             readiness.execution_ready
 3146:         } else {
 3147:             process_present
 3148:                 && matches!(
 3149:                     live_ip_state,
 3150:                     ProbeState::Ok { .. } | ProbeState::Fallback { .. }
 3151:                 )
 3152:                 && ssh_port_status == "open"
 3153:                 && authoritative_target_present
 3154:         };
 3155:         if ready {
 3156:             ready_count += 1;
 3157:             if inventory_match.is_some() {
 3158:                 ready_inventory_states.push(LocalUtmReadyState {
 3159:                     alias: inventory_alias.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| utm_name.clone()),
 3160:                     utm_name: utm_name.clone(),
 3161:                     process_present,
 3162:                     live_ip: live_ip.clone(),
 3163:                     ssh_port_status: ssh_port_status.clone(),
 3164:                     ssh_auth_status: match &ssh_auth_state {
 3165:                         ProbeState::Ok { value } | ProbeState::Fallback { value, .. } => {
 3166:                             value.clone()
 3167:                         }
 3168:                         ProbeState::Missing { reason } | ProbeState::Error { reason } => {
 3169:                             reason.clone()
 3170:                         }
 3171:                     },
 3172:                     platform: discovery_platform,
 3173:                 });
 3174:             }
 3175:         }
 3176: 
 3177:         entries.push(json!({
 3178:             "alias": inventory_alias.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| utm_name.clone()),
 3179:             "bundle_path": bundle_path.display().to_string(),
 3180:             "utm_name": utm_name,
 3181:             "controller": {
 3182:                 "type": "local_utm",
 3183:                 "bundle_path": bundle_path.display().to_string(),
 3184:             },
 3185:             "inventory_match": inventory_match.is_some(),
 3186:             "inventory_alias": inventory_alias,
 3187:             "inventory_node_id": inventory_node_id,
 3188:             "inventory_lab_role": inventory_lab_role,
 3189:             "inventory_ssh_target": inventory_ssh_target,
 3190:             "inventory_ssh_user": inventory_ssh_user,
 3191:             "inventory_last_known_ip": inventory_last_known_ip,
 3192:             "inventory_mesh_ip": inventory_mesh_ip,
 3193:             "inventory_controller_bundle_path": inventory_controller_bundle_path,
 3194:             "inventory_controller_utm_name": inventory_controller_utm_name,
 3195:             "platform": discovery_platform.as_str(),
 3196:             "live_ip": live_ip,
 3197:             "live_ip_source": live_ip_source,
 3198:             "ssh_target": authoritative_ssh_target.clone().or(advisory_ssh_target.clone()),
 3199:             "authoritative_ssh_target": authoritative_ssh_target,
 3200:             "advisory_ssh_target": advisory_ssh_target,
 3201:             "ssh_target_source": ssh_target_source,
 3202:             "ssh_user": ssh_user,
 3203:             "ssh_port": ssh_port,
 3204:             "ssh_port_status": ssh_port_status,
 3205:             "ssh_port_error": ssh_port_error,
 3206:             "utm_process_present": process_present,
 3207:             "ready": ready,
 3208:             "process_state": process_state,
 3209:             "live_ip_state": live_ip_state,
 3210:             "ssh_port_state": ssh_port_state,
 3211:             "ssh_auth_state": ssh_auth_state,
 3212:             "known_hosts_state": known_hosts_state,
 3213:             "windows_ssh_probe_state": windows_ssh_probe_state,
 3214:             "readiness": readiness,
 3215:             "notes": discovery_notes,
 3216:         }));
 3217:     }
 3218: 
 3219:     let overall_status = if ready_count == entries.len() {
 3220:         "complete"
 3221:     } else {
 3222:         "partial"
 3223:     };
 3224:     let inventory_update = if config.update_inventory_live_ips {
 3225:         let inventory_path = config.inventory_path.as_deref().ok_or_else(|| {
 3226:             "vm-lab-discover-local-utm --update-inventory-live-ips requires --inventory".to_string()
 3227:         })?;
 3228:         Some(if matched_inventory_count == 0 {
 3229:             format!(
 3230:                 "inventory live IP update skipped because no inventory-matched local UTM bundles were discovered in {}",
 3231:                 inventory_path.display()
 3232:             )
 3233:         } else if ready_inventory_states.len() != matched_inventory_count {
 3234:             format!(
 3235:                 "inventory live IP update skipped because only {}/{} inventory-matched local UTM bundles were execution-ready",
 3236:                 ready_inventory_states.len(),
 3237:                 matched_inventory_count
 3238:             )
 3239:         } else {
 3240:             persist_local_utm_ready_states_to_inventory(
 3241:                 inventory_path,
 3242:                 ready_inventory_states.as_slice(),
 3243:             )?
 3244:         })
 3245:     } else {
 3246:         None
 3247:     };
 3248:     let payload = json!({
 3249:         "schema_version": 1,
 3250:         "mode": "vm_lab_local_utm_discovery",
 3251:         "collected_at_utc": collected_at_utc_now(),
 3252:         "utm_documents_root": documents_root.display().to_string(),
 3253:         "inventory_path": config
 3254:             .inventory_path
 3255:             .as_ref()
 3256:             .map(|path| path.display().to_string()),
 3257:         "utmctl_path": utmctl_path.display().to_string(),
 3258:         "ssh_port": ssh_port,
 3259:         "summary": {
 3260:             "status": overall_status,
 3261:             "bundle_count": entries.len(),
 3262:             "inventory_matched_count": matched_inventory_count,
 3263:             "process_present_count": process_present_count,
 3264:             "live_ip_count": live_ip_count,
 3265:             "ssh_port_open_count": ssh_port_open_count,
 3266:             "ready_count": ready_count,
 3267:         },
 3268:         "inventory_error": inventory_error,
 3269:         "inventory_update": inventory_update,
 3270:         "entries": entries,
 3271:     });
 3272:     let rendered = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&payload)
 3273:         .map_err(|err| format!("serialize local UTM discovery report failed: {err}"))?;
 3274:     if let Some(report_dir) = config.report_dir.as_deref() {
 3275:         write_orchestration_artifact(
 3276:             report_dir.join("vm_lab_discover_local_utm.json").as_path(),
 3277:             rendered.as_str(),
 3278:         )?;
 3279:     }
 3280:     Ok(rendered)
 3281: }
 3282: 
 3283: pub fn execute_ops_vm_lab_discover_local_utm_summary(
 3284:     config: VmLabDiscoverLocalUtmConfig,
 3285: ) -> Result<String, String> {
 3286:     let summary_report_dir = config.report_dir.clone();
 3287:     let report = execute_ops_vm_lab_discover_local_utm(config)?;
 3288:     let report: Value = serde_json::from_str(report.as_str())
 3289:         .map_err(|err| format!("parse local UTM discovery report failed: {err}"))?;
 3290:     let rendered = render_local_utm_discovery_summary(
 3291:         report
 3292:             .as_object()
 3293:             .ok_or_else(|| "local UTM discovery report must be a JSON object".to_string())?,
 3294:     )?;
 3295:     if let Some(report_dir) = summary_report_dir.as_deref() {
 3296:         write_orchestration_artifact(
 3297:             report_dir
 3298:                 .join("vm_lab_discover_local_utm_summary.txt")
 3299:                 .as_path(),
 3300:             rendered.as_str(),
 3301:         )?;
 3302:     }
 3303:     Ok(rendered)
 3304: }
 3305: 
 3306: fn render_local_utm_discovery_summary(
 3307:     report: &serde_json::Map<String, Value>,
 3308: ) -> Result<String, String> {
 3309:     let summary = report
 3310:         .get("summary")
 3311:         .and_then(Value::as_object)
 3312:         .ok_or_else(|| "local UTM discovery report is missing summary data".to_string())?;
 3313:     let entries = report
 3314:         .get("entries")
 3315:         .and_then(Value::as_array)
 3316:         .ok_or_else(|| "local UTM discovery report is missing entries data".to_string())?;
 3317: 
 3318:     let summary_string = |key: &str| -> Result<String, String> {
 3319:         summary
 3320:             .get(key)
 3321:             .and_then(Value::as_str)
 3322:             .map(ToString::to_string)
 3323:             .ok_or_else(|| format!("local UTM discovery summary is missing string field: {key}"))
 3324:     };
 3325:     let summary_u64 = |key: &str| -> Result<u64, String> {
 3326:         summary
 3327:             .get(key)
 3328:             .and_then(Value::as_u64)
 3329:             .ok_or_else(|| format!("local UTM discovery summary is missing numeric field: {key}"))
 3330:     };
 3331:     let report_string = |key: &str| -> Option<String> {
 3332:         report
 3333:             .get(key)
 3334:             .and_then(Value::as_str)
 3335:             .map(ToString::to_string)
 3336:     };
 3337:     let entry_string = |entry: &Value, key: &str| -> Option<String> {
 3338:         entry
 3339:             .get(key)
 3340:             .and_then(Value::as_str)
 3341:             .map(ToString::to_string)
 3342:     };
 3343: 
 3344:     let mut lines = vec![
 3345:         format!("discovery_summary.status={}", summary_string("status")?),
 3346:         format!(
 3347:             "discovery_summary.bundle_count={}",
 3348:             summary_u64("bundle_count")?
 3349:         ),
 3350:         format!(
 3351:             "discovery_summary.inventory_matched_count={}",
 3352:             summary_u64("inventory_matched_count")?
 3353:         ),
 3354:         format!(
 3355:             "discovery_summary.live_ip_count={}",
 3356:             summary_u64("live_ip_count")?
 3357:         ),
 3358:         format!(
 3359:             "discovery_summary.ssh_port_open_count={}",
 3360:             summary_u64("ssh_port_open_count")?
 3361:         ),
 3362:         format!(
 3363:             "discovery_summary.ready_count={}",
 3364:             summary_u64("ready_count")?
 3365:         ),
 3366:     ];
 3367: 
 3368:     if let Some(value) = report_string("utm_documents_root") {
 3369:         lines.push(format!("discovery_summary.utm_documents_root={value}"));
 3370:     }
 3371:     if let Some(value) = report_string("inventory_path") {
 3372:         lines.push(format!("discovery_summary.inventory_path={value}"));
 3373:     }
 3374:     if let Some(value) = report_string("utmctl_path") {
 3375:         lines.push(format!("discovery_summary.utmctl_path={value}"));
 3376:     }
 3377:     if let Some(value) = report.get("inventory_error").and_then(Value::as_str)
 3378:         && !value.trim().is_empty()
 3379:     {
 3380:         lines.push(format!("discovery_summary.inventory_error={value}"));
 3381:     }
 3382:     if let Some(value) = report.get("inventory_update").and_then(Value::as_str)
 3383:         && !value.trim().is_empty()
 3384:     {
 3385:         lines.push(format!("discovery_summary.inventory_update={value}"));
 3386:     }
 3387: 
 3388:     for (index, entry) in entries.iter().enumerate() {
 3389:         let prefix = format!("node[{index}]");
 3390:         lines.push(format!(
 3391:             "{prefix}.alias={}",
 3392:             entry_string(entry, "alias").unwrap_or_else(|| "<unknown>".to_string())
 3393:         ));
 3394:         if let Some(value) = entry_string(entry, "inventory_alias") {
 3395:             lines.push(format!("{prefix}.inventory_alias={value}"));
 3396:         }
 3397:         if let Some(value) = entry_string(entry, "inventory_node_id") {
 3398:             lines.push(format!("{prefix}.node_id={value}"));
 3399:         }
 3400:         if let Some(value) = entry_string(entry, "inventory_lab_role") {
 3401:             lines.push(format!("{prefix}.role={value}"));
 3402:         }
 3403:         if let Some(value) = entry_string(entry, "inventory_ssh_target") {
 3404:             lines.push(format!("{prefix}.inventory_ssh_target={value}"));
 3405:         }
 3406:         if let Some(value) = entry_string(entry, "inventory_last_known_ip") {
 3407:             lines.push(format!("{prefix}.inventory_last_known_ip={value}"));
 3408:         }
 3409:         if let Some(value) = entry_string(entry, "inventory_mesh_ip") {
 3410:             lines.push(format!("{prefix}.inventory_mesh_ip={value}"));
 3411:         }
 3412:         if let Some(value) = entry_string(entry, "platform") {
 3413:             lines.push(format!("{prefix}.platform={value}"));
 3414:         }
 3415:         if let Some(value) = entry_string(entry, "live_ip") {
 3416:             lines.push(format!("{prefix}.live_ip={value}"));
 3417:         }
 3418:         if let Some(value) = entry_string(entry, "ssh_target") {
 3419:             lines.push(format!("{prefix}.ssh_target={value}"));
 3420:         }
 3421:         if let Some(value) = entry_string(entry, "ssh_port_status") {
 3422:             lines.push(format!("{prefix}.ssh_port_status={value}"));
 3423:         }
 3424:         if let Some(readiness) = entry.get("readiness").and_then(Value::as_object) {
 3425:             for key in [
 3426:                 "powered",
 3427:                 "networked",
 3428:                 "tcp_ready",
 3429:                 "auth_ready",
 3430:                 "execution_ready",
 3431:             ] {
 3432:                 if let Some(value) = readiness.get(key).and_then(Value::as_bool) {
 3433:                     lines.push(format!("{prefix}.readiness.{key}={value}"));
 3434:                 }
 3435:             }
 3436:             if let Some(reason_codes) = readiness.get("reason_codes").and_then(Value::as_array) {
 3437:                 let joined = reason_codes
 3438:                     .iter()
 3439:                     .filter_map(Value::as_str)
 3440:                     .collect::<Vec<_>>()
 3441:                     .join(",");
 3442:                 if !joined.is_empty() {
 3443:                     lines.push(format!("{prefix}.readiness.reason_codes={joined}"));
 3444:                 }
 3445:             }
 3446:         }
 3447:         if let Some(probe_state) = entry
 3448:             .get("windows_ssh_probe_state")
 3449:             .and_then(Value::as_object)
 3450:         {
 3451:             if let Some(kind) = probe_state.get("kind").and_then(Value::as_str) {
 3452:                 lines.push(format!("{prefix}.windows_ssh_probe.kind={kind}"));
 3453:             }
 3454:             if let Some(reason) = probe_state.get("reason").and_then(Value::as_str) {
 3455:                 lines.push(format!("{prefix}.windows_ssh_probe.reason={reason}"));
 3456:             }
 3457:             if let Some(value) = probe_state.get("value").and_then(Value::as_object) {
 3458:                 for key in [
 3459:                     "openssh_installed",
 3460:                     "service_running",
 3461:                     "firewall_rule_enabled",
 3462:                     "host_key_present",
 3463:                     "listener_ready",
 3464:                 ] {
 3465:                     if let Some(flag) = value.get(key).and_then(Value::as_bool) {
 3466:                         lines.push(format!("{prefix}.windows_ssh_probe.{key}={flag}"));
 3467:                     }
 3468:                 }
 3469:             }
 3470:         }
 3471:         lines.push(format!(
 3472:             "{prefix}.ready={}",
 3473:             entry.get("ready").and_then(Value::as_bool).unwrap_or(false)
 3474:         ));
 3475:         if let Some(notes) = entry.get("notes").and_then(Value::as_array) {
 3476:             let notes = notes
 3477:                 .iter()
 3478:                 .filter_map(Value::as_str)
 3479:                 .map(str::trim)
 3480:                 .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
 3481:                 .collect::<Vec<_>>();
 3482:             if !notes.is_empty() {
 3483:                 lines.push(format!("{prefix}.notes={}", notes.join(", ")));
 3484:             }
 3485:         }
 3486:     }
 3487: 
 3488:     Ok(lines.join("\n"))
 3489: }
