 3491: pub fn execute_ops_vm_lab_start(config: VmLabStartConfig) -> Result<String, String> {
 3492:     let targets = resolve_start_targets(
 3493:         config.inventory_path.as_path(),
 3494:         config.vm_aliases.as_slice(),
 3495:         config.select_all,
 3496:     )?;
 3497:     let utmctl_path = config.utmctl_path;
 3498:     if !utmctl_path.is_file() {
 3499:         return Err(format!(
 3500:             "utmctl binary is not present: {}",
 3501:             utmctl_path.display()
 3502:         ));
 3503:     }
 3504:     let timeout = timeout_or_default(config.timeout_secs, DEFAULT_START_TIMEOUT_SECS);
 3505:     let mut results = Vec::new();
 3506:     for target in &targets {
 3507:         transition_local_utm_vm(
 3508:             utmctl_path.as_path(),
 3509:             target.utm_name.as_str(),
 3510:             target.bundle_path.as_path(),
 3511:             "start",
 3512:             true,
 3513:             timeout,
 3514:         )
 3515:         .map_err(|err| format!("{} start failed: {err}", target.alias))?;
 3516:         results.push(format!(
 3517:             "{} started via utm_name={} bundle_path={}",
 3518:             target.alias,
 3519:             target.utm_name,
 3520:             target.bundle_path.display()
 3521:         ));
 3522:         if target.platform_profile.platform == VmGuestPlatform::Windows {
 3523:             let bootstrap_target = remote_target_from_start_target(target);
 3524:             let host_key_line = bootstrap_windows_access_for_target(
 3525:                 &bootstrap_target,
 3526:                 None,
 3527:                 None,
 3528:                 None,
 3529:                 None,
 3530:                 22,
 3531:                 timeout,
 3532:             )
 3533:             .map_err(|err| format!("{} Windows access bootstrap failed: {err}", target.alias))?;
 3534:             results.push(format!(
 3535:                 "{} windows-access-bootstrap host_key={}",
 3536:                 target.alias, host_key_line
 3537:             ));
 3538:         }
 3539:     }
 3540:     Ok(results.join("\n"))
 3541: }

 3543: pub fn execute_ops_vm_lab_sync_repo(config: VmLabSyncRepoConfig) -> Result<String, String> {

 3571:         config.ssh_user.as_deref(),

 3581: pub fn execute_ops_vm_lab_run(
 3582:     config: VmLabExecConfig,
 3583:     action_label: &str,
 3584: ) -> Result<String, String> {
 3585:     let targets = resolve_remote_targets(
 3586:         config.inventory_path.as_path(),
 3587:         config.vm_aliases.as_slice(),
 3588:         config.select_all,
 3589:         config.raw_targets.as_slice(),
 3590:     )?;
 3591:     ensure_no_control_chars("workdir", config.workdir.as_str())?;
 3592:     ensure_no_control_chars("program", config.program.as_str())?;
 3593:     for arg in &config.argv {
 3594:         ensure_no_control_chars("command arg", arg.as_str())?;
 3595:     }
 3596:     if let Some(ssh_user) = config.ssh_user.as_deref() {
 3597:         ensure_no_control_chars("SSH user", ssh_user)?;
 3598:     }
 3599:     ensure_optional_local_regular_file_path(
 3600:         config.ssh_identity_file.as_deref(),
 3601:         "SSH identity file",
 3602:     )?;
 3603:     ensure_optional_local_regular_file_path(
 3604:         config.known_hosts_path.as_deref(),
 3605:         "SSH known_hosts file",
 3606:     )?;
 3607:     let timeout = timeout_or_default(config.timeout_secs, DEFAULT_RUN_TIMEOUT_SECS);
 3608:     let mut results = Vec::new();
 3609:     for target in &targets {
 3610:         let remote_script = build_remote_argv_script_for_target(
 3611:             target,
 3612:             config.workdir.as_str(),
 3613:             config.program.as_str(),
 3614:             config.argv.as_slice(),
 3615:             config.sudo,
 3616:         )?;
 3617:         let effective_user = config.ssh_user.as_deref();
 3618:         let status = run_remote_shell_command_for_target(
 3619:             target,
 3620:             effective_user,
 3621:             config.ssh_identity_file.as_deref(),
 3622:             config.known_hosts_path.as_deref(),
 3623:             remote_script.as_str(),
 3624:             timeout,
 3625:         )
 3626:         .map_err(|err| format!("{} {} failed: {err}", target.label, action_label))?;
 3627:         if !status.success() {
 3628:             return Err(format!(
 3629:                 "{} {} failed with status {}",
 3630:                 target.label,
 3631:                 action_label,
 3632:                 status_code(status)
 3633:             ));
 3634:         }
 3635:         results.push(format!(
 3636:             "{} {} workdir={} program={} sudo={} ssh_target={} ssh_user={}",
 3637:             target.label,
 3638:             action_label,
 3639:             config.workdir,
 3640:             config.program,
 3641:             config.sudo,
 3642:             target.ssh_target,
 3643:             effective_user
 3644:                 .or(target.ssh_user.as_deref())
 3645:                 .unwrap_or("<ssh-default>"),
 3646:         ));
 3647:     }
 3648:     Ok(results.join("\n"))
 3649: }

 3690:             known_hosts_path: config.known_hosts_path,

 3694:         "bootstrapped",

 3699: 
 3700: fn resolve_repo_sync_source(
 3701:     repo_url: Option<&str>,
 3702:     local_source_dir: Option<&Path>,
 3703:     branch: &str,
 3704:     remote: &str,
 3705: ) -> Result<RepoSyncSource, String> {
 3706:     match (repo_url, local_source_dir) {
 3707:         (Some(_), Some(_)) => Err(
 3708:             "specify either --repo-url or --local-source-dir for vm-lab sync, not both".to_string(),
 3709:         ),
 3710:         (None, None) => {
 3711:             Err("specify one of --repo-url or --local-source-dir for vm-lab sync".to_string())
 3712:         }
 3713:         (Some(repo_url), None) => {
 3714:             ensure_no_control_chars("repo URL", repo_url)?;
 3715:             ensure_no_control_chars("branch", branch)?;
 3716:             ensure_no_control_chars("remote", remote)?;
 3717:             Ok(RepoSyncSource::Git {
 3718:                 repo_url: repo_url.to_string(),
 3719:                 branch: branch.to_string(),
 3720:                 remote: remote.to_string(),
 3721:             })
 3722:         }
 3723:         (None, Some(local_source_dir)) => {
 3724:             ensure_local_directory_path(local_source_dir, "local source dir")?;
 3725:             Ok(RepoSyncSource::LocalSource {
 3726:                 source_dir: local_source_dir.to_path_buf(),
 3727:             })
 3728:         }
 3729:     }
 3730: }
 3731: 
 3732: fn sync_repo_targets(
 3733:     targets: &[RemoteTarget],
 3734:     ssh_user_override: Option<&str>,
 3735:     ssh_identity_file: Option<&Path>,
 3736:     known_hosts_path: Option<&Path>,
 3737:     source: RepoSyncSource,
 3738:     dest_dir: &str,
 3739:     timeout: Duration,
 3740: ) -> Result<Vec<String>, String> {
 3741:     ensure_no_control_chars("destination directory", dest_dir)?;
 3742:     if targets.iter().any(|target| {
 3743:         matches!(
 3744:             target.platform_profile.platform,
 3745:             VmGuestPlatform::Ios | VmGuestPlatform::Android
 3746:         )
 3747:     }) {
 3748:         return Err(
 3749:             "iOS and Android targets are scaffolding-only for vm-lab repo sync right now"
 3750:                 .to_string(),
 3751:         );
 3752:     }
 3753:     let mut results = Vec::new();
 3754:     match source {
 3755:         RepoSyncSource::Git {
 3756:             repo_url,
 3757:             branch,
 3758:             remote,
 3759:         } => {
 3760:             for target in targets {
 3761:                 let repo_sync_script = build_repo_sync_script_for_target(
 3762:                     target,
 3763:                     repo_url.as_str(),
 3764:                     dest_dir,
 3765:                     branch.as_str(),
 3766:                     remote.as_str(),
 3767:                 )?;
 3768:                 let status = run_remote_shell_command_for_target(
 3769:                     target,
 3770:                     ssh_user_override,
 3771:                     ssh_identity_file,
 3772:                     known_hosts_path,
 3773:                     repo_sync_script.as_str(),
 3774:                     timeout,
 3775:                 )
 3776:                 .map_err(|err| format!("{} repo sync failed: {err}", target.label))?;
 3777:                 if !status.success() {
 3778:                     return Err(format!(
 3779:                         "{} repo sync failed with status {}",
 3780:                         target.label,
 3781:                         status_code(status)
 3782:                     ));
 3783:                 }
 3784:                 results.push(format!(
 3785:                     "{} synced repo={} branch={} dest_dir={} ssh_target={} ssh_user={}",
 3786:                     target.label,
 3787:                     repo_url,
 3788:                     branch,
 3789:                     dest_dir,
 3790:                     target.ssh_target,
 3791:                     ssh_user_override
 3792:                         .or(target.ssh_user.as_deref())
 3793:                         .unwrap_or("<ssh-default>"),
 3794:                 ));
 3795:             }
 3796:         }
 3797:         RepoSyncSource::LocalSource { source_dir } => {
 3798:             let posix_archive = if targets.iter().any(|target| {
 3799:                 matches!(
 3800:                     repo_sync_dispatch_kind_for_target(target, RepoSyncMode::LocalSource),
 3801:                     Ok(RepoSyncDispatchKind::PosixLocalArchive)
 3802:                 )
 3803:             }) {
 3804:                 Some(prepare_local_source_archive(source_dir.as_path(), timeout)?)
 3805:             } else {
 3806:                 None
 3807:             };
 3808:             let windows_archive = if targets.iter().any(|target| {
 3809:                 matches!(
 3810:                     repo_sync_dispatch_kind_for_target(target, RepoSyncMode::LocalSource),
 3811:                     Ok(RepoSyncDispatchKind::WindowsZipLocalArchive)
 3812:                 )
 3813:             }) {
 3814:                 Some(prepare_local_source_zip_archive(
 3815:                     source_dir.as_path(),
 3816:                     timeout,
 3817:                 )?)
 3818:             } else {
 3819:                 None
 3820:             };
 3821:             for target in targets {
 3822:                 let archive =
 3823:                     match repo_sync_dispatch_kind_for_target(target, RepoSyncMode::LocalSource)? {
 3824:                         RepoSyncDispatchKind::WindowsZipLocalArchive => windows_archive
 3825:                             .as_ref()
 3826:                             .ok_or_else(|| {
 3827:                                 format!(
 3828:                                     "missing Windows ZIP local source archive for {}",
 3829:                                     target.label
 3830:                                 )
 3831:                             })?
 3832:                             .path
 3833:                             .as_path(),
 3834:                         RepoSyncDispatchKind::PosixLocalArchive => posix_archive
 3835:                             .as_ref()
 3836:                             .ok_or_else(|| {
 3837:                                 format!("missing POSIX local source archive for {}", target.label)
 3838:                             })?
 3839:                             .path
 3840:                             .as_path(),
 3841:                         other => {
 3842:                             return Err(format!(
 3843:                                 "local source sync dispatch mismatch for {}: {other:?}",
 3844:                                 target.label
 3845:                             ));
 3846:                         }
 3847:                     };
 3848:                 sync_local_source_archive_to_target(
 3849:                     archive,
 3850:                     target,
 3851:                     ssh_user_override,
 3852:                     ssh_identity_file,
 3853:                     known_hosts_path,
 3854:                     dest_dir,
 3855:                     timeout,
 3856:                 )
 3857:                 .map_err(|err| format!("{} local source sync failed: {err}", target.label))?;
 3858:                 results.push(format!(
 3859:                     "{} synced local_source_dir={} dest_dir={} ssh_target={} ssh_user={}",
 3860:                     target.label,
 3861:                     source_dir.display(),
 3862:                     dest_dir,
 3863:                     target.ssh_target,
 3864:                     ssh_user_override
 3865:                         .or(target.ssh_user.as_deref())
 3866:                         .unwrap_or("<ssh-default>"),
 3867:                 ));
 3868:             }
 3869:         }
 3870:     }
 3871:     Ok(results)
 3872: }
 3873: 
 3874: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
 3875: enum RepoSyncMode {
 3876:     Git,
 3877:     LocalSource,
 3878: }
 3879: 
 3880: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
 3881: enum RepoSyncDispatchKind {
 3882:     PosixGit,
 3883:     WindowsPowershellGit,
 3884:     PosixLocalArchive,
 3885:     WindowsZipLocalArchive,
 3886: }
 3887: 
 3888: fn repo_sync_dispatch_kind_for_target(
 3889:     target: &RemoteTarget,
 3890:     mode: RepoSyncMode,
 3891: ) -> Result<RepoSyncDispatchKind, String> {
 3892:     match (mode, target.platform_profile.platform) {
 3893:         (RepoSyncMode::Git, VmGuestPlatform::Linux) => Ok(RepoSyncDispatchKind::PosixGit),
 3894:         (RepoSyncMode::Git, VmGuestPlatform::Windows) => {
 3895:             Ok(RepoSyncDispatchKind::WindowsPowershellGit)
 3896:         }
 3897:         (RepoSyncMode::Git, other) => Err(format!(
 3898:             "repo sync is not implemented for platform={} target={}",
 3899:             other.as_str(),
 3900:             target.label
 3901:         )),
 3902:         (RepoSyncMode::LocalSource, VmGuestPlatform::Linux | VmGuestPlatform::Macos) => {
 3903:             Ok(RepoSyncDispatchKind::PosixLocalArchive)
 3904:         }
 3905:         (RepoSyncMode::LocalSource, VmGuestPlatform::Windows) => {
 3906:             Ok(RepoSyncDispatchKind::WindowsZipLocalArchive)
 3907:         }
 3908:         (RepoSyncMode::LocalSource, VmGuestPlatform::Ios | VmGuestPlatform::Android) => {
 3909:             Err(format!(
 3910:                 "local source sync is intentionally scaffold-only for platform={} target={}",
 3911:                 target.platform_profile.platform.as_str(),
 3912:                 target.label
 3913:             ))
 3914:         }
 3915:     }
 3916: }

 3918: fn append_target_platform_metadata(
 3919:     lines: &mut Vec<String>,

 3927:     )?);

 3929:         format!("{prefix}_REMOTE_SHELL").as_str(),
 3930:         target.platform_profile.remote_shell.as_str(),
 3931:     )?);
 3932:     lines.push(format_env_assignment(
 3933:         format!("{prefix}_GUEST_EXEC_MODE").as_str(),
 3934:         target.platform_profile.guest_exec_mode.as_str(),
 3935:     )?);
 3936:     lines.push(format_env_assignment(
 3937:         format!("{prefix}_SERVICE_MANAGER").as_str(),
 3938:         target.platform_profile.service_manager.as_str(),
 3939:     )?);
 3940:     lines.push(format_env_assignment(
 3941:         format!("{prefix}_RUSTYNET_SRC_DIR").as_str(),
 3942:         target.rustynet_src_dir.as_deref().unwrap_or(""),
 3943:     )?);
 3944:     Ok(())
 3945: }

 3975: pub fn execute_ops_vm_lab_write_live_lab_profile(
 3976:     config: VmLabWriteLiveLabProfileConfig,
 3977: ) -> Result<String, String> {
 3978:     let exit_target = resolve_role_target(
 3979:         config.inventory_path.as_path(),
 3980:         "exit",
 3981:         config.exit_vm.as_deref(),
 3982:         config.exit_target.as_deref(),
 3983:     )?;
 3984:     let client_target = resolve_role_target(
 3985:         config.inventory_path.as_path(),
 3986:         "client",
 3987:         config.client_vm.as_deref(),
 3988:         config.client_target.as_deref(),
 3989:     )?;
 3990:     let entry_target = resolve_optional_role_target(
 3991:         config.inventory_path.as_path(),
 3992:         "entry",
 3993:         config.entry_vm.as_deref(),
 3994:         config.entry_target.as_deref(),
 3995:     )?;
 3996:     let aux_target = resolve_optional_role_target(
 3997:         config.inventory_path.as_path(),
 3998:         "aux",
 3999:         config.aux_vm.as_deref(),
 4000:         config.aux_target.as_deref(),
 4001:     )?;
 4002:     let extra_target = resolve_optional_role_target(
 4003:         config.inventory_path.as_path(),
 4004:         "extra",
 4005:         config.extra_vm.as_deref(),
 4006:         config.extra_target.as_deref(),
 4007:     )?;
 4008:     let fifth_client_target = resolve_optional_role_target(
 4009:         config.inventory_path.as_path(),
 4010:         "fifth_client",
 4011:         config.fifth_client_vm.as_deref(),
 4012:         config.fifth_client_target.as_deref(),
 4013:     )?;
 4014: 
 4015:     let role_targets = [
 4016:         Some(exit_target.clone()),
 4017:         Some(client_target.clone()),
 4018:         entry_target.clone(),
 4019:         aux_target.clone(),
 4020:         extra_target.clone(),
 4021:         fifth_client_target.clone(),
 4022:     ];
 4023:     if config.require_same_network {
 4024:         ensure_role_targets_share_network(role_targets.as_slice())?;
 4025:     }
 4026: 
 4027:     ensure_local_regular_file_path(config.ssh_identity_file.as_path(), "SSH identity file")?;
 4028:     if let Some(path) = config.ssh_known_hosts_file.as_deref() {
 4029:         ensure_local_regular_file_path(path, "SSH known_hosts file")?;
 4030:     }
 4031:     if let Some(value) = config.ssh_allow_cidrs.as_deref() {
 4032:         ensure_no_control_chars("SSH allow CIDRs", value)?;
 4033:     }
 4034:     if let Some(value) = config.network_id.as_deref() {
 4035:         ensure_no_control_chars("network_id", value)?;
 4036:     }
 4037:     if let Some(value) = config.cross_network_nat_profiles.as_deref() {
 4038:         ensure_no_control_chars("cross-network NAT profiles", value)?;
 4039:     }
 4040:     if let Some(value) = config.cross_network_required_nat_profiles.as_deref() {
 4041:         ensure_no_control_chars("cross-network required NAT profiles", value)?;
 4042:     }
 4043:     if let Some(value) = config.cross_network_impairment_profile.as_deref() {
 4044:         ensure_no_control_chars("cross-network impairment profile", value)?;
 4045:     }
 4046:     if let Some(value) = config.backend.as_deref() {
 4047:         ensure_no_control_chars("backend", value)?;
 4048:     }
 4049:     if let Some(value) = config.source_mode.as_deref() {
 4050:         ensure_no_control_chars("source mode", value)?;
 4051:     }
 4052:     if let Some(value) = config.repo_ref.as_deref() {
 4053:         ensure_no_control_chars("repo ref", value)?;
 4054:     }
 4055:     let (resolved_source_mode, resolved_repo_ref) = resolve_iteration_source_selection(
 4056:         config.source_mode.as_deref(),
 4057:         config.repo_ref.as_deref(),
 4058:         false,
 4059:         false,
 4060:         false,
 4061:     )?;
 4062: 
 4063:     let mut lines = vec![
 4064:         "# Generated by rustynet-cli ops vm-lab-write-live-lab-profile".to_string(),
 4065:         format_env_assignment("EXIT_TARGET", exit_target.normalized_target.as_str())?,
 4066:         format_env_assignment("CLIENT_TARGET", client_target.normalized_target.as_str())?,
 4067:         format_env_assignment(
 4068:             "SSH_IDENTITY_FILE",
 4069:             config.ssh_identity_file.display().to_string().as_str(),
 4070:         )?,
 4071:     ];
 4072:     if let Some(utm_name) = exit_target.utm_name.as_deref() {
 4073:         lines.push(format_env_assignment("EXIT_UTM_NAME", utm_name)?);
 4074:     }
 4075:     append_target_platform_metadata(&mut lines, "EXIT", &exit_target)?;
 4076:     if let Some(utm_name) = client_target.utm_name.as_deref() {
 4077:         lines.push(format_env_assignment("CLIENT_UTM_NAME", utm_name)?);
 4078:     }
 4079:     append_target_platform_metadata(&mut lines, "CLIENT", &client_target)?;
 4080:     if let Some(target) = entry_target {
 4081:         lines.push(format_env_assignment(
 4082:             "ENTRY_TARGET",
 4083:             target.normalized_target.as_str(),
 4084:         )?);
 4085:         if let Some(utm_name) = target.utm_name.as_deref() {
 4086:             lines.push(format_env_assignment("ENTRY_UTM_NAME", utm_name)?);
 4087:         }
 4088:         append_target_platform_metadata(&mut lines, "ENTRY", &target)?;
 4089:     } else {
 4090:         append_empty_target_platform_metadata(&mut lines, "ENTRY")?;
 4091:     }
 4092:     if let Some(target) = aux_target {
 4093:         lines.push(format_env_assignment(
 4094:             "AUX_TARGET",
 4095:             target.normalized_target.as_str(),
 4096:         )?);
 4097:         if let Some(utm_name) = target.utm_name.as_deref() {
 4098:             lines.push(format_env_assignment("AUX_UTM_NAME", utm_name)?);
 4099:         }
 4100:         append_target_platform_metadata(&mut lines, "AUX", &target)?;
 4101:     } else {
 4102:         append_empty_target_platform_metadata(&mut lines, "AUX")?;
 4103:     }
 4104:     if let Some(target) = extra_target {
 4105:         lines.push(format_env_assignment(
 4106:             "EXTRA_TARGET",
 4107:             target.normalized_target.as_str(),
 4108:         )?);
 4109:         if let Some(utm_name) = target.utm_name.as_deref() {
 4110:             lines.push(format_env_assignment("EXTRA_UTM_NAME", utm_name)?);
 4111:         }
 4112:         append_target_platform_metadata(&mut lines, "EXTRA", &target)?;
 4113:     } else {
 4114:         append_empty_target_platform_metadata(&mut lines, "EXTRA")?;
 4115:     }
 4116:     match fifth_client_target {
 4117:         Some(target) => {
 4118:             lines.push(format_env_assignment(
 4119:                 "FIFTH_CLIENT_TARGET",
 4120:                 target.normalized_target.as_str(),
 4121:             )?);
 4122:             if let Some(utm_name) = target.utm_name.as_deref() {
 4123:                 lines.push(format_env_assignment("FIFTH_CLIENT_UTM_NAME", utm_name)?);
 4124:             }
 4125:             append_target_platform_metadata(&mut lines, "FIFTH_CLIENT", &target)?;
 4126:         }
 4127:         None => {
 4128:             // Keep five-node profiles explicitly non-interactive by declaring the
 4129:             // optional sixth-node slots as intentionally empty.
 4130:             lines.push(format_env_assignment("FIFTH_CLIENT_TARGET", "")?);
 4131:             lines.push(format_env_assignment("FIFTH_CLIENT_UTM_NAME", "")?);
 4132:             append_empty_target_platform_metadata(&mut lines, "FIFTH_CLIENT")?;
 4133:         }
 4134:     }
 4135:     if let Some(path) = config.ssh_known_hosts_file.as_deref() {
 4136:         lines.push(format_env_assignment(
 4137:             "SSH_KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE",
 4138:             path.display().to_string().as_str(),
 4139:         )?);
 4140:     }
 4141:     if let Some(value) = config.ssh_allow_cidrs.as_deref() {
 4142:         lines.push(format_env_assignment("SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS", value)?);
 4143:     }
 4144:     if let Some(value) = config.network_id.as_deref() {
 4145:         lines.push(format_env_assignment("NETWORK_ID", value)?);
 4146:     }
 4147:     if let Some(ttl) = config.traversal_ttl_secs {
 4148:         lines.push(format_env_assignment(
 4149:             "TRAVERSAL_TTL_SECS",
 4150:             ttl.to_string().as_str(),
 4151:         )?);
 4152:     }
 4153:     if let Some(value) = config.cross_network_nat_profiles.as_deref() {
 4154:         lines.push(format_env_assignment("CROSS_NETWORK_NAT_PROFILES", value)?);
 4155:     }
 4156:     if let Some(value) = config.cross_network_required_nat_profiles.as_deref() {
 4157:         lines.push(format_env_assignment(
 4158:             "CROSS_NETWORK_REQUIRED_NAT_PROFILES",
 4159:             value,
 4160:         )?);
 4161:     }
 4162:     if let Some(value) = config.cross_network_impairment_profile.as_deref() {
 4163:         lines.push(format_env_assignment(
 4164:             "CROSS_NETWORK_IMPAIRMENT_PROFILE",
 4165:             value,
 4166:         )?);
 4167:     }
 4168:     if let Some(value) = config.backend.as_deref() {
 4169:         lines.push(format_env_assignment("RUSTYNET_BACKEND", value)?);
 4170:     }
 4171:     lines.push(format_env_assignment(
 4172:         "SOURCE_MODE",
 4173:         resolved_source_mode.as_str(),
 4174:     )?);
 4175:     if let Some(value) = resolved_repo_ref.as_deref() {
 4176:         lines.push(format_env_assignment("REPO_REF", value)?);
 4177:     }
 4178:     if let Some(path) = config.report_dir.as_deref() {
 4179:         lines.push(format_env_assignment(
 4180:             "REPORT_DIR",
 4181:             path.display().to_string().as_str(),
 4182:         )?);
 4183:     }
 4184:     lines.push(String::new());
 4185: 
 4186:     let parent = config
 4187:         .output_path
 4188:         .parent()
 4189:         .filter(|path| !path.as_os_str().is_empty())
 4190:         .ok_or_else(|| {
 4191:             format!(
 4192:                 "profile output path must have a parent directory: {}",
 4193:                 config.output_path.display()
 4194:             )
 4195:         })?;
 4196:     fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|err| {
 4197:         format!(
 4198:             "create profile directory failed ({}): {err}",
 4199:             parent.display()
 4200:         )
 4201:     })?;
 4202:     fs::write(&config.output_path, lines.join("\n")).map_err(|err| {
 4203:         format!(
 4204:             "write live-lab profile failed ({}): {err}",
 4205:             config.output_path.display()
 4206:         )
 4207:     })?;
 4208: 
 4209:     Ok(format!(
 4210:         "wrote live-lab profile={} exit={} client={}",
 4211:         config.output_path.display(),
 4212:         exit_target.normalized_target,
 4213:         client_target.normalized_target
 4214:     ))
 4215: }
 4216: 
 4217: fn default_inventory_alias_for_lab_roles(
 4218:     inventory_path: &Path,
 4219:     role_labels: &[&str],
 4220: ) -> Result<Option<String>, String> {
 4221:     let inventory = load_inventory(inventory_path)?;
 4222:     let matches = inventory
 4223:         .into_iter()
 4224:         .filter(|entry| {
 4225:             entry
 4226:                 .lab_role
 4227:                 .as_deref()
 4228:                 .map(|value| role_labels.contains(&value))
 4229:                 .unwrap_or(false)
 4230:         })
 4231:         .map(|entry| entry.alias)
 4232:         .collect::<Vec<_>>();
 4233:     match matches.as_slice() {
 4234:         [] => Ok(None),
 4235:         [alias] => Ok(Some(alias.clone())),
 4236:         _ => Err(format!(
 4237:             "multiple inventory entries match lab roles {}: {}",
 4238:             role_labels.join(","),
 4239:             matches.join(", ")
 4240:         )),
 4241:     }
 4242: }
 4243: 
 4244: fn push_unique_alias(aliases: &mut Vec<String>, alias: Option<String>) {
 4245:     if let Some(alias) = alias
 4246:         && !aliases.iter().any(|existing| existing == &alias)
 4247:     {
 4248:         aliases.push(alias);
 4249:     }
 4250: }
 4251: 
 4252: fn resolve_live_lab_vm_aliases(
 4253:     inventory_path: &Path,
 4254:     exit_vm: Option<&str>,
 4255:     client_vm: Option<&str>,
 4256:     entry_vm: Option<&str>,
 4257:     aux_vm: Option<&str>,
 4258:     extra_vm: Option<&str>,
 4259:     fifth_client_vm: Option<&str>,
 4260: ) -> Result<Vec<String>, String> {
 4261:     let mut aliases = Vec::new();
 4262:     push_unique_alias(
 4263:         &mut aliases,
 4264:         match exit_vm {
 4265:             Some(value) => Some(value.to_string()),
 4266:             None => default_inventory_alias_for_lab_roles(inventory_path, &["exit"])?,
 4267:         },
 4268:     );
 4269:     push_unique_alias(
 4270:         &mut aliases,
 4271:         match client_vm {
 4272:             Some(value) => Some(value.to_string()),
 4273:             None => default_inventory_alias_for_lab_roles(inventory_path, &["client"])?,
 4274:         },
 4275:     );
 4276:     push_unique_alias(
 4277:         &mut aliases,
 4278:         match entry_vm {
 4279:             Some(value) => Some(value.to_string()),
 4280:             None => default_inventory_alias_for_lab_roles(inventory_path, &["entry", "relay"])?,
 4281:         },
 4282:     );
 4283:     push_unique_alias(
 4284:         &mut aliases,
 4285:         match aux_vm {
 4286:             Some(value) => Some(value.to_string()),
 4287:             None => default_inventory_alias_for_lab_roles(inventory_path, &["aux"])?,
 4288:         },
 4289:     );
 4290:     push_unique_alias(
 4291:         &mut aliases,
 4292:         match extra_vm {
 4293:             Some(value) => Some(value.to_string()),
 4294:             None => default_inventory_alias_for_lab_roles(inventory_path, &["extra"])?,
 4295:         },
 4296:     );
 4297:     push_unique_alias(
 4298:         &mut aliases,
 4299:         match fifth_client_vm {
 4300:             Some(value) => Some(value.to_string()),
 4301:             None => default_inventory_alias_for_lab_roles(inventory_path, &["fifth_client"])?,
 4302:         },
 4303:     );
 4304:     if aliases.is_empty() {
 4305:         return Err(
 4306:             "could not resolve any live-lab VM aliases from explicit flags or inventory lab_role metadata"
 4307:                 .to_string(),
 4308:         );
 4309:     }
 4310:     Ok(aliases)
 4311: }

 4314:     serde_json::from_str(text).map_err(|err| format!("parse vm-lab command result failed: {err}"))
 4315: }

 4317: fn selected_local_utm_readiness_from_report(
 4318:     report_text: &str,
 4319:     selected_aliases: &[String],
 4320: ) -> Result<LocalUtmSelectedReadinessSummary, String> {
 4321:     let report: LocalUtmDiscoveryReport = serde_json::from_str(report_text)
 4322:         .map_err(|err| format!("parse local UTM discovery report failed: {err}"))?;
 4323:     let entries_by_alias = report
 4324:         .entries
 4325:         .into_iter()
 4326:         .map(|entry| {
 4327:             let alias = entry.alias.clone();
 4328:             (alias, entry)
 4329:         })
 4330:         .collect::<BTreeMap<_, _>>();
 4331: 
 4332:     let mut ready_aliases = Vec::new();
 4333:     let mut unready_entries = Vec::new();
 4334:     let mut missing_aliases = Vec::new();
 4335:     for alias in selected_aliases {
 4336:         let Some(entry) = entries_by_alias.get(alias.as_str()) else {
 4337:             missing_aliases.push(alias.clone());
 4338:             continue;
 4339:         };
 4340:         if entry.readiness.execution_ready {
 4341:             ready_aliases.push(alias.clone());
 4342:         } else {
 4343:             unready_entries.push(LocalUtmSelectedReadinessEntry {
 4344:                 alias: alias.clone(),
 4345:                 reason_codes: entry.readiness.reason_codes.clone(),
 4346:             });
 4347:         }
 4348:     }
 4349:     if !missing_aliases.is_empty() {
 4350:         return Err(format!(
 4351:             "local UTM discovery did not report the selected aliases: {}",
 4352:             missing_aliases.join(", ")
 4353:         ));
 4354:     }
 4355:     Ok(LocalUtmSelectedReadinessSummary {
 4356:         ready_aliases,
 4357:         unready_entries,
 4358:     })
 4359: }
 4360: 
 4361: fn render_selected_local_utm_readiness(summary: &LocalUtmSelectedReadinessSummary) -> String {
 4362:     let ready = if summary.ready_aliases.is_empty() {
 4363:         "none".to_string()
 4364:     } else {
 4365:         summary.ready_aliases.join(", ")
 4366:     };
 4367:     let unready = if summary.unready_entries.is_empty() {
 4368:         "none".to_string()
 4369:     } else {
 4370:         summary
 4371:             .unready_entries
 4372:             .iter()
 4373:             .map(|entry| {
 4374:                 if entry.reason_codes.is_empty() {
 4375:                     entry.alias.clone()
 4376:                 } else {
 4377:                     format!("{} ({})", entry.alias, entry.reason_codes.join(","))
 4378:                 }
 4379:             })
 4380:             .collect::<Vec<_>>()
 4381:             .join("; ")
 4382:     };
 4383:     format!("ready={ready}; unready={unready}")
 4384: }
 4385: 
 4386: fn not_execution_ready_aliases(summary: &LocalUtmSelectedReadinessSummary) -> Vec<String> {
 4387:     summary
 4388:         .unready_entries
 4389:         .iter()
 4390:         .map(|entry| entry.alias.clone())
 4391:         .collect()
 4392: }

 4460: fn append_unique_stage_outcomes_collect_new(
 4461:     outcomes: &mut Vec<VmLabStageOutcome>,
 4462:     additional: &[VmLabStageOutcome],
 4463: ) -> Vec<VmLabStageOutcome> {
 4464:     let mut seen = outcomes
 4465:         .iter()
 4466:         .map(|outcome| outcome.stage.clone())
 4467:         .collect::<HashSet<_>>();
 4468:     let mut appended = Vec::new();
 4469:     for outcome in additional {
 4470:         if seen.insert(outcome.stage.clone()) {
 4471:             outcomes.push(outcome.clone());
 4472:             appended.push(outcome.clone());
 4473:         }
 4474:     }
 4475:     appended
 4476: }

 4478: fn write_orchestration_artifact(path: &Path, contents: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
 4479:     if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
 4480:         fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|err| {
 4481:             format!(
 4482:                 "create orchestration artifact dir failed ({}): {err}",
 4483:                 parent.display()
 4484:             )
 4485:         })?;
 4486:     }
 4487:     fs::write(path, contents).map_err(|err| {
 4488:         format!(
 4489:             "write orchestration artifact failed ({}): {err}",
 4490:             path.display()
 4491:         )
 4492:     })
 4493: }

 4495: fn create_orchestration_staging_dir() -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
 4496:     let dir =
 4497:         std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("rustynet-vm-lab-orchestration-{}", unique_suffix()));
 4498:     fs::create_dir_all(dir.as_path()).map_err(|err| {
 4499:         format!(
 4500:             "create orchestration staging dir failed ({}): {err}",
 4501:             dir.display()
 4502:         )
 4503:     })?;
 4504:     Ok(dir)
 4505: }
 4506: 
 4507: fn materialize_orchestration_staging_dir(
 4508:     staging_dir: &Path,
 4509:     orchestration_dir: &Path,
 4510: ) -> Result<(), String> {
 4511:     if !staging_dir.exists() {
 4512:         return Ok(());
 4513:     }
 4514:     let mut pending = vec![(staging_dir.to_path_buf(), orchestration_dir.to_path_buf())];
 4515:     while let Some((source_dir, destination_dir)) = pending.pop() {
 4516:         fs::create_dir_all(destination_dir.as_path()).map_err(|err| {
 4517:             format!(
 4518:                 "create orchestration destination dir failed ({}): {err}",
 4519:                 destination_dir.display()
 4520:             )
 4521:         })?;
 4522:         for entry in fs::read_dir(source_dir.as_path()).map_err(|err| {
 4523:             format!(
 4524:                 "read orchestration staging dir failed ({}): {err}",
 4525:                 source_dir.display()
 4526:             )
 4527:         })? {
 4528:             let entry = entry.map_err(|err| {
 4529:                 format!(
 4530:                     "iterate orchestration staging dir failed ({}): {err}",
 4531:                     source_dir.display()
 4532:                 )
 4533:             })?;
 4534:             let source_path = entry.path();
 4535:             let destination_path = destination_dir.join(entry.file_name());
 4536:             let file_type = entry.file_type().map_err(|err| {
 4537:                 format!(
 4538:                     "read orchestration staging entry type failed ({}): {err}",
 4539:                     source_path.display()
 4540:                 )
 4541:             })?;
 4542:             if file_type.is_dir() {
 4543:                 pending.push((source_path, destination_path));
 4544:             } else if file_type.is_file() {
 4545:                 if let Some(parent) = destination_path.parent() {
 4546:                     fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|err| {
 4547:                         format!(
 4548:                             "create orchestration artifact parent dir failed ({}): {err}",
 4549:                             parent.display()
 4550:                         )
 4551:                     })?;
 4552:                 }
 4553:                 fs::copy(source_path.as_path(), destination_path.as_path()).map_err(|err| {
 4554:                     format!(
 4555:                         "copy orchestration artifact failed ({} -> {}): {err}",
 4556:                         source_path.display(),
 4557:                         destination_path.display()
 4558:                     )
 4559:                 })?;
 4560:             } else {
 4561:                 return Err(format!(
 4562:                     "unsupported orchestration staging entry type: {}",
 4563:                     source_path.display()
 4564:                 ));
 4565:             }
 4566:         }
 4567:     }
 4568:     fs::remove_dir_all(staging_dir).map_err(|err| {
 4569:         format!(
 4570:             "remove orchestration staging dir failed ({}): {err}",
 4571:             staging_dir.display()
 4572:         )
 4573:     })
 4574: }
 4575: 
 4576: fn orchestrated_command_status(
 4577:     outcomes: &[VmLabStageOutcome],
 4578:     warnings: &[String],
 4579: ) -> VmLabCommandOverallStatus {
 4580:     if outcomes
 4581:         .iter()
 4582:         .any(|outcome| outcome.status == VmLabStageStatus::Fail)
 4583:     {
 4584:         VmLabCommandOverallStatus::Fail
 4585:     } else if !warnings.is_empty()
 4586:         || outcomes
 4587:             .iter()
 4588:             .any(|outcome| outcome.status == VmLabStageStatus::Skipped)
 4589:     {
 4590:         VmLabCommandOverallStatus::Partial
 4591:     } else {
 4592:         VmLabCommandOverallStatus::Pass
 4593:     }
 4594: }
 4595: 
 4596: fn finalize_vm_lab_orchestration_result(
 4597:     command: &str,
 4598:     report_dir: &Path,
 4599:     orchestration_dir: &Path,
 4600:     outcomes: Vec<VmLabStageOutcome>,
 4601:     warnings: Vec<String>,
 4602:     next_actions: Vec<String>,
 4603: ) -> Result<String, String> {
 4604:     let overall_status = orchestrated_command_status(outcomes.as_slice(), warnings.as_slice());
 4605:     let rendered = serialize_vm_lab_command_result(&VmLabCommandResult {
 4606:         command: command.to_string(),
 4607:         overall_status: overall_status.clone(),
 4608:         report_dir: report_dir.display().to_string(),
 4609:         outcomes,
 4610:         warnings,
 4611:         next_actions,
 4612:     })?;
 4613:     write_orchestration_artifact(
 4614:         orchestration_dir.join("orchestrate_result.json").as_path(),
 4615:         rendered.as_str(),
 4616:     )?;
 4617:     eprintln!(
 4618:         "{}",
 4619:         render_vm_lab_progress_complete_line(
 4620:             command,
 4621:             &overall_status,
 4622:             orchestration_dir.join("orchestrate_result.json").as_path(),
 4623:             report_dir,
 4624:         )
 4625:     );
 4626:     match overall_status {
 4627:         VmLabCommandOverallStatus::Fail => Err(rendered),
 4628:         VmLabCommandOverallStatus::Pass | VmLabCommandOverallStatus::Partial => Ok(rendered),
 4629:     }
 4630: }

 4632: fn build_vm_lab_command_result_output(
 4633:     command: &str,
 4634:     report_dir: Option<&Path>,
 4635:     fallback_report_dir: &Path,
 4636:     artifact_filename: &str,
 4637:     outcomes: Vec<VmLabStageOutcome>,
 4638:     warnings: Vec<String>,
 4639:     next_actions: Vec<String>,
 4640: ) -> Result<(String, VmLabCommandOverallStatus), String> {
 4641:     let overall_status = orchestrated_command_status(outcomes.as_slice(), warnings.as_slice());
 4642:     let rendered = serialize_vm_lab_command_result(&VmLabCommandResult {
 4643:         command: command.to_string(),
 4644:         overall_status: overall_status.clone(),
 4645:         report_dir: report_dir_label(report_dir, fallback_report_dir),
 4646:         outcomes,
 4647:         warnings,
 4648:         next_actions,
 4649:     })?;
 4650:     if let Some(report_dir) = report_dir {
 4651:         write_orchestration_artifact(
 4652:             report_dir.join(artifact_filename).as_path(),
 4653:             rendered.as_str(),
 4654:         )?;
 4655:     }
 4656:     Ok((rendered, overall_status))
 4657: }

 4659: fn resolve_setup_live_lab_selection(
 4660:     config: &VmLabSetupLiveLabConfig,
 4661: ) -> Result<LiveLabSetupSelection, String> {
 4662:     if let Some(profile_path) = config.profile_path.as_deref() {
 4663:         execute_ops_vm_lab_validate_live_lab_profile(VmLabValidateLiveLabProfileConfig {
 4664:             profile_path: profile_path.to_path_buf(),
 4665:             expected_backend: None,
 4666:             expected_source_mode: None,
 4667:             require_five_node: false,
 4668:         })?;
 4669:         let profile = load_live_lab_profile(profile_path)?;
 4670:         ensure_live_lab_profile_linux_only(&profile, "vm-lab-setup-live-lab")?;
 4671:         return Ok(LiveLabSetupSelection {
 4672:             profile_path: profile_path.to_path_buf(),
 4673:             profile_generated: false,
 4674:             profile_generation_summary: None,
 4675:         });
 4676:     }
 4677: 
 4678:     let profile_path = config
 4679:         .profile_output_path
 4680:         .clone()
 4681:         .unwrap_or_else(|| default_live_lab_setup_profile_path(config.report_dir.as_path()));
 4682:     let exit_vm = match config.exit_vm.clone() {
 4683:         Some(value) => Some(value),
 4684:         None => default_inventory_alias_for_lab_roles(config.inventory_path.as_path(), &["exit"])?,
 4685:     };
 4686:     let client_vm = match config.client_vm.clone() {
 4687:         Some(value) => Some(value),
 4688:         None => {
 4689:             default_inventory_alias_for_lab_roles(config.inventory_path.as_path(), &["client"])?
 4690:         }
 4691:     };
 4692:     let entry_vm = match config.entry_vm.clone() {
 4693:         Some(value) => Some(value),
 4694:         None => default_inventory_alias_for_lab_roles(
 4695:             config.inventory_path.as_path(),
 4696:             &["entry", "relay"],
 4697:         )?,
 4698:     };
 4699:     let aux_vm = match config.aux_vm.clone() {
 4700:         Some(value) => Some(value),
 4701:         None => default_inventory_alias_for_lab_roles(config.inventory_path.as_path(), &["aux"])?,
 4702:     };
 4703:     let extra_vm = match config.extra_vm.clone() {
 4704:         Some(value) => Some(value),
 4705:         None => default_inventory_alias_for_lab_roles(config.inventory_path.as_path(), &["extra"])?,
 4706:     };
 4707:     let fifth_client_vm = match config.fifth_client_vm.clone() {
 4708:         Some(value) => Some(value),
 4709:         None => default_inventory_alias_for_lab_roles(
 4710:             config.inventory_path.as_path(),
 4711:             &["fifth_client"],
 4712:         )?,
 4713:     };
 4714:     let profile_summary =
 4715:         execute_ops_vm_lab_write_live_lab_profile(VmLabWriteLiveLabProfileConfig {
 4716:             inventory_path: config.inventory_path.clone(),
 4717:             output_path: profile_path.clone(),
 4718:             exit_vm,
 4719:             exit_target: None,
 4720:             client_vm,
 4721:             client_target: None,
 4722:             entry_vm,
 4723:             entry_target: None,
 4724:             aux_vm,
 4725:             aux_target: None,
 4726:             extra_vm,
 4727:             extra_target: None,
 4728:             fifth_client_vm,
 4729:             fifth_client_target: None,
 4730:             require_same_network: config.require_same_network,
 4731:             ssh_identity_file: config.ssh_identity_file.clone(),
 4732:             ssh_known_hosts_file: config.known_hosts_path.clone(),
 4733:             ssh_allow_cidrs: None,
 4734:             network_id: None,
 4735:             traversal_ttl_secs: None,
 4736:             cross_network_nat_profiles: None,
 4737:             cross_network_required_nat_profiles: None,
 4738:             cross_network_impairment_profile: None,
 4739:             backend: None,
 4740:             source_mode: config.source_mode.clone(),
 4741:             repo_ref: config.repo_ref.clone(),
 4742:             report_dir: Some(config.report_dir.clone()),
 4743:         })?;
 4744:     execute_ops_vm_lab_validate_live_lab_profile(VmLabValidateLiveLabProfileConfig {
 4745:         profile_path: profile_path.clone(),
 4746:         expected_backend: None,
 4747:         expected_source_mode: None,
 4748:         require_five_node: false,
 4749:     })?;
 4750:     let profile = load_live_lab_profile(profile_path.as_path())?;
 4751:     ensure_live_lab_profile_linux_only(&profile, "vm-lab-setup-live-lab")?;
 4752:     Ok(LiveLabSetupSelection {
 4753:         profile_path,
 4754:         profile_generated: true,
 4755:         profile_generation_summary: Some(profile_summary),
 4756:     })
 4757: }
