 6014: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 6015: // W3.3 RustOrchestrator
 6016: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
 6017: 
 6018: /// Per-target Rust orchestrator that selects between two execution
 6019: /// strategies based on the target platform set:
 6020: ///
 6021: /// 1. **Pure-Linux node set** — delegates to the wrapped
 6022: ///    `LinuxBashOrchestrator`. Parity with the existing bash impl is
 6023: ///    *identity* in this mode: the live-lab is run by literally
 6024: ///    invoking `scripts/e2e/live_linux_lab_orchestrator.sh`, exactly
 6025: ///    as it has been since the repository's first live-lab landed.
 6026: ///    No new dispatch code runs, no behavioral surface drifts; the
 6027: ///    plan §6.1 + §9 rollback contract — "for pure-Linux node sets,
 6028: ///    [`RustOrchestrator`] must produce byte-identical (or
 6029: ///    behaviorally equivalent) reports to the bash impl. No silent
 6030: ///    divergence." — is satisfied by construction.
 6031: ///
 6032: /// 2. **Heterogeneous node set (any non-Linux target)** — rejects up-
 6033: ///    front with a roadmap blocker citing W4.1. The Linux-only gate
 6034: ///    `ensure_live_lab_profile_linux_only` at the existing
 6035: ///    `execute_ops_vm_lab_run_live_lab` entry point enforces the same
 6036: ///    contract today; `RustOrchestrator` mirrors it so any caller
 6037: ///    that bypasses the entry-point function and reaches for the
 6038: ///    trait directly still fails closed. When W4.1 lands the per-
 6039: ///    stage capability gating + the per-target adapter dispatch
 6040: ///    (using the W3.2 `RuntimePaths` / `ServiceManager` /
 6041: ///    `RemoteExec` / `DaemonProbe` traits), this branch becomes the
 6042: ///    real heterogeneous execution path.
 6043: ///
 6044: /// `RustOrchestrator::new(linux_bash, target_platforms)` consumes a
 6045: /// pre-built `LinuxBashOrchestrator` and the resolved per-target
 6046: /// platform set. The platform set is captured up-front so the
 6047: /// dispatch decision is a pure function of the inputs and cannot be
 6048: /// affected by mid-run inventory mutation.
 6049: #[allow(dead_code)]
 6050: pub struct RustOrchestrator {
 6051:     linux_bash: LinuxBashOrchestrator,
 6052:     target_platforms: Vec<VmGuestPlatform>,
 6053: }
 6054: 
 6055: impl RustOrchestrator {
 6056:     #[allow(dead_code)]
 6057:     pub fn new(linux_bash: LinuxBashOrchestrator, target_platforms: Vec<VmGuestPlatform>) -> Self {
 6058:         Self {
 6059:             linux_bash,
 6060:             target_platforms,
 6061:         }
 6062:     }
 6063: 
 6064:     /// True when every captured target platform is `Linux` (or the
 6065:     /// platform set is empty — empty defaults to Linux today since
 6066:     /// the bash orchestrator's profile gating already enforces a
 6067:     /// 5×Linux topology).
 6068:     #[allow(dead_code)]
 6069:     fn is_pure_linux(&self) -> bool {
 6070:         self.target_platforms.is_empty()
 6071:             || self
 6072:                 .target_platforms
 6073:                 .iter()
 6074:                 .all(|p| matches!(p, VmGuestPlatform::Linux))
 6075:     }
 6076: 
 6077:     /// Names of any non-Linux platforms in the captured set. Used to
 6078:     /// build a precise blocker message when the heterogeneous-set
 6079:     /// branch rejects.
 6080:     #[allow(dead_code)]
 6081:     fn non_linux_platforms(&self) -> Vec<&'static str> {
 6082:         let mut found = Vec::new();
 6083:         for platform in &self.target_platforms {
 6084:             if !matches!(platform, VmGuestPlatform::Linux) {
 6085:                 let label = platform.as_str();
 6086:                 if !found.contains(&label) {
 6087:                     found.push(label);
 6088:                 }
 6089:             }
 6090:         }
 6091:         found
 6092:     }
 6093: }
 6094: 
 6095: impl StageOrchestrator for RustOrchestrator {
 6096:     fn execute_live_lab(&self, inputs: &LiveLabRunInputs) -> Result<LiveLabRunReport, String> {
 6097:         if self.is_pure_linux() {
 6098:             // Parity proof for pure-Linux: delegate to the wrapped
 6099:             // bash orchestrator. Behavior is identity — same script,
 6100:             // same flag set, same TSV-on-disk contract. No new code
 6101:             // runs in this branch beyond the dispatch decision
 6102:             // itself.
 6103:             return self.linux_bash.execute_live_lab(inputs);
 6104:         }
 6105: 
 6106:         // Heterogeneous set: refuse to execute today. The orchestrator
 6107:         // entry point's `ensure_live_lab_profile_linux_only` already
 6108:         // rejects this case at the profile boundary; this is the
 6109:         // belt-and-braces equivalent at the trait boundary so a
 6110:         // caller who bypasses the entry point and reaches for the
 6111:         // trait directly still fails closed. W4.1 wires per-stage
 6112:         // capability gating + per-target adapter dispatch and turns
 6113:         // this branch into the real heterogeneous execution path.
 6114:         let blockers = self.non_linux_platforms();
 6115:         Err(format!(
 6116:             "RustOrchestrator refuses heterogeneous live-lab execution today: \
 6117:              non-Linux platforms in target set [{}]. The W4.1 capability-gating \
 6118:              slice removes the Linux-only gate and wires per-target adapter \
 6119:              dispatch (see OS-agnostic delta plan §6.2 / §7 W4.1). Until then, \
 6120:              use the LinuxBashOrchestrator path for pure-Linux runs and the \
 6121:              existing Windows sidecar for Windows peers.",
 6122:             blockers.join(", ")
 6123:         ))
 6124:     }
 6125: }
 6126: 
 6127: pub fn execute_ops_vm_lab_run_live_lab(config: VmLabRunLiveLabConfig) -> Result<String, String> {
 6128:     ensure_local_regular_file_path(config.profile_path.as_path(), "live-lab profile")?;
 6129:     ensure_local_regular_file_path(config.script_path.as_path(), "live-lab script")?;
 6130:     let profile = load_live_lab_profile(config.profile_path.as_path())?;
 6131:     ensure_live_lab_profile_linux_only(&profile, "vm-lab-run-live-lab")?;
 6132:     if let Some(value) = config.source_mode.as_deref() {
 6133:         ensure_no_control_chars("source mode", value)?;
 6134:     }
 6135:     if let Some(value) = config.repo_ref.as_deref() {
 6136:         ensure_no_control_chars("repo ref", value)?;
 6137:     }
 6138:     let (resolved_source_mode, resolved_repo_ref) = resolve_iteration_source_selection(
 6139:         config.source_mode.as_deref(),
 6140:         config.repo_ref.as_deref(),
 6141:         false,
 6142:         false,
 6143:         false,
 6144:     )?;
 6145: 
 6146:     let report_dir = match config.report_dir.clone() {
 6147:         Some(path) => path,
 6148:         None => profile
 6149:             .optional("REPORT_DIR")
 6150:             .map(PathBuf::from)
 6151:             .unwrap_or_else(|| {
 6152:                 default_live_lab_report_root().join(format!("run_{}", unique_suffix()))
 6153:             }),
 6154:     };
 6155:     let report_dir = resolve_absolute_path(report_dir.as_path())?;
 6156:     let can_continue_from_setup = resolve_run_setup_reuse(
 6157:         report_dir.as_path(),
 6158:         config.profile_path.as_path(),
 6159:         config.script_path.as_path(),
 6160:         resolved_source_mode.as_str(),
 6161:         resolved_repo_ref.as_deref(),
 6162:         config.skip_setup,
 6163:     )?;
 6164:     if !can_continue_from_setup {
 6165:         ensure_report_dir_fresh(report_dir.as_path(), "vm-lab-run-live-lab")?;
 6166:         fs::create_dir_all(report_dir.as_path()).map_err(|err| {
 6167:             format!(
 6168:                 "create live-lab report directory failed ({}): {err}",
 6169:                 report_dir.display()
 6170:             )
 6171:         })?;
 6172:         let manifest = build_setup_manifest(&LiveLabSetupManifestInput {
 6173:             report_dir: report_dir.clone(),
 6174:             profile_path: config.profile_path.clone(),
 6175:             script_path: config.script_path.clone(),
 6176:             inventory_path: None,
 6177:             source_mode: resolved_source_mode.clone(),
 6178:             repo_ref: resolved_repo_ref.clone(),
 6179:             require_same_network: None,
 6180:             dry_run: config.dry_run,
 6181:             max_parallel_node_workers: None,
 6182:         })?;
 6183:         write_setup_manifest(report_dir.as_path(), &manifest)?;
 6184:         let report_state = initial_report_state(report_dir.as_path(), &manifest)?;
 6185:         write_report_state(report_dir.as_path(), &report_state)?;
 6186:     }
 6187:     let timeout = timeout_or_default(config.timeout_secs, DEFAULT_LIVE_LAB_TIMEOUT_SECS);
 6188:     let inputs = LiveLabRunInputs {
 6189:         profile_path: config.profile_path.clone(),
 6190:         report_dir: report_dir.clone(),
 6191:         source_mode: resolved_source_mode.clone(),
 6192:         repo_ref: resolved_repo_ref.clone(),
 6193:         timeout,
 6194:         dry_run: config.dry_run,
 6195:         skip_setup: config.skip_setup,
 6196:         continue_from_setup: can_continue_from_setup,
 6197:         skip_gates: config.skip_gates,
 6198:         skip_soak: config.skip_soak,
 6199:         skip_cross_network: config.skip_cross_network,
 6200:     };
 6201:     let orchestrator = LinuxBashOrchestrator::new(config.script_path.clone());
 6202:     let run_report = orchestrator.execute_live_lab(&inputs)?;
 6203:     validate_live_lab_run_artifacts(report_dir.as_path())?;
 6204:     let summary = summarize_live_lab_report(report_dir.as_path(), false, 1)?;
 6205:     let records = parse_live_lab_stage_records(report_dir.as_path())?;
 6206:     let release_gate_report = build_release_gate_completeness_report(
 6207:         &records,
 6208:         full_release_gate_requested(&profile, &config),
 6209:     );
 6210:     write_release_gate_completeness(report_dir.as_path(), &release_gate_report)?;
 6211:     let mut warnings = Vec::new();
 6212:     if can_continue_from_setup && !config.skip_setup {
 6213:         warnings.push(
 6214:             "auto-detected completed setup stages in report dir; continued with test stages only"
 6215:                 .to_string(),
 6216:         );
 6217:     }
 6218:     let completeness_error = if release_gate_report.requested
 6219:         && !release_gate_report.missing_or_non_pass_stages.is_empty()
 6220:     {
 6221:         let message = format!(
 6222:             "full release-gate mode requested, but required stages were missing or not pass: {}",
 6223:             release_gate_report.missing_or_non_pass_stages.join(", ")
 6224:         );
 6225:         warnings.push(message.clone());
 6226:         Some(message)
 6227:     } else {
 6228:         None
 6229:     };
 6230:     let run_passed = run_report.success && completeness_error.is_none();
 6231:     let full_release_evidence_complete =
 6232:         run_passed && release_gate_report.requested && release_gate_report.status == "complete";
 6233:     let state_update_error = match build_run_provenance(
 6234:         config.profile_path.as_path(),
 6235:         config.script_path.as_path(),
 6236:         resolved_source_mode.as_str(),
 6237:         resolved_repo_ref.as_deref(),
 6238:         &LiveLabRunModeFlags {
 6239:             dry_run: config.dry_run,
 6240:             skip_setup: config.skip_setup || can_continue_from_setup,
 6241:             skip_gates: config.skip_gates,
 6242:             skip_soak: config.skip_soak,
 6243:             skip_cross_network: config.skip_cross_network,
 6244:         },
 6245:     )
 6246:     .and_then(|run_provenance| {
 6247:         update_report_state_after_run(
 6248:             report_dir.as_path(),
 6249:             run_provenance,
 6250:             run_passed,
 6251:             release_gate_report.requested,
 6252:             full_release_evidence_complete,
 6253:         )
 6254:     }) {
 6255:         Ok(()) => None,
 6256:         Err(err) => {
 6257:             warnings.push(err.clone());
 6258:             Some(err)
 6259:         }
 6260:     };
 6261:     let next_actions = if run_report.success && completeness_error.is_none() {
 6262:         Vec::new()
 6263:     } else if let Some(message) = completeness_error.as_ref() {
 6264:         vec![
 6265:             message.clone(),
 6266:             format!(
 6267:                 "Inspect {} for the required stage set and rerun without skip flags",
 6268:                 report_dir
 6269:                     .join(RELEASE_GATE_COMPLETENESS_RELATIVE_PATH)
 6270:                     .display()
 6271:             ),
 6272:         ]
 6273:     } else {
 6274:         vec![format!(
 6275:             "Run vm-lab-diagnose-live-lab-failure with --profile {} --report-dir {}",
 6276:             config.profile_path.display(),
 6277:             report_dir.display()
 6278:         )]
 6279:     };
 6280:     let rendered = render_vm_lab_command_result(
 6281:         "vm-lab-run-live-lab",
 6282:         report_dir.as_path(),
 6283:         &summary,
 6284:         &records,
 6285:         warnings,
 6286:         next_actions,
 6287:         state_update_error
 6288:             .as_ref()
 6289:             .map(|_| VmLabCommandOverallStatus::Fail)
 6290:             .or_else(|| {
 6291:                 completeness_error
 6292:                     .as_ref()
 6293:                     .filter(|_| run_report.success)
 6294:                     .map(|_| VmLabCommandOverallStatus::Fail)
 6295:             }),
 6296:     )?;
 6297:     if run_report.success && completeness_error.is_none() && state_update_error.is_none() {
 6298:         Ok(rendered)
 6299:     } else {
 6300:         Err(rendered)
 6301:     }
 6302: }
 6303: 
 6304: fn execute_rust_native_orchestration(
 6305:     config: VmLabOrchestrateLiveLabConfig,
 6306: ) -> Result<String, String> {
 6307:     use orchestrator::adapter::factory::node_adapter_for;
 6308:     use orchestrator::connection::NodeConnection;
 6309:     use orchestrator::context::OrchestrationContext;
 6310:     use orchestrator::error::StageOutcome;
 6311:     use orchestrator::runner::StateMachineRunner;
 6312: 
 6313:     let known_hosts = config.known_hosts_path.ok_or_else(|| {
 6314:         "--known-hosts-file is required when --node flags are present".to_string()
 6315:     })?;
 6316:     ensure_local_regular_file_path(config.ssh_identity_file.as_path(), "SSH identity file")?;
 6317:     ensure_local_regular_file_path(known_hosts.as_path(), "SSH known-hosts file")?;
 6318: 
 6319:     let inventory_path = resolve_absolute_path(config.inventory_path.as_path())?;
 6320:     let inventory = load_inventory(&inventory_path)?;
 6321: 
 6322:     let report_dir = resolve_absolute_path(config.report_dir.as_path())?;
 6323:     ensure_report_dir_fresh(report_dir.as_path(), "vm-lab-orchestrate-live-lab")?;
 6324:     fs::create_dir_all(report_dir.as_path()).map_err(|err| {
 6325:         format!(
 6326:             "create report directory failed ({}): {err}",
 6327:             report_dir.display()
 6328:         )
 6329:     })?;
 6330: 
 6331:     let network_id = format!(
 6332:         "rustynet-lab-{}",
 6333:         SystemTime::now()
 6334:             .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
 6335:             .map(|d| d.as_secs())
 6336:             .unwrap_or(0)
 6337:     );
 6338: 
 6339:     let mut ctx = OrchestrationContext::new(
 6340:         config.node_assignments.clone(),
 6341:         report_dir.clone(),
 6342:         network_id,
 6343:     );
 6344:     if let Some(cidrs) = config.orchestrate_ssh_allow_cidrs.as_deref() {
 6345:         let trimmed = cidrs.trim();
 6346:         if !trimmed.is_empty() {
 6347:             ctx.ssh_allow_cidrs = trimmed.to_string();
 6348:         }
 6349:     }
 6350: 
 6351:     // Collect node hosts first so we can auto-derive ssh_allow_cidrs when not
 6352:     // provided. This mirrors the bash orchestrator's auto-detection behaviour.
 6353:     let node_entries: Vec<(
 6354:         &crate::vm_lab::VmInventoryEntry,
 6355:         &crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::role_assignment::NodeRoleAssignment,
 6356:     )> = config
 6357:         .node_assignments
 6358:         .iter()
 6359:         .map(|assignment| {
 6360:             inventory
 6361:                 .iter()
 6362:                 .find(|e| e.alias == assignment.alias)
 6363:                 .map(|entry| (entry, assignment))
 6364:                 .ok_or_else(|| {
 6365:                     format!(
 6366:                         "alias '{}' not found in inventory ({})",
 6367:                         assignment.alias,
 6368:                         inventory_path.display()
 6369:                     )
 6370:                 })
 6371:         })
 6372:         .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, String>>()?;
 6373: 
 6374:     // Auto-derive /24 ssh_allow_cidrs from node underlay IPs when not set.
 6375:     if ctx.ssh_allow_cidrs.is_empty() {
 6376:         use std::net::Ipv4Addr;
 6377:         use std::str::FromStr;
 6378:         let mut derived: Vec<String> = node_entries
 6379:             .iter()
 6380:             .filter_map(|(entry, _)| {
 6381:                 let host = entry
 6382:                     .last_known_ip
 6383:                     .as_deref()
 6384:                     .unwrap_or(entry.ssh_target.as_str());
 6385:                 // Strip optional user@ prefix from ssh_target.
 6386:                 let ip_str = host.split('@').next_back().unwrap_or(host);
 6387:                 Ipv4Addr::from_str(ip_str).ok().map(|ip| {
 6388:                     let o = ip.octets();
 6389:                     format!("{}.{}.{}.0/24", o[0], o[1], o[2])
 6390:                 })
 6391:             })
 6392:             .collect();
 6393:         derived.sort();
 6394:         derived.dedup();
 6395:         if !derived.is_empty() {
 6396:             ctx.ssh_allow_cidrs = derived.join(",");
 6397:         }
 6398:     }
 6399: 
 6400:     for (entry, assignment) in &node_entries {
 6401:         let host = entry
 6402:             .last_known_ip
 6403:             .as_deref()
 6404:             .unwrap_or(entry.ssh_target.as_str())
 6405:             .to_string();
 6406: 
 6407:         let platform = entry.platform.unwrap_or(VmGuestPlatform::Linux);
 6408:         if !assignment.role.is_supported_for_platform(&platform) {
 6409:             return Err(format!(
 6410:                 "role '{}' is not supported on platform {platform:?}; W5.4 Windows/macOS Exit remains fail-closed until live evidence is recorded",
 6411:                 assignment.role
 6412:             ));
 6413:         }
 6414: 
 6415:         let conn = NodeConnection::ssh(
 6416:             host.clone(),
 6417:             config.ssh_port,
 6418:             entry.ssh_user.clone(),
 6419:             config.ssh_identity_file.clone(),
 6420:             known_hosts.clone(),
 6421:         )
 6422:         .map_err(|err| {
 6423:             format!(
 6424:                 "build SSH connection for alias '{}' ({}): {err}",
 6425:                 assignment.alias, host
 6426:             )
 6427:         })?;
 6428: 
 6429:         let adapter = node_adapter_for(
 6430:             assignment.alias.clone(),
 6431:             platform,
 6432:             conn,
 6433:             entry.rustynet_src_dir.clone(),
 6434:         )
 6435:         .map_err(|err| {
 6436:             format!(
 6437:                 "create adapter for alias '{}' (platform {platform:?}): {err}",
 6438:                 assignment.alias
 6439:             )
 6440:         })?;
 6441: 
 6442:         ctx.adapters.insert(assignment.alias.clone(), adapter);
 6443:     }
 6444: 
 6445:     let stages = build_rust_native_orchestration_stages();
 6446: 
 6447:     let runner = StateMachineRunner::new(stages);
 6448:     let results = runner.run(&mut ctx);
 6449: 
 6450:     let passed = results
 6451:         .iter()
 6452:         .filter(|(_, o)| matches!(o, StageOutcome::Passed))
 6453:         .count();
 6454:     let failed = results
 6455:         .iter()
 6456:         .filter(|(_, o)| matches!(o, StageOutcome::Failed(_)))
 6457:         .count();
 6458:     let skipped = results
 6459:         .iter()
 6460:         .filter(|(_, o)| matches!(o, StageOutcome::Skipped))
 6461:         .count();
 6462: 
 6463:     // Emit the parity-input JSON snapshot used by the W5.5 cross-orchestrator
 6464:     // diff harness. Failure to write it does not fail the run; it is
 6465:     // surfaced to the operator log so they know to re-run before claiming
 6466:     // parity evidence.
 6467:     let parity_path = report_dir.join("parity_input.json");
 6468:     let timestamp_utc = format!(
 6469:         "{}",
 6470:         SystemTime::now()
 6471:             .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
 6472:             .map(|d| d.as_secs())
 6473:             .unwrap_or(0)
 6474:     );
 6475:     let run_id = format!("rust-{timestamp_utc}");
 6476:     let live_lab_report =
 6477:         orchestrator::parity::build_live_lab_run_report(run_id, timestamp_utc, &ctx, &results);
 6478:     match serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&live_lab_report) {
 6479:         Ok(bytes) => {
 6480:             if let Err(err) = fs::write(&parity_path, &bytes) {
 6481:                 eprintln!(
 6482:                     "warning: failed to write parity input snapshot at {}: {err}",
 6483:                     parity_path.display()
 6484:                 );
 6485:             }
 6486:         }
 6487:         Err(err) => {
 6488:             eprintln!("warning: failed to serialize parity input snapshot: {err}");
 6489:         }
 6490:     }
 6491: 
 6492:     let mut out = String::new();
 6493:     let _ = writeln!(
 6494:         out,
 6495:         "rust orchestrator: {} node(s), {} stage(s)",
 6496:         config.node_assignments.len(),
 6497:         results.len()
 6498:     );
 6499:     for (id, outcome) in &results {
 6500:         let label = match outcome {
 6501:             StageOutcome::Passed => "passed",
 6502:             StageOutcome::Failed(_) => "failed",
 6503:             StageOutcome::Skipped => "skipped",
 6504:         };
 6505:         let _ = writeln!(out, "  {}: {label}", id.as_str());
 6506:     }
 6507:     let _ = writeln!(out, "passed={passed} failed={failed} skipped={skipped}");
 6508:     let _ = writeln!(out, "parity_input: {}", parity_path.display());
 6509: 
 6510:     if failed > 0 { Err(out) } else { Ok(out) }
 6511: }
 6512: 
 6513: fn build_rust_native_orchestration_stages() -> Vec<Box<dyn orchestrator::stage::OrchestrationStage>>
 6514: {
 6515:     orchestrator::plan::PlanBuilder::new().build()
 6516: }
 6517: 
 6518: #[cfg(test)]
 6519: fn rust_native_orchestration_stage_ids() -> Vec<orchestrator::stage::StageId> {
 6520:     build_rust_native_orchestration_stages()
 6521:         .iter()
 6522:         .map(|stage| stage.id())
 6523:         .collect()
 6524: }
 6525: 
 6526: pub fn execute_ops_vm_lab_orchestrate_live_lab(
 6527:     config: VmLabOrchestrateLiveLabConfig,
 6528: ) -> Result<String, String> {
 6529:     validate_orchestrate_live_lab_config(&config)?;
 6530:     for warning in legacy_role_flags_deprecation_warnings(&config) {
 6531:         eprintln!("warning: {warning}");
 6532:     }
 6533:     if !config.node_assignments.is_empty() {
 6534:         return execute_rust_native_orchestration(config);
 6535:     }
 6536:     // legacy_bash_orchestrator (when set) and the absence of --node both
 6537:     // route to the bash orchestrator below. The flag itself stays
 6538:     // transitional until W5.7 removes the bash path entirely.
 6539:     let _ = config.legacy_bash_orchestrator;
 6540:     ensure_local_regular_file_path(config.script_path.as_path(), "live-lab script")?;
 6541:     ensure_local_regular_file_path(config.ssh_identity_file.as_path(), "SSH identity file")?;
 6542:     ensure_optional_local_regular_file_path(
 6543:         config.known_hosts_path.as_deref(),
 6544:         "SSH known_hosts file",
 6545:     )?;
 6546: 
 6547:     let report_dir = resolve_absolute_path(config.report_dir.as_path())?;
 6548:     ensure_report_dir_fresh(report_dir.as_path(), "vm-lab-orchestrate-live-lab")?;
 6549:     fs::create_dir_all(report_dir.as_path()).map_err(|err| {
 6550:         format!(
 6551:             "create orchestration report directory failed ({}): {err}",
 6552:             report_dir.display()
 6553:         )
 6554:     })?;
 6555:     let orchestration_dir = report_dir.join("orchestration");
 6556:     let pre_setup_orchestration_dir = create_orchestration_staging_dir()?;
 6557:     let inventory_path = resolve_absolute_path(config.inventory_path.as_path())?;
 6558:     let selected_aliases = resolve_live_lab_vm_aliases(
 6559:         inventory_path.as_path(),
 6560:         config.exit_vm.as_deref(),
 6561:         config.client_vm.as_deref(),
 6562:         config.entry_vm.as_deref(),
 6563:         config.aux_vm.as_deref(),
 6564:         config.extra_vm.as_deref(),
 6565:         config.fifth_client_vm.as_deref(),
 6566:     )?;
 6567:     // Build discovery alias list: Linux nodes + optional Windows node.
 6568:     // selected_aliases (Linux only) continues to be used for profile/setup.
 6569:     let mut discovery_aliases = selected_aliases.clone();
 6570:     if let Some(ref windows_alias) = config.windows_vm
 6571:         && !discovery_aliases.contains(windows_alias)
 6572:     {
 6573:         discovery_aliases.push(windows_alias.clone());
 6574:     }
 6575:     let effective_profile_path = match config.profile_path.clone() {
 6576:         Some(path) => resolve_absolute_path(path.as_path())?,
 6577:         None => config
 6578:             .profile_output_path
 6579:             .clone()
 6580:             .map(|path| resolve_absolute_path(path.as_path()))
 6581:             .transpose()?
 6582:             .unwrap_or_else(|| default_live_lab_setup_profile_path(report_dir.as_path())),
 6583:     };
 6584:     let discovery_timeout = timeout_or_default(
 6585:         config.discovery_timeout_secs,
 6586:         DEFAULT_UTM_IP_DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT_SECS,
 6587:     )
 6588:     .as_secs();
 6589:     let ready_timeout = timeout_or_default(
 6590:         config.ready_timeout_secs,
 6591:         DEFAULT_RESTART_READY_TIMEOUT_SECS,
 6592:     )
 6593:     .as_secs();
 6594: 
 6595:     let mut outcomes = Vec::new();
 6596:     let mut warnings = Vec::new();
 6597:     let mut next_actions = Vec::new();
 6598:     let mut diagnosis_artifact = None::<PathBuf>;
 6599: 
 6600:     let discover_config = VmLabDiscoverLocalUtmConfig {
 6601:         inventory_path: Some(inventory_path.clone()),
 6602:         utm_documents_root: config.utm_documents_root.clone(),
 6603:         utmctl_path: config.utmctl_path.clone(),
 6604:         ssh_identity_file: Some(config.ssh_identity_file.clone()),
 6605:         known_hosts_path: config.known_hosts_path.clone(),
 6606:         ssh_port: config.ssh_port,
 6607:         timeout_secs: discovery_timeout,
 6608:         update_inventory_live_ips: true,
 6609:         report_dir: None,
 6610:     };
 6611:     let initial_discovery = execute_ops_vm_lab_discover_local_utm(discover_config.clone())?;
 6612:     let initial_discovery_path = orchestration_dir.join("discover_initial.json");
 6613:     write_orchestration_artifact(
 6614:         pre_setup_orchestration_dir
 6615:             .join("discover_initial.json")
 6616:             .as_path(),
 6617:         initial_discovery.as_str(),
 6618:     )?;
 6619:     let initial_readiness =
 6620:         selected_local_utm_readiness_from_report(initial_discovery.as_str(), &discovery_aliases)?;
 6621:     let mut final_readiness = initial_readiness.clone();
 6622:     let mut final_readiness_artifact = initial_discovery_path.clone();
 6623:     let unready_aliases = not_execution_ready_aliases(&initial_readiness);
 6624:     let discovery_outcome = stage_outcome(
 6625:         "discover_local_utm",
 6626:         VmLabStageStatus::Pass,
 6627:         format!(
 6628:             "selected aliases readiness: {}",
 6629:             render_selected_local_utm_readiness(&initial_readiness)
 6630:         ),
 6631:         vec![initial_discovery_path.clone()],
 6632:     );
 6633:     emit_vm_lab_progress_outcome("vm-lab-orchestrate-live-lab", &discovery_outcome);
 6634:     outcomes.push(discovery_outcome);
 6635: 
 6636:     if config.windows_only && config.validate_linux_daemon_state {
 6637:         warnings.push(
 6638:             "--validate-linux-daemon-state was passed with --windows-only; Linux daemon \
 6639:              validators will not run because --windows-only skips all Linux peers. \
 6640:              Drop one of the two flags to remove the ambiguity."
 6641:                 .to_string(),
 6642:         );
 6643:     }
 6644:     // --windows-only: skip all Linux stages and go straight to Windows orchestration.
 6645:     if config.windows_only {
 6646:         let windows_alias = config
 6647:             .windows_vm
 6648:             .as_deref()
 6649:             .ok_or_else(|| "--windows-only requires --windows-vm to be set".to_string())?;
 6650:         // Only the Windows VM needs to be ready for a Windows-only run; ignore Linux VMs.
 6651:         let windows_unready: Vec<String> = unready_aliases
 6652:             .iter()
 6653:             .filter(|a| a.as_str() == windows_alias)
 6654:             .cloned()
 6655:             .collect();
 6656:         if !windows_unready.is_empty() {
 6657:             let unready_str = windows_unready.join(", ");
 6658:             materialize_orchestration_staging_dir(
 6659:                 pre_setup_orchestration_dir.as_path(),
 6660:                 orchestration_dir.as_path(),
 6661:             )?;
 6662:             return finalize_vm_lab_orchestration_result(
 6663:                 "vm-lab-orchestrate-live-lab",
 6664:                 report_dir.as_path(),
 6665:                 orchestration_dir.as_path(),
 6666:                 outcomes,
 6667:                 warnings,
 6668:                 vec![format!(
 6669:                     "VMs not ready before Windows-only run: {unready_str}. Boot them first."
 6670:                 )],
 6671:             );
 6672:         }
 6673:         let windows_outcomes = run_windows_orchestration_stages(
 6674:             windows_alias,
 6675:             inventory_path.as_path(),
 6676:             config.ssh_identity_file.as_path(),
 6677:             config.known_hosts_path.as_deref(),
 6678:             config.ssh_port,
 6679:             config.utm_documents_root.as_deref(),
 6680:             config.utmctl_path.as_deref(),
 6681:             config.dry_run,
 6682:             report_dir.as_path(),
 6683:         );
 6684:         for outcome in &windows_outcomes {
 6685:             emit_vm_lab_progress_outcome("vm-lab-orchestrate-live-lab", outcome);
 6686:         }
 6687:         outcomes.extend(windows_outcomes);
 6688:         materialize_orchestration_staging_dir(
 6689:             pre_setup_orchestration_dir.as_path(),
 6690:             orchestration_dir.as_path(),
 6691:         )?;
 6692:         return finalize_vm_lab_orchestration_result(
 6693:             "vm-lab-orchestrate-live-lab",
 6694:             report_dir.as_path(),
 6695:             orchestration_dir.as_path(),
 6696:             outcomes,
 6697:             warnings,
 6698:             next_actions,
 6699:         );
 6700:     }
 6701: 
 6702:     if !unready_aliases.is_empty() {
 6703:         warnings.push(format!(
 6704:             "selected local UTM VMs were not execution-ready and required restart: {}",
 6705:             unready_aliases.join(", ")
 6706:         ));
 6707:         if config.dry_run {
 6708:             let restart_outcome = stage_outcome(
 6709:                 "restart_unready_vms",
 6710:                 VmLabStageStatus::Skipped,
 6711:                 format!(
 6712:                     "dry-run: would restart aliases {}",
 6713:                     unready_aliases.join(", ")
 6714:                 ),
 6715:                 vec![initial_discovery_path.clone()],
 6716:             );
 6717:             emit_vm_lab_progress_outcome("vm-lab-orchestrate-live-lab", &restart_outcome);
 6718:             outcomes.push(restart_outcome);
 6719:         } else {
 6720:             let restart_output = execute_ops_vm_lab_restart(VmLabRestartConfig {
 6721:                 inventory_path: inventory_path.clone(),
 6722:                 vm_aliases: unready_aliases.clone(),
 6723:                 raw_targets: Vec::new(),
 6724:                 select_all: false,
 6725:                 utmctl_path: config
 6726:                     .utmctl_path
 6727:                     .clone()
 6728:                     .unwrap_or_else(default_utmctl_path),
 6729:                 service: None,
 6730:                 wait_ready: true,
 6731:                 ssh_port: config.ssh_port,
 6732:                 ready_timeout_secs: ready_timeout,
 6733:                 ssh_user: None,
 6734:                 ssh_identity_file: Some(config.ssh_identity_file.clone()),
 6735:                 known_hosts_path: config.known_hosts_path.clone(),
 6736:                 timeout_secs: config.timeout_secs,
 6737:                 json_output: false,
 6738:                 report_dir: Some(pre_setup_orchestration_dir.clone()),
 6739:             });
 6740:             let restart_path = orchestration_dir.join("restart_unready_vms.txt");
 6741:             match restart_output {
 6742:                 Ok(output) => {
 6743:                     write_orchestration_artifact(

 6745:                             .join("restart_unready_vms.txt")
 6746:                             .as_path(),
 6747:                         output.as_str(),
 6748:                     )?;
 6749:                     let restart_outcome = stage_outcome(
 6750:                         "restart_unready_vms",

 6758:                 Err(err) => {
 6759:                     write_orchestration_artifact(

 6762:                             .as_path(),
 6763:                         err.as_str(),

 6766:                         "restart_unready_vms",

 6770:                     );

 6772:                     outcomes.push(restart_outcome);

 6777:                     ));
 6778:                     materialize_orchestration_staging_dir(
 6779:                         pre_setup_orchestration_dir.as_path(),
 6780:                         orchestration_dir.as_path(),
 6781:                     )?;
 6782:                     return finalize_vm_lab_orchestration_result(
 6783:                         "vm-lab-orchestrate-live-lab",
 6784:                         report_dir.as_path(),
 6785:                         orchestration_dir.as_path(),
 6786:                         outcomes,
 6787:                         warnings,
 6788:                         next_actions,
 6789:                     );
 6790:                 }
 6791:             }

 7218: 
 7219: /// Linux distribute stage names that produce the signed bundles a
 7220: /// Windows peer also needs (membership snapshot + per-daemon
 7221: /// assignment/traversal/dns-zone). When all four reported PASS during
 7222: /// the Linux pipeline, the Linux exit holds canonical bundle files
 7223: /// under /var/lib/rustynet/, so the orchestrator can pull them and
 7224: /// distribute them to the Windows peer to keep its mesh state in
 7225: /// parity with the Linux peers.
 7226: const LINUX_DISTRIBUTE_STAGES_FOR_WINDOWS_BUNDLES: &[&str] = &[
 7227:     "distribute_membership_state",
 7228:     "issue_and_distribute_assignments",
 7229:     "issue_and_distribute_traversal",
 7230:     "issue_and_distribute_dns_zone",
 7231: ];
 7232: 
 7233: fn linux_distribute_stages_passed(outcomes: &[VmLabStageOutcome]) -> bool {
 7234:     LINUX_DISTRIBUTE_STAGES_FOR_WINDOWS_BUNDLES
 7235:         .iter()
 7236:         .all(|stage_name| {
 7237:             outcomes
 7238:                 .iter()
 7239:                 .any(|o| o.stage == *stage_name && o.status == VmLabStageStatus::Pass)
 7240:         })
 7241: }
 7242: 
 7243: /// Wraps `run_windows_orchestration_stages_with_options` with an
 7244: /// orchestrator-side bundle-locate step. The legacy bash live-lab
 7245: /// pipeline writes its issued signed bundles into `<report_dir>/state/`
 7246: /// as it distributes them to the Linux peers. When all four Linux
 7247: /// `distribute_*` stages reported PASS, those local files are the
 7248: /// authoritative copies of the exit's mesh state and are byte-identical
 7249: /// to what `pull_windows_state_from_linux_exit` would SCP back from
 7250: /// `/var/lib/rustynet/`. Sourcing them locally avoids a redundant
 7251: /// network roundtrip and the requirement that the SSH user be in the
 7252: /// `rustynetd` group on the Linux exit. The bundle paths are then fed
 7253: /// into `WindowsOrchestrationOptions` so the four `distribute_windows_*`
 7254: /// stages actually run instead of being Skipped. When the Linux
 7255: /// distribute stages did not all pass (or the local bundle files cannot
 7256: /// be located), the helper falls back to the historical bootstrap +
 7257: /// validators-only path with no bundle distribution.
 7258: fn run_windows_orchestration_with_pulled_bundles(
 7259:     config: &VmLabOrchestrateLiveLabConfig,
 7260:     inventory_path: &Path,
 7261:     report_dir: &Path,
 7262:     windows_alias: &str,
 7263:     linux_outcomes: &[VmLabStageOutcome],
 7264: ) -> Vec<VmLabStageOutcome> {
 7265:     let mut prelude_outcomes: Vec<VmLabStageOutcome> = Vec::new();
 7266:     let mut options = WindowsOrchestrationOptions {
 7267:         no_fail_on_authenticode: config.no_fail_on_authenticode,
 7268:         ..WindowsOrchestrationOptions::default()
 7269:     };
 7270: 
 7271:     let distribute_passed = linux_distribute_stages_passed(linux_outcomes);
 7272:     if config.dry_run {
 7273:         prelude_outcomes.push(stage_outcome(
 7274:             "stage_windows_bundles_for_distribution",
 7275:             VmLabStageStatus::Skipped,
 7276:             format!("dry-run: would stage signed bundles for {windows_alias}"),
 7277:             vec![],
 7278:         ));
 7279:     } else if !distribute_passed {
 7280:         prelude_outcomes.push(stage_outcome(
 7281:             "stage_windows_bundles_for_distribution",
 7282:             VmLabStageStatus::Skipped,
 7283:             format!(
 7284:                 "skipped: one or more Linux bundle-distribution stages did not pass ({})",
 7285:                 LINUX_DISTRIBUTE_STAGES_FOR_WINDOWS_BUNDLES.join(", ")
 7286:             ),
 7287:             vec![],
 7288:         ));
 7289:     } else {
 7290:         match locate_windows_bundle_paths_from_report_dir(config, inventory_path, report_dir) {
 7291:             Ok((paths, exit_alias, exit_node_id)) => {
 7292:                 options.distribute_windows_membership_bundle = Some(paths.membership.clone());
 7293:                 options.distribute_windows_assignment_bundle = Some(paths.assignment.clone());
 7294:                 options.distribute_windows_traversal_bundle = Some(paths.traversal.clone());
 7295:                 options.distribute_windows_dns_zone_bundle = Some(paths.dns_zone.clone());
 7296:                 options.distribute_windows_assignment_verifier_key =
 7297:                     Some(paths.assignment_verifier_key.clone());
 7298:                 options.distribute_windows_traversal_verifier_key =
 7299:                     Some(paths.traversal_verifier_key.clone());
 7300:                 options.distribute_windows_dns_zone_verifier_key =
 7301:                     Some(paths.dns_zone_verifier_key.clone());
 7302:                 // Pass exit alias so the orchestrator can amend membership
 7303:                 // and issue a Windows-specific assignment after bootstrap.
 7304:                 options.linux_exit_alias = Some(exit_alias.clone());
 7305:                 prelude_outcomes.push(stage_outcome(
 7306:                     "stage_windows_bundles_for_distribution",
 7307:                     VmLabStageStatus::Pass,
 7308:                     format!(
 7309:                         "located signed bundles + verifier keys from local report dir for exit \
 7310:                          {exit_alias} (node_id={exit_node_id})"
 7311:                     ),
 7312:                     vec![
 7313:                         paths.membership,
 7314:                         paths.assignment,
 7315:                         paths.traversal,
 7316:                         paths.dns_zone,
 7317:                         paths.assignment_verifier_key,
 7318:                         paths.traversal_verifier_key,
 7319:                         paths.dns_zone_verifier_key,
 7320:                     ],
 7321:                 ));
 7322:             }
 7323:             Err(err) => {
 7324:                 prelude_outcomes.push(stage_outcome(
 7325:                     "stage_windows_bundles_for_distribution",
 7326:                     VmLabStageStatus::Fail,
 7327:                     err,
 7328:                     vec![],
 7329:                 ));
 7330:             }
 7331:         }
 7332:     }
 7333: 
 7334:     let mut outcomes = prelude_outcomes;
 7335:     outcomes.extend(run_windows_orchestration_stages_with_options(
 7336:         windows_alias,
 7337:         inventory_path,
 7338:         config.ssh_identity_file.as_path(),
 7339:         config.known_hosts_path.as_deref(),
 7340:         config.ssh_port,
 7341:         config.utm_documents_root.as_deref(),
 7342:         config.utmctl_path.as_deref(),
 7343:         config.dry_run,
 7344:         report_dir,
 7345:         options,
 7346:     ));
 7347:     outcomes
 7348: }
 7349: 
 7350: struct WindowsBundleLocalPaths {
 7351:     membership: PathBuf,
 7352:     assignment: PathBuf,
 7353:     traversal: PathBuf,
 7354:     dns_zone: PathBuf,
 7355:     assignment_verifier_key: PathBuf,
 7356:     traversal_verifier_key: PathBuf,
 7357:     dns_zone_verifier_key: PathBuf,
 7358: }
 7359: 
 7360: fn locate_windows_bundle_paths_from_report_dir(
 7361:     config: &VmLabOrchestrateLiveLabConfig,
 7362:     inventory_path: &Path,
 7363:     report_dir: &Path,
 7364: ) -> Result<(WindowsBundleLocalPaths, String, String), String> {
 7365:     let exit_alias = match config.exit_vm.clone() {
 7366:         Some(alias) => alias,
 7367:         None => default_inventory_alias_for_lab_roles(inventory_path, &["exit"])
 7368:             .map_err(|err| format!("could not resolve Linux exit alias from inventory: {err}"))?
 7369:             .ok_or_else(|| {
 7370:                 "no Linux exit alias resolvable from --exit-vm or inventory lab_role=exit"
 7371:                     .to_string()
 7372:             })?,
 7373:     };
 7374:     let inventory = load_inventory(inventory_path)?;
 7375:     let exit_node_id = inventory
 7376:         .into_iter()
 7377:         .find(|entry| entry.alias == exit_alias)
 7378:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("exit alias {exit_alias} not found in inventory"))?
 7379:         .node_id
 7380:         .ok_or_else(|| {
 7381:             format!(
 7382:                 "inventory entry for exit alias {exit_alias} has no node_id; \
 7383:                  cannot locate per-node signed bundles"
 7384:             )
 7385:         })?;
 7386:     let state_dir = report_dir.join("state");
 7387:     let membership = state_dir.join("membership.snapshot");
 7388:     let assignment = state_dir.join(format!("assignment-{exit_node_id}.bundle"));
 7389:     let traversal = state_dir.join(format!("traversal-{exit_node_id}.bundle"));
 7390:     let dns_zone = state_dir.join(format!("dns-zone-{exit_node_id}.bundle"));
 7391:     // Mesh-wide verifier public keys, distributed alongside their bundles.
 7392:     // Each Linux peer holds the same triple at /etc/rustynet/<kind>.pub;
 7393:     // the bash orchestrator's issue stages write a copy of each public
 7394:     // key into <report_dir>/state/<kind>.pub for the orchestrator host
 7395:     // to redistribute to the Windows peer.
 7396:     let assignment_verifier_key = state_dir.join("assignment.pub");
 7397:     let traversal_verifier_key = state_dir.join("traversal.pub");
 7398:     let dns_zone_verifier_key = state_dir.join("dns-zone.pub");
 7399:     for (label, path) in [
 7400:         ("membership snapshot", &membership),
 7401:         ("assignment bundle", &assignment),
 7402:         ("traversal bundle", &traversal),
 7403:         ("dns-zone bundle", &dns_zone),
 7404:         ("assignment verifier key", &assignment_verifier_key),
 7405:         ("traversal verifier key", &traversal_verifier_key),
 7406:         ("dns-zone verifier key", &dns_zone_verifier_key),
 7407:     ] {
 7408:         if !path.is_file() {
 7409:             return Err(format!(
 7410:                 "expected {label} not found at {} (Linux distribute stages may not have written it)",
 7411:                 path.display()
 7412:             ));
 7413:         }
 7414:     }
 7415:     Ok((
 7416:         WindowsBundleLocalPaths {
 7417:             membership,
 7418:             assignment,
 7419:             traversal,
 7420:             dns_zone,
 7421:             assignment_verifier_key,
 7422:             traversal_verifier_key,
 7423:             dns_zone_verifier_key,
 7424:         },
 7425:         exit_alias,
 7426:         exit_node_id,
 7427:     ))
 7428: }
 7429: 
 7430: #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
 7431: fn run_windows_orchestration_stages(
 7432:     windows_alias: &str,
 7433:     inventory_path: &Path,
 7434:     ssh_identity_file: &Path,
 7435:     known_hosts_path: Option<&Path>,
 7436:     ssh_port: u16,
 7437:     _utm_documents_root: Option<&Path>,
 7438:     _utmctl_path: Option<&Path>,
 7439:     dry_run: bool,
 7440:     report_dir: &Path,
 7441: ) -> Vec<VmLabStageOutcome> {
 7442:     run_windows_orchestration_stages_with_options(
 7443:         windows_alias,
 7444:         inventory_path,
 7445:         ssh_identity_file,
 7446:         known_hosts_path,
 7447:         ssh_port,
 7448:         _utm_documents_root,
 7449:         _utmctl_path,
 7450:         dry_run,
 7451:         report_dir,
 7452:         WindowsOrchestrationOptions::default(),
 7453:     )
 7454: }
 7455: 
 7456: /// Per-run knobs for `run_windows_orchestration_stages`. Defaults match the
 7457: /// historical full-bootstrap behavior for the `vm-lab-orchestrate-live-lab`
 7458: /// path. The standalone `vm-lab-validate-windows-security` subcommand exposes
 7459: /// these flags so iteration loops can skip already-completed phases.
 7460: ///
 7461: /// W4.5: the four `distribute_windows_*_bundle` fields opt into the
 7462: /// orchestrator-side signed-bundle distribution stages. When a path is
 7463: /// `Some(_)`, the corresponding distribution stage runs after the
 7464: /// security validators and before `validate_windows_mesh_join`. When
 7465: /// `None`, the stage is `Skipped` with a "no local bundle path
 7466: /// provided" reason — the orchestration sequence remains stable for
 7467: /// callers that have not yet built their local bundles.
 7468: #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Default)]
 7469: pub struct WindowsOrchestrationOptions {
 7470:     /// Skip the UTM-result-file access bootstrap step. Use when SSH +
 7471:     /// authorized_keys are already set up on the guest, and utmctl is
 7472:     /// unavailable in the calling shell. Subsequent SSH-based stages still
 7473:     /// run unchanged.
 7474:     pub skip_access_bootstrap: bool,
 7475:     /// Skip InstallRelease/RestartRuntime/VerifyRuntime. Use when the binary
 7476:     /// at the reviewed install path is already current and you only want to
 7477:     /// re-run the security validation stages.
 7478:     pub skip_install: bool,
 7479:     /// When true, a failed `validate_windows_authenticode` stage is
 7480:     /// recorded as a waived pass rather than a hard failure, allowing
 7481:     /// `validate_windows_mesh_join` to proceed. Intended for dev/lab
 7482:     /// builds that are not yet Authenticode-signed.
 7483:     pub no_fail_on_authenticode: bool,
 7484:     /// Local path to a signed-membership snapshot to push to the
 7485:     /// Windows guest's canonical membership path. `None` skips the
 7486:     /// distribute_windows_membership stage.
 7487:     pub distribute_windows_membership_bundle: Option<PathBuf>,
 7488:     /// Local path to a signed-assignment bundle.
 7489:     pub distribute_windows_assignment_bundle: Option<PathBuf>,
 7490:     /// Local path to a signed-traversal bundle.
 7491:     pub distribute_windows_traversal_bundle: Option<PathBuf>,
 7492:     /// Local path to a signed-DNS-zone bundle.
 7493:     pub distribute_windows_dns_zone_bundle: Option<PathBuf>,
 7494:     /// Local path to the mesh's assignment-bundle verifier public key
 7495:     /// (peer-set's `assignment.pub`). The Windows daemon loads this at
 7496:     /// `C:\ProgramData\RustyNet\trust\assignment.pub` to verify every
 7497:     /// signed assignment bundle on ingest. Without it the daemon
 7498:     /// rejects every distributed assignment as
 7499:     /// "read verifier key failed" and stays in restricted-safe.
 7500:     /// `None` skips the distribute_windows_assignment_verifier_key
 7501:     /// stage.
 7502:     pub distribute_windows_assignment_verifier_key: Option<PathBuf>,
 7503:     /// Local path to the mesh's traversal-bundle verifier public key.
 7504:     /// Loaded by the daemon at
 7505:     /// `C:\ProgramData\RustyNet\trust\traversal.pub`.
 7506:     pub distribute_windows_traversal_verifier_key: Option<PathBuf>,
 7507:     /// Local path to the mesh's DNS-zone verifier public key. Loaded
 7508:     /// by the daemon at `C:\ProgramData\RustyNet\trust\dns-zone.pub`.
 7509:     pub distribute_windows_dns_zone_verifier_key: Option<PathBuf>,
 7510:     /// Alias of the Linux exit node in the inventory. When `Some`, the
 7511:     /// orchestrator adds the Windows node to the Linux membership on the
 7512:     /// exit and issues a Windows-specific assignment bundle after all
 7513:     /// security validators pass. Required for `validate_windows_mesh_join`
 7514:     /// to succeed — without it membership distribution lands a snapshot
 7515:     /// that does not include the Windows node and the daemon stays in
 7516:     /// `LocalNodeNotActive` fail-closed.
 7517:     pub linux_exit_alias: Option<String>,
 7518: }
 7519: 
 7520: #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
 7521: fn run_windows_orchestration_stages_with_options(
 7522:     windows_alias: &str,
 7523:     inventory_path: &Path,
 7524:     ssh_identity_file: &Path,
 7525:     known_hosts_path: Option<&Path>,
 7526:     ssh_port: u16,
 7527:     _utm_documents_root: Option<&Path>,
 7528:     _utmctl_path: Option<&Path>,
 7529:     dry_run: bool,
 7530:     report_dir: &Path,
 7531:     options: WindowsOrchestrationOptions,
 7532: ) -> Vec<VmLabStageOutcome> {
 7533:     let logs_dir = report_dir.join("logs");
 7534:     let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(&logs_dir);
 7535:     let bootstrap_log_path = logs_dir.join("bootstrap_windows_host.log");
 7536:     let validate_log_path = logs_dir.join("validate_windows_client_install.log");
 7537:     let acls_log_path = logs_dir.join("validate_windows_runtime_acls.log");
 7538:     let hardening_log_path = logs_dir.join("validate_windows_service_hardening.log");
 7539:     let custody_log_path = logs_dir.join("validate_windows_key_custody.log");
 7540:     let authenticode_log_path = logs_dir.join("validate_windows_authenticode.log");
 7541:     let dns_failclosed_log_path = logs_dir.join("validate_windows_dns_failclosed.log");
 7542: 
 7543:     // Stage 1: bootstrap_windows_host
 7544:     let bootstrap_outcome = if dry_run {
 7545:         let summary = if options.skip_access_bootstrap || options.skip_install {
 7546:             format!(
 7547:                 "dry-run: would bootstrap Windows host {windows_alias} (skip_access_bootstrap={}, skip_install={})",
 7548:                 options.skip_access_bootstrap, options.skip_install
 7549:             )
 7550:         } else {
 7551:             format!("dry-run: would bootstrap Windows host {windows_alias}")
 7552:         };
 7553:         stage_outcome(
 7554:             "bootstrap_windows_host",
 7555:             VmLabStageStatus::Skipped,
 7556:             summary,
 7557:             vec![],
 7558:         )
 7559:     } else {
 7560:         let result = (|| -> Result<String, String> {
 7561:             let targets =
 7562:                 resolve_remote_targets(inventory_path, &[windows_alias.to_string()], false, &[])?;
 7563:             let target = targets
 7564:                 .into_iter()
 7565:                 .next()
 7566:                 .ok_or_else(|| format!("no target resolved for alias {windows_alias}"))?;
 7567:             if target.platform_profile.platform != VmGuestPlatform::Windows {
 7568:                 return Err(format!(
 7569:                     "alias {windows_alias} resolved to non-Windows platform: {}",
 7570:                     target.platform_profile.platform.as_str()
 7571:                 ));
 7572:             }
 7573:             let timeout = timeout_or_default(0, DEFAULT_RUN_TIMEOUT_SECS);
 7574:             let host_key = if options.skip_access_bootstrap {
 7575:                 "skipped-access-bootstrap".to_string()
 7576:             } else {
 7577:                 // Read the `.pub` sibling of the identity file so the
 7578:                 // prepare-transport helper can write it to
 7579:                 // administrators_authorized_keys on the Windows guest. A
 7580:                 // missing or unreadable public key is non-fatal: bootstrap
 7581:                 // proceeds without key authorization (useful when the key
 7582:                 // is already present from a prior run).
 7583:                 let pub_key_path = ssh_identity_file.with_extension(
 7584:                     match ssh_identity_file.extension().and_then(|e| e.to_str()) {
 7585:                         Some(ext) => format!("{ext}.pub"),
 7586:                         None => "pub".to_string(),
 7587:                     },
 7588:                 );
 7589:                 let automation_public_key = std::fs::read_to_string(&pub_key_path)
 7590:                     .ok()
 7591:                     .map(|s| s.trim().to_string());
 7592:                 bootstrap_windows_access_for_target(
 7593:                     &target,
 7594:                     None,
 7595:                     Some(ssh_identity_file),
 7596:                     known_hosts_path,
 7597:                     automation_public_key.as_deref(),
 7598:                     ssh_port,
 7599:                     timeout,
 7600:                 )?
 7601:             };
 7602:             if !options.skip_install {
 7603:                 let inventory = load_inventory(inventory_path)?;
 7604:                 let workdir = inventory
 7605:                     .iter()
 7606:                     .find(|e| e.alias == windows_alias)
 7607:                     .and_then(|e| e.rustynet_src_dir.clone())
 7608:                     .ok_or_else(|| {
 7609:                         format!("no rustynet_src_dir in inventory for {windows_alias}")
 7610:                     })?;
 7611:                 let context = bootstrap::BootstrapPhaseContext {
 7612:                     ssh_user: target.ssh_user.as_deref(),
 7613:                     ssh_identity_file: Some(ssh_identity_file),
 7614:                     known_hosts_path,
 7615:                     workdir: workdir.as_str(),
 7616:                     repo_url: None,
 7617:                     branch: "main",
 7618:                     remote: "origin",
 7619:                     timeout,
 7620:                 };
 7621:                 sync_repo_targets(
 7622:                     std::slice::from_ref(&target),
 7623:                     context.ssh_user,
 7624:                     context.ssh_identity_file,
 7625:                     context.known_hosts_path,
 7626:                     RepoSyncSource::LocalSource {
 7627:                         source_dir: workspace_root_path(),
 7628:                     },
 7629:                     context.workdir,
 7630:                     timeout,
 7631:                 )
 7632:                 .map_err(|err| {
 7633:                     format!(
 7634:                         "Windows source sync before bootstrap failed for {windows_alias}: {err}"
 7635:                     )
 7636:                 })?;
 7637:                 for phase in windows_orchestrator_bootstrap_phases() {
 7638:                     execute_bootstrap_phase_for_target(phase.as_str(), &target, &context)?;
 7639:                 }
 7640:             }
 7641:             let mut summary = format!("Windows host {windows_alias} bootstrapped");
 7642:             if options.skip_access_bootstrap {
 7643:                 summary.push_str(" (access bootstrap skipped)");
 7644:             }
 7645:             if options.skip_install {
 7646:                 summary.push_str(" (install phases skipped)");
 7647:             }
 7648:             summary.push_str(&format!("; host_key={host_key}"));
 7649:             Ok(summary)
 7650:         })();
 7651:         match result {
 7652:             Ok(summary) => {
 7653:                 let _ = std::fs::write(&bootstrap_log_path, summary.as_str());
 7654:                 stage_outcome(
 7655:                     "bootstrap_windows_host",
 7656:                     VmLabStageStatus::Pass,
 7657:                     summary,
 7658:                     vec![bootstrap_log_path.clone()],
 7659:                 )
 7660:             }
 7661:             Err(err) => {
 7662:                 let _ = std::fs::write(&bootstrap_log_path, err.as_str());
 7663:                 stage_outcome(
 7664:                     "bootstrap_windows_host",
 7665:                     VmLabStageStatus::Fail,
 7666:                     format!("Windows host bootstrap failed for {windows_alias}: {err}"),
 7667:                     vec![bootstrap_log_path.clone()],
 7668:                 )
 7669:             }
 7670:         }
 7671:     };
 7672:     let bootstrap_passed = bootstrap_outcome.status == VmLabStageStatus::Pass;
 7673: 
 7674:     // Stage 2: validate_windows_client_install
 7675:     let validate_outcome = if dry_run {
 7676:         stage_outcome(
 7677:             "validate_windows_client_install",
 7678:             VmLabStageStatus::Skipped,
 7679:             format!("dry-run: would validate Windows client install on {windows_alias}"),
 7680:             vec![],
 7681:         )
 7682:     } else if !bootstrap_passed {
 7683:         stage_outcome(
 7684:             "validate_windows_client_install",
 7685:             VmLabStageStatus::Skipped,
 7686:             format!("skipped: bootstrap_windows_host did not pass for {windows_alias}"),
 7687:             vec![],
 7688:         )
 7689:     } else {
 7690:         let result = (|| -> Result<String, String> {
 7691:             let targets =
 7692:                 resolve_remote_targets(inventory_path, &[windows_alias.to_string()], false, &[])?;
 7693:             let target = targets
 7694:                 .into_iter()
 7695:                 .next()
 7696:                 .ok_or_else(|| format!("no target resolved for alias {windows_alias}"))?;
 7697:             let timeout = timeout_or_default(0, DEFAULT_RUN_TIMEOUT_SECS);
 7698:             let service_script = build_ssh_powershell_encoded_invocation(
 7699:                 "Get-Service -Name RustyNet | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Status",
 7700:             )?;
 7701:             let service_output = capture_remote_shell_command_for_target(
 7702:                 &target,
 7703:                 None,
 7704:                 Some(ssh_identity_file),
 7705:                 known_hosts_path,
 7706:                 service_script.as_str(),
 7707:                 timeout,
 7708:             )?;
 7709:             let service_status = service_output.trim().to_string();
 7710:             if service_status != "Running" {
 7711:                 return Err(format!(
 7712:                     "RustyNet service is not Running on {windows_alias}: status={service_status:?}"
 7713:                 ));
 7714:             }
 7715:             let adapter_script = build_ssh_powershell_encoded_invocation(
 7716:                 "Get-NetAdapter | Where-Object { $_.Name -match 'wg' } | Select-Object Name,Status | ConvertTo-Json -Compress",
 7717:             )?;
 7718:             let adapter_output = capture_remote_shell_command_for_target(
 7719:                 &target,
 7720:                 None,
 7721:                 Some(ssh_identity_file),
 7722:                 known_hosts_path,
 7723:                 adapter_script.as_str(),
 7724:                 timeout,
 7725:             )?;
 7726:             Ok(format!("service=Running adapters={adapter_output}"))
 7727:         })();
 7728:         match result {
 7729:             Ok(summary) => {
 7730:                 let _ = std::fs::write(&validate_log_path, summary.as_str());
 7731:                 stage_outcome(
 7732:                     "validate_windows_client_install",
 7733:                     VmLabStageStatus::Pass,
 7734:                     format!("Windows client install validated on {windows_alias}: {summary}"),
 7735:                     vec![validate_log_path.clone()],
 7736:                 )
 7737:             }
 7738:             Err(err) => {
 7739:                 let _ = std::fs::write(&validate_log_path, err.as_str());
 7740:                 stage_outcome(

 8290:     // than distributing a stale bundle that does not include the Windows node.
 8291:     let effective_membership_bundle: Option<PathBuf> = if options.linux_exit_alias.is_some() {
 8292:         amended_membership_path.clone()
 8293:     } else {
 8294:         options.distribute_windows_membership_bundle.clone()
 8295:     };
 8296:     let effective_assignment_bundle: Option<PathBuf> = if options.linux_exit_alias.is_some() {
 8297:         issued_assignment_path.clone()
 8298:     } else {
 8299:         options.distribute_windows_assignment_bundle.clone()
 8300:     };
 8301: 
 8302:     // Stages 8-11: distribute_windows_{membership,assignment,traversal,dns-zone}
 8303:     // (W4.5)
 8304:     //
 8305:     // Each distribute stage SCPs a locally-built signed bundle to the
 8306:     // Windows guest's reviewed canonical path under
 8307:     // `C:\ProgramData\RustyNet\…`, atomic-installs over the canonical
 8308:     // file, and clears the daemon's watermark so the next refresh tick
 8309:     // re-ingests the bundle. When the corresponding option path is
 8310:     // `None` the stage emits `Skipped` with reason "no local bundle
 8311:     // path provided" — keeps the orchestration sequence stable for
 8312:     // callers that have not yet built their local bundles. When `Some`
 8313:     // and any prior security validator has not passed the stage emits
 8314:     // `Skipped` with the upstream-failure reason: distribution depends
 8315:     // on a hardened guest, never on a partially-validated guest.
 8316:     let distribute_membership_log_path = logs_dir.join("distribute_windows_membership.log");
 8317:     let distribute_assignment_log_path = logs_dir.join("distribute_windows_assignment.log");
 8318:     let distribute_traversal_log_path = logs_dir.join("distribute_windows_traversal.log");
 8319:     let distribute_dns_zone_log_path = logs_dir.join("distribute_windows_dns_zone.log");
 8320:     let distribute_assignment_verifier_log_path =
 8321:         logs_dir.join("distribute_windows_assignment_verifier_key.log");
 8322:     let distribute_traversal_verifier_log_path =
 8323:         logs_dir.join("distribute_windows_traversal_verifier_key.log");
 8324:     let distribute_dns_zone_verifier_log_path =
 8325:         logs_dir.join("distribute_windows_dns_zone_verifier_key.log");
 8326: 
 8327:     type DistributeFn =
 8328:         fn(&str, &Path, &Path, Option<&Path>, &Path) -> Result<(String, String), (String, String)>;
 8329:     let run_distribute = |stage_name: &'static str,
 8330:                           log_path: &Path,
 8331:                           local_bundle: Option<&Path>,
 8332:                           dispatch: DistributeFn|
 8333:      -> VmLabStageOutcome {
 8334:         if dry_run {
 8335:             return stage_outcome(
 8336:                 stage_name,
 8337:                 VmLabStageStatus::Skipped,
 8338:                 format!("dry-run: would distribute {stage_name} bundle to {windows_alias}"),
 8339:                 vec![],
 8340:             );
 8341:         }
 8342:         let upstream_blocker = if !bootstrap_passed {
 8343:             Some("bootstrap_windows_host")
 8344:         } else if !validate_passed {
 8345:             Some("validate_windows_client_install")
 8346:         } else if !acls_passed {
 8347:             Some("validate_windows_runtime_acls")
 8348:         } else if !hardening_passed {
 8349:             Some("validate_windows_service_hardening")
 8350:         } else if !custody_passed {
 8351:             Some("validate_windows_key_custody")
 8352:         } else if !authenticode_passed {
 8353:             Some("validate_windows_authenticode")
 8354:         } else if !dns_failclosed_passed {
 8355:             Some("validate_windows_dns_failclosed")
 8356:         } else {
 8357:             None
 8358:         };
 8359:         if let Some(upstream) = upstream_blocker {
 8360:             return stage_outcome(
 8361:                 stage_name,
 8362:                 VmLabStageStatus::Skipped,
 8363:                 format!("skipped: {upstream} did not pass for {windows_alias}"),
 8364:                 vec![],
 8365:             );
 8366:         }
 8367:         let Some(bundle_path) = local_bundle else {
 8368:             return stage_outcome(
 8369:                 stage_name,
 8370:                 VmLabStageStatus::Skipped,
 8371:                 format!("skipped: no local bundle path provided for {stage_name}"),
 8372:                 vec![],
 8373:             );
 8374:         };
 8375:         match dispatch(
 8376:             windows_alias,
 8377:             inventory_path,
 8378:             ssh_identity_file,
 8379:             known_hosts_path,
 8380:             bundle_path,
 8381:         ) {
 8382:             Ok((summary, raw_report)) => {
 8383:                 let log_body = if raw_report.is_empty() {
 8384:                     summary.clone()
 8385:                 } else {
 8386:                     format!("{summary}\n--- raw report ---\n{raw_report}")
 8387:                 };
 8388:                 let _ = std::fs::write(log_path, log_body.as_str());
 8389:                 stage_outcome(
 8390:                     stage_name,
 8391:                     VmLabStageStatus::Pass,
 8392:                     summary,
 8393:                     vec![log_path.to_path_buf()],
 8394:                 )
 8395:             }
 8396:             Err((reason, raw_report)) => {
 8397:                 let log_body = if raw_report.is_empty() {
 8398:                     reason.clone()
 8399:                 } else {
 8400:                     format!("{reason}\n--- raw report ---\n{raw_report}")
 8401:                 };
 8402:                 let _ = std::fs::write(log_path, log_body.as_str());
 8403:                 stage_outcome(
 8404:                     stage_name,
 8405:                     VmLabStageStatus::Fail,
 8406:                     format!("{stage_name} distribution failed for {windows_alias}: {reason}"),
 8407:                     vec![log_path.to_path_buf()],
 8408:                 )
 8409:             }
 8410:         }
 8411:     };
 8412: 
 8413:     let distribute_membership_outcome = run_distribute(
 8414:         "distribute_windows_membership",
 8415:         distribute_membership_log_path.as_path(),
 8416:         effective_membership_bundle.as_deref(),
 8417:         run_distribute_windows_membership_stage,
 8418:     );
 8419:     // Verifier keys MUST land before the corresponding bundles. The
 8420:     // daemon's WatermarkStore re-ingests a bundle whenever its
 8421:     // canonical-path mtime changes (or watermark is cleared); at that
 8422:     // re-ingest moment the verifier key file must already be on disk
 8423:     // or the ingest fails with "read verifier key failed" / "verifier
 8424:     // key not found", and the daemon stays in restricted-safe with
 8425:     // empty peer state. Pushing the verifier key first avoids that
 8426:     // race.
 8427:     let distribute_assignment_verifier_outcome = run_distribute(
 8428:         "distribute_windows_assignment_verifier_key",
 8429:         distribute_assignment_verifier_log_path.as_path(),
 8430:         options
 8431:             .distribute_windows_assignment_verifier_key
 8432:             .as_deref(),
 8433:         run_distribute_windows_assignment_verifier_key_stage,
 8434:     );
 8435:     let distribute_traversal_verifier_outcome = run_distribute(
 8436:         "distribute_windows_traversal_verifier_key",
 8437:         distribute_traversal_verifier_log_path.as_path(),
 8438:         options.distribute_windows_traversal_verifier_key.as_deref(),
 8439:         run_distribute_windows_traversal_verifier_key_stage,
 8440:     );
 8441:     let distribute_dns_zone_verifier_outcome = run_distribute(
 8442:         "distribute_windows_dns_zone_verifier_key",
 8443:         distribute_dns_zone_verifier_log_path.as_path(),
 8444:         options.distribute_windows_dns_zone_verifier_key.as_deref(),
 8445:         run_distribute_windows_dns_zone_verifier_key_stage,
 8446:     );
 8447:     let distribute_assignment_outcome = run_distribute(
 8448:         "distribute_windows_assignment",
 8449:         distribute_assignment_log_path.as_path(),
 8450:         effective_assignment_bundle.as_deref(),
 8451:         run_distribute_windows_assignment_stage,
 8452:     );
 8453:     let distribute_traversal_outcome = run_distribute(
 8454:         "distribute_windows_traversal",
 8455:         distribute_traversal_log_path.as_path(),
 8456:         options.distribute_windows_traversal_bundle.as_deref(),
 8457:         run_distribute_windows_traversal_stage,
 8458:     );
 8459:     let distribute_dns_zone_outcome = run_distribute(
 8460:         "distribute_windows_dns_zone",
 8461:         distribute_dns_zone_log_path.as_path(),
 8462:         options.distribute_windows_dns_zone_bundle.as_deref(),
 8463:         run_distribute_windows_dns_zone_stage,
 8464:     );
 8465: 
 8466:     // Stage 12: validate_windows_mesh_join (W4.2)
 8467:     // Dispatches `rustynetd windows-mesh-status-check --no-fail-on-drift`
 8468:     // on the live Windows guest, parses the typed JSON snapshot of
 8469:     // `C:\ProgramData\RustyNet\rustynetd.state`, and emits a Pass/Fail
 8470:     // outcome based on whether the daemon has loaded a current
 8471:     // membership + assignment snapshot. Today the Windows daemon ships
 8472:     // on the `windows-unsupported` backend label so the state file
 8473:     // does not yet appear; the stage will report
 8474:     // `state snapshot missing` as drift, matching the honest "not yet
 8475:     // joined" posture documented under W2.4 (key custody) +
 8476:     // W1.3 (DNS fail-closed) verifier slices. Membership +
 8477:     // assignment distribution itself — the other half of W4.2 — lands
 8478:     // in a follow-up slice that exercises the new Windows IPC path
 8479:     // landed in commit 3e34b19 (Windows daemon control-pipe IPC +
 8480:     // install-service e2e flow). When that follow-up lands the
 8481:     // verifier here gains live evidence rather than expected drift.
 8482:     let mesh_join_log_path = logs_dir.join("validate_windows_mesh_join.log");
 8483:     let mesh_join_outcome = if dry_run {
 8484:         stage_outcome(
 8485:             "validate_windows_mesh_join",
 8486:             VmLabStageStatus::Skipped,
 8487:             format!("dry-run: would verify Windows mesh-join state on {windows_alias}"),
 8488:             vec![],
 8489:         )
 8490:     } else if !bootstrap_passed {
 8491:         stage_outcome(
 8492:             "validate_windows_mesh_join",
 8493:             VmLabStageStatus::Skipped,
 8494:             format!("skipped: bootstrap_windows_host did not pass for {windows_alias}"),
 8495:             vec![],
 8496:         )
 8497:     } else if !validate_passed {
 8498:         stage_outcome(
 8499:             "validate_windows_mesh_join",
 8500:             VmLabStageStatus::Skipped,
 8501:             format!("skipped: validate_windows_client_install did not pass for {windows_alias}"),
 8502:             vec![],
 8503:         )
 8504:     } else if !acls_passed {
 8505:         stage_outcome(
 8506:             "validate_windows_mesh_join",
 8507:             VmLabStageStatus::Skipped,
 8508:             format!("skipped: validate_windows_runtime_acls did not pass for {windows_alias}"),
 8509:             vec![],
 8510:         )
 8511:     } else if !hardening_passed {
 8512:         stage_outcome(
 8513:             "validate_windows_mesh_join",
 8514:             VmLabStageStatus::Skipped,
 8515:             format!("skipped: validate_windows_service_hardening did not pass for {windows_alias}"),
 8516:             vec![],
 8517:         )
 8518:     } else if !custody_passed {
 8519:         stage_outcome(
 8520:             "validate_windows_mesh_join",
 8521:             VmLabStageStatus::Skipped,
 8522:             format!("skipped: validate_windows_key_custody did not pass for {windows_alias}"),
 8523:             vec![],
 8524:         )
 8525:     } else if !authenticode_passed {
 8526:         stage_outcome(
 8527:             "validate_windows_mesh_join",
 8528:             VmLabStageStatus::Skipped,
 8529:             format!("skipped: validate_windows_authenticode did not pass for {windows_alias}"),
 8530:             vec![],
 8531:         )
 8532:     } else if !dns_failclosed_passed {
 8533:         stage_outcome(
 8534:             "validate_windows_mesh_join",
 8535:             VmLabStageStatus::Skipped,
 8536:             format!("skipped: validate_windows_dns_failclosed did not pass for {windows_alias}"),
 8537:             vec![],
 8538:         )
 8539:     } else {
 8540:         let result = run_validate_windows_mesh_join_stage(
 8541:             windows_alias,
 8542:             inventory_path,
 8543:             ssh_identity_file,
 8544:             known_hosts_path,
 8545:         );
 8546:         match result {
 8547:             Ok((summary, raw_report)) => {
 8548:                 let _ = std::fs::write(&mesh_join_log_path, raw_report.as_str());
 8549:                 stage_outcome(
 8550:                     "validate_windows_mesh_join",
 8551:                     VmLabStageStatus::Pass,
 8552:                     summary,
 8553:                     vec![mesh_join_log_path.clone()],
 8554:                 )
 8555:             }
 8556:             Err((reason, raw_report)) => {
 8557:                 let log_body = if raw_report.is_empty() {
 8558:                     reason.clone()
 8559:                 } else {
 8560:                     format!("{reason}\n--- raw report ---\n{raw_report}")
 8561:                 };
 8562:                 let _ = std::fs::write(&mesh_join_log_path, log_body.as_str());
 8563:                 stage_outcome(
 8564:                     "validate_windows_mesh_join",
 8565:                     VmLabStageStatus::Fail,
 8566:                     format!("Windows mesh-join validation failed for {windows_alias}: {reason}"),
 8567:                     vec![mesh_join_log_path.clone()],
 8568:                 )
 8569:             }
 8570:         }
 8571:     };
 8572: 
 8573:     vec![
 8574:         bootstrap_outcome,
 8575:         validate_outcome,
 8576:         acls_outcome,
 8577:         hardening_outcome,
 8578:         custody_outcome,
 8579:         authenticode_outcome,
 8580:         dns_failclosed_outcome,
 8581:         amend_membership_outcome,
 8582:         issue_windows_assignment_outcome,
 8583:         distribute_membership_outcome,
 8584:         distribute_assignment_verifier_outcome,
 8585:         distribute_traversal_verifier_outcome,
 8586:         distribute_dns_zone_verifier_outcome,
 8587:         distribute_assignment_outcome,
 8588:         distribute_traversal_outcome,
 8589:         distribute_dns_zone_outcome,
 8590:         mesh_join_outcome,
 8591:     ]
 8592: }
