10513: /// Mesh-status stage overrides — Linux parity for the Windows side's
10514: /// `--state-path / --expected-peer-id / --max-age-seconds` knobs.
10515: /// `None` / empty means "use the daemon's defaults"; the daemon
10516: /// already pins `/var/lib/rustynet/rustynetd.state` as the default
10517: /// state path and disables freshness checking when no max-age is set.
10518: #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Default)]
10519: pub struct MeshStatusOverrides {
10520:     pub state_path: Option<PathBuf>,
10521:     pub expected_peer_ids: Vec<String>,
10522:     pub max_age_seconds: Option<i64>,
10523: }
10524: 
10525: /// Per-run knobs for the Linux orchestrator. Mirrors the
10526: /// `WindowsOrchestrationOptions` shape; `mesh_status_overrides`
10527: /// match the Windows-side mesh-join flags.
10528: #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Default)]
10529: struct LinuxOrchestrationOptions {
10530:     dry_run: bool,
10531:     mesh_status_overrides: MeshStatusOverrides,
10532: }
10533: 
10534: /// Linux-side validator orchestrator. Mirrors the Windows
10535: /// `run_windows_orchestration_stages_with_options` shape but covers
10536: /// only the validator path — Linux peers are bootstrapped /
10537: /// installed by the existing bash orchestrator, so this chainer
10538: /// starts from a fully-installed peer and exercises each
10539: /// `linux-*-check` subcommand in order.
10540: ///
10541: /// Stage skip-cascade: every stage gates on `runtime_acls_passed`
10542: /// because the foundational ACL pin is the prerequisite for trusting
10543: /// any other on-disk state. Subsequent stages add their own gates so
10544: /// a failure halfway through still leaves the operator with the full
10545: /// set of upstream-blocker reasons in the report.
10546: fn run_linux_orchestration_stages_with_options(
10547:     linux_alias: &str,
10548:     inventory_path: &Path,
10549:     ssh_identity_file: &Path,
10550:     known_hosts_path: Option<&Path>,
10551:     report_dir: &Path,
10552:     options: LinuxOrchestrationOptions,
10553: ) -> Vec<VmLabStageOutcome> {
10554:     let logs_dir = report_dir.join("logs");
10555:     let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(&logs_dir);
10556:     let runtime_acls_log_path = logs_dir.join("validate_linux_runtime_acls.log");
10557:     let mesh_status_log_path = logs_dir.join("validate_linux_mesh_status.log");
10558:     let key_custody_log_path = logs_dir.join("validate_linux_key_custody.log");
10559:     let authenticode_log_path = logs_dir.join("validate_linux_authenticode.log");
10560:     let hardening_log_path = logs_dir.join("validate_linux_service_hardening.log");
10561:     let dns_failclosed_log_path = logs_dir.join("validate_linux_dns_failclosed.log");
10562: 
10563:     type LinuxStageFn =
10564:         fn(&str, &Path, &Path, Option<&Path>) -> Result<(String, String), (String, String)>;
10565:     let dispatch_stage =
10566:         |stage_name: &'static str, log_path: &Path, dispatch: LinuxStageFn| -> VmLabStageOutcome {
10567:             if options.dry_run {
10568:                 return stage_outcome(
10569:                     stage_name,
10570:                     VmLabStageStatus::Skipped,
10571:                     format!("dry-run: would dispatch {stage_name} on {linux_alias}"),
10572:                     vec![],
10573:                 );
10574:             }
10575:             match dispatch(
10576:                 linux_alias,
10577:                 inventory_path,
10578:                 ssh_identity_file,
10579:                 known_hosts_path,
10580:             ) {
10581:                 Ok((summary, raw)) => {
10582:                     let log_body = if raw.is_empty() {
10583:                         summary.clone()
10584:                     } else {
10585:                         format!("{summary}\n--- raw report ---\n{raw}")
10586:                     };
10587:                     let _ = std::fs::write(log_path, log_body.as_str());
10588:                     stage_outcome(
10589:                         stage_name,
10590:                         VmLabStageStatus::Pass,
10591:                         summary,
10592:                         vec![log_path.to_path_buf()],
10593:                     )
10594:                 }
10595:                 Err((reason, raw)) => {
10596:                     let log_body = if raw.is_empty() {
10597:                         reason.clone()
10598:                     } else {
10599:                         format!("{reason}\n--- raw report ---\n{raw}")
10600:                     };
10601:                     let _ = std::fs::write(log_path, log_body.as_str());
10602:                     stage_outcome(
10603:                         stage_name,
10604:                         VmLabStageStatus::Fail,
10605:                         format!("{stage_name} failed for {linux_alias}: {reason}"),
10606:                         vec![log_path.to_path_buf()],
10607:                     )
10608:                 }
10609:             }
10610:         };
10611: 
10612:     let runtime_acls_outcome = dispatch_stage(
10613:         "validate_linux_runtime_acls",
10614:         runtime_acls_log_path.as_path(),
10615:         run_validate_linux_runtime_acls_stage,
10616:     );
10617:     let runtime_acls_passed = runtime_acls_outcome.status == VmLabStageStatus::Pass;
10618: 
10619:     let make_skipped = |stage_name: &'static str, upstream: &str| -> VmLabStageOutcome {
10620:         stage_outcome(
10621:             stage_name,
10622:             VmLabStageStatus::Skipped,
10623:             format!("skipped: {upstream} did not pass for {linux_alias}"),
10624:             vec![],
10625:         )
10626:     };
10627: 
10628:     let key_custody_outcome = if !runtime_acls_passed && !options.dry_run {
10629:         make_skipped("validate_linux_key_custody", "validate_linux_runtime_acls")
10630:     } else {
10631:         dispatch_stage(
10632:             "validate_linux_key_custody",
10633:             key_custody_log_path.as_path(),
10634:             run_validate_linux_key_custody_stage,
10635:         )
10636:     };
10637:     let key_custody_passed = key_custody_outcome.status == VmLabStageStatus::Pass;
10638: 
10639:     let hardening_outcome = if !runtime_acls_passed && !options.dry_run {
10640:         make_skipped(
10641:             "validate_linux_service_hardening",
10642:             "validate_linux_runtime_acls",
10643:         )
10644:     } else {
10645:         dispatch_stage(
10646:             "validate_linux_service_hardening",
10647:             hardening_log_path.as_path(),
10648:             run_validate_linux_service_hardening_stage,
10649:         )
10650:     };
10651:     let hardening_passed = hardening_outcome.status == VmLabStageStatus::Pass;
10652: 
10653:     let authenticode_outcome = if !runtime_acls_passed && !options.dry_run {
10654:         make_skipped("validate_linux_authenticode", "validate_linux_runtime_acls")
10655:     } else {
10656:         dispatch_stage(
10657:             "validate_linux_authenticode",
10658:             authenticode_log_path.as_path(),
10659:             run_validate_linux_authenticode_stage,
10660:         )
10661:     };
10662: 
10663:     let dns_failclosed_outcome = if !runtime_acls_passed && !options.dry_run {
10664:         make_skipped(
10665:             "validate_linux_dns_failclosed",
10666:             "validate_linux_runtime_acls",
10667:         )
10668:     } else if !key_custody_passed && !options.dry_run {
10669:         make_skipped(
10670:             "validate_linux_dns_failclosed",
10671:             "validate_linux_key_custody",
10672:         )
10673:     } else if !hardening_passed && !options.dry_run {
10674:         make_skipped(
10675:             "validate_linux_dns_failclosed",
10676:             "validate_linux_service_hardening",
10677:         )
10678:     } else {
10679:         dispatch_stage(
10680:             "validate_linux_dns_failclosed",
10681:             dns_failclosed_log_path.as_path(),
10682:             run_validate_linux_dns_failclosed_stage,
10683:         )
10684:     };
10685:     let dns_failclosed_passed = dns_failclosed_outcome.status == VmLabStageStatus::Pass;
10686: 
10687:     let mesh_status_outcome = if !runtime_acls_passed && !options.dry_run {
10688:         make_skipped("validate_linux_mesh_status", "validate_linux_runtime_acls")
10689:     } else if !key_custody_passed && !options.dry_run {
10690:         make_skipped("validate_linux_mesh_status", "validate_linux_key_custody")
10691:     } else if !hardening_passed && !options.dry_run {
10692:         make_skipped(
10693:             "validate_linux_mesh_status",
10694:             "validate_linux_service_hardening",
10695:         )
10696:     } else if !dns_failclosed_passed && !options.dry_run {
10697:         make_skipped(
10698:             "validate_linux_mesh_status",
10699:             "validate_linux_dns_failclosed",
10700:         )
10701:     } else if options.dry_run {
10702:         stage_outcome(
10703:             "validate_linux_mesh_status",
10704:             VmLabStageStatus::Skipped,
10705:             format!("dry-run: would dispatch validate_linux_mesh_status on {linux_alias}"),
10706:             vec![],
10707:         )
10708:     } else {
10709:         // Mesh-status uses the with-overrides runner because the
10710:         // operator can pass `--state-path / --expected-peer-id /
10711:         // --max-age-seconds` through the CLI; the other five
10712:         // stages run with daemon defaults.
10713:         match run_validate_linux_mesh_status_stage_with_overrides(
10714:             linux_alias,
10715:             inventory_path,
10716:             ssh_identity_file,
10717:             known_hosts_path,
10718:             &options.mesh_status_overrides,
10719:         ) {
10720:             Ok((summary, raw)) => {
10721:                 let log_body = if raw.is_empty() {
10722:                     summary.clone()
10723:                 } else {
10724:                     format!("{summary}\n--- raw report ---\n{raw}")
10725:                 };
10726:                 let _ = std::fs::write(mesh_status_log_path.as_path(), log_body.as_str());
10727:                 stage_outcome(
10728:                     "validate_linux_mesh_status",
10729:                     VmLabStageStatus::Pass,
10730:                     summary,
10731:                     vec![mesh_status_log_path.clone()],
10732:                 )
10733:             }
10734:             Err((reason, raw)) => {
10735:                 let log_body = if raw.is_empty() {
10736:                     reason.clone()
10737:                 } else {
10738:                     format!("{reason}\n--- raw report ---\n{raw}")
10739:                 };
10740:                 let _ = std::fs::write(mesh_status_log_path.as_path(), log_body.as_str());
10741:                 stage_outcome(
10742:                     "validate_linux_mesh_status",
10743:                     VmLabStageStatus::Fail,
10744:                     format!("validate_linux_mesh_status failed for {linux_alias}: {reason}"),
10745:                     vec![mesh_status_log_path.clone()],
10746:                 )
10747:             }
10748:         }
10749:     };
10750: 
10751:     vec![
10752:         runtime_acls_outcome,
10753:         key_custody_outcome,
10754:         hardening_outcome,
10755:         authenticode_outcome,
10756:         dns_failclosed_outcome,
10757:         mesh_status_outcome,
10758:     ]
10759: }
10760: 
10761: /// Run the Linux validator chainer against every alias in `linux_aliases`,
10762: /// each scoped under a per-alias log subdirectory under `report_dir`.
10763: /// Stage names are prefixed with `<alias>::` so the orchestration report's
10764: /// stage list disambiguates between peers cleanly.
10765: ///
10766: /// Returns the flattened outcome list (in alias order). The caller decides
10767: /// whether to short-circuit on first failure or continue across peers; this
10768: /// helper continues across peers so a single bad peer does not mask drift
10769: /// on the others.
10770: fn run_linux_daemon_validators_for_aliases(
10771:     linux_aliases: &[String],
10772:     inventory_path: &Path,
10773:     ssh_identity_file: &Path,
10774:     known_hosts_path: Option<&Path>,
10775:     report_dir: &Path,
10776:     dry_run: bool,
10777: ) -> Vec<VmLabStageOutcome> {
10778:     let mut outcomes: Vec<VmLabStageOutcome> = Vec::new();
10779:     let validate_root = report_dir.join("validate_linux_daemon_state");
10780:     let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(validate_root.as_path());
10781:     for alias in linux_aliases {
10782:         let per_alias_dir = validate_root.join(alias);
10783:         let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(per_alias_dir.as_path());
10784:         let chainer_outcomes = run_linux_orchestration_stages_with_options(
10785:             alias.as_str(),
10786:             inventory_path,
10787:             ssh_identity_file,
10788:             known_hosts_path,
10789:             per_alias_dir.as_path(),
10790:             LinuxOrchestrationOptions {
10791:                 dry_run,
10792:                 mesh_status_overrides: MeshStatusOverrides::default(),
10793:             },
10794:         );
10795:         for mut outcome in chainer_outcomes {
10796:             outcome.stage = format!("{alias}::{}", outcome.stage);
10797:             outcomes.push(outcome);
10798:         }
10799:     }
10800:     outcomes
10801: }
10802: 
10803: /// Operator-facing config for the `vm-lab-validate-linux-security`
10804: /// subcommand. Linux parity for `VmLabValidateWindowsSecurityConfig`.
10805: #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
10806: pub struct VmLabValidateLinuxSecurityConfig {
10807:     pub inventory_path: PathBuf,
10808:     pub linux_vm: String,
10809:     pub ssh_identity_file: PathBuf,
10810:     pub known_hosts_path: Option<PathBuf>,
10811:     pub report_dir: PathBuf,
10812:     pub dry_run: bool,
10813:     /// Mesh-status stage override: alternate path to the daemon's
10814:     /// session-snapshot file (defaults to
10815:     /// `/var/lib/rustynet/rustynetd.state` per the systemd unit).
10816:     pub mesh_status_state_path: Option<PathBuf>,
10817:     /// Mesh-status stage override: peer IDs the operator expects the
10818:     /// daemon to have loaded. Empty list = no peer-presence check.
10819:     pub mesh_status_expected_peer_ids: Vec<String>,
10820:     /// Mesh-status stage override: snapshot freshness budget. `None`
10821:     /// disables the freshness check.
10822:     pub mesh_status_max_age_seconds: Option<i64>,
10823: }
10824: 
10825: pub fn run_validate_linux_security(
10826:     config: &VmLabValidateLinuxSecurityConfig,
10827: ) -> Result<String, String> {
10828:     std::fs::create_dir_all(&config.report_dir).map_err(|err| {
10829:         format!(
10830:             "create report dir {} failed: {err}",
10831:             config.report_dir.display()
10832:         )
10833:     })?;
10834:     let outcomes = run_linux_orchestration_stages_with_options(
10835:         config.linux_vm.as_str(),
10836:         config.inventory_path.as_path(),
10837:         config.ssh_identity_file.as_path(),
10838:         config.known_hosts_path.as_deref(),
10839:         config.report_dir.as_path(),
10840:         LinuxOrchestrationOptions {
10841:             dry_run: config.dry_run,
10842:             mesh_status_overrides: MeshStatusOverrides {
10843:                 state_path: config.mesh_status_state_path.clone(),
10844:                 expected_peer_ids: config.mesh_status_expected_peer_ids.clone(),
10845:                 max_age_seconds: config.mesh_status_max_age_seconds,
10846:             },
10847:         },
10848:     );
10849:     let summary_path = config.report_dir.join("linux_security_validation.json");
10850:     let payload = serde_json::json!({
10851:         "schema_version": 1,
10852:         "linux_vm": config.linux_vm,
10853:         "dry_run": config.dry_run,
10854:         "stages": outcomes
10855:             .iter()
10856:             .map(|o| {
10857:                 serde_json::json!({
10858:                     "stage": o.stage,
10859:                     "status": format!("{:?}", o.status).to_ascii_lowercase(),
10860:                     "summary": o.summary,
10861:                     "artifacts": o.artifacts.clone(),
10862:                 })
10863:             })
10864:             .collect::<Vec<_>>(),
10865:     });
10866:     let serialized = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&payload)
10867:         .map_err(|err| format!("serialize Linux security validation report failed: {err}"))?;
10868:     std::fs::write(summary_path.as_path(), serialized.as_str()).map_err(|err| {
10869:         format!(
10870:             "write Linux security validation report to {} failed: {err}",
10871:             summary_path.display()
10872:         )
10873:     })?;
10874:     println!("{serialized}");
10875:     let any_failed = outcomes.iter().any(|o| o.status == VmLabStageStatus::Fail);
10876:     if any_failed {
10877:         return Err(format!(
10878:             "Linux security validation reported one or more stage failures; report at {}",
10879:             summary_path.display()
10880:         ));
10881:     }
10882:     Ok(format!(
10883:         "Linux security validation passed for {}; report at {}",
10884:         config.linux_vm,
10885:         summary_path.display()
10886:     ))
10887: }

10958: pub fn execute_ops_vm_lab_iterate_live_lab(
10959:     config: VmLabIterateLiveLabConfig,
10960: ) -> Result<String, String> {
10961:     if config.validation_steps.is_empty() {
10962:         return Err(
10963:             "specify at least one --validation-step for vm-lab-iterate-live-lab".to_string(),
10964:         );
10965:     }
10966: 
10967:     let dirty_worktree = if config.require_clean_tree || config.require_local_head {
10968:         Some(git_worktree_is_dirty()?)
10969:     } else {
10970:         None
10971:     };
10972:     let (resolved_source_mode, resolved_repo_ref) = resolve_iteration_source_selection(
10973:         config.source_mode.as_deref(),
10974:         config.repo_ref.as_deref(),
10975:         config.require_clean_tree,
10976:         config.require_local_head,
10977:         dirty_worktree.unwrap_or(false),
10978:     )?;
10979: 
10980:     let profile_output_path = config
10981:         .profile_output_path
10982:         .clone()
10983:         .unwrap_or_else(default_live_lab_iteration_profile_path);
10984:     let report_dir = config
10985:         .report_dir
10986:         .clone()
10987:         .unwrap_or_else(default_live_lab_iteration_report_dir);
10988:     let script_path = config.script_path.clone();
10989:     let timeout_secs = config.timeout_secs;
10990: 
10991:     for step in &config.validation_steps {
10992:         execute_vm_lab_iteration_validation_step(step, timeout_secs)?;
10993:     }
10994: 
10995:     let profile_result =
10996:         execute_ops_vm_lab_write_live_lab_profile(VmLabWriteLiveLabProfileConfig {
10997:             inventory_path: config.inventory_path.clone(),
10998:             output_path: profile_output_path.clone(),
10999:             exit_vm: config.exit_vm.clone(),
11000:             exit_target: config.exit_target.clone(),
11001:             client_vm: config.client_vm.clone(),
11002:             client_target: config.client_target.clone(),
11003:             entry_vm: config.entry_vm.clone(),
11004:             entry_target: config.entry_target.clone(),
11005:             aux_vm: config.aux_vm.clone(),
11006:             aux_target: config.aux_target.clone(),
11007:             extra_vm: config.extra_vm.clone(),
11008:             extra_target: config.extra_target.clone(),
11009:             fifth_client_vm: config.fifth_client_vm.clone(),
11010:             fifth_client_target: config.fifth_client_target.clone(),
11011:             require_same_network: config.require_same_network,
11012:             ssh_identity_file: config.ssh_identity_file.clone(),
11013:             ssh_known_hosts_file: config.ssh_known_hosts_file.clone(),
11014:             ssh_allow_cidrs: config.ssh_allow_cidrs.clone(),
11015:             network_id: config.network_id.clone(),
11016:             traversal_ttl_secs: config.traversal_ttl_secs,
11017:             cross_network_nat_profiles: None,
11018:             cross_network_required_nat_profiles: None,
11019:             cross_network_impairment_profile: None,
11020:             backend: Some(
11021:                 config
11022:                     .backend
11023:                     .clone()
11024:                     .unwrap_or_else(|| "linux-wireguard-userspace-shared".to_string()),
11025:             ),
11026:             source_mode: Some(resolved_source_mode.clone()),
11027:             repo_ref: resolved_repo_ref.clone(),
11028:             report_dir: Some(report_dir.clone()),
11029:         })?;
11030: 
11031:     let live_lab_result = execute_ops_vm_lab_run_live_lab(VmLabRunLiveLabConfig {
11032:         profile_path: profile_output_path.clone(),
11033:         script_path,
11034:         dry_run: config.dry_run,
11035:         skip_setup: false,
11036:         skip_gates: config.skip_gates,
11037:         skip_soak: config.skip_soak,
11038:         skip_cross_network: config.skip_cross_network,
11039:         source_mode: Some(resolved_source_mode),
11040:         repo_ref: resolved_repo_ref,
11041:         report_dir: Some(report_dir.clone()),
11042:         timeout_secs,
11043:     });
11044: 
11045:     let summary = summarize_live_lab_report(
11046:         report_dir.as_path(),
11047:         config.collect_failure_diagnostics,
11048:         config.failed_log_tail_lines,
11049:     )?;
11050:     let summary_text = render_live_lab_iteration_summary(
11051:         profile_output_path.as_path(),
11052:         report_dir.as_path(),
11053:         profile_result.as_str(),
11054:         &summary,
11055:     );
11056: 
11057:     match live_lab_result {
11058:         Ok(_) => Ok(summary_text),
11059:         Err(err) => Err(format!("{summary_text}\nrun_error={err}")),
11060:     }
11061: }

11063: pub fn execute_ops_vm_lab_validate_live_lab_profile(
11064:     config: VmLabValidateLiveLabProfileConfig,
11065: ) -> Result<String, String> {
11066:     let profile = load_live_lab_profile(config.profile_path.as_path())?;
11067:     ensure_local_regular_file_path(
11068:         Path::new(profile.required("SSH_IDENTITY_FILE")?.as_str()),
11069:         "SSH identity file",
11070:     )?;
11071:     if let Some(path) = profile.optional("SSH_KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE") {
11072:         ensure_local_regular_file_path(Path::new(path.as_str()), "SSH known_hosts file")?;
11073:     }
11074:     let source_mode = profile.optional("SOURCE_MODE");
11075:     let backend = profile.optional("RUSTYNET_BACKEND");
11076:     if let Some(expected_backend) = config.expected_backend.as_deref()
11077:         && backend.as_deref() != Some(expected_backend)
11078:     {
11079:         return Err(format!(
11080:             "live-lab profile backend mismatch: expected {expected_backend}, got {}",
11081:             backend.as_deref().unwrap_or("none")
11082:         ));
11083:     }
11084:     if let Some(expected_source_mode) = config.expected_source_mode.as_deref()
11085:         && source_mode.as_deref() != Some(expected_source_mode)
11086:     {
11087:         return Err(format!(
11088:             "live-lab profile source mode mismatch: expected {expected_source_mode}, got {}",
11089:             source_mode.as_deref().unwrap_or("none")
11090:         ));
11091:     }
11092:     if let Some(mode) = source_mode.as_deref() {
11093:         validate_live_lab_source_mode(mode)?;
11094:         if mode == "ref" && profile.optional("REPO_REF").is_none() {
11095:             return Err("live-lab profile SOURCE_MODE=ref requires REPO_REF".to_string());
11096:         }
11097:     }
11098:     if config.require_five_node {
11099:         for key in ["ENTRY_TARGET", "AUX_TARGET", "EXTRA_TARGET"] {
11100:             if profile.optional(key).is_none() {
11101:                 return Err(format!(
11102:                     "live-lab profile must define {key} for the reduced five-node topology"
11103:                 ));
11104:             }
11105:         }
11106:     }
11107: 
11108:     ensure_live_lab_profile_platform_metadata(&profile)?;
11109:     ensure_live_lab_profile_linux_only(&profile, "vm-lab-validate-live-lab-profile")?;
11110: 
11111:     let targets = profile.configured_targets()?;
11112:     let mut lines = vec![
11113:         format!("profile_path={}", config.profile_path.display()),
11114:         format!("target_count={}", targets.len()),
11115:         format!("backend={}", backend.as_deref().unwrap_or("none")),
11116:         format!("source_mode={}", source_mode.as_deref().unwrap_or("none")),
11117:         format!(
11118:             "repo_ref={}",
11119:             profile.optional("REPO_REF").as_deref().unwrap_or("none")
11120:         ),
11121:         format!(
11122:             "report_dir={}",
11123:             profile.optional("REPORT_DIR").as_deref().unwrap_or("none")
11124:         ),
11125:     ];
11126:     for target in &targets {
11127:         lines.push(format!("target.{}={}", target.role, target.target));
11128:     }
11129:     Ok(lines.join("\n"))
11130: }

11132: pub fn execute_ops_vm_lab_diagnose_live_lab_failure(
11133:     config: VmLabDiagnoseLiveLabFailureConfig,
11134: ) -> Result<String, String> {
11135:     let report_dir = resolve_absolute_path(config.report_dir.as_path())?;
11136:     let profile = load_live_lab_profile(config.profile_path.as_path())?;
11137:     ensure_live_lab_profile_linux_only(&profile, "vm-lab-diagnose-live-lab-failure")?;
11138:     let summary = summarize_live_lab_report(report_dir.as_path(), false, 1)?;
11139:     let stage = if let Some(stage) = config.stage.as_deref() {
11140:         stage.to_string()
11141:     } else {
11142:         summary
11143:             .first_failed_stage
11144:             .clone()
11145:             .ok_or_else(|| "live-lab report does not contain a failed stage".to_string())?
11146:     };
11147:     let stage_records = parse_live_lab_stage_records(report_dir.as_path())?;
11148:     let stage_record = stage_records
11149:         .iter()
11150:         .find(|record| record.name == stage)
11151:         .cloned()
11152:         .or_else(|| infer_live_lab_stage_record(report_dir.as_path(), stage.as_str()).ok())
11153:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("stage {stage} is not present in {}", report_dir.display()))?;
11154:     let diagnostics_dir = config.output_dir.clone().unwrap_or_else(|| {
11155:         report_dir
11156:             .join("diagnostics")
11157:             .join(sanitize_label_for_path(stage.as_str()))
11158:     });
11159:     fs::create_dir_all(diagnostics_dir.as_path()).map_err(|err| {
11160:         format!(
11161:             "create diagnostics dir failed ({}): {err}",
11162:             diagnostics_dir.display()
11163:         )
11164:     })?;
11165: 
11166:     let targets = resolve_live_lab_profile_targets(config.inventory_path.as_path(), &profile)?;
11167:     let ssh_identity_file = profile.optional("SSH_IDENTITY_FILE").map(PathBuf::from);
11168:     let ssh_known_hosts_file = profile.optional("SSH_KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE").map(PathBuf::from);
11169:     let timeout = timeout_or_default(config.timeout_secs, DEFAULT_COLLECT_TIMEOUT_SECS);
11170:     let mut warnings = Vec::new();
11171:     let status_targets = targets
11172:         .iter()
11173:         .map(|target| target.remote_target.clone())
11174:         .collect::<Vec<_>>();
11175:     let status_output = match execute_vm_lab_status_for_targets(
11176:         status_targets.as_slice(),
11177:         None,
11178:         ssh_identity_file.as_deref(),
11179:         ssh_known_hosts_file.as_deref(),
11180:         timeout,
11181:     ) {
11182:         Ok(output) => output,
11183:         Err(output) => {
11184:             warnings.push(
11185:                 "vm-lab-status reported probe failures; inspect vm_lab_status.json for partial results"
11186:                     .to_string(),
11187:             );
11188:             output
11189:         }
11190:     };
11191:     let status_path = diagnostics_dir.join("vm_lab_status.json");
11192:     fs::write(status_path.as_path(), status_output.as_bytes()).map_err(|err| {
11193:         format!(
11194:             "write vm-lab status output failed ({}): {err}",
11195:             status_path.display()
11196:         )
11197:     })?;
11198: 
11199:     let artifacts_dir = if config.collect_artifacts {
11200:         let artifacts_dir = diagnostics_dir.join("artifacts");
11201:         if let Err(err) = execute_vm_lab_collect_artifacts_for_targets(
11202:             status_targets.as_slice(),
11203:             None,
11204:             ssh_identity_file.as_deref(),
11205:             ssh_known_hosts_file.as_deref(),
11206:             artifacts_dir.as_path(),
11207:             timeout,
11208:         ) {
11209:             warnings.push(
11210:                 "artifact collection reported probe failures; inspect artifacts/collection_error.txt for details"
11211:                     .to_string(),
11212:             );
11213:             fs::create_dir_all(artifacts_dir.as_path()).map_err(|create_err| {
11214:                 format!(
11215:                     "create artifact diagnostics dir failed ({}): {create_err}",
11216:                     artifacts_dir.display()
11217:                 )
11218:             })?;
11219:             let error_path = artifacts_dir.join("collection_error.txt");
11220:             fs::write(error_path.as_path(), err.as_bytes()).map_err(|write_err| {
11221:                 format!(
11222:                     "write artifact collection error failed ({}): {write_err}",
11223:                     error_path.display()
11224:                 )
11225:             })?;
11226:         }
11227:         Some(artifacts_dir)
11228:     } else {
11229:         None
11230:     };
11231:     let stage_forensics = collect_live_lab_stage_forensics(
11232:         report_dir.as_path(),
11233:         &stage_record,
11234:         &summary,
11235:         diagnostics_dir.as_path(),
11236:         targets.as_slice(),
11237:         timeout,
11238:     )?;
11239:     warnings.extend(stage_forensics.warnings.iter().cloned());
11240: 
11241:     let targets_json = targets
11242:         .iter()
11243:         .map(|target| {
11244:             json!({
11245:                 "role": target.role,
11246:                 "target": target.profile_target,
11247:                 "ssh_target": target.remote_target.ssh_target,
11248:             })
11249:         })
11250:         .collect::<Vec<_>>();
11251:     let summary_json = json!({
11252:         "report_dir": config.report_dir,
11253:         "profile_path": config.profile_path,
11254:         "stage": stage,
11255:         "stage_description": stage_record.description,
11256:         "key_report_path": summary.key_report_path.clone(),
11257:         "key_log_path": summary.key_log_path.clone(),
11258:         "likely_reason": summary.likely_reason.clone(),
11259:         "target_count": targets.len(),
11260:         "targets": targets_json,
11261:         "status_output_path": status_path.clone(),
11262:         "artifacts_dir": artifacts_dir.clone(),
11263:         "warnings": warnings.clone(),
11264:         "stage_forensics": {
11265:             "strategy": stage_forensics.strategy.clone(),
11266:             "report_context_dir": stage_forensics.report_context_dir.clone(),
11267:             "summary_json_path": stage_forensics.summary_json_path.clone(),
11268:             "review_markdown_path": stage_forensics.review_markdown_path.clone(),
11269:             "remote_probe_dir": stage_forensics.remote_probe_dir.clone(),
11270:             "worker_results_json_path": stage_forensics.worker_results_json_path.clone(),
11271:             "worker_results_markdown_path": stage_forensics.worker_results_markdown_path.clone(),
11272:             "copied_paths": stage_forensics.copied_paths.clone(),
11273:             "notes": stage_forensics.notes.clone(),
11274:         },
11275:     });
11276:     let summary_path = diagnostics_dir.join("diagnostics_summary.json");
11277:     fs::write(
11278:         summary_path.as_path(),
11279:         serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&summary_json)
11280:             .map_err(|err| format!("serialize live-lab diagnostics summary failed: {err}"))?,
11281:     )
11282:     .map_err(|err| {
11283:         format!(
11284:             "write diagnostics summary failed ({}): {err}",
11285:             summary_path.display()
11286:         )
11287:     })?;
11288:     validate_live_lab_diagnostics_artifacts(diagnostics_dir.as_path())?;
11289:     serialize_vm_lab_command_result(&VmLabCommandResult {
11290:         command: "vm-lab-diagnose-live-lab-failure".to_string(),
11291:         overall_status: VmLabCommandOverallStatus::Pass,
11292:         report_dir: diagnostics_dir.display().to_string(),
11293:         outcomes: vec![VmLabStageOutcome {
11294:             stage: stage_record.name,
11295:             status: VmLabStageStatus::Pass,
11296:             summary: stage_record.description,
11297:             artifacts: vec![
11298:                 status_path.display().to_string(),
11299:                 summary_path.display().to_string(),
11300:                 stage_forensics.summary_json_path.display().to_string(),
11301:                 stage_forensics.review_markdown_path.display().to_string(),
11302:             ],
11303:         }],
11304:         warnings,
11305:         next_actions: vec![format!(
11306:             "Inspect {} for the AI-focused review bundle",
11307:             stage_forensics.review_markdown_path.display()
11308:         )],
11309:     })
11310: }
11311: 
11312: fn infer_live_lab_stage_record(
11313:     report_dir: &Path,
11314:     stage: &str,
11315: ) -> Result<LiveLabStageRecord, String> {
11316:     let log_path = report_dir.join("logs").join(format!("{stage}.log"));
11317:     let parallel_stage_dir = report_dir.join("state").join(format!("parallel-{stage}"));
11318:     if !log_path.is_file() && !parallel_stage_dir.is_dir() {
11319:         return Err(format!(
11320:             "stage {stage} is not present in {}",
11321:             report_dir.display()
11322:         ));
11323:     }
11324: 
11325:     let description_prefix = format!("[stage:{stage}] START ");
11326:     let description = fs::read_to_string(log_path.as_path())
11327:         .ok()
11328:         .and_then(|body| {
11329:             body.lines().find_map(|line| {
11330:                 line.trim()
11331:                     .strip_prefix(description_prefix.as_str())
11332:                     .map(|value| value.trim().to_string())
11333:             })
11334:         })
11335:         .unwrap_or_else(|| stage.replace('_', " "));
11336: 
11337:     Ok(LiveLabStageRecord {
11338:         name: stage.to_string(),
11339:         severity: "unknown".to_string(),
11340:         status: "incomplete".to_string(),
11341:         rc: String::new(),
11342:         log_path,
11343:         description,
11344:     })
11345: }
11346: 
11347: fn collect_live_lab_stage_forensics(
11348:     report_dir: &Path,
11349:     stage_record: &LiveLabStageRecord,
11350:     summary: &LiveLabStageSummary,
11351:     diagnostics_dir: &Path,
11352:     targets: &[ResolvedLiveLabTarget],
11353:     timeout: Duration,
11354: ) -> Result<LiveLabStageForensicsBundle, String> {
11355:     let strategy = live_lab_stage_forensics_strategy(stage_record.name.as_str()).to_string();
11356:     let local_bundle =
11357:         collect_live_lab_stage_local_bundle(report_dir, stage_record, summary, diagnostics_dir)?;
11358:     let mut notes = live_lab_stage_forensics_notes(stage_record.name.as_str());
11359:     let mut warnings = Vec::new();
11360:     let remote_probe = match stage_record.name.as_str() {
11361:         "validate_baseline_runtime" => {
11362:             collect_validate_baseline_runtime_remote_probe(diagnostics_dir, targets, timeout)?
11363:         }
11364:         _ => LiveLabStageRemoteProbeSummary {
11365:             remote_probe_dir: None,
11366:             notes: Vec::new(),
11367:             warnings: Vec::new(),
11368:         },
11369:     };
11370:     notes.extend(remote_probe.notes.iter().cloned());
11371:     warnings.extend(remote_probe.warnings.iter().cloned());
11372: 
11373:     let review_markdown_path = diagnostics_dir.join("stage_forensics_review.md");
11374:     let review_markdown = render_live_lab_stage_forensics_review(LiveLabStageReviewContext {
11375:         report_dir,
11376:         stage_record,
11377:         summary,
11378:         strategy: strategy.as_str(),
11379:         local_bundle: &local_bundle,
11380:         remote_probe_dir: remote_probe.remote_probe_dir.as_deref(),
11381:         notes: notes.as_slice(),
11382:         warnings: warnings.as_slice(),
11383:     });
11384:     fs::write(review_markdown_path.as_path(), review_markdown.as_bytes()).map_err(|err| {
11385:         format!(
11386:             "write stage forensics review failed ({}): {err}",
11387:             review_markdown_path.display()
11388:         )
11389:     })?;
11390: 
11391:     let summary_json_path = diagnostics_dir.join("stage_forensics_summary.json");
11392:     let summary_json = json!({
11393:         "stage": stage_record.name,
11394:         "strategy": strategy.clone(),
11395:         "report_context_dir": local_bundle.report_context_dir.clone(),
11396:         "copied_paths": local_bundle.copied_paths.clone(),
11397:         "worker_result_count": local_bundle.worker_results.len(),
11398:         "failed_worker_count": local_bundle.worker_results.iter().filter(|result| result.rc != 0).count(),
11399:         "worker_results_json_path": local_bundle.worker_results_json_path.clone(),
11400:         "worker_results_markdown_path": local_bundle.worker_results_markdown_path.clone(),
11401:         "remote_probe_dir": remote_probe.remote_probe_dir.clone(),
11402:         "notes": notes.clone(),
11403:         "warnings": warnings.clone(),
11404:         "review_markdown_path": review_markdown_path.clone(),
11405:     });
11406:     fs::write(
11407:         summary_json_path.as_path(),
11408:         serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&summary_json)
11409:             .map_err(|err| format!("serialize stage forensics summary failed: {err}"))?,
11410:     )
11411:     .map_err(|err| {
11412:         format!(
11413:             "write stage forensics summary failed ({}): {err}",
11414:             summary_json_path.display()
11415:         )
11416:     })?;
11417: 
11418:     let mut copied_paths = local_bundle.copied_paths.clone();
11419:     copied_paths.push(summary_json_path.clone());
11420:     copied_paths.push(review_markdown_path.clone());
11421: 
11422:     Ok(LiveLabStageForensicsBundle {
11423:         strategy,
11424:         report_context_dir: local_bundle.report_context_dir,
11425:         summary_json_path,
11426:         review_markdown_path,
11427:         remote_probe_dir: remote_probe.remote_probe_dir,
11428:         copied_paths,
11429:         worker_results_json_path: local_bundle.worker_results_json_path,
11430:         worker_results_markdown_path: local_bundle.worker_results_markdown_path,
11431:         notes,
11432:         warnings,
11433:     })
11434: }

11436: fn collect_live_lab_stage_local_bundle(
11437:     report_dir: &Path,
11438:     stage_record: &LiveLabStageRecord,
11439:     summary: &LiveLabStageSummary,
11440:     diagnostics_dir: &Path,
11441: ) -> Result<LiveLabStageLocalBundle, String> {
11442:     let report_context_dir = diagnostics_dir.join("report_context");
11443:     fs::create_dir_all(report_context_dir.as_path()).map_err(|err| {
11444:         format!(
11445:             "create stage report context dir failed ({}): {err}",
11446:             report_context_dir.display()
11447:         )
11448:     })?;
11449: 
11450:     let mut copied_paths = Vec::new();
11451:     let mut seen_sources = HashSet::new();
11452:     copy_stage_bundle_file(
11453:         summary.key_report_path.as_path(),
11454:         report_context_dir.join("failure_digest.md").as_path(),
11455:         &mut seen_sources,
11456:         &mut copied_paths,
11457:     )?;
11458:     copy_stage_bundle_file(
11459:         report_dir.join("failure_digest.json").as_path(),
11460:         report_context_dir.join("failure_digest.json").as_path(),
11461:         &mut seen_sources,
11462:         &mut copied_paths,
11463:     )?;
11464:     copy_stage_bundle_file(
11465:         report_dir.join("run_summary.md").as_path(),
11466:         report_context_dir.join("run_summary.md").as_path(),
11467:         &mut seen_sources,
11468:         &mut copied_paths,
11469:     )?;
11470:     copy_stage_bundle_file(
11471:         report_dir.join("run_summary.json").as_path(),
11472:         report_context_dir.join("run_summary.json").as_path(),
11473:         &mut seen_sources,
11474:         &mut copied_paths,
11475:     )?;
11476:     copy_stage_bundle_file(
11477:         report_dir.join("state/stages.tsv").as_path(),
11478:         report_context_dir.join("state/stages.tsv").as_path(),
11479:         &mut seen_sources,
11480:         &mut copied_paths,
11481:     )?;
11482:     copy_stage_bundle_file(
11483:         stage_record.log_path.as_path(),
11484:         report_context_dir
11485:             .join("logs")
11486:             .join(
11487:                 stage_record
11488:                     .log_path
11489:                     .file_name()
11490:                     .unwrap_or_else(|| std::ffi::OsStr::new("stage.log")),
11491:             )
11492:             .as_path(),
11493:         &mut seen_sources,
11494:         &mut copied_paths,
11495:     )?;
11496: 
11497:     let parallel_stage_dir = report_dir
11498:         .join("state")
11499:         .join(format!("parallel-{}", stage_record.name));
11500:     let copied_parallel_dir = report_context_dir
11501:         .join("state")
11502:         .join(format!("parallel-{}", stage_record.name));
11503:     if parallel_stage_dir.is_dir() {
11504:         copy_stage_bundle_dir(
11505:             parallel_stage_dir.as_path(),
11506:             copied_parallel_dir.as_path(),
11507:             &mut seen_sources,
11508:             &mut copied_paths,
11509:         )?;
11510:     }
11511: 
11512:     let worker_results = read_parallel_stage_results(report_dir, stage_record.name.as_str());
11513:     let (worker_results_json_path, worker_results_markdown_path) = if worker_results.is_empty() {
11514:         (None, None)
11515:     } else {
11516:         let json_path = diagnostics_dir.join("stage_worker_results.json");
11517:         let markdown_path = diagnostics_dir.join("stage_worker_results.md");
11518:         write_live_lab_worker_results_summary(
11519:             worker_results.as_slice(),
11520:             json_path.as_path(),
11521:             markdown_path.as_path(),
11522:         )?;
11523:         copied_paths.push(json_path.clone());
11524:         copied_paths.push(markdown_path.clone());
11525:         (Some(json_path), Some(markdown_path))
11526:     };
11527: 
11528:     Ok(LiveLabStageLocalBundle {
11529:         report_context_dir,
11530:         copied_paths,
11531:         worker_results,
11532:         worker_results_json_path,
11533:         worker_results_markdown_path,
11534:     })
11535: }
11536: 
11537: fn write_live_lab_worker_results_summary(
11538:     worker_results: &[LiveLabWorkerResult],
11539:     json_path: &Path,
11540:     markdown_path: &Path,
11541: ) -> Result<(), String> {
11542:     let results_json = worker_results
11543:         .iter()
11544:         .map(|result| {
11545:             json!({
11546:                 "stage_name": result.stage_name,
11547:                 "label": result.label,
11548:                 "target": result.target,
11549:                 "node_id": result.node_id,
11550:                 "role": result.role,
11551:                 "rc": result.rc,
11552:                 "started_at": result.started_at,
11553:                 "finished_at": result.finished_at,
11554:                 "log_path": result.log_path,
11555:                 "snapshot_path": result.snapshot_path,
11556:                 "route_policy_path": result.route_policy_path,
11557:                 "dns_state_path": result.dns_state_path,
11558:                 "primary_failure_reason": result.primary_failure_reason,
11559:             })
11560:         })
11561:         .collect::<Vec<_>>();
11562:     let summary_json = json!({
11563:         "worker_count": worker_results.len(),
11564:         "failed_worker_count": worker_results.iter().filter(|result| result.rc != 0).count(),
11565:         "results": results_json,
11566:     });
11567:     fs::write(
11568:         json_path,
11569:         serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&summary_json)
11570:             .map_err(|err| format!("serialize worker results summary failed: {err}"))?,
11571:     )
11572:     .map_err(|err| {
11573:         format!(
11574:             "write worker results summary failed ({}): {err}",
11575:             json_path.display()
11576:         )
11577:     })?;
11578: 
11579:     let mut lines = vec![
11580:         "# Live-Lab Worker Results".to_string(),
11581:         String::new(),
11582:         format!("- worker_count={}", worker_results.len()),
11583:         format!(
11584:             "- failed_worker_count={}",
11585:             worker_results
11586:                 .iter()
11587:                 .filter(|result| result.rc != 0)
11588:                 .count()
11589:         ),
11590:     ];
11591:     for result in worker_results {
11592:         let reason = if result.primary_failure_reason.trim().is_empty() {
11593:             "none"
11594:         } else {
11595:             result.primary_failure_reason.as_str()
11596:         };
11597:         lines.push(format!(
11598:             "- label={} role={} node_id={} rc={} reason={} log_path={} snapshot_path={} route_policy_path={} dns_state_path={}",
11599:             result.label,
11600:             result.role,
11601:             result.node_id,
11602:             result.rc,
11603:             reason,
11604:             result.log_path,
11605:             result.snapshot_path,
11606:             result.route_policy_path,
11607:             result.dns_state_path
11608:         ));
11609:     }
11610:     fs::write(markdown_path, lines.join("\n").as_bytes()).map_err(|err| {
11611:         format!(
11612:             "write worker results markdown failed ({}): {err}",
11613:             markdown_path.display()
11614:         )
11615:     })?;
11616:     Ok(())
11617: }

11619: fn collect_windows_diagnostics_for_target(
11620:     target: &ResolvedLiveLabTarget,
11621:     target_dir: &Path,
11622:     timeout: Duration,
11623: ) -> Result<(Vec<String>, Vec<String>), String> {
11624:     let helper_local_path = windows_diagnostics_helper_script_local_path();
11625:     let remote_root = windows_helper_script_remote_path(
11626:         &target.remote_target,
11627:         &format!(
11628:             "diagnostics\\{}",
11629:             sanitize_label_for_path(target.role.as_str())
11630:         ),
11631:     )?;
11632:     let context = RemoteFallbackContext {
11633:         target: &target.remote_target,
11634:         ssh_user_override: None,
11635:         ssh_identity_file: None,
11636:         known_hosts_path: None,
11637:         timeout,
11638:     };
11639:     let output = capture_windows_helper_script_output_from_path(
11640:         &context,
11641:         helper_local_path.as_path(),
11642:         WINDOWS_COLLECT_DIAGNOSTICS_HELPER_FILE,
11643:         &["-OutputRoot".to_string(), remote_root.clone()],
11644:     )?;
11645:     let helper_output_root = output.trim();
11646:     if helper_output_root.is_empty() {
11647:         return Err(format!(
11648:             "Windows diagnostics helper did not emit an output root for {}",
11649:             target.role
11650:         ));
11651:     }
11652:     if helper_output_root != remote_root {
11653:         return Err(format!(
11654:             "Windows diagnostics helper emitted unexpected output root for {}: expected {}, got {}",
11655:             target.role, remote_root, helper_output_root
11656:         ));
11657:     }
11658: 
11659:     let output_files = [
11660:         "services.txt",
11661:         "net-ip.txt",
11662:         "routes.txt",
11663:         "dns.txt",
11664:         "firewall.txt",
11665:         "events-system.txt",
11666:         "events-application.txt",
11667:         "tooling.txt",
11668:     ];
11669:     let mut copied_paths = Vec::new();
11670:     for file_name in output_files {
11671:         let remote_file = windows_guest_path_join(helper_output_root, file_name)?;
11672:         let local_file = target_dir.join(file_name);
11673:         let status = if let Some(VmController::LocalUtm { utm_name, .. }) =
11674:             target.remote_target.controller.as_ref()
11675:         {
11676:             utm_pull_raw(
11677:                 utm_name.as_str(),
11678:                 remote_file.as_str(),
11679:                 local_file.as_path(),
11680:                 timeout,
11681:             )?
11682:         } else {
11683:             scp_from_remote(
11684:                 &target.remote_target,
11685:                 None,
11686:                 None,
11687:                 None,
11688:                 remote_file.as_str(),
11689:                 local_file.as_path(),
11690:                 timeout,
11691:             )?
11692:         };
11693:         ensure_success_status(
11694:             status,
11695:             format!("copy Windows diagnostics file {file_name}").as_str(),
11696:         )?;
11697:         copied_paths.push(local_file);
11698:     }
11699: 
11700:     let metadata_path = target_dir.join("metadata.json");
11701:     let metadata = json!({
11702:         "role": target.role,
11703:         "target": target.profile_target,
11704:         "ssh_target": target.remote_target.ssh_target,
11705:         "platform": target.remote_target.platform_profile.platform.as_str(),
11706:         "remote_shell": target.remote_target.platform_profile.remote_shell.as_str(),
11707:         "guest_exec_mode": target.remote_target.platform_profile.guest_exec_mode.as_str(),
11708:         "service_manager": target.remote_target.platform_profile.service_manager.as_str(),
11709:         "remote_output_root": helper_output_root,
11710:         "helper_script": WINDOWS_COLLECT_DIAGNOSTICS_HELPER_FILE,
11711:         "copied_paths": copied_paths,
11712:     });
11713:     fs::write(
11714:         metadata_path.as_path(),
11715:         serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&metadata)
11716:             .map_err(|err| format!("serialize Windows diagnostics metadata failed: {err}"))?,
11717:     )
11718:     .map_err(|err| {
11719:         format!(
11720:             "write Windows diagnostics metadata failed ({}): {err}",
11721:             metadata_path.display()
11722:         )
11723:     })?;
11724: 
11725:     Ok((
11726:         vec![format!(
11727:             "Windows diagnostics helper collected services, network, route, DNS, firewall, event-log, and tooling state for {} via {}",
11728:             target.role, WINDOWS_COLLECT_DIAGNOSTICS_HELPER_FILE
11729:         )],
11730:         Vec::new(),
11731:     ))
11732: }

11734: fn collect_validate_baseline_runtime_remote_probe(
11735:     diagnostics_dir: &Path,
11736:     targets: &[ResolvedLiveLabTarget],
11737:     timeout: Duration,
11738: ) -> Result<LiveLabStageRemoteProbeSummary, String> {
11739:     let remote_probe_dir = diagnostics_dir.join("remote_validate_baseline_runtime");
11740:     fs::create_dir_all(remote_probe_dir.as_path()).map_err(|err| {
11741:         format!(
11742:             "create baseline remote probe dir failed ({}): {err}",
11743:             remote_probe_dir.display()
11744:         )
11745:     })?;
11746:     let mut warnings = Vec::new();
11747:     let mut results = Vec::new();
11748:     let mut notes = Vec::new();
11749: 
11750:     for target in targets {
11751:         let target_dir = remote_probe_dir.join(sanitize_label_for_path(target.role.as_str()));
11752:         fs::create_dir_all(target_dir.as_path()).map_err(|err| {
11753:             format!(
11754:                 "create baseline target probe dir failed ({}): {err}",
11755:                 target_dir.display()
11756:             )
11757:         })?;
11758:         match target.remote_target.platform_profile.platform {
11759:             VmGuestPlatform::Linux | VmGuestPlatform::Macos => {
11760:                 let rustynet_status_script = privileged_rustynet_cli_script("status");
11761:                 let rustynet_netcheck_script = privileged_rustynet_cli_script("netcheck");
11762:                 let sections = [
11763:                     ("hostname", "hostname"),
11764:                     (
11765:                         "service_active",
11766:                         "if command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then systemctl is-active rustynetd.service 2>&1; else echo systemctl-unavailable; fi",
11767:                     ),
11768:                     ("rustynet_status", rustynet_status_script.as_str()),
11769:                     ("rustynet_netcheck", rustynet_netcheck_script.as_str()),
11770:                     (
11771:                         "daemon_socket",
11772:                         "if [ -S /run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock ]; then echo daemon_socket=present; else echo daemon_socket=missing; fi",
11773:                     ),
11774:                     (
11775:                         "route_get_1_1_1_1",
11776:                         "if command -v ip >/dev/null 2>&1; then ip -4 route get 1.1.1.1 2>&1; else echo ip-unavailable; fi",
11777:                     ),
11778:                     (
11779:                         "plaintext_passphrase_check",
11780:                         "if test ! -e /var/lib/rustynet/keys/wireguard.passphrase && test ! -e /etc/rustynet/wireguard.passphrase && test ! -e /etc/rustynet/signing_key_passphrase; then echo no-plaintext-passphrase-files; else echo plaintext-passphrase-files-present; fi",
11781:                     ),
11782:                     (
11783:                         "plaintext_passphrase_paths",
11784:                         "for path in /var/lib/rustynet/keys/wireguard.passphrase /etc/rustynet/wireguard.passphrase /etc/rustynet/signing_key_passphrase; do if [ -e \"$path\" ]; then ls -ld \"$path\" 2>&1; else printf '%s missing\\n' \"$path\"; fi; done",
11785:                     ),
11786:                     (
11787:                         "runtime_state_paths",
11788: /* ELIDED: original line had 8 backslash-quote sequences — removed to avoid DeepSeek parser failure */
11789:                     ),
11790:                     (
11791:                         "time_state",
11792:                         "if command -v timedatectl >/dev/null 2>&1; then timedatectl status 2>&1; else date -u '+%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ'; fi",
11793:                     ),
11794:                     (
11795:                         "journalctl_rustynetd_tail",
11796:                         "if command -v journalctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then if sudo -n true >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo -n journalctl -u rustynetd.service --no-pager -n 80 2>&1; else journalctl -u rustynetd.service --no-pager -n 80 2>&1; fi; else echo journalctl-unavailable; fi",
11797:                     ),
11798:                 ];
11799:                 let capture_script = build_section_capture_script(sections.as_slice());
11800:                 match capture_remote_shell_command_for_target(
11801:                     &target.remote_target,
11802:                     None,
11803:                     None,
11804:                     None,
11805:                     capture_script.as_str(),
11806:                     timeout,
11807:                 ) {
11808:                     Ok(output) => {
11809:                         let sections = parse_section_capture(output.as_str());
11810:                         for (name, body) in &sections {
11811:                             fs::write(target_dir.join(format!("{name}.txt")), body.as_bytes())
11812:                                 .map_err(|err| {
11813:                                     format!(
11814:                                         "write baseline stage probe failed ({} {}): {err}",
11815:                                         target.role, name
11816:                                     )
11817:                                 })?;
11818:                         }
11819:                         let metadata_path = target_dir.join("metadata.json");
11820:                         let metadata = json!({
11821:                             "role": target.role,
11822:                             "target": target.profile_target,
11823:                             "ssh_target": target.remote_target.ssh_target,
11824:                             "platform": target.remote_target.platform_profile.platform.as_str(),
11825:                             "sections": sections.keys().cloned().collect::<Vec<_>>(),
11826:                         });
11827:                         fs::write(
11828:                             metadata_path.as_path(),
11829:                             serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&metadata).map_err(|err| {
11830:                                 format!("serialize baseline probe metadata failed: {err}")
11831:                             })?,
11832:                         )
11833:                         .map_err(|err| {
11834:                             format!(
11835:                                 "write baseline probe metadata failed ({}): {err}",
11836:                                 metadata_path.display()
11837:                             )
11838:                         })?;
11839:                         results.push(json!({
11840:                             "role": target.role,
11841:                             "target": target.profile_target,
11842:                             "ssh_target": target.remote_target.ssh_target,
11843:                             "platform": target.remote_target.platform_profile.platform.as_str(),
11844:                             "target_dir": target_dir,
11845:                             "error": Value::Null,
11846:                         }));
11847:                     }
11848:                     Err(err) => {
11849:                         warnings.push(format!(
11850:                             "baseline runtime probe failed for {} ({}): {err}",
11851:                             target.role, target.profile_target
11852:                         ));
11853:                         let error_path = target_dir.join("error.txt");
11854:                         fs::write(error_path.as_path(), err.as_bytes()).map_err(|write_err| {
11855:                             format!(
11856:                                 "write baseline probe error failed ({}): {write_err}",
11857:                                 error_path.display()
11858:                             )
11859:                         })?;
11860:                         results.push(json!({
11861:                             "role": target.role,
11862:                             "target": target.profile_target,
11863:                             "ssh_target": target.remote_target.ssh_target,
11864:                             "platform": target.remote_target.platform_profile.platform.as_str(),
11865:                             "target_dir": target_dir,
11866:                             "error": err,
11867:                         }));
11868:                     }
11869:                 }
11870:             }
11871:             VmGuestPlatform::Windows => {
11872:                 match collect_windows_diagnostics_for_target(target, target_dir.as_path(), timeout)
11873:                 {
11874:                     Ok((target_notes, target_warnings)) => {
11875:                         notes.extend(target_notes);
11876:                         warnings.extend(target_warnings);
11877:                         results.push(json!({
11878:                             "role": target.role,
11879:                             "target": target.profile_target,
11880:                             "ssh_target": target.remote_target.ssh_target,
11881:                             "platform": target.remote_target.platform_profile.platform.as_str(),
11882:                             "target_dir": target_dir,
11883:                             "error": Value::Null,
11884:                         }));
11885:                     }
11886:                     Err(err) => {
11887:                         warnings.push(format!(
11888:                             "Windows baseline runtime diagnostics failed for {} ({}): {err}",
11889:                             target.role, target.profile_target
11890:                         ));
11891:                         let error_path = target_dir.join("error.txt");
11892:                         fs::write(error_path.as_path(), err.as_bytes()).map_err(|write_err| {
11893:                             format!(
11894:                                 "write Windows baseline probe error failed ({}): {write_err}",
11895:                                 error_path.display()
11896:                             )
11897:                         })?;
11898:                         results.push(json!({
11899:                             "role": target.role,
11900:                             "target": target.profile_target,
11901:                             "ssh_target": target.remote_target.ssh_target,
11902:                             "platform": target.remote_target.platform_profile.platform.as_str(),
11903:                             "target_dir": target_dir,
11904:                             "error": err,
11905:                         }));
11906:                     }
11907:                 }
11908:             }
11909:             VmGuestPlatform::Ios | VmGuestPlatform::Android => {
11910:                 return Err(format!(
11911:                     "baseline runtime diagnostics are not implemented for platform {} ({})",
11912:                     target.remote_target.platform_profile.platform.as_str(),
11913:                     target.role
11914:                 ));
11915:             }
11916:         }
11917:     }
11918: 
11919:     let summary_path = remote_probe_dir.join("summary.json");
11920:     fs::write(
11921:         summary_path.as_path(),
11922:         serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&json!({
11923:             "target_count": targets.len(),
11924:             "failed_probes": warnings.len(),
11925:             "results": results,
11926:         }))
11927:         .map_err(|err| format!("serialize baseline remote probe summary failed: {err}"))?,
11928:     )
11929:     .map_err(|err| {
11930:         format!(
11931:             "write baseline remote probe summary failed ({}): {err}",
11932:             summary_path.display()
11933:         )
11934:     })?;
11935: 
11936:     let mut summary_notes = vec![
11937:         "Baseline runtime forensics include focused remote probes for rustynet status, daemon socket presence, route selection, plaintext-passphrase absence, runtime state files, time state, and the last 80 journal lines from rustynetd.".to_string(),
11938:     ];
11939:     summary_notes.extend(notes);
11940: 
11941:     Ok(LiveLabStageRemoteProbeSummary {
11942:         remote_probe_dir: Some(remote_probe_dir),
11943:         notes: summary_notes,
11944:         warnings,
11945:     })
11946: }
11947: 
11948: fn render_live_lab_stage_forensics_review(context: LiveLabStageReviewContext<'_>) -> String {
11949:     let LiveLabStageReviewContext {
11950:         report_dir,
11951:         stage_record,
11952:         summary,
11953:         strategy,
11954:         local_bundle,
11955:         remote_probe_dir,
11956:         notes,
11957:         warnings,
11958:     } = context;
11959:     let mut lines = vec![
11960:         "# Live-Lab Stage Forensics".to_string(),
11961:         String::new(),
11962:         format!("- report_dir={}", report_dir.display()),
11963:         format!("- stage={}", stage_record.name),
11964:         format!("- stage_description={}", stage_record.description),
11965:         format!("- stage_strategy={strategy}"),

11967:         format!("- stage_rc={}", stage_record.rc),
11968:         format!("- key_report_path={}", summary.key_report_path.display()),
11969:         format!("- stage_log_path={}", stage_record.log_path.display()),
11970:         format!(
11971:             "- report_context_dir={}",
11972:             local_bundle.report_context_dir.display()
11973:         ),
11974:         format!("- copied_path_count={}", local_bundle.copied_paths.len()),
11975:     ];
11976:     if let Some(reason) = summary.likely_reason.as_deref() {
11977:         lines.push(format!("- likely_reason={reason}"));
11978:     }

11980:         lines.push(format!("- key_log_path={}", key_log_path.display()));
11981:     }

11983:         lines.push(format!("- remote_probe_dir={}", remote_probe_dir.display()));
11984:     }
11985:     if let Some(path) = local_bundle.worker_results_json_path.as_deref() {
11986:         lines.push(format!("- worker_results_json_path={}", path.display()));
11987:     }

11989:         lines.push(format!("- worker_results_markdown_path={}", path.display()));
11990:     }
11991: 
11992:     if !notes.is_empty() {
11993:         lines.push(String::new());
11994:         lines.push("## Notes".to_string());
11995:         for note in notes {
11996:             lines.push(format!("- {note}"));
11997:         }
11998:     }
11999: 
12000:     if !warnings.is_empty() {
12001:         lines.push(String::new());
12002:         lines.push("## Warnings".to_string());
12003:         for warning in warnings {
12004:             lines.push(format!("- {warning}"));
12005:         }
12006:     }
12007: 
12008:     if !local_bundle.worker_results.is_empty() {
12009:         lines.push(String::new());
12010:         lines.push("## Worker Results".to_string());
12011:         for result in &local_bundle.worker_results {
12012:             let reason = if result.primary_failure_reason.trim().is_empty() {
12013:                 "none"
12014:             } else {
12015:                 result.primary_failure_reason.as_str()
12016:             };

12018:                 "- label={} role={} node_id={} rc={} reason={} log_path={} snapshot_path={} route_policy_path={} dns_state_path={}",
12019:                 result.label,
12020:                 result.role,
12021:                 result.node_id,
12022:                 result.rc,
12023:                 reason,
12024:                 result.log_path,
12025:                 result.snapshot_path,
12026:                 result.route_policy_path,
12027:                 result.dns_state_path

12029:         }
12030:     }
12031: 
12032:     lines.push(String::new());
12033:     lines.push("## Copied Report Context".to_string());
12034:     for path in &local_bundle.copied_paths {
12035:         lines.push(format!("- {}", path.display()));

12061: fn copy_stage_bundle_file(
12062:     source: &Path,
12063:     destination: &Path,
12064:     seen_sources: &mut HashSet<PathBuf>,
12065:     copied_paths: &mut Vec<PathBuf>,
12066: ) -> Result<(), String> {
12067:     if !source.exists() || !source.is_file() {
12068:         return Ok(());
12069:     }
12070:     if !seen_sources.insert(source.to_path_buf()) {
12071:         return Ok(());
12072:     }
12073:     if let Some(parent) = destination.parent() {
12074:         fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|err| {
12075:             format!(
12076:                 "create stage bundle dir failed ({}): {err}",
12077:                 parent.display()
12078:             )
12079:         })?;
12080:     }
12081:     fs::copy(source, destination).map_err(|err| {
12082:         format!(
12083:             "copy stage bundle file failed ({} -> {}): {err}",
12084:             source.display(),
12085:             destination.display()
12086:         )
12087:     })?;
12088:     copied_paths.push(destination.to_path_buf());
12089:     Ok(())
12090: }
12091: 
12092: fn copy_stage_bundle_dir(
12093:     source: &Path,
12094:     destination: &Path,
12095:     seen_sources: &mut HashSet<PathBuf>,
12096:     copied_paths: &mut Vec<PathBuf>,
12097: ) -> Result<(), String> {
12098:     if !source.exists() || !source.is_dir() {
12099:         return Ok(());
12100:     }
12101:     if !seen_sources.insert(source.to_path_buf()) {
12102:         return Ok(());
12103:     }
12104:     copy_dir_recursive(source, destination)?;
12105:     copied_paths.push(destination.to_path_buf());
12106:     Ok(())
12107: }
12108: 
12109: fn copy_dir_recursive(source: &Path, destination: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
12110:     fs::create_dir_all(destination).map_err(|err| {
12111:         format!(
12112:             "create copied directory failed ({}): {err}",
12113:             destination.display()
12114:         )
12115:     })?;
12116:     for entry in fs::read_dir(source)
12117:         .map_err(|err| format!("read directory failed ({}): {err}", source.display()))?
12118:     {
12119:         let entry = entry
12120:             .map_err(|err| format!("read directory entry failed ({}): {err}", source.display()))?;
12121:         let entry_path = entry.path();
12122:         let destination_path = destination.join(entry.file_name());
12123:         let file_type = entry
12124:             .file_type()
12125:             .map_err(|err| format!("read file type failed ({}): {err}", entry_path.display()))?;
12126:         if file_type.is_dir() {
12127:             copy_dir_recursive(entry_path.as_path(), destination_path.as_path())?;
12128:         } else if file_type.is_file() {
12129:             if let Some(parent) = destination_path.parent() {
12130:                 fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|err| {
12131:                     format!(
12132:                         "create copied file parent failed ({}): {err}",
12133:                         parent.display()
12134:                     )
12135:                 })?;
12136:             }
12137:             fs::copy(entry_path.as_path(), destination_path.as_path()).map_err(|err| {
12138:                 format!(
12139:                     "copy directory entry failed ({} -> {}): {err}",
12140:                     entry_path.display(),
12141:                     destination_path.display()
12142:                 )
12143:             })?;
12144:         }
12145:     }
12146:     Ok(())
12147: }
12148: 
12149: fn resolve_path(path: &Path) -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
12150:     if path.is_absolute() {
12151:         Ok(path.to_path_buf())
12152:     } else {
12153:         std::env::current_dir()
12154:             .map_err(|err| format!("resolve current directory failed: {err}"))
12155:             .map(|cwd| cwd.join(path))
12156:     }
12157: }
12158: 
12159: fn resolve_absolute_path(path: &Path) -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
12160:     resolve_path(path)
12161: }

12166:         .unwrap_or_default()
12167:         .as_secs()

12170: fn collected_at_utc_now() -> String {
12171:     Command::new("date")
12172:         .arg("-u")
12173:         .arg("+%FT%TZ")
12174:         .output()
12175:         .ok()
12176:         .filter(|output| output.status.success())
12177:         .and_then(|output| String::from_utf8(output.stdout).ok())
12178:         .map(|text| text.trim().to_string())
12179:         .filter(|text| !text.is_empty())
12180:         .unwrap_or_else(|| format!("unix:{}", unix_now()))

12183: pub fn execute_ops_vm_lab_diff_live_lab_runs(
12184:     config: VmLabDiffLiveLabRunsConfig,
12185: ) -> Result<String, String> {
12186:     let old_summary = summarize_live_lab_report(config.old_report_dir.as_path(), false, 1)?;
12187:     let new_summary = summarize_live_lab_report(config.new_report_dir.as_path(), false, 1)?;
12188:     let old_records = parse_live_lab_stage_records(config.old_report_dir.as_path())?;
12189:     let new_records = parse_live_lab_stage_records(config.new_report_dir.as_path())?;
12190:     let old_map = old_records
12191:         .iter()
12192:         .map(|record| (record.name.clone(), record))
12193:         .collect::<BTreeMap<_, _>>();
12194:     let new_map = new_records
12195:         .iter()
12196:         .map(|record| (record.name.clone(), record))
12197:         .collect::<BTreeMap<_, _>>();
12198:     let ordered_names = old_records
12199:         .iter()
12200:         .map(|record| record.name.clone())
12201:         .chain(
12202:             new_records
12203:                 .iter()
12204:                 .map(|record| record.name.clone())
12205:                 .filter(|name| !old_map.contains_key(name)),
12206:         )
12207:         .collect::<Vec<_>>();
12208: 
12209:     let mut first_divergent_stage = None;
12210:     let mut changes = Vec::new();
12211:     for name in ordered_names {
12212:         let old_status = old_map.get(&name).map(|record| record.status.as_str());
12213:         let new_status = new_map.get(&name).map(|record| record.status.as_str());
12214:         let old_rc = old_map.get(&name).map(|record| record.rc.as_str());
12215:         let new_rc = new_map.get(&name).map(|record| record.rc.as_str());
12216:         if old_status != new_status || old_rc != new_rc {
12217:             if first_divergent_stage.is_none() {
12218:                 first_divergent_stage = Some(name.clone());
12219:             }
12220:             changes.push(format!(
12221:                 "{}:{}:{} -> {}:{}",
12222:                 name,
12223:                 old_status.unwrap_or("missing"),
12224:                 old_rc.unwrap_or("missing"),
12225:                 new_status.unwrap_or("missing"),
12226:                 new_rc.unwrap_or("missing")
12227:             ));
12228:         }
12229:     }
12230: 
12231:     let mut lines = vec![
12232:         format!("old_report_dir={}", config.old_report_dir.display()),
12233:         format!("new_report_dir={}", config.new_report_dir.display()),
12234:         format!("old_overall_status={}", old_summary.overall_status),
12235:         format!("new_overall_status={}", new_summary.overall_status),
12236:         format!(
12237:             "old_first_failed_stage={}",
12238:             old_summary.first_failed_stage.as_deref().unwrap_or("none")
12239:         ),
12240:         format!(
12241:             "new_first_failed_stage={}",
12242:             new_summary.first_failed_stage.as_deref().unwrap_or("none")
12243:         ),
12244:         format!(
12245:             "first_divergent_stage={}",
12246:             first_divergent_stage.as_deref().unwrap_or("none")
12247:         ),
12248:         format!("changed_stage_count={}", changes.len()),
12249:     ];
12250:     if let Some(reason) = old_summary.likely_reason.as_deref() {
12251:         lines.push(format!("old_likely_reason={reason}"));
12252:     }
12253:     if let Some(reason) = new_summary.likely_reason.as_deref() {
12254:         lines.push(format!("new_likely_reason={reason}"));
12255:     }
12256:     for change in changes {
12257:         lines.push(format!("stage_change={change}"));
12258:     }
12259:     Ok(lines.join("\n"))
12260: }

12262: fn resolve_iteration_source_selection(
12263:     configured_source_mode: Option<&str>,
12264:     configured_repo_ref: Option<&str>,
12265:     require_clean_tree: bool,
12266:     require_local_head: bool,
12267:     dirty_worktree: bool,
12268: ) -> Result<(String, Option<String>), String> {
12269:     if (require_clean_tree || require_local_head) && dirty_worktree {
12270:         return Err("git worktree must be clean for this live-lab iteration".to_string());
12271:     }
12272:     if require_local_head {
12273:         if let Some(source_mode) = configured_source_mode
12274:             && source_mode != "local-head"
12275:         {
12276:             return Err(format!(
12277:                 "--require-local-head is incompatible with --source-mode {source_mode}"
12278:             ));
12279:         }
12280:         if let Some(repo_ref) = configured_repo_ref
12281:             && repo_ref != "HEAD"
12282:         {
12283:             return Err(format!(
12284:                 "--require-local-head is incompatible with --repo-ref {repo_ref} (expected HEAD)"
12285:             ));
12286:         }
12287:         return Ok(("local-head".to_string(), None));
12288:     }
12289:     let source_mode = configured_source_mode.unwrap_or("working-tree");
12290:     validate_live_lab_source_mode(source_mode)?;
12291:     let repo_ref = if source_mode == "ref" {
12292:         let value = configured_repo_ref
12293:             .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
12294:             .ok_or_else(|| "source-mode=ref requires --repo-ref".to_string())?;
12295:         Some(value.to_string())
12296:     } else {
12297:         None
12298:     };
12299:     Ok((source_mode.to_string(), repo_ref))
12300: }

12302: fn git_worktree_is_dirty() -> Result<bool, String> {
12303:     let mut command = Command::new("git");
12304:     command.current_dir(workspace_root_path());
12305:     command.args(["status", "--short"]);
12306:     let output = run_output_with_timeout(
12307:         &mut command,
12308:         timeout_or_default(30, DEFAULT_RUN_TIMEOUT_SECS),
12309:     )?;
12310:     if !output.status.success() {
12311:         return Err(format!(
12312:             "git status failed with status {}",
12313:             status_code(output.status)
12314:         ));
12315:     }
12316:     let stdout = String::from_utf8(output.stdout)
12317:         .map_err(|err| format!("git status returned non-UTF-8 output: {err}"))?;
12318:     Ok(!stdout.trim().is_empty())
12319: }
