12321: impl LiveLabProfile {
12322:     fn required(&self, key: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
12323:         self.values
12324:             .get(key)
12325:             .cloned()
12326:             .ok_or_else(|| format!("live-lab profile is missing required key {key}"))
12327:     }
12328: 
12329:     fn optional(&self, key: &str) -> Option<String> {
12330:         self.values.get(key).cloned()
12331:     }
12332: 
12333:     fn configured_targets(&self) -> Result<Vec<LiveLabProfileTarget>, String> {
12334:         let mut targets = vec![
12335:             LiveLabProfileTarget {
12336:                 role: "exit".to_string(),
12337:                 target: self.required("EXIT_TARGET")?,
12338:                 utm_name: self
12339:                     .optional("EXIT_UTM_NAME")
12340:                     .filter(|value| !value.trim().is_empty()),
12341:             },
12342:             LiveLabProfileTarget {
12343:                 role: "client".to_string(),
12344:                 target: self.required("CLIENT_TARGET")?,
12345:                 utm_name: self
12346:                     .optional("CLIENT_UTM_NAME")
12347:                     .filter(|value| !value.trim().is_empty()),
12348:             },
12349:         ];
12350:         for (key, utm_key, role) in [
12351:             ("ENTRY_TARGET", "ENTRY_UTM_NAME", "entry"),
12352:             ("AUX_TARGET", "AUX_UTM_NAME", "aux"),
12353:             ("EXTRA_TARGET", "EXTRA_UTM_NAME", "extra"),
12354:             (
12355:                 "FIFTH_CLIENT_TARGET",
12356:                 "FIFTH_CLIENT_UTM_NAME",
12357:                 "fifth_client",
12358:             ),
12359:         ] {
12360:             if let Some(target) = self.optional(key)
12361:                 && !target.trim().is_empty()
12362:             {
12363:                 targets.push(LiveLabProfileTarget {
12364:                     role: role.to_string(),
12365:                     target,
12366:                     utm_name: self
12367:                         .optional(utm_key)
12368:                         .filter(|value| !value.trim().is_empty()),
12369:                 });
12370:             }
12371:         }
12372:         Ok(targets)
12373:     }
12374: }

12376: fn live_lab_profile_target_platform_profile(
12377:     profile: &LiveLabProfile,
12378:     role: &str,
12379: ) -> Result<Option<VmPlatformProfile>, String> {
12380:     let prefix = role.to_ascii_uppercase();
12381:     let target_key = format!("{prefix}_TARGET");
12382:     let Some(target) = profile.optional(target_key.as_str()) else {
12383:         return Ok(None);
12384:     };
12385:     if target.trim().is_empty() {
12386:         return Ok(None);
12387:     }
12388: 
12389:     let platform = VmGuestPlatform::parse(
12390:         profile
12391:             .required(format!("{prefix}_PLATFORM").as_str())?
12392:             .as_str(),
12393:     )
12394:     .map_err(|err| format!("{prefix}_PLATFORM: {err}"))?;
12395:     let remote_shell = VmRemoteShell::parse(
12396:         profile
12397:             .required(format!("{prefix}_REMOTE_SHELL").as_str())?
12398:             .as_str(),
12399:     )
12400:     .map_err(|err| format!("{prefix}_REMOTE_SHELL: {err}"))?;
12401:     let guest_exec_mode = VmGuestExecMode::parse(
12402:         profile
12403:             .required(format!("{prefix}_GUEST_EXEC_MODE").as_str())?
12404:             .as_str(),
12405:     )
12406:     .map_err(|err| format!("{prefix}_GUEST_EXEC_MODE: {err}"))?;
12407:     let service_manager = VmServiceManager::parse(
12408:         profile
12409:             .required(format!("{prefix}_SERVICE_MANAGER").as_str())?
12410:             .as_str(),
12411:     )
12412:     .map_err(|err| format!("{prefix}_SERVICE_MANAGER: {err}"))?;
12413: 
12414:     Ok(Some(VmPlatformProfile {
12415:         platform,
12416:         remote_shell,
12417:         guest_exec_mode,
12418:         service_manager,
12419:     }))
12420: }

12423:     profile: &LiveLabProfile,

12432:                 target.role
12433:             ));
12434:         };

12445: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
12446: // W4.1 LiveLabStageCapability machinery
12447: // ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
12448: 
12449: /// Per-stage host-capability tag. Each live-lab stage that depends on
12450: /// a kernel / userland feature publishes its required capability set;
12451: /// a target satisfies the stage only when its `target_capabilities()`
12452: /// is a superset of the stage's requirement set.
12453: ///
12454: /// Adding a new capability:
12455: /// - It MUST name a feature that is observable at orchestration time
12456: ///   (i.e. derived from `VmPlatformProfile`, not from a runtime probe).
12457: /// - Capabilities expressing security guarantees (e.g. NFT default-
12458: ///   deny enforcement) MUST follow CLAUDE.md §3.10: a target without
12459: ///   the capability fails the stage rather than skipping it. Pure
12460: ///   convenience capabilities (e.g. NETEM kernel-impairment for test
12461: ///   stages) skip-with-reason.
12462: ///
12463: /// The labels listed here mirror the eight reviewed stage-set
12464: /// dependencies the bash orchestrator (`scripts/e2e/live_linux_lab_orchestrator.sh`)
12465: /// currently encodes implicitly via its all-or-nothing `platform=linux`
12466: /// gate — surfacing them as typed capabilities lets W4.2+ heterogeneous
12467: /// dispatch decide per-stage rather than per-run.
12468: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
12469: #[allow(dead_code)]
12470: pub enum LiveLabStageCapability {
12471:     /// POSIX-shell remote dispatch (SSH + bash).
12472:     PosixShell,
12473:     /// systemd unit lifecycle management on the target host.
12474:     Systemd,
12475:     /// Linux bash interpreter on the target host (the orchestrator
12476:     /// shell scripts are bash-specific; sh / zsh would not satisfy).
12477:     LinuxBashGuestExec,
12478:     /// `tc` / netem kernel network impairment (Linux-only kernel
12479:     /// feature; pure convenience for impairment-test stages).
12480:     NetemImpairment,
12481:     /// `nftables` ingress / egress filtering (Linux-only kernel
12482:     /// feature; security-bar capability for default-deny stages).
12483:     NftablesFiltering,
12484:     /// `systemd-resolved` DNS interception for the protected-mode
12485:     /// resolver bind (Linux-only userspace; security-bar for the
12486:     /// Linux DNS fail-closed stage).
12487:     SystemdResolvedDns,
12488:     /// Windows SCM service manager (lifecycle + service identity).
12489:     WindowsServiceManager,
12490:     /// Windows NRPT (Name Resolution Policy Table) for the
12491:     /// protected-mode DNS path (security-bar for the W1.3 verifier
12492:     /// + W1.4 stage).
12493:     WindowsNrptDns,
12494:     /// PowerShell SSH dispatch over the encoded-command channel.
12495:     WindowsPowershellShell,
12496: }
12497: 
12498: impl LiveLabStageCapability {
12499:     #[allow(dead_code)]
12500:     pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str {
12501:         match self {
12502:             LiveLabStageCapability::PosixShell => "posix-shell",
12503:             LiveLabStageCapability::Systemd => "systemd",
12504:             LiveLabStageCapability::LinuxBashGuestExec => "linux-bash-guest-exec",
12505:             LiveLabStageCapability::NetemImpairment => "netem-impairment",
12506:             LiveLabStageCapability::NftablesFiltering => "nftables-filtering",
12507:             LiveLabStageCapability::SystemdResolvedDns => "systemd-resolved-dns",
12508:             LiveLabStageCapability::WindowsServiceManager => "windows-service-manager",
12509:             LiveLabStageCapability::WindowsNrptDns => "windows-nrpt-dns",
12510:             LiveLabStageCapability::WindowsPowershellShell => "windows-powershell-shell",
12511:         }
12512:     }
12513: }
12514: 
12515: /// Capabilities published by a target's platform profile. The lookup
12516: /// is a pure function of the profile (no runtime probe) so the
12517: /// orchestrator can compute the per-target capability set up-front
12518: /// before any SSH dispatch.
12519: #[allow(dead_code)]
12520: pub fn target_capabilities(profile: VmPlatformProfile) -> Vec<LiveLabStageCapability> {
12521:     let mut caps = Vec::new();
12522:     match profile.remote_shell {
12523:         VmRemoteShell::Posix => caps.push(LiveLabStageCapability::PosixShell),
12524:         VmRemoteShell::Powershell => caps.push(LiveLabStageCapability::WindowsPowershellShell),
12525:         VmRemoteShell::Unsupported => {}
12526:     }
12527:     match profile.service_manager {
12528:         VmServiceManager::Systemd => caps.push(LiveLabStageCapability::Systemd),
12529:         VmServiceManager::WindowsService => {
12530:             caps.push(LiveLabStageCapability::WindowsServiceManager)
12531:         }
12532:         VmServiceManager::Launchd | VmServiceManager::Unsupported => {}
12533:     }
12534:     if matches!(profile.guest_exec_mode, VmGuestExecMode::LinuxBash) {
12535:         caps.push(LiveLabStageCapability::LinuxBashGuestExec);
12536:     }
12537:     match profile.platform {
12538:         VmGuestPlatform::Linux => {
12539:             // Linux kernel + userspace bring tc/netem, nftables, and
12540:             // systemd-resolved into reach by default on the reviewed
12541:             // RustyNet Linux distros (debian-headless-*).
12542:             caps.push(LiveLabStageCapability::NetemImpairment);
12543:             caps.push(LiveLabStageCapability::NftablesFiltering);
12544:             caps.push(LiveLabStageCapability::SystemdResolvedDns);
12545:         }
12546:         VmGuestPlatform::Windows => {
12547:             caps.push(LiveLabStageCapability::WindowsNrptDns);
12548:         }
12549:         VmGuestPlatform::Macos | VmGuestPlatform::Ios | VmGuestPlatform::Android => {}
12550:     }
12551:     caps
12552: }
12553: 
12554: /// Capability set the existing Linux bash orchestrator's stage list
12555: /// implicitly requires of every target. Today this is the strict
12556: /// 5×Linux all-or-nothing set the `ensure_live_lab_profile_linux_only`
12557: /// gate enforced; surfacing it as a typed list lets W4.2+ split the
12558: /// stages so individual stages can drop dependencies they don't need
12559: /// (e.g. a Windows-only validator stage drops `LinuxBashGuestExec`).
12560: #[allow(dead_code)]
12561: pub const LIVE_LAB_LINUX_ONLY_REQUIRED_CAPABILITIES: &[LiveLabStageCapability] = &[
12562:     LiveLabStageCapability::PosixShell,
12563:     LiveLabStageCapability::Systemd,
12564:     LiveLabStageCapability::LinuxBashGuestExec,
12565:     LiveLabStageCapability::NftablesFiltering,
12566:     LiveLabStageCapability::SystemdResolvedDns,
12567: ];
12568: 
12569: /// Gate the orchestrator entry points on a typed capability list.
12570: /// Returns the list of `(role, target, missing_capabilities)` tuples
12571: /// for any target that does not advertise a superset of `required`.
12572: /// Each entry point chooses how to react: today every entry point
12573: /// rejects a non-empty result (matches the
12574: /// `ensure_live_lab_profile_linux_only` semantics this fn replaces).
12575: #[allow(dead_code)]
12576: fn live_lab_targets_missing_capabilities(
12577:     profile: &LiveLabProfile,
12578:     required: &[LiveLabStageCapability],
12579: ) -> Result<Vec<(String, String, Vec<LiveLabStageCapability>)>, String> {
12580:     let mut blocked = Vec::new();
12581:     for (role, target, platform_profile) in configured_live_lab_target_platform_profiles(profile)? {
12582:         let caps = target_capabilities(platform_profile);
12583:         let missing: Vec<LiveLabStageCapability> = required
12584:             .iter()
12585:             .copied()
12586:             .filter(|cap| !caps.contains(cap))
12587:             .collect();
12588:         if !missing.is_empty() {
12589:             blocked.push((role, target, missing));
12590:         }
12591:     }
12592:     Ok(blocked)
12593: }
12594: 
12595: /// Capability-driven gate. Orchestrator entry points call this with
12596: /// the per-stage-set required-capability list; a non-empty
12597: /// `missing` list rejects with a precise per-target reason. The
12598: /// `command_name` is included in the rejection blocker for
12599: /// downstream diagnose-live-lab-failure ergonomics.
12600: #[allow(dead_code)]
12601: fn ensure_live_lab_profile_capabilities(
12602:     profile: &LiveLabProfile,
12603:     required: &[LiveLabStageCapability],
12604:     command_name: &str,
12605: ) -> Result<(), String> {
12606:     let blocked = live_lab_targets_missing_capabilities(profile, required)?;
12607:     if blocked.is_empty() {
12608:         return Ok(());
12609:     }
12610:     let rendered = blocked
12611:         .into_iter()
12612:         .map(|(role, target, missing)| {
12613:             let labels = missing
12614:                 .iter()
12615:                 .map(|cap| cap.as_str())
12616:                 .collect::<Vec<_>>()
12617:                 .join(",");
12618:             format!("role={role} target={target} missing={labels}")
12619:         })
12620:         .collect::<Vec<_>>()
12621:         .join("; ");
12622:     Err(format!(
12623:         "{command_name} requires capabilities [{}]; blocked targets: {rendered}",
12624:         required
12625:             .iter()
12626:             .map(|cap| cap.as_str())
12627:             .collect::<Vec<_>>()
12628:             .join(",")
12629:     ))
12630: }
12631: 
12632: fn ensure_live_lab_profile_linux_only(
12633:     profile: &LiveLabProfile,
12634:     command_name: &str,
12635: ) -> Result<(), String> {
12636:     // Delegate to the new capability-driven gate with the legacy
12637:     // Linux-bash-orchestrator capability set. Behavior preserved:
12638:     // any target that does not advertise the full Linux capability
12639:     // bundle still rejects with a precise reason, just rendered via
12640:     // the new capability vocabulary so downstream tooling can grep
12641:     // on stable capability labels rather than the older
12642:     // `platform=linux remote_shell=posix …` free-form string.
12643:     ensure_live_lab_profile_capabilities(
12644:         profile,
12645:         LIVE_LAB_LINUX_ONLY_REQUIRED_CAPABILITIES,
12646:         command_name,
12647:     )
12648: }
12649: 
12650: fn load_live_lab_profile(path: &Path) -> Result<LiveLabProfile, String> {
12651:     ensure_local_regular_file_path(path, "live-lab profile")?;
12652:     let body = fs::read_to_string(path)
12653:         .map_err(|err| format!("read live-lab profile failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
12654:     let mut values = BTreeMap::new();
12655:     for (index, raw_line) in body.lines().enumerate() {
12656:         let line = raw_line.trim();
12657:         if line.is_empty() || line.starts_with('#') {
12658:             continue;
12659:         }
12660:         let (key, raw_value) = line.split_once('=').ok_or_else(|| {
12661:             format!(
12662:                 "invalid live-lab profile line {} in {}: expected KEY=VALUE",
12663:                 index + 1,
12664:                 path.display()
12665:             )
12666:         })?;
12667:         let key = key.trim();
12668:         ensure_live_lab_profile_key(key)?;
12669:         if values.contains_key(key) {
12670:             return Err(format!(
12671:                 "duplicate live-lab profile key {} in {}",
12672:                 key,
12673:                 path.display()
12674:             ));
12675:         }
12676:         let value = parse_env_value(raw_value).map_err(|err| {
12677:             format!(
12678:                 "invalid live-lab profile value for {} in {}: {}",
12679:                 key,
12680:                 path.display(),
12681:                 err
12682:             )
12683:         })?;
12684:         values.insert(key.to_string(), value);
12685:     }
12686:     let profile = LiveLabProfile { values };
12687:     ensure_ssh_target("EXIT_TARGET", profile.required("EXIT_TARGET")?.as_str())?;
12688:     ensure_ssh_target("CLIENT_TARGET", profile.required("CLIENT_TARGET")?.as_str())?;
12689:     let _ = profile.required("SSH_IDENTITY_FILE")?;
12690:     Ok(profile)
12691: }
12692: 
12693: fn resolve_live_lab_profile_targets(
12694:     inventory_path: &Path,
12695:     profile: &LiveLabProfile,
12696: ) -> Result<Vec<ResolvedLiveLabTarget>, String> {
12697:     let inventory = load_inventory(inventory_path)?;
12698:     let mut resolved = Vec::new();
12699:     for target in profile.configured_targets()? {
12700:         let remote_target = resolve_live_lab_profile_remote_target(inventory.as_slice(), &target)?;
12701:         resolved.push(ResolvedLiveLabTarget {
12702:             role: target.role.clone(),
12703:             profile_target: target.target.clone(),
12704:             remote_target,
12705:         });
12706:     }
12707:     Ok(resolved)
12708: }
12709: 
12710: fn resolve_live_lab_profile_remote_target(
12711:     inventory: &[VmInventoryEntry],
12712:     profile_target: &LiveLabProfileTarget,
12713: ) -> Result<RemoteTarget, String> {
12714:     if let Some(utm_name) = profile_target.utm_name.as_deref() {
12715:         let entry = inventory
12716:             .iter()
12717:             .find(|entry| {
12718:                 matches!(
12719:                     entry.controller.as_ref(),
12720:                     Some(VmController::LocalUtm {
12721:                         utm_name: entry_utm_name,
12722:                         ..
12723:                     }) if entry_utm_name == utm_name
12724:                 )
12725:             })
12726:             .ok_or_else(|| {
12727:                 format!(
12728:                     "live-lab profile target {} references UTM controller {} that is not present in inventory",
12729:                     profile_target.role, utm_name
12730:                 )
12731:             })?;
12732:         let mut remote_target = remote_target_from_inventory_entry(entry, None);
12733:         remote_target.label = profile_target.role.clone();
12734:         if remote_target.ssh_user.is_none() {
12735:             remote_target.ssh_user =
12736:                 ssh_target_user(profile_target.target.as_str()).map(str::to_string);
12737:         }
12738:         return Ok(remote_target);
12739:     }
12740: 
12741:     if let Some(entry) = inventory.iter().find(|entry| {
12742:         resolved_inventory_ssh_target(entry) == profile_target.target
12743:             || normalized_ssh_target(
12744:                 entry.ssh_target.as_str(),
12745:                 entry.ssh_user.as_deref(),
12746:                 profile_target.role.as_str(),
12747:             )
12748:             .map(|candidate| candidate == profile_target.target)
12749:             .unwrap_or(false)
12750:     }) {
12751:         let mut remote_target = remote_target_from_inventory_entry(entry, None);
12752:         remote_target.label = profile_target.role.clone();
12753:         return Ok(remote_target);
12754:     }
12755: 
12756:     Ok(remote_target_from_raw_target(
12757:         profile_target.role.clone(),
12758:         profile_target.target.clone(),
12759:     ))
12760: }
12761: 
12762: fn ensure_live_lab_profile_key(key: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
12763:     if key.is_empty()
12764:         || !key
12765:             .chars()
12766:             .all(|ch| ch.is_ascii_uppercase() || ch.is_ascii_digit() || ch == '_')
12767:     {
12768:         return Err(format!("invalid live-lab profile key: {key}"));
12769:     }
12770:     Ok(())
12771: }

12773: fn validate_live_lab_source_mode(value: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
12774:     match value {
12775:         "working-tree" | "local-head" | "origin-main" | "ref" => Ok(()),
12776:         _ => Err(format!(
12777:             "unsupported live-lab profile source mode: {value} (expected working-tree|local-head|origin-main|ref)"
12778:         )),
12779:     }
12780: }

12782: fn parse_live_lab_stage_records(report_dir: &Path) -> Result<Vec<LiveLabStageRecord>, String> {
12783:     let report_dir = if report_dir.is_absolute() {
12784:         report_dir.to_path_buf()
12785:     } else {
12786:         std::env::current_dir()
12787:             .map_err(|err| format!("resolve current directory failed: {err}"))?
12788:             .join(report_dir)
12789:     };
12790:     let stages_path = report_dir.join("state/stages.tsv");
12791:     let stages_body = fs::read_to_string(&stages_path).map_err(|err| {
12792:         format!(
12793:             "read live-lab stages failed ({}): {err}",
12794:             stages_path.display()
12795:         )
12796:     })?;
12797:     let mut records = Vec::new();
12798:     for line in stages_body.lines().filter(|line| !line.trim().is_empty()) {
12799:         let columns = line.split('\t').collect::<Vec<_>>();
12800:         if columns.len() < 6 {
12801:             continue;
12802:         }
12803:         records.push(LiveLabStageRecord {
12804:             name: columns[0].to_string(),
12805:             severity: columns[1].to_string(),
12806:             status: columns[2].to_string(),
12807:             rc: columns[3].to_string(),
12808:             log_path: resolve_report_relative_path(columns[4], report_dir.as_path())?,
12809:             description: columns[5].to_string(),
12810:         });
12811:     }
12812:     Ok(records)
12813: }
12814: 
12815: fn execute_vm_lab_iteration_validation_step(
12816:     step: &VmLabIterationValidationStep,
12817:     timeout_secs: u64,
12818: ) -> Result<(), String> {
12819:     let timeout = timeout_or_default(timeout_secs, DEFAULT_RUN_TIMEOUT_SECS);
12820:     let mut command = Command::new("cargo");
12821:     command.current_dir(workspace_root_path());
12822:     match step {
12823:         VmLabIterationValidationStep::FmtCheck => {
12824:             command.args(["fmt", "--all", "--", "--check"]);
12825:         }
12826:         VmLabIterationValidationStep::CargoCheckPackage { package } => {
12827:             command.args(["check", "-p", package.as_str()]);
12828:         }
12829:         VmLabIterationValidationStep::CargoCheckBin { package, bin } => {
12830:             command.args(["check", "-p", package.as_str(), "--bin", bin.as_str()]);
12831:         }
12832:         VmLabIterationValidationStep::CargoTestPackage { package, filter } => {
12833:             command.args(["test", "-p", package.as_str()]);
12834:             if let Some(filter) = filter.as_deref() {
12835:                 command.arg(filter);
12836:             }
12837:             command.args(["--", "--nocapture"]);
12838:         }
12839:         VmLabIterationValidationStep::CargoTestBin {
12840:             package,
12841:             bin,
12842:             filter,
12843:         } => {
12844:             command.args(["test", "-p", package.as_str(), "--bin", bin.as_str()]);
12845:             if let Some(filter) = filter.as_deref() {
12846:                 command.arg(filter);
12847:             }
12848:             command.args(["--", "--nocapture"]);
12849:         }
12850:     }
12851:     let step_label = step.label();
12852:     let status = run_status_with_timeout_passthrough(&mut command, timeout)
12853:         .map_err(|err| format!("validation step {step_label} failed: {err}"))?;
12854:     ensure_success_status(status, &format!("validation step {step_label}"))
12855: }

12868: fn summarize_live_lab_report(
12869:     report_dir: &Path,
12870:     collect_failure_diagnostics: bool,
12871:     failed_log_tail_lines: usize,
12872: ) -> Result<LiveLabStageSummary, String> {
12873:     let report_dir = if report_dir.is_absolute() {
12874:         report_dir.to_path_buf()
12875:     } else {
12876:         std::env::current_dir()
12877:             .map_err(|err| format!("resolve current directory failed: {err}"))?
12878:             .join(report_dir)
12879:     };
12880:     let stages_path = report_dir.join("state/stages.tsv");
12881:     let failure_digest_path = report_dir.join("failure_digest.md");
12882:     let stages_body = fs::read_to_string(&stages_path).map_err(|err| {
12883:         format!(
12884:             "read live-lab stages failed ({}): {err}",
12885:             stages_path.display()
12886:         )
12887:     })?;
12888:     let mut first_failed_stage = None;
12889:     let mut key_log_path = None;
12890:     for line in stages_body.lines().filter(|line| !line.trim().is_empty()) {
12891:         let columns = line.split('\t').collect::<Vec<_>>();
12892:         if columns.len() < 5 {
12893:             continue;
12894:         }
12895:         if columns[2] == "fail" {
12896:             first_failed_stage = Some(columns[0].to_string());
12897:             key_log_path = Some(resolve_report_relative_path(
12898:                 columns[4],
12899:                 report_dir.as_path(),
12900:             )?);
12901:             break;
12902:         }
12903:     }
12904:     let likely_reason = key_log_path
12905:         .as_deref()
12906:         .map(extract_iteration_likely_reason)
12907:         .filter(|reason| !reason.is_empty());
12908:     let failed_log_tail = if collect_failure_diagnostics {
12909:         key_log_path
12910:             .as_deref()
12911:             .map(|path| tail_log_lines(path, failed_log_tail_lines))
12912:             .transpose()?
12913:     } else {
12914:         None
12915:     };
12916:     Ok(LiveLabStageSummary {
12917:         overall_status: if first_failed_stage.is_some() {
12918:             "fail".to_string()
12919:         } else {
12920:             "pass".to_string()
12921:         },
12922:         first_failed_stage,
12923:         key_report_path: failure_digest_path,
12924:         key_log_path,
12925:         likely_reason,
12926:         failed_log_tail,
12927:     })
12928: }
12929: 
12930: fn resolve_report_relative_path(value: &str, report_dir: &Path) -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
12931:     let path = Path::new(value);
12932:     if path.is_absolute() {
12933:         return Ok(path.to_path_buf());
12934:     }
12935:     let cwd = std::env::current_dir()
12936:         .map_err(|err| format!("resolve current directory failed: {err}"))?;
12937:     let cwd_joined = cwd.join(path);
12938:     if cwd_joined.exists() {
12939:         Ok(cwd_joined)
12940:     } else {
12941:         Ok(report_dir.join(path))
12942:     }
12943: }
12944: 
12945: fn extract_iteration_likely_reason(log_path: &Path) -> String {
12946:     let Ok(body) = fs::read_to_string(log_path) else {
12947:         return "see full log".to_string();
12948:     };
12949:     let mut candidates = Vec::new();
12950:     for raw_line in body.lines() {
12951:         let line = raw_line.trim();
12952:         if line.is_empty() {
12953:             continue;
12954:         }
12955:         if line.starts_with("[stage:")
12956:             && (line.contains("] START") || line.contains("] PASS") || line.contains("] FAIL"))
12957:         {
12958:             continue;
12959:         }
12960:         if line.starts_with("[parallel:") || line.starts_with("----- ") {
12961:             continue;
12962:         }
12963:         candidates.push(line.to_string());
12964:     }
12965:     if candidates.is_empty() {
12966:         return "see full log".to_string();
12967:     }
12968:     for line in candidates.iter().rev() {
12969:         let lowered = line.to_ascii_lowercase();
12970:         if lowered.contains("error:")
12971:             || lowered.contains("fail")
12972:             || lowered.contains("timed out")
12973:             || lowered.contains("timeout")
12974:             || lowered.contains("permission denied")
12975:             || lowered.contains("missing")
12976:             || lowered.contains("invalid")
12977:             || lowered.contains("mismatch")
12978:             || lowered.contains("does not exist")
12979:             || lowered.contains("no such")
12980:             || lowered.contains("unreachable")
12981:         {
12982:             return line.clone();
12983:         }
12984:     }
12985:     candidates
12986:         .last()
12987:         .cloned()
12988:         .unwrap_or_else(|| "see full log".to_string())
12989: }
12990: 
12991: fn tail_log_lines(path: &Path, max_lines: usize) -> Result<String, String> {
12992:     let body = fs::read_to_string(path)
12993:         .map_err(|err| format!("read failed log tail failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
12994:     let lines = body
12995:         .lines()
12996:         .map(str::trim_end)
12997:         .filter(|line| !line.is_empty())
12998:         .collect::<Vec<_>>();
12999:     let start = lines.len().saturating_sub(max_lines.max(1));
13000:     Ok(lines[start..].join("\n"))
13001: }
13002: 
13003: fn render_live_lab_iteration_summary(
13004:     profile_output_path: &Path,
13005:     report_dir: &Path,
13006:     profile_result: &str,
13007:     summary: &LiveLabStageSummary,
13008: ) -> String {
13009:     let mut lines = vec![
13010:         format!("profile_result={profile_result}"),
13011:         format!("profile_path={}", profile_output_path.display()),
13012:         format!("report_dir={}", report_dir.display()),
13013:         format!("overall_status={}", summary.overall_status),
13014:         format!(
13015:             "first_failed_stage={}",
13016:             summary.first_failed_stage.as_deref().unwrap_or("none")
13017:         ),
13018:         format!("key_report_path={}", summary.key_report_path.display()),
13019:         format!(
13020:             "key_log_path={}",
13021:             summary
13022:                 .key_log_path
13023:                 .as_deref()
13024:                 .map(|path| path.display().to_string())
13025:                 .unwrap_or_else(|| "none".to_string())
13026:         ),
13027:     ];
13028:     if let Some(reason) = summary.likely_reason.as_deref() {
13029:         lines.push(format!("likely_reason={reason}"));
13030:     }
13031:     if let Some(tail) = summary.failed_log_tail.as_deref() {
13032:         lines.push("diagnostic_log_tail<<EOF".to_string());
13033:         lines.push(tail.to_string());
13034:         lines.push("EOF".to_string());
13035:     }
13036:     lines.join("\n")
13037: }

13039: fn port_status_from_probe(value: &str) -> PortStatus {
13040:     match value {
13041:         "open" => PortStatus::Open,
13042:         "refused" => PortStatus::Refused,
13043:         "timed_out" => PortStatus::TimedOut,
13044:         "unreachable" => PortStatus::Unreachable,
13045:         _ => PortStatus::Unknown,
13046:     }
13047: }
13048: 
13049: fn port_status_from_probe_error(reason: Option<&str>) -> PortStatus {
13050:     let Some(reason) = reason else {
13051:         return PortStatus::Unknown;
13052:     };
13053:     let lowered = reason.to_ascii_lowercase();
13054:     if lowered.contains("refused") {
13055:         PortStatus::Refused
13056:     } else if lowered.contains("timed out") || lowered.contains("timeout") {
13057:         PortStatus::TimedOut
13058:     } else if lowered.contains("unreachable")
13059:         || lowered.contains("no route to host")
13060:         || lowered.contains("network is unreachable")
13061:     {
13062:         PortStatus::Unreachable
13063:     } else {
13064:         PortStatus::Unknown
13065:     }
13066: }
13067: 
13068: fn push_unique_reason_code(reason_codes: &mut Vec<String>, reason_code: &str) {
13069:     if !reason_codes.iter().any(|existing| existing == reason_code) {
13070:         reason_codes.push(reason_code.to_string());
13071:     }
13072: }
13073: 
13074: fn windows_ssh_auth_timeout(reason: &str) -> bool {
13075:     let lowered = reason.to_ascii_lowercase();
13076:     lowered.contains("timed out") || lowered.contains("timeout")
13077: }
13078: 
13079: fn known_hosts_lookup_candidates(
13080:     authoritative_target: &str,
13081:     live_ip: Option<&str>,
13082:     ssh_port: u16,
13083: ) -> Vec<String> {
13084:     let mut hosts = BTreeSet::new();
13085:     hosts.insert(ssh_target_host(authoritative_target));
13086:     if let Some(live_ip) = live_ip {
13087:         hosts.insert(live_ip.to_string());
13088:     }
13089:     hosts
13090:         .into_iter()
13091:         .map(|host| {
13092:             if ssh_port == 22 {
13093:                 host
13094:             } else {
13095:                 format!("[{host}]:{ssh_port}")
13096:             }
13097:         })
13098:         .collect()
13099: }
13100: 
13101: fn windows_discovery_known_hosts_state(
13102:     authoritative_target: Option<&str>,
13103:     live_ip: Option<&str>,
13104:     ssh_port: u16,
13105:     known_hosts_path: Option<&Path>,
13106: ) -> Option<ProbeState<bool>> {
13107:     let path = known_hosts_path?;
13108:     let Some(authoritative_target) = authoritative_target else {
13109:         return Some(ProbeState::Missing {
13110:             reason: "no-authoritative-ssh-target".to_string(),
13111:         });
13112:     };
13113:     let candidates = known_hosts_lookup_candidates(authoritative_target, live_ip, ssh_port);
13114:     Some(match find_known_hosts_match(path, candidates.as_slice()) {
13115:         Ok(Some(_)) => ProbeState::Ok { value: true },
13116:         Ok(None) => ProbeState::Missing {
13117:             reason: "known-hosts-entry-missing".to_string(),
13118:         },
13119:         Err(err) => ProbeState::Error { reason: err },
13120:     })
13121: }
13122: 
13123: fn pull_windows_local_utm_guest_file_with_retry(
13124:     utm_name: &str,
13125:     remote_path: &str,
13126:     local_path: &Path,
13127:     timeout: Duration,
13128:     label: &str,
13129: ) -> Result<(), String> {
13130:     let retry_budget = windows_local_utm_result_pull_retry_budget(timeout);
13131:     let started_at = Instant::now();
13132:     let pull_timeout = windows_local_utm_result_pull_attempt_timeout(timeout);
13133:     let mut last_error = None::<String>;
13134:     loop {
13135:         let remaining = retry_budget
13136:             .checked_sub(started_at.elapsed())
13137:             .unwrap_or_default();
13138:         if remaining.is_zero() {
13139:             break;
13140:         }
13141:         let attempt_timeout = pull_timeout.min(remaining).max(Duration::from_secs(1));
13142:         let _ = fs::remove_file(local_path);
13143:         match utm_pull_raw(utm_name, remote_path, local_path, attempt_timeout) {
13144:             Ok(status) if status.success() => return Ok(()),
13145:             Ok(_) => {
13146:                 last_error = Some(format!(
13147:                     "{label} file pull exited unsuccessfully for {utm_name}:{remote_path}"
13148:                 ));
13149:             }
13150:             Err(err) => {
13151:                 last_error = Some(format!(
13152:                     "{label} file pull failed for {utm_name}:{remote_path}: {err}"
13153:                 ));
13154:             }
13155:         }
13156:         let remaining = retry_budget
13157:             .checked_sub(started_at.elapsed())
13158:             .unwrap_or_default();
13159:         if remaining.is_zero() {
13160:             break;
13161:         }
13162:         thread::sleep(Duration::from_secs(1).min(remaining));
13163:     }
13164:     Err(last_error
13165:         .unwrap_or_else(|| format!("{label} file pull failed for {utm_name}:{remote_path}")))
13166: }
13167: 
13168: fn windows_local_utm_result_pull_retry_budget(timeout: Duration) -> Duration {
13169:     let capped = timeout.min(Duration::from_secs(
13170:         WINDOWS_UTM_RESULT_PULL_RETRY_BUDGET_SECS,
13171:     ));
13172:     if capped.is_zero() {
13173:         Duration::from_secs(1)
13174:     } else {
13175:         capped
13176:     }
13177: }
13178: 
13179: fn windows_local_utm_result_pull_attempt_timeout(timeout: Duration) -> Duration {
13180:     let capped = timeout.min(Duration::from_secs(20));
13181:     if capped < Duration::from_secs(1) {
13182:         Duration::from_secs(1)
13183:     } else {
13184:         capped
13185:     }
13186: }
13187: 
13188: fn read_windows_local_utm_utf8_file(path: &Path, label: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
13189:     let bytes =
13190:         fs::read(path).map_err(|err| format!("{label} read failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
13191:     let text =
13192:         String::from_utf8(bytes).map_err(|err| format!("{label} was not valid UTF-8: {err}"))?;
13193:     Ok(text.trim_start_matches('\u{feff}').to_string())
13194: }
13195: 
13196: fn format_windows_local_utm_result_pull_failure(
13197:     probe_label: &str,
13198:     utm_name: &str,
13199:     host_status: &Result<ExitStatus, String>,
13200:     pull_error: &str,
13201: ) -> String {
13202:     match host_status {
13203:         Err(err) => format!("{probe_label} transport failed for {utm_name}: {err}; {pull_error}"),
13204:         Ok(status) if !status.success() => {
13205:             format!("{probe_label} wrapper failed for {utm_name}; {pull_error}")
13206:         }
13207:         Ok(_) => format!("{probe_label} result retrieval failed for {utm_name}: {pull_error}"),
13208:     }
13209: }
13210: 
13211: fn execute_windows_local_utm_result_file_probe<F>(
13212:     utm_name: &str,
13213:     probe_label: &str,
13214:     timeout: Duration,
13215:     remote_result_path: &str,
13216:     build_result_script: F,
13217: ) -> Result<String, String>
13218: where
13219:     F: FnOnce(&str) -> Result<String, String>,
13220: {
13221:     let local_root = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!(
13222:         "rustynet-vm-lab-windows-result-{}",
13223:         unique_suffix()
13224:     ));
13225:     fs::create_dir_all(local_root.as_path()).map_err(|err| {
13226:         format!(
13227:             "create local Windows UTM result dir failed ({}): {err}",
13228:             local_root.display()
13229:         )
13230:     })?;
13231:     let local_result_path = local_root.join("result.json");
13232:     let result_script = build_result_script(remote_result_path)?;
13233:     let host_status = utm_exec_windows_raw(utm_name, result_script.as_str(), timeout);
13234:     let pull_result = pull_windows_local_utm_guest_file_with_retry(
13235:         utm_name,
13236:         remote_result_path,
13237:         local_result_path.as_path(),
13238:         timeout,
13239:         probe_label,
13240:     );
13241:     let output = match pull_result {
13242:         Ok(()) => read_windows_local_utm_utf8_file(local_result_path.as_path(), probe_label),
13243:         Err(pull_error) => Err(format_windows_local_utm_result_pull_failure(
13244:             probe_label,
13245:             utm_name,
13246:             &host_status,
13247:             pull_error.as_str(),
13248:         )),
13249:     };
13250:     let _ = best_effort_remove_windows_local_utm_guest_file(
13251:         utm_name,
13252:         remote_result_path,
13253:         Duration::from_secs(20),
13254:     );
13255:     let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(local_root.as_path());
13256:     let output = output?;
13257:     if output.trim().is_empty() {
13258:         return Err(format!(
13259:             "{probe_label} result file was empty for {utm_name}: {remote_result_path}"
13260:         ));
13261:     }
13262:     Ok(output)
13263: }
13264: 
13265: fn build_windows_ssh_readiness_probe_script() -> String {
13266:     r#"
13267: Set-StrictMode -Version Latest
13268: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
13269: $programData = [Environment]::GetFolderPath('CommonApplicationData')
13270: $sshdPath = Join-Path $env:WINDIR 'System32\OpenSSH\sshd.exe'
13271: $hostKeyPath = Join-Path $programData 'ssh\ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub'
13272: $service = Get-Service -Name 'sshd' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
13273: $firewallRule = Get-NetFirewallRule -Name 'OpenSSH-Server-In-TCP' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
13274: $listenerReady = [System.Net.NetworkInformation.IPGlobalProperties]::GetIPGlobalProperties().
13275:     GetActiveTcpListeners() |
13276:     Where-Object { $_.Port -eq 22 } |
13277:     Select-Object -First 1
13278: $result = [ordered]@{
13279:   openssh_installed = ((Test-Path -LiteralPath $sshdPath) -or $null -ne $service)
13280:   service_running = ($null -ne $service -and $service.Status -eq 'Running')
13281:   firewall_rule_enabled = ($null -ne $firewallRule -and $firewallRule.Enabled -eq 'True' -and $firewallRule.Direction -eq 'Inbound' -and $firewallRule.Action -eq 'Allow')
13282:   host_key_present = ((Test-Path -LiteralPath $hostKeyPath) -and ((Get-Item -LiteralPath $hostKeyPath).Length -gt 0))
13283:   listener_ready = ($null -ne $listenerReady)
13284: }
13285: $result | ConvertTo-Json -Compress
13286: "#
13287:     .trim()
13288:     .to_string()
13289: }
13290: 
13291: fn build_windows_ssh_readiness_result_script(remote_result_path: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
13292:     let encoded_body =
13293:         encode_powershell_command(build_windows_ssh_readiness_probe_script().as_str())?;
13294:     Ok(format!(
13295:         "Set-StrictMode -Version Latest; \
13296:          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; \
13297:          $resultPath = {result_path}; \
13298:          $resultParent = Split-Path -Path $resultPath -Parent; \
13299:          if ($resultParent -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $resultParent)) {{ \
13300:            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $resultParent -Force | Out-Null \
13301:          }}; \
13302:          if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $resultPath) {{ \
13303:            Remove-Item -LiteralPath $resultPath -Force \
13304:          }}; \
13305:          $body = ''; \
13306:          $probeExit = 0; \
13307:          try {{ \
13308:            $decoded = [System.Text.Encoding]::Unicode.GetString([System.Convert]::FromBase64String({encoded_body})); \
13309:            $scriptBlock = [ScriptBlock]::Create($decoded); \
13310:            $body = (& $scriptBlock *>&1 | Out-String); \
13311:            $lastExitCode = Get-Variable -Name LASTEXITCODE -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; \
13312:            if ($null -ne $lastExitCode) {{ \
13313:              $probeExit = [int]$lastExitCode.Value \
13314:            }} elseif (-not $?) {{ \
13315:              $probeExit = 1 \
13316:            }} \
13317:          }} catch {{ \
13318:            $probeExit = 1; \
13319:            $body = (@{{ status = 'error'; reason = ('windows-ssh-readiness-probe-exception: ' + $_.ToString().Trim()) }} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress) \
13320:          }}; \
13321:          $body = $body.Trim(); \
13322:          if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($body)) {{ \
13323:            if ($probeExit -eq 0) {{ \
13324:              $body = (@{{ status = 'error'; reason = 'windows-ssh-readiness-probe-produced-no-output' }} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress) \
13325:            }} else {{ \
13326:              $body = (@{{ status = 'error'; reason = 'windows-ssh-readiness-probe-failed-without-output' }} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress) \
13327:            }} \
13328:          }}; \
13329:          Set-Content -LiteralPath $resultPath -Value $body -Encoding utf8; \
13330:          exit $probeExit",
13331:         encoded_body = powershell_quote(encoded_body.as_str())?,
13332:         result_path = powershell_quote(remote_result_path)?,
13333:     ))
13334: }
13335: 
13336: fn parse_windows_ssh_readiness_probe_output(
13337:     output: &str,
13338:     target_label: &str,
13339: ) -> Result<WindowsSshReadinessProbe, String> {
13340:     let trimmed = output.trim();
13341:     if trimmed.is_empty() {
13342:         return Err(format!(
13343:             "Windows SSH readiness probe produced no output for {target_label}"
13344:         ));
13345:     }
13346:     let parsed: Value = serde_json::from_str(trimmed).map_err(|err| {
13347:         format!("Windows SSH readiness probe did not emit valid JSON for {target_label}: {err}")
13348:     })?;
13349:     if let Some(status) = parsed.get("status").and_then(Value::as_str)
13350:         && status != "pass"
13351:     {
13352:         let reason = parsed
13353:             .get("reason")
13354:             .and_then(Value::as_str)
13355:             .unwrap_or("unknown");
13356:         return Err(format!(
13357:             "Windows SSH readiness probe reported status={status} reason={reason} for {target_label}"
13358:         ));
13359:     }
13360:     serde_json::from_value(parsed).map_err(|err| {
13361:         format!("Windows SSH readiness probe payload was not valid for {target_label}: {err}")
13362:     })
13363: }
13364: 
13365: fn best_effort_remove_windows_local_utm_guest_file(
13366:     utm_name: &str,
13367:     remote_path: &str,
13368:     timeout: Duration,
13369: ) -> Result<(), String> {
13370:     let cleanup_script = format!(
13371:         "Set-StrictMode -Version Latest; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; if (Test-Path -LiteralPath {}) {{ Remove-Item -LiteralPath {} -Force -ErrorAction Stop }}",
13372:         powershell_quote(remote_path)?,
13373:         powershell_quote(remote_path)?,
13374:     );
13375:     let _ = utm_exec_windows_raw(utm_name, cleanup_script.as_str(), timeout);
13376:     Ok(())
13377: }
13378: 
13379: fn probe_windows_local_utm_ssh_readiness(
13380:     utm_name: &str,
13381:     timeout: Duration,
13382: ) -> ProbeState<WindowsSshReadinessProbe> {
13383:     let remote_result_path = format!(
13384:         r"C:\ProgramData\Rustynet\vm-lab\windows-ssh-readiness.{}.json",
13385:         unique_suffix()
13386:     );
13387:     let output = match execute_windows_local_utm_result_file_probe(
13388:         utm_name,
13389:         "Windows SSH readiness probe",
13390:         timeout,
13391:         remote_result_path.as_str(),
13392:         build_windows_ssh_readiness_result_script,
13393:     ) {
13394:         Ok(output) => output,
13395:         Err(err) => return ProbeState::Error { reason: err },
13396:     };
13397:     let _ = best_effort_remove_windows_local_utm_guest_file(
13398:         utm_name,
13399:         remote_result_path.as_str(),
13400:         Duration::from_secs(20),
13401:     );
13402:     match parse_windows_ssh_readiness_probe_output(output.as_str(), utm_name) {
13403:         Ok(report) => ProbeState::Ok { value: report },
13404:         Err(err) => ProbeState::Error { reason: err },
13405:     }
13406: }
13407: 
13408: fn build_windows_utm_reason_codes(
13409:     process_state: &ProbeState<bool>,
13410:     live_ip_state: &ProbeState<String>,
13411:     ssh_port_state: &ProbeState<PortStatus>,
13412:     ssh_auth_state: &ProbeState<String>,
13413:     authoritative_target_present: bool,
13414:     known_hosts_state: Option<&ProbeState<bool>>,
13415:     windows_ssh_probe_state: Option<&ProbeState<WindowsSshReadinessProbe>>,
13416: ) -> Vec<String> {
13417:     let powered = matches!(process_state, ProbeState::Ok { value: true });
13418:     let networked = matches!(live_ip_state, ProbeState::Ok { .. });
13419:     let tcp_ready = matches!(
13420:         ssh_port_state,
13421:         ProbeState::Ok {
13422:             value: PortStatus::Open
13423:         }
13424:     );
13425:     let auth_ready = matches!(
13426:         ssh_auth_state,
13427:         ProbeState::Ok { value } if value == "ok" || value == "ready"
13428:     );
13429:     let mut reason_codes = Vec::new();
13430:     if !powered {
13431:         push_unique_reason_code(&mut reason_codes, "process-not-ready");
13432:     }
13433:     if !networked {
13434:         push_unique_reason_code(&mut reason_codes, "live-ip-not-authoritative");
13435:         if powered {
13436:             push_unique_reason_code(&mut reason_codes, "guest-agent-not-ready");
13437:         }
13438:     }
13439:     if !authoritative_target_present {
13440:         push_unique_reason_code(&mut reason_codes, "no-authoritative-ssh-target");
13441:     }
13442:     if let Some(ProbeState::Ok { value }) = windows_ssh_probe_state {
13443:         if !value.openssh_installed || !value.service_running {
13444:             push_unique_reason_code(&mut reason_codes, "ssh-service-not-running");
13445:         }
13446:         if !value.firewall_rule_enabled {
13447:             push_unique_reason_code(&mut reason_codes, "ssh-firewall-not-open");
13448:         }
13449:         if !value.listener_ready {
13450:             push_unique_reason_code(&mut reason_codes, "ssh-listener-not-ready");
13451:         }
13452:         if !value.host_key_present {
13453:             push_unique_reason_code(&mut reason_codes, "ssh-host-key-not-ready");
13454:         }
13455:     } else if !tcp_ready {
13456:         match ssh_port_state {
13457:             ProbeState::Fallback {
13458:                 value: PortStatus::TimedOut | PortStatus::Unreachable,
13459:                 ..
13460:             }
13461:             | ProbeState::Error { .. } => {
13462:                 push_unique_reason_code(&mut reason_codes, "ssh-firewall-not-open");
13463:             }
13464:             ProbeState::Fallback {
13465:                 value: PortStatus::Refused,
13466:                 ..
13467:             } => {
13468:                 push_unique_reason_code(&mut reason_codes, "ssh-service-not-running");
13469:                 push_unique_reason_code(&mut reason_codes, "ssh-listener-not-ready");
13470:             }
13471:             ProbeState::Missing { .. }
13472:             | ProbeState::Fallback {
13473:                 value: PortStatus::Unknown,
13474:                 ..
13475:             } => {
13476:                 push_unique_reason_code(&mut reason_codes, "ssh-listener-not-ready");
13477:             }
13478:             ProbeState::Fallback {
13479:                 value: PortStatus::Open,
13480:                 ..
13481:             }
13482:             | ProbeState::Ok { .. } => {}
13483:         }
13484:     }
13485:     if let Some(state) = known_hosts_state {
13486:         match state {
13487:             ProbeState::Ok { value: true } => {}
13488:             ProbeState::Ok { value: false }
13489:             | ProbeState::Fallback { .. }
13490:             | ProbeState::Missing { .. }
13491:             | ProbeState::Error { .. } => {
13492:                 if authoritative_target_present {
13493:                     push_unique_reason_code(&mut reason_codes, "ssh-host-key-not-ready");
13494:                 }
13495:             }
13496:         }
13497:     }
13498:     if tcp_ready && authoritative_target_present && !auth_ready {
13499:         match ssh_auth_state {
13500:             ProbeState::Error { reason } if windows_ssh_auth_timeout(reason.as_str()) => {
13501:                 push_unique_reason_code(&mut reason_codes, "ssh-auth-timeout");
13502:             }
13503:             ProbeState::Fallback { .. } | ProbeState::Error { .. } => {
13504:                 push_unique_reason_code(&mut reason_codes, "ssh-auth-rejected");
13505:             }
13506:             ProbeState::Missing { reason }
13507:                 if reason == "no-ssh-target" || reason == "no-ssh-user" =>
13508:             {
13509:                 push_unique_reason_code(&mut reason_codes, "no-authoritative-ssh-target");
13510:             }
13511:             ProbeState::Missing { .. } | ProbeState::Ok { .. } => {}
13512:         }
13513:     }
13514:     reason_codes
13515: }
13516: 
13517: struct UtmReadinessInputs<'a> {
13518:     platform: VmGuestPlatform,
13519:     process_state: &'a ProbeState<bool>,
13520:     live_ip_state: &'a ProbeState<String>,
13521:     ssh_port_state: &'a ProbeState<PortStatus>,
13522:     ssh_auth_state: &'a ProbeState<String>,
13523:     authoritative_target_present: bool,
13524:     known_hosts_state: Option<&'a ProbeState<bool>>,
13525:     windows_ssh_probe_state: Option<&'a ProbeState<WindowsSshReadinessProbe>>,
13526: }
13527: 
13528: fn build_utm_readiness(inputs: UtmReadinessInputs<'_>) -> VmLabReadiness {
13529:     let powered = matches!(inputs.process_state, ProbeState::Ok { value: true });
13530:     let networked = matches!(inputs.live_ip_state, ProbeState::Ok { .. });
13531:     let tcp_ready = matches!(
13532:         inputs.ssh_port_state,
13533:         ProbeState::Ok {
13534:             value: PortStatus::Open
13535:         }
13536:     );
13537:     let auth_ready = matches!(
13538:         inputs.ssh_auth_state,
13539:         ProbeState::Ok { value } if value == "ok" || value == "ready"
13540:     );
13541:     let reason_codes = if inputs.platform == VmGuestPlatform::Windows {
13542:         build_windows_utm_reason_codes(
13543:             inputs.process_state,
13544:             inputs.live_ip_state,
13545:             inputs.ssh_port_state,
13546:             inputs.ssh_auth_state,
13547:             inputs.authoritative_target_present,
13548:             inputs.known_hosts_state,
13549:             inputs.windows_ssh_probe_state,
13550:         )
13551:     } else {
13552:         let mut reason_codes = Vec::new();
13553:         if !powered {
13554:             reason_codes.push("process-not-ready".to_string());
13555:         }
13556:         if !networked {
13557:             reason_codes.push("live-ip-not-authoritative".to_string());
13558:         }
13559:         if !tcp_ready {
13560:             reason_codes.push("ssh-tcp-not-open".to_string());
13561:         }
13562:         if !auth_ready {
13563:             reason_codes.push("ssh-auth-not-ready".to_string());
13564:         }
13565:         if !inputs.authoritative_target_present {
13566:             reason_codes.push("no-authoritative-ssh-target".to_string());
13567:         }
13568:         reason_codes
13569:     };
13570:     // Windows VMs participate in the lab but SSH may not be configured or may be
13571:     // firewalled. Execution-ready for Windows means the VM is booted and reachable
13572:     // on the network; SSH readiness is advisory and does not gate orchestration.
13573:     let execution_ready = if inputs.platform == VmGuestPlatform::Windows {
13574:         powered && networked
13575:     } else {
13576:         powered && networked && tcp_ready && auth_ready && inputs.authoritative_target_present
13577:     };
13578:     VmLabReadiness {
13579:         powered,
13580:         networked,
13581:         tcp_ready,
13582:         auth_ready,
13583:         execution_ready,
13584:         reason_codes,
13585:     }
13586: }

13588: fn stage_status_from_record(record: &LiveLabStageRecord) -> VmLabStageStatus {
13589:     match record.status.as_str() {
13590:         "pass" => VmLabStageStatus::Pass,
13591:         "fail" => VmLabStageStatus::Fail,
13592:         _ => VmLabStageStatus::Skipped,
13593:     }
13594: }
13595: 
13596: fn command_status_from_summary(summary: &LiveLabStageSummary) -> VmLabCommandOverallStatus {
13597:     match summary.overall_status.as_str() {
13598:         "pass" => VmLabCommandOverallStatus::Pass,
13599:         "pass_with_warnings" => VmLabCommandOverallStatus::Partial,
13600:         _ => VmLabCommandOverallStatus::Fail,
13601:     }
13602: }

13640: fn validate_live_lab_run_artifacts(report_dir: &Path) -> Result<(), String> {
13641:     if !report_dir.is_dir() {
13642:         return Err(format!(
13643:             "live-lab report directory does not exist: {}",
13644:             report_dir.display()
13645:         ));
13646:     }
13647:     for artifact in [
13648:         report_dir.join("run_summary.json"),
13649:         report_dir.join("run_summary.md"),
13650:         report_dir.join("state/stages.tsv"),
13651:         report_dir.join("state/nodes.tsv"),
13652:     ] {
13653:         if !artifact.exists() {
13654:             return Err(format!(
13655:                 "required live-lab artifact is missing: {}",
13656:                 artifact.display()
13657:             ));
13658:         }
13659:     }
13660: 
13661:     let records = parse_live_lab_stage_records(report_dir)?;
13662:     if records.is_empty() {
13663:         return Err(format!(
13664:             "live-lab report contains no stage records: {}",
13665:             report_dir.join("state/stages.tsv").display()
13666:         ));
13667:     }
13668:     for record in &records {
13669:         if !record.log_path.exists() {
13670:             return Err(format!(
13671:                 "stage log declared in stages.tsv is missing: {}",
13672:                 record.log_path.display()
13673:             ));
13674:         }
13675:     }
13676:     if records.iter().any(|record| record.status == "fail")
13677:         && !report_dir.join("failure_digest.md").exists()
13678:         && !report_dir.join("failure_digest.json").exists()
13679:     {
13680:         return Err(format!(
13681:             "run contains failed stages but no failure digest exists under {}",
13682:             report_dir.display()
13683:         ));
13684:     }
13685:     Ok(())
13686: }

13688: fn live_lab_profile_has_full_release_gate_topology(profile: &LiveLabProfile) -> bool {
13689:     ["ENTRY_TARGET", "AUX_TARGET", "EXTRA_TARGET"]
13690:         .iter()
13691:         .all(|key| {
13692:             profile
13693:                 .optional(key)
13694:                 .map(|value| !value.trim().is_empty())
13695:                 .unwrap_or(false)
13696:         })
13697: }

13699: fn full_release_gate_requested(profile: &LiveLabProfile, config: &VmLabRunLiveLabConfig) -> bool {
13700:     !config.skip_gates
13701:         && !config.skip_soak
13702:         && !config.skip_cross_network
13703:         && live_lab_profile_has_full_release_gate_topology(profile)
13704: }

13706: fn build_release_gate_completeness_report(
13707:     records: &[LiveLabStageRecord],
13708:     requested: bool,
13709: ) -> ReleaseGateCompletenessReport {
13710:     let observed_pass_stages = records
13711:         .iter()
13712:         .filter(|record| record.status == "pass")
13713:         .map(|record| record.name.clone())
13714:         .collect::<Vec<_>>();
13715:     let observed_pass_set = observed_pass_stages
13716:         .iter()
13717:         .map(String::as_str)
13718:         .collect::<HashSet<_>>();
13719:     let required_stages = FULL_RELEASE_GATE_REQUIRED_STAGES
13720:         .iter()
13721:         .map(|stage| (*stage).to_string())
13722:         .collect::<Vec<_>>();
13723:     let missing_or_non_pass_stages = if requested {
13724:         FULL_RELEASE_GATE_REQUIRED_STAGES
13725:             .iter()
13726:             .filter(|stage| !observed_pass_set.contains(**stage))
13727:             .map(|stage| (*stage).to_string())
13728:             .collect::<Vec<_>>()
13729:     } else {
13730:         Vec::new()
13731:     };
13732:     let status = if !requested {
13733:         "not_requested"
13734:     } else if missing_or_non_pass_stages.is_empty() {
13735:         "complete"
13736:     } else {
13737:         "incomplete"
13738:     };
13739:     ReleaseGateCompletenessReport {
13740:         requested,
13741:         status: status.to_string(),
13742:         required_stages,
13743:         observed_pass_stages,
13744:         missing_or_non_pass_stages,
13745:     }
13746: }
13747: 
13748: fn write_release_gate_completeness(
13749:     report_dir: &Path,
13750:     report: &ReleaseGateCompletenessReport,
13751: ) -> Result<(), String> {
13752:     let path = report_dir.join(RELEASE_GATE_COMPLETENESS_RELATIVE_PATH);
13753:     let parent = path.parent().ok_or_else(|| {
13754:         format!(
13755:             "release-gate completeness path has no parent: {}",
13756:             path.display()
13757:         )
13758:     })?;
13759:     fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|err| {
13760:         format!(
13761:             "create release-gate completeness directory failed ({}): {err}",
13762:             parent.display()
13763:         )
13764:     })?;
13765:     let body = serde_json::to_vec_pretty(report)
13766:         .map_err(|err| format!("serialize release-gate completeness failed: {err}"))?;
13767:     fs::write(&path, body).map_err(|err| {
13768:         format!(
13769:             "write release-gate completeness failed ({}): {err}",
13770:             path.display()
13771:         )
13772:     })
13773: }

13792: fn live_lab_setup_complete(report_dir: &Path) -> Result<bool, String> {
13793:     if !report_dir.join("state/stages.tsv").exists() {
13794:         return Ok(false);
13795:     }
13796:     let records = parse_live_lab_stage_records(report_dir)?;
13797:     Ok(records
13798:         .iter()
13799:         .find(|record| record.name == "validate_baseline_runtime")
13800:         .map(|record| record.status == "pass")
13801:         .unwrap_or(false))
13802: }
