13804: fn live_lab_report_has_non_setup_stage_records(report_dir: &Path) -> Result<bool, String> {
13805:     if !report_dir.join("state/stages.tsv").exists() {
13806:         return Ok(false);
13807:     }
13808:     let setup_stages = setup_stage_names().iter().copied().collect::<HashSet<_>>();
13809:     let records = parse_live_lab_stage_records(report_dir)?;
13810:     Ok(records
13811:         .iter()
13812:         .any(|record| !setup_stages.contains(record.name.as_str())))
13813: }
13814: 
13815: pub fn execute_ops_vm_lab_check_known_hosts(
13816:     config: VmLabCheckKnownHostsConfig,
13817: ) -> Result<String, String> {
13818:     ensure_local_regular_file_path(config.known_hosts_path.as_path(), "known_hosts file")?;
13819:     let inventory = load_inventory(config.inventory_path.as_path())?;
13820:     let selected_targets = resolve_known_hosts_targets(
13821:         inventory.as_slice(),
13822:         config.vm_aliases.as_slice(),
13823:         config.select_all,
13824:         config.raw_targets.as_slice(),
13825:     )?;
13826:     let mut lines = Vec::new();
13827:     let mut missing = Vec::new();
13828:     for target in selected_targets {
13829:         let matched = find_known_hosts_match(
13830:             config.known_hosts_path.as_path(),
13831:             target.host_candidates.as_slice(),
13832:         )?;
13833:         if let Some(candidate) = matched {
13834:             lines.push(format!(
13835:                 "label={} status=present matched={} candidates={}",
13836:                 target.label,
13837:                 candidate,
13838:                 target.host_candidates.join(",")
13839:             ));
13840:         } else {
13841:             missing.push(target.label.clone());
13842:             lines.push(format!(
13843:                 "label={} status=missing candidates={}",
13844:                 target.label,
13845:                 target.host_candidates.join(",")
13846:             ));
13847:         }
13848:     }
13849:     if missing.is_empty() {
13850:         Ok(lines.join("\n"))
13851:     } else {
13852:         Err(format!(
13853:             "{}\nmissing pinned known_hosts entries for: {}",
13854:             lines.join("\n"),
13855:             missing.join(", ")
13856:         ))
13857:     }
13858: }
13859: 
13860: pub fn execute_ops_vm_lab_preflight(config: VmLabPreflightConfig) -> Result<String, String> {
13861:     if config.require_same_network {
13862:         ensure_remote_selection_declares_single_network(
13863:             config.inventory_path.as_path(),
13864:             config.vm_aliases.as_slice(),
13865:             config.select_all,
13866:             config.raw_targets.as_slice(),
13867:         )?;
13868:     }
13869:     if let Some(path) = config.known_hosts_path.as_deref() {
13870:         execute_ops_vm_lab_check_known_hosts(VmLabCheckKnownHostsConfig {
13871:             inventory_path: config.inventory_path.clone(),
13872:             vm_aliases: config.vm_aliases.clone(),
13873:             raw_targets: config.raw_targets.clone(),
13874:             select_all: config.select_all,
13875:             known_hosts_path: path.to_path_buf(),
13876:         })?;
13877:     }
13878:     ensure_optional_local_regular_file_path(
13879:         config.ssh_identity_file.as_deref(),
13880:         "SSH identity file",
13881:     )?;
13882:     ensure_optional_local_regular_file_path(
13883:         config.known_hosts_path.as_deref(),
13884:         "SSH known_hosts file",
13885:     )?;
13886: 
13887:     let targets = resolve_remote_targets(
13888:         config.inventory_path.as_path(),
13889:         config.vm_aliases.as_slice(),
13890:         config.select_all,
13891:         config.raw_targets.as_slice(),
13892:     )?;
13893:     let required_commands = if config.require_commands.is_empty() {
13894:         DEFAULT_PRECHECK_COMMANDS
13895:             .iter()
13896:             .map(|value| value.to_string())
13897:             .collect::<Vec<_>>()
13898:     } else {
13899:         config.require_commands.clone()
13900:     };
13901:     for command_name in &required_commands {
13902:         ensure_inventory_alias(command_name)?;
13903:     }
13904:     let timeout = timeout_or_default(config.timeout_secs, DEFAULT_PREFLIGHT_TIMEOUT_SECS);
13905:     let mut results = Vec::new();
13906:     let mut failures = 0usize;
13907: 
13908:     for target in &targets {
13909:         let effective_user = target.ssh_user.as_deref();
13910:         match capture_remote_shell_command_for_target(
13911:             target,
13912:             None,
13913:             config.ssh_identity_file.as_deref(),
13914:             config.known_hosts_path.as_deref(),
13915:             build_preflight_script(
13916:                 required_commands.as_slice(),
13917:                 config.min_free_kib,
13918:                 config.require_rustynet_installed,
13919:             )?
13920:             .as_str(),
13921:             timeout,
13922:         ) {
13923:             Ok(output) => {
13924:                 let values = parse_key_value_output(output.as_str());
13925:                 let free_kib = values
13926:                     .get("free_kib")
13927:                     .and_then(|value| value.parse::<u64>().ok())
13928:                     .unwrap_or_default();
13929:                 let sudo_ok = values.get("sudo_ok").map(String::as_str) == Some("true");
13930:                 let rustynet_installed =
13931:                     values.get("rustynet_installed").map(String::as_str) == Some("true");
13932:                 let mut missing_commands = Vec::new();
13933:                 for command_name in &required_commands {
13934:                     let key = format!("cmd.{command_name}");
13935:                     if values.get(key.as_str()).map(String::as_str) != Some("present") {
13936:                         missing_commands.push(command_name.clone());
13937:                     }
13938:                 }
13939:                 let mut problems = Vec::new();
13940:                 if !sudo_ok {
13941:                     problems.push("sudo-n".to_string());
13942:                 }
13943:                 if free_kib < config.min_free_kib {
13944:                     problems.push(format!("free_kib<{min}", min = config.min_free_kib));
13945:                 }
13946:                 if config.require_rustynet_installed && !rustynet_installed {
13947:                     problems.push("rustynet-missing".to_string());
13948:                 }
13949:                 if !missing_commands.is_empty() {
13950:                     problems.push(format!("missing-commands={}", missing_commands.join(",")));
13951:                 }
13952:                 if !problems.is_empty() {
13953:                     failures += 1;
13954:                 }
13955:                 results.push(json!({
13956:                     "label": target.label,
13957:                     "ssh_target": target.ssh_target,
13958:                     "ssh_user": effective_user,
13959:                     "hostname": values.get("hostname"),
13960:                     "os": values.get("os"),
13961:                     "free_kib": free_kib,
13962:                     "sudo_ok": sudo_ok,
13963:                     "rustynet_installed": rustynet_installed,
13964:                     "commands": required_commands.iter().map(|command_name| {
13965:                         let key = format!("cmd.{command_name}");
13966:                         (
13967:                             command_name.clone(),
13968:                             values.get(key.as_str()).cloned().unwrap_or_else(|| "missing".to_string())
13969:                         )
13970:                     }).collect::<BTreeMap<_, _>>(),
13971:                     "status": if problems.is_empty() { "pass" } else { "fail" },
13972:                     "problems": problems,
13973:                 }));
13974:             }
13975:             Err(err) => {
13976:                 failures += 1;
13977:                 results.push(json!({
13978:                     "label": target.label,
13979:                     "ssh_target": target.ssh_target,
13980:                     "ssh_user": effective_user,
13981:                     "status": "fail",
13982:                     "error": err,
13983:                 }));
13984:             }
13985:         }
13986:     }
13987: 
13988:     let payload = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&json!({
13989:         "summary": {
13990:             "targets": targets.len(),
13991:             "passed": targets.len().saturating_sub(failures),
13992:             "failed": failures,
13993:         },
13994:         "results": results,
13995:     }))
13996:     .map_err(|err| format!("serialize preflight report failed: {err}"))?;
13997:     if failures == 0 {
13998:         Ok(payload)
13999:     } else {
14000:         Err(payload)
14001:     }
14002: }
14003: 
14004: /// Pre-orchestrate readiness check.
14005: ///
14006: /// For each selected alias:
14007: ///   1. Resolve the SSH target IP from the inventory.
14008: ///   2. Probe TCP/<ssh_port> with a short timeout to confirm the VM
14009: ///      is up + SSH server is listening.
14010: ///   3. If TCP open, run a minimal identity probe over SSH (`whoami`
14011: ///      on POSIX, `whoami` via PowerShell on Windows) to confirm
14012: ///      authentication + the right user identity.
14013: ///   4. Record alias / ssh_target / platform / port_open / auth_ok
14014: ///      / observed_user / blocker.
14015: ///
14016: /// Continues across aliases so the operator sees the full set of
14017: /// blockers in one report. Returns the report JSON on success
14018: /// (every alias ready) or wraps the same JSON in `Err` when any
14019: /// alias has a blocker — matching the preflight subcommand's
14020: /// pass/fail convention.
14021: pub fn execute_ops_vm_lab_readiness_check(
14022:     config: VmLabReadinessCheckConfig,
14023: ) -> Result<String, String> {
14024:     ensure_optional_local_regular_file_path(
14025:         config.ssh_identity_file.as_deref(),
14026:         "SSH identity file",
14027:     )?;
14028:     ensure_optional_local_regular_file_path(
14029:         config.known_hosts_path.as_deref(),
14030:         "SSH known_hosts file",
14031:     )?;
14032:     let targets = resolve_remote_targets(
14033:         config.inventory_path.as_path(),
14034:         config.vm_aliases.as_slice(),
14035:         config.select_all,
14036:         config.raw_targets.as_slice(),
14037:     )?;
14038:     if targets.is_empty() {
14039:         return Err(
14040:             "no targets selected for readiness check; pass --vms <alias[,alias...]> or --all"
14041:                 .to_string(),
14042:         );
14043:     }
14044:     let connect_timeout = Duration::from_secs(if config.connect_timeout_secs == 0 {
14045:         5
14046:     } else {
14047:         config.connect_timeout_secs
14048:     });
14049: 
14050:     let mut results: Vec<serde_json::Value> = Vec::new();
14051:     let mut failures = 0usize;
14052: 
14053:     for target in &targets {
14054:         let platform = target.platform_profile.platform.as_str().to_string();
14055:         let ssh_user_for_probe =
14056:             target
14057:                 .ssh_user
14058:                 .clone()
14059:                 .unwrap_or_else(|| match target.platform_profile.platform {
14060:                     VmGuestPlatform::Windows => "Administrator".to_string(),
14061:                     _ => "user".to_string(),
14062:                 });
14063:         let mut entry = serde_json::Map::new();
14064:         entry.insert(
14065:             "alias".to_string(),
14066:             serde_json::Value::String(target.label.clone()),
14067:         );
14068:         entry.insert(
14069:             "ssh_target".to_string(),
14070:             serde_json::Value::String(target.ssh_target.clone()),
14071:         );
14072:         entry.insert(
14073:             "platform".to_string(),
14074:             serde_json::Value::String(platform.clone()),
14075:         );
14076:         entry.insert(
14077:             "ssh_user".to_string(),
14078:             serde_json::Value::String(ssh_user_for_probe.clone()),
14079:         );
14080: 
14081:         // Step 1: TCP/<port> probe.
14082:         let port_status = match probe_tcp_port_status(
14083:             target.ssh_target.as_str(),
14084:             config.ssh_port,
14085:             connect_timeout,
14086:         ) {
14087:             Ok((status, reason)) => (status, reason),
14088:             Err(err) => ("invalid".to_string(), Some(err)),
14089:         };
14090:         let port_open = port_status.0 == "open";
14091:         entry.insert(
14092:             "tcp_port_open".to_string(),
14093:             serde_json::Value::Bool(port_open),
14094:         );
14095:         if let Some(reason) = port_status.1 {
14096:             entry.insert(
14097:                 "tcp_probe_reason".to_string(),
14098:                 serde_json::Value::String(reason),
14099:             );
14100:         }
14101:         if !port_open {
14102:             failures += 1;
14103:             entry.insert("ready".to_string(), serde_json::Value::Bool(false));
14104:             entry.insert(
14105:                 "blocker".to_string(),
14106:                 serde_json::Value::String(format!(
14107:                     "TCP/{} not reachable on {} (VM offline, sshd not running, or firewall)",
14108:                     config.ssh_port, target.ssh_target
14109:                 )),
14110:             );
14111:             results.push(serde_json::Value::Object(entry));
14112:             continue;
14113:         }
14114: 
14115:         // Step 2: SSH identity probe (`whoami`).
14116:         let identity_script = match target.platform_profile.remote_shell {
14117:             VmRemoteShell::Posix => "whoami".to_string(),
14118:             VmRemoteShell::Powershell => match build_ssh_powershell_encoded_invocation("whoami") {
14119:                 Ok(script) => script,
14120:                 Err(err) => {
14121:                     failures += 1;
14122:                     entry.insert("ready".to_string(), serde_json::Value::Bool(false));
14123:                     entry.insert(
14124:                         "blocker".to_string(),
14125:                         serde_json::Value::String(format!(
14126:                             "build PS-encoded whoami invocation failed: {err}"
14127:                         )),
14128:                     );
14129:                     results.push(serde_json::Value::Object(entry));
14130:                     continue;
14131:                 }
14132:             },
14133:             VmRemoteShell::Unsupported => {
14134:                 failures += 1;
14135:                 entry.insert("ready".to_string(), serde_json::Value::Bool(false));
14136:                 entry.insert(
14137:                     "blocker".to_string(),
14138:                     serde_json::Value::String(format!(
14139:                         "remote shell unsupported for platform {platform}"
14140:                     )),
14141:                 );
14142:                 results.push(serde_json::Value::Object(entry));
14143:                 continue;
14144:             }
14145:         };
14146:         match capture_remote_shell_command_for_target(
14147:             target,
14148:             None,
14149:             config.ssh_identity_file.as_deref(),
14150:             config.known_hosts_path.as_deref(),
14151:             identity_script.as_str(),
14152:             connect_timeout,
14153:         ) {
14154:             Ok(observed) => {
14155:                 let observed_trimmed = observed.trim().to_string();
14156:                 entry.insert("auth_ok".to_string(), serde_json::Value::Bool(true));
14157:                 entry.insert(
14158:                     "observed_user".to_string(),
14159:                     serde_json::Value::String(observed_trimmed.clone()),
14160:                 );
14161:                 entry.insert("ready".to_string(), serde_json::Value::Bool(true));
14162:             }
14163:             Err(err) => {
14164:                 failures += 1;
14165:                 entry.insert("auth_ok".to_string(), serde_json::Value::Bool(false));
14166:                 entry.insert("ready".to_string(), serde_json::Value::Bool(false));
14167:                 entry.insert(
14168:                     "blocker".to_string(),
14169:                     serde_json::Value::String(format!("SSH identity probe failed: {err}")),
14170:                 );
14171:             }
14172:         }
14173:         results.push(serde_json::Value::Object(entry));
14174:     }
14175: 
14176:     let payload = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&serde_json::json!({
14177:         "schema_version": 1,
14178:         "summary": {
14179:             "targets": targets.len(),
14180:             "ready": targets.len().saturating_sub(failures),
14181:             "blocked": failures,
14182:         },
14183:         "results": results,
14184:     }))
14185:     .map_err(|err| format!("serialize readiness report failed: {err}"))?;
14186: 
14187:     if let Some(report_dir) = config.report_dir.as_deref() {
14188:         std::fs::create_dir_all(report_dir).map_err(|err| {
14189:             format!(
14190:                 "create readiness-check report dir failed ({}): {err}",
14191:                 report_dir.display()
14192:             )
14193:         })?;
14194:         let report_path = report_dir.join("vm_lab_readiness_check.json");
14195:         std::fs::write(report_path.as_path(), payload.as_str()).map_err(|err| {
14196:             format!(
14197:                 "write readiness-check report to {} failed: {err}",
14198:                 report_path.display()
14199:             )
14200:         })?;
14201:     }
14202: 
14203:     if failures == 0 {
14204:         Ok(payload)
14205:     } else {
14206:         Err(payload)
14207:     }
14208: }
14209: 
14210: pub fn execute_ops_vm_lab_status(config: VmLabStatusConfig) -> Result<String, String> {
14211:     let targets = resolve_remote_targets(
14212:         config.inventory_path.as_path(),
14213:         config.vm_aliases.as_slice(),
14214:         config.select_all,
14215:         config.raw_targets.as_slice(),
14216:     )?;
14217:     let timeout = timeout_or_default(config.timeout_secs, DEFAULT_PREFLIGHT_TIMEOUT_SECS);
14218:     ensure_optional_local_regular_file_path(
14219:         config.ssh_identity_file.as_deref(),
14220:         "SSH identity file",
14221:     )?;
14222:     ensure_optional_local_regular_file_path(
14223:         config.known_hosts_path.as_deref(),
14224:         "SSH known_hosts file",
14225:     )?;
14226:     execute_vm_lab_status_for_targets(
14227:         targets.as_slice(),
14228:         config.ssh_user.as_deref(),
14229:         config.ssh_identity_file.as_deref(),
14230:         config.known_hosts_path.as_deref(),
14231:         timeout,
14232:     )
14233: }
14234: 
14235: fn execute_vm_lab_status_for_targets(
14236:     targets: &[RemoteTarget],
14237:     ssh_user_override: Option<&str>,
14238:     ssh_identity_file: Option<&Path>,
14239:     known_hosts_path: Option<&Path>,
14240:     timeout: Duration,
14241: ) -> Result<String, String> {
14242:     let mut results = Vec::new();
14243:     let mut failures = 0usize;
14244:     let rustynet_status_script = privileged_rustynet_cli_script("status");
14245:     let rustynet_netcheck_script = privileged_rustynet_cli_script("netcheck");
14246:     let sections = [
14247:         ("hostname", "hostname"),
14248:         (
14249:             "service_active",
14250:             "if command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then systemctl is-active rustynetd.service; else echo systemctl-unavailable; fi",
14251:         ),
14252:         ("rustynet_status", rustynet_status_script.as_str()),
14253:         ("rustynet_netcheck", rustynet_netcheck_script.as_str()),
14254:         (
14255:             "latest_handshakes",
14256:             "if command -v wg >/dev/null 2>&1; then if sudo -n true >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo -n wg show all latest-handshakes 2>&1; else wg show all latest-handshakes 2>&1; fi; else echo wg-not-installed; fi",
14257:         ),
14258:         (
14259:             "ip_addr",
14260:             "if command -v ip >/dev/null 2>&1; then ip -brief addr; else echo ip-unavailable; fi",
14261:         ),
14262:     ];
14263:     let capture_script = build_section_capture_script(sections.as_slice());
14264: 
14265:     for target in targets {
14266:         let effective_user = ssh_user_override.or(target.ssh_user.as_deref());
14267:         match capture_remote_shell_command_for_target(
14268:             target,
14269:             ssh_user_override,
14270:             ssh_identity_file,
14271:             known_hosts_path,
14272:             capture_script.as_str(),
14273:             timeout,
14274:         ) {
14275:             Ok(output) => {
14276:                 results.push(json!({
14277:                     "label": target.label,
14278:                     "ssh_target": target.ssh_target,
14279:                     "ssh_user": effective_user,
14280:                     "sections": parse_section_capture(output.as_str()),
14281:                 }));
14282:             }
14283:             Err(err) => {
14284:                 failures += 1;
14285:                 results.push(json!({
14286:                     "label": target.label,
14287:                     "ssh_target": target.ssh_target,
14288:                     "ssh_user": effective_user,
14289:                     "error": err,
14290:                 }));
14291:             }
14292:         }
14293:     }
14294: 
14295:     let payload = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&json!({
14296:         "summary": {
14297:             "targets": targets.len(),
14298:             "failed": failures,
14299:         },
14300:         "results": results,
14301:     }))
14302:     .map_err(|err| format!("serialize vm-lab status failed: {err}"))?;
14303:     if failures == 0 {
14304:         Ok(payload)
14305:     } else {
14306:         Err(payload)
14307:     }
14308: }
14309: 
14310: pub fn execute_ops_vm_lab_stop(config: VmLabStopConfig) -> Result<String, String> {
14311:     let targets = resolve_start_targets(
14312:         config.inventory_path.as_path(),
14313:         config.vm_aliases.as_slice(),
14314:         config.select_all,
14315:     )?;
14316:     let utmctl_path = config.utmctl_path;
14317:     if !utmctl_path.is_file() {
14318:         return Err(format!(
14319:             "utmctl binary is not present: {}",
14320:             utmctl_path.display()
14321:         ));
14322:     }
14323:     let timeout = timeout_or_default(config.timeout_secs, DEFAULT_START_TIMEOUT_SECS);
14324:     let mut results = Vec::new();
14325:     for target in &targets {
14326:         transition_local_utm_vm(
14327:             utmctl_path.as_path(),
14328:             target.utm_name.as_str(),
14329:             target.bundle_path.as_path(),
14330:             "stop",
14331:             false,
14332:             timeout,
14333:         )
14334:         .map_err(|err| format!("{} stop failed: {err}", target.alias))?;
14335:         results.push(format!(
14336:             "{} stopped via utm_name={} bundle_path={}",
14337:             target.alias,
14338:             target.utm_name,
14339:             target.bundle_path.display()
14340:         ));
14341:     }
14342:     Ok(results.join("\n"))
14343: }
14344: 
14345: pub fn execute_ops_vm_lab_restart(config: VmLabRestartConfig) -> Result<String, String> {
14346:     let fallback_report_dir = config
14347:         .report_dir
14348:         .clone()
14349:         .or_else(|| config.inventory_path.parent().map(Path::to_path_buf))
14350:         .unwrap_or_else(|| PathBuf::from("."));
14351:     let report_dir = config.report_dir.as_deref();
14352:     if let Some(service) = config.service.as_deref() {
14353:         ensure_no_control_chars("service", service)?;
14354:         if config.wait_ready {
14355:             return Err(
14356:                 "--wait-ready is only supported for local UTM VM restarts, not --service restarts"
14357:                     .to_string(),
14358:             );
14359:         }
14360:         let result = execute_ops_vm_lab_run(
14361:             VmLabExecConfig {
14362:                 inventory_path: config.inventory_path,
14363:                 vm_aliases: config.vm_aliases,
14364:                 raw_targets: config.raw_targets,
14365:                 select_all: config.select_all,
14366:                 workdir: "/".to_string(),
14367:                 program: "systemctl".to_string(),
14368:                 argv: vec!["restart".to_string(), service.to_string()],
14369:                 ssh_user: config.ssh_user,
14370:                 ssh_identity_file: config.ssh_identity_file,
14371:                 known_hosts_path: config.known_hosts_path,
14372:                 sudo: true,
14373:                 timeout_secs: config.timeout_secs,
14374:             },
14375:             "restarted",
14376:         );
14377:         let text = match &result {
14378:             Ok(output) => output.clone(),
14379:             Err(err) => err.clone(),
14380:         };
14381:         let raw_artifact =
14382:             maybe_write_report_artifact(report_dir, "vm_lab_restart_service.txt", text.as_str())?;
14383:         let (rendered, overall_status) = build_vm_lab_command_result_output(
14384:             "vm-lab-restart",
14385:             report_dir,
14386:             fallback_report_dir.as_path(),
14387:             "vm_lab_restart_result.json",
14388:             vec![stage_outcome(
14389:                 "restart_service",
14390:                 if result.is_ok() {
14391:                     VmLabStageStatus::Pass
14392:                 } else {
14393:                     VmLabStageStatus::Fail
14394:                 },
14395:                 if result.is_ok() {
14396:                     format!("restarted service {service}")
14397:                 } else {
14398:                     format!("restart service {service} failed")
14399:                 },
14400:                 raw_artifact.into_iter().collect(),
14401:             )],
14402:             Vec::new(),
14403:             if result.is_ok() {
14404:                 Vec::new()
14405:             } else {
14406:                 vec![format!(
14407:                     "Inspect {} for the service restart failure",
14408:                     report_dir
14409:                         .map(|path| path.join("vm_lab_restart_service.txt"))
14410:                         .unwrap_or_else(|| fallback_report_dir.join("vm_lab_restart_service.txt"))
14411:                         .display()
14412:                 )]
14413:             },
14414:         )?;
14415:         if config.json_output {
14416:             return match overall_status {
14417:                 VmLabCommandOverallStatus::Fail => Err(rendered),
14418:                 VmLabCommandOverallStatus::Pass | VmLabCommandOverallStatus::Partial => {
14419:                     Ok(rendered)
14420:                 }
14421:             };
14422:         }
14423:         return result;
14424:     }
14425: 
14426:     ensure_optional_local_regular_file_path(
14427:         config.ssh_identity_file.as_deref(),
14428:         "SSH identity file",
14429:     )?;
14430:     ensure_optional_local_regular_file_path(
14431:         config.known_hosts_path.as_deref(),
14432:         "SSH known_hosts file",
14433:     )?;
14434:     let inventory_path = config.inventory_path.clone();
14435:     let utmctl_path = config.utmctl_path.clone();
14436:     let ready_targets = if config.wait_ready {
14437:         Some(resolve_start_targets(
14438:             inventory_path.as_path(),
14439:             config.vm_aliases.as_slice(),
14440:             config.select_all,
14441:         )?)
14442:     } else {
14443:         None
14444:     };
14445:     let stop_result = execute_ops_vm_lab_stop(VmLabStopConfig {
14446:         inventory_path: inventory_path.clone(),
14447:         vm_aliases: config.vm_aliases.clone(),
14448:         select_all: config.select_all,
14449:         utmctl_path: utmctl_path.clone(),
14450:         timeout_secs: config.timeout_secs,
14451:     });
14452:     let stop_text = match &stop_result {
14453:         Ok(output) => output.clone(),
14454:         Err(err) => err.clone(),
14455:     };
14456:     let stop_artifact =
14457:         maybe_write_report_artifact(report_dir, "vm_lab_restart_stop.txt", stop_text.as_str())?;
14458:     let stop_result = match stop_result {
14459:         Ok(output) => output,
14460:         Err(err) => {
14461:             let (rendered, overall_status) = build_vm_lab_command_result_output(
14462:                 "vm-lab-restart",
14463:                 report_dir,
14464:                 fallback_report_dir.as_path(),
14465:                 "vm_lab_restart_result.json",
14466:                 vec![stage_outcome(
14467:                     "stop_local_utm_vms",
14468:                     VmLabStageStatus::Fail,
14469:                     "failed to stop selected local UTM VMs",
14470:                     stop_artifact.into_iter().collect(),
14471:                 )],
14472:                 Vec::new(),
14473:                 vec!["Inspect the stop artifact and UTM controller state".to_string()],
14474:             )?;
14475:             return if config.json_output {
14476:                 match overall_status {
14477:                     VmLabCommandOverallStatus::Fail => Err(rendered),
14478:                     VmLabCommandOverallStatus::Pass | VmLabCommandOverallStatus::Partial => {
14479:                         Ok(rendered)
14480:                     }
14481:                 }
14482:             } else {
14483:                 Err(err)
14484:             };
14485:         }
14486:     };
14487:     let start_result = execute_ops_vm_lab_start(VmLabStartConfig {
14488:         inventory_path,
14489:         vm_aliases: config.vm_aliases,
14490:         select_all: config.select_all,
14491:         utmctl_path: utmctl_path.clone(),
14492:         timeout_secs: config.timeout_secs,
14493:     });
14494:     let start_text = match &start_result {
14495:         Ok(output) => output.clone(),
14496:         Err(err) => err.clone(),
14497:     };
14498:     let start_artifact =
14499:         maybe_write_report_artifact(report_dir, "vm_lab_restart_start.txt", start_text.as_str())?;
14500:     let start_result = match start_result {
14501:         Ok(output) => output,
14502:         Err(err) => {
14503:             let (rendered, overall_status) = build_vm_lab_command_result_output(
14504:                 "vm-lab-restart",
14505:                 report_dir,
14506:                 fallback_report_dir.as_path(),
14507:                 "vm_lab_restart_result.json",
14508:                 vec![
14509:                     stage_outcome(
14510:                         "stop_local_utm_vms",
14511:                         VmLabStageStatus::Pass,
14512:                         "stopped selected local UTM VMs",
14513:                         stop_artifact.into_iter().collect(),
14514:                     ),
14515:                     stage_outcome(
14516:                         "start_local_utm_vms",
14517:                         VmLabStageStatus::Fail,
14518:                         "failed to start selected local UTM VMs",
14519:                         start_artifact.into_iter().collect(),
14520:                     ),
14521:                 ],
14522:                 Vec::new(),
14523:                 vec!["Inspect the start artifact and UTM controller state".to_string()],
14524:             )?;
14525:             return if config.json_output {
14526:                 match overall_status {
14527:                     VmLabCommandOverallStatus::Fail => Err(rendered),
14528:                     VmLabCommandOverallStatus::Pass | VmLabCommandOverallStatus::Partial => {
14529:                         Ok(rendered)
14530:                     }
14531:                 }
14532:             } else {
14533:                 Err(err)
14534:             };
14535:         }
14536:     };
14537:     if !config.wait_ready {
14538:         let text = format!("{stop_result}\n{start_result}");
14539:         let combined_artifact =
14540:             maybe_write_report_artifact(report_dir, "vm_lab_restart.txt", text.as_str())?;
14541:         let (rendered, overall_status) = build_vm_lab_command_result_output(
14542:             "vm-lab-restart",
14543:             report_dir,
14544:             fallback_report_dir.as_path(),
14545:             "vm_lab_restart_result.json",
14546:             vec![
14547:                 stage_outcome(
14548:                     "stop_local_utm_vms",
14549:                     VmLabStageStatus::Pass,
14550:                     "stopped selected local UTM VMs",
14551:                     stop_artifact.into_iter().collect(),
14552:                 ),
14553:                 stage_outcome(
14554:                     "start_local_utm_vms",
14555:                     VmLabStageStatus::Pass,
14556:                     "started selected local UTM VMs",
14557:                     start_artifact
14558:                         .into_iter()
14559:                         .chain(combined_artifact.into_iter())
14560:                         .collect(),
14561:                 ),
14562:             ],
14563:             Vec::new(),
14564:             vec!["Run vm-lab-discover-local-utm-summary to verify readiness".to_string()],
14565:         )?;
14566:         return if config.json_output {
14567:             match overall_status {
14568:                 VmLabCommandOverallStatus::Fail => Err(rendered),
14569:                 VmLabCommandOverallStatus::Pass | VmLabCommandOverallStatus::Partial => {
14570:                     Ok(rendered)
14571:                 }
14572:             }
14573:         } else {
14574:             Ok(text)
14575:         };
14576:     }
14577: 
14578:     let ready_states = wait_for_local_utm_targets_ready(
14579:         ready_targets
14580:             .as_deref()
14581:             .expect("wait-ready path precomputes restart targets"),
14582:         utmctl_path.as_path(),
14583:         config.ssh_port,
14584:         config.ssh_identity_file.as_deref(),
14585:         config.known_hosts_path.as_deref(),
14586:         timeout_or_default(
14587:             config.ready_timeout_secs,
14588:             DEFAULT_RESTART_READY_TIMEOUT_SECS,
14589:         ),
14590:     );
14591:     let ready_states = match ready_states {
14592:         Ok(states) => states,
14593:         Err(err) => {
14594:             let raw_artifact = maybe_write_report_artifact(
14595:                 report_dir,
14596:                 "vm_lab_restart_wait_ready.txt",
14597:                 err.as_str(),
14598:             )?;
14599:             let (rendered, overall_status) = build_vm_lab_command_result_output(
14600:                 "vm-lab-restart",
14601:                 report_dir,
14602:                 fallback_report_dir.as_path(),
14603:                 "vm_lab_restart_result.json",
14604:                 vec![
14605:                     stage_outcome(
14606:                         "stop_local_utm_vms",
14607:                         VmLabStageStatus::Pass,
14608:                         "stopped selected local UTM VMs",
14609:                         stop_artifact.into_iter().collect(),
14610:                     ),
14611:                     stage_outcome(
14612:                         "start_local_utm_vms",
14613:                         VmLabStageStatus::Pass,
14614:                         "started selected local UTM VMs",
14615:                         start_artifact.into_iter().collect(),
14616:                     ),
14617:                     stage_outcome(
14618:                         "wait_ready",
14619:                         VmLabStageStatus::Fail,
14620:                         "timed out waiting for selected local UTM VMs to become execution-ready",
14621:                         raw_artifact.into_iter().collect(),
14622:                     ),
14623:                 ],
14624:                 Vec::new(),
14625:                 vec!["Inspect the wait-ready artifact for the last observed VM states".to_string()],
14626:             )?;
14627:             return if config.json_output {
14628:                 match overall_status {
14629:                     VmLabCommandOverallStatus::Fail => Err(rendered),
14630:                     VmLabCommandOverallStatus::Pass | VmLabCommandOverallStatus::Partial => {
14631:                         Ok(rendered)
14632:                     }
14633:                 }
14634:             } else {
14635:                 Err(err)
14636:             };
14637:         }
14638:     };
14639:     let ready_report = render_local_utm_ready_states(ready_states.as_slice());
14640:     let ready_text_artifact = maybe_write_report_artifact(
14641:         report_dir,
14642:         "vm_lab_restart_ready_states.txt",
14643:         ready_report.as_str(),
14644:     )?;
14645:     let ready_states_json = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&ready_states)
14646:         .map_err(|err| format!("serialize local UTM ready states failed: {err}"))?;
14647:     let ready_json_artifact = maybe_write_report_artifact(
14648:         report_dir,
14649:         "vm_lab_restart_ready_states.json",
14650:         ready_states_json.as_str(),
14651:     )?;
14652:     let inventory_report = persist_local_utm_ready_states_to_inventory(
14653:         config.inventory_path.as_path(),
14654:         ready_states.as_slice(),
14655:     );
14656:     let inventory_report = match inventory_report {
14657:         Ok(report) => report,
14658:         Err(err) => {
14659:             let raw_artifact = maybe_write_report_artifact(
14660:                 report_dir,
14661:                 "vm_lab_restart_inventory_update.txt",
14662:                 err.as_str(),
14663:             )?;
14664:             let (rendered, overall_status) = build_vm_lab_command_result_output(
14665:                 "vm-lab-restart",
14666:                 report_dir,
14667:                 fallback_report_dir.as_path(),
14668:                 "vm_lab_restart_result.json",
14669:                 vec![
14670:                     stage_outcome(
14671:                         "stop_local_utm_vms",
14672:                         VmLabStageStatus::Pass,
14673:                         "stopped selected local UTM VMs",
14674:                         stop_artifact.into_iter().collect(),
14675:                     ),
14676:                     stage_outcome(
14677:                         "start_local_utm_vms",
14678:                         VmLabStageStatus::Pass,
14679:                         "started selected local UTM VMs",
14680:                         start_artifact.into_iter().collect(),
14681:                     ),
14682:                     stage_outcome(
14683:                         "wait_ready",
14684:                         VmLabStageStatus::Pass,
14685:                         "selected local UTM VMs became execution-ready",
14686:                         ready_text_artifact
14687:                             .clone()
14688:                             .into_iter()
14689:                             .chain(ready_json_artifact.clone().into_iter())
14690:                             .collect(),
14691:                     ),
14692:                     stage_outcome(
14693:                         "update_inventory_live_ips",
14694:                         VmLabStageStatus::Fail,
14695:                         "failed to persist discovered live IPs into inventory",
14696:                         raw_artifact.into_iter().collect(),
14697:                     ),
14698:                 ],
14699:                 Vec::new(),
14700:                 vec!["Inspect the inventory update artifact and inventory JSON".to_string()],
14701:             )?;
14702:             return if config.json_output {
14703:                 match overall_status {
14704:                     VmLabCommandOverallStatus::Fail => Err(rendered),
14705:                     VmLabCommandOverallStatus::Pass | VmLabCommandOverallStatus::Partial => {
14706:                         Ok(rendered)
14707:                     }
14708:                 }
14709:             } else {
14710:                 Err(err)
14711:             };
14712:         }
14713:     };
14714:     let inventory_artifact = maybe_write_report_artifact(
14715:         report_dir,
14716:         "vm_lab_restart_inventory_update.txt",
14717:         inventory_report.as_str(),
14718:     )?;
14719:     let text = format!("{stop_result}\n{start_result}\n{ready_report}\n{inventory_report}");
14720:     let combined_artifact =
14721:         maybe_write_report_artifact(report_dir, "vm_lab_restart.txt", text.as_str())?;
14722:     let (rendered, overall_status) = build_vm_lab_command_result_output(
14723:         "vm-lab-restart",
14724:         report_dir,
14725:         fallback_report_dir.as_path(),
14726:         "vm_lab_restart_result.json",
14727:         vec![
14728:             stage_outcome(
14729:                 "stop_local_utm_vms",
14730:                 VmLabStageStatus::Pass,
14731:                 "stopped selected local UTM VMs",
14732:                 stop_artifact.into_iter().collect(),
14733:             ),
14734:             stage_outcome(
14735:                 "start_local_utm_vms",
14736:                 VmLabStageStatus::Pass,
14737:                 "started selected local UTM VMs",
14738:                 start_artifact.into_iter().collect(),
14739:             ),
14740:             stage_outcome(
14741:                 "wait_ready",
14742:                 VmLabStageStatus::Pass,
14743:                 "selected local UTM VMs became execution-ready",
14744:                 ready_text_artifact
14745:                     .into_iter()
14746:                     .chain(ready_json_artifact.into_iter())
14747:                     .collect(),
14748:             ),
14749:             stage_outcome(
14750:                 "update_inventory_live_ips",
14751:                 VmLabStageStatus::Pass,
14752:                 inventory_report.clone(),
14753:                 inventory_artifact
14754:                     .into_iter()
14755:                     .chain(combined_artifact.into_iter())
14756:                     .collect(),
14757:             ),
14758:         ],
14759:         Vec::new(),
14760:         Vec::new(),
14761:     )?;
14762:     if config.json_output {
14763:         return match overall_status {
14764:             VmLabCommandOverallStatus::Fail => Err(rendered),
14765:             VmLabCommandOverallStatus::Pass | VmLabCommandOverallStatus::Partial => Ok(rendered),
14766:         };
14767:     }
14768:     Ok(text)
14769: }

14771: pub fn execute_ops_vm_lab_collect_artifacts(
14772:     config: VmLabCollectArtifactsConfig,
14773: ) -> Result<String, String> {
14774:     let targets = resolve_remote_targets(
14775:         config.inventory_path.as_path(),
14776:         config.vm_aliases.as_slice(),
14777:         config.select_all,
14778:         config.raw_targets.as_slice(),
14779:     )?;
14780:     let timeout = timeout_or_default(config.timeout_secs, DEFAULT_COLLECT_TIMEOUT_SECS);
14781:     ensure_optional_local_regular_file_path(
14782:         config.ssh_identity_file.as_deref(),
14783:         "SSH identity file",
14784:     )?;
14785:     ensure_optional_local_regular_file_path(
14786:         config.known_hosts_path.as_deref(),
14787:         "SSH known_hosts file",
14788:     )?;
14789:     let output_root = config.output_dir;
14790:     fs::create_dir_all(output_root.as_path()).map_err(|err| {
14791:         format!(
14792:             "create artifact output dir failed ({}): {err}",
14793:             output_root.display()
14794:         )
14795:     })?;
14796:     execute_vm_lab_collect_artifacts_for_targets(
14797:         targets.as_slice(),
14798:         config.ssh_user.as_deref(),
14799:         config.ssh_identity_file.as_deref(),
14800:         config.known_hosts_path.as_deref(),
14801:         output_root.as_path(),
14802:         timeout,
14803:     )
14804: }

14806: fn execute_vm_lab_collect_artifacts_for_targets(
14807:     targets: &[RemoteTarget],
14808:     ssh_user_override: Option<&str>,
14809:     ssh_identity_file: Option<&Path>,
14810:     known_hosts_path: Option<&Path>,
14811:     output_root: &Path,
14812:     timeout: Duration,
14813: ) -> Result<String, String> {
14814:     let rustynet_status_script = privileged_rustynet_cli_script("status");
14815:     let rustynet_netcheck_script = privileged_rustynet_cli_script("netcheck");
14816:     let sections = [
14817:         ("hostname", "hostname"),
14818:         ("rustynet_status", rustynet_status_script.as_str()),
14819:         ("rustynet_netcheck", rustynet_netcheck_script.as_str()),
14820:         (
14821:             "service_status",
14822:             "if command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then systemctl status rustynetd.service --no-pager -n 80 2>&1; else echo systemctl-unavailable; fi",
14823:         ),
14824:         (
14825:             "journalctl_rustynetd",
14826:             "if command -v journalctl >/dev/null 2>&1; then if sudo -n true >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo -n journalctl -u rustynetd.service --no-pager -n 200 2>&1; else journalctl -u rustynetd.service --no-pager -n 200 2>&1; fi; else echo journalctl-unavailable; fi",
14827:         ),
14828:         (
14829:             "latest_handshakes",
14830:             "if command -v wg >/dev/null 2>&1; then if sudo -n true >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo -n wg show all latest-handshakes 2>&1; else wg show all latest-handshakes 2>&1; fi; else echo wg-not-installed; fi",
14831:         ),
14832:         (
14833:             "ip_addr",
14834:             "if command -v ip >/dev/null 2>&1; then ip -brief addr; else echo ip-unavailable; fi",
14835:         ),
14836:         (
14837:             "ip_route",
14838:             "if command -v ip >/dev/null 2>&1; then ip route; else echo ip-unavailable; fi",
14839:         ),
14840:         (
14841:             "assignment_bundle",
14842:             "if [ -f /var/lib/rustynet/rustynetd.assignment ]; then if sudo -n true >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo -n cat /var/lib/rustynet/rustynetd.assignment 2>&1; else cat /var/lib/rustynet/rustynetd.assignment 2>&1; fi; else echo assignment-bundle-missing; fi",
14843:         ),
14844:         (
14845:             "traversal_bundle",
14846:             "if [ -f /var/lib/rustynet/rustynetd.traversal ]; then if sudo -n true >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo -n cat /var/lib/rustynet/rustynetd.traversal 2>&1; else cat /var/lib/rustynet/rustynetd.traversal 2>&1; fi; else echo traversal-bundle-missing; fi",
14847:         ),
14848:     ];
14849:     let capture_script = build_section_capture_script(sections.as_slice());
14850:     let mut lines = Vec::new();
14851:     let mut failures = Vec::new();
14852: 
14853:     for target in targets {
14854:         let effective_user = ssh_user_override.or(target.ssh_user.as_deref());
14855:         let target_dir = output_root.join(sanitize_label_for_path(target.label.as_str()));
14856:         fs::create_dir_all(target_dir.as_path()).map_err(|err| {
14857:             format!(
14858:                 "create target artifact dir failed ({}): {err}",
14859:                 target_dir.display()
14860:             )
14861:         })?;
14862:         match capture_remote_shell_command_for_target(
14863:             target,
14864:             ssh_user_override,
14865:             ssh_identity_file,
14866:             known_hosts_path,
14867:             capture_script.as_str(),
14868:             timeout,
14869:         ) {
14870:             Ok(output) => {
14871:                 let sections = parse_section_capture(output.as_str());
14872:                 for (name, body) in &sections {
14873:                     fs::write(target_dir.join(format!("{name}.txt")), body.as_bytes()).map_err(
14874:                         |err| format!("write artifact failed ({} {}): {err}", target.label, name),
14875:                     )?;
14876:                 }
14877:                 let metadata = json!({
14878:                     "label": target.label,
14879:                     "ssh_target": target.ssh_target,
14880:                     "ssh_user": effective_user,
14881:                     "artifacts": sections.keys().cloned().collect::<Vec<_>>(),
14882:                 });
14883:                 fs::write(
14884:                     target_dir.join("metadata.json"),
14885:                     serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&metadata)
14886:                         .map_err(|err| format!("serialize metadata failed: {err}"))?,
14887:                 )
14888:                 .map_err(|err| format!("write metadata failed ({}): {err}", target.label))?;
14889:                 lines.push(format!(
14890:                     "{} collected artifacts into {}",
14891:                     target.label,
14892:                     target_dir.display()
14893:                 ));
14894:             }
14895:             Err(err) => {
14896:                 failures.push(format!("{} ({err})", target.label));
14897:             }
14898:         }
14899:     }
14900: 
14901:     if failures.is_empty() {
14902:         Ok(lines.join("\n"))
14903:     } else {
14904:         Err(format!(
14905:             "{}\nartifact collection failed for: {}",
14906:             lines.join("\n"),
14907:             failures.join(", ")
14908:         ))
14909:     }
14910: }

14912: pub fn execute_ops_vm_lab_write_topology(
14913:     config: VmLabWriteTopologyConfig,
14914: ) -> Result<String, String> {
14915:     let inventory = load_inventory(config.inventory_path.as_path())?;
14916:     let selected =
14917:         select_inventory_entries(&inventory, config.vm_aliases.as_slice(), config.select_all)?;
14918:     if config.require_same_network {
14919:         ensure_inventory_entries_share_network(selected.as_slice())?;
14920:     }
14921:     let topology = build_vm_lab_topology(selected.as_slice(), config.suite.as_str())?;
14922:     let parent = config
14923:         .output_path
14924:         .parent()
14925:         .filter(|path| !path.as_os_str().is_empty())
14926:         .ok_or_else(|| {
14927:             format!(
14928:                 "topology output path must have a parent directory: {}",
14929:                 config.output_path.display()
14930:             )
14931:         })?;
14932:     fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|err| {
14933:         format!(
14934:             "create topology output dir failed ({}): {err}",
14935:             parent.display()
14936:         )
14937:     })?;
14938:     fs::write(
14939:         &config.output_path,
14940:         serde_json::to_vec_pretty(&topology)
14941:             .map_err(|err| format!("serialize topology failed: {err}"))?,
14942:     )
14943:     .map_err(|err| {
14944:         format!(
14945:             "write topology failed ({}): {err}",
14946:             config.output_path.display()
14947:         )
14948:     })?;
14949: 
14950:     Ok(format!(
14951:         "wrote vm-lab topology={} suite={}",
14952:         config.output_path.display(),
14953:         normalized_suite_name(config.suite.as_str())?
14954:     ))
14955: }
