14957: pub fn execute_ops_vm_lab_issue_and_distribute_state(
14958:     config: VmLabIssueDistributeStateConfig,
14959: ) -> Result<String, String> {
14960:     let topology = load_vm_lab_topology(config.topology_path.as_path())?;
14961:     let inventory = load_inventory(config.inventory_path.as_path())?;
14962:     let timeout = timeout_or_default(config.timeout_secs, DEFAULT_RUN_TIMEOUT_SECS);
14963:     ensure_optional_local_regular_file_path(
14964:         config.ssh_identity_file.as_deref(),
14965:         "SSH identity file",
14966:     )?;
14967:     ensure_optional_local_regular_file_path(
14968:         config.known_hosts_path.as_deref(),
14969:         "SSH known_hosts file",
14970:     )?;
14971:     let authority_entry = inventory
14972:         .iter()
14973:         .find(|entry| entry.alias == config.authority_vm)
14974:         .cloned()
14975:         .ok_or_else(|| {
14976:             format!(
14977:                 "authority VM alias not found in inventory: {}",
14978:                 config.authority_vm
14979:             )
14980:         })?;
14981:     let authority_target =
14982:         remote_target_from_inventory_entry(&authority_entry, config.ssh_user.as_deref());
14983: 
14984:     let artifact_dir =
14985:         std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("rustynet-vm-lab-state-{}", unique_suffix()));
14986:     fs::create_dir_all(artifact_dir.as_path()).map_err(|err| {
14987:         format!(
14988:             "create vm-lab temporary state dir failed ({}): {err}",
14989:             artifact_dir.display()
14990:         )
14991:     })?;
14992: 
14993:     let nodes_spec = build_nodes_spec(
14994:         topology.nodes.values().collect::<Vec<_>>().as_slice(),
14995:         inventory.as_slice(),
14996:         timeout,
14997:         config.ssh_user.as_deref(),
14998:         config.ssh_identity_file.as_deref(),
14999:         config.known_hosts_path.as_deref(),
15000:     )?;
15001:     let allow_spec = build_allow_spec(topology.nodes.values().collect::<Vec<_>>().as_slice());
15002:     let assignments_spec = build_assignments_spec(&topology)?;
15003:     let traversal_ttl_secs = 120u64;
15004: 
15005:     let assignment_env_path = artifact_dir.join("assignment.env");
15006:     let traversal_env_path = artifact_dir.join("traversal.env");
15007:     fs::write(
15008:         assignment_env_path.as_path(),
15009:         build_assignment_issue_env(
15010:             nodes_spec.as_str(),
15011:             allow_spec.as_str(),
15012:             assignments_spec.as_str(),
15013:         )?,
15014:     )
15015:     .map_err(|err| format!("write assignment env failed: {err}"))?;
15016:     fs::write(
15017:         traversal_env_path.as_path(),
15018:         build_traversal_issue_env(nodes_spec.as_str(), allow_spec.as_str(), traversal_ttl_secs)?,
15019:     )
15020:     .map_err(|err| format!("write traversal env failed: {err}"))?;
15021: 
15022:     let remote_assignment_env = format!("/tmp/rn-vm-lab-assignment-{}.env", unique_suffix());
15023:     let remote_traversal_env = format!("/tmp/rn-vm-lab-traversal-{}.env", unique_suffix());
15024:     ensure_success_status(
15025:         scp_to_remote_for_target(
15026:             &authority_target,
15027:             config.ssh_user.as_deref(),
15028:             config.ssh_identity_file.as_deref(),
15029:             config.known_hosts_path.as_deref(),
15030:             assignment_env_path.as_path(),
15031:             remote_assignment_env.as_str(),
15032:             timeout,
15033:         )
15034:         .map_err(|err| format!("copy assignment env to authority failed: {err}"))?,
15035:         "copy assignment env to authority",
15036:     )?;
15037:     ensure_success_status(
15038:         scp_to_remote_for_target(
15039:             &authority_target,
15040:             config.ssh_user.as_deref(),
15041:             config.ssh_identity_file.as_deref(),
15042:             config.known_hosts_path.as_deref(),
15043:             traversal_env_path.as_path(),
15044:             remote_traversal_env.as_str(),
15045:             timeout,
15046:         )
15047:         .map_err(|err| format!("copy traversal env to authority failed: {err}"))?,
15048:         "copy traversal env to authority",
15049:     )?;
15050: 
15051:     let authority_issue_script = format!(
15052:         "set -eu; \
15053: if sudo -n true >/dev/null 2>&1; then SUDO='sudo -n'; else SUDO=''; fi; \
15054: $SUDO mkdir -p /run/rustynet/assignment-issue /run/rustynet/traversal-issue; \
15055: $SUDO rustynet ops e2e-issue-assignment-bundles-from-env --env-file {assignment_env}; \
15056: $SUDO rustynet ops e2e-issue-traversal-bundles-from-env --env-file {traversal_env}; \
15057: $SUDO rm -f {assignment_env} {traversal_env}",
15058:         assignment_env = shell_quote(remote_assignment_env.as_str()),
15059:         traversal_env = shell_quote(remote_traversal_env.as_str()),
15060:     );
15061:     let issue_status = run_remote_shell_command_for_target(
15062:         &authority_target,
15063:         config.ssh_user.as_deref(),
15064:         config.ssh_identity_file.as_deref(),
15065:         config.known_hosts_path.as_deref(),
15066:         authority_issue_script.as_str(),
15067:         timeout,
15068:     )
15069:     .map_err(|err| format!("issue state on authority failed: {err}"))?;
15070:     if !issue_status.success() {
15071:         return Err(format!(
15072:             "issue state on authority failed with status {}",
15073:             status_code(issue_status)
15074:         ));
15075:     }
15076: 
15077:     let assignment_pub_local = artifact_dir.join("rn-assignment.pub");
15078:     let traversal_pub_local = artifact_dir.join("rn-traversal.pub");
15079:     capture_remote_file_to_local(
15080:         &authority_target,
15081:         config.ssh_user.as_deref(),
15082:         config.ssh_identity_file.as_deref(),
15083:         config.known_hosts_path.as_deref(),
15084:         "/run/rustynet/assignment-issue/rn-assignment.pub",
15085:         assignment_pub_local.as_path(),
15086:         timeout,
15087:     )?;
15088:     capture_remote_file_to_local(
15089:         &authority_target,
15090:         config.ssh_user.as_deref(),
15091:         config.ssh_identity_file.as_deref(),
15092:         config.known_hosts_path.as_deref(),
15093:         "/run/rustynet/traversal-issue/rn-traversal.pub",
15094:         traversal_pub_local.as_path(),
15095:         timeout,
15096:     )?;
15097: 
15098:     let mut lines = vec![format!(
15099:         "issued signed assignment/traversal state via authority={} artifacts={}",
15100:         authority_target.label,
15101:         artifact_dir.display()
15102:     )];
15103: 
15104:     for node in topology.nodes.values() {
15105:         let inventory_entry = inventory
15106:             .iter()
15107:             .find(|entry| entry.alias == node.alias)
15108:             .cloned()
15109:             .ok_or_else(|| format!("topology node missing from inventory: {}", node.alias))?;
15110:         let target =
15111:             remote_target_from_inventory_entry(&inventory_entry, config.ssh_user.as_deref());
15112:         let assignment_local =
15113:             artifact_dir.join(format!("rn-assignment-{}.assignment", node.node_id));
15114:         let traversal_local = artifact_dir.join(format!("rn-traversal-{}.traversal", node.node_id));
15115:         capture_remote_file_to_local(
15116:             &authority_target,
15117:             config.ssh_user.as_deref(),
15118:             config.ssh_identity_file.as_deref(),
15119:             config.known_hosts_path.as_deref(),
15120:             format!(
15121:                 "/run/rustynet/assignment-issue/rn-assignment-{}.assignment",
15122:                 node.node_id
15123:             )
15124:             .as_str(),
15125:             assignment_local.as_path(),
15126:             timeout,
15127:         )?;
15128:         capture_remote_file_to_local(
15129:             &authority_target,
15130:             config.ssh_user.as_deref(),
15131:             config.ssh_identity_file.as_deref(),
15132:             config.known_hosts_path.as_deref(),
15133:             format!(
15134:                 "/run/rustynet/traversal-issue/rn-traversal-{}.traversal",
15135:                 node.node_id
15136:             )
15137:             .as_str(),
15138:             traversal_local.as_path(),
15139:             timeout,
15140:         )?;
15141: 
15142:         let refresh_env_path = artifact_dir.join(format!("assignment-refresh-{}.env", node.alias));
15143:         fs::write(
15144:             refresh_env_path.as_path(),
15145:             build_assignment_refresh_env(
15146:                 node.node_id.as_str(),
15147:                 nodes_spec.as_str(),
15148:                 allow_spec.as_str(),
15149:                 assignment_exit_node_id(&topology, node.alias.as_str())?,
15150:             )?,
15151:         )
15152:         .map_err(|err| {
15153:             format!(
15154:                 "write assignment refresh env failed ({}): {err}",
15155:                 node.alias
15156:             )
15157:         })?;
15158: 
15159:         install_state_artifacts_on_target(
15160:             &target,
15161:             &StateArtifactInstallPaths {
15162:                 assignment_pub: assignment_pub_local.as_path(),
15163:                 assignment_bundle: assignment_local.as_path(),
15164:                 traversal_pub: traversal_pub_local.as_path(),
15165:                 traversal_bundle: traversal_local.as_path(),
15166:                 refresh_env: refresh_env_path.as_path(),
15167:             },
15168:             config.ssh_identity_file.as_deref(),
15169:             config.known_hosts_path.as_deref(),
15170:             timeout,
15171:         )?;
15172:         lines.push(format!(
15173:             "{} installed assignment/traversal artifacts node_id={}",
15174:             target.label, node.node_id
15175:         ));
15176:     }
15177: 
15178:     Ok(lines.join("\n"))
15179: }
15180: 
15181: pub fn execute_ops_vm_lab_run_suite(config: VmLabRunSuiteConfig) -> Result<String, String> {
15182:     let inventory = load_inventory(config.inventory_path.as_path())?;
15183:     let topology = if let Some(path) = config.topology_path.as_deref() {
15184:         load_vm_lab_topology(path)?
15185:     } else {
15186:         let selected =
15187:             select_inventory_entries(&inventory, config.vm_aliases.as_slice(), config.select_all)?;
15188:         let value = build_vm_lab_topology(selected.as_slice(), config.suite.as_str())?;
15189:         parse_vm_lab_topology(value)?
15190:     };
15191:     ensure_local_regular_file_path(config.ssh_identity_file.as_path(), "SSH identity file")?;
15192:     let suite_name = normalized_suite_name(config.suite.as_str())?;
15193:     let report_dir = config.report_dir.unwrap_or_else(|| {
15194:         default_artifact_root().join(format!("{}-{}", suite_name, unique_suffix()))
15195:     });
15196:     fs::create_dir_all(report_dir.as_path()).map_err(|err| {
15197:         format!(
15198:             "create suite report dir failed ({}): {err}",
15199:             report_dir.display()
15200:         )
15201:     })?;
15202: 
15203:     let mut suite_command = build_suite_command(
15204:         suite_name.as_str(),
15205:         &topology,
15206:         inventory.as_slice(),
15207:         config.ssh_identity_file.as_path(),
15208:         config.nat_profile.as_deref(),
15209:         config.impairment_profile.as_deref(),
15210:         report_dir.as_path(),
15211:     )?;
15212:     if config.dry_run {
15213:         return Ok(suite_command.rendered);
15214:     }
15215: 
15216:     let status = run_status_with_timeout_passthrough(
15217:         &mut suite_command.command,
15218:         timeout_or_default(config.timeout_secs, DEFAULT_LIVE_LAB_TIMEOUT_SECS),
15219:     )
15220:     .map_err(|err| format!("vm-lab suite run failed: {err}"))?;
15221:     if !status.success() {
15222:         return Err(format!(
15223:             "vm-lab suite run failed with status {} command={}",
15224:             status_code(status),
15225:             suite_command.rendered
15226:         ));
15227:     }
15228:     Ok(format!(
15229:         "ran vm-lab suite={} report_dir={}",
15230:         suite_name,
15231:         report_dir.display()
15232:     ))
15233: }
15234: 
15235: pub fn execute_ops_vm_lab_bootstrap_phase(
15236:     config: VmLabBootstrapPhaseConfig,
15237: ) -> Result<String, String> {
15238:     if config.require_same_network {
15239:         ensure_remote_selection_declares_single_network(
15240:             config.inventory_path.as_path(),
15241:             config.vm_aliases.as_slice(),
15242:             config.select_all,
15243:             config.raw_targets.as_slice(),
15244:         )?;
15245:     }
15246:     let phase = bootstrap::BootstrapPhase::parse(config.phase.as_str())?;
15247:     let timeout = timeout_or_default(config.timeout_secs, DEFAULT_RUN_TIMEOUT_SECS);
15248:     ensure_optional_local_regular_file_path(
15249:         config.ssh_identity_file.as_deref(),
15250:         "SSH identity file",
15251:     )?;
15252:     ensure_optional_local_regular_file_path(
15253:         config.known_hosts_path.as_deref(),
15254:         "SSH known_hosts file",
15255:     )?;
15256:     let targets = resolve_remote_targets(
15257:         config.inventory_path.as_path(),
15258:         config.vm_aliases.as_slice(),
15259:         config.select_all,
15260:         config.raw_targets.as_slice(),
15261:     )?;
15262:     let inventory = load_inventory(config.inventory_path.as_path())?;
15263:     let mut workdirs = BTreeMap::new();
15264:     for target in &targets {
15265:         let inventory_entry = inventory.iter().find(|entry| entry.alias == target.label);
15266:         let workdir = config
15267:             .dest_dir
15268:             .clone()
15269:             .or_else(|| inventory_entry.and_then(|entry| entry.rustynet_src_dir.clone()))
15270:             .ok_or_else(|| {
15271:                 format!(
15272:                     "bootstrap phase {} requires --dest-dir or rustynet_src_dir inventory metadata for {}",
15273:                     phase.as_str(),
15274:                     target.label
15275:                 )
15276:             })?;
15277:         workdirs.insert(target.label.clone(), workdir);
15278:     }
15279: 
15280:     let mut lines = Vec::new();
15281:     if matches!(
15282:         phase,
15283:         bootstrap::BootstrapPhase::SyncSource | bootstrap::BootstrapPhase::All
15284:     ) {
15285:         let sync_dest_dir = workdirs
15286:             .values()
15287:             .next()
15288:             .cloned()
15289:             .ok_or_else(|| "no targets selected for bootstrap phase".to_string())?;
15290:         if workdirs.values().any(|workdir| workdir != &sync_dest_dir) {
15291:             return Err(
15292:                 "bootstrap sync-source/all requires a single destination directory across selected targets"
15293:                     .to_string(),
15294:             );
15295:         }
15296:         let sync_source = resolve_repo_sync_source(
15297:             config.repo_url.as_deref(),
15298:             config.local_source_dir.as_deref(),
15299:             config.branch.as_str(),
15300:             config.remote.as_str(),
15301:         )?;
15302:         lines.extend(sync_repo_targets(
15303:             targets.as_slice(),
15304:             config.ssh_user.as_deref(),
15305:             config.ssh_identity_file.as_deref(),
15306:             config.known_hosts_path.as_deref(),
15307:             sync_source,
15308:             sync_dest_dir.as_str(),
15309:             timeout,
15310:         )?);
15311:         if phase == bootstrap::BootstrapPhase::SyncSource {
15312:             return Ok(lines.join("\n"));
15313:         }
15314:     }
15315: 
15316:     let phases = if phase == bootstrap::BootstrapPhase::All {
15317:         vec![
15318:             bootstrap::BootstrapPhase::BuildRelease,
15319:             bootstrap::BootstrapPhase::SmokeServiceHost,
15320:             bootstrap::BootstrapPhase::InstallRelease,
15321:             bootstrap::BootstrapPhase::RestartRuntime,
15322:             bootstrap::BootstrapPhase::VerifyRuntime,
15323:         ]
15324:     } else {
15325:         vec![phase]
15326:     };
15327: 
15328:     for target in &targets {
15329:         let workdir = workdirs
15330:             .get(target.label.as_str())
15331:             .ok_or_else(|| format!("missing bootstrap workdir for {}", target.label))?;
15332:         let effective_user = config.ssh_user.as_deref().or(target.ssh_user.as_deref());
15333:         let context = bootstrap::BootstrapPhaseContext {
15334:             ssh_user: effective_user,
15335:             ssh_identity_file: config.ssh_identity_file.as_deref(),
15336:             known_hosts_path: config.known_hosts_path.as_deref(),
15337:             workdir: workdir.as_str(),
15338:             repo_url: config.repo_url.as_deref(),
15339:             branch: config.branch.as_str(),
15340:             remote: config.remote.as_str(),
15341:             timeout,
15342:         };
15343:         for phase_name in &phases {
15344:             if *phase_name == bootstrap::BootstrapPhase::SyncSource
15345:                 && target.platform_profile.platform != VmGuestPlatform::Windows
15346:             {
15347:                 continue;
15348:             }
15349:             execute_bootstrap_phase_for_target(phase_name.as_str(), target, &context)?;
15350:             lines.push(format!(
15351:                 "{} completed bootstrap phase={} workdir={}",
15352:                 target.label,
15353:                 phase_name.as_str(),
15354:                 workdir
15355:             ));
15356:         }
15357:     }
15358: 
15359:     Ok(lines.join("\n"))
15360: }
15361: 
15362: fn resolve_start_targets(
15363:     inventory_path: &Path,
15364:     aliases: &[String],
15365:     select_all: bool,
15366: ) -> Result<Vec<StartTarget>, String> {
15367:     let inventory = load_inventory(inventory_path)?;
15368:     let chosen = select_inventory_entries(&inventory, aliases, select_all)?;
15369:     let mut results = Vec::new();
15370:     for entry in chosen {
15371:         let platform_profile = entry.platform_profile();
15372:         let Some(controller) = entry.controller else {
15373:             return Err(format!(
15374:                 "VM alias {} does not declare a local start controller; only local UTM-backed entries can be started here",
15375:                 entry.alias
15376:             ));
15377:         };
15378:         match controller {
15379:             VmController::LocalUtm {
15380:                 utm_name,
15381:                 bundle_path,
15382:             } => {
15383:                 results.push(StartTarget {
15384:                     alias: entry.alias,
15385:                     utm_name,
15386:                     bundle_path,
15387:                     ssh_user: entry.ssh_user,
15388:                     last_known_ip: entry.last_known_ip,
15389:                     mesh_ip: entry.mesh_ip,
15390:                     platform_profile,
15391:                 });
15392:             }
15393:         }
15394:     }
15395:     Ok(results)
15396: }
15397: 
15398: fn wait_for_local_utm_targets_ready(
15399:     targets: &[StartTarget],
15400:     utmctl_path: &Path,
15401:     ssh_port: u16,
15402:     ssh_identity_file: Option<&Path>,
15403:     known_hosts_path: Option<&Path>,
15404:     timeout: Duration,
15405: ) -> Result<Vec<LocalUtmReadyState>, String> {
15406:     let started_at = Instant::now();
15407:     let ssh_port = if ssh_port == 0 { 22 } else { ssh_port };
15408:     let probe_timeout = Duration::from_secs(5).min(timeout);
15409: 
15410:     loop {
15411:         let states = targets
15412:             .iter()
15413:             .map(|target| {
15414:                 observe_local_utm_target_ready(
15415:                     target,
15416:                     utmctl_path,
15417:                     ssh_port,
15418:                     ssh_identity_file,
15419:                     known_hosts_path,
15420:                     probe_timeout,
15421:                 )
15422:             })
15423:             .collect::<Vec<_>>();
15424:         if states.iter().all(local_utm_ready_state_is_ready) {
15425:             return Ok(states);
15426:         }
15427:         if started_at.elapsed() >= timeout {
15428:             return Err(format!(
15429:                 "timed out waiting for restarted local UTM VMs to become ready\n{}",
15430:                 render_local_utm_ready_states(states.as_slice())
15431:             ));
15432:         }
15433:         thread::sleep(Duration::from_secs(2));
15434:     }
15435: }
15436: 
15437: fn ssh_auth_probe_command(profile: VmPlatformProfile) -> Result<&'static str, String> {
15438:     match profile.remote_shell {
15439:         VmRemoteShell::Posix => Ok("true"),
15440:         VmRemoteShell::Powershell => Ok(
15441:             "powershell.exe -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command \"$PSVersionTable.PSVersion.ToString() | Out-Null; exit 0\"",
15442:         ),
15443:         VmRemoteShell::Unsupported => Err(format!(
15444:             "vm-lab SSH readiness probing is not yet implemented for platform {}",
15445:             profile.platform.as_str()
15446:         )),
15447:     }
15448: }
15449: 
15450: fn unmatched_local_utm_advisory_target(platform: VmGuestPlatform, live_ip: &str) -> Option<String> {
15451:     match platform {
15452:         VmGuestPlatform::Linux => Some(rewrite_ssh_target_host("debian@", live_ip)),
15453:         VmGuestPlatform::Macos
15454:         | VmGuestPlatform::Windows
15455:         | VmGuestPlatform::Ios
15456:         | VmGuestPlatform::Android => Some(live_ip.to_string()),
15457:     }
15458: }
15459: 
15460: fn observe_local_utm_target_ready(
15461:     target: &StartTarget,
15462:     utmctl_path: &Path,
15463:     ssh_port: u16,
15464:     ssh_identity_file: Option<&Path>,
15465:     known_hosts_path: Option<&Path>,
15466:     timeout: Duration,
15467: ) -> LocalUtmReadyState {
15468:     let process_present = local_utm_process_present_with_probes(
15469:         utmctl_path,
15470:         Path::new("ps"),
15471:         target.utm_name.as_str(),
15472:         target.bundle_path.as_path(),
15473:         timeout,
15474:     )
15475:     .unwrap_or(false);
15476:     let live_ip = resolve_local_utm_live_host_by_name(
15477:         target.utm_name.as_str(),
15478:         target.last_known_ip.as_deref(),
15479:         target.mesh_ip.as_deref(),
15480:         utmctl_path,
15481:     );
15482:     // SSH is only probed for Linux and macOS targets. Windows VMs may have SSH
15483:     // firewalled or unconfigured; they are considered ready once powered + networked.
15484:     let requires_ssh = matches!(
15485:         target.platform_profile.platform,
15486:         VmGuestPlatform::Linux | VmGuestPlatform::Macos
15487:     );
15488:     let ssh_port_status = if !requires_ssh {
15489:         "n/a".to_string()
15490:     } else {
15491:         match live_ip.as_deref() {
15492:             Some(ip) => probe_tcp_port_status(ip, ssh_port, timeout)
15493:                 .map(|(status, _)| status)
15494:                 .unwrap_or_else(|_| "unknown".to_string()),
15495:             None => "unavailable".to_string(),
15496:         }
15497:     };
15498:     let ssh_auth_status = if !requires_ssh {
15499:         "n/a".to_string()
15500:     } else {
15501:         match (live_ip.as_deref(), target.ssh_user.as_deref()) {
15502:             (None, _) => "skipped-no-live-ip".to_string(),
15503:             (_, None) => "skipped-no-ssh-user".to_string(),
15504:             (_, Some(_)) if ssh_port_status != "open" => "skipped-port-not-open".to_string(),
15505:             (Some(ip), Some(ssh_user)) => match ssh_auth_probe_command(target.platform_profile) {
15506:                 Ok(probe_command) => match run_remote_shell_command(
15507:                     ip,
15508:                     Some(ssh_user),
15509:                     ssh_identity_file,
15510:                     known_hosts_path,
15511:                     probe_command,
15512:                     timeout,
15513:                 ) {
15514:                     Ok(status) if status.success() => "ok".to_string(),
15515:                     Ok(status) => format!("failed-exit-{}", status_code(status)),
15516:                     Err(err) => format!("error:{err}"),
15517:                 },
15518:                 Err(err) => format!("error:{err}"),
15519:             },
15520:         }
15521:     };
15522:     LocalUtmReadyState {
15523:         alias: target.alias.clone(),
15524:         utm_name: target.utm_name.clone(),
15525:         process_present,
15526:         live_ip,
15527:         ssh_port_status,
15528:         ssh_auth_status,
15529:         platform: target.platform_profile.platform,
15530:     }
15531: }
15532: 
15533: fn local_utm_ready_state_is_ready(state: &LocalUtmReadyState) -> bool {
15534:     if !state.process_present || state.live_ip.is_none() {
15535:         return false;
15536:     }
15537:     // Windows VMs are ready once powered and networked; SSH is not required.
15538:     match state.platform {
15539:         VmGuestPlatform::Linux | VmGuestPlatform::Macos => {
15540:             state.ssh_port_status == "open" && state.ssh_auth_status == "ok"
15541:         }
15542:         _ => true,
15543:     }
15544: }
15545: 
15546: fn render_local_utm_ready_states(states: &[LocalUtmReadyState]) -> String {
15547:     states
15548:         .iter()
15549:         .map(|state| {
15550:             format!(
15551:                 "{} ready process_present={} live_ip={} ssh_port_status={} ssh_auth_status={}",
15552:                 state.alias,
15553:                 state.process_present,
15554:                 state.live_ip.as_deref().unwrap_or("unavailable"),
15555:                 state.ssh_port_status,
15556:                 state.ssh_auth_status
15557:             )
15558:         })
15559:         .collect::<Vec<_>>()
15560:         .join("\n")
15561: }
15562: 
15563: fn persist_local_utm_ready_states_to_inventory(
15564:     inventory_path: &Path,
15565:     states: &[LocalUtmReadyState],
15566: ) -> Result<String, String> {
15567:     let original = fs::read_to_string(inventory_path).map_err(|err| {
15568:         format!(
15569:             "read vm inventory for live IP update failed ({}): {err}",
15570:             inventory_path.display()
15571:         )
15572:     })?;
15573:     let mut document: Value = serde_json::from_str(original.as_str()).map_err(|err| {
15574:         format!(
15575:             "parse vm inventory for live IP update failed ({}): {err}",
15576:             inventory_path.display()
15577:         )
15578:     })?;
15579:     let object = document.as_object_mut().ok_or_else(|| {
15580:         format!(
15581:             "vm inventory root must be an object: {}",
15582:             inventory_path.display()
15583:         )
15584:     })?;
15585:     let entries = object
15586:         .get_mut("entries")
15587:         .and_then(Value::as_array_mut)
15588:         .ok_or_else(|| {
15589:             format!(
15590:                 "vm inventory is missing entries array: {}",
15591:                 inventory_path.display()
15592:             )
15593:         })?;
15594: 
15595:     let updates = states
15596:         .iter()
15597:         .filter_map(|state| {
15598:             state
15599:                 .live_ip
15600:                 .as_ref()
15601:                 .map(|live_ip| (state.alias.as_str(), live_ip.as_str()))
15602:         })
15603:         .collect::<BTreeMap<_, _>>();
15604:     if updates.is_empty() {
15605:         return Ok(format!(
15606:             "inventory not updated because no authoritative live IPs were observed in {}",
15607:             inventory_path.display()
15608:         ));
15609:     }
15610: 
15611:     let mut updated_aliases = Vec::new();
15612:     let mut missing_aliases = Vec::new();
15613:     for (alias, live_ip) in &updates {
15614:         let Some(entry_value) = entries.iter_mut().find(|entry| {
15615:             entry
15616:                 .as_object()
15617:                 .and_then(|object| object.get("alias"))
15618:                 .and_then(Value::as_str)
15619:                 == Some(*alias)
15620:         }) else {
15621:             missing_aliases.push((*alias).to_string());
15622:             continue;
15623:         };
15624:         let entry = entry_value.as_object_mut().ok_or_else(|| {
15625:             format!(
15626:                 "vm inventory entry for alias {} must be an object: {}",
15627:                 alias,
15628:                 inventory_path.display()
15629:             )
15630:         })?;
15631:         let current_ssh_target = required_string_field(entry, "ssh_target")?;
15632:         let new_ssh_target = rewrite_ssh_target_host(current_ssh_target.as_str(), live_ip);
15633:         ensure_ssh_target("ssh_target", new_ssh_target.as_str())?;
15634:         ensure_no_control_chars("last_known_ip", live_ip)?;
15635:         entry.insert(
15636:             "ssh_target".to_string(),
15637:             Value::String(new_ssh_target.clone()),
15638:         );
15639:         entry.insert(
15640:             "last_known_ip".to_string(),
15641:             Value::String((*live_ip).to_string()),
15642:         );
15643:         if let Some(existing_live_ips) = entry.get_mut("live_ips") {
15644:             let mut ordered = vec![(*live_ip).to_string()];
15645:             if let Some(values) = existing_live_ips.as_array() {
15646:                 for value in values.iter().filter_map(Value::as_str) {
15647:                     if !ordered.iter().any(|existing| existing == value) {
15648:                         ordered.push(value.to_string());
15649:                     }
15650:                 }
15651:             }
15652:             *existing_live_ips =
15653:                 Value::Array(ordered.into_iter().map(Value::String).collect::<Vec<_>>());
15654:         }
15655:         updated_aliases.push(format!(
15656:             "{alias} ssh_target={new_ssh_target} last_known_ip={live_ip}"
15657:         ));
15658:     }
15659:     if !missing_aliases.is_empty() {
15660:         return Err(format!(
15661:             "cannot update vm inventory {}; aliases not found: {}",
15662:             inventory_path.display(),
15663:             missing_aliases.join(", ")
15664:         ));
15665:     }
15666: 
15667:     let rendered = serde_json::to_string_pretty(&document)
15668:         .map_err(|err| format!("serialize updated vm inventory failed: {err}"))?;
15669:     write_text_file_atomically(inventory_path, rendered.as_str())?;
15670:     load_inventory(inventory_path)?;
15671:     Ok(format!(
15672:         "updated inventory live IPs in {}: {}",
15673:         inventory_path.display(),
15674:         updated_aliases.join("; ")
15675:     ))
15676: }
15677: 
15678: fn write_text_file_atomically(path: &Path, contents: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
15679:     let parent = path.parent().ok_or_else(|| {
15680:         format!(
15681:             "cannot atomically write file without parent directory: {}",
15682:             path.display()
15683:         )
15684:     })?;
15685:     fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|err| {
15686:         format!(
15687:             "create parent directory for atomic write failed ({}): {err}",
15688:             parent.display()
15689:         )
15690:     })?;
15691:     let temp_path = parent.join(format!(
15692:         ".{}.{}.tmp",
15693:         path.file_name()
15694:             .and_then(|value| value.to_str())
15695:             .unwrap_or("inventory"),
15696:         unique_suffix()
15697:     ));
15698:     let normalized_contents = if contents.ends_with('\n') {
15699:         contents.to_string()
15700:     } else {
15701:         format!("{contents}\n")
15702:     };
15703:     fs::write(temp_path.as_path(), normalized_contents.as_bytes()).map_err(|err| {
15704:         format!(
15705:             "write temporary file for atomic write failed ({}): {err}",
15706:             temp_path.display()
15707:         )
15708:     })?;
15709:     fs::rename(temp_path.as_path(), path).map_err(|err| {
15710:         let _ = fs::remove_file(temp_path.as_path());
15711:         format!(
15712:             "replace file during atomic write failed ({} -> {}): {err}",
15713:             temp_path.display(),
15714:             path.display()
15715:         )
15716:     })
15717: }
15718: 
15719: fn resolve_remote_targets(
15720:     inventory_path: &Path,
15721:     aliases: &[String],
15722:     select_all: bool,
15723:     raw_targets: &[String],
15724: ) -> Result<Vec<RemoteTarget>, String> {
15725:     let mut resolved = Vec::new();
15726:     let mut seen = HashSet::new();
15727: 
15728:     if select_all || !aliases.is_empty() {
15729:         let inventory = load_inventory(inventory_path)?;
15730:         for entry in select_inventory_entries(&inventory, aliases, select_all)? {
15731:             let key = format!(
15732:                 "{}|{}",
15733:                 entry.ssh_user.as_deref().unwrap_or(""),
15734:                 entry.ssh_target
15735:             );
15736:             if seen.insert(key) {
15737:                 resolved.push(remote_target_from_inventory_entry(&entry, None));
15738:             }
15739:         }
15740:     }
15741: 
15742:     for raw_target in raw_targets {
15743:         ensure_ssh_target("target", raw_target)?;
15744:         let key = format!("|{raw_target}");
15745:         if seen.insert(key) {
15746:             resolved.push(remote_target_from_raw_target(
15747:                 raw_target.clone(),
15748:                 raw_target.clone(),
15749:             ));
15750:         }
15751:     }
15752: 
15753:     if resolved.is_empty() {
15754:         return Err("specify at least one inventory alias/--all or explicit --target".to_string());
15755:     }
15756: 
15757:     Ok(resolved)
15758: }
15759: 
15760: fn resolve_role_target(
15761:     inventory_path: &Path,
15762:     role_label: &str,
15763:     alias: Option<&str>,
15764:     raw_target: Option<&str>,
15765: ) -> Result<RoleTarget, String> {
15766:     match (alias, raw_target) {
15767:         (Some(_), Some(_)) => Err(format!(
15768:             "{role_label} target must use either --{role_label}-vm or --{role_label}-target, not both"
15769:         )),
15770:         (None, None) => Err(format!(
15771:             "{role_label} target is required; specify --{role_label}-vm or --{role_label}-target"
15772:         )),
15773:         (Some(alias), None) => {
15774:             resolve_role_target_from_inventory(inventory_path, role_label, alias)
15775:         }
15776:         (None, Some(raw_target)) => resolve_role_target_from_raw(role_label, raw_target),
15777:     }
15778: }
15779: 
15780: fn resolve_optional_role_target(
15781:     inventory_path: &Path,
15782:     role_label: &str,
15783:     alias: Option<&str>,
15784:     raw_target: Option<&str>,
15785: ) -> Result<Option<RoleTarget>, String> {
15786:     match (alias, raw_target) {
15787:         (None, None) => Ok(None),
15788:         _ => resolve_role_target(inventory_path, role_label, alias, raw_target).map(Some),
15789:     }
15790: }
15791: 
15792: fn resolve_role_target_from_inventory(
15793:     inventory_path: &Path,
15794:     role_label: &str,
15795:     alias: &str,
15796: ) -> Result<RoleTarget, String> {
15797:     ensure_inventory_alias(alias)?;
15798:     let inventory = load_inventory(inventory_path)?;
15799:     let entry = inventory
15800:         .into_iter()
15801:         .find(|entry| entry.alias == alias)
15802:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("unknown VM alias for {role_label} target: {alias}"))?;
15803:     let resolved_target = resolved_inventory_ssh_target(&entry);
15804:     let normalized_target = normalized_ssh_target(
15805:         resolved_target.as_str(),
15806:         entry.ssh_user.as_deref(),
15807:         role_label,
15808:     )?;
15809:     let platform_profile = entry.platform_profile();
15810:     let utm_name = entry
15811:         .controller
15812:         .as_ref()
15813:         .map(|VmController::LocalUtm { utm_name, .. }| utm_name.clone());
15814:     Ok(RoleTarget {
15815:         label: entry.alias,
15816:         normalized_target,
15817:         network_group: entry.network_group,
15818:         utm_name,
15819:         platform_profile,
15820:         rustynet_src_dir: entry.rustynet_src_dir.clone().or_else(|| {
15821:             Some(default_rustynet_src_dir_for_profile(
15822:                 platform_profile,
15823:                 entry.ssh_user.as_deref(),
15824:             ))
15825:         }),
15826:     })
15827: }

15829: fn resolve_role_target_from_raw(role_label: &str, raw_target: &str) -> Result<RoleTarget, String> {
15830:     ensure_ssh_target(role_label, raw_target)?;
15831:     if !raw_target.contains('@') {
15832:         return Err(format!(
15833:             "{role_label} raw target must include an explicit SSH user (user@host): {raw_target}"
15834:         ));
15835:     }
15836:     let platform_profile = default_platform_profile(VmGuestPlatform::Linux);
15837:     let ssh_user = ssh_target_user(raw_target).map(str::to_string);
15838:     Ok(RoleTarget {
15839:         label: raw_target.to_string(),
15840:         normalized_target: raw_target.to_string(),
15841:         network_group: None,
15842:         utm_name: None,
15843:         platform_profile,
15844:         rustynet_src_dir: Some(default_rustynet_src_dir_for_profile(
15845:             platform_profile,
15846:             ssh_user.as_deref(),
15847:         )),
15848:     })
15849: }

15851: fn normalized_ssh_target(
15852:     ssh_target: &str,
15853:     ssh_user: Option<&str>,
15854:     label: &str,
15855: ) -> Result<String, String> {
15856:     ensure_ssh_target(label, ssh_target)?;
15857:     if ssh_target.contains('@') {
15858:         return Ok(ssh_target.to_string());
15859:     }
15860:     let ssh_user = ssh_user.ok_or_else(|| {
15861:         format!(
15862:             "{label} target requires ssh_user metadata because ssh_target lacks user@host form: {ssh_target}"
15863:         )
15864:     })?;
15865:     ensure_ssh_user(ssh_user)?;
15866:     Ok(format!("{ssh_user}@{ssh_target}"))
15867: }

15941: fn resolved_inventory_ssh_target(entry: &VmInventoryEntry) -> String {
15942:     resolved_inventory_ssh_target_with_utmctl(entry, default_utmctl_path().as_path())
15943: }

15945: fn resolved_inventory_ssh_target_with_utmctl(
15946:     entry: &VmInventoryEntry,
15947:     utmctl_path: &Path,
15948: ) -> String {
15949:     resolve_local_utm_live_host(entry, utmctl_path)
15950:         .map(|host| rewrite_ssh_target_host(entry.ssh_target.as_str(), host.as_str()))
15951:         .unwrap_or_else(|| entry.ssh_target.clone())
15952: }

15954: fn resolve_local_utm_live_host(entry: &VmInventoryEntry, utmctl_path: &Path) -> Option<String> {
15955:     let utm_name = match entry.controller.as_ref()? {
15956:         VmController::LocalUtm { utm_name, .. } => utm_name,
15957:     };
15958:     resolve_local_utm_live_host_by_name(
15959:         utm_name.as_str(),
15960:         entry.last_known_ip.as_deref(),
15961:         entry.mesh_ip.as_deref(),
15962:         utmctl_path,
15963:     )
15964: }
15965: 
15966: fn resolve_local_utm_live_host_by_name(
15967:     utm_name: &str,
15968:     last_known_ip: Option<&str>,
15969:     mesh_ip: Option<&str>,
15970:     utmctl_path: &Path,
15971: ) -> Option<String> {
15972:     if !utmctl_path.is_file() {
15973:         return None;
15974:     }
15975:     let mut command = Command::new(utmctl_path);
15976:     command.arg("ip-address").arg(utm_name);
15977:     let output = run_output_with_timeout(
15978:         &mut command,
15979:         Duration::from_secs(DEFAULT_UTM_IP_DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT_SECS),
15980:     )
15981:     .ok()?;
15982:     if !output.status.success() {
15983:         return None;
15984:     }
15985:     let stdout = String::from_utf8(output.stdout).ok()?;
15986:     select_live_ssh_host_from_utm_output(stdout.as_str(), last_known_ip, mesh_ip)
15987: }

15989: fn matches_local_utm_inventory_entry(
15990:     entry: &VmInventoryEntry,
15991:     bundle_path: &Path,
15992:     utm_name: &str,
15993: ) -> bool {
15994:     let Some(VmController::LocalUtm {
15995:         utm_name: inventory_utm_name,
15996:         bundle_path: inventory_bundle_path,
15997:     }) = entry.controller.as_ref()
15998:     else {
15999:         return false;
16000:     };
16001:     if inventory_utm_name == utm_name {
16002:         return true;
16003:     }
16004:     match (
16005:         fs::canonicalize(bundle_path),
16006:         fs::canonicalize(inventory_bundle_path.as_path()),
16007:     ) {
16008:         (Ok(observed), Ok(expected)) => observed == expected,
16009:         _ => false,
16010:     }
16011: }
16012: 
16013: fn probe_tcp_port_status(
16014:     ip: &str,
16015:     port: u16,
16016:     timeout: Duration,
16017: ) -> Result<(String, Option<String>), String> {
16018:     let parsed_ip = ip
16019:         .trim()
16020:         .parse::<IpAddr>()
16021:         .map_err(|err| format!("invalid SSH probe IP {ip:?}: {err}"))?;
16022:     let socket_addr = SocketAddr::new(parsed_ip, port);
16023:     match TcpStream::connect_timeout(&socket_addr, timeout) {
16024:         Ok(_) => Ok(("open".to_string(), None)),
16025:         Err(primary_err) => {
16026:             // On macOS, the 192.168.64.0/24 UTM shared-network route is SCOPED to bridge100
16027:             // and absent from the global routing table. TcpStream::connect_timeout uses the
16028:             // global table → routes via en0 → fails. Retry by binding to 192.168.64.1 so the
16029:             // OS selects the bridge100-scoped route instead.
16030:             if let IpAddr::V4(v4) = parsed_ip {
16031:                 let octets = v4.octets();
16032:                 if octets[0] == 192 && octets[1] == 168 && octets[2] == 64 {
16033:                     use socket2::{Domain, SockAddr, Socket, Type};
16034:                     if let Ok(sock) = Socket::new(Domain::IPV4, Type::STREAM, None) {
16035:                         let bind: SocketAddr = "192.168.64.1:0".parse().unwrap();
16036:                         if sock.bind(&SockAddr::from(bind)).is_ok()
16037:                             && sock
16038:                                 .connect_timeout(&SockAddr::from(socket_addr), timeout)
16039:                                 .is_ok()
16040:                         {
16041:                             return Ok(("open".to_string(), None));
16042:                         }
16043:                     }
16044:                 }
16045:             }
16046:             Ok(("closed".to_string(), Some(format!("{primary_err}"))))
16047:         }
16048:     }
16049: }
16050: 
16051: fn discover_local_utm_bundle_paths(root: &Path) -> Result<Vec<PathBuf>, String> {
16052:     let mut bundles = Vec::new();
16053:     discover_local_utm_bundle_paths_recursive(root, &mut bundles)?;
16054:     bundles.sort();
16055:     bundles.dedup();
16056:     Ok(bundles)
16057: }
16058: 
16059: fn discover_local_utm_bundle_paths_recursive(
16060:     current: &Path,
16061:     bundles: &mut Vec<PathBuf>,
16062: ) -> Result<(), String> {
16063:     let mut entries = fs::read_dir(current)
16064:         .map_err(|err| {
16065:             format!(
16066:                 "read UTM documents directory failed ({}): {err}",
16067:                 current.display()
16068:             )
16069:         })?
16070:         .filter_map(Result::ok)
16071:         .collect::<Vec<_>>();
16072:     entries.sort_by_key(|entry| entry.file_name());
16073:     for entry in entries {
16074:         let path = entry.path();
16075:         let file_type = entry
16076:             .file_type()
16077:             .map_err(|err| format!("read file type failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
16078:         if file_type.is_symlink() {
16079:             continue;
16080:         }
16081:         if file_type.is_dir() {
16082:             if path.extension().and_then(|value| value.to_str()) == Some("utm") {
16083:                 bundles.push(fs::canonicalize(path.as_path()).map_err(|err| {
16084:                     format!("canonicalize UTM bundle failed ({}): {err}", path.display())
16085:                 })?);
16086:             } else {
16087:                 discover_local_utm_bundle_paths_recursive(path.as_path(), bundles)?;
16088:             }
16089:         }
16090:     }
16091:     Ok(())
16092: }
16093: 
16094: fn select_live_ssh_host_from_utm_output(
16095:     output: &str,
16096:     last_known_ip: Option<&str>,
16097:     mesh_ip: Option<&str>,
16098: ) -> Option<String> {
16099:     let candidates = output
16100:         .lines()
16101:         .filter_map(|line| line.trim().parse::<IpAddr>().ok())
16102:         .collect::<Vec<_>>();
16103:     select_preferred_live_ssh_ip(candidates.as_slice(), last_known_ip, mesh_ip)
16104:         .map(|ip| ip.to_string())
16105: }
16106: 
16107: fn select_preferred_live_ssh_ip(
16108:     candidates: &[IpAddr],
16109:     last_known_ip: Option<&str>,
16110:     mesh_ip: Option<&str>,
16111: ) -> Option<IpAddr> {
16112:     let last_known_ip = last_known_ip.and_then(|value| value.parse::<IpAddr>().ok());
16113:     let mesh_ip = mesh_ip.and_then(|value| value.parse::<IpAddr>().ok());
16114: 
16115:     let viable: Vec<IpAddr> = candidates
16116:         .iter()
16117:         .copied()
16118:         .filter(|c| is_viable_live_ssh_ip(*c))
16119:         .filter(|c| Some(*c) != mesh_ip)
16120:         .collect();
16121: 
16122:     // If no IPv4 candidate survives (only IPv6 secondary/tunnel addresses like
16123:     // SLAAC ULA from bridge100 or a stale WireGuard interface), include
16124:     // last_known_ip as a fallback to avoid selecting a non-SSH-accessible IPv6.
16125:     let has_ipv4 = viable.iter().any(IpAddr::is_ipv4);
16126:     let mut all_candidates = viable;
16127:     if !has_ipv4
16128:         && let Some(lk) = last_known_ip
16129:         && lk.is_ipv4()
16130:         && is_viable_live_ssh_ip(lk)
16131:         && Some(lk) != mesh_ip
16132:     {
16133:         all_candidates.push(lk);
16134:     }
16135: 
16136:     all_candidates
16137:         .iter()
16138:         .copied()
16139:         .max_by_key(|c| live_ssh_ip_score(*c, last_known_ip))
16140: }
16141: 
16142: fn is_viable_live_ssh_ip(candidate: IpAddr) -> bool {
16143:     match candidate {
16144:         IpAddr::V4(addr) => {
16145:             !(addr.is_unspecified()
16146:                 || addr.is_loopback()
16147:                 || addr.is_multicast()
16148:                 || addr.is_link_local())
16149:         }
16150:         IpAddr::V6(addr) => {
16151:             !(addr.is_unspecified()
16152:                 || addr.is_loopback()
16153:                 || addr.is_multicast()
16154:                 || addr.is_unicast_link_local())
16155:         }
16156:     }
16157: }
16158: 
16159: fn live_ssh_ip_score(candidate: IpAddr, last_known_ip: Option<IpAddr>) -> i32 {
16160:     let mut score = 0;
16161:     if Some(candidate) == last_known_ip {
16162:         score += 100;
16163:     }
16164:     if let Some(last_known_ip) = last_known_ip
16165:         && std::mem::discriminant(&candidate) == std::mem::discriminant(&last_known_ip)
16166:     {
16167:         score += 40;
16168:     }
16169:     match candidate {
16170:         IpAddr::V4(addr) => {
16171:             score += 30;
16172:             if addr.is_private() {
16173:                 score += 20;
16174:             }
16175:             if ipv4_is_shared_address_space(addr) {
16176:                 score -= 10;
16177:             }
16178:         }
16179:         IpAddr::V6(addr) => {
16180:             if !addr.is_unique_local() {
16181:                 score += 5;
16182:             }
16183:         }
16184:     }
16185:     score
16186: }
16187: 
16188: fn ipv4_is_shared_address_space(addr: std::net::Ipv4Addr) -> bool {
16189:     let octets = addr.octets();
16190:     octets[0] == 100 && (octets[1] & 0b1100_0000) == 0b0100_0000
16191: }
16192: 
16193: fn rewrite_ssh_target_host(ssh_target: &str, new_host: &str) -> String {
16194:     let formatted_host = if new_host.contains(':') {
16195:         format!("[{new_host}]")
16196:     } else {
16197:         new_host.to_string()
16198:     };
16199:     match ssh_target.rsplit_once('@') {
16200:         Some((user, _)) => format!("{user}@{formatted_host}"),
16201:         None => formatted_host,
16202:     }
16203: }
16204: 
16205: fn literal_ip_host_from_ssh_target(ssh_target: &str) -> Option<String> {
16206:     let host = ssh_target_host(ssh_target);
16207:     host.parse::<IpAddr>().ok().map(|_| host)
16208: }
16209: 
16210: fn select_inventory_entries(
16211:     inventory: &[VmInventoryEntry],
16212:     aliases: &[String],
16213:     select_all: bool,
16214: ) -> Result<Vec<VmInventoryEntry>, String> {
16215:     let requested = if select_all {
16216:         inventory
16217:             .iter()
16218:             .filter(|entry| entry.include_in_all.unwrap_or(true))
16219:             .map(|entry| entry.alias.clone())
16220:             .collect::<Vec<_>>()
16221:     } else {
16222:         aliases.to_vec()
16223:     };
16224:     if requested.is_empty() {
16225:         return Err("specify at least one --vm alias or use --all".to_string());
16226:     }
16227:     let mut selected = Vec::new();
16228:     let mut seen_aliases = HashSet::new();
16229:     for alias in requested {
16230:         if !seen_aliases.insert(alias.clone()) {
16231:             continue;
16232:         }
16233:         let entry = inventory
16234:             .iter()
16235:             .find(|candidate| candidate.alias == alias)
16236:             .cloned()
16237:             .ok_or_else(|| format!("unknown VM alias: {alias}"))?;
16238:         selected.push(entry);
16239:     }
16240:     Ok(selected)
16241: }
16242: 
16243: fn ensure_remote_selection_declares_single_network(
16244:     inventory_path: &Path,
16245:     aliases: &[String],
16246:     select_all: bool,
16247:     raw_targets: &[String],
16248: ) -> Result<String, String> {
16249:     if !raw_targets.is_empty() {
16250:         return Err(
16251:             "require-same-network only supports inventory-backed targets; raw --target values do not declare network metadata"
16252:                 .to_string(),
16253:         );
16254:     }
16255:     let inventory = load_inventory(inventory_path)?;
16256:     let selected = select_inventory_entries(&inventory, aliases, select_all)?;
16257:     ensure_inventory_entries_share_network(selected.as_slice())
16258: }
16259: 
16260: fn ensure_inventory_entries_share_network(entries: &[VmInventoryEntry]) -> Result<String, String> {
16261:     let mut chosen_group: Option<String> = None;
16262:     for entry in entries {
16263:         let group = entry.network_group.as_deref().ok_or_else(|| {
16264:             format!(
16265:                 "VM alias {} is missing network_group metadata required for same-network validation",
16266:                 entry.alias
16267:             )
16268:         })?;
16269:         match chosen_group.as_deref() {
16270:             None => chosen_group = Some(group.to_string()),
16271:             Some(existing) if existing == group => {}
16272:             Some(existing) => {
16273:                 return Err(format!(
16274:                     "selected VMs span multiple network groups: {} is on {} but expected {}",
16275:                     entry.alias, group, existing
16276:                 ));
16277:             }
16278:         }
16279:     }
16280:     chosen_group.ok_or_else(|| "no inventory-backed targets were selected".to_string())
16281: }
16282: 
16283: fn ensure_role_targets_share_network(targets: &[Option<RoleTarget>]) -> Result<String, String> {
16284:     let mut chosen_group: Option<String> = None;
16285:     for target in targets {
16286:         let Some(target) = target.as_ref() else {
16287:             continue;
16288:         };
16289:         let group = target.network_group.as_deref().ok_or_else(|| {
16290:             format!(
16291:                 "target {} is missing inventory-backed network_group metadata required for same-network validation",
16292:                 target.label
16293:             )
16294:         })?;
16295:         match chosen_group.as_deref() {
16296:             None => chosen_group = Some(group.to_string()),
16297:             Some(existing) if existing == group => {}
16298:             Some(existing) => {
16299:                 return Err(format!(
16300:                     "selected role targets span multiple network groups: {} is on {} but expected {}",
16301:                     target.label, group, existing
16302:                 ));
16303:             }
16304:         }
16305:     }
16306:     chosen_group
16307:         .ok_or_else(|| "same-network validation requires at least one resolved target".to_string())
16308: }
16309: 
16310: fn load_inventory(path: &Path) -> Result<Vec<VmInventoryEntry>, String> {
16311:     let body = fs::read_to_string(path)
16312:         .map_err(|err| format!("read vm inventory failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
16313:     let value = serde_json::from_str::<Value>(body.as_str())
16314:         .map_err(|err| format!("parse vm inventory failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
16315:     let object = value
16316:         .as_object()
16317:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("vm inventory must be a JSON object: {}", path.display()))?;
16318:     let version = object
16319:         .get("version")
16320:         .and_then(Value::as_u64)
16321:         .ok_or_else(|| {
16322:             format!(
16323:                 "vm inventory is missing numeric version: {}",
16324:                 path.display()
16325:             )
16326:         })?;
16327:     if version != 1 {
16328:         return Err(format!(
16329:             "unsupported vm inventory version {} in {}",
16330:             version,
16331:             path.display()
16332:         ));
16333:     }
16334:     let entries = object
16335:         .get("entries")
16336:         .and_then(Value::as_array)
16337:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("vm inventory is missing entries array: {}", path.display()))?;
16338:     if entries.is_empty() {
16339:         return Err(format!("vm inventory has no entries: {}", path.display()));
16340:     }
16341: 
16342:     let mut parsed = Vec::with_capacity(entries.len());
16343:     let mut seen_aliases = HashSet::new();
16344:     for entry in entries {
16345:         let parsed_entry = parse_inventory_entry(entry)?;
16346:         if !seen_aliases.insert(parsed_entry.alias.clone()) {
16347:             return Err(format!(
16348:                 "vm inventory contains duplicate alias: {}",
16349:                 parsed_entry.alias
16350:             ));
16351:         }
16352:         parsed.push(parsed_entry);
16353:     }
16354:     Ok(parsed)
16355: }
16356: 
16357: fn parse_inventory_entry(value: &Value) -> Result<VmInventoryEntry, String> {
16358:     let object = value
16359:         .as_object()
16360:         .ok_or_else(|| "vm inventory entry must be an object".to_string())?;
16361:     let alias = required_string_field(object, "alias")?;
16362:     ensure_inventory_alias(alias.as_str())?;
16363:     let ssh_target = required_string_field(object, "ssh_target")?;
16364:     ensure_ssh_target("ssh_target", ssh_target.as_str())?;
16365:     let ssh_user = optional_string_field(object, "ssh_user")?;
16366:     if let Some(user) = ssh_user.as_deref() {
16367:         ensure_ssh_user(user)?;
16368:     }
16369:     let ssh_password = optional_string_field(object, "ssh_password")?;
16370:     if let Some(value) = ssh_password.as_deref() {
16371:         ensure_no_control_chars("ssh_password", value)?;
16372:     }
16373:     let include_in_all = optional_bool_field(object, "include_in_all")?;
16374:     let os = optional_string_field(object, "os")?;
16375:     if let Some(value) = os.as_deref() {
16376:         ensure_no_control_chars("os", value)?;
16377:     }
16378:     let last_known_ip = optional_string_field(object, "last_known_ip")?;
16379:     if let Some(value) = last_known_ip.as_deref() {
16380:         ensure_no_control_chars("last_known_ip", value)?;
16381:     }
16382:     let parent_device = optional_string_field(object, "parent_device")?;
16383:     if let Some(value) = parent_device.as_deref() {
16384:         ensure_no_control_chars("parent_device", value)?;
16385:     }
16386:     let last_known_network = optional_string_field(object, "last_known_network")?;
16387:     if let Some(value) = last_known_network.as_deref() {
16388:         ensure_no_control_chars("last_known_network", value)?;
16389:     }
16390:     let network_group = optional_string_field(object, "network_group")?;
16391:     if let Some(value) = network_group.as_deref() {
16392:         ensure_no_control_chars("network_group", value)?;
16393:     }
16394:     let node_id = optional_string_field(object, "node_id")?;
16395:     if let Some(value) = node_id.as_deref() {
16396:         ensure_inventory_alias(value)?;
16397:     }
16398:     let lab_role = optional_string_field(object, "lab_role")?;
16399:     if let Some(value) = lab_role.as_deref() {
16400:         ensure_inventory_alias(value)?;
16401:     }
16402:     let mesh_ip = optional_string_field(object, "mesh_ip")?;
16403:     if let Some(value) = mesh_ip.as_deref() {
16404:         ensure_no_control_chars("mesh_ip", value)?;
16405:     }
16406:     let exit_capable = optional_bool_field(object, "exit_capable")?;
16407:     let relay_capable = optional_bool_field(object, "relay_capable")?;
16408:     let remote_temp_dir = optional_string_field(object, "remote_temp_dir")?;
16409:     if let Some(value) = remote_temp_dir.as_deref() {
16410:         ensure_no_control_chars("remote_temp_dir", value)?;
16411:     }
16412:     let utm_staging_dir = optional_string_field(object, "utm_staging_dir")?;
16413:     if let Some(value) = utm_staging_dir.as_deref() {
16414:         ensure_no_control_chars("utm_staging_dir", value)?;
16415:     }
16416:     let rustynet_src_dir = optional_string_field(object, "rustynet_src_dir")?;
16417:     if let Some(value) = rustynet_src_dir.as_deref() {
16418:         ensure_no_control_chars("rustynet_src_dir", value)?;
16419:     }
16420:     let platform = match optional_string_field(object, "platform")? {
16421:         Some(value) => {
16422:             Some(VmGuestPlatform::parse(value.as_str()).map_err(|err| format!("platform: {err}"))?)
16423:         }
16424:         None => None,
16425:     };
16426:     let remote_shell = match optional_string_field(object, "remote_shell")? {
16427:         Some(value) => Some(
16428:             VmRemoteShell::parse(value.as_str()).map_err(|err| format!("remote_shell: {err}"))?,
16429:         ),
16430:         None => None,
16431:     };
16432:     let guest_exec_mode = match optional_string_field(object, "guest_exec_mode")? {
16433:         Some(value) => Some(
16434:             VmGuestExecMode::parse(value.as_str())
16435:                 .map_err(|err| format!("guest_exec_mode: {err}"))?,
16436:         ),
16437:         None => None,
16438:     };
16439:     let service_manager = match optional_string_field(object, "service_manager")? {
16440:         Some(value) => Some(
16441:             VmServiceManager::parse(value.as_str())
16442:                 .map_err(|err| format!("service_manager: {err}"))?,
16443:         ),
16444:         None => None,
16445:     };
16446:     let controller = match object.get("controller") {
16447:         None | Some(Value::Null) => None,
16448:         Some(value) => Some(parse_controller(value)?),
16449:     };
16450:     Ok(VmInventoryEntry {
16451:         alias,
16452:         ssh_target,
16453:         ssh_user,
16454:         ssh_password,
16455:         include_in_all,
16456:         os,
16457:         last_known_ip,
16458:         parent_device,
16459:         last_known_network,
16460:         network_group,
16461:         node_id,
16462:         lab_role,
16463:         mesh_ip,
16464:         exit_capable,
16465:         relay_capable,
16466:         remote_temp_dir,
16467:         utm_staging_dir,
16468:         rustynet_src_dir,
16469:         platform,
16470:         remote_shell,
16471:         guest_exec_mode,
16472:         service_manager,
16473:         controller,
16474:     })
16475: }
16476: 
16477: fn parse_controller(value: &Value) -> Result<VmController, String> {
16478:     let object = value
16479:         .as_object()
16480:         .ok_or_else(|| "vm controller must be an object".to_string())?;
16481:     let controller_type = required_string_field(object, "type")?;
16482:     match controller_type.as_str() {
16483:         "local_utm" => {
16484:             let utm_name = required_string_field(object, "utm_name")?;
16485:             ensure_no_control_chars("utm_name", utm_name.as_str())?;
16486:             let bundle_path_raw = required_string_field(object, "bundle_path")?;
16487:             let bundle_path = PathBuf::from(bundle_path_raw.as_str());
16488:             if !bundle_path.is_absolute() {
16489:                 return Err(format!(
16490:                     "local_utm bundle_path must be absolute: {}",
16491:                     bundle_path.display()
16492:                 ));
16493:             }
16494:             Ok(VmController::LocalUtm {
16495:                 utm_name,
16496:                 bundle_path,
16497:             })
16498:         }
16499:         _ => Err(format!("unsupported vm controller type: {controller_type}")),
16500:     }
16501: }
16502: 
16503: fn required_string_field(
16504:     object: &serde_json::Map<String, Value>,
16505:     key: &str,
16506: ) -> Result<String, String> {
16507:     object
16508:         .get(key)
16509:         .and_then(Value::as_str)
16510:         .map(str::trim)
16511:         .filter(|value| !value.is_empty())
16512:         .map(ToString::to_string)
16513:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("vm inventory entry is missing string field: {key}"))
16514: }
16515: 
16516: fn optional_string_field(
16517:     object: &serde_json::Map<String, Value>,
16518:     key: &str,
16519: ) -> Result<Option<String>, String> {
16520:     match object.get(key) {
16521:         None | Some(Value::Null) => Ok(None),
16522:         Some(Value::String(value)) => {
16523:             let trimmed = value.trim();
16524:             if trimmed.is_empty() {
16525:                 Ok(None)
16526:             } else {
16527:                 Ok(Some(trimmed.to_string()))
16528:             }
16529:         }
16530:         _ => Err(format!(
16531:             "vm inventory field must be a string when present: {key}"
16532:         )),
16533:     }
16534: }
16535: 
16536: fn optional_bool_field(
16537:     object: &serde_json::Map<String, Value>,
16538:     key: &str,
16539: ) -> Result<Option<bool>, String> {
16540:     match object.get(key) {
16541:         None | Some(Value::Null) => Ok(None),
16542:         Some(Value::Bool(value)) => Ok(Some(*value)),
16543:         _ => Err(format!(
16544:             "vm inventory field must be a boolean when present: {key}"
16545:         )),
16546:     }
16547: }
16548: 
16549: fn ensure_inventory_alias(value: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
16550:     if value.is_empty() {
16551:         return Err("vm alias must not be empty".to_string());
16552:     }
16553:     let allowed = |ch: char| ch.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(ch, '-' | '_' | '.');
16554:     if !value.chars().all(allowed) {
16555:         return Err(format!("vm alias contains unsupported characters: {value}"));
16556:     }
16557:     Ok(())
16558: }
16559: 
16560: fn ensure_ssh_target(label: &str, value: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
16561:     if value.is_empty() {
16562:         return Err(format!("{label} must not be empty"));
16563:     }
16564:     if value.chars().any(char::is_whitespace) {
16565:         return Err(format!("{label} must not contain whitespace: {value}"));
16566:     }
16567:     ensure_no_control_chars(label, value)
16568: }
16569: 
16570: fn ensure_ssh_user(value: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
16571:     if value.is_empty() {
16572:         return Err("SSH user must not be empty".to_string());
16573:     }
16574:     if value.chars().any(char::is_whitespace) {
16575:         return Err(format!("SSH user must not contain whitespace: {value}"));
16576:     }
16577:     ensure_no_control_chars("SSH user", value)
16578: }
16579: 
16580: fn build_repo_sync_script(
16581:     repo_url: &str,
16582:     dest_dir: &str,
16583:     branch: &str,
16584:     remote: &str,
16585: ) -> Result<String, String> {
16586:     ensure_no_control_chars("repo URL", repo_url)?;
16587:     ensure_no_control_chars("destination directory", dest_dir)?;
16588:     ensure_no_control_chars("branch", branch)?;
16589:     ensure_no_control_chars("remote", remote)?;
16590:     let parent = Path::new(dest_dir)
16591:         .parent()
16592:         .filter(|path| !path.as_os_str().is_empty())
16593:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("destination directory must have a parent: {dest_dir}"))?;
16594:     let parent = parent
16595:         .to_str()
16596:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("destination directory parent is not valid UTF-8: {dest_dir}"))?;
16597:     let dest_git_dir = format!("{dest_dir}/.git");
16598:     Ok(format!(
16599:         "set -eu; mkdir -p {parent}; \
16600: if [ -e {dest_dir} ] && [ ! -d {dest_dir} ]; then \
16601: printf '%s\\n' 'destination path exists but is not a directory: {dest_dir_literal}' >&2; \
16602: exit 1; \
16603: fi; \
16604: if [ -d {dest_dir} ] && [ ! -d {dest_git_dir} ]; then \
16605: backup_path={dest_dir}.prep.$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%S).$$; \
16606: mv -- {dest_dir} \"$backup_path\"; \
16607: fi; \
16608: if [ -d {dest_git_dir} ]; then \
16609: git -C {dest_dir} remote set-url {remote} {repo_url}; \
16610: git -C {dest_dir} fetch --prune {remote}; \
16611: else \
16612: git clone --origin {remote} --branch {branch} -- {repo_url} {dest_dir}; \
16613: fi; \
16614: git -C {dest_dir} checkout --force {branch}; \
16615: git -C {dest_dir} reset --hard {remote}/{branch}",
16616:         parent = shell_quote(parent),
16617:         dest_git_dir = shell_quote(dest_git_dir.as_str()),
16618:         dest_dir = shell_quote(dest_dir),
16619:         dest_dir_literal = dest_dir,
16620:         remote = shell_quote(remote),
16621:         repo_url = shell_quote(repo_url),
16622:         branch = shell_quote(branch),
16623:     ))
16624: }
16625: 
16626: fn build_windows_repo_sync_script(
16627:     repo_url: &str,
16628:     dest_dir: &str,
16629:     branch: &str,
16630:     remote: &str,
16631: ) -> Result<String, String> {
16632:     ensure_no_control_chars("repo URL", repo_url)?;
16633:     ensure_no_control_chars("destination directory", dest_dir)?;
16634:     ensure_no_control_chars("branch", branch)?;
16635:     ensure_no_control_chars("remote", remote)?;
16636:     Ok(format!(
16637:         "Set-StrictMode -Version Latest; \
16638:          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; \
16639:          $dest = {dest}; \
16640:          $parent = Split-Path -Parent $dest; \
16641:          if ($parent -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $parent)) {{ New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $parent | Out-Null }}; \
16642:          if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dest)) {{ git clone --origin {remote_name} --branch {branch_name} --single-branch {repo} $dest | Out-Null }} \
16643:          elseif (Test-Path -LiteralPath (Join-Path $dest '.git')) {{ \
16644:              git -C $dest remote set-url {remote_name} {repo}; \
16645:              git -C $dest fetch {remote_name} {branch_name} --prune; \
16646:              git -C $dest checkout -B {branch_name} FETCH_HEAD; \
16647:              git -C $dest reset --hard FETCH_HEAD; \
16648:              git -C $dest clean -fdx \
16649:          }} else {{ throw \"destination exists but is not a git repository: $dest\" }}",
16650:         dest = powershell_quote(dest_dir)?,
16651:         remote_name = powershell_quote(remote)?,
16652:         branch_name = powershell_quote(branch)?,
16653:         repo = powershell_quote(repo_url)?,
16654:     ))
16655: }
16656: 
16657: fn build_repo_sync_script_for_target(
16658:     target: &RemoteTarget,
16659:     repo_url: &str,
16660:     dest_dir: &str,
16661:     branch: &str,
16662:     remote: &str,
16663: ) -> Result<String, String> {
16664:     match repo_sync_dispatch_kind_for_target(target, RepoSyncMode::Git)? {
16665:         RepoSyncDispatchKind::PosixGit => {
16666:             build_repo_sync_script(repo_url, dest_dir, branch, remote)
16667:         }
16668:         RepoSyncDispatchKind::WindowsPowershellGit => {
16669:             build_windows_repo_sync_script(repo_url, dest_dir, branch, remote)
16670:         }
16671:         other => Err(format!(
16672:             "repo sync dispatch mismatch for {}: {other:?}",
16673:             target.label
16674:         )),
16675:     }
16676: }
