16678: fn build_local_source_extract_script(
16679:     dest_dir: &str,
16680:     remote_archive_path: &str,
16681: ) -> Result<String, String> {
16682:     ensure_no_control_chars("destination directory", dest_dir)?;
16683:     ensure_no_control_chars("remote archive path", remote_archive_path)?;
16684:     let parent = Path::new(dest_dir)
16685:         .parent()
16686:         .filter(|path| !path.as_os_str().is_empty())
16687:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("destination directory must have a parent: {dest_dir}"))?;
16688:     let parent = parent
16689:         .to_str()
16690:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("destination directory parent is not valid UTF-8: {dest_dir}"))?;
16691:     Ok(format!(
16692:         "set -eu; mkdir -p {parent}; \
16693: if [ -e {dest_dir} ] && [ ! -d {dest_dir} ]; then \
16694: printf '%s\\n' 'destination path exists but is not a directory: {dest_dir_literal}' >&2; \
16695: rm -f -- {remote_archive}; \
16696: exit 1; \
16697: fi; \
16698: if [ -d {dest_dir} ]; then \
16699: backup_path={dest_dir}.prep.$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%S).$$; \
16700: mv -- {dest_dir} \"$backup_path\"; \
16701: fi; \
16702: mkdir -p {dest_dir}; \
16703: tar -xf {remote_archive} -C {dest_dir}; \
16704: rm -f -- {remote_archive}",
16705:         parent = shell_quote(parent),
16706:         dest_dir = shell_quote(dest_dir),
16707:         dest_dir_literal = dest_dir,
16708:         remote_archive = shell_quote(remote_archive_path),
16709:     ))
16710: }
16711: 
16712: fn build_windows_local_source_extract_script(
16713:     dest_dir: &str,
16714:     remote_archive_path: &str,
16715: ) -> Result<String, String> {
16716:     ensure_no_control_chars("destination directory", dest_dir)?;
16717:     ensure_no_control_chars("remote archive path", remote_archive_path)?;
16718:     Ok(format!(
16719:         "Set-StrictMode -Version Latest; \
16720:          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; \
16721:          $ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'; \
16722:          $dest = {dest}; \
16723:          $archive = {archive}; \
16724:          $parent = Split-Path -Parent $dest; \
16725:          $staging = Join-Path $parent ('rn-vm-lab-source-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N')); \
16726:          $currentScriptPath = ''; \
16727:          if ($PSCommandPath) {{ \
16728:            try {{ $currentScriptPath = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $PSCommandPath -ErrorAction Stop).Path }} catch {{ $currentScriptPath = $PSCommandPath }} \
16729:          }}; \
16730:          if ($parent -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $parent)) {{ New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $parent | Out-Null }}; \
16731:          if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $archive)) {{ throw ('Windows local source archive is missing: {{0}}' -f $archive) }}; \
16732:          if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $staging) {{ Remove-Item -LiteralPath $staging -Recurse -Force }}; \
16733:          try {{ \
16734:            if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dest)) {{ New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dest | Out-Null }}; \
16735:            Expand-Archive -LiteralPath $archive -DestinationPath $staging -Force; \
16736:            $stagedEntries = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $staging -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); \
16737:            if ($stagedEntries.Count -eq 0) {{ throw ('Windows local source archive extracted no files: {{0}}' -f $archive) }}; \
16738:            foreach ($existing in @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $dest -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {{ \
16739:              $existingPath = $existing.FullName; \
16740:              if ($currentScriptPath -and $existingPath.Equals($currentScriptPath, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {{ continue }}; \
16741:              if ($existing.Name -like 'utm_*.ps1') {{ continue }}; \
16742:              Remove-Item -LiteralPath $existingPath -Recurse -Force \
16743:            }}; \
16744:            foreach ($entry in $stagedEntries) {{ \
16745:              Move-Item -LiteralPath $entry.FullName -Destination $dest -Force \
16746:            }}; \
16747:          }} catch {{ \
16748:            $detail = if ($_.Exception -and $_.Exception.Message) {{ $_.Exception.Message.Trim() }} else {{ ($_ | Out-String).Trim() }}; \
16749:            if (-not $detail) {{ $detail = 'windows-local-source-extract-failed' }}; \
16750:            Write-Output ('windows-local-source-extract-error=' + $detail); \
16751:            throw \
16752:          }} finally {{ \
16753:            if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $archive) {{ Remove-Item -LiteralPath $archive -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }}; \
16754:            if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $staging) {{ Remove-Item -LiteralPath $staging -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }} \
16755:          }};",
16756:         dest = powershell_quote(dest_dir)?,
16757:         archive = powershell_quote(remote_archive_path)?,
16758:     ))
16759: }
16760: 
16761: fn build_windows_local_source_extract_result_script(
16762:     dest_dir: &str,
16763:     remote_archive_path: &str,
16764:     remote_result_path: &str,
16765: ) -> Result<String, String> {
16766:     ensure_no_control_chars("destination directory", dest_dir)?;
16767:     ensure_no_control_chars("remote archive path", remote_archive_path)?;
16768:     ensure_no_control_chars("Windows extract result path", remote_result_path)?;
16769:     Ok(format!(
16770:         "Set-StrictMode -Version Latest; \
16771:          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; \
16772:          $ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'; \
16773:          $dest = {dest}; \
16774:          $archive = {archive}; \
16775:          $resultPath = {result_path}; \
16776:          $resultParent = Split-Path -Path $resultPath -Parent; \
16777:          if ($resultParent -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $resultParent)) {{ New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $resultParent | Out-Null }}; \
16778:          if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $resultPath) {{ Remove-Item -LiteralPath $resultPath -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }}; \
16779:          $parent = Split-Path -Parent $dest; \
16780:          $staging = Join-Path $parent ('rn-vm-lab-source-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N')); \
16781:          $currentScriptPath = ''; \
16782:          if ($PSCommandPath) {{ \
16783:            try {{ $currentScriptPath = (Resolve-Path -LiteralPath $PSCommandPath -ErrorAction Stop).Path }} catch {{ $currentScriptPath = $PSCommandPath }} \
16784:          }}; \
16785:          if ($parent -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $parent)) {{ New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $parent | Out-Null }}; \
16786:          $report = $null; \
16787:          try {{ \
16788:            if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $archive)) {{ throw ('Windows local source archive is missing: {{0}}' -f $archive) }}; \
16789:            if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $staging) {{ Remove-Item -LiteralPath $staging -Recurse -Force }}; \
16790:            if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $dest)) {{ New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $dest | Out-Null }}; \
16791:            Expand-Archive -LiteralPath $archive -DestinationPath $staging -Force; \
16792:            $stagedEntries = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $staging -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); \
16793:            if ($stagedEntries.Count -eq 0) {{ throw ('Windows local source archive extracted no files: {{0}}' -f $archive) }}; \
16794:            foreach ($existing in @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $dest -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {{ \
16795:              $existingPath = $existing.FullName; \
16796:              if ($currentScriptPath -and $existingPath.Equals($currentScriptPath, [System.StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase)) {{ continue }}; \
16797:              if ($existing.Name -like 'utm_*.ps1') {{ continue }}; \
16798:              Remove-Item -LiteralPath $existingPath -Recurse -Force \
16799:            }}; \
16800:            foreach ($entry in $stagedEntries) {{ \
16801:              Move-Item -LiteralPath $entry.FullName -Destination $dest -Force \
16802:            }}; \
16803:            $report = [ordered]@{{ status = 'pass'; dest = $dest }} \
16804:          }} catch {{ \
16805:            $detail = if ($_.Exception -and $_.Exception.Message) {{ $_.Exception.Message.Trim() }} else {{ ($_ | Out-String).Trim() }}; \
16806:            if (-not $detail) {{ $detail = 'windows-local-source-extract-failed' }}; \
16807:            $report = [ordered]@{{ status = 'fail'; reason = $detail; dest = $dest }} \
16808:          }} finally {{ \
16809:            if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $archive) {{ Remove-Item -LiteralPath $archive -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }}; \
16810:            if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $staging) {{ Remove-Item -LiteralPath $staging -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }} \
16811:          }}; \
16812:          $report | ConvertTo-Json -Compress | Set-Content -LiteralPath $resultPath -Encoding UTF8; \
16813:          if ($report.status -ne 'pass') {{ exit 1 }}",
16814:         dest = powershell_quote(dest_dir)?,
16815:         archive = powershell_quote(remote_archive_path)?,
16816:         result_path = powershell_quote(remote_result_path)?,
16817:     ))
16818: }
16819: 
16820: fn prepare_local_source_archive(
16821:     source_dir: &Path,
16822:     timeout: Duration,
16823: ) -> Result<LocalSourceArchive, String> {
16824:     ensure_local_directory_path(source_dir, "local source dir")?;
16825:     let archive_path =
16826:         std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("rustynet-vm-lab-source-{}.tar", unique_suffix()));
16827:     let extras = prepare_local_source_bundle_extras(source_dir, timeout)?;
16828:     if let Err(git_err) =
16829:         write_git_worktree_archive(source_dir, archive_path.as_path(), timeout, extras.as_ref())
16830:         && let Err(raw_err) =
16831:             write_raw_directory_archive(source_dir, archive_path.as_path(), extras.as_ref())
16832:     {
16833:         let _ = fs::remove_file(archive_path.as_path());
16834:         return Err(format!(
16835:             "local source archive failed via git-managed path ({git_err}); raw directory fallback also failed ({raw_err})"
16836:         ));
16837:     }
16838:     Ok(LocalSourceArchive { path: archive_path })
16839: }
16840: 
16841: fn prepare_local_source_zip_archive(
16842:     source_dir: &Path,
16843:     timeout: Duration,
16844: ) -> Result<LocalSourceArchive, String> {
16845:     ensure_local_directory_path(source_dir, "local source dir")?;
16846:     let archive_path =
16847:         std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("rustynet-vm-lab-source-{}.zip", unique_suffix()));
16848:     let extras = prepare_local_source_bundle_extras(source_dir, timeout)?;
16849:     if let Err(git_err) =
16850:         write_git_worktree_zip_archive(source_dir, archive_path.as_path(), timeout, extras.as_ref())
16851:         && let Err(raw_err) =
16852:             write_raw_directory_zip_archive(source_dir, archive_path.as_path(), extras.as_ref())
16853:     {
16854:         let _ = fs::remove_file(archive_path.as_path());
16855:         return Err(format!(
16856:             "local ZIP source archive failed via git-managed path ({git_err}); raw directory fallback also failed ({raw_err})"
16857:         ));
16858:     }
16859:     Ok(LocalSourceArchive { path: archive_path })
16860: }
16861: 
16862: fn write_raw_directory_archive(
16863:     source_dir: &Path,
16864:     archive_path: &Path,
16865:     extras: Option<&LocalSourceBundleExtras>,
16866: ) -> Result<(), String> {
16867:     let file = fs::File::create(archive_path).map_err(|err| {
16868:         format!(
16869:             "create raw local source archive failed ({}): {err}",
16870:             archive_path.display()
16871:         )
16872:     })?;
16873:     let mut archive = Builder::new(file);
16874:     let mut included = 0usize;
16875:     append_raw_local_source_tree(&mut archive, source_dir, source_dir, &mut included)?;
16876:     append_local_source_bundle_extras(&mut archive, extras, &mut included)?;
16877:     if included == 0 {
16878:         let _ = fs::remove_file(archive_path);
16879:         return Err(format!(
16880:             "local source dir did not yield any syncable files: {}",
16881:             source_dir.display()
16882:         ));
16883:     }
16884:     archive.finish().map_err(|err| {
16885:         format!(
16886:             "finalize raw local source archive failed ({}): {err}",
16887:             archive_path.display()
16888:         )
16889:     })
16890: }
16891: 
16892: fn write_raw_directory_zip_archive(
16893:     source_dir: &Path,
16894:     archive_path: &Path,
16895:     extras: Option<&LocalSourceBundleExtras>,
16896: ) -> Result<(), String> {
16897:     let file = fs::File::create(archive_path).map_err(|err| {
16898:         format!(
16899:             "create raw local ZIP source archive failed ({}): {err}",
16900:             archive_path.display()
16901:         )
16902:     })?;
16903:     let mut zip = ZipWriter::new(file);
16904:     let options = SimpleFileOptions::default()
16905:         .compression_method(CompressionMethod::Deflated)
16906:         .unix_permissions(0o644);
16907:     let mut included = 0usize;
16908:     append_raw_local_source_tree_to_zip(&mut zip, &options, source_dir, source_dir, &mut included)?;
16909:     append_local_source_bundle_extras_to_zip(&mut zip, &options, extras, &mut included)?;
16910:     if included == 0 {
16911:         let _ = fs::remove_file(archive_path);
16912:         return Err(format!(
16913:             "local source dir did not yield any syncable files for ZIP archive: {}",
16914:             source_dir.display()
16915:         ));
16916:     }
16917:     zip.finish().map_err(|err| {
16918:         format!(
16919:             "finalize raw local ZIP source archive failed ({}): {err}",
16920:             archive_path.display()
16921:         )
16922:     })?;
16923:     Ok(())
16924: }
16925: 
16926: fn write_git_worktree_archive(
16927:     source_dir: &Path,
16928:     archive_path: &Path,
16929:     timeout: Duration,
16930:     extras: Option<&LocalSourceBundleExtras>,
16931: ) -> Result<(), String> {
16932:     let mut list_command = Command::new("git");
16933:     list_command.arg("-C").arg(source_dir).args([
16934:         "ls-files",
16935:         "-z",
16936:         "--cached",
16937:         "--others",
16938:         "--exclude-standard",
16939:     ]);
16940:     let output = run_output_with_timeout(&mut list_command, timeout)?;
16941:     if !output.status.success() {
16942:         return Err(format!(
16943:             "collect local source file list failed with status {}",
16944:             status_code(output.status)
16945:         ));
16946:     }
16947: 
16948:     let mut archive = Builder::new(fs::File::create(archive_path).map_err(|err| {
16949:         format!(
16950:             "create local source archive failed ({}): {err}",
16951:             archive_path.display()
16952:         )
16953:     })?);
16954:     let mut included = 0usize;
16955:     let mut seen = HashSet::new();
16956:     for raw_path in output.stdout.split(|byte| *byte == 0) {
16957:         if raw_path.is_empty() {
16958:             continue;
16959:         }
16960:         let relative = std::str::from_utf8(raw_path)
16961:             .map_err(|err| format!("local source file list contained non-utf8 path: {err}"))?;
16962:         if relative.is_empty() || !seen.insert(relative.to_string()) {
16963:             continue;
16964:         }
16965:         let relative_path = Path::new(relative);
16966:         let absolute_path = source_dir.join(relative_path);
16967:         if !absolute_path.exists() {
16968:             continue;
16969:         }
16970:         archive
16971:             .append_path_with_name(absolute_path.as_path(), relative_path)
16972:             .map_err(|err| {
16973:                 format!(
16974:                     "append local source path failed ({}): {err}",
16975:                     relative_path.display()
16976:                 )
16977:             })?;
16978:         included += 1;
16979:     }
16980:     append_local_source_bundle_extras(&mut archive, extras, &mut included)?;
16981:     if included == 0 {
16982:         return Err(format!(
16983:             "local source dir did not yield any syncable files: {}",
16984:             source_dir.display()
16985:         ));
16986:     }
16987:     archive.finish().map_err(|err| {
16988:         format!(
16989:             "finalize local source archive failed ({}): {err}",
16990:             archive_path.display()
16991:         )
16992:     })
16993: }
16994: 
16995: fn write_git_worktree_zip_archive(
16996:     source_dir: &Path,
16997:     archive_path: &Path,
16998:     timeout: Duration,
16999:     extras: Option<&LocalSourceBundleExtras>,
17000: ) -> Result<(), String> {
17001:     let mut list_command = Command::new("git");
17002:     list_command.arg("-C").arg(source_dir).args([
17003:         "ls-files",
17004:         "-z",
17005:         "--cached",
17006:         "--others",
17007:         "--exclude-standard",
17008:     ]);
17009:     let output = run_output_with_timeout(&mut list_command, timeout)?;
17010:     if !output.status.success() {
17011:         return Err(format!(
17012:             "collect local ZIP source file list failed with status {}",
17013:             status_code(output.status)
17014:         ));
17015:     }
17016: 
17017:     let file = fs::File::create(archive_path).map_err(|err| {
17018:         format!(
17019:             "create local ZIP source archive failed ({}): {err}",
17020:             archive_path.display()
17021:         )
17022:     })?;
17023:     let mut zip = ZipWriter::new(file);
17024:     let options = SimpleFileOptions::default()
17025:         .compression_method(CompressionMethod::Deflated)
17026:         .unix_permissions(0o644);
17027:     let mut included = 0usize;
17028:     let mut seen = HashSet::new();
17029:     for raw_path in output.stdout.split(|byte| *byte == 0) {
17030:         if raw_path.is_empty() {
17031:             continue;
17032:         }
17033:         let relative = std::str::from_utf8(raw_path)
17034:             .map_err(|err| format!("local source file list contained non-utf8 path: {err}"))?;
17035:         if relative.is_empty() || !seen.insert(relative.to_string()) {
17036:             continue;
17037:         }
17038:         let relative_path = Path::new(relative);
17039:         let absolute_path = source_dir.join(relative_path);
17040:         if !absolute_path.is_file() {
17041:             continue;
17042:         }
17043:         append_file_to_zip(
17044:             &mut zip,
17045:             &options,
17046:             absolute_path.as_path(),
17047:             relative_path,
17048:             &mut included,
17049:         )?;
17050:     }
17051:     append_local_source_bundle_extras_to_zip(&mut zip, &options, extras, &mut included)?;
17052:     if included == 0 {
17053:         return Err(format!(
17054:             "local source dir did not yield any syncable files for ZIP archive: {}",
17055:             source_dir.display()
17056:         ));
17057:     }
17058:     zip.finish().map_err(|err| {
17059:         format!(
17060:             "finalize local ZIP source archive failed ({}): {err}",
17061:             archive_path.display()
17062:         )
17063:     })?;
17064:     Ok(())
17065: }
17066: 
17067: fn prepare_local_source_bundle_extras(
17068:     source_dir: &Path,
17069:     timeout: Duration,
17070: ) -> Result<Option<LocalSourceBundleExtras>, String> {
17071:     let manifest_path = source_dir.join("Cargo.toml");
17072:     if !manifest_path.is_file() {
17073:         return Ok(None);
17074:     }
17075: 
17076:     let temp_root =
17077:         std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("rustynet-vm-lab-bundle-{}", unique_suffix()));
17078:     fs::create_dir_all(temp_root.as_path()).map_err(|err| {
17079:         format!(
17080:             "create local source bundle dir failed ({}): {err}",
17081:             temp_root.display()
17082:         )
17083:     })?;
17084:     let vendor_dir = temp_root.join("vendor");
17085:     let mut command = Command::new("cargo");
17086:     command
17087:         .current_dir(temp_root.as_path())
17088:         .arg("vendor")
17089:         .arg("--locked")
17090:         .arg("--offline")
17091:         .arg("--versioned-dirs")
17092:         .arg("--manifest-path")
17093:         .arg(manifest_path.as_os_str())
17094:         .arg("vendor");
17095:     let output = run_output_with_timeout(&mut command, timeout)?;
17096:     if !output.status.success() {
17097:         let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(output.stderr.as_slice())
17098:             .trim()
17099:             .to_string();
17100:         if stderr.contains("--offline was specified")
17101:             || stderr.contains("failed to download")
17102:             || stderr.contains("failed to sync")
17103:         {
17104:             let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(temp_root.as_path());
17105:             return Ok(None);
17106:         }
17107:         let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(temp_root.as_path());
17108:         return Err(format!(
17109:             "prepare vendored cargo dependencies failed with status {}{}",
17110:             status_code(output.status),
17111:             if stderr.is_empty() {
17112:                 String::new()
17113:             } else {
17114:                 format!(": {stderr}")
17115:             }
17116:         ));
17117:     }
17118: 
17119:     let cargo_config_dir = temp_root.join(".cargo");
17120:     fs::create_dir_all(cargo_config_dir.as_path()).map_err(|err| {
17121:         format!(
17122:             "create vendored cargo config dir failed ({}): {err}",
17123:             cargo_config_dir.display()
17124:         )
17125:     })?;
17126:     let cargo_config_path = cargo_config_dir.join("config.toml");
17127:     let vendor_stdout = String::from_utf8(output.stdout)
17128:         .map_err(|err| format!("vendored cargo config was not valid UTF-8: {err}"))?;
17129:     fs::write(
17130:         cargo_config_path.as_path(),
17131:         build_vendored_cargo_config(vendor_stdout.as_str()).as_bytes(),
17132:     )
17133:     .map_err(|err| {
17134:         format!(
17135:             "write vendored cargo config failed ({}): {err}",
17136:             cargo_config_path.display()
17137:         )
17138:     })?;
17139: 
17140:     Ok(Some(LocalSourceBundleExtras {
17141:         temp_root,
17142:         vendor_dir: Some(vendor_dir),
17143:         cargo_config_path: Some(cargo_config_path),
17144:     }))
17145: }
17146: 
17147: fn build_vendored_cargo_config(vendor_stdout: &str) -> String {
17148:     let mut config = vendor_stdout.trim().to_string();
17149:     if !config.ends_with('\n') {
17150:         config.push('\n');
17151:     }
17152:     config.push_str("\n[net]\noffline = true\n");
17153:     config
17154: }
17155: 
17156: fn append_local_source_bundle_extras(
17157:     archive: &mut Builder<fs::File>,
17158:     extras: Option<&LocalSourceBundleExtras>,
17159:     included: &mut usize,
17160: ) -> Result<(), String> {
17161:     let Some(extras) = extras else {
17162:         return Ok(());
17163:     };
17164:     if let Some(vendor_dir) = extras.vendor_dir.as_deref() {
17165:         append_directory_tree_to_archive(archive, vendor_dir, Path::new("vendor"), included)?;
17166:     }
17167:     if let Some(cargo_config_path) = extras.cargo_config_path.as_deref() {
17168:         archive
17169:             .append_path_with_name(cargo_config_path, Path::new(".cargo/config.toml"))
17170:             .map_err(|err| {
17171:                 format!(
17172:                     "append vendored cargo config failed ({}): {err}",
17173:                     cargo_config_path.display()
17174:                 )
17175:             })?;
17176:         *included += 1;
17177:     }
17178:     Ok(())
17179: }
17180: 
17181: fn append_local_source_bundle_extras_to_zip(
17182:     zip: &mut ZipWriter<fs::File>,
17183:     options: &SimpleFileOptions,
17184:     extras: Option<&LocalSourceBundleExtras>,
17185:     included: &mut usize,
17186: ) -> Result<(), String> {
17187:     let Some(extras) = extras else {
17188:         return Ok(());
17189:     };
17190:     if let Some(vendor_dir) = extras.vendor_dir.as_deref() {
17191:         append_directory_tree_to_zip(zip, options, vendor_dir, Path::new("vendor"), included)?;
17192:     }
17193:     if let Some(cargo_config_path) = extras.cargo_config_path.as_deref() {
17194:         append_file_to_zip(
17195:             zip,
17196:             options,
17197:             cargo_config_path,
17198:             Path::new(".cargo/config.toml"),
17199:             included,
17200:         )?;
17201:     }
17202:     Ok(())
17203: }
17204: 
17205: fn append_raw_local_source_tree(
17206:     archive: &mut Builder<fs::File>,
17207:     source_root: &Path,
17208:     current_dir: &Path,
17209:     included: &mut usize,
17210: ) -> Result<(), String> {
17211:     let entries = fs::read_dir(current_dir).map_err(|err| {
17212:         format!(
17213:             "read local source dir failed ({}): {err}",
17214:             current_dir.display()
17215:         )
17216:     })?;
17217:     for entry in entries {
17218:         let entry = entry.map_err(|err| {
17219:             format!(
17220:                 "read local source dir entry failed ({}): {err}",
17221:                 current_dir.display()
17222:             )
17223:         })?;
17224:         let path = entry.path();
17225:         let relative = path.strip_prefix(source_root).map_err(|err| {
17226:             format!(
17227:                 "strip local source prefix failed ({}): {err}",
17228:                 path.display()
17229:             )
17230:         })?;
17231:         if should_skip_raw_local_source_path(relative) {
17232:             continue;
17233:         }
17234:         let file_type = entry.file_type().map_err(|err| {
17235:             format!(
17236:                 "read local source entry type failed ({}): {err}",
17237:                 path.display()
17238:             )
17239:         })?;
17240:         if file_type.is_dir() {
17241:             append_raw_local_source_tree(archive, source_root, path.as_path(), included)?;
17242:             continue;
17243:         }
17244:         archive
17245:             .append_path_with_name(path.as_path(), relative)
17246:             .map_err(|err| {
17247:                 format!(
17248:                     "append raw local source path failed ({}): {err}",
17249:                     relative.display()
17250:                 )
17251:             })?;
17252:         *included += 1;
17253:     }
17254:     Ok(())
17255: }
17256: 
17257: fn append_raw_local_source_tree_to_zip(
17258:     zip: &mut ZipWriter<fs::File>,
17259:     options: &SimpleFileOptions,
17260:     source_root: &Path,
17261:     current_dir: &Path,
17262:     included: &mut usize,
17263: ) -> Result<(), String> {
17264:     let entries = fs::read_dir(current_dir).map_err(|err| {
17265:         format!(
17266:             "read local ZIP source dir failed ({}): {err}",
17267:             current_dir.display()
17268:         )
17269:     })?;
17270:     for entry in entries {
17271:         let entry = entry.map_err(|err| {
17272:             format!(
17273:                 "read local ZIP source dir entry failed ({}): {err}",
17274:                 current_dir.display()
17275:             )
17276:         })?;
17277:         let path = entry.path();
17278:         let relative = path.strip_prefix(source_root).map_err(|err| {
17279:             format!(
17280:                 "strip local ZIP source prefix failed ({}): {err}",
17281:                 path.display()
17282:             )
17283:         })?;
17284:         if should_skip_raw_local_source_path(relative) {
17285:             continue;
17286:         }
17287:         let file_type = entry.file_type().map_err(|err| {
17288:             format!(
17289:                 "read local ZIP source entry type failed ({}): {err}",
17290:                 path.display()
17291:             )
17292:         })?;
17293:         if file_type.is_dir() {
17294:             append_raw_local_source_tree_to_zip(
17295:                 zip,
17296:                 options,
17297:                 source_root,
17298:                 path.as_path(),
17299:                 included,
17300:             )?;
17301:             continue;
17302:         }
17303:         append_file_to_zip(zip, options, path.as_path(), relative, included)?;
17304:     }
17305:     Ok(())
17306: }

17308: fn append_directory_tree_to_archive(
17309:     archive: &mut Builder<fs::File>,
17310:     source_root: &Path,
17311:     archive_root: &Path,
17312:     included: &mut usize,
17313: ) -> Result<(), String> {
17314:     let entries = fs::read_dir(source_root).map_err(|err| {
17315:         format!(
17316:             "read archive source dir failed ({}): {err}",
17317:             source_root.display()
17318:         )
17319:     })?;
17320:     for entry in entries {
17321:         let entry = entry.map_err(|err| {
17322:             format!(
17323:                 "read archive source dir entry failed ({}): {err}",
17324:                 source_root.display()
17325:             )
17326:         })?;
17327:         let path = entry.path();
17328:         let archive_path = archive_root.join(entry.file_name());
17329:         let file_type = entry.file_type().map_err(|err| {
17330:             format!(
17331:                 "read archive source entry type failed ({}): {err}",
17332:                 path.display()
17333:             )
17334:         })?;
17335:         if file_type.is_dir() {
17336:             append_directory_tree_to_archive(
17337:                 archive,
17338:                 path.as_path(),
17339:                 archive_path.as_path(),
17340:                 included,
17341:             )?;
17342:             continue;
17343:         }
17344:         archive
17345:             .append_path_with_name(path.as_path(), archive_path.as_path())
17346:             .map_err(|err| {
17347:                 format!(
17348:                     "append archive source path failed ({}): {err}",
17349:                     archive_path.display()
17350:                 )
17351:             })?;
17352:         *included += 1;
17353:     }
17354:     Ok(())
17355: }
17356: 
17357: fn append_directory_tree_to_zip(
17358:     zip: &mut ZipWriter<fs::File>,
17359:     options: &SimpleFileOptions,
17360:     source_root: &Path,
17361:     archive_root: &Path,
17362:     included: &mut usize,
17363: ) -> Result<(), String> {
17364:     let entries = fs::read_dir(source_root).map_err(|err| {
17365:         format!(
17366:             "read ZIP archive source dir failed ({}): {err}",
17367:             source_root.display()
17368:         )
17369:     })?;
17370:     for entry in entries {
17371:         let entry = entry.map_err(|err| {
17372:             format!(
17373:                 "read ZIP archive source dir entry failed ({}): {err}",
17374:                 source_root.display()
17375:             )
17376:         })?;
17377:         let path = entry.path();
17378:         let archive_path = archive_root.join(entry.file_name());
17379:         let file_type = entry.file_type().map_err(|err| {
17380:             format!(
17381:                 "read ZIP archive source entry type failed ({}): {err}",
17382:                 path.display()
17383:             )
17384:         })?;
17385:         if file_type.is_dir() {
17386:             append_directory_tree_to_zip(
17387:                 zip,
17388:                 options,
17389:                 path.as_path(),
17390:                 archive_path.as_path(),
17391:                 included,
17392:             )?;
17393:             continue;
17394:         }
17395:         append_file_to_zip(
17396:             zip,
17397:             options,
17398:             path.as_path(),
17399:             archive_path.as_path(),
17400:             included,
17401:         )?;
17402:     }
17403:     Ok(())
17404: }
17405: 
17406: fn append_file_to_zip(
17407:     zip: &mut ZipWriter<fs::File>,
17408:     options: &SimpleFileOptions,
17409:     source_path: &Path,
17410:     archive_path: &Path,
17411:     included: &mut usize,
17412: ) -> Result<(), String> {
17413:     let name = archive_path
17414:         .to_str()
17415:         .ok_or_else(|| {
17416:             format!(
17417:                 "path is not valid UTF-8 for ZIP archive: {}",
17418:                 archive_path.display()
17419:             )
17420:         })?
17421:         .replace('\\', "/");
17422:     zip.start_file(name, *options).map_err(|err| {
17423:         format!(
17424:             "start ZIP file entry failed ({}): {err}",
17425:             archive_path.display()
17426:         )
17427:     })?;
17428:     let mut input = fs::File::open(source_path).map_err(|err| {
17429:         format!(
17430:             "open ZIP source file failed ({}): {err}",
17431:             source_path.display()
17432:         )
17433:     })?;
17434:     std::io::copy(&mut input, zip)
17435:         .map_err(|err| format!("write ZIP entry failed ({}): {err}", archive_path.display()))?;
17436:     *included += 1;
17437:     Ok(())
17438: }
17439: 
17440: fn should_skip_raw_local_source_path(relative: &Path) -> bool {
17441:     if relative.file_name().and_then(|name| name.to_str()) == Some(".DS_Store") {
17442:         return true;
17443:     }
17444:     let first = relative.iter().next().and_then(|part| part.to_str());
17445:     matches!(first, Some(".git" | "target" | "artifacts"))
17446: }
17447: 
17448: fn sync_local_source_archive_to_target(
17449:     archive_path: &Path,
17450:     target: &RemoteTarget,
17451:     ssh_user_override: Option<&str>,
17452:     ssh_identity_file: Option<&Path>,
17453:     known_hosts_path: Option<&Path>,
17454:     dest_dir: &str,
17455:     timeout: Duration,
17456: ) -> Result<(), String> {
17457:     ensure_local_regular_file_path(archive_path, "local source archive")?;
17458:     if target.platform_profile.platform == VmGuestPlatform::Windows {
17459:         // Stage the archive under windows_orchestration_root so the SSH
17460:         // user can SCP it AND the SYSTEM-context utmctl can read the
17461:         // companion .result.json that the extract wrapper writes.  The
17462:         // legacy vm-lab path was unreachable from utmctl on UTM Windows
17463:         // guests (state-tree hardening strips the SYSTEM ACE) and was
17464:         // wedging the result-file pull retry loop.
17465:         let archive_root = windows_orchestration_root(target);
17466:         let archive_root = archive_root.trim_end_matches(['\\', '/']);
17467:         let remote_archive = format!(r"{archive_root}\rn-vm-lab-source-{}.zip", unique_suffix());
17468:         ensure_success_status(
17469:             scp_to_remote_for_target(
17470:                 target,
17471:                 ssh_user_override,
17472:                 ssh_identity_file,
17473:                 known_hosts_path,
17474:                 archive_path,
17475:                 remote_archive.as_str(),
17476:                 timeout,
17477:             )?,
17478:             "copy local ZIP source archive to Windows remote",
17479:         )?;
17480:         if remote_target_local_utm(target).is_some() {
17481:             let (utm_name, _) = remote_target_local_utm(target).expect("validated local UTM");
17482:             let remote_result_path = format!(r"{remote_archive}.result.json");
17483:             let output = execute_windows_local_utm_result_file_probe(
17484:                 utm_name,
17485:                 "Windows local source extract",
17486:                 timeout,
17487:                 remote_result_path.as_str(),
17488:                 |remote_result_path| {
17489:                     build_windows_local_source_extract_result_script(
17490:                         dest_dir,
17491:                         remote_archive.as_str(),
17492:                         remote_result_path,
17493:                     )
17494:                 },
17495:             )?;
17496:             let parsed: serde_json::Value =
17497:                 serde_json::from_str(output.as_str()).map_err(|err| {
17498:                     format!("Windows local source extract returned invalid JSON: {err}")
17499:                 })?;
17500:             let status = parsed
17501:                 .get("status")
17502:                 .and_then(|value| value.as_str())
17503:                 .unwrap_or("fail");
17504:             if status == "pass" {
17505:                 return Ok(());
17506:             }
17507:             let reason = parsed
17508:                 .get("reason")
17509:                 .and_then(|value| value.as_str())
17510:                 .unwrap_or("windows-local-source-extract-failed");
17511:             return Err(format!(
17512:                 "extract local ZIP source archive on Windows remote failed: {reason}"
17513:             ));
17514:         }
17515:         let extract_script =
17516:             build_windows_local_source_extract_script(dest_dir, remote_archive.as_str())?;
17517:         let status = run_remote_shell_command_for_target(
17518:             target,
17519:             ssh_user_override,
17520:             ssh_identity_file,
17521:             known_hosts_path,
17522:             extract_script.as_str(),
17523:             timeout,
17524:         )?;
17525:         return ensure_success_status(status, "extract local ZIP source archive on Windows remote");
17526:     }
17527:     // These guest images accept SFTP writes into the SSH user's home directory
17528:     // reliably, while absolute /tmp uploads are rejected on some hosts.
17529:     let remote_archive = if remote_target_local_utm(target).is_some() {
17530:         let ssh_user = remote_target_effective_user(target, ssh_user_override)?;
17531:         format!(
17532:             "{}/.rn-vm-lab-source-{}.tar",
17533:             remote_target_home(ssh_user.as_str()),
17534:             unique_suffix()
17535:         )
17536:     } else {
17537:         format!(".rn-vm-lab-source-{}.tar", unique_suffix())
17538:     };
17539:     ensure_success_status(
17540:         scp_to_remote_for_target(
17541:             target,
17542:             ssh_user_override,
17543:             ssh_identity_file,
17544:             known_hosts_path,
17545:             archive_path,
17546:             remote_archive.as_str(),
17547:             timeout,
17548:         )?,
17549:         "copy local source archive to remote",
17550:     )?;
17551:     let extract_script = build_local_source_extract_script(dest_dir, remote_archive.as_str())?;
17552:     let status = run_remote_shell_command_for_target(
17553:         target,
17554:         ssh_user_override,
17555:         ssh_identity_file,
17556:         known_hosts_path,
17557:         extract_script.as_str(),
17558:         timeout,
17559:     )?;
17560:     ensure_success_status(status, "extract local source archive on remote")
17561: }
17562: 
17563: fn build_remote_argv_script(
17564:     workdir: &str,
17565:     program: &str,
17566:     argv: &[String],
17567:     sudo: bool,
17568: ) -> Result<String, String> {
17569:     ensure_no_control_chars("workdir", workdir)?;
17570:     ensure_no_control_chars("program", program)?;
17571:     let mut command = String::new();
17572:     if sudo {
17573:         command.push_str("sudo -n -- ");
17574:     } else {
17575:         command.push_str("exec ");
17576:     }
17577:     command.push_str(shell_quote(program).as_str());
17578:     for arg in argv {
17579:         ensure_no_control_chars("command arg", arg.as_str())?;
17580:         command.push(' ');
17581:         command.push_str(shell_quote(arg.as_str()).as_str());
17582:     }
17583:     if sudo {
17584:         command = format!("exec {command}");
17585:     }
17586:     Ok(format!("set -eu; cd {}; {}", shell_quote(workdir), command))
17587: }
17588: 
17589: fn ensure_optional_local_regular_file_path(path: Option<&Path>, label: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
17590:     if let Some(path) = path {
17591:         ensure_local_regular_file_path(path, label)?;
17592:     }
17593:     Ok(())
17594: }

17596: fn append_ssh_transport_options(
17597:     command: &mut Command,
17598:     ssh_identity_file: Option<&Path>,
17599:     known_hosts_path: Option<&Path>,
17600: ) -> Result<(), String> {
17601:     ensure_optional_local_regular_file_path(ssh_identity_file, "SSH identity file")?;
17602:     ensure_optional_local_regular_file_path(known_hosts_path, "SSH known_hosts file")?;
17603:     if let Some(path) = ssh_identity_file {
17604:         command.arg("-i").arg(path);
17605:     }
17606:     if let Some(path) = known_hosts_path {
17607:         command
17608:             .arg("-o")
17609:             .arg(format!("UserKnownHostsFile={}", path.display()));
17610:     }
17611:     Ok(())
17612: }

17614: fn remote_target_local_utm(target: &RemoteTarget) -> Option<(&str, &Path)> {
17615:     match target.controller.as_ref() {
17616:         Some(VmController::LocalUtm {
17617:             utm_name,
17618:             bundle_path,
17619:         }) => Some((utm_name.as_str(), bundle_path.as_path())),
17620:         None => None,
17621:     }
17622: }
17623: 
17624: fn remote_target_effective_user(
17625:     target: &RemoteTarget,
17626:     ssh_user_override: Option<&str>,
17627: ) -> Result<String, String> {
17628:     if let Some(ssh_user) = ssh_user_override {
17629:         ensure_ssh_user(ssh_user)?;
17630:         return Ok(ssh_user.to_string());
17631:     }
17632:     if let Some(ssh_user) = target.ssh_user.as_deref() {
17633:         ensure_ssh_user(ssh_user)?;
17634:         return Ok(ssh_user.to_string());
17635:     }
17636:     if let Some(ssh_user) = ssh_target_user(target.ssh_target.as_str()) {
17637:         ensure_ssh_user(ssh_user)?;
17638:         return Ok(ssh_user.to_string());
17639:     }
17640:     Err(format!(
17641:         "UTM-backed target {} requires an explicit ssh_user or user@host SSH target",
17642:         target.label
17643:     ))
17644: }

17646: fn remote_target_home(ssh_user: &str) -> String {
17647:     if ssh_user == "root" {
17648:         "/root".to_string()
17649:     } else {
17650:         format!("/home/{ssh_user}")
17651:     }
17652: }

17654: fn utmctl_binary_path() -> Result<PathBuf, String> {
17655:     let path = default_utmctl_path();
17656:     if !path.is_file() {
17657:         return Err(format!("utmctl binary is not present: {}", path.display()));
17658:     }
17659:     Ok(path)
17660: }
17661: 
17662: fn utm_push_raw(
17663:     utm_name: &str,
17664:     src: &Path,
17665:     dst: &str,
17666:     timeout: Duration,
17667: ) -> Result<ExitStatus, String> {
17668:     ensure_local_regular_file_path(src, "UTM push source file")?;
17669:     ensure_no_control_chars("UTM push destination path", dst)?;
17670:     let utmctl_path = utmctl_binary_path()?;
17671:     let stdin = fs::File::open(src)
17672:         .map_err(|err| format!("open UTM push source failed ({}): {err}", src.display()))?;
17673:     let mut command = Command::new(utmctl_path);
17674:     command.arg("file").arg("push").arg(utm_name).arg(dst);
17675:     command.stdin(Stdio::from(stdin));
17676:     command.stdout(Stdio::null());
17677:     command.stderr(Stdio::piped());
17678:     // Use _preserve to avoid run_output_with_timeout overriding our stdin setup.
17679:     let output = run_output_with_timeout_preserve(&mut command, timeout)?;
17680:     let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).trim().to_string();
17681:     if !stderr.is_empty() {
17682:         return Err(format!(
17683:             "UTM file push reported error for {utm_name}:{dst}: {stderr}"
17684:         ));
17685:     }
17686:     Ok(output.status)
17687: }
17688: 
17689: fn utm_pull_raw(
17690:     utm_name: &str,
17691:     src: &str,
17692:     dst: &Path,
17693:     timeout: Duration,
17694: ) -> Result<ExitStatus, String> {
17695:     ensure_no_control_chars("UTM pull source path", src)?;
17696:     let utmctl_path = utmctl_binary_path()?;
17697:     let parent = dst.parent().filter(|path| !path.as_os_str().is_empty());
17698:     if let Some(parent) = parent {
17699:         fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|err| {
17700:             format!(
17701:                 "create UTM pull destination dir failed ({}): {err}",
17702:                 parent.display()
17703:             )
17704:         })?;
17705:     }
17706:     let mut command = Command::new(utmctl_path);
17707:     command.arg("file").arg("pull").arg(utm_name).arg(src);
17708:     let output = run_output_with_timeout(&mut command, timeout)?;
17709:     fs::write(dst, &output.stdout).map_err(|err| {
17710:         format!(
17711:             "write UTM pull destination failed ({}): {err}",
17712:             dst.display()
17713:         )
17714:     })?;
17715:     let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).trim().to_string();
17716:     if !stderr.is_empty() {
17717:         let _ = fs::remove_file(dst);
17718:         return Err(format!(
17719:             "UTM file pull reported error for {utm_name}:{src}: {stderr}"
17720:         ));
17721:     }
17722:     Ok(output.status)
17723: }
17724: 
17725: fn utm_exec_root_raw(
17726:     utm_name: &str,
17727:     command_script: &str,
17728:     timeout: Duration,
17729: ) -> Result<ExitStatus, String> {
17730:     ensure_no_control_chars("UTM exec command", command_script)?;
17731:     let utmctl_path = utmctl_binary_path()?;
17732:     let mut command = Command::new(utmctl_path);
17733:     command.arg("exec").arg(utm_name);
17734:     // Use a single `--cmd` followed by bare positional args. The Linux
17735:     // QEMU guest agent delivers subsequent `--cmd` tokens as literal argv
17736:     // elements to the executed binary (i.e. bash receives "--cmd" as an
17737:     // unknown option and exits 2). Passing a single `--cmd /bin/bash`
17738:     // then bare positionals keeps the argv clean on both Linux QEMU and
17739:     // the Windows UTM guest-agent path. The collapsing issue observed for
17740:     // the Windows powershell.exe path in livelab4/5 was specific to the
17741:     // Windows guest agent and does not affect Linux; the Windows exec path
17742:     // uses `utm_exec_windows_raw`/`append_utmctl_windows_exec_command`
17743:     // instead of this function.
17744:     command
17745:         .arg("--cmd")
17746:         .arg("/bin/bash")
17747:         .arg("-lc")
17748:         .arg(command_script);
17749:     run_status_with_timeout(&mut command, timeout)
17750: }
17751: 
17752: /// Ensure a directory exists on the Windows guest before any
17753: /// `utm_push_raw` to a path inside it. utmctl file push does NOT create
17754: /// intermediate directories — pushing to a missing path returns
17755: /// `OSStatus -2700` ("The system cannot find the path specified.").
17756: ///
17757: /// Idempotent: `New-Item -Force` on an existing directory is a no-op.
17758: fn ensure_utm_windows_dir(
17759:     utm_name: &str,
17760:     remote_dir: &str,
17761:     timeout: Duration,
17762: ) -> Result<(), String> {
17763:     ensure_no_control_chars("UTM Windows dir", remote_dir)?;
17764:     let quoted = powershell_quote(remote_dir)?;
17765:     let script = format!(
17766:         "Set-StrictMode -Version Latest; \
17767:          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; \
17768:          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path {quoted} | Out-Null"
17769:     );
17770:     let status = utm_exec_windows_raw(utm_name, script.as_str(), timeout)?;
17771:     if !status.success() {
17772:         return Err(format!(
17773:             "UTM Windows mkdir for {utm_name}:{remote_dir} exited with status {}",
17774:             status_code(status)
17775:         ));
17776:     }
17777:     Ok(())
17778: }
17779: 
17780: fn utm_cleanup_exec_files(
17781:     utm_name: &str,
17782:     remote_script: &str,
17783:     remote_wrapper: &str,
17784:     remote_output: &str,
17785:     remote_rc: &str,
17786: ) {
17787:     let cleanup = format!(
17788:         "rm -f {} {} {} {}",
17789:         shell_quote(remote_script),
17790:         shell_quote(remote_wrapper),
17791:         shell_quote(remote_output),
17792:         shell_quote(remote_rc),
17793:     );
17794:     let _ = utm_exec_root_raw(utm_name, cleanup.as_str(), Duration::from_secs(20));
17795: }
17796: 
17797: fn execute_utm_remote_script_as_user(
17798:     utm_name: &str,
17799:     ssh_user: &str,
17800:     home: &str,
17801:     remote_script: &str,
17802:     timeout: Duration,
17803: ) -> Result<(i32, String), String> {
17804:     ensure_ssh_user(ssh_user)?;
17805:     ensure_no_control_chars("UTM exec home", home)?;
17806:     if remote_script.chars().any(|ch| ch == '\0') {
17807:         return Err("UTM remote script contains unsupported NUL byte".to_string());
17808:     }
17809: 
17810:     let temp_root = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("rustynet-vm-lab-utm-{}", unique_suffix()));
17811:     fs::create_dir_all(temp_root.as_path()).map_err(|err| {
17812:         format!(
17813:             "create local UTM helper dir failed ({}): {err}",
17814:             temp_root.display()
17815:         )
17816:     })?;
17817:     let local_script = temp_root.join("command.sh");
17818:     let local_wrapper = temp_root.join("wrapper.sh");
17819:     let local_output = temp_root.join("output.txt");
17820:     let local_rc = temp_root.join("rc.txt");
17821:     fs::write(
17822:         local_script.as_path(),
17823:         format!("#!/usr/bin/env bash\nset -euo pipefail\n{remote_script}\n").as_bytes(),
17824:     )
17825:     .map_err(|err| {
17826:         let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(temp_root.as_path());
17827:         format!(
17828:             "write local UTM command script failed ({}): {err}",
17829:             local_script.display()
17830:         )
17831:     })?;
17832:     fs::write(
17833:         local_wrapper.as_path(),
17834:         br#"#!/usr/bin/env bash
17835: set -euo pipefail
17836: 
17837: if [[ $# -ne 5 ]]; then
17838:   echo "usage: rn-utm-wrapper.sh <user> <home> <command-script> <output-path> <rc-path>" >&2
17839:   exit 2
17840: fi
17841: 
17842: user="$1"
17843: home="$2"
17844: command_script="$3"
17845: output_path="$4"
17846: rc_path="$5"
17847: rc=0
17848: 
17849: if [[ "$user" == "root" ]]; then
17850:   chmod 700 "$command_script"
17851:   if /usr/bin/env HOME="$home" USER=root LOGNAME=root PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin \
17852:     /bin/bash "$command_script" >"$output_path" 2>&1
17853:   then
17854:     rc=0
17855:   else
17856:     rc=$?
17857:   fi
17858: else
17859:   chmod 755 "$command_script"
17860:   if runuser -u "$user" -- env HOME="$home" USER="$user" LOGNAME="$user" PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin \
17861:     /bin/bash "$command_script" >"$output_path" 2>&1
17862:   then
17863:     rc=0
17864:   else
17865:     rc=$?
17866:   fi
17867: fi
17868: 
17869: printf '%s\n' "$rc" > "$rc_path"
17870: sync "$output_path" "$rc_path" >/dev/null 2>&1 || sync >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
17871: exit 0
17872: "#,
17873:     )
17874:     .map_err(|err| {
17875:         let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(temp_root.as_path());
17876:         format!(
17877:             "write local UTM wrapper script failed ({}): {err}",
17878:             local_wrapper.display()
17879:         )
17880:     })?;
17881: 
17882:     let remote_base = format!("/var/tmp/rn-utm-exec.{}", unique_suffix());
17883:     let remote_command_path = format!("{remote_base}.sh");
17884:     let remote_wrapper_path = format!("{remote_base}.wrapper.sh");
17885:     let remote_output_path = format!("{remote_base}.out");
17886:     let remote_rc_path = format!("{remote_base}.rc");
17887: 
17888:     let push_timeout = timeout.min(Duration::from_secs(60));
17889:     for (path, destination, label) in [
17890:         (
17891:             local_script.as_path(),
17892:             remote_command_path.as_str(),
17893:             "command",
17894:         ),
17895:         (
17896:             local_wrapper.as_path(),
17897:             remote_wrapper_path.as_str(),
17898:             "wrapper",
17899:         ),
17900:     ] {
17901:         let status = utm_push_raw(utm_name, path, destination, push_timeout).map_err(|err| {
17902:             let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(temp_root.as_path());
17903:             format!("UTM push {label} script failed: {err}")
17904:         })?;
17905:         if !status.success() {
17906:             let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(temp_root.as_path());
17907:             return Err(format!(
17908:                 "UTM push {label} script failed with status {}",
17909:                 status_code(status)
17910:             ));
17911:         }
17912:     }
17913: 
17914:     let host_status = {
17915:         let utmctl_path = utmctl_binary_path()?;
17916:         let mut command = Command::new(utmctl_path);
17917:         command.arg("exec").arg(utm_name);
17918:         // Explicit `--cmd` per arg (matches utmctl's documented syntax,
17919:         // never collapses positional args). See utm_exec_root_raw above
17920:         // for the same fix on the bash-utmctl path.
17921:         for arg in [
17922:             "/bin/bash",
17923:             remote_wrapper_path.as_str(),
17924:             ssh_user,
17925:             home,
17926:             remote_command_path.as_str(),
17927:             remote_output_path.as_str(),
17928:             remote_rc_path.as_str(),
17929:         ] {
17930:             command.arg("--cmd").arg(arg);
17931:         }
17932:         run_status_with_timeout(&mut command, timeout + Duration::from_secs(30))?
17933:     };
17934:     if !host_status.success() {
17935:         utm_cleanup_exec_files(
17936:             utm_name,
17937:             remote_command_path.as_str(),
17938:             remote_wrapper_path.as_str(),
17939:             remote_output_path.as_str(),
17940:             remote_rc_path.as_str(),
17941:         );
17942:         let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(temp_root.as_path());
17943:         return Err(format!(
17944:             "UTM exec wrapper failed with status {}",
17945:             status_code(host_status)
17946:         ));
17947:     }
17948: 
17949:     let max_rc_attempts = timeout.as_secs().max(10);
17950:     let mut rc = None;
17951:     for attempt in 1..=max_rc_attempts {
17952:         let rc_status = utm_pull_raw(
17953:             utm_name,
17954:             remote_rc_path.as_str(),
17955:             local_rc.as_path(),
17956:             push_timeout,
17957:         )?;
17958:         if rc_status.success()
17959:             && let Ok(rc_text) = fs::read_to_string(local_rc.as_path())
17960:             && let Ok(parsed_rc) = rc_text.trim().parse::<i32>()
17961:         {
17962:             rc = Some(parsed_rc);
17963:             break;
17964:         }
17965:         if attempt < max_rc_attempts {
17966:             thread::sleep(Duration::from_secs(1));
17967:         }
17968:     }
17969:     let rc = if let Some(rc) = rc {
17970:         rc
17971:     } else {
17972:         utm_cleanup_exec_files(
17973:             utm_name,
17974:             remote_command_path.as_str(),
17975:             remote_wrapper_path.as_str(),
17976:             remote_output_path.as_str(),
17977:             remote_rc_path.as_str(),
17978:         );
17979:         let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(temp_root.as_path());
17980:         return Err(format!(
17981:             "parse local UTM exit-code failed ({}): cannot parse integer from empty string",
17982:             local_rc.display()
17983:         ));
17984:     };
17985:     let output_status = utm_pull_raw(
17986:         utm_name,
17987:         remote_output_path.as_str(),
17988:         local_output.as_path(),
17989:         push_timeout,
17990:     )?;
17991:     if !output_status.success() {
17992:         utm_cleanup_exec_files(
17993:             utm_name,
17994:             remote_command_path.as_str(),
17995:             remote_wrapper_path.as_str(),
17996:             remote_output_path.as_str(),
17997:             remote_rc_path.as_str(),
17998:         );
17999:         let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(temp_root.as_path());
18000:         return Err(format!(
18001:             "UTM exec output pull failed with status {}",
18002:             status_code(output_status)
18003:         ));
18004:     }
18005: 
18006:     let output_bytes = fs::read(local_output.as_path()).map_err(|err| {
18007:         utm_cleanup_exec_files(
18008:             utm_name,
18009:             remote_command_path.as_str(),
18010:             remote_wrapper_path.as_str(),
18011:             remote_output_path.as_str(),
18012:             remote_rc_path.as_str(),
18013:         );
18014:         let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(temp_root.as_path());
18015:         format!(
18016:             "read local UTM output file failed ({}): {err}",
18017:             local_output.display()
18018:         )
18019:     })?;
18020:     let output = String::from_utf8(output_bytes).map_err(|err| {
18021:         utm_cleanup_exec_files(
18022:             utm_name,
18023:             remote_command_path.as_str(),
18024:             remote_wrapper_path.as_str(),
18025:             remote_output_path.as_str(),
18026:             remote_rc_path.as_str(),
18027:         );
18028:         let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(temp_root.as_path());
18029:         format!("UTM remote output was not valid UTF-8: {err}")
18030:     })?;
18031: 
18032:     utm_cleanup_exec_files(
18033:         utm_name,
18034:         remote_command_path.as_str(),
18035:         remote_wrapper_path.as_str(),
18036:         remote_output_path.as_str(),
18037:         remote_rc_path.as_str(),
18038:     );
18039:     let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(temp_root.as_path());
18040:     Ok((rc, output))
18041: }
18042: 
18043: fn synthetic_exit_status(code: i32) -> ExitStatus {
18044:     let normalized = code.clamp(0, 255);
18045:     ExitStatus::from_raw(normalized << 8)
18046: }

18048: fn fallback_remote_shell_command_to_ssh(
18049:     target: &RemoteTarget,
18050:     ssh_user_override: Option<&str>,
18051:     ssh_identity_file: Option<&Path>,
18052:     known_hosts_path: Option<&Path>,
18053:     remote_script: &str,
18054:     timeout: Duration,
18055:     utm_error: &str,
18056: ) -> Result<ExitStatus, String> {
18057:     let ssh_script = remote_script_for_ssh_transport(target, remote_script)?;
18058:     run_remote_shell_command(
18059:         target.ssh_target.as_str(),
18060:         ssh_user_override.or(target.ssh_user.as_deref()),
18061:         ssh_identity_file,
18062:         known_hosts_path,
18063:         ssh_script.as_str(),
18064:         timeout,
18065:     )
18066:     .map_err(|ssh_err| {
18067:         format!(
18068:             "UTM transport failed for {} ({utm_error}); SSH fallback failed: {ssh_err}",
18069:             target.label
18070:         )
18071:     })
18072: }

18100: fn fallback_scp_to_remote(
18101:     context: &RemoteFallbackContext<'_>,
18102:     src: &Path,
18103:     dst: &str,
18104:     utm_error: &str,
18105: ) -> Result<ExitStatus, String> {
18106:     scp_to_remote(
18107:         src,
18108:         context.target.ssh_target.as_str(),
18109:         context
18110:             .ssh_user_override
18111:             .or(context.target.ssh_user.as_deref()),
18112:         context.ssh_identity_file,
18113:         context.known_hosts_path,
18114:         dst,
18115:         context.timeout,
18116:     )
18117:     .map_err(|ssh_err| {
18118:         format!(
18119:             "UTM transport failed for {} ({utm_error}); SSH fallback failed: {ssh_err}",
18120:             context.target.label
18121:         )
18122:     })

18125: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
18126: enum RemoteTransportPhase {
18127:     AccessEstablishment,
18128:     PostBootstrap,
18129: }
18130: 
18131: /// Return the utmctl staging directory for a Windows UTM target.
18132: ///
18133: /// The staging directory is a SYSTEM-writable location that the QEMU
18134: /// guest agent can read and write via `utmctl file push`/`utmctl file
18135: /// pull`. It MUST live outside the runtime state tree
18136: /// (`C:\ProgramData\Rustynet\`) because that tree is hardened with
18137: /// `icacls /grant:r <user>:(OI)(CI)(F) /T`, which strips the SYSTEM
18138: /// ACE and therefore breaks utmctl file operations.
18139: ///
18140: /// Falls back to the platform default when the target does not carry an
18141: /// explicit value, but never returns `remote_temp_dir` because that
18142: /// path lives inside the hardened tree.
18143: fn remote_target_windows_utm_staging_dir(target: &RemoteTarget) -> Result<String, String> {
18144:     if let Some(dir) = target.utm_staging_dir.as_deref() {
18145:         return Ok(dir.to_string());
18146:     }
18147:     default_utm_staging_dir_for_profile(target.platform_profile, target.ssh_user.as_deref())
18148:         .ok_or_else(|| {
18149:             format!(
18150:                 "no UTM staging directory configured for Windows target {}",
18151:                 target.label
18152:             )
18153:         })
18154: }
18155: 
18156: fn ssh_fallback_allowed_for_target(_target: &RemoteTarget, _phase: RemoteTransportPhase) -> bool {
18157:     // SSH SCP and SSH exec fallback are always permitted. The original
18158:     // restriction (blocking AccessEstablishment + Windows UTM) was intended to
18159:     // prevent a circular dependency, but utmctl file push exits 0 even when it
18160:     // fails to write the file (OSStatus -2700 / Access is denied), making the
18161:     // UTM path unreliable. Allowing SCP fallback is safe: if SSH auth is not
18162:     // yet configured the SCP will fail with a clear auth error; if it is
18163:     // configured (as on this lab VM) the SCP succeeds and unblocks bootstrap.
18164:     true
18165: }
18166: 
18167: fn format_windows_access_establishment_transport_error(
18168:     target_label: &str,
18169:     operation: &str,
18170:     cause: &str,
18171: ) -> String {
18172:     format!("Windows access establishment {operation} failed for {target_label}: {cause}")
18173: }
18174: 
18175: fn run_remote_shell_command_for_target_with_phase(
18176:     target: &RemoteTarget,
18177:     ssh_user_override: Option<&str>,
18178:     ssh_identity_file: Option<&Path>,
18179:     known_hosts_path: Option<&Path>,
18180:     remote_script: &str,
18181:     timeout: Duration,
18182:     phase: RemoteTransportPhase,
18183: ) -> Result<ExitStatus, String> {
18184:     if let Some((utm_name, _)) = remote_target_local_utm(target) {
18185:         return match target.platform_profile.platform {
18186:             VmGuestPlatform::Linux => {
18187:                 let ssh_user = remote_target_effective_user(target, ssh_user_override)?;
18188:                 let home = remote_target_home(ssh_user.as_str());
18189:                 let (rc, _) = match execute_utm_remote_script_as_user(
18190:                     utm_name,
18191:                     ssh_user.as_str(),
18192:                     home.as_str(),
18193:                     remote_script,
18194:                     timeout,
18195:                 ) {
18196:                     Ok(result) => result,
18197:                     Err(err) => {
18198:                         return fallback_remote_shell_command_to_ssh(
18199:                             target,
18200:                             ssh_user_override,
18201:                             ssh_identity_file,
18202:                             known_hosts_path,
18203:                             remote_script,
18204:                             timeout,
18205:                             err.as_str(),
18206:                         );
18207:                     }
18208:                 };
18209:                 Ok(synthetic_exit_status(rc))
18210:             }
18211:             VmGuestPlatform::Windows => {
18212:                 // Primary path: utmctl exec + result-file (network-independent;
18213:                 // survives WireGuard interface up/down mid-orchestration).
18214:                 // SSH fallback only on transport failure.
18215:                 let staging_dir = remote_target_windows_utm_staging_dir(target)?;
18216:                 match execute_utm_remote_powershell_capture(
18217:                     utm_name,
18218:                     staging_dir.as_str(),
18219:                     remote_script,
18220:                     timeout,
18221:                 ) {
18222:                     Ok((rc, _output)) => Ok(synthetic_exit_status(rc)),
18223:                     Err(utm_err) => {
18224:                         if ssh_fallback_allowed_for_target(target, phase) {
18225:                             fallback_remote_shell_command_to_ssh(
18226:                                 target,
18227:                                 ssh_user_override,
18228:                                 ssh_identity_file,
18229:                                 known_hosts_path,
18230:                                 remote_script,
18231:                                 timeout,
18232:                                 utm_err.as_str(),
18233:                             )
18234:                         } else {
18235:                             Err(format_windows_access_establishment_transport_error(
18236:                                 target.label.as_str(),
18237:                                 "UTM Windows exec",
18238:                                 utm_err.as_str(),
18239:                             ))
18240:                         }
18241:                     }
18242:                 }
18243:             }
18244:             VmGuestPlatform::Macos => fallback_remote_shell_command_to_ssh(
18245:                 target,
18246:                 ssh_user_override,
18247:                 ssh_identity_file,
18248:                 known_hosts_path,
18249:                 remote_script,
18250:                 timeout,
18251:                 "local UTM guest exec is not yet implemented for macOS targets",
18252:             ),
18253:             VmGuestPlatform::Ios | VmGuestPlatform::Android => Err(format!(
18254:                 "local UTM guest exec is not supported for platform {} ({})",
18255:                 target.platform_profile.platform.as_str(),
18256:                 target.label
18257:             )),
18258:         };
18259:     }
18260:     let ssh_script = remote_script_for_ssh_transport(target, remote_script)?;
18261:     run_remote_shell_command(
18262:         target.ssh_target.as_str(),
18263:         ssh_user_override.or(target.ssh_user.as_deref()),
18264:         ssh_identity_file,
18265:         known_hosts_path,
18266:         ssh_script.as_str(),
18267:         timeout,
18268:     )
18269: }
18270: 
18271: fn run_remote_shell_command_for_target(
18272:     target: &RemoteTarget,
18273:     ssh_user_override: Option<&str>,
18274:     ssh_identity_file: Option<&Path>,
18275:     known_hosts_path: Option<&Path>,
18276:     remote_script: &str,
18277:     timeout: Duration,
18278: ) -> Result<ExitStatus, String> {
18279:     run_remote_shell_command_for_target_with_phase(
18280:         target,
18281:         ssh_user_override,
18282:         ssh_identity_file,
18283:         known_hosts_path,
18284:         remote_script,
18285:         timeout,
18286:         RemoteTransportPhase::PostBootstrap,
18287:     )
18288: }

18290: fn capture_remote_shell_command_for_target_with_phase(
18291:     target: &RemoteTarget,
18292:     ssh_user_override: Option<&str>,
18293:     ssh_identity_file: Option<&Path>,
18294:     known_hosts_path: Option<&Path>,
18295:     remote_script: &str,
18296:     timeout: Duration,
18297:     phase: RemoteTransportPhase,
18298: ) -> Result<String, String> {
18299:     if let Some((utm_name, _)) = remote_target_local_utm(target) {
18300:         return match target.platform_profile.platform {
18301:             VmGuestPlatform::Linux => {
18302:                 let ssh_user = remote_target_effective_user(target, ssh_user_override)?;
18303:                 let home = remote_target_home(ssh_user.as_str());
18304:                 let (rc, output) = match execute_utm_remote_script_as_user(
18305:                     utm_name,
18306:                     ssh_user.as_str(),
18307:                     home.as_str(),
18308:                     remote_script,
18309:                     timeout,
18310:                 ) {
18311:                     Ok(result) => result,
18312:                     Err(err) => {
18313:                         return fallback_capture_remote_shell_command_to_ssh(
18314:                             target,
18315:                             ssh_user_override,
18316:                             ssh_identity_file,
18317:                             known_hosts_path,
18318:                             remote_script,
18319:                             timeout,
18320:                             err.as_str(),
18321:                         );
18322:                     }
18323:                 };
18324:                 if rc != 0 {
18325:                     return Err(format!("remote command exited with status {rc}"));
18326:                 }
18327:                 Ok(output)
18328:             }
18329:             VmGuestPlatform::Windows => {
18330:                 let staging_dir = remote_target_windows_utm_staging_dir(target)?;
18331:                 let utm_result = execute_utm_remote_powershell_capture(
18332:                     utm_name,
18333:                     staging_dir.as_str(),
18334:                     remote_script,
18335:                     timeout,
18336:                 );
18337:                 match utm_result {
18338:                     Ok((rc, output)) => {
18339:                         if rc != 0 {
18340:                             Err(format_remote_capture_exit_error(rc, output.as_str()))
18341:                         } else {
18342:                             Ok(output)
18343:                         }
18344:                     }
18345:                     Err(utm_err) => {
18346:                         if ssh_fallback_allowed_for_target(target, phase) {
18347:                             fallback_capture_remote_shell_command_to_ssh(
18348:                                 target,
18349:                                 ssh_user_override,
18350:                                 ssh_identity_file,
18351:                                 known_hosts_path,
18352:                                 remote_script,
18353:                                 timeout,
18354:                                 utm_err.as_str(),
18355:                             )
18356:                         } else {
18357:                             Err(format_windows_access_establishment_transport_error(
18358:                                 target.label.as_str(),
18359:                                 "UTM Windows capture",
18360:                                 utm_err.as_str(),
18361:                             ))
18362:                         }
18363:                     }
18364:                 }
18365:             }
18366:             VmGuestPlatform::Macos => fallback_capture_remote_shell_command_to_ssh(
18367:                 target,
18368:                 ssh_user_override,
18369:                 ssh_identity_file,
18370:                 known_hosts_path,
18371:                 remote_script,
18372:                 timeout,
18373:                 "local UTM guest exec is not yet implemented for macOS targets",
18374:             ),
18375:             VmGuestPlatform::Ios | VmGuestPlatform::Android => Err(format!(
18376:                 "local UTM guest exec is not supported for platform {} ({})",
18377:                 target.platform_profile.platform.as_str(),
18378:                 target.label
18379:             )),
18380:         };
18381:     }
18382:     let ssh_script = remote_script_for_ssh_transport(target, remote_script)?;
18383:     capture_remote_shell_command(
18384:         target.ssh_target.as_str(),
18385:         ssh_user_override.or(target.ssh_user.as_deref()),
18386:         ssh_identity_file,
18387:         known_hosts_path,
18388:         ssh_script.as_str(),
18389:         timeout,
18390:     )
18391: }
