18393: fn capture_remote_shell_command_for_target(
18394:     target: &RemoteTarget,
18395:     ssh_user_override: Option<&str>,
18396:     ssh_identity_file: Option<&Path>,
18397:     known_hosts_path: Option<&Path>,
18398:     remote_script: &str,
18399:     timeout: Duration,
18400: ) -> Result<String, String> {
18401:     capture_remote_shell_command_for_target_with_phase(
18402:         target,
18403:         ssh_user_override,
18404:         ssh_identity_file,
18405:         known_hosts_path,
18406:         remote_script,
18407:         timeout,
18408:         RemoteTransportPhase::PostBootstrap,
18409:     )
18410: }
18411: 
18412: fn scp_to_remote_for_target_with_phase(
18413:     context: &RemoteFallbackContext<'_>,
18414:     src: &Path,
18415:     dst: &str,
18416:     phase: RemoteTransportPhase,
18417: ) -> Result<ExitStatus, String> {
18418:     let dst = remote_copy_destination_for_target(context.target, dst);
18419:     if let Some((utm_name, _)) = remote_target_local_utm(context.target) {
18420:         return match context.target.platform_profile.platform {
18421:             VmGuestPlatform::Linux => {
18422:                 let ssh_user =
18423:                     remote_target_effective_user(context.target, context.ssh_user_override)?;
18424:                 let status = match utm_push_raw(utm_name, src, dst.as_str(), context.timeout) {
18425:                     Ok(status) if status.success() => status,
18426:                     Ok(status) => {
18427:                         return fallback_scp_to_remote(
18428:                             context,
18429:                             src,
18430:                             dst.as_str(),
18431:                             format!("UTM push failed with status {}", status_code(status)).as_str(),
18432:                         );
18433:                     }
18434:                     Err(err) => {
18435:                         return fallback_scp_to_remote(context, src, dst.as_str(), err.as_str());
18436:                     }
18437:                 };
18438:                 if ssh_user != "root" {
18439:                     let chown_status = utm_exec_root_raw(
18440:                         utm_name,
18441:                         format!(
18442:                             "chown {}:{} {}",
18443:                             shell_quote(ssh_user.as_str()),
18444:                             shell_quote(ssh_user.as_str()),
18445:                             shell_quote(dst.as_str()),
18446:                         )
18447:                         .as_str(),
18448:                         Duration::from_secs(20),
18449:                     )?;
18450:                     if !chown_status.success() {
18451:                         return Ok(chown_status);
18452:                     }
18453:                 }
18454:                 Ok(status)
18455:             }
18456:             VmGuestPlatform::Windows => {
18457:                 // Windows UTM staging strategy:
18458:                 //
18459:                 // - `windows_helper_script_remote_path` and
18460:                 //   `windows_orchestration_root` route helper paths under
18461:                 //   `utm_staging_dir` (typically
18462:                 //   C:\Users\<windows>\rustynet-utm-stage), which both the
18463:                 //   SSH user and the SYSTEM-level guest agent can read+write.
18464:                 // - During access establishment, SSH may be down by
18465:                 //   definition, so use utmctl push for helper/support files
18466:                 //   under staging and fall back to SCP only if the guest
18467:                 //   agent path fails.
18468:                 // - Post-bootstrap paths keep using SCP so ordinary Windows
18469:                 //   targets and SSH-only lab paths exercise the same operator
18470:                 //   transport after access has been proven.
18471:                 //
18472:                 // SCP needs the staging directory to exist (it does not
18473:                 // create intermediate directories). utmctl push also needs
18474:                 // it. Use `utmctl exec` to mkdir it — that's
18475:                 // network-independent and idempotent — before either copy
18476:                 // path runs.
18477:                 if let Some(staging_dir) = context.target.utm_staging_dir.as_deref() {
18478:                     let parent = windows_guest_parent_dir(dst.as_str()).unwrap_or_default();
18479:                     let needs_mkdir =
18480:                         parent.is_empty() || windows_path_is_within(parent.as_str(), staging_dir);
18481:                     if needs_mkdir {
18482:                         let mkdir_target = if parent.is_empty() {
18483:                             staging_dir.to_string()
18484:                         } else {
18485:                             parent
18486:                         };
18487:                         if let Err(err) = ensure_utm_windows_dir(
18488:                             utm_name,
18489:                             mkdir_target.as_str(),
18490:                             context.timeout.min(Duration::from_secs(30)),
18491:                         ) {
18492:                             return Err(format!(
18493:                                 "UTM Windows staging mkdir failed for {} ({}): {err}",
18494:                                 context.target.label, mkdir_target
18495:                             ));
18496:                         }
18497:                     }
18498:                 }
18499:                 if phase == RemoteTransportPhase::AccessEstablishment {
18500:                     match utm_push_raw(utm_name, src, dst.as_str(), context.timeout) {
18501:                         Ok(status) if status.success() => return Ok(status),
18502:                         Ok(status) => {
18503:                             return fallback_scp_to_remote(
18504:                                 context,
18505:                                 src,
18506:                                 dst.as_str(),
18507:                                 format!("UTM push failed with status {}", status_code(status))
18508:                                     .as_str(),
18509:                             );
18510:                         }
18511:                         Err(err) => {
18512:                             return fallback_scp_to_remote(
18513:                                 context,
18514:                                 src,
18515:                                 dst.as_str(),
18516:                                 err.as_str(),
18517:                             );
18518:                         }
18519:                     }
18520:                 }
18521:                 fallback_scp_to_remote(
18522:                     context,
18523:                     src,
18524:                     dst.as_str(),
18525:                     "Windows UTM SCP path uses staging directory directly",
18526:                 )
18527:             }
18528:             VmGuestPlatform::Macos => fallback_scp_to_remote(
18529:                 context,
18530:                 src,
18531:                 dst.as_str(),
18532:                 "local UTM file push is not yet implemented for macOS targets",
18533:             ),
18534:             VmGuestPlatform::Ios | VmGuestPlatform::Android => Err(format!(
18535:                 "local UTM file copy is not supported for platform {} ({})",
18536:                 context.target.platform_profile.platform.as_str(),
18537:                 context.target.label
18538:             )),
18539:         };
18540:     }
18541:     let ssh_user = context
18542:         .ssh_user_override
18543:         .or(context.target.ssh_user.as_deref());
18544:     scp_to_remote(
18545:         src,
18546:         context.target.ssh_target.as_str(),
18547:         ssh_user,
18548:         context.ssh_identity_file,
18549:         context.known_hosts_path,
18550:         dst.as_str(),
18551:         context.timeout,
18552:     )
18553: }
18554: 
18555: fn scp_to_remote_for_target(
18556:     target: &RemoteTarget,
18557:     ssh_user_override: Option<&str>,
18558:     ssh_identity_file: Option<&Path>,
18559:     known_hosts_path: Option<&Path>,
18560:     src: &Path,
18561:     dst: &str,
18562:     timeout: Duration,
18563: ) -> Result<ExitStatus, String> {
18564:     let context = RemoteFallbackContext {
18565:         target,
18566:         ssh_user_override,
18567:         ssh_identity_file,
18568:         known_hosts_path,
18569:         timeout,
18570:     };
18571:     scp_to_remote_for_target_with_phase(&context, src, dst, RemoteTransportPhase::PostBootstrap)
18572: }
18573: 
18574: fn run_remote_shell_command(
18575:     target: &str,
18576:     ssh_user: Option<&str>,
18577:     ssh_identity_file: Option<&Path>,
18578:     known_hosts_path: Option<&Path>,
18579:     remote_script: &str,
18580:     timeout: Duration,
18581: ) -> Result<ExitStatus, String> {
18582:     validate_target_user_combination(target, ssh_user)?;
18583:     let mut command = Command::new("ssh");
18584:     command.args([
18585:         "-n",
18586:         "-o",
18587:         "LogLevel=ERROR",
18588:         "-o",
18589:         "BatchMode=yes",
18590:         "-o",
18591:         "StrictHostKeyChecking=yes",
18592:         "-o",
18593:         "ConnectTimeout=15",
18594:         "-o",
18595:         "ServerAliveInterval=20",
18596:         "-o",
18597:         "ServerAliveCountMax=3",
18598:         "-o",
18599:         "IdentitiesOnly=yes",
18600:     ]);
18601:     append_ssh_transport_options(&mut command, ssh_identity_file, known_hosts_path)?;
18602:     if let Some(ssh_user) = ssh_user {
18603:         command.arg("-l").arg(ssh_user);
18604:     }
18605:     command.arg("--").arg(target).arg(remote_script);
18606:     run_status_with_timeout(&mut command, timeout)
18607: }

18609: fn capture_remote_shell_command(
18610:     target: &str,
18611:     ssh_user: Option<&str>,
18612:     ssh_identity_file: Option<&Path>,
18613:     known_hosts_path: Option<&Path>,
18614:     remote_script: &str,
18615:     timeout: Duration,
18616: ) -> Result<String, String> {
18617:     validate_target_user_combination(target, ssh_user)?;
18618:     let mut command = Command::new("ssh");
18619:     command.args([
18620:         "-n",
18621:         "-o",
18622:         "LogLevel=ERROR",
18623:         "-o",
18624:         "BatchMode=yes",
18625:         "-o",
18626:         "StrictHostKeyChecking=yes",
18627:         "-o",
18628:         "ConnectTimeout=15",
18629:         "-o",
18630:         "ServerAliveInterval=20",
18631:         "-o",
18632:         "ServerAliveCountMax=3",
18633:         "-o",
18634:         "IdentitiesOnly=yes",
18635:     ]);
18636:     append_ssh_transport_options(&mut command, ssh_identity_file, known_hosts_path)?;
18637:     if let Some(ssh_user) = ssh_user {
18638:         command.arg("-l").arg(ssh_user);
18639:     }
18640:     command.arg("--").arg(target).arg(remote_script);
18641:     let output = run_output_with_timeout(&mut command, timeout)?;

18647:     }
18648:     String::from_utf8(output.stdout)
18649:         .map_err(|err| format!("remote output was not valid UTF-8: {err}"))
18650: }

18652: fn scp_to_remote(
18653:     src: &Path,
18654:     target: &str,
18655:     ssh_user: Option<&str>,
18656:     ssh_identity_file: Option<&Path>,
18657:     known_hosts_path: Option<&Path>,
18658:     dst: &str,
18659:     timeout: Duration,
18660: ) -> Result<ExitStatus, String> {
18661:     validate_target_user_combination(target, ssh_user)?;
18662:     ensure_no_control_chars("remote destination path", dst)?;
18663:     let mut command = Command::new("scp");
18664:     command.args([
18665:         "-q",
18666:         "-o",
18667:         "LogLevel=ERROR",
18668:         "-o",
18669:         "BatchMode=yes",
18670:         "-o",
18671:         "StrictHostKeyChecking=yes",
18672:         "-o",
18673:         "ConnectTimeout=15",
18674:         "-o",
18675:         "IdentitiesOnly=yes",
18676:     ]);
18677:     append_ssh_transport_options(&mut command, ssh_identity_file, known_hosts_path)?;
18678:     if let Some(ssh_user) = ssh_user {
18679:         command.arg("-o").arg(format!("User={ssh_user}"));
18680:     }
18681:     command
18682:         .arg("--")
18683:         .arg(src.as_os_str())
18684:         .arg(format!("{target}:{dst}"));
18685:     // Capture stderr.  The previous implementation routed it to /dev/null
18686:     // via run_status_with_timeout, which made every scp failure look like
18687:     // a silent multi-second hang to the orchestrator.  Surfacing the last
18688:     // few stderr lines on non-zero exit makes auth, host-key, and
18689:     // connection-reset failures self-diagnosing.
18690:     let output = run_output_with_timeout(&mut command, timeout)?;
18691:     if !output.status.success() {
18692:         let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr);
18693:         let tail = stderr
18694:             .lines()
18695:             .rev()
18696:             .take(8)
18697:             .collect::<Vec<_>>()
18698:             .into_iter()
18699:             .rev()
18700:             .collect::<Vec<_>>()
18701:             .join(" | ");
18702:         return Err(format!(
18703:             "scp to {target}:{dst} failed with status {}: {}",
18704:             status_code(output.status),
18705:             if tail.is_empty() {
18706:                 "(no stderr)"
18707:             } else {
18708:                 tail.as_str()
18709:             }
18710:         ));
18711:     }
18712:     Ok(output.status)
18713: }
18714: 
18715: fn scp_from_remote(
18716:     target: &RemoteTarget,
18717:     ssh_user: Option<&str>,
18718:     ssh_identity_file: Option<&Path>,
18719:     known_hosts_path: Option<&Path>,
18720:     src: &str,
18721:     dst: &Path,
18722:     timeout: Duration,
18723: ) -> Result<ExitStatus, String> {
18724:     validate_target_user_combination(target.ssh_target.as_str(), ssh_user)?;
18725:     ensure_no_control_chars("remote source path", src)?;
18726:     let mut command = Command::new("scp");
18727:     command.args([
18728:         "-q",
18729:         "-o",
18730:         "LogLevel=ERROR",
18731:         "-o",
18732:         "BatchMode=yes",
18733:         "-o",
18734:         "StrictHostKeyChecking=yes",
18735:         "-o",
18736:         "ConnectTimeout=15",
18737:         "-o",
18738:         "IdentitiesOnly=yes",
18739:     ]);
18740:     append_ssh_transport_options(&mut command, ssh_identity_file, known_hosts_path)?;
18741:     if let Some(ssh_user) = ssh_user {
18742:         command.arg("-o").arg(format!("User={ssh_user}"));
18743:     }
18744:     if let Some(parent) = dst.parent().filter(|path| !path.as_os_str().is_empty()) {
18745:         fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|err| {
18746:             format!(
18747:                 "create remote scp destination dir failed ({}): {err}",
18748:                 parent.display()
18749:             )
18750:         })?;
18751:     }
18752:     command
18753:         .arg("--")
18754:         .arg(format!(
18755:             "{}:{}",
18756:             target.ssh_target,
18757:             remote_copy_source_for_target(target, src)
18758:         ))
18759:         .arg(dst.as_os_str());
18760:     run_status_with_timeout(&mut command, timeout)
18761: }
18762: 
18763: fn run_status_with_timeout(command: &mut Command, timeout: Duration) -> Result<ExitStatus, String> {
18764:     command.stdin(Stdio::null());
18765:     command.stdout(Stdio::null());
18766:     command.stderr(Stdio::null());
18767:     run_status_with_timeout_preserve(command, timeout)
18768: }
18769: 
18770: fn run_status_with_timeout_preserve(
18771:     command: &mut Command,
18772:     timeout: Duration,
18773: ) -> Result<ExitStatus, String> {
18774:     let mut child = command
18775:         .spawn()
18776:         .map_err(|err| format!("spawn failed: {err}"))?;
18777:     let started_at = Instant::now();
18778:     loop {
18779:         if let Some(status) = child
18780:             .try_wait()
18781:             .map_err(|err| format!("wait failed: {err}"))?
18782:         {
18783:             return Ok(status);
18784:         }
18785:         if started_at.elapsed() >= timeout {
18786:             let _ = child.kill();
18787:             let _ = child.wait();
18788:             return Err(format!("timed out after {} seconds", timeout.as_secs()));
18789:         }
18790:         thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(POLL_INTERVAL_MILLIS));
18791:     }
18792: }
18793: 
18794: fn run_output_with_timeout(
18795:     command: &mut Command,
18796:     timeout: Duration,
18797: ) -> Result<std::process::Output, String> {
18798:     command.stdin(Stdio::null());
18799:     command.stdout(Stdio::piped());
18800:     command.stderr(Stdio::piped());
18801:     run_output_with_timeout_preserve(command, timeout)
18802: }
18803: 
18804: fn run_output_with_timeout_preserve(
18805:     command: &mut Command,
18806:     timeout: Duration,
18807: ) -> Result<std::process::Output, String> {
18808:     let mut child = command
18809:         .spawn()
18810:         .map_err(|err| format!("spawn failed: {err}"))?;
18811:     let started_at = Instant::now();
18812:     loop {
18813:         if child
18814:             .try_wait()
18815:             .map_err(|err| format!("wait failed: {err}"))?
18816:             .is_some()
18817:         {
18818:             return child
18819:                 .wait_with_output()
18820:                 .map_err(|err| format!("collect output failed: {err}"));
18821:         }
18822:         if started_at.elapsed() >= timeout {
18823:             let _ = child.kill();
18824:             let _ = child.wait();
18825:             return Err(format!("timed out after {} seconds", timeout.as_secs()));
18826:         }
18827:         thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(POLL_INTERVAL_MILLIS));
18828:     }
18829: }
18830:

18843:         {

18845:         }

18847:             let _ = child.kill();

18850:         }
18851:         thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(POLL_INTERVAL_MILLIS));
18852:     }
18853: }

18855: fn transition_local_utm_vm(
18856:     utmctl_path: &Path,
18857:     utm_name: &str,
18858:     bundle_path: &Path,
18859:     action: &str,
18860:     expected_process_present: bool,
18861:     timeout: Duration,
18862: ) -> Result<(), String> {
18863:     transition_local_utm_vm_with_process_probe(
18864:         utmctl_path,
18865:         Path::new("ps"),
18866:         utm_name,
18867:         bundle_path,
18868:         action,
18869:         expected_process_present,
18870:         timeout,
18871:     )
18872: }
18873: 
18874: fn transition_local_utm_vm_with_process_probe(
18875:     utmctl_path: &Path,
18876:     ps_path: &Path,
18877:     utm_name: &str,
18878:     bundle_path: &Path,
18879:     action: &str,
18880:     expected_process_present: bool,
18881:     timeout: Duration,
18882: ) -> Result<(), String> {
18883:     let observed = local_utm_process_present_with_probes(
18884:         utmctl_path,
18885:         ps_path,
18886:         utm_name,
18887:         bundle_path,
18888:         timeout,
18889:     )?;
18890:     if observed == expected_process_present {
18891:         return Ok(());
18892:     }
18893: 
18894:     let mut command = Command::new(utmctl_path);
18895:     command.arg(action).arg(utm_name);
18896:     let status = match run_status_with_timeout(&mut command, timeout) {
18897:         Ok(status) => status,
18898:         Err(err) => {
18899:             match wait_for_local_utm_process_state_with_probes(
18900:                 utmctl_path,
18901:                 ps_path,
18902:                 utm_name,
18903:                 bundle_path,
18904:                 expected_process_present,
18905:                 transition_reconciliation_timeout(timeout),
18906:             ) {
18907:                 Ok(()) => return Ok(()),
18908:                 Err(probe_err) => {
18909:                     return Err(format!(
18910:                         "{err}; follow-up process-state probe failed: {probe_err}"
18911:                     ));
18912:                 }
18913:             }
18914:         }
18915:     };
18916:     if !status.success() {
18917:         match wait_for_local_utm_process_state_with_probes(
18918:             utmctl_path,
18919:             ps_path,
18920:             utm_name,
18921:             bundle_path,
18922:             expected_process_present,
18923:             transition_reconciliation_timeout(timeout),
18924:         ) {
18925:             Ok(()) => return Ok(()),
18926:             Err(probe_err) => {
18927:                 return Err(format!(
18928:                     "{action} exited with status {}; follow-up process-state probe failed: {probe_err}",
18929:                     status_code(status)
18930:                 ));
18931:             }
18932:         }
18933:     }
18934:     wait_for_local_utm_process_state_with_probes(
18935:         utmctl_path,
18936:         ps_path,
18937:         utm_name,
18938:         bundle_path,
18939:         expected_process_present,
18940:         timeout,
18941:     )
18942: }
18943: 
18944: fn wait_for_local_utm_process_state_with_probes(
18945:     utmctl_path: &Path,
18946:     ps_path: &Path,
18947:     utm_name: &str,
18948:     bundle_path: &Path,
18949:     expected_present: bool,
18950:     timeout: Duration,
18951: ) -> Result<(), String> {
18952:     let started_at = Instant::now();
18953:     loop {
18954:         let observed = local_utm_process_present_with_probes(
18955:             utmctl_path,
18956:             ps_path,
18957:             utm_name,
18958:             bundle_path,
18959:             timeout,
18960:         )?;
18961:         if observed == expected_present {
18962:             return Ok(());
18963:         }
18964:         if started_at.elapsed() >= timeout {
18965:             return Err(format!(
18966:                 "timed out waiting for local UTM process presence={} for {}",
18967:                 expected_present,
18968:                 bundle_path.display()
18969:             ));
18970:         }
18971:         thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(POLL_INTERVAL_MILLIS));
18972:     }
18973: }
18974: 
18975: fn local_utm_process_present_with_probes(
18976:     utmctl_path: &Path,
18977:     ps_path: &Path,
18978:     utm_name: &str,
18979:     bundle_path: &Path,
18980:     timeout: Duration,
18981: ) -> Result<bool, String> {
18982:     match local_utm_process_present_with_utmctl_list(utmctl_path, utm_name, timeout) {
18983:         Ok(Some(present)) => return Ok(present),
18984:         Ok(None) => {}
18985:         Err(utmctl_err) => {
18986:             return local_utm_process_present_with_ps(ps_path, bundle_path, timeout).map_err(
18987:                 |ps_err| {
18988:                     format!(
18989:                         "utmctl process probe failed: {utmctl_err}; ps process probe failed: {ps_err}"
18990:                     )
18991:                 },
18992:             );
18993:         }
18994:     }
18995:     local_utm_process_present_with_ps(ps_path, bundle_path, timeout)
18996: }
18997: 
18998: fn local_utm_process_present_with_utmctl_list(
18999:     utmctl_path: &Path,
19000:     utm_name: &str,
19001:     timeout: Duration,
19002: ) -> Result<Option<bool>, String> {
19003:     if !utmctl_path.is_file() {
19004:         return Ok(None);
19005:     }
19006:     let mut command = Command::new(utmctl_path);
19007:     command.arg("list");
19008:     let output = run_output_with_timeout(&mut command, timeout)?;
19009:     if !output.status.success() {
19010:         return Ok(None);
19011:     }
19012:     let stdout = String::from_utf8(output.stdout)
19013:         .map_err(|err| format!("utmctl list returned non-UTF-8 output: {err}"))?;
19014:     Ok(parse_local_utm_list_started_status(
19015:         stdout.as_str(),
19016:         utm_name,
19017:     ))
19018: }
19019: 
19020: fn local_utm_process_present_with_ps(
19021:     ps_path: &Path,
19022:     bundle_path: &Path,
19023:     timeout: Duration,
19024: ) -> Result<bool, String> {
19025:     let mut command = Command::new(ps_path);
19026:     command.args(["axww", "-o", "command"]);
19027:     let output = run_output_with_timeout(&mut command, timeout)?;
19028:     if !output.status.success() {
19029:         return Err(format!(
19030:             "ps exited with status {}",
19031:             status_code(output.status)
19032:         ));
19033:     }
19034:     let ps_output = String::from_utf8(output.stdout)
19035:         .map_err(|err| format!("ps returned non-UTF-8 output: {err}"))?;
19036:     Ok(local_utm_process_present_in_ps_output(
19037:         ps_output.as_str(),
19038:         bundle_path,
19039:     ))
19040: }
19041: 
19042: fn local_utm_process_present_in_ps_output(ps_output: &str, bundle_path: &Path) -> bool {
19043:     let needle = bundle_path.display().to_string();
19044:     ps_output
19045:         .lines()
19046:         .any(|line| line.contains("QEMULauncher") && line.contains(needle.as_str()))
19047: }
19048: 
19049: fn parse_local_utm_list_started_status(list_output: &str, utm_name: &str) -> Option<bool> {
19050:     list_output.lines().find_map(|line| {
19051:         let trimmed = line.trim();
19052:         if trimmed.is_empty() || trimmed.starts_with("UUID") {
19053:             return None;
19054:         }
19055: 
19056:         let mut parts = trimmed.split_whitespace();
19057:         let _uuid = parts.next()?;
19058:         let status = parts.next()?;
19059:         let name_start = trimmed.find(status)? + status.len();
19060:         let name = trimmed[name_start..].trim();
19061:         if name != utm_name {
19062:             return None;
19063:         }
19064: 
19065:         Some(status == "started")
19066:     })
19067: }
19068: 
19069: fn transition_reconciliation_timeout(_timeout: Duration) -> Duration {
19070:     Duration::from_secs(15)
19071: }
19072: 
19073: fn timeout_or_default(value: u64, default_secs: u64) -> Duration {
19074:     let secs = if value == 0 { default_secs } else { value };
19075:     Duration::from_secs(secs)
19076: }
19077: 
19078: fn status_code(status: ExitStatus) -> i32 {
19079:     match status.code() {
19080:         Some(code) => code,
19081:         None => {
19082:             #[cfg(unix)]
19083:             {
19084:                 use std::os::unix::process::ExitStatusExt;
19085: 
19086:                 match status.signal() {
19087:                     Some(signal) => 128 + signal,
19088:                     None => 1,
19089:                 }
19090:             }
19091:             #[cfg(not(unix))]
19092:             {
19093:                 1
19094:             }
19095:         }
19096:     }
19097: }
19098: 
19099: fn ensure_success_status(status: ExitStatus, label: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
19100:     if status.success() {
19101:         Ok(())
19102:     } else {
19103:         Err(format!(
19104:             "{label} failed with status {}",
19105:             status_code(status)
19106:         ))
19107:     }
19108: }
19109: 
19110: fn ensure_no_control_chars(label: &str, value: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
19111:     if value.trim().is_empty() {
19112:         return Err(format!("{label} must not be empty"));
19113:     }
19114:     if value
19115:         .chars()
19116:         .any(|ch| ch == '\0' || ch == '\n' || ch == '\r')
19117:     {
19118:         return Err(format!("{label} contains unsupported control characters"));
19119:     }
19120:     Ok(())
19121: }
19122: 
19123: fn ensure_local_regular_file_path(path: &Path, label: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
19124:     let metadata = fs::metadata(path)
19125:         .map_err(|err| format!("{label} metadata read failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
19126:     if !metadata.is_file() {
19127:         return Err(format!(
19128:             "{label} must be a regular file: {}",
19129:             path.display()
19130:         ));
19131:     }
19132:     Ok(())
19133: }
19134: 
19135: fn ensure_local_directory_path(path: &Path, label: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
19136:     let metadata = fs::metadata(path)
19137:         .map_err(|err| format!("{label} metadata read failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
19138:     if !metadata.is_dir() {
19139:         return Err(format!("{label} must be a directory: {}", path.display()));
19140:     }
19141:     Ok(())
19142: }
19143: 
19144: fn shell_quote(value: &str) -> String {
19145:     let mut out = String::from("'");
19146:     for ch in value.chars() {
19147:         if ch == '\'' {
19148:             out.push_str("'\\''");
19149:         } else {
19150:             out.push(ch);
19151:         }
19152:     }
19153:     out.push('\'');
19154:     out
19155: }
19156: 
19157: fn powershell_quote(value: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
19158:     ensure_no_control_chars("PowerShell literal", value)?;
19159:     Ok(format!("'{}'", value.replace('\'', "''")))
19160: }
19161: 
19162: fn encode_powershell_command(script: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
19163:     if script.chars().any(|ch| ch == '\0') {
19164:         return Err("PowerShell script contains unsupported NUL byte".to_string());
19165:     }
19166:     let mut bytes = Vec::with_capacity(script.len() * 2);
19167:     for unit in script.encode_utf16() {
19168:         bytes.extend_from_slice(&unit.to_le_bytes());
19169:     }
19170:     Ok(BASE64_STANDARD.encode(bytes))
19171: }
19172: 
19173: fn build_ssh_powershell_encoded_invocation(script: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
19174:     let encoded = encode_powershell_command(script)?;
19175:     Ok(format!(
19176:         "powershell.exe -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -EncodedCommand {encoded}"
19177:     ))
19178: }

19180: fn build_remote_argv_powershell_script(
19181:     workdir: &str,
19182:     program: &str,
19183:     argv: &[String],
19184: ) -> Result<String, String> {
19185:     ensure_no_control_chars("workdir", workdir)?;
19186:     ensure_no_control_chars("program", program)?;
19187:     let mut script = String::new();
19188:     script.push_str("Set-StrictMode -Version Latest; ");
19189:     script.push_str("$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; ");
19190:     script.push_str(format!("Set-Location -LiteralPath {}; ", powershell_quote(workdir)?).as_str());
19191:     script.push_str(format!("& {}", powershell_quote(program)?).as_str());
19192:     for arg in argv {
19193:         ensure_no_control_chars("command arg", arg.as_str())?;
19194:         script.push(' ');
19195:         script.push_str(powershell_quote(arg.as_str())?.as_str());
19196:     }
19197:     script.push_str("; $lastExitCode = Get-Variable -Name LASTEXITCODE -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($null -ne $lastExitCode -and [int]$lastExitCode.Value -ne 0) { exit [int]$lastExitCode.Value }");
19198:     Ok(script)
19199: }
19200: 
19201: fn build_remote_argv_script_for_target(
19202:     target: &RemoteTarget,
19203:     workdir: &str,
19204:     program: &str,
19205:     argv: &[String],
19206:     sudo: bool,
19207: ) -> Result<String, String> {
19208:     match target.platform_profile.remote_shell {
19209:         VmRemoteShell::Posix => build_remote_argv_script(workdir, program, argv, sudo),
19210:         VmRemoteShell::Powershell => {
19211:             if sudo {
19212:                 return Err(format!(
19213:                     "sudo is not supported for Windows targets: {}",
19214:                     target.label
19215:                 ));
19216:             }
19217:             build_remote_argv_powershell_script(workdir, program, argv)
19218:         }
19219:         VmRemoteShell::Unsupported => Err(format!(
19220:             "vm-lab remote shell is not yet implemented for platform {} ({})",
19221:             target.platform_profile.platform.as_str(),
19222:             target.label
19223:         )),
19224:     }
19225: }

19262: fn windows_guest_path_join(root: &str, file_name: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
19263:     ensure_no_control_chars("Windows guest root", root)?;
19264:     ensure_no_control_chars("Windows guest file name", file_name)?;
19265:     let trimmed = root.trim_end_matches(['\\', '/']);
19266:     Ok(format!(r"{trimmed}\{file_name}"))
19267: }
19268: 
19269: /// Strip the trailing path component from a Windows guest path. Returns
19270: /// an empty string when the path has no parent (single component or empty).
19271: /// Tolerates both `\` and `/` separators.
19272: fn windows_guest_parent_dir(path: &str) -> Option<String> {
19273:     let last = path.rfind(['\\', '/']).filter(|idx| *idx > 0)?;
19274:     Some(path[..last].to_string())
19275: }
19276: 
19277: /// True when `path` lies at or below `root`, treating both `\` and `/` as
19278: /// path separators and ignoring case (Windows file systems are typically
19279: /// case-insensitive).
19280: fn windows_path_is_within(path: &str, root: &str) -> bool {
19281:     fn normalize(value: &str) -> String {
19282:         value
19283:             .replace('/', "\\")
19284:             .trim_end_matches('\\')
19285:             .to_ascii_lowercase()
19286:     }
19287:     let path_norm = normalize(path);
19288:     let root_norm = normalize(root);
19289:     if root_norm.is_empty() {
19290:         return false;
19291:     }
19292:     if path_norm == root_norm {
19293:         return true;
19294:     }
19295:     let prefix = format!("{root_norm}\\");
19296:     path_norm.starts_with(prefix.as_str())
19297: }
19298: 
19299: /// Single source of truth for "where does Windows orchestration scratch go?"
19300: ///
19301: /// For Windows local-UTM targets, returns `utm_staging_dir` so that both
19302: /// halves of the transport share one directory:
19303: /// - SCP staging (runs as the SSH user `windows`) can write there because
19304: ///   `C:\Users\windows\...` inherits `windows:F`.
19305: /// - `utmctl exec` (runs as `NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM`) can read+write there
19306: ///   because the same path inherits `SYSTEM:F`.
19307: ///
19308: /// For non-UTM Windows targets and other platforms, returns
19309: /// `remote_temp_dir`. That preserves vm-lab semantics for SSH-only
19310: /// Windows hosts (lab-LAN, future cloud) where the SYSTEM ACL clash
19311: /// does not apply.
19312: fn windows_orchestration_root(target: &RemoteTarget) -> String {
19313:     if target.platform_profile.platform == VmGuestPlatform::Windows
19314:         && remote_target_local_utm(target).is_some()
19315:         && let Some(staging) = target.utm_staging_dir.as_deref()
19316:     {
19317:         return staging.to_string();
19318:     }
19319:     target
19320:         .remote_temp_dir
19321:         .clone()
19322:         .unwrap_or_else(|| default_remote_temp_dir_for_profile(target.platform_profile))
19323: }
19324: 
19325: fn windows_helper_script_remote_path(
19326:     target: &RemoteTarget,
19327:     file_name: &str,
19328: ) -> Result<String, String> {
19329:     let remote_root = windows_orchestration_root(target);
19330:     windows_guest_path_join(remote_root.as_str(), file_name)
19331: }
19332: 
19333: fn utm_exec_windows_raw(
19334:     utm_name: &str,
19335:     powershell_script: &str,
19336:     timeout: Duration,
19337: ) -> Result<ExitStatus, String> {
19338:     ensure_no_control_chars("UTM exec command", powershell_script)?;
19339:     // Prepend $ProgressPreference suppression so PowerShell's "Preparing
19340:     // modules for first use" progress record (and any other progress
19341:     // record) does not get serialized to stderr as a CLIXML envelope.
19342:     // Observed on a freshly-booted Windows guest: the first powershell
19343:     // -EncodedCommand under utmctl exec emits "#< CLIXML ...<Progress
19344:     // .../>...</Objs>" on stderr even when the command itself runs fine
19345:     // and exits 0.  Without suppression we treat that benign noise as a
19346:     // hard failure.
19347:     let wrapped_script = format!(
19348:         "$ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'; $VerbosePreference = 'SilentlyContinue'; $InformationPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'; {powershell_script}"
19349:     );
19350:     let encoded = encode_powershell_command(wrapped_script.as_str())?;
19351:     let utmctl_path = utmctl_binary_path()?;
19352:     let mut command = Command::new(utmctl_path);
19353:     command.arg("exec").arg(utm_name);
19354:     append_utmctl_windows_exec_command(
19355:         &mut command,
19356:         &[
19357:             // UTM Windows guest exec accepts absolute Windows paths when
19358:             // the separators are forward slashes. Backslash separators can
19359:             // be misparsed by the guest agent and leak literal `--cmd`
19360:             // tokens into PowerShell.
19361:             "C:/Windows/System32/WindowsPowerShell/v1.0/powershell.exe",
19362:             "-NoLogo",
19363:             "-NoProfile",
19364:             "-NonInteractive",
19365:             "-OutputFormat",
19366:             "Text",
19367:             "-ExecutionPolicy",
19368:             "Bypass",
19369:             "-EncodedCommand",
19370:             encoded.as_str(),
19371:         ],
19372:     );
19373:     // Retry up to 3 times: rapid back-to-back utmctl exec calls intermittently
19374:     // return exit 1 with empty stderr on macOS when the UTM guest agent is still
19375:     // processing the previous command's Apple Event.  This is not a script error
19376:     // (PowerShell exit codes are not forwarded by utmctl) — it is a host-side
19377:     // transient.  Sleep briefly and retry; keep the last attempt's result.
19378:     const UTMCTL_EXEC_RETRIES: u32 = 3;
19379:     const UTMCTL_EXEC_RETRY_SLEEP_MS: u64 = 600;
19380:     let mut last_output = None;
19381:     for attempt in 0..=UTMCTL_EXEC_RETRIES {
19382:         let output = run_output_with_timeout(&mut command, timeout)?;
19383:         let stderr_raw = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr);
19384:         // Strip CLIXML envelopes from the stderr stream defensively even
19385:         // after the preference suppression above: nested PowerShell calls
19386:         // (like the build-release wrapper invoking another powershell.exe
19387:         // -EncodedCommand) can re-emit them.  CLIXML payloads start with
19388:         // "#< CLIXML" and continue as XML; everything around them (real
19389:         // utmctl host errors like "OSStatus error -2700" / "Access is
19390:         // denied") is what we actually care about.
19391:         let stderr_filtered = strip_powershell_clixml_noise(stderr_raw.as_ref())
19392:             .trim()
19393:             .to_string();
19394:         if !stderr_filtered.is_empty() {
19395:             return Err(format!(
19396:                 "UTM Windows exec reported error for {utm_name}: {stderr_filtered}"
19397:             ));
19398:         }
19399:         if output.status.success() || attempt == UTMCTL_EXEC_RETRIES {
19400:             last_output = Some(output);
19401:             break;
19402:         }
19403:         // exit non-zero + empty stderr = UTM agent transient; retry after brief sleep
19404:         thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(UTMCTL_EXEC_RETRY_SLEEP_MS));
19405:     }
19406:     Ok(last_output
19407:         .expect("retry loop always sets last_output")
19408:         .status)
19409: }
19410: 
19411: fn append_utmctl_windows_exec_command(command: &mut Command, args: &[&str]) {
19412:     // `utmctl exec <vm> --cmd <cmd> ...` accepts one variadic `--cmd`
19413:     // option. On the Windows guest-agent path used by the live lab,
19414:     // repeating `--cmd` for every argv element can return host success
19415:     // while the guest command never runs, leaving no result file for the
19416:     // orchestrator to pull. Keep the boundary argv-only by passing every
19417:     // element as a separate `Command` arg after a single `--cmd`.
19418:     command.arg("--cmd");
19419:     for arg in args {
19420:         command.arg(arg);
19421:     }
19422: }
19423: 
19424: /// Remove PowerShell CLIXML serialization payloads from a stderr buffer.
19425: ///
19426: /// PowerShell, when invoked as a child process with `-OutputFormat Text`,
19427: /// still emits its non-stdout streams (Progress, Verbose, Information,
19428: /// sometimes Error and Warning records) as a CLIXML envelope on stderr
19429: /// the first time the host runspace initializes after a cold boot or a
19430: /// module-cache invalidation.  Setting `$ProgressPreference =
19431: /// 'SilentlyContinue'` reduces it but does not eliminate it, because the
19432: /// CLIXML emitter is per-runspace and the OUTER runspace activates
19433: /// before our wrapper script runs.
19434: ///
19435: /// The CLIXML payload always begins with the literal `#< CLIXML` marker
19436: /// followed by an XML envelope.  This helper drops that marker and any
19437: /// XML-like lines, returning whatever else is left.  Real utmctl host
19438: /// failures (Apple Events errors, OSStatus codes, "Access is denied"
19439: /// from the guest agent) are plain text and pass through untouched.
19440: fn strip_powershell_clixml_noise(stderr: &str) -> String {
19441:     let mut kept = Vec::new();
19442:     let mut in_clixml = false;
19443:     for line in stderr.lines() {
19444:         let trimmed = line.trim_start();
19445:         if trimmed.starts_with("#< CLIXML") {
19446:             in_clixml = true;
19447:             continue;
19448:         }
19449:         if in_clixml {
19450:             // CLIXML payload is XML; once we hit the closing </Objs> we
19451:             // exit the block.  Any line that is empty or starts with '<'
19452:             // is treated as part of the envelope.
19453:             if trimmed.starts_with("</Objs>") {
19454:                 in_clixml = false;
19455:                 continue;
19456:             }
19457:             if trimmed.is_empty() || trimmed.starts_with('<') {
19458:                 continue;
19459:             }
19460:             // Defensive: a non-XML, non-empty line inside what we
19461:             // thought was a CLIXML block means the envelope ended
19462:             // unexpectedly.  Keep this line and exit the block.
19463:             in_clixml = false;
19464:             kept.push(line);
19465:             continue;
19466:         }
19467:         kept.push(line);
19468:     }
19469:     kept.join("\n")
19470: }
19471: 
19472: fn format_remote_capture_exit_error(rc: i32, output: &str) -> String {
19473:     let trimmed = output.trim();
19474:     if trimmed.is_empty() {
19475:         format!("remote command exited with status {rc}")
19476:     } else {
19477:         format!("remote command exited with status {rc}: {trimmed}")
19478:     }
19479: }
19480: 
19481: /// Build a PowerShell wrapper script that runs `powershell_script` and
19482: /// writes its captured output and exit code to two files in the staging
19483: /// directory. utmctl exec exposes only the guest exit code (no stdout
19484: /// or stderr capture), so we redirect the inner script's combined
19485: /// streams to a file the host can `utm_pull` afterwards.
19486: fn build_utm_windows_result_file_wrapper_script(
19487:     powershell_script: &str,
19488:     remote_output_path: &str,
19489:     remote_rc_path: &str,
19490: ) -> Result<String, String> {
19491:     let encoded_body = encode_powershell_command(powershell_script)?;
19492:     Ok(format!(
19493:         "Set-StrictMode -Version Latest; \
19494:          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; \
19495:          $ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'; \
19496:          $outputPath = {output_path}; \
19497:          $rcPath = {rc_path}; \
19498:          foreach ($path in @($outputPath, $rcPath)) {{ \
19499:            $parent = Split-Path -Path $path -Parent; \
19500:            if ($parent -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $parent)) {{ \
19501:              New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $parent -Force | Out-Null \
19502:            }}; \
19503:            if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $path) {{ \
19504:              Remove-Item -LiteralPath $path -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue \
19505:            }} \
19506:          }}; \
19507:          $rc = 0; \
19508:          $captured = ''; \
19509:          $psExe = Join-Path $env:WINDIR 'System32\\WindowsPowerShell\\v1.0\\powershell.exe'; \
19510:          if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $psExe)) {{ $psExe = 'powershell.exe' }}; \
19511:          try {{ \
19512:            $captured = (& $psExe -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -OutputFormat Text -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -EncodedCommand {encoded_body} *>&1 | Out-String); \
19513:            $rcVar = Get-Variable -Name LASTEXITCODE -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; \
19514:            if ($null -ne $rcVar -and $null -ne $rcVar.Value) {{ \
19515:              $rcRaw = $rcVar.Value; \
19516:              if ($rcRaw -is [System.Management.Automation.PSVariable]) {{ $rcRaw = $rcRaw.Value }}; \
19517:              if ($null -ne $rcRaw -and [string]$rcRaw -match '^-?[0-9]+$') {{ \
19518:                $rc = [int]$rcRaw \
19519:              }} \
19520:            }} elseif (-not $?) {{ \
19521:              $rc = 1 \
19522:            }} \
19523:          }} catch {{ \
19524:            $captured = ($_ | Out-String); \
19525:            $rc = 1 \
19526:          }}; \
19527:          if ($null -eq $captured) {{ $captured = '' }}; \
19528:          Set-Content -LiteralPath $outputPath -Value ([string]$captured) -Encoding utf8; \
19529:          Set-Content -LiteralPath $rcPath -Value ([string]$rc) -Encoding ascii; \
19530:          exit 0",
19531:         encoded_body = powershell_quote(encoded_body.as_str())?,
19532:         output_path = powershell_quote(remote_output_path)?,
19533:         rc_path = powershell_quote(remote_rc_path)?,
19534:     ))
19535: }
19536: 
19537: /// Execute a PowerShell script on a Windows UTM guest via the guest agent
19538: /// (network-independent) and return its (exit_code, captured_output).
19539: ///
19540: /// Mechanism:
19541: /// 1. Wrap the script so it writes output and rc to two files in
19542: ///    `staging_dir` (which must be SYSTEM-writable; see
19543: ///    [`default_utm_staging_dir_for_profile`]).
19544: /// 2. `utmctl exec` the wrapper (one round-trip; runs as SYSTEM in-guest).
19545: /// 3. `utmctl file pull` the rc and output files back.
19546: /// 4. Best-effort remove the remote files.
19547: ///
19548: /// This survives mid-orchestration network changes (e.g. WireGuard
19549: /// interface coming up and reordering routes) because it never touches
19550: /// SSH. It is the primary control channel for Windows UTM guests; SSH
19551: /// is the fallback when utmctl itself errors.
19552: fn execute_utm_remote_powershell_capture(
19553:     utm_name: &str,
19554:     staging_dir: &str,
19555:     powershell_script: &str,
19556:     timeout: Duration,
19557: ) -> Result<(i32, String), String> {
19558:     if powershell_script.chars().any(|ch| ch == '\0') {
19559:         return Err("UTM remote PowerShell script contains unsupported NUL byte".to_string());
19560:     }
19561:     ensure_no_control_chars("UTM Windows staging dir", staging_dir)?;
19562: 
19563:     // Make sure the staging directory exists before the wrapper runs.
19564:     // The wrapper itself also creates output-file parents defensively,
19565:     // but pulling from a missing dir would still fail.
19566:     ensure_utm_windows_dir(utm_name, staging_dir, timeout.min(Duration::from_secs(30)))?;
19567: 
19568:     let local_root =
19569:         std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("rustynet-vm-lab-windows-exec-{}", unique_suffix()));
19570:     fs::create_dir_all(local_root.as_path()).map_err(|err| {
19571:         format!(
19572:             "create local Windows UTM exec dir failed ({}): {err}",
19573:             local_root.display()
19574:         )
19575:     })?;
19576:     let local_output_path = local_root.join("output.txt");
19577:     let local_rc_path = local_root.join("rc.txt");
19578:     let separator = if staging_dir.ends_with('\\') {
19579:         ""
19580:     } else {
19581:         "\\"
19582:     };
19583:     let unique = unique_suffix();
19584:     let remote_output_path = format!("{staging_dir}{separator}rn-utm-exec.{unique}.out");
19585:     let remote_rc_path = format!("{staging_dir}{separator}rn-utm-exec.{unique}.rc");
19586: 
19587:     let cleanup = |reason_root: &Path| {
19588:         let _ = best_effort_remove_windows_local_utm_guest_file(
19589:             utm_name,
19590:             remote_output_path.as_str(),
19591:             Duration::from_secs(20),
19592:         );
19593:         let _ = best_effort_remove_windows_local_utm_guest_file(
19594:             utm_name,
19595:             remote_rc_path.as_str(),
19596:             Duration::from_secs(20),
19597:         );
19598:         let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(reason_root);
19599:     };
19600: 
19601:     let wrapped_script = match build_utm_windows_result_file_wrapper_script(
19602:         powershell_script,
19603:         remote_output_path.as_str(),
19604:         remote_rc_path.as_str(),
19605:     ) {
19606:         Ok(script) => script,
19607:         Err(err) => {
19608:             cleanup(local_root.as_path());
19609:             return Err(err);
19610:         }
19611:     };
19612: 
19613:     let host_status = utm_exec_windows_raw(utm_name, wrapped_script.as_str(), timeout);
19614:     if let Err(host_err) = host_status.as_ref() {
19615:         cleanup(local_root.as_path());
19616:         return Err(format!(
19617:             "UTM Windows exec failed for {utm_name} before result file could be written: {host_err}"
19618:         ));
19619:     }
19620: 
19621:     let rc_pull = pull_windows_local_utm_guest_file_with_retry(
19622:         utm_name,
19623:         remote_rc_path.as_str(),
19624:         local_rc_path.as_path(),
19625:         timeout,
19626:         "UTM Windows rc",
19627:     );
19628:     if let Err(pull_error) = rc_pull {
19629:         let pull_failure_msg = format_windows_local_utm_result_pull_failure(
19630:             "UTM Windows PowerShell capture",
19631:             utm_name,
19632:             &host_status,
19633:             pull_error.as_str(),
19634:         );
19635:         cleanup(local_root.as_path());
19636:         return Err(pull_failure_msg);
19637:     }
19638: 
19639:     let rc_text = match read_windows_local_utm_utf8_file(local_rc_path.as_path(), "UTM Windows rc")
19640:     {
19641:         Ok(text) => text,
19642:         Err(err) => {
19643:             cleanup(local_root.as_path());
19644:             return Err(err);
19645:         }
19646:     };
19647:     let rc = match rc_text.trim().parse::<i32>() {
19648:         Ok(rc) => rc,
19649:         Err(_) => {
19650:             let trimmed = rc_text.trim().to_string();
19651:             cleanup(local_root.as_path());
19652:             return Err(format!(
19653:                 "UTM Windows rc was not a valid integer for {utm_name}: {trimmed}"
19654:             ));
19655:         }
19656:     };
19657: 
19658:     let output_pull = pull_windows_local_utm_guest_file_with_retry(
19659:         utm_name,
19660:         remote_output_path.as_str(),
19661:         local_output_path.as_path(),
19662:         timeout,
19663:         "UTM Windows output",
19664:     );
19665:     if let Err(pull_error) = output_pull {
19666:         let pull_failure_msg = format_windows_local_utm_result_pull_failure(
19667:             "UTM Windows PowerShell capture",
19668:             utm_name,
19669:             &host_status,
19670:             pull_error.as_str(),
19671:         );
19672:         cleanup(local_root.as_path());
19673:         return Err(pull_failure_msg);
19674:     }
19675: 
19676:     let output =
19677:         match read_windows_local_utm_utf8_file(local_output_path.as_path(), "UTM Windows output") {
19678:             Ok(text) => text,
19679:             Err(err) => {
19680:                 cleanup(local_root.as_path());
19681:                 return Err(err);
19682:             }
19683:         };
19684: 
19685:     cleanup(local_root.as_path());
19686:     Ok((rc, output))
19687: }
19688: 
19689: fn stage_windows_helper_script_from_path(
19690:     context: &RemoteFallbackContext<'_>,
19691:     local_path: &Path,
19692:     remote_file_name: &str,
19693: ) -> Result<String, String> {
19694:     let phase = if windows_local_utm_execution_authority(context.target, false).is_some() {
19695:         RemoteTransportPhase::AccessEstablishment
19696:     } else {
19697:         RemoteTransportPhase::PostBootstrap
19698:     };
19699:     stage_windows_helper_script_from_path_with_phase(context, local_path, remote_file_name, phase)
19700: }
19701: 
19702: fn stage_windows_helper_script_from_path_with_phase(
19703:     context: &RemoteFallbackContext<'_>,
19704:     local_path: &Path,
19705:     remote_file_name: &str,
19706:     phase: RemoteTransportPhase,
19707: ) -> Result<String, String> {
19708:     ensure_local_regular_file_path(local_path, "Windows helper script")?;
19709:     let remote_path = windows_helper_script_remote_path(context.target, remote_file_name)?;
19710:     let status =
19711:         scp_to_remote_for_target_with_phase(context, local_path, remote_path.as_str(), phase)?;
19712:     if !status.success() {
19713:         return Err(format!(
19714:             "stage Windows helper script failed with status {} ({})",
19715:             status_code(status),
19716:             local_path.display()
19717:         ));
19718:     }
19719:     Ok(remote_path)
19720: }
19721: 
19722: fn stage_windows_helper_script(
19723:     context: &RemoteFallbackContext<'_>,
19724:     helper_file_name: &str,
19725:     remote_file_name: &str,
19726: ) -> Result<String, String> {
19727:     let local_path = windows_helper_script_local_path(helper_file_name);
19728:     stage_windows_helper_script_from_path(context, local_path.as_path(), remote_file_name)
19729: }

19731: fn stage_windows_helper_support_files(
19732:     context: &RemoteFallbackContext<'_>,
19733:     helper_file_name: &str,
19734: ) -> Result<(), String> {
19735:     if helper_file_name != WINDOWS_BOOTSTRAP_HELPER_FILE
19736:         && helper_file_name != WINDOWS_ENABLE_ACCESS_HELPER_FILE
19737:     {
19738:         return Ok(());
19739:     }
19740:     if helper_file_name == WINDOWS_ENABLE_ACCESS_HELPER_FILE {
19741:         let local_path = windows_bootstrap_helper_script_local_path();
19742:         stage_windows_helper_script_from_path(
19743:             context,
19744:             local_path.as_path(),
19745:             WINDOWS_BOOTSTRAP_HELPER_FILE,
19746:         )?;
19747:     }
19748:     for support_file_name in [
19749:         WINDOWS_BOOTSTRAP_WINGET_CONFIG_FILE,
19750:         WINDOWS_BOOTSTRAP_VSCONFIG_FILE,
19751:         WINDOWS_SERVICE_INSTALL_HELPER_FILE,
19752:         WINDOWS_VERIFY_HELPER_FILE,
19753:         WINDOWS_COLLECT_DIAGNOSTICS_HELPER_FILE,
19754:     ] {
19755:         let local_path = windows_helper_script_local_path(support_file_name);
19756:         stage_windows_helper_script_from_path(context, local_path.as_path(), support_file_name)?;
19757:     }
19758:     Ok(())
19759: }

19761: fn build_windows_helper_invocation_script(
19762:     remote_path: &str,
19763:     args: &[String],
19764: ) -> Result<String, String> {
19765:     let helper_command = build_windows_helper_command(remote_path, args)?;
19766:     let mut script = format!(
19767:         "Set-StrictMode -Version Latest; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; {helper_command}"
19768:     );
19769:     script.push_str("; if (-not $?) { throw 'Windows helper invocation failed' }; $_helperExitCodeParsed = 0; if ([int]::TryParse([string]$LASTEXITCODE, [ref]$_helperExitCodeParsed) -and $_helperExitCodeParsed -ne 0) { throw (\"Windows helper invocation failed with exit code {0}\" -f $_helperExitCodeParsed) }");
19770:     Ok(script)
19771: }

19773: fn build_windows_result_file_helper_invocation_script(
19774:     remote_path: &str,
19775:     args: &[String],
19776:     remote_result_path: &str,
19777:     helper_label: &str,
19778: ) -> Result<String, String> {
19779:     let mut helper_args = args.to_vec();
19780:     let has_result_path = helper_args
19781:         .windows(2)
19782:         .any(|pair| pair[0] == "-OutputPath" || pair[0] == "-ResultPath");
19783:     if !has_result_path {
19784:         helper_args.push("-OutputPath".to_string());
19785:         helper_args.push(remote_result_path.to_string());
19786:     }
19787:     let helper_command = build_windows_helper_command(remote_path, helper_args.as_slice())?;
19788:     let encoded_helper = encode_powershell_command(helper_command.as_str())?;
19789:     let encoded_helper_literal = powershell_quote(encoded_helper.as_str())?;
19790:     ensure_no_control_chars("Windows result helper label", helper_label)?;
19791:     Ok(format!(
19792:         "Set-StrictMode -Version Latest; \
19793:          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; \
19794:          $resultPath = {result_path}; \
19795:          $resultParent = Split-Path -Path $resultPath -Parent; \
19796:          if ($resultParent -and -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $resultParent)) {{ \
19797:            New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $resultParent -Force | Out-Null \
19798:          }}; \
19799:          if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $resultPath) {{ \
19800:            Remove-Item -LiteralPath $resultPath -Force \
19801:          }}; \
19802:          $helperExit = 0; \
19803:          $captured = ''; \
19804:          $failureMessage = ''; \
19805:          $LASTEXITCODE = 0; \
19806:          $encodedHelper = {encoded_helper}; \
19807:          try {{ \
19808:            $decodedHelper = [System.Text.Encoding]::Unicode.GetString([System.Convert]::FromBase64String($encodedHelper)); \
19809:            $helperBlock = [ScriptBlock]::Create($decodedHelper); \
19810:            $captured = (& $helperBlock *>&1 | Out-String); \
19811:            $_exitCodeParsed = 0; \
19812:            if ([int]::TryParse([string]$LASTEXITCODE, [ref]$_exitCodeParsed)) {{ \
19813:              $helperExit = $_exitCodeParsed \
19814:            }} elseif (-not $?) {{ \
19815:              $helperExit = 1 \
19816:            }} \
19817:          }} catch {{ \
19818:            $failureMessage = if ($_.Exception -and $_.Exception.Message) {{ $_.Exception.Message.Trim() }} else {{ ($_ | Out-String).Trim() }}; \
19819:            $helperExit = 1 \
19820:          }}; \
19821:          if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($failureMessage) -and -not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($captured)) {{ \
19822:            $failureMessage = $captured.Trim() \
19823:          }}; \
19824:          if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $resultPath)) {{ \
19825:            if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($failureMessage)) {{ \
19826:              $failureMessage = ('{helper_label} did not write result file: {{0}}' -f $resultPath) \
19827:            }}; \
19828:            ([ordered]@{{ \
19829:              status = 'fail'; \
19830:              reason = $failureMessage; \
19831:              backend_label = ''; \
19832:              notes = @('helper-wrapper-fallback'); \
19833:              service_status = 'missing'; \
19834:              start_error = $failureMessage; \
19835:              host_surface_validated = $false; \
19836:              cleanup_status = 'failed'; \
19837:              openssh_installed = $false; \
19838:              service_running = $false; \
19839:              firewall_rule_enabled = $false; \
19840:              authorized_keys_applied = $false; \
19841:              host_key_present = $false; \
19842:              listener_ready = $false; \
19843:              default_shell_configured = $false; \
19844:              host_key = '' \
19845:            }} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress) | Set-Content -LiteralPath $resultPath -Encoding UTF8 \
19846:          }}; \
19847:          $body = Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $resultPath -Encoding UTF8; \
19848:          if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($body)) {{ \
19849:            $failureMessage = ('{helper_label} wrote empty result file: {{0}}' -f $resultPath); \
19850:            ([ordered]@{{ \
19851:              status = 'fail'; \
19852:              reason = $failureMessage; \
19853:              backend_label = ''; \
19854:              notes = @('helper-wrapper-empty-result'); \
19855:              service_status = 'missing'; \
19856:              start_error = $failureMessage; \
19857:              host_surface_validated = $false; \
19858:              cleanup_status = 'failed'; \
19859:              openssh_installed = $false; \
19860:              service_running = $false; \
19861:              firewall_rule_enabled = $false; \
19862:              authorized_keys_applied = $false; \
19863:              host_key_present = $false; \
19864:              listener_ready = $false; \
19865:              default_shell_configured = $false; \
19866:              host_key = '' \
19867:            }} | ConvertTo-Json -Compress) | Set-Content -LiteralPath $resultPath -Encoding UTF8 \
19868:          }}; \
19869:          exit $helperExit",
19870:         result_path = powershell_quote(remote_result_path)?,
19871:         encoded_helper = encoded_helper_literal,
19872:         helper_label = helper_label,
19873:     ))
19874: }

19895: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
19896: enum WindowsLocalUtmExecutionAuthority {
19897:     StatusProbeResultFile,
19898:     CaptureOutput,
19899: }
19900: 
19901: fn windows_local_utm_execution_authority(
19902:     target: &RemoteTarget,
19903:     capture_output_required: bool,
19904: ) -> Option<WindowsLocalUtmExecutionAuthority> {
19905:     if remote_target_local_utm(target).is_none()
19906:         || target.platform_profile.platform != VmGuestPlatform::Windows
19907:     {
19908:         return None;
19909:     }
19910:     Some(if capture_output_required {
19911:         WindowsLocalUtmExecutionAuthority::CaptureOutput
19912:     } else {
19913:         WindowsLocalUtmExecutionAuthority::StatusProbeResultFile
19914:     })
19915: }
19916: 
19917: fn build_windows_helper_command(remote_path: &str, args: &[String]) -> Result<String, String> {
19918:     let mut command = format!("& {}", powershell_quote(remote_path)?);
19919:     for arg in args {
19920:         ensure_no_control_chars("Windows helper arg", arg.as_str())?;
19921:         command.push(' ');
19922:         if arg.starts_with('-')
19923:             && arg
19924:                 .chars()
19925:                 .skip(1)
19926:                 .all(|ch| ch.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || ch == '-')
19927:         {
19928:             command.push_str(arg.as_str());
19929:         } else {
19930:             command.push_str(powershell_quote(arg.as_str())?.as_str());
19931:         }
19932:     }
19933:     Ok(command)
19934: }

19958:         RemoteTransportPhase::AccessEstablishment

19980: fn build_windows_access_bootstrap_args(
19981:     automation_public_key: Option<&str>,
19982:     result_path: Option<&str>,
19983: ) -> Result<Vec<String>, String> {
19984:     let mut args = vec!["-Phase".to_string(), "prepare-transport".to_string()];
19985:     if let Some(public_key) = automation_public_key {
19986:         ensure_no_control_chars("automation public key", public_key)?;
19987:         args.push("-AutomationPublicKey".to_string());
19988:         args.push(public_key.to_string());
19989:     }
19990:     if let Some(result_path) = result_path {
19991:         ensure_no_control_chars("Windows access bootstrap result path", result_path)?;
19992:         args.push("-ResultPath".to_string());
19993:         args.push(result_path.to_string());
19994:     }
19995:     Ok(args)
19996: }

19998: fn invoke_windows_helper_script_for_target(
19999:     context: &RemoteFallbackContext<'_>,
20000:     invocation: WindowsHelperInvocation<'_>,
20001: ) -> Result<ExitStatus, String> {
20002:     let phase = if windows_local_utm_execution_authority(context.target, false).is_some() {
20003:         RemoteTransportPhase::AccessEstablishment
20004:     } else {
20005:         RemoteTransportPhase::PostBootstrap
20006:     };
20007:     stage_windows_helper_support_files(context, invocation.helper_file_name)?;
20008:     let local_path = match invocation.helper_file_name {
20009:         WINDOWS_BOOTSTRAP_HELPER_FILE => windows_bootstrap_helper_script_local_path(),
20010:         WINDOWS_SERVICE_INSTALL_HELPER_FILE => windows_service_install_helper_script_local_path(),
20011:         WINDOWS_VERIFY_HELPER_FILE => windows_verify_helper_script_local_path(),
20012:         WINDOWS_COLLECT_DIAGNOSTICS_HELPER_FILE => windows_diagnostics_helper_script_local_path(),
20013:         WINDOWS_SERVICE_HOST_SMOKE_HELPER_FILE => {
20014:             windows_service_host_smoke_helper_script_local_path()
20015:         }
20016:         _ => windows_helper_script_local_path(invocation.helper_file_name),
20017:     };
20018:     let remote_path = stage_windows_helper_script(
20019:         context,
20020:         local_path
20021:             .file_name()
20022:             .and_then(|value| value.to_str())
20023:             .unwrap_or(invocation.helper_file_name),
20024:         invocation.remote_file_name,
20025:     )?;
20026:     let script = build_windows_helper_invocation_script(remote_path.as_str(), invocation.args)?;
20027:     run_remote_shell_command_for_target_with_phase(
20028:         context.target,
20029:         context.ssh_user_override,
20030:         context.ssh_identity_file,
20031:         context.known_hosts_path,
20032:         script.as_str(),
20033:         context.timeout,
20034:         phase,
20035:     )
20036: }

20038: fn render_known_hosts_line(host: &str, port: u16, public_key_line: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
20039:     ensure_no_control_chars("known_hosts host", host)?;
20040:     ensure_no_control_chars("known_hosts key", public_key_line)?;
20041:     let mut parts = public_key_line.split_whitespace();
20042:     let key_type = parts
20043:         .next()
20044:         .ok_or_else(|| "Windows SSH host key line is missing key type".to_string())?;
20045:     let key_data = parts
20046:         .next()
20047:         .ok_or_else(|| "Windows SSH host key line is missing key payload".to_string())?;
20048:     let host_field = if port == 22 {
20049:         host.to_string()
20050:     } else {
20051:         format!("[{host}]:{port}")
20052:     };
20053:     Ok(format!("{host_field} {key_type} {key_data}"))
20054: }
20055: 
20056: fn append_known_hosts_entry(path: &Path, rendered_line: &str) -> Result<(), String> {
20057:     ensure_no_control_chars("known_hosts entry", rendered_line)?;
20058:     let mut existing = if path.exists() {
20059:         fs::read_to_string(path)
20060:             .map_err(|err| format!("read known_hosts file failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?
20061:     } else {
20062:         String::new()
20063:     };
20064:     if existing
20065:         .lines()
20066:         .any(|line| line.trim() == rendered_line.trim())
20067:     {
20068:         return Ok(());
20069:     }
20070:     if !existing.is_empty() && !existing.ends_with('\n') {
20071:         existing.push('\n');
20072:     }
20073:     existing.push_str(rendered_line.trim_end());
20074:     existing.push('\n');
20075:     write_text_file_atomically(path, existing.as_str())
20076: }
