20078: #[derive(Debug, Deserialize)]
20079: struct WindowsAccessBootstrapReport {
20080:     openssh_installed: bool,
20081:     service_running: bool,
20082:     firewall_rule_enabled: bool,
20083:     authorized_keys_applied: bool,
20084:     host_key_present: bool,
20085:     listener_ready: bool,
20086:     default_shell_configured: bool,
20087:     status: String,
20088:     reason: String,
20089:     #[serde(default)]
20090:     host_key: String,
20091: }
20092: 
20093: fn parse_windows_access_bootstrap_output(
20094:     output: &str,
20095:     target_label: &str,
20096: ) -> Result<WindowsAccessBootstrapReport, String> {
20097:     let trimmed = output.trim();
20098:     if trimmed.is_empty() {
20099:         return Err(format!(
20100:             "Windows access bootstrap helper produced no output for {target_label}"
20101:         ));
20102:     }
20103:     let report: WindowsAccessBootstrapReport = serde_json::from_str(trimmed).map_err(|err| {
20104:         format!("Windows access bootstrap helper did not emit valid JSON for {target_label}: {err}")
20105:     })?;
20106:     if report.status != "pass" {
20107:         return Err(format!(
20108:             "Windows access bootstrap helper reported status={} reason={} authorized_keys_applied={} for {}",
20109:             report.status, report.reason, report.authorized_keys_applied, target_label
20110:         ));
20111:     }
20112:     for (field_name, value) in [
20113:         ("openssh_installed", report.openssh_installed),
20114:         ("service_running", report.service_running),
20115:         ("firewall_rule_enabled", report.firewall_rule_enabled),
20116:         ("host_key_present", report.host_key_present),
20117:         ("listener_ready", report.listener_ready),
20118:         ("default_shell_configured", report.default_shell_configured),
20119:     ] {
20120:         if !value {
20121:             return Err(format!(
20122:                 "Windows access bootstrap helper reported status=pass but {field_name}=false for {target_label}"
20123:             ));
20124:         }
20125:     }
20126:     if report.host_key.trim().is_empty() {
20127:         return Err(format!(
20128:             "Windows access bootstrap helper reported status=pass but host_key was empty for {target_label}"
20129:         ));
20130:     }
20131:     Ok(report)
20132: }
20133: 
20134: fn bootstrap_windows_access_for_target(
20135:     target: &RemoteTarget,
20136:     ssh_user_override: Option<&str>,
20137:     ssh_identity_file: Option<&Path>,
20138:     known_hosts_path: Option<&Path>,
20139:     automation_public_key: Option<&str>,
20140:     ssh_port: u16,
20141:     timeout: Duration,
20142: ) -> Result<String, String> {
20143:     if target.platform_profile.platform != VmGuestPlatform::Windows {
20144:         return Err(format!(
20145:             "Windows access bootstrap requested for non-Windows target: {}",
20146:             target.label
20147:         ));
20148:     }
20149:     let context = RemoteFallbackContext {
20150:         target,
20151:         ssh_user_override,
20152:         ssh_identity_file,
20153:         known_hosts_path,
20154:         timeout,
20155:     };
20156:     let report_output = match windows_local_utm_execution_authority(target, false) {
20157:         Some(WindowsLocalUtmExecutionAuthority::StatusProbeResultFile) => {
20158:             let (utm_name, _) = remote_target_local_utm(target).ok_or_else(|| {
20159:                 format!(
20160:                     "Windows access bootstrap probe requested local UTM mode for non-UTM target {}",
20161:                     target.label
20162:                 )
20163:             })?;
20164:             let local_path = windows_bootstrap_helper_script_local_path();
20165:             stage_windows_helper_support_files(&context, WINDOWS_BOOTSTRAP_HELPER_FILE)?;
20166:             // Use a unique per-run remote name so a Defender file lock on the
20167:             // previously-executed copy does not block the UTM push (OSStatus
20168:             // -2700 / "file in use").  The result file already uses this
20169:             // pattern; apply it to the script itself for the same reason.
20170:             let remote_bootstrap_name =
20171:                 format!("Bootstrap-RustyNetWindows.{}.ps1", unique_suffix());
20172:             let remote_path = stage_windows_helper_script_from_path_with_phase(
20173:                 &context,
20174:                 local_path.as_path(),
20175:                 remote_bootstrap_name.as_str(),
20176:                 RemoteTransportPhase::AccessEstablishment,
20177:             )?;
20178:             let remote_result_name = format!(
20179:                 "{}.result.{}.json",
20180:                 sanitize_label_for_path(WINDOWS_BOOTSTRAP_HELPER_FILE),
20181:                 unique_suffix()
20182:             );
20183:             let remote_result_path =
20184:                 windows_helper_script_remote_path(context.target, remote_result_name.as_str())?;
20185:             let args = build_windows_access_bootstrap_args(
20186:                 automation_public_key,
20187:                 Some(&remote_result_path),
20188:             )?;
20189:             // Cap the UTM probe timeout so we can fall back to SSH in a
20190:             // reasonable time when the UTM file pull is broken on this guest.
20191:             // The exec step blocks until the script completes; give it up to
20192:             // 6 minutes (covering slower first-time OpenSSH installs), then
20193:             // allow equal time for pull retries before giving up on the UTM
20194:             // path entirely.
20195:             let utm_probe_timeout = context.timeout.min(Duration::from_secs(360));
20196:             let report_output = execute_windows_local_utm_result_file_probe(
20197:                 utm_name,
20198:                 "Windows access bootstrap probe",
20199:                 utm_probe_timeout,
20200:                 remote_result_path.as_str(),
20201:                 |remote_result_path| {
20202:                     build_windows_access_bootstrap_result_script(
20203:                         remote_path.as_str(),
20204:                         args.as_slice(),
20205:                         remote_result_path,
20206:                     )
20207:                 },
20208:             );
20209:             let _ = best_effort_remove_windows_local_utm_guest_file(
20210:                 utm_name,
20211:                 remote_result_path.as_str(),
20212:                 Duration::from_secs(20),
20213:             );
20214:             match report_output {
20215:                 Ok(output) => output,
20216:                 Err(utm_err) => {
20217:                     // UTM file operations are broken on this Windows guest
20218:                     // (push exits 0 but writes nothing; pull fails with
20219:                     // -2700). Stage the bootstrap script via SCP and run it
20220:                     // directly over SSH instead. sshd restart inside the
20221:                     // bootstrap does not kill the existing SSH session on
20222:                     // Windows OpenSSH (child sshd processes outlive service
20223:                     // restarts).
20224:                     let ssh_user = context.ssh_user_override.or(target.ssh_user.as_deref());
20225:                     let scp_dst = remote_copy_destination_for_target(target, remote_path.as_str());
20226:                     let scp_status = scp_to_remote(
20227:                         local_path.as_path(),
20228:                         target.ssh_target.as_str(),
20229:                         ssh_user,
20230:                         context.ssh_identity_file,
20231:                         context.known_hosts_path,
20232:                         scp_dst.as_str(),
20233:                         Duration::from_secs(60),
20234:                     )
20235:                     .map_err(|scp_err| {
20236:                         format!("{utm_err}; SCP staging for SSH fallback failed: {scp_err}")
20237:                     })?;
20238:                     if !scp_status.success() {
20239:                         return Err(format!(
20240:                             "{utm_err}; SCP staging for SSH fallback failed with status {}",
20241:                             status_code(scp_status)
20242:                         ));
20243:                     }
20244:                     let ssh_args =
20245:                         build_windows_access_bootstrap_args(automation_public_key, None)?;
20246:                     let script = build_windows_helper_invocation_script(
20247:                         remote_path.as_str(),
20248:                         ssh_args.as_slice(),
20249:                     )?;
20250:                     let ssh_script = remote_script_for_ssh_transport(target, script.as_str())?;
20251:                     capture_remote_shell_command(
20252:                         target.ssh_target.as_str(),
20253:                         ssh_user,
20254:                         context.ssh_identity_file,
20255:                         context.known_hosts_path,
20256:                         ssh_script.as_str(),
20257:                         context.timeout,
20258:                     )
20259:                     .map_err(|ssh_err| format!("{utm_err}; SSH fallback also failed: {ssh_err}"))?
20260:                 }
20261:             }
20262:         }
20263:         _ => {
20264:             let args = build_windows_access_bootstrap_args(automation_public_key, None)?;
20265:             capture_windows_helper_script_output_from_path(
20266:                 &context,
20267:                 windows_bootstrap_helper_script_local_path().as_path(),
20268:                 WINDOWS_BOOTSTRAP_HELPER_FILE,
20269:                 args.as_slice(),
20270:             )?
20271:         }
20272:     };
20273:     let report =
20274:         parse_windows_access_bootstrap_output(report_output.as_str(), target.label.as_str())?;
20275:     let host_key_line = report.host_key.trim();
20276: 
20277:     if let Some(path) = known_hosts_path {
20278:         let host = ssh_target_host(target.ssh_target.as_str());
20279:         let rendered = render_known_hosts_line(host.as_str(), ssh_port, host_key_line)?;
20280:         append_known_hosts_entry(path, rendered.as_str())?;
20281:     }
20282: 
20283:     Ok(host_key_line.to_string())
20284: }
20285: 
20286: fn summarize_ssh_probe_streams(stdout: &[u8], stderr: &[u8]) -> String {
20287:     let stderr_text = String::from_utf8_lossy(stderr).trim().to_string();
20288:     if !stderr_text.is_empty() {
20289:         return stderr_text;
20290:     }
20291:     let stdout_text = String::from_utf8_lossy(stdout).trim().to_string();
20292:     if !stdout_text.is_empty() {
20293:         return stdout_text;
20294:     }
20295:     String::new()
20296: }
20297: 
20298: fn classify_windows_ssh_access_probe_failure(detail: &str, status: Option<ExitStatus>) -> String {
20299:     let normalized_detail = detail.trim();
20300:     let lowered = normalized_detail.to_ascii_lowercase();
20301:     let status_detail = status.map(status_code);
20302:     let fallback_detail = status_detail
20303:         .map(|code| format!("remote command exited with status {code}"))
20304:         .unwrap_or_else(|| "remote command failed".to_string());
20305:     let rendered_detail = if normalized_detail.is_empty() {
20306:         fallback_detail
20307:     } else {
20308:         normalized_detail.to_string()
20309:     };
20310:     if lowered.contains("host key verification failed")
20311:         || lowered.contains("remote host identification has changed")
20312:         || lowered.contains("offending key")
20313:         || lowered.contains("no matching host key")
20314:     {
20315:         format!("ssh-host-key-not-ready: {rendered_detail}")
20316:     } else if lowered.contains("permission denied")
20317:         || lowered.contains("publickey")
20318:         || lowered.contains("authentication failed")
20319:         || lowered.contains("access denied")
20320:     {
20321:         format!("ssh-auth-rejected: {rendered_detail}")
20322:     } else if lowered.contains("connection refused") {
20323:         format!("ssh-listener-not-ready: {rendered_detail}")
20324:     } else if lowered.contains("could not resolve hostname")
20325:         || lowered.contains("name or service not known")
20326:         || lowered.contains("temporary failure in name resolution")
20327:         || lowered.contains("no address associated with hostname")
20328:     {
20329:         format!("no-authoritative-ssh-target: {rendered_detail}")
20330:     } else if lowered.contains("timed out")
20331:         || lowered.contains("timeout")
20332:         || lowered.contains("no route to host")
20333:         || lowered.contains("network is unreachable")
20334:         || lowered.contains("unreachable")
20335:     {
20336:         format!("ssh-firewall-not-open: {rendered_detail}")
20337:     } else {
20338:         format!("ssh-auth-rejected: {rendered_detail}")
20339:     }
20340: }
20341: 
20342: fn prove_windows_ssh_access_for_target(
20343:     target: &RemoteTarget,
20344:     ssh_user_override: Option<&str>,
20345:     ssh_identity_file: Option<&Path>,
20346:     known_hosts_path: Option<&Path>,
20347:     timeout: Duration,
20348: ) -> Result<(), String> {
20349:     let ssh_target = target.ssh_target.as_str();
20350:     let ssh_user = ssh_user_override.or(target.ssh_user.as_deref());
20351:     if ssh_user.is_none() {
20352:         return Err("no-authoritative-ssh-target: no Windows ssh_user is configured".to_string());
20353:     }
20354:     validate_target_user_combination(ssh_target, ssh_user)?;
20355:     let probe_command = ssh_auth_probe_command(target.platform_profile)?;
20356:     let ssh_script = remote_script_for_ssh_transport(target, probe_command)?;
20357:     let mut command = Command::new("ssh");
20358:     command.args([
20359:         "-n",
20360:         "-o",
20361:         "LogLevel=ERROR",
20362:         "-o",
20363:         "BatchMode=yes",
20364:         "-o",
20365:         "StrictHostKeyChecking=yes",
20366:         "-o",
20367:         "ConnectTimeout=15",
20368:         "-o",
20369:         "ServerAliveInterval=20",
20370:         "-o",
20371:         "ServerAliveCountMax=3",
20372:         "-o",
20373:         "IdentitiesOnly=yes",
20374:     ]);
20375:     append_ssh_transport_options(&mut command, ssh_identity_file, known_hosts_path)?;
20376:     if let Some(ssh_user) = ssh_user {
20377:         command.arg("-l").arg(ssh_user);
20378:     }
20379:     command.arg("--").arg(ssh_target).arg(ssh_script);
20380:     let output = run_output_with_timeout(&mut command, timeout)
20381:         .map_err(|err| classify_windows_ssh_access_probe_failure(err.as_str(), None))?;
20382:     if output.status.success() {
20383:         return Ok(());
20384:     }
20385:     let detail = summarize_ssh_probe_streams(output.stdout.as_slice(), output.stderr.as_slice());
20386:     Err(classify_windows_ssh_access_probe_failure(
20387:         detail.as_str(),
20388:         Some(output.status),
20389:     ))
20390: }
20391: 
20392: fn ensure_windows_runtime_access_ready_for_target(
20393:     target: &RemoteTarget,
20394:     ssh_user_override: Option<&str>,
20395:     ssh_identity_file: Option<&Path>,
20396:     known_hosts_path: Option<&Path>,
20397:     timeout: Duration,
20398: ) -> Result<(), String> {
20399:     if target.platform_profile.platform != VmGuestPlatform::Windows {
20400:         return Err(format!(
20401:             "Windows runtime access proof requested for non-Windows target: {}",
20402:             target.label
20403:         ));
20404:     }
20405:     if remote_target_local_utm(target).is_some() {
20406:         bootstrap_windows_access_for_target(
20407:             target,
20408:             ssh_user_override,
20409:             ssh_identity_file,
20410:             known_hosts_path,
20411:             None,
20412:             22,
20413:             timeout,
20414:         )
20415:         .map_err(|err| format!("access-bootstrap-not-ready: {err}"))?;
20416:     }
20417:     prove_windows_ssh_access_for_target(
20418:         target,
20419:         ssh_user_override,
20420:         ssh_identity_file,
20421:         known_hosts_path,
20422:         timeout,
20423:     )
20424:     .map_err(|err| format!("ssh-access-not-ready: {err}"))
20425: }

20427: fn validate_target_user_combination(target: &str, ssh_user: Option<&str>) -> Result<(), String> {
20428:     if ssh_user.is_some() && target.contains('@') {
20429:         return Err(format!(
20430:             "explicit SSH user override cannot be combined with user@host target: {target}"
20431:         ));
20432:     }
20433:     Ok(())
20434: }
20435: 
20436: fn unique_suffix() -> u128 {
20437:     let now = SystemTime::now()
20438:         .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)
20439:         .unwrap_or_default()
20440:         .as_nanos();
20441:     let counter = UNIQUE_COUNTER.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed) as u128;
20442:     (now << 16) ^ counter
20443: }

20445: fn sanitize_label_for_path(value: &str) -> String {
20446:     let mut out = String::with_capacity(value.len());
20447:     for ch in value.chars() {
20448:         if ch.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(ch, '-' | '_' | '.') {
20449:             out.push(ch);
20450:         } else {
20451:             out.push('_');
20452:         }
20453:     }
20454:     if out.is_empty() {
20455:         "target".to_string()
20456:     } else {
20457:         out
20458:     }
20459: }
20460: 
20461: fn ssh_target_host(value: &str) -> String {
20462:     let without_user = value
20463:         .rsplit_once('@')
20464:         .map(|(_, host)| host)
20465:         .unwrap_or(value);
20466:     without_user
20467:         .strip_prefix('[')
20468:         .and_then(|host| host.strip_suffix(']'))
20469:         .unwrap_or(without_user)
20470:         .to_string()
20471: }
20472: 
20473: fn ssh_target_user(value: &str) -> Option<&str> {
20474:     value.rsplit_once('@').map(|(user, _)| user)
20475: }

20477: fn resolve_known_hosts_targets(
20478:     inventory: &[VmInventoryEntry],
20479:     aliases: &[String],
20480:     select_all: bool,
20481:     raw_targets: &[String],
20482: ) -> Result<Vec<KnownHostsTarget>, String> {
20483:     let mut results = Vec::new();
20484:     let mut seen = HashSet::new();
20485:     if select_all || !aliases.is_empty() {
20486:         for entry in select_inventory_entries(inventory, aliases, select_all)? {
20487:             let mut candidates = Vec::new();
20488:             let live_host = ssh_target_host(resolved_inventory_ssh_target(&entry).as_str());
20489:             if !live_host.is_empty() {
20490:                 candidates.push(live_host);
20491:             }
20492:             let inventory_host = ssh_target_host(entry.ssh_target.as_str());
20493:             if !inventory_host.is_empty()
20494:                 && !candidates
20495:                     .iter()
20496:                     .any(|candidate| candidate == &inventory_host)
20497:             {
20498:                 candidates.push(inventory_host);
20499:             }
20500:             if let Some(last_known_ip) = entry.last_known_ip.as_deref()
20501:                 && !candidates
20502:                     .iter()
20503:                     .any(|candidate| candidate == last_known_ip)
20504:             {
20505:                 candidates.push(last_known_ip.to_string());
20506:             }
20507:             if seen.insert(entry.alias.clone()) {
20508:                 results.push(KnownHostsTarget {
20509:                     label: entry.alias,
20510:                     host_candidates: candidates,
20511:                 });
20512:             }
20513:         }
20514:     }
20515:     for raw_target in raw_targets {
20516:         ensure_ssh_target("target", raw_target)?;
20517:         let label = raw_target.clone();
20518:         if seen.insert(label.clone()) {
20519:             results.push(KnownHostsTarget {
20520:                 label,
20521:                 host_candidates: vec![ssh_target_host(raw_target)],
20522:             });
20523:         }
20524:     }
20525:     if results.is_empty() {
20526:         return Err("specify at least one inventory alias/--all or explicit --target".to_string());
20527:     }
20528:     Ok(results)
20529: }
20530: 
20531: fn find_known_hosts_match(path: &Path, candidates: &[String]) -> Result<Option<String>, String> {
20532:     for candidate in candidates {
20533:         let status = Command::new("ssh-keygen")
20534:             .arg("-F")
20535:             .arg(candidate)
20536:             .arg("-f")
20537:             .arg(path)
20538:             .stdin(Stdio::null())
20539:             .stdout(Stdio::null())
20540:             .stderr(Stdio::null())
20541:             .status()
20542:             .map_err(|err| format!("ssh-keygen lookup failed for {candidate}: {err}"))?;
20543:         if status.success() {
20544:             return Ok(Some(candidate.clone()));
20545:         }
20546:     }
20547:     Ok(None)
20548: }

20550: fn build_preflight_script(
20551:     required_commands: &[String],
20552:     _min_free_kib: u64,
20553:     require_rustynet_installed: bool,
20554: ) -> Result<String, String> {
20555:     let mut script = String::from(
20556:         "set -eu; \
20557: printf 'hostname=%s\\n' \"$(hostname)\"; \
20558: printf 'os=%s\\n' \"$(uname -srm)\"; \
20559: printf 'free_kib=%s\\n' \"$(df -Pk / | awk 'NR==2 {print $4}')\"; \
20560: if sudo -n true >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf 'sudo_ok=true\\n'; else printf 'sudo_ok=false\\n'; fi; ",
20561:     );
20562:     if require_rustynet_installed {
20563:         script.push_str(
20564:             "if command -v rustynet >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf 'rustynet_installed=true\\n'; else printf 'rustynet_installed=false\\n'; fi; ",
20565:         );
20566:     } else {
20567:         script.push_str("printf 'rustynet_installed=skipped\\n'; ");
20568:     }
20569:     for command_name in required_commands {
20570:         ensure_inventory_alias(command_name)?;
20571:         let _ = write!(
20572:             script,
20573:             "if command -v {cmd} >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf 'cmd.{cmd}=present\\n'; else printf 'cmd.{cmd}=missing\\n'; fi; ",
20574:             cmd = shell_quote(command_name)
20575:         );
20576:     }
20577:     Ok(script)
20578: }

20580: fn privileged_rustynet_cli_script(subcommand: &str) -> String {
20581:     format!(
20582:         "if command -v rustynet >/dev/null 2>&1; then if sudo -n true >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo -n env RUSTYNET_DAEMON_SOCKET=/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock rustynet {subcommand} 2>&1; else RUSTYNET_DAEMON_SOCKET=/run/rustynet/rustynetd.sock rustynet {subcommand} 2>&1; fi; else echo rustynet-not-installed; fi"
20583:     )
20584: }

20586: fn parse_key_value_output(output: &str) -> BTreeMap<String, String> {

20588:     for line in output.lines() {
20589:         if let Some((key, value)) = line.split_once('=') {

20596: fn build_section_capture_script(sections: &[(&str, &str)]) -> String {
20597:     let mut script = String::from("set +e; ");
20598:     for (name, body) in sections {
20599:         let _ = write!(
20600:             script,
20601:             "printf '%s\\n' '__VM_LAB_SECTION__{name}'; {{ {body}; }} 2>&1 || true; printf '%s\\n' '__VM_LAB_SECTION_END__'; "
20602:         );
20603:     }
20604:     script
20605: }
20606: 
20607: fn parse_section_capture(output: &str) -> BTreeMap<String, String> {
20608:     let mut sections = BTreeMap::new();
20609:     let mut current_name: Option<String> = None;
20610:     let mut current_body = String::new();
20611:     for line in output.lines() {
20612:         if let Some(name) = line.strip_prefix("__VM_LAB_SECTION__") {
20613:             current_name = Some(name.to_string());
20614:             current_body.clear();
20615:             continue;
20616:         }
20617:         if line == "__VM_LAB_SECTION_END__" {
20618:             if let Some(name) = current_name.take() {
20619:                 sections.insert(name, current_body.trim_end().to_string());
20620:             }
20621:             current_body.clear();
20622:             continue;
20623:         }
20624:         if current_name.is_some() {
20625:             current_body.push_str(line);
20626:             current_body.push('\n');
20627:         }
20628:     }
20629:     sections
20630: }

20632: fn normalized_suite_name(value: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
20633:     let normalized = value.trim().to_ascii_lowercase().replace('_', "-");
20634:     match normalized.as_str() {
20635:         "direct-remote-exit" | "relay-remote-exit" | "failback-roaming" | "full-live-lab" => {
20636:             Ok(normalized)
20637:         }
20638:         _ => Err(format!(
20639:             "unsupported vm-lab suite: {value} (expected direct-remote-exit|relay-remote-exit|failback-roaming|full-live-lab)"
20640:         )),
20641:     }
20642: }

20644: fn build_vm_lab_topology(entries: &[VmInventoryEntry], suite: &str) -> Result<Value, String> {
20645:     let suite_name = normalized_suite_name(suite)?;
20646:     let mut roles = BTreeMap::new();
20647:     let mut nodes = Vec::new();
20648:     for entry in entries {
20649:         let resolved_target = resolved_inventory_ssh_target(entry);
20650:         let normalized_target = normalized_ssh_target(
20651:             resolved_target.as_str(),
20652:             entry.ssh_user.as_deref(),
20653:             entry.alias.as_str(),
20654:         )?;
20655:         let node_id = entry.node_id.clone().ok_or_else(|| {
20656:             format!(
20657:                 "inventory entry {} is missing node_id required for topology generation",
20658:                 entry.alias
20659:             )
20660:         })?;
20661:         let lab_role = entry.lab_role.clone().ok_or_else(|| {
20662:             format!(
20663:                 "inventory entry {} is missing lab_role required for topology generation",
20664:                 entry.alias
20665:             )
20666:         })?;
20667:         let network_id = entry
20668:             .network_group
20669:             .clone()
20670:             .or_else(|| entry.last_known_network.clone())
20671:             .ok_or_else(|| {
20672:                 format!(
20673:                     "inventory entry {} is missing network_group/last_known_network required for topology generation",
20674:                     entry.alias
20675:                 )
20676:             })?;
20677:         if roles
20678:             .insert(lab_role.clone(), entry.alias.clone())
20679:             .is_some()
20680:         {
20681:             return Err(format!(
20682:                 "multiple selected entries declare lab_role={lab_role}; topology roles must be unique"
20683:             ));
20684:         }
20685:         nodes.push(json!({
20686:             "alias": entry.alias,
20687:             "normalized_target": normalized_target,
20688:             "node_id": node_id,
20689:             "lab_role": lab_role,
20690:             "network_id": network_id,
20691:             "mesh_ip": entry.mesh_ip,
20692:             "last_known_ip": literal_ip_host_from_ssh_target(normalized_target.as_str())
20693:                 .or_else(|| entry.last_known_ip.clone()),
20694:             "exit_capable": entry.exit_capable.unwrap_or(false),
20695:             "relay_capable": entry.relay_capable.unwrap_or(false),
20696:             "rustynet_src_dir": entry.rustynet_src_dir,
20697:         }));
20698:     }
20699: 
20700:     let topology = json!({
20701:         "version": 1,
20702:         "generated_at_unix": SystemTime::now().duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH).unwrap_or_default().as_secs(),
20703:         "suite": suite_name,
20704:         "roles": roles,
20705:         "nodes": nodes,
20706:     });
20707:     let parsed = parse_vm_lab_topology(topology.clone())?;
20708:     validate_vm_lab_topology(&parsed)?;
20709:     Ok(topology)
20710: }

20712: fn load_vm_lab_topology(path: &Path) -> Result<VmLabTopology, String> {
20713:     let body = fs::read_to_string(path)
20714:         .map_err(|err| format!("read vm-lab topology failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
20715:     let value = serde_json::from_str::<Value>(body.as_str())
20716:         .map_err(|err| format!("parse vm-lab topology failed ({}): {err}", path.display()))?;
20717:     let topology = parse_vm_lab_topology(value)?;
20718:     validate_vm_lab_topology(&topology)?;
20719:     Ok(topology)
20720: }
20721: 
20722: fn parse_vm_lab_topology(value: Value) -> Result<VmLabTopology, String> {
20723:     let object = value
20724:         .as_object()
20725:         .ok_or_else(|| "vm-lab topology must be a JSON object".to_string())?;
20726:     let version = object
20727:         .get("version")
20728:         .and_then(Value::as_u64)
20729:         .ok_or_else(|| "vm-lab topology is missing numeric version".to_string())?;
20730:     if version != 1 {
20731:         return Err(format!("unsupported vm-lab topology version: {version}"));
20732:     }
20733:     let suite = object
20734:         .get("suite")
20735:         .and_then(Value::as_str)
20736:         .ok_or_else(|| "vm-lab topology is missing suite".to_string())?
20737:         .to_string();
20738:     let suite = normalized_suite_name(suite.as_str())?;
20739:     let roles_object = object
20740:         .get("roles")
20741:         .and_then(Value::as_object)
20742:         .ok_or_else(|| "vm-lab topology is missing roles object".to_string())?;
20743:     let mut roles = BTreeMap::new();
20744:     for (key, value) in roles_object {
20745:         let alias = value
20746:             .as_str()
20747:             .ok_or_else(|| format!("vm-lab topology role {key} must be a string alias"))?;
20748:         roles.insert(key.clone(), alias.to_string());
20749:     }
20750:     let node_array = object
20751:         .get("nodes")
20752:         .and_then(Value::as_array)
20753:         .ok_or_else(|| "vm-lab topology is missing nodes array".to_string())?;
20754:     let mut nodes = BTreeMap::new();
20755:     for node_value in node_array {
20756:         let node_object = node_value
20757:             .as_object()
20758:             .ok_or_else(|| "vm-lab topology node must be an object".to_string())?;
20759:         let alias = required_string_field(node_object, "alias")?;
20760:         let normalized_target = required_string_field(node_object, "normalized_target")?;
20761:         let node_id = required_string_field(node_object, "node_id")?;
20762:         let lab_role = required_string_field(node_object, "lab_role")?;
20763:         let network_id = required_string_field(node_object, "network_id")?;
20764:         let mesh_ip = optional_string_field(node_object, "mesh_ip")?;
20765:         let last_known_ip = optional_string_field(node_object, "last_known_ip")?;
20766:         let exit_capable = optional_bool_field(node_object, "exit_capable")?.unwrap_or(false);
20767:         let relay_capable = optional_bool_field(node_object, "relay_capable")?.unwrap_or(false);
20768:         let rustynet_src_dir = optional_string_field(node_object, "rustynet_src_dir")?;
20769:         nodes.insert(
20770:             alias.clone(),
20771:             VmLabTopologyNode {
20772:                 alias,
20773:                 normalized_target,
20774:                 node_id,
20775:                 lab_role,
20776:                 network_id,
20777:                 mesh_ip,
20778:                 last_known_ip,
20779:                 exit_capable,
20780:                 relay_capable,
20781:                 rustynet_src_dir,
20782:             },
20783:         );
20784:     }
20785:     Ok(VmLabTopology {
20786:         suite,
20787:         roles,
20788:         nodes,
20789:     })
20790: }
20791: 
20792: fn validate_vm_lab_topology(topology: &VmLabTopology) -> Result<(), String> {
20793:     match topology.suite.as_str() {
20794:         "direct-remote-exit" => {
20795:             let client = topology_role_node(topology, &["client"])?;
20796:             let exit = topology_role_node(topology, &["exit"])?;
20797:             ensure_distinct_topology_networks([client, exit].as_slice())?;
20798:         }
20799:         "relay-remote-exit" | "failback-roaming" => {
20800:             let client = topology_role_node(topology, &["client"])?;
20801:             let exit = topology_role_node(topology, &["exit"])?;
20802:             let relay = topology_role_node(topology, &["relay", "entry"])?;
20803:             ensure_distinct_topology_networks([client, exit, relay].as_slice())?;
20804:         }
20805:         "full-live-lab" => {
20806:             let _ = topology_role_node(topology, &["client"])?;
20807:             let _ = topology_role_node(topology, &["exit"])?;
20808:             let _ = topology_role_node(topology, &["entry", "relay"])?;
20809:             let _ = topology_role_node(topology, &["aux"])?;
20810:         }
20811:         _ => {}
20812:     }
20813:     Ok(())
20814: }
20815: 
20816: fn topology_role_node<'a>(
20817:     topology: &'a VmLabTopology,
20818:     role_candidates: &[&str],
20819: ) -> Result<&'a VmLabTopologyNode, String> {
20820:     for role in role_candidates {
20821:         if let Some(alias) = topology.roles.get(*role) {
20822:             return topology.nodes.get(alias).ok_or_else(|| {
20823:                 format!("vm-lab topology role {role} points to missing alias {alias}")
20824:             });
20825:         }
20826:     }
20827:     Err(format!(
20828:         "vm-lab topology is missing required role; expected one of {}",
20829:         role_candidates.join(", ")
20830:     ))
20831: }
20832: 
20833: fn topology_optional_role_node<'a>(
20834:     topology: &'a VmLabTopology,
20835:     role_candidates: &[&str],
20836: ) -> Result<Option<&'a VmLabTopologyNode>, String> {
20837:     for role in role_candidates {
20838:         if let Some(alias) = topology.roles.get(*role) {
20839:             return topology.nodes.get(alias).map(Some).ok_or_else(|| {
20840:                 format!("vm-lab topology role {role} points to missing alias {alias}")
20841:             });
20842:         }
20843:     }
20844:     Ok(None)
20845: }
20846: 
20847: fn ensure_distinct_topology_networks(nodes: &[&VmLabTopologyNode]) -> Result<(), String> {
20848:     let mut seen = HashSet::new();
20849:     for node in nodes {
20850:         if !seen.insert(node.network_id.clone()) {
20851:             return Err(format!(
20852:                 "suite {} requires distinct network_id values but duplicate network {} was found",
20853:                 nodes
20854:                     .first()
20855:                     .map(|_| "cross-network")
20856:                     .unwrap_or("cross-network"),
20857:                 node.network_id
20858:             ));
20859:         }
20860:     }
20861:     Ok(())
20862: }
20863: 
20864: fn build_nodes_spec(
20865:     nodes: &[&VmLabTopologyNode],
20866:     inventory: &[VmInventoryEntry],
20867:     timeout: Duration,
20868:     ssh_user_override: Option<&str>,
20869:     ssh_identity_file: Option<&Path>,
20870:     known_hosts_path: Option<&Path>,
20871: ) -> Result<String, String> {
20872:     let mut parts = Vec::new();
20873:     for node in nodes {
20874:         let inventory_entry = inventory
20875:             .iter()
20876:             .find(|entry| entry.alias == node.alias)
20877:             .cloned()
20878:             .ok_or_else(|| format!("topology alias missing from inventory: {}", node.alias))?;
20879:         let target = remote_target_from_inventory_entry(&inventory_entry, ssh_user_override);
20880:         let pubkey_hex = collect_public_key_hex_for_target(
20881:             &target,
20882:             ssh_identity_file,
20883:             known_hosts_path,
20884:             timeout,
20885:         )?;
20886:         let underlay_ip = literal_ip_host_from_ssh_target(node.normalized_target.as_str())
20887:             .or_else(|| node.last_known_ip.clone())
20888:             .ok_or_else(|| {
20889:                 format!(
20890:                     "node {} is missing last_known_ip and its SSH target is not a literal IP; cannot build authoritative NODES_SPEC endpoint",
20891:                     node.alias
20892:                 )
20893:             })?;
20894:         parts.push(format!(
20895:             "{}|{}:51820|{}",
20896:             node.node_id, underlay_ip, pubkey_hex
20897:         ));
20898:     }
20899:     Ok(parts.join(";"))
20900: }
20901: 
20902: fn collect_public_key_hex_for_target(
20903:     target: &RemoteTarget,
20904:     ssh_identity_file: Option<&Path>,
20905:     known_hosts_path: Option<&Path>,
20906:     timeout: Duration,
20907: ) -> Result<String, String> {
20908:     let output = capture_remote_shell_command_for_target(
20909:         target,
20910:         None,
20911:         ssh_identity_file,
20912:         known_hosts_path,
20913:         "set -eu; if sudo -n true >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo -n cat /var/lib/rustynet/keys/wireguard.pub; else cat /var/lib/rustynet/keys/wireguard.pub; fi",
20914:         timeout,
20915:     )
20916:     .map_err(|err| format!("collect pubkey failed for {}: {err}", target.label))?;
20917:     decode_wireguard_pubkey_to_hex(output.trim())
20918:         .map_err(|err| format!("decode pubkey failed for {}: {err}", target.label))
20919: }
20920: 
20921: fn decode_wireguard_pubkey_to_hex(value: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
20922:     let decoded = BASE64_STANDARD
20923:         .decode(value.as_bytes())
20924:         .map_err(|err| format!("base64 decode failed: {err}"))?;
20925:     if decoded.len() != 32 {
20926:         return Err(format!(
20927:             "expected 32-byte WireGuard public key, got {} bytes",
20928:             decoded.len()
20929:         ));
20930:     }
20931:     let mut out = String::with_capacity(decoded.len() * 2);
20932:     for byte in decoded {
20933:         let _ = write!(out, "{byte:02x}");
20934:     }
20935:     Ok(out)
20936: }
20937: 
20938: fn build_allow_spec(nodes: &[&VmLabTopologyNode]) -> String {
20939:     let mut pairs = Vec::new();
20940:     for source in nodes {
20941:         for target in nodes {
20942:             if source.node_id != target.node_id {
20943:                 pairs.push(format!("{}|{}", source.node_id, target.node_id));
20944:             }
20945:         }
20946:     }
20947:     pairs.join(";")
20948: }
20949: 
20950: fn build_assignments_spec(topology: &VmLabTopology) -> Result<String, String> {
20951:     let mut assignments = Vec::new();
20952:     for node in topology.nodes.values() {
20953:         let upstream = assignment_exit_node_id(topology, node.alias.as_str())?;
20954:         assignments.push(format!(
20955:             "{}|{}",
20956:             node.node_id,
20957:             upstream.as_deref().unwrap_or("-")
20958:         ));
20959:     }
20960:     Ok(assignments.join(";"))
20961: }
20962: 
20963: fn assignment_exit_node_id(
20964:     topology: &VmLabTopology,
20965:     alias: &str,
20966: ) -> Result<Option<String>, String> {
20967:     let node = topology
20968:         .nodes
20969:         .get(alias)
20970:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("vm-lab topology alias not found: {alias}"))?;
20971:     let exit = topology_optional_role_node(topology, &["exit"])?;
20972:     let relay = topology_optional_role_node(topology, &["relay", "entry"])?;
20973:     match node.lab_role.as_str() {
20974:         "exit" => Ok(None),
20975:         "relay" | "entry" => Ok(exit.map(|node| node.node_id.clone())),
20976:         "client" | "aux" | "extra" | "fifth_client" | "probe" => Ok(relay
20977:             .map(|node| node.node_id.clone())
20978:             .or_else(|| exit.map(|node| node.node_id.clone()))),
20979:         _ => Ok(exit.map(|node| node.node_id.clone())),
20980:     }
20981: }

20987: ) -> Result<String, String> {
20988:     let lines = [

20990:         format_env_assignment("ALLOW_SPEC", allow_spec)?,
20991:         format_env_assignment("ASSIGNMENTS_SPEC", assignments_spec)?,
20992:         String::new(),
20993:     ];
20994:     Ok(lines.join("\n"))
20995: }

21014: fn build_assignment_refresh_env(
21015:     target_node_id: &str,
21016:     nodes_spec: &str,
21017:     allow_spec: &str,
21018:     exit_node_id: Option<String>,
21019: ) -> Result<String, String> {

21033:         format_env_assignment("RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_MIN_REMAINING_SECS", "180")?,
21034:     ];
21035:     if let Some(exit_node_id) = exit_node_id {
21036:         lines.push(format_env_assignment(
21037:             "RUSTYNET_ASSIGNMENT_EXIT_NODE_ID",
21038:             exit_node_id.as_str(),
21039:         )?);
21040:     }
21041:     lines.push(String::new());
21042:     Ok(lines.join("\n"))
21043: }

21045: fn capture_remote_file_to_local(
21046:     target: &RemoteTarget,
21047:     ssh_user_override: Option<&str>,
21048:     ssh_identity_file: Option<&Path>,
21049:     known_hosts_path: Option<&Path>,
21050:     remote_path: &str,
21051:     local_path: &Path,
21052:     timeout: Duration,
21053: ) -> Result<(), String> {
21054:     let output = capture_remote_shell_command_for_target(
21055:         target,
21056:         ssh_user_override,
21057:         ssh_identity_file,
21058:         known_hosts_path,
21059:         format!(
21060:             "set -eu; if sudo -n true >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo -n cat {}; else cat {}; fi",
21061:             shell_quote(remote_path),
21062:             shell_quote(remote_path)
21063:         )
21064:         .as_str(),
21065:         timeout,
21066:     )?;
21067:     fs::write(local_path, output.as_bytes()).map_err(|err| {
21068:         format!(
21069:             "write local capture failed ({}): {err}",
21070:             local_path.display()
21071:         )
21072:     })
21073: }

21075: fn install_state_artifacts_on_target(
21076:     target: &RemoteTarget,
21077:     paths: &StateArtifactInstallPaths<'_>,
21078:     ssh_identity_file: Option<&Path>,
21079:     known_hosts_path: Option<&Path>,
21080:     timeout: Duration,
21081: ) -> Result<(), String> {
21082:     ensure_success_status(
21083:         scp_to_remote_for_target(

21085:             None,
21086:             ssh_identity_file,
21087:             known_hosts_path,
21088:             paths.assignment_pub,
21089:             "/tmp/rn-assignment.pub",
21090:             timeout,
21091:         )?,
21092:         "copy assignment verifier to remote",
21093:     )?;
21094:     ensure_success_status(
21095:         scp_to_remote_for_target(
21096:             target,
21097:             None,
21098:             ssh_identity_file,
21099:             known_hosts_path,
21100:             paths.assignment_bundle,
21101:             "/tmp/rn-assignment.bundle",
21102:             timeout,
21103:         )?,
21104:         "copy assignment bundle to remote",
21105:     )?;
21106:     ensure_success_status(
21107:         scp_to_remote_for_target(
21108:             target,
21109:             None,
21110:             ssh_identity_file,
21111:             known_hosts_path,
21112:             paths.traversal_pub,
21113:             "/tmp/rn-traversal.pub",
21114:             timeout,
21115:         )?,
21116:         "copy traversal verifier to remote",
21117:     )?;
21118:     ensure_success_status(
21119:         scp_to_remote_for_target(
21120:             target,
21121:             None,
21122:             ssh_identity_file,
21123:             known_hosts_path,
21124:             paths.traversal_bundle,
21125:             "/tmp/rn-traversal.bundle",
21126:             timeout,
21127:         )?,
21128:         "copy traversal bundle to remote",
21129:     )?;
21130:     ensure_success_status(
21131:         scp_to_remote_for_target(
21132:             target,
21133:             None,
21134:             ssh_identity_file,
21135:             known_hosts_path,
21136:             paths.refresh_env,
21137:             "/tmp/rn-assignment-refresh.env",
21138:             timeout,
21139:         )?,
21140:         "copy assignment refresh env to remote",
21141:     )?;
21142:     let install_script = "set -eu; \
21143: if sudo -n true >/dev/null 2>&1; then SUDO='sudo -n'; else SUDO=''; fi; \
21144: $SUDO install -m 0644 -o root -g root /tmp/rn-assignment.pub /etc/rustynet/assignment.pub; \
21145: $SUDO install -m 0640 -o root -g rustynetd /tmp/rn-assignment.bundle /var/lib/rustynet/rustynetd.assignment; \
21146: $SUDO rm -f /var/lib/rustynet/rustynetd.assignment.watermark; \
21147: $SUDO install -m 0644 -o root -g root /tmp/rn-traversal.pub /etc/rustynet/traversal.pub; \
21148: $SUDO install -m 0640 -o root -g rustynetd /tmp/rn-traversal.bundle /var/lib/rustynet/rustynetd.traversal; \
21149: $SUDO rm -f /var/lib/rustynet/rustynetd.traversal.watermark; \
21150: $SUDO install -m 0600 -o root -g root /tmp/rn-assignment-refresh.env /etc/rustynet/assignment-refresh.env; \
21151: $SUDO rm -f /tmp/rn-assignment.pub /tmp/rn-assignment.bundle /tmp/rn-traversal.pub /tmp/rn-traversal.bundle /tmp/rn-assignment-refresh.env";
21152:     let status = run_remote_shell_command_for_target(
21153:         target,
21154:         None,
21155:         ssh_identity_file,
21156:         known_hosts_path,
21157:         install_script,
21158:         timeout,
21159:     )
21160:     .map_err(|err| format!("install state artifacts failed for {}: {err}", target.label))?;
21161:     if !status.success() {
21162:         return Err(format!(
21163:             "install state artifacts failed for {} with status {}",
21164:             target.label,
21165:             status_code(status)
21166:         ));
21167:     }
21168:     Ok(())
21169: }
21170: 
21171: fn suite_topology_nodes<'a>(
21172:     topology: &'a VmLabTopology,
21173:     suite: &str,
21174: ) -> Result<Vec<&'a VmLabTopologyNode>, String> {
21175:     match suite {
21176:         "direct-remote-exit" => Ok(vec![
21177:             topology_role_node(topology, &["client"])?,
21178:             topology_role_node(topology, &["exit"])?,
21179:         ]),
21180:         "relay-remote-exit" | "failback-roaming" => Ok(vec![
21181:             topology_role_node(topology, &["client"])?,
21182:             topology_role_node(topology, &["exit"])?,
21183:             topology_role_node(topology, &["relay", "entry"])?,
21184:         ]),
21185:         "full-live-lab" => {
21186:             let mut nodes = vec![
21187:                 topology_role_node(topology, &["exit"])?,
21188:                 topology_role_node(topology, &["client"])?,
21189:                 topology_role_node(topology, &["entry", "relay"])?,
21190:                 topology_role_node(topology, &["aux"])?,
21191:             ];
21192:             if let Some(extra) = topology_optional_role_node(topology, &["extra"])? {
21193:                 nodes.push(extra);
21194:             }
21195:             if let Some(fifth_client) = topology_optional_role_node(topology, &["fifth_client"])? {
21196:                 nodes.push(fifth_client);
21197:             }
21198:             Ok(nodes)
21199:         }
21200:         _ => Err(format!("unsupported vm-lab suite: {suite}")),
21201:     }
21202: }
21203: 
21204: fn ensure_suite_topology_linux_only(
21205:     suite: &str,
21206:     topology: &VmLabTopology,
21207:     inventory: &[VmInventoryEntry],
21208: ) -> Result<(), String> {
21209:     let nodes = suite_topology_nodes(topology, suite)?;
21210:     let mut blocked = Vec::new();
21211:     for node in nodes {
21212:         let inventory_entry = inventory
21213:             .iter()
21214:             .find(|entry| entry.alias == node.alias)
21215:             .ok_or_else(|| {
21216:                 format!(
21217:                     "vm-lab topology alias {} is missing from inventory; cannot verify suite platform compatibility",
21218:                     node.alias
21219:                 )
21220:             })?;
21221:         let platform_profile = inventory_entry.platform_profile();
21222:         if platform_profile.platform != VmGuestPlatform::Linux {
21223:             blocked.push(format!(
21224:                 "role={} alias={} target={} platform={} remote_shell={} guest_exec_mode={} service_manager={}",
21225:                 node.lab_role,
21226:                 node.alias,
21227:                 node.normalized_target,
21228:                 platform_profile.platform.as_str(),
21229:                 platform_profile.remote_shell.as_str(),
21230:                 platform_profile.guest_exec_mode.as_str(),
21231:                 platform_profile.service_manager.as_str(),
21232:             ));
21233:         }
21234:     }
21235:     if blocked.is_empty() {
21236:         Ok(())
21237:     } else {
21238:         Err(format!(
21239:             "vm-lab suite {} is not yet supported for Windows targets in the Linux live-lab shell orchestrator; blocked targets: {}",
21240:             suite,
21241:             blocked.join("; ")
21242:         ))
21243:     }
21244: }
21245: 
21246: fn build_suite_command(
21247:     suite: &str,
21248:     topology: &VmLabTopology,
21249:     inventory: &[VmInventoryEntry],
21250:     ssh_identity_file: &Path,
21251:     nat_profile: Option<&str>,
21252:     impairment_profile: Option<&str>,
21253:     report_dir: &Path,
21254: ) -> Result<SuiteCommand, String> {
21255:     let nat_profile = nat_profile.unwrap_or("baseline_lan");
21256:     let impairment_profile = impairment_profile.unwrap_or("none");
21257:     ensure_suite_topology_linux_only(suite, topology, inventory)?;
21258:     let mut command = Command::new("bash");
21259:     let rendered = match suite {
21260:         "direct-remote-exit" => {
21261:             let script = default_cross_network_direct_script_path();
21262:             let client = topology_role_node(topology, &["client"])?;
21263:             let exit = topology_role_node(topology, &["exit"])?;
21264:             let report_path = report_dir.join("cross_network_direct_remote_exit_report.json");
21265:             let log_path = report_dir.join("cross_network_direct_remote_exit.log");
21266:             command
21267:                 .arg(script.as_path())
21268:                 .arg("--ssh-identity-file")
21269:                 .arg(ssh_identity_file)
21270:                 .arg("--client-host")
21271:                 .arg(client.normalized_target.as_str())
21272:                 .arg("--exit-host")
21273:                 .arg(exit.normalized_target.as_str())
21274:                 .arg("--client-node-id")
21275:                 .arg(client.node_id.as_str())
21276:                 .arg("--exit-node-id")
21277:                 .arg(exit.node_id.as_str())
21278:                 .arg("--client-network-id")
21279:                 .arg(client.network_id.as_str())
21280:                 .arg("--exit-network-id")
21281:                 .arg(exit.network_id.as_str())
21282:                 .arg("--nat-profile")
21283:                 .arg(nat_profile)
21284:                 .arg("--impairment-profile")
21285:                 .arg(impairment_profile)
21286:                 .arg("--report-path")
21287:                 .arg(report_path.as_path())
21288:                 .arg("--log-path")
21289:                 .arg(log_path.as_path());
21290:             render_command_for_display(&command)

21300:                 .arg(script.as_path())

21314:                 .arg(relay.node_id.as_str())
21315:                 .arg("--client-network-id")
21316:                 .arg(client.network_id.as_str())
21317:                 .arg("--exit-network-id")
21318:                 .arg(exit.network_id.as_str())
21319:                 .arg("--relay-network-id")

21321:                 .arg("--nat-profile")
21322:                 .arg(nat_profile)
21323:                 .arg("--impairment-profile")
21324:                 .arg(impairment_profile)

21326:                 .arg(report_path.as_path())
21327:                 .arg("--log-path")
21328:                 .arg(log_path.as_path());
21329:             render_command_for_display(&command)
21330:         }
21331:         "failback-roaming" => {
21332:             let script = default_cross_network_failback_script_path();
21333:             let client = topology_role_node(topology, &["client"])?;
21334:             let exit = topology_role_node(topology, &["exit"])?;
21335:             let relay = topology_role_node(topology, &["relay", "entry"])?;

21359:                 .arg(relay.network_id.as_str())

21361:                 .arg(nat_profile)

21363:                 .arg(impairment_profile)
21364:                 .arg("--report-path")
21365:                 .arg(report_path.as_path())
21366:                 .arg("--log-path")
21367:                 .arg(log_path.as_path());

21371:             let script = default_live_lab_orchestrator_path();

21373:             let client = topology_role_node(topology, &["client"])?;
21374:             let entry = topology_role_node(topology, &["entry", "relay"])?;
21375:             let aux = topology_role_node(topology, &["aux"])?;
21376:             let extra = topology_optional_role_node(topology, &["extra"])?;
21377:             let fifth_client = topology_optional_role_node(topology, &["fifth_client"])?;
21378:             let profile_path = report_dir.join("vm_lab_live_lab.env");
21379:             let mut lines = vec![
21380:                 format_env_assignment("EXIT_TARGET", exit.normalized_target.as_str())?,
21381:                 format_env_assignment("CLIENT_TARGET", client.normalized_target.as_str())?,
21382:                 format_env_assignment("ENTRY_TARGET", entry.normalized_target.as_str())?,
21383:                 format_env_assignment("AUX_TARGET", aux.normalized_target.as_str())?,
21384:                 format_env_assignment(
21385:                     "SSH_IDENTITY_FILE",
21386:                     ssh_identity_file.display().to_string().as_str(),
21387:                 )?,
21388:             ];
21389:             if let Some(extra) = extra {
21390:                 lines.push(format_env_assignment(
21391:                     "EXTRA_TARGET",
21392:                     extra.normalized_target.as_str(),
21393:                 )?);
21394:             }
21395:             if let Some(fifth_client) = fifth_client {
21396:                 lines.push(format_env_assignment(
21397:                     "FIFTH_CLIENT_TARGET",
21398:                     fifth_client.normalized_target.as_str(),
21399:                 )?);
21400:             }
21401:             lines.push(format_env_assignment("SOURCE_MODE", "local-head")?);
21402:             lines.push(format_env_assignment(
21403:                 "REPORT_DIR",
21404:                 report_dir.display().to_string().as_str(),
21405:             )?);
21406:             lines.push(String::new());
21407:             fs::write(profile_path.as_path(), lines.join("\n")).map_err(|err| {
21408:                 format!(
21409:                     "write full live-lab profile failed ({}): {err}",
21410:                     profile_path.display()
21411:                 )
21412:             })?;
21413:             command
21414:                 .arg(script.as_path())
21415:                 .arg("--profile")
21416:                 .arg(profile_path.as_path());
21417:             render_command_for_display(&command)
21418:         }
21419:         _ => return Err(format!("unsupported vm-lab suite command: {suite}")),
21420:     };
21421:     Ok(SuiteCommand { command, rendered })
21422: }
21423: 
21424: fn render_command_for_display(command: &Command) -> String {
21425:     let mut rendered = String::new();
21426:     rendered.push_str(command.get_program().to_string_lossy().as_ref());
21427:     for arg in command.get_args() {
21428:         rendered.push(' ');
21429:         rendered.push_str(shell_quote(arg.to_string_lossy().as_ref()).as_str());
21430:     }
21431:     rendered
21432: }

21434: fn execute_legacy_posix_bootstrap_phase_for_target(
21435:     phase: bootstrap::BootstrapPhase,
21436:     target: &RemoteTarget,
21437:     context: &bootstrap::BootstrapPhaseContext<'_>,
21438: ) -> Result<(), String> {
21439:     if target.platform_profile.platform != VmGuestPlatform::Linux {
21440:         return Err(format!(
21441:             "legacy POSIX bootstrap executor only supports Linux targets: {}",
21442:             target.label
21443:         ));
21444:     }
21445:     match phase {
21446:         bootstrap::BootstrapPhase::SyncSource => {
21447:             let repo_url = context.repo_url.ok_or_else(|| {
21448:                 format!(
21449:                     "bootstrap phase {} requires --repo-url for {}",
21450:                     phase.as_str(),
21451:                     target.label
21452:                 )
21453:             })?;
21454:             let status = run_remote_shell_command_for_target(
21455:                 target,
21456:                 context.ssh_user,
21457:                 context.ssh_identity_file,
21458:                 context.known_hosts_path,
21459:                 build_repo_sync_script(repo_url, context.workdir, context.branch, context.remote)?
21460:                     .as_str(),
21461:                 context.timeout,
21462:             )
21463:             .map_err(|err| format!("{} failed for {}: {err}", phase.as_str(), target.label))?;
21464:             if !status.success() {
21465:                 return Err(format!(
21466:                     "{} failed for {} with status {}",
21467:                     phase.as_str(),
21468:                     target.label,
21469:                     status_code(status)
21470:                 ));
21471:             }
21472:         }
21473:         bootstrap::BootstrapPhase::BuildRelease => {
21474:             let tmpdir = format!("{}/.tmp", context.workdir);
21475:             let status = run_remote_shell_command_for_target(
21476:                 target,
21477:                 context.ssh_user,
21478:                 context.ssh_identity_file,
21479:                 context.known_hosts_path,
21480:                 format!(
21481:                     "set -eu; cd {workdir}; mkdir -p {tmpdir}; \
21482: toolchain_name=''; \
21483: if command -v rustup >/dev/null 2>&1; then \
21484:   toolchain_name=\"$(rustup toolchain list 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR==1 {{ print $1; exit }}' | sed 's/ (default)$//')\"; \
21485: fi; \
21486: cargo_bin='cargo'; \
21487: toolchain_bin=''; \
21488: if [ -n \"$toolchain_name\" ] && [ -d \"$HOME/.rustup/toolchains/$toolchain_name/bin\" ]; then \
21489:   toolchain_bin=\"$HOME/.rustup/toolchains/$toolchain_name/bin\"; \
21490:   cargo_bin=\"$toolchain_bin/cargo\"; \
21491: fi; \
21492: if [ -n \"$toolchain_bin\" ]; then \
21493:   export PATH=\"$toolchain_bin:$PATH\"; \
21494:   export RUSTC=\"$toolchain_bin/rustc\"; \
21495: fi; \
21496: TMPDIR={tmpdir} RUSTUP_SKIP_UPDATE_CHECK=yes exec \"$cargo_bin\" build --locked --release -p rustynetd -p rustynet-cli",
21497:                     workdir = shell_quote(context.workdir),
21498:                     tmpdir = shell_quote(tmpdir.as_str()),
21499:                 )
21500:                 .as_str(),
21501:                 context.timeout,
21502:             )
21503:             .map_err(|err| format!("{} failed for {}: {err}", phase.as_str(), target.label))?;
21504:             if !status.success() {
21505:                 return Err(format!(
21506:                     "{} failed for {} with status {}",
21507:                     phase.as_str(),
21508:                     target.label,
21509:                     status_code(status)
21510:                 ));
21511:             }
21512:         }
21513:         bootstrap::BootstrapPhase::SmokeServiceHost => {
21514:             return Err(format!(
21515:                 "bootstrap phase {} is currently Windows-only: {}",
21516:                 phase.as_str(),
21517:                 target.label
21518:             ));
21519:         }
21520:         bootstrap::BootstrapPhase::InstallRelease => {
21521:             let script = format!(
21522:                 "set -eu; cd {workdir}; \
21523: if sudo -n true >/dev/null 2>&1; then SUDO='sudo -n'; else SUDO=''; fi; \
21524: $SUDO install -m 0755 target/release/rustynetd /usr/local/bin/rustynetd; \
21525: $SUDO install -m 0755 target/release/rustynet-cli /usr/local/bin/rustynet",
21526:                 workdir = shell_quote(context.workdir),
21527:             );
21528:             let status = run_remote_shell_command_for_target(
21529:                 target,
21530:                 context.ssh_user,
21531:                 context.ssh_identity_file,
21532:                 context.known_hosts_path,
21533:                 script.as_str(),
21534:                 context.timeout,
21535:             )
21536:             .map_err(|err| format!("{} failed for {}: {err}", phase.as_str(), target.label))?;
21537:             if !status.success() {
21538:                 return Err(format!(
21539:                     "{} failed for {} with status {}",
21540:                     phase.as_str(),
21541:                     target.label,
21542:                     status_code(status)
21543:                 ));
21544:             }
21545:         }
21546:         bootstrap::BootstrapPhase::RestartRuntime => {
21547:             let status = run_remote_shell_command_for_target(
21548:                 target,
21549:                 context.ssh_user,
21550:                 context.ssh_identity_file,
21551:                 context.known_hosts_path,
21552:                 "set -eu; if sudo -n true >/dev/null 2>&1; then sudo -n systemctl restart rustynetd.service; else systemctl restart rustynetd.service; fi",
21553:                 context.timeout,
21554:             )
21555:             .map_err(|err| format!("{} failed for {}: {err}", phase.as_str(), target.label))?;
21556:             if !status.success() {
21557:                 return Err(format!(
21558:                     "{} failed for {} with status {}",
21559:                     phase.as_str(),
21560:                     target.label,
21561:                     status_code(status)
21562:                 ));
21563:             }
21564:         }
21565:         bootstrap::BootstrapPhase::VerifyRuntime => {
21566:             let status_script = privileged_rustynet_cli_script("status");
21567:             let netcheck_script = privileged_rustynet_cli_script("netcheck");
21568:             let status = run_remote_shell_command_for_target(
21569:                 target,
21570:                 context.ssh_user,
21571:                 context.ssh_identity_file,
21572:                 context.known_hosts_path,
21573:                 format!("set -eu; {status_script} >/dev/null; {netcheck_script} >/dev/null")
21574:                     .as_str(),
21575:                 context.timeout,
21576:             )
21577:             .map_err(|err| format!("{} failed for {}: {err}", phase.as_str(), target.label))?;
21578:             if !status.success() {
21579:                 return Err(format!(
21580:                     "{} failed for {} with status {}",
21581:                     phase.as_str(),
21582:                     target.label,
21583:                     status_code(status)
21584:                 ));
21585:             }
21586:         }
21587:         bootstrap::BootstrapPhase::All => {
21588:             execute_legacy_posix_bootstrap_phase_for_target(
21589:                 bootstrap::BootstrapPhase::SyncSource,
21590:                 target,
21591:                 context,
21592:             )?;
21593:             execute_legacy_posix_bootstrap_phase_for_target(
21594:                 bootstrap::BootstrapPhase::BuildRelease,
21595:                 target,
21596:                 context,
21597:             )?;
21598:             execute_legacy_posix_bootstrap_phase_for_target(
21599:                 bootstrap::BootstrapPhase::InstallRelease,
21600:                 target,
21601:                 context,
21602:             )?;
21603:             execute_legacy_posix_bootstrap_phase_for_target(
21604:                 bootstrap::BootstrapPhase::RestartRuntime,
21605:                 target,
21606:                 context,
21607:             )?;
21608:             execute_legacy_posix_bootstrap_phase_for_target(
21609:                 bootstrap::BootstrapPhase::VerifyRuntime,
21610:                 target,
21611:                 context,
21612:             )?;
21613:         }
21614:     }
21615:     Ok(())
21616: }
21617: 
21618: fn execute_bootstrap_phase_for_target(
21619:     phase: &str,
21620:     target: &RemoteTarget,
21621:     context: &bootstrap::BootstrapPhaseContext<'_>,
21622: ) -> Result<(), String> {
21623:     bootstrap::execute_bootstrap_phase_for_target(phase, target, context)
21624: }

21693:     fn resolve_platform_remote_target(platform: &str) -> (PathBuf, super::RemoteTarget) {
21694:         let (alias, ssh_target, ssh_user, remote_temp_dir) = match platform {
21695:             "linux" => ("linux-utm-1", "debian@192.168.64.10", "debian", "/var/tmp"),
21696:             "windows" => (
21697:                 "windows-utm-1",
21698:                 "192.168.64.20",
21699:                 "Administrator",
21700:                 r"C:\ProgramData\Rustynet\vm-lab",
21701:             ),
21702:             "macos" => (
21703:                 "macos-utm-1",
21704:                 "macos@192.168.64.30",
21705:                 "macos",
21706:                 "/private/var/tmp",
21707:             ),
21708:             "ios" => (
21709:                 "ios-sim-1",
21710:                 "ios@192.168.64.40",
21711:                 "mobile",
21712:                 "/var/mobile/tmp",
21713:             ),
21714:             "android" => (
21715:                 "android-emulator-1",
21716:                 "android@192.168.64.50",
21717:                 "shell",
21718:                 "/data/local/tmp",
21719:             ),
21720:             other => panic!("unsupported test platform: {other}"),
21721:         };
21722:         let remote_temp_dir = remote_temp_dir.replace('\\', "\\\\");
21723:         let path = write_temp_inventory(&format!(
21724:             r#"{{
21725:   "version": 1,
21726:   "entries": [
21727:     {{
21728:       "alias": "{alias}",
21729:       "ssh_target": "{ssh_target}",
21730:       "ssh_user": "{ssh_user}",
21731:       "platform": "{platform}",
21732:       "remote_temp_dir": "{remote_temp_dir}",
21733:       "controller": {{
21734:         "type": "local_utm",
21735:         "utm_name": "{alias}",
21736:         "bundle_path": "/tmp/{alias}.utm"
21737:       }}
21738:     }}
21739:   ]
21740: }}"#,
21741:         ));
21742:         let raw_targets: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
21743:         let target = resolve_remote_targets(
21744:             path.as_path(),
21745:             &[alias.to_string()],
21746:             false,
21747:             raw_targets.as_slice(),
21748:         )
21749:         .expect("target should resolve")
21750:         .into_iter()
21751:         .next()
21752:         .expect("resolved target should exist");
21753:         (path, target)
21754:     }

21760:     fn write_temp_executable(body: &str) -> PathBuf {
21761:         let unique = super::unique_suffix();
21762:         let dir = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("rustynet-vm-lab-bin-{unique}.dir"));
21763:         fs::create_dir_all(&dir).expect("temp executable dir should exist");
21764:         let path = dir.join("mock-bin.sh");
21765:         fs::write(&path, body).expect("temp executable should be written");
21766:         let mut permissions = fs::metadata(&path)
21767:             .expect("temp executable metadata should read")
21768:             .permissions();
21769:         permissions.set_mode(0o755);
21770:         fs::set_permissions(&path, permissions).expect("temp executable should be chmodded");
21771:         path
21772:     }

21784:         let dir = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("rustynet-live-lab-profile-{unique}.dir"));
21785:         fs::create_dir_all(&dir).expect("temp dir should exist");
21786:         let identity = dir.join("id_ed25519");
21787:         fs::write(&identity, "dummy-key").expect("identity file should write");
21788:         let known_hosts = dir.join("known_hosts");
21789:         fs::write(&known_hosts, "example ssh-ed25519 AAAA\n").expect("known hosts should write");
21790:         let profile_path = dir.join("profile.env");
21791:         let rendered = body
21792:             .replace("$IDENTITY_FILE", identity.display().to_string().as_str())
21793:             .replace(
21794:                 "$KNOWN_HOSTS_FILE",
21795:                 known_hosts.display().to_string().as_str(),
21796:             );
21797:         let rendered = append_default_live_lab_platform_metadata(rendered.as_str());
21798:         fs::write(&profile_path, rendered).expect("profile should write");
21799:         profile_path
21800:     }
21801: 
21802:     fn append_default_live_lab_platform_metadata(rendered: &str) -> String {
21803:         let mut rendered = rendered.to_string();
21804:         for role in ["EXIT", "CLIENT", "ENTRY", "AUX", "EXTRA", "FIFTH_CLIENT"] {
21805:             let target_key = format!("{role}_TARGET=");
21806:             let platform_key = format!("{role}_PLATFORM=");
21807:             if rendered.contains(target_key.as_str()) && !rendered.contains(platform_key.as_str()) {
21808:                 rendered.push_str(&format!(
21809: /* ELIDED: original line had 10 backslash-quote sequences — removed to avoid DeepSeek parser failure */
21810:                 ));
21811:             }
21812:         }
21813:         rendered
21814:     }
21815: 
21816:     fn write_temp_stage_rows(report_dir: &Path, rows: &[(&str, &str)]) {
21817:         let mut rendered = String::new();
21818:         for (index, (name, status)) in rows.iter().enumerate() {
21819:             let log_path = report_dir.join("logs").join(format!("{name}.log"));
21820:             fs::write(&log_path, format!("{name} {status}\n")).expect("stage log should write");
21821:             rendered.push_str(&format!(
21822:                 "{name}\thard\t{status}\t{}\t{}\t{name} stage\t2026-04-12T00:00:{index:02}Z\t2026-04-12T00:00:{end:02}Z\n",
21823:                 if *status == "pass" { 0 } else { 1 },
21824:                 log_path.display(),
21825:                 end = index + 1,
21826:             ));
21827:         }
21828:         fs::write(report_dir.join("state/stages.tsv"), rendered).expect("stages should write");
21829:     }
21830: 
21831:     fn cleanup_temp_path(path: &Path) {
21832:         if let Some(parent) = path.parent() {
21833:             let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(parent);
21834:         }
21835:     }

22431:     #[test]
22432:     fn strip_clixml_noise_drops_progress_envelope_keeps_real_errors() {
22433:         // Benign progress envelope from a freshly-booted PowerShell
22434:         // runspace.  Strip cleanly; nothing left.
22435:         let envelope = "#< CLIXML\n<Objs Version=\"1.1.0.1\" xmlns=\"http://schemas.microsoft.com/powershell/2004/04\"><Progress S=\"Progress\"><PR>0</PR><AS>Preparing modules for first use.</AS></Progress></Objs>";
22436:         let filtered = super::strip_powershell_clixml_noise(envelope);
22437:         assert!(
22438:             filtered.trim().is_empty(),
22439:             "CLIXML envelope should be stripped, got: {filtered:?}"
22440:         );
22441: 
22442:         // Real utmctl host error must pass through untouched even when
22443:         // mixed with CLIXML noise.
22444:         let mixed = "#< CLIXML\n<Objs><Progress/></Objs>\nError from event: Access is denied.";
22445:         let filtered = super::strip_powershell_clixml_noise(mixed);
22446:         assert!(
22447:             filtered.contains("Access is denied"),
22448:             "real utmctl error must survive CLIXML stripping, got: {filtered:?}"
22449:         );
22450: 
22451:         // Plain text with no CLIXML pass through.
22452:         let plain = "Error from event: OSStatus error -2700.\nfailed to open file";
22453:         let filtered = super::strip_powershell_clixml_noise(plain);
22454:         assert_eq!(filtered, plain);
22455:     }

24555:     fn validate_live_lab_profile_rejects_non_linux_stage_targets() {
24556:         let profile_path = write_temp_live_lab_profile(
24557: /* ELIDED: original line had 16 backslash-quote sequences — removed to avoid DeepSeek parser failure */
24558:         );
24559: 
24560:         let err = execute_ops_vm_lab_validate_live_lab_profile(VmLabValidateLiveLabProfileConfig {
24561:             profile_path: profile_path.clone(),
24562:             expected_backend: None,
24563:             expected_source_mode: None,
24564:             require_five_node: false,
24565:         })
24566:         .expect_err("non-linux live-lab targets must fail closed");
24567: 
24568:         // W4.1 capability gate format: rejection enumerates the
24569:         // missing capability labels for each blocked target. A
24570:         // Windows target lacks the Linux kernel/userspace caps
24571:         // (`linux-bash-guest-exec`, `nftables-filtering`,
24572:         // `systemd-resolved-dns`) that the bash orchestrator's
24573:         // existing stage list still requires.
24574:         assert!(err.contains("requires capabilities"));
24575:         assert!(err.contains("blocked targets"));
24576:         assert!(err.contains("missing="));
24577:         assert!(
24578:             err.contains("linux-bash-guest-exec")
24579:                 || err.contains("nftables-filtering")
24580:                 || err.contains("systemd-resolved-dns")
24581:         );
24582: 
24583:         cleanup_temp_path(profile_path.as_path());
24584:     }

26454:     #[test]
26455:     fn evaluate_windows_authenticode_report_rejects_overall_ok_true_with_untrusted_chain() {
26456:         // W2.1b: overall_ok=true must imply chain_status=verified. A
26457:         // stale or crafted JSON payload could try to claim overall_ok
26458:         // while leaving chain_status as untrusted; the orchestrator-
26459:         // side double-check rejects it as inconsistent.
26460:         let mut payload = signed_authenticode_payload();
26461:         payload["chain_status"] = serde_json::json!({
26462:             "outcome": "untrusted",
26463:             "reason": "WinVerifyTrust returned 0x800b0109 (CERT_E_UNTRUSTEDROOT) for ...",
26464:             "hresult": 0x800B0109_i64
26465:         });
26466:         let err = super::evaluate_windows_authenticode_report(
26467:             "windows-utm-1",
26468:             payload.to_string().as_str(),
26469:         )
26470:         .expect_err("overall_ok=true with untrusted chain must fail closed");
26471:         assert!(
26472:             err.contains("chain_status is not 'verified'"),
26473:             "unexpected error: {err}"
26474:         );
26475:     }
26476: 
26477:     #[test]
26478:     fn evaluate_windows_authenticode_report_rejects_overall_ok_true_with_not_evaluated_chain() {
26479:         // Same invariant as above for the NotEvaluated variant. The
26480:         // off-Windows path is the typical case here; the daemon-side
26481:         // collector should already mark overall_ok=false in that
26482:         // case, but we double-check at the orchestrator boundary.
26483:         let mut payload = signed_authenticode_payload();
26484:         payload["chain_status"] = serde_json::json!({
26485:             "outcome": "not_evaluated",
26486:             "reason": "off-Windows host"
26487:         });
26488:         let err = super::evaluate_windows_authenticode_report(
26489:             "windows-utm-1",
26490:             payload.to_string().as_str(),
26491:         )
26492:         .expect_err("overall_ok=true with not_evaluated chain must fail closed");
26493:         assert!(
26494:             err.contains("chain_status is not 'verified'"),
26495:             "unexpected error: {err}"
26496:         );
26497:     }

26503:         // explicitly so downstream tooling can grep for the new
26504:         // posture (W2.1a's summary said "signature present").
26505:         let summary = super::evaluate_windows_authenticode_report(

26513:         );

26733:     #[test]
26734:     fn windows_bundle_staging_filename_uses_hex_unique_suffix_for_every_bundle() {
26735:         // Every reviewed bundle contract produces filenames in the
26736:         // same `<prefix>.<32-hex-u128>.staging` shape; only the prefix
26737:         // differs.
26738:         for (contract, expected_prefix) in [
26739:             (&super::WINDOWS_BUNDLE_MEMBERSHIP, "membership.snapshot"),
26740:             (&super::WINDOWS_BUNDLE_ASSIGNMENT, "rustynetd.assignment"),
26741:             (&super::WINDOWS_BUNDLE_TRAVERSAL, "rustynetd.traversal"),
26742:             (&super::WINDOWS_BUNDLE_DNS_ZONE, "rustynetd.dns-zone"),
26743:         ] {
26744:             let filename = super::windows_bundle_staging_filename(contract, 0xdeadbeef_u128);
26745:             assert!(
26746:                 filename.starts_with(&format!("{expected_prefix}.")),
26747:                 "filename must start with {expected_prefix}.: {filename}"
26748:             );
26749:             assert!(filename.ends_with(".staging"));
26750:             let core = filename
26751:                 .strip_prefix(&format!("{expected_prefix}."))
26752:                 .unwrap()
26753:                 .strip_suffix(".staging")
26754:                 .unwrap();
26755:             assert_eq!(core.len(), 32, "hex u128 portion must be 32 chars");
26756:             assert!(
26757:                 core.chars().all(|c| c.is_ascii_hexdigit()),
26758:                 "hex portion must be all hex digits: {core}"
26759:             );
26760:         }
26761:     }
