 198: /// Issue signed bundles on this exit node and SCP the results to `local_out_dir`.
 199: pub fn issue_bundles_to_dir(
 200:     conn: &NodeConnection,
 201:     rustynet_path: &str,
 202:     kind: &crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::error::BundleKind,
 203:     env_content: &str,
 204:     local_out_dir: &std::path::Path,
 205: ) -> Result<(), AdapterError> {
 206:     use std::io::Write as IoWrite;
 207:     let pid = std::process::id();
 208:     let remote_env = format!("/tmp/rn_issue_env_{pid}.env");
 209:     let remote_issue_dir = format!("/tmp/rn_issue_{pid}");
 210: 
 211:     let issue_subcmd = match kind {
 212:         crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::error::BundleKind::Assignment => {
 213:             "e2e-issue-assignment-bundles-from-env"
 214:         }
 215:         crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::error::BundleKind::Traversal => {
 216:             "e2e-issue-traversal-bundles-from-env"
 217:         }
 218:         crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::error::BundleKind::DnsZone => {
 219:             "e2e-issue-dns-zone-bundles-from-env"
 220:         }
 221:         crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::error::BundleKind::Membership => {
 222:             return Err(AdapterError::Protocol {
 223:                 message: "Membership bundles are issued via init_membership_snapshot".to_string(),
 224:             });
 225:         }
 226:     };
 227: 
 228:     let mut env_tmp = std::env::temp_dir();
 229:     env_tmp.push(format!("rn_issue_env_{pid}.env"));
 230:     {
 231:         let mut f = std::fs::File::create(&env_tmp).map_err(|e| AdapterError::Io {
 232:             message: format!("create env tmp: {e}"),
 233:         })?;
 234:         f.write_all(env_content.as_bytes())
 235:             .map_err(|e| AdapterError::Io {
 236:                 message: format!("write env tmp: {e}"),
 237:             })?;
 238:     }
 239:     ssh::scp_to(conn, &env_tmp, &remote_env, MEDIUM_TIMEOUT)?;
 240:     let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&env_tmp);
 241: 
 242:     ssh::run_remote(
 243:         conn,
 244:         &format!("mkdir -p '{remote_issue_dir}'"),
 245:         SHORT_TIMEOUT,
 246:     )?;
 247: 
 248:     let safe_rustynet = rustynet_path.replace('\'', "'\"'\"'");
 249:     ssh::run_remote(
 250:         conn,
 251:         &format!(
 252:             "env RUSTYNET_NODE_ROLE=admin sudo \
 253:              '{safe_rustynet}' ops {issue_subcmd} \
 254:              --env-file '{remote_env}' --issue-dir '{remote_issue_dir}'"
 255:         ),
 256:         MEDIUM_TIMEOUT,
 257:     )?;
 258: 
 259:     let listing = ssh::run_remote(
 260:         conn,
 261:         &format!("ls -1 '{remote_issue_dir}' 2>/dev/null"),
 262:         SHORT_TIMEOUT,
 263:     )?;
 264: 
 265:     std::fs::create_dir_all(local_out_dir).map_err(|e| AdapterError::Io {
 266:         message: format!("create local out dir: {e}"),
 267:     })?;
 268: 
 269:     for filename in listing.lines().map(str::trim).filter(|s| !s.is_empty()) {
 270:         let remote_path = format!("{remote_issue_dir}/{filename}");
 271:         let local_path = local_out_dir.join(filename);
 272:         ssh::scp_from(conn, &remote_path, &local_path, MEDIUM_TIMEOUT)?;
 273:     }
 274: 
 275:     let _ = ssh::run_remote(
 276:         conn,
 277:         &format!("rm -f '{remote_env}' && rm -rf '{remote_issue_dir}'"),
 278:         SHORT_TIMEOUT,
 279:     );
 280: 
 281:     Ok(())
 282: }
 283: 
 284: // ── Internal helpers ───
 285: 
 286: fn validate_ip_arg(ip: &str) -> Result<(), AdapterError> {
 287:     if ip
 288:         .chars()
 289:         .all(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(c, '.' | ':' | '/'))
 290:     {
 291:         Ok(())
 292:     } else {
 293:         Err(AdapterError::Protocol {
 294:             message: format!(
 295:                 "IP argument '{ip}' contains characters not safe for shell embedding \
 296:                  (allowed: alphanumeric, '.', ':', '/')"
 297:             ),
 298:         })
 299:     }
 300: }
 301: 
 302: fn decode_wireguard_pubkey_to_hex(value: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
 303:     let decoded = base64_decode_simple(value.as_bytes())
 304:         .map_err(|err| format!("base64 decode of WireGuard public key failed: {err}"))?;
 305:     if decoded.len() != 32 {
 306:         return Err(format!(
 307:             "expected 32-byte WireGuard public key, got {} bytes",
 308:             decoded.len()
 309:         ));
 310:     }
 311:     let mut out = String::with_capacity(64);
 312:     for byte in decoded {
 313:         out.push_str(&format!("{byte:02x}"));
 314:     }
 315:     Ok(out)
 316: }
 317: 
 318: fn base64_decode_simple(encoded: &[u8]) -> Result<Vec<u8>, String> {
 319:     let filtered: Vec<u8> = encoded
 320:         .iter()
 321:         .copied()
 322:         .filter(|b| !b.is_ascii_whitespace())
 323:         .collect();
 324:     if filtered.is_empty() {
 325:         return Err("empty base64 input".to_string());
 326:     }
 327:     let mut table = [255u8; 256];
 328:     for (i, ch) in b"ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
 329:         .iter()
 330:         .enumerate()
 331:     {
 332:         table[*ch as usize] = i as u8;
 333:     }
 334:     table[b'=' as usize] = 64;
 335: 
 336:     let mut output = Vec::with_capacity((filtered.len() * 3) / 4);
 337:     let mut i = 0;
 338:     while i + 3 < filtered.len() {
 339:         let a = table[filtered[i] as usize];
 340:         let b = table[filtered[i + 1] as usize];
 341:         let c = table[filtered[i + 2] as usize];
 342:         let d = table[filtered[i + 3] as usize];
 343:         if a == 255 || b == 255 {
 344:             return Err(format!("invalid base64 character at position {i}"));
 345:         }
 346:         output.push((a << 2) | (b >> 4));
 347:         if c != 64 {
 348:             output.push(((b & 0xf) << 4) | (c >> 2));
 349:         }
 350:         if d != 64 {
 351:             output.push(((c & 0x3) << 6) | d);
 352:         }
 353:         i += 4;
 354:     }
 355:     Ok(output)
 356: }
 357: 
 358: /// Assert that the collected artifact tarball at `path` contains no key material.
 359: fn verify_no_key_material_tarball(path: &Path) -> Result<(), AdapterError> {
 360:     use std::process::Command;
 361:     let output = Command::new("tar")
 362:         .args(["-tzf"])
 363:         .arg(path.as_os_str())
 364:         .output()
 365:         .map_err(|err| AdapterError::Io {
 366:             message: format!("list tar contents failed: {err}"),
 367:         })?;
 368:     if !output.status.success() {
 369:         let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr);
 370:         if stderr.is_empty() || (!stderr.contains("error") && !stderr.contains("Error")) {
 371:             return Ok(());
 372:         }
 373:         return Ok(());
 374:     }
 375:     let listing = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout);
 376:     for entry in listing.lines() {
 377:         let lower = entry.to_lowercase();
 378:         if lower.contains("/keys/")
 379:             || lower.ends_with(".priv")
 380:             || lower.ends_with(".pem")
 381:             || lower.ends_with(".key")
 382:         {
 383:             return Err(AdapterError::KeyExclusionViolation {
 384:                 path: entry.to_string(),
 385:             });
 386:         }
 387:     }
 388:     Ok(())
 389: }

  15: /// Extract SSH connection parameters from a `NodeConnection`.
  16: /// Returns `Err` if `conn` is not `NodeConnection::Ssh`.
  17: pub fn ssh_params(
  18:     conn: &NodeConnection,
  19: ) -> Result<(&str, u16, Option<&str>, &Path, &Path), AdapterError> {
  20:     match conn {
  21:         NodeConnection::Ssh {
  22:             host,
  23:             port,
  24:             user,
  25:             identity_file,
  26:             known_hosts,
  27:         } => Ok((
  28:             host.as_str(),
  29:             *port,
  30:             user.as_deref(),
  31:             identity_file.as_path(),
  32:             known_hosts.as_path(),
  33:         )),
  34:         other => Err(AdapterError::Ssh {
  35:             message: format!(
  36:                 "SSH operations require NodeConnection::Ssh; got '{}'",
  37:                 other.kind_label()
  38:             ),
  39:         }),
  40:     }
  41: }
  42: 
  43: // ── Command builders ───
  44: 
  45: fn base_ssh_command(
  46:     host: &str,
  47:     port: u16,
  48:     user: Option<&str>,
  49:     identity_file: &Path,
  50:     known_hosts: &Path,
  51: ) -> Command {
  52:     let mut cmd = Command::new("ssh");
  53:     cmd.args([
  54:         "-n",
  55:         "-o",
  56:         "LogLevel=ERROR",
  57:         "-o",
  58:         "BatchMode=yes",
  59:         "-o",
  60:         "StrictHostKeyChecking=yes",
  61:         "-o",
  62:         "ConnectTimeout=15",
  63:         "-o",
  64:         "ServerAliveInterval=20",
  65:         "-o",
  66:         "ServerAliveCountMax=3",
  67:         "-o",
  68:         "IdentitiesOnly=yes",
  69:         "-p",
  70:         &port.to_string(),
  71:     ]);
  72:     cmd.arg("-i").arg(identity_file);
  73:     cmd.arg("-o")
  74:         .arg(format!("UserKnownHostsFile={}", known_hosts.display()));
  75:     if let Some(u) = user {
  76:         cmd.arg("-l").arg(u);
  77:     }
  78:     cmd.arg("--").arg(host);
  79:     cmd
  80: }
  81: 
  82: fn base_scp_command(
  83:     port: u16,
  84:     identity_file: &Path,
  85:     known_hosts: &Path,
  86:     user: Option<&str>,
  87: ) -> Command {
  88:     let mut cmd = Command::new("scp");
  89:     cmd.args([
  90:         "-q",
  91:         "-o",
  92:         "LogLevel=ERROR",
  93:         "-o",
  94:         "BatchMode=yes",
  95:         "-o",
  96:         "StrictHostKeyChecking=yes",
  97:         "-o",
  98:         "ConnectTimeout=15",
  99:         "-o",
 100:         "IdentitiesOnly=yes",
 101:         "-P",
 102:         &port.to_string(),
 103:     ]);
 104:     cmd.arg("-i").arg(identity_file);
 105:     cmd.arg("-o")
 106:         .arg(format!("UserKnownHostsFile={}", known_hosts.display()));
 107:     if let Some(u) = user {
 108:         cmd.arg("-o").arg(format!("User={u}"));
 109:     }
 110:     cmd
 111: }

 113: // ── Public API ───

 115: /// Run `script` on the remote host over SSH. Returns trimmed stdout on success.
 116: /// Non-zero exit code → `AdapterError::Command`.
 117: pub fn run_remote(
 118:     conn: &NodeConnection,
 119:     script: &str,
 120:     timeout: Duration,
 121: ) -> Result<String, AdapterError> {
 122:     let (host, port, user, identity_file, known_hosts) = ssh_params(conn)?;
 123:     let mut cmd = base_ssh_command(host, port, user, identity_file, known_hosts);
 124:     cmd.arg(script);
 125:     let output =
 126:         run_output_with_timeout(&mut cmd, timeout).map_err(|message| AdapterError::Ssh {
 127:             message: format!("SSH spawn failed for {host}: {message}"),
 128:         })?;
 129:     if !output.status.success() {
 130:         let stderr_raw = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).trim().to_string();
 131:         // Windows PowerShell over OpenSSH frequently writes diagnostic
 132:         // detail to stdout (CLIXML stream / Write-Host). When stderr is
 133:         // empty, fall back to a tail of stdout so the operator sees
 134:         // *something* rather than a bare "(exit Some(1)): ".
 135:         let stdout_lossy = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout);
 136:         let stdout_trimmed = stdout_lossy.trim();
 137:         let stderr = if stderr_raw.is_empty() {
 138:             // Windows PowerShell over OpenSSH frequently writes diagnostic
 139:             // detail to stdout (CLIXML stream / Write-Host). When stderr is
 140:             // empty, fall back to a tail of stdout so the operator sees
 141:             // *something* rather than a bare "(exit Some(1)): ".
 142:             if stdout_trimmed.is_empty() {
 143:                 String::new()
 144:             } else {
 145:                 let tail: String = stdout_trimmed
 146:                     .chars()
 147:                     .rev()
 148:                     .take(800)
 149:                     .collect::<Vec<_>>()
 150:                     .into_iter()
 151:                     .rev()
 152:                     .collect();
 153:                 format!("(stderr empty; stdout tail) {tail}")
 154:             }
 155:         } else if !stdout_trimmed.is_empty() {
 156:             // Both streams have content. Cargo writes progress to stderr; the
 157:             // rustynet binary writes errors to stdout via println!. Combine
 158:             // tails from both so the operator sees the actual failure message.
 159:             let stderr_tail: String = stderr_raw
 160:                 .chars()
 161:                 .rev()
 162:                 .take(600)
 163:                 .collect::<Vec<_>>()
 164:                 .into_iter()
 165:                 .rev()
 166:                 .collect();
 167:             let stdout_tail: String = stdout_trimmed
 168:                 .chars()
 169:                 .rev()
 170:                 .take(400)
 171:                 .collect::<Vec<_>>()
 172:                 .into_iter()
 173:                 .rev()
 174:                 .collect();
 175:             format!("{stderr_tail}\n[stdout: {stdout_tail}]")
 176:         } else {
 177:             stderr_raw
 178:         };
 179:         let code = output.status.code();
 180:         return Err(AdapterError::Command {
 181:             exit_code: code,
 182:             stderr,
 183:         });
 184:     }
 185:     String::from_utf8(output.stdout)
 186:         .map(|s| s.trim().to_string())
 187:         .map_err(|err| AdapterError::Protocol {
 188:             message: format!("remote output was not valid UTF-8: {err}"),
 189:         })
 190: }
 191: 
 192: /// Run `script` on the remote host. Returns `true` if exit code is 0.
 193: /// Never returns `Err` for non-zero exit — use this only for boolean probes.
 194: pub fn run_remote_check(
 195:     conn: &NodeConnection,
 196:     script: &str,
 197:     timeout: Duration,
 198: ) -> Result<bool, AdapterError> {
 199:     match run_remote(conn, script, timeout) {
 200:         Ok(_) => Ok(true),
 201:         Err(AdapterError::Command { .. }) => Ok(false),
 202:         Err(other) => Err(other),
 203:     }
 204: }

 206: /// SCP a local file to the remote host.
 207: pub fn scp_to(
 208:     conn: &NodeConnection,
 209:     local: &Path,
 210:     remote_dst: &str,
 211:     timeout: Duration,
 212: ) -> Result<(), AdapterError> {
 213:     let (host, port, user, identity_file, known_hosts) = ssh_params(conn)?;
 214:     let mut cmd = base_scp_command(port, identity_file, known_hosts, user);
 215:     cmd.arg("--")
 216:         .arg(local.as_os_str())
 217:         .arg(format!("{host}:{remote_dst}"));
 218:     let status =
 219:         run_status_with_timeout(&mut cmd, timeout).map_err(|message| AdapterError::Ssh {
 220:             message: format!("SCP to {host}:{remote_dst} failed: {message}"),
 221:         })?;
 222:     if !status.success() {
 223:         return Err(AdapterError::Command {
 224:             exit_code: status.code(),
 225:             stderr: format!("scp to {host}:{remote_dst} exited with status {status}"),
 226:         });
 227:     }
 228:     Ok(())
 229: }
 230: 
 231: /// SCP a file from the remote host to a local path.
 232: pub fn scp_from(
 233:     conn: &NodeConnection,
 234:     remote_src: &str,
 235:     local_dst: &Path,
 236:     timeout: Duration,
 237: ) -> Result<(), AdapterError> {
 238:     let (host, port, user, identity_file, known_hosts) = ssh_params(conn)?;
 239:     if let Some(parent) = local_dst.parent().filter(|p| !p.as_os_str().is_empty()) {
 240:         fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|err| AdapterError::Io {
 241:             message: format!("create local scp destination dir failed: {err}"),
 242:         })?;
 243:     }
 244:     let mut cmd = base_scp_command(port, identity_file, known_hosts, user);
 245:     cmd.arg("--")
 246:         .arg(format!("{host}:{remote_src}"))
 247:         .arg(local_dst.as_os_str());
 248:     let status =
 249:         run_status_with_timeout(&mut cmd, timeout).map_err(|message| AdapterError::Ssh {
 250:             message: format!("SCP from {host}:{remote_src} failed: {message}"),
 251:         })?;
 252:     if !status.success() {
 253:         return Err(AdapterError::Command {
 254:             exit_code: status.code(),
 255:             stderr: format!("scp from {host}:{remote_src} exited with status {status}"),
 256:         });
 257:     }
 258:     Ok(())
 259: }
 260: 
 261: /// Poll until `socket_path` exists on the remote (a UNIX domain socket file).
 262: /// Returns `Err` if the socket does not appear within `timeout`.
 263: pub fn wait_for_remote_socket(
 264:     conn: &NodeConnection,
 265:     socket_path: &str,
 266:     timeout: Duration,
 267: ) -> Result<(), AdapterError> {
 268:     let deadline = Instant::now() + timeout;
 269:     let poll = Duration::from_millis(500);
 270:     let script = format!("test -S {socket_path}");
 271:     loop {
 272:         if run_remote_check(conn, &script, Duration::from_secs(10))? {
 273:             return Ok(());
 274:         }
 275:         if Instant::now() >= deadline {
 276:             return Err(AdapterError::Ssh {
 277:                 message: format!("daemon socket {socket_path} did not appear within {timeout:?}"),
 278:             });
 279:         }
 280:         thread::sleep(poll);
 281:     }
 282: }
 283: 
 284: // ── Private runtime helpers ───
 285: 
 286: fn run_output_with_timeout(
 287:     command: &mut Command,
 288:     timeout: Duration,
 289: ) -> Result<std::process::Output, String> {
 290:     command.stdin(Stdio::null());
 291:     command.stdout(Stdio::piped());
 292:     command.stderr(Stdio::piped());
 293:     let mut child = command
 294:         .spawn()
 295:         .map_err(|err| format!("spawn failed: {err}"))?;
 296:     let started_at = Instant::now();
 297:     loop {
 298:         if child
 299:             .try_wait()
 300:             .map_err(|err| format!("wait failed: {err}"))?
 301:             .is_some()
 302:         {
 303:             return child
 304:                 .wait_with_output()
 305:                 .map_err(|err| format!("collect output failed: {err}"));
 306:         }
 307:         if started_at.elapsed() >= timeout {
 308:             let _ = child.kill();
 309:             let _ = child.wait();
 310:             return Err(format!("timed out after {} seconds", timeout.as_secs()));
 311:         }
 312:         thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(POLL_INTERVAL_MILLIS));
 313:     }
 314: }
 315: 
 316: fn run_status_with_timeout(
 317:     command: &mut Command,
 318:     timeout: Duration,
 319: ) -> Result<std::process::ExitStatus, String> {
 320:     command.stdin(Stdio::null());
 321:     command.stdout(Stdio::null());
 322:     command.stderr(Stdio::null());
 323:     let mut child = command
 324:         .spawn()
 325:         .map_err(|err| format!("spawn failed: {err}"))?;
 326:     let started_at = Instant::now();
 327:     loop {
 328:         if let Some(status) = child
 329:             .try_wait()
 330:             .map_err(|err| format!("wait failed: {err}"))?
 331:         {
 332:             return Ok(status);
 333:         }
 334:         if started_at.elapsed() >= timeout {
 335:             let _ = child.kill();
 336:             let _ = child.wait();
 337:             return Err(format!("timed out after {} seconds", timeout.as_secs()));
 338:         }
 339:         thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(POLL_INTERVAL_MILLIS));
 340:     }
 341: }
 342: 
 343: /// Parse the `node_id=<value>` field from a `rustynet status` output line.
 344: /// The status response is `key=value key=value …` space-separated.
 345: pub fn parse_status_node_id(status_text: &str) -> Option<String> {
 346:     status_text.split_whitespace().find_map(|field| {
 347:         field
 348:             .strip_prefix("node_id=")
 349:             .map(|value| value.to_string())
 350:     })
 351: }
 352: 
 353: /// Parse any `key=<value>` field from a `rustynet status` space-separated output.
 354: pub fn parse_status_field(status_text: &str, key: &str) -> Option<String> {
 355:     let prefix = format!("{key}=");
 356:     status_text
 357:         .split_whitespace()
 358:         .find_map(|field| field.strip_prefix(prefix.as_str()).map(|v| v.to_string()))
 359: }
 360: 
 361: // ── Build remote path for a host+user combination ───
 362: 
 363: pub fn remote_home(user: Option<&str>) -> &'static str {
 364:     match user {
 365:         Some("root") | None => "/root",
 366:         _ => "/home/",
 367:     }
 368: }
 369: 
 370: pub fn remote_home_for_user(user: Option<&str>, heap_user: &str) -> PathBuf {
 371:     match user {
 372:         Some("root") => PathBuf::from("/root"),
 373:         Some(u) => PathBuf::from(format!("/home/{u}")),
 374:         None => PathBuf::from(format!("/home/{heap_user}")),
 375:     }
 376: }

 204: // ── Internal helpers ───
 205: 
 206: /// Build a PowerShell script that invokes the validator binary.
 207: /// argv must be [daemon_path, subcommand, ...flags] as produced by
 208: /// `WindowsDaemonProbe::build_argv`.
 209: fn build_validator_script(argv: &[String]) -> String {
 210:     use crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::adapter::windows_install::ps_quote;
 211:     if argv.is_empty() {
 212:         return String::new();
 213:     }
 214:     // Quote binary path; remaining args are fixed safe strings (subcommand + flags).
 215:     let binary = ps_quote(argv[0].as_str()).unwrap_or_else(|_| format!("'{}'", argv[0]));
 216:     let rest: Vec<&str> = argv[1..].iter().map(String::as_str).collect();
 217:     if rest.is_empty() {
 218:         format!("& {binary}")
 219:     } else {
 220:         format!(
 221:             "$out = & {binary} {} 2>&1; Write-Output $out",
 222:             rest.join(" ")
 223:         )
 224:     }
 225: }

  18: // `Install-RustyNetWindowsService.ps1` applies (NT SERVICE\RustyNet only)
  19: // cannot inherit onto SCP-staged files. C:\Windows\Temp is world-writable
  20: // by default and ships as the canonical Windows transient-binary location.

  22: pub const WINDOWS_MEMBERSHIP_OWNER_PUBKEY_PATH: &str =

  30: const WINDOWS_MEMBERSHIP_LOG_PATH: &str = r"C:\ProgramData\RustyNet\membership\membership.log";

  40: static BOOTSTRAP_SCRIPT: &str =
  41:     include_str!("../../../../../../scripts/bootstrap/windows/Bootstrap-RustyNetWindows.ps1");
  42: static INSTALL_SERVICE_SCRIPT: &str =
  43:     include_str!("../../../../../../scripts/bootstrap/windows/Install-RustyNetWindowsService.ps1");
  44: static UNINSTALL_SERVICE_SCRIPT: &str = include_str!(
  45:     "../../../../../../scripts/bootstrap/windows/Uninstall-RustyNetWindowsService.ps1"
  46: );
  47: 
  48: const SHORT_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(30);
  49: const BUILD_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(3600); // cold release build on Windows VM can take 30-60 min
  50: 
  51: // ── PowerShell encoding helpers ───
  52: 
  53: /// Encode a PowerShell script as UTF-16LE + base64 for `-EncodedCommand`.
  54: pub fn encode_ps_command(script: &str) -> Result<String, AdapterError> {
  55:     if script.contains('\0') {
  56:         return Err(AdapterError::Protocol {
  57:             message: "PowerShell script contains NUL byte".to_string(),
  58:         });
  59:     }
  60:     let mut bytes = Vec::with_capacity(script.len() * 2);
  61:     for unit in script.encode_utf16() {
  62:         bytes.extend_from_slice(&unit.to_le_bytes());
  63:     }
  64:     Ok(BASE64_STANDARD.encode(bytes))
  65: }
  66: 
  67: /// Build the SSH command string that invokes PowerShell with an encoded script.
  68: pub fn build_ps_invocation(script: &str) -> Result<String, AdapterError> {
  69:     let encoded = encode_ps_command(script)?;
  70:     Ok(format!(
  71:         "powershell.exe -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -EncodedCommand {encoded}"
  72:     ))
  73: }
  74: 
  75: /// Single-quote a value for embedding in a PS literal string.
  76: /// Rejects control characters (NUL/CR/LF) that could escape the literal.
  77: pub fn ps_quote(value: &str) -> Result<String, AdapterError> {
  78:     if value
  79:         .chars()
  80:         .any(|ch| ch == '\0' || ch == '\r' || ch == '\n')
  81:     {
  82:         return Err(AdapterError::Protocol {
  83:             message: format!(
  84:                 "value contains control characters not safe for PS quoting: {value:?}"
  85:             ),
  86:         });
  87:     }
  88:     Ok(format!("'{}'", value.replace('\'', "''")))
  89: }
  90: 
  91: // ── Remote PS execution ───
  92: 
  93: /// Run a PowerShell script over SSH. The script is base64-encoded so it
  94: /// survives the SSH quoting layer. Returns trimmed stdout on success.
  95: pub fn run_remote_ps(
  96:     conn: &NodeConnection,
  97:     script: &str,
  98:     timeout: Duration,
  99: ) -> Result<String, AdapterError> {
 100:     let invocation = build_ps_invocation(script)?;
 101:     ssh::run_remote(conn, &invocation, timeout)
 102: }
 103: 
 104: /// Run a PowerShell script over SSH. Returns `true` if exit code is 0.
 105: pub fn run_remote_ps_check(
 106:     conn: &NodeConnection,
 107:     script: &str,
 108:     timeout: Duration,
 109: ) -> Result<bool, AdapterError> {
 110:     let invocation = build_ps_invocation(script)?;
 111:     ssh::run_remote_check(conn, &invocation, timeout)
 112: }
 113: 
 114: // ── Install lifecycle ───
 115: 
 116: /// Bootstrap the daemon on a Windows host. Extracts `source` into `workdir`
 117: /// via tar.exe, then runs Bootstrap-RustyNetWindows.ps1 -Phase build-release,
 118: /// Install-RustyNetWindowsService.ps1, and runs the e2e bootstrap sequence to
 119: /// generate WireGuard keys, membership state, and trust evidence.
 120: pub fn install_daemon(
 121:     conn: &NodeConnection,
 122:     alias: &str,
 123:     workdir: &str,
 124:     source: &crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::source_archive::SourceArchive,
 125:     ctx: &OrchestrationContext,
 126: ) -> Result<InstallReport, AdapterError> {
 127:     validate_windows_path(workdir)?;
 128: 
 129:     let staging_dir = WINDOWS_STAGING_DIR;
 130:     let remote_archive = format!(r"{staging_dir}\rn_source.tar.gz");
 131: 
 132:     // SCP bootstrap helpers to staging dir.
 133:     let bootstrap_tmp = write_temp_file(
 134:         "Bootstrap-RustyNetWindows_",
 135:         ".ps1",
 136:         BOOTSTRAP_SCRIPT.as_bytes(),
 137:     )?;
 138:     let install_tmp = write_temp_file(
 139:         "Install-RustyNetWindowsService_",
 140:         ".ps1",
 141:         INSTALL_SERVICE_SCRIPT.as_bytes(),
 142:     )?;
 143: 
 144:     // Ensure staging dir exists on remote.
 145:     let ensure_dir_script = format!(
 146:         "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path {} | Out-Null",
 147:         ps_quote(staging_dir)?
 148:     );
 149:     run_remote_ps(conn, &ensure_dir_script, SHORT_TIMEOUT)?;
 150: 
 151:     let remote_bootstrap = format!(r"{staging_dir}\Bootstrap-RustyNetWindows.ps1");
 152:     let remote_install_svc = format!(r"{staging_dir}\Install-RustyNetWindowsService.ps1");
 153: 
 154:     ssh::scp_to(
 155:         conn,
 156:         bootstrap_tmp.as_path(),
 157:         &remote_bootstrap.replace('\\', "/"),
 158:         SHORT_TIMEOUT,
 159:     )?;
 160:     ssh::scp_to(
 161:         conn,
 162:         install_tmp.as_path(),
 163:         &remote_install_svc.replace('\\', "/"),
 164:         SHORT_TIMEOUT,
 165:     )?;
 166:     // SCP the source archive.
 167:     ssh::scp_to(
 168:         conn,
 169:         source.path(),
 170:         &remote_archive.replace('\\', "/"),
 171:         Duration::from_secs(120),
 172:     )?;
 173: 
 174:     let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&bootstrap_tmp);
 175:     let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&install_tmp);
 176: 
 177:     // Extract source archive into workdir, overwriting existing files.
 178:     // Uses Windows built-in tar.exe (available since Windows 10 1803).
 179:     // git archive produces files at the archive root (no leading dir component).
 180:     let extract_script = format!(
 181:         "$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; \
 182:          $ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'; \
 183:          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path {workdir_q} | Out-Null; \
 184:          & tar.exe -xzf {archive_q} -C {workdir_q}",
 185:         workdir_q = ps_quote(workdir)?,
 186:         archive_q = ps_quote(&remote_archive)?,
 187:     );
 188:     run_remote_ps(conn, &extract_script, Duration::from_secs(120))?;
 189: 
 190:     // Build release from synced workdir.
 191:     let build_script = format!(
 192:         "Set-StrictMode -Version Latest; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; \
 193:          $ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'; \
 194:          Set-Location -LiteralPath {workdir_q}; \
 195:          & {bootstrap_q} -Phase build-release -RustyNetRoot {workdir_q}",
 196:         workdir_q = ps_quote(workdir)?,
 197:         bootstrap_q = ps_quote(&remote_bootstrap)?,
 198:     );
 199:     run_remote_ps(conn, &build_script, BUILD_TIMEOUT)?;
 200: 
 201:     // Install the service.
 202:     let install_script = format!(
 203:         "Set-StrictMode -Version Latest; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; \
 204:          $ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'; \
 205:          & {install_q} \
 206:            -RustyNetRoot {workdir_q} \
 207:            -InstallRoot {install_root_q} \
 208:            -StateRoot {state_root_q} \
 209:            -ServiceName {svc_q}",
 210:         install_q = ps_quote(&remote_install_svc)?,
 211:         workdir_q = ps_quote(workdir)?,
 212:         install_root_q = ps_quote(WINDOWS_INSTALL_ROOT)?,
 213:         state_root_q = ps_quote(WINDOWS_STATE_ROOT)?,
 214:         svc_q = ps_quote(WINDOWS_SERVICE_NAME)?,
 215:     );
 216:     run_remote_ps(conn, &install_script, Duration::from_secs(120))?;
 217: 
 218:     // Verify the daemon binary is present before running e2e bootstrap.
 219:     let verify_script = format!(
 220:         "if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath {})) {{ throw 'rustynetd.exe not found' }}",
 221:         ps_quote(WINDOWS_RUSTYNETD_PATH)?,
 222:     );
 223:     run_remote_ps(conn, &verify_script, SHORT_TIMEOUT)?;
 224: 
 225:     // Run the e2e bootstrap sequence to generate WireGuard keys, membership
 226:     // state, and trust evidence. The service starts AFTER bootstrap completes.
 227:     run_windows_e2e_bootstrap(conn, alias, ctx)?;
 228: 
 229:     Ok(InstallReport {
 230:         daemon_path: WINDOWS_RUSTYNETD_PATH.into(),
 231:         service_name: WINDOWS_SERVICE_NAME.to_string(),
 232:     })
 233: }

 250: /// Stop and remove the service; optionally purge state root.
 251: pub fn uninstall_daemon(conn: &NodeConnection) -> Result<(), AdapterError> {
 252:     // Stop first (best-effort).
 253:     let _ = stop_daemon(conn);
 254: 
 255:     let staging_dir = WINDOWS_STAGING_DIR;
 256:     let uninstall_tmp = write_temp_file(
 257:         "Uninstall-RustyNetWindowsService_",
 258:         ".ps1",
 259:         UNINSTALL_SERVICE_SCRIPT.as_bytes(),
 260:     )?;
 261:     let remote_uninstall = format!(r"{staging_dir}\Uninstall-RustyNetWindowsService.ps1");
 262: 
 263:     let ensure_dir_script = format!(
 264:         "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path {} | Out-Null",
 265:         ps_quote(staging_dir)?
 266:     );
 267:     run_remote_ps(conn, &ensure_dir_script, SHORT_TIMEOUT)?;
 268: 
 269:     ssh::scp_to(
 270:         conn,
 271:         uninstall_tmp.as_path(),
 272:         &remote_uninstall.replace('\\', "/"),
 273:         SHORT_TIMEOUT,
 274:     )?;
 275:     let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&uninstall_tmp);
 276: 
 277:     let script = format!(
 278:         "Set-StrictMode -Version Latest; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; \
 279:          $ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'; \
 280:          & {uninstall_q} \
 281:            -ServiceName {svc_q} \
 282:            -InstallRoot {install_root_q} \
 283:            -StateRoot {state_root_q} \
 284:            -PurgeStateRoot -PurgeInstallRoot",
 285:         uninstall_q = ps_quote(&remote_uninstall)?,
 286:         svc_q = ps_quote(WINDOWS_SERVICE_NAME)?,
 287:         install_root_q = ps_quote(WINDOWS_INSTALL_ROOT)?,
 288:         state_root_q = ps_quote(WINDOWS_STATE_ROOT)?,
 289:     );
 290:     run_remote_ps(conn, &script, Duration::from_secs(60))?;
 291:     Ok(())
 292: }
 293: 
 294: // ── Windows e2e bootstrap ───
 295: 
 296: /// Generate WireGuard keys, membership state, and trust evidence for a Windows host.
 297: /// Trust keys are generated locally on the orchestrator (rustynet-cli cannot compile
 298: /// on Windows due to std::os::unix::* imports) and SCP'd to the remote host.
 299: /// Called from `install_daemon` after the service binaries are installed.
 300: fn run_windows_e2e_bootstrap(
 301:     conn: &NodeConnection,
 302:     alias: &str,
 303:     ctx: &OrchestrationContext,
 304: ) -> Result<(), AdapterError> {
 305:     let node_id = ctx
 306:         .node_ids
 307:         .get(alias)
 308:         .cloned()
 309:         .unwrap_or_else(|| format!("{alias}-bootstrap"));
 310:     let network_id = &ctx.network_id;
 311:     let role_str = match ctx
 312:         .assignments
 313:         .iter()
 314:         .find(|a| a.alias == alias)
 315:         .map(|a| &a.role)
 316:     {
 317:         Some(NodeRole::Exit) => "admin",
 318:         _ => "client",
 319:     };
 320:     let _ = role_str;
 321: 
 322:     // ── 1. Generate trust material locally ───
 323:     let (verifier_key_content, trust_evidence_content) =
 324:         generate_local_trust_material().map_err(|msg| AdapterError::Protocol { message: msg })?;
 325: 
 326:     // Ensure trust directory exists on remote before SCP.
 327:     let trust_dir_q = ps_quote(r"C:\ProgramData\RustyNet\trust")?;
 328:     run_remote_ps(
 329:         conn,
 330:         &format!("New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path {trust_dir_q} | Out-Null"),
 331:         SHORT_TIMEOUT,
 332:     )?;
 333: 
 334:     let verifier_tmp = write_temp_file("trust_verifier_", ".pub", verifier_key_content.as_bytes())?;
 335:     let evidence_tmp =
 336:         write_temp_file("trust_evidence_", ".dat", trust_evidence_content.as_bytes())?;
 337: 
 338:     let scp_result = (|| {
 339:         ssh::scp_to(
 340:             conn,
 341:             &verifier_tmp,
 342:             &WINDOWS_TRUST_VERIFIER_KEY_PATH.replace('\\', "/"),
 343:             SHORT_TIMEOUT,
 344:         )?;
 345:         ssh::scp_to(
 346:             conn,
 347:             &evidence_tmp,
 348:             &WINDOWS_TRUST_EVIDENCE_PATH.replace('\\', "/"),
 349:             SHORT_TIMEOUT,
 350:         )
 351:     })();
 352:     let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&verifier_tmp);
 353:     let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&evidence_tmp);
 354:     scp_result?;
 355: 
 356:     // ── 2. WireGuard key init + membership init + service start ───
 357:     let passphrase_q = ps_quote(WINDOWS_WG_PASSPHRASE_PATH)?;
 358:     let rustynetd_q = ps_quote(WINDOWS_RUSTYNETD_PATH)?;
 359:     let wg_binary_q = ps_quote(WINDOWS_WG_BINARY_PATH)?;
 360:     let node_id_q = ps_quote(&node_id)?;
 361:     let network_id_q = ps_quote(network_id)?;
 362:     let membership_owner_key_q = ps_quote(WINDOWS_MEMBERSHIP_OWNER_KEY_PATH)?;
 363:     let membership_log_q = ps_quote(WINDOWS_MEMBERSHIP_LOG_PATH)?;
 364:     let membership_watermark_q = ps_quote(WINDOWS_MEMBERSHIP_WATERMARK_PATH)?;
 365:     let membership_snapshot_q = ps_quote(WINDOWS_MEMBERSHIP_SNAPSHOT_PATH)?;
 366:     let svc_q = ps_quote(WINDOWS_SERVICE_NAME)?;
 367: 
 368:     let bootstrap_script = format!(
 369:         "$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; \
 370:          $ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'; \
 371:          $env:RUSTYNET_WG_BINARY_PATH = {wg_binary_q}; \
 372:          $rng = [System.Security.Cryptography.RandomNumberGenerator]::Create(); \
 373:          $bytes = New-Object byte[] 48; \
 374:          $rng.GetBytes($bytes); \
 375:          $pp = -join ($bytes | ForEach-Object {{ $_.ToString('x2') }}); \
 376:          $buser = (whoami.exe).Trim(); \
 377:          takeown.exe /f 'C:\\ProgramData\\RustyNet' /r /d y; \
 378:          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {{ throw \"takeown state-root failed (exit $LASTEXITCODE)\" }}; \
 379:          icacls.exe 'C:\\ProgramData\\RustyNet' /grant:r \"${{buser}}:(OI)(CI)(F)\" /T; \
 380:          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {{ throw \"icacls state-root grant failed (exit $LASTEXITCODE)\" }}; \
 381:          icacls.exe 'C:\\ProgramData\\RustyNet' /setowner 'BUILTIN\\Administrators' /T; \
 382:          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {{ Write-Warning \"icacls setowner failed (exit $LASTEXITCODE) - continuing\" }}; \
 383:          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path (Split-Path {passphrase_q}) | Out-Null; \
 384:          [System.IO.File]::WriteAllText({passphrase_q}, $pp); \
 385:          $keyInitOut = (& {rustynetd_q} key init --passphrase-file {passphrase_q} --force 2>&1) -join ' '; \
 386:          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {{ throw \"rustynetd key init failed: $keyInitOut\" }}; \
 387:          $mbInitOut = (& {rustynetd_q} membership init \
 388:              --snapshot {membership_snapshot_q} \
 389:              --log {membership_log_q} \
 390:              --watermark {membership_watermark_q} \
 391:              --owner-signing-key {membership_owner_key_q} \
 392:              --owner-signing-key-passphrase-file {passphrase_q} \
 393:              --node-id {node_id_q} \
 394:              --network-id {network_id_q} \
 395:              --force 2>&1) -join ' '; \
 396:          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {{ throw \"rustynetd membership init failed: $mbInitOut\" }}; \
 397:          $kspOut = (& {rustynetd_q} key store-passphrase --passphrase-file {passphrase_q} 2>&1) -join ' '; \
 398:          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {{ throw \"rustynetd key store-passphrase failed: $kspOut\" }}; \
 399:          $aclOut = (& {rustynetd_q} windows-runtime-acls-check 2>&1) -join ' '; \
 400:          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {{ throw \"runtime ACL check failed (startup would fail): $aclOut\" }}; \
 401:          Stop-Service -Name {svc_q} -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; \
 402:          Start-Service -Name {svc_q}; \
 403:          Start-Sleep -Seconds 8; \
 404:          $svcStatus = (Get-Service -Name {svc_q} -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Status; \
 405:          if ($svcStatus -ne 'Running') {{ \
 406:              $scmEvt = try {{ (Get-EventLog -LogName System -Source 'Service Control Manager' -Newest 5 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object {{ $_.Message -like '*RustyNet*' }} | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Message) -join ' | ' }} catch {{ '' }}; \
 407:              $appEvt = try {{ (Get-EventLog -LogName Application -Newest 15 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object {{ $_.Message -like '*rustynet*' -or $_.Source -like '*rustynet*' }} | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Message) -join ' | ' }} catch {{ '' }}; \
 408:              $svcExitCode = try {{ (Get-WmiObject win32_service -Filter \"Name={svc_q}\" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).ExitCode }} catch {{ 'unknown' }}; \
 409:              throw \"Service failed (status=$svcStatus exitCode=$svcExitCode) scm=[$scmEvt] app=[$appEvt]\" \
 410:          }}",
 411:     );
 412:     run_remote_ps(conn, &bootstrap_script, Duration::from_secs(120))?;
 413:     Ok(())
 414: }
 415: 
 416: /// Generate an ed25519 trust signing key and matching trust evidence locally.
 417: /// Returns `(verifier_key_file_content, trust_evidence_file_content)`.
 418: fn generate_local_trust_material() -> Result<(String, String), String> {
 419:     use ed25519_dalek::{Signer, SigningKey};
 420:     use rand::{TryRngCore, rngs::OsRng};
 421:     use zeroize::Zeroize;
 422: 
 423:     let mut seed = [0u8; 32];
 424:     OsRng
 425:         .try_fill_bytes(&mut seed)
 426:         .map_err(|e| format!("OsRng seed failed: {e}"))?;
 427:     let mut nonce_bytes = [0u8; 8];
 428:     OsRng
 429:         .try_fill_bytes(&mut nonce_bytes)
 430:         .map_err(|e| format!("OsRng nonce failed: {e}"))?;
 431:     let nonce = u64::from_le_bytes(nonce_bytes);
 432:     let now = std::time::SystemTime::now()
 433:         .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
 434:         .map_err(|e| format!("system time error: {e}"))?
 435:         .as_secs();
 436: 
 437:     let signing_key = SigningKey::from_bytes(&seed);
 438:     let verifier_hex = encode_hex(signing_key.verifying_key().as_bytes());
 439:     let payload = format!(
 440:         "version=2\ntls13_valid=true\nsigned_control_valid=true\
 441:          \nsigned_data_age_secs=0\nclock_skew_secs=0\
 442:          \nupdated_at_unix={now}\nnonce={nonce}\n"
 443:     );
 444:     let signature = signing_key.sign(payload.as_bytes());
 445:     let evidence = format!("{payload}signature={}\n", encode_hex(&signature.to_bytes()));
 446: 
 447:     let mut seed_zeroed = seed;
 448:     seed_zeroed.zeroize();
 449: 
 450:     Ok((format!("{verifier_hex}\n"), evidence))
 451: }
 452: 
 453: fn encode_hex(bytes: &[u8]) -> String {
 454:     let mut out = String::with_capacity(bytes.len() * 2);
 455:     for byte in bytes {
 456:         out.push_str(&format!("{byte:02x}"));
 457:     }
 458:     out
 459: }

 463: fn run_service_action(conn: &NodeConnection, action_cmdlet: &str) -> Result<(), AdapterError> {
 464:     let svc = ps_quote(WINDOWS_SERVICE_NAME)?;

 467:          $ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'; \

 474: /// Validate a Windows path argument: reject NUL/CR/LF that could escape PS quoting.
 475: fn validate_windows_path(path: &str) -> Result<(), AdapterError> {
 476:     if path
 477:         .chars()
 478:         .any(|ch| ch == '\0' || ch == '\r' || ch == '\n')
 479:     {
 480:         return Err(AdapterError::Protocol {
 481:             message: format!(
 482:                 "Windows path argument '{path}' contains control characters not safe for shell embedding"
 483:             ),
 484:         });
 485:     }
 486:     if path.is_empty() {
 487:         return Err(AdapterError::Protocol {
 488:             message: "Windows path argument must not be empty".to_string(),
 489:         });
 490:     }
 491:     Ok(())
 492: }
 493: 
 494: fn write_temp_file(
 495:     prefix: &str,
 496:     suffix: &str,
 497:     content: &[u8],
 498: ) -> Result<std::path::PathBuf, AdapterError> {
 499:     use std::io::Write;
 500:     let mut path = std::env::temp_dir();
 501:     path.push(format!("{prefix}{}{suffix}", std::process::id()));
 502:     let mut file = std::fs::File::create(&path).map_err(|err| AdapterError::Io {
 503:         message: format!("create temp file failed: {err}"),
 504:     })?;
 505:     file.write_all(content).map_err(|err| AdapterError::Io {
 506:         message: format!("write temp file failed: {err}"),
 507:     })?;
 508:     Ok(path)
 509: }

 534:         let script = "Write-Host Hello";
 535:         let encoded = encode_ps_command(script).unwrap();
 536:         // Decode back and check UTF-16LE roundtrip.
 537:         let raw = base64::prelude::BASE64_STANDARD.decode(&encoded).unwrap();
 538:         assert_eq!(raw.len() % 2, 0, "UTF-16LE must have even byte count");
 539:         let units: Vec<u16> = raw
 540:             .chunks_exact(2)
 541:             .map(|c| u16::from_le_bytes([c[0], c[1]]))
 542:             .collect();
 543:         let decoded = String::from_utf16(&units).unwrap();
 544:         assert_eq!(decoded, script);
 545:     }

   1: #![allow(dead_code)]

   5: use crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::adapter::ssh;
   6: use crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::adapter::windows_install::{
   7:     WINDOWS_MEMBERSHIP_OWNER_PUBKEY_PATH, WINDOWS_MEMBERSHIP_SNAPSHOT_PATH, WINDOWS_RUSTYNET_PATH,
   8:     WINDOWS_STAGING_DIR, WINDOWS_STATE_ROOT, ps_quote, run_remote_ps,

  10: use crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::connection::NodeConnection;

  17: const MEDIUM_TIMEOUT: Duration = Duration::from_secs(120);
  18: 
  19: /// Read the membership owner public key from a Windows exit node.
  20: /// Reads `WINDOWS_MEMBERSHIP_OWNER_PUBKEY_PATH` via PowerShell `Get-Content`.
  21: pub fn issue_membership_owner_key(
  22:     conn: &NodeConnection,
  23: ) -> Result<MembershipOwnerKey, AdapterError> {
  24:     let read_script = format!(
  25:         "$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; \
  26:          $ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'; \
  27:          $p = {path_q}; \
  28:          if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $p)) {{ \
  29:              throw 'membership owner public key not found at ' + $p + '; has membership been initialized?' \
  30:          }}; \
  31:          (Get-Content -LiteralPath $p -Raw).Trim()",
  32:         path_q = ps_quote(WINDOWS_MEMBERSHIP_OWNER_PUBKEY_PATH)?,
  33:     );
  34:     let pem = run_remote_ps(conn, &read_script, SHORT_TIMEOUT)?;
  35:     let pem = pem.trim().to_string();
  36:     if pem.is_empty() {
  37:         return Err(AdapterError::Protocol {
  38:             message: "membership owner public key is empty on remote; \
  39:                       has membership been initialized?"
  40:                 .to_string(),
  41:         });
  42:     }
  43:     Ok(MembershipOwnerKey {
  44:         public_key_pem: pem,
  45:     })
  46: }
  47: 
  48: /// Initialize the membership snapshot on a Windows exit node.
  49: ///
  50: /// Runs `rustynet.exe ops init-membership`, then adds each non-exit peer
  51: /// via `ops e2e-membership-add`, then reads back the snapshot bytes.
  52: /// Requires the SSH session to run as an Administrator user.
  53: pub fn init_membership_snapshot(
  54:     conn: &NodeConnection,
  55:     _owner_key: &MembershipOwnerKey,
  56:     peers: &[NodeMembershipPeer],
  57: ) -> Result<MembershipSnapshot, AdapterError> {
  58:     // 1. Run ops init-membership (idempotent).
  59:     let init_script = format!(
  60:         "$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; \
  61:          $ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'; \
  62:          $env:RUSTYNET_NODE_ROLE = 'admin'; \
  63:          & {rustynet_q} ops init-membership; \
  64:          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {{ throw 'ops init-membership failed with exit code ' + $LASTEXITCODE }}",
  65:         rustynet_q = ps_quote(WINDOWS_RUSTYNET_PATH)?,
  66:     );
  67:     run_remote_ps(conn, &init_script, MEDIUM_TIMEOUT)?;
  68: 
  69:     // 2. Add each non-exit peer.
  70:     for peer in peers {
  71:         if peer.role == NodeRole::Exit {
  72:             continue;
  73:         }
  74:         let pubkey_hex = hex_32_arg(&peer.public_key_hex)?;
  75:         let add_script = format!(
  76:             "$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; \
  77:              $ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'; \
  78:              $ownerApprover = (& {rustynet_q} ops owner-approver-id 2>$null); \
  79:              if (-not $ownerApprover) {{ $ownerApprover = 'none' }}; \
  80:              & {rustynet_q} ops e2e-membership-add \
  81:                  --client-node-id {node_id_q} \
  82:                  --client-pubkey-hex {pubkey_q} \
  83:                  --owner-approver-id $ownerApprover; \
  84:              if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {{ \
  85:                  throw 'ops e2e-membership-add failed for ' + {node_id_q} \
  86:              }}",
  87:             rustynet_q = ps_quote(WINDOWS_RUSTYNET_PATH)?,
  88:             node_id_q = ps_quote(&peer.node_id)?,
  89:             pubkey_q = ps_quote(&pubkey_hex)?,
  90:         );
  91:         run_remote_ps(conn, &add_script, MEDIUM_TIMEOUT)?;
  92:     }
  93: 
  94:     // 3. Read snapshot back as base64.
  95:     let read_snapshot_script = format!(
  96:         "$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; \
  97:          $ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'; \
  98:          [Convert]::ToBase64String([System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes({snapshot_q}))",
  99:         snapshot_q = ps_quote(WINDOWS_MEMBERSHIP_SNAPSHOT_PATH)?,
 100:     );
 101:     let snapshot_b64 = run_remote_ps(conn, &read_snapshot_script, SHORT_TIMEOUT)?;
 102:     let data = base64_decode(snapshot_b64.trim())?;
 103:     Ok(MembershipSnapshot { data })
 104: }
 105: 
 106: /// Distribute a signed bundle to a Windows client node.
 107: /// Stages the bundle in `WINDOWS_STAGING_DIR`, SCPs it, then uses
 108: /// PowerShell `Move-Item` to install atomically to the final path.
 109: pub fn distribute_signed_bundle(
 110:     conn: &NodeConnection,
 111:     kind: BundleKind,
 112:     bundle_path: &Path,
 113: ) -> Result<(), AdapterError> {
 114:     let (remote_staging, remote_dst) = remote_bundle_paths(&kind);
 115: 
 116:     let dst_parent = remote_dst
 117:         .rsplit_once('\\')
 118:         .map(|(dir, _)| dir.to_string())
 119:         .unwrap_or_else(|| WINDOWS_STATE_ROOT.to_string());
 120:     let ensure_dirs_script = format!(
 121:         "foreach ($d in @({staging_q}, {dst_parent_q})) {{ \
 122:              if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $d)) {{ \
 123:                  New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $d | Out-Null \
 124:              }} \
 125:          }}",
 126:         staging_q = ps_quote(WINDOWS_STAGING_DIR)?,
 127:         dst_parent_q = ps_quote(&dst_parent)?,
 128:     );
 129:     run_remote_ps(conn, &ensure_dirs_script, SHORT_TIMEOUT)?;
 130: 
 131:     ssh::scp_to(
 132:         conn,
 133:         bundle_path,
 134:         &remote_staging.replace('\\', "/"),
 135:         MEDIUM_TIMEOUT,
 136:     )?;
 137: 
 138:     let install_script = format!(
 139:         "Set-StrictMode -Version Latest; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; \
 140:          $ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'; \
 141:          Move-Item -LiteralPath {src_q} -Destination {dst_q} -Force",
 142:         src_q = ps_quote(&remote_staging)?,
 143:         dst_q = ps_quote(&remote_dst)?,
 144:     );
 145:     run_remote_ps(conn, &install_script, SHORT_TIMEOUT)?;
 146: 
 147:     Ok(())
 148: }
 149: 
 150: // ── Helpers ───
 151: 
 152: fn remote_bundle_paths(kind: &BundleKind) -> (String, String) {
 153:     let staging = WINDOWS_STAGING_DIR;
 154:     let state = WINDOWS_STATE_ROOT;
 155:     match kind {
 156:         BundleKind::Membership => (
 157:             format!(r"{staging}\rn-membership.snapshot"),
 158:             format!(r"{state}\membership\membership.snapshot"),
 159:         ),
 160:         BundleKind::Assignment => (
 161:             format!(r"{staging}\rn-assignment.bundle"),
 162:             format!(r"{state}\trust\rustynetd.assignment"),
 163:         ),
 164:         BundleKind::Traversal => (
 165:             format!(r"{staging}\rn-traversal.bundle"),
 166:             format!(r"{state}\trust\rustynetd.traversal"),
 167:         ),
 168:         BundleKind::DnsZone => (
 169:             format!(r"{staging}\rn-dns-zone.bundle"),
 170:             format!(r"{state}\trust\rustynetd.dns-zone"),
 171:         ),
 172:     }
 173: }
 174: 
 175: fn hex_32_arg(value: &str) -> Result<String, AdapterError> {
 176:     if NodeMembershipPeer::is_valid_public_key_hex(value) {
 177:         Ok(value.to_string())
 178:     } else {
 179:         Err(AdapterError::Protocol {
 180:             message: "WireGuard public key must be 64 hex chars".to_string(),
 181:         })
 182:     }
 183: }
 184: 
 185: fn base64_decode(encoded: &str) -> Result<Vec<u8>, AdapterError> {
 186:     base64_std_decode(encoded).map_err(|err| AdapterError::Protocol {
 187:         message: format!("base64 decode of membership snapshot failed: {err}"),
 188:     })
 189: }
 190: 
 191: fn base64_std_decode(encoded: &str) -> Result<Vec<u8>, String> {
 192:     let clean: String = encoded
 193:         .chars()
 194:         .filter(|c| !c.is_ascii_whitespace())
 195:         .collect();
 196:     use std::io::Write;
 197:     use std::process::{Command, Stdio};
 198:     let output = Command::new("base64")
 199:         .arg("-d")
 200:         .stdin(Stdio::piped())
 201:         .stdout(Stdio::piped())
 202:         .stderr(Stdio::piped())
 203:         .spawn()
 204:         .and_then(|mut child| {
 205:             if let Some(mut stdin) = child.stdin.take() {
 206:                 let _ = stdin.write_all(clean.as_bytes());
 207:             }
 208:             child.wait_with_output()
 209:         })
 210:         .map_err(|err| format!("base64 -d spawn failed: {err}"))?;
 211:     if !output.status.success() {
 212:         let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr).trim().to_string();
 213:         return Err(format!("base64 -d failed: {stderr}"));
 214:     }
 215:     Ok(output.stdout)
 216: }

  16: /// Read the WireGuard public key from `C:\ProgramData\RustyNet\keys\wireguard.pub`.
  17: /// Returns the base64-encoded key decoded to hex (32-byte key → 64-char hex).
  18: pub fn collect_wireguard_public_key(conn: &NodeConnection) -> Result<String, AdapterError> {
  19:     let key_path = format!(r"{WINDOWS_STATE_ROOT}\keys\wireguard.pub");
  20:     let script = format!(
  21:         "Get-Content -LiteralPath {} -Encoding utf8 -Raw",
  22:         ps_quote(&key_path)?
  23:     );
  24:     let raw = run_remote_ps(conn, &script, SHORT_TIMEOUT)?;
  25:     let hex = decode_wireguard_pubkey_to_hex(raw.trim())
  26:         .map_err(|err| AdapterError::Protocol { message: err })?;
  27:     Ok(hex)
  28: }

  30: /// Read the local node_id from the running daemon via `rustynetd.exe status`.
  31: /// The daemon socket on Windows is a named pipe.
  32: pub fn collect_node_id(conn: &NodeConnection) -> Result<String, AdapterError> {
  33:     // Use the rustynet.exe CLI (same binary name as Linux but `.exe`).
  34:     let daemon_pipe = r"\\.\pipe\rustynet-rustynetd";
  35:     let script = format!(
  36:         "$env:RUSTYNET_DAEMON_SOCKET = {pipe_q}; \

  38:          Write-Output $out",
  39:         pipe_q = ps_quote(daemon_pipe)?
  40:     );
  41:     let output = run_remote_ps(conn, &script, SHORT_TIMEOUT)?;

  43:         message: format!(

  50: /// Ping `peer_mesh_ip` 3 times via `Test-Connection`. Returns `Reachable` on success.
  51: pub fn ping_mesh_peer(
  52:     conn: &NodeConnection,
  53:     peer_mesh_ip: &str,
  54: ) -> Result<TrafficTestResult, AdapterError> {
  55:     validate_ip_arg(peer_mesh_ip)?;
  56:     let script = format!(
  57:         "Test-Connection -ComputerName {ip_q} -Count 3 -Quiet",
  58:         ip_q = ps_quote(peer_mesh_ip)?
  59:     );
  60:     match run_remote_ps_check(conn, &script, Duration::from_secs(30))? {
  61:         true => Ok(TrafficTestResult::Reachable),
  62:         false => Ok(TrafficTestResult::Error(format!(
  63:             "Test-Connection to {peer_mesh_ip} returned false"
  64:         ))),
  65:     }
  66: }

  68: /// Negative ACL test: confirm `denied_ip` is blocked. Expects connection failure.
  69: /// Returns `Blocked` when ping fails (as expected), `Reachable` on security failure.
  70: pub fn probe_denied_peer(
  71:     conn: &NodeConnection,
  72:     denied_ip: &str,
  73: ) -> Result<TrafficTestResult, AdapterError> {
  74:     validate_ip_arg(denied_ip)?;
  75:     let script = format!(
  76:         "Test-Connection -ComputerName {ip_q} -Count 1 -Quiet",
  77:         ip_q = ps_quote(denied_ip)?
  78:     );
  79:     match run_remote_ps_check(conn, &script, Duration::from_secs(10))? {
  80:         true => Ok(TrafficTestResult::Reachable), // reached denied target = security failure
  81:         false => Ok(TrafficTestResult::Blocked),  // blocked as expected
  82:     }
  83: }

  85: /// Collect active WireGuard tunnels via `wireguard.exe` show.
  86: pub fn collect_active_tunnels(conn: &NodeConnection) -> Result<TunnelsList, AdapterError> {
  87:     let script = "if (Get-Command 'wireguard.exe' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { \
  88:          & 'wireguard.exe' /show } else { Write-Output 'wg-not-installed' }";
  89:     let output = run_remote_ps(conn, script, SHORT_TIMEOUT)?;
  90:     let tunnels: Vec<String> = output
  91:         .lines()
  92:         .filter(|l| !l.is_empty())
  93:         .map(|s| s.to_string())
  94:         .collect();
  95:     Ok(TunnelsList { tunnels })
  96: }

  98: /// Collect diagnostic artifacts from the Windows host to `dst`.
  99: /// Key material paths (`keys\*`, `*.priv`) MUST NOT appear in the collected set.
 100: pub fn collect_artifacts(conn: &NodeConnection, dst: &Path) -> Result<(), AdapterError> {
 101:     let remote_tmp = format!(r"{WINDOWS_STAGING_DIR}\rn_diag_artifacts.zip");
 102:     let remote_tmp_ps = remote_tmp.replace('\\', "/");
 103: 
 104:     // Create archive on remote, excluding keys directory.
 105:     let diag_script = format!(
 106:         "Set-StrictMode -Version Latest; \
 107:          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; \
 108:          $ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'; \
 109:          $stagingDir = {staging_q}; \
 110:          if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $stagingDir)) {{ \
 111:              New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $stagingDir | Out-Null \
 112:          }}; \
 113:          $logsDir = {logs_dir_q}; \
 114:          $zipPath = {zip_q}; \
 115:          $filesToArchive = if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $logsDir) {{ \
 116:              Get-ChildItem -Path $logsDir -Recurse -File | \
 117:                  Where-Object {{ $_.FullName -notlike {keys_pattern_q} }} \
 118:          }} else {{ @() }}; \
 119:          if ($filesToArchive.Count -gt 0) {{ \
 120:              Compress-Archive -Path ($filesToArchive | Select-Object -ExpandProperty FullName) \
 121:                  -DestinationPath $zipPath -Force \
 122:          }} else {{ \
 123:              $dummy = [System.IO.Compression.ZipFile]; \
 124:              [System.IO.Compression.ZipFile]::Open( \
 125:                  $zipPath, [System.IO.Compression.ZipArchiveMode]::Create).Dispose() \
 126:          }}",
 127:         staging_q = ps_quote(WINDOWS_STAGING_DIR)?,
 128:         logs_dir_q = ps_quote(&format!(r"{WINDOWS_STATE_ROOT}\logs"))?,
 129:         zip_q = ps_quote(&remote_tmp)?,
 130:         keys_pattern_q = ps_quote(&format!(r"{WINDOWS_STATE_ROOT}\keys\*"))?,
 131:     );
 132:     run_remote_ps(conn, &diag_script, MEDIUM_TIMEOUT)?;
 133: 
 134:     // Download the archive.
 135:     if let Some(parent) = dst.parent().filter(|p| !p.as_os_str().is_empty()) {
 136:         std::fs::create_dir_all(parent).map_err(|err| AdapterError::Io {
 137:             message: format!("create local artifact destination dir failed: {err}"),
 138:         })?;
 139:     }
 140:     ssh::scp_from(conn, &remote_tmp_ps, dst, Duration::from_secs(120))?;
 141: 
 142:     // Remove temp archive from remote (best-effort).
 143:     let cleanup_script = format!(
 144:         "Remove-Item -LiteralPath {} -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue",
 145:         ps_quote(&remote_tmp)?
 146:     );
 147:     let _ = run_remote_ps(conn, &cleanup_script, SHORT_TIMEOUT);
 148: 
 149:     // Verify no key material in the collected archive.
 150:     verify_no_key_material_zip(dst)?;
 151: 
 152:     Ok(())
 153: }

 155: /// Remove runtime state files, leaving the installation intact.
 156: pub fn cleanup_runtime_state(conn: &NodeConnection) -> Result<(), AdapterError> {
 157:     // Stop service first (best-effort).
 158:     let stop_script = format!(
 159:         "Stop-Service -Name {} -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue",
 160:         ps_quote(WINDOWS_SERVICE_NAME)?
 161:     );
 162:     let _ = run_remote_ps(conn, &stop_script, SHORT_TIMEOUT);
 163: 
 164:     // Remove runtime state but keep keys and installation. Best-effort:
 165:     // mirrors the Linux `rm -rf … 2>/dev/null; true` pattern. We deliberately
 166:     // do not enable Set-StrictMode here — the cleanup target list is allowed
 167:     // to contain paths that do not exist on a fresh box, and any other
 168:     // anomaly should not cascade-fail subsequent stages whose preconditions
 169:     // are independent of cleanup (e.g. install).
 170:     let cleanup_script = format!(
 171:         "$ErrorActionPreference = 'Continue'; \
 172:          $ProgressPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'; \
 173:          $stateRoot = {state_root_q}; \
 174:          $toRemove = @( \
 175:              (Join-Path $stateRoot 'membership\\membership.snapshot'), \
 176:              (Join-Path $stateRoot 'membership\\membership.log'), \
 177:              (Join-Path $stateRoot 'membership\\membership.watermark'), \
 178:              (Join-Path $stateRoot 'trust\\rustynetd.assignment'), \
 179:              (Join-Path $stateRoot 'trust\\rustynetd.assignment.watermark'), \
 180:              (Join-Path $stateRoot 'trust\\rustynetd.traversal'), \
 181:              (Join-Path $stateRoot 'trust\\rustynetd.traversal.watermark'), \
 182:              (Join-Path $stateRoot 'trust\\rustynetd.dns-zone'), \
 183:              (Join-Path $stateRoot 'trust\\rustynetd.dns-zone.watermark') \
 184:          ); \
 185:          foreach ($f in $toRemove) {{ \
 186:              try {{ Remove-Item -LiteralPath $f -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }} catch {{ }} \
 187:          }}; \
 188:          try {{ Remove-Item -Path {staging_q} -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }} catch {{ }}; \
 189:          exit 0",
 190:         state_root_q = ps_quote(WINDOWS_STATE_ROOT)?,
 191:         staging_q = ps_quote(WINDOWS_STAGING_DIR)?
 192:     );
 193:     run_remote_ps(conn, &cleanup_script, SHORT_TIMEOUT)?;
 194:     Ok(())
 195: }

 203: /// Collect the WireGuard mesh IP from the running daemon or network interface.
 204: pub fn collect_mesh_ip(conn: &NodeConnection) -> Result<String, AdapterError> {
 205:     let script = "$iface = Get-NetAdapter | Where-Object { $_.InterfaceDescription -like '*rustynet*' -or $_.Name -like '*rustynet*' } | Select-Object -First 1; \
 206:          if ($iface) { (Get-NetIPAddress -InterfaceIndex $iface.ifIndex -AddressFamily IPv4 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1).IPAddress } else { '' }";
 207:     let ip = run_remote_ps(conn, script, SHORT_TIMEOUT)?;
 208:     let ip = ip.trim().to_string();
 209:     if !ip.is_empty() {
 210:         return Ok(ip);
 211:     }
 212:     let daemon_pipe = r"\\.\pipe\rustynet-rustynetd";
 213:     let status_script = format!(
 214:         "$env:RUSTYNET_DAEMON_SOCKET = {pipe_q}; \
 215:          $out = & 'C:\\Program Files\\RustyNet\\rustynet.exe' status 2>&1; \
 216:          Write-Output $out",
 217:         pipe_q = crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::adapter::windows_install::ps_quote(daemon_pipe)?
 218:     );
 219:     let status = run_remote_ps(conn, &status_script, SHORT_TIMEOUT)?;
 220:     ssh::parse_status_field(&status, "mesh_ip")
 221:         .or_else(|| ssh::parse_status_field(&status, "wg_ip"))
 222:         .ok_or_else(|| AdapterError::Protocol {
 223:             message: "mesh IP not found via network interface or rustynet status".to_string(),
 224:         })
 225: }

 227: /// Issue signed bundles on this (Windows) exit node and SCP results to `local_out_dir`.
 228: pub fn issue_bundles_to_dir(
 229:     conn: &NodeConnection,
 230:     rustynet_path: &str,
 231:     kind: &crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::error::BundleKind,
 232:     env_content: &str,
 233:     local_out_dir: &std::path::Path,
 234: ) -> Result<(), AdapterError> {
 235:     use crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::adapter::windows_install::{WINDOWS_STAGING_DIR, ps_quote};
 236:     use std::io::Write as IoWrite;
 237:     let pid = std::process::id();
 238:     let remote_env = format!(r"{WINDOWS_STAGING_DIR}\rn_issue_env_{pid}.env");
 239:     let remote_issue_dir = format!(r"{WINDOWS_STAGING_DIR}\rn_issue_{pid}");
 240: 
 241:     let issue_subcmd = match kind {
 242:         crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::error::BundleKind::Assignment => {
 243:             "e2e-issue-assignment-bundles-from-env"
 244:         }
 245:         crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::error::BundleKind::Traversal => {
 246:             "e2e-issue-traversal-bundles-from-env"
 247:         }
 248:         crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::error::BundleKind::DnsZone => {
 249:             "e2e-issue-dns-zone-bundles-from-env"
 250:         }
 251:         crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::error::BundleKind::Membership => {
 252:             return Err(AdapterError::Protocol {
 253:                 message: "Membership bundles are issued via init_membership_snapshot".to_string(),
 254:             });
 255:         }
 256:     };
 257: 
 258:     let mut env_tmp = std::env::temp_dir();
 259:     env_tmp.push(format!("rn_issue_env_{pid}.env"));
 260:     {
 261:         let mut f = std::fs::File::create(&env_tmp).map_err(|e| AdapterError::Io {
 262:             message: format!("create env tmp: {e}"),
 263:         })?;
 264:         f.write_all(env_content.as_bytes())
 265:             .map_err(|e| AdapterError::Io {
 266:                 message: format!("write env tmp: {e}"),
 267:             })?;
 268:     }
 269:     ssh::scp_to(
 270:         conn,
 271:         &env_tmp,
 272:         &remote_env.replace('\\', "/"),
 273:         MEDIUM_TIMEOUT,
 274:     )?;
 275:     let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&env_tmp);
 276: 
 277:     let ensure_script = format!(
 278:         "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path {} | Out-Null; \
 279:          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path {} | Out-Null",
 280:         ps_quote(WINDOWS_STAGING_DIR)?,
 281:         ps_quote(&remote_issue_dir)?,
 282:     );
 283:     run_remote_ps(conn, &ensure_script, SHORT_TIMEOUT)?;
 284: 
 285:     let run_script = format!(
 286:         "$env:RUSTYNET_NODE_ROLE = 'admin'; \
 287:          & {rustynet_q} ops {issue_subcmd} \
 288:              --env-file {env_q} --issue-dir {issue_dir_q}; \
 289:          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {{ throw '{issue_subcmd} failed with exit code ' + $LASTEXITCODE }}",
 290:         rustynet_q = ps_quote(rustynet_path)?,
 291:         issue_subcmd = issue_subcmd,
 292:         env_q = ps_quote(&remote_env)?,
 293:         issue_dir_q = ps_quote(&remote_issue_dir)?,
 294:     );
 295:     run_remote_ps(conn, &run_script, MEDIUM_TIMEOUT)?;
 296: 
 297:     let list_script = format!(
 298:         "Get-ChildItem -Path {} | Select-Object -ExpandProperty Name",
 299:         ps_quote(&remote_issue_dir)?
 300:     );
 301:     let listing = run_remote_ps(conn, &list_script, SHORT_TIMEOUT)?;
 302: 
 303:     std::fs::create_dir_all(local_out_dir).map_err(|e| AdapterError::Io {
 304:         message: format!("create local out dir: {e}"),
 305:     })?;
 306: 
 307:     for filename in listing.lines().map(str::trim).filter(|s| !s.is_empty()) {
 308:         let remote_path = format!("{remote_issue_dir}\\{filename}");
 309:         let local_path = local_out_dir.join(filename);
 310:         ssh::scp_from(
 311:             conn,
 312:             &remote_path.replace('\\', "/"),
 313:             &local_path,
 314:             MEDIUM_TIMEOUT,
 315:         )?;
 316:     }
 317: 
 318:     let cleanup_script = format!(
 319:         "Remove-Item -LiteralPath {env_q} -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; \
 320:          Remove-Item -LiteralPath {dir_q} -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue",
 321:         env_q = ps_quote(&remote_env)?,
 322:         dir_q = ps_quote(&remote_issue_dir)?,
 323:     );
 324:     let _ = run_remote_ps(conn, &cleanup_script, SHORT_TIMEOUT);
 325: 
 326:     Ok(())
 327: }

 331: /// Validate that an IP address argument contains no shell-dangerous characters.
 332: fn validate_ip_arg(ip: &str) -> Result<(), AdapterError> {
 333:     if ip
 334:         .chars()
 335:         .all(|c| c.is_ascii_alphanumeric() || matches!(c, '.' | ':' | '/'))
 336:     {
 337:         Ok(())
 338:     } else {
 339:         Err(AdapterError::Protocol {
 340:             message: format!(
 341:                 "IP argument '{ip}' contains characters not safe for shell embedding \
 342:                  (allowed: alphanumeric, '.', ':', '/')"
 343:             ),
 344:         })
 345:     }
 346: }
 347: 
 348: fn decode_wireguard_pubkey_to_hex(value: &str) -> Result<String, String> {
 349:     let decoded = base64_decode_simple(value.as_bytes())
 350:         .map_err(|err| format!("base64 decode of WireGuard public key failed: {err}"))?;
 351:     if decoded.len() != 32 {
 352:         return Err(format!(
 353:             "expected 32-byte WireGuard public key, got {} bytes",
 354:             decoded.len()
 355:         ));
 356:     }
 357:     let mut out = String::with_capacity(64);
 358:     for byte in decoded {
 359:         out.push_str(&format!("{byte:02x}"));
 360:     }
 361:     Ok(out)
 362: }
 363: 
 364: /// Minimal base64 decode (standard alphabet A-Z a-z 0-9 + /).
 365: fn base64_decode_simple(encoded: &[u8]) -> Result<Vec<u8>, String> {
 366:     let filtered: Vec<u8> = encoded
 367:         .iter()
 368:         .copied()
 369:         .filter(|b| !b.is_ascii_whitespace())
 370:         .collect();
 371:     if filtered.is_empty() {
 372:         return Err("empty base64 input".to_string());
 373:     }
 374:     let mut table = [255u8; 256];
 375:     for (i, ch) in b"ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
 376:         .iter()
 377:         .enumerate()
 378:     {
 379:         table[*ch as usize] = i as u8;
 380:     }
 381:     table[b'=' as usize] = 64;
 382: 
 383:     let mut output = Vec::with_capacity((filtered.len() * 3) / 4);
 384:     let mut i = 0;
 385:     while i + 3 < filtered.len() {
 386:         let a = table[filtered[i] as usize];
 387:         let b = table[filtered[i + 1] as usize];
 388:         let c = table[filtered[i + 2] as usize];
 389:         let d = table[filtered[i + 3] as usize];
 390:         if a == 255 || b == 255 {
 391:             return Err(format!("invalid base64 character at position {i}"));
 392:         }
 393:         output.push((a << 2) | (b >> 4));
 394:         if c != 64 {
 395:             output.push(((b & 0xf) << 4) | (c >> 2));
 396:         }
 397:         if d != 64 {
 398:             output.push(((c & 0x3) << 6) | d);
 399:         }
 400:         i += 4;
 401:     }
 402:     Ok(output)
 403: }
 404: 
 405: /// Assert that the collected artifact zip at `path` contains no key material.
 406: /// Key material patterns: paths containing `keys\` or `keys/`, ending with `.priv`.
 407: fn verify_no_key_material_zip(path: &Path) -> Result<(), AdapterError> {
 408:     use std::process::Command;
 409:     // Use `unzip -Z -1` to list entries; fall back to `python3 -c` if unzip absent.
 410:     let output = Command::new("unzip")
 411:         .args(["-Z", "-1"])
 412:         .arg(path.as_os_str())
 413:         .output()
 414:         .or_else(|_| {
 415:             // Fallback: use python3 to list zip entries.
 416:             Command::new("python3")
 417:                 .args(["-c", "import sys,zipfile; [print(n) for n in zipfile.ZipFile(sys.argv[1]).namelist()]"])
 418:                 .arg(path.as_os_str())
 419:                 .output()
 420:         })
 421:         .map_err(|err| AdapterError::Io {
 422:             message: format!("list zip contents failed: {err}"),
 423:         })?;
 424:     if !output.status.success() {
 425:         // An empty archive returns non-zero from unzip -Z — treat as ok if listing is empty.
 426:         let stderr = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stderr);
 427:         if !stderr.contains("error") && !stderr.contains("Error") {
 428:             return Ok(());
 429:         }
 430:         return Ok(());
 431:     }
 432:     let listing = String::from_utf8_lossy(&output.stdout);
 433:     for entry in listing.lines() {
 434:         let lower = entry.to_lowercase();
 435:         if lower.contains("keys/")
 436:             || lower.contains("keys\\")
 437:             || lower.ends_with(".priv")
 438:             || lower.ends_with(".pem")
 439:             || lower.ends_with(".key")
 440:         {
 441:             return Err(AdapterError::KeyExclusionViolation {
 442:                 path: entry.to_string(),
 443:             });
 444:         }
 445:     }
 446:     Ok(())
 447: }

===== /crates/rustynet-cli/src/vm_lab/orchestrator/connection.rs =====

   1: #![allow(dead_code)]
   2: use std::path::PathBuf;
   3: 
   4: use crate::vm_lab::VmGuestPlatform;
   5: use crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::error::AdapterError;
   6: 
   7: /// Transport injected at adapter construction by `node_adapter_for`.
   8: /// `NodeAdapter` methods carry no connection argument — connection details
   9: /// live here, not on every call site.
  10: #[derive(Debug, Clone)]
  11: pub enum NodeConnection {
  12:     /// SSH to a POSIX or PowerShell-capable host (Linux, Windows, macOS).
  13:     Ssh {
  14:         host: String,
  15:         port: u16,
  16:         user: Option<String>,
  17:         identity_file: PathBuf,
  18:         /// `StrictHostKeyChecking=yes` enforced at SSH layer.
  19:         /// Path is validated to exist at construction time.
  20:         known_hosts: PathBuf,
  21:     },
  22:     /// Android Debug Bridge — lab-only, not a production path.
  23:     Adb { device_serial: String },
  24:     /// Apple MDM / Network Extension management channel — future IosNodeAdapter.
  25:     Mdm { enrollment_id: String },
  26: }
  27: 
  28: impl NodeConnection {
  29:     /// Build an SSH connection. Returns `Err` if `known_hosts` does not exist.
  30:     /// `StrictHostKeyChecking=yes` depends on this file being present + correct.
  31:     pub fn ssh(
  32:         host: impl Into<String>,
  33:         port: u16,
  34:         user: Option<String>,
  35:         identity_file: PathBuf,
  36:         known_hosts: PathBuf,
  37:     ) -> Result<Self, AdapterError> {
  38:         if !known_hosts.exists() {
  39:             return Err(AdapterError::InvalidPath {
  40:                 path: known_hosts,
  41:                 reason: "known_hosts file does not exist; \
  42:                          StrictHostKeyChecking=yes requires this file \
  43:                          to be pre-populated before connecting"
  44:                     .to_string(),
  45:             });
  46:         }
  47:         Ok(NodeConnection::Ssh {
  48:             host: host.into(),
  49:             port,
  50:             user,
  51:             identity_file,
  52:             known_hosts,
  53:         })
  54:     }
  55: 
  56:     pub fn kind_label(&self) -> &'static str {
  57:         match self {
  58:             NodeConnection::Ssh { .. } => "ssh",
  59:             NodeConnection::Adb { .. } => "adb",
  60:             NodeConnection::Mdm { .. } => "mdm",
  61:         }
  62:     }
  63: 
  64:     /// Returns true if this connection type is valid for the given platform.
  65:     pub fn is_valid_for_platform(&self, platform: &VmGuestPlatform) -> bool {
  66:         matches!(
  67:             (self, platform),
  68:             (NodeConnection::Ssh { .. }, VmGuestPlatform::Linux)
  69:                 | (NodeConnection::Ssh { .. }, VmGuestPlatform::Windows)
  70:                 | (NodeConnection::Ssh { .. }, VmGuestPlatform::Macos)
  71:                 | (NodeConnection::Adb { .. }, VmGuestPlatform::Android)
  72:                 | (NodeConnection::Mdm { .. }, VmGuestPlatform::Ios)
  73:         )
  74:     }
  75: }
  76:

   5: use crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::adapter::node_adapter::NodeAdapter;

  11: /// Shared state threaded through all orchestration stages.
  12: pub struct OrchestrationContext {
  13:     /// Role assignment for each node alias in this lab run.
  14:     pub assignments: Vec<NodeRoleAssignment>,
  15:     /// Per-alias adapter handles (populated before stage execution begins).
  16:     pub adapters: HashMap<String, Box<dyn NodeAdapter>>,
  17:     /// The source archive shipped to remote nodes.
  18:     pub source_archive: Option<SourceArchive>,
  19:     /// Directory for logs, JSON reports, and collected artifacts.
  20:     pub report_dir: PathBuf,
  21:     /// Accumulated per-stage outcomes.
  22:     pub stage_outcomes: HashMap<StageId, StageOutcome>,
  23:     /// Collected WireGuard public keys, keyed by node alias.
  24:     pub collected_pubkeys: HashMap<String, WireguardPublicKey>,
  25:     /// Mesh network identifier passed to the bootstrap env.
  26:     pub network_id: String,
  27:     /// Pre-generated node IDs, keyed by alias.
  28:     /// Populated by the Preflight / PrepareSourceArchive stage before
  29:     /// `install_daemon` runs. If absent for an alias, `install_daemon`
  30:     /// falls back to `<alias>-bootstrap`.
  31:     pub node_ids: HashMap<String, String>,
  32:     /// CIDRs that SSH is allowed from (passed to bootstrap env as
  33:     /// `SSH_ALLOW_CIDRS`). Empty string means no restriction at bootstrap.
  34:     pub ssh_allow_cidrs: String,
  35:     /// Membership snapshot bytes collected from exit node during MembershipInit.
  36:     pub membership_snapshot: Option<Vec<u8>>,
  37:     /// WireGuard mesh IPs per alias, collected during CollectPubkeys.
  38:     pub mesh_ips: HashMap<String, String>,
  39:     /// WireGuard endpoint (host:port) per alias, collected during CollectPubkeys.
  40:     pub endpoints: HashMap<String, String>,
  41: }
  42: 
  43: impl OrchestrationContext {
  44:     pub fn new(
  45:         assignments: Vec<NodeRoleAssignment>,
  46:         report_dir: PathBuf,
  47:         network_id: String,
  48:     ) -> Self {
  49:         OrchestrationContext {
  50:             assignments,
  51:             adapters: HashMap::new(),
  52:             source_archive: None,
  53:             report_dir,
  54:             stage_outcomes: HashMap::new(),
  55:             collected_pubkeys: HashMap::new(),
  56:             network_id,
  57:             node_ids: HashMap::new(),
  58:             ssh_allow_cidrs: String::new(),
  59:             membership_snapshot: None,
  60:             mesh_ips: HashMap::new(),
  61:             endpoints: HashMap::new(),
  62:         }
  63:     }
  64: 
  65:     pub fn record_outcome(&mut self, stage: StageId, outcome: StageOutcome) {
  66:         self.stage_outcomes.insert(stage, outcome);
  67:     }
  68: 
  69:     pub fn outcome_of(&self, stage: &StageId) -> Option<&StageOutcome> {
  70:         self.stage_outcomes.get(stage)
  71:     }
  72: }
