  84: // ── AdapterError ───
  85: 
  86: #[derive(Debug)]
  87: pub enum AdapterError {
  88:     /// Platform not yet implemented. Message must name specific security barriers.
  89:     UnsupportedPlatform {
  90:         platform: VmGuestPlatform,
  91:         message: String,
  92:     },
  93:     /// Connection type incompatible with platform (e.g. Adb for Linux).
  94:     ConnectionPlatformMismatch {
  95:         platform: VmGuestPlatform,
  96:         connection_kind: &'static str,
  97:     },
  98:     /// SSH transport error.
  99:     Ssh { message: String },
 100:     /// I/O error.
 101:     Io { message: String },
 102:     /// Remote command failed.
 103:     Command {
 104:         exit_code: Option<i32>,
 105:         stderr: String,
 106:     },
 107:     /// Path validation failed at construction.
 108:     InvalidPath { path: PathBuf, reason: String },
 109:     /// Protocol-level error (e.g. parse failure, unexpected output).
 110:     Protocol { message: String },
 111:     /// Key material found in artifact archive — security invariant violation.
 112:     KeyExclusionViolation { path: String },
 113: }
 114: 
 115: impl fmt::Display for AdapterError {
 116:     fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
 117:         match self {
 118:             AdapterError::UnsupportedPlatform { platform, message } => {
 119:                 write!(f, "platform {:?} not supported: {}", platform, message)
 120:             }
 121:             AdapterError::ConnectionPlatformMismatch {
 122:                 platform,
 123:                 connection_kind,
 124:             } => {
 125:                 write!(
 126:                     f,
 127:                     "connection type '{connection_kind}' is not valid for platform {:?}",
 128:                     platform
 129:                 )
 130:             }
 131:             AdapterError::Ssh { message } => write!(f, "SSH error: {message}"),
 132:             AdapterError::Io { message } => write!(f, "I/O error: {message}"),
 133:             AdapterError::Command { exit_code, stderr } => {
 134:                 write!(f, "remote command failed (exit {:?}): {stderr}", exit_code)
 135:             }
 136:             AdapterError::InvalidPath { path, reason } => {
 137:                 write!(f, "invalid path '{}': {reason}", path.display())
 138:             }
 139:             AdapterError::Protocol { message } => write!(f, "protocol error: {message}"),
 140:             AdapterError::KeyExclusionViolation { path } => {
 141:                 write!(
 142:                     f,
 143:                     "key material found in artifact archive at '{path}': key-exclusion invariant violated"
 144:                 )
 145:             }
 146:         }
 147:     }
 148: }
 149: 
 150: impl std::error::Error for AdapterError {}
 151: 
 152: impl From<std::io::Error> for AdapterError {
 153:     fn from(e: std::io::Error) -> Self {
 154:         AdapterError::Io {
 155:             message: e.to_string(),
 156:         }
 157:     }
 158: }
 159: 
 160: // ── StageError + StageOutcome ───
 161: 
 162: #[derive(Debug, Clone)]
 163: pub enum StageError {
 164:     AdapterFailure { alias: String, message: String },
 165:     DependencyFailed { dependency: String },
 166:     ValidationFailed { details: String },
 167:     Io { message: String },
 168: }
 169: 
 170: impl fmt::Display for StageError {
 171:     fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
 172:         match self {
 173:             StageError::AdapterFailure { alias, message } => {
 174:                 write!(f, "adapter failure for '{alias}': {message}")
 175:             }
 176:             StageError::DependencyFailed { dependency } => {
 177:                 write!(f, "dependency '{dependency}' failed or was skipped")
 178:             }
 179:             StageError::ValidationFailed { details } => {
 180:                 write!(f, "validation failed: {details}")
 181:             }
 182:             StageError::Io { message } => write!(f, "I/O error: {message}"),
 183:         }
 184:     }
 185: }
 186: 
 187: impl std::error::Error for StageError {}
 188: 
 189: #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
 190: pub enum StageOutcome {
 191:     Passed,
 192:     Failed(String),
 193:     Skipped,
 194: }
 195: 
 196: impl StageOutcome {
 197:     pub fn is_blocking(&self) -> bool {
 198:         matches!(self, StageOutcome::Failed(_))
 199:     }
 200: 
 201:     pub fn is_terminal(&self) -> bool {
 202:         matches!(
 203:             self,
 204:             StageOutcome::Passed | StageOutcome::Failed(_) | StageOutcome::Skipped
 205:         )
 206:     }
 207: }

===== /crates/rustynet-cli/src/vm_lab/orchestrator/parity.rs =====

   1: //! Cross-orchestrator parity diff (W5.5 evidence harness).
   2: //!
   3: //! Both the bash and the Rust orchestrators are expected to converge on the
   4: //! same `LiveLabRunReport`-shaped JSON (`parity_input.json`) for the same
   5: //! lab. This module produces a deterministic, machine-readable diff between
   6: //! two such reports so the operator can prove parity without manual
   7: //! eyeballing.
   8: //!
   9: //! The schema deliberately surfaces every dimension §W5.5 calls out:
  10: //! - identical stage ID list (no missing/extra stages),
  11: //! - identical pass/fail per stage,
  12: //! - identical overall exit code,
  13: //! - matching per-stage `outcome`,
  14: //! - matching peer/validator counts.
  15: //!
  16: //! Live runs that produce the input reports are gated on a real lab; this
  17: //! module is intentionally pure-data so it has full unit coverage.
  18: 
  19: use std::collections::{BTreeMap, HashMap};
  20: 
  21: use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
  22: 
  23: use crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::context::OrchestrationContext;
  24: use crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::error::StageOutcome;
  25: use crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::report::{
  26:     LiveLabRunReport, NodeStatus, RunStatus, StageOutcomeRecord, StageReport,
  27: };
  28: use crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::stage::StageId;
  29: 
  30: /// Build a `LiveLabRunReport` from the `(StageId, StageOutcome)` list
  31: /// produced by `StateMachineRunner::run`, plus the `OrchestrationContext`
  32: /// that holds the role assignments.
  33: ///
  34: /// Validator results are not yet collected into the context (W3.2 wires
  35: /// stage-level outcomes only); per-node `validator_results` therefore
  36: /// ships empty until follow-up work threads `ValidatorReport` through
  37: /// the context. The parity diff handles 0 vs 0 as a match, which is the
  38: /// correct semantics until both orchestrators emit validator detail.
  39: pub fn build_live_lab_run_report(
  40:     run_id: String,
  41:     timestamp_utc: String,
  42:     ctx: &OrchestrationContext,
  43:     results: &[(StageId, StageOutcome)],
  44: ) -> LiveLabRunReport {
  45:     let stages: Vec<StageReport> = results
  46:         .iter()
  47:         .map(|(id, outcome)| {
  48:             let (rec, error_detail) = match outcome {
  49:                 StageOutcome::Passed => (StageOutcomeRecord::Passed, None),
  50:                 StageOutcome::Skipped => (StageOutcomeRecord::Skipped, None),
  51:                 StageOutcome::Failed(msg) => (StageOutcomeRecord::Failed, Some(msg.clone())),
  52:             };
  53:             StageReport {
  54:                 stage_id: id.as_str().to_string(),
  55:                 stage_name: id.as_str().to_string(),
  56:                 outcome: rec,
  57:                 duration_ms: 0,
  58:                 error_detail,
  59:             }
  60:         })
  61:         .collect();
  62: 
  63:     let any_failed = stages
  64:         .iter()
  65:         .any(|s| s.outcome == StageOutcomeRecord::Failed);
  66:     let any_skipped = stages
  67:         .iter()
  68:         .any(|s| s.outcome == StageOutcomeRecord::Skipped);
  69:     let overall_status = if any_failed {
  70:         RunStatus::Failed
  71:     } else if any_skipped {
  72:         RunStatus::Partial
  73:     } else {
  74:         RunStatus::Passed
  75:     };
  76: 
  77:     let mut node_statuses: HashMap<String, NodeStatus> = HashMap::new();
  78:     for assignment in &ctx.assignments {
  79:         let platform = ctx
  80:             .adapters
  81:             .get(&assignment.alias)
  82:             .map(|a| format!("{:?}", a.platform()).to_lowercase())
  83:             .unwrap_or_else(|| "unknown".to_string());
  84:         node_statuses.insert(
  85:             assignment.alias.clone(),
  86:             NodeStatus {
  87:                 alias: assignment.alias.clone(),
  88:                 platform,
  89:                 role: assignment.role.as_str().to_string(),
  90:                 validator_results: Vec::new(),
  91:             },
  92:         );
  93:     }
  94: 
  95:     LiveLabRunReport {
  96:         run_id,
  97:         timestamp_utc,
  98:         overall_status,
  99:         stages,
 100:         node_statuses,
 101:     }
 102: }
 103: 
 104: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq)]
 105: pub struct ParityDiff {
 106:     /// `true` iff every dimension matches: stage list, per-stage outcome,
 107:     /// overall status, node count, validator pass count.
 108:     pub overall_parity_pass: bool,
 109: 
 110:     pub overall_status_match: bool,
 111:     pub overall_status_left: RunStatus,
 112:     pub overall_status_right: RunStatus,
 113: 
 114:     /// One entry per stage that appears in either report. Order is the
 115:     /// union of left's order followed by any right-only stages, preserving
 116:     /// determinism for repeated diffs.
 117:     pub stages: Vec<StageParityEntry>,
 118: 
 119:     /// Stage IDs present on left but absent on right.
 120:     pub stages_only_in_left: Vec<String>,
 121:     /// Stage IDs present on right but absent on left.
 122:     pub stages_only_in_right: Vec<String>,
 123: 
 124:     pub node_count_match: bool,
 125:     pub node_count_left: usize,
 126:     pub node_count_right: usize,
 127: 
 128:     pub validator_pass_count_match: bool,
 129:     pub validator_pass_count_left: usize,
 130:     pub validator_pass_count_right: usize,
 131: 
 132:     pub validator_total_count_match: bool,
 133:     pub validator_total_count_left: usize,
 134:     pub validator_total_count_right: usize,
 135: }
 136: 
 137: #[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize, PartialEq, Eq)]
 138: pub struct StageParityEntry {
 139:     pub stage_id: String,
 140:     pub left_outcome: Option<StageOutcomeRecord>,
 141:     pub right_outcome: Option<StageOutcomeRecord>,
 142:     pub matches: bool,
 143: }
 144: 
 145: /// Count validator passes across all node statuses.
 146: fn count_validator_results(report: &LiveLabRunReport) -> (usize, usize) {
 147:     let mut total = 0usize;
 148:     let mut passed = 0usize;
 149:     for node in report.node_statuses.values() {
 150:         for v in &node.validator_results {
 151:             total += 1;
 152:             if v.passed {
 153:                 passed += 1;
 154:             }
 155:         }
 156:     }
 157:     (passed, total)
 158: }
 159: 
 160: /// Return the per-stage diff between two reports.
 161: ///
 162: /// `left` is conventionally the legacy bash orchestrator's report and
 163: /// `right` the Rust-native orchestrator's, but the function is symmetric
 164: /// in semantics: an empty diff means full parity in either direction.
 165: pub fn diff_live_lab_reports(left: &LiveLabRunReport, right: &LiveLabRunReport) -> ParityDiff {
 166:     let left_by_id: BTreeMap<&str, &StageReport> = left
 167:         .stages
 168:         .iter()
 169:         .map(|s| (s.stage_id.as_str(), s))
 170:         .collect();
 171:     let right_by_id: BTreeMap<&str, &StageReport> = right
 172:         .stages
 173:         .iter()
 174:         .map(|s| (s.stage_id.as_str(), s))
 175:         .collect();
 176: 
 177:     let mut stages: Vec<StageParityEntry> = Vec::new();
 178:     // Walk left in order, then append right-only entries in right's order.
 179:     for s in &left.stages {
 180:         let left_outcome = Some(s.outcome.clone());
 181:         let right_outcome = right_by_id
 182:             .get(s.stage_id.as_str())
 183:             .map(|r| r.outcome.clone());
 184:         let matches = right_outcome.as_ref().is_some_and(|ro| ro == &s.outcome);
 185:         stages.push(StageParityEntry {
 186:             stage_id: s.stage_id.clone(),
 187:             left_outcome,
 188:             right_outcome,
 189:             matches,
 190:         });
 191:     }
 192:     for s in &right.stages {
 193:         if !left_by_id.contains_key(s.stage_id.as_str()) {
 194:             stages.push(StageParityEntry {
 195:                 stage_id: s.stage_id.clone(),
 196:                 left_outcome: None,
 197:                 right_outcome: Some(s.outcome.clone()),
 198:                 matches: false,
 199:             });
 200:         }
 201:     }
 202: 
 203:     let stages_only_in_left: Vec<String> = left
 204:         .stages
 205:         .iter()
 206:         .filter(|s| !right_by_id.contains_key(s.stage_id.as_str()))
 207:         .map(|s| s.stage_id.clone())
 208:         .collect();
 209:     let stages_only_in_right: Vec<String> = right
 210:         .stages
 211:         .iter()
 212:         .filter(|s| !left_by_id.contains_key(s.stage_id.as_str()))
 213:         .map(|s| s.stage_id.clone())
 214:         .collect();
 215: 
 216:     let overall_status_match = left.overall_status == right.overall_status;
 217: 
 218:     let node_count_left = left.node_statuses.len();
 219:     let node_count_right = right.node_statuses.len();
 220:     let node_count_match = node_count_left == node_count_right;
 221: 
 222:     let (vp_left, vt_left) = count_validator_results(left);
 223:     let (vp_right, vt_right) = count_validator_results(right);
 224:     let validator_pass_count_match = vp_left == vp_right;
 225:     let validator_total_count_match = vt_left == vt_right;
 226: 
 227:     let stages_match_all = stages_only_in_left.is_empty()
 228:         && stages_only_in_right.is_empty()
 229:         && stages.iter().all(|e| e.matches);
 230: 
 231:     let overall_parity_pass = overall_status_match
 232:         && stages_match_all
 233:         && node_count_match
 234:         && validator_pass_count_match
 235:         && validator_total_count_match;
 236: 
 237:     ParityDiff {
 238:         overall_parity_pass,
 239:         overall_status_match,
 240:         overall_status_left: left.overall_status.clone(),
 241:         overall_status_right: right.overall_status.clone(),
 242:         stages,
 243:         stages_only_in_left,
 244:         stages_only_in_right,
 245:         node_count_match,
 246:         node_count_left,
 247:         node_count_right,
 248:         validator_pass_count_match,
 249:         validator_pass_count_left: vp_left,
 250:         validator_pass_count_right: vp_right,
 251:         validator_total_count_match,
 252:         validator_total_count_left: vt_left,
 253:         validator_total_count_right: vt_right,
 254:     }
 255: }

 274:         let validator_results = validators

 285:                 alias: alias.to_string(),
 286:                 platform: "linux".to_string(),
 287:                 role: "client".to_string(),
 288:                 validator_results,
 289:             },
 290:         )
 291:     }

 309:     fn full_parity_two_identical_reports() {
 310:         let stages_a = vec![
 311:             stage("preflight", StageOutcomeRecord::Passed),
 312:             stage("install", StageOutcomeRecord::Passed),
 313:         ];
 314:         let stages_b = stages_a.clone();
 315:         let a = report(
 316:             "a",
 317:             RunStatus::Passed,
 318:             stages_a,
 319:             vec![node("n1", vec![("acl", true)])],
 320:         );
 321:         let b = report(
 322:             "b",
 323:             RunStatus::Passed,
 324:             stages_b,
 325:             vec![node("n1", vec![("acl", true)])],
 326:         );
 327:         let diff = diff_live_lab_reports(&a, &b);
 328:         assert!(diff.overall_parity_pass, "{diff:#?}");
 329:         assert!(diff.stages.iter().all(|e| e.matches));
 330:         assert!(diff.stages_only_in_left.is_empty());
 331:         assert!(diff.stages_only_in_right.is_empty());
 332:     }

 475:     fn parity_diff_is_serializable_json() {
 476:         let s = vec![stage("preflight", StageOutcomeRecord::Passed)];

 478:         let b = report("b", RunStatus::Passed, s, vec![]);

 480:         let json = serde_json::to_string(&diff).expect("ParityDiff must serialize");
 481:         assert!(json.contains("\"overall_parity_pass\":true"));
 482:         let round: ParityDiff = serde_json::from_str(&json).expect("ParityDiff must round-trip");
 483:         assert_eq!(round, diff);

 486:     #[test]
 487:     fn overall_parity_pass_requires_all_dimensions() {
 488:         // Same stages but different node counts → parity must fail.
 489:         let s = vec![stage("preflight", StageOutcomeRecord::Passed)];
 490:         let a = report("a", RunStatus::Passed, s.clone(), vec![]);
 491:         let b = report("b", RunStatus::Passed, s, vec![node("n1", vec![])]);
 492:         let diff = diff_live_lab_reports(&a, &b);
 493:         assert!(diff.overall_status_match);
 494:         assert!(diff.stages.iter().all(|e| e.matches));
 495:         assert!(!diff.node_count_match);
 496:         assert!(!diff.overall_parity_pass);
 497:     }

===== /crates/rustynet-cli/src/vm_lab/orchestrator/role.rs =====

   1: #![allow(dead_code)]
   2: use std::fmt;
   3: 
   4: use crate::vm_lab::VmGuestPlatform;
   5: 
   6: /// OS-agnostic role definition. The 5 named roles match the bash
   7: /// orchestrator's existing names so membership / traffic-test / role-switch
   8: /// logic stays semantically identical.
   9: #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
  10: pub enum NodeRole {
  11:     Exit,
  12:     Client,
  13:     Entry,
  14:     Aux,
  15:     Extra,
  16:     Custom(String),
  17: }
  18: 
  19: impl NodeRole {
  20:     /// Exactly one node per lab may hold an Exit role.
  21:     pub fn is_unique_per_lab(&self) -> bool {
  22:         matches!(self, NodeRole::Exit)
  23:     }
  24: 
  25:     /// Returns true for roles that act as the membership-owner (signs bundles).
  26:     pub fn is_membership_owner(&self) -> bool {
  27:         matches!(self, NodeRole::Exit)
  28:     }
  29: 
  30:     /// Role-platform matrix currently enforced by the Rust-native path.
  31:     /// Windows/macOS Exit remains fail-closed until W5.4 live evidence is recorded.
  32:     ///
  33:     /// | Role   | Linux | Windows | macOS | iOS | Android |
  34:     /// |--------|-------|---------|-------|-----|---------|
  35:     /// | Exit   | ✓     | ✗       | ✗     | ✗   | ✗       |
  36:     /// | Client | ✓     | ✓       | ✓     | ✗   | ✗       |
  37:     /// | Entry  | ✓     | ✓       | ✓     | ✗   | ✗       |
  38:     /// | Aux    | ✓     | ✓       | ✓     | ✗   | ✗       |
  39:     /// | Extra  | ✓     | ✓       | ✓     | ✗   | ✗       |
  40:     ///
  41:     /// iOS and Android adapters fail closed with security-specific rejection
  42:     /// messages (unreviewed key custody + connection model + daemon coverage).
  43:     pub fn is_supported_for_platform(&self, platform: &VmGuestPlatform) -> bool {
  44:         match platform {
  45:             VmGuestPlatform::Ios | VmGuestPlatform::Android => false,
  46:             VmGuestPlatform::Linux => true,
  47:             VmGuestPlatform::Windows | VmGuestPlatform::Macos => !self.is_membership_owner(),
  48:         }
  49:     }
  50: 
  51:     pub fn as_str(&self) -> &str {
  52:         match self {
  53:             NodeRole::Exit => "exit",
  54:             NodeRole::Client => "client",
  55:             NodeRole::Entry => "entry",
  56:             NodeRole::Aux => "aux",
  57:             NodeRole::Extra => "extra",
  58:             NodeRole::Custom(s) => s.as_str(),
  59:         }
  60:     }
  61: 
  62:     pub fn parse(s: &str) -> Result<Self, String> {
  63:         match s.trim() {
  64:             "exit" => Ok(NodeRole::Exit),
  65:             "client" => Ok(NodeRole::Client),
  66:             "entry" => Ok(NodeRole::Entry),
  67:             "aux" => Ok(NodeRole::Aux),
  68:             "extra" => Ok(NodeRole::Extra),
  69:             other => {
  70:                 if let Some(label) = other.strip_prefix("custom-") {
  71:                     if label.is_empty() {
  72:                         return Err("custom role label must not be empty".to_string());
  73:                     }
  74:                     Ok(NodeRole::Custom(label.to_string()))
  75:                 } else {
  76:                     Err(format!(
  77:                         "unknown role '{other}'; expected one of: exit, client, entry, aux, extra, custom-<label>"
  78:                     ))
  79:                 }
  80:             }
  81:         }
  82:     }
  83: }
  84: 
  85: impl fmt::Display for NodeRole {
  86:     fn fmt(&self, f: &mut fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> fmt::Result {
  87:         write!(f, "{}", self.as_str())
  88:     }
  89: }

===== /crates/rustynet-cli/src/vm_lab/orchestrator/role_assignment.rs =====

   1: #![allow(dead_code)]
   2: use crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::role::NodeRole;
   3: 
   4: /// Translate the legacy per-role `--<role>-vm <alias>` CLI flags into the
   5: /// `Vec<NodeRoleAssignment>` shape used by `--node <alias>:<role>`.
   6: ///
   7: /// Mapping mirrors `scripts/e2e/live_linux_lab_orchestrator.sh`:
   8: ///   --exit-vm          → `<alias>:exit`
   9: ///   --client-vm        → `<alias>:client`
  10: ///   --entry-vm         → `<alias>:entry`
  11: ///   --aux-vm           → `<alias>:aux`
  12: ///   --extra-vm         → `<alias>:extra`
  13: ///   --fifth-client-vm  → `<alias>:client` (bash treats this as a 2nd client)
  14: ///   --windows-vm       → `<alias>:client` (bash post-validate treats it as a client peer)
  15: ///
  16: /// Aliases that are `Some("")` after trimming are silently skipped, matching
  17: /// the bash orchestrator's "missing flag = role not assigned" semantics.
  18: pub fn translate_legacy_role_flags(
  19:     exit_vm: Option<&str>,
  20:     client_vm: Option<&str>,
  21:     entry_vm: Option<&str>,
  22:     aux_vm: Option<&str>,
  23:     extra_vm: Option<&str>,
  24:     fifth_client_vm: Option<&str>,
  25:     windows_vm: Option<&str>,
  26: ) -> Vec<NodeRoleAssignment> {
  27:     let mut out = Vec::new();
  28:     let push_if_present =
  29:         |out: &mut Vec<NodeRoleAssignment>, alias: Option<&str>, role: NodeRole| {
  30:             if let Some(a) = alias {
  31:                 let trimmed = a.trim();
  32:                 if !trimmed.is_empty() {
  33:                     out.push(NodeRoleAssignment {
  34:                         alias: trimmed.to_string(),
  35:                         role,
  36:                     });
  37:                 }
  38:             }
  39:         };
  40:     push_if_present(&mut out, exit_vm, NodeRole::Exit);
  41:     push_if_present(&mut out, client_vm, NodeRole::Client);
  42:     push_if_present(&mut out, entry_vm, NodeRole::Entry);
  43:     push_if_present(&mut out, aux_vm, NodeRole::Aux);
  44:     push_if_present(&mut out, extra_vm, NodeRole::Extra);
  45:     push_if_present(&mut out, fifth_client_vm, NodeRole::Client);
  46:     push_if_present(&mut out, windows_vm, NodeRole::Client);
  47:     out
  48: }
  49: 
  50: /// Binding of a node alias to a role for one lab run.
  51: #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
  52: pub struct NodeRoleAssignment {
  53:     pub alias: String,
  54:     pub role: NodeRole,
  55: }
  56: 
  57: /// Parse `"<alias>:<role>"` from a CLI `--node` argument.
  58: /// Returns `Err` on empty input, missing colon, empty alias/role, or
  59: /// unknown role name.
  60: pub fn parse_node_role_arg(s: &str) -> Result<NodeRoleAssignment, String> {
  61:     let s = s.trim();
  62:     if s.is_empty() {
  63:         return Err("--node argument must not be empty".to_string());
  64:     }
  65:     let (alias, role_str) = s
  66:         .split_once(':')
  67:         .ok_or_else(|| format!("--node argument '{s}' must be in the form '<alias>:<role>'"))?;
  68:     let alias = alias.trim();
  69:     let role_str = role_str.trim();
  70:     if alias.is_empty() {
  71:         return Err(format!("alias part of '--node {s}' must not be empty"));
  72:     }
  73:     if role_str.is_empty() {
  74:         return Err(format!("role part of '--node {s}' must not be empty"));
  75:     }
  76:     let role = NodeRole::parse(role_str)?;
  77:     Ok(NodeRoleAssignment {
  78:         alias: alias.to_string(),
  79:         role,
  80:     })
  81: }
  82:

===== /crates/rustynet-cli/src/vm_lab/orchestrator/runner.rs =====

   1: #![allow(dead_code)]
   2: use std::collections::{HashMap, HashSet};
   3: 
   4: use crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::context::OrchestrationContext;
   5: use crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::error::StageOutcome;
   6: use crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::stage::{OrchestrationStage, StageId};
   7: 
   8: /// Drives stages in dependency order with skip-cascade.
   9: ///
  10: /// Skip-cascade rule: if a stage fails or is skipped, every stage that lists
  11: /// it in `dependencies()` is also skipped (recursively).
  12: pub struct StateMachineRunner {
  13:     stages: Vec<Box<dyn OrchestrationStage>>,
  14:     /// Stage IDs explicitly requested to skip via `--skip-stage`.
  15:     explicit_skips: HashSet<StageId>,
  16: }
  17: 
  18: impl StateMachineRunner {
  19:     pub fn new(stages: Vec<Box<dyn OrchestrationStage>>) -> Self {
  20:         StateMachineRunner {
  21:             stages,
  22:             explicit_skips: HashSet::new(),
  23:         }
  24:     }
  25: 
  26:     pub fn with_explicit_skips(mut self, skips: impl IntoIterator<Item = StageId>) -> Self {
  27:         self.explicit_skips.extend(skips);
  28:         self
  29:     }
  30: 
  31:     /// Execute all stages in dependency order, applying skip-cascade.
  32:     /// Returns a list of (StageId, StageOutcome) in execution order.
  33:     pub fn run(&self, ctx: &mut OrchestrationContext) -> Vec<(StageId, StageOutcome)> {
  34:         let ordered = topological_order(&self.stages);
  35:         let mut results: Vec<(StageId, StageOutcome)> = Vec::new();
  36:         let mut blocked: HashSet<StageId> = self.explicit_skips.clone();
  37: 
  38:         for idx in ordered {
  39:             let stage = &self.stages[idx];
  40:             let id = stage.id();
  41: 
  42:             if blocked.contains(&id) {
  43:                 results.push((id.clone(), StageOutcome::Skipped));
  44:                 ctx.record_outcome(id, StageOutcome::Skipped);
  45:                 continue;
  46:             }
  47: 
  48:             let dep_blocked = stage.dependencies().iter().any(|dep| {
  49:                 blocked.contains(dep)
  50:                     || ctx
  51:                         .outcome_of(dep)
  52:                         .map(|o| o.is_blocking())
  53:                         .unwrap_or(false)
  54:             });
  55: 
  56:             if dep_blocked {
  57:                 blocked.insert(id.clone());
  58:                 results.push((id.clone(), StageOutcome::Skipped));
  59:                 ctx.record_outcome(id, StageOutcome::Skipped);
  60:                 continue;
  61:             }
  62: 
  63:             let outcome = stage.execute(ctx);
  64: 
  65:             if outcome.is_blocking() {
  66:                 blocked.insert(id.clone());
  67:             }
  68: 
  69:             ctx.record_outcome(id.clone(), outcome.clone());
  70:             results.push((id, outcome));
  71:         }
  72: 
  73:         results
  74:     }
  75: }
  76: 
  77: /// Topological sort of stages by `dependencies()`.
  78: /// Returns indices into `stages` in dependency-first order.
  79: /// Stages with no dependency relationship preserve insertion order.
  80: fn topological_order(stages: &[Box<dyn OrchestrationStage>]) -> Vec<usize> {
  81:     let id_to_idx: HashMap<StageId, usize> = stages
  82:         .iter()
  83:         .enumerate()
  84:         .map(|(i, s)| (s.id(), i))
  85:         .collect();
  86: 
  87:     let n = stages.len();
  88:     let mut in_degree: Vec<usize> = vec![0; n];
  89:     let mut adj: Vec<Vec<usize>> = vec![vec![]; n];
  90: 
  91:     for (i, stage) in stages.iter().enumerate() {
  92:         for dep in stage.dependencies() {
  93:             if let Some(&dep_idx) = id_to_idx.get(dep) {
  94:                 adj[dep_idx].push(i);
  95:                 in_degree[i] += 1;
  96:             }
  97:         }
  98:     }
  99: 
 100:     let mut queue: std::collections::VecDeque<usize> =
 101:         (0..n).filter(|&i| in_degree[i] == 0).collect();
 102: 
 103:     let mut order = Vec::with_capacity(n);
 104:     while let Some(node) = queue.pop_front() {
 105:         order.push(node);
 106:         for &next in &adj[node] {
 107:             in_degree[next] -= 1;
 108:             if in_degree[next] == 0 {
 109:                 queue.push_back(next);
 110:             }
 111:         }
 112:     }
 113: 
 114:     // Append any nodes not reached (cycles or missing deps) at the end.
 115:     // In practice the stage list is acyclic; this is a safety net.
 116:     if order.len() < n {
 117:         for i in 0..n {
 118:             if !order.contains(&i) {
 119:                 order.push(i);
 120:             }
 121:         }
 122:     }
 123: 
 124:     order
 125: }

  23:     }

   1: #![allow(dead_code)]

   7: pub struct CleanupHostsStage;
   8: 
   9: impl OrchestrationStage for CleanupHostsStage {
  10:     fn id(&self) -> StageId {
  11:         StageId::CleanupHosts
  12:     }
  13:     fn name(&self) -> &str {
  14:         "cleanup_hosts"
  15:     }
  16:     fn dependencies(&self) -> &[StageId] {
  17:         &[StageId::VerifySshReachability]
  18:     }
  19:     fn applies_to_roles(&self) -> &[NodeRole] {
  20:         &[]
  21:     }
  22:     fn fanout(&self) -> StageFanout {
  23:         StageFanout::PerNode
  24:     }
  25: 
  26:     fn execute(&self, ctx: &mut OrchestrationContext) -> StageOutcome {
  27:         let aliases: Vec<String> = ctx.assignments.iter().map(|a| a.alias.clone()).collect();
  28:         let results: Vec<(String, Result<(), String>)> = aliases
  29:             .iter()
  30:             .map(|alias| {
  31:                 let r = match ctx.adapters.get(alias.as_str()) {
  32:                     Some(adapter) => adapter.cleanup_runtime_state().map_err(|e| e.to_string()),
  33:                     None => Ok(()), // no adapter = nothing to clean
  34:                 };
  35:                 (alias.clone(), r)
  36:             })
  37:             .collect();
  38:         let errors: Vec<String> = results
  39:             .into_iter()
  40:             .filter_map(|(alias, r)| r.err().map(|e| format!("{alias}: {e}")))
  41:             .collect();
  42:         if errors.is_empty() {
  43:             StageOutcome::Passed
  44:         } else {
  45:             StageOutcome::Failed(errors.join("; "))
  46:         }
  47:     }
  48: }

===== /crates/rustynet-cli/src/vm_lab/orchestrator/stage/collect_pubkeys.rs =====

   1: #![allow(dead_code)]
   2: use crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::context::OrchestrationContext;
   3: use crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::error::StageOutcome;
   4: use crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::role::NodeRole;
   5: use crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::stage::{OrchestrationStage, StageFanout, StageId};
   6: 
   7: pub struct CollectPubkeysStage;
   8: 
   9: impl OrchestrationStage for CollectPubkeysStage {
  10:     fn id(&self) -> StageId {
  11:         StageId::CollectPubkeys
  12:     }
  13:     fn name(&self) -> &str {
  14:         "collect_pubkeys"
  15:     }
  16:     fn dependencies(&self) -> &[StageId] {
  17:         &[StageId::BootstrapHosts]
  18:     }
  19:     fn applies_to_roles(&self) -> &[NodeRole] {
  20:         &[]
  21:     }
  22:     fn fanout(&self) -> StageFanout {
  23:         StageFanout::PerNode
  24:     }
  25: 
  26:     fn execute(&self, ctx: &mut OrchestrationContext) -> StageOutcome {
  27:         use crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::error::WireguardPublicKey;
  28: 
  29:         let aliases: Vec<String> = ctx.assignments.iter().map(|a| a.alias.clone()).collect();
  30: 
  31:         struct NodeData {
  32:             alias: String,
  33:             pubkey: Result<WireguardPublicKey, String>,
  34:             node_id: Result<String, String>,
  35:             mesh_ip: Option<String>,
  36:             endpoint: String,
  37:         }
  38: 
  39:         // Collect pass: no ctx mutation
  40:         let data: Vec<NodeData> = aliases
  41:             .iter()
  42:             .map(|alias| {
  43:                 let (pubkey, node_id, mesh_ip, endpoint) = match ctx.adapters.get(alias.as_str()) {
  44:                     Some(adapter) => {
  45:                         let pk = adapter
  46:                             .collect_wireguard_public_key()
  47:                             .map_err(|e| e.to_string());
  48:                         let nid = adapter
  49:                             .collect_node_id()
  50:                             .map(|n| n.0)
  51:                             .map_err(|e| e.to_string());
  52:                         let mip = adapter.collect_mesh_ip().ok();
  53:                         let ep = adapter.endpoint();
  54:                         (pk, nid, mip, ep)
  55:                     }
  56:                     None => (
  57:                         Err(format!("no adapter for '{alias}'")),
  58:                         Err(format!("no adapter for '{alias}'")),
  59:                         None,
  60:                         "0.0.0.0:51820".to_string(),
  61:                     ),
  62:                 };
  63:                 NodeData {
  64:                     alias: alias.clone(),
  65:                     pubkey,
  66:                     node_id,
  67:                     mesh_ip,
  68:                     endpoint,
  69:                 }
  70:             })
  71:             .collect();
  72: 
  73:         // Mutate pass: adapter borrows no longer live
  74:         let mut errors = Vec::new();
  75:         for d in data {
  76:             match d.pubkey {
  77:                 Ok(pk) => {
  78:                     ctx.collected_pubkeys.insert(d.alias.clone(), pk);
  79:                 }
  80:                 Err(e) => errors.push(format!("{}: pubkey: {e}", d.alias)),
  81:             }
  82:             match d.node_id {
  83:                 Ok(nid) => {
  84:                     ctx.node_ids.insert(d.alias.clone(), nid);
  85:                 }
  86:                 Err(e) => errors.push(format!("{}: node_id: {e}", d.alias)),
  87:             }
  88:             if let Some(ip) = d.mesh_ip {
  89:                 ctx.mesh_ips.insert(d.alias.clone(), ip);
  90:             }
  91:             ctx.endpoints.insert(d.alias.clone(), d.endpoint);
  92:         }
  93: 
  94:         if errors.is_empty() {
  95:             StageOutcome::Passed
  96:         } else {
  97:             StageOutcome::Failed(errors.join("; "))
  98:         }
  99:     }
 100: }

  12:     }

  17:         &[StageId::DistributeMembership]
  18:     }
  19:     fn applies_to_roles(&self) -> &[NodeRole] {
  20:         &[]
  21:     }
  22:     fn fanout(&self) -> StageFanout {
  23:         StageFanout::Once
  24:     }
  25: 
  26:     fn execute(&self, ctx: &mut OrchestrationContext) -> StageOutcome {
  27:         distribute_bundle_kind(ctx, BundleKind::Assignment, "rn-assignment", "assignment")
  28:     }
  29: }
  30: 
  31: /// Build the env file content for bundle issuance.
  32: pub(crate) fn build_bundle_env(
  33:     ctx: &OrchestrationContext,
  34:     kind: &BundleKind,
  35: ) -> Result<String, String> {
  36:     // NODES_SPEC: node_id|endpoint|public_key_hex;...
  37:     let mut nodes_parts = Vec::new();
  38:     for a in &ctx.assignments {
  39:         let node_id = ctx
  40:             .node_ids
  41:             .get(&a.alias)
  42:             .ok_or_else(|| format!("no node_id for '{}'", a.alias))?;
  43:         let pubkey = ctx
  44:             .collected_pubkeys
  45:             .get(&a.alias)
  46:             .ok_or_else(|| format!("no pubkey for '{}'", a.alias))?;
  47:         let endpoint = ctx
  48:             .endpoints
  49:             .get(&a.alias)
  50:             .cloned()
  51:             .unwrap_or_else(|| "0.0.0.0:51820".to_string());
  52:         nodes_parts.push(format!("{node_id}|{endpoint}|{}", pubkey.0));
  53:     }
  54:     let nodes_spec = nodes_parts.join(";");
  55: 
  56:     // ALLOW_SPEC: full mesh (every pair bidirectionally)
  57:     let mut allow_parts = Vec::new();
  58:     for src in &ctx.assignments {
  59:         let src_id = ctx
  60:             .node_ids
  61:             .get(&src.alias)
  62:             .ok_or_else(|| format!("no node_id for '{}'", src.alias))?;
  63:         for dst in &ctx.assignments {
  64:             if dst.alias == src.alias {
  65:                 continue;
  66:             }
  67:             let dst_id = ctx
  68:                 .node_ids
  69:                 .get(&dst.alias)
  70:                 .ok_or_else(|| format!("no node_id for '{}'", dst.alias))?;
  71:             allow_parts.push(format!("{src_id}|{dst_id}"));
  72:         }
  73:     }
  74:     let allow_spec = allow_parts.join(";");
  75: 
  76:     let mut lines = vec![
  77:         format!("NODES_SPEC={nodes_spec}"),
  78:         format!("ALLOW_SPEC={allow_spec}"),
  79:     ];
  80: 
  81:     if matches!(kind, BundleKind::Assignment) {
  82:         let exit_node_id = ctx
  83:             .assignments
  84:             .iter()
  85:             .find(|a| a.role == NodeRole::Exit)
  86:             .and_then(|a| ctx.node_ids.get(&a.alias))
  87:             .ok_or_else(|| "no exit node_id".to_string())?
  88:             .clone();
  89:         let assignment_parts: Vec<String> = ctx
  90:             .assignments
  91:             .iter()
  92:             .map(|a| {
  93:                 ctx.node_ids
  94:                     .get(&a.alias)
  95:                     .map(|nid| format!("{nid}|{exit_node_id}"))
  96:                     .ok_or_else(|| format!("no node_id for '{}'", a.alias))
  97:             })
  98:             .collect::<Result<Vec<_>, _>>()?;
  99:         lines.push(format!("ASSIGNMENTS_SPEC={}", assignment_parts.join(";")));
 100:     }
 101: 
 102:     Ok(lines.join("\n") + "\n")
 103: }
 104: 
 105: /// Shared bundle distribution logic used by Assignment, Traversal, and DnsZone stages.
 106: pub(crate) fn distribute_bundle_kind(
 107:     ctx: &mut OrchestrationContext,
 108:     kind: BundleKind,
 109:     file_prefix: &str,
 110:     file_ext: &str,
 111: ) -> StageOutcome {
 112:     let exit_alias = match ctx.assignments.iter().find(|a| a.role == NodeRole::Exit) {
 113:         Some(a) => a.alias.clone(),
 114:         None => return StageOutcome::Failed("no Exit node in assignments".to_string()),
 115:     };
 116: 
 117:     let env_content = match build_bundle_env(ctx, &kind) {
 118:         Ok(c) => c,
 119:         Err(e) => return StageOutcome::Failed(format!("build env: {e}")),
 120:     };
 121: 
 122:     let tmp_dir = {
 123:         let mut p = std::env::temp_dir();
 124:         p.push(format!("rn_bundles_{}_{}", std::process::id(), kind));
 125:         if let Err(e) = std::fs::create_dir_all(&p) {
 126:             return StageOutcome::Failed(format!("create tmp bundle dir: {e}"));
 127:         }
 128:         p
 129:     };
 130: 
 131:     // Issue bundles (exit adapter only — no ctx mutation needed after)
 132:     {
 133:         let exit_adapter = match ctx.adapters.get(exit_alias.as_str()) {
 134:             Some(a) => a,
 135:             None => {
 136:                 let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&tmp_dir);
 137:                 return StageOutcome::Failed(format!("no adapter for exit '{exit_alias}'"));
 138:             }
 139:         };
 140:         if let Err(e) = exit_adapter.issue_bundles_to_dir(kind.clone(), &env_content, &tmp_dir) {
 141:             let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&tmp_dir);
 142:             return StageOutcome::Failed(format!("issue {kind} bundles: {e}"));
 143:         }
 144:     }
 145: 
 146:     // Collect alias→node_id mapping (no mutation)
 147:     let aliases: Vec<(String, String)> = ctx
 148:         .assignments
 149:         .iter()
 150:         .filter_map(|a| {
 151:             ctx.node_ids
 152:                 .get(&a.alias)
 153:                 .map(|nid| (a.alias.clone(), nid.clone()))
 154:         })
 155:         .collect();
 156: 
 157:     // Distribute to each node
 158:     let results: Vec<(String, Result<(), String>)> = aliases
 159:         .iter()
 160:         .map(|(alias, node_id)| {
 161:             let fname = format!("{file_prefix}-{node_id}.{file_ext}");
 162:             let bundle_path = tmp_dir.join(&fname);
 163:             let r = if !bundle_path.exists() {
 164:                 Err(format!("bundle not found: {fname}"))
 165:             } else {
 166:                 match ctx.adapters.get(alias.as_str()) {
 167:                     Some(adapter) => adapter
 168:                         .distribute_signed_bundle(kind.clone(), &bundle_path)
 169:                         .map_err(|e| e.to_string()),
 170:                     None => Err(format!("no adapter for '{alias}'")),
 171:                 }
 172:             };
 173:             (alias.clone(), r)
 174:         })
 175:         .collect();
 176: 
 177:     let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&tmp_dir);
 178: 
 179:     let errors: Vec<String> = results
 180:         .into_iter()
 181:         .filter_map(|(alias, r): (String, Result<(), String>)| {
 182:             r.err().map(|e| format!("{alias}: {e}"))
 183:         })
 184:         .collect();
 185:     if errors.is_empty() {
 186:         StageOutcome::Passed
 187:     } else {
 188:         StageOutcome::Failed(errors.join("; "))
 189:     }
 190: }
 191:

===== /crates/rustynet-cli/src/vm_lab/orchestrator/stage/distribute_membership.rs =====

   1: #![allow(dead_code)]
   2: use crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::context::OrchestrationContext;
   3: use crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::error::{BundleKind, StageOutcome};
   4: use crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::role::NodeRole;
   5: use crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::stage::{OrchestrationStage, StageFanout, StageId};
   6: 
   7: pub struct DistributeMembershipStage;
   8: 
   9: impl OrchestrationStage for DistributeMembershipStage {
  10:     fn id(&self) -> StageId {
  11:         StageId::DistributeMembership
  12:     }
  13:     fn name(&self) -> &str {
  14:         "distribute_membership"
  15:     }
  16:     fn dependencies(&self) -> &[StageId] {
  17:         &[StageId::MembershipInit]
  18:     }
  19:     fn applies_to_roles(&self) -> &[NodeRole] {
  20:         &[]
  21:     }
  22:     fn fanout(&self) -> StageFanout {
  23:         StageFanout::PerNode
  24:     }
  25: 
  26:     fn execute(&self, ctx: &mut OrchestrationContext) -> StageOutcome {
  27:         let snapshot_data = match &ctx.membership_snapshot {
  28:             Some(d) => d.clone(),
  29:             None => {
  30:                 return StageOutcome::Failed(
  31:                     "no membership snapshot in context (MembershipInit must run first)".to_string(),
  32:                 );
  33:             }
  34:         };
  35: 
  36:         let tmp_path = {
  37:             let mut p = std::env::temp_dir();
  38:             p.push(format!("rn_membership_{}.snapshot", std::process::id()));
  39:             p
  40:         };
  41:         if let Err(e) = std::fs::write(&tmp_path, &snapshot_data) {
  42:             return StageOutcome::Failed(format!("write membership snapshot tmp: {e}"));
  43:         }
  44: 
  45:         let non_exit: Vec<String> = ctx
  46:             .assignments
  47:             .iter()
  48:             .filter(|a| a.role != NodeRole::Exit)
  49:             .map(|a| a.alias.clone())
  50:             .collect();
  51: 
  52:         let results: Vec<(String, Result<(), String>)> = non_exit
  53:             .iter()
  54:             .map(|alias| {
  55:                 let r = match ctx.adapters.get(alias.as_str()) {
  56:                     Some(adapter) => adapter
  57:                         .distribute_signed_bundle(BundleKind::Membership, &tmp_path)
  58:                         .map_err(|e| e.to_string()),
  59:                     None => Err(format!("no adapter for '{alias}'")),
  60:                 };
  61:                 (alias.clone(), r)
  62:             })
  63:             .collect();
  64: 
  65:         let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&tmp_path);
  66: 
  67:         let errors: Vec<String> = results
  68:             .into_iter()
  69:             .filter_map(|(alias, r)| r.err().map(|e| format!("{alias}: {e}")))
  70:             .collect();
  71:         if errors.is_empty() {
  72:             StageOutcome::Passed
  73:         } else {
  74:             StageOutcome::Failed(errors.join("; "))
  75:         }
  76:     }
  77: }
  78:

===== /crates/rustynet-cli/src/vm_lab/orchestrator/stage/final_cleanup.rs =====

   1: #![allow(dead_code)]
   2: use crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::context::OrchestrationContext;
   3: use crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::error::StageOutcome;
   4: use crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::role::NodeRole;
   5: use crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::stage::{OrchestrationStage, StageFanout, StageId};
   6: 
   7: pub struct FinalCleanupStage;
   8: 
   9: impl OrchestrationStage for FinalCleanupStage {
  10:     fn id(&self) -> StageId {
  11:         StageId::Cleanup
  12:     }
  13:     fn name(&self) -> &str {
  14:         "cleanup"
  15:     }
  16:     fn dependencies(&self) -> &[StageId] {
  17:         &[StageId::ExitHandoff]
  18:     }
  19:     fn applies_to_roles(&self) -> &[NodeRole] {
  20:         &[]
  21:     }
  22:     fn fanout(&self) -> StageFanout {
  23:         StageFanout::PerNode
  24:     }
  25: 
  26:     fn execute(&self, ctx: &mut OrchestrationContext) -> StageOutcome {
  27:         let aliases: Vec<String> = ctx.assignments.iter().map(|a| a.alias.clone()).collect();
  28:         let results: Vec<(String, Result<(), String>)> = aliases
  29:             .iter()
  30:             .map(|alias| {
  31:                 let r = match ctx.adapters.get(alias.as_str()) {
  32:                     Some(adapter) => adapter.cleanup_runtime_state().map_err(|e| e.to_string()),
  33:                     None => Ok(()), // no adapter = nothing to clean
  34:                 };
  35:                 (alias.clone(), r)
  36:             })
  37:             .collect();
  38:         let errors: Vec<String> = results
  39:             .into_iter()
  40:             .filter_map(|(alias, r)| r.err().map(|e| format!("{alias}: {e}")))
  41:             .collect();
  42:         if errors.is_empty() {
  43:             StageOutcome::Passed
  44:         } else {
  45:             StageOutcome::Failed(errors.join("; "))
  46:         }
  47:     }
  48: }
  49:

  51: mod tests {
  52:     use super::*;

  54: 
  55:     #[test]
  56:     fn empty_assignments_passes() {
  57:         let mut ctx = OrchestrationContext {
  58:             assignments: vec![],
  59:             adapters: HashMap::new(),
  60:             source_archive: None,
  61:             report_dir: std::env::temp_dir(),
  62:             stage_outcomes: HashMap::new(),
  63:             collected_pubkeys: HashMap::new(),
  64:             network_id: "net".to_string(),
  65:             node_ids: HashMap::new(),
  66:             ssh_allow_cidrs: String::new(),
  67:             membership_snapshot: None,
  68:             mesh_ips: HashMap::new(),
  69:             endpoints: HashMap::new(),
  70:         };
  71:         assert_eq!(FinalCleanupStage.execute(&mut ctx), StageOutcome::Passed);
  72:     }
  73: }

===== /crates/rustynet-cli/src/vm_lab/orchestrator/stage/install.rs =====

   1: #![allow(dead_code)]
   2: use crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::context::OrchestrationContext;
   3: use crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::error::StageOutcome;
   4: use crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::role::NodeRole;
   5: use crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::stage::{OrchestrationStage, StageFanout, StageId};
   6: 
   7: pub struct BootstrapHostsStage;
   8: 
   9: impl OrchestrationStage for BootstrapHostsStage {
  10:     fn id(&self) -> StageId {
  11:         StageId::BootstrapHosts
  12:     }
  13:     fn name(&self) -> &str {
  14:         "bootstrap_hosts"
  15:     }
  16:     fn dependencies(&self) -> &[StageId] {
  17:         &[StageId::CleanupHosts]
  18:     }
  19:     fn applies_to_roles(&self) -> &[NodeRole] {
  20:         &[]
  21:     }
  22:     fn fanout(&self) -> StageFanout {
  23:         StageFanout::PerNode
  24:     }
  25: 
  26:     fn execute(&self, ctx: &mut OrchestrationContext) -> StageOutcome {
  27:         let source = match ctx.source_archive.clone() {
  28:             Some(s) => s,
  29:             None => return StageOutcome::Failed("no source archive in context".to_string()),
  30:         };
  31:         let aliases: Vec<String> = ctx.assignments.iter().map(|a| a.alias.clone()).collect();
  32:         let results: Vec<(String, Result<(), String>)> = aliases
  33:             .iter()
  34:             .map(|alias| {
  35:                 let r = match ctx.adapters.get(alias.as_str()) {
  36:                     Some(adapter) => adapter
  37:                         .install_daemon(&source, ctx)
  38:                         .map(|_| ())
  39:                         .map_err(|e| e.to_string()),
  40:                     None => Err(format!("no adapter for '{alias}'")),
  41:                 };
  42:                 (alias.clone(), r)
  43:             })
  44:             .collect();
  45:         let errors: Vec<String> = results
  46:             .into_iter()
  47:             .filter_map(|(alias, r)| r.err().map(|e| format!("{alias}: {e}")))
  48:             .collect();
  49:         if errors.is_empty() {
  50:             StageOutcome::Passed
  51:         } else {
  52:             StageOutcome::Failed(errors.join("; "))
  53:         }
  54:     }
  55: }
  56:

===== /crates/rustynet-cli/src/vm_lab/orchestrator/stage/membership_init.rs =====

   1: #![allow(dead_code)]
   2: use crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::context::OrchestrationContext;
   3: use crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::error::{NodeMembershipPeer, StageOutcome};
   4: use crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::role::NodeRole;
   5: use crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::stage::{OrchestrationStage, StageFanout, StageId};
   6: 
   7: pub struct MembershipInitStage;
   8: 
   9: impl OrchestrationStage for MembershipInitStage {
  10:     fn id(&self) -> StageId {
  11:         StageId::MembershipInit
  12:     }
  13:     fn name(&self) -> &str {
  14:         "membership_init"
  15:     }
  16:     fn dependencies(&self) -> &[StageId] {
  17:         &[StageId::CollectPubkeys]
  18:     }
  19:     fn applies_to_roles(&self) -> &[NodeRole] {
  20:         &[NodeRole::Exit]
  21:     }
  22:     fn fanout(&self) -> StageFanout {
  23:         StageFanout::Once
  24:     }
  25: 
  26:     fn execute(&self, ctx: &mut OrchestrationContext) -> StageOutcome {
  27:         let exit_alias = ctx
  28:             .assignments
  29:             .iter()
  30:             .find(|a| a.role == NodeRole::Exit)
  31:             .map(|a| a.alias.clone());
  32:         let exit_alias = match exit_alias {
  33:             Some(a) => a,
  34:             None => return StageOutcome::Failed("no Exit node in assignments".to_string()),
  35:         };
  36: 
  37:         // Clone peers before adapter borrow
  38:         let peers = match build_membership_peers(ctx) {
  39:             Ok(peers) => peers,
  40:             Err(err) => return StageOutcome::Failed(err),
  41:         };
  42: 
  43:         let (owner_key_r, snapshot_r) = {
  44:             let adapter = match ctx.adapters.get(exit_alias.as_str()) {
  45:                 Some(a) => a,
  46:                 None => return StageOutcome::Failed(format!("no adapter for exit '{exit_alias}'")),
  47:             };
  48:             let owner_key = adapter
  49:                 .issue_membership_owner_key()
  50:                 .map_err(|e| e.to_string());
  51:             let snapshot = match &owner_key {
  52:                 Ok(k) => Some(
  53:                     adapter
  54:                         .init_membership_snapshot(k, &peers)
  55:                         .map_err(|e| e.to_string()),
  56:                 ),
  57:                 Err(_) => None,
  58:             };
  59:             (owner_key, snapshot)
  60:         };
  61: 
  62:         match (owner_key_r, snapshot_r) {
  63:             (Err(e), _) => StageOutcome::Failed(format!("issue_membership_owner_key: {e}")),
  64:             (_, None) => StageOutcome::Failed(
  65:                 "owner key fetch succeeded but no snapshot attempted".to_string(),
  66:             ),
  67:             (_, Some(Err(e))) => StageOutcome::Failed(format!("init_membership_snapshot: {e}")),
  68:             (_, Some(Ok(snap))) => {
  69:                 ctx.membership_snapshot = Some(snap.data);
  70:                 StageOutcome::Passed
  71:             }
  72:         }
  73:     }
  74: }
  75: 
  76: pub(crate) fn build_membership_peers(
  77:     ctx: &OrchestrationContext,
  78: ) -> Result<Vec<NodeMembershipPeer>, String> {
  79:     ctx.assignments
  80:         .iter()
  81:         .map(|assignment| {
  82:             let node_id = ctx
  83:                 .node_ids
  84:                 .get(&assignment.alias)
  85:                 .ok_or_else(|| format!("missing node_id for '{}'", assignment.alias))?;
  86:             if node_id.trim().is_empty() {
  87:                 return Err(format!("empty node_id for '{}'", assignment.alias));
  88:             }
  89: 
  90:             let public_key_hex = ctx
  91:                 .collected_pubkeys
  92:                 .get(&assignment.alias)
  93:                 .ok_or_else(|| format!("missing WireGuard public key for '{}'", assignment.alias))?
  94:                 .0
  95:                 .clone();
  96:             if !NodeMembershipPeer::is_valid_public_key_hex(&public_key_hex) {
  97:                 return Err(format!(
  98:                     "invalid WireGuard public key for '{}': expected 64 hex chars",
  99:                     assignment.alias
 100:                 ));
 101:             }
 102: 
 103:             Ok(NodeMembershipPeer {
 104:                 alias: assignment.alias.clone(),
 105:                 role: assignment.role.clone(),
 106:                 node_id: node_id.clone(),
 107:                 public_key_hex,
 108:             })
 109:         })
 110:         .collect()
 111: }

 142:     #[test]
 143:     fn build_membership_peers_threads_real_pubkeys_for_non_exit_peers() {
 144:         let mut ctx = OrchestrationContext {
 145:             assignments: vec![
 146:                 NodeRoleAssignment {
 147:                     alias: "exit-1".to_string(),
 148:                     role: NodeRole::Exit,
 149:                 },
 150:                 NodeRoleAssignment {
 151:                     alias: "client-1".to_string(),
 152:                     role: NodeRole::Client,
 153:                 },
 154:             ],
 155:             adapters: HashMap::new(),
 156:             source_archive: None,
 157:             report_dir: std::env::temp_dir(),
 158:             stage_outcomes: HashMap::new(),
 159:             collected_pubkeys: HashMap::new(),
 160:             network_id: "net".to_string(),
 161:             node_ids: HashMap::new(),
 162:             ssh_allow_cidrs: String::new(),
 163:             membership_snapshot: None,
 164:             mesh_ips: HashMap::new(),
 165:             endpoints: HashMap::new(),
 166:         };
 167:         let exit_key = "a".repeat(64);
 168:         let client_key = "b".repeat(64);
 169:         ctx.collected_pubkeys
 170:             .insert("exit-1".to_string(), WireguardPublicKey(exit_key.clone()));
 171:         ctx.collected_pubkeys.insert(
 172:             "client-1".to_string(),
 173:             WireguardPublicKey(client_key.clone()),
 174:         );
 175:         ctx.node_ids
 176:             .insert("exit-1".to_string(), "exit-node-id".to_string());
 177:         ctx.node_ids
 178:             .insert("client-1".to_string(), "client-node-id".to_string());
 179: 
 180:         let peers = build_membership_peers(&ctx).unwrap();
 181:         let client = peers.iter().find(|p| p.alias == "client-1").unwrap();
 182:         assert_eq!(client.node_id, "client-node-id");
 183:         assert_eq!(client.public_key_hex, client_key);
 184:         assert_eq!(client.public_key_hex.len(), 64);
 185:     }

  24: /// Enumerated stage IDs — not a String alias.
  25: /// Matches the 16 stages from the bash orchestrator plus cleanup.
  26: #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
  27: pub enum StageId {
  28:     Preflight,
  29:     PrepareSourceArchive,
  30:     VerifySshReachability,
  31:     CleanupHosts,
  32:     BootstrapHosts,
  33:     CollectPubkeys,
  34:     MembershipInit,
  35:     DistributeMembership,
  36:     DistributeAssignments,
  37:     DistributeTraversal,
  38:     DistributeDnsZone,
  39:     EnforceBaselineRuntime,
  40:     ValidateBaselineRuntime,
  41:     TrafficTestMatrix,
  42:     RoleSwitchMatrix,
  43:     ExitHandoff,
  44:     Cleanup,
  45: }
  46: 
  47: impl StageId {
  48:     pub fn as_str(&self) -> &'static str {
  49:         match self {
  50:             StageId::Preflight => "preflight",
  51:             StageId::PrepareSourceArchive => "prepare_source_archive",
  52:             StageId::VerifySshReachability => "verify_ssh_reachability",
  53:             StageId::CleanupHosts => "cleanup_hosts",
  54:             StageId::BootstrapHosts => "bootstrap_hosts",
  55:             StageId::CollectPubkeys => "collect_pubkeys",
  56:             StageId::MembershipInit => "membership_init",
  57:             StageId::DistributeMembership => "distribute_membership",
  58:             StageId::DistributeAssignments => "distribute_assignments",
  59:             StageId::DistributeTraversal => "distribute_traversal",
  60:             StageId::DistributeDnsZone => "distribute_dns_zone",
  61:             StageId::EnforceBaselineRuntime => "enforce_baseline_runtime",
  62:             StageId::ValidateBaselineRuntime => "validate_baseline_runtime",
  63:             StageId::TrafficTestMatrix => "traffic_test_matrix",
  64:             StageId::RoleSwitchMatrix => "role_switch_matrix",
  65:             StageId::ExitHandoff => "exit_handoff",
  66:             StageId::Cleanup => "cleanup",
  67:         }
  68:     }
  69: }
  70: 
  71: impl std::fmt::Display for StageId {
  72:     fn fmt(&self, f: &mut std::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> std::fmt::Result {
  73:         write!(f, "{}", self.as_str())
  74:     }
  75: }
  76: 
  77: /// How a stage fans out across nodes.
  78: #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
  79: pub enum StageFanout {
  80:     /// Execute once for the whole lab (e.g. membership-init on exit node).
  81:     Once,
  82:     /// Execute once per role-matched node.
  83:     PerNode,
  84: }
  85: 
  86: /// One stage in the orchestration pipeline. One impl per stage file.
  87: pub trait OrchestrationStage: Send + Sync {
  88:     fn id(&self) -> StageId;
  89:     fn name(&self) -> &str;
  90: 
  91:     /// Stages that must pass before this one runs.
  92:     /// Failure or skip of a dependency triggers skip-cascade on this stage.
  93:     fn dependencies(&self) -> &[StageId];
  94: 
  95:     /// Which roles this stage operates on. Empty slice = all roles.
  96:     fn applies_to_roles(&self) -> &[NodeRole];
  97: 
  98:     fn fanout(&self) -> StageFanout;
  99: 
 100:     fn execute(&self, ctx: &mut OrchestrationContext) -> StageOutcome;
 101: }

===== /crates/rustynet-cli/src/vm_lab/orchestrator/stage/preflight.rs =====

   1: #![allow(dead_code)]
   2: use crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::context::OrchestrationContext;
   3: use crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::error::StageOutcome;
   4: use crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::role::NodeRole;
   5: use crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::stage::{OrchestrationStage, StageFanout, StageId};
   6: 
   7: pub struct PreflightStage;
   8: 
   9: impl OrchestrationStage for PreflightStage {
  10:     fn id(&self) -> StageId {
  11:         StageId::Preflight
  12:     }
  13:     fn name(&self) -> &str {
  14:         "preflight"
  15:     }
  16:     fn dependencies(&self) -> &[StageId] {
  17:         &[]
  18:     }
  19:     fn applies_to_roles(&self) -> &[NodeRole] {
  20:         &[]
  21:     }
  22:     fn fanout(&self) -> StageFanout {
  23:         StageFanout::Once
  24:     }
  25: 
  26:     fn execute(&self, ctx: &mut OrchestrationContext) -> StageOutcome {
  27:         // 1. report_dir writable
  28:         if !ctx.report_dir.exists()
  29:             && let Err(e) = std::fs::create_dir_all(&ctx.report_dir)
  30:         {
  31:             return StageOutcome::Failed(format!(
  32:                 "cannot create report dir '{}': {e}",
  33:                 ctx.report_dir.display()
  34:             ));
  35:         }
  36:         let probe = ctx.report_dir.join(".preflight_write_test");
  37:         if std::fs::write(&probe, b"ok").is_err() {
  38:             return StageOutcome::Failed(format!(
  39:                 "report dir '{}' is not writable",
  40:                 ctx.report_dir.display()
  41:             ));
  42:         }
  43:         let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&probe);
  44: 
  45:         // 2. ssh binary
  46:         if std::process::Command::new("ssh")
  47:             .arg("-V")
  48:             .stdout(std::process::Stdio::null())
  49:             .stderr(std::process::Stdio::null())
  50:             .spawn()
  51:             .is_err()
  52:         {
  53:             return StageOutcome::Failed("ssh binary not found in PATH".to_string());
  54:         }
  55: 
  56:         // 3. exactly one exit node
  57:         let exit_count = ctx
  58:             .assignments
  59:             .iter()
  60:             .filter(|a| a.role == NodeRole::Exit)
  61:             .count();
  62:         if exit_count != 1 {
  63:             return StageOutcome::Failed(format!(
  64:                 "lab requires exactly 1 Exit node, found {exit_count}"
  65:             ));
  66:         }
  67: 
  68:         StageOutcome::Passed
  69:     }
  70: }
  71:

 112:         let mut ctx = OrchestrationContext {
 113:             assignments: vec![NodeRoleAssignment {

 115:                 role: NodeRole::Client,

 127:             endpoints: HashMap::new(),

 129:         let outcome = PreflightStage.execute(&mut ctx);

===== /crates/rustynet-cli/src/vm_lab/orchestrator/stage/source_archive.rs =====

   1: #![allow(dead_code)]
   2: use crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::context::OrchestrationContext;
   3: use crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::error::StageOutcome;
   4: use crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::role::NodeRole;
   5: use crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::source_archive::SourceArchive;
   6: use crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::stage::{OrchestrationStage, StageFanout, StageId};
   7: 
   8: pub struct PrepareSourceArchiveStage;
   9: 
  10: impl OrchestrationStage for PrepareSourceArchiveStage {
  11:     fn id(&self) -> StageId {
  12:         StageId::PrepareSourceArchive
  13:     }
  14:     fn name(&self) -> &str {
  15:         "prepare_source_archive"
  16:     }
  17:     fn dependencies(&self) -> &[StageId] {
  18:         &[StageId::Preflight]
  19:     }
  20:     fn applies_to_roles(&self) -> &[NodeRole] {
  21:         &[]
  22:     }
  23:     fn fanout(&self) -> StageFanout {
  24:         StageFanout::Once
  25:     }
  26: 
  27:     fn execute(&self, ctx: &mut OrchestrationContext) -> StageOutcome {
  28:         if ctx.source_archive.is_some() {
  29:             return StageOutcome::Passed;
  30:         }
  31:         let archive_path = {
  32:             let mut p = std::env::temp_dir();
  33:             p.push(format!("rn_source_{}.tar.gz", std::process::id()));
  34:             p
  35:         };
  36:         let status = std::process::Command::new("git")
  37:             .args(["archive", "--format=tar.gz", "-o"])
  38:             .arg(&archive_path)
  39:             .arg("HEAD")
  40:             .stdout(std::process::Stdio::null())
  41:             .stderr(std::process::Stdio::null())
  42:             .status();
  43:         match status {
  44:             Ok(s) if s.success() => match SourceArchive::from_existing(archive_path) {
  45:                 Ok(archive) => {
  46:                     ctx.source_archive = Some(archive);
  47:                     StageOutcome::Passed
  48:                 }
  49:                 Err(e) => StageOutcome::Failed(format!("source archive validation failed: {e}")),
  50:             },
  51:             Ok(s) => StageOutcome::Failed(format!("git archive exited with {s}")),
  52:             Err(e) => StageOutcome::Failed(format!("git archive spawn failed: {e}")),
  53:         }
  54:     }
  55: }
  56: 
  57: #[cfg(test)]
  58: mod tests {
  59:     use super::*;
  60:     use crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::source_archive::SourceArchive;
  61:     use std::collections::HashMap;
  62:     use std::io::Write;
  63:     use tempfile::NamedTempFile;
  64: 
  65:     fn make_ctx_with_archive() -> (OrchestrationContext, NamedTempFile) {
  66:         let mut f = NamedTempFile::new().unwrap();
  67:         writeln!(f, "placeholder").unwrap();
  68:         let archive = SourceArchive::from_existing(f.path().to_path_buf()).unwrap();
  69:         let ctx = OrchestrationContext {
  70:             assignments: vec![],
  71:             adapters: HashMap::new(),
  72:             source_archive: Some(archive),
  73:             report_dir: std::env::temp_dir(),
  74:             stage_outcomes: HashMap::new(),
  75:             collected_pubkeys: HashMap::new(),
  76:             network_id: "net".to_string(),
  77:             node_ids: HashMap::new(),
  78:             ssh_allow_cidrs: String::new(),
  79:             membership_snapshot: None,
  80:             mesh_ips: HashMap::new(),
  81:             endpoints: HashMap::new(),
  82:         };
  83:         (ctx, f)
  84:     }
  85: 
  86:     #[test]
  87:     fn already_present_archive_passes_immediately() {
  88:         let (mut ctx, _f) = make_ctx_with_archive();
  89:         let outcome = PrepareSourceArchiveStage.execute(&mut ctx);
  90:         assert_eq!(outcome, StageOutcome::Passed);
  91:     }
  92: }

===== /crates/rustynet-cli/src/vm_lab/orchestrator/stage/traffic_test_matrix.rs =====

   1: #![allow(dead_code)]
   2: use crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::context::OrchestrationContext;
   3: use crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::error::{StageOutcome, TrafficTestResult};
   4: use crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::role::NodeRole;
   5: use crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::stage::{OrchestrationStage, StageFanout, StageId};
   6: 
   7: pub struct TrafficTestMatrixStage;
   8: 
   9: impl OrchestrationStage for TrafficTestMatrixStage {
  10:     fn id(&self) -> StageId {
  11:         StageId::TrafficTestMatrix
  12:     }
  13:     fn name(&self) -> &str {
  14:         "traffic_test_matrix"
  15:     }
  16:     fn dependencies(&self) -> &[StageId] {
  17:         &[StageId::ValidateBaselineRuntime]
  18:     }
  19:     fn applies_to_roles(&self) -> &[NodeRole] {
  20:         &[]
  21:     }
  22:     fn fanout(&self) -> StageFanout {
  23:         StageFanout::PerNode
  24:     }
  25: 
  26:     fn execute(&self, ctx: &mut OrchestrationContext) -> StageOutcome {
  27:         let aliases: Vec<String> = ctx.assignments.iter().map(|a| a.alias.clone()).collect();
  28: 
  29:         // Collect mesh IPs from adapters if not already populated
  30:         if ctx.mesh_ips.is_empty() {
  31:             let collected: Vec<(String, Option<String>)> = aliases
  32:                 .iter()
  33:                 .map(|alias| {
  34:                     let ip = ctx
  35:                         .adapters
  36:                         .get(alias.as_str())
  37:                         .and_then(|a| a.collect_mesh_ip().ok());
  38:                     (alias.clone(), ip)
  39:                 })
  40:                 .collect();
  41:             for (alias, ip) in collected {
  42:                 if let Some(ip) = ip {
  43:                     ctx.mesh_ips.insert(alias, ip);
  44:                 }
  45:             }
  46:         }
  47: 
  48:         if ctx.mesh_ips.is_empty() {
  49:             return StageOutcome::Failed(
  50:                 "no mesh IPs available; cannot run traffic tests".to_string(),
  51:             );
  52:         }
  53: 
  54:         let mesh_ips = ctx.mesh_ips.clone();
  55:         let mut errors = Vec::new();
  56: 
  57:         for src_alias in &aliases {
  58:             // Positive tests: ping each peer
  59:             for peer_alias in &aliases {
  60:                 if peer_alias == src_alias {
  61:                     continue;
  62:                 }
  63:                 let peer_ip = match mesh_ips.get(peer_alias) {
  64:                     Some(ip) => ip.clone(),
  65:                     None => {
  66:                         errors.push(format!("{src_alias}: no mesh IP for '{peer_alias}'"));
  67:                         continue;
  68:                     }
  69:                 };
  70:                 match ctx
  71:                     .adapters
  72:                     .get(src_alias.as_str())
  73:                     .map(|a| a.ping_mesh_peer(&peer_ip))
  74:                 {
  75:                     Some(Ok(TrafficTestResult::Reachable)) => {}
  76:                     Some(Ok(TrafficTestResult::Blocked)) => {
  77:                         errors.push(format!(
  78:                             "{src_alias} → {peer_alias} ({peer_ip}): blocked (expected reachable)"
  79:                         ));
  80:                     }
  81:                     Some(Ok(TrafficTestResult::Error(e))) => {
  82:                         errors.push(format!("{src_alias} → {peer_alias} ({peer_ip}): {e}"));
  83:                     }
  84:                     Some(Err(e)) => errors.push(format!("{src_alias} → {peer_alias}: {e}")),
  85:                     None => errors.push(format!("no adapter for '{src_alias}'")),
  86:                 }
  87:             }
  88: 
  89:             // Negative test: confirm default-deny
  90:             // TEST-NET-2 (RFC 5737) — never routable in real meshes
  91:             let denied_ip = "198.51.100.1";
  92:             match ctx
  93:                 .adapters
  94:                 .get(src_alias.as_str())
  95:                 .map(|a| a.probe_denied_peer(denied_ip))
  96:             {
  97:                 Some(Ok(TrafficTestResult::Blocked)) | Some(Ok(TrafficTestResult::Error(_))) => {}
  98:                 Some(Ok(TrafficTestResult::Reachable)) => {
  99:                     errors.push(format!(
 100:                         "{src_alias}: default-deny VIOLATED — {denied_ip} was reachable"
 101:                     ));
 102:                 }
 103:                 Some(Err(e)) => errors.push(format!("{src_alias}: probe_denied_peer error: {e}")),
 104:                 None => {} // no adapter: skip denied probe
 105:             }
 106:         }
 107: 
 108:         if errors.is_empty() {
 109:             StageOutcome::Passed
 110:         } else {
 111:             StageOutcome::Failed(errors.join("; "))
 112:         }
 113:     }
 114: }
 115: 
 116: #[cfg(test)]
 117: mod tests {
 118:     use super::*;
 119:     use std::collections::HashMap;
 120: 
 121:     #[test]
 122:     fn empty_assignments_no_mesh_ips_fails() {
 123:         let mut ctx = OrchestrationContext {
 124:             assignments: vec![],
 125:             adapters: HashMap::new(),
 126:             source_archive: None,
 127:             report_dir: std::env::temp_dir(),
 128:             stage_outcomes: HashMap::new(),
 129:             collected_pubkeys: HashMap::new(),
 130:             network_id: "net".to_string(),
 131:             node_ids: HashMap::new(),
 132:             ssh_allow_cidrs: String::new(),
 133:             membership_snapshot: None,
 134:             mesh_ips: HashMap::new(),
 135:             endpoints: HashMap::new(),
 136:         };
 137:         // No assignments, no adapters, no mesh IPs → fail
 138:         assert!(matches!(

 140:             StageOutcome::Failed(_)
 141:         ));
 142:     }

===== /crates/rustynet-cli/src/vm_lab/orchestrator/stage/validate_runtime.rs =====

   1: #![allow(dead_code)]
   2: use crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::context::OrchestrationContext;
   3: use crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::error::StageOutcome;
   4: use crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::role::NodeRole;
   5: use crate::vm_lab::orchestrator::stage::{OrchestrationStage, StageFanout, StageId};
   6: 
   7: pub struct ValidateBaselineRuntimeStage;
   8: 
   9: impl OrchestrationStage for ValidateBaselineRuntimeStage {
  10:     fn id(&self) -> StageId {
  11:         StageId::ValidateBaselineRuntime
  12:     }
  13:     fn name(&self) -> &str {
  14:         "validate_baseline_runtime"
  15:     }
  16:     fn dependencies(&self) -> &[StageId] {
  17:         &[StageId::EnforceBaselineRuntime]
  18:     }
  19:     fn applies_to_roles(&self) -> &[NodeRole] {
  20:         &[]
  21:     }
  22:     fn fanout(&self) -> StageFanout {
  23:         StageFanout::PerNode
  24:     }
  25: 
  26:     fn execute(&self, ctx: &mut OrchestrationContext) -> StageOutcome {
  27:         use crate::vm_lab::DaemonProbeOp;
  28: 
  29:         const OPS: &[DaemonProbeOp] = &[
  30:             DaemonProbeOp::RuntimeAcls,
  31:             DaemonProbeOp::ServiceHardening,
  32:             DaemonProbeOp::KeyCustody,
  33:             DaemonProbeOp::Authenticode,
  34:             DaemonProbeOp::MeshStatus,
  35:             DaemonProbeOp::DnsFailclosed,
  36:         ];
  37: 
  38:         let aliases: Vec<String> = ctx.assignments.iter().map(|a| a.alias.clone()).collect();
  39: 
  40:         // Collect pass: gather all results before any mutation
  41:         let all_results: Vec<(String, Vec<Result<bool, String>>)> = aliases
  42:             .iter()
  43:             .map(|alias| {
  44:                 let op_results: Vec<Result<bool, String>> = OPS
  45:                     .iter()
  46:                     .map(|&op| match ctx.adapters.get(alias.as_str()) {
  47:                         Some(adapter) => adapter
  48:                             .run_validator(op)
  49:                             .map(|r| r.passed)
  50:                             .map_err(|e| e.to_string()),
  51:                         None => Err(format!("no adapter for '{alias}'")),
  52:                     })
  53:                     .collect();
  54:                 (alias.clone(), op_results)
  55:             })
  56:             .collect();
  57: 
  58:         let mut errors = Vec::new();
  59:         for (alias, op_results) in all_results {
  60:             for (op, r) in OPS.iter().zip(op_results) {
  61:                 match r {
  62:                     Ok(false) => errors.push(format!("{alias}/{op:?}: validation not passed")),
  63:                     Err(e) => errors.push(format!("{alias}/{op:?}: {e}")),
  64:                     Ok(true) => {}
  65:                 }
  66:             }
  67:         }
  68: 
  69:         if errors.is_empty() {
  70:             StageOutcome::Passed
  71:         } else {
  72:             StageOutcome::Failed(errors.join("; "))
  73:         }
  74:     }
  75: }
  76: 
  77: #[cfg(test)]
  78: mod tests {
  79:     use super::*;
  80:     use std::collections::HashMap;
  81: 
  82:     #[test]
  83:     fn empty_assignments_passes() {
  84:         let mut ctx = OrchestrationContext {
  85:             assignments: vec![],
  86:             adapters: HashMap::new(),
  87:             source_archive: None,
  88:             report_dir: std::env::temp_dir(),
  89:             stage_outcomes: HashMap::new(),
  90:             collected_pubkeys: HashMap::new(),
  91:             network_id: "net".to_string(),
  92:             node_ids: HashMap::new(),
  93:             ssh_allow_cidrs: String::new(),
  94:             membership_snapshot: None,
  95:             mesh_ips: HashMap::new(),
  96:             endpoints: HashMap::new(),
  97:         };
  98:         assert_eq!(
  99:             ValidateBaselineRuntimeStage.execute(&mut ctx),
 100:             StageOutcome::Passed
 101:         );
 102:     }
 103: }
